name: Sourcery Connect
description:
Sourcery Connect is the digital trade platform for fibres and textiles. Source, negotiate and close physical commodity trades with your partners, from the first enquiry to delivery and payment, in one app.

BUILD YOUR TRADING NETWORK
• Connect with partners by scanning their QR code or entering their Sourcery ID
• Register your companies and add the people who work with you, each with their role
• Add your trading places (farms, facilities, warehouses and offices), link each one to a company and mark its boundary on the map

TRADE WITH CONFIDENCE
• Send enquiries and offers for cotton fibre, yarn, fabric and more, to one partner or many
• Agree specifications, quantity, price, Incoterms, delivery date and payment terms
• Sign a Transparent Trade Agreement digitally, on behalf of your company
• Record transport documents, shipments and payment confirmations as the trade moves forward

STAY ON TOP OF EVERY TRADE
• See all your enquiries and offers, open, confirmed and completed, in one place
• Chat with your partners in the app
• Step-by-step Help Centre guides for adding partners, companies and places, and for trading

SECURE SIGN-IN
• Log in with a one-time code sent to your phone or email
• Use Face ID for quick, secure access

Sourcery is a member-owned solution for trading essential physical commodities, combining a digital trade platform with expert advisory. Built by and for supply chain professionals.

name: 81 İl: Türkiye Haritası Oyunu
description:
Türkiye'yi ne kadar iyi tanıyorsun? 81 ili oynayarak öğren!

GÜNÜN İLİ
Her gün herkes için aynı gizemli il. Silüetine bak, 6 tahminde bul. Her yanlış tahminde uzaklığı, yönü ve ne kadar yaklaştığını gör.

5 FARKLI OYUN
- Silüetten Bil: İlin şeklinden adını bul.
- Plaka Ustası: 34 hangi il? Kayseri'nin plakası kaç?
- Fotoğraftan Bil: Peri bacaları, Sümela, Nemrut… Bu manzara hangi ilde?
- Haritada Bul: İli Türkiye haritasında işaretle.
- Komşular: Bir ilin bütün komşularını bul.

FOTOĞRAFLI İL REHBERİ
Doğru bildiğin her il, rehberde fotoğrafıyla açılır: simgesi, meşhur lezzeti, komşuları ve kısa tanıtımı. 81 ilin hepsini topla!

ÖĞRENCİLER VE AİLELER İÇİN
Coğrafya dersine, KPSS ve YKS hazırlığına, yolculuklarda ailece oynamaya çok uygun.

JOKERLER VE REKORLAR
Takılınca joker kullan. Her oyunda rekorunu kır, serini büyüt.

Hesap yok, kayıt yok. Oyun ücretsizdir ve reklamlarla desteklenir.
Fotoğraflar Wikimedia Commons'tan alınır; her fotoğrafın fotoğrafçısı ve lisansı uygulamada belirtilir.

name: A C E N
description: Transforme les images en liens web AR.

name: AFTXSA
description: AFTXSABy reconciling net receipts and payments between checkpoints against your ledger entries, you can uncover discrepancies that might otherwise remain hidden—even when the month-end balances appear to match. You can expand any specific time interval to view the corresponding USD transactions, add missing entries, adjust amounts or transaction dates, and preview how these changes will affect subsequent balances before saving. For inter-account transfers, you can separately record the outflow, inflow, and any associated fees, making it easier to verify the exact amount and timing of the receipt. Once you have reconciled individual bank transactions, you can save the reconciliation status along with supporting notes. Should you need to modify past records later, you can navigate back to the affected time intervals directly from your reconciliation history.

name: Agon – Spiritual Warfare
description:
Agon is a Catholic guide to spiritual warfare under the patronage of Saint Michael the Archangel. It brings together prayers and short readings on the grace we receive in baptism. The prayer texts come from public-domain sources, with references in the app.

Begin with Pope Leo XIII’s Prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel. The sequence continues with the Litany of Saint Michael, the Leonine Prayers, the Chaplet of Saint Michael the Archangel, the Exorcism Rosary, the Exorcism of Leo XIII in the form for the faithful, and the prayers of Saint Basil the Great. There is also a novena to Saint Michael for September 21–29.

Hold your phone in one hand as you pray. Each prayer opens in full screen and scrolls on its own, one passage at a time. Choose from nine speeds; the Pause button stops the scrolling. You can read all seven prayers in one continuous sequence. The screen stays awake while you read, in light or dark mode.

The Understand section explores what Scripture says about the authority Christ gives the baptized and offers guidance on how to pray. Short readings cover confession, the Eucharist, sacramentals, and turning away from occult practices. Notes point you to Scripture, the Church Fathers, and Church teaching.

All content is available offline as soon as you install the app. Choose from Latin, French, Italian, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and Polish. Set a daily prayer reminder for a time that suits you, or share a prayer. Agon is free, with no account, purchases, ads, or data collection.

name: AirSeasonDiary
description: Air Season Diary "is a light notebook about" turning on air conditioning for the first time this year ". It doesn't pursue quantifying life, it just wants to capture that specific moment for you: one afternoon when you press the remote control for the first time, the cool breeze or warm breeze finally arrives. Each record only includes a few simple things - whether it's cooling or heating, which air conditioner it belongs to, the date of the day, the outdoor temperature you remember, and a casual note. Record by year and device grouping, one machine per clue, even if there are several air conditioners at home, they will not be confused. Looking back after two or three seasons, the dates will gradually connect into a line: which year's heat comes particularly early, how many days have passed between the first cooling and heating, and how different the rhythms of different rooms are. The statistics page uses several refreshing charts to spread out these changes, while the annual comparison arranges each year and shows the differences at a glance.

name: Aladyno Service
description:
Aladyno Service est l'application dédiée aux techniciens partenaires d'Aladyno. Elle vous permet de gérer vos missions de manière simple et efficace, où que vous soyez.

Dès qu'une nouvelle réservation vous est attribuée, vous recevez une notification et accédez à tous ses détails : le service demandé, la date, l'adresse du client et le montant. Vous mettez à jour le statut de chaque intervention en quelques gestes et ouvrez l'itinéraire jusqu'au client directement depuis l'application.

La messagerie intégrée vous permet d'échanger avec vos clients et votre prestataire, tandis que votre tableau de bord et votre historique vous offrent une vue claire de votre activité.

L'accès est réservé aux techniciens dont le compte a été créé par un prestataire Aladyno.

name: Alta Play
description:
Alta Play is a media player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro. It plays the playlists you already have: it does not sell, host or include any channels, movies, series or other content.

To use it, you need your own playlist (M3U or Xtream Codes) from a provider that holds the rights to the content. Without a playlist, the app shows no content.

HOW TO SIGN IN
• Access code
• Server, username and password (Xtream Codes)
• M3U playlist address or file
Your playlist details are stored securely on this device (Keychain). You can save several playlists and switch between them.

FEATURES
• Live channels by category, with what is on now and next when the playlist provides a guide (EPG)
• Full program guide and, when the playlist server offers it, programs that already aired
• Movies and series by category, with seasons, episodes, resume playback and next episode
• Search channels, movies and series
• Favorites, recent channels and Continue watching
• My queues: line up titles to watch one after another
• Choose the audio track and subtitles when the file includes them
• AirPlay and Picture in Picture on iPhone, iPad and Mac; Lock Screen controls on iPhone and iPad
• On iPad and Mac: sidebar, multiple windows and keyboard shortcuts
• On Apple TV: everything with the remote, with an on-screen number pad to jump straight to a channel
• On Apple Vision Pro: a cinema window and 180° and 360° videos

FAMILY
• Up to 5 profiles, each with its own favorites and history
• Kids profile, with a daily time limit and bedtime
• Parental controls: adult content locked by PIN or hidden

HELP
• Diagnostics (internet, playlist and last error) and in-app problem reports

App languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Important: Alta Play does not provide content and is not affiliated with any playlist provider. Only use playlists and content you have the right to access.

name: AP-ApprovalHub
description:
AP-ApprovalHub brings your ApprovalHub approvals to your iPhone and iPad. It is made for managers, administrators and executives who decide on requests every day, and it follows the same approval chain, signatures and records as the ApprovalHub portal.

• See what waits for you: requests to approve, to review and to stamp, and what your managers are waiting on.
• Read the full document before you decide, with every version and attachment.
• Approve, reject, delegate or ask for a review, with your comment kept on the record. Approve plain requests with a swipe.
• Sign and approve: place your signature exactly where it will be printed on the document.
• Place your organization's stamp, and send Chamber of Commerce copies.
• Get notified the moment a request needs you, and open it straight from the notification.
• Follow the requests you raised and send a reminder when one waits too long.
• Administrators see their organization's approval figures at a glance.
• Arabic and English, light and dark, on iPhone and iPad.

Secure by design: sign in with your work email or your Microsoft work account, unlock the app with Face ID, confirm sensitive actions with a code sent to your email, and sign out a lost phone from the portal. Lists and documents are kept encrypted on the phone.

AP-ApprovalHub is for people who already have an ApprovalHub account with Manager, Admin or Super Admin access. Accounts are created by your administrator, and requests are raised in the ApprovalHub portal.

name: Aprómancsok Diéta Kalkulátor
description:
Az Aprómancsok Diéta Kalkulátor segít összeállítani macskád házi kosztját. Nem kell többé papíron számolgatni: megadod, mennyi hús áll rendelkezésre, beállítod az arányokat, és az app kiszámolja, miből mennyi kell, és mennyibe kerül.

HOGYAN MŰKÖDIK?
• Megadod a hús mennyiségét (vagy a teljes elkészítendő adagot).
• Beállítod, melyik kategóriából hány százalékot adsz: hús és fehérje, zöldség és gyümölcs, glutén tartalmú gabona, gluténmentes termék. Például 50% hús, 25% zöldség, 25% köret.
• Kipipálod, mit tudsz adni a cicádnak.
• Az app kategóriánként és alapanyagonként kiszámolja a pontos mennyiséget és a becsült költséget.

FŐ FUNKCIÓK
• Négy kategória, szabadon állítható arányok és gyors beállítások
• 60 alapanyag: húsok, belsőségek, tejtermékek, zöldségek, gyümölcsök, gabonák és gluténmentes köretek
• Saját arány minden alapanyaghoz – pl. répa 300 : sütőtök 75 : burgonya 50
• Tejtermékek hús-egyenértékkel: a túró 100%-ban, a joghurt 50%-ban, az író 25%-ban számít húsnak
• Saját árak (Ft/kg) – a költség automatikusan frissül
• Kipipálható bevásárlólista, amely egy koppintással másolható és elküldhető
• A szigorú baromfimentes diéta legfontosabb szabályai mindig kéznél
• Magyar és angol nyelv
• Reklám és regisztráció nélkül, internet nélkül is működik

KINEK SZÓL?
Azoknak a gazdiknak, akik állatorvosi javaslatra házi, baromfimentes vagy más speciális étrenden tartják a macskájukat, és szeretnék, ha minden adag pontosan és következetesen készülne.

FONTOS
A kalkulátor segédeszköz, és nem helyettesíti az állatorvosi tanácsot. Az étrendet és az arányokat mindig egyeztesd az állatorvosoddal. Ne feledkezz meg a kalcium pótlásáról, és macskáknál figyelj a taurinbevitelre!

Készítette az Aprómancsok – apromancsok.eu

Újdonságok ebben a verzióban (What's New):
Az első kiadás – jó étvágyat a cicáknak!

name: ArabTides: المد والجزر
description:
ArabTides يعرض لك مواعيد المد والجزر وأفضل أوقات الصيد لأكثر من 380 ميناءً وشاطئاً في العالم العربي وحول العالم، بلغة عربية واضحة وتوقيت كل ميناء المحلي.

ما الذي يقدمه التطبيق:
• حالة الماء الآن: هل يرتفع أم ينخفض، وكم ارتفاعه، ومتى المد العالي أو الجزر المنخفض القادم.
• منحنى المد والجزر لليوم: اسحب إصبعك عليه لترى الارتفاع في أي ساعة، مع الليل وفترات الصيد ظاهرة عليه.
• تقييم الصيد من 1 إلى 5 لكل يوم، مع الفترات الكبرى والصغرى وأفضل الأيام في الشهر.
• الشروق والغروب، وشروق القمر وغروبه، وطور القمر والتاريخ الهجري.
• أوقات الصلاة لكل ميناء (طريقة أم القرى للموانئ العربية).
• معامل المد وحالته (مد ربيعي أو محاقي).
• تقويم الشهر بتقييم كل يوم، حتى نهاية الشهر القادم.
• شاشة «اليوم» لموانئك المفضلة في لمحة، وقائمة بالموانئ التي فتحتها مؤخراً.
• شرح مبسّط لكل مصطلح بزر «؟».
• الوضع الليلي، ودعم الخط الكبير وقارئ الشاشة.

يعمل دون إنترنت: البيانات محفوظة في التطبيق، ويحدّثها من موقعنا arabtides.com حين يتوفر الاتصال.

خصوصيتك محفوظة: لا حساب، ولا إعلانات، ولا تتبّع. لا يطلب التطبيق موقعك ولا يجمع أي بيانات عنك، وتبقى موانئك المفضلة على هاتفك فقط.

تنبيه: الأوقات والارتفاعات حسابات فلكية تقديرية من نموذج EOT20 العالمي، وهي للصيد والنزهة والتخطيط فقط، ولا تُستخدم للملاحة. اعتمد الجداول الرسمية للملاحة البحرية.

من ناشر موقع ArabTides، شركة MARIBLU LLC.
الدعم: hello@arabtides.com

name: Atlas de Ecos
description: Recorre 250 ciudades de 25 países en una aventura arcade en miniatura. Camina, apunta y lanza pulsos para despejar cada escenario. Completa las ciudades de un país para ganar su sello en el pasaporte y desbloquear el siguiente destino. Cada día te espera un reto diferente. En el modo infinito, intenta superar tu mejor puntuación y descubre tu puesto en la clasificación mundial.

name: AttemptJournal
description:
Every new attempt is worth looking back at for a second time.

AttemptJournal is a tool for attempting to record and review. It doesn't pursue the number of clock ins, but helps you write down "what I expected", "what actually happened", and "what I want to keep" in a few minutes after one attempt, and then see your own pattern in the statistics.

Main Functions
-Record attempts: title, category, date, results (successful/partially achieved/encountered/paused), rating and energy consumption, accompanied by expectations, reality, and gains.
-Photo imprint: You can add a photo for each attempt or remove it at any time.
-Category management: Customize the names, icons, and colors of categories; When deleting a category, the original entries will be automatically migrated to other categories, and the content will not be lost.
-Review queue: Attempts marked as "pending review" will appear in the queue for easy review after a period of time. It also supports one click marking of all attempts as reviewed.
-Statistical insights: total frequency, average rating, active days, current and longest consecutive, new additions this month and this week; Support viewing trend bar charts by week, month, and year, as well as classification proportion ring charts and rating distributions.
-Monthly view: View what is recorded every day by month, click on the date to see the entries for that day.
Suitable for people who want to turn "what they have tried" into "what they have learned": changing to a new work method, practicing an unfamiliar skill, and trying a new pace of life can all leave a complete review here.

name: AviaReport
description:
Aviareport — современное приложение для удобной работы с авиационной информацией и отчетами.

Приложение предназначено для упрощения рабочих процессов, быстрого доступа к необходимым данным и удобного управления авиационной информацией.

С Aviareport вы можете:
• Удобно работать с авиационными отчетами.
• Быстро получать доступ к необходимой информации.
• Организовывать и контролировать рабочие данные.
• Использовать современные инструменты для повышения эффективности работы.

Aviareport — всё необходимое для удобной и эффективной работы в одном приложении.

name: AVXTOGM
description: Record the date, route, fare, and payment proof for every trip; you can also retroactively log trips in bulk by specifying a date range. Once you have configured transfer discounts, multi-use discounts, and daily or periodic spending caps, you can view the itemized charges for each trip, including the specific transaction that triggered a cap. When reconciling bank statements, you can allocate a single debit across multiple travel days, or match multiple debits to a single day. Subsequent adjustments—such as late charges or refunds—can be linked to the original transaction, recorded based on the actual posting date, and traced back to the original billing cycle. You can review the accrued charges, actual debits, and outstanding reconciliation discrepancies on a weekly or monthly basis, and compare the total amounts before and after retroactive entries or rule modifications.

name: Backline - Piano Remote & Band
description:
Backline is a Bluetooth remote and practice band for the Casio Privia PX-S1100 digital piano with its WU-BT10 adaptor. Open it and it connects to the piano by itself.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE PIANO'S HIDDEN SETTINGS
- Metronome controls include start and stop, tempo from 20 to 255 with tap tempo, beat and volume.
- All 17 tones, Layer with its own tone and volume, and Split with the split point and bass volume.
- Effects include hall simulator type and depth, surround, chorus and brilliance.
- An 88-key keyboard lights up as you play.

A PRACTICE BAND THAT FOLLOWS YOUR CHART
- Recorded upright bass and jazz drums, with optional comping on grand piano, electric piano, jazz guitar or vibes.
- Explore 26 styles, including swing, ballads, waltz, blues, gospel and soul, bossa, samba, salsa and other Afro-Cuban and Latin grooves, straight and fusion, stride, boogie and ragtime.
- Type your own chord changes or start from a preset, including the ii-V-I in all 12 keys.
- The chart shows the current chord, the next one and where you are in the form.
- One START button and one tempo drive either the piano's metronome or the band.

HEAR THE BAND THROUGH THE PIANO
Pair your iPhone or iPad once with the adaptor's Bluetooth audio and the band plays through the piano's own speakers. An illustrated guide in the app shows how.

MADE TO LOOK THE PART
A vintage synth panel in your piano's finish. Choose Black, White, Red, Blue or Beige. Portrait and landscape, iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics. Bluetooth is used only to talk to your piano.

The band works without a piano, so you can try it first. The remote needs a Casio Privia PX-S1100 with the WU-BT10 Bluetooth adaptor that comes with it.

Casio, Privia and PX-S1100 are trademarks of Casio Computer Co., Ltd. Backline is not made by or affiliated with Casio.

name: BayStateArchive
description:
Bay State Archive is a reading room for the scattered photographic memory of Massachusetts. The state's libraries, historical societies and museums have each digitised their own corner of it — a wharf in Gloucester, a mill gate in Lowell, a cobbled street on Nantucket — and filed those pictures under their own spellings, their own dates and their own rules about reproduction.

This app gathers that material into one place and lets you start the way a local historian actually starts: with a town. Open a dossier and you can see which institutions hold photographs, maps and letters for that place, how far back the material runs, and where the record is thin. From there you can pull a plate, read the description exactly as the institution wrote it, and keep it on a research board that remembers where it came from.

For the question of change, the workbench sets two frames of the same ground side by side and lets you drag the seam between them. A river that was filled, a rail line that was moved, a neighbourhood that was replaced — the comparison makes those shifts visible in a way a single photograph cannot.

Citations are written from the metadata on the record, and the reading-room log keeps what each institution told you about reproduction beside the date you were told it. Teachers can assemble a source packet that carries the credit and the rights statement for every plate, so a class can see the provenance of what it is looking at.

Nothing is normalised. Where an institution wrote "So. Boston", the app shows "So. Boston".

name: BeamBook
description:
BeamBook is the apprentice logbook that proves the hours. Built with union apprenticeship programs in the building trades, it replaces the paper work report with a phone app apprentices can use in two minutes at the end of a shift.

FOR APPRENTICES
• Check in at the job site with one tap, step off for lunch, and check back in. Your on-site time fills in your log.
• Tell me about your day: say it out loud, in English or Spanish, and BeamBook fills in the contractor, hours, craft area and what you worked on.
• Add job photos to each day.
• Snap your pay stub. BeamBook checks it against the hours you logged.
• See your month, your classroom vs on-the-job hours, and how close you are to your next raise.
• No signal on site? Your log and photos are saved on the phone and sent when the signal comes back.
• Reminders on the days you work, never on your days off.

FOR TRAINING STAFF
• A review queue that pre-checks every monthly report and approves the clean ones in one tap.
• Every apprentice's logs, photos and pay stub checks in one place.
• Program reports, hours by craft and contractor, and who needs a check-in.
• Ask BeamBook AI questions in plain words; any change waits for your confirm.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Check-in times and places belong to the apprentice. Union staff see the hours in the daily log, never your location. Location points are deleted after 60 days.

BeamBook accounts are by invitation from your apprenticeship program.

name: better/vok
description:
better/vok hilft dir, deinen eigenen Schulstoff zu lernen, nicht nur Vokabeln aus einem fertigen Katalog.

So geht es:
• Foto von deiner Vokabelliste machen oder Vokabeln eintippen. Die Texterkennung läuft auf dem Gerät, du kannst alles vor dem Speichern korrigieren.
• Aus deinen Vokabeln entstehen Lektionen mit Auswahlaufgaben, Tippen, Paaren und Sätzen zum Zusammenbauen.
• Sammle XP, halte deine Serie und löse Aufgaben des Tages. Falsche Antworten kommen später noch einmal.
• Piks, der Igel, begleitet dich durch die App.

Lernen ohne KI:
Alle Lektionen funktionieren auch ohne KI. Ein Beispielkurs mit Englisch-Vokabeln ist gleich dabei.

KI als Zusatz (freiwillig):
• Kurs zu einem Thema erzeugen lassen
• Mit dem Tutor über deinen Lernstoff sprechen
• Wähle selbst: Apple Intelligence (wenn dein Gerät es unterstützt), ein kleines Sprachmodell, das nach deiner Bestätigung auf dein Gerät geladen wird, oder dein eigener API-Schlüssel eines Anbieters deiner Wahl.

Keine Werbung, kein Konto, keine Tracker. Dein Name und dein Lernstand bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

name: Billetico: Dólar TRM Colombia
description:
Billetico te muestra la TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado), el dólar oficial en Colombia certificado por la Superintendencia Financiera, de forma clara y rápida.

Ideal si importas, viajas, compras en tiendas del exterior o cobras en dólares.

LA TRM DE HOY Y LA DE MAÑANA
• Valor vigente en grande, con su variación en pesos y en porcentaje.
• Apenas se publica, ves la TRM de mañana y si sube o baja.
• Fechas de vigencia claras, también en fines de semana y festivos.
• Gráfico interactivo: desliza el dedo para ver la TRM de cada día.

WIDGETS PARA TU PANTALLA DE INICIO
• Pequeño: TRM y variación.
• Mediano: TRM, variación, gráfico de 7 días y la TRM de mañana.
• Se actualizan solos y funcionan aunque no tengas conexión.

ALERTAS DE PRECIO
• Crea varias alertas: "avísame si sube de $ 4.000" o "si baja de $ 3.800".
• Notificación diaria con la TRM del día siguiente.

CONVERSOR
• Dólares a pesos y pesos a dólares con la TRM vigente y la de mañana.
• Teclado propio con formato colombiano: $ 3.850,25.

HISTORIAL
• Gráficos de 7 días, 1 mes, 6 meses, 1 año y 5 años.
• Máximo, mínimo y promedio de cada período.
• Consulta la TRM de cualquier fecha desde 1991.

BILLETICO PREMIUM
• Sin anuncios y 5 temas de color (Caribe, Esmeralda, Orquídea, Café y Grafito), con un pago único.

PENSADA PARA TI
• Sin registro y sin cuentas: tus alertas y ajustes se quedan en tu teléfono.
• Modo claro y oscuro.

FUENTE E INFORMACIÓN IMPORTANTE
Los datos provienen de la Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia y se consultan en el portal de datos abiertos del Gobierno de Colombia (datos.gov.co).

Billetico muestra información referencial. No es una entidad financiera, no compra ni vende divisas y no está afiliada ni representa a la Superintendencia Financiera ni a ninguna entidad del gobierno. Bancos y casas de cambio usan sus propias tasas de compra y venta.

Desarrollada por Plutonia SpA.

name: BotanicalPlate
description:
Botanical Plate is a quiet reading room for the historical plant illustrations held by plantillustrations.org. It is made for the people who ask a very specific question: where was this species first drawn, and who drew it.

Type a scientific name and the archive answers with the genera and species it keeps. Open one and the plates appear in the order they were printed, each with the book it came from, the plate number, the year and, where the archive knows it, the hand that made it. Put two of them side by side and the differences between centuries become visible: an inflorescence drawn larger than life, a leaf simplified for the engraver, a colour that no longer exists in the wild.

Every plate keeps its own provenance. The library that digitised the scan is named on the plate and on the citation card you can compose from it, so a reference can be written and credited properly. Plates worth returning to can be filed on a personal shelf, with a note about what to look at next time.

Botanical Plate reads the same pages as the website and adds nothing to them. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising; the shelf lives on your own device.

name: Brewbook - وصفات البار
description:
Brewbook يجمع وصفات بار محلك في مكان واحد: المدير يعدّل، والموظفين يشوفون على طول.

• محاصيل الأسبوع: بارد وحار وإسبريسو، بالجرامات والحرارة والطحنة والصبّات.
• المدير يضيف ويعدّل ويأرشف المحاصيل، والتحديث يوصل للفريق لحظياً.
• رسائل وإشعارات للموظفين لما تتغيّر وصفة أو ينزل محصول جديد.
• التطبيق يتلوّن بشعار محلك وألوانه.
• عربي وإنجليزي.

جرّب المحل التجريبي: كود المحل DEMO، المدير 1111، الموظف 2222.
تبي Brewbook لمحلك؟ اطلب انضمام من داخل التطبيق أو كلّمنا على الواتساب.

name: BrewNote
description:
BrewNote is a brewing journal that keeps recipes, batch notes, and fermentation readings together. Track each batch through its stages, log temperature, specific gravity, and pH, and review your readings on interactive charts.

Calculate ABV from original and final gravity, compare saved results, and keep track of ingredient stock. Set local reminders, share PDF or CSV reports, and back up your notebook with its attachments.

name: ByntharoZemvik
description: Tank screen calculator: tank, valve, flow, strainer and costs.

name: Carnet Pi
description:
Carnet Pi range tes alias PI-SPI au même endroit et te permet de les partager en un geste.

PI-SPI est le système de paiement instantané de l'UEMOA : pour recevoir de l'argent, tu donnes un alias (un identifiant, un numéro de téléphone…) au lieu d'un numéro de compte. Carnet Pi est le carnet où tu les gardes tous, pour tes banques, tes comptes de monnaie électronique et tes institutions de microfinance, dans les huit pays de l'UEMOA : Bénin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinée-Bissau, Mali, Niger, Sénégal et Togo.

CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE
• Enregistrer tes alias par établissement, avec un libellé (Compte courant, Épargne, Perso, Pro…).
• Retrouver un alias en quelques lettres : établissement, pays, libellé ou alias.
• Copier un alias d'un toucher.
• Partager un ou plusieurs alias en un seul message, prêt pour WhatsApp ou SMS.
• Afficher le QR code PI d'un alias, avec ou sans montant, à faire scanner depuis une application PI-SPI.
• Garder tes alias favoris à portée de main.
• Protéger l'accès avec Face ID, Touch ID ou le code de l'iPhone (facultatif).
• Exporter une sauvegarde et la réimporter quand tu veux.

TES DONNÉES RESTENT SUR TON IPHONE
Carnet Pi fonctionne sans compte, sans serveur et sans connexion. Aucune donnée n'est collectée. Aucune publicité, aucun traceur. Tes alias ne quittent ton appareil que lorsque tu choisis de les partager ou d'exporter une sauvegarde.

CE QUE CARNET PI NE FAIT PAS
Carnet Pi n'effectue aucun paiement, ne détient pas d'argent et ne se connecte à aucun établissement. L'app ne crée pas d'alias : tu les obtiens auprès de ta banque ou de ton établissement.

APPLICATION INDÉPENDANTE
Carnet Pi est une application indépendante. Elle n'est ni affiliée à la BCEAO, ni approuvée par elle, et n'a aucun lien avec les établissements affichés. Les noms des établissements appartiennent à leurs propriétaires respectifs ; ils servent uniquement à reconnaître l'établissement de chaque alias.

name: CendolRovliStack
description: Aan wie de gedeelde apparatuur is uitgeleend en hoeveel er beschikbaar is, kunt u controleren in CendolRovliStack. Maak bij het goedkeuren van het gebruik een afspraak voor een inleverdatum en noteer de staat van het materieel bij oplevering. Dezelfde lening kan in batches worden geretourneerd en het beschikbare leenbedrag wordt elke keer bijgewerkt als een batch wordt geretourneerd. Vul tijdens de inventarisatie de werkelijke hoeveelheid en de reden voor de aanpassing in om toekomstige voorraadverificatie te vergemakkelijken.

name: Central Conecta
description: Aplicativo para acessos de condóminos e síndicos as informações do condomínio, como extratos com comprovantes digitalizados, demonstrativos financeiros, boletos, reservas de áreas, acessos da portaria, inadimplência, atas, convenções, documentos, avisos e notificações diversas. Este aplicativo é de uso das administradoras de condomínios clientes da Sami Sistemas.

name: Clube Balbina
description: Aplicativo que fornece vantagens exclusivas para os participantes do Clube Balbina, de acordo com o perfil de compra. Os clientes que se cadastrarem no Clube poderão usufruir das vantagens disponibilizadas identificando-se com o CPF nas compras em troca dos benefícios concedidos. Faça o download e aproveite!

name: Clube Laticínios Central
description: Aplicativo que fornece vantagens exclusivas para os participantes do Clube Laticínios Central, de acordo com o perfil de compra. Os clientes que se cadastrarem no Clube poderão usufruir das vantagens disponibilizadas identificando-se com o CPF nas compras em troca dos benefícios concedidos. Faça o download e aproveite!

name: Coco Galaxy
description:
Coco Galaxy es la app de los negocios de tu ciudad.

• Junta puntos en cada compra y úsalos en tu siguiente visita.
• Gana Polvo Estelar y cámbialo en la Tienda Galaxy.
• Usa cupones y ofertas exclusivas de tus negocios favoritos.
• Cuida a tu mascota virtual: crece y decora su cuarto con tus compras.
• Encuentra locales cercanos y mira sus promociones del día.
• Muestra tu QR al pagar para sumar tus puntos al instante.
• Revisa tu saldo y tu historial cuando quieras.

Gratis y sin compras dentro de la app: todo se gana comprando en los negocios.

name: Complete Robot Approval Inbox
description:
Approval Inbox is for Complete Robot employees. Sign in with your company account to see requests that need your attention, review decisions and follow their outcomes. Confirm an authorized decision in your browser with your registered passkey.

Read your private daily summaries and open notifications directly to the relevant item. Designated reviewers can inspect operational alarms and their recovery status.

Authorized employees can enter details from a business card they received outside the app. They scan the card on their iPhone, review the details and choose what to save in Attio. The photo and raw scan stay on the iPhone. Complete’s sales team may later email or call the prospective customer outside the app.

name: CONPT
description:
CONPT is a quiet household desk for the homes, jars, cards, and receipts you already keep. Open it and the held total is on the first screen, with the sample ticker and the upkeep card beside it. Nothing here is a coin, a wallet address, or a market you can trade.

The book is three addresses — 12 Elm Road, Flat 4 on Queen Street, and 27 Harbour View — each with a rent, a planning window, and a lamp. Steady means the date is comfortable. Watch means it is inside seventy days. Lapse means the date has passed. Booking a visit from the holding pushes the certificate forward and writes the fee into the jar you choose, as long as that jar stays in the black.

Cash lives in four jars: Savings, Current, Operations, and Set-aside. A move keeps the household total the same. The set-aside jar will not be drawn below this month’s line, which is a fifth of the open month’s income. Expenses and income are chosen from chips — amount, jar, holding, band, date, note, and payee — so the desk never asks you to type a story. A row is Detected when the amount, the payee, and the note agree with a known receipt. It is Settled when it sits in its band. It is Held when it still needs a look.

Month close reads the open month as Clear, Watch, or Short. A lapsed lamp or a held row makes the month Short. A gap in the set-aside, or a lamp inside the watch window, makes it Watch. Two sealed months are already Clear, so the streak has a start. Clear the open month and the streak grows.

Market Watch is a local sample board: forex, bonds, indices, stocks, and funds, priced from the date on this device. The figures are not live, not an offer, and not a reason to send money anywhere. Search only filters that list.

Fee bands, regions, reminders, cover plans, the print cabinet, and the glossary are all on the device. Settings, haptics, privacy, and credits are pages, not accounts. There is no login, no cloud copy, and no feed. Airplane mode is the normal way to use Northwell. If the book ever needs to return to the sample household, the safe box does that with two taps, and only on this phone.

name: Corgi Runner: Dog Jump Games
description:
A corgi runs, and the world does not want to let him pass. Jump over stumps, crates and logs, duck under birds, and see how far you can go.

ONE BUTTON TO START
Press to jump. Hold the button to jump higher. Press down to duck, or to drop faster from a jump. After a hit, one press starts the next run.

THREE WORLDS
Run through green hills, a harbour town with a lighthouse, and snowy mountains. Each world has its own obstacles and its own flyers.

DAY AND NIGHT
Day turns into night while you run. Each world looks different in the dark.

FASTER AND FASTER
The run gets faster, and the groups of obstacles get bigger. Flyers come low, in the middle and high: jump over one, duck under the next.

LEADERBOARD OF YOUR LIVING ROOM
The ten best runs stay on your Apple TV. Type a name after a run and find out who is the best at home.

WORLD LEADERBOARD
Sign in to Game Center and compare your best run with players from other countries.

MADE FOR THE SIRI REMOTE
Press Select or Up to jump, Down to duck, Play/Pause to take a break. The sounds of the game mix with your music.

The game works offline. No ads and no separate account.

For Apple TV.

name: DayOff Mate - Leave Tracker
description:
Enter your start date and how your company grants leave, and DayOff Mate works out your remaining annual leave and expiry dates under the Korean Labor Standards Act. Use it right away without an account; sign in to see days off together with your partner, friends or team.

■ Your leave at a glance
• See the days you can use now, when new leave arrives and when unused leave expires
• Works with hire-date and fiscal-year systems, including first-year monthly leave, with the calculation shown step by step
• Plan when to use the rest of your leave with the planner

■ Easy logging
• Log full days, half days, quarter days, hourly leave, substitute days off and statutory leave such as health, family-event and spouse childbirth leave
• Log many days at once; weekends and public holidays are skipped automatically
• Type it in plain words like "next Friday afternoon half day", or read the text from a photo
• Comp time and substitute days off are kept in a separate wallet and used soonest-expiring first

■ Breaks and reminders
• See how many days off in a row you can get by adding leave around public holidays
• Get reminders the day before your leave, before leave expires, and before new leave arrives when a lot is still left

■ Days off together (sign-in)
• Create couple, friend or team groups and invite with a link
• Choose which groups see each record, and whether they see only that you are off or the leave type too. Notes are never shared
• Find days everyone is off and breaks you can take together, and collect available times for plans

■ Work schedule and plans
• Enter your shift schedule and paste a new one to apply only the days that changed
• If plans overlap your work, see whether a half day or a day off frees the time
• When a schedule change makes plans overlap, find free times to move them to

■ Keep your records safe
• Signed in, your records are saved to your account and carry over to a new phone
• Google Drive auto backup, plus export and import files
• Add your leave to your phone calendar and see other calendar events alongside
• Make a leave usage report or settlement summary as PDF

■ Good to know
• Results are estimates. Your company's rules or attendance may give different numbers
• Statutory annual leave does not apply to workplaces with fewer than 5 regular employees
• If you don't sign in, your records stay only on this phone

name: DblSix Field
description: இந்த பயன்பாட்டில் நீங்கள் அறியப்பட்ட ஒலி அளவு (dB) மற்றும் அளவெடுத்த தூரத்தை உள்ளிடலாம். பின்னர் வேறொரு தூரத்தில் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படும் ஒலி அளவை கணக்கிடுகிறது. புள்ளி ஒலி மூலம், வரி ஒலி மூலம் தேர்வு செய்யலாம். தூரம் இரட்டிப்பாகும் ஒவ்வொரு முறையிலும் குறைவு விகிதத்தை பார்க்கலாம். பல தூரங்களை ஒப்பிட்டு, வீழ்ச்சி வளைவை வரைந்து சேமிக்கலாம். வழக்கமான காட்சிகளுக்கு முன் அமைப்புகள் உள்ளன. முடிவுகள் இந்த சாதனத்தில் சேமிக்கப்படும். நிர்வாக வெளியிடல் மட்டுமே; தடைகள், நிலம், வானிலை அல்லது அறை பிரதிபலிப்புகளை இது கணக்கில் எடுக்காது. இது கேட்கும் திறன் பாதுகாப்பு அளவீடு அல்ல.

name: Demon King's Subcontract Forge
description:
The Demon King's army marched in, and you, the village blacksmith, signed the subcontract.
You have five days. Every day a quota of demon weapons is due.

STRIKE TO STRENGTHEN. STRIKE TOO FAR AND IT BREAKS.
Tap to hammer. Each strike makes the weapon stronger, cracks it, or shatters it.
Deliver before it breaks and you get paid. Get greedy and you are left with scrap.
Every chance is shown on screen. Nothing is hidden.

A FIVE-DAY CONTRACT
Three weapons a day: pick a sword, a greatsword or an axe. Miss the quota and you get a warning. Three warnings end the contract.
Survive all five days and see how your finest weapon fared on the front line.

RELICS AND AWAKENINGS
Choose from 24 relics to shape how you work.
A strong enough weapon gains one of 12 awakenings, takes on fire, water or lightning, and keeps changing form as you forge on (38 forms).

OVERTIME AND BEYOND
After day five, overtime begins and the quota keeps growing.
Forge a weapon of legend and another path opens instead of delivery.

COLLECT AND COMPETE
Fill your collection with weapons, awakenings and front-line reports.
Compete with other smiths on weekly deliveries and the single finest weapon.

10 to 15 minutes a run. Portrait, one hand.

name: DePlay Labs
description: DePlay Labs permite a cada empresa gestionar su operación desde una sola plataforma. La empresa elige los módulos que necesita para coordinar personal, sucursales, compras, ventas, inventario, transporte y mantenimiento. Cada integrante accede a las funciones que le corresponden según su perfil.

name: DerbiPlay: fútbol amateur
description:
DerbiPlay es la app del jugador de fútbol amateur. Entra con la misma cuenta de derbiplay.com y lleva en el bolsillo tu carnet, tu torneo y tu carrera.

TU CARNET A LA MANO
Muéstraselo al planillero antes del partido. El código cambia cada 30 segundos y funciona sin señal.

TU TORNEO, AL DÍA
Partidos, tabla y goleadores de tu torneo, también sin señal. Si hay un partido en juego, el marcador se actualiza solo.

TU CARRERA, GOL A GOL
Desliza tu historia: cada partido con su marcador, tus goles, tarjetas y MVP. Cuando llegas a un título, se celebra.

TU DERBICARD
Tu carta de jugador abre la app y se mueve contigo. Elige su estilo, guárdala en tus fotos y comparte tu CV con un link.

JUEGA Y SUBE DE NIVEL
Tu nivel sube con lo que haces en los torneos: cada partido, cada gol y cada MVP suman experiencia.

QUE NO TE FALTE NADA
La app te dice qué le falta a tu cuenta y para qué sirve. Si no ves tu historial, buscas tu ficha y la conectas.

En la cancha no siempre hay señal: lo que ya viste se abre con lo último guardado.

name: Diwan Medicines
seller_name: Shafra Al-Takween Company for Technology and Information Systems LLC
description:
Diwan Medicines connects people, pharmacies and medicine suppliers in Libya.

Looking for a medicine
Type its name and send one request to the pharmacies in your city. Pharmacies that have it reply with the price and address, so you can call and visit. You buy and pay at the pharmacy, not in the app.

For pharmacies
Receive medicine requests from your city and reply with a price. Browse approved suppliers' products, send them stock orders and follow each order's stage. Post job and offer ads.

For suppliers (agents and wholesalers)
Add products one by one or from an Excel file, receive orders from pharmacies and move each one to its next stage.

For pharmacists and pharmacy students
Reply to medicine requests and apply for jobs and training.

Every pharmacist, pharmacy and supplier uploads a licence when signing up, and the account stays limited until the platform administration checks it. Payment and delivery between pharmacies and suppliers happen directly between them, outside the app.

The platform is operated by Shafra Al-Takween Company for Technology and Information Systems, Tripoli.

name: Döngüm Ecem
description:
Döngüm, regl döngünü sade ve güzel bir arayüzle takip etmeni sağlayan, partnerinle bağlantıda kalmayı kolaylaştıran bir uygulamadır.

DÖNGÜ TAKİBİ
• Döngünün kaçıncı günündesin, regle ve yumurtlamaya kaç gün var, bir bakışta gör
• Regl, tahmini regl ve verimli dönem günlerini takvimde izle
• Kanama, ruh hali, ağrı, belirtiler ve notlarını günlük olarak kaydet
• Regl başlangıç tarihini kendin gir ya da "Regl başladı" ile işaretle
• Kayıtların arttıkça tahminler kişisel döngüne göre güncellenir

SEVDİĞİNE TEK DOKUNUŞ
• Kalp gönder: "Seni düşünüyorum"
• Hazır hızlı mesajlar: "Sarılmaya ihtiyacım var", "Çikolata krizi" ve daha fazlası
• Tek dokunuşla ara ya da WhatsApp'ta yaz
• Acil butonu: partnerine anında çağrı gönder

PARTNER İÇİN
• Eşi/sevgilisinin döngü durumunu gör
• Her döneme özel ipuçları: ona nasıl destek olabileceğini öğren
• Önemli günler için hatırlatıcılar
• Gelen mesajlara kalp, "Yoldayım" gibi hızlı yanıtlar ver

GİZLİLİK
• Günlük kayıtların sadece telefonunda kalır
• Face ID ile kilitle
• Reklam yok, takip yok, hesap gerekmez
• Eşleşme kodunla sadece döngü özeti ve mesajlar paylaşılır
• İstediğin an Ayarlar'dan tüm verileri sil

Not: Döngüm bir tıbbi cihaz değildir ve tıbbi tavsiye vermez. Tahminler kayıtlarına dayanan hesaplamalardır, korunma yöntemi olarak kullanılmamalıdır. Sağlığınla ilgili konularda doktoruna danış.

name: Dropfield
description:
Dropfield is a 3D survival match. You and up to 29 AI players drop into one arena, and the last one standing wins.

Each match lasts about 8 minutes. The safe zone keeps shrinking, so stay inside it, find gear, and outlast everyone.

HIGHLIGHTS
- Set in a virtual national tournament
- Offline play against up to 29 AI players
- No internet connection or account needed
- Tag opponents with paint rounds. If you're out, keep watching from the stands.
- Languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
- Battery saver mode and graphics quality options

IN THE MATCH
- Two-story houses with stairs
- Vehicles to cross the arena quickly
- Healing, scopes, and throwables
- Quick emotes: Nice, Here, Careful, Thanks
- A practice match and a quick controls guide
- Customizable touch controls

PRICING
Free to play. Dropfield Pro is a one-time purchase that adds:
- Custom matches: choose difficulty and map
- Outfit colors (only the color changes)
- Match history saved on your device
The base game is fully playable without Pro. No ads, no loot boxes, and no personal data collected.

name: Duatu
description:
Duatu is a digital vault for afterwards. You place in it what your loved ones should receive the day you are no longer here: a letter for each of them, your photos and videos, your codes and instructions, your important papers.

WHAT YOU DEPOSIT
• Letters, each one for a specific person and read by them alone
• Photos, videos and your voice
• Your access: codes, recovery keys, how to unlock your devices
• Your documents: PDF, Word, papers for the notary
• A series of messages to be received one a day, so you keep talking to them

DUATU WATCHES OVER
As long as you use the app, nothing happens. If the silence lasts, Duatu gently reminds you, then alerts your guardians: trusted people you have chosen. When two guardians confirm, and after a safety delay, everyone receives what was meant for them.

ENCRYPTED WITH YOUR KEY
Everything is encrypted on your device before it is sent. Neither Duatu nor the host can read your content. Your key is split into shares given to your guardians: it can only be rebuilt by several of them, when the time comes.

OPENINGS THAT MOVE THEM
Each letter opens in a mood you choose: hearts, petals, stars, ocean, sky, legacy… with its own music and animation.

No advertising trackers. Hosted in France.
What matters carries on.

30-DAY LETTERS SUBSCRIPTION (optional)
Most of Duatu is free. The optional monthly "30-day letters" subscription adds 30 letters composed with you and a letter every day. It is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your Apple account settings.

Terms of use: https://duatu.com/cgv
Privacy: https://duatu.com/confidentialite

name: EDANI: тревога и паника
description:
EDANI помогает пройти через паническую атаку и шаг за шагом вернуть себе жизнь, которой управлял страх.

Приложение собрано на методах когнитивно-поведенческой психотерапии и книгах Павла Федоренко, эксперта по тревожным расстройствам с пятнадцатилетней практикой.

SOS за одно касание
Когда накрывает, ничего не нужно искать. Кнопка SOS ведёт по шагам: дыхание с подсказкой вибрацией, заземление, короткое объяснение того, что происходит в теле. Практики работают без интернета.

Дневник мыслей СМЭР
Ситуация, мысль, эмоция, реакция. Записываете, что случилось, находите ловушку мышления и формулируете новую, честную мысль. С шестой записи открывается профиль тревоги: где она чаще запускается и что её держит.

Курсы
Паника, постоянное беспокойство, страх за здоровье, навязчивые мысли, страх чужого мнения, страх полётов. Уроки короткими карточками, с озвучкой и заданиями. Модули «Понимание себя», «Основы КПТ», «Сон», «Самокритика» и «Нереальность» открыты полностью, в остальных доступны первые уроки.

Практики
Дыхание, заземление, расслабление, работа с внутренним критиком. Можно слушать или читать.

Даня, помощник на основе ИИ
Даня опирается на материалы автора: помогает разобрать мысль, подготовиться к трудному событию, побыть рядом в тревожный вечер. Бесплатно несколько сообщений в день, режим «Паника сейчас» без ограничений.

Страх полётов
Отдельный режим для самолёта: что происходит на каждом этапе полёта и что делать, когда трясёт. Работает без связи.

Тесты
Тест на тип тревоги показывает, что у вас на первом плане и с чего начать. Тест на уровень тревоги GAD-7 можно проходить повторно и видеть, как меняется результат.

А ещё
Аналитика настроения и приступов. Отчёт в PDF для вашего психолога. Вход по коду или Face ID. Светлая и тёмная тема. На iPad и раскладном iPhone экраны раскрываются на всю ширину.

EDANI+
Подписка открывает все уроки курсов и снимает дневное ограничение на сообщения Дане. Оформляется на месяц или на год, первые 7 дней бесплатно. Продлевается автоматически, пока вы не отключите её в настройках Apple ID.

name: Energydesk
description:
Energydesk ist die App für dein Team im Betrieb – ob Tankstelle, Gastronomie oder ein anderer Betrieb mit Schichtarbeit.

Mit der App hast du alles dabei, was du für deine Arbeit brauchst:

• Dienstplan: Deine Schichten auf einen Blick, Woche für Woche.
• Offene Schichten und Tausch: Schichten übernehmen oder mit Kollegen tauschen.
• Stempeln: Ein- und ausstempeln und Pausen erfassen, wenn dein Betrieb das mobil erlaubt.
• Urlaub und Krankmeldung: Urlaub beantragen, Krankmeldung abgeben und die Bescheinigung als Foto oder PDF hochladen.
• Aufgaben: Persönliche Aufgaben erledigen, bei Bedarf mit Foto oder Unterschrift.
• Belehrungen und Verträge: Lesen und direkt in der App unterschreiben.
• Stundenzettel und Lohnabrechnungen: Deine Stunden und Abrechnungen einsehen.
• Dokumente: Eigene Unterlagen ansehen und hochladen.
• Nachrichten: Deinem Betrieb schreiben.

Mitteilungen halten dich auf dem Laufenden – zum Beispiel, wenn dein Urlaub genehmigt wurde, eine Schicht freigegeben ist oder ein Vertrag auf deine Unterschrift wartet.

So meldest du dich an: Die App nutzt du mit dem Zugang, den du von deinem Betrieb bekommst. Du erhältst dafür eine E-Mail mit einem Link, über den du dein Passwort festlegst. Ein eigenes Konto kannst du in der App nicht anlegen.

Dein Betrieb nutzt Energydesk noch nicht? Mehr unter energydesk.online.

name: ERASISMAX TRACKER
description:
ERASISMAX TRACKER lleva el control de tu flota al bolsillo: mira todos tus vehículos en un mapa en vivo, revisa por dónde pasó cada unidad y reacciona a tiempo cuando algo no anda bien.

MAPA EN VIVO DE LA FLOTA
• Todos tus vehículos sobre mapas de Google con icono, rumbo y estado.
• Capas de rutas, geocercas y nombres, más vista Plano, Satélite, Híbrido, Relieve y tráfico.
• Toca un vehículo para centrarlo y abre su ficha con velocidad, dirección y última conexión.
• Modo seguir: el mapa acompaña al vehículo mientras se mueve.

HISTORIAL Y RUTAS
• Reproduce el recorrido de cualquier unidad en un rango de fechas.
• Línea de ruta con inicio y destino marcados y panel de detalle minimizable.

SEGURIDAD Y ALARMAS
• Botón de pánico con presión de 5 segundos y sirena de alarma entrante.

• Notificaciones push incluso con la app en segundo plano.

TRABAJO DIARIO

• Selector de flota y acceso rápido a la lista de vehículos.

PRIVACIDAD

• Política de privacidad: https://respaldo.erasismax.com/privacidad.html

Requiere una cuenta activa de la plataforma ERASISMAX.

Desarrollada y creada por el Ing. Leonardo Elizalde.

name: Escáner 3D
description:
Convierte objetos reales en modelos 3D listos para imprimir, directamente con tu iPhone.

Escáner 3D usa la cámara y el escáner LiDAR con Object Capture de Apple: te guía mientras rodeas el objeto, toma las fotos y crea el modelo en el propio iPhone, sin internet ni servidores.

GRATIS
• Captura guiada: la app te indica cuándo dar otra vuelta o girar el objeto.
• Modelo 3D creado en el iPhone, con barra de progreso.
• Galería con miniaturas para renombrar y borrar tus escaneos.
• Visor en realidad aumentada para ver el modelo a tamaño real sobre la mesa.
• Comparte el modelo en USDZ, con texturas.

ESCÁNER 3D PRO (pago único, sin suscripción)
• STL listo para laminar: en milímetros, apoyado en la cama y centrado.
• Base plana ajustable para que el modelo apoye bien.
• Medidas reales de ancho, fondo y alto antes de exportar.
• Aviso si la malla tiene agujeros que pueden dar problemas al imprimir.
• Exportación en OBJ.

REQUISITOS
iPhone con escáner LiDAR y chip A14 o posterior (iPhone 12 Pro y modelos Pro posteriores) con iOS 18 o posterior. En otros iPhone la app explica por qué no puede escanear.

PRIVACIDAD
Escáner 3D no recoge datos. Las fotos y los modelos se quedan en tu iPhone y solo salen de él cuando tú los compartes.

name: evmetra: Elektrikli Araç
description:

• Yakınındaki istasyonlar, DC hızlı şarj ve güce göre filtre

HESAPLIYORUM

ARACIM VAR

Hesabın sitedeki hesabınla aynıdır: favorilerin, alarmların ve Garajım kayıtların telefonda ve bilgisayarda birlikte güncellenir. Apple, Google ya da e-postayla giriş yapabilirsin.

name: Farine & Co
description:
Farine & Co, c'est le carnet de recettes de la famille, au propre et dans la poche.

GARDER TOUTES SES RECETTES
• Un lien Instagram, TikTok, YouTube ou un blog : la recette est lue et rangée dans ton carnet, avec ses ingrédients, ses quantités et ses étapes.
• La fiche de ta grand-mère ou la page d'un livre : prends-la en photo (plusieurs pages si besoin), elle est recopiée au propre.
• Rien n'est inventé : une quantité absente est signalée pour que tu la complètes.
• Ou écris tes recettes toi-même.

LES PARTAGER EN FAMILLE
• Crée des cercles privés, sur invitation : la famille, les amis, la colocation.
• Chacun garde la main sur ses recettes : les autres proposent une modification, tu l'acceptes ou non, ou ils font leur propre version.
• Une conversation par cercle sous chaque recette.
• L'histoire de la recette : qui te l'a transmise, un souvenir.

CUISINER ENSEMBLE
• Portions ajustables et conversions d'unités.
• Mode cuisine : grandes étapes, écran toujours allumé, ingrédients à portée de main.
• Minuteurs qui sonnent même téléphone verrouillé.
• Liste de courses partagée en temps réel avec ton cercle, sans doublon.

Gratuit, sans publicité et sans pistage.

name: Fazendinha 3D
description:
Um pouco de campo no seu dia. Na Fazendinha 3D, você começa com um terreno para cuidar e vai criando uma fazenda do seu jeito.

Escolha suas sementes, regue os canteiros e volte para colher. Ganhe moedas e experiência para trazer animais, desbloquear melhorias e dar seu toque às decorações. Guarde a produção no celeiro, descubra receitas na oficina e avance até desbloquear a pesca.

Explore o cenário em 3D, aproxime a câmera dos detalhes e organize o terreno. Ative a tela cheia quando quiser mais espaço para jogar.

Você pode começar como visitante. Crie uma conta para proteger seu progresso e continuar em outro aparelho. É necessário acesso à internet para carregar o jogo e salvar as ações.

A conta e o progresso pertencem somente à Fazendinha 3D.

name: FilmHeritage
description:
Somewhere in Europe there is a print of the film you need, and the honest answer to "may I see it?" starts with "it depends which archive holds it".

FilmHeritage is a reading desk built around that question. It gathers the moving image heritage catalogued by the film archives of Europe — newsreels, amateur reels, documentary, fiction and formal experiment — and arranges it the way research actually happens: by country, by decade, and by the institution that holds the material. Nothing here is a streaming service. It is an index that tells you where the reel is, what state it survives in, and who decides what may be done with it.

Open a record and three things are kept apart that are usually flattened into one. How the material can be watched. What the rights statement actually says. Whether a print may be put in front of an audience. A film that streams in a reading room is not a film you may advertise, and the app says so on every record, in the same place, without hedging. The holding archive is named with its city, its founding year and the way a viewing is arranged, because the next step after finding a film is writing to the people who keep it.

The dossiers are the part that changes how a period reads. Instead of grouping similar titles, they set records against each other: a newsreel, a fiction feature and a formal experiment made in the same months in different countries. A comparison screen then holds two records side by side, field by field, and marks in colour every place where the catalogue's own answers diverge. For a programmer, that is the difference between a list of films and an argument about them.

Your own work stays on the device. A chronology records what you have actually sat through, in which reading room, in what condition, and what it was worth; the year rail turns those notes into a viewing history. A programme draft collects records for a screening and exports them with the archive, the access route and the screening position attached to every line, so the person receiving it can verify each one before a single poster is printed. No account, no sign-in, no upload.

Records, rights wording and institution names are drawn from the European Film Gateway, the single access point to films, images and texts from selected collections of forty film archives across Europe. FilmHeritage is an independent reading tool, not affiliated with the gateway, and the authoritative version of every record remains the one published there.

name: Finly AI: Expense Tracker
description:
Finly AI is your personal smart AI assistant for managing your money.

It’s more than a typical expense tracker. Just write about a purchase in your own words, like in a chat. Finly works out the amount, category, account and tags and prepares the transaction for you to confirm.

Chat with the AI assistant about your money: ask where your spending goes, how your budget is changing and what you spend the most on. Finly analyzes your financial data, helps you spot patterns and better understand your money habits.

SMART AI TRANSACTION ENTRY
• Just type: “Lunch $15, main card, tag Work”.
• Finly automatically picks out the amount, category, account and tags and prepares the transaction.
• Check the suggested details and confirm to save. No more filling in every field by hand.

AI FINANCIAL ASSISTANT
• Ask in everyday language: “Where did most of my money go this month?”
• Answers come from your own income, expenses, budgets and accounts, often with a chart, and AI keeps the context when you follow up.

INSIGHTS AND ANALYTICS
• Spending by category, subcategory, tag, account and weekday; income vs. expenses and monthly trends.
• Insight cards point out what changed this month.

EVERYTHING ELSE
• Manual entry in a few taps, when you prefer it.
• Budgets by category, savings goals, debts and loans with due dates.
• Cards, bank accounts, cash, e-wallets and savings — each in its own currency.
• A Home screen you arrange yourself, with your own widgets.

YOUR DATA
• You add accounts yourself — Finly never asks for your bank password.
• Sign in with Google; keep your data on the Finly server or in your own cloud with end-to-end encryption. Available in 13 languages.

PLANS AND AI LIMITS
Finly is free to download. The Free plan includes 25 AI requests per week, up to 3 accounts, 3 budgets and analytics for the current month. Finly Plus and Pro add more AI requests, receipt scanning, cloud voice input, unlimited accounts and budgets, full analytics history and import. Subscriptions are optional.
Finly does not give investment, tax or credit advice.

Tell Finly about your next purchase — and ask where your money goes.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period and can be managed in Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://finly.caravan-delivery.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://finly.caravan-delivery.com/privacy

name: Finventory
description:
Finventory is a private vault for the things you own. Record your belongings with photos, serial numbers and what they're worth, keep receipts and warranties together, and have an inventory ready the day you need it.

THE VAULT
• A combination dial shows the total estimated value of everything you've deposited. Turn it to see what you paid, how the value has changed and how many items you own.
• Collections (Electronics, Jewellery, Furniture and your own) in a carousel, with counts and totals.
• Premium deposit cards for every asset: photo, collection, room, condition, value and warranty status.

EVERY DETAIL OF AN ASSET
• Name, collection, room or location, serial number, purchase date, price, store, estimated value, condition and notes.
• Photos from your library or camera.
• Tap the asset card to flip it: the front shows the photo and value, the back shows purchase and warranty details.
• Value history: record valuations over time and follow them on an interactive chart.
• Maintenance history: services and repairs with dates, costs and who did the work.

WARRANTIES THAT NEVER SLIP
• Warranty end date, provider and coverage for each asset.
• A timeline of warranty seals ordered by end date, with a "today" marker and active, expiring and expired counts.
• Optional reminders 30 days, 7 days and 1 day before a warranty ends.

RECEIPTS
• Attach receipts as photos or PDF files and link them to an asset.
• Search the receipt drawer, filter linked or unlinked receipts, view and share the files.

REPORTS & EXPORT
• Vault value over 12 months, value by collection, warranty coverage and maintenance spend — drawn as charts you can tap to inspect.
• Export a PDF inventory report for your insurer, CSV spreadsheets of assets and maintenance, or a complete JSON copy of your data.

SEARCH THE LEDGER
• Search by name, serial, room, store or notes. Filter by collection, room, condition and warranty status, and sort by value, name, purchase date or recently added.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• Sign in with your email and password. Your vault syncs to your own private account so it's there on every device where you sign in.
• Works fully offline: everything is saved on your iPhone first and syncs when you're back online.
• Manage your profile, change your password, sign out or permanently delete your account and all its data from inside the app.
• No ads and no tracking.

DESIGNED WITH CARE
• Light and dark appearance, haptics you can switch off, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver labels.

Values in Finventory are your own estimates. Finventory doesn't appraise items; check with your insurer which documentation they accept.

name: FlashForge Printer Manager
description:
FlashForge Printer Manager brings local AD5X monitoring and everyday controls to your iPhone. This free companion from Green Teaching connects directly to your printer on the same Wi-Fi.

MONITOR YOUR PRINTER
• See printer status, current job progress, layers and temperatures.
• View the local printer camera with simple show, hide and reload controls.
• Read printer and firmware information.

EVERYDAY CONTROLS
• Set bed and nozzle temperature targets.
• Adjust print speed during an eligible print.
• Switch the printer light on or off.
• Request bed levelling and vibration compensation when the printer is Ready.
• Open Flashforge firmware guidance and release information. Firmware installation is performed on the printer.

OPTIONAL MAC LINK
Pair a compatible Printer Manager Mac companion by scanning its private QR code. Read the Mac’s filament inventory, loaded spool colours and recent usage history. The Mac records deductions once; the phone displays its balances without changing them. Cached balances are labelled when the Mac is unavailable.

For simultaneous camera viewing, enable camera sharing on the paired Mac and choose Via Mac on the phone. The current spool can be highlighted and animated when fresh matching information is available. Mac estimates are labelled.

REQUIREMENTS
A compatible Flashforge AD5X in LAN Only mode, its local IP address, serial number and Check Code, and the same local Wi-Fi network. The optional Mac features require a Mac companion with an iPhone link page; the initial Mac App Store LAN 1.0 edition does not include that link. Remote internet monitoring and Cloud sign-in are not included.

Printer credentials and pairing keys are stored in iOS Keychain. No advertising or developer analytics. The iPhone camera permission is used only to scan the Mac pairing QR code. Live printer video may have a small delay.

Independent software by Green Teaching. Flashforge and AD5X identify compatible hardware; no affiliation or endorsement is implied.

name: Floppy Corgi: Flying Pet Game
description:
One corgi, one button and one endless flight. Press to rise, fall between presses, and fly through the gaps.

ONE BUTTON
Press the clickpad and the corgi goes up. Between presses it comes down. Each gate you pass is a point. Touch a gate, the ground or the top of the screen, and the round is over.

THREE WORLDS IN THE SKY
Fly over a green meadow, the rooftops of an old town and the islands of a cloud kingdom. The world changes every 20 points while you fly.

HARDER AND HARDER
The gaps get smaller and the flight gets faster. The round gets harder for the first 56 gates and has no end.

DAY AND NIGHT
Each world has a light and a dark look. The game follows the appearance setting of your Apple TV.

A TRAIL OF TREATS
Bones, biscuits, cheese and bacon fly behind the corgi. After a crash, its ears drop and it looks sad.

LEADERBOARD
The best scores are on the start screen. Sign in to Game Center to compare your best score with the scores of other players. Without Game Center, the list shows your own best rounds.

EASY TO PLAY
Press the clickpad to fly. Press Play/Pause to take a break.

The game works offline. No ads and no separate account.

name: Flow Latino Radio
description:
Flow Latino Radio es tu estación de música latina las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana.

¿QUÉ INCLUYE?
• Radio en vivo en alta calidad
• Programación semanal con horarios de cada show
• Portada del álbum de la canción que suena
• Redes sociales de la estación al alcance de un toque
• Continúa sonando aunque cambies de app o bloquees el teléfono
• Control desde los audífonos y la pantalla de bloqueo

Sintonízanos y vive la música latina.

name: Flurrora: Magical Snow Globes
description:
Flurrora is a little snow globe you can hold in your hand. Gently tilt or shake your iPhone and watch snow swirl around a tiny landmark inside the glass, then drift down and settle softly, just like the real thing.

THE GLOBE IS THE APP
Open Flurrora and your globe is already there: no sign-in, no tutorial, no setup. The glass sphere takes center stage, with soft highlights, reflections, and a quiet base, so it feels like a treasured keepsake rather than a busy game.

SNOW THAT FEELS REAL
• Tilt your iPhone and the snow drifts downhill, changing direction as you move.
• A gentle shake starts a lively flurry. There's no need to shake hard.
• Hold still and the flakes slow down, swirl, and settle on the ground.
• Shake again and the settled snow lifts back into the air.
• Flakes fall at different depths, in front of and behind the landmark, and always stay inside the glass.

SEVEN MINIATURE WORLDS
Choose from seven miniature scenes inspired by famous places:
• Eiffel Tower, Paris, France
• Statue of Liberty, New York City, USA
• Big Ben, London, United Kingdom
• Taj Mahal, Agra, India
• Pyramids of Giza, Giza, Egypt
• Mount Fuji, Honshu, Japan
• Sydney Opera House, Sydney, Australia

Every scene is original artwork made for Flurrora: a playful miniature, not a photograph. Kids can pick a globe by its picture alone.

MAKE IT YOURS, SIMPLY
• Lighting: Day, Dusk, or Night.
• Snow: Classic soft white flakes, or Sparkle with gentle glints that never flash.
Changes appear on the globe right away, and Flurrora remembers your globe, lighting, and snow style for next time.

MAKE IT SNOW WITH A TAP
Prefer not to move your phone? Tap the snowflake button for the same swirl of snow. Everything you can do by moving your iPhone also works with on-screen buttons.

FOR KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
Kids understand it at a glance: move the phone or tap the snowflake and watch the snow fly. No reading required, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no scores or timers. Grown-ups get a calm, beautifully crafted moment of quiet whenever they need one.

THOUGHTFUL AND ACCESSIBLE
• VoiceOver labels for the globe, every scene, and every option.
• Respects Reduce Motion, plus an optional Gentle Effects setting for extra-calm snow.
• Supports Dynamic Type and both Light and Dark Mode.
• Soft haptic feedback when the snow swirls, which you can turn off.
• Adapts to every iPhone screen, in portrait or landscape.
• Silent by design, with no sudden sounds.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Flurrora works entirely offline. Motion readings are used only in the moment to move the snow and are never recorded or shared. No accounts, no analytics, no tracking.

name: FollyTrail
description:
FollyTrail is a field guide for the moment you stop the car and ask what that tower on the hill actually is.

It began with a simple problem. Britain and Europe are full of buildings that were put up to be looked at rather than lived in: sham ruins, prospect towers, bridges over nothing, dovecotes wearing battlements. They are everywhere, they are usually on somebody else's land, and almost nothing tells you what you are looking at when you are standing in a gateway with the engine running.

So this app draws them. Every building is shown as an elevation rather than a photograph, because a silhouette is what you see from a distance and what you need in order to recognise a place before you reach it. Each entry tells you when it was built, who paid for it, what it was for, and what state it is in now. Each one also states plainly whether you may walk to it, whether you may only see it from the road, or whether it is private ground that should be left alone.

The part people tend to remember is the explanation. A folly is often mistaken for a ruin, and the app shows you why the mistake happens: a wall that was built broken has edges cut to a rhythm, while a wall that fell down has edges lost to gravity. Two small drawings side by side settle an argument that has been going on since the eighteenth century.

For a longer day out, the routes chain several buildings into a half-day drive, in order, with the parking, the visibility and the awkward gates already thought through. For photographers there is a compass showing which way the best light falls and a note on where to stand. And for anyone who keeps count, the journal records what you have visited and turns it into a plotting sheet of your own.

The gazetteer is compiled from the published pages of The Folly Fellowship, the charity founded in 1988 to protect, preserve and promote follies, grottoes and garden buildings. The app is an independent field guide; it is not published by the Fellowship, and it does not replace the pleasure of standing in front of the real thing.

name: From Cat to Moon: Associations
description:
How do you get from a cat to the Moon? A cat is black, black is the night, and at night the Moon shines. Three steps and you're there!

From Cat to Moon: Associations is a relaxing puzzle about words and the links between them. At every step, pick one of the associated words and build a path to the goal. The shorter the path, the more stars you earn.

• 200 levels in 10 chapters — from simple chains to tricky routes.
• Daily Path — a new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Compare your result with other players and keep your streak.
• Link dictionary — every association you discover is saved with a short phrase explaining the connection.
• Warmer/colder and best-move hints when you're stuck. Undo a step anytime.
• Your path becomes a constellation in the night sky — share it with friends.
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards, cloud save with Sign in with Apple or email.
• No timers, no rush. Play in English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German or French.

Train your vocabulary and logic a few minutes a day — and step from word to word all the way to the Moon.

The game is free.

name: Frost Pass: Snow Defense
description:
Every night, snow creatures roll down the mountain. Keep the pass safe before all five village lanterns go out.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Play one card per turn to place Throwers, Ice Walls, Braziers and Icicle Traps on the lanes.
- Cards cost firewood, and you gain one each turn. Spend it now, or wait for a bigger play.
- The strip above the board shows where the next creatures will appear.
- Hold 8 waves to win. Between waves, pick one of three reward cards to grow your deck.

TODAY'S PASS
A run set by the date: everyone meets the same creatures and reward cards that day. Your best score for each day goes on a calendar.

FIVE SNOW CREATURES
Snowballs, Sleetlings that move two tiles at a time, Cracked Snowballs that split in two, and tough Boulderballs. Everything you meet fills your field guide.

- Turn-based: stop any time and continue where you left off. About five minutes a run, one hand.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in, and it works offline.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.

name: FrovaniQesmir
description: Soft starter calculator: motor, current, ramp time, voltage and costs.

name: FructumOrbitara
description: FructumOrbitara is an original orbital fruit puzzle. Rotate rings, swap fruits, and trigger arc or spoke resonance to clear boards, hit score goals, or align monochrome spokes. Explore 36 campaign levels across four worlds, play a date-seeded Daily Orbit, unlock Fruit Codex lore, earn achievements, and track stars and coins. Sign in with Apple, Google, or continue as a guest. Built for quick sessions with thoughtful strategy and a vibrant fruit-orbit style.

name: fSMS: Virtual Number & SMS
description:
Virtual Number: your verification code in seconds!

Verify your accounts without sharing your personal number. Get a virtual number from 150+ countries and receive your SMS verification code in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a country. Your suggested country is at the top.
2. Get your number. It's ready in seconds.
3. Enter the number where you sign up and request a code.
4. When the code arrives, copy it with one tap.

WHY fSMS?
• 100% verification guaranteed: no code, no charge to your numbers. It's returned to you.
• No sign-up: we never ask for your name, email or phone number.
• 150+ countries: from Europe to the Americas and Asia.
• Ready in seconds: get your number without waiting.
• One-tap copy: or let the code copy automatically.
• Your privacy, protected: your personal number stays private.

name: globeSIM - Travel eSIM & Data
description:
globeSIM gets your phone online the moment you land. Pick a plan for your destination, install the eSIM before you fly and switch it on when you arrive. No SIM swap, no roaming bill.

PLANS FOR 168 COUNTRIES
• 168 countries and 6 regional plans: Europe + UK, Balkans, Central Asia & Caucasus, North America, South America and Southeast Asia
• Prices in your own currency, with 133 currencies to choose from
• Plan sizes from 1 GB to 100 GB

PAY AND INSTALL IN A MINUTE
• Pay with Apple Pay or card. Payments by Stripe

ON THE TRIP

THE NEXT TRIP

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
