Good to know: globeSIM plans are data only, with no phone number. Your phone needs to support eSIM and be unlocked.

name: GoldRoad: Daily Path Puzzle
description:
GoldRoad is a daily number path puzzle. Every day brings two new roads: Classic and Expedition.

Walk from your footprints to the finish flag, one tile at a time. Each tile changes your score. You cannot retrace your steps. The road is solved only when you reach the flag with your score exactly on the target: not more, not less.

TWO ROADS EVERY DAY
• Classic is the main daily challenge.
• Expedition unlocks when you solve Classic, with toll and bonus lanes.

EARN YOUR MEDAL
• Solve on your first try for gold.
• Second try is silver. Third try is bronze.
• Keep going after that: it still counts as solved.

STUCK? TAKE A HINT
Hints are always there, with no penalty. They guide you back onto a road that reaches the target.

MORE TO PLAY
• Past Roads: play earlier daily roads at your own pace.
• Stats: your streaks, medals and history.
• Community stats: see how the field played, if you choose to share.
• Widget: your Classic streak and a countdown to the next road.
• Daily reminder, if you want one.
• Your history syncs through iCloud.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your history stays on your device and in your iCloud. The app asks before it sends any community play stats.

New roads arrive every day. See you on the road.

name: GracesGuide
description:
Grace's Guide is a reading companion to the volunteer record of British industrial history. It is made for the moment when you are standing in front of an old machine, a cast nameplate or a page from a catalogue, and you want to know who made it, where the works stood and when the firm stopped.

The app keeps the shape of the archive instead of flattening it into a product list. Records are arranged by trade, town and date, and each one carries a drawn plate of its trade, the works address, the years the firm traded, the products it was known for and the sources the entry was compiled from. Where two businesses share a name, both are shown with the details that separate them, so a works number or a street can settle the question.

The works map does something a list cannot. Switch it to street level and the pins gather into the roads where several firms stood, which is how an industrial district actually formed. Photographs of nameplates and trade marks can be kept on a shelf, tied to the record they belong to and placed on a map of their own. For museum work, objects whose maker is uncertain can be matched to a works entry, and the app writes the label out in full.

Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. Entries are read from gracesguide.co.uk, and the bundled index stays readable without a connection. The archive belongs to its contributors; this app is a way of reading it in the place where the objects actually are.

name: Gravity Keyboard: 3D Keycaps
description:
Every keycap is your miniature creative space. Gravity Keyboard transforms everyday typing into a tactile 3D design studio—combining real-time GPU optical materials, miniature buoyancy & collision physics, material-bound ASMR acoustics, and stress-relief arcade play.

PER-KEY 3D SPATIAL ATELIER
Go far beyond flat wallpaper themes. Customize individual keys or full sets with direct spatial controls:
• 24 Real-Time Optical Materials: Squishy Jelly, Clear Droplet, Flowing Golden Sand, Cozy Plush, Cosmic Crystal, Rose Champagne, Liquid Mercury, Frosted Ice, Matcha Boba, and more—with live transparency, softness, gloss, and micro-grain sliders.
• 60 Physical 3D Micro-Charms: Stars, clouds, sakura petals, sea shells, koi fish, berries, and tiny plushies governed by real physics—watch them float and ripple in water, gently settle in sand, or bounce inside squishy jelly.
• Material-Bound Native Acoustics & Haptics: Sound is born from physics. Drop a charm into water to hear crisp ripples; drop it into sand to hear soft shifting grains, paired with crisp Taptic Engine feedback.

40+ AESTHETIC WORLDS & TACTILE MINI-GAMES
• Explore curated miniature worlds across Liquid, Jelly, Plush, Botanical, and Cosmic collections—apply instantly or remix every key.
• Unwind anytime with 5 built-in physics mini-games right on your keyboard stage.
• Save unlimited custom creations in My Recipes and share or import worlds effortlessly via instant offline Share Codes.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE, IPHONE DUO & IPAD
• Tailored spatial Bento studio, macro keycap inspector, and live physics telemetry across iPhone, unfolded iPhone Duo dual-pane displays, and iPad 11" & 13".
• Smooth, responsive everyday typing with multilingual layouts.

100% ON-DEVICE PRIVACY & FAIR ONE-TIME UNLOCK
• Zero network permission in the system keyboard extension—everything you type stays strictly on your device.
• Core keyboard features and starter materials are free forever with zero ads. Enjoy a 3-day free trial and a single one-time Lifetime Unlock (with Family Sharing)—no subscriptions ever.

name: Gravity Launch: Orbit
description:
Master pure orbital momentum with one control.

In Gravity Launch: Orbit, you pilot a high-energy comet Orb trapped in a neon cosmic arena of volatile spiky stars. Hold to ignite your thruster and surge forward—then release to snap a glowing plasma gravity tether to the nearest star, whip around its orbit, and fling it into the arena walls before the 30-second countdown hits zero.

Stay moving. As you coast without boosting, your Orb gradually loses momentum and mass, letting nearby stars pull you tighter into close synchronous orbit—until you ignite your boost and tear free.

FEATURES
• Pure One-Button Physics: Hold to boost and gain mass; release to tether, orbit, and slingshot.
• Fuse & Split Mechanics: Colliding stars fuse into larger multi-hit giants. Smash combined stars against arena walls or slam through them with your Orb to split them down cleanly until only single stars shatter.
• Singularity Rounds Every 5 Levels: Merge every star in the arena into a single giant core—walls bounce safely while lasers bisect targets—then trigger a Black Hole collapse that pulls your Orb through the wormhole into the next sector.
• Escalating Cosmic Hazards: Survive cross-arena sweeping plasma lasers starting at Level 11 (and during Singularity rounds), and confront pre-grown giant stars starting at Level 25.
• Game Center & iCloud Sync: Climb the global Highest Level Game Center leaderboard and automatically sync your best level and audio/haptics settings across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.
• Living Color-Shifting Soundtrack: Four driving electronic tracks cycle seamlessly as dynamic space nebulas, warped spacetime grids, and glowing palettes shift smoothly to match every song.
• Custom Audio & Haptics: Independently toggle Music, Sound Effects, and Tactile Haptics anytime from the main menu or pause screen.
• Universal Apple Arcade Feel: Play seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Mac (click or Spacebar), and Apple TV 4K (Siri Remote Select or game controller).

How many sectors can you clear before time runs out?

name: Hanako Surreal & Subtly Funny
description: Hanako brings you surreal, subtly funny replies with her signature straight face! A little quirky, a little silly, and perfect for adding a smile to daily chats

name: Highlight Reader: Text & PDF
description:
Highlight Reader reads text and PDFs aloud with the voices already on your iPhone, and highlights each sentence as it is spoken, so your eyes and ears stay in the same place.

WHAT IT DOES

• Paste or type text, add a PDF or a plain-text file from Files, or share a PDF to Highlight Reader from another app.
• The sentence being read is highlighted and kept on screen. Tap any sentence to read from there, or step back and forward one sentence at a time.
• Choose a voice and a speed from 0.5× to 2×. Automatic picks the best installed voice for the document's language.
• Keeps reading with the screen locked. Play, pause and skip sentences from the Lock Screen or Control Center.
• Your library remembers where you stopped in each document.
• Not sure yet? Tap Try the Sample: a few tongue twisters, two Aesop fables in our own words and a couple of nursery rhymes.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics. The app makes no network requests, and your documents stay on this iPhone.
• It cannot read scanned PDFs (pages that are only pictures, with no text layer), and it cannot open password-protected PDFs.
• It speaks with Apple's built-in voices, so how natural it sounds depends on which voices are installed. For more natural ones, open Settings › Accessibility › Read & Speak › Voices (on some iOS versions: Spoken Content › Voices) and download an Enhanced or Premium voice.
• It highlights whole sentences, not word by word.

Made by a small studio. If something reads wrong, the support page says how to reach us.

name: House Planner: Home Care
description:
A home needs lots of small checks. House Planner helps you remember them and keep track of water and heating on iPhone and iPad.

FOLLOW YOUR CONSUMPTION
Record the cumulative meter reading and date. Compare a week, 14 days, month, quarter, half-year or year. Estimates and partial periods are clearly marked. Track water, district heating or other meters you can read yourself. Electricity is optional. For heat pumps, delivered heat and electricity used by the pump are kept separate.

CHOOSE YOUR HOME CHECKS
Gutters, smoke alarms, alarm sensors, ventilation filters and more. Every suggested check is optional. Choose what fits your home or create your own tasks with dates, intervals and notes. Mark a task as done or postpone it until tomorrow. Your history remembers completed checks.

REMEMBER WHEN IT MATTERS
Allow local notifications and choose the time. Reminders can arrive even when the app is closed. Focus and system settings may affect delivery.

YOUR HOME. YOUR INFORMATION.
No account, ads or automatic syncing. Your home data stays on your device. Save a backup in Files and restore it when you want to move your home or return to an earlier copy.

Start with your own home or explore the clearly marked example home. Find the built-in user guide in Settings and choose from 19 languages.

House Planner requires manual meter readings. It does not connect to meters or sensors and does not provide continuous leak or fire alarms. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for your installations and alarms.

name: HurricaneTrack
description:
HurricaneTrack is a coastal desk for the National Hurricane Center's public data. Choose the stretch of coast you care about, and the app turns an official track into a local story: how far the centre is, which side of you it is passing, when tropical-storm-force winds could arrive, and what the archived wind field says about your neighbourhood.

When a system is active, the desk follows the NHC advisory cycle and keeps the advisory number and issue time in view, so you always know which version you are reading. When the basin is quiet, the archive takes over. Replay a best track fix by fix, watch the wind field expand and contract, and find the exact moment a storm turned — the clearest way to understand why a forecast can change.

The preparedness kit is a private, practical list for the same coast: water, food, documents, pets, power and a route inland, with three quiet seasonal reminders a year. Nothing is uploaded, and no account is required. HurricaneTrack reads official products; it does not issue forecasts, warnings or evacuation orders.

name: Huyệt Vị 3D
description:
Huyệt Vị 3D giúp bạn học và tra cứu huyệt vị, kinh lạc trên mô hình cơ thể người ba chiều. Xoay, phóng to, chạm vào từng điểm để biết huyệt nằm ở đâu và thuộc đường kinh nào.

MÔ HÌNH 3D
• Cơ thể người 3D xoay 360 độ, xem mặt trước, mặt sau, đầu mặt, bàn tay, bàn chân.
• 14 đường kinh chính vẽ trên cơ thể, có vệt sáng chạy theo hướng kinh.
• Chế độ xuyên thấu để thấy huyệt ở mặt khuất.

TRA CỨU
• 361 huyệt theo chuẩn WHO và các huyệt ngoài kinh.
• Tìm theo tên Hán Việt (gõ không dấu cũng được), pinyin, chữ Hán, mã WHO (LI4), mã Việt (BQ23) hoặc triệu chứng.
• Mỗi huyệt có vị trí, công năng, chủ trị, phối huyệt và lưu ý.
• Thông tin 14 đường kinh và các mạch kỳ kinh: lộ trình, tạng phủ, chứng bệnh.
• Kiến thức châm cứu: các bài đọc ngắn, chạm vào tên huyệt để mở ngay trên mô hình.

CỦA RIÊNG BẠN
• Đánh dấu huyệt yêu thích và ghi chú riêng cho từng huyệt.
• Xem lại những huyệt vừa tra.
• Mở được khi không có mạng sau lần tải đầu.

TÀI KHOẢN
Không bắt buộc. Đăng nhập bằng Apple (có thể ẩn email) để giữ huyệt yêu thích và ghi chú khi đổi máy. Xoá tài khoản bất cứ lúc nào trong ứng dụng.

Không quảng cáo. Không theo dõi.

LƯU Ý
Huyệt Vị 3D là tài liệu tham khảo và học tập, không phải lời khuyên y tế và không dùng để chẩn đoán hay điều trị. Vị trí huyệt trên mô hình là gần đúng. Châm cứu, bấm huyệt cần do người có chuyên môn thực hiện.

Mô hình cơ thể: MakeHuman (CC0).
Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://huyetvi.ap.vn/privacy
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://huyetvi.ap.vn/terms

name: IFMIExp

Save glossary entries and charts, organize notes with tags, track your learning progress, and export notes as PDFs. O InoveAtende leva o atendimento da sua empresa para o celular. Converse com seus clientes do WhatsApp, acompanhe a fila e veja os resultados da equipe, sem precisar estar no computador.

• Lista de conversas atualizada na hora, separada em Minhas, Na fila, Bot e Todas

name: Invertigo TV
description:
Flip gravity. Find your line. Survive the stars.

Guide your ship through five independent worlds, each with 25 levels and its own obstacles, scenery and music. Click the Siri Remote or press A on a game controller to reverse gravity, weave through moving hazards and reach Mission Complete.

• Play 125 levels across five distinct worlds.
• Navigate freight gates, drifting ice sheets, swinging pendulums, solar flares and moving space hazards.
• Start each mission at Level 1, with a gradual rise in challenge.
• Choose three lives or take on Survivor with a single life.
• Use Practice to try any level with unlimited retries.
• Enjoy original gameplay tracks and smooth musical transitions every five levels.
• Save personal bests and progress on your Apple TV.

The Apple TV edition does not display advertisements. Play/Pause pauses your flight.

name: IPTV Taos
description:
O IPTV Taos é um player simples e rápido para a sua lista IPTV. Conecte um link M3U ou os dados de um servidor Xtream e assista aos canais ao vivo, filmes e séries da sua lista na Apple TV, com uma interface feita para o controle remoto.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS

• Minha lista: guarde filmes e séries para assistir depois
• Continua de onde você parou, inclusive em séries

IMPORTANTE
O IPTV Taos é apenas um player de mídia. Ele não inclui, vende nem fornece canais, filmes, séries ou listas. Você precisa de uma lista própria de um provedor, e é responsável por assistir apenas a conteúdos que tem direito de assistir.

name: Jaimental - Four-Colour Abacus
description:
Explore place value with Jaimental, Jaime García Serrano’s four-colour abacus. Combine beads worth 1, 2, 3, and 6 to build numbers of up to ten digits.

• Tap beads or enter a number to see how it is represented.
• Use the built-in guide to learn place value and practise carrying with 5 + 6.
• Undo moves, clear the board, and choose how many columns you want.
• Practise in portrait or landscape, and pick up where you left off.

Jaimental works offline and does not require an account. It is free, with no ads or in-app purchases.

name: Japan Travel Offline Guide
description:
Japan, at your own pace.

Japan Tourism helps you discover and organise places in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Nara, Kamakura, Nikko and Hiroshima. Built for iPhone and iPad with one upfront purchase, no ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

SEVEN CITIES FROM THE FIRST LAUNCH
Over 34,000 included places: temples, shrines, museums, parks, viewpoints, cherry blossom spots, stations, toilets, shops and convenience stores. Search by name, including Japanese names, and choose the categories you want to see.

BROWSE OFFLINE
All seven city catalogs are included. Browse places and favourites, write notes and explore a local schematic of places and railways without internet. This schematic does not include streets or navigation. For street maps and directions, you can open Apple's services with an internet connection.

SAVED PLACES AND NOTES
Prepare your trip by saving places and recording your own tips and memories. Export and import a JSON backup of your data from this Apple edition.

YOUR DAY ROUTE
Add stops from one city, rearrange them and order them by proximity. Distances are straight-line measurements and walking times are estimates. Open any stop in Apple Maps to check directions.

YOUR GOSHUIN COLLECTION
Find places with goshuin and record the seals you have collected at temples and shrines, with the collection date.

VERIFIED UPDATES
Update each city in Settings. The app checks package signatures and integrity before installation. Where published, extended descriptions and cultural and travel insights associated with places are downloaded too.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Spanish and English interface. On iPad, browse the place list alongside the map. Location is optional and is not used in the background.

Opening times, prices, facilities and goshuin availability can change: check with each place before visiting. Transport and directions depend on Apple's service coverage and your connection.

Geographic data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Wikidata data, CC0. Wikipedia descriptions retain their source and licence.

name: Jól írom?
description:
Tíz helyesírási kérdés minden napra, és minden válasz után megtudod, miért úgy helyes.

HAT TÉMAKÖR
• j vagy ly
• Hosszú vagy rövid? – ékezetek és hosszú mássalhangzók
• Egybe vagy külön?
• -ba vagy -ban?
• Vessző
• Kis- vagy nagybetű?

NÉGYFÉLE KÉRDÉS
• Válaszd ki a helyes alakot
• Egészítsd ki a mondatot
• Koppints a hibás szóra
• Tedd ki a vesszőket a mondatban

MINDEN NAP
• Éjfélkor tíz új kérdés, mindenkinek ugyanaz
• Sorozat, ha minden nap megoldod
• A nap szava a kezdőképernyőn
• Megosztható eredmény, amely nem árulja el a válaszokat

GYAKORLÁS
• Tíz kérdés egy választott témakörből, bármikor
• Hibáim: újra azok a kérdések, amelyeket elrontottál
• Témakörönkénti statisztika: mit tudsz már biztosan

MEGBÍZHATÓ
Minden kérdés A magyar helyesírás szabályai 12. kiadására (AkH. 12) épül, és a magyarázat alatt ott a szabálypont is. A -ba/-ban témakör nyelvhelyességi szakirodalomra támaszkodik.

KÉNYELMESEN
• A félbehagyott kvíz megvár
• Internet nélkül is működik
• Sötét mód, nagy betűk, halk hangok és kikapcsolható rezgés
• Választható napi emlékeztető

Felnőtteknek, akik szeretnének biztosak lenni a dolgukban, és szülőknek, akik a gyerekükkel gyakorolnának.

Ingyenes, alkalmi hirdetéssel két gyakorlókör között, kvíz közben és a napi kvíz után soha. A Hibáim kör egy rövid videóért indul. Egyszeri vásárlással eltűnnek a hirdetések, és ingyenes lesz a Hibáim kör. Nincs fiók, nincs regisztráció.

name: JUVENTUD LATINA TV
description:
¡Conéctate al ritmo de toda una generación con la app oficial de JUVENTUD LATINA TV! Tu espacio definitivo para disfrutar de la mejor música, entretenimiento y transmisiones en vivo que mueven a Latinoamérica y el mundo.

Vive una experiencia multiplataforma con la combinación perfecta entre radio y señal en streaming, diseñada para acompañarte con la máxima calidad de audio y video. con esta aplicación puedes escuchar emisora en vivo con audio continuo y acceder a las redes sociales.

name: Karanfil Mutfak
description:
Karanfil Mutfak is a warm kitchen companion that helps you decide what to cook with what you already have. It knows what is in your kitchen, helps you waste less, keeps your shopping in order, and cooks with you step by step alongside Grandma Saniye.

STOCK YOUR KITCHEN
• Snap your fridge or a grocery receipt; items are added to your kitchen and you just check them.
• Scan a barcode, say it out loud or type it. Adding the same item again merges the amounts.
• Separate fridge, freezer and pantry, with reminders before things expire.

WHAT SHOULD I COOK?
• "Find recipes with what I have": Turkish recipes based on your kitchen, your servings, time and diet, and the foods you avoid.
• Grandma's notebook: 83 classic recipes that work offline, with the ones you can make right now on top.
• Quick ideas for breakfast, for guests, or let Saniye pick.
• Add recipes from a link, from text or from a photo of a cookbook page.

COOK STEP BY STEP
• Cooking mode: big step text, the screen stays on, timers for the times in each step, and steps read aloud if you like.
• Change servings and the amounts adjust; see approximate calories and nutrients per serving.
• Tap "I cooked it" and the ingredients you used come off your kitchen.

PLAN AND SHOP
• Weekly menu plan; add the week's missing ingredients to your shopping list in one tap.
• Shopping list grouped by aisle; move what you bought into your kitchen.
• Seasonal calendar: what's plentiful and cheap at the market this month.
• Budget: keep an eye on your weekly kitchen spending.

FOR THE FAMILY
• Family kitchen: share your kitchen and shopping list with your household using an invite code.
• Save everyone's allergies and dislikes; suggestions respect them.

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your kitchen and preferences stay on your phone.
• AI features only run after you agree, and the app and privacy policy say exactly what is sent where.
• AI can make mistakes: if you have an allergy, always check ingredients and package labels yourself.

Available in Turkish and English.

name: KataPose: Photo Pose & Film
description:
Feeling stiff in front of the lens, or unsure how to frame natural portraits for your partner, friends, or travel companions?

KataPose brings together pre-shoot scene lighting plans, live camera contour overlays with calm offline voice direction, and an on-device analog film darkroom in one warm, distraction-free photography workspace.

What You Can Do:

1. 108 Curated Portrait Poses Across 34 Real-World Scenes
- Explore 108 watercolor-illustrated poses across 34 everyday scenarios including Seaside Cafe, Golden-Hour Reeds, Sweet Couple, Bestie Bench, Glamping Tent, Vinyl Bookstore, Cat Window, Campus Graduation, Bridal Veil, and Editorial Studio.
- Review overhead lighting diagrams, phone zoom recommendations (1x Wide / 2x Portrait / 3x Close), and prop ideas before shooting.
- Tap "Show Pose" to display a full-screen visual cue card from across the room—then match the silhouette in camera in seconds.

2. Live Optical Portrait Viewfinder
- Frame shots naturally with three live camera guides: clean portrait contour lines, adjustable onion-skin reference overlays, and a golden spiral composition grid.
- Mirror any pose horizontally in one tap to match left- or right-side window light on location.
- Check live device horizon tilt, tap to place a focus reticle, and shoot with a hands-free countdown timer.

3. 3 Offline Voice Director Personas & Field Q&A
- Choose from three calm spoken personas (Linxi, Luchuan, and Xiaoman) for gentle, natural audio prompts that help subjects relax their shoulders, hands, and gaze—even offline with no cell signal.
- Search practical portrait fixes for harsh midday sun, backlit silhouettes, or awkward hands.

4. On-Device Film Darkroom & Gallery EXIF Borders
- Import existing portraits directly from your photo library for side-by-side culling and star ratings.
- Apply 6 analog-inspired film curves—from warm daylight negative and amber gold to classic silver-halide monochrome—with fine Kelvin temperature and pixel-level film grain controls.
- Frame finished selects with clean Gallery EXIF white borders featuring customizable titles, focal metadata, and studio signatures, ready to save in full resolution.

Local-First Privacy:
- Live camera feeds and imported Darkroom photos are processed 100% locally in on-device memory and sandbox storage; your personal photos are never uploaded to external servers, with zero third-party ad SDKs.
- Starter poses, full-screen cue cards, offline voice coaching, and darkroom previews work immediately with no account required. Optional creator email sign-in syncs only your saved pose bookmarks and shot lists, and you can delete your cloud account anytime in three steps under Me -> Privacy & Data.

Pay Once, Own Forever — Free Tier, 3-Day Cardless Trial & One-Time Lifetime Unlock:
- Download free to use starter portrait poses, full-screen model cue cards, foundational film presets, and live gallery border previews.
- New users can activate a 3-day full-feature free trial with no payment card required—when the trial ends, the app reverts cleanly to Free mode and never auto-renews.
- Upgrade once to optional KataPose Pro Lifetime Edition (cn.lenscript.katapose.pro.lifetime; exact regional price shown in-app) with zero recurring monthly or annual fees to permanently own all 108 poses, 34 scene blueprints, pro film LUTs, watermark-free HD Gallery EXIF exports, and all 3 voice coaching personas, with Restore Purchases across devices on the same store platform.

name: Keeper's Log
description:
Ibn Khaldun kept one lighthouse for thirty-eight years. Then they took the lens away, and with nothing to tend, his mind went back to Isfahan, and to Ghazal, the woman who married a prince instead of a poor scribe with a guitar.

Under the boathouse floor he finds a logbook: a thousand lighthouses around the world, every one of them dark. So he takes the old tender and goes to light them, one at a time, to keep from remembering.

SEARCH BY LANTERN
Land at night and sweep your lantern over the rock. Tools, keepsakes, bottles and old letters glint in the dark.

MEND IT WITH YOUR HANDS
Scrub soot, scrape rust, chip ice, saw timber, haul casks, fit stones and polish the lens. Every job has its own feel in your fingers, with haptics designed for each one. Pinch to look closer whenever you like.

LIGHT IT AGAIN
Climb the tower, set the lens and strike the lamp. Watch the beam come round over the water for the first time in years, then stamp the light into the Keeper's Log.

A THOUSAND REAL LIGHTHOUSES
Bell Rock, Eddystone, Fastnet, Cape Hatteras and nearly a thousand more, in six seas, with their real names, places, years and light patterns. Every light also has its own invented story, told around the real facts.

HIS STORY, AND HERS
Between the lights, Ibn Khaldun writes about Ghazal: the garden, the bridge of thirty-three arches, the wedding he watched from under an arch. He finally sends her a letter, and in time she writes back. Keep going, and at the thousandth light she is waiting at the foot of the tower.

A VOYAGE WITH MILESTONES
Each of the six seas has its own milestones, with a painted scene and an honour when you have kept its lights, and old friends turn up along the way: the Board's inspector, a carpet trader with news of Isfahan, a girl who collects postmarks, a lifeboat coxswain and a young keeper learning the trade. Now and then a night is different, with a storm to keep the lamp burning through, a boat in trouble, or the northern lights over the tower.

A HOME TO COME BACK TO
Everything you find on the rocks comes home to Cape Sable, where room by room it puts Ibn Khaldun's old cottage right again.

TAKE A BREAK
Put the tools down. Play the guitar, sing an old song, cook supper, fish off the rocks, find the old guiding stars, or just watch the sea.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
Open the book and the lighthouse fills both pages: the outside on one, the inside on the other. Closed, the side rail holds every control so the art gets the whole screen.

CALM BY DESIGN
There are no timers to race and no adverts to sit through, and you will never be asked to make an account, buy anything, or hand over a single piece of personal data. If you pause to wonder what comes next, a gentle hand appears to show the way, and every step you take is saved as you go, so you can set the game down at any moment and pick it up again exactly where you left it.

name: Kvasir Pro
description:
Appreciate you choosing this app; every comment you share steers our next round of polish.

YOUR RAIL, AT A GLANCE

- Ticker: US equity quotes you can refresh and open
- Ledger: paper positions, fills, and history
- Post: Favorites, Simulator, Support, Feedback, Privacy, and Terms

PLACE A PAPER ORDER IN SECONDS

- Limits stay visible so you stay inside today's rail
- Review the fill on Ledger, then try a paper exit when you are ready

A RHYTHM FOR PRACTICE

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: La Caisse – Group Kitty
description:

• One kitty for everyone, shared by link via WhatsApp, Messages or mail
• Tap the plus to add an expense, the amount is ready at once
• Families count by their size, children less than adults
• Drinks can be split separately

• Readable offline; entries made offline are sent later
• No account, no sign-up, no ads

La Caisse never holds money. You pay each other directly; the app only shows who owes whom.

name: La Masă: Cards, Table & Remi
description:
La Masă brings the games of a Romanian family table online: Macao, Șeptică, Whist, Rentz, Table (backgammon) and Remi.

SEVEN GAMES
• Macao (2 to 4 players): 2s, 3s, jokers and the dreaded last card. Be the first out of cards.
• Șeptică (2 to 4, four as two teams): cut with the seven, collect the aces and tens.
• Whist (3 to 6): say how many tricks you will take, then take exactly those.
• Rentz (3 to 6): eight games in one, each player chooses each game once.
• Table (2 players): backgammon, the Romanian way, with the marț.
• Remi etalat (2 to 4): tile rummy, melds laid on the table, 45 points to open.
• Remi pe tablă (2 to 4): nothing is laid; close when your whole rack stands in melds.

PLAY HOW YOU LIKE
• Quick game: pick a game and sit down at once with whoever is waiting. Robots fill the empty seats, so you never wait long.
• Table for friends: share a four-letter code, add robots if you are short of players, and start.
• No account, no sign-up, no ads. Type a name and play.

A LEAGUE, RANKS AND FRIENDS
• A weekly league: a point for every game, three for a win, twice that with people at the table. A new week starts every Monday.
• A rank for each game, which moves only in games against people.
• Friends: add them with a six-letter code or from the people you just played with, see who is online, and call them to your table.

FREE TO START, THEN ONE SUBSCRIPTION
• Your first 3 days are free: every game, every table, no payment, no sign-up.
• Then one subscription opens every game, monthly, with 7 more days free for new subscribers. The price in your currency is shown before you subscribe.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

MADE FOR PLAYING ON A PHONE
• A clock for every turn. If your time runs out, a robot plays that turn for you, and after two missed turns it keeps playing until you are back.
• Lose your connection and your seat is kept: reconnect and you are back at the table.
• In English and in Romanian, following your phone's language.

La Masă is played for fun only: no bets and no prizes. The only purchase is the subscription.

Privacy policy: https://mcnunited.ro/lamasa/privacy/

name: Lantern Alley: Wire Puzzle
description:

· Turn goal: fewer turns earn more stars.
· Lantern string: each day you light all three of today's alleys, a lantern is hung on a calendar-style string.
· Free alleys: a practice mode whose alleys grow up to 6×8 as you climb levels.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in, and it works offline.

name: Lasimu – Alcohol Delivery
description:
Lasimu brings wine, beer and spirits to your door in Erbil. Lasimu is for adults only.

Pay the rider in cash when your order arrives. No card needed.

CLEAR PRICES
Once your address is saved, you see the delivery fee for your area and how much more you need for free delivery. When a bottle is on sale, the old price is shown struck through, and your basket shows what you save.

KNOW WHERE YOUR ORDER IS
Follow each step of your order. When a rider has it, you can see them on the map and call or message them. You can also chat with the shop about your order.

EVERY ORDER IS HANDED TO AN ADULT
Our rider checks ID at the door. We never leave drinks outside.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Browse by category or by brand: wine, whisky, beer, vodka, gin, mixers and more
- Search, with your recent searches saved
- Read about each bottle: strength, where it is from, and tasting notes and how it is made where we have them
- See any sale that is on, and Mix & save deals
- Ask our drinks concierge: tap a few answers about the occasion, your mood, the tastes you like and your budget, and get a bottle pick, another option and one step up
- Save your addresses with their place on the map
- Pay cash on delivery
- Follow your order live and contact your rider
- Chat with the shop for help
- Earn rewards points and move up the tiers
- Spend wallet credit at checkout
- Invite a friend: when their first order is delivered, you get credit
- Get order updates by notification, if you allow them
- Use the app in English, Arabic or Kurdish (Sorani)
- Delete your account in the app at any time

EASY SIGN-IN
You can look around as a guest first. To order, sign in with your phone number and a code sent by WhatsApp, or with a password once you set one.

18+ ONLY
You must be of legal drinking age to use Lasimu. We ask for your date of birth when you sign up. Our riders can refuse an order if the customer looks underage or has had too much to drink.

Delivery is inside our Erbil delivery zones.

Questions? Chat with us in the app or write to support@lasimu.com.

For adults 18+. Please drink responsibly.

name: LeatherRepairLedger
description:
LeatherRepairLedger "is a quiet and meticulous place dedicated to the thing you carry with you every day but rarely take it seriously. The aging process of wallets is very unique: the lines at the bends will loosen first, the edges will start to fuzz, and the areas that often rub against the pockets will gradually become thinner. Most people noticed it at the time and thought of dealing with it another day until the seam completely cracked open before remembering. This application is prepared for the moment before cracking.

You just need to take note of what happened and on which day it happened. Select the wallet, mark the repair date, write down what was done at that time, and if willing, leave a photo as proof. After a few months, these entries will become something you didn't expect: a history of small care and a clear picture of which wallets always have recurring problems and which just naturally come to an end.

Statistics make this history truly useful. You can see the distribution of repairs in different months of the year, which type of damage occurs the most, the approximate severity, and the differences between several wallets. When you find that the same corner cracks every spring, or that a wallet has been repaired six times in two years, whether to "continue repairing" or "replace it" is no longer a decision based on intuition.

This is a small tool designed for those who would rather fix it than throw it away, as well as for those who want to know when they last started.

name: Lifespan Timer: Habit Clock
description:
How much time do you have left to spend with the people you love?

Lifespan Timer looks up the average life expectancy for your age and sex in the U.S. Social Security Administration Period Life Table (2023), adjusts it for your usual habits, and estimates your remaining time. Then your daily logs show how much that time grew or shrank today.

[The clock]
- Shows a date like "Until Jun 2, 2066" plus the years, days, hours, minutes and seconds left.
- Put a photo of someone you love behind the clock. The photo stays on your device.
- On days the number feels heavy, switch to "Show only time gained today" to hide the remaining time.

[Today's change]
- Log smoking, alcohol (soju, beer, wine, makgeolli, whisky), exercise, fruits and vegetables, sitting and leisure screen time, red and processed meat, sleep and weight.
- Compared with your usual habits, see the minutes reclaimed or lost today.
- Daily changes are capped at plus or minus 120 minutes so one day never looks exaggerated.

[Actions for right now]
- Get suggestions you can do right away, like "10-min walk = about 30 min". Tap one and it is added to today's log.
- Optional morning summary, action and evening notifications (local notifications on your device).

[Health sync]
- Only if you turn it on, reads steps, workout time, sleep and weight from Apple Health on iPhone.
- Read only. The app never writes to your health data.

[Share card]
- Save or share an image of the time you reclaimed this week.
- The card never includes your name or birth date.

[Sources in the open]
- See the life table source and the studies and evidence grade behind every habit inside the app.

[Privacy]
- No account and no server. Everything you enter stays on your device.
- Delete all data at once from the Sources tab.

[Price]
- Every feature is free. A banner ad (Google AdMob) is shown at the bottom of the screen.

[Please note]
- This app shows a reference estimate based on average life expectancy from the U.S. Social Security Administration Period Life Table (2023) and population averages from lifestyle studies. It does not predict or diagnose actual lifespan.
- This product is not a medical device and cannot determine the presence of disease. Consult a physician before making health decisions.
- Not for users under 14.

Privacy policy: https://pb.soloflux.net/lifespan-timer/privacy.html

name: LumiPOS - Quản lý quán cafe
description:
MorningPOS là app bán hàng cho quán cà phê, quán ăn, nhà hàng: gọi món tại bàn, gửi phiếu xuống bếp, thu tiền và xem doanh thu ngay trên iPhone, iPad.

Bán hàng tại bàn và mang về
• Sơ đồ bàn theo khu vực: thấy bàn nào có khách, ngồi bao lâu, đang tạm tính bao nhiêu.
• Thực đơn theo nhóm, có ảnh món, topping, ghi chú cho từng món, báo hết món.
• Chuyển bàn, tạm tính, giảm giá theo số tiền hoặc phần trăm.
• Lưu đơn là món mới xuống bếp; trả món, hủy món sau khi đã báo bếp đều được ghi nhật ký.

Thu tiền
• Tiền mặt, chuyển khoản bằng mã QR của quán, hoặc kết hợp cả hai.
• Kết nối 9Check để tự báo khi tiền chuyển khoản đã về tài khoản quán.
• In hóa đơn, phiếu tạm tính qua máy in mạng LAN / Wi-Fi, mẫu in quán tự thiết kế.

Bếp và quầy pha chế
• Màn hình bếp ngay trên điện thoại, máy tính bảng: món mới hiện lên, làm xong bấm Xong, mang ra bấm Đã ra.
• Phiếu chế biến in theo nhóm món ra đúng máy in bếp, quầy bar.

Quản lý quán
• Tổng quan doanh thu trong ngày; báo cáo bán hàng theo ngày, theo món, theo nhóm, theo thu ngân; lãi lỗ, xuất nhập tồn, sổ quỹ.
• Mở ca, kết ca, đếm tiền mặt cuối ca.
• Hàng hóa, nhập hàng, xuất hàng, tồn kho, báo hàng sắp hết.
• Thu chi, khách hàng, nhà cung cấp, công nợ nhà cung cấp.
• Tài khoản nhân viên theo nhóm quyền: chủ đầu tư, quản lý, giám sát, order, thu ngân.
• Chấm công nhân viên.
• Một chuỗi nhiều cửa hàng, mỗi cửa hàng có thực đơn, bàn, kho riêng.

Dùng chung với web
App dùng chung tài khoản và dữ liệu với MorningPOS trên web (morning.9id.vn): đơn gọi trên iPhone hiện ở máy tính quầy và ngược lại. Cần có tài khoản cửa hàng MorningPOS; chủ quán đăng ký trên web rồi tạo tài khoản cho nhân viên trong app.

name: Maatha Pachchi
description:
Maatha Pachchi is the desi forehead game for family nights, house parties, shaadi functions and long train rides.

One person holds the phone sideways on their forehead, screen facing the room. Everyone else gives clues: describe it, act it out without a word, or hum the tune. Guessed it? Tilt the phone down for सही (sahi). Stuck? Tilt it up to pass. Beat the clock, then hand the phone to the next player.

18 DESI DECKS, 1,300+ CARDS
• Bollywood Blockbusters, Filmy Sitaare and Dialogue Baazi
• Gaana Gaao: hum it, whistle it, no lyrics allowed
• Hook Steps and Desi Dumb Charades: act it out, no talking
• Desi Khana, Shaadi Season, Desi Ghar & Parents
• Desi Slang & Hinglish, Muhavare
• Cricket Fever, Tyohaar, Myths & Folk Tales
• TV & OTT, 90s Kids, Bharat Darshan, Desi Brands & Ads
• Masala Mix shuffles every deck together

MAKE IT YOUR GAME
• Apna Deck: type your own cards, from inside jokes to family nicknames
• Choose cards: switch off any card you never want to see
• Rounds of 30 seconds, 60 seconds, 90 seconds or 2 minutes
• Menus in English or Hindi
• Holi morning (light) and Diwali night (dark) looks, following your phone or set in Settings

PLAY WITH THE WHOLE GROUP
• Add players to keep score across rounds, with a leaderboard and a winner at the end
• Optional candid photos: the front camera snaps the clue-givers mid-act for a highlight reel when the game ends. Photos stay in the phone's memory and are gone when you close the app. It's off until you turn it on.
• Haptics on every answer, and the screen stays awake during a round

TILT OR TAP
Tilt down for sahi and up to pass, with no setup. Prefer buttons? Turn off Tilt controls in Settings and tap Pass or सही on screen.

FREE, PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no sign-up. The game doesn't collect any data, and everything you save (players, scores, your own decks) stays on your phone. It works with no internet, so it's ready on a flight, in the mountains or at Nani's house.

House rule: a Hindi, English or Hinglish guess counts, as long as it gets the scene. Anyone can pass.

Made with love for desi families everywhere.

name: Mandkhuur

YOUR BOOKINGS

SAFE COMMUNITY

Available in Mongolian, Korean and English, with light and dark mode. Payment for the live performance is arranged directly with our team after your booking is confirmed (KakaoPay, Toss or bank transfer).

name: Markets by FurtherMarkets

Intelligence on emerging and frontier markets: business and investment intelligence on 40 countries across Africa, the Gulf, Asia and Latin America, from FurtherMarkets' own desks: FurtherAfrica, FurtherArabia, FurtherAsia and FurtherBrazil.

name: Maruhide Smash King
description:
A side-scrolling brawler where you punch your way through the city. Smash buildings as you walk right, knock out the enemies in your way, and beat the boss waiting at the end of each stage.

HOW TO PLAY
Use the stick at the bottom left to walk, jump and crouch, and the buttons at the bottom right to punch and to unleash your Super.
Read the cues: enemies show an arrow before they attack. ↑ means jump, ↓ means crouch, ← means step back. The arrow turns from yellow to red, and they strike when it is red. You can turn the cues off in Settings.
Keep punching: landing punches in a row chains into a combo of jab, body blow and uppercut.
Fill the gauge to unleash your Super.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 10 stages, 30 levels: downtown, a snowy hot-spring town, an amusement park, an old castle town, a future city, desert ruins, a seaside resort, a volcano zone, a snowy mountain fortress and a space station. A boss waits at the third level of every stage.
- Every level is ranked S to C.
- 63 titles, an 87-entry Collection and daily Missions.
- Wrecked buildings and beaten enemies give you cash. Spend it on HP, Punch Power, Super and more.
- Clear all 30 levels to unlock the tougher "Brutal" mode.

NOTES
- Free to play. No in-app purchases. The app shows ads (a banner at the top of the screen, and a full-screen ad when a level ends).
- No account needed. Progress is saved on your device only.
- All people, groups and buildings in the game are fictional.
- Some images were created or edited with Grok (Created with Grok).
- Available in Japanese, English and Traditional Chinese (follows the device language).

name: MaxCurve Pro
description:
用曲线和图层调整照片色调，完成从基础调色到局部编辑的工作。

• 使用 RGB、CMYK、HSL、Lab 和明度曲线调整色彩。
• 通过图层、混合模式和蒙版进行局部调整。
• 导入系统支持的 RAW 照片，调整显影参数。
• 裁切、旋转、添加文字水印，并以 JPEG、PNG 或 TIFF 导出。
• 通过局域网连接 Photoshop，发送照片或接收文档缩略图。

照片在设备上处理。RAW 支持取决于设备和系统；Photoshop 连接需要在电脑上启用远程连接。

name: MCT Timeline
description:
MCT Timeline is an unofficial, independent fan-made chronological watch order guide for the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and interconnected superhero movies, series, and specials. Browse every title in narrative order (by when events happen in the story) or by theatrical release order.

FEATURES
- 132+ titles with release date and narrative placement
- Narrative order that puts every continuity on a single timeline
- Lane graph connecting titles of the same group by Earth, phase, or franchise
- Mark what you have already watched and keep your favorites
- Progress statistics: titles and hours watched, remaining runtime, breakdown by type, phase, and saga
- Search and filters by franchise and content type
- Spoiler notes and post-credit scenes kept separate from the plot, hidden until you open them
- Interface in 9 languages (English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese)
- Exportable data backup to move to another phone

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-up required and no advertising. Your progress stays on your device and is never sent to anyone.

Unofficial fan-made reference app. Not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Marvel Studios, Disney, or TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

name: MeeM
description:
MeeM giúp bạn hiểu mình hơn qua hệ thống Enneagram – 9 kiểu tính cách, mỗi kiểu có động lực, nỗi sợ và cách lớn lên riêng.

BÀI NHANH (2 PHÚT)
Trả lời vài câu ngắn, MeeM dự đoán ba kiểu gần bạn nhất.

BÀI KỸ (KHOẢNG 8 PHÚT)
Chấm mức độ giống mình cho từng câu để phân xử giữa các kiểu và tìm ra cánh của bạn. Làm dở cũng được, câu đã chấm được giữ trên máy.

CHÂN DUNG TÍNH CÁCH
Mỗi kiểu có một bản chân dung: điều thúc đẩy bạn, điểm mạnh, chỗ dễ vấp, khi căng thẳng, khi bạn tốt lên, và những việc nên thử.

KHÔNG CẦN TÀI KHOẢN
Mở app là làm được ngay. Xem lại hoặc xoá kết quả bất cứ lúc nào trong mục Hồ sơ.

Kết quả để tham khảo và tự hiểu mình, không phải chẩn đoán tâm lý.

name: Memoro - シンプルなメモ帳
description:
思いついたら、すぐメモ。

Memoro は、開いたらすぐ書ける・話せる、シンプルなメモ帳です。

■ 話すだけでメモになる
マイクを押して話すと、その場で文字になります。声は iPhone の中で文字にして、録音は残しません。

■ アクションボタンから、すぐ声でメモ
iPhone のアクションボタンに入れておけば、押すだけで録音が始まります。アクションボタンがない iPhone は、コントロールセンターにボタンを置けます。

■ 開いたら、白い紙
アプリを開くと、すぐ書けます。保存のボタンはありません。書くたびに、自動で保存されます。

■ フォルダとタグ
メモはフォルダに分けて、タグを付けられます。一覧では、フォルダとタグで絞りこんだり、文字でさがしたりできます。

■ ピン留め
忘れたくないメモは、ピン留めすると、ロック画面に出しておけます。

■ メモは iPhone の中だけ
アカウントの登録はいりません。メモは iPhone の中だけに保存されます。全部のメモを、まとめて書き出すこともできます。

name: MendMemoJournal
description:
MendMemoJournal is a pocket sized clothing repair file.

Every piece of clothing has its own experiences: worn cuffs, torn knees, and loose buttons. Sewing notes leave these traces along with the date, location, stitch technique, and thread color, so that the next time you pick up a needle or thread, you don't have to recall where it was last patched from memory.

It does not urge you, nor does it evaluate whether you have made up for it well or not. You just need to take a few seconds to jot down a stroke after sewing it together; Over time, these scattered records will connect to the complete experience of a piece of clothing, as well as the changes in your own craftsmanship.

Suitable for people who like to do it themselves, as well as those who entrust clothes to tailors and want to leave a receipt.

name: Mikai
description:
Mikai is your AI agent dashboard for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo: see live what your AI chats and coding agents are doing, what needs you and how much of your usage limit is left. Free, no account and no ads.

Running several AIs at once – a coding agent in the terminal, a deep research in the browser, a chat on your phone? Mikai brings them together and tells you the moment something is done or needs you.

AT A GLANCE
• Running, Waiting, New: three numbers show you where you're needed.
• "For you" first: anything waiting for your approval sits on top – with the AI's question.
• A page for every AI: swipe left to your AIs, each with its own list.
• One tap: open the chat on your Mac, in the browser or right in the app.

LIMITS IN VIEW
See how much of your 5-hour and weekly limit is used – before you get cut off mid-task.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT DON'T NAG
Mikai only speaks up when an AI needs you, finishes or hits a limit. The lock screen shows the AI and its state, never your content. Plus widgets and a badge for open items.

HOW YOUR TASKS GET TO MIKAI
• Free helper for Mac: reports coding agents from terminal and editor, and with the browser extension your web chats too.
• iPhone only: sign in to your AIs inside Mikai – no computer needed.
• Share: send a chat link to Mikai from the share sheet.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Mikai has no server and no account. Everything syncs through your private iCloud between your own devices. No ads, no tracking.

Mikai is an independent tool and is not affiliated with the providers of the supported AI services. All trademarks belong to their owners.

name: MindSongDiary
description:
ฟังเพลง ฟังใจตัวเอง

เพลงแทนใจ (MindSongDiary) คือสมุดบันทึกเพลงที่คุณฟังและความรู้สึกที่เพลงพาไป เลือกเพลงหนึ่งเพลง บันทึกว่าเพลงนั้นทำให้รู้สึกอย่างไร แล้วย้อนดูได้ว่าเพลงของคุณพาอารมณ์แบบไหนมาบ้าง

บันทึกบทเพลง
• วันที่ฟัง ชื่อเพลง ศิลปิน และลิงก์เพลง
• ใส่รูปประกอบได้ถ้าต้องการ
• ให้คะแนนระดับความพอใจและระดับความตื่นตัวของอารมณ์ขณะนี้ ตั้งแต่ −10 ถึง 10
• เลือกอารมณ์ (กระปรี้กระเปร่า ชิว ซึม หรือวิตกกังวล) และคำที่ตรงกับใจ
• บอกว่าเพลงนี้ทำให้คุณ อ่อนไหว ซึ้งใจ เบิกบานใจ หรือมีกำลังใจ
• เขียนสิ่งที่อยากบอก เช่น ความคิด ท่อนเพลงที่ชอบ หรือความทรงจำ
• ดูสรุปบันทึกบนแผนภาพอารมณ์สองแกนก่อนบันทึก

ย้อนดู
• ค้นหาบันทึก กรองตามอารมณ์หรือลักษณะเพลง และเรียงตามวันที่
• หน้าเท่าทันอารมณ์แสดงเพลย์ลิสต์ของคุณ จำนวนครั้งของแต่ละอารมณ์ และสิ่งที่คุณเคยบอก

แชร์
• ทำบันทึกเป็นรูปการ์ดเพื่อแชร์หรือบันทึกรูป

เป็นส่วนตัว
• ไม่ต้องสมัครหรือสร้างบัญชี
• บันทึกเก็บในเครื่องของคุณ แอปไม่ส่งบันทึกให้ใคร
• ย้ายไปเครื่องใหม่ได้ด้วยการส่งออกไฟล์สำรองแล้วนำเข้าในเครื่องใหม่ ไฟล์นี้ไม่ได้เข้ารหัส ควรเก็บไว้ในที่ปลอดภัย

name: mockingbird-ai
description:
Mockingbird puts the things you reach for at home on one calm screen: your lights, plugs, switches, weather and music.

LIGHTS, PLUGS AND SWITCHES
Find Kasa (TP-Link) plugs, wall switches and lights on your Wi-Fi. Turn them on and off, dim the lights, and run All On, Bright, Evening and All Off in one tap.

WEATHER AND MUSIC
See local weather at a glance, control Apple Music, and choose which speaker plays.

VOICE
Tap the orb and ask for what you need, like turning on a light or checking the weather.

TRY IT FIRST
A built-in demo mode fills the dashboard with sample devices, so you can explore every control before you connect anything.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your settings stay on your device. Lights and plugs are controlled directly over your home Wi-Fi.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
On a phone the dashboard puts lights and plugs first. On an iPad it spreads into columns, in portrait or landscape. Day and night themes, Fahrenheit or Celsius, and optional Face ID before turning everything off.

Kasa and TP-Link are trademarks of TP-Link. Apple Music is a trademark of Apple Inc. Mockingbird is not affiliated with or endorsed by these companies.

name: Morlunet Play
description:
Открывайте бережно. Оставляйте место для возвращения.

Morlunet Play — пространственная головоломка о деревянных планках, свободном месте и поиске нового пути назад. Сдвигайте каждую планку вдоль её направляющей. Используйте доступные места за рамкой, чтобы добраться до фигурки цвета слоновой кости.

Достать фигурку — лишь половина задачи. В более сложных головоломках после её извлечения смещается видимый ограничитель. Верните планки через те же края, через которые они вышли, и найдите раскладку, позволяющую закрыть шкатулку.

ПЯТНАДЦАТЬ ГОЛОВОЛОМОК, ТРИ СЕРИИ
Исследуйте пересекающиеся планки, мостики и всё более сложные пути возвращения. Выбирайте любую головоломку в каталоге. В основной игре нет таймера и счётчика жизней.

СНАЧАЛА ПОСМОТРИТЕ ХОД
Играйте быстрыми ходами или включите предварительный просмотр каждого действия. Полупрозрачная планка показывает новое положение до подтверждения. Стрелки входа, отметки закрытия и подсветка столкновений помогают разобраться в поле. Отмените ход, начните заново или запросите подсказку для текущей раскладки.

МАСТЕРСКАЯ, В КОТОРУЮ МОЖНО ВЕРНУТЬСЯ
Подтверждённые ходы сохраняются на устройстве. Оставьте незавершённую головоломку и продолжите позже. Храните завершённые маршруты, просматривайте их по шагам и сравнивайте свои лучшие результаты по числу ходов. Открывайте недавние маршруты, лучший маршрут каждой головоломки или всю коллекцию.

МАЛЕНЬКИЕ ПОБЕДЫ НА ПАМЯТЬ
Поделитесь изображением фигурки через системное меню. Удаляйте отдельные сохранённые маршруты или очищайте локальный прогресс в настройках.

Авторские многослойные иллюстрации и необязательная музыка создают атмосферу маленькой мастерской. При первом запуске музыка и звуковые эффекты выключены. Их можно включить в настройках.

Интерфейс игры — на английском языке. Прогресс основных головоломок хранится на устройстве. Для выполнения атрибуции AppsFlyer система может запросить разрешение на отслеживание. Отказ не ограничивает функции основной игры.

name: Motion Piano: Watch & iPhone
description:
Motion Piano

Knock the desk. Play the piano. Motion Piano turns Apple Watch and iPhone into one offline piano: advance notes by knocking on your Watch while iPhone shows falling rhythm bars and judgments—or play only on iPhone, free-play the keyboard, or write Jianpu scores. No account, subscription, or network required. Open and play.

【Who it’s for】
- Anyone who wants rhythmic play and casual practice with Apple Watch
- Parents and kids enjoying children’s songs, folk tunes, and simple classical themes
- Learners who want offline Jianpu study, composing, and piano preview

【Core play: Watch knock + phone rhythm】
1. On iPhone Home, pick a song and tap Send to Apple Watch
2. Keep Motion Piano open on iPhone
3. On Watch, select the song and tap Play to start the countdown
4. After the countdown, lightly knock the desk while wearing the Watch (or tap the mini keyboard) to advance each note
5. iPhone opens the rhythm screen: bars fall to the judge line in sync with Watch hits, with judgment, score, and combo

In Watch Settings, adjust knock sensitivity, run calibration, and toggle haptics so different desks and wear styles feel right.

【Full experience on iPhone alone】
- Phone Play: play on the rhythm screen without sending to Watch
- Any Key / Find the Key: practice timing or pitch recognition
- Demo: hear the full rhythm before you play
- Free piano: tap the Home piano image for virtual piano anytime

【Library and Create】
- Built-in Jianpu covers children’s songs, folk and classical themes, plus five-finger, scale, and skip exercises
- Music browses built-in pieces and My Creations; details support preview, send to Watch, or phone play
- Create with solfege 1–7, letter names, or piano recording; import existing scores too
- Jianpu is movable-do: 1 is the tonic of the current key; save and preview on piano when done

【Why Motion Piano】
- Two-device play: Watch drives hits and note advance; iPhone handles visuals, audio feedback, and scoring—not a simple remote
- Truly offline: scores, sounds, and progress stay on device—no ads, accounts, or cloud sync
- Piano tone: FluidR3 piano soundfont for practice and casual listening
- Clear notices: in-app how-to, music copyright notice, and soundfont license

【Tips】
- Keep Motion Piano open on iPhone while playing on Watch so hits sync and the rhythm screen can open
- Watch and iPhone sync scores and hit events over system connectivity; continuous audio is not streamed
- Full steps: Mine → How to Use

Piano on your wrist and in your pocket—pick a song, knock once, and the melody begins.

name: Ñandu Go
description:
ÑanduGo es la app chilena para pedir viajes, fletes y encomiendas, y para trabajar como conductor.

PASAJEROS
• Pide un viaje, un flete o el envío de una encomienda indicando origen y destino.
• Conductores cercanos te ofertan y tú eliges la oferta que prefieras.
• Agrega paradas intermedias a tu recorrido.
• Sigue el viaje en el mapa en tiempo real y comparte el recorrido.
• Habla con tu conductor por chat o por llamada, sin mostrar tu número.
• Paga en efectivo, con Mercado Pago o con tu tarjeta inscrita.
• Revisa tu historial de viajes y tus comprobantes.

CONDUCTORES
• Conéctate para recibir solicitudes cercanas y envía tus ofertas.
• Navega hasta el pasajero y hasta el destino.
• Revisa tus ganancias del día, la semana y el mes.
• Elige cada día cómo pagar la comisión: monto fijo por jornada o porcentaje por viaje.
• Carga tus documentos y los de tu vehículo desde la app.

PROPIETARIOS
• Administra tus vehículos y los conductores que los manejan.

Seguridad: botón de ayuda, contactos de confianza y registro de cada viaje. ÑanduGo no reemplaza a los servicios de emergencia: ante una emergencia, llama al 133 (Carabineros) o al 131 (SAMU).

name: Nikofrei: Quit Smoking
description:
Nikofrei helps you quit vapes and cigarettes – right at the moment it gets hard.

The advice in the app is based on studies about quitting. Wherever a statement rests on research, the app shows the source.

WHEN A CRAVING COMES
One tap on “I have a craving” – on the main screen, in the Lock Screen widget or in Control Center. Your own reason appears instantly, in your words and with your photo. Below it, a tool is already running: breathing with a circle that guides you through vibration too, two minutes of movement, a ten-minute delay, “watch the wave”, where you see the craving go down again, or picturing the moment from your reason.

ANSWER THE ADDICTION
“Just one.” “I've earned it.” “Tonight is an exception.” The addiction keeps saying the same sentences. Tap what it is saying right now and you get a clear answer, a small task for the next minute and the reason behind it. Over time you write your own answers.

HONEST WHEN IT HAPPENS
After a slip, the app shows you what you've already achieved and helps you adjust your plan for that moment – no blame, but no sugar-coating either. If slips turn into a relapse, a new attempt begins. Your previous attempt stays visible.

YOUR PLAN
• If-then sentences for your hardest moments: coffee, stress, parties, breaks
• A message to yourself – written on a good day, for a weak minute
• A savings goal with a picture – you see what's left and when you'll get there
• Reminders before your difficult times of day, including the ones the app spots in your entries

YOUR PROGRESS
• How long you've been free, how much you've saved and how many cravings you've beaten
• Milestones from the very first hour
• A journal that almost fills itself, with your curve: how often did cravings come, and how strong?
• An insight card for each of the first 30 days
• Share your milestone as an image with friends

FOR VAPES AND CIGARETTES
Nikofrei calculates for e-cigarettes (in disposables, pods or liquid), cigarettes or both.

No account, no ads.

Nikofrei supports and motivates you. The app is not a medical device and does not replace medical advice.

name: Notebook Putt: Daily Mini Golf
description:
Putt your way through mini golf courses sketched in ballpoint on a notebook page. Drag anywhere to set direction and power, then let go. Bank shots off the walls, slow down in the sand, and if you splash into water you take a one-stroke penalty and replay from your spot. Red bumpers kick the ball back.

▶ Today's 6: every date builds the same six-hole course. A finished round stamps your record calendar alongside a scorecard.
▶ Ladder: an endless climb, one floor per hole, with more turns and ponds the higher you go.
▶ Records: rounds played, best round, holes in one and highest ladder floor on a monthly calendar.
▶ Fair courses: every hole has an open path from tee to cup, and par comes from actually playing the hole. Can't sink it in eight? The ball is picked up and you move on, so you never get stuck.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in, and it works offline.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.

name: Nutrimentrix
description:
Nutrimentrix biedt medewerkers persoonlijke leefstijlcoaching via hun werkgever.

Werk aan wat voor jóu telt — meer energie, minder stress, betere balans of een gezondere routine. Je doet een korte vitaliteitscheck, kiest je eigen coach en plant een gesprek van 25 minuten, via video of telefoon.

• Vitaliteitscheck met een persoonlijk profiel
• Kies je eigen coach en plan gesprekken wanneer het jou uitkomt
• Elke week een korte check-in en een haalbare mini-stap
• Artikelen, recepten en opdrachten van onze coaches
• Herinneringen zodat je geen afspraak mist
• Vertrouwelijk: je werkgever ziet nooit jouw persoonlijke gegevens of of je de dienst gebruikt

Nutrimentrix is beschikbaar voor medewerkers van organisaties met een Nutrimentrix-abonnement. Inloggen kan met het e-mailadres dat bij je werkgever bekend is.

name: OdoTell
description:
OdoTell يجمع كلشي عن سيارتك بمكان واحد، ويفهمك شنو صاير بيها.

افهم العطل
• اكتب كود العطل ويشرحلك معناه وأسبابه الأرجح وخطوات فحصه.
• وصّل قطعة OBD واقرا الأكواد والعدادات الحية وحالة البطارية.
• ما عندك كود؟ اختار الصوت أو الريحة أو لمبة التحذير.
• مخططات تفحص بيها الحساسات والقطع بالملتيميتر.

ورشتك بالتطبيق
• اربط حسابك بورشتك، ومن يطلع عطل توصلها الأكواد وتدزلك سعر متوقع وموعد.
• تصليحاتك وفواتيرك عندها تطلع بسجل سيارتك.
• أنت تختار شنو توصلها، وتگدر تفصلها بأي وقت.

مصاريفك وأوراقك
• البانزين والصيانة والقطع والتأمين، وشكد تكلفك السيارة بالشهر وبالكيلو.
• السنوية والتأمين وإجازة السوق، ويذكّرك قبل ما تخلص.
• ضمان القطع وعمر الإطارات والمخالفات اللي تسجلها أنت.

لسواق التكسي والدلفري
• شفتات وكروات بضغطة، وربحك الصافي بعد البانزين والضمان.

وبعد
• وين صفّيت سيارتك، الرحلات، الإعارة، الفحص قبل الشراء، ورقة البيع، وطلب قطع بالدفع عند الاستلام.
• يشتغل هواية منه بدون إنترنت، وبخمس لغات: العربية والكردية والإنجليزية والفرنسية والإسبانية.

مجاني: ماكو اشتراك ولا دفع داخل التطبيق. بياناتك إلك، وتگدر تحذف حسابك من داخل التطبيق.

قراءة السيارة تحتاج قطعة OBD تنباع وحدها. الشرح والتنبيهات للمساعدة ومو بديل عن الفني. OdoTell تطبيق خاص ومو جهة حكومية.

name: OdrivexaKelsun

name: Open Calls
description:
Open Calls is an assistant that makes your phone calls. Say who to call and what the call is for, and an AI assistant places the call. You follow it as it goes: its words appear on your phone, and if it needs you, it asks.

Three kinds of call:

- Autonomous. The assistant makes the call and does the task for you, such as booking a table or asking about an order, then tells you what came of it.
- Wait & connect. The assistant gets through the menus and the hold music, and brings you onto the call when a person answers.
- Translator. The assistant calls you and the other person, and interprets between you.

On any call you can listen, join, or take over from the assistant.

An AI assistant, and it says so. When someone answers, the assistant says that it is an AI assistant from Open Calls, calling for you by your first name. Anyone it calls can say they do not want calls, and nobody using Open Calls calls that number again.

Your contacts, only when you choose. You can bring contacts in from your phone to pick whom to call. They are kept on your account for your own calls; nobody is contacted from them.

Your calls, kept for you. Each call's words and what came of it are kept in your history until you delete the call or your account. You can download what is kept, or delete your account, from the app.

Calls use minutes, counted from when a call is answered. Minutes and the Plus and Pro plans are bought in the app; minutes you buy do not expire.

You must be 18 or older to use Open Calls. Terms: https://open-calls-simple.fly.dev/terms

name: Pagenib
description:
Pagenib is a fast, straightforward PDF viewer and editor made for people who work with drawings. Open large plan sets, set the scale, and take measurements right on the sheet with your finger.

MEASURE
- Set the scale from standard architectural, engineering and metric scales, or calibrate from a known dimension
- Length, polyline length and area in feet-inches or metric, with a magnifier under your finger
- Snap to line ends and crossings of the drawing for accurate points

MARK UP
- Text boxes, callouts, clouds, highlighter, pen, rectangles, ellipses, lines and arrows
- Colours, line widths and fills; move, resize and edit anything, with undo and redo

FILL & SIGN
- Fill in PDF forms
- Sign with your own digital ID, with a signature picture you draw or take from a photo
- Add today's date

PAGES AND FILES
- Page thumbnails with sheet names; share, save, rotate, flatten or delete pages
- Share a file as it is or as a flattened copy
- Search the text of a PDF
- Print
- Open PDFs from Files, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Mail and other apps, or keep them in Pagenib's folders

SAVES STANDARD PDF
Markups, measurements and scales are saved as standard PDF annotations, so other PDF apps open them and Pagenib on your computer shows them too.

Made for iPhone and iPad, including Split View and Stage Manager on iPad.

Your files stay on your device. Pagenib has no account, no ads and no tracking.

name: Pitanga: cycle & pregnancy
description:
Pitanga is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. For health decisions, talk to a professional.

A place to care for your body at your own pace, with kindness and without judgement.

For your moment
- Cycle: predictions with an honest window, symptoms, mood and patterns.
- Getting pregnant: estimated fertile window, body signs and lightness.
- Pregnancy: week by week, in plain words.
- Perimenopause: diary, timeline and questions for your appointment.

Made with care
- Log what you like. A blank day never turns into pressure.
- After a loss, the app pauses counts and reminders right away.
- Articles with sources and signs of when to seek care.
- PDF summary and a list to take to your appointment.

What is yours stays with you
- Entries encrypted on your device. Works offline and without an account.
- Optional encrypted backup, with a phrase only you have.
- Discreet reminders: the lock screen only says there is a little note.
- Passcode, face or fingerprint, anonymous mode, export and delete everything.
- Partner sharing by code: they see only what you turn on.
- No ads, no trackers and no data sales.

How predictions are made: the average of your latest cycles and the signs you log. They can be wrong and are never contraception.

For people aged 18 or over. This version is free, with no in-app purchases and no ads. In an emergency, call your local service.

A product of CAIXA LIMITED. Contact: pitanga@caixa.ie

name: PitRoll
description:
PitRoll was born in the photo pit. A concert photographer built it for dark rooms and hard stage light, and it is just as good for people, portraits and street photography.

LOOKS
One tap for a look, from clean colour to deep film. Swipe across the photo to set the strength.

LIGHT
Add a spot, an ambient light or the sun. PitRoll reads the depth of your photo and lights your subject from the front. Add glow: beams, stars, haze, flares.

TEXTURE
Grain, dust, halation, vignette and light leaks. Shoot as if through glass: reflections of city lights, windows, cars and trees.

FRAMES
Film edges, slides, instant and print frames.

FAST
• Undo every step, hold to see the original
• Apply one edit to up to 30 photos
• Share in full resolution with one tap

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no upload, no tracking. Works offline.

Free to use with a set of looks, textures, lights and frames. More packs are available as one-time purchases. No subscription.

name: PLUSH LAB: Claw Practice
description:
Where should the claw land to support a prize?
Practice with three 3D claw machines, then study where the fingers touched and how the prize moved.

THREE WAYS TO PRACTICE
• Classic plush: find support under the body and watch the remaining swing.
• Boxed figures: compare edges, rotation and balance.
• Giant plush: study weight distribution and carrying posture.

Move the lever to swing the claw, or use manual stacking to grab, carry and place prizes yourself. Retry a starting layout to compare different aim positions. Collect 49 virtual characters and arrange your favorites on a six-slot shelf.

FREE PRACTICE PLAYS
Your free balance tops up to 10 each local device day. One free play recharges every 10 minutes, up to a balance of 10. A play is used only when a new grab starts, and free plays are used first. Releasing a prize during manual carry does not use another play.

PRACTICE PRO AND CABINET APPEARANCES
Try one Pro tool session free. The optional one-time Pro purchase supports up to 10 named saved layouts, comparison of your latest 30 attempt summaries and a separate 3D replay viewer for the latest three attempts in the current app session. Replays last up to 45 seconds per attempt and play at 0.25x, 0.5x or 1x speed. Replays are cleared when the app session ends.

Aurora Cabinet and Golden Arcade are optional one-time appearance purchases. Pro and cabinet appearances do not change claw strength or prize rules. Pro and cabinet appearances can be restored using the same Apple Account.

EXTRA PRACTICE PLAYS
The 30 Practice Plays pack is a repeatable in-app purchase, priced at KRW 1,000 in the Korean storefront. The purchase screen displays your local price. Purchased plays are credited after the payment is verified. They do not expire or reset each day.

Purchased play balances stay on the current device and do not automatically transfer to another device. Ordinary purchase restoration does not recover the balance of consumable practice plays. Deleting the app, resetting app data or losing the device can lose unused purchased plays. There is no game account or cloud wallet.

LANGUAGE AND RECORDS
Korean and English are supported. Change the interface language in Settings. Collection progress and settings stay on this device, with manual backup export and import. Basic progress backups exclude free and purchased plays, purchase rights, Pro layouts, attempt summaries and replays.

Play without ads. All prizes are virtual items; there are no physical prizes, shipping or cash rewards. This is a virtual physics practice game, so results on physical machines can differ.

name: Postilight
description:
Postilight est l'app compagnon du cadre LED Postilight : 256 LED (16 × 16) pilotées en Bluetooth depuis votre iPhone.

• Images et GIF animés : choisissez une photo ou un GIF, l'app le transforme en pixel art 16 × 16 et vous montre l'aperçu avant l'envoi.
• Texte : faites défiler un message sur le cadre.
• Modes : diaporama d'images, texte, couleur unie, motifs animés ou bargraph.
• Luminosité et allumage des LED réglables à tout moment.
• Gestion du contenu : parcourez les images, animations et textes enregistrés sur le cadre et supprimez ceux dont vous ne voulez plus.
• Réglages : transitions par défilement ou fondu, durées d'affichage, vitesse des GIF et du texte, couleur unie, retournement de l'affichage.

L'app fonctionne entièrement en local, en Bluetooth : pas de compte, pas de publicité, aucune donnée collectée.

Un cadre LED Postilight est nécessaire pour utiliser l'app.

Posto Anda Luz – Abastecer é ganhar vantagens!

name: ProteinFold
description:
ProteinFold is a pocket atlas of the Protein Data Bank. Type a four character identifier, or the name of a protein, and the structure opens as a turning model you can hold in your hand. Colour it by chain to see how subunits assemble, switch the ligands on to find the small molecule that sits in a pocket, and measure which residues actually touch it. The answer is calculated on the device from the deposited coordinates, so you can point at a contact and say why it is there.

Every entry in the archive was produced by an experiment, and the app keeps that context in view. A short teaching card explains whether the model came from X-ray crystallography, cryo-electron microscopy or NMR, what the quoted resolution allows you to claim, and where the model stops being a picture of reality. It is written for the classroom: a teacher can open a structure, save it, and attach the note that explains what the class should notice.

Large coordinate files are handled with care. A low detail model appears almost immediately, the complete file is downloaded only when you ask for it, and anything you have already opened stays available without a connection. Inspect a position in the model to see where a residue sits, which residues surround it and what the archive annotates at that spot, with a clear reminder that location is not a diagnosis. Save the structures you teach with, keep the notes beside them, and let the insights page show what your collection says about the way you look at proteins.

name: PULSAR Fitness Coach
description:
PULSAR is a training coach for every age and every sport. It reads your workouts and turns them into clear guidance: how fit you are, how tired you are, and what to do next.

TRAINING LOAD
• Fitness (CTL), fatigue (ATL) and form (TSB) from heart rate, power and pace
• Taper simulator: set a race date and PULSAR builds a 14-day taper that brings your race-day form into the +15 to +25 range

AGE-GRADED PERFORMANCE
• Compare your 5K, 10K, half and marathon times using the 2025 road age-grading tables
• See your open-class equivalent time and your tier, from Bronze to Apex
• VO2 max ranked against people of your own age and sex

COURSE STRATEGY
• Import a GPX or FIT course and see the elevation profile split into climbs, flats and descents
• Target pace for every segment, adjusted for gradient from your threshold pace
• Send the plan to Apple Watch as a workout

SWIM ANALYSIS
• Lap-by-lap strokes, SWOLF and heart rate in one chart
• Pace per 100 m, colored by stroke

ON APPLE WATCH
• Running dynamics, grade-adjusted pace and elevation gain
• Distinct haptics for too fast and too slow
• Fueling reminders based on estimated carbohydrate use
• Triathlon leg switching from the Action Button
• Water Lock for swims, ultra mode for long days
• Workouts are stored on the watch and sync to iPhone when it reconnects

BUILT AROUND YOUR AGE
The home screen changes with your age. Younger athletes see sprint, strength and race metrics first. Athletes over 50 see heart-rate recovery, joint impact load and lower-impact alternatives first.

PRIVACY
Your health data stays on your device. PULSAR has no account, no ads and no tracking.

PULSAR is not a medical device and does not give medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new training program.
