name: Ranu Personal Ledger
description:
Lunch goes on your card today. The bill comes out of your bank account next month. Ranu keeps both dates straight and counts lunch just once. Track everyday spending alongside savings, loans, and the changing value of your home, even when your accounts use different currencies.

Add a note and a category to each entry. Catching up on last week? Keep the date and enter the next transaction right away. When you transfer between currencies, record the amounts that actually left one account and arrived in the other.

Set each card’s billing cycle and due date, then record a full or partial payment. For loans, track what you borrow and what you pay back, including how much of each repayment goes toward principal and interest.

When a property or investment changes in value, update its balance. The change can appear on your net worth chart without adding to your monthly income. Explore net worth, cash flow, and spending by week, month, year, or any dates you choose.

Keep the same ledger available on iPhone and iPad with optional iCloud sync, and choose whether to share usage analytics in Settings.

name: RDRNF
description:
RDRNF — Your personal asset research workspace

Keep your digital asset records and research in one organized place. RDRNF helps you build a personal list of assets, record historical prices and transactions, and review your entries at your own pace.

• Create asset profiles with a name, symbol, network, category and optional image.
• Record prices and transactions, then explore charts, positions and changes based on your entries.
• Save article summaries and research notes so you can revisit the points that matter to you.
• Set optional review reminders and quiet hours around your routine.
• Import supported CSV files, export records, and manage your data on your device.

RDRNF does not provide live market prices, execute trades or offer financial advice. Values and analysis depend on the information you enter. No account is required.

name: ReDom
description:
ReDom — приложение для жителей и мастеров жилых комплексов, которые обслуживает управляющая компания, ОСИ или КСК, подключённые к ReDom.

Жителю
• Заявка за минуту: опишите проблему, приложите фото — диспетчер управляющей компании назначит мастера.
• Ход заявки: подана, принята, в работе, выполнена. Отчёт и фото мастера, оценка работы.
• Платные услуги по прайсу управляющей компании.
• Счета и долг по квартире, объявления дома.
• Камеры и въезды, машины для шлагбаума — если их подключила управляющая компания.
• Помощник в чате подскажет, что делать, и поможет оформить заявку.
• Несколько квартир в одном аккаунте.

Мастеру
• Назначенные заявки с адресом и телефоном жителя.
• «Приступить», «Завершить» с отчётом и фото, «Не получается выполнить» с причиной.
• Средняя оценка и счётчики выполненных работ.

Вход без пароля: код на почту или в Telegram, «Войти с Apple» или «Войти с Google».

ReDom работает в ЖК, которые подключила управляющая компания. Чтобы подключить свой дом, напишите на support@redom.kz.

name: ReelClub: Reel Maker Templates
description:
Turn your photos into Reels, carousels and stories with 100+ editorial templates.
Pick a template, add your photos and videos, and your Reel is ready with music in a few taps. No account, no design skills needed.
Photo dumps, magazine covers, birthday recaps, wedding invitations, café menus: there's a template for every moment.

THE LIBRARY
• Reels: vertical video templates with music, 1080×1920
• Carousels: multi-page 4:5 posts made to be swiped, including a seamless panorama
• Stories: monthly calendars, about me, note of the day and more
• Collages and grids: several photos in one frame, 3×3 grid posts, film grids and photo dumps
• Categories: Photo dump, Editorial, Lifestyle, Everyday, Collage, Special days, Travel, Food, Business
• Monthly packs: seasonal templates for holidays and special days, from New Year's Eve to Valentine's Day and Mother's Day
• Suggestions based on the interests you pick, and Favorites for the ones you love

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a template and preview it full screen.
2. Use it, then choose photos and videos from your library.
3. Fine-tune the text, music and details in the editor.
4. Export. Your video is saved to Photos, ready to share on Instagram or TikTok.

THE EDITOR
• Text: fonts and styles
• 130 stickers, 19 frames and layers
• Sound: a built-in music library, tracks matched to each template, and the exact part of the song you want
• Focus point: choose which part of each photo stays in frame
• Undo and redo; drafts save automatically
• Export as a Reel, story or carousel

LESS WORK
• Several Reels at once: choose your photos and ReelClub places them into a few templates, so you can keep your favorite
• A ready-made caption and hashtag suggestions, copied in one tap
• Trending sound guide: shows you step by step how to add a trending sound when you post
• A projects page that keeps your drafts and finished work in one place

PRIVACY
• No account needed
• Your photos and projects stay on your iPhone and are never uploaded
• No ads and no tracking. Subscriptions are handled by Apple and RevenueCat with an anonymous ID

REELCLUB PRO
Browsing and previewing templates is open to everyone. Using a template, starting a new project, editing and exporting require ReelClub Pro.
• ReelClub Pro is an auto-renewing subscription with a weekly and a yearly plan.
• Both plans include a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. The trial can be used once per Apple Account.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase or, if you start a trial, when the trial ends.
• Your subscription renews automatically for the same period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or from Settings inside the app. If you cancel during the trial, you won't be charged.
• If you allow notifications, we'll remind you one day before your trial ends.
• If you close the subscription screen, we won't show you a second offer.
• Prices are shown in your local currency on the subscription screen and on the App Store before you buy, and may vary by region.

Terms of Use: https://ardasamett.github.io/reelclub-yasal/kosullar.html?dil=en
Privacy Policy: https://ardasamett.github.io/reelclub-yasal/gizlilik.html?dil=en

name: Referly for Business
description:
Referly for Business puts your affiliate program in your pocket. It is the companion app to Referly, the affiliate and referral program software for online businesses.

• Dashboard: revenue, clicks, referrals and commissions for each program, with charts for any period.
• Affiliates: review and approve applications, open any affiliate's profile, links and results, and change their commission plan.
• Referrals and sales: follow each referral from the first click to the sale.
• Payouts: see what each affiliate is owed and what has been paid.
• Messages: chat with your affiliates one to one or in groups, with photos and videos.
• Engage: publish announcements and keep bonuses, contests and content rewards running.
• Notifications: a sale, a new application or a message reaches you right away.
• Several programs? Switch between them in a tap.

Sign in with your Referly account. Lock the app with Face ID and choose exactly which notifications you get.

name: Ri FSM
description:
Ri FSM là ứng dụng dành cho nhân viên kỹ thuật và dịch vụ hiện trường của các doanh nghiệp đang dùng phần mềm Ri-S. Từ lúc nhận lệnh đến lúc khách ký xác nhận, mọi bước đều làm ngay trên điện thoại.

CÔNG VIỆC HẰNG NGÀY
• Xem danh sách lệnh hôm nay, lệnh chưa xong và lệnh đã hoàn thành
• Thông tin khách hàng, địa chỉ, số điện thoại, mô tả yêu cầu
• Gọi khách và chỉ đường đến địa điểm chỉ với một chạm

XỬ LÝ TẠI HIỆN TRƯỜNG
• Báo đang di chuyển, check-in có ghi nhận vị trí
• Tạm dừng và tiếp tục kèm lý do
• Chụp ảnh hiện trường, ghi kết quả xử lý
• Ghi vật tư đã sử dụng
• Khách hàng ký xác nhận trên màn hình, gửi biên bản PDF ngay

LỘ TRÌNH VÀ LỊCH LÀM VIỆC
• Lộ trình trong ngày theo thứ tự các điểm cần đến
• Mở bản đồ chỉ đường qua cả tuyến
• Lịch làm việc theo tuần

THIẾT BỊ VÀ LỊCH SỬ
• Quét mã serial hoặc mã QR trên thiết bị để xem thông tin
• Xem lịch sử sửa chữa của thiết bị và các lần xử lý trước tại cùng địa điểm

LUÔN KẾT NỐI
• Nhận thông báo khi được giao lệnh mới, lệnh bị hủy hoặc đổi lịch
• Vẫn thao tác được khi mất mạng, dữ liệu tự gửi lên khi có kết nối

Ứng dụng dành cho doanh nghiệp đã sử dụng Ri-S của SOC Tech. Tài khoản đăng nhập do công ty cấp cho nhân viên.

name: RPS Link
description:
Transforme seu dia a dia com o RPS Link. Automação e conectividade para deixar sua rotina mais simples, prática e confortável.

Tenha a tecnologia como sua aliada para facilitar tarefas e trazer mais comodidade aos momentos que fazem parte da sua vida.

Descubra uma nova maneira de se conectar ao seu mundo e aproveite as possibilidades da automação.

RPS Link: automatize sua vida.

name: RsssfArchive
description:
Football Yearbook is a reading companion to the RSSSF archive, the volunteer-built record of world football that has been kept since 1994. It is made for the reader who asks a very specific question: who went down in that league, that year, and why did the title end up somewhere unexpected.

Open a season and you get the final table as it was printed, with the qualification bands, the point deductions and the notes that decided the arithmetic. Every score is either there or it is not; a blank stays blank and is never turned into a goalless draw. The app also tells you how much of a season was actually transcribed, so you know whether you are reading a complete record or a fragment recovered from a newspaper.

National sides can be read match by match, split by competition and by opponent, with friendlies marked apart from competitive fixtures. Your own ground log turns the places you have actually stood into a personal map, and the check sheet compares a published table with one rebuilt from the results, listing every difference instead of smoothing it over. Seasons can be exported as plain text for a database or a spreadsheet.

No account, no advertising, no tracking. Just the archive, read carefully.

name: Saapaadu - Tamil Recipes
description:
Saapaadu brings everyday vegetarian cooking to your iPhone in Tamil.

Find what to cook, plan your week and follow each recipe at your own pace, with heritage illustrations inspired by Tamil home kitchens.

• 201 vegetarian recipes, including South Indian favourites and other Indian dishes. Ingredients, cooking steps and food illustrations are bundled for offline use.
• Daily meal suggestions with quick breakfast, lunch and dinner swaps, plus recently cooked recipes.
• Guided cooking with one step at a time, a timer, pause and resume, and an optional keep-screen-awake setting.
• Pantry matching: select ingredients you have, see available and missing ingredients, and add missing items to groceries.
• An editable seven-day meal planner with a shopping list generated from your chosen meals.
• Organised groceries: combine compatible quantities, add your own items, mark purchases, undo removals and share through the iPhone share sheet.
• Favourites and personal recipe notes for the changes that make a dish yours.
• Light and dark appearances and support for larger text.

The app interface and recipes are in Tamil. Common English recipe and ingredient search terms are supported. Your saved information stays on your device; there is no in-app account or cloud sync.

One-time purchase. No advertisements, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Core recipe features work offline. External links and the sharing services you choose may require an internet connection. Timer notifications depend on iPhone permissions and settings.

Nutrition figures are approximate estimates, not personalised medical or dietary advice. Food illustrations may differ from the finished dish.

Created with care by Malar Hari.

name: Sağlık Ağı: Sağlık Personeli
seller_name: PRISMA GRUP MEDYA PRODUKSIYON TEKSTIL GIDA YAZILIM VE SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Hemşire, ebe, hekim, sağlık teknikeri, ATT ve paramedik… Sağlık Ağı, sağlık personelinin cep asistanı. Nöbetinizi girin; nöbet ücretiniz, hizmet puanınız ve izniniz otomatik hesaplansın.

NÖBET TAKVİMİ VE NÖBET ÇİZELGESİ
• Gündüz, gece, 24 saat, izin ve rapor kayıtlarını tek dokunuşla ekleyin
• "Hızlı ekle" ile tüm ayın nöbetlerini saniyeler içinde girin
• Sıradaki nöbetiniz ve canlı nöbet sayacı ana sayfada
• Aylık nöbet çizelgenizi PDF olarak paylaşın

NÖBET ÜCRETİ HESAPLAMA
• Unvan grubunuzun göstergesi ve dönem katsayısıyla otomatik hesap
• Acil servis, yoğun bakım ve 112 için %50 artırım
• Hafta sonu ve resmî tatilleri ayırt eder, aylık 130 saat sınırını ve damga vergisini uygular
• Hesabın nasıl yapıldığını satır satır görün

HİZMET PUANI, KURA VE TAYİN
• Görev yerlerinizi girin, hizmet puanınız SEGE sıralamasına göre hesaplansın
• Tercih ettiğiniz illeri geçen dönem kura taban puanlarıyla karşılaştırın
• Eş durumu, sağlık mazereti, becayiş ve diğer tayin dilekçesi örnekleri

YILLIK İZİN
• Kalan izin, devreden izin ve yıl sonunda yanacak günler
• Yanmak üzere olan izin için zamanında uyarı

MEVZUAT VE KLİNİK
• 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanunu ve Atama ve Yer Değiştirme Yönetmeliği özetleri, internet olmadan da
• Madde arama ve favorilere ekleme
• APGAR gibi klinik ölçekler ve hızlı başvuru kartları
• İlinizdeki nöbetçi eczaneler

SAĞLIK GÜNDEMİ
• Atama, maaş, Sağlık Bakanlığı kararları ve personel alımı haberleri
• Takip ettiğiniz konularda anında bildirim

PREMIUM
• Ana ekran widget'ları, kilit ekranında canlı nöbet sayacı, Apple Watch
• Nöbetlerin iPhone takvimine aktarılması ve PDF çizelge
• Bulut yedek ve yeni telefona taşıma
• Tüm ayların nöbet ücreti hesabı ve kura asistanı

Premium aylık veya yıllık otomatik yenilenen abonelikle sunulur ve 7 gün ücretsiz denenebilir. Ödeme, satın alma onayıyla Apple Kimliği hesabınızdan alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik yenilenir. Aboneliğinizi Ayarlar › Apple Kimliği › Abonelikler bölümünden yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsiniz.

Hesap açmak isteğe bağlıdır. Nöbet, izin ve hizmet puanı bilgileriniz telefonunuzda kalır.

Hesaplamalar bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; kesin tutarlar için bordronuzu ve kurumunuzu esas alın. Sağlık Ağı resmî bir kurum uygulaması değildir.

Kullanım Koşulları: https://saglikagi.com/uygulama-kullanim-kosullari/
Gizlilik Politikası: https://saglikagi.com/uygulama-gizlilik-politikasi/

name: Sahra: Diwaniya Party Games
description:
Sahra puts the classic get-together games in one phone. Split into teams, put the phone on the table or show the board on your TV, and you're ready.

THE CHALLENGE
Team trivia on a 6×6 board. Pick 6 categories, each with 200, 400 and 600 point questions, and use power cards like Double, Steal and Swap to turn the game around.
• 520 questions in 13 categories: general knowledge, geography, sports, science, Gulf food, animals, Islamic, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the Gulf and more
• No repeats: Sahra remembers what you've played and keeps the questions fresh

THE OUTSIDER
Everyone knows the secret word except one player. Ask each other questions and catch the outsider before they work out the word.

THE WHEEL
Spin it for a truth, a dare, a quick-fire round or a group vote. There's a family mode and a friends mode.

ACT IT OUT
Act out or describe the word and get your team to guess it before time runs out.

PLAY ON TV
Mirror the board to your TV with AirPlay, or open it in any browser. The phone stays with the host.

Works in English, Arabic and Turkish.

SAHRA PREMIUM
Try the games for free. Unlock every game and category with a 24-hour Night Pass, or with a monthly or yearly subscription.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings. The Night Pass is a one-time purchase and doesn't renew.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sahra-4b7f9.web.app/privacy.html

name: ScaleBuildJournal
description:
The Scale Build Journal is a quiet desk record written for all those who assemble models - Gundam assembled in a few nights, tanks placed on shelves for half a month, building blocks assembled in an afternoon, and those who want to know the process, not just remember the appearance of the finished product.

Each work has its own place in the record: planned steps and steps that have been checked off, hours invested, notes left for oneself, and photos taken along the way. You don't have to wait until the end to fill in, the records will grow along with the model, with each check and a period of time, gradually accumulating.

In a few weeks, this record will be worth looking back at. The chart will tell you where your time has been spent, which type of kit requires the most effort, and whether the pace of model development is stable. When a model is finally completed, its entries will still remain in the portfolio, with the complete process - the first trial assembly, the seams polished twice, and the afternoon when the protective paint was applied.

name: ScentLab
description:
ScentLab is a studio notebook for candle and soap makers. Save your recipes, scale ingredient amounts for different batch sizes, and track each batch through curing.

Keep tabs on materials and production costs, set curing and low-stock reminders, and record batch notes along the way. Export reports or create a local backup of your studio records.

name: SCFCoffee
description: SCFCoffeeDesigned for those who prefer to organize expenses into specific cycles while reconciling them against calendar-month statements. After recording income, expenditures, refunds, and transfers, you can tap on the monthly report figures to view the underlying pay cycle and the specific transactions included. If your salary arrives in multiple installments, you can consolidate them into a single entry, while your account balance remains updated based on the actual date of each individual transaction. Before retroactively adding income or adjusting cycle boundaries, you can preview which entries will shift to a different period and how the subtotal for each affected period will change. You can reconcile your records by entering the closing balance from your bank statement, marking verified transactions as "checked," and linking specific transfers to your savings accounts. Once a billing cycle is finalized, it can be saved as a historical version. Should any corrections be necessary later, you can compare the previous version with the current one to trace the exact cause of any discrepancies, transaction by transaction.

name: Sendr -
description:
Sendr is a climbing journal built around every attempt, not just the final send.

Record gym or crag sessions with time on the wall, photos, and video. Log each route attempt with its grade, result, and beta. Unfinished routes remain in your projects, so you can pick up where you left off and see what changed when you finally send them.

Plan training sessions and goal routes, set local reminders, and record recovery and finger-strength checks. Your grade pyramid, training load, and personal bests bring those records together.

The Wall gives you a place to keep personal climbing stories and field notes. You can also turn milestones into climbing cards.

Use Sendr as a guest, or register and sign in to a local account to keep your records separate from other profiles on the same device. Records and media stay on your device; there is no cloud sync.

name: Seoul Toilet Navi
description:
Find public toilets in Seoul, right from where you are.

4,115 locations from the official dataset published by the Seoul Metropolitan Government. The data is bundled in the app, so searching needs no network connection. It works underground and in airplane mode.

■ What's not included (please read first)

Toilets inside subway stations, department stores and cafes are not in the official dataset. This app covers public toilets the city tracks, plus private facilities that open their toilets to the public.

■ Features

• Search within 500m / 1km / 2km of your location
• Sorted by distance, with open or closed status at a glance
• Filter by accessible stall, baby changing table, or emergency alarm
• Facility names shown in English alongside the Korean original
• "Show in Korean" — displays the address and "May I use the toilet?" in large Korean text, ready to show a taxi driver or shop staff
• Check what the building looks like with Google Street View
• Save toilets for later — handy for marking spots near your hotel before you set out
• Works without location permission: browse 12 tourist areas including Myeongdong, Hongdae, Gangnam, Dongdaemun, Gyeongbokgung, Insadong, Itaewon, N Seoul Tower, Jamsil, Seongsu, Seoul Station and Ikseondong

■ About privately opened toilets

Gas stations and shops that open their toilets to the public are included. Some may require a door code, or you may need to ask a staff member first. The detail screen tells you when this applies.

■ Reports from travelers

See what other travelers reported — "Clean", "No paper" and more. You can add your own with a single tap. There is no free-text field.

■ Privacy

Your location is used only on your device and is never transmitted. No account needed.

name: Sgppillor
description: SgppillorTrack your funds day-by-day using the billing cycle calendar. Each transaction is recorded individually; by selecting categories such as cash, expenses, outstanding debts, pending deposit refunds, or net assets, you can highlight the specific entries that impact those balances. Open the transaction details to view the dates and amounts for repayments, deductions, and incoming funds; you can also separately log the withholding and subsequent receipt of deposits. On the account page, you can reconcile institutional statements by matching them against individual transactions. The budget feature displays remaining balances by category, while the "to-do" section consolidates recurring payments, deposit recoveries, and end-of-month reconciliations. When planning for the next billing cycle, you can compare cash flow forecasts and generate a summary report of your current financial activity.

name: SID Player
description:
SID Player brings the legendary sound of the Commodore 64 to your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

At its heart is a built-in emulation of the C64's 6510 processor, timers and the famous SID sound chip, including its analogue filter. Tunes play the way they did on the original hardware, with a choice of the classic 6581 or the later 8580 chip.

YOUR COLLECTION, BEAUTIFULLY ORGANISED • Import .sid files or whole folders, such as the free High Voltage SID Collection (HVSC) • Browse All Tunes, Favorites, Recently Played and Recently Added • Explore by composer or by tune title • Search by title, composer or year • Build playlists, including individual subtunes • On iPhone and iPad, drop tunes into the SID Player folder in the Files app

SEE THE MUSIC • Glowing oscilloscope, per-voice traces and a spectrum analyser • Live note names, envelopes, waveforms and filter settings for each of the three voices • Mute or solo any voice to hear how a tune is built

READ ALONG WITH A LIVE SCORE • SID Player transcribes the tune into notation as it plays • Follow along, tap a bar to jump to it, or loop a passage • Adjust key, tempo and time signature, then export as MusicXML or MIDI

LISTENING, YOUR WAY • Exact song lengths and subtune names with HVSC's Songlengths and STIL databases • Plays every subtune in a file, with shuffle, repeat and gentle fade-outs • Skips silence automatically • Background playback with Lock Screen, Control Center and keyboard controls

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No accounts, no ads and no tracking. Your library stays on your device.

SID Player doesn't include any music. The High Voltage SID Collection offers tens of thousands of C64 tunes to download for free at hvsc.c64.org.

If you enjoy SID Player, you can say thanks with an optional tip in Settings. Tips are entirely optional and unlock nothing.

name: Silver Halide Kids
description:
Hand your phone to a toddler without worrying about what they'll tap next. Silver Halide Kids is a simple instant camera built for young children, with one big red shutter button and no words on the screen.

Every photo slides out dark and slowly appears, just like real instant film. Shake the phone or rub the print to hurry it along, or just wait while sparkles and a chime finish the shot.

FOR KIDS 
• Tap the big red shutter or use either volume button to snap a photo. 
• A row of film sheets tracks the day's pack. When the last sheet is used, the camera falls asleep until morning. 
• If a finger creeps over the lens, a little hand pops up as a hint. Cover the whole lens by mistake and peekaboo eyes appear instead, so the camera never wastes a sheet of film. 
• Finished prints go straight onto a fridge door with magnets. Kids can tap a heart on favorites or draw across any print with eight chunky crayons.

FOR GROWN-UPS 
• Settings, saving, and sharing stay locked behind a quick multiplication question. 
• Choose whether kids shake the phone or just wait, adjust how fast photos appear, and set a daily shot limit. 
• Pick between soft color, black and white, or the wild light leaks and film grain from Silver Halide. 
• Print your child's name and the date along the bottom border. 
• Your phone sorts the best shots to the top, making it easy to find the real keepers past all the blurry carpet photos and save or share them. 
• Built for Guided Access. Lock your phone inside the app, and hide the album, selfie camera, or settings lock right from iOS Guided Access options. 
• Fills the whole screen on iPad and unfolded iPhone Duo, upright or sideways.

FREE & PRIVATE 
Everything stays on your device unless you save or share a photo. There are no ads, accounts, or tracking, and nothing to buy inside the app.

MEET SILVER HALIDE 
Silver Halide Kids has a big sibling: Silver Halide, the grown-up instant camera from the same maker. In Silver Halide, every shot takes 30 seconds to develop, and how you tilt, shake, or expose the phone to light permanently changes the print. Hosting a birthday party, family trip, or wedding? Start a shared Event Roll so everyone's shots land in one album.

name: Silvias Restaurant
description:
Herzlich Willkommen bei Silvias Restaurant in Sarstedt. Wir bedienen unsere Kunden mit Nudeln, Pizza, Burger und machen das seit mehreren Jahren aus Leidenschaft. Wir freuen uns immer wieder, neue Kunden unserer Herkunft näher zu bringen und möchten ihnen die Möglichkeit geben, ihre Bestellung unkompliziert und total einfach abzugeben. Aus diesem Grund möchten wir Ihnen unsere neue App und unseren Online Shop vorstellen, mit dem Sie problemlos über Paypal, Bar und Kreditkarte bezahlen können.

Wir laden Sie ein, es zu versuchen, Sie bekommen bis zu 10% Rabatt auf Ihre Bestellung. Ihr Team von Silvias Restaurant in Sarstedt.

name: Simple Qibla & Prayer Tracker
description:
Simple Qibla helps you keep all five daily prayers, every day.

Tick off each prayer the moment you've prayed it, right from your Home Screen. Watch your streak grow, see your whole month at a glance, and always know how long until the next prayer. When it's time to pray, one arrow points you to the Kaaba.

TRACK ALL FIVE PRAYERS
• Tick off Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha with one tap
• Build a daily streak, and see your best one
• See your month as a calendar, with the share of prayers you've logged
• Forgot to tick one? Mark it any time later that day
• Optional alerts when each prayer begins. Pick which prayers, and tap "I've prayed" right on the alert

TRACK FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Pray Now widget: the current prayer, the time until the next one, and an "I've prayed" button
• Today's Prayers widget: all five prayers in a row. Tap a circle to tick it off
• The large size adds your last seven days
• Lock Screen widgets count down to the next prayer

FIND THE QIBLA
• Hold your iPhone flat and turn. A single arrow points to the Kaaba in Makkah
• Feel it: gentle clicks as you get closer, and a tap when you're lined up
• The whole screen turns green when you're facing the Qibla

ACCURATE PRAYER TIMES
• A live countdown to the next prayer, and when the last adhan was
• 12 calculation methods, including Moonsighting Committee, ISNA, Muslim World League, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, Karachi, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, Singapore, Diyanet and Tehran
• Shafi'i/Maliki/Hanbali or Hanafi Asr
• Automatic mode picks what's most common where you live

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• Your prayer history and location stay on your iPhone
• Works offline. Everything is calculated on the device

Prayer times are calculated with the trusted open-source Adhan library. If your local masjid publishes a timetable, choose the method that matches it.

name: SkiSOS: Ski Resort Emergency
description:
Hurt or unable to move at a ski resort in Japan? SkiSOS helps you call for help without hesitation.

■ The rescue number for the resort you are at
- Detects which of about 500 resorts across Japan you are at and shows its ski patrol / rescue number in large type
- Numbers confirmed on the resort's official website carry an "Official" mark
- After opening hours, the app points you to 110 or 119
- Shows at a glance when to call 119 (ambulance / fire) and when to call 110 (police / lost)

■ Tell them exactly where you are
- Shows your coordinates, also in the degrees-minutes-seconds form used on the phone in Japan
- Text your location to your emergency contacts in one tap
- Shows what to say on the phone in Japanese, and can read it aloud

■ No Japanese needed
- Available in 8 languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, Spanish and French
- Each Japanese phrase comes with its meaning in your language and the pronunciation in romaji

■ Third-party help, for someone who finds an injured person
- Step-by-step: make the scene safe, check the casualty, call for help
- The page language can be switched on the spot
- Shows the owner's name, medical notes and emergency contacts

■ Call for help with sound when you can't shout
- Recorded calls for help in Japanese and English, a warning tone, siren, whistle and bear bell

■ Emergency card on the lock screen
- After you call, a card shows your name and emergency contacts without unlocking
- You can also make an emergency card image to use as your wallpaper

■ Also included
- First aid by type of injury
- Pre-trip checklist with Japan Meteorological Agency weather, warnings and advisories
- What to do with no signal
- A record of your emergency calls
- Drill mode: practise the whole flow once without placing a call
- No account needed. What you enter stays on this device

[Please note]
- Phone numbers were collected from public information online (such as resort websites). Their accuracy is not guaranteed, including numbers marked "Official". When you arrive, always check them against the signs or trail map at the resort.
- If a number fails or life is at risk, call 119 or 110 without hesitation.
- This app helps you call for help. It does not monitor you, call automatically or provide satellite communication.
- This is not an official app of any ski resort, the police or the fire department.

name: SMM Defteri
seller_name: PNET BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI TELEKOMUNIKASYON INTERNET VE DANISMANLIK HIZMETLERI TICARET LTD. STI.
description:
SMM Defteri, mali müşavir ofisleri için iş takibi uygulamasıdır. Beyanname takvimi, dönem tablosu, eksik evrak takibi ve mükellef yazışmaları tek yerde.

OFİSİNİZ İÇİN
• Beyanname takvimi: KDV, muhtasar, damga, geçici vergi, e-defter… Mükellef türüne göre yükümlülükler bir kez tanımlanır, her ayın işleri kendiliğinden açılır. Hafta sonu, resmî tatil ve süre uzatmaları hesaba katılır.
• Dönem takibi: Bütün mükellefler ve bu ayın beyannameleri tek tabloda. Hangisi verildi, hangisi hazırlanıyor, hangisi gecikti bir bakışta görünür.
• İş panosu: Her işin sorumlusu, son günü ve kontrol listesi belli. Ekip arkadaşlarınız kendi işlerini görür.
• Evrak takibi: Alış-satış faturaları, banka ekstreleri, puantaj… Eksik evrak için mükellefe tek dokunuşla hatırlatma.
• Bildirimler: Size atanan işler ve son günü yaklaşan beyannameler telefonunuza bildirim olarak gelir.

MÜKELLEFLERİNİZ İÇİN
• Mükellef girişi ile evraklarını fotoğraflayıp yükler.
• Tahakkuk ve beyannamelerini görür, indirir.
• Mali müşaviriyle uygulama içinden yazışır.

Uygulamayı kullanmak için mali müşavir ofisinizin SMM Defteri hesabı gerekir. Mükellef hesapları mali müşaviriniz tarafından açılır.

name: Snake: Retro Arcade Game
description:
One snake, one open field and one long round. Eat cherries, grow, and see how far you can go.

NO EDGES, NO LEVELS
Leave the field on the right and come back on the left. A round has no end: it goes on until you crash. Each cherry gives a point and a longer tail, and the snake speeds up to its limit.

WALLS THAT COME AND GO
Long, short and one-block walls rise from the ground and disappear after 3 to 20 seconds. An outline shows where a wall will rise. Walls never close the way to the cherries.

TELEPORTS
Two holes open on the field. Enter one and come out of the other. They work in both directions.

THREE RARE BONUSES
The star gives 10 points, and the tail does not grow.
The armor breaks every wall in your way for 30 seconds.
The ghost lets the snake go through walls for 15 seconds. Get out in time: if any part of the snake is still in a wall when the ghost ends, the round is over.

NEW COLORS
The field changes its colors while you play, from blue stone to a green garden. It has a light and a dark look.

LEADERBOARD
The best scores are on the start screen. Sign in to Game Center to compare your rounds with other players. Without Game Center, the list shows your own best rounds.

EASY TO PLAY
Turn the snake up, down, left or right with the remote. Press Play/Pause to take a break.

The game works offline. No ads and no separate account.

name: SOL-APP
description:
SOL ist dein HTML Reader für das iPad. Öffne HTML-Inhalte, speichere sie geordnet und verwalte sie an einem Ort.

HTML lesen
Importiere HTML-Dateien und lies sie direkt in der App, ohne Browser und ohne Umwege.

Bearbeiten
Passe Inhalte an, benenne Dateien um und sortiere sie in eigene Ordner, zum Beispiel nach Fächern.

Medien einfügen
Füge Audio, Video und Anhänge wie PDF-Dateien ein, spiele sie direkt ab und lade sie bei Bedarf herunter.

Aufnehmen und bearbeiten
Verlangt eine HTML-Aufgabe, ein Video oder eine Audioaufnahme zu machen, wird die Aufnahme immer automatisch in dem Ordner gespeichert, in dem sich die HTML-Datei befindet. In diesem Ordner kannst du Video und Audio mit einfachen Werkzeugen wie Schneiden und Trimmen bearbeiten.

iCloud
Deine Ordner und Dateien liegen in deinem iCloud Drive und sind auf allen iPads mit derselben Apple-ID verfügbar. Ist iCloud aus, bleibt alles lokal auf dem Gerät.

Ideal für Unterricht, Lernen und Material, das du immer griffbereit haben möchtest.

name: Songblip: Guess the Song Quiz
description:
Hear half a second. Name the song.

Songblip plays you the shortest slice of a hit song. Know it? Search and pick it. Not sure? Unlock a longer clip: 1, 2, 4, 8, then 15 seconds. Six tries, and the fewer you need, the better.

DAILY 5
Five songs a day, the same five for everyone in your country. Finish them, see your grid and share it without spoiling the answers. Come back tomorrow to keep your streak.

UNLIMITED
One song after another, for as long as you like. Play today's top hits, or pick your music: the '60s to the 2010s, 14 genres from Pop and Rock to K-Pop and Metal, or any artist you search for. No daily limit, no waiting.

PARTY
Put one phone in the middle of the table. Everyone gets a buzzer. The first to hit theirs says the song out loud, and the table decides if it was right. Early answers score more; a wrong answer costs a point. Choose the music for the night: a decade, a genre or one artist.

WHAT YOU GET
• The most-played songs in your country, straight from the charts
• Decades, genres and artists to choose from, all free
• Hints when you're close: right artist, or right title by someone else
• The full 30-second preview after every round, and a link to open the song in Apple Music
• Streaks and results saved on your phone. No account.

NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Daily, Unlimited and two-player Party (5 songs) are free, with all the music. An optional one-time Party Pack adds 3 to 8 players and longer games of 10, 15 or 20 songs.

Songs and previews come from Apple Music. You don't need an Apple Music subscription: Songblip asks for Apple Music access only to load the charts and play the previews.

name: Spaceship: Alien Space Shooter
description:
One spaceship and one endless round. Meteors and alien ships come from the right. Shoot them, dodge them and see how far you can fly.

FLY IN FOUR DIRECTIONS
The ship flies up, down, forward and back, and fires by itself. You only steer.

WHAT COMES AT YOU
Meteors of three sizes. A large one breaks into three small ones.
Saucers that fly in waves and shoot back.
Fighters that chase your ship.
The round keeps getting harder for the first two and a half minutes and goes on until you lose your last life.

14 POWER-UPS
One more shot, up to three at a time.
Rockets that find a target.
A shield for one hit.
An extra life, up to three.
A star that gives points.
A bomb that clears the screen.
Eight powers with a timer: rapid fire, a laser, two drones, chain lightning, a ram that breaks everything, a magnet, slow time and double points.

LEADERBOARD
Your ten best rounds are in the game. Sign in to Game Center to compare your score with other players.

EASY TO PLAY
Steer with the remote or with a game controller. Press Play/Pause to take a break.

The game works offline. No ads and no separate account.

name: Split It: Slice Shapes in Half
description:
Split It is a clean, addictive skill game: slice shapes in two with a single straight line.

Swipe across the shape, make your cut and instantly see the area of each piece. Your goal is to match the target split as closely as you can. Near-flawless cuts like 49–51% are PERFECT: they earn bonus points and grow your combo.

• Mathematically exact area calculation: every cut's percentages shown instantly
• Shapes that get trickier as you go: squares, stars, hearts, L and U shapes and more
• Changing targets: 50% – 50%, 40% – 60%, 30% – 70%…
• 3 lives: a cut more than 5 points off the target costs a life
• Chain perfect cuts to multiply your score
• Endless mode plus a Daily Puzzle with the same 10 shapes for everyone
• Game Center leaderboard
• One-tap restart, no menus in your way
• Smooth animations, vivid pastel colors, sound effects and haptics
• Plays fully offline; no ads, no data collected

Trust your eye? Try to split it right down the middle!

name: Storybook : Histoires & Douas
description:
Storybook, ce sont des histoires audio au prénom de votre enfant, pour découvrir l'islam avec douceur.

Chaque soir, votre enfant devient le héros d'une histoire écrite pour lui : son prénom, son âge, son doudou et une valeur à transmettre. La patience, le partage, la gratitude, le respect des parents, la confiance en Allah… Vous donnez l'idée en une phrase, et l'histoire est prête à écouter en quelques minutes, avec une illustration et une voix douce.

DES HISTOIRES PERSONNALISÉES
• Le prénom et l'âge de votre enfant, pour une histoire à sa mesure
• Plusieurs enfants dans la même histoire, frères et sœurs réunis
• Une illustration pour chaque histoire
• Des histoires immersives, jouées à plusieurs voix

DES COLLECTIONS POUR APPRENDRE L'ISLAM
• J'apprends la prière : les ablutions, les gestes et les mots, pas à pas
• Les 5 piliers de l'islam : comprendre pourquoi chacun compte
• Les 4 califes : les histoires des compagnons qui ont guidé la communauté
Chaque collection achetée reste à vous, à réécouter autant que vous le souhaitez.

LE CARNET DE DOUAS
Chaque histoire fait découvrir une doua. Votre enfant la retrouve dans son carnet, en arabe, en phonétique et en français, avec sa récitation.

POUR LE MOMENT DU COUCHER
• Écoute avec l'écran verrouillé
• Favoris et histoires classées par enfant
• Une bibliothèque à réécouter en famille

Les histoires sont créées avec l'aide de l'intelligence artificielle, à partir de vos indications. Rien n'est envoyé sans votre accord.

Une question ? contact@story-book.fr

name: SubTrack: Subscription Radar
description:
SubTrack brings all your subscriptions and other recurring payments together in one place, so you can see at a glance what you really spend on subscriptions each month and each year and, if you want, get a reminder before you are charged.

ALL YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS AT A GLANCE
Monthly equivalent spending, yearly forecast, the next 30 days and upcoming renewals, calculated across all your active subscriptions.

YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS, BY CATEGORY
Entertainment, music, software, insurance, home and more, or create your own. Each category shows its subscription count and monthly total. Pause or cancel without losing history.

QUICK SETUP

REMINDERS BEFORE EVERY CHARGE

CALENDAR AND ANALYTICS

name: Tahwila Pager App
description:

سواء كنت في صالة الطعام أو منطقة الاستلام أو طلبات السيارات، امسح رمز QR على الإيصال أو الكاونتر — أو ابحث برقم النداء أو رقم الطلب — واحصل على متابعة فورية ومباشرة لحالة طلبك.

أبرز المميزات:
• متابعة فورية ومباشرة: تحديثات لحظية لحالة الطلب (قيد الانتظار، جاري التحضير، الطلب جاهز للاستلام).
• تنبيهات صوتية واهتزاز مميزة: نغمة تنبيه واضحة وعاجلة تصلك حتى عند قفل الشاشة لكي لا يفوتك موعد استلام طلبك.
• الأنشطة الحية والجزيرة التفاعلية (Live Activities & Dynamic Island): راقب حالة طلبك مباشرة من شاشة القفل أو الجزء العلوي من الشاشة بدون فتح التطبيق.
• إشعار "أنا في الطريق": أخبر فريق المطعم بضغطة زر واحدة فور جاهزية طلبك بأنك متجه للاستلام.
• تجربة App Clip فورية: لا يشترط تثبيت التطبيق مسبقاً — افتح بطاقة التتبع فوراً عند مسح رمز QR في المطعم.
• البحث برقم الطلب أو النداء: تابع أي طلب نشط يدوياً بإدخال نطاق المطعم ورقم النداء أو رقم الطلب.
• دعم ثنائي اللغة (العربية والإنجليزية): واجهة عربية افتراضية متكاملة (RTL) مع إمكانية التبديل الفوري إلى الإنجليزية.
• تفضيلات مخصصة وسجل الطلبات الأخيرة: تحكّم في تفعيل الصوت أو الاهتزاز، وارجع بسرعة لآخر طلباتك.

بيجر تحويلة — استلم طلبك في وقته وبكل راحة.

Is your closet full but you never have anything to wear? TeddyCloset helps you keep only what you really use, without taking a photo of every item.

tendto ist die Software für Surf-Häuser, Hostels und kleine Hotels. Mit der App hast du dein Haus in der Tasche.

name: Tenuo
description:
When you keep wanting to check the stove, the door or the plug, Tenuo lets you record the urge itself. Tap “Log an urge” to choose a place and start a line. At varying intervals, the app asks how strong the urge is right now, and you tap the matching height from 0 to 10.

Tenuo does not know whether anything is locked or switched off, and it will not tell you. There are no photos or checkmarks to serve as proof. The history doesn’t display times of day. Tenuo is a tool for taking notes. It does not provide treatment or replace your work with a professional.

You close by noting how it went: “I did not check”, “I checked after all” or “I don't know”. All three answers have the same appearance. In the history, each place shows its counts and lines. Recent lines appear by week and older ones by month.

For a conversation you can share a sheet with your lines as a PDF or as text. It carries a note saying it proves nothing. The help page has information for the region you select. A short practice run when you first open Tenuo shows how a line is drawn.

name: TerrainSample
description:
Some routes are decided by a single number: how much the ground rises under your feet. TerrainSample turns that number into something you can see before you leave the house. You draw a line across a map, the app asks OpenTopography for the height of the terrain at regular intervals along it, and the answer comes back as a profile you can read the way you read a landscape — where the climb bites, where it eases off, where the ridge falls away on both sides.

The profile is treated as a surface rather than a graph. Switch it to hillshade and the ground is lit from the north-west, the way a cartographer would draw it; switch to slope and every metre is coloured by its gradient, so the cruel parts announce themselves; switch to contour and the height lines come forward. Drag a finger across it and a cursor reads the exact height and gradient under your finger, so a suspicion about a steep pitch becomes a measurement.

TerrainSample is honest about what a digital elevation model can and cannot tell you. Every profile carries the dataset it came from, its grid resolution, its vertical datum and its licence, and the app says plainly that a thirty-metre surface cannot see a step, a tree trunk or a boulder. Heights are a shape, not a survey.

For walking, running and riding, the app marks the stretches where a bike has to be pushed or carried, and the crests where the ground drops away on both sides. It also learns your pace: record a few outings you have already done and the time estimate stops being a textbook average and starts being yours.

Before a trip into the hills, build an offline pack. The app samples a coarse square of heights around a region and stores it on the phone, so profiles inside that square still work with no signal and without spending another request. Four reference grids come with the app for the routes it ships with.

For geology teaching, the profile can be read against the rock beneath it: a column of units runs along the same distance axis, and each unit explains how its resistance to erosion shaped the gradient above it. Hard, jointed rock stands up as steps; soft rock is worn into benches and hollows.

• Help Santa, his elves, and the wonderful inhabitants of the Christmas world.
• Explore snowy landscapes, magical workshops, and festive places.

Your Very Own Advent Calendar

Choose which door to open and discover the surprise waiting inside!

There is no race against time. Just wonderful discoveries, playful challenges, and the pleasure of making Christmas a little more magical.

The workshop doors are open. Santa is waiting.

Are you ready to become the Christmas Apprentice?

name: The Rotation Closet
description:
What to wear, already decided.

Photograph your closet once. Every morning The Rotation turns the rack and stops on one outfit, picked for the weather and the kind of day you have. One tap and you are dressed.

HOW IT WORKS
- Add your clothes with the camera. Each piece is redrawn as a clean catalog picture, so your closet looks like a shop.
- Open the app in the morning. Today shows one outfit: layer, top, bottom, belt and shoes, with a line on why it works.
- Not feeling it? Dress me picks again, or swap any single piece.
- Tap Wear this and it is logged, so the app does not hand you the same thing next week.

IT KNOWS YOUR DAY
- Reads the forecast for your town: a coat when it is cold, no suede in the rain.
- Connect your calendar and it dresses you up on the days that call for it. It sees only whether a day is ordinary or dressed up, never the titles of your events.

CHECK AN OUTFIT
- Put on your own combination, take a photo, and ask if it works. You get a straight answer: it works, one change, or not quite, with the piece from your closet to swap in.

MORE THAN THIS MORNING
- Trips: say where and when, and it plans an outfit for each day from a small bag, with a packing list.
- Favorites: mark the looks you like and they come back more often.
- Wishlist: paste a link from any store. It shows what the piece goes with in your closet and tells you when the price drops.
- Shop: ideas for what your closet is missing, in the price range and brands you choose.
- Looks: share an outfit with the community if you want to. Your closet stays private.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- A Today widget shows the day's outfit.
- A morning notification brings it to you at the hour you set.

Your photos and closet are yours. Download everything or delete your account at any time in Settings.

name: Think & Slide
description:
Slide the pieces into the empty space until they match the target.

Think & Slide is a calm 4×4 sliding puzzle. Each game shows you a target pattern. Move the tiles one at a time until your board looks the same. It's easy to learn and fun to master, for kids and grown-ups alike.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Two colors: sort 15 pieces of two colors into the target pattern.
• Four colors: a harder challenge with four colors to place.
• Pairs: put each character next to its object, like Rabbit & Carrot, Horse & Hay ball, Child & Playground, and Family & Home. Choose 1 to 4 pairs to set the difficulty.

ALWAYS SOLVABLE
Every puzzle is scrambled with real moves, so every board can be solved. Stuck? Peek at the target, undo a move, reshuffle, or try a new target.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Pick from soft, nature-inspired color sets like Seaside, Garden, Dusk and Fjord.
• Each color also has its own shape, so pieces are easy to tell apart, also for color-blind players.
• Swap the pair pictures for your own photos.
• Light, Dark or Automatic theme.
• Show or hide the moves, time and "to fix" counters. They're hidden by default for a relaxed game.

FAIR AND FAMILY-FRIENDLY
• 3 free puzzles every day.
• One small payment unlocks unlimited puzzles forever. No subscription.
• No ads, ever.
• Purchases are behind a parental gate.
• Available in 10 languages.

Take a breath, think it through, and slide.

name: Ukrainian Cossacks
description:
Take command in 1654 and reshape Eastern Europe in a deterministic, turn-based tactical strategy game with zero randomness.

Here, victory belongs to pure calculation, positioning, and territory control. You don't have to fight every enemy head-on—cut off their supply lines, and isolated armies will collapse before they can strike back.

KEY FEATURES:

- Pure Deterministic Combat (No RNG)
No lucky rolls or hidden crits. Combat outcomes are determined by unit tiers, terrain bonuses, fortifications, and adjacent ally support—with an exact battle preview before every attack.

- Supply Lines & Encirclement
Every move captures territory. Cut enemy units off from their capital and villages to isolate and eliminate even the strongest forces without a direct fight.

- 4 Historical Factions
Command the Cossacks (Hetmanate), Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Crimean Khanate, or Muscovy—each with distinct unit art, banners, buildings, and voiceovers.

- Massive Offline Campaign
38 historical provinces and 150 handcrafted levels with separate progression for every faction. Play the entire campaign offline anytime.

- Adaptive AI & Interactive Tutorial
10 levels of adaptive AI difficulty that scales with your skill, plus a step-by-step tutorial covering combat, economy, and supply tactics.

- Local 1v1 Duel (HotSeat)
Play against a friend on a single device with automatic 180° camera and UI rotation between turns. Includes optional chess clocks (Blitz, Rapid, Tactical) for fast-paced matches.

- Deep Terrain & Logistics
Master 6 biomes (plains, forests, hills, swamps, rivers, and impassable mountains), build villages, roads, bridges, and watchtowers, and fight across 4 seasons with dynamic weather.

- Fair & One-Handed
Designed for crisp portrait-mode gameplay. No pay-to-win mechanics, no paid combat boosts—just pure tactical depth.

name: Velth: Step Counter & Races
description:
A step counter you share with your friends: Velth turns walking into a race. Your iPhone or Apple Watch already counts your steps; Velth puts them next to your friends’ and makes every day a small competition.

Your daily step goal stops being just a number. Challenge a friend to a duel, set up a stage race with your crew, walk all day and see who won in the morning.

DUELS: ONE-ON-ONE WALKING CHALLENGES • You and a friend for 1, 3 or 7 days. Most steps wins. • Send the invite link; your friend joins in one tap.

STAGE RACES: DAYS WITH YOUR CREW • 3 to 20 people, 3 to 28 days. Every day is a stage with points by place. • Head start: people who walked less in recent weeks start each day a little ahead, so everyone has a shot. • Home straight, podium and medals: gold, silver and bronze when the race ends.

FAIR PLAY • Steps are read from Apple Health; steps entered by hand don’t count. • Nothing above 30,000 a day counts, and hours over 12,000 are checked by whoever set up the race. • Each day is final the next morning.

MOTIVATION: STREAKS, FORM, LEVELS • Hit your daily goal to grow your streak; your weekly form comes back as points. • Breaks for illness or travel that keep your streak. • Six levels from Street to World, medals and weekly awards. • Home Screen widget: today’s steps, your streak and your place in the race. • Notifications when someone passes you and when results are in. You choose which ones.

PRIVACY • Your steps are visible only to the people you race with. • No ads, no tracking, your data is never sold. • Delete your account and all your data from the app in one tap.

Velth is free. It’s a walking game, not medical advice.

name: VolumeHabitJournal
description:
Volume HabitJournal is a quiet booklet used to record something we rarely pay attention to: how much volume we actually turn up. After listening to a song, an episode of a podcast, or a video, just jot down a number, which is the level you feel comfortable at that time, and then add the scene, equipment, and listening experience. After a few times, you can see the pattern: which pair of headphones always make you unconsciously turn up, which time of day is the easiest to increase the sound, and where are your truly comfortable positions.

If you have also turned down the volume after listening for a long time and are curious about how it increases, this can be used as a starting point to pay attention.

name: WarrTrack
description:
WarrTrack keeps the warranties of your purchases in one place, so you know what each one covers and when it expires, and reminds you before it is too late.

SCAN YOUR RECEIPT OR INVOICE
Photograph the receipt or invoice and WarrTrack reads the store, date and amount on your own iPhone to fill in the entry. You review and save.

WARRANTY PERIOD IN A SNAP

EVERYTHING TOGETHER
Keep several photos of receipts and invoices and attach files, such as the warranty coverage document. Note the store, the price in EUR, USD or another currency, and your notes.

BY CATEGORY
Appliances, electronics, tools, automotive and more, or create your own. Add a warranty straight from each category.

REMINDERS AND CALENDAR
Reminders 30, 7 and 1 day before expiry, and a calendar with every expiry of the year.

PRIVACY FIRST
No sign-up, no servers, no ads and no tracking. The app does not use the Internet. Optional lock with Face ID or passcode and CSV export of your warranties.

In English and Spanish.

**What's new (1.0):** First release of WarrTrack.

name: Xeibit: Save Links
description:
Ever see a video you like and then can't find it again? With Xeibit you save it in a second and keep it organized.

Perfect for saving recipes, workouts, travel ideas, tutorials or music to watch later, and keeping your favorite reels and TikToks always at hand.

HOW IT WORKS
1. In TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X or any other app, tap Share.
2. Choose Xeibit.
3. It's saved in its folder, with its title and image, without leaving the app you're in.

When you want to watch it, tap it in Xeibit and it opens in its original app.

ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Automatic folders for each platform, plus your own: recipes, travel, humor, sports…
• Favorites for the ones you love most.
• A Private folder that opens with Face ID or your iPhone passcode.
• Search to find any video by its title.
• Several looks to make Xeibit your own.
• Available in 10 languages.

TRULY PRIVATE
• No accounts: no sign-up needed.
• No servers: everything stays on your iPhone and nobody else sees what you save.
• No ads.
• Only asks for the permissions it really needs.

Xeibit doesn't download videos: it saves the link, title and image, and opens it in its original app. So it takes up no space on your iPhone and creators don't lose their views.

A PERSONAL PROJECT
Xeibit is a personal project, made in Santiago de Compostela, Spain, with one clear goal: to be as safe as possible. It's free and has no ads. If you like it, a rating helps me a lot.

Questions, ideas, or a link that doesn't save properly? Write to info@xeibit.com.

Xeibit is an independent app and is not affiliated with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook or X. Their names and logos belong to their respective owners.

name: XiPlay – Media Player
description:
XiPlay is a lean media player for Apple TV and iPad. It plays your own videos - on Apple TV entirely with the remote, on iPad with touch.

IMPORTANT
XiPlay is a player. The app contains no channels, movies or series and does not recommend any providers. You need your own playlist or your own network drive. You are responsible for the content yourself.
After installation the app is empty: you add your own list or connect your own network drive (NAS).

LIVE TV
• Channel list with groups and preview
• Favorites and your own custom order
• TV guide (XMLTV)
• Sleep timer
• Connection speed indicator (Mbit/s)

MOVIES & SERIES
• Continue Watching right where you left off
• Keep track of seasons and episodes, mark whole seasons as watched
• Choose audio track and subtitles
• Search across channels, movies and series

LIBRARY FROM YOUR NETWORK DRIVE
• Your own videos from your NAS (WebDAV or SMB) in tidy rows with thumbnails
• Continue Watching for your own videos, too

APPLE TV
• Top Shelf: recently watched channels, new movies or your favorite items right on the Home Screen
• Press and hold any item to put it on the Home Screen yourself

COMFORT
• Picture format per channel, movie and series (original, fill screen, stretch, zoom)
• Parental controls: a 4-digit PIN locks groups and sources

name: YakCall
description:
약콜은 약 먹을 시간에 AI가 먼저 전화를 걸어 복용을 챙겨 주는 복약 컨시어지예요. 알림을 끄고 잊어버리는 대신, 전화로 "드셨나요?"라고 물어보고 대답만으로 기록을 남겨요. 미국에서 일반의약품을 스스로 골라 먹는 분, 영어 약 설명이 어려운 분, 여러 약을 함께 드시는 분을 위해 만들었어요.

■ AI가 먼저 전화해요

정해 둔 시간에 약 이름과 함께 전화가 걸려 와요.
잠금 화면과 음성에서는 약 이름을 숨길 수 있고, 통화는 녹음하지 않아요.

■ "먹었어" 한마디로 기록 끝

통화 중 대답만 하면 복용 완료로 자동 기록돼요.
"오늘 비타민 먹었었나?"처럼 물어보면 기록을 보고 바로 답해요.
매일 먹는 약과 복용 기록을 날짜별로 한 화면에서 확인해요.

■ 같이 먹어도 될까? 3단계로 바로 확인

내 약, 나이, 임신 여부, 알레르기를 함께 보고 '괜찮아요 / 같이 먹지 마세요 / 확인 필요'로 알려 줘요.
판단이 애매하면 약사에게 물어볼 수 있도록 연결해요.

■ 근처 매장 재고 미리 보기

근처 약국·마트에 약이 남아 있는지, 가격은 얼마인지 미리 비교해요.
도시를 바꿔 다른 지역의 재고도 볼 수 있어요.

■ 낯선 미국 약도 한국어로

마트 진열대의 일반의약품을 효과·성분별로 정리한 도감을 제공해요.
약 라벨을 찍어 성분을 확인하고, 약국에서 보여 줄 영어 카드를 만들어요.
한국어와 영어 음성으로 또박또박 읽어 줘요.

■ 개인정보

복용 기록과 내 약 목록은 기기 안에만 저장돼요.
음성은 Apple 음성 인식으로 글자로 바뀌며, 약콜은 통화를 녹음하지 않아요.

[안내] 약콜은 복약 관리를 돕는 정보 서비스이며 의사·약사의 진단이나 처방을 대신하지 않아요. 복용량 변경이나 처방약 대체는 반드시 의사 또는 약사와 상담하세요. 재고·가격 정보는 참고용이며 매장 사정에 따라 다를 수 있어요. 응급 상황에서는 즉시 911(한국 119)에 연락하세요.

name: Застолье: меню и гости
description:
«Застолье» — планировщик праздничного стола, который делает то, чего не умеют обычные списки и книги рецептов.

ЧЕГО НЕТ В ДРУГИХ ПРИЛОЖЕНИЯХ
• Гости отвечают по ссылке прямо в браузере — без приложения и регистрации: «приду, нас двое, несу торт». Вы нажимаете на ответ — всё отмечается само.
• Рассадка за столом в одно касание: пары рядом, дети у родителей, хозяйка у кухни, спорщики — подальше.
• Помощники на кухне: «Папа — нарезать оливье в 18:15». Каждому — свой список по ссылке, «сделано» возвращается к вам.
• Остатки по срокам Роспотребнадзора: до какого часа доесть, что заморозить, что приготовить на 1 января.
• Приложение учится на вашей семье: в следующий раз оливье будет ровно столько, сколько у вас съедают.
• Балкон по прогнозу погоды: можно ли вынести кастрюли в ночь перед праздником — или морс замёрзнет.
• «Что приготовить?» — поднос-барабан с блюдами: крутите или встряхните телефон. С учётом того, что есть дома, сколько есть времени и кто не ест мясо; можно собрать ужин целиком.

СКОЛЬКО ГОТОВИТЬ
• 7 взрослых и 2 детей, двое без майонеза, один вегетарианец — количество каждого блюда считается само.
• Чем больше салатов, тем меньше нужно каждого — как на настоящем застолье. Аппетит: «скромно» или «как у бабушки».
• 46 блюд — от оливье и холодца до утки с яблоками и «Наполеона». Любое можно изменить под себя: свои продукты, количество, время, фото.
• Своё блюдо — с нуля, по ссылке на рецепт, с фото страницы кулинарной книги или бабушкиной тетради, вставкой текста: продукты и количество распознаются сами, рецепт «на 6 человек» пересчитается на ваших гостей.

ПОКУПКИ И ДЕНЬГИ
• Один список по магазинам — рынок, супермаркет, пекарня — сразу в упаковках: «2 пачки майонеза», «десяток яиц».
• Итог стола, сколько с человека и кто кому переводит; семья скидывается одной строкой.
• Наведите камеру на QR-код чека — трата запишется сама.

ПЛАН ГОТОВКИ ПО ЧАСАМ
• Время считается назад от начала застолья: «10:00 — утку в маринад», «13:00 — сварить овощи на оливье и шубу».
• В духовке два противня — третье блюдо приложение поставит раньше. Покупки разложены по дням.
• 31 декабря текущее дело с таймером — на экране блокировки и в «острове», кнопка «Готово» прямо там.

ВИДЖЕТЫ
• «Покупки» — отмечайте купленное галочкой прямо на рабочем столе, не открывая приложение.
• «План» — ближайшие дела по часам с кнопкой «Готово».
• «Гости» — кто придёт, что несёт и кто ещё не ответил.
• «До застолья» — дни до праздника, покупки и ближайшее дело; есть и для экрана блокировки.

ПОСЛЕ ПРАЗДНИКА
• Отметьте «съели всё», «осталась половина» или «почти не ели» — получите сроки, напоминания и список «гостям с собой».
• Альбом застолий: фото стола, кто был, что съели подчистую, заметка на следующий год.

И ЕЩЁ
• Тайный Дед Мороз: жеребьёвка ссылками, пары и семьи друг другу не дарят.
• Новый год, Рождество, Масленица, 23 Февраля, 8 Марта, Пасха (дата считается сама), шашлыки, день рождения, юбилей и просто гости.

Все праздники хранятся только на вашем iPhone. Приглашения и ответы — это ссылки: данные лежат в самой ссылке, на сервер ничего не уходит. Без аккаунтов и подписок.
