name: 잘못된 기억
description:
오래 가지 않은 곳은 안개에 잠긴다. 그곳을 기억해 내면, 기억한 그대로 돌아온다. 틀리게 기억해도.

당신은 잊혀 가는 세계의 마지막 기록관. 세 곳을 차례로 빠져나가야 한다.

1장 잊혀 가는 왕국 — 문지기는 왕이 죽었다고 믿고, 성문은 왕의 인장 없이는 열리지 않는다. 왕이 살아 있었다고 기억해 보면 어떨까?
2장 물레방아 나루 — 강물은 불었고 나룻배는 가라앉았다. 이 마을에서는 원인과 결과가 맞물린다. 강물이 빠지려면 무엇이 먼저 바뀌어야 할까?
3장 등불 항구 — 선장은 밤에만 배를 띄운다. 그런데 지금은 한낮이다. 이 항구에서는 하늘이 하나다.

■ 기억으로 세계를 고친다 — 안개 낀 곳은 당신이 고르거나 글로 적은 모습대로 돌아온다.
■ 그러나 거짓말에는 증인이 있다 — 깨어 있는 사람의 말, 남은 기록, 맞물린 원인과 어긋나는 기억은 흩어진다.
■ 시간은 흐른다 — 정해진 틱 안에 빠져나가지 못하면 그곳 전체가 안개에 잠긴다.
■ 결말은 하나가 아니다 — 2장과 3장은 다른 길로도 빠져나갈 수 있다. 찾은 결말과 최고 기록이 장마다 남는다.
■ 장별 순위 — 가장 적은 틱으로 빠져나간 기록관이 위에 오른다(어썸 계정, 선택).

가입 없이 바로 시작한다. 판 중간에는 광고가 없다. 그곳이 안개에 사라졌을 때 원하면 광고를 보고 한 번 더 버틸 수 있다.

name: シンプル動画編集 - 自動字幕＆テロップ作成
description:
「シンプル動画編集」は、TikTok・YouTubeショート・Instagramリールなどの縦型ショート動画制作に特化した、軽快で使いやすい動画編集アプリです。

【主な機能】 ・直感的なタイムライン編集：動画のカット・分割・並び替え・トリミングが指先ひとつで完結 ・AI音声認識による自動字幕：動画の音声から自動でテロップを生成し、文字起こし作業を大幅短縮 ・豊富なテロップ＆デザイン：極太ゴシック・丸ゴシック・明朝体などの書体や、黒縁取り・座布団・出現アニメーションを設定可能 ・画像・スタンプ挿入：写真や画像をタイムラインに追加し、自由な位置・サイズで配置（レイヤー順の入れ替えにも対応） ・BGM・効果音＆音声読み上げ：プリセットBGMや端末内の音楽、動画からの音声抽出、テキスト読み上げ（TTS）も搭載 ・高画質書き出し：編集した動画をすぐにカメラロールへ保存（Pro版でフルHD 1080p出力＆広告・透かし非表示に対応）

name: 留学バトン
description:
留学バトンは、留学・ワーキングホリデーのための「引き継ぎ掲示板」です。

帰国する先輩から、これから渡航する後輩へ。
住まい・仕事・家具や家電・現地の生活情報を、バトンのようにつなぐサービスです。

■ こんな方におすすめ
・これから留学・ワーキングホリデーに行く予定で、現地の住まいや仕事を探している方
・帰国が決まり、住まいや家具、家電などを次の方に引き継ぎたい方
・渡航準備や現地の生活について、経験者に気軽に相談したい方
・同じ街で生活する仲間と交流したい方

■ 主な機能
・掲示板：住まい（シェアハウス・部屋）、仕事、家具・家電・自転車などの譲渡情報を、都市や条件に応じて検索できます。
・投稿：写真付きで、簡単に情報を投稿できます。
・メッセージ：気になる投稿の相手と、アプリ内で1対1のやり取りができます。個人の連絡先を公開する必要はありません。
・Q&A：渡航準備や現地の生活に関する疑問を質問し、経験者から回答を得ることができます。
・ひとこと・つながる：近況の共有や、同じ街にいる仲間との交流、イベントへの参加ができます。
・通知：メッセージや回答が届いた際に、通知でお知らせします。

■ ご利用にあたって
留学バトンは、夢カナ留学および業務提携先のサービスをご利用の方を対象とした会員限定サービスです。

運営：株式会社Jstyle（夢カナ留学）
お問い合わせ：info@jstyle-yumekana.com

name: 診療放射線技師 過去問
description:
診療放射線技師国家試験の過去問を、午前・午後に分けて解けるアプリです。第74回〜第77回の4回分、789問を収録しています(厚生労働省が公表した問題と正答)。
【収録している問題】
・午前・午後あわせて789問(各回の午前100問・午後100問から、公式が採点から除外した問題などを除いています)
・「2つ選べ」「3つ選べ」の複数選択問題 89問に対応
・別冊の医用画像(X線写真・CT・MRI・超音波・核医学の画像)つきの問題 93問。画像は公式の紙面のまま表示し、タップで拡大できます
・グラフ・回路・計算式を含む問題は、公式の紙面を画像で表示します
【解き方】
・第74回〜第77回の回ごと、午前・午後ごとに解けます
・間違えた問題は「今日の復習」に入り、その後も1・3・7・14・30日後に出てきます
・分析の画面で、午前・午後ごとの正答率(弱い順)・連続で学習した日数・今日の解答数を確認できます
【ご利用にあたって】
・出典: 厚生労働省ホームページ「診療放射線技師国家試験問題および正答について」(第74回〜第77回)を加工して作成。このアプリは厚生労働省の公式アプリではなく、同省が作成したものではありません。
・解説は収録していません。正答と○×の表示のみです。
・学習の記録は端末の中に保存され、アカウント登録は不要です。
・合格を保証するものではありません。

name: Shout Hop: Voice Runner
description:
Your voice is the controller: talk to make Hop run, scream to make him jump, and film the laughter.

• No buttons: the louder you talk, the faster Hop runs; the louder you scream, the higher he jumps
• Party mode: your face is filmed while you play, then you get a vertical video ready to share
• Whisper mode: play silently on the train or at the office
• Daily Challenge: the same level for everyone, a Game Center leaderboard and a day streak
• Duel: 2 to 4 players take turns on one phone
• 20 to 40 second runs, perfect for passing the phone around

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• The reaction video is built in: no second phone needed to film
• A 10-second automatic calibration adapts the game to your voice and the room noise
• A whisper mode so you can play anywhere, even when you need to be quiet
• Touch control for people who can't speak or shout

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 30 levels across 3 worlds: Meadow, City Rooftops and Volcano
• 3 stars per level: finish, grab the notes, beat the clock
• A high-pitched voice in the air makes Hop glide; a murmur gets him under low ceilings
• 13 characters and 6 jump sounds
• Daily Challenge widget, Siri Shortcuts, dark mode
• Available in 10 languages, on iPhone and iPad

YOUR VOICE STAYS YOURS
• In normal games no sound is recorded: the app only measures the volume and pitch of your voice, on your device, then forgets them
• In Party mode the video stays on your device until you share it
• No account, no sign-up, no data sent to our servers

Free. Optional one-time in-app purchases (no subscription): character packs, a sound pack, and one purchase that removes the promo screens between games and lets you continue instantly.

Support: https://noxiforge.com/contact/

Tip: warn your neighbors.

name: gametuck
description:
gametuck plays the retro game files you own, on iPhone and iPad, with touch controls built to be exact.

PRECISE TOUCH CONTROLS
No setup, nothing to drag around. The D-pad sits on the left, B and A on the right, and they never move. The whole side of the screen is the button area, so your thumbs never miss, and pressing both A and B is a roll of the thumb. Every press is read the instant it lands, quick taps are never lost, and a light tap of haptics confirms each one.

OR BRING A CONTROLLER
MFi, Xbox, PlayStation and Backbone controllers work the moment they connect. Turn the touch controls off for a clean picture.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
gametuck saves your place every time you leave a game, and your library shows each game where you left it, sorted from a to z.

EARN ACHIEVEMENTS
Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in hundreds of classic games. It's optional, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you sign in.

YOUR GAMES, YOUR WAY
Add game files (.nes and .zip) or whole folders from Files, iCloud Drive or AirDrop. Switch vibration, button sounds and game sound on or off.

COMES WITH GAMEPI
No games yet? gamepi, a free little platformer made for gametuck, is one tap away in settings.

gametuck doesn't include or download any commercial games. Play only game files you legally own.

The emulation core is QuickNES, licensed under the GNU LGPL 2.1; its source is at github.com/Ivanmtta/quicknes-lgpl.

name: (Witness) Protection
description:
Witness turns your camera into a protected-witness interview from the TV news.

Point it at yourself and your face is found and pixelated automatically, following you as you move. Your voice is pitched down, or turned into a robotic vocoder, live as you talk. Add a lower-third caption and on-device subtitles, record a take, and save or share it.

• Face: mosaic, blur, black bar, or a full silhouette
• Voice: the classic pitch-down or a vocoder, adjustable while you listen
• Scene: blur the background, edit the lower-third caption, turn on live subtitles
• Everything runs on your device. Nothing you film or say is uploaded. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Witness is for fun and for the look of a TV interview. It isn't a guarantee of anonymity: a face that is turned away or partly covered can be missed, and a pitch-shifted voice can sometimes be shifted back.

name: 10-48 Admin
description:
10-48 Admin is the officer app for police departments that use 10-48 Admin. Your department adds you and sends your invite. Then you sign in with a code texted to your phone.

Built for small and mid-size departments, it replaces the clipboards, group texts and spreadsheets behind the daily admin work.

CRUISER CHECK
• Check your assigned unit in seconds: odometer, then All Good or Flag Issue
• Mark an issue minor or out of service, and add a note and a photo
• Works with no signal; checks send when you're back in range

SCHEDULE
• Your next shift, your upcoming shifts and your squad
• Get notified when you're moved or added, and tap Acknowledge
• Request time off and see when it's approved

MY GEAR & TRAINING
• See every item issued to you, with serial numbers and expirations
• Confirm receipt, report a problem or ask for a replacement
• Your CEU hours and qualifications, as logged by your department

ALSO
• Alerts for schedule changes, time-off decisions, new gear and expiring items
• History of your recent checks, reports and acknowledgments
• If a phone is lost, your department can sign it out remotely

10-48 Admin holds administrative records only. It is not a records management system and doesn't hold criminal-justice information.

The app is free for officers. Your department's office uses the 10-48 Admin web dashboard.

name: 1st Platform: Ambient Sounds
description:
Settle into a rainy coffee shop with just enough background noise to study or read. Take the window seat for more rain, or move to the espresso bar for the hiss of steam and the clink of cups. Listen to the room on its own or let it play beneath your favorite music.

Ride the lift in 1st Platform and explore five rooms in 3D. Each has four places to sit, and every seat changes what you hear.

• Cozy Coffee Shop — Share a long table with the regulars, or slip into the reading nook where the chatter fades into the background.
• The Tea Shop — Listen to the kettle at the tea counter, or sit by the round window for bamboo chimes and birds in the garden.
• The Bakehouse — Pull up a stool by the ovens. The wood fire crackles as the bakers slide in another tray.
• The Grand Lobby — Sink into a lounge sofa with the fountain nearby. Now and then, a bell rings at the front desk or a suitcase rolls across the marble floor.
• The Jazz Bar — Take a seat by the stage for soft piano and double bass, or settle into a booth with rain against the glass.

Each room has six sound controls. Turn up the rain, soften the voices, or mute the espresso machine when you need to focus. Save your favorite seat and mix as your usual, and the lift will take you there next time.

All five rooms work offline and keep playing when you lock your screen.

Privacy Policy: https://binggu1996-home-page.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://binggu1996-home-page.web.app/terms

name: 20 Dollar Draft: Party Game
description:
Everyone gets the same budget. A list of silly things shows prices. Take turns drafting your team, then argue about whose team is best.

Pass one phone around the room and play a $20 draft with friends. Pick a pack, say who is playing, and start. No account, no sign-up, no internet needed.

HOW A ROUND GOES
Pick a theme, for example Pizza Night, Zoo Breakout or Roommates From Hell. Each option has a price. You have $20 and four picks. Spend it all on one star or spread it out. Every option can be drafted by one player only, so the best things go fast.
Then the teams are revealed one by one. Vote on the best team, let one judge decide, or just argue until you agree. The winner gets a result card you can share.

WHAT IS FREE
The whole game. 18 free packs, a pack builder of your own, 2 to 8 players, every mode, light and dark look, sound and haptics you can switch off, and a saved game if you close the app. No ads. No timers.

WHAT YOU CAN ADD
One payment unlocks all the extra packs and every pack added later. No subscription and no weekly plan. If you ever change phones, tap Restore Purchase.

MADE FOR
Game nights, car rides, dorm rooms, office parties, and anyone who loves a pointless argument.

Optional 18+ "After dark" packs (innuendo and dark humour) are off by default and switched on in Settings after an age confirmation.

GOOD TO KNOW
Works fully offline. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere. Games are saved on your phone only. All lists are original and made for this game.

Not affiliated with TikTok, Google, Apple or any league, brand or franchise.

name: 2027 AGB Forum
description:
Make the most of your experience at the 2027 AGB Foundation Leadership Forum with the event app.

The Foundation Leadership Forum brings together college and university foundation board members, chief executives, professional staff, institutional leaders, and industry experts from across the country. Together, participants will examine how foundations can strengthen governance, deepen institution-foundation partnerships, prepare for the future of philanthropy, and advance the mission of public higher education.

The 2027 AGB Forum app helps you get more from your time in Washington, DC, so you can walk away with an action plan for the year ahead. Use the app to build your agenda, explore sessions and speakers, connect with fellow attendees, access event resources, and stay up to date throughout the Forum.

name: 369 Wars
description:
Drop a tile. Build a chain. Time your next move.

369 Wars turns a compact 5 × 7 board into a number-merging duel. Tap a column, combine equal tiles and plan around your next tile. Build larger numbers while keeping room for the next drop.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Practice without a match timer and pause when you need a break.
• Challenge the bot in a three-minute duel.
• Use Apple Game Center to invite a friend or search for an online 1v1 match.

MAKE YOUR ENERGY COUNT
Merges earn energy for four skills. Attack sends a garbage tile to your opponent. Shield blocks an incoming garbage attack. Smoke hides the top four rows of the opponent’s board for three seconds. Clear lets you choose a tile to remove.

FEEL EVERY MOVE
Enjoy animated drops, merges and chains, original sound effects, optional background music and haptic feedback. Adjust sound, music and haptics separately, or enable Reduce Motion for simpler feedback.

Available in English, Thai, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Practice and bot play work offline. Online play requires an internet connection, Game Center and a different Game Center account for each player. Quick Match requires another compatible player to be available. Keep the app in the foreground during an online duel; if the connection ends, return to the lobby to start another match.

name: 4096: Slide & Merge
description:
Slide the tiles. Match equal numbers. Watch them merge and double. Can you build a 4096?

4096: Slide & Merge is a calm, satisfying take on the sliding-number puzzle, played on a roomy 5×5 board. Every swipe moves every tile. Two tiles with the same number merge into one worth twice as much, and a new tile appears. Plan ahead, keep your big numbers in a corner, and don't let the board fill up.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: play at your own pace, with undo when you need it.
• Daily: one new board each day, the same for everyone. Your first finish counts on the daily leaderboard.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Smooth sliding, gentle sounds and light haptics
• Every number has its own bold color, in light and dark mode
• Pick up exactly where you left off
• Stats and streaks sync across your devices with iCloud

GAME CENTER
Climb the Best Score and Daily leaderboards and earn achievements, from your first merge to the 8192 tile.

ACCESSIBLE
Full VoiceOver support, including moving tiles with VoiceOver actions. Respects Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNTS.
Your data stays on your devices. Free, with no in-app purchases.

name: 5PCL SE
description: This app is designed for scenarios where a single payment serves multiple purposes. After recording the amount, date, and account, you can split the total into smaller portions and assign each to its respective expense category. For instance, you could allocate a portion of your monthly internet bill to "work/study" while keeping the remainder under "housing." When selecting multiple categories, the app displays the net actual expenditure (excluding overlaps), the amount shared across categories, and any double-counted figures; you can also expand these entries to view the original transaction. You can set default categories for recurring payments and preview how these assignments will affect your past records. When a refund is received, you can verify its original purpose before reallocating it to the appropriate category. Additionally, items awaiting categorization, incomplete splits, and rule conflicts can all be managed—sorted by amount—within a single, unified list.

name: 5th Row Center: Theater Guide
description:
From Broadway Broadcasting's national award-winning TV talk show, 5th Row Center ...with Roma Torre, comes 5th Row Center: Theater Guide, to help you find your best seat in the house, whatever your budget.

THE SHOW PICKER
Choose New York or London, then pick by stage, mood, occasion or genre. Tap Surprise Me for a pick from each stage: Broadway, Off-Broadway, Cultural stage, Regional and Unexpected Experiences, from holiday spectaculars to circus and pop-ups.

Every show page brings together what you need to decide: Emmy Award-winning critic Roma Torre’s 5th Row Center TV reviews, links to the New York Stage Review critics, Broadway average ticket prices from The Broadway League, closing dates, and official box office, lottery and rush links. Save your favorites to a shortlist as you go.

THE CURTAIN CRAWL
Seeing more than one show in a day? The Curtain Crawl plans it for you. Add your performances, and the clock shows when to leave, how long it takes to get to the next theater and whether there’s time for a bite. You can even add 10 minutes for the bathroom line. Explore the theater map up close.

MY SHOW STACKS
Back from a theater binge? Log every show you saw on your trip, add a favorite moment and copy your tally to share.

5th Row Center does not sell tickets and does not collect your data. Ticket links go to each show’s official box office, lottery or rush page.

name: 70% Rider
description:
Seventy Percent Rider is built for delivery riders who want to stay organized, move fast, and get things done without the hassle.

Whether you are heading out for your first delivery of the day or wrapping up your last one, the app keeps everything you need right in your pocket. Your orders are organized in one place, so you always know what needs to go out, what is in progress, and what is already done.

When you arrive at a pickup or delivery point, scanning boxes takes seconds. Just point your camera at the QR code or barcode and the app handles the rest. No manual entry, no confusion. You can verify multiple boxes at once and set any order as your active ride with a single tap.

Completing a delivery is simple too. Take a photo at the doorstep as proof, capture your GPS location, and choose how the customer is paying, whether by card or cash. Once done, the order is marked complete and you can move on to the next one.

The app also keeps you in the loop with push notifications, so you never miss an update from your dispatcher. Check your notification list anytime and mark alerts as read once you have gone through them.

Built for riders working in the field, Seventy Percent Rider works in both English and Arabic, so you can use it in whichever language feels most natural to you.

What you can do with the app:

• View all your assigned orders and deliveries in one organized list
• Filter orders by city, date, and delivery status
• Scan QR codes and barcodes to verify packages instantly
• Set any order as your current active ride
• Take a delivery photo and capture location as proof
• Collect payments by card or cash
• Receive push notifications and stay updated
• Switch between English and Arabic anytime

name: 7K Golden Cue
description:
Welcome to 7K Golden Cue, the ultimate pool and billiards experience on your mobile device. Dive into the world of 8-ball and 9-ball games with stunning graphics and intuitive controls that bring the real-life pool hall to your fingertips.

**Quick Match and Tournaments**
Challenge yourself with quick matches or dive into competitive tournaments. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned pro, 7K Golden Cue offers multiple levels of difficulty to suit your skills. Participate in daily challenges and unlock new cues and tables as you progress.

**Multiplayer Action**
Compete against players from around the world in real-time multiplayer matches. Show off your skills, climb the leaderboards, and earn your place among the best. With seamless matchmaking, you can quickly find opponents and start playing instantly.

**Career Mode**
Embark on a world tour and conquer different cities to claim the prestigious Golden Cue. Each city presents unique challenges and rewards, pushing you to refine your strategy and perfect your shots.

**Customisation and Upgrades**
Personalise your gameplay with a variety of cues and tables. Earn coins to upgrade your equipment and enhance your performance. The better your gear, the more competitive you become.

**Realistic Physics and 3D Graphics**
Experience the most realistic pool physics and immersive 3D graphics. Every shot feels authentic, and the detailed visuals make each game a pleasure to play.


Download now and start your journey to becoming a pool legend. Whether you're playing for fun or aiming for the top, 7K Golden Cue offers endless hours of entertainment and challenge. Ready your cue and take your best shot today!

name: 9darts
description:
9darts ist das Turniertool für Dartspieler und Veranstalter. Turniere finden, anmelden, live mitfiebern und am Board schreiben, alles in einer App.

Turniere finden
Steel und E-Dart in deiner Nähe, nach Ort und Datum. Mit einem Tipp angemeldet, auch im Doppel mit Partner.

Live dabei
Jedes Spiel mit Spielstand, Average und Highlights, der Turnierbaum aktualisiert sich von selbst. Folge Spielern und sieh sofort, wo und gegen wen sie als Nächstes spielen.

Benachrichtigungen
Du bist dran, du schreibst, dein Ergebnis: 9darts meldet sich, wenn es dich betrifft. Auf Wunsch auch bei 180 und Highfinish der Spieler, denen du folgst.

Dein Spielerprofil
Average, 180er, Highfinishes und Platzierungen über alle Turniere, dazu deine nächsten Anmeldungen direkt auf der Startseite.

Checkout-Quiz
Ein Rest, drei Darts: Tipp deinen Weg ein wie am Board. Richtig oder falsch? 9darts zeigt dir, wie es geht.

Scorer fürs Board
Mach dein iPhone oder iPad zum Eingabegerät am Board. Spiegelst du es per AirPlay auf den Fernseher, zeigt der Fernseher das Spiel groß und ohne Tastatur. Fällt das WLAN aus, wird weitergeschrieben. Auch ohne Turnier: einfach ein schnelles Spiel starten.

Für Veranstalter
Anmeldungen, Auslosung, Turnierbaum, Geräte an den Boards und die Anzeige fürs Publikum. Die Turnierleitung geht auch am iPhone.

Anmelden mit Apple, Google oder E-Mail.

name: 9Hrm – Chấm công, tính lương
description:
9Hrm là app chấm công dành cho nhân viên của quán cà phê, nhà hàng, cửa hàng đang dùng phần mềm quản lý nhân sự 9Hrm của 9pos. Tài khoản do cửa hàng cấp: mở app, nhập mã thương hiệu, tên đăng nhập và mật khẩu là dùng được.

CHẤM CÔNG NGAY TẠI QUÁN
• Bấm Vào ca / Ra ca, kèm ảnh chụp có đóng dấu giờ và tên cửa hàng.
• Xác nhận đang ở cửa hàng bằng vị trí GPS hoặc quét mã QR đổi liên tục tại quầy.
• So khớp khuôn mặt (khi cửa hàng bật) để không ai chấm công hộ.
• Giờ chấm lấy theo máy chủ, chỉnh giờ trên điện thoại cũng không đổi được.
• Báo rõ khi đi trễ, chưa tới giờ ra ca hay quên chấm; ở lại làm thêm thì bấm Vào tăng ca, quản lý duyệt sau.

LỊCH CA VÀ CÔNG VIỆC
• Xem lịch ca của mình và của cả quán theo tuần.
• Đăng ký ca muốn làm, chờ quản lý duyệt.
• Việc hôm nay: checklist mở quầy, vệ sinh, đóng quầy; nhận việc và đánh dấu xong ngay trên điện thoại.
• Sổ tay quán: nội quy, quy trình, công thức; đọc và xác nhận đã đọc.

ĐƠN TỪ
• Xin nghỉ phép, nghỉ không lương, giải trình đi trễ, xin tăng ca, bổ sung công khi quên chấm.
• Theo dõi đơn đang chờ, đã duyệt hay bị từ chối.

CÔNG VÀ LƯƠNG RÕ RÀNG
• Bảng công theo tháng: số ca, giờ làm, công, phút đi trễ của từng ngày.
• Phiếu lương chi tiết: lương chính, phụ cấp, thưởng, phạt, tạm ứng, thực lĩnh; xác nhận phiếu ngay trong app.

THÔNG BÁO TỨC THÌ
• Báo ngay khi được xếp ca, đơn được duyệt, có phiếu lương mới hay được giao việc.

DÀNH CHO CHỦ QUÁN
Chủ quán và quản lý xếp ca, duyệt đơn, xem báo cáo và tính lương trên web 9Hrm. Nhân viên chỉ cần app này để chấm công và theo dõi công, lương của mình. Liên hệ 9pos để mở tài khoản cho cửa hàng.

Quyền riêng tư: 9Hrm chỉ dùng vị trí và camera lúc bạn chấm công. Ảnh và dữ liệu chấm công thuộc về cửa hàng nơi bạn làm việc.

name: 9pos Order – Gọi món tại bàn
description:
9pos Order là app gọi món tại bàn dành cho nhân viên phục vụ nhà hàng, quán cà phê, quán nhậu đang dùng phần mềm bán hàng 9pos. App chạy cùng dữ liệu với 9pos: menu, bàn, giá, khuyến mãi, máy in đều lấy từ phần mềm của quán, không phải nhập lại.

SƠ ĐỒ BÀN TRỰC QUAN
• Xem bàn theo khu vực, màu sắc cho biết bàn trống, đang phục vụ, đã gửi bếp hay đã tạm tính.

TẠM TÍNH VÀ THANH TOÁN
• Xem tạm tính theo lượt order hoặc gom theo món.

• In tạm tính, in kiểm số lượng, thanh toán tiền mặt, chuyển khoản (mã VietQR hiện ngay trên máy), quẹt thẻ, ghi nợ.

DÀNH CHO CHỦ QUÁN
• Phân quyền theo tài khoản nhân viên trong 9pos: ai được trả món, chiết khấu, chuyển bàn, thanh toán.

App dành cho quán đang dùng 9pos. Tài khoản đăng nhập do chủ quán cấp trong phần mềm 9pos. Chưa có tài khoản, liên hệ hotline 078 2525 078 hoặc https://9pos.vn để được tư vấn.

description: Look up any IPv4 or IPv6 address to read its abuse confidence score, reporter history, network owner and hosting profile, then keep the result in a searchable local ledger with notes, tags, batch checks and CSV or JSON exports. History, saved addresses and offline cache stay on the device so the ledger keeps working without a connection.

name: Abyssal Horror: Flesh Survivor
description:
Awaken within the abyssal darkness as an embryonic flesh monstrosity. In this forsaken bio-lab, survival is not granted—it is devoured! Slay grotesque aberrations, harvest severed limbs, stitch them into your living anatomy, and mutate into an unstoppable Old God overlord!

Abyssal Horror: Flesh Survivor is a visceral dark-fantasy roguelite horde survivor action RPG. Featuring deep procedural modular body construction, intense 360-degree combat, dynamic darkness vision mechanics, and rewarding permanent meta-progression.

100% AD-FREE & FULLY OFFLINE:
Enjoy pure, uninterrupted gameplay! No banner ads, no popups, no rewarded video walls, and no internet connection required. Play anytime, anywhere.

UNIQUE GAMEPLAY MECHANICS

8 MODULAR ANATOMICAL SLOTS
Break free from rigid hero archetypes! Your body is a customizable biological canvas. Freely attach harvested limbs and organs into 8 distinct anatomy sockets:
• Head: Acid Spitter, Void Maw, Mind Flayer Eyes, or Horned Ram.
• Torso: Chitin Carapace, Thorny Ribcage, or Spore Lung.
• Left & Right Claws: Scythe Blades, Pincer Crushers, or Shadow Rakes.
• Left & Right Wings: Membrane Gliders, Insectoid Flutter, or Spore Vanes.
• Tail: Stinger Lash, Spiked Flail, or Toxic Whip.
• Core Aura: Pulsing Eldritch Heart, Bioluminescent Beacon, or Void Vortex.

HARVEST, SEW & FUSE LIMBS
Every defeated monster drops organic limbs across 5 distinct rarity tiers (Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary). Open the Flesh Sewing Workshop at any time during battle to stitch new limbs or fuse duplicates to shatter level and stat caps!

RESONANT GENOME SYNERGIES
Combine specialized organ types to awaken game-changing passive synergies:
• Twin Scythes: Unleash Whirlwind Cleave attacks on dash.
• Toxic Spore Cloud: Coat the battlefield in caustic miasma that erodes enemy armor.
• Bioluminescent Radiance: Expand vision radius and blind nearby stalkers.
• Shadow Stalker: Drastically amplify backstab critical strike damage.
• Flesh Devourer: Convert slain enemies into instant HP restoration.

TACTICAL DARKNESS & LIGHT SUPPRESSION
The Abyss is enveloped in choking pitch-black shadow. Your bioluminescence guides your path, but beware—light attracts ravenous predators! Toggle "Mimicry Stealth" to extinguish your glow, slip past elite hunter packs, or set up devastating ambushes.

MYSTERIOUS ABYSSAL POIS & ALTARS
Explore procedurally generated arenas teeming with ancient secrets:
• Blood Altars: Offer captured flesh to activate ancient seals.
• Void Rifts: Trigger catastrophic shockwaves that annihilate surrounding swarms.
• Sanctuary Oases: Rest within radiant purification pools to recover vitality.
• Alien Flesh Meteors: Crack open fallen celestial cores for permanent max HP boosts!

MOTHER HIVE LABORATORY (PERMANENT META)
Collect Abyss Essence during every run to unlock permanent genetic enhancements, unlock starting strains (Flesh Abomination, Shadow Stalker, Toxic Devourer), and conquer higher Abyssal Tiers.

MOBILE POLISH & IOS OPTIMIZATIONS
• Responsive Dual-Mode Controls: Smooth virtual joystick and full tactile touch navigation.
• Notch & Dynamic Island Adapted: Full screen Safe Area padding for iPhone and iPad displays.
• Butter-Smooth 60 FPS: Lightweight procedural 2D rendering engine optimized for low battery drain.
• Zero Data Collection: Your game saves entirely on your local device.

Will you be consumed by the darkness, or become the apex predator of the Abyss?
Download Abyssal Horror: Flesh Survivor today and unleash your inner nightmare!

name: Acaib: Osmanlı Yemekleri
description: 72 Osmanlı yemeği, her biri kaynağıyla. Tariflerin çoğu Türabi Efendi'nin 1864'te Londra'da basılan yemek kitabındaki numaralı tariflere dayanıyor. Yemek adlarının geçtiği şenlik ve ziyafet listeleri tarifin altında yazıyor. Ölçü ve süreler bugünün mutfağına göre uyarlandı. Çorbalar, et ve balık yemekleri, dolmalar, börekler, pilavlar, tatlılar ve şerbetler var. Pişirirken adımlar tek tek ve büyük yazıyla gelir, ekran kararmaz, süre yazan adımda sayaç kurarsın. Evde olan malzemeyi işaretle, kalanını alışveriş listene ekle. Her tarif bir minyatüre bağlanıyor ve bağın nereye kadar gittiği açıkça yazıyor. Yemeğin resimde olmadığı yerde bunu da söylüyor. 34 tarifin minyatürü uygulamada, öbürlerinin yaprağı acaib.art’ta açılır. Uygulamadaki minyatürler The Metropolitan Museum of Art ve The Walters Art Museum'un açık lisanslı taramaları. Hesap gerekmez, reklam yok, tarifler internetsiz açılır.

name: AccelStudy 司法試験
description:
AccelStudy 司法試験は、司法試験・予備試験の短答式の過去問を、肢ごとの○×でテンポよく解いていく学習アプリです。憲法・民法・刑法を収録しています。
過去問を短い時間で何度も回せるよう、動作の軽さと操作のわかりやすさを重視しています。

■ 憲法・民法・刑法の過去問を収録
- 憲法: 司法試験（平成18年〜令和7年）と予備試験（平成23年〜令和7年）から、457問・肢1,367個
- 民法: 司法試験（平成18年〜令和7年）と予備試験（平成23年〜令和7年）から、464問・肢2,276個
- 刑法: 司法試験（平成18年〜令和7年）と予備試験（平成23年〜令和7年）から、444問・肢1,464個
- 見解・穴埋め・個数・対応づけの問題も収録しています
- 改正や判例変更で正誤が変わった肢は、今の法律での正誤に直し、出題当時との違いを注記しています
- 科目はホームの題から、ワンタップで切り替えられます。進み具合も科目ごとに記録します

■ 肢ごとの○×で、忘れかけたころに出し直す
- 1つの肢を1問として、画面下の大きな○×ボタンで答えます。片手でも操作できます
- 事例や設例のある肢は、その前提も一緒に表示します
- 答えるとすぐに正誤と解説が表示されます。誤りの肢は、正しく直した文と直した箇所を色で確認できます
- 問題文の色の付いた語句を押すと、誤りの箇所・ひっかけ・決め手の説明がその場で開きます
- 間違えた肢や、忘れかけている肢を、記憶の研究にもとづく間隔で自動的に出し直します
- 論点や章ごとの演習では、最後に「間違えた肢をもう一度」で解き直せます

■ 本試験と同じ形式でも演習
- 多肢選択の問題も、各記述に○×を付ける問題も、本試験と同じ形式で解けます
- 答え合わせのあと、記述ごとに正誤と解説を確認できます

■ 体系の資料と条文
- 憲法・民法・刑法の全体を、章・論点ごとにまとめた資料を収録しています
- 要件の整理、比較の表、図、判例の要旨、見解の対立、ひっかけの注意を載せています。初めて 語集もあります
- 資料の論点から、その論点の過去問をすぐに解けます
- 日本国憲法・民法・刑法・刑事訴訟法・国会法など23の法律の条文を、目次と検索から読めます
- 解説や資料の中の条文は、押すとその場で確認できます

■ 進み具合がひと目でわかる
- 今日の目標、学習した肢・定着した肢の数、連続学習日数を表示します
- 試験日と「新しい肢を見終える目標日」を決めると、1日に必要な数と、今のペースで間に合うかを表示します
- 20肢のミニテストで、点数・正答率・タイムの推移を確認できます

■ プライバシー
- アカウント登録は不要です。学習の記録はすべて端末の中に保存され、外部には送信しません
- インストール後は、インターネットに接続していなくても使えます

■ ご注意
- 解説・正しく直した文・資料は、AI が条文と判例をもとに作成し、別の AI で確認したものです。誤りが含まれる可能性があります
- 問題文は、法務省ウェブサイトで公表されている試験問題を加工して作成したもので、法務省がが作成したものではありません

name: AccordNest
description:
Keep meeting decisions connected to action. Save meeting notes, attendees and decisions, then add actions with an owner and due date. Find open, overdue or completed actions across meetings. Mark actions complete and review decisions alongside progress. Records remain private to your device; this is a personal organizer, without team sync.

Core tools work offline. No login, ads or in-app purchases. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance and one of eight interface languages. Your records and preferences persist between launches. Optional sample data helps you explore an empty library.

name: Acorn: Learn Language
description:
Learn English playfully with Puko! Acorn turns vocabulary, pronunciation, reading, and sentence building into 9 hands-on, illustrated games designed for children, beginners, and families.

From first words to real everyday sentences, Acorn guides learners step by step through over 195 curated levels across three progressive stages:

1. VOCABULARY & LISTENING
• Meet the Letters — Explore the alphabet and swipe through illustrated words with clear native audio.
• Word Match — Read, listen, and connect each word with its matching illustration.
• Balloon Pop — Pop colorful floating balloons and hear every new word aloud.

2. SPEAKING & READING
• Speaking Studio — Listen to natural pronunciation, tap the microphone, and practice saying words and everyday phrases out loud.
• Sentence Wheel — Spin the wheel to listen and explore practical everyday expressions.
• Word Search — Spot hidden English words across, down, and diagonally inside the letter grid.

3. SPELLING & SENTENCE BUILDING
• Picture Spelling — Look at the picture and place the letters in order to spell each word.
• Build with Letters — Listen to the word and snap magnetic letter tiles onto the board.
• Word Train — Arrange words on the train cars in the right order to build complete sentences.

WHY LEARNERS & PARENTS LOVE ACORN
• 100% Ad-Free & Safe — Zero third-party ads, zero pop-ups, and no account registration required.
• Start Playing Free — Play the first 3 levels of every game completely free.
• No Subscriptions — Optional one-time Acorn Pro unlock behind a Parent Gate, with no recurring fees.
• Multi-Language Interface & Meaning Hints — Navigate the app and view optional native-language meaning hints in English, Turkish, Spanish, or French.
• Light & Dark Themes — Comfortable daytime and nighttime color themes for iPhone and iPad, plus customizable letter fonts and custom word lists.

Download Acorn today and build lasting English skills through joyful play!

name: Ada: Crownfall
description:
Ada: Crownfall is a complete three-lane 5v5 MOBA built for iPhone. Choose one of five heroes, enter the Crownfall Plateau, and fight with AI teammates and opponents through towers, jungle camps, minions, and a Nexus. The battle opens in full-screen landscape and returns to the portrait lobby when you leave.

FIVE HEROES, THREE LANES
Arthur, Richard, Eleanor, Edward, and Vlad cover tank, fighter, mage, marksman, and assassin roles. Pick the hero that fits your squad, learn the map, and push the lane that gives your team the cleanest objective.

A SQUAD HUB
Ada keeps the game and the social layer together: house identity, player profiles, conversations, match recaps, a feed for squad moments, and the safety tools to report, block, or delete your account. The hub stays in portrait while Crownfall takes over the screen for the match.

SAFETY
Report a player, conversation, or post from the menu on that screen. Block someone from their profile, manage the block list in Me, and delete your account from Me → Account → Delete account.

FREE TO PLAY
Ada is free. There are no ads and no in-app purchases. The app is intended for players 18 and older in the United States.

name: Adaptive View for Safari
description:
Adaptive View for Safari is a Safari extension designed to enhance your browsing experience on iPhone Duo. Automatically adapt websites to your device's configuration, enjoy greater control over how websites are displayed, and make the most of your foldable screen.

Features:

· Automatic View Switching: Automatically adapts the website view when you fold or unfold your iPhone Duo.

· Adaptive Website View: Uses desktop view when your iPhone Duo is unfolded horizontally and mobile view when folded.

· Designed for iPhone Duo: Specifically designed to improve the browsing experience on iPhone Duo.

· Floating View Button: Quickly switch between mobile and desktop views without leaving the website.

· Preserve Original Text Size: Maintains the original text proportions on desktop websites.

· Website Zoom: Adjust the zoom level of each website for a more comfortable browsing experience.

· Website Exclusions: Disable automatic view switching and other extension features on selected websites.

· Privacy-first design: No data collection, tracking, or logging, your browsing stays completely private.

· Multilingual support: Use the extension in multiple languages for a globally friendly experience.

· Clean, user-friendly UI: Enjoy a streamlined design that integrates smoothly into your workflow.

name: AdBras
seller_name: BR TRUST ON SOLUCOES TECNOLOGICAS EM INFORMATICA LTDA
description:
O app oficial da AdBras.

Acompanhe o que a igreja publica: Avisos, Nossos Cultos, Para Edificação e Destaques.

Veja a agenda de cultos e eventos e encontre as igrejas no mapa.

Membro da igreja entra com o CPF e tem a área do membro: credencial, histórico de contribuições e pedidos de oração.

name: ADR Schein & Berufskraftfahrer
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer IHK, einer Behörde oder einem Schulungsveranstalter.

Wer gefährliche Güter auf der Straße transportiert, braucht die ADR-Schulungsbescheinigung, und wer gewerblich Lkw oder Bus fährt, die Berufskraftfahrer-Qualifikation. Mit ADR Schein & Berufskraftfahrer bereitest du dich auf die Prüfungen dafür vor.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Gefahrgutklassen, Kennzeichnung und Begleitpapiere
- Pflichten von Fahrer, Verlader und Beförderer
- Verhalten bei Unfällen und Notfällen
- Tankfahrzeuge und explosive Stoffe (Klasse 1)
- Fahrphysik, Sozialvorschriften und Ladungssicherung
- Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Dienstleistung im Fahrberuf

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- ADR-Prüfung Gefahrgutfahrer: Basiskurs
- ADR-Aufbaukurs Tank und ADR-Aufbaukurs Klasse 1
- Berufskraftfahrer Prüfung Vorbereitung
- Berufskraftfahrer Grundqualifikation (IHK)
- Gefahrgutbeauftragter: Prüfung nach GbV
- Berufskraftfahrer Einstellungstest

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Verkehr und Logistik

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zu ADR, Berufskraftfahrern und Gefahrgut in dieser App:
- Gefahrgutverordnung Straße, Eisenbahn und Binnenschifffahrt, § 14: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ggvseb/__14.html
- Gefahrgutbeauftragtenverordnung: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/gbv_2011/
- Berufskraftfahrerqualifikationsgesetz: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bkrfqg_2020/
- Berufskraftfahrerqualifikationsverordnung: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bkrfqv_2020/
- DIHK, Sach- und Fachkundeprüfungen im Verkehr: https://www.dihk.de/de/serviceportal/qualifizierung/sach-und-fachkundepruefungen-im-verkehr-141732
- DIHK, EU-Berufskraftfahrer: https://www.dihk.de/de/serviceportal/qualifizierung/eu-berufskraftfahrer-158470

name: Ads Manager Desk Pro
description:
Ads Manager Desk Pro helps independent sellers keep their daily shop operations organized. Start with a product catalog, record orders, and use the dispatch queue to see what needs packing and shipping. Product stock updates as you record orders, and historical orders keep their original item details.

Log returns and refunds, set follow-up dates, and save replies to customer requests. Use reports to see sales and top products from the records you enter, keep an expense journal, and build a checklist for your next promotion.

**Key Features**

- Dispatch queue with ship-by dates, order search, status filters and batch updates
- Product catalog with SKUs, prices, photos and stock counts
- Order-linked returns and recorded refunds
- Customer cases, follow-up dates and reusable reply drafts
- Sales reports, a finance journal and growth checklists

name: Ads Manager Hub Suit
description:
Gift Card Ledger helps small stores keep track of gift cards they issue and redeem through their existing store system.

Log an issued card using an internal reference, its original value, and its issue date. Record each redemption with a transaction reference and amount. The app calculates the remaining balance and blocks duplicate entries for the same card or redemptions that exceed its available balance.

Use Overview to see total outstanding balances and compare the value of cards issued and redeemed over time. Open Balance History to review each card's entries and see how its balance changed after each redemption.

In Marketing, enter daily ad reports manually or import USD campaign data from a CSV file in Files. Link issued cards to a campaign to compare recorded ad spend with the number and total face value of linked cards.

Gift Card Ledger works offline and stores your records on your device. It uses US English and USD. All features are free, with no account, subscription, or in-app purchases. The app is a recordkeeping tool for activity completed in your store system.

name: ADT Team
description:
ADT Team is the internal app for chauffeurs and office staff of ADT Chauffeur Amsterdam. Accounts are created by invitation only.

For chauffeurs
• See your upcoming rides with pickup, stops, drop-off, passengers and flight
• One tap to update the ride: On my way, Arrived, Passenger on board, Dropped off
• Share your live location with the office and the passenger only during a ride, also while you use your navigation app
• Get a notification when a new ride is assigned to you and when your passenger's flight lands
• Call or message your passenger and navigate to the pickup

For the office
• Agenda with all rides, drivers and payments
• Assign chauffeurs and follow rides live on the map
• WhatsApp inbox and instant notifications

Location is used only from "On my way" until "Dropped off" for a ride assigned to you, and stops automatically after drop-off.

name: Advent Calendar Countdown 2026
description:
How many sleeps until Christmas? Find out at a glance, then open a little gift every day of December.

Christmas Countdown is a cozy holiday countdown and Advent calendar for the whole family. There are no ads, ever.

COUNT DOWN YOUR WAY

- A live countdown in days, hours, minutes and seconds
- Show it as days, sleeps or weeks
- Count to Christmas Eve or Christmas Day
- Move the countdown where you like and turn the falling snow on or off
- 12 hand-crafted paper-cut scenes (6 free, 6 with Premium): a snowy village, Santa on the rooftop, Santa and his reindeer in the birch wood, a moonlit sleigh, the Nativity, a Christmas market and more

A NEW GIFT EVERY DAY

From December 1 to 25, a new gift waits under the tree each morning. Open it to find:

- A paper-cut picture for the day
- A small idea for something to do today, written by our team
- A Christmas song for the day
- A jigsaw puzzle: solve it and the picture lights up for the evening

Save any picture to Photos to use as your wallpaper. All 25 days are free, and every picture you open is kept in your Advent album.

GAMES FOR THE WAIT

- Bauble Drop: drop ornaments and merge matching ones through 11 tiers, all the way up to the star. Your game is saved when you leave. Premium adds a second set, Sweets, and more box colours.
- A puzzle room with 16 light puzzle games: Jigsaw, Classic Sudoku, Water Sort, Wood Unblock, Block Puzzle, Word Weaver, Mahjong Tray, Classic Mahjong, Klondike Solitaire, Nonogram, Arrow Escape, 2048, Word Search, Word Guess, Minesweeper and Picture Slide

CHRISTMAS CAROLS

Listen to 11 classic carols while you count down (all free; each one unlocks when its Advent gift is opened).

GENTLE REMINDERS

Turn on a morning reminder so you never miss a day of the Advent calendar. You can switch it off any time in Settings.

AFTER CHRISTMAS

From December 26, the countdown switches to New Year's Day.

PREMIUM: ONE PAYMENT

The countdown, all 25 Advent days, the Advent album, Bauble Drop and every light puzzle are free. Premium adds:

- 6 more scenes (12 in all)
- 2 more countdown styles and 4 decorative boxes
- Your opened Advent pictures as countdown backgrounds
- Sharper full-size wallpapers (the full-size picture instead of phone size)
- A second Bauble Drop set, Sweets, and 3 more box colours
- Home screen widgets: a sleeps counter and a scene with the days left

Choose Lifetime (yours forever, restore it on a new iPhone) or Premium 2026, a season pass that never renews (until January 31, 2027).

No ads. No account. Made by a small team who loves Christmas.

name: Aelyn pro
description:
Aelyn is a quiet sky book for the objects you return to, and the nights that showed them.

Keep a list of galaxies, nebulae, clusters, planets, moons and comets. Record each night at the eyepiece — the place, the glass, the seeing, the moon, and the line you wrote afterwards. Then look back at the year in starlight.

A BOOK, NOT A DASHBOARD
• Objects: a hand-kept list with state, usual glass, constellation and a one-line note.
• Nights: every session with site, instrument, seeing, transparency, moon phase and duration.
• Sites: the places you return to, with Bortle class and the objects seen there.
• Almanac: nights by month, hours under the sky, most-returned objects and favourite sites.
• Settings: local file details, CSV and JSON export, and display defaults.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no cloud.
• No location, camera, contacts or notifications.
• No analytics, advertising or tracking.
• No network requests.
• Your book is one local JSON file. Delete the app and it is gone.

Aelyn opens with a small worked example — 18 objects, 21 nights and 6 sites — so every page has meaning from the first launch. Edit it, add your own objects, or delete the sample records and begin with an empty sky.

A sky, not a feed.

name: AeroStudy: FAA Part 107 Drone
description:
Pass the FAA Part 107 remote pilot knowledge test.

363 questions, every one of them written the way the FAA writes them, with 21 real figures — sectional chart excerpts, METAR and TAF reports, the load factor chart. Tap any figure to open it full screen, pinch to zoom, rotate a sideways chart upright without turning your phone.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
The Part 107 exam is not evenly weighted: regulations are 48% of it, weather is 5%. Most apps show you a flat percentage per topic, which hides that. AeroStudy projects your exam score using the FAA's own topic weights, so the subjects that carry more questions move your number more.

It also refuses to guess. Until enough of the exam has been measured, it says so and tells you which areas are still untouched — instead of showing you a confident number built on ten answers.

SIX WAYS TO STUDY
• Quick quiz — ten questions with instant feedback
• Topic quiz — drill one area at a time
• Practice exam — 60 questions and 120 minutes, drawn in the FAA's own proportions, exactly like the real test
• Voice tutor — answer out loud, hands free
• Focus practice — a set built from the questions you keep missing
• Flashcards — spaced repetition that brings a card back until it sticks

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No account. No sign-in. No server of ours. Questions, figures and your progress are all bundled in the app, so it works on a job site with no signal as well as it does at a desk. If you want your progress to survive a new phone, you can turn on copying through your own iCloud — it is off until you turn it on, and it never passes through us.

ONE PAYMENT
The first 50 questions are free so you can see whether the app suits you. One payment unlocks the rest — no subscription, no renewal. Paid once for your Apple Account, so it comes back on your other devices and after a reinstall.

Practice material only. This app is not an official FAA test and does not replace your instructor or the current regulations.

name: aEYEcal
description:
Stop wasting time tracking schedules.

aEYEcal converts random schedules into shareable, trackable calendars you can add to Apple Calendar or Google Calendar — and it tells you when something important changes.

Give aEYEcal a link to a schedule — a tournament page, a league schedule, a school calendar, a concert venue, a team's season — and it builds a clean calendar page anyone can open, share, and subscribe to. Then it keeps an eye on the original schedule, checking every hour. When a check spots a changed time, field, or opponent, subscribers get an alert instead of a surprise.

All your calendars in one place.

- Works with GotSport and Athlete One links, school calendars, venue listings, major-league schedules, pasted schedules, and calendar feeds
- One link per team or group: everyone subscribes once for the season
- Email and push alerts when a check spots a change — and a heads-up if watching ever stops working
- Optional reminders before each event, so nothing sneaks up on you
- Groups combine several calendars into one page and one feed
- Managing a team somewhere else? Export a schedule file for TeamSnap or Spond
- Sign-in is optional — your calendars live on your device unless you choose to sync them

Built by a team manager who got tired of being the human schedule-change hotline.

name: AFigureLight
description: Order, symmetry, regularity—put your mind to work and get things organized.

name: Agenda Mente&Tech
description:
A Agenda Mente&Tech foi criada por uma psicóloga e neuropsicologa para quem sente que o dia foge das mãos. É simples, visual e pensada também para pessoas com PHDA.
DESPEJO MENTAL COM IA Escreva ou dite tudo o que tem na cabeça. A inteligência artificial divide em tarefas, dá prioridade, estima o tempo com margem e encaixa tudo na agenda.
O DIA NUMA LINHA DO TEMPO Veja o dia com cores por tipo de tarefa. Arraste para mudar a hora e puxe para mudar a duração.
LEMBRETES Receba um aviso antes de cada tarefa, para mudar de atividade sem stress.
TEMPORIZADOR DE FOCO Escolha uma tarefa, 10 a 45 minutos e trabalhe sem distrações.
TAREFAS E CALENDÁRIO Passos pequenos para tarefas grandes, lista de pendentes e vista do mês.
SEM CULPA No fim do dia, passe o que ficou por fazer para amanhã com um toque.
PRIVACIDADE As suas tarefas ficam guardadas apenas no seu telemóvel.
Esta app ajuda a organizar e não substitui avaliação nem acompanhamento profissional.

name: Aha Chord: Learn Music Theory
description:
Aha Chord is a music theory textbook you can hear. Tap keys and pads, compare what you hear, and once you notice the difference, learn its name. You can start as a complete beginner, even if you can't read sheet music. Over 90 topics take you step by step from how chords work to modulation, jazz harmony, counterpoint, mixing and arranging.

■ How you learn
• No concepts thrown at you. Each new idea is introduced step by step, building on what you've learned and the sounds you just played
• Sound before text. Compare two sounds, notice the difference, then get the name and the reasoning
• Start anywhere: follow a course or open any topic. When an idea from another topic comes up, tap the word to see a short explanation and jump to the topic that covers it
• Check yourself with questions. 30 days after you finish a topic, a notification lets you redo just the questions, right when you're starting to forget

Here, music theory isn't rules to memorize, but names for typical patterns in how music sounds. Since you've already heard the difference, the names stay tied to the sounds.

■ What you can learn
Not just the basics, but subjects from specialist books too.
• Why some chords sound bright and others wistful (triads, seventh chords, diatonic chords)
• Why a song feels "finished" or "not done yet" (harmonic function, cadences)
• How a song changes color partway through (modulation, chromatic harmony, modes)
• The sound of jazz, and music without a key (jazz harmony, 20th-century techniques)
• The rules of classical harmony, and why they exist (four-part harmony, voice-leading rules)
• Melody shapes, and playing two melodies at once (motifs, counterpoint, fugue, harmony lines)
• Why the feel of a rhythm changes (meter, groove, tempo and timing)
• How sound itself works (vibration, overtones, temperament, timbre)
• Shaping and finishing your sound (synths, sampling, programming, mixing, mastering, orchestration)
• Making a song (getting started, figuring out songs by ear, structure, arrangement, analysis, improvisation, music for film and games)
• What makes each genre sound like itself, and where it came from

Goal-based courses such as "Write your first song" and "Figure out songs by ear" take you through just the topics you need. Tools like the circle of fifths and a chord chart are there to open and play whenever you want to look something up.

■ Made for you if
• You bought a music theory book but never finished it
• You want to pick chord progressions knowing why they work, not just by feel
• You want to start producing music or writing songs, and can't read sheet music
• You want to figure out songs by ear
• You play an instrument but have always put theory off
• You want to go past the basics, into counterpoint, jazz harmony and more

■ From the maker
I tried to learn music theory several times and gave up each time, for two reasons. What I memorized never connected with listening to or playing music. And I never got a feel for what each idea was built on, or where it led.
So Aha Chord always plays the sound first. Each new idea is built carefully on what you have already learned, and a link always takes you back to the ideas it rests on. The name "Aha" comes from the aha moment, when something suddenly makes sense.
My goal is to make it the easiest-to-understand music theory textbook in the world.

■ Free and Premium
• Free: all topics and tools, with full-screen ads between study sessions
• Premium: a one-time purchase that removes the ads. What you can learn is the same

■ Also
• No account needed. Your progress stays on your device
• Available in Japanese, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

■ Links
• Web version: https://ahachord.com
• Privacy policy: https://ahachord.com/en/privacy

name: Aha! – Where I Put It
description:
aha! Where Did I Put It is the iPhone app that remembers where you put things, so you don't have to. Save where anything is in about five seconds with a photo, your voice or a quick sentence. Later, just ask “where's my passport?” and aha! shows you the exact spot.

You put it somewhere safe. So safe, even you can't find it. aha! fixes that.

GREAT FOR
• Important documents: passport, birth certificate, social security card, car title, warranties, receipts
• Spare keys, chargers, remotes, tools and batteries
• Holiday decorations, seasonal clothes and camping gear
• Moving boxes, storage units, garage shelves, attics and closets
• Jewelry, emergency cash and surprise gifts (in Secret Vault)
• Anyone who misplaces things, including busy parents, people with ADHD and caregivers

REMEMBER IN ABOUT FIVE SECONDS
• Snap it: take a photo of where it lives and drop a pin on the exact spot.
• Say it: “The spare key is in the junk drawer in the kitchen.”
• Type it: write it like you'd say it. aha! fills in the details and you confirm.
• Remember a whole box: one photo, one place, and everything inside is searchable.

JUST ASK
• Ask in plain English: “where's my passport?”, “where are the xmas lights?”
• Typos and nicknames work (“pasport”, “xmas”).
• Get a clear answer with the photo, the pin and the place.
• aha! never guesses. If it doesn't know, it offers to remember it.

FOUND IT!
Tap Found it! for a little celebration. Moved it? Update in a tap. aha! keeps the full location history, so nothing gets lost twice.

YOUR WHOLE HOME, ORGANIZED
A simple home inventory without the spreadsheet: places, boxes and drawers in one view, everything you've saved, and a timeline of what you put away, moved and found.

SECRET VAULT
Some things are just for you. Keep private spots behind Face ID or your passcode. Vault items never appear on Home, in regular search, the timeline or exports.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Data collected: none.
• Your memories and photos stay on your iPhone and work offline.
• Voice recognition runs on-device when supported; online fallback only if you turn it on.
• Password-encrypted backups you save and control.

HOW IS AHA! DIFFERENT?
• Unlike AirTag or Find My, aha! needs no trackers. It remembers where you stored anything, even paper documents.
• Unlike a notes app, every memory has a photo, a pin and a place, and you can just ask for it.

NO SUBSCRIPTION
No in-app purchases and no limits on how many things you remember.

aha! One less thing to remember.

name: AI Camper · Rutas Autocaravana
description:
AI Camper planifica rutas para autocaravana, camper y furgoneta camperizada que rodean las ciudades, eligen qué peajes compensan y evitan rotondas.

Los navegadores normales te meten por el centro de las ciudades. Con ocho metros de vehículo, eso significa mobiliario urbano, giros imposibles, calles peatonales y multas. AI Camper calcula la ruta de tu autocaravana rodeando los cascos urbanos desde el principio, no avisándote cuando ya estás dentro.

NO ES UN NAVEGADOR. ES LO QUE VA ANTES.

Planificas aquí, con las medidas de tu autocaravana o tu camper, y te llevas la ruta a Google Maps, Waze o un archivo GPX. Navegas con la aplicación que ya sabes usar.

TRES RUTAS, Y LA DIFERENCIA EXPLICADA CON NÚMEROS

• Prisa: la más rápida, con peajes.
• Sin peajes: la que los esquiva todos.
• Calma: la nuestra. Decide peaje a peaje cuáles compensan y cuáles no, y rodea los cascos urbanos.

De cada una ves los kilómetros, el tiempo, el coste estimado de peajes y combustible, y cuántas rotondas tiene. Cuarenta rotondas de diferencia son cuarenta frenadas y cuarenta maniobras con ocho metros detrás.

PÍDESELO CON TUS PALABRAS

AI Camper lleva un asistente con inteligencia artificial. Le cuentas a dónde quieres ir, como se lo contarías a alguien («de Valencia a Burdeos en tres días»), y te prepara el viaje. Te explica por qué ha pagado un peaje y ha esquivado otro, y te avisa de lo que no sabe: un ferry sin tarifa, kilómetros sin censo de rotondas, una viñeta que no está en el total. Si una respuesta está mal, la puedes reportar desde la propia conversación.

ÁREAS DE AUTOCARAVANAS Y SITIOS PARA PERNOCTAR, A TU MEDIDA

Reparte el viaje en etapas, por kilómetros u horas al día, y te propone dónde dormir cada noche: áreas de autocaravanas, campings y sitios para pernoctar a lo largo de la ruta, descartando los que no admiten tu altura o tu longitud cuando el dato existe.

PENSADA PARA LEERSE EN LA CABINA, CON EL SOL DE CARA

Letra grande de serie, cifras con contraste alto y botones que se tocan con el móvil en una mano. Sin cobertura puedes seguir consultando lo que ya tienes calculado.

DÓNDE FUNCIONA

Funciona mejor en España, Portugal y Francia, y también calcula rutas por el resto de Europa. La aplicación está en español. Entras con tu correo, con Google o con Apple.

LO QUE NO HACE, PARA QUE NO TE LLEVES UNA SORPRESA

• No da indicaciones giro a giro. Para eso está Google Maps o Waze.
• No es un buscador de áreas de autocaravanas: cruza las que hay con tu ruta.
• No lleva las cuentas del viaje.

Los costes de peaje y combustible son estimaciones. Antes de salir, comprueba siempre las alturas, los pesos permitidos y las normas de cada sitio: mandan las señales y las autoridades.

name: Aidithi (Adithi)
description:
Aidithi: every visitor, queue and event, handled divinely.

Aidithi is an all-in-one platform for managing visitors, crowds, counters and tokens. It connects self-service kiosks and instant WhatsApp messaging, so your front desk runs smoothly even when the lobby doesn't.

From the gate to the counter to the RSVP list, Aidithi keeps people moving and keeps you informed.

VISITOR MANAGEMENT
- Fast check-in and check-out with digital visitor records
- Unique QR codes for each visitor, for quick and contactless entry
- Pre-registration and host approvals
- A complete visitor history you can search anytime

TOKEN AND COUNTER MANAGEMENT
- Automatic token generation and smart queue allocation
- Multiple counters, services and departments
- Live token status on display screens
- Shorter waits and fewer crowded waiting areas

CROWD MANAGEMENT
- Real-time occupancy and footfall tracking
- Peak-hour insights to help you plan staff
- Flow control across entry points and service areas

SELF-SERVICE KIOSKS
- Seamless integration with touch kiosks for walk-in registration
- Visitors can self check-in, generate tokens and print badges
- Lower front-desk workload with no compromise on experience

INSTANT WHATSAPP MESSAGING
- Visitors receive confirmations, QR passes and token updates instantly
- "Your turn is next" alerts, so visitors don't have to hover near the counter
- Host notifications when guests arrive

EVENTS AND RSVP
- Create events and manage invitations and RSVPs
- QR-based event entry and attendance tracking
- Guest communication through WhatsApp

DEVICE MANAGEMENT
- Manage kiosks, displays and devices from one place
- Monitor device status and push updates remotely

BUILT FOR
Corporate offices, hospitals and clinics, government offices, banks, events and venues, service centres.

WHY AIDITHI?
- One platform instead of five disconnected tools
- Contactless, QR-first experience
- WhatsApp communication your visitors already use
- Kiosk-ready from day one
- Scales from a single reception desk to multiple sites

Fewer queues, less paperwork and a better first impression.

(Ai)dithi: welcome, organised with a touch of AI.

name: AIM Quiz — Quiz Night Host
description:
AIM Quiz is the host's console for a quiz night. Run the whole evening from a phone or a tablet: the questions, the clock, the answers coming in, the scores and the final podium. Teams play on their own phones, in the browser, with nothing to install.

HOW A NIGHT RUNS
• Sign in with your AIM Quiz Host or Venue key and pick one of your quiz packs.
• Teams scan the code and name their team. A captain answers for the team; teammates follow on their own phones.
• One big button moves the night on: the round's title card, each question, the recap, collecting the answers, then the right answers one by one.
• Scores update as the answers are revealed. Add a team playing on paper and give it points by hand.
• The night ends with third, second and the winner, then the table of every round.

WITH A TV, OR WITHOUT ONE
• Pair any TV or projector with a browser by a six-digit code, and the questions, pictures and scores go on the big screen.
• No TV? This device reads the questions out and plays the music clips, and teams see everything on their phones. Prop a tablet up and show the quiz to the room.

A NIGHT THAT DOES NOT STOP
• The quiz runs on our server, so a dropped connection or a flat battery does not end it. Carry on from another device with the rescue code.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no email, no tracking, no ads. Your key stays in the device's secure storage.

AIM Quiz needs an AIM Quiz Host or Venue key. Teams never need the app.

name: Air Traffic Stream - View ATC
description:
Pick a tower and watch the airport work. Airtraffic.stream places live aircraft reports into a 3D view of the airfield. Tap a plane to follow it, check its flight information, or switch to surface radar to see where it is in relation to the runways and gates.

Explore San Francisco, Oakland, San José, Newark, JFK, LaGuardia, Heathrow, and Dubai. Palo Alto and Teterboro are available through Explore. Pan around the terminals, zoom in on a taxiway, or turn on Aircraft TV and let the viewer choose the next plane.

At SFO and Oakland, the flight board includes arrivals and departures. At SFO you can also rewind traffic you have watched or use Forecast to see projected activity. Weather reports, aircraft positions, and flight-board coverage depend on the airport and the available feeds.

Free to use. No account required. An internet connection is required. For recreational plane spotting. For travel decisions, check with your airline.

name: Airframe – Remote Desktop
description:
Airframe puts your Mac in your pocket. See its screen and control it from your iPhone as if you were sitting in front of it.

NOTHING EXTRA TO INSTALL ON YOUR MAC
Airframe connects to the Screen Sharing that is built into macOS. Turn it on in System Settings, and your Mac is ready.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Airframe connects your iPhone to your Mac over Tailscale, the private network you already use. There is no Airframe account, no cloud service in the middle and no relay of ours. Your Mac password stays on your iPhone, in the Keychain, only if you choose to save it. Airframe collects no data at all.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Trackpad mode moves the pointer like a MacBook trackpad; Touch mode clicks right where you tap.
• Scroll with two fingers and pinch to zoom in on small text.
• Swipe three fingers to switch desktops and full-screen apps, or up for Mission Control. Zoomed in, three fingers pan.
• A full keyboard with Command, Option, Control and Shift, plus a composer for longer text.
• Portrait and landscape.

FAST WHERE IT COUNTS
Airframe uses the efficient screen format that macOS Screen Sharing offers its own viewer, so updates stay small and quick.

KNOWS WHEN YOUR MAC IS READY
Each saved Mac shows whether it is reachable and whether Screen Sharing is on before you connect, and Airframe tells you what to fix if it is not.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Use your Mac account, or a separate Screen Sharing (VNC) password. Airframe never connects without signing in.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac with Screen Sharing turned on (System Settings › General › Sharing).
• Tailscale installed and signed in on both your iPhone and your Mac, in the same tailnet.

Airframe is not affiliated with Apple or Tailscale. Mac and macOS are trademarks of Apple Inc. Tailscale is a trademark of Tailscale Inc.

name: Akviyo: Online Aquarium
description:
Ready to build the aquarium of your dreams? In Akviyo you feed and grow your fish, decorate your tank and meet friends in the open sea!

COLLECT 34 FISH SPECIES
From goldfish to lionfish, from swordfish to sharks — dozens of species are waiting for you. Feed them, raise them, sell them and complete your collection. Finish album sets and claim big rewards!

DECORATE YOUR AQUARIUM
Corals, sunken castles, treasure chests, seashells and much more. Place over 80 decorations anywhere you like, resize them and pick a lighting theme for your tank. Upgrade from a tiny bowl to a giant tank with 9 aquarium models!

GO FISHING
Cast your line in four fishing spots, from a quiet reed lake to a coral bay, a tropical river and the deep sea. Keep the bobber in the green zone and don't let the big one get away!

MEET FRIENDS IN THE OPEN SEA
Take your fish to the Open Sea, swim with other players, chat and join races. Visit your friends' aquariums, like them and climb the leaderboards.

OPEN CHESTS, WIN RARE FISH
A free fish crate every day! Sea, Coral and Legendary chests hold grown, rare and shiny fish.

NEW GOALS EVERY DAY
Daily quests, login rewards, an order board, achievements and a marketplace keep your aquarium busy all the time.

Download Akviyo for free and dive into a new adventure with your fish!

Note: The game is free to play and offers optional in-game items that can be purchased with real money. An internet connection is required for online features.

name: Albanese Hair Boutique
description: Albanese Hair Boutique è un’app di prenotazioni intuitiva e facile da usare. Con questa app potrai prenotare tutti i tuoi appuntamenti con semplicità, da qualsiasi luogo e in qualsiasi momento. Scarica l’app di Albanese Hair Boutique oggi stesso e inizia a prenotare i tuoi appuntamenti con tranquillità!

name: Algos: Go Viral with AI Fans
description:
Algos is single-player social media. Post a real photo or video and an audience of AI fans reacts to what's actually in it: views, likes, comments, followers and DMs.

But nothing blows up by itself. The algos test every post on a few hundred people first. If they watch and share, it gets pushed to thousands, then tens of thousands, over hours and days. If not, it stalls, and your coach tells you why.

PLAY THE ALGOS
• Watch your post get tested, then pushed in waves on a real clock
• Use what works: a rising sound, today's trend, the right hour, your streak, a boost
• Reply early: the feed notices
• Meet your regulars: a superfan, a bestie and a hater who show up on every post
• Brands and fans slide into your DMs when a post takes off
• Grow from New to Rising, Creator, Influencer and Star (1M)

ALGOS PRO (OPTIONAL)
• Post as much as you want (free: 1 post a day)
• Reply to every comment and DM (free: 5 a day)
• A boost every day and your coach's full notes
Algos Pro is $39.99 per year and renews yearly until you cancel. Manage it any time from your profile.

Every follower, comment and DM in Algos is made by AI. Nobody else sees your posts.

Terms: https://algos.towers.app/terms/
Privacy: https://algos.towers.app/privacy/

name: Aligner Wear Timer: Back In
description:
Aligners out too long again? Look at this.
Back In times your aligners out and rings when it's been too long.
Tap Out when they come out. If they're still out at your limit, your phone rings, even on silent.

Your trays come out for lunch. Then the afternoon happens, and at 4 PM they're still in the case.

Back In is a timer for the time your aligners are out. Tap Out when they come out. If they're still out at your limit (30 minutes, or whatever you set), your phone rings like an alarm. Neither silent mode nor a Focus will quiet it. Tap Back in and the time counts toward your goal again.

The ring on the home screen shows the hours worn today. Under it you'll see how much out time is left before the day's goal slips, and a strip of the day with every time they came out.

What you get without paying:
• The out timer, and the alarm when trays are out too long
• Today's ring and the out time you have left
• The last 7 days, with times you can fix if you forgot to tap
• Your streak: days in a row at your goal
• A reminder the evening before your orthodontist check-up
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Trays out in Back In"
• Retainer mode for after treatment. Nights run noon to noon, so 10 PM to 7 AM counts as one night.

For the full treatment, Pro adds:
• The out timer on your lock screen
• Every day of history, your best streak and averages
• Your tray schedule (tray 7 of 24, day 3) and a reminder on switch day
• A wear report to show your orthodontist, as a PDF or a CSV
• A limit for each reason, like 30 minutes for meals and 15 for snacks
• Widgets and a Control Center button
• Three more alarm sounds

Treatment takes months and retainers take years, so there's a one-time price: $39.99 and you're done. If you'd rather, Pro is $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year, with the first week of the yearly plan free and a reminder 2 days before the trial ends. Those two renew automatically. Cancel any time in your Apple account settings, at least 24 hours before the period ends, and nothing more is charged.

No ads, ever. No account. Your history stays on your phone, and an update won't wipe it. It works with any clear aligner or retainer.

Back In is a reminder and a log. It isn't medical advice, and your orthodontist's instructions come first.

Requires iOS 26.

If something's wrong, email support@rowhousesoftware.com and a person will answer.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rowhousesoftware.com/privacy

name: All QR Code Scanner - Barcode
description:
All QR Code Scanner - Barcode is a fast, clean and private QR code and barcode scanner and maker for iPhone.

SCAN IN A BLINK 
• Point your camera at a QR code or barcode and get the result instantly
• Scan from a photo or screenshot in your library
• Flashlight for dark places and pinch to zoom for small codes
• Supports QR, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, PDF417, Aztec, Data Matrix and ITF-14

SMART ACTIONS FOR EVERY CODE 
• Websites: open the link
• Phone numbers: call
• Email and SMS: write a message
• Locations: open in Maps
• Contacts: add to your contacts
• Wi-Fi: see the network and copy the password
• Product barcodes: search the web
• Text: copy or share

SAFER SCANNING 
The app shows what is inside a code before anything happens, and warns you about risky links: unencrypted http links, shortened links and look-alike websites.

CREATE YOUR OWN QR CODES
• Website, Text, Wi-Fi, Contact, Email, Phone, SMS, Location and Barcode
• Live preview as you type
• Style presets and custom colors
• Choose the error correction level
• Save a high-resolution image to Photos or share it anywhere

HISTORY AND FAVORITES
• Every scan and creation is saved on your device
• Search, filter by scanned, created or favorites
• Swipe to favorite or delete, or clear everything
• Turn history off any time in Settings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything stays on your iPhone: scans, images and history are never uploaded
• Camera access is used only to read codes

MADE FOR iPHONE 
• Haptic feedback
• Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Portuguese, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Turkish and Vietnamese

Questions or ideas? Visit our support page from Settings > Support.

name: AllergyCard: Food Allergy Card
description:
AllergyCard gives travelers with food allergies, celiac disease, or strict dietary restrictions peace of mind at any restaurant worldwide.

Display full-screen, high-contrast native chef cards clearly explaining what you cannot eat — even with zero cell signal or Wi-Fi.

KEY FEATURES
• 16+ Native Travel Languages: Switch instantly between English, Japanese, French, Spanish, German, Korean, Thai, Italian, and more.
• Full-Screen High-Contrast Chef View: Large, unmistakable typography designed for busy restaurant kitchens.
• Comprehensive Allergen Library: Peanuts, tree nuts, gluten/celiac, dairy, shellfish, eggs, soy, sesame, and custom items.
• 100% Offline Reliability: Works on planes, subways, and remote local restaurants without internet.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock all 16+ languages, unlimited family profiles, and custom allergens forever.

name: Allign Agency
description:
Allign Agency is the client portal for UK dental practices that work with Allign Agency, a patient acquisition agency. Access is by invitation. There is no public sign-up.

What you can do:
- See today's appointments and open the full calendar.
- Mark a patient as showed up or no-show after the appointment.
- See your leads: patients who enquired through the ads and landing pages Allign Agency runs for your practice.
- Text a patient from their lead record, where your practice has this switched on.
- See call activity. The app shows only that a call happened and how long it lasted.
- Work through action items, and view your creatives and landing page.

Signing in and privacy:
- Sign in with your email address and a 6 digit code. There is no password.
- Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode can lock the app. This is optional.
- Push notifications are optional, and you choose which ones.
- You can delete your own access from inside the app.

What you see depends on the access your practice has been given. Patient names and phone numbers are shown to practice staff only, after sign-in.

Help: hello@allign.agency.

name: Alpine Signal Observatory
description:
A mountain observatory has lost its signal. Rotate hexagonal modules to align their ports and bring every probe back online.

Start at the relay and follow the pulse through the branches you’ve connected. Use the board’s edges and neighboring ports to work out which way each tile should face. A puzzle is solved when every tile belongs to a single network with no open ends or loops.

Alpine Signal Observatory is a single-player logic puzzle for iPhone. Each turn changes the paths the signal can take, giving you a new clue about where to look next.

name: Alpinglow
description:
Alpinglow is the app for Alpinglow Summit and Summit+ red and near-infrared light panels from Alpinglow, Switzerland.

START A SESSION FROM YOUR PHONE
• Choose a programme – Recovery, Performance, Sleep or Skin – or set red, near-infrared, pulse and time yourself.
• A large countdown dial shows the time left; pause or stop at any time.
• Change the values during a session under Adjust.

REMINDERS
• Get a reminder when you can turn around: halfway, in equal parts or every few minutes.
• Reminders also arrive when the app is closed.
• The time left is shown on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.

FAVOURITES
• Save your own settings with a name and an icon and start them with one tap.

SEVERAL PANELS
• Groups 1 to 3 let you control several panels together or separately.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account and no tracking. The app does not collect personal data.
• Bluetooth is only used to send commands to your panel.
• Available in English, German, French, Italian and Czech.

Requires an Alpinglow Summit or Summit+ panel. Please read the contraindications in the app before use. Light therapy does not replace medical advice.

name: ALSATRACK GPS
description:
ALSATRACK GPS es la app oficial de ALSATRACK para monitorear tus vehículos y equipos GPS desde el celular, estés donde estés.

Con ALSATRACK GPS puedes:
• Ver tus vehículos en tiempo real en el mapa, con su estado en colores: en movimiento, ralentí, estacionado o desconectado.
• Revisar el historial de recorridos y reproducir rutas.
• Recibir notificaciones al instante: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, entrada y salida de geocercas y más.
• Generar reportes en PDF o Excel y compartirlos.
• Bloquear y desbloquear tu vehículo y activar el parqueo seguro (si tu plan lo incluye).
• Compartir la ubicación en tiempo real con un enlace.
• Ver el video en vivo de tus cámaras (si tu plan lo incluye).

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta del servicio de rastreo de ALSATRACK. Si todavía no la tienes, contáctanos:
+593984355080 · alsatrack@gmail.com

name: Amazuka Logistique
description:
Amazuka Logistique puts a motorbike rider at your service, whenever you need one.

SEND A PARCEL
Choose the pickup and delivery neighbourhoods: the price shows instantly. A rider picks up your parcel and hands it over in person. Small, medium or large: envelope, bag, box, groceries.

HOME SERVICES
- Gas bottle refill or exchange
- Drinking water delivery
- Laundry pickup and return
- Document delivery
The rider takes care of everything and brings back what you need.

LIVE TRACKING
See your rider on the map, call them in one tap, and give your handover code only once you have received the parcel.

PAY YOUR WAY
Cash to the rider, Amazuka Pay (the same wallet as Amazuka Eats and amazuka.com), Orange Money or MTN MoMo.

BUSINESS SPACE
Shops, pharmacies, restaurants: send one or many deliveries to your customers in seconds. The rider collects the cash for you, and the money lands in your Amazuka Pay, fees deducted.

No password: your name and phone number are enough. The app is available in French and English.

name: Ambertray
description:
Your darkroom, in the amber light.

Ambertray is a companion for black-and-white film and print darkroom work. It times your trays and tanks with cues you can hear in the dark, keeps a log of every session, watches how tired your chemistry is, and helps a shared community darkroom agree before anyone turns on the white light.

DEVELOP BY EAR
Pick a process — B&W film in an inversion tank, RC paper, archival fibre paper, or your own — set the bath temperature and press Start. Developer time is scaled from 20 °C automatically. A struck-bell chime marks every step, every agitation and every rest, and an optional voice names them ("Stop bath now. One minute."). The cues keep sounding with the screen locked or the phone face-down, so you can work a film tank in total darkness.

The running timer shows one big number in safelight red, the AGITATE / REST state and every step ahead. Pause, skip to the next step, or end at any time. When it's done, log the session in one tap.

SOUND BEDS
Choose what plays under the timer: wash water, rain on the skylight, an extractor fan, an old mechanical timer tick, or enlarger hum.

LOG EVERY SESSION
