Record each visit to the darkroom: rolls developed (film, format, developer, dilution, temperature, time, push or pull) and prints made (negative, paper, size, filter grade, aperture, seconds, dodging and burning, keepers). Rate how it came out from Muddy to Luminous, write a note for future you, and attach optional field photos of a print, a contact sheet or the bench. Search everything, see your hours in the dark, rolls, prints, week streak and an eight-week glance, and share a session summary.

CHEMISTRY SHELF
Add each working solution when you mix it. Ambertray shows how many rolls or prints it has handled against its capacity and how many days it has left, and marks it Fresh, Tiring, Spent or Past date.

BENCH TOOLS
• f-stop test strip — even steps of light with the time to give each strip
• Reprint calculator — new time for a bigger print or a new aperture
• Dilution — stock and water for any 1+n mix
• Temperature table — developer time from 16 to 27 °C
• Darkroom guide — safety, tray order and good habits

INTRO FILM
Watch "Into the Amber", a short five-chapter film about a first night of printing. Play, pause, mute, jump between chapters, and cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV.

SHARED DARKROOM
In a club, college or community darkroom, everyone on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot joins one room code. See each station, what they're doing and what's left on their timer. Ask "May I turn the white light on?" and the room answers Hold or Clear — the light goes on only when everyone says clear. Only short fixed calls are sent, never messages, photos or location, and anyone can be muted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no ads. Your sessions, chemistry and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: Ambientebeleuchtung
description:
Steuere die Ambientebeleuchtung von OEM:plus in deinem Fahrzeug bequem mit dem iPhone.

• Echte Innenraumansicht: Du siehst sofort, welche Bereiche leuchten – in der Farbe, die du einstellst.
• Zonen: Armaturenbrett, Türen, Fußraum und mehr getrennt oder gemeinsam steuern.
• Farben und Helligkeit stufenlos, mit kräftigen Mischfarben.
• Lauflichter und Musik-Effekte mit einstellbarer Geschwindigkeit.
• Szenen speichern und mit einem Tipp abrufen.
• Begrüßungslicht beim Öffnen des Fahrzeugs.
• Einfache Einrichtung in wenigen Schritten: Fahrzeug wählen, Lichtmodul verbinden, Lichtelemente festlegen.
• Mehrere Fahrzeuge in einer App.

Die App verbindet sich per Bluetooth direkt mit dem Lichtmodul. Es gibt kein Konto, keine Werbung und keine Datenerfassung.

Voraussetzung: eine von OEM:plus eingebaute Ambientebeleuchtung.

name: American Football Story
description:
Two dreams. Two towns. One choice at a time.
Most football games end at the final whistle. Here your life keeps going: college offers, transfers, a girlfriend with a career of her own.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• You actually learn football: one lesson at a time, then the same situation in a real game
• A love story where she isn't a prize: she has her own school, career and future, and you shape each other's lives
• Choices with weight: colleges, the transfer portal, the truth or a lie, her town or yours
• About 25 pages a run out of 205, 10 endings, one girlfriend or several: every run is different

WOULD YOU...
• Follow her to a small college where you start, or take the big school where you sit?
• Hit the transfer portal to be in her town, or stay and fight for your job?
• Tell her about the other girl now, or hope she never finds out?
• Use the Time Machine to fix one season, knowing what you know?

AGE 16: 5-ON-5 FLAG FOOTBALL
• Fast and open: no tackles, you pull the runner's flag
• Pick a co-ed team and the girls from the story play beside you
• You're in every game, on offense and on defense

COLLEGE: 11-ON-11 TACKLE FOOTBALL
• The big game: real tackles, linemen, a 100-yard field
• New reads to master: the blitz, play action, press coverage
• Earn the starting job, or watch from the sideline

FREE TO START
The story's first week is free. One purchase, the full version, opens the rest of the story: four seasons and 10 endings. Pay once, play forever. No subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Single player, plays offline. No ads, no account, no tracking
• Made for touch: tap an answer to pick it, tap to go on
• The whole game in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Japanese
• On iPhone the game plays upright; iPad and Mac show the wide layout

name: Amidst: Where Everyone Is
description:
When I stopped using our family’s location app, my parents understood. But they missed the little things it helped them know. Was I still on the road? Had I made it home? Was it a good time to call?

I missed that part, too. I wanted an iPhone app that let me share where I was, without handing over a readable copy of my location to a service. I also needed something my family could use without anyone setting up a server at home. That’s why I built Amidst.

With Amidst, your location is encrypted on your phone before it’s sent. The people you share with can see it, and the service that delivers it can’t read it. The app’s source code is public, so anyone (or any AI) can see how that works. There are no ads or in-app purchases.

• Check how the trip is going. See the locations family and friends choose to share with you on one map. If they’ve turned on Live Requests, you can ask their phone for an updated location.

• Choose who can see you. Add people by username and turn sharing on or off for each person. You can accept a friend request without sharing your own location.

• Share for just this trip. Send a time-limited link to someone you trust so they can follow along in a browser.

• Keep your map organized. Group people into folders so family, friends, and travel companions are easy to find.

name: Aminyo
description:
Aminyo is a personal journal for melody restoration and brick breaker gameplay. You drag the butterfly paddle to bounce pearls, trigger same-color resonances in crystal brick arrays, and collect three sound cores to complete each stage.

Explore 36 levels, daily layouts, and free practice modes. All features and optional assists are completely free to play without hidden paywalls. Customize your experience with photo color themes and local stats tracking.

name: Ammo Kitchen
description:
Match three. Feed your flock. Defend your castle.

Turn berries, gems and stars into ammo for three brave birds. Match the right color to keep each defender ready, line up a clever combo and stop a parade of mischievous monsters before they reach your castle.

MATCH WITH A PURPOSE
Every move feeds the action. Red berries, blue gems and golden stars supply different birds, so choosing your next match is part of the battle.

MAKE COMBOS COUNT
Chain satisfying matches, crack frozen tiles and clear tangled roots. Unleash colorful power-ups and keep your flock fighting when the crowd closes in.

MEET YOUR FEATHERED DEFENDERS
Give your birds a look of their own with hats, crowns, armor and capes. Upgrade their cannons and build a tougher castle as your adventure grows.

EXPLORE 24 WILD WORLDS
Follow the trail from Lantern Garden to Gummy Beach, Candyfloss Mill and the Cosmic Kitchen. Discover playful enemies, colorful scenery and surprises along the way.

TAKE ON THE BIG BOSSES
Face larger-than-life troublemakers that put your matching skills to the test. Keep an eye on the battle, feed the right bird and make your next move count.

1,200 LEVELS. ONE BRAVE FLOCK.
Enjoy an adventure full of satisfying matches, cheerful characters and fresh challenges. Your tiny team has a big castle to protect.

Contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: Amphour: LiFePO4 BMS Monitor
description:
Amphour shows what your lithium battery is doing, cell by cell, on your iPhone or iPad. It reads your battery management system (BMS) and Victron devices over Bluetooth, keeps the history on your device and warns you before a cell drifts out of range.

One screen for the whole system
Group packs, a shunt, a solar charger and a DC-DC charger into one system for your van, RV, boat or cabin. The dashboard shows state of charge, power in and out, and the amp-hours left.

Every cell, not just the total
See each cell's voltage, the spread between the highest and lowest cell, temperature sensors, cycles, MOSFET state and any active BMS protection.

History that stays on your device
Amphour logs every second while connected: one-second detail for 24 hours, one-minute for 90 days, 15-minute after that. Export any range as CSV.

Alerts
Rules for high and low cell voltage, cell imbalance, high temperature, charging in the cold, low state of charge, BMS protection and a device going offline. Defaults are conservative for LiFePO4, and every threshold can be changed.

Battery health reports
Make a PDF for 30 days, 90 days or a year, with cell delta over time and the events in that range. Useful for a warranty claim, selling a used battery or handing over an installation.

Works with
• JBD and Xiaoxiang smart BMS, tested on real hardware
• Victron battery monitors, solar chargers and DC-DC chargers with Instant Readout, community-tested
• Daly smart BMS, experimental
Not sure about yours? Scan, and Amphour tells you what it found. A demo system lets you try every screen without hardware.

Amphour Pro
Amphour Pro adds every device and system, Victron devices, full history with CSV export, insights, your own alert thresholds and battery health reports. Live readings, cells and default alerts work without it.

Read only
Amphour never changes settings, switches MOSFETs or updates firmware. Your BMS keeps protecting the battery.

No account and no server. Readings, history and Victron encryption keys stay on your device.

Brand names describe compatibility only. Amphour is not affiliated with Victron Energy, JBD or Daly.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.cihat.dev/amphour/privacy-policy/

name: AMYAL Car Rental
description:
AMYAL is a Saudi car rental company licensed by the Transport General Authority, with branches in Riyadh: Al-Maghrazat, Kairouan and Shubra. Choose a branch and a time, compare the cars available and their prices, and book in a few steps.

What you can do in the app
• Choose from 18 models, from economy cars to family SUVs and luxury sedans. The price you see includes VAT.
• See AMYAL's branches on the map, the nearest one to you and the time it takes to get there.
• Verify your identity before you arrive: a photo of your driving licence, of your national ID, Iqama or passport, and a selfie.
• Book now and pay at the branch when you pick the car up. You get a receipt.
• Show your pick-up pass from your phone at the branch, and photograph the car at pick-up and at return to record its condition.
• Extend your rental in the app and follow your upcoming and past bookings.
• In an emergency, find the emergency and roadside numbers and send your location to AMYAL with one tap.
• Cancel for free before pick-up, within the time stated in the booking terms.
• Read the rules for driving to other GCC countries and the border-crossing permit before you travel.

The app is in Arabic and English and follows your phone's text size.

Delete your account at any time from Account → Delete account.
Need help? Call us on 920004348.

name: ANAÏS AI
description:
ANAÏS AI is a privacy-first adult AI productivity assistant built by Pharoah Technology Ltd.

• Five Structured Assistant Modes: Ask (direct question answering), Summarise (condense user-supplied notes and articles), Draft (generate emails and documents clearly labelled [DRAFT ONLY — NOT SENT]), Checklist (actionable step-by-step plans), and App Blueprint Text Spec (software architecture specifications).
• Explicit AI Consent & Transparency: Clear pre-transmission disclosure naming the active AI provider (Google Gemini 3 Flash or OpenAI GPT-5.4 Mini via Pharoah AI Gateway) with instant consent toggle in Settings.
• Strict User & Tenant Isolation: All conversations and preferences are isolated to your account with 1-tap conversation deletion, offensive-output reporting, and immediate in-app account deletion.
• Built-In Multi-Language Interface: Switch seamlessly between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Free Launch Starter Credits: Includes 30 free starter credits (1 credit per assistant turn) with zero automatic billing.

name: Anatomy Zoom – Anatomie lernen
description:
Das Bild zoomt heraus – erkennst du das Organ, bevor es ganz zu sehen ist?

Anatomy Zoom ist ein Lernspiel für den Körper von Mensch und Tier. 211 selbst gezeichnete Strukturen – Knochen, Muskeln, Herz und Lunge, Verdauung, Niere, Nerven und Hormone – plus der Hund im Vergleich.

SO LERNST DU
• Lupen-Quiz: Die Nahaufnahme zoomt langsam heraus. Je früher du es weißt, desto mehr Punkte.
• Wo liegt’s? Tippe die Stelle direkt am Körper an – die App sagt dir, wie viele Zentimeter du daneben lagst.
• Reise durch den Körper: Jeden Tag ein Weg – Blut, Nahrung oder Luft –, für alle gleich.
• Lernen mit Gedächtniskurve: Fehler kommen bald wieder, Sicheres erst nach Tagen.
• Fachbegriffe: Latein ↔ Deutsch nach Terminologia Anatomica.
• Mensch ↔ Tier: Wer hat vier Mägen? Warum hat das Pferd keine Gallenblase?

ORGANE IM DETAIL
Auge, Ohr, Herz von innen, Gehirn, Zahn, Haut, Zunge, Nase, Niere, Hand und Fuß – jedes mit eigenen Lernkarten, Lupe und „Wo?“.

DAZU
• 3D-Körper zum Drehen und Antippen
• Mein Körper-Atlas: Der Körper färbt sich, je mehr du kannst
• Profil mit Tagesserie und acht Stufen von Schüler:in bis Professor:in, jede mit eigenem Outfit
• Tägliche Erinnerung (freiwillig, lokal auf dem Gerät)
• Auf Deutsch und Aserbaidschanisch, ohne Konto, läuft auch offline

Für Schule, Ausbildung (Pflege, MFA, Physiotherapie), Studium oder einfach aus Neugier.

Kostenlos mit Werbung. Der einmalige Kauf „Werbefrei“ entfernt die Werbepausen; freiwillige Videos für doppelte Punkte bleiben verfügbar.

Hinweis: Anatomy Zoom dient dem Lernen und ersetzt keine medizinische Beratung. Alle Abbildungen sind vereinfachte, selbst gezeichnete Schemata. Mit Unterstützung von KI entwickelt.

name: Angebix
description:
Angebix – Dienstleister finden, Preise vergleichen und sofort ein Angebot erhalten. Kostenlos und ohne Registrierung.

Ob Friseur, Handwerker, Reinigung, Umzug, Kfz-Werkstatt oder Garten: Auf Angebix veröffentlichen Unternehmen ihre echten Preise. Sie sehen auf einen Blick, was eine Leistung kostet, und erhalten Ihr Angebot direkt als PDF.

SO FUNKTIONIERT'S
• Leistung suchen, z. B. „Fliesen verlegen“, „Haarschnitt“ oder „Umzug“
• Stadt oder PLZ und Umkreis wählen
• Preise der Anbieter in Ihrer Nähe vergleichen
• Leistungen auswählen, Menge eingeben – fertig ist Ihr Angebot

SAMMELVERGLEICH
Fragen Sie mehrere Firmen gleichzeitig an und vergleichen Sie die Angebote nebeneinander.

FIRMENSEITEN
Jedes Unternehmen hat eine eigene Seite mit Preisliste, Kontaktdaten, Bewertungen und – wenn verfügbar – freien Terminen.

IN IHRER SPRACHE
Angebix ist in 24 Sprachen verfügbar. Preise werden in Ihrer Landeswährung angezeigt.

FÜR KUNDEN KOSTENLOS
Keine Registrierung, keine Kosten, keine versteckten Gebühren.

Sie haben ein Unternehmen? Laden Sie die App „Angebix Business“ und verwalten Sie dort Ihre Preisliste und Anfragen.

name: Angebix Business
description:
Angebix Business – die App für Unternehmen auf angebix.com. Verwalten Sie Ihre Preisliste, beantworten Sie Kundenanfragen und behalten Sie Ihre Bewertungen im Blick – direkt vom Smartphone oder Tablet.

IHRE PREISLISTE
• Kategorien und Leistungen anlegen und bearbeiten
• Feste Preise oder Von–bis-Preise, Einheiten und Hinweise
• Vorlagen für über 30 Branchen als Startpunkt
• Sicherungen Ihrer Preise erstellen und wiederherstellen

ANFRAGEN
• Alle Kundenanfragen mit gewählten Leistungen, Mengen und geschätztem Betrag
• Kontaktdaten des Kunden auf einen Blick
• Nach dem Auftrag um eine Bewertung bitten

IHRE FIRMENSEITE
• Firmenprofil, Logo, Foto und Akzentfarbe
• Design-Vorlagen für Ihre öffentliche Seite
• Bis zu 24 Sprachen – Kunden sehen Ihre Preise in ihrer Sprache
• Steuer-Einstellungen (Netto/Brutto, Kleinunternehmer)

BEWERTUNGEN & KONTAKT
• Bewertungen ansehen und veröffentlichen
• Kontaktwünsche von Kunden (Telefon, Treffen, Videoanruf)

Die App richtet sich an Unternehmen, die bereits ein Angebix-Konto haben. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse und Ihrem Passwort an.

Sie suchen einen Dienstleister? Laden Sie die kostenlose App „Angebix“.

name: Ánh Đèn – Đọc sách cùng nhau
description:
Ánh Đèn là một phòng đọc sách 3D, nơi bạn ngồi đọc cùng những người khác, mỗi người một cuốn, cùng một lúc.

Đọc sách thường là việc lặng lẽ một mình. Ở Ánh Đèn, bạn chọn một chỗ ngồi, mở sách và đọc bên cạnh những người cũng đang đọc. Không cần nói chuyện, không chấm điểm, không quảng cáo. Chỉ cần biết có người đọc cùng.

GẦN 700 CUỐN SÁCH MIỄN PHÍ
Văn học Việt Nam, sách tiếng Anh, Nhật, Hàn đã hết bản quyền, đọc ngay trong ứng dụng. Bạn cũng có thể mở sách của riêng mình (EPUB, PDF) hoặc ngồi đọc sách giấy cùng mọi người.

THẮP ĐÈN ĐỌC SÁCH
Mỗi ngày đọc, thắp một ngọn đèn cho tỉnh, thành của bạn. Bản đồ sáng dần theo những người đang đọc.

ĐỌC 5 PHÚT MỖI NGÀY
Một đoạn văn, một bài thơ ngắn để bắt đầu thói quen đọc.

NHẮC ĐỌC MỖI NGÀY
Tự chọn giờ để Ánh Đèn nhắc bạn đọc sách. Chỉ bật khi bạn muốn.

MỘT GÓC YÊN TĨNH
Nhạc cổ điển nhẹ (vẫn phát khi khoá màn hình), màn hình luôn sáng khi bạn đang đọc, Phòng Đèn Khuya mỗi tối thứ Bảy.

BẠN ĐỌC
Kết bạn và gửi thư về sách. Có báo cáo và chặn để giữ không gian an toàn.

Ánh Đèn miễn phí, không quảng cáo, không bán gì trong ứng dụng.

name: Aniga
description:
Aniga is the employee app for your company's HR. You are checked in when you arrive at work and checked out when you leave, without pressing a button. Apply for leave, claim expenses and see your payslips from your phone.

Aniga means "me" in Somali: your own place for everything about your work.

PLEASE NOTE: Aniga works with your employer's HR system. You need the server address and the login that your HR team gives you. You cannot sign up on your own.

AUTOMATIC ATTENDANCE
• Checked in when you arrive at your workplace, checked out when you leave. Nothing to forget.
• Your check-out time is the time you actually left.
• Step out for a few minutes and come back: no check-out is recorded.
• A notification confirms every check-in and check-out.
• Keeps working when the app is closed and after the phone restarts.

SECURE AND FAIR
• Each phone is registered once and approved by HR, so attendance can only come from your own phone.
• Every check-in is signed with a key kept in your phone's secure hardware.
• Fake-location apps are detected and refused.
• Your location is read only when you arrive at or leave your workplace. Aniga does not follow your route during the day.

EVERYTHING ELSE AT WORK
• Today: your shift, check-in time and hours worked at a glance
• Attendance: your month day by day, and a request for a missed day in one tap
• Shifts: ask for a different shift
• Leave: apply, see your balances and upcoming holidays, follow each request
• Expense claims and advances, with receipts
• Salary slips and your pay for the year so far
• Managers: approve your team's requests from the phone

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Setup and attendance screens are available in English and Somali (af-Soomaali).

GETTING STARTED
1. Install Aniga and enter the server address from your HR team, for example hr.yourcompany.com.
2. Log in with your work account.
3. Register your phone. HR approves it.
4. Turn on automatic attendance and allow location "All the time".

YOUR PRIVACY
Your information goes only to your employer's own HR server. Aniga has no ads and no tracking, and does not sell or share your data. Location is used only to check you in and out at your workplace.

name: Animal Pairs: Kids Memory
description:
Flip the cards and find the animal pairs!

Animal Pairs is a gentle memory game for young children. Tap two cards to turn them over. When the animals match, they stay open and a friendly voice says their name. Boards start with just 2 pairs and slowly grow to 8, so the game grows with your child.

FEATURES
• 14 cute hand-drawn animals: cat, dog, pig, frog, panda, lion, owl and more
• Hear every animal's name in English or Turkish
• Boards grow from 4 to 16 cards
• Nobody loses: every board ends with a cheer
• Big cards for little fingers
• Purchases and links sit behind a parent check
• Play offline

For parents: Animal Pairs shows only child-directed, non-personalised ads and never tracks your child. A one-time Remove Ads purchase (behind a parent check) turns ads off.

name: Ankrolab Brewing Co.
description:
Download the Ankrolab Brewing Co. app for access to our memberships & special perks!

With the Ankrolab Brewing Co. App you will find:

- Our Mug Clubs
- Members Only Rewards
- Punch Cards
- Menus
- Notifications
- Events

Stay connected to Ankrolab Brewing Co.! Check out our tap list, shop online, and see what events we have coming up. Join one of our Mug Clubs and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: Anniversary Alert: D-Day
description:
Almost forgot your anniversary again? Anniversary Alert announces upcoming days like emergency alerts, step by step.

· D-14 Watch — plenty of time, plan now and you win
· D-7 Warning — still time to book flowers and dinner
· D-3 Escalated — no gift yet? Order today or it won't arrive
· D-1 Critical — even one line in a card counts
· All clear on the evening of the day

■ Everyone in one place
Partner, spouse, kids, parents, in-laws, friends and pets, with several dates per person.

■ Counted for you
· Add the day you started dating and get 100 days, 200 days, 300 days and every anniversary
· Add a baby's birthday and get 50 days, 100 days, the 1st birthday and every birthday after
· Milestone birthdays like the 60th, 70th and 80th are named for you

■ A to-do list for each relationship
Flowers and a note for a partner, a call and a meal for parents, double treats for a pet. Tap an alert to open its checklist.

■ Holidays you can switch on or off
Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day and Christmas.

■ Light and private
No sign-up, no server. Everything stays on your phone, and you can export a text backup anywhere you like.

Available in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

name: Anode: Battery Health
description:
Anode reads your battery health from the analytics files your iPhone writes itself, and shows how it changes over time.

SUMMARY
Battery health with one decimal (like 92.9%), cycle count and your latest reading on one screen. The battery's lifetime average, lowest and highest temperatures are here too.

HISTORY AND FORECAST
Every reading becomes part of a chart. See the effect of iOS updates and recalibrations, and how many cycles you use each month. As readings add up, Anode estimates when your battery may reach 80% health.

COMPARE
If you like, join the Community and compare your battery with iPhones of the same model and a similar cycle count.

PRIVACY
Your data stays on your phone. If you join the Community, your measurements are shared without your name, to compare your battery with similar iPhones and to improve battery life forecasts. No account needed, no ads.

GETTING STARTED
Turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements → Share iPhone Analytics; the first file appears the next day. The steps in the app show how to find and add it. Until your first file is ready, you can explore with sample data. You can back up and restore your history and set reminders.

name: Ant Manager by Teisman Apps
description:
AntManager is the ultimate companion designed by and for ant-keeping and myrmecology enthusiasts. Whether you are starting with your first queen or caring for multiple mature colonies, AntManager gives you every tool you need to track your formicariums in a clean, visual, and scientific way.

With a modern dark and light interface, easily log every stage of your colonies' life cycle: feeding, cleaning, population growth, hibernation, and daily observations.

Key Features:

• Complete Colony Management: Detailed colony profiles with automatic status detection (Founding, Growing, Established, Hibernating), smart hunger indicator with hibernation scaling, and feeding alerts.
• 260+ Species Catalog: Rich species sheets with taxonomy, habitat, ideal temperature and humidity, diet, caste sizes, and care tips.
• Calendar & Daily Logbook: Record feedings (protein, sugars, seeds, water), cleanings, observations, and incidents automatically synced with your dashboard indicators.
• Evolution Gallery & PDF Reports: Build a photo timeline for each nest, pick cover photos, and export printable technical PDF reports.
• QR Scanner & Printable Labels: Generate printable QR labels for your formicariums and scan them with your camera to jump straight to any colony.
• Analytics & Achievements: Interactive feeding frequency, diet, and population charts plus 24 unlockable achievements.
• AI Myrmecology Assistant (AntBot): Ask questions about your own colonies, identify species from photos, and use voice dictation (configurable with your own Gemini API key).
• Offline-First & Private: All your data and photos stay locally on your device with exportable backups. Available in 6 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese).

name: Anupama Jewellery
description:
Welcome to Anupama Gold Edavanna – your convenient digital companion for managing your jewellery savings schemes.

Stay connected with Anupama Gold And Diamonds and manage your gold savings with ease. Our app makes it simple for customers to access their jewellery scheme accounts, pay instalments, track payments, and stay updated with the latest jewellery collections and offers.

Key Features

• Easy Registration & Login: Access your account securely using your registered mobile number and OTP verification.

• Manage Gold Savings Schemes: View your enrolled schemes, instalment details, payment schedules, and account information in one place.

• Convenient Instalment Payments: Pay your scheme instalments through the available online payment options without visiting the showroom.

• Payment History: Keep track of your previous payments and monitor your scheme progress.

• Payment Verification: Submit payment details for verification by our jewellery team and receive updates on payment status.

• Gold Value Tracking: View the gold value accumulated or reserved against your accepted instalments according to the applicable scheme terms and gold rates.

• Jewellery Collections: Explore the latest jewellery designs and collections from Anupama Gold Edavanna.

• Offers & Updates: Stay informed about exclusive offers, promotions, scheme updates, and important announcements from Anupama Gold Edavanna.

A Simpler Way to Save for Gold

Whether you are making your regular instalment payment or checking your scheme progress, Anupama Gold And Diamonds helps you stay connected with your jewellery savings journey.

Download the app and enjoy a convenient way to manage your jewellery savings with Anupama Gold Edavanna.

name: ApertureCraft: Analog Film Cam
description:
ApertureCraft brings the tactile soul of classic 35mm analog film to your iPhone — processed 100% offline on-device.

Craft timeless photographs with carefully calibrated film emulations, organic halation and grain, and precision color grading tools.

KEY FEATURES
• Classic 35mm Film Stocks: Warm daylight, moody tungsten, crisp monochrome, and cinematic slide looks.
• Real-Time LUT & Tone Controls: Fine-tune exposure, contrast, split toning, grain size, and vignette.
• Non-Destructive Offline Editing: Full-resolution export with original quality preserved.
• 100% Private: Photos never leave your device. No cloud upload, no login required.
• One-Time Buyout: Pay once to unlock every film stock and custom LUT preset forever.

name: APLLOPOR
description: APLLOPOR您可以使用此工具進行個人支出對帳。 您可以輸入交易明細（例如原始商家名稱、日期及付款帳戶），或是匯入帳單明細並逐筆核對。 若遇到商家名稱重複的情況，系統支援並列比對交易編號與帳戶，並提供預覽功能，讓您在合併前即可檢視合併後的總金額。 針對涵蓋多種支出類別的交易，您可以儲存常用的分攤比例；若退款發生在不同月份，也能將其關聯回原始交易。 透過支出目錄，您可以將任何實際支付款項追溯至原始交易紀錄，即使更換信用卡或價格隨時間變動，也能確保資料的連貫性。 此外，您還能進行定期對帳、管理待辦事項、追蹤預期費用與實際支出間的差異，並監控每月支出是否符合預算。

name: Apolo Player TV
description:
APOLO PLAYER TV – YOUR CONTENT. YOUR EXPERIENCE.

Discover a smarter way to enjoy your personal entertainment.

Apolo Player TV is a modern IPTV and media player that brings your compatible playlists into one beautifully organized viewing experience. Enjoy a premium cinematic interface, intuitive navigation and flexible playback designed around your entertainment needs.

Connect your own authorized media source and explore live TV, movies and series with ease.

ENTERTAINMENT, REIMAGINED

Experience IPTV playback through an elegant dark interface, vibrant blue accents, cinematic artwork and intuitive navigation. Access your personal media collections without unnecessary complexity.

POWERFUL FEATURES

• Flexible Playlist Integration
Connect using Xtream Codes credentials or compatible M3U playlist URLs through a simple authentication process.

• Live TV
Browse available television channels, explore categories and access broadcasts included in your authorized playlists.

• Cinematic Movies Library
Explore your movie collection through immersive poster layouts and organized categories.

• Series & Episodes
Discover available series, browse seasons and select episodes through an intuitive interface.

• Immersive Video Playback
Enjoy compatible video streams with convenient playback controls.

• Recently Played
Quickly access previously played channels, movies and series.

• Smart Search
Find your preferred channels, movies and series with ease.

• Premium UI/UX
Experience modern navigation, cinematic layouts and a distinctive dark theme.

• Multilingual Interface
Choose between English, French, Spanish and German.

• Saved Sessions
Store your connection details locally for convenient access to your media source.

ONE PLAYER. MULTIPLE DEVICES.

Designed for iPhone and iPad, Apolo Player TV brings your personal media collections into a convenient mobile viewing experience.

QUICK AND EASY SETUP

1. Open Apolo Player TV.
2. Select Xtream Codes or M3U URL.
3. Enter your authorized connection details.
4. Browse your available media and start watching.

No bundled playlists. No built-in channels. Just your content and your preferred viewing experience.

IMPORTANT NOTICE & DISCLAIMER

Apolo Player TV is strictly an independent IPTV and multimedia player, not an IPTV service or streaming content provider.

• We do not provide, host, sell, resell, distribute or supply M3U links, IPTV playlists, Xtream Codes accounts or IPTV subscriptions.

• No television channels, movies, series, sports broadcasts or streaming content are included with the application.

• Users must provide their own legally obtained playlists, authorized credentials and compatible media sources.

• Users are solely responsible for ensuring they have the necessary rights, licenses and permissions to access and stream their selected content.

• Apolo Player TV does not control, monitor or verify the legality, availability, accuracy or quality of third-party content.

• The developer is not responsible for third-party content accessed through user-provided playlists or services, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

• We do not endorse, encourage or support copyright infringement or unauthorized access to copyrighted material.

• Apolo Player TV is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any third-party IPTV provider, broadcaster or streaming platform.

Playback availability and quality depend on your media source, internet connection and device capabilities.

APOLO PLAYER TV

Your playlists. Your entertainment. Your way to watch.

© 2026 Ilyas Dev. All rights reserved.

name: AppRevenue: Stats
description:
AppRevenue brings the numbers of all your apps and games into one place: downloads, installs, revenue and customer reviews from the App Store, Google Play, Microsoft Store and Steam.

CONNECT ONCE, SEE EVERY APP
Connect a developer account with its own API key. AppRevenue finds every app the account can see, including apps you publish later, and syncs the store reports every day.

EVERY METRIC, DAY BY DAY
• Downloads, first downloads, redownloads, installs and updates
• Proceeds and sales in their original currency, or converted to your currency at each day's exchange rate
• Store page views, impressions and listing visitors
• Steam wishlists, units sold and refunds
Tap any number to split it by day, app, product and country.

ALL REVIEWS IN ONE INBOX
Read and search the latest reviews from every store, with stars or Steam recommendations.

STAY UP TO DATE
Get a daily or weekly email summary, a daily notification with yesterday's totals, and an alert when a new review arrives.

SHARE LIVE REPORTS
Create a web page with live numbers for the apps you choose, with a PDF download. Hide app or store names when you share with a publisher or a client.

SEVERAL ACCOUNTS
Keep your studio, your clients and your side projects in separate accounts and switch between them with one tap.

HONEST NUMBERS
Missing or delayed data is shown as unavailable, never as zero. Store credentials stay on the AppRevenue service and are never sent back to your device.

JUST LOOKING?
Explore the sample portfolio with fictional apps, no account needed.

SUBSCRIPTION
AppRevenue Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. New subscribers get the first week free. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free week ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://apprev.dev/privacy

name: AquaTrace: Mineral Water
description:
AquaTrace helps you understand what's in your bottled water and choose one that suits you.

DISCOVER MINERAL WATERS
Browse still and sparkling waters sold in the US, UK and Europe — from Mountain Valley, Poland Spring and Topo Chico to Evian, Highland Spring and Gerolsteiner. Search by brand or country, filter by region or low sodium, and sort by calcium, magnesium or total minerals. Every brand links to its published water report.

COMPARE SIDE BY SIDE
See calcium, magnesium, sodium, potassium, bicarbonate, dry residue and pH in one clear table, with the highest value in each row highlighted.

SCAN ANY BOTTLE LABEL
Point your camera at the mineral table on a bottle. AquaTrace reads the label on your iPhone, fills in the values and lets you check them before saving. Photos never leave your device.

LEARN WHAT THE NUMBERS MEAN
Plain-English guides to sodium, calcium and magnesium, what "mineral", "spring" and "purified" mean under FDA and EU/UK rules, alkaline water, and how bottled and tap water are regulated in the UK, EU and US.

AQUATRACE PREMIUM
• Unlimited label scans (free: 3 per month)
• Compare up to 4 waters at once (free: 2)
• Water hardness plus US (FDA/EPA) and EU/UK label-threshold analysis
• Personalised matches based on your preferences
• Shareable comparison reports
• Unlimited saved waters (free: 5)

Premium is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your saved waters and scans stay on your iPhone.

AquaTrace provides educational information only. It is not a medical device and is not a substitute for professional medical advice or laboratory water-quality testing. Mineral values are typical label figures and may change; always check the current label.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.ascendwater.co.uk/post/aquatrace-privacy-policy

name: Arah: Compass & Altimeter
description:
Arah is a compass, Qibla finder and altimeter that keeps working on a mountain with no signal. No ads, no subscription, no account. The extras in Arah Pro are a single one-time purchase.

NUMBERS YOU CAN CHECK
• The compass and altitude show where they come from and how precise they are: compass accuracy in ± degrees, and the altitude source (GPS, barometer or your own calibration) with ± meters.
• A warning when metal or magnets disturb the compass, and a hint when it needs calibrating.
• No barometer on your device, or no GPS on a Wi-Fi iPad? Arah tells you instead of guessing.

COMPASS
• True north or magnetic north, with large degrees, the cardinal direction and the magnetic declination where you are.
• Tap to lock a bearing and see how far you are off it.

QIBLA, FREE FOREVER
• Qibla bearing from true north and the distance to the Kaaba.
• An arrow on the dial, with a gentle tap and a clear sign on screen when you face the Qibla.

ALTITUDE AND AIR PRESSURE
• Altitude from GPS and the barometer, in meters, feet or both.
• Calibrate from a known altitude (a trail sign, a map, an airport) for the closest reading.
• Pressure altitude and QNH for pilots.
• Air pressure in hPa, inHg or mmHg, with the trend since you opened the app.

COORDINATES
• Decimal or degrees, minutes and seconds, with the horizontal accuracy. Copy or share in one tap.

ON THE TRAIL AND IN THE CAR
• Keep the screen on while you navigate.
• Dashboard mode: big numbers in landscape for a car mount.
• A real iPad layout, in portrait and landscape.

ARAH PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Apple Watch app that works without your iPhone. Compass and Qibla on the watch are free; Pro adds altitude, air pressure, coordinates, the way back to a saved point, and complications.
• Trip recording, also with the screen off, with altitude and pressure charts, trip stats and GPX export.
• Saved points: save where you are and find your way back with an arrow and the distance.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your last altitude, air pressure and Qibla bearing.
Pay once and keep it. Pro works with Family Sharing, and features that are free today stay free.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your location and barometer readings are used on your device and never leave it. Arah needs no internet connection.

name: Arcade TD
description:
Arcade TD is a retro pixel-art tower defense game with a glowing CRT arcade look.

Enemies march down the path toward your castle, wave after wave. Place your towers on the build spots, upgrade them and stop every last one before they get through.

BUILD AND UPGRADE FOUR TOWERS
• Archer – fast arrows that pierce armor
• Cannon – heavy shots with splash damage
• Mage – magic bolts that slow enemies down
• Chaos – raw power that ignores defenses
Each tower has 10 upgrade levels and grows into a bigger, stronger version of itself.

EVERY ENEMY HAS A WEAKNESS
Heavily armored brutes, swift runners, flying creatures, enemies that can't be slowed… Each wave shows which towers deal extra damage, so think before you build.

15 LEVELS IN 3 REGIONS
• Forest – learn the ropes among the trees
• Desert – new enemies and the Sandworm, a boss that burrows under the sand
• Volcano – the hardest battles and the Lava Dragon, a three-phase final boss

TOKENS AND THE LEADERBOARD
Every new game costs 1 token, and free tokens refill over time. Finish all 15 levels with as few tokens as possible to earn a top score, and climb the global leaderboard. Want to keep going right away? Token packs are available in the shop.

MORE TO LOVE
• Three difficulty modes: Normal, Hard and Deadly
• Your run is saved even in the middle of a wave
• Arcade sound effects and an original soundtrack
• Sign in with Apple to keep your tokens and progress across devices
• Available in English, Turkish, French, Portuguese and Chinese

Ready to hold the line? Insert coin and start your defense!

name: Argos VMS
description:
Argos is the mobile app for Argos video management servers. Connect to your own Argos server at your site, or sign in with Argos Cloud to reach all of your sites from anywhere.

LIVE VIEW
• Grids of live cameras, full screen with pinch-to-zoom and drag
• Snapshots from any camera
• Pan, tilt and zoom control for PTZ cameras
• Two-way talk and announcements through camera speakers and network speakers

PLAYBACK
• Timeline for any day, with motion and event markers
• Jump to bookmarks and alarms
• Smooth scrubbing and speed control

ALARMS
• Camera offline, motion and rule alarms from your server
• Acknowledge alarms from your phone

ARGOS CLOUD
• One sign-in for every site you have access to
• On the site's own network the app connects directly; elsewhere it connects through the Argos Cloud relay
• Video is encrypted from your server to your phone; the relay cannot read it

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
• Two-step sign-in for Argos Cloud
• Recordings stay on your own server, not in the cloud
• No advertising, no tracking

Argos requires an Argos server (installed by you or your security dealer). Settings for cameras, recording, users and more are available to administrators.

name: Aria - Exercise Together
description:
Aria is a social app for people who want to play, not just talk about it. Post a sport, a level, and a time, then meet people who show up ready.
This 1.0 build is a local prototype. All people, plans, messages, and reports are fictional and stay on the device. No network, purchases, push notifications, analytics, or real moderation are connected yet.

name: Ark Sommelier: Wine Pairing
description:
Ark Sommelier is a guide for anyone who wants to learn about food and wine pairing.

Snap a photo of your dish or type its name. Ark Sommelier breaks down the dish's balance of fat, acidity, salt, spice and intensity, and explains why certain wine styles go well with those flavors. Every suggestion includes the grape, region and serving temperature, chosen from wines that are easy to find where you live.

DISH CATALOG
Dozens of dishes with photos, from seafood, meat, Turkish, Italian, Spanish, French and Asian cuisines. Tap one and see the pairing right away.

NON-ALCOHOLIC PAIRINGS
For every dish you'll also find a non-alcoholic pairing idea: şerbet (a chilled sweet drink), ayran, kombucha, brewed tea and more.

VINEYARD MAP
Explore Türkiye's wine regions and native grapes on the map, along with regions around the world like Tuscany, Bordeaux, Rioja, Mosel, Douro, Crete and Napa.

PLAN A MENU
Build a menu for a gathering step by step, from starter to dessert. Each course comes with a matching wine style, a non-alcoholic pairing and notes on moderate serving.

No account needed, no ads. The app doesn't recommend brands, sell anything or promote anything.

Alcohol is harmful to your health. Ark Sommelier is only for users aged 18 and over. If you're pregnant, taking medication or planning to drive, don't drink alcohol. Suggestions are generated by AI and are for information only.

name: Army Tycoon: Idle Tank War
description:
Start with one rifle squad and build it into a modern army.
Tap to fire, buy tanks, jets and warships, and keep earning gold while you're away.
Pick your country and take it from rank 40 to number one.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every tap fires a shot, and tapping an enemy marks it for the whole army. Keep tapping to fill the Fury meter and your fire rate doubles for a few seconds. Don't feel like tapping? Turn on hold to fire and keep a finger down. When you close the app, your army keeps fighting the stage it's on and banks up to 8 hours of gold.

YOUR ARMY
18 units in six branches: infantry, armor, artillery, air force, navy and missiles. You start with a rifle squad and work up to main battle tanks, attack helicopters, rocket artillery, stealth bombers, destroyers and an aircraft carrier. Missiles build up over time and you fire them by hand. Units level up with gold, rank up to five stars with blueprints, and earn mastery the longer they fight. Gems also buy 12 colour skins that repaint your units, such as desert camo and night ops.

THE CAMPAIGN
Six theatres: desert, coast, city, jungle, mountain and arctic. Every tenth stage is a fortified HQ with a 30 second clock, weak points to tap, and a shield or air phase. Lose three times and an intel report tells you which unit to level and how long it will take to afford. No boss is locked behind a purchase.

REDEPLOY AND GO FURTHER
From stage 30 you can redeploy. You go back to stage 1 and earn Commendations, which add damage for good, so each run gets further than the last. Pick a field order after a new boss win and spend medals in the research tree. Research also unlocks three switches: auto buy spends your gold on the upgrade that adds the most power for the price, auto boss takes on the boss once your army looks strong enough, and auto redeploy starts the next run for you.

THE LADDER
39 rival commanders stand between you and rank 1. Beat them in War Games to take their rank, then go back for the medals you missed. They are computer commanders, not real players.

EVERY DAY
The War Room has a supply crate every 4 hours and three Operations with odd rules, like no tapping or air units only. There is also a weekly score attack, weekend events with their own shop, and a 28 day season pass with a free track.

ADS ONLY IF YOU WANT THEM
There are no forced ads. Some buttons offer a short video for a reward, such as double offline gold or a boss retry with extra damage. Skip them and you lose nothing. The Ad Skip Pass gives the same rewards without the video.

PIXEL ART AND SETTINGS
The whole game is drawn in pixel art and plays on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape. Settings cover haptics, reduce motion and a left handed layout.

VIP SUBSCRIPTION
VIP Monthly is an optional subscription that lasts one month and costs $7.99 a month in the US. The App Store shows the price in your currency before you buy. VIP gives 30 gems a day, auto tap, auto abilities, 16 hours of offline earnings instead of 8, one extra missile slot, a fourth field order choice and a second attempt at each Operation. The Nuclear Missile can only be bought while VIP is active, and you keep it if VIP ends.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. VIP renews every month unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings (Settings > your name > Subscriptions). Deleting the game does not cancel it.

Army Tycoon is free to play with optional in-app purchases. The game is in English.

Terms of Use: https://armytycoonwebsite.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://armytycoonwebsite.vercel.app/privacy

name: Arrow Strum
description:
Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, plucking a note as it goes. But only if nothing stands in its way. Work out the order, free every arrow and play the whole board like a harp.

Arrow Strum is a calm, clever puzzle that starts simple and ends very, very hard.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each arrow moves only in the direction it points.
• If another arrow is in the way, it bumps and one of your three skulls fills in. Fill all three and the level is over.
• Long arrows wind around the board and lock whole stretches of it, so think a few moves ahead.

EVERY ARROW IS A STRING
Short arrows sing high and long ones sing low. The longest play a whole chord. Past the first few lessons, every level has its own tune hidden inside, and clearing the board ends it with a strum.

Pick your instrument: harp, piano, guitar, harpsichord, shamisen or a classic synth.

100 LEVELS, SIX RANKS
Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, Ultra Hard and Basically Impossible. The boards grow as you climb, and Basically Impossible keeps going past level 100.

ALL SORTS OF SHAPES
A cat, an apple, a lighthouse, a guitar, a palm tree, a teapot and dozens more. Zoom out to see the whole picture, then pinch in to work on the details.

A LITTLE SONGBOOK
Four original songs to play at your own pace: First Light, Paper Lanterns, Skipping Stones and Afterglow. Follow the guide, turn on Autoplay to hear how it goes, or find your own way through.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Hints when you are stuck
• Best times, Perfect badges and a perfect streak to protect
• 22 achievements to earn
• Replay any level you have cleared
• Dark mode

AND NOTHING ELSE
No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No tracking. Arrow Strum works completely offline, and your progress never leaves your phone.

I’m Eric, and Help Yourself is my one-person studio making simple, fun games. Thanks for playing.

name: Arrowfold
description:
Arrowfold is a calm, clever puzzle about arrows wrapped around 3D shapes.

Every shape is covered in arrows. Tap one and it slides the way it points. If the path is clear, it flies off. If another arrow is in the way, it bounces back and costs a heart. Arrows bend around corners and wrap over edges, so turn the shape and look at it from every side to find your next move. Clear every arrow to win.

• 22 puzzles on cubes, towers, stairs, crosses, pyramids and more
• Every puzzle is guaranteed to be solvable
• Stuck? A hint lights up the best arrow to move
• Play in AR: set the puzzle on your real table and walk around it
• Holiday bonus levels, free for everyone while they last
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking

The first 10 levels are free. One purchase unlocks every level, including all levels added later. Extra hints are available as an in-app purchase.

name: Art in Nature
description:
Art in Nature is a living artwork that doesn't explain itself. Touch it, tilt it, or simply watch: everything responds, everything sounds, and it is never the same twice.

Forty-eight movements drift into one another, each lasting a few minutes and unfolding slowly:
• A spiral galaxy, held together by nothing but a pattern in its orbits
• Ink dropped on water and combed into marbled paper
• Jellyfish glowing brighter as you sink into the deep
• A fractal coastline you can fall into for ever
• Curtains of aurora, a kelp forest, a meadow that blooms and goes to seed
• Fireflies that learn to flash as one, frost, rivers, dunes, lightning, a whole day passing over the hills
…and many more, some hidden, some only found by doing something.

LISTEN AND TOUCH
Every movement makes its own sound, made from what you see: orbits, ripples, falling sand, the length of a day's light. Haptics let you feel it too. Sound plays with the silent switch on.

IT KNOWS WHERE AND WHEN YOU ARE
The real Sun, Moon and stars, the hour, the season and the holidays where you live, and a few live signals from the planet: earthquakes, the Sun's weather, new Wikipedia pages as they are written.

NEVER THE SAME TWICE
New colours, shapes and keys every visit; lenses that change how you see a movement; secrets that leave gold stars in its night sky. It remembers you, and changes as you come back.

WIDGETS AND STANDBY
Today's pattern (the same one everyone on Earth is seeing this hour), the year as a spiral, tonight's Moon, and a tree that grows while you're not looking.

FREE, WHOLE, PRIVATE
No ads, no account, nothing locked. Everything it remembers stays on your device. An optional one-time Patron purchase supports it and adds two keepsakes: keep any moment as a picture, and let it drift on through the night while your phone charges.

Also on the web at timesbane.com.

name: ArtGuide: Museum Audio Guide
description:
Every artwork has a story. ArtGuide helps you find it.

Point your camera at a painting in a museum and ArtGuide recognises it in seconds. Then read its story or listen to it, at your own pace, in English, Russian or Armenian.

RECOGNISE ARTWORKS WITH YOUR CAMERA
Hold your phone up to a painting. ArtGuide finds it in the camera view, matches it against museum catalogues and opens its page. You can also take or choose a photo.

THE STORY BEHIND EACH WORK
Who painted it, when, and why it matters. Clear, carefully sourced texts about the artwork, the artist and the moment it captures.

LISTEN AS YOU WALK
Turn any artwork page into an audio guide and keep your eyes on the art, not on the screen.

AI DESCRIPTIONS FOR THE UNKNOWN (PREMIUM)
Found something ArtGuide doesn't know yet? Ask the AI for a description. AI answers are always clearly marked as unverified, so they are never confused with museum content.

MUSEUMS AND THE MAP
Explore the National Gallery of Armenia, house-museums in Yerevan and art museums beyond Armenia. See opening details and find the museums near you on the map.

CURATED TOURS
Follow guided routes through a collection, from Armenian historical painting to the views of Ararat that artists returned to again and again.

YOUR PERSONAL LIBRARY
Save the artworks you love, revisit the ones you recognised and keep a record of your museum visits.

THREE LANGUAGES
The whole app, the artwork stories and the narration are available in English, Russian and Armenian.

FREE TO START
Museum profiles, artwork pages and tour routes are free. A free account includes 3 artwork identifications and narration previews.

ARTGUIDE PREMIUM
Unlimited identification, full narration, narrated tours and AI descriptions. Choose a 3-Day Pass for a trip (does not renew) or an annual subscription that renews automatically until you cancel it in your store account settings.

Your photos are analysed and then discarded: ArtGuide does not store them. No ads, no tracking.

Privacy Policy: https://artguide.online/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://artguide.online/terms/

name: Arvo: Punto de venta y stock
description:
Arvo es el punto de venta y sistema de gestión para comercios: almacenes, kioscos, ferreterías, tiendas de ropa, dietéticas y más. Escaneás, cobrás y listo.

VENDÉ MÁS RÁPIDO
• Escaneá códigos de barras con la cámara del iPhone o con un lector Bluetooth.
• Productos por unidad o por peso, con variantes (talle, color).
• Descuentos, varios medios de pago, vuelto y ventas en espera.
• Ticket para imprimir o enviar por WhatsApp o email.

SEGUÍ VENDIENDO SIN INTERNET
• Las ventas, la caja y los clientes nuevos se guardan en el dispositivo.
• Cuando vuelve la conexión, todo se envía solo.

CONTROLÁ TU STOCK
• Stock por sucursal con alertas de stock bajo.
• Ingresos, egresos, compras y conteos de inventario con escáner.
• Importá tus productos desde Excel y actualizá precios en masa.

CAJA Y CLIENTES
• Apertura y cierre de caja con diferencia de efectivo.
• Ficha de clientes con historial de compras.

TODO EL NEGOCIO EN UN LUGAR
• Dashboard de ventas por día, hora, medio de pago, producto y sucursal.
• Usuarios con roles y permisos: dueño, administrador, encargado y cajero.
• Cambio rápido de cajero con PIN en un dispositivo compartido.
• Ingreso con Face ID o Touch ID.
• Funciona en el iPhone, el iPad y la computadora, con los mismos datos.

Los tickets de Arvo son comprobantes internos y no reemplazan la factura electrónica.

name: As-Salam Islamic Center
description:
The official app of As-Salam Islamic Center in Roanoke, Virginia.

PRAYER TIMES
Accurate daily prayer times for Roanoke, or for your own location. Choose the Standard or Hanafi Asr method.

ADHAN ALERTS
Set an alert for each prayer with a tap. Choose your adhan voice. Alerts are scheduled on your phone, so they still sound without internet.

IQAMAH TIMES
See this week's iqamah times for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha, and get a notice on Saturday night when next week's times change.

HOME AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
See the next prayer without opening the app.

QURAN
Read the full Quran with translation and transliteration, listen to recitation by several reciters, and save your place and bookmarks.

QIBLA, DUAS AND PRAYER LOG
Find the Qibla direction, read daily duas, and keep track of your prayers.

FROM THE MOSQUE
Announcements and urgent notices such as Janazah, Friday khutba videos, Sunday School lessons, the community calendar, and donation links.

LANGUAGES
English, Arabic, Urdu, French and Spanish.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your location stays on your phone.

name: Ashland State Park
description:
Ashland is a quiet walk through a real place: Ashland State Park in Massachusetts, rebuilt from its map, its elevation and its tree cover.

Each season is a year. Step in through autumn, winter, spring and summer, and the park changes around you: leaves turn and fall, the lake freezes and thaws, the woods fill back in.

WANDER
Follow the trails around the reservoir, cross the dam, sit on a stump and watch the light go. Fish and turtles, squirrels and herons are there if you're patient.

ROW AND FISH
Take a rowboat out on the lake and cast from the boat or the shore. Every catch goes in your journal.

YOUR PHONE
A map that fills in as you explore, a camera for photos of the park, and a few tools for the walk.

WHAT YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Ashland is also an art experiment about choice. If you want, you can tell the park how much you use AI, and it will feel that use the way a real watershed feels a data center. The effects are coarse and shown to you openly, and nothing ever leaves your device. What's done stays done; trees regrow slowly.

A YEAR OF YOUR LIFE
Each year in the game can be a year of your life. Enter the year you were born (optional) and the game uses it as its clock.

No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, no tracking. Made by Sam Ling, with megaZINE.

name: Ashvale War
description:
Lead a medieval army across a twelve-stage strategy campaign. Recruit troops, capture flags, and defend your castle as battles unfold across painted landscapes and changing weather.

Use farms and miners to fund reinforcements and upgrades. Choose your formations, manage where you commit your army, and scroll across the battlefield to follow the fight.

Play in landscape using touch controls for recruitment, commands, and navigation.

name: AskOra: Christian AI
description:
Ora is warm, trustworthy AI shaped by historic Christian values. Ask her anything you would ask a general AI, and get help that respects your faith.

Plan your week, write a hard email, understand a Bible passage, get a short devotional, or talk something through. Ora helps with everyday life, and faith shows up when it matters, not forced.

WHAT ORA HELPS WITH
- Everyday tasks: plans, lists, emails, messages and ideas
- Bible study: explain a passage, its context and how Christians have read it
- Short devotionals for your morning or a hard day
- Talking things through when you need to think out loud
- Questions about faith, asked honestly and answered with care

SCRIPTURE YOU CAN TRUST
Ora quotes the Bible from real Bible text, not from memory.

SHAPED BY WHAT YOU ALREADY TRUST
Ora starts from historic Christianity: Jesus, Scripture and the creeds Christians share. Tell her your church's website and she learns your church, its tradition and what it believes. Where Christians differ, Ora describes each view fairly and points you to your pastor.

YOUR LIFE STAYS YOURS
- For adults 18 and over, with phone verification
- Nothing reaches your church unless you choose to send it
- See or delete what Ora has learned about you

REAL HELP IN A CRISIS
If you are in crisis, Ora points you to real help right away. Ora is not a counselor, doctor or emergency service. Ora is an AI and can make mistakes, so check important answers.

AskOra is built by MissionPulse, a company started by a pastor, so the AI you use every day can be one you trust.

name: assembll
description:
assembll is the studio where you build games, apps and hardware with the AI coding agents you already use. This app puts it in your pocket.

Your agents run on your own computer, signed in to your own AI accounts. assembll for iPhone connects to that computer through assembll's secure relay, so you can:

• See every project and thread, and what each agent is doing right now
• Message an agent to steer it, answer its questions or start the next step
• Get a notification when an agent finishes, needs your input or hits an error
• Hear when someone votes on or replies to your work on assembll.xyz
• Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode

Your code and projects stay on your computer. Notifications carry only a short title, never message contents.

You'll need the free assembll desktop app on a Mac, Windows or Linux computer, signed in to the same assembll account. Get it at assembll.xyz/download.

assembll is in public beta: it works, it changes often, and we'd love your feedback.

name: Assnaift
description:
Assnaift is a gentle desk-corner ritual—not a to-do list or social app.

Set up your nook with a name and lamp tone (Amber, Dawn, or Moss). On the Nook tab, watch warmth, calm, and tidy bars and tap five desk items when you want a small moment. Repeats use quiet cooldowns so the pace stays unhurried. Run **Tidy round** once per day for a stronger boost. **Shelf** keeps a simple timeline on device.

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases.

name: ATAVIP
description:
ATAVIP vous permet de louer un véhicule avec chauffeur en République démocratique du Congo, en toute confiance : à Kinshasa, Lubumbashi, Goma, Bukavu, Matadi, Kolwezi, Kisangani, Mbuji-Mayi, et bientôt dans d'autres villes. Pour une heure, une journée ou un transfert vers l'aéroport.

Des chauffeurs et des véhicules vérifiés
Chaque propriétaire, chaque chauffeur et chaque véhicule est vérifié par l'équipe ATAVIP avant d'être publié : pièce d'identité, permis du chauffeur, carte rose, assurance et contrôle technique. Un véhicule dont une pièce a expiré n'est plus proposé.

Commander en trois étapes
• Cherchez un véhicule depuis l'accueil : formule, ville et date.
• Consultez sa fiche : photos, chauffeur, prix à la journée, à l'heure ou pour un transfert aéroport, jours libres et avis des clients.
• Choisissez vos dates, le lieu et l'heure de prise en charge, vérifiez, envoyez : le chauffeur confirme la course.

Suivre ses commandes
Retrouvez vos commandes à venir et passées, avec la prochaine étape de chacune. Vous êtes prévenu par notification à chaque étape.

Payer à la fin de la course
Vous payez le chauffeur directement, à la fin de la course. Aucun paiement dans l'application.

Donner son avis
Après une course terminée, laissez un avis sur le véhicule.

Vous êtes propriétaire ?
Proposez vos véhicules avec chauffeur, sans commission sur vos locations. Le mode propriétaire vous guide : votre dossier, puis l'ajout de chaque véhicule pas à pas (chauffeur, photos, pièces), et l'écran « À faire » vous montre votre prochaine étape. Recevez et confirmez les commandes de vos clients, gérez vos chauffeurs et votre calendrier.

L'application est disponible en français et en anglais.

name: Atlántica FM
description:
Escuchá Atlántica FM en vivo desde tu iPhone.

Disfrutá de nuestra programación, música y entretenimiento estés donde estés, mediante una aplicación sencilla e intuitiva.

• Radio en vivo.
• Reproducción en segundo plano.
• Controles de reproducción con la pantalla bloqueada.
• Acceso a nuestras redes sociales.

Conectate con Atlántica FM y disfrutá de nuestra programación en cualquier momento y lugar.

name: AtomShop
Attendance Kiosk On-Prem
description:
Attendance Kiosk On-Prem turns a phone or tablet at your entrance or reception into a face-recognition time clock for your organisation. It connects directly to your company's own on-premise HR server — attendance data stays with your organisation.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter the company code or server address from your HR administrator.
2. Pair the kiosk by scanning the QR code from your admin panel, or by typing the pairing code.
3. Employees look at the screen to clock in and out — no cards, PINs or fingerprints.

FACE ATTENDANCE
• Fast face recognition for every employee assigned to the kiosk
• Liveness check helps stop photos and screens being used to punch
• Location check for the kiosk's site
• Clear on-screen confirmation for each punch

WORKS OFFLINE
• Punches are saved on the device when the server can't be reached
• They sync automatically when the connection is back

FOR ADMINISTRATORS
• Administrator verification by face before opening admin tools
• Punch history with search and filters
• Attendance calendar for any employee
• Regularisation requests and leave records
• Employee list and on-demand sync
• Data backup and import

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Works only over HTTPS with your organisation's own server
• Face data is used only for attendance and is managed by your organisation

Attendance Kiosk On-Prem requires an organisation that uses the on-premise HR system. Your HR administrator provides the company code and pairing code.

name: Atualizador IBISUL
seller_name: IBISUL AUTOMACAO COMERCIO DE ELETRONICOS LTDA
description:
O Atualizador IBISUL permite atualizar o software e a interface da tela de equipamentos IBISUL compatíveis diretamente pelo iPhone.

Com instruções organizadas por etapas, o aplicativo orienta a busca dos arquivos, a conexão ao equipamento e o envio da atualização.

COMO FUNCIONA

• Escolha entre atualizar o software ou a tela.
• Informe o número de série do equipamento.
• Baixe a atualização pela internet.
• Conecte o iPhone ao Wi-Fi do equipamento e siga as instruções para concluir.

name: Audience Verdict
description:
Discover movies. Share your opinions. Make better movie choices.

Audience Verdict is a movie discovery and audience review platform that brings movie lovers together. Explore movies, read audience opinions, share your reviews and discover what people think before choosing your next movie.

FEATURES

Discover Movies

Explore movies and discover films that match your interests.

Audience Ratings

See audience opinions and ratings to help you decide what to watch.

Share Your Reviews

Express your opinions, rate movies and share your movie experiences.

Movie Ticket Booking

Explore available theatres and shows, select seats and book tickets where supported.

Your Profile

Manage your account and access your personal app experience.

Notifications

Stay informed about relevant updates and app activity.

Your Movie Experience, Your Verdict.

Join Audience Verdict and become part of a community where every movie opinion matters.

name: AuntDus
description:
AuntDus turns a few real-life goals into light RPG-style quests on your iPhone.

Keep up to three main quests active. Each step you take fills the boss bar, earns XP, and raises your level. When a quest hits 100%, it clears and frees a slot for something new. The Chronicle tab is a simple log of steps you have taken—no social feed, no cloud journal.

• Quests — level, streak, up to 3 active quests; optional rest timer between steps (default 15 min; adjustable in Settings)  
• New quest — name + category (Health, Mind, Craft, Bond)  
• Chronicle — timeline of steps with optional notes  
• More — Settings (cooldown, reset), About (how the app works), Privacy policy in Safari

name: Aurex
description:
Το Aurex είναι διαγνωστικός πάγκος για στόλους μηχανημάτων. Κρατά τη ραδιοζεύξη, τους κωδικούς, το δελτίο συνεργείου και την επιστολή κλεισίματος σε μία οθόνη — ώστε η στάση στο λατομείο να μην γίνει κυνήγι.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς

Ανοίγεις την εφαρμογή. Αρχική είναι ο σφυγμός στόλου: δείκτης, τάση, το πιο αδύναμο όχημα, ράβδοι ζεύξης και ανοιχτά δελτία. Κάθε μπλοκ ανοίγει δική του σελίδα. Πάνω δεξιά είναι η ανταπόκριση.
Η Πυξίδα έχει πέντε θαλάμους: Σφυγμός, Μηχανές, Εργασία, Εργαλεία, Αρχείο. Χωρίς κάτω μπάρα. Μπαίνεις, τελειώνεις τη δουλειά, επιστρέφεις.
Οι Μηχανές είναι πλάκες με υγεία, εργοτάξιο και χειριστή. Κάθε όχημα έχει μενού: κονσόλα κινητήρα / υδραυλικών / ηλεκτρικών, κωδικοί SPN/FMI, χειραψία ECU, περίπατος μηχανής, ώρες σέρβις.
Για να κλείσεις βλάβη: Χειραψία → σάρωση → συμπτώματα που βλέπει το μέτωπο → κατάταξη αιτιών (κωδικοί × συμπτώματα) → δελτίο συνεργείου → λίστα, σημείωση, κλείσιμο. Η επιστολή μπαίνει στο Αρχείο και κοινοποιείται.
Η Εργασία έχει σάρωση, δελτία και συναγερμούς. Τα Εργαλεία έχουν ραδιοθάλαμο, άτλαντα κωδικών, όρια, διαστήματα, αποθήκη, ημερολόγιο βάρδιας και δοκιμή υπό φορτίο. Το Αρχείο κρατά σημειώσεις ανά υποσύστημα και επιστολές.
Έρχεται με στόλο λατομείου έτοιμο στη συσκευή. Πλήρης βρόχος χωρίς λογαριασμό και χωρίς οθόνες εισαγωγής. Μόνο φωτεινή εμφάνιση.

name: Aurilo
description:
Aurilo is a quiet digital space for amateur badminton players and court-side scorers to track matches effortlessly. One tap updates the score while automatically calculating the next server, receiver, and court positioning for singles or doubles.

Designed for offline use on the court, Aurilo keeps your current match running seamlessly, supports instant undo for accidental taps, and automatically guides side changes and game intervals. Save your match history locally, attach personal memorial photos, and export clean score report cards to your system photo library.

name: Authenticator App: 2FA Restore
description:
Authenticator App keeps your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes and proves you can get them back. Most people only learn whether their 2FA backup works on the day they've already lost their phone. With Authenticator App, you find out today.

RECOVERY DRILL
In about a minute, Authenticator App opens your backup the way a new iPhone would, using only your Recovery Key, and checks that each account would produce the right code. Nothing on your iPhone changes.

A BACKUP YOU CAN SEE
• A clear status tells you whether you're ready to lose this iPhone
• Encrypted backups keep several versions, so a bad change can't replace your only good copy
• A printable Emergency Kit holds your Recovery Key
• Track which accounts have their own recovery codes saved
• A step-by-step guide for moving to a new iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, email or phone number
• No analytics, ads or tracking
• No server of ours holds your codes
• Codes are generated on your iPhone and work offline
• Backups are encrypted on your iPhone before reaching your own iCloud
• App Lock with Face ID is enforced by iOS

EASY TO MOVE IN, FREE TO LEAVE
• Import from Google Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis, Proton Authenticator and Ente Auth
• Scan a QR code or enter a setup key
• Export everything for free, at any time
• The backup format is publicly documented, so your data doesn't depend on this app

BUILT FOR EVERY DAY
• AutoFill (Premium) suggests a code only on the website it belongs to
• Apple Watch (optional) shows your codes on your wrist, encrypted so only your watch can read them
• Search, pinned accounts and large, readable codes
• Time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time codes: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, 6 to 8 digits
• Available in 14 languages

Important: if you lose both your iPhone and your Recovery Key, nobody can recover your codes, including us. That's what keeps them private, and it's why the drill exists.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: up to 2 codes, with backup, recovery drill, restore, export and App Lock.
Premium: unlimited codes and AutoFill.
If a subscription ends, every code you have keeps working.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Premium is available weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, monthly, or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://authenticator-app-2fa.pages.dev/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://authenticator-app-2fa.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Auto Blur: Face Blur
description:
Auto Blur hides faces in your photos so you can share them without exposing anyone.

Add a photo and every face is detected and blurred automatically. Change the filter, adjust the strength, and save or share the result.

FEATURES
• Automatic face detection and blur
• Filters you can preview live on your own photo
• One slider for strength. Faces stay unrecognizable even at the lowest setting
• Turn individual faces on or off
• Add an area by hand when a face is missed
• Process several photos at once and save them together
• Compare with the original by holding the image

name: Auto ID Photo
description:
Powered by face detection algorithm, this APP automatically create single ID photos and multi-photo print sheets from a quick selfie or existed photos, with control over dimensions, head position and background.

START WITH YOUR SETTINGS
Each launch begins with specification settings and a short four-step guide. Confirm photo size, head-height range, background and paper size before opening the camera. Settings are remembered. English is the default interface; switch to Simplified Chinese using the globe button.

CAPTURE OR CHOOSE A PHOTO
Use the live camera preview, starting with the front camera, or choose an image from your photo library. Switch between front and rear cameras when taking a photo.

DETECT AND ADJUST
After capture or import, face detection sets a head box. Move the box or resize its corners to align the crown, chin and head position. As you adjust the box, green indicates that the crop fits the current settings; red explains a framing problem. This checks crop space, not background quality or acceptance of the finished photo.

CHOOSE YOUR BACKGROUND
Keep the original background or use portrait cutout with white, light grey, blue or red. With a replacement background, missing space above the source image can be filled in the selected colour; the head, sides and bottom must still fit. Check hair and shoulder edges in the generated preview.

CONTROL SIZE AND RESOLUTION
Adjust photo dimensions, head-height range, paper size and spacing. Defaults arrange eight 35 × 45 mm photos on a 6 × 4 inch sheet. Generate a new sheet after changing settings.

By default, the single photo keeps the source crop's pixel dimensions. Alternatively, choose a fixed DPI. JPEG files include DPI metadata for the selected physical size. Print-sheet JPEGs are limited to 20 megapixels; the PDF uses the single photo's full generated resolution without that sheet limit. Preview captions show the JPEG pixel dimensions.

SAVE OR SHARE
Export a single JPEG or a print sheet as JPEG or PDF. Each photo's share menu offers Save to Photos and photo-access controls, with a shortcut to system settings when permission needs attention. Grey spacing separates photos; cutting marks appear when space allows.

Image processing takes place on your device. Photos are not uploaded for processing.

Requires iOS 17 or later. For printing, use matching paper, 100% / actual size and no automatic page fitting or enlargement. Prefer PDF and check the printed dimensions with a ruler.

name: Awake Call
description:
Awake Call is an alarm clock that wakes you with a real two-way conversation.

At the time you set, it rings like an incoming call. Answer, and a realistic AI voice talks with you until it can tell you are actually up. If you hang up, stay quiet, or try to bargain for five more minutes, it can call back and try again.

Preview a call for free, anytime. Saving an alarm requires Awake Call Plus.

VOICES
Pick the tone that gets you out of bed:
• Gentle — Nova. A quiet voice that still will not hang up.
• Friendly — Jules. Warm, a little teasing, and hard to ignore.
• Coach — Vale. Short words. Feet on the floor.
• Drill Sergeant — Sgt. Voss. Firm and brief. You set the order.

The conversation stays on the line with you. There are no phone numbers and no carrier calls. Everything happens in the app.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set a time on a two-ring dial — minutes on the outer ring, hours on the inner ring.
• Choose a voice and a ringtone.
• When it is time, the alarm rings like a phone call.
• Talk naturally. You do not have to say a set phrase. If you are getting out of bed, it should understand you.
• If you are not up yet, it stays on the line, and it can call back until you are.

AWAKE CALL PLUS
Preview calls are free for everyone. A subscription is required to save an alarm.

• Monthly: $8.99 per month
• Yearly: $59.99 per year
• 7-day free trial on both plans
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
• The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings
• Restore Purchases is available in the app

Privacy Policy: https://awakecall.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://awakecall.com/terms
Support: https://awakecall.com/support

Awake Call is made by Raise Profits Inc.

name: Awakeframe: Living Art Frame
description:
Got a tablet asleep in a drawer?
Awakeframe turns it into a living art frame for your wall.

■ Living artworks
· Not a frame that just plays videos. Many works are computed on the tablet as they play, so no scene ever repeats.
· Tap and light blooms where your finger lands. Tilt the device and the flow follows.
· Brightness and colors change with the time of day.
· Video works made by artists can hang alongside them.

■ Control it from your phone
· On the tablet, choose “Use this device as a frame”. On your phone, choose “Control another frame”. Pair with a 6-digit code.
· Change the artwork, brightness, night brightness and sleep schedule right from your phone.
· Touch the frame from across the room with the touch pad and the artwork responds.
· Several frames? Organize them by room — living room, study and more.

■ Color controls
· Original · Mono · Warm · Cool · Sepia · Vivid · Soft
· Fine-tune warm ↔ cool, saturation, contrast and grayscale to suit your room.

■ Just one tablet is enough
· Hang free artworks right away, no account needed.
· Long-press the frame for the menu — brightness, color, sleep schedule and browsing.

■ Own artworks or subscribe
· Own the works you love with coins and hang them on any of your frames, as often as you like.
· Subscribe to swap in new artworks every month (first 7 days free).
· Cancel anytime in your store settings. Artworks you own stay yours.

Quality adapts to your device so even older tablets run smoothly.

Subscriptions (Basic · Plus · Unlimited) are billed monthly to your App Store account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. New subscribers get the first 7 days free. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://awakeframe.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://awakeframe.com/privacy/

name: Ayah: Daily Quran Reader
description:
Ayah is a calm, focused way to read the Quran, one ayah at a time.

Read straight through in canonical order (Al-Faatiha to An-Naas), or jump to any surah or ayah with search. Every verse shows the Arabic text alongside a clear English translation (M. M. Pickthall, 1930, public domain) so the meaning is never a guess. Tap any verse to study it in context and write a private note.

Keep the ayat that move you for later, adjust the text size to however you like to read, and share a verse with the system share sheet whenever you want to pass it on.

Ayah works fully offline. There is no account, no sign-in, and nothing is ever uploaded: kept verses and notes stay on this phone. The Arabic text and transliteration are from the Tanzil Project (CC BY 3.0).

name: Azalt: Sigara Azaltma Koçu
description:
