Sigarayı birden bırakmak çoğu kişi için işe yaramaz. Azalt, sigarayı adım adım azaltman için tasarlandı.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
• Belirlediğin saatler arasında, belirli aralıklarla (ör. saatte bir) yeni bir hak kazanırsın.
• Kullanmadığın haklar gün içinde birikir, gece yarısı sıfırlanır.
• İçtiğinde tek dokunuşla kaydedersin; uygulamayı açmadan, bildirimden bile.
• Hakkın yokken içmek istersen Azalt seni durdurur ve isteğin geçmesi için birkaç öneri sunar.

KADEMELİ AZALTMA PLANI (PRO)
Haklar arasındaki süre her hafta kendiliğinden uzar. Örneğin saatte birden başlayıp her hafta 10 dakika eklersen, birkaç ay içinde günlük sınırın yarıya iner. Hızı ve hedefi sen seçersin.

İLERLEMENİ GÖR
• Bugün kaç hak kazandın, kaçını kullandın, kaçı birikti
• Günlük grafik ve ortalamalar (Pro ile 30 ve 90 günlük geçmiş)

GİZLİLİK ÖNCELİKLİ
• Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok.
• Tüm verilerin yalnızca telefonunda kalır.

AZALT PRO
Tek seferlik ödeme, abonelik yok:
• Kademeli azaltma planı
• 30 ve 90 günlük geçmiş

Azalt tıbbi bir tedavi değildir. Sigarayı bırakma konusunda bir sağlık uzmanından destek almanı öneririz.

name: AzProLift
description:
AzProLift — приложение для жителей домов с системой доступа к лифту AzProLift. Учётную запись создаёт управляющая компания (MTK); вы входите по номеру телефона и паролю.

Что можно делать в приложении:

• Вызывать лифт с телефона — лифт открывается на ваш этаж, даже если карты нет с собой.
• Давать гостям код — гость вводит код на считывателе лифта, и лифт едет только на ваш этаж. Код срабатывает один раз и истекает по окончании выбранного срока.
• Впускать гостя удалённо — если гость уже в лифте, вы открываете свой этаж одним касанием.
• Оплаты — долг, история платежей и напоминания.
• Объявления управляющей компании — вода, свет, ремонт.
• Заявки мастеру — сантехник, электрик и другие работы, со статусом заявки.
• Экстренная помощь, если застряли в лифте — сигнал управляющей компании и охране одной кнопкой.
• История поездок — когда использовались ваша карта и приложение.

Для кого: для жителей домов, где установлена система AzProLift. Если в вашем доме системы нет, войти не получится — обратитесь в управляющую компанию.

Конфиденциальность: приложение не использует геолокацию, камеру, фото и контакты. Удалить учётную запись можно в приложении: Настройки → Удалить аккаунт.

name: Bag by Bag
description:
Six bags, seven slots. Which bag will you open first? Each bag empties into the tray at once. Three matching pieces clear together. A single leftover heart can make the next bag fit, or leave you staring at a full tray.

Play 150 levels across six chapters. Read each seal, free pieces from the ice and plan around the bags underneath. Later boards put up to nine bags within reach. Match multiple triples in one opening to build a higher score. Finish a level without helpers to earn all three stars.

Tweezers pull one piece through a blocked bag. Extra Space sets one piece aside. Undo takes you back one move. You can play the campaign offline. Go online to try the daily bag or enter the world ranking with an alias and an optional country flag.

Includes English and Spanish, reduced motion and separate music and sound settings. Offers optional one-time purchases.

name: BaizstaufSax
description:
BaizstaufSax helps you pick dinner without the endless "what do you want?" debate.

Build a pantry of up to 12 meals, spin the wheel, and lock in a choice when you are ready. Wheel colors match your lineup below the disc. Meals you committed to in the last 48 hours stay on the wheel but get a smaller slice — fairer rotation, not a ban.

• Spin tab — weighted wheel, "Give it a whirl," verdict overlay  
• Pantry — edit list, swipe to delete, capacity up to 12  
• Meal history — entries only after you tap Let's eat  
• Reset — clears pantry, history, and wheel position; starters return  

Everything stays on your iPhone. No account. No tracking.

name: Ballast Bench
description:
Ballast Bench is a dive-weight workbench for iPhone. It proposes a starting weight from your suit, tank, and water, walks you through an in-water check, and records the kilograms you actually wore so the next check begins from that number.

How it works
1. Set the conditions for this check: snorkel or scuba, salt or fresh water, exposure, cylinder, and the lead you already carry.
2. Read a starting weight, then choose lighter, standard, or heavier.
3. Check it in the water: load, surface, and a hold near five metres. Snorkel mode checks surface buoyancy only, with a 2.0 kg cap.
4. Record what you wore and what happened. The next check starts from that entry.

Also included
• A gear list for suits, cylinders, lead, and BCD
• Reference tools for tank air, salt and fresh water, lead combinations, and eye level
• A local check log, with export and erase

Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account, no in-app purchase, and no advertising. Location is optional and is used only to display nearby water temperature and wind. It is not saved with a check and does not change the kilograms. An avatar photo, if you add one, remains on this device.

Ballast Bench gives you a starting point and a log. It is not a course, an instructor, or a buddy, and it does not decide whether you enter the water. It is not a dive computer and does not provide decompression, maximum operating depth, gas mix, or permission to dive.

name: BalloonXD
description:
BalloonX is a quick, colorful tapping game for everyone.
 
 Balloons rise from the bottom of the screen — pop them before they escape! Every balloon that gets away costs you a life. The more you pop, the faster they come.

 SPECIAL BALLOONS
  Gold — small and fast, worth 5 points
  Heart — win back a life
  Ice — freeze every balloon for 3 seconds
  Bomb — don't touch! Popping one costs a life
 
  FEATURES
  • Simple one-finger play — easy to learn, hard to master
  • Difficulty that ramps up as your score climbs
  • Your best score is saved so you can keep beating it
  • Satisfying pop sounds and haptic feedback
  • Pause anytime — the game pauses itself if you get a call
  • Sound on/off toggle
  • No ads, no tracking, no data collected
 
  How high can you score?

name: Bandroom: Hum to Song
description:
Make music with no experience needed.

HUM A TUNE, GET A SONG
Hum, whistle, sing, beatbox, clap or play an instrument. Bandroom hears every note, writes it down in the right key and builds a band around it: pop, chill, epic or dance.

GROW A LOOP INTO A FULL SONG
Pick one of 27 styles, from pop and hip-hop to house, jazz and film score, or start from a blank page. When your loop sounds good, Make it a song adds an intro, verses, choruses, a bridge and an ending.

NEVER STUCK
Every row of the grid is already in key, so it's hard to go wrong. After each note, Bandroom shows the notes that fit next and why: a smooth step, fits the chord, leads home. Tap Idea for a whole melody, chords, a bassline or a beat.

MAKE MUSIC TOGETHER
Invite friends with a link and build the same song at the same time, on iPad, iPhone or a computer. Sessions are end-to-end encrypted.

MASH UP YOUR SONGS
Mix two or more songs into a mashup or a DJ mix. On-device AI splits each song into vocals, drums, bass and music, then matches their tempo and key.

RECORD AND SHARE
Record your voice or an instrument over the band, choose a reverb room and balance the mix. Save as MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AIFF or MIDI to Files, or send a listen link.

Your songs and recordings stay on your device. Bandroom works offline, except Together.

name: BangGiaDatHCM
description:
BangGiaDatHCM hỗ trợ tra cứu bảng giá đất tại TP.HCM theo khu vực, phường / xã, tên đường và đoạn đường.

TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH
• Tìm kiếm theo tên đường hoặc đoạn đường.
• Lọc khu vực TP.HCM (cũ), Bình Dương (cũ), Bà Rịa – Vũng Tàu (cũ) và Khu công nghệ cao.
• Chọn phường / xã để xem danh sách các tuyến đường.
• Xem đơn giá theo các loại đất hiển thị trong ứng dụng: đất ở, thương mại dịch vụ và sản xuất kinh doanh.
• Xem chi tiết phạm vi từng đoạn đường và đơn giá tính theo đồng/m².
• Nhập diện tích để tính nhanh theo đơn giá đang hiển thị.
• Sao chép thông tin tra cứu để tiện sử dụng.

CÁCH SỬ DỤNG
Chọn khu vực và phường / xã hoặc nhập tên đường vào ô tìm kiếm. Chọn kết quả để xem chi tiết, sau đó nhập diện tích nếu cần tính nhanh.

LƯU Ý
Kết quả tính nhanh dựa trên đơn giá đang hiển thị và diện tích bạn nhập. Vui lòng đối chiếu nguồn dữ liệu và văn bản áp dụng trước khi sử dụng thông tin cho hồ sơ hoặc giao dịch.

NGUỒN DỮ LIỆU
Nghị quyết số 87/2025/NQ-HĐND ngày 26/12/2025 của Hội đồng nhân dân Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, ban hành quy định bảng giá đất lần đầu áp dụng từ ngày 01/01/2026 trên địa bàn Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.
Văn bản tham khảo trên Công báo TP.HCM: https://www.congbao.hochiminhcity.gov.vn/cong-bao/van-ban/nghi-quyet/so/87-2025-nq-hdnd/ngay/26-12-2025/48983?cbid=48995

name: Banyan School
description:
Introducing the brand new app for Banyan School.

    NEVER MISS AN EVENT
    The event section shows a list of events throughout the district.  Users can add an event to their calendar to share the event with friends and family with one tap.

    CUSTOMIZE NOTIFICATIONS
    Select your student's organization within the app and make sure you never miss a message.

    CAFETERIA MENUS
    Within the dining section, you'll find an easy to navigate, weekly menu, sorted by day and meal type.

    DISTRICT UPDATES
    In the Live Feed is where you'll find updates from the administration about what's going on in the district right now. Whether that's celebrating a student's success, or reminding you about an upcoming deadline.

    CONTACT STAFF & DEPARTMENTS
    Find relevant staff and department contacts under an easy-to-navigate directory.

name: Barcode Generator: QR Maker
description:
Make a barcode or a QR code in a few seconds, and know that it scans.

TEN KINDS OF CODE
QR Code, Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8, Code 39, ITF (and ITF-14), PDF417, Aztec and Data Matrix. Each kind says what it is used for and what it can hold, in plain words.

IT TELLS YOU WHAT IS WRONG
A product number with a digit too few, a letter that Code 39 does not have, a check digit that does not fit: the app says so, and says what would be right. Check digits of EAN, UPC and ITF-14 are added for you.

READ BACK ON THE SPOT
The picture of your code is read back by the iPhone's own barcode reader, and what it read is shown under the code.

QR CODES THAT DO SOMETHING
Fill in a form instead of typing strange text: a link, a Wi-Fi network with its password, a contact, an e-mail, a phone number, a message, a place on the map.

SAVE AND SHARE
Send the code as a picture, put it in Photos, and keep the codes you need again in a list, each with a name.

FREE
All ten kinds, the QR forms, pictures in black on white, and five codes kept.

BARCODE PRO: MANY CODES AT ONCE
Paste a list, one code a line with an optional name, and get a code for every line. Lines that cannot be made are named with the reason.

BARCODE PRO: LABEL SHEETS
The codes laid out on a sheet of labels as a PDF: Letter with 30, 10 or 80 labels, A4 with 24, 21 or 14. You see the first page before you print.

BARCODE PRO: SHARP AND IN YOUR COLOURS
A vector PDF of a single code that stays sharp at any size. Coloured bars on a coloured ground, with a warning when a scanner may not tell them apart. A picture in the middle of a QR code.

BARCODE PRO: EVERYTHING KEPT
As many saved codes as you like.

GOOD TO KNOW
The app draws the bars for the numbers you type. Product numbers (EAN and UPC) belong to whoever registered them; the app does not give out numbers. Before printing many labels, scan one with the device that will read them.

PRIVATE
The codes are made on your iPhone. Nothing you type leaves it, and there is no account.

Barcode Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/barcode-generator/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bas Bakalım: Bilgi ve Dikkat
description:
Ekranda tek bir buton var. Gerisi senin dikkatine bağlı!

Her soruda butona ne yapman gerektiği yazar: "Her köşe için bir kez bas", "Kırmızı ışık yanarken basılı tut, sönünce bırak", "Örümcek görürsen BASMA!"… Soruyu oku, düşün ve süre halkası bitmeden doğru cevabı ver. Bir hata ve yandın!

• Tek buton, sonsuz soru: 30 farklı soru türüyle binlerce farklı soru
• Şekil ve nokta sayma, matematik, bilgi soruları, renk tuzakları, kelime ve harf soruları
• Basılı tut, bırak, hiç basma: sadece saymak yetmez, zamanlama da önemli
• Sinsi tuzaklar: "Basarsan yanarsın", "Basmamazlık etme"…
• Her soruda süre kısalır, yeni soru türleri açılır
• Takma adınla sıralamaya katıl, en iyilerle yarış
• Reklam yok, hesap açmak yok, hemen oyna

Kaç soru dayanabilirsin? Bas bakalım!

name: Base Storm Defence
description:
Defend an outpost in a first-person action game where every round tests your aim and your preparations. Hold the line against advancing waves, then spend your earnings in the armory before the next round.

Build a three-slot loadout, upgrade individual weapons, and strengthen your perimeter with fences, turrets, and crew. Balance repairs against firepower as you push through the campaign.

Designed for landscape play with touch controls for movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and swapping weapons.

name: Basketball Card Scanner: Value
description:
Scan any basketball card and see what it's worth in seconds. Card Tracker identifies the player, year, set, card number and parallel with AI, then shows real eBay sold prices, live listings and its value in your card's condition or grade. Then track your collection and work out whether a rookie is worth grading.

Built for rookie collectors, slab investors, card flippers and box breakers.

— SCAN ANY CARD —

• Take up to 3 photos: the front, the back or a slab label
• AI card identifier finds the player, year, set, card number and parallel
• Spots rookie cards, numbered parallels, refractors, autographs, patches and case hits
• Works with raw cards and graded slabs (PSA, BGS, SGC, CGC)
• Modern chrome and prizm-style cards, inserts and vintage cardboard from the '80s and '90s
• NBA, WNBA and college basketball cards, plus sealed packs and boxes

— KNOW WHAT IT'S WORTH —

• Recent sold prices from eBay and Mercari
• Live eBay listings to compare asking prices
• Estimated value by condition, from Near Mint to Damaged, or by grade
• Every price is labeled with its source, so you know where it came from
• Where to sell and what you'd keep after fees: eBay, COMC or a local card shop
• Check local listings on Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Kijiji, Gumtree, Vinted and more

— TRACK YOUR COLLECTION —

• Your portfolio's value with a chart that updates every day
• Refresh every price in one tap
• See which cards moved the most
• Watch cards you want and set price alerts that notify you
• Price history for each card
• See values in your currency (21 currencies)
• Free iCloud backup

— COLLECTOR TOOLS —

• Should I Grade It? Compare raw and graded prices with realistic grade odds, grading fees and shipping, and see your expected return
• Centering Tool: measure left/right and top/bottom centering from a photo and see the best grade it allows. Card edges are found automatically
• Deal Calculator for card shows: set your buy, trade and sell percentages, add both sides of the deal, show the other collector the total and save it to your inventory

— TRACK YOUR FLIPS —

• Log what you paid, where you bought it and what it sold for
• Profit and ROI for every card and any time range
• Export your inventory and yearly sales to CSV

— PRIVATE BY DESIGN —

No account needed. Your collection stays on your iPhone. Photos are only sent to identify a card after you agree, and they aren't stored.

— HOW IT WORKS —

Snap your card → AI identifies it → See sold prices and value → Add it to your collection

Start with 3 free scans. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited scans:
• Yearly, with a 3-day free trial. We'll remind you the day before it ends
• Weekly

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Prices are estimates for information only and can vary by condition and market. Card Tracker is an independent app and isn't affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the NBA, WNBA, NBPA, any team or card manufacturer, eBay, COMC, PSA, BGS, SGC or CGC. Player names, team names and brands are trademarks of their respective owners.

Terms of Use: https://basketballcardtracker.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://basketballcardtracker.com/privacy/

name: Basta: Stop & Tutti Frutti
description:
The categories game families have played for generations, now with a phone in the middle of the table. Everyone grabs paper and a pen; Basta draws the letter, runs the clock and keeps score.

This is not an online word game. Everyone writes their answers on paper, and the people at the table judge them.

HOW IT PLAYS
• The phone draws a letter: M
• Everyone writes a name, a country, an animal, a color… that starts with M
• First one done taps ¡BASTA! and everyone stops writing
• Read your answers aloud: unique 100, repeated 50, none 0
• After the last letter, the most points wins

THE TABLE DECIDES
No dictionary rejecting good answers. Not sure "Mango" is a color? Tap the raised hand and the table votes. A tie keeps the answer.

YOUR GAME, YOUR WAY
• 2 to 12 players
• 5 to 12 categories per round, shuffled for you
• A 1 to 3 minute clock, or none
• A buzzer when time is up, so nobody has to watch the clock
• 10 more seconds after ¡Basta! to finish your word
• 3, 5 or 8 rounds, or play until you stop
• Hard letters (K, Q, W, X, Y, Z) on or off

• The whole game is free with the Classic pack
• In English and Spanish
• No ads, no lives, no subscription, no account, no data collected
• Basta Pro is a one-time purchase

BASTA PRO (one-time purchase)
• 5 more category packs: Family & kids, Food & drink, Movies, TV & music, Mexico & Latin America, Brands & more
• Your own categories
• Scoring your way: 10 / 5 / 0, or double points for the only answer in a category

name: BatchCrest
description:
Choose a batch of self-defined jobs within a whole-minute budget with BatchCrest. Enter each job’s estimated duration, your own value points and its maximum repeat count, then inspect exactly what is selected and left out.

A TRANSPARENT SELECTION RULE
The exact calculation maximizes your points, then minimizes used minutes, then prefers the larger count at the first differing candidate in saved order. Every candidate remains visible, including zero selections, with chosen, maximum and unselected counts plus time and point contributions.

COMPARE TWO BUDGETS
Run both budgets against one immutable candidate revision. See both complete selections and changes in points, minutes and counts. Applying a comparison budget to the plan is a separate, explicit action.

REUSE JOB DEFINITIONS
Keep reusable estimates in Catalog and copy selected jobs into a plan. The copies are independent: later Catalog edits do not rewrite your plan or a frozen report. Edit and reorder candidates, then recompute when a result becomes stale.

FREEZE COMPLETE REPORTS
Save a batch or comparison snapshot independently of the plan. Generate real paginated PDF tables, full CSV, report JSON and editable plan JSON. Preview or share the actual files. Import BatchCrest schema 1 plan JSON as a new plan with new identities and preserved order; report JSON is a separate format.

TRY THE CONTENT DESK SAMPLE
Explicitly load the built-in sample. A 120-minute budget selects two short-clip edits and one caption for 22 points; 90 minutes gives 16 points and 60 minutes gives 12 points. Sample creation is an explicit action.

LIMITS AND SCOPE
Budgets are 0–1440 whole minutes; each copy takes 1–1440 minutes and 1–1,000,000 points, with maximum count 0–99. Up to 64 candidates per plan, 100 plans, 300 Catalog definitions and 150 reports share a 128 MiB owned-payload allowance. Editable plan imports are limited to 512 KiB.

A result is a composition of jobs, not a chronological schedule. Points and durations are your estimates, not money, quality ratings or completion guarantees. The app does not model dependencies, deadlines, setup time, multitasking or team assignments, and does not write calendars or time execution.

name: Bazza Parceiros
description:
Bazza Parceiros é o app das lojas que vendem no Bazza, o app de entregas de Moçambique: restaurantes, mercearias, farmácias, padarias, lojas de roupa e muito mais.

Com o app podes:
• Receber os pedidos com som e notificação, mesmo com o telemóvel bloqueado
• Aceitar ou recusar pedidos e avisar quando estão prontos
• Editar o menu, os preços, as fotos e o stock de cada produto
• Abrir e fechar a loja, fazer pausas e mudar o horário
• Ver as vendas do dia, da semana e do mês
• Ler as avaliações dos clientes e responder-lhes
• Conversar com o cliente e com o motorista sobre cada pedido
• Juntar a equipa da loja, cada pessoa com as suas permissões

Para usar o app, a tua loja tem de estar registada e aprovada no Bazza. Regista-te em bazzamz.com/parceiros.

Precisas de ajuda? Fala connosco pelo WhatsApp 84 033 5994 ou por geral@bazzamz.com.

name: Beadio: Fuse Bead Pattern
description:
Turn any photo into a printable fuse-bead pattern right on your iPhone. Beadio matches your image to real bead color palettes compatible with popular fuse bead brands, splits it into pegboards, and tells you exactly how many beads of each color you need.

PHOTO TO BEAD PATTERN IN SECONDS
Pick a photo from your library or start from a blank pegboard. Crop your image, choose your pegboard layout (1×1 29×29, 2×2, 2×3, or a custom size), set how many colors to use, and Beadio builds your pattern instantly.

BUILT FOR REAL CRAFTERS
• Perceptual Color Matching: Uses CIELAB color distance so skin tones, outlines, and details look right with real fuse beads.
• Full Pattern Editor: Zoom and pan with pegboard dividers, paint single beads, flood fill regions, erase empty holes, and swap one color across the whole pattern.
• Instant Shopping List: See the exact bead count, color name, and code for every color used, ready to copy or share before you shop.
• Board-by-Board Printable PDFs: Export a multi-page PDF with a full overview and individual numbered pegboard pages, ready to print and place under your pegboard.

100% OFFLINE & PRIVATE
No account, no sign-up, no tracking, and no cloud uploads. Your photos and saved patterns stay strictly on your device.

FREE & PRO OPTIONS
• Free: Create 1×1 (29×29) patterns with up to 8 colors, full editing tools, shopping list, up to 3 saved patterns, and watermarked exports.
• Beadio Pro (Lifetime one-time unlock or yearly subscription): Unlimited saved patterns, multi-board (2×2, 2×3) and custom sizes, up to 40 colors, and exports without a watermark.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://qaswaapps.com/beadio/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://qaswaapps.com/beadio/privacy

name: Beat Line: Music Runner
description:
Put on your headphones, feel the pulse, and dive into Beat Line: Music Runner — a fast-paced 3D rhythm adventure where every tap, turn, and leap brings the music to life!
Guide your favorite animated 3D characters across breathtaking, ever-changing worlds that build and react dynamically around you to the beat of the soundtrack. Listen closely to the melody, trust your rhythm, and react with split-second precision as the track twists, climbs, and launches you into the sky.
KEY FEATURES:
• One-Touch Rhythm Gameplay
Simple to learn, thrilling to master! Tap right on the beat to make sharp 90-degree turns, leap over hazards, and soar through aerial sections in perfect sync with the music.
• 50+ Dynamic Stages & Reactive 3D Worlds
Race through vibrant low-poly and neon environments that transform in real time — from glowing cyberpunk cities, clockwork towers, and crystal caves to spooky forests, desert canyons, and stormy skies.
• Precision Timing & Combo System
Test your musical reflexes! Chain together Perfect and Good beat judgments to build massive combos, trigger dazzling visual effects, and earn 3-star ratings on every stage.
• Adorable Animated 3D Characters
Unlock and collect a charming cast of 3D runners — including the lightning-fast Roadrunner, White Bunny, Golden Pup, Orange Tabby, Penguin, White Duck, and their ultra-cute Chubby variants, each with custom animations and colorful glowing trails!
• Practice Mode & Checkpoints
Stuck on a fast tempo drop? Use checkpoints and Practice Mode to master tricky rhythm patterns at your own pace before going for a flawless full-stage clear.
• Audio Calibration & Haptic Feedback
Fine-tune audio sync delay in Settings for wireless headphones and feel every beat with crisp percussion sound effects and vibration feedback.
Put your reflexes and sense of rhythm to the ultimate test. Download Beat Line: Music Runner now and let the music guide your path!

name: Beatifу
description:
Beatify is a rhythm studio in your pocket. Create a beat, keep time, and learn how rhythm works.

Build a groove in the studio. Choose a style, lay down drums, then add guitar, keys, strings, brass, or synth. Every sound is made inside the app. Import a song from your library and mix it with your beat.

Practice with the metronome. Set the tempo, time signature, and subdivision, or tap the beat. Drag the dial to change the click tone.

Learn in the academy. Short lessons take you from the pulse to syncopation, swing, triplets, and odd meters. Your progress is real: a lesson counts only when you pass it.

Save your work, then export a WAV or MIDI file and share it.

Beatify works offline. Your projects, lessons, and recordings stay on your iPhone.

name: Becinig Stitch
description:
Becinig Stitch é uma aplicação que desenha moldes de costura ajustados às suas medidas.

Chega de tamanhos genéricos.

Os moldes comerciais são pensados para um corpo médio, que raramente corresponde a alguém em concreto. Quem costura em casa conhece bem o resultado: ombros descaídos, cavas apertadas, cinturas que nunca assentam bem. Com o Becinig Stitch, o ponto de partida é o seu corpo.

Tudo começa pelas medidas. Introduza os valores que tirou com uma fita métrica e a aplicação usa esses números para desenhar o molde. Cada medida que regista faz parte do resultado final.

Meça com calma. Uma medida tirada por cima de roupa larga, ou com a fita torcida, fica registada tal como foi lida, e o molde segue esse valor. Vale a pena medir duas vezes e apontar cada número antes de o introduzir.

Com as medidas registadas, a aplicação gera um molde ajustado às suas proporções. O resultado parte do seu corpo e não de uma tabela de tamanhos, por isso deixa de ter de adivinhar onde a peça vai ficar justa ou larga.

Depois de gerado, o molde pode seguir por dois caminhos. O primeiro é a impressão: imprima em papel, recorte as peças e junte-as como faria com um molde tradicional. Antes de recortar, confirme a escala da impressão, porque uma pequena diferença no papel pode alterar o ajuste final.

O segundo é a projeção sobre o tecido. O molde é projetado diretamente sobre o pano, com os contornos bem visíveis para os marcar. Sem folhas para colar nem papel a ocupar a mesa de corte. Ideal para tecidos delicados, que não toleram marcas repetidas, e para quem prefere poupar o tempo que se perde a colar folhas.

Esta aplicação é para quem costura em casa. Para quem já sabe coser e está cansado de corrigir moldes genéricos à custa de alfinetes e fita métrica.

O objetivo é só um: transformar as suas medidas em moldes que lhe servem, prontos a imprimir ou a projetar sobre o tecido.

Se o ajuste sempre foi o problema, comece pelas medidas. O molde trata do resto.

name: Bedtime Heroes : 3D
description:
When the lights go out, the nightmares come out. Bedtime Heroes is a one-thumb action game: move to dodge, stop to shoot, and clear every toy room of sock monsters, dust bunnies and shadow cats.

- Twenty chapters across five Houses, from the Bedroom to the Kitchen, each ending in a big boss.
- Pick a new power at every level-up: bouncing shots, freeze, lightning, spinning tops and 30 more.
- Four heroes to unlock: Captain, Twinkle, Bolt and Nova, each with their own attack.
- Toy Gear: blasters, pajamas, nightcaps and 3D plush buddies that fight beside you, in sets with bonuses.
- Daily Challenge, Stardust Cave, Sewing Room, Toy Tower, Dream Rush, the Long Night and the Arena.
- Online rankings by world, country and state.

Free to play, with optional purchases and optional reward videos.

Premium is a monthly auto-renewing subscription: no ads and a double daily gift. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://bedtimeheroes.divinersgroup.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bekobod Plus: Hamkor
description:
Bekobod Plus Hamkor — Bekobod Plus Market orqali sotadigan Bekoboddagi restoran, kafe va do‘konlar uchun ilova.

Buyurtmalar
• Yangi buyurtma darhol keladi — baland ovozli signal bilan
• Buyurtmani bir bosishda qabul qiling yoki rad eting
• Buyurtma tayyor bo‘lganini belgilang — Bekobod Plus kuryeri olib ketib, mijozga yetkazadi
• Buyurtma tarkibi, summasi, mijoz izohi va yetkazish holati ko‘rinib turadi

Menyu
• Taom va mahsulotlarni rasmi, narxi va tavsifi bilan qo‘shing
• Tugagan mahsulotni belgilang — mijozlar uni buyurtma qila olmaydi
• Narxlarni bir zumda o‘zgartiring

Do‘kon
• Ish vaqti va band bo‘lganingizda buyurtma qabul qilishni to‘xtatib turish
• Logotip, muqova, manzil va telefon raqami
• Stol va vitrinalar uchun do‘koningizning QR kodi
• Telefonni tekshirish: buyurtmani o‘tkazib yubormaslik uchun qaysi sozlamani yoqish kerakligini ilova o‘zi ko‘rsatadi

Qanday hamkor bo‘lish mumkin
Arizani to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ilovadan yuboring — Bekobod Plus administratori siz bilan bog‘lanadi, do‘koningizni ulaydi va login hamda parol beradi.

Yetkazishni Bekobod Plus kuryerlari bajaradi — o‘z kuryeringiz kerak emas.

name: Bell Clip
description:
Bell Clip is a desk-side tool for an elementary or middle-school teacher. Before the bell, write the period, the handout, the number of desks, and the number of sheets. Seat the brass clip on the stack. The phone then says whether the sheets are even with the desks, short, or extra.

Even means the two counts match. Short is desks minus sheets. Extra is sheets minus desks. One loose period sits on the tray. After the clip is seated, that period stays in Clips on this iPhone.

Bell Clip does not collect children's names, grades, attendance, or diagnoses. It is not an app for children. It does not connect to a network, an account, or a school system. Nothing leaves the phone.

name: Bellissima Pizza Castor ave pa
description:
Bellissima Pizza is a neighborhood pizzeria at 7816 Castor Ave in Northeast Philadelphia. Every pie is hand tossed and baked fresh, and we use only beef and turkey products. Order ahead for pickup or get it delivered from our kitchen.

ORDER IN A FEW TAPS
• Browse the full menu with photos and prices
• Search any dish, category or special
• Pick your size and toppings
• Pickup, delivery or dine-in, now or scheduled for later
• Secure online checkout

PIZZA, BAKED FRESH
• Plain pizza, white pizza, tomato pie, upside down pizza and Margherita
• 25 gourmet pizzas: Philly Cheesesteak, Buffalo Chicken, BBQ Chicken, Meat Lovers, Supreme and our house Bellissima Pizza
• Brazilian Corner: Chicken Catupiry, Portuguese and Moda da Casa pizzas
• Stuffed pizza, strombolis and calzones

PHILLY FAVORITES
• 10 oz. sirloin cheesesteaks, pizza steaks and chicken cheesesteaks
• Hoagies, grinders, paninis, wraps, quesadillas and clubs
• Homemade Black Angus burgers and gyros
• Famous Buffalo wings, boneless wings and chicken fingers
• Seafood platters, pasta, fresh salads and loaded fries

SPECIALS THAT SAVE
• Everyday specials with pizzas, wings, fries and a 2 liter soda
• Lunch specials Monday to Friday, 11am to 3pm

CATERING
Pizza, wings, hoagies, pasta and salads for parties, offices, churches and schools. Churches and schools get 10% off catering.

LIVE ORDER UPDATES
Follow your order from the kitchen to pickup or to your door, and reorder your favorites in seconds.

Open Monday to Thursday 11am to 11pm, Friday and Saturday 11am to midnight, Sunday 12pm to 11pm.

Bellissima Pizza
7816 Castor Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19152
(215) 745-8676

name: Belora
description:
Belora is a set of eight bells on your phone. Tap a bell and it rings. You see what you play. You hear what you play. No account.

HOW TO USE IT

Four tabs sit at the bottom: Yard, Play, Pieces, Book.

YARD
This is home. You see today's piece, the Tower, and the bell colors. Tap the three bells at the top to hear them. Tap today's piece to play it. Tap Tower for the memory trials.

PLAY
Ring freely. Choose a scale — Major, Minor, or Pentatonic — and Long ring or Short ring. Tap the eight bells however you like.
To keep a phrase: tap Record, play, tap Stop. Then Hear the take to listen, Keep to save it with a name, or Discard take to throw it away.

PIECES
Eight written pieces for eight bells. Open one. Listen to hear it. Play to perform it. When the circle closes on a bell, strike that bell at the same moment. You get a percent at the end. Again retries. Back returns.

BOOK
Recordings and patterns stay on this device only. Open a recording to listen, rename, or delete it.
New pattern opens an 8×16 grid. Light a square — each column is one moment. Set Tempo, tap Play, then Keep and give it a name.

TOWER
Open Tower from Yard. Tap Listen, hear the row, then play it back on the same bells. A wrong note starts the row over. Twelve trials. As you clear them, new enamel colors unlock. Pick a color on Yard.

Everything stays on the device. No account. No cloud.

name: Bendly: Conduit Bending Calc
description:
Bendly gives you the marks for every bend on the straight stick — before you bend.

Built on centerline-radius geometry, not just multipliers, so big conduit and big angles come out right.

BENDS
• Offset (with parallel conduit marks)
• Stub-up 90° and back-to-back 90°
• 3-point and 4-point saddles
• Rolling offset (true offset and roll angle)
• Kick
• Segmented (large-radius) 90°
• Multi-bend stick: stub, offsets, saddles and an end 90 on one piece, shrink added for you

ON THE JOB
• Big glove-friendly keypad with 1/16" fractions and feet
• Red / orange warnings when a bend is impossible or tight
• NEC 360° total-degree check
• Picture of the bent conduit and the straight stick with every mark
• Step-by-step instructions for each bend
• Hands-free protractor that vibrates at your target angle
• Save jobs and share a PDF bend sheet

YOUR BENDER
• Hand bender, one-shot (NEC minimum radius) and multiplier method built in
• Make your own bender with your radius and deduct
• Calibrate from a test 90: Bendly works out the real deduct and radius

Inches (fractions or decimal), feet-inches, mm or cm. English, Español, Tiếng Việt. Works offline, no account, no tracking.

Pay once — every feature, forever. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.

Always check marks against your bender and local code before bending.

name: Benito: Baby Tracker
description:
Benito is a baby tracker for the newborn months: feeds, sleep and diapers, logged in one or two taps and shared with everyone who looks after your baby.

It has no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no analytics. There is no company cloud. Your baby's log stays on your iPhone, or on a small server your family runs itself.

LOG IN A TAP
• Nursing timer with left and right sides, pause and resume
• Bottles with ounces, breast milk or formula
• Diapers: wet, dirty or both
• Sleep and naps, by timer or entered afterwards
• Pumping, medicine, walks, car rides and crying
• Fix mistakes: edit or delete any entry, or log one at an earlier time

SEE THE DAY AT A GLANCE
• Home shows time since the last feed and diaper, and whether your baby is asleep
• Day and week timelines
• Daily totals for feeds, ounces, diapers and sleep, ready for the pediatrician
• Running timers on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in the Apple Watch Smart Stack
• Siri and Shortcuts: start a feed, start a nap, log a diaper

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
• Every phone sees the same timeline, and timers started on one phone run on the others
• Invite a partner, grandparent or babysitter by Messages, AirDrop, QR code or SharePlay
• No usernames or passwords for family: each iPhone gets its own key, kept in the Secure Enclave
• Caregiver invites can end after a few hours or days
• Sharing uses the Benito server, a small open-source program you run on a Mac, a Raspberry Pi, a NAS or a VPS. Setup guide: https://benito.mikeroysoft.com/self-host/

OR USE IT ON ONE IPHONE
Choose "This iPhone only" (or "This iPad only") and Benito works with no server and no account. Connect a server later and your history comes along.

YOUR DATA
• Data Not Collected: the developer receives nothing from the app
• Export everything as JSON or CSV at any time
• Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/mikeroysoft-org/benito-app

Benito is a logbook. It does not give medical advice. Ask your pediatrician about your baby's health.

name: Bento Drop
description:
That last dish won’t move. The cats are staring. Your finger is already swiping.

Bento Drop is the cozy Japanese food merge puzzle that turns “just one kitchen” into a full tip-chasing binge. Swipe the board, merge matching dishes up the sushi ladder, and feed adorable chef cats before the orders pile up. Clear kitchens across a 500-level road, survive boss stages, then jump into Endless when you want a pure high-score spiral.

WHY IT’S DANGEROUSLY ADDICTIVE
• Every merge feels like a tiny win—edamame to mochi to onigiri all the way to golden bento
• Cute chef cats wait for exact orders… and rain tips when you nail the serve
• Sticky board? Chopsticks. Total chaos? Shuffle. Bottom row disaster? Broom
• Order Swap and Tip Boost for clutch comebacks when the kitchen goes feral
• Soft kitchen vibes + haptics that make every merge feel delicious

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Level Road: 500 kitchens, chapter unlocks, and boss kitchens that actually wake you up
• Endless: no finish line—just score, tips, and “one more run” energy
• Daily login treats so coming back feels rewarding
• No account wall. No login. Open the app and cook cute immediately

HOW TO PLAY (30 SECONDS)
1) Swipe dishes around the board
2) Merge matches to climb the food ladder
3) Complete cat orders to earn tips and coins
4) Use tools when the kitchen gets sticky
5) Clear the level… then pretend you’re done (you’re not)

PERFECT IF YOU LOVE
Merge puzzles, cute cats, sushi aesthetics, chill-but-clever gameplay, and the classic “okay last kitchen” lie.

OPTIONAL BOOSTS
Coins and tool packs are available if you want to speed up the fun. Restore Purchases anytime. This launch build is IAP-focused with ads off—pure puzzle comfort.

FROM DELICIOUS GAME DEVELOPERS
A Delicious Holdings LLC kitchen. Soft lights. Hungry cats. One more merge.

WHY DOWNLOAD RIGHT NOW
You get a complete cozy loop on day one: a tutorial that actually teaches, tools that feel fair, progression that keeps unlocking new kitchen energy, and cats that somehow make almost-losing weirdly charming. Whether you’ve got two minutes in line or twenty on the couch, Bento Drop fits the pocket and refuses to leave your brain.

THE FOOD LADDER FANTASY
Start tiny. Merge smarter. Watch dishes evolve into something ridiculous and beautiful. There’s a special kind of dopamine in watching a messy board suddenly click into a perfect serve—especially when a chef cat tips you like you saved dinner service.

BOSS KITCHENS & ENDLESS
Boss stages raise the pressure without killing the cozy vibe. Endless mode is for the nights you want numbers going up and boards getting meaner. Chase tips. Stack coins. Beat yesterday-you.

STILL READING? GOOD.
That means you’re exactly the kind of player who will open Bento Drop “for a second” and look up an hour later surrounded by imaginary sushi.

DOWNLOAD WARNING
If soft lights, sushi merges, and chef cats sound harmless, that’s the trap. Bento Drop is built for the “one more kitchen” spiral: satisfying merges, tip-hungry cats, boss kitchens that spike the tension, and Endless mode for late-night score chasing.

Cook cute. Merge smart. Feed the cats. Then feed them again. Then tell your friends you “only played for a minute.”

MORE OF THE FANTASY
Keep climbing the ladder. Keep plating for cats who somehow have stronger opinions than most food critics. Keep chasing that golden bento glow. The kitchen is warm, the cats are cute, and the next merge is already calling your name.

READY?
Download Bento Drop and open the first kitchen. The orders are up. The cats are waiting. Your swipe hand knows what to do.

FINAL NOTE FROM THE KITCHEN
We built Bento Drop for players who want cozy vibes without empty busywork—short sessions that still feel smart, long sessions that still feel soft, and a food fantasy that looks good enough to screenshot. If you make it past kitchen one without smiling at a cat, we’ll be shocked.

More kitchens. More cats. More merges. Don’t say nobody warned you.

name: Berberim – Berber Randevusu
description:
Berberim ile berberinizden birkaç dokunuşta randevu alırsınız; berberler ve salon sahipleri aynı uygulamada günün takvimini yönetir.

MÜŞTERİLER İÇİN
• Salonu seçin; hizmetler, süreler ve fiyatlar tek sayfada.
• Saç, sakal, ikisi birden, çocuk tıraşı… Birden çok hizmet seçin, süre ve tutar kendiliğinden hesaplansın.
• Berberinizi seçin ya da “fark etmez” deyin; o saatte boş olan berber atanır.
• Yalnız gerçekten boş saatleri görürsünüz.
• Onay, değişiklik ve iptalde bildirim; randevudan bir saat önce hatırlatma.
• Randevularım: yaklaşan randevular, tek dokunuşla iptal, geçmişten “tekrar al”.

MAKAM KULLANICILARINA
Makam şoför hizmeti kullanıyorsanız hesabınızı Makam’ın kendi izin sayfasından bir kez bağlayın. “Aracım beni götürsün” seçildiğinde o günkü Makam programınıza göre yolculuğa uyan saatler işaretlenir ve en az ek yol getiren üçü önerilir. Berber onaylayınca randevunuz Makam programınıza “Berber” durağı olarak eklenir; taşınır ya da iptal edilirse durak da güncellenir.

BERBERLER VE SALON SAHİPLERİ İÇİN
• Günlük takvim; onay bekleyenler en üstte.
• Onayla, geldi, tamamlandı, gelmedi, taşı.
• Telefonla gelen müşteri için elle randevu.
• Öğle arası ve izin için blok saat.
• Salon sahibi: hizmetler ve fiyatlar, berberler ve giriş hesapları, çalışma saatleri, tatil günleri, otomatik onay, gün sonu ciro özeti.

Uygulama ve randevu ücretsizdir; hizmet ücretini salonda ödersiniz. Konum, kişi listesi, kamera ya da mikrofon izni istemez. Hesabınızı uygulama içinden istediğiniz an silebilirsiniz.

name: Besharam: 18+ Desi Charades
description:
Besharam is desi charades for adults. Leave the sanskaar at home.

One person holds the phone sideways on their forehead. Everyone else acts out the card, no talking allowed. Guessed it? Tilt the phone down for सही (sahi). Stuck? Tilt it up to pass. Beat the clock, then hand the phone on.

ADULTS ONLY
This game is for people 18 and over. It has adult humour, innuendo, drinking jokes and cheeky situations that the kids' table should not see. The app asks you to confirm your age the first time you open it.

ACTED DECKS FOR THE GROWN-UPS' TABLE
• Baraat dance floors and wedding chaos
• Raat Ki Baat: sneaking around and getting caught
• Ghar Waale: hiding your real life from the family
• Dating & Office: apps, appraisals and the office crush
• Gen Z Brain Rot: rizz, reels and poses the group chat knows
• Double Meaning Gaane: try the hook step first, hum if you must, no lyrics
• Besharam Mix shuffles them all together

YOU SET THE HEAT
A heat slider decides how spicy the cards get, starting from Halka (mild) and going up from there. Turn it up as the night goes on, or keep it gentle. A separate Kaala humour switch adds the darker decks, and it's off until you turn it on.

MAKE IT YOUR GAME
• Apna Deck: write your own cards for your own crowd
• Choose cards: switch off anything your group never wants to see
• Rounds of 30 seconds, 60 seconds, 90 seconds or 2 minutes
• Menus in English or Hindi
• A neon look made for dim rooms and late nights

PLAY WITH THE WHOLE GROUP
• Add players to keep score, with a leaderboard and a winner at the end
• Optional candid photos: the front camera snaps the actors mid-scene for a highlight reel when the game ends. Photos stay in the phone's memory and are gone when you close the app. It's off until you turn it on.
• Haptics on every answer, and the screen stays awake during a round

TILT OR TAP
Tilt down for sahi and up to pass. Prefer buttons? Turn off Tilt controls in Settings and tap Pass or सही on screen.

FREE, PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no sign-up. The game doesn't collect any data, and everything you save stays on your phone. It works with no internet.

House rule: laugh at the situation, never at a community, caste, religion or skin colour.

name: Better Knot Guide
description:
Naučte se vázat uzly krok za krokem a ověřte si, že jim opravdu rozumíte. Better Knot Guide vás provede praktickým učením na obrazovce, kde vybíráte správný konec lana, tvoříte smyčku, vedete lano kolem opory a utahujete hotový uzel. Každý krok je jasný, přehledný a navržený tak, aby odpovídal skutečnému vázání.

Hlavní funkce
- Knihovna více než 20 uzlů - od jednoduchého uzlu přes osmičku, buňku, přímý uzel, škotový uzel až po dva půlštiky a další praktické varianty
- Výuka podle kroků - každý uzel má jasný postup, správné pořadí a vizuální kontrolu výsledku
- Testování výsledku - procvičte si rozpoznání správného uzlu, chyby v propletení i další správný krok
- Výběr podle úkolu - rychle najděte uzel pro smyčku, spojení dvou konců, upevnění k oporě nebo zarážku
- Oblíbené a pokrok - ukládejte si uzly, vracejte se k nim a sledujte své studium i úspěšné prověrky
- Režim s nápovědou i bez nápovědy - trénujte bezpečně, nebo si zkuste vše pamatovat sami

Pro koho je aplikace ideální
- Pro začátečníky, kteří se chtějí naučit základní i užitečné uzly bez složité teorie
- Pro turisty, kutili, skauty, rybáře, jachtaře i všechny, kdo potřebují rychle najít správný uzel pro konkrétní situaci
- Pro každého, kdo chce trénovat paměť, přesnost a jistotu při práci s lanem

Proč si vybrat právě nás
Better Knot Guide spojuje praktický trénink, vizuální přehlednost a ověření znalostí v jedné aplikaci. Nepotřebujete internet, vše funguje lokálně, a svůj pokrok máte vždy po ruce. Díky krátkým krokům, jasným akcím a zpětné vazbě po každém pohybu se učíte rychleji a s větší jistotou.

Začněte hned teď a naučte se uzly, které opravdu využijete v praxi.

name: Better Lights: Light Mockups
description:
Better Lights is a sales tool for permanent and holiday lighting installers. Take a photo of a house, trace the roofline and show the homeowner their home lit up. Then send the quote before you leave the driveway.

TAKE A PHOTO, TRACE THE ROOFLINE
- Take a photo from the curb or use one you already have.
- Tap corner to corner along the edges you'd light, or trace with Apple Pencil on iPad. Freehand lines snap to the roof edge.
- The live preview updates as you draw, right on your device, at day, dusk or night.
- On-device scene depth keeps the light off the sky and the trees.

EVERY COLOR ON THE SAME HOUSE
- Warm and cool whites, colors and holiday themes like Christmas, Halloween and July 4th, or your own color.
- Singles or pairs, with your own spacing.
- Permanent LEDs, C9 bulbs or mini lights.

LINE COLORS ARE YOUR PRODUCTS
- Each line color is a product from your price list, with its own name and price per foot.
- Better Lights measures every run from the photo, counts the lights and keeps a running total.
- For exact numbers, enter one width you know, like the garage door, or type in your own measurements.
- Put a legend on the image so the homeowner sees what each line is and what it costs.

AI RENDERS
- Turn the same drawing into a realistic picture of the finished job.
- Pick a color or a holiday theme and dusk or night, and try several looks at once.
- AI renders use credits. Paid plans include credits every month, and credit packs work on any plan, including Free.

QUOTES
- Quote PDFs built from the drawing: your logo and contact details, the homeowner's name and address, a picture of the layout, a line for each product, the total and the deposit.
- Pick one of three layouts, add your own terms and set how long the price is good for.
- Letter or A4, any currency, feet or meters.
- Text or email the PDF on the spot.

SYNC AND TEAMS
- Sign in to keep your projects in sync between iPhone, iPad and the web.
- Your plan and AI credits belong to your account and work everywhere you sign in.
- On a Team, every rep works from the same price list, with company branding on every quote. Owners and admins manage the team.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO START
Draw, preview and make a basic quote without an account. Your projects stay on your device. A photo is only uploaded when you sync a project or make an AI render.

PLANS
- Free: the full editor and live preview, projects on your device and a basic quote. Exports carry a small watermark.
- Starter: sync, branded quotes with your logo, HD exports without a watermark and AI credits every month.
- Pro: everything in Starter, plus HDR and 4K exports, quote templates and deposits, and more AI credits.
- Max: everything in Pro, plus the most AI credits and a priority render queue.
- Team: for companies, set up by your company admin, with a shared price list, company branding, roles and AI credits for each rep.
- Credit packs: more AI renders on any plan. Purchased credits don't expire.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Starter, Pro and Max are auto-renewing subscriptions, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://betterlights.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://betterlights.app/privacy

name: BETTERDOG
description:
BETTERDOG brings expert-led, science-based dog training and behaviour education directly to your fingertips.

Developed by internationally recognised canine behaviour specialist Jo-Rosie Haffenden, BETTERDOG helps owners better understand their dogs, overcome everyday challenges and build stronger relationships.

Access structured training programmes, educational videos, practical exercises and step-by-step guidance covering puppy development, everyday training and behavioural challenges.

Learn at your own pace, access your enrolled courses and discover professional dog trainers through our trainer directory.

Better understanding. Better training. Better dogs.

name: Bible Bumper
description:
Bible Bumper sets the chapters of the Bible to song, so the Word stays with you on your drive, at work and with your family.

Open a book like an album and listen chapter by chapter, start to finish. Every chapter has its own original song, sung by bands across many genres: country, folk, soul, pop, hip hop, dance, reggae, worship and more, in English and Español. Choose your favorite band for a book, or mix them up. New books are added all the time.

SING ALONG WITH THE WORD
- Live lyrics that move with the music
- The Bible verse beside every line. Tap it to read the passage
- A short prayer to close each chapter

MAKE IT YOURS
- Heart the songs you love and build your own playlists
- Pick up where you left off on your phone, the web or your TV
- Shuffle, repeat, a sleep timer and a look at what's coming up
- English, Español or both

PRAY TOGETHER
- Share one prayer a day on the Prayer wall
- Pray for others and see who is praying with you

MEET THE CREATORS
- Follow the artists, pastors and creators behind the songs
- Watch their videos and shop their stores

Your first month is free. Then choose a monthly or yearly membership.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Your membership renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://biblebumper.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://biblebumper.app/privacy

name: Bikbik Curier
description:
Bikbik Curier is made for pizzerias, restaurants and courier firms that deliver by motorbike or scooter.

FOR THE DISPATCHER OR THE SHOP
• Add an order in seconds and send it to a rider on shift
• See every rider on the live map, with how long ago each position came in
• Get an alert at once if a rider falls or asks for help, with the exact place
• Message your riders from the app

FOR THE RIDER
• New orders arrive as a notification and are read out loud
• The next pick-up or drop-off is always on top, with turn-by-turn navigation
• Say "picked up" or "delivered" without touching the phone
• Proof of delivery with a photo; time and place are saved automatically
• Fall detection: if you don't answer "Are you OK?" within 30 seconds, your dispatcher is alerted

PRIVACY
Location is used only while you are on shift. When you end the shift, tracking stops. Delivery photos are deleted after 6 months. No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.

Alerts go to your company's dispatcher only, not to emergency services.

Bikbik Curier is made in Ireland by Pyramid Business Express Ltd.

name: BİLSEM ATLASI
description:
BİLSEM ATLASI, BİLSEM tanılama sürecine hazırlanan 1, 2 ve 3. sınıf öğrencileri ve velileri için hazırlanmış bir çalışma uygulamasıdır. Çocuğunuz sınavda karşılaşabileceği soru türleriyle tek tek pratik yapar, süreli denemelerle sınav gününe alışır, yanlışlarını adım adım çözümlerle öğrenir. Bağımsız bir hazırlık uygulamasıdır; MEB ya da BİLSEM ile resmî bir bağı yoktur.

Her konunun ilk testi ücretsizdir.

• 8.000'den fazla soru, sürekli genişleyen soru kütüphanesi
• Gerçek sınav süresinde, 45 dakikalık deneme sınavları
• Adım adım ve videolu soru çözümleri, konu anlatım videoları

SORU TÜRLERİ
Örüntü, matris, küp açınımı, kâğıt katlama, simetri, döndürme, şifreleme, eksik parça, analoji, sıralama, gruplama, eş ve zıt anlamlı sözcükler ve daha fazlası.

HAFIZA VE DİKKAT
• Görsel hafıza ve sayısal hafıza görevleri
• Sınavdaki gibi sesli sorular
• Parmakla yolu çizilen labirentler
• Kelime Eşleştirme: süreye karşı kelime çiftleri
• Sözlü Kartlar ve genel kültür alıştırmaları

TESTLER VE DENEMELER
• Her soru türü için süreli konu testleri
• Sınav düzeninde, 45 dakikalık deneme sınavları
• Kendini Dene: tüm konulardan rastgele 5, 10, 20, 30 ya da 40 soru
• Denemeleri cihaza indirip internet olmadan çözme (Plus)

ÇÖZÜMLER VE YANLIŞ DEFTERİ
• Çözümler adım adım canlanır; oynat, durdur, ileri-geri sar
• Videolu soru çözümleri ve konu anlatımları
• Yanlış yapılan sorular Yanlış Defteri'ne kendiliğinden düşer, istediğiniz an yeniden çözülür
• Soru ekranında çocuğunuzun seçtiği hayvan koçtan ipucu (Plus)

ARKADAŞLA DÜELLO
Plus üyesi 5 ya da 10 soruluk bir düello kurar, kodu arkadaşıyla paylaşır. Kodu alan herkes ücretsiz katılır; iki taraf aynı soruları çözer, sonuçları karşılaştırır.

İLERLEME VE MOTİVASYON
• Soru türlerine göre başarı oranı
• Günlük hedef ve çalışma serisi
• Haftanın Yıldızları sıralaması

VELİLER İÇİN
• BİLSEM Hakkında: sınav ve kabul süreci rehberi
• Profilde sınav tarihleri ve isteğe bağlı veli PIN kilidi
• 6-8 yaş için okunaklı, sade arayüz
• Uygulamada reklam yoktur
• iPhone ve iPad'de çalışır

BİLSEM PLUS
Ücretsiz sürümde adım adım çözümler, ilerleme ve Yanlış Defteri açıktır. BİLSEM Plus aboneliği şunları açar:
• Bütün konu testleri ve deneme sınavları
• Denemeleri cihaza indirip çevrimdışı çözme
• Çalışma Koçu: zayıf konulara göre günlük kişisel plan ve aralıklı tekrar
• Hayvan koçtan soru ekranında ipucu
• Mülakat hazırlıkta bütün testler (sayısal hafıza, görsel hafıza, genel kültür) ve labirentler
• Kendini Dene ile rastgele soru setleri
• Arkadaşla Düello kurma

ABONELİK BİLGİSİ
BİLSEM Plus aylık, 3 aylık, 6 aylık ve 12 aylık otomatik yenilenen abonelik seçenekleriyle sunulur. 3, 6 ve 12 aylık paketlerde 7 gün ücretsiz deneme vardır; deneme bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse paket ücreti deneme bitiminde alınır. Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Kimliği hesabınızdan alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse aynı süre için otomatik olarak yenilenir ve yenileme ücreti dönem bitmeden önceki 24 saat içinde hesabınızdan alınır. Aboneliğinizi App Store hesap ayarlarınızdan yönetebilir ya da iptal edebilirsiniz.

Hesap açmak için e-posta, Google ya da Apple ile giriş kullanılır. Kayıt sırasında veli onayı alınır. Hesabınızı ve verilerinizi uygulama içinden silebilirsiniz.

Gizlilik politikası: https://bilsem.atlasareltech.com/privacy.html
Kullanım koşulları: https://bilsem.atlasareltech.com/kullanim-kosullari.html

BİLSEM ATLASI bağımsız bir hazırlık uygulamasıdır. Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı ya da Bilim ve Sanat Merkezleri ile bir bağı yoktur; sınavla ilgili resmî bilgi için MEB duyurularını takip edin.

name: Biodiversa
description: Biodiversa is a working reading room for the Biodiversity Heritage Library: search rare natural-history literature by species, author, subject or year, then open digitised volumes, plates and OCR text. Star the titles you need, file them into collections, annotate pages, compare editions and keep page lists offline for the field. Everything you write stays on your device; catalogue records are requested from BHL only when you search or refresh a title.

name: BirdFrame: Telephoto Finder
description:
With a long telephoto lens, the hard part is often not focusing. It is finding the subject. At 400mm, 600mm or 800mm the view is so narrow that one hop along a branch, or one aircraft crossing overhead, leaves you looking at empty sky.

BirdFrame turns your iPhone into a finder for your telephoto lens. Fix the phone to your camera's hot shoe or your lens's tripod foot. The screen shows the phone's wide view, with a yellow frame marking exactly what your long lens covers right now. Find the subject in the wide view, bring it inside the frame, then look through the camera. It is there.

Not only for birds. Aircraft, wildlife, motorsport, sailing, the moon: if you shoot with a long lens and the subject is hard to find, BirdFrame helps.

FEATURES

• Telephoto frame
The frame is calculated from your lens's focal length and drawn over the live view, with a larger guide frame around it. Everything inside the yellow line is in your shot.

• Built-in lens list
57 popular telephoto lenses from Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, OM System, Panasonic, Sigma and Tamron. Pick yours and the focal length menu shows only what it covers. If your lens is not listed, type any focal length from 50mm to 3000mm.

• Teleconverters and sensor formats
1.25x, 1.4x and 2x teleconverters. Full frame, APS-C 1.5x, APS-C 1.6x and Micro Four Thirds. The effective focal length is worked out for you.

• Guided calibration
The first time you open the app, it walks you through calibration: aim at a distant target, drag the frame onto it, then check against a second target. Calibrate once and it stays. You can fine-tune position and size by hand at any time.

• Magnifier
A small window shows the inside of the frame enlarged, so you can confirm the subject. Drag it wherever it is out of the way.

• 1x / 1.5x / 2x preview
Enlarge the preview when the subject is far away. The frame scales with it.

• Made for one hand
The phone is on the camera, one hand holds the rig and the other taps the screen. Every button is large, and the bottom controls fold away with one tap to clear the view.

• Maximum brightness
One switch takes the screen to full brightness for sunlight, and your own brightness comes back when you leave the app.

• Standby
One tap stops the camera and dims the screen to save power while you wait. One tap brings it back.

• Far focus
Autofocus favours distant subjects.

PRICE

Free for 14 days with every feature included. Nothing is charged when the trial ends. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks BirdFrame for good. No subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW

• You need a phone holder that fits your camera's hot shoe or your lens's tripod foot. It is sold separately.
• Calibrate on a target at least 50 m away. The farther the subject, the more exact the frame. For subjects within about 20 m it shifts slightly.
• BirdFrame only helps you aim. It does not take or save photos or video.

PRIVACY

The image is shown live on your phone and nowhere else. Nothing is uploaded or saved. BirdFrame needs no account and collects no data. It goes online only to ask the App Store about your trial and purchase, and works without a connection the rest of the time.

Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese. Landscape only.

name: BitlineVoice
description:
BitlineVoice is Bitline's own calling app. When a customer taps "Call us" on bitline.io, the phones of the available Bitline team members ring. The first person to answer takes the call.

On iPhone, calls ring on the iPhone's own call screen, even when the phone is locked or the app is closed.

FEATURES
•  Incoming calls on the iPhone's call screen, with Answer and Decline, also on the lock screen
•  See the customer's name, number and topic in the app when they share them
•  Clear voice calls, with no phone numbers needed
•  Available, Away and your working hours
•  Call-backs, call notes and call history
•  Earpiece, speaker, headsets and Bluetooth
•  Test my phone: a test ring from our server shows that your iPhone will ring

FOR THE BITLINE TEAM
For Bitline staff only. Your Bitline administrator invites you; sign in with your work email and password. There is no sign-up in the app.

PRIVACY
Live voice only: calls are never recorded. No ads, no tracking.

name: Bitrado Menyala
description:
Nusantara is fading in Bitrado. Only culture that is truly practiced can light it up again.

Explore the regions of Indonesia with Rino and Rika and play their cultural actions one by one. Every action you finish brings colour back to that place.

CULTURAL ACTIONS
There are 18 playable cultural actions, and seven of them are scored by AI models running on your device. For example:
• Ucap: say a greeting in the local language while on-device AI listens and scores your pronunciation.
• Tulis: write your name in a Nusantara script on paper and the camera reads it on your device.
• Batik: trace hot wax with a canting along the pattern, dye the cloth, and remove the wax until your batik is done.
• Wayang: perform the Punakawan on the screen in time with the gamelan.
• Tabuh: each phone becomes one instrument, so play together and keep the rhythm.
• Singgah: assemble a traditional house in its customary order, then bring it into your room at full size with AR.
• Knot a noken bag, weave Tidore cloth, cook Ternate dishes, share irrigation water like the Balinese subak, watch shadows vanish when the sun is overhead in Pontianak, and more.

SAKSI NUSANTARA
Explore 21 digital twins of heritage sites, including Borobudur Temple, the Equator Monument, and Jam Gadang, then place them on your table with AR. Every part carries a certainty label (Measured, Source based reconstruction, or Hypothesis) so reconstruction is never read as fact.

KITAB NUSANTARA
Collect 154 culture cards with 366 traceable references. Cards still waiting for review by local experts carry a Needs verification label.

CULTURE GLOW MAP
See which traditions are being practiced again across Indonesia. Every recorded event is anonymous, with no account or device attached.

PLAY TOGETHER
Add friends, play as a pair across islands, or form a group to travel together.

PRIVACY
You can start playing right away as a guest with no account. Sign in with Apple, Google, or email only if you want to sync progress across devices and play with friends. Camera and audio are processed on your device and never sent to a server. You can delete your account at any time from inside the app.

FROM 2021 TO 2026
Bitrado was born at ITS Surabaya in 2021 as a 3D Android game. Bitrado Menyala is its 2026 iteration, built with web technology plus AI, computer vision, and AR, continuing the concept, characters, and design of the 2021 version.

Figures as of 25 November 2026, with details at bitrado.id/angka.

name: BiWar Tanks
description:
Tank battles in a neon maze. Team up with a bot ally, outsmart your rivals in the fog of war and blast them before they find you.

ONLINE BATTLES
• 2 vs 2 or 1 vs 1 against real players, matched by tank power for fair fights
• No one around? You still get a match within a minute
• Back in the fight after a call or if the app closes – your match keeps going

CAMPAIGN
• 50 stages across 5 sectors, each with its own drone swarm
• Drive through mazes or hold the line in turret defense stages
• Bosses that summon escorts and charge your tank
• Earn up to 3 stars on every stage

AETERNUM – ENDLESS MODE
• Beat the campaign to unlock it
• Waves of hundreds of drones, tougher every time, with a boss every five waves
• After each wave choose 1 of 3 bonuses: attack speed, critical hits, split fire, explosive shells, mines and more
• Build a new combo every run and chase your best wave on every stage

BUILD YOUR TANK
• 4 tanks: Light, Heavy, Sniper and Assault
• Upgrade health, fire rate, firepower, speed and vision
• Over 80 parts: rocket pods, rear lasers, miniguns, plasma cannons, EMP, radar, armor plating, repair drones and more
• Upgrade your standard cannon through 50 levels with a new perk every 10

TACTICS
• Fog of war: you only see what your tank sees
• Power-ups: shields, rapid fire, speed, radar, homing missiles, mines
• 8 map styles, or build your own maps and share them with a code
• Play the best player-made maps from the Top Maps list

MORE
• Practice against bots at three difficulty levels
• Daily tasks with gold rewards
• Match history and stats

name: BKTK International
description:
BKTK International — Votre grossiste alimentaire professionnel et vos factures dans votre poche.

Conçue pour les restaurateurs, traiteurs, épiceries et professionnels de l’alimentation en Île-de-France et partout en France, l’application BKTK International centralise vos commandes en gros et demi-gros, vos tarifs HT et vos documents comptables dans une interface rapide et claire.

VOS FACTURES ET VOTRE COMPTE PRO DANS VOTRE POCHE
• Ouvrez votre compte professionnel avec votre numéro SIRET (validation sous 48 h ouvrées ou immédiate par téléphone).
• Accédez à vos prix pro HT dédiés et tarifs dégressifs au sac, au carton ou à la palette.
• Retrouvez vos factures, avoirs, commandes passées et produits consultés récemment à tout moment.
• Recommandez votre dernière commande ligne par ligne ou ajoutez des articles par référence, nom ou code EAN.

CATALOGUE COMPLET EN STOCK DIRECT
Parcourez plus de 161 références réparties sur 14 rayons et 42 marques (Alishaan, TRS, Anju, Humza, boissons, huiles, épices, farines, légumineuses, produits laitiers, emballages et hygiène) :
• Filtres professionnels par rayon, disponibilité en stock, poids (de moins d’1 kg à 20 kg et plus), conditionnement (sac, sachet, carton, boîte, bouteille, canette, bidon, pack, vrac) et marque.
• Tri instantané par pertinence, nouveautés, ordre alphabétique ou taille de format.

VUE 3D ET COMPARATEUR À L’ÉCHELLE RÉELLE
• Inspectez vos produits phares — dont le riz basmati indien Alishaan Superba 1121 extra-long — en vue 3D interactive à 360°.
• Comparez les formats (200 g, 5 kg, 10 kg, 20 kg) à l’échelle réelle avec leurs dimensions exactes avant de commander.
• Profitez d’un échantillon de 200 g offert sur votre première commande de riz Alishaan.

ASSISTANT IA BAI & SUPPORT DIRECT
• Besoin d’un renseignement, d’un format spécifique ou d’un devis ? Demandez à BAI, votre assistant intégré, ou échangez directement sur WhatsApp.
• Une équipe joignable au 01 41 50 62 71 et par e-mail sur contact@bktkintl.fr.

7 LANGUES & MODE CLAIR / SOMBRE
• Interface complète disponible en français, anglais, espagnol, japonais, hindi, népalais et chinois simplifié.
• Affichage adaptable en mode Clair, Sombre ou synchronisé avec votre appareil.

LIVRAISON ÎLE-DE-FRANCE & RETRAIT AU BOURGET (93)
• Livraison standard offerte en Île-de-France dès 199,99 € TTC (en moyenne le lendemain) et livraison express sous 2 jours ouvrés.
• Expédition partout en France.
• Retrait gratuit sans minimum au dépôt : 2 Rue Jean Moulin, ZI Le Vaillant, Local C3B, 93350 Le Bourget (prêt en 2 h, −2 % avec paiement immédiat hors Alishaan).

name: blakeryan.co
description:
The members app for the blakeryan.co YouTube mentorship.

Everything from the portal, built for your phone:

- Message Blake, Luke and your coaches directly, with photos and voice notes
- Get a notification the moment someone replies, mentions you or posts an announcement
- Chat with the community and share your wins
- Watch every course module and pick up where you left off
- See your group calls, tools and announcements in one place

Members only: sign in with the Google account, Apple ID or email you joined with. There is no sign-up or purchase in the app; membership starts with an application on blakeryan.co.

name: BLC - Bom Lugar City
description:
BLC - Bom Lugar City é um jogo de vida real numa cidade do interior do Brasil, feita com base na cidade de verdade: as ruas, a praça, a prefeitura, os postos, o estádio e a entrada "Seja bem vindo".

DIRIJA E PERSONALIZE
- Carros, picapes e motos brasileiras para comprar e dirigir pela cidade.
- Oficina completa: pintura, rodas, suspensão, vidros e ronco.
- Som automotivo de verdade: monte o porta-malas, o paredão e a carretinha, e toque as suas músicas.

UMA CIDADE VIVA
- Trânsito, pedestres, dia e noite e postos para abastecer.
- Polícia na rua: blitz, abordagem e perseguição se você fugir.
- Acidentes chamam a viatura, com giroflex e sirene.

JOGUE ONLINE
- Encontre outros jogadores na cidade, mostre o seu carro e o seu som.
- Chat de texto e de voz com quem está perto (opcional).

Moedas podem ser ganhas jogando, assistindo vídeos opcionais ou compradas na loja do jogo.

Suporte: blcgames.suporte@gmail.com

name: Blind Simulator
description:
Welcome to the most honest simulator around.

Tap JUGAR (Play) and you see nothing. Move the joystick and footsteps play. Every step raises the counter. That is the game.

The app's interface is in Spanish: the buttons read JUGAR (Play) and RANKING (Leaderboard).

• A truly black screen
• Joystick with footstep sounds and haptics
• A minimap that only shows which way you are facing
• A button with a dog that barks
• Pause: continue or go back to the menu
• Accumulated-steps leaderboard with Game Center

No levels, no goals, no explanations. It is a joke, and the app knows it.

name: Blink: One Second a Day
description:
Imagine your whole year in one short film.

Blink makes it simple. Each day, pick one second from a video or Live Photo. Choosing it takes a moment. Your calendar fills up with the moments you want to keep.

At the end of the month, or the year, Blink joins your clips into one video. Press play and relive it.

START WITH TODAY
• Pick a video or Live Photo, or fill in a past day.
• Trim the best 1, 1.5 or 2 seconds. Zoom, move, rotate, mute, or switch between fill and fit.
• See every day on a monthly calendar.
• Compile a month, a year, or any range into one video, with an optional date on each day.
• Save it to your Photos.

KEEP THE HABIT
• A daily reminder that stays quiet if you already saved today.
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen shows your streak and nudges you on days without a clip. Fill in a missed day later and the streak comes back.

YOURS TO KEEP
• Your clips live in Blink's own folder in iCloud Drive. If iCloud is off, they stay on your iPhone and go away if you delete the app. They are plain video files that you can open without the app.
• No account. No ads. No tracking. Blink does not collect any data.
• Blink never changes or deletes anything in your Photos library. It only reads it, and saves your finished video.

FOR EVERYONE
• Works with VoiceOver and larger text.
• Light and dark appearance.
• English and Spanish.

Blink is free.

Your next year starts today. Open Blink and pick today's second.

Questions or ideas: contact@emlopezr.com

name: Block Combo: Puzzle Blast
seller_name: Hong Kong Chaorong Technology Co., Limited
description:
Block Combo: Puzzle Blast is a relaxing block puzzle game you can play offline, anytime, with no WiFi needed.

Drag colorful blocks onto the 8x8 board and fill complete rows or columns to clear them. Chain clears back to back to set off bigger combos, keep the board open, and push your best score higher.

Easy to learn, satisfying to master. Every move matters, and every combo feels better than the last.

FEATURES
- Classic 8x8 block puzzle with combo clearing
- Satisfying chain reactions when you clear several lines in a row
- Play offline, no WiFi or internet required
- Single player, play at your own pace
- Simple drag and drop controls
- Endless rounds and a personal best to beat
- Light install with smooth performance

HOW TO PLAY
1. Drag a block onto the board.
2. Fill a full row or column to clear it.
3. Clear several lines in a row for a bigger combo.
4. Keep space open for the pieces that are coming next.
5. Beat your best score.

WHY YOU WILL LIKE IT
No pressure, just you and the board. A quick round on the bus or a longer session at home both fit, because the rules take seconds to learn and the combos keep you coming back.

Download Block Combo: Puzzle Blast and start your first combo today.

name: Blockchain Life Conf
description:
Which talks do you want to catch at Blockchain Life in Dubai? What did you promise to send the person you met afterward? Keep both answers in one place with this independent attendee notebook for the December 1–2, 2026 forum.

Before a talk, browse the agenda by day, look up a speaker and save sessions to My Day. Compare overlapping sessions or set a local reminder for an upcoming talk. The bundled program is a dated snapshot. Event info links to the organizer for schedule updates, venue details and tickets.

During a session, tap Take a note to keep your question beside the talk. You can also start a blank note in Notebook. Search by a word in the title or body when you want to find an idea again. Removing a session from My Day keeps the note you wrote.

After a conversation, scan a QR contact card or enter a contact by hand. Record where you met and what you agreed to do. Mark the next step done when you follow up. Your own QR card shares only the public details you choose.

Your notes, agenda and contacts work offline without an account. You can export a personal backup from Settings. External links and ticket booking require internet access.

name: BlockCity: Puzzle Towns
description:
Place blocks, clear lines and build a whole town from what you collect.

Every line you complete can bring timber, stone or leaves. Use them to open the beach café, raise the pier and plant the garden. Finish a town and travel to the next one.

SIX TOWNS
• Seaside Square: palms, a pier and a little café
• Pine Village: a forest inn and a campfire square
• Snow Peak: a cocoa house and an ice rink
• Desert Oasis: a tea house and a bazaar
• Volcano Island: a hot spring and an observatory
• Cloud City: a windmill, a star garden and a balloon dock

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag three pieces onto an 8×8 board
• Fill a row or a column to clear it
• Collect resources and improve five buildings in each town
• Undo a move or use the hammer when you are stuck
• Puzzles get harder as you travel

TAKE YOUR TIME
• No timer
• 20 quests and daily goals
• Change the colours of your finished buildings
• 21 languages
• Works offline

No ads, no purchases and no account. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Bloom Pop: Bubble Shooter
seller_name: ENEGAL TECH YAZILIM BILISIM DANISMANLIK SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Aim, pop and bloom! Bloom Pop is a relaxing bubble shooter with 300 levels and a warm story.

Pull back the slingshot and let go: a soft pull curves your shot up, a strong one flies straight. Match three or more bubbles of one colour to pop them, drop whole clusters and keep your combo going to earn flame, paint and bomb balls.

13 WORLDS TO EXPLORE
Travel from Foam Lake through the Greenhouse, Riverside, Coral Reef, Funfair, Clockworks and more, all the way up to the Cloud Palace. Every world brings its own twist: flower pots, river currents, seal pups to rescue, balloons, spinning wheels, paint buckets, echo crystals, tumbleweeds, moss, penguins and butterflies.

A STORY TOLD IN PAINTED FILMS
Follow Ellie and Daniel across the pond. Daniel guides you through every new idea, and painted films with narration open, carry and close the journey.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Every level wears its own material: jelly, glass marbles, gems, felt, wood, paper and more
• Juicy pops, warm sounds and rich haptics
• A fair colour bag and a preview of your next two bubbles: skill beats luck
• Trophies for the hardest levels
• Classic endless mode: how long can you keep the board clear?

BLOOM POP PLUS
An optional subscription: unlimited lives, no ads between levels, second chances without watching a video and play without internet. Choose monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://enegalstudio.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://enegalstudio.com/privacy/

name: BloomWay: Water Puzzle
description:
BloomWay is a handcrafted botanical clay-tile irrigation puzzle game!

Rotate the water channels from the central spring to bring every flower to bloom. Watch the countdown timer — to earn 3 stars, you must connect 100% of the water paths on the board!

KEY FEATURES
• Fresh Layouts Every Run: Starting from Level 2, every playthrough generates a fresh, mathematically guaranteed 100% solvable irrigation network.
