• Self-Evolving Garden AI: Learns your play style, speed, and move efficiency — evolving new generations with Deep Frost, Counter-Twins, live garden gusts, and AI-synthesized obstacles with custom animations.
• 5 Tactical Skills & Cosmetics Shop: Equip Root Radar, Hint, Time Freeze, Time Rewind, and Flower Path; unlock emerald water, marble/terracotta/obsidian tiles, and lotus blossoms.
• 4 Languages & Cross-Device Save Transfer: Turkish, English, Chinese, and Russian.
• Ad-Free & Offline Friendly!

name: Blue Lock - Password Vault
description:
Blue Lock is a password vault that is easy enough for seniors to use.
Write down your complicated IDs and passwords here, and remember just one master password.

[Why you'll like it]
- Large text, simple screens: clear buttons make it easy even on the first try.
- Open with one master password: the vault only opens when you enter it.
- Save text and photos: keep IDs and passwords as text, and things like card backs or certificate notes as photos.
- Stays on your device: there is no server. Your data is encrypted, lives only on this phone, and is never sent anywhere.
- Move between devices: export the vault file and import it on a new phone.

[Please note]
If you forget your master password, the vault cannot be recovered. Neither the developer nor any server knows it. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe.
We also recommend exporting the vault file as a separate backup.

name: BoardBox
description:
BoardBox ist deine persönliche Bibliothek für Pinnwände und Links. Speichere TaskCards-Pinnwände und genauso andere Boards und Webseiten – etwa Padlet, Lernplattformen, Materialsammlungen oder Fortbildungsseiten – und finde alles mit einem Tipp wieder. Ein TaskCards-Konto brauchst du dafür nicht.

GEMACHT FÜR LEHRKRÄFTE
Links zu Pinnwänden kommen per Mail, Messenger, QR-Code oder aus Fortbildungen. BoardBox sammelt sie an einem Ort und ordnet sie so, wie du unterrichtest: nach Fächern, Klassen, Themen und Projekten.

SAMMELN
• Link einfügen, aus der Zwischenablage übernehmen oder QR-Code scannen
• Direkt aus Safari, Mail und anderen Apps über „Teilen → BoardBox“
• Erkennt TaskCards-Pinnwände und Organisationen automatisch
• Funktioniert auch für alle anderen Webadressen

ORGANISIEREN
• Farbige Ordner und Unterordner mit handgezeichneten Buntstift-Symbolen
• Eigene Bilder für Ordner und Pinnwände
• Schlagwörter, Favoriten und persönliche Notizen
• Intelligente Sammlungen: zuletzt geöffnet, häufig genutzt, ohne Ordner und eigene Regeln
• Sortieren per Ziehen, Kachel- oder Listenansicht

WIEDERFINDEN
• Schnelle Suche über Titel, Notizen, Schlagwörter und Ordner
• Ein Tipp öffnet das Board im Browser
• Widget für den Home-Bildschirm, Siri-Kurzbefehle und Spotlight-Suche

SICHER UND PRIVAT
• App-Sperre mit 4-stelligem Code, Face ID oder Touch ID
• Optionale Pinnwand-Passwörter, sicher im Schlüsselbund
• Abgleich über deine private iCloud zwischen iPhone, iPad und Mac
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking – der Entwickler erhält keine Daten
• Sicherung und Import als Datei, kompatibel mit der BoardBox-Webapp

BoardBox ist ein unabhängiges Werkzeug und keine offizielle App von TaskCards.

name: Boardkeeper
description:
¿Quién va ganando? ¿Cuántos puntos llevaba cada uno? ¿Dónde está el papel de la última partida?

BoardKeeper es la forma más sencilla de llevar la cuenta de tus juegos de mesa. Olvídate del lápiz, las hojas perdidas y las discusiones por los puntos: tú juega, que BoardKeeper apunta.

ANOTA TUS PARTIDAS EN SEGUNDOS
• Crea una partida, añade a los jugadores y empieza a sumar puntos.
• Funciona con cualquier juego: de cartas, de tablero, de dados o de rol.
• Suma y resta puntos ronda a ronda, sin errores de cálculo.

TODO TU HISTORIAL EN UN SOLO LUGAR
• Consulta las partidas anteriores cuando quieras.
• Descubre quién gana más, cuál es tu juego favorito y quién tiene el récord.
• Revive tus mejores victorias (y las derrotas más dolorosas).

PENSADA PARA LA MESA
• Diseño claro y fácil de leer, incluso con poca luz.
• Rápida de usar: menos tiempo con el móvil y más tiempo jugando.
• Ideal para noches de juegos con amigos, en familia o en tu club.

Tanto si juegas una partida rápida de cartas como una campaña de varias horas, BoardKeeper lleva la cuenta para que tú solo tengas que pensar en ganar.

Descarga BoardKeeper y que empiece la parti

name: Boil Boss: Crawfish Calculator
description:
Set a cup on the table for everyone coming. The pounds you need show up spelled out in crawfish.
Pay once. No account, no ads, no subscription.

HOW MUCH TO BUY
• Crawfish by how your crowd eats: light, regular or big eaters, and less for kids
• Potatoes, corn, sausage, onions, lemons, garlic, seasoning and ice, all counted for you
• Sacks as a range, since no two sacks weigh the same
• Tap each thing as it goes in the bag, or send the whole list to whoever's shopping

THE POT
• Pick your pot, 40 to 120 quarts, and see how many batches it takes and how many pounds go in each

THE BOIL, STEP BY STEP
• Season the water, then potatoes and onions, then crawfish and sausage
• The boil clock doesn't start till the water is rolling again
• An alert at the end of each timed step, so you can be out with your guests
• Ice and corn at the end, then a taste test: soak five more, or dump it

THE SPLIT
• Type what you spent and see what each person owes, to the penny

WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM
Pounds per person, sides and times come from published recipes and guides, and the app lists them. Every cook does it a little different, so taste as you go.

Crawfish boils only. What you enter stays on your iPhone.

name: Boltique: Screw Puzzle
description:
Tap a screw and watch it spin out of its plate and fly into the box of its colour. Fill a box with three screws and it closes. When a plate loses its last screw, it drops away and shows what was hiding underneath.

Sounds simple. Then the boxes come in a set order, screws without a box wait in a small tray, and the plates are stacked in layers. Pick the wrong screw and the tray fills up. Pick the right one and the whole board falls apart in a satisfying cascade.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 300 levels, every one solved by our checker before it ships
- 15 workshops with their own materials: wood, brushed steel, ice, candy and more
- Hard and Super Hard levels that are clearly marked
- Three Boosters when you're stuck: Extra Slot, Undo and Clear Tray
- No timers: take each level at your own pace
- Replay any level you've finished
- Works offline
- Colour symbols on every screw for colour-blind players, and a reduced-motion setting

FREE TO PLAY
Boltique is free and supported by ads. Rewarded ads are always your choice. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off the ads between levels; coin packs and a Starter Pack are optional.

name: Bonbon Bash: Candy Match 3
description:
Swap sweets, craft bombs and beat the clock! Bonbon Bash is a bright, fast match-3 puzzle where every level is a 60-second dash for the score target, ending in fireworks.

EASY TO LEARN
Swipe one sweet next to another and line up three of a kind. Cascades keep popping on their own, and every chain scores more than the last.

BOMBS, BLASTS AND RAINBOWS
Match four or more to craft boosters: row and column blasts, bombs and rainbow gems. Set one off next to another and watch the board light up.

SUGAR RUSH
Fill the Rush meter and every sweet scores double for a few sparkling seconds. Perfect for one big comeback.

THREE HELPFUL TOOLS
Smash a stubborn sweet with the Hammer, mix up the board with Shuffle, or buy yourself 10 more seconds. You collect coins as you play, so the tools are always within reach.

THE SWEET ROAD
The levels never run out, and each one asks for a bit more than the last: bigger scores and, from level 2, a sweet to collect. Replay any level on the map to win three stars.

FRESH EVERY LEVEL
A new sunny sky for every level, a cast of cheerful, smiling sweets, and juicy sounds and effects that make every match feel good.

A GIFT EVERY DAY
Open the game daily for a gift. Keep the streak going and the seventh day pays the most.

YOUR WAY
Music, sound effects and vibration each have their own switch in Settings.

FREE TO PLAY
Everything in Bonbon Bash can be reached for free. Optional purchases at fixed prices (four coin packs and a one-time Starter pack) let you stock up on tools faster; what you see is what you get, no random loot.

SWEET PASS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Sweet Pass is an optional monthly subscription: the daily gift is doubled, every continue costs 30% less and the more-games window stays away. The price is shown in the game before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bonbonbash.278labs.co.uk/privacy/

name: Bookify: Randevu Yönetimi
description:
Bookify, güzellik salonları, kuaförler, berberler, klinikler, spa merkezleri ve randevu ile çalışan tüm işletmeler için geliştirilmiş modern randevu ve müşteri yönetimi uygulamasıdır.

İşletme sahipleri, şube yöneticileri, personel ve müşteriler için rol bazlı özel deneyimler sunar.

İŞLETME SAHİPLERİ VE YÖNETİCİLER İÇİN
• Anlık Takvim & Randevu Yönetimi: Günlük, haftalık ve aylık randevuları tek ekrandan görüntüleyin, onaylayın veya düzenleyin.
• Çoklu Şube Desteği: Birden fazla şubenizi tek hesaptan anlık olarak takip edin.
• Gelir & Performans Raporları: Ciro, ortalama sepet, hizmet dağılımı ve ekip verimliliğini inceleyin; raporları PDF veya Excel (CSV) olarak paylaşın.
• Müşteri & Sadakat Yönetimi: Danışan geçmişi, seans notları, öncesi/sonrası fotoğraflar ve sadakat puanlarını takip edin.
• QR Kod ile Hızlı Check-In: Müşteri randevularını kamera ile saniyeler içinde doğrulayın.
• Ekip ve Yetki Kontrolü: Personel programlarını ve erişim izinlerini kolayca yönetin.

PERSONEL İÇİN
• Size atanan günlük randevuları anlık takip edin.
• Randevu durumlarını güncelleyin ve müşteri notlarına hızla ulaşın.
• Anlık bildirimlerle yeni randevu ve değişikliklerden haberdar olun.

MÜŞTERİLER İÇİN
• Saniyeler içinde online randevu oluşturun ve yaklaşan randevularınızı takip edin.
• Geçmiş hizmetlerinizi, puanlarınızı ve bakım önerilerinizi görüntüleyin.
• Randevu hatırlatma bildirimleriyle hiçbir seansı kaçırmayın.

GÜVENLİK VE GİZLİLİK
• Tüm veri iletişimi HTTPS/TLS ile şifrelenir.
• Face ID / biyometrik giriş desteği ile hesabınız güvende kalır.
• KVKK uyumlu veri yönetimi ve uygulama içi anında hesap silme desteği sunar.

Sorularınız için: destek@bookify.com.tr

name: Bookoosh
description:
Bookoosh is the staff app for leisure venues that take their bookings with Bookoosh. It puts your whole Bookoosh dashboard on your phone, so you can run the day from the front desk, out on the floor or on the move.

This app is for venue owners and their team. It is not for booking a visit. To book an activity, use the venue's own booking page or website.

What you can do

• See today's bookings and takings the moment you open the app
• Check customers in as they arrive, by name or booking reference, or scan the QR code on their confirmation
• Take payments at the till with your Bookoosh card reader and sell to walk-ups
• Get an alert on your phone as soon as a new booking comes in, and switch it off on your own phone whenever you like
• Change a booking, move it to another time or add a note without going back to the office
• Look up a customer, their past visits and their signed waivers
• Keep your activities, prices, opening hours, memberships and vouchers up to date
• Check your revenue, payouts and reports for the day, the week or the month

It is the same Bookoosh account you use on your computer, so everything stays in step. A change made on the phone shows up straight away for the rest of the team.

You need a Bookoosh venue account to sign in. Venue owners can set one up at bookoosh.com and invite their staff from Settings. Each person signs in with their own email and password and sees what their role allows.

Need a hand? Visit bookoosh.com/help or email hello@bookoosh.com.

name: Bootsführerschein See & Binnen
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zur Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes, zu den Prüfungsausschüssen oder zu einer anderen Behörde.

Mit Bootsführerschein See & Binnen bereitest du dich auf die theoretische Prüfung für den Sportbootführerschein See und den Sportbootführerschein Binnen vor. Jede Prüfungsfrage hat vier Antworten, genau eine ist richtig. Beim SBF See beantwortest du 39 Fragen in 60 Minuten, dazu gehört eine Navigationsaufgabe. Beide amtlichen Fragenkataloge umfassen je 300 Fragen.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Basiswissen für See und Binnen
- Schifffahrtsrecht und Vorfahrtsregeln
- Lichterführung, Schallsignale und Sichtzeichen
- Navigation und die Kartenaufgabe
- Wetterkunde und Seemannschaft
- Sicherheit an Bord

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Sportbootführerschein See (SBF See)
- Sportbootführerschein Binnen (SBF Binnen)

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Boot und Verkehr

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zum Sportbootführerschein in dieser App:
- Generaldirektion Wasserstraßen und Schifffahrt (ELWIS), Sportbootführerscheine: https://www.elwis.de/DE/Sportschifffahrt/Sportbootfuehrerscheine/Sportbootfuehrerscheine-node.html
- ELWIS, Fragenkatalog Sportbootführerschein See: https://www.elwis.de/DE/Sportschifffahrt/Sportbootfuehrerscheine/Fragenkatalog-See/Fragenkatalog-See-node.html
- ELWIS, Fragenkatalog Sportbootführerschein Binnen: https://www.elwis.de/DE/Sportschifffahrt/Sportbootfuehrerscheine/Fragenkatalog-Binnen/Fragenkatalog-Binnen-node.html
- ELWIS, Bewertungsschlüssel der theoretischen Prüfung: https://www.elwis.de/DE/Sportschifffahrt/Sportbootfuehrerscheine/Bewertungsschluessel/Bewertungsschluessel-node.html
- Sportbootführerscheinverordnung: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/spfv/BJNR101610017.html

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Bootstrap Greek Grammar
description:
How do you introduce yourself in Greek? Start with εγώ είμαι (I am). Hear it in the sentence “I’m a student”, then try introducing yourself. By the final lesson you’ll be writing to a friend, from the opening Γεια σου Μαρία (Hi Maria) to thanking her for a present.

Bootstrap Greek Grammar takes you there in 250 short, ordered lessons for English speakers. Each topic explains one point, lets you hear it in several sentences and gives you a chance to use it yourself. Try the first 10 topics free, with the audio and exercises included.

Start with a sentence you can use
The second lesson turns the conversation towards the person you’re talking to with εσύ είσαι (you are). Learn when the verb ending tells you enough to leave out “I” or “you”. Then turn a statement into a question. The early lessons take time over details that can surprise an English speaker, such as choosing between ο, η and το where English uses “the”.

Hear what changes, and why
All 3,844 example sentences come with Greek audio, an English meaning and a reading in Latin letters. If the alphabet is still new to you, listen first, follow the reading, then try the Greek again. Tap to replay a sentence or slow it down to catch a stressed syllable. The notes explain details you might otherwise miss. Take the name Νίκος (Nikos). Call out “Nikos, where are you?” and it becomes Νίκο. That final s drops away because you’re speaking directly to him. Next time you hear someone call his name, listen for the difference.

Build it yourself
Put word tiles in order to build a sentence. Choose the missing word, or type the form a sentence needs using the built-in Greek keyboard, accents included. When a grammar choice trips you up, tap “Why?” to see the reason. Then try the sentence again while the explanation is fresh.

Say more as you go
Move from describing your morning to telling someone what you did yesterday or what you’ll do tomorrow. Use the genitive to say whose bag it is. Practise the past tense to tell a story, and use pronouns to keep it going without repeating everyone’s name. Along the way, you’ll ask how to get to the station, follow the answer and learn how to pass on what someone else said.

Keep the Greek that matters to you
Save useful examples to your personal Study List. Spaced repetition brings them back when they’re due for practice, so a sentence you understood last week gets another chance to stick.

The first 10 topics are ready to use offline as soon as you install the app. One in-app purchase unlocks the remaining 240 for life, with no subscription. The lessons, recordings and “Why?” explanations download automatically after purchase. Once downloaded, you can study offline on iPhone or iPad.

name: Boterm
description:
O Boterm no iPhone acompanha o Boterm do seu Mac, o terminal para equipes de agentes de IA como Codex, Claude e Gemini. Saia da mesa sem perder o fio do trabalho.

• Veja todas as sessões abertas, por projeto, e quais estão trabalhando ou esperando.
• "Precisa de você" junta num só lugar os pedidos de confirmação dos agentes e as aprovações do Mensageiro.
• Abra um terminal para ler a tela e responder com Enter, Esc, setas, y/n ou números.
• Envie texto ou dite uma mensagem. O texto fica no campo para você revisar antes de enviar.
• Receba notificações quando um agente precisar de você. As notificações não levam o conteúdo dos terminais.

Segurança
• A conexão só acontece pelo QR code que o seu Mac mostra, válido por 3 minutos e de uso único. O Mac e o iPhone mostram o mesmo código de 6 dígitos, e você confirma no Mac.
• Cada celular tem as suas próprias chaves. Tudo vai cifrado de ponta a ponta entre o iPhone e o seu Mac; o relé no meio só repassa dados que não consegue ler.
• Face ID para abrir o app e antes de cada tecla, envio ou aprovação.
• Sem conta, sem anúncios e sem rastreamento.

Requer o Boterm 0.5.0 ou mais recente no Mac, gratuito e de código aberto. Sem um Mac conectado, toque em "Ver demonstração" para conhecer o app.

name: Bouldering.md
description:
Bouldering.md is the app of the Chisinau Bouldering Project, for the people who climb there.

ENTER WITH YOUR PHONE
Your personal QR code is one tap away: the yellow button in the middle of the bar. Show it at reception and you are in. It is drawn on your phone, so it works without signal, and it changes every minute so nobody can borrow it from a screenshot.

EVERY PROBLEM IN THE GYM
All the problems up right now, each with its circuit colour and grade range, the holds circled on its photo, and the setter's name. Search by name, colour or setter, filter what you have climbed, sort by grade, newest or most liked. Scan the QR sticker on a problem to open it.

LOG A CLIMB IN ONE TAP
Flash, top or attempt: one tap, undo for ten seconds. Say how a problem felt for its range, like it, leave a note for the setter.

YOUR PROGRESS, WITHOUT PRESSURE
Your sessions, your colour pyramid, your hardest top and flash, personal records, your visit history. A weekly rhythm that forgives a missed week, with no streak to lose.

TROPHIES AND BOARDS
Milestones for visits, colours and exploring the gym, celebrated when you earn them. Season boards and the monthly challenge are opt-in: you choose whether to appear, and you are compared only with climbers at your level.

YOUR CARD
Your membership as a pass on the first screen: visits left and dates, certificates, offers and bonus days. Renew it, or ask for a freeze, in the app.

THE GYM IN YOUR POCKET
Home has the gym's map, phone, email and social channels, and your latest activity.

YOU DECIDE WHAT ARRIVES
News of new problems, your trophies and the monthly challenge are on from the start; offers by push only if you say yes. Switch any of it off in Profile > Notifications at any time. Messages about your own card always arrive.

FOR SETTERS
Add a problem from your phone: photograph it, pick its circuit, circle every hold, publish. Take one down, see your stats and the climbers' notes.

Sign in with your phone number (a code arrives by SMS) or with the code reception gives you. Languages: Русский, Română, English.

name: Box Brain: Moving Box Labels
description:
Which box has the kettle? Box Brain knows.

Moving is chaos. Box Brain turns it into a list you can search.

SNAP A BOX — Open the box, take one photo. Box Brain lists what's inside: "Electric kettle, 6 mugs, toaster…". Fix anything it got wrong in a tap. No more typing every item.

STICK A BIG LABEL ON IT — Every box gets a big number, a room band and a QR code. Print a sheet of labels or share them. The QR code holds only a random box id, never the contents.

FIND ANYTHING — Search "kettle" and see "Box 07 · Kitchen". At the new place, scan a box's QR code to see what's in it before you open it.

UNPACK MODE — On moving day, switch to unpack mode: tick boxes off as they arrive and items as you unpack them.

PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTION. — You move once, so you pay once. 5 AI scans are free. The Move Pass ($9.99, one time) covers 400 boxes — enough for a whole house. Need more? Top up 200 scans for $2.99.
Typing items in, labels, printing, search and backup are always free, with no box limit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up.
• Your box lists stay on your phone.
• Photos are sent only to list the items, then discarded — never stored on our servers and never used to train AI.
• Mark any box "Private" and it's never sent to AI at all.
• Export a backup file any time. Delete everything in one tap.

Made for people moving house in a hurry.

name: Boxing Career: Rise to Champ
description: Create your boxer and chase the undisputed title. Plan your training week and play drills, pick fights, scout opponents, and call tactics round by round while three judges score it. A living world keeps fighting without you: rivals rise, champions fall, promoters sign and drop fighters, and news breaks. Three save slots keep three careers apart. Every fighter and brand is fictional.

name: BoxLedger Moving List
description:
Know what is in each moving box with BoxLedger Moving List.

Give a box a unique number and a destination room. List its contents with quantities and notes. When you need something, search the item name or notes to find its box and room.

Keep a record of packed and unpacked boxes. Rooms groups your boxes by destination, and the unpacking queue lists boxes still to open. Marking a box unpacked keeps its contents available for reference.

• Manage up to 200 numbered boxes.
• Record up to 100 item entries per box.
• Edit quantities, rooms and notes without duplicating entries.
• Search contents and share a selected box list.

All box records are stored on this device. No account or camera access is required. Box numbers and items are entered manually; the app does not scan barcodes or provide delivery tracking.

name: BoxRise: AI Boxing Workout
description:
Your phone camera is your boxing coach. It calls the combos, counts every punch and tells you what to fix first.
No gym. No partner. Just your fists and a coach who never looks away.
Day 1: your first jab. Day 14: four-punch combos and a slip that makes them miss.

I HOLD THE PADS. YOU HIT THEM.
Your AI coach lights up the mitts and calls it: jab, cross, hook, uppercut. Land it on time: PERFECT. Build the streak, hit the multiplier, break your best. Pad work without a partner, any hour of the day.

HE THROWS. YOU SLIP.
Red side: get your head out of there. Green side: hit back. Fast, sweaty dodge drills that teach your head to move before you think.

SEVEN RIVALS. ONE OF YOU GOES DOWN.
First person, in the ring, crowd roaring. Slip his shot, break his guard, drop him. Get past The Rookie, Metronome, Iron Chin, The Faker, The Turtle and Southpaw Flash, and The Rival is waiting. His record: 30-0.

LEARN TO BOX FROM ZERO
22 moves in 7 chapters: stance, jab, cross, hooks, uppercuts, slips, rolls, blocks, pivots, counters, body shots, combos. Watch it. Learn it. Throw it. Every chapter ends with a rival who tests exactly what you just learned.

YOUR ROUND, SCORED OUT OF 100
Film 60 seconds or upload a video: shadow boxing, heavy bag, pads, sparring. See your speed, guard, defense, stamina and technique, and the three things to fix, biggest first. Drill the first one in a tap. Film again. Watch the number climb.

A FIGHT CAMP BUILT FOR YOU
• Learn to Box in 14 Days
• 30-Day Shadowboxing Challenge
• Fight Camp: 8 Weeks
• Boxing Burn: 28 Days
10, 20 or 30 minutes. A new session every training day. Fight Night tests show how far you've come.

ALSO IN YOUR CORNER
• Shadow boxing with combos called out loud
• Pad rounds on video with your coach
• Fighter circuits: jump rope, burpees, push-ups, jump squats
• Boxing timer with rounds, rest and a bell
• Speed test, reaction test, punch counter
• Snap your meal: calories, protein, carbs, fat
• Weigh-ins, water and your weight class
• Streaks and ranks, from Rookie to Legend
• Orthodox and southpaw

WHO STEPS IN
Never thrown a punch. Trained once and stopped. Feel watched at the gym. Tired of saving boxing videos you never do. Your corner is ready.

Your camera video never leaves your phone. No ads. No account.

Every fighter you've ever watched once threw a first jab. Download BoxRise and throw yours today.

BOXRISE PRO
All training is part of BoxRise Pro, an auto-renewing subscription, yearly or monthly. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://boxrise.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://boxrise.app/privacy
Support: https://boxrise.app/support

Talk to your doctor before starting a new workout.

name: Bponi Desk
description:
Bponi Desk is the phone app for sales teams that use Bponi Desk CRM. It keeps every lead, call, visit and follow-up in one place, so nobody is forgotten.

What you can do:
- See today's work first: who to call, who to meet, what is late.
- Add a lead by speaking. Desk writes it down and you check it before saving.
- Call or message a lead and note how it went in one tap.
- Plan and log visits, with the place kept on the visit.
- See what the buyer wants, who decides and the next best step.
- Hold an item, make a quote and share a brochure.
- Reply to customer chats from your website, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.
- Tasks, calendar, approvals and team targets for managers.
- When a known customer phones, see their name on the call screen (optional, you turn it on).
- Keep working with weak signal: notes, tasks and visit logs are sent when the connection is back.

Bangla and English. Each person sees only what their role allows.

You need a Bponi Desk account from your company to sign in. Learn more at desk.bponi.com.

name: Brand Pharma Expense Tracker
description:
Brand Pharma makes it easier to understand where your money goes. Record everyday expenses, set a monthly budget, and see your spending at a glance—all without creating an account.

TRACK EVERY EXPENSE
Add an expense with an amount, category, date, and optional note. Update or delete entries whenever you need to, and search your records by name, category, or note.

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR BUDGET
Set a separate budget for each month. See how much you have spent and what remains, with an in-app indicator when you approach or exceed your limit.

SEE THE BIGGER PICTURE
Explore spending by category and compare the selected month's total with the previous month. Browse your history month by month and export a monthly expense report as a CSV file.

KEEP A BACKUP
Export your expenses and budgets as a JSON backup and save or share it using the iOS share sheet. You can restore a compatible backup later after reviewing and confirming the replacement of your current records.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
Your records are stored locally on your device. No account is required, and your entries are not sent to an app-operated server. The interface is available in Arabic and English, and amounts are shown in Egyptian pounds (EGP).

Exported files and device backups are managed separately from the app. JSON backups are not encrypted, so keep them in a safe place.

name: Brasilzinho
description:
Explore o Brasil em miniatura num mapa 3D vivo com mais de 5.500 cidades!

No Brasilzinho, você escolhe sua cidade, constrói e decora sua casa em 3D, passeia pelas ruas com amigos em tempo real, adota pets fofos em pixel art e desbloqueia móveis, carros e visuais incríveis.

O que você encontra no Brasilzinho:
• Mapa 3D do Brasil inteiro: conquiste e visite cidades de todos os estados.
• Sua casa do seu jeito: decore cômodos com móveis interativos (sente no sofá, deite na cama!), escolha fachadas e quintais 3D.
• Pets companheiros: adote e cuide dos seus bichinhos, equipe acessórios e leve-os para passear pela vila.
• Passeio e carros 3D: caminhe ou dirija pela vila, encontre vizinhos ao vivo e converse no chat da comunidade (com denúncia e bloqueio integrados).
• Passe de Temporada e missões diárias: ganhe Brasilpoints jogando e personalize seu boneco no provador.

Assinatura Clube Brasilzinho:
O Clube Brasilzinho é uma assinatura mensal com renovação automática que libera benefícios cosméticos e de comodidade (500 Cashpoints por ciclo, Cuidador Automático de Pets, +1 vaga de pet, selo VIP, traje exclusivo e placa personalizada). O pagamento é cobrado na sua Conta Apple na confirmação e renovado automaticamente salvo cancelamento até 24 horas antes do fim do período nos Ajustes da Conta Apple.

Termos de Uso: https://brasilzinho.lunnary.com.br/termos
Política de Privacidade: https://brasilzinho.lunnary.com.br/privacidade
Suporte: https://brasilzinho.lunnary.com.br/suporte

name: Brass Crown: Tower Defense
description:
Defend the Sky-Archipelago, Obsidian Caldera, and Astral Star-Spire in Brass Crown: Tower Defense — a hand-painted steampunk hero siege strategy game built from the ground up for iPhone and iPad.

MASTER 15 HAND-PAINTED REALMS ACROSS 3 FULL CHAPTERS
• Chapter 1 — Sky-Archipelago (Stages 1–5): Guard floating brass aqueducts and confront the Sovereign Aether Dragon.
• Chapter 2 — Obsidian Caldera (Stages 6–10): Hold volcanic bridge chokepoints against the Obsidian Magma-Wyrm.
• Chapter 3 — Astral Star-Spire (Stages 11–15): Defend celestial observatories against the Celestial Void-Seraph.

HAND-PAINTED 360° ROTATING TURRETS & MYTHIC EVOLUTIONS
• Build and upgrade 6 distinct steampunk towers: Pyro Siege Mortar, Volt Arc Spire, Cryo Frost Prism, Oil Alchemist, Aether Rail-Ballista, and Royal Aegis Bastion.
• Watch hand-painted 8-direction cannon and railgun turrets track advancing enemies across 360° while perched on carved stone pedestals.
• Unlock Tier-4 Branching Mythic Evolutions (Solar Howitzer, Hyperion Rail-Cannon, Cathedral Bastion, and more) with bespoke upgrade cinematics.

TRIGGER 5 EXPLOSIVE ELEMENTAL COMBOS
• Combine tower and hero elements on primed foes to unleash Napalm Inferno, Superconduct Shatter, Static Mire, Thermal Shock, and Permafrost Tar — or detonate every active primer at once with Sir Aldric's Royal Cataclysm.

COMMAND 7 EVOLVING HEROES WITH DIRECT CONTROL
• Tap any road or drag your Hero directly across the battlefield to intercept elites, shield towers, and unleash voiced Ultimate abilities.
• Level Heroes to unlock visible battlefield evolutions at Lv.4 (Ascendant), Lv.7 (Sovereign), and Lv.10 (Emperor).

INTERACTIVE 2.5D TABLETOP CAMERA & MID-BATTLE SAVE-RESUME
• Pinch to zoom (1.0x–2.6x), pan, rotate the battlefield 360° with upright billboarded units, or toggle 3D isometric perspective tilt.
• Pause anytime to save your live wave, towers, and gold, upgrade in the Royal Forge 8×10 Tech Tree, and jump straight back into battle.
• Compete in Daily Mutator challenges and Endless Siege Game Center leaderboards — fully playable offline, with optional Sign in with Apple and iCloud progress backup.

name: Breakveil
seller_name: ORGANIK KOZMETIK SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Breakveil, klasik tuğla kırma heyecanını ünlü tablolar, dünya bayrakları ve ikonik yapılarla buluşturan hızlı bir arcade bulmaca oyunudur.

• Tünelleri tuttur, top yağmurunu başlat ve perdeyi parçala!
• Arkadaki gizli eseri en az blok kırarak tahmin et, 3x erken bonus ve 3 yıldız kazan.
• Günün Perdesi ile her gün tüm oyuncularla aynı bulmacayı çöz ve sonucunu 5x5 kare kartıyla paylaş.
• 30 el yapımı bölüm, Sonsuz Mod ve açtığın eserleri saklayan Müze koleksiyonu.
• Çevrimdışı oynanabilir, hesap veya giriş gerektirmez.

name: Breezeroll: Photo Cleaner
description:
Your iPhone is full of near-identical burst shots, blurry misfires, pocket photos, old receipts, saved memes, forgotten screenshots and huge videos. Breezeroll finds them with smart on-device AI and helps you clear them out in a few taps, without uploading a single photo.

SMART ON-DEVICE DETECTION
Breezeroll uses Apple's Vision framework right on your iPhone to understand your library. Nothing is sent to a server.
- Blurry & junk: out-of-focus shots, near-black frames, pocket shots and accidental photos, worst first.
- Smart categories: documents, receipts, screenshots with text, memes, whiteboards, WhatsApp and messaging downloads, food, pets and nature. Open any category and delete many at once.

VIDEO COMPRESSOR
Shrink big videos with Apple's HEVC encoder, on your iPhone. See the estimated new size first and the real space saved after. The smaller copy keeps the original date and location, and you choose whether to delete the original.

CLEAN ONE MONTH TODAY
A quick daily swipe session builds a streak. Swipe left to toss, right to keep, and undo anytime. Turn on an optional daily reminder and pick its time in Settings.

DUPLICATES & LOOKALIKES
Breezeroll matches identical copies and similar shots on your device and picks the best one to keep (highest resolution, your favorites first). Tap any photo to change the pick.

SCREENSHOTS & LARGE VIDEOS
See every screenshot and your biggest videos, sorted by size, and select many at once.

WATCH THE SPACE COME BACK
Every cleanup shows how much space you freed, and Breezeroll keeps a running total.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- All analysis happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
- Recognized text is only used to sort photos and is never stored.
- No account and no analytics. Pro has no ads; free users can choose to watch an optional reward video.
- Every deletion is confirmed with Apple's own prompt, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

BREEZEROLL PRO
Scanning is free, including smart detection. The free version includes 20 deletions per day and 1 video compression, and you can watch an optional reward video for 20 more deletions (or 1 more compression), up to 3 times a day. Breezeroll Pro unlocks unlimited deletions and compression:
- Weekly: $4.99/week with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
- Yearly: $29.99/year
Prices may vary by region. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://fauzanid.github.io/breezeroll/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://fauzanid.github.io/breezeroll/privacy.html

name: BrewMath: Brew Calculator
description:
BrewMath is a brewing calculator and notebook that stays out of your way.

No account. No subscription. No ads. It works with the phone in airplane mode, standing next to a boiling kettle.

FREE, FOREVER
• IBU — Tinseth and Rager side by side, with pellet and whole-leaf correction
• ABV — standard and Hall formulas, plus apparent and real attenuation
• Gravity — SG, °Plato and Brix, converted in both directions
• Priming sugar — dosed against the volume you actually bottle, not the batch size
• Strike water — temperature, volume and absorption
• Colour — Morey, SRM and EBC with a real swatch
• Efficiency — reverse-engineer your own system from a measured OG
• Water salts — ion contributions and sulfate:chloride ratio
• Brew day timer — mash, boil and every hop addition
• Unlimited batches, change tracking and tasting notes

BUILT FOR BREW DAY
Large numbers you can read from a metre away, a keypad sized for wet hands, and a screen that stays awake while the timer runs. Enter 1056 and it becomes 1.056.

TELL IT

name: Bridge Hop: Stick Bridge Run
description:
Hold, build the bridge and help the little fox cross!

Bridge Hop is a calm but tricky timing game. Hold the screen to grow the bridge, let go to drop it across the gap. Too short or too long and down you go. Land the tip right on the red mark for a Perfect and bonus coins. Cross every pillar to finish the level.

FEATURES
• One-finger hold and release controls
• Perfect landings for bonus coins
• Narrower pillars and wider gaps as you go
• Cute heroes to unlock: panda, frog, cat, chick, owl
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Play offline

Bridge Hop is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Bridge Master: Card Game
description:
Bridge Master is contract bridge for one player. You sit South; your partner and both opponents are bots, so you can play a full game at any time, in a few minutes, without a connection to other players.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Tap any call in the auction to see what it means in the bidding system (SAYC style): how many points, how many cards in which suit, and the idea behind the bid. The bidding box is one tap per bid and appears only on your turn, with your hand in view.

ADVICE WHEN YOU ARE STUCK
Tap Advice on your turn to see what to bid or play, and why. For a bid, "More about bidding…" opens a full guide to the bidding system, at the part that fits your hand. A short tutorial explains how bridge is played.

SMART BOTS
The bots bid by a standard system and play their cards by looking ahead. They think about the cards they cannot see, use what the bidding has told them, and solve the endgame exactly.

DUPLICATE SESSIONS
A session is 16 boards with the standard dealers and vulnerability. Every board is scored in matchpoints against a field of bot tables that played the same deal, so you see how well you really did: your percentage after each board and a summary at the end.

FAST AND FAIR
Undo a misclick before the bots answer. When the rest of the tricks are certain, the board is claimed for you. Concede a lost hand with one tap. A forced card plays itself. Cards slide onto the table, and a tap takes the finished trick at once.

SEASONS AND TOP PLAYERS
Play the same monthly deals as everyone else and, if you like, add your name to a worldwide list. It is optional and off until you choose it.

The app is free and shows ads. A one-time purchase removes them.

Good for beginners who want to see how bidding works, and for players who want quick practice hands.

name: Bridgy: Draw a Bridge
description:
Draw a bridge across the canyon, press Go and watch the convoy cross. Every car has to make it home!

Drag a line between the glowing points and the bridge appears under your finger. Ropes sag, timber flexes, steel stays straight. Too steep and the cars slip back; too long and the planks snap into the river. Use as little bridge as you can for three stars.

Features
• Real physics: every plank bends, sags and snaps for real
• 100 levels in 5 worlds: Sunny Canyon, Spire Gorge, High Ridges, Steel Valley and Heavy Load
• Vans, sports cars, tractors, loaders and dump trucks, each with its own way of climbing; the heavy ones snap a weak bridge
• Rope, timber, iron and steel, plus pylons that hold the bridge from above
• Daily Puzzle: one canyon a day, the same for everyone, ranked by the shortest bridge
• Stuck? A hint shows a bridge that works, or take 2 extra metres, or skip the level
• Paint your convoy in six colours
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break; plays offline
• Optional ads only: watch one if you want a free helper, never forced

Shop
• Coin packs: 1,500 coins and 5,000 coins, one-off purchases
• Pro: every hint, extra bridge and skip free, no ads, the gold convoy and 3,000 bonus coins, $1.99 per month or $9.99 per year
• Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. It renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
• Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Privacy Policy: https://aghgames.dev/privacy/

No account needed.

aghgames.dev

name: Brynel
description:
Brynel is a quiet, offline journal for walking fens, reedbeds, carrs, meres, dykes and washes.
Keep a private record of every wetland walk: when you went, how long you were out, the route, the shape of the day, the light, the weather, the footing underfoot and the grounds you passed. Twenty-four kinds of lowland ground are built in, from saw-sedge fen and common reedbed to alder carr, oxbow mere, boundary dyke and tidal wash.
WHAT IT IS NOT
Brynel is not a map, a route planner, a weather forecast, a tide table, a GPS tracker, a plant identifier or a fitness log. The month note is a calendar nudge, never a prediction. Check a local forecast, the wind over the reed and the state of the water before you go out.

name: Bube Shop: Store Management
description:
Bube Shop is a store management app for shop owners and small businesses: follow orders, inventory, customers and reports from your phone, in sync with the web app.

SALES & ORDERS
• Create orders and scan barcodes with the camera to add products.
• Follow orders and e-invoice status.
• Manage customers.

INVENTORY & PRODUCTS
• Manage your product catalog, stock levels and stock vouchers.
• Upload product and document photos from your phone (pick or take a photo).

REPORTS & MULTI-BRANCH
• Product, cash-flow, receivables and inventory reports by date range and branch.
• Staff roles and permissions, member invitations, multiple branches.

BubeAI ASSISTANT
• Ask questions and look up store figures in plain language.

SAFE & PRIVATE
• Sign in with email and password, Apple or Google.
• Delete your account right inside the app (Account › Delete account).
• Data is encrypted in transit.

Need help? bubebusiness.support@gmail.com · https://bube-shop.com/en/support

name: Buckly
description:
Buckly is the step before you open a property-line app: it tells you which county is worth the drive.

Every county in all 50 states gets a hunting score from 0 to 100, built from three things: how much game is taken there, how much public land there is, and how much hunting pressure it gets. Tap a county to see the score and exactly what went into it.

WHAT YOU GET FREE
• The whole national map, with Pennsylvania and one state of your choice fully unlocked
• Best times: an hour-by-hour deer movement forecast from sun, moon and the National Weather Service
• Seasons and license costs for all 50 states
• Scout: a close-up topo map with public land marked, and whether hunting is usually allowed there
• A private hunt journal and five map marks

WHAT PRO ADDS
• Every county in every state, with species filters for whitetail, turkey, elk, bear and waterfowl
• Stand Alerts: tell Buckly which winds suit a stand and get a notification the evening before a good sit
• Aerial imagery and a scent cone on Scout
• My Hunt: outline your own ground, keep trail-camera photos, plan trips
• Unlimited marks, reminders and saved spots

HONEST NUMBERS
Scores are a planning guide, not a promise. Where a state does not publish county harvest numbers, Buckly estimates them from unit or statewide totals and says so on the county card. Waterfowl scores are a habitat estimate. Season dates and license prices come from state agencies and are rechecked each year; your state's regulations always govern.

YOUR SPOTS STAY YOURS
Stands, cameras, journal entries and photos are private to your account. Nothing you mark is ever shown on the public map.

Pro is a subscription bought on huntbuckly.com. Terms: https://huntbuckly.com/terms  Privacy: https://huntbuckly.com/privacy

name: Bunkora Studio
description:
Bunkora Studio is de app voor kinderbedden en jeugdkamers. Bekijk de collectie, stel je meubel samen en bestel direct vanuit je telefoon. Gemaakt van echt hout, ontworpen voor echte kamers.

ONZE COLLECTIE
Stapelbedden, hoogslapers, combinatiebedden met bureau en kast, uitschuifbedden, een glijbaanbed en een huisbed. Aangevuld met bureau's, kasten, een matras en beddengoed.

ZELF SAMENSTELLEN
Kies per artikel de kleur, maat en eventuele extra's. Je ziet direct wat je keuze kost, in het overzicht van het product.

DIRECT BESTELLEN
Koop een artikel meteen, of bewaar het eerst in je winkelmand en bestel later. Bij het afrekenen kies je voor bezorging of bezorging met montage. Je betaalt bij levering.

BEWAAR JE FAVORIETEN
Hartje op een artikel dat je bevalt, zodat je het later makkelijk terugvindt.

BESTELLINGEN IN ÉÉN OVERZICHT
Bekijk je eerdere en lopende bestellingen in je account en bestel eerdere aankopen opnieuw. Een bestelling kun je annuleren zolang deze nog niet bevestigd is.

INSPIRATIE EN ADVIES
Lees onze verhalen en gidsen over inrichten, de juiste maat kiezen en montage.

name: Buoy Set
description:
Buoy Set is for a fisherman at the edge of a net just set. Write the net, the depth in fathoms, and the line in fathoms. Drag the buoy to the right. The phone writes the spare line, or how short the line is.

Spare line is the line minus the depth. Short is the depth minus the line. Buoy Set does not record a catch, a position, or a boat. It does not connect to a fishery system. It does not use a network or an account. The sets stay on this iPhone.

name: Buur: Jass offline
description:
Buur bringt den Schieber auf dein iPhone und iPad. Du jasst mit deinem Partner gegen zwei Computer-Gegner – komplett offline, ohne Werbung und ohne Tracking. Mischle, verteile, jasse.

DER KLASSISCHE SCHIEBER
• Trumpf, Obenabe und Undenufe
• Schieben: Passt das Blatt nicht, wählt dein Partner den Trumpf
• Buur und Nell, Bedienen und Stechen, kein Untertrumpfen
• Weis und Stöck werden automatisch erkannt und geschrieben
• Match mit 100 Extrapunkten, letzter Stich mit 5 Punkten
• Jasstafel mit allen Runden, Trumpf und Punkten
• Letzten Stich jederzeit ansehen
• Laufende Partie wird automatisch gespeichert

DEINE KARTEN
Wähle zwischen Deutschschweizer Karten (Schellen, Schilten, Rosen, Eicheln) und französischen Karten. Grosse, gut lesbare Karten auf dem Jasstisch.

LERNEN LEICHT GEMACHT
Die Regeln sind in der App kurz erklärt, inklusive Trumpf-Reihenfolge. Der Tipp-Modus zeigt dir auf Wunsch die beste Karte.

GRATIS JASSEN
Schieber mit allen Trumpfarten, Schieben, Weis, Stöck und Match, KI-Stufe «Anfänger», Partien auf 1000 Punkte, drei Tipps pro Tag und die Statistik deiner letzten 10 Partien – gratis und ohne Werbung.

VOLLVERSION – EINMALIG, KEIN ABO
• KI-Stufen «Fortgeschritten» und «Profi» – die Profi-KI zählt jede Karte mit
• Multiplikatoren: Schellen und Schilten doppelt, Obenabe und Undenufe dreifach
• Partien auf 1000, 1500 oder 2500 Punkte
• Unbegrenzte Tipps
• Komplette Statistik: Siegquote, Matches, Weis-Punkte

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Spielstände und Statistiken werden nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert.

Buur ist ein reines Unterhaltungsspiel ohne Geldeinsätze und ohne Gewinne.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://buurjass.xyz/terms/
Datenschutz: https://buurjass.xyz/privacy/

name: BuzzRound Games Moderator
description:
BuzzRound Host is the iPad remote for running BuzzRound live trivia and bingo at your bar, restaurant or event. Build your games on the BuzzRound website, then run the whole night from the iPad in your hand.

Trivia:
• Open the lobby so teams join by scanning the QR code on the TV
• Move the game forward with one big button: show the question, close answers, reveal, leaderboard, breaks between rounds
• See every team's answer as it comes in, and mark write-in answers correct, incorrect or half credit, or give bonus points
• Track wagers and multipliers, settle tie-breakers, and enter scores for paper teams
• Go back and show an earlier question on screen again
• Pick bonus prize winners and finish with final standings and fun stats on the TV

Bingo:
• Tap a number to call it. It shows full screen on every TV, then lights up on the board
• Called the wrong ball? Tap it to take it back
• Show each round's pattern and prizes, pause to check a bingo, and celebrate the winner
• Players can call bingo from their phones, and you acknowledge it with a tap

Your TVs:
• Pair a TV running BuzzRound Display with its six-digit code, and choose what each TV shows
• Use AirPlay to put the game on any TV from your iPad
• A live preview shows what the TV shows now, and what it will show after your next press

Rename or remove teams at any time, and the change shows on the TV and every phone right away.

BuzzRound Host requires an existing BuzzRound host account.

name: C21 Authenticator
description:
Protect your online accounts with C21 Authenticator, a simple and reliable authentication app designed to add an extra layer of security to your digital life.

C21 Authenticator helps you manage your authentication codes conveniently and securely.

name: Cable Drop
description:
Cable Drop sizes a cable run by voltage drop on this iPhone.

Enter the supply voltage, the load current, the metal, and whether the limit is lighting at 3 percent or another load at 5. Single phase uses 2 × length × current × resistivity ÷ area. Three phase uses √3. Copper resistivity is 0.0225 and aluminum is 0.036. The plan shows the cabinet, the run, and the load. Drag the load to the length, or lengthen and shorten by ten metres. The reading is the smallest size you own that stays inside the limit. Pass means the size on the plan already fits. Upsize means a larger owned size fits and that size is the one to use. Over means even the largest size you own is past the limit. A run can be several segments. The drops add. The last segment stays. Ampacity is not checked here.

Runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: CacheSpan
description:
CacheSpan helps you understand the cache timing of a response you already have. Paste or import GET / 200 response headers, set explicit UTC capture times, and inspect how response age and an explicit lifetime are calculated.

Switch between Private and Shared to review max-age, s-maxage and Expires priority. Keep freshness separate from storage restrictions, validation requirements and Vary limits. See where every calculation and policy conclusion comes from.

Save editable cases, compare two sources at the same reference time, and freeze independent reports. Generate real JSON, CSV or TXT files, preview them and choose where to share them. Frozen reports remain unchanged when source cases are later edited or deleted.

FEATURES
• Ordered header audit with source lines and diagnostics.
• Full age trace, explicit lifetime source and exact stale boundary.
• Conditional-header text from valid ETag and Last-Modified fields.
• Two-case comparison using one UTC reference and cache type.
• Independent case or comparison reports with real file exports.
• Search, duplicate, edit, cancel and confirmed local deletion.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
One complete GET / 200 response with supplied header text and times. No live fetching, packet capture, browser/CDN simulation, authenticated or partial responses, request directives, heuristic TTL or 304 merging. A fresh result alone does not prove actual request reuse. Input and policy limits are explained in the app and support guide.

Designed for iPhone. No subscription, paid API or account is required for the worksheet.

name: Caderno – Learn Portuguese
description:
Caderno is a notebook for the Brazilian Portuguese you meet in real life: a word in a song, on a menu, or in a conversation with a friend. Save it in seconds, and Caderno brings it back at just the right moment so it sticks.
SAVE WORDS IN SECONDS
• Type a word, or say it out loud
• Tap Fill in to add the meaning, type and an example sentence
• Nouns show their article (o / a), verbs their infinitive

REVIEW AT THE RIGHT TIME
• Spaced repetition shows each word just before you’d forget it
• Rate each card Again, Hard, Good or Easy, and Caderno plans the next review
• Practice Portuguese → English, English → Portuguese, or both mixed
• Say it: answer out loud and Caderno tells you how close you were
• Hear every word spoken in Brazilian Portuguese
• Keep a daily streak, with an optional gentle reminder

A FREE DICTIONARY, EVEN OFFLINE
• Look up over 50,000 words in Portuguese or English
• Find words from any form: “falei” takes you to “falar”
• Meanings, examples and pronunciation for each entry
• Add any word to your notebook with one tap

LEARN THE WORDS THAT MATTER
• Browse words by level, from the 1,000 most common upwards
• See how much of each level you’ve already saved
• Dodge false friends like “puxar” (pull, not push) and “livraria” (bookshop, not library)

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• Works fully without an account
• Sign in with Apple or email to back up and sync across your devices
• No ads, no tracking
• Delete your account and data at any time from the app

Feito para quem está aprendendo português do Brasil. Boa sorte!

Dictionary from Wiktionary (via kaikki.org) and word frequencies from FrequencyWords, both under CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: CADLocal: STEP, DXF & 3MF
description:
Open, inspect, measure, slice, and convert industrial CAD assemblies and 3D manufacturing files 100% offline on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac — ZERO cloud uploads, ZERO account sign-ups, and ZERO ads.

Built for mechanical engineers, CNC machinists, sheet-metal laser fabricators, and modern 3D printing studios working with confidential NDA drawings.

KEY ENGINEERING CAPABILITIES

• Multi-Format Local CAD & Mesh Engine
Open ISO-10303-21 STEP (.step / .stp), IGES (.iges / .igs), 2D/3D DXF drawings (.dxf), multi-part 3MF (.3mf), Binary & ASCII STL (.stl), GLB/glTF, OBJ, and USDZ directly from Files, Mail, AirDrop, or messages.

• True 3D Orthographic Camera & Shaded + Edges
Switch in one tap between distortion-free Orthographic projection and Perspective view, jump to standard ISO / TOP / FRONT / RIGHT engineering orientations with gimbal-lock-free arcball controls, and inspect crisp B-Rep topological edges, X-Ray internal clearances, and surface normal directions.

• Precision Hole-to-Hole & Snap Caliper Measurement
Magnetically snap to bolt-hole centers (Ø), arc centers, vertices, and surfaces to measure exact center-to-center pitch, bore diameters, and ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ tolerances in millimeters or inches. Automatically calculates DXF laser cut-path length and hole count.

• Real-Time X/Y/Z Cross-Section, Exploded View & Alloy Mass
Slice parts dynamically along X, Y, or Z axes with highlighted interior caps, explode multi-part assemblies to inspect internal tolerances, isolate individual solids or DXF layers, check 180–350mm 3D print beds, and estimate part weight across Aluminum 6061, Stainless Steel 304, Titanium Ti-6Al-4V, Brass, PLA, PETG, and ABS.

• 100% On-Device Format Converter & 1:1 AR Placement
Convert STEP, IGES, 3MF, and STL locally to calibrated millimeter Binary STL, compressed 3MF packages, Wavefront OBJ, 1:1 millimeter Laser-Cut SVG profiles, USDZ archives, and BOM CSV spreadsheets — or place parts at true 1:1 scale on your shop floor with Apple AR Quick Look.

CADLocal Pro is available via Lifetime Unlock ($39.99 one-time with Family Sharing), Yearly ($29.99/year with a 3-day free trial), or Weekly ($4.99/week). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Apple ID Account Settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://cadlocal.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://cadlocal.com/privacy/

name: Caliber LLC
description:
Caliber is the time clock for Caliber LLC's crew. It's for Caliber employees only: sign in with the cell number Caliber has on file and a texted code.

• Clock in to a job and cost code, switch jobs in one tap, and clock out.
• Start and end breaks.
• With location on, the app suggests the job site you're at.
• Get directions to any job site.
• See today's and this week's hours, and fix your own entries until the office approves them.
• Works with no service: punches are saved on the phone and sent when service is back.
• A reminder at 6 PM if you're still clocked in.

Your hours go to Caliber's project management system for job costing and payroll.

name: CaliJazz
description:
Take Jazz, a cape-wearing cat, on a side-scrolling platforming adventure through Southern California.

Glide under a kite over the Long Beach boardwalk, climb the rocky ledges of Griffith Park, and bound across Hollywood rooftops. Jump, roll, and grab ledges to navigate gaps, dodge gulls and crabs, and take on a puma at the observatory.

Collect treats to restore hearts and find hidden straws for extra lives.

name: Calm Companion
description:
Calm Companion is the calm navigation app. Choose the calmer way to walk, cycle or take transit, and see the calm route next to the fastest.

Calm routes: pick a route by how calm it feels, not only how fast it is. Guidance keeps working with the screen locked.

Sounds you choose: gentle sounds while you travel, with full control over what you hear and how loud.

Music: play the kalimba, record a loop, add layers, and leave it on the map for someone to find.

Fidgets: a spinner, clicky switches and soft sensory toys with gentle sound and haptics.

Calm+ (optional, one payment, no subscription) adds the drum machine, chord pads, two extra fidgets and premium spinner designs. Navigation, the kalimba and the sounds always stay included.

name: CalSnap: Flyer to Calendar
description:
Never type a school flyer or sports schedule into your calendar again.

CalSnap reads paper calendars, fridge notes, school letters, team schedules and PDFs, and turns them into calendar events in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
- Take a photo, or pick an image or PDF.
- CalSnap finds each event's title, date, time and location, plus details like volunteer duties and snack assignments.
- Check and edit the events, then tap Add to my calendar to add them to your iPhone's calendar, or share them as an .ics file.

SEE YOUR MONTH
A color-coded month view shows every event by child or activity.

YOUR HISTORY, ON YOUR PHONE
Your past scans are saved on your iPhone so you can open them again anytime.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and documents are only used to create your events. They aren't stored on our servers. No account needed.

PRICING
5 free scans a month. Need more? Buy a 20-scan pack, or go unlimited with a monthly or yearly subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in iPhone Settings.

Terms of Service: https://calsnap.strascorp.com/terms

name: Caltsceue-Think Tap
description:
Harjoittele valikoivaa tarkkaavaisuutta ja impulssien hallintaa lyhyillä, leikkisillä kuvatehtävillä.

Katso laboratoriokehyksessä näkyvää pääkuviota. Napauta vain, kun se vastaa ruudulla näkyvää sääntöä. Muulloin odota. Vihreä ympyrä voi tarkoittaa, että saat napauttaa, ja oranssi ympyrä, että on aika odottaa. Joskus vasemmalle osoittava nuoli on merkki napauttaa ja oikealle osoittava nuoli merkki odottaa.

Jokaisessa tehtävässä kuvio ja vihje vaihtuvat, joten harjoittelu pysyy vaihtelevana. Edistymispalkista näet, kuinka pitkällä olet tehtävässä. Oikeaan aikaan odottaminen on yhtä arvokasta kuin oikeaan aikaan napauttaminen. Harjoituksen tahti ja lisäkuvioiden määrä mukautuvat vähitellen sen mukaan, kuinka tarkasti noudatat sääntöä ja kuinka usein napautat vahingossa.

Kuvio-opas esittelee kaikki kuviot, ja harjoituskartasta voit seurata edistymistäsi. Taukopajassa voit harjoitella rauhassa odottamista, ja sääntöharjoituksessa voit kerrata yhden tehtävän sääntöä. Harjoituskortit ja kuviopaja tarjoavat lapsille ja perheille lyhyitä, käytännönläheisiä tehtäviä.

name: Cam-Cord
description:
CamCord captures the moment before the moment.

Tap once to start recording as you line up your shot, then tap again to capture your photo. CamCord saves a short video of the seconds leading up to your shot, then ends on a freeze-frame of the still photo (complete with a shutter click). It's the charm of b-roll footage on classic digital cameras, right on your iPhone.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap once to start recording
- Tap again to capture your still(s)
- CamCord keeps the last few seconds of motion before the shot, then freeze-frames on your photo
- The finished video and your photos are saved to your Photos library—you'll get both the hybrid video, and the photos alone.

FEATURES
- Capture 1, 2, or 3 stills per shot, with a countdown as each is taken
- Creative control: control flash, zoom in, adjust exposure, toggle front and back cameras
- Tap to focus, slide to adjust exposure, and pinch to zoom
- Use your phone's volume buttons or the on-screen camera button as a shutter
- Adjustable shutter sound volume, or mute it completely
- Built-in guide: tap the info button for a tour of the controls

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
CamCord has no accounts, ads, or tracking. Everything you capture stays on your device and goes straight to your Photos library.

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS, EVER
Just a one-time purchase and CamCord is yours. No subscriptions, no catch, no hidden fees.

name: CanvassFM
description:
CanvassFM is the iPhone app for field sales teams in the United States and Canada that already use CanvassFM at work.

Company login required. There is no public sign-up.

Reps open today’s route, follow the map, and record what happened at each door. Attach an ID or a bill photo from the camera, then check stats when the day is done.

Managers see activity, escalations, and follow-ups, assign routes, and look after the team from the phone.

Admins run onboarding, teams, and the background-check queue without going back to a desk.

Precise location is used only while the app is open, so a door result can store where it was logged. The app does not track location in the background.

No ads. No in-app purchases. For adults 18 and older.

Support: support@canvassfm.com
Account deletion: https://app.canvassfm.com/legal/account-deletion
Privacy: https://app.canvassfm.com/legal/privacy

name: Cap Ferry: Bowen Island
description:
Cap Ferry follows the Bowen Island ferry in real time, so you know whether you need to run for the boat or you've got time for another coffee.

WHERE'S THE BOAT See the Queen of Capilano moving between Snug Cove and Horseshoe Bay, tracked live over AIS. When she leaves the dock, Cap Ferry matches the departure to the schedule and tells you if she's on time or running late.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN Start a Live Activity and the boat's position, delay and next departures stay on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, updating even when the app is closed.

DECK SPACE See how full the next Horseshoe Bay sailing is before you join the lineup.

TIME TO LEAVE Tap a sailing and Cap Ferry works out how long it takes you to get to the terminal, driving or walking, and reminds you when it's time to go.

TODAY'S SCHEDULE Every sailing from both terminals, with schedule notes, dangerous goods sailings and service notices. Cap Ferry uses your location to show departures from the side of the water you're on.

WEBCAMS Check the lineup at the terminal before you head down.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Cap Ferry is an independent app and isn't affiliated with BC Ferries. Always check current conditions with BC Ferries before you travel.

name: CAPILLARA
description:
A narrow gap can change your whole plan. Split a larger droplet, send the pieces through one at a time, then bring them back together where the board allows.

CAPILLARA is an offline logic puzzle game set on glassy underwater boards. Guide numbered droplets to golden rings of the same size. Each slide moves a barrier one square, so the order of your moves matters.

Teal plates push droplets ahead. Amber wicks can also pull a droplet from directly behind them. Droplets that share an edge merge and add their sizes. A pink splitter post can divide a larger droplet, and only size-one droplets fit through narrow gaps.

Explore different boards from the Play menu. Start with a simple push or skip ahead to a board that combines multiple mechanics. Each level gives you a limited number of moves and time to think through them. Use Undo to take back a move, restart from Pause, or replay a clear to improve your personal best and earn more stars.

CAPILLARA plays entirely offline, with no ads or account. Your earned stars, best move counts, and sound preference are saved on your device.

name: Car Battle Arena
description:
Eight cars. One marker. A target line that punishes every late input. Tune your garage, then put it on the clock. Pick from 720 route layouts across 18 venues. Each race asks for three timed inputs, and your finishing time and accuracy come back right away. A fast but sloppy run shows up immediately, so you adjust the setup and go again. Runs are quick, which makes one more attempt easy.

Every stat pulls differently depending on the mode. A setup that flies in one can fall apart in the next, so the garage never stops being a puzzle. Eight cars means eight different answers. Change one part, run again and see what moves.

Drag Strip
Time Attack
Technical Circuit
Precision Trial
New cars for the garage
Performance parts
Garage lighting
Points from every race

Every race pays out, and every payout has somewhere to go. Beat the rotating daily challenge for a bonus. Enter the Turbo Cup, an eight driver bracket, and clear three rounds to take the trophy. Your offline career keeps cars, upgrades and recent race results saved on your iPhone.

name: Car Driving Simulator Game 3D
description:
Experience the ultimate car driving simulator and take your racing skills to a whole new level!

Car Driving Simulator Game 3D combines realistic car driving physics, exciting street racing, epic drift challenges and powerful sports cars in one action-packed car game. Drive through busy city streets, race through traffic, customize your favorite cars and become the ultimate racing champion!

Enjoy realistic car simulation, high-speed racing and an incredible driving experience with smooth controls and immersive 3D environments.

REALISTIC CAR DRIVING SIMULATOR

Experience advanced car driving physics, realistic car handling, high-speed driving and exciting drift mechanics. Explore city roads, race through traffic and master your driving skills in challenging racing missions.

SPORTS CARS & SUPER CARS

Discover an impressive collection of sports cars, classic cars and powerful supercars. Collect coins, unlock new cars and build your ultimate car collection. Enjoy easy driving controls and exciting test drives.

CAR CUSTOMIZATION & UPGRADES

Customize your favorite cars with colorful paints, cool stickers and performance upgrades. Upgrade your engine, improve your speed and tune your car for the ultimate racing and drifting experience.

EXPLORE AMAZING 3D CITIES

Experience exciting car racing across environments inspired by Tokyo, Paris, Chicago, London, Macao, Cairo, Hawaii, Chengdu and Arizona. Discover unique roads, challenging tracks and thrilling traffic racing experiences.

MULTIPLE CAR RACING GAME MODES

• Career Mode  
• Elimination Tournament  
• 1 vs 1 Racing  
• Time Trial  
• Traffic Racing  
• Exciting Driving Challenges

GAME FEATURES

• Realistic 3D car driving simulator  
• Exciting street racing and traffic challenges  
• Advanced car physics and drift mechanics  
• Sports cars, classic cars and supercars  
• Car customization and performance upgrades  
• Smooth and easy driving controls  
• Multiple racing modes and challenging missions  
• Coins, rewards and unlockable cars  
• Immersive 3D racing environments  
• Competitive leaderboards

Whether you enjoy car games, driving simulator games, drift racing, traffic racing or realistic car simulation, Car Driving Simulator Game 3D delivers an exciting driving experience.

Start your engine, upgrade your cars, master the drift and become the ultimate car racing champion.

Download Car Driving Simulator Game 3D and start your racing adventure today!

name: Card Tracker: Riftbound TCG
description:
Scan any Riftbound card and see what it's worth in seconds. Card Tracker identifies the exact card, set, number and print with AI, then shows real sold prices, the TCGplayer market price and its value in your card's condition. Then track your collection, finish your sets and work out whether a card is worth grading.

Built for binder collectors, slab investors, card flippers and pack openers.

— SCAN ANY CARD —

• Take up to 3 photos: the front, the back or a slab label
• AI card identifier finds the champion, set, card number, rarity and print
• Spots Foil, Alternate Art, Overnumbered and gold-signed Signature cards
• Works with raw cards and graded slabs (PSA, BGS, CGC)
• Recognizes Chinese and other non-English cards
• Legends, champion units, spells, gear, runes, battlefields and promos from Origins, Spiritforged, Unleashed, Vendetta, Radiance and every new set

— KNOW WHAT IT'S WORTH —

• Recent sold prices from eBay, TCGplayer and Mercari
• TCGplayer market price for the exact card and print
• Live eBay listings to compare asking prices
• Estimated value by condition, from Near Mint to Damaged
• Every price is labeled with its source, so you know where it came from
• Where to sell and what you'd keep after fees: eBay, TCGplayer or a local game store buylist
• Check local listings on Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Kijiji, Gumtree, Vinted and more

— TRACK YOUR COLLECTION —

• Your portfolio's value with a chart that updates every day
• Refresh every price in one tap
• See which cards moved the most
• Watch cards you want and set price alerts that notify you
• Price history for each card
• See values in your currency (21 currencies)

— COMPLETE YOUR SETS —

• Browse every Riftbound set, from Origins to the latest release
• See how complete each set is, with filters for owned and missing cards
• Collect mode: tap the cards in your binder to check them off
• Search cards by name across all sets
• Card details with TCGplayer prices for Normal and Foil prints, domains, Might and rules text
• Sets you've opened stay available offline

— COLLECTOR TOOLS —

• Should I Grade It? Compare raw and graded prices with realistic grade odds, grading fees and shipping, and see your expected return
• Centering Tool: measure left/right and top/bottom centering from a photo and see the best grade it allows. Card edges are found automatically
• Deal Calculator for card shows and game nights: set your buy, trade and sell percentages, add both sides of the deal, show the other player the total and save it to your inventory

— TRACK YOUR FLIPS —

• Log what you paid, where you bought it and what it sold for
• Profit and ROI for every card and any time range
• Export your inventory and yearly sales to CSV

— PRIVATE BY DESIGN —

No account needed. Your collection stays on your iPhone. Photos are only sent to identify a card after you agree, and they aren't stored.

— HOW IT WORKS —

Snap your card → AI identifies it → See sold prices and value → Add it to your collection

Start with 3 free scans. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited scans:
• Yearly, with a 3-day free trial. We'll remind you the day before it ends
• Weekly

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Prices are estimates for information only and can vary by condition and market. Card Tracker is an independent app and isn't affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Riot Games, TCGplayer, eBay, PSA, BGS or CGC. Riftbound, League of Legends and card names are trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.

Terms of Use: https://riftboundcardtracker.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://riftboundcardtracker.com/privacy/

name: CardYam
description:
Sell eligible gift cards with CardYam. Browse supported cards, check your estimated payout, and track your sale from submission through review.

- Choose a card, issuing region, and card type where applicable. Enter its value and quantity to see an estimate.
- Attach a card photo or enter a card code, then review and submit your order.
- Check sale and withdrawal updates in Orders.
- See your wallet balance and history, and request a withdrawal using an eligible payout method.

Available cards, rates, and payout methods vary by market.

name: Carnet de tournée
description:
Carnet de tournée accompagne les professionnels qui entretiennent régulièrement les mêmes jardins et piscines. Retrouvez les prochains passages, le matériel à charger et la note laissée chez chaque client.

PRÉPAREZ VOTRE TOURNÉE
• Planifiez le jardin et la piscine à la même adresse, chacun à son rythme. Activez un rappel ou reportez un passage si besoin.
• Repérez le matériel du client déjà sur place et cochez les outils à emporter avant de partir.

NOTEZ LE TRAVAIL SUR PLACE
• Cochez les tâches réalisées et ajoutez celles qui ne figurent pas dans la liste.
• Prenez les photos avant et après l’intervention. Retrouvez-les dans l’historique du client, avec les tâches et la note du passage.

PARTAGEZ LE COMPTE RENDU
• Créez un PDF avec les tâches réalisées et les photos que vous choisissez d’y inclure.
• Conservez vos fiches sur votre iPhone et activez, si vous le souhaitez, le verrouillage de l’application.

UN CLIENT COMPLET GRATUIT
Le planning, le matériel, les photos et l’export PDF sont inclus pour un client. L’achat unique Carnet de tournée Pro débloque les clients illimités, les checklists réutilisables et les PDF au nom de votre entreprise.

Aucun compte à créer.

name: Casuro Mates
description:
Mates are AI teammates that do real work. Each one has its own computer and browser, and the apps you connect, so you can hand over a whole task and it gets done.

Casuro Mates puts your mates in your pocket.

TALK TO YOUR MATES
Chat with each mate one to one. Ask a question, hand over a task, or send a photo. Watch the work as it happens: the pages a mate opens, the steps it takes, and the answer at the end.

HAND IT OFF AND WALK AWAY
A mate keeps working after you close the app. You get a notification when it finishes, with the mate's face on it, so you know who is reporting back.

WORK TOGETHER IN CHANNELS
Bring several mates and teammates into one channel. Mention a mate to pull it into the conversation, and approve what it shares before it goes out.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
A mate asks before it shares your information with others. Approve or decline from your phone.

MAKE A MATE YOUR OWN
Create a new mate in a minute: give it a name, a character and a brief. Pick the AI model it runs on, or let Casuro choose the best one for each task.

CONNECT YOUR APPS
Give a mate access to the tools you already use, such as email and calendar, so it can work where you work.

Start in seconds with Apple, Google or email. A new account comes with an Executive Assistant mate, ready for its first task.

name: Cat and Code: Signal Trail
description:
Help a cat bring a signal back to life, one wire at a time.

Rotate tiles to connect the fixed transmitter to every receiver. Connected wires glow as the signal spreads across the board. Progress through 24 circuits, from a compact first puzzle to larger networks with more branches.

• Four board sizes, from 3 × 3 to 6 × 6
• Hints that rotate one wire toward a solution
• A move counter and a circuit picker for replaying unlocked puzzles
• Progress saved on your device, ready for your next session

Play offline with no account, ads or purchases. Available in English and Russian.

name: Cat Browser - Web & Files
description:
Cat Browser is a clean browser where one panel at the bottom of the screen reaches everything — the address bar, tabs, files and menu. Photos, PDFs and videos you gather along the way live in the in-app Files, ready to sort and open.

■ A browser made for one hand
• Address bar, back, forward, tabs, files and menu sit together at the bottom
• Scroll down and the bar shrinks into a small capsule so you see more of the page
• Find on page, desktop mode, choose your search engine, hide page ads and trackers
• Swipe from the edge to go back or forward, long-press back for this tab's history

■ Private tabs
• Private tabs don't keep history or searches
• Lock private tabs with Face ID (Pro)

■ Bookmarks, history and memos
• Group favorite sites into bookmarks and folders
• Browse history by date and search it to find a page again
• Pin the page you're reading to a memo and organize with checklists, lists and tags

■ Files
• Bring in photos, PDFs and videos from Photos or Files and sort them into folders
• Pick photos and PDFs in order and merge them into one PDF
• Convert photos to PNG, HEIC, WEBP and more (1 free, then Pro)
• Bundle files into a ZIP (Pro) — anyone can open ZIP files
• Lock a folder so others can't open it (Pro)
• Deleted files stay in the Trash for a while so you can restore them

■ Player and image viewer
• Play your own videos and music in the in-app player
• Keep playing in in-app picture-in-picture · PiP over other apps with Pro
• Swipe through photos in the image viewer

■ And more
• Scan a QR code to open it right away
• Screenshot the visible screen, or capture a whole page in one image (Pro · or once per ad)
• Light and dark themes, English and Korean

■ Cat Browser Pro (auto-renewing subscription)
• Choose monthly or yearly
• Pro includes: private tab lock, folder lock, unlimited conversions, ZIP compression, PiP over other apps, full-page screenshots
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
• The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or turn off auto-renew in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mg-policy.pages.dev/privacy/catbrowser?lang=en
Contact: hodoristudio@naver.com

name: Catch It - QR Share
description:
Stop sharing your personal contact information just to give someone a destination. Catch It is a privacy-focused utility that turns any location or text into a QR code on your screen, ready to be scanned.

WHY USE CATCH IT?
Have you ever been in a taxi or a ride and needed to share your exact destination, but did not want to give the driver your phone number or a messaging account?

Catch It bridges that gap. It catches a link from Google Maps (or any other app) and turns it into a QR code on your screen. The driver scans it with the camera, and navigation opens on their phone. No messages sent, no numbers exchanged.

HOW IT WORKS:
