1. Open Google Maps and find your destination.
2. Tap Share and choose the Catch It icon.
3. Catch It instantly generates a QR code.
4. Show your screen to the driver or a friend to scan.
5. Done. You are on your way.

You can also type or paste any text or link into the field inside the app. Use COPY TO CLIPBOARD to copy the text, and Watch tutorial to replay the short first-launch guide.

KEY FEATURES:
• Instant share through the system Share sheet.
• No phone number, email, or social account required.
• Works with any text or link, and is especially useful for maps links.
• Light, simple, and fast.
• QR codes are generated on your device — you do not need a network connection to create the code.

THE CATCH IT MISSION:
In an era where digital privacy is shrinking, Catch It lets you share information in person without leaving a digital footprint. Keep your contact info yours. Just Catch It and show it.

name: Cây Gia Phả by Hinosoft
description:
Cây Gia Phả giúp bạn ghi chép dòng họ theo đúng cách trình bày phả đồ truyền thống, ngay trên điện thoại.

  BA CÁCH XEM MỘT CÂY
  • Gia đình: một người ở giữa, cha mẹ phía trên, anh chị em vuốt ngang, các con phía dưới. Chữ to, dễ đọc, hợp với cả người lớn tuổi.
  • Danh sách: phả ký thụt lề theo đời, chia theo chi, tìm tên không cần gõ dấu.
  • Phả đồ: cả cây theo hàng đời, phóng to thu nhỏ bằng hai ngón.

  GHI ĐÚNG CHUẨN GIA PHẢ
  • Mỗi đời một hàng; anh chị em xếp theo thứ tự sinh, con trưởng đứng đầu.
  • Mã d'Aboville tự tính: 1.2.1 là đời 3, chi 2.
  • Ký hiệu chuẩn: ô vuông nam, ô tròn nữ, gạch chéo đã mất, đường đôi vợ chồng.
  • Mỗi người: họ tên, năm sinh, năm mất, ngày giỗ âm lịch, quê quán, nơi an táng, tiểu sử, con nuôi, một hoặc nhiều vợ / chồng.

  CHIA SẺ VÀ SAO LƯU
  • Gửi ảnh phả đồ qua Zalo, Messenger hoặc mang đi in tranh.
  • Xuất bản sao lưu để mở lại trên máy khác.
  • Xuất tệp GEDCOM để dùng với phần mềm gia phả khác.

  RIÊNG TƯ
  Không cần tài khoản. Cây gia phả chỉ lưu trên điện thoại của bạn, ứng dụng không thu thập dữ liệu, không quảng cáo.

  Có sẵn cây mẫu 6 đời để xem thử trước khi tự ghi.

name: CCM Studio
description:
CCM Studio is a place to discover contemporary Christian music and create worship songs inspired by Scripture and prayer.

■ Listen without signing in
Explore the daily, weekly and all-time worship charts. Browse new releases, charts by style and themed albums, or search by song, album, songwriter or style. Follow the lyrics as the music plays.

■ Create worship songs with AI
Start with a Bible verse, a prayer topic or the mood you have in mind. Use AI to create lyrics, music and cover art, whether you're writing a theme song for your church or making a gift for someone you love. Generation limits apply. To use AI features, sign in, confirm that you're 18 or older and accept the generative AI terms. When you request generation, your input is sent to the relevant service providers.

■ Organize the songs you make
Collect your songs in albums and choose who can see them. New songs are public by default and can be made private later. Download your own songs as MP3s and download the subtitle files.

The main screens are available in English. Posted song titles, lyrics and album descriptions appear in the language in which they were written.

https://ccmstudio.ai/en/terms.html
https://ccmstudio.ai/en/privacy

name: CelLedger: Exposure Sheets
description:
Plan frame timing for hand-drawn and stop-motion shots. Add layers, enter drawing IDs and hold lengths, and scrub the frame ruler to see which drawing is active on each layer. Blank cells keep the layer clear while other layers continue.

Play the exposure cues at the project frame rate, track your total duration and share frame ranges as CSV. Save multiple shot plans and open a sample scene to learn the workflow.

CelLedger records planning cues and drawing labels. It works offline, without a camera, account or rendering service.

name: Centelha Comunidade
Central - Squad Up & Play
description:
Central is an iOS shooter built around short tactical runs in Port Ashton. Every drop gives you one objective: cut three uplinks, reach the yard, and get out. Each run ends with a report that shows your time, kills, and accuracy.

Runs start from the drop card on the Central tab. The card shows the live map, the players waiting in the yard, and how many are ready, so you can drop in as soon as you open the app.

A run goes better with a crew, so Central keeps a squad layer around the game. Chat with the crew you play with, build a squad from Friends, and compare run reports in Feed.

Safety sits in the same screens. Report and block from any profile or conversation, review your privacy and notification settings in Me, and delete your account from Me whenever you want.

privacy policy: https://centralod.com/privacy-policy
terms of service: https://centralod.com/terms-of-service
support: https://centralod.com/support

name: CepHafıza: Not & Hafıza Kasası
description:
Zihnini Ozgurlestir, Onemli Olan Hicbir Seyi Unutma!

CepHafiza; kisisel dusuncelerinizi, web baglantilarinizi, onemli notlarinizi ve anilarinizi guvenle saklayabileceginiz kisisel bir dijital hafiza ve ikinci beyin uygulamasidir.

TEMEL OZELLIKLER:

- Hizli Hafiza Yakalama:
Akliniza gelen parlak fikirleri, gunluk notlari veya okunacak makale baglantilarini saniyeler icinde kaydedin.

- Hafizana Sor:
Kaydettiginiz yuzlerce not ve baglanti arasinda kaybolmayin. Akilli arama ve filtreleme ozelligiyle aradiginiz her bilgiye aninda ulasin.

- Koleksiyonlar ve Etiketler:
Notlarinizi is, kisisel, projeler, okuma listesi gibi ozel kategorilere ayirin ve etiketlerle duzenleyin.

- Hatirlaticilar ve Gunluk Ozet:
Onemli gorevlerinizi ve gozden gecirmek istediginiz hafizalarinizi size hatirlatan akilli bildirim sistemi.

- %100 Cihaz Ici Guvenlik:
Notlariniz ve hafizalariniz varsayilan olarak tamamen kendi cihazinizda saklanir. Ucuncu taraflara hicbir kisisel veriniz aktarilmaz.

name: Chaino: Domi
description:
Welcome to Chaino: Domi, the ultimate domino strategy game that challenges your mind and sharpens your skills. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the world of dominoes, Chaino: Domi offers a fresh and exciting experience for everyone.

**Engage in Multiple Game Modes**
Discover various game modes to suit your mood and skill level. From the traditional Classic mode with no time limits to the fast-paced Quick Match, there's something for everyone. Try the Match Series for a best-of-three challenge or test your skills in All Fives, where strategy meets arithmetic.

**Sharpen Your Skills**
Practice makes perfect! Dive into our Practice modes, including Memory, where you flip tiles and match pairs, or Solitaire, where you build a chain and clear your hand. The Training mode lets you hone your placement skills, perfect for beginners and experts alike.

**Challenge Friends and AI**
Compete against friends or take on the AI with adjustable difficulty settings. Enable challenges for an extra layer of excitement and see who can build the longest chain.

**Track Your Progress**
Monitor your performance with detailed stats and unlock milestones as you play. Keep track of your wins, losses, and overall progress to become the ultimate Chaino master.

**Accessible and Customizable**
Chaino: Domi is designed with accessibility in mind. Enjoy features like large elements and simplified mode for an easy-to-navigate experience. Change language settings to play in your preferred language and make the game truly yours.

Join the Chaino community today and start building your domino empire. Download now and see how far your strategy skills can take you!

name: Chalet Arpian
description:
Arpian is the stay guide for Chalet Arpian, in Valmorel, Savoie, in the French Alps. The app is reserved for guests with a booking: you enter with your booking number, and the people traveling with you enter with your tribe code.

BEFORE YOU ARRIVE
- Online registration and rental agreement signature, from your phone.
- Directions by train or by car, and the weather.
- A reminder the day before you arrive and on the morning of arrival day.

AT THE CHALET
- Check-in, step by step, with your arrival time sent to our concierge.
- Wi-Fi and the ski room code, kept on your phone.
- Check-in and check-out inventories, filled in and signed in the app.
- How-to pages for the chalet: wood-fired hot tub and sauna, kitchen, Family Room.
- Upcoming departures of the Valmobus shuttle, which stops 50 meters from the chalet.
- The chalet shop: an extra pack of firewood, paid in the app, picked up from the locker cabinet.

ROGER, YOUR DIGITAL CONCIERGE
Roger is named after the man who founded the place in the 1970s. He answers your questions about the chalet and Valmorel at any hour, in English or in French. When a request is beyond him, he passes it on to our concierge or to your hosts, and the conversation continues in the app.

YOUR TRIBE
Shared stay dates, tasks divided up, common expenses with balances worked out, and polls to decide together.

AROUND THE CHALET
Things to do in Valmorel, summer and winter. The chalet's partners and their perks. Chef Sam, private chef, for meals at the chalet: packages from €23 per adult per day, drinks not included.

IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
An Emergency button at the top of every page walks you through it: the fire department first in case of fire, then an alert to our concierge and your hosts, which needs a connection. Instructions for fire, water leaks and power outages stay readable offline.

BUILT FOR THE MOUNTAINS
- Offline: pages, photos and instructions live in the app. Roger, the shuttle, messaging, online registration, inventories and the emergency alert need a connection.
- Stay reminders: before arrival and before departure, if you allow them.
- Shortcuts: press and hold the icon to open access codes, the shuttle, Roger or "If something goes wrong."
- Light or dark theme, in English and French.

Not booked yet? “Discover the chalet,” on the welcome screen, shows you the house and lets you book your stay.

One tribe. One chalet.

name: Charmius Comedy Fest
description:
Explore the festival program, discover comedy terminology, and put your creativity into practice. From browsing performances to writing your own punchlines, Charmius brings schedules, learning, and playful activities together.
 Browse performances by month, date, and stage. View show descriptions, starting times, durations, and age recommendations. Save favorites and share performance details.
 Invent a comedy stage name, explore writing prompts, and capture moments through photo activities. Save your responses, track your progress, and return to completed challenges to edit your work. Your entries stay on your device.
 Play Match Challenge by pairing definitions with the correct comedy terms. Choose your game length, play against the clock or without a time limit, and try to improve your personal best.
 Explore 33 festival facts and 50 comedy dictionary entries. Browse a selection of articles and videos about stand-up, improvisation, writing, and performance. Bookmark resources and follow related creative exercises.
 Explore 31 menu items with prices, vendor locations, ingredients, and allergen information. Search for a dish or filter by category. The menu is for browsing; ordering and payment take place at the counter.
 Search frequently asked questions or ask the offline Festival Assistant about shows, food, stages, and festival services.
 Your favorites, bookmarks, challenge entries, photos, and best game score are saved locally. Audience Choice lets you record a personal vote for a performance on your device.
 No account is required. The schedule and core activities are available offline. Linked articles and videos open on publishers’ websites and require an internet connection.

name: Chess: Animal Friends
description:
Chess for beginners: from the very first move to your first win against the Lion. A bright board, clear lessons and animal opponents to beat one after another.

SIX OPPONENTS
The Chick has just learned the moves, the Bunny grabs whatever it sees, the Kitten sometimes sets traps, the Fox is sly but makes mistakes, the Owl thinks several moves ahead and the Lion plays for real. Win a game and earn a star.

14 LESSONS FROM SCRATCH
The board and square names, how every piece moves, piece values, check and checkmate, castling, en passant, stalemate and the golden rules of the opening. You learn by doing: collect stars with the knight, capture pawns with the rook, give checkmate yourself.

100 CHECKMATE PUZZLES
60 mate-in-one and 40 mate-in-two puzzles, from easy to hard. Every puzzle has exactly one solution.

A COACH BY YOUR SIDE
If a move loses a piece or allows checkmate, the owl warns you, shows the opponent's reply with an arrow and lets you take the move back. There is also a best-move hint and an Undo button. The coach can be turned off.

TWO PLAYERS
Play with a friend or a parent on one iPhone or iPad.

HONEST
Free. No ads, no purchases, no links to outside websites. Works offline and collects no data. An unfinished game is saved automatically.

name: Chicken Rescue Squad
description:
A call comes in: a puppy under a porch, and a fire in the hall. Three specialists roll out, and you decide who hops where.
Chicken Rescue Squad is a puzzle game played on a tray of cups. Every hop is a beat, every job is a beat, and the fewer beats you need, the more stars you earn.

THE SQUAD
• Captain Cluck, firefighter: puts out a fire one cup away.
• Gear Hen, engineer: mends a crushed cup one cup away.
• Doctor Peep, medic: treats an animal one cup away.
Tap the trouble and the right one goes. Tap one of the squad, then a cup, to move them yourself. Water and missing cups are walls, and the three of them get in each other's way.

FORTY CALLS, EIGHT REGIONS
• Sunnybrook Town, Flooded Bay, Blazing Forest, Frozen Peaks, Thunder Valley, Desert Canyon, Volcano Island and Rescue Capital.
• Five calls in each. Answer one call in a region and the next region opens.
• Every call has a briefing: what is in the way, and how many beats three stars allow.
• Take a step back or start a call over at any time.

THE ALBUM
• 48 animals to bring home, six in every region. Each one is a sticker with a name and a line about how it was found.
• Nine badges for what the squad has done. Each pays stars once.

THE BASE
• Spend stars on the station: lookout, bunk room, canteen, workshop, sick bay, engine bay and kennel.
• Seven rooms, five levels each.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A squad drill teaches the game in five taps the first time you open it. It can be skipped, and run again from settings.
• Stars are earned by playing and spent at the base. They cannot be bought.
• No ads and no accounts. Progress is kept on your device, and the game plays without a connection.
• Sound and haptics can each be switched off.

name: ChimiRing
description:
ChimiRing is a game of skill, speed and strategy that tests your reflexes, your focus and your ability to make quick decisions.

Discover a competitive experience with unique mechanics, exciting challenges and multiple difficulty levels.

SORT, COMPETE AND CONQUER

- Sort the Chimi Rings in the shortest time possible.
- Challenge other players in 1v1 online duels.
- Beat your personal records.
- Climb to the top of the global leaderboard.
- Master different difficulty levels.
- Develop your own game strategy.
- Play offline, no Internet connection needed.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

Enjoy intuitive controls, smooth moves and a modern design. Every move counts, every second matters and every game is a new chance to prove your skill.

YOU SET THE PACE. YOU SET THE LIMIT.

Train, sharpen your technique and challenge players from all over the world.

Do you have what it takes to become the best ChimiRing player?

Take the challenge!

name: Chimney Chase
description:
A Christmas delivery run, one tap at a time.

Santa circles each chimney in his sleigh. Wait for the dotted beam to turn green, then tap to fly to the next rooftop. Drop a present down the chimney and watch the house come to life with Christmas lights and curling smoke.

Keep moving before the village scrolls away. Every ten deliveries brings a new level, with a gentle first level to help you get started. Miss your launch and Santa heads home with a ho-ho-ho and a shower of stars.

- Simple one-tap controls
- Snowy rooftops, cobbled streets and decorated Christmas trees
- Christmas music, sleigh bells and delivery effects
- A best score saved on your device
- Pause and resume whenever you like
- Native iPhone and iPad layouts, including iPad landscape
- Works offline

The whole game is free. No purchases, no account, no tracking and no third-party adverts. Includes links to other Westsmith games.

name: Chloe: Film Club
description:
Chloe is a local-first film club for people who stay for the credits.

Browse screenings near you, save a seat, host your own night, and keep the conversation going after the film. See the venue, the time, the host, and the conversation prompt before you join.

WATCH
Search and filter sample screenings by genre. Open a screening to see the film, place, time, seats, and host. Join or leave a seat, save it to your shortlist, or message the host.

HOST
Publish a screening with a title, description, place, time, and genre. Your screening appears at the top of the list and stays available after a relaunch.

CHATS
Open a conversation with a host or member. Messages are stored on your device; replies are local simulated samples. Report or block a person from the relevant screen. Reports and blocks stay on this device.

ME
Edit your name, city, and bio. See joined, hosted, and chat counts. Open the privacy policy, terms, support, and delete your account.

LOCAL 1.0
Chloe 1.0 is a local prototype. Your profile, screenings, messages, reports, and blocks stay on your iPhone. There is no Chloe account server, no analytics, no advertising, no push notification, and no in-app purchase. Sign in with Apple is handled by Apple. All people and screenings are fictional sample content.

Chloe is intended for users 18 and over.

name: Chợ Nail
description:
Chợ Nail is the marketplace of the nail industry: jobs, salons for sale, techs looking for work, a directory of nail salons and supply prices, all in one place, in English and Vietnamese.

NAIL JOBS
• More than 4,800 nail jobs across the US, newest first.
• Filter by state, skill (acrylic, dip, gel, mani-pedi, wax) and whether housing is offered.
• Turn on "Near me" to see only the jobs around you, nearest first.
• See how the pay compares with what's usual in that state.

SALONS FOR SALE
• More than 2,800 nail salons for sale, with the price, chairs, tables and rent.
• See whether the price is fair next to similar salons.
• Estimate a loan to buy the salon.

NAIL SUPPLIES
• Compare more than 32,000 products at 34 US nail supply stores: gel, dip, acrylic, tools.
• See the cheapest store, how the price has moved and what's in stock.
• Get an alert when the price drops or it's back in stock; keep a supplies list for your salon.

TECHS AND THE DIRECTORY
• Nail techs looking for work, by skill and place.
• A directory of more than 70,000 nail salons, with maps, hours and reviews.

POST AN AD
• Post a job, a salon for sale or equipment, with photos. Edit or take it down any time.
• Message people in the app without showing your phone number or email.

Chợ Nail doesn't sell your data or track you across other apps. Your location is only turned into the nearest zip code and is not kept.

name: Chocks – Flight Checklist
description:
Chocks is a free app for building checklists for your aircraft and running them in the cockpit with one hand. It works offline and your checklists stay on your device.

IMPORTANT NOTICE
This is a reference aid. The aircraft's flight manual (POH/AFM) is the only valid source. The app does not replace flight training or the manual: always check every checklist against your aircraft's manual.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Create an aircraft from scratch or start from a generic template (single- or twin-engine piston) and adapt it to your manual.
• Organize checklists by phase: preflight, engine start, taxi, run-up, takeoff, cruise, approach, landing, shutdown and postflight.
• Write each item as challenge and response, and mark critical items.
• Use cockpit mode: one item at a time, a large DONE button, undo and progress always visible.
• Open emergencies with one tap from any screen.
• Hear each item with the phone's read-aloud voice.
• Write down clearances in the ATC notepad: runway, heading, altitude, squawk, QNH, wind, ATIS and frequencies.
• Share a checklist with your school or fellow pilots as a file or as QR codes, and import it by scanning the codes.
• Choose a dark theme for night or a light theme for day.
• Use it on tablets and foldables with a split layout.
• Use it in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, Italian, French or German.

PRIVACY
• No accounts, no ads. Only anonymous usage statistics and crash reports, which you can turn off in Settings.
• The camera is used only to read QR codes on the device; no image is saved or sent.
• Sharing or exporting happens only when you ask for it.

Chocks is free and has no in-app purchases.

name: ChoreOFF
description:
ChoreOFF helps you get home jobs done by local pros. Describe the job, pick up to 3 pros, compare their prices and book the one you want.

Free for homeowners and renters. You never pay ChoreOFF. You pay the pro you book for the job, the way you agree with them.

ANY HOME JOB
Lawn care, snow removal, cleaning, junk removal, handyman work, moving help and furniture assembly, plus home trades like roofing, painting, plumbing and electrical. Not sure what to call it? Pick "Something else" and describe it.

PICK YOUR PROS
See local pros with their own prices, years in business, ratings from homeowners who booked them, and their insurance, registration and license details. Pick up to 3, or tap "Choose for me".

COMPARE PRICES
Each pro you picked sends a price or passes. A price can be fixed, an estimate, per hour or per visit, with up to 3 days they can come. Pick the price you like and the day that works. No obligation.

YOUR DETAILS STAY WITH YOU
Pros see your job, not your contact details. When you book a pro, you both get each other's contact details. Pros you did not book never see them.

MESSAGES
Ask each pro about your job before you book.

ALERTS
Turn on alerts to hear when a pro sends a price or a message. Tap an alert to open that job.

PHOTOS
Add photos of the job from your camera or your library, so pros can price it right.

RATE YOUR PRO
After the job, rate the pro you booked. Only homeowners who booked a pro can rate them.

SIGN IN WITH A CODE
Sign in with your email and a 6 digit code. No password.

ChoreOFF does not do the work and does not employ the pros. Pros are independent local businesses that set their own prices.

name: Chrono Siege War Game
description:
Command your army across six ages of history and beyond, and destroy the enemy citadel before yours falls!

Chrono Siege is a fast, easy-to-learn lane-battle strategy game. Train units, earn gold and XP from every kill, and evolve your civilization from the fiery Ember Age through the Iron, Steam and Diesel ages, into the glowing Neon age and finally the mighty Aether age. Every age brings new warriors, new war machines, new turrets and a new devastating special strike.

FEATURES
• SIX AGES TO CONQUER – Ember, Iron, Steam, Diesel, Neon and Aether, each with its own look, units and weapons
• TRAIN YOUR ARMY – Melee fighters, ranged attackers and heavy war machines. Pick the right mix to break the enemy line
• BUILD TURRETS – Defend your citadel with turrets that upgrade as you evolve
• SPECIAL STRIKES – Call down meteors, rain, bombs and more at the perfect moment
• SKILL TREE – Earn skill points from battle and upgrade damage, health, income, XP gain, turrets and citadel strength. Unlock Rally Cry and Field Medic abilities
• SUPPLY CRATES – Catch parachuting crates for gold, XP, healing, damage boosts, freezes and citadel shields
• THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS – Easy, Normal and Hard, with a smart enemy that keeps you on your toes
• QUICK TUTORIAL – Jump straight into the action with guided tips
• BUILT FOR TOUCH – Smooth controls on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape

Easy to pick up, hard to master. Will you rule the ages?

Made by aDev Games.

name: Churchfront Plans
description:
Plans puts Churchfront plan sets on your iPhone and iPad, ready to use on site with or without signal.

• Every sheet of the set, kept on the device for working offline
• Mark up with Apple Pencil or your finger: pens, highlighters, shapes, clouds, callouts, text and photos
• Shared markups the whole team sees, and Personal markups only you see
• Pull past the edge of a sheet to turn to the next one
• On iPad, view two or four sheets at once, each with its own sheet list
• Search the words on every sheet
• Check off cables and devices as they are installed
• Print cable and device labels on Brady printers

Plans is for Churchfront staff. Sign in with the email address on your Churchfront account, or tap "Try a sample plan set" to explore a sample church's plans without an account.

name: Cinder
description:
Fly a paper kite up through an autumn dusk. Steer through drifting maple leaves, reel in your string, and climb from glowing rooftops all the way to the starfield.

STEER, REEL, CLIMB
Drag anywhere to steer. Hold your finger still, or add a second finger, to reel in and climb faster. Every reel raises the string tension, so let go before the meter turns red or the string snaps. Keep some tension in smoke downdrafts or your kite sags and drifts away. It is easy to learn and hard to put down.

A SKY THAT CHANGES AS YOU RISE
Climb through five skies: Rooftops, Maple Canopy, Lantern Festival, Aurora and Starfield. Ride flowing wind ribbons and golden updrafts, brace for gust warnings, dodge crows and slip around chimney smoke. Gather glowing embers to raise your score multiplier and catch coins drifting on the breeze.

THREE WAYS TO FLY
- Classic: an endless climb for your best score.
- Festival Flights: 32 handcrafted flights with goal heights, ember targets and string rules, each worth up to 3 stars.
- Daily Challenge: the same seeded wind map for every pilot, with its own leaderboard that resets each day.

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Open the Locker to unlock 12 kite designs, from Paper Crane and Ember Moth to Harvest Moon and Starling, plus 8 tail ribbons, some of which glow. Pick up Steady String to save a snapping string once, or Updraft Start to launch 100 m higher.

GOALS EVERY DAY
Complete 20 missions for coin rewards, claim a 7-day Daily Gift calendar, follow your progress in Pilot Stats, and compete on All-time and Today leaderboards.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play as a guest with no sign-up, or create an optional free account with email and password to keep your progress safe across devices. You can delete your data or your account at any time from Settings.

FRIENDLY AND FAIR
No ads. A short hands-on flight school teaches the controls on your first flight. Coins are earned by flying, missions and daily gifts. Optional coin packs are available in the Shop if you want to unlock things sooner, but every kite, ribbon and boost can be earned for free.

Original papercraft art and plucked-string sounds made for this game. Catch the wind and see how high your kite can climb.

name: City Shoots 3D
description:
Find your shooting rhythm on 3D basketball courts inspired by parks and city landmarks around the world.

Drag to aim and release to shoot. Follow the trajectory guide to practice clean swishes, bank shots and scoring streaks.

• Endless stages with rising score targets.
• Shooting distance and the trajectory guide change as your score within a stage grows.
• Random city courts with distinctive scenery.
• Achievements for scoring streaks, swishes and high scores.
• Optional pre-stage rewards for a longer aiming guide or extra attempts.
• Play as a guest without creating an account.
• Sign in with Apple or Google for cloud saves and leaderboards.

Play in English or Simplified Chinese. The game follows your device language; you can change it on the sign-in screen or in Settings.

name: Clack: Retro Instant Camera
description:
Clack turns your iPhone Duo into a real instant camera.

Open it like a camera. Press the big orange shutter. Clack. Your photo slides out, still blank, and slowly develops while you hold it. Give it a shake if you can't wait.

No feeds, no sliders, no endless retakes. One press, one photo, one moment you actually keep.

WHY CLACK
• Feels like the real thing: a camera body you hold, a shutter you press, a print that ejects
• Photos develop in front of you, with the soft colors and grain of instant film
• The classic white frame on every shot, ready to save or share
• Sounds and haptics that make every shot satisfying
• Designed for iPhone Duo from the first pixel: both screens, the fold, the whole object

MADE FOR
• Parties, trips and weekends you want to remember differently
• Friends who miss disposable and analog cameras
• Anyone tired of taking 40 photos and keeping none

Shoot. Eject. Shake. Keep.

name: Claudeck
description:
Claudeck runs your Claude Code instances on your Windows PC, sorted into projects. This app is its companion: it shows the same instances on your phone, live, and lets you step in when Claude needs you.

• See every instance and its state at a glance: working, asks a question, done, ready or asleep
• Open an instance to watch its screen and read the last prompts and answers
• Answer Claude's questions with a tap, or use the arrow, Enter and Esc keys
• Send a new prompt from anywhere; it goes straight into Claude on your PC
• Wake a sleeping instance or stop one that is working
• Get a notification when Claude finishes or waits for you
• Several PCs on one account, each in its own tab

End-to-end encrypted: everything your PC sends is encrypted with a key derived from your password. The Claudeck server only passes it on and cannot read it, and your password never leaves your devices.

How to start: install Claudeck on your PC (claudeck.io), sign in to your Claudeck account there and switch on "Control from the phone" in Settings > Phone. Then sign in here with the same account.

Claudeck is an independent product by LivePick s.r.o. and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.

name: Clearpage Browser
description:
Clearpage is a browser for iPhone built for pages that run in front of people.

FULL SCREEN
Hide the address bar and the status bar so your page fills the whole display. Swipe down with three fingers to bring the bar back. Each favorite remembers how it should open.

APP CLIP
Choose one of your favorites as your App Clip page. A link or an NFC tag opens that page on any iPhone in seconds, with nothing to install. Change the page in the app and every tag you have handed out opens the new one.

NFC TAGS
Write your App Clip link to an NFC tag from inside the app.

FAVORITES
Save pages with their own icon and colour, and choose how each one opens.

FOR PAGES YOU TRUST
Pages on sites you saved as favorites can use haptics, the volume buttons, Bluetooth accessories and a direct link between two iPhones. Every other page is an ordinary web page. Access is switched off again each time a new page loads.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your favorites and history stay on your iPhone.

name: ClearRead: Medicine Magnifier
description:
ClearRead is crafted specifically for seniors and anyone tired of squinting at tiny prescription bottles, ingredient lists, and restaurant menus.

KEY FEATURES
• Ultra-Sharp Live Magnifier: Smooth zoom with torch control and instant freeze-frame inspection.
• On-Device Vision OCR & Voice Readout: Snap any tiny medicine label and hear it read aloud clearly — 100% offline.
• High-Contrast Senior UI: Extra-large typography and zero confusing clutter.
• 100% Private & Offline: Camera never uploads a single frame to any cloud server.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited saved scans, custom voice speed, and high-contrast themes forever.

name: ClearToCoach: Coach Clearances
description:
ClearToCoach helps league administrators, volunteer coordinators and club registrars keep track of the background-check, safety-training and education dates of every coach and volunteer, and see at a glance who is cleared this week.

ClearToCoach is a record-keeping and reminder tool. It does not perform, order, verify or validate background checks, trainings or certifications, and it is not an official verification or screening service. Statuses reflect only the dates your organization enters.

WHO IS CLEARED THIS WEEK
- The home view groups everyone by team with a clear badge: Cleared, Expiring soon, Pending or Not cleared. Every badge has an icon and a word, never just a color.
- A summary such as "38 cleared · 4 expiring · 2 not cleared".
- See this week, next week or any week. If something lapses mid-week, the badge says when ("Lapses Thu").
- Show only problems, filter by team, tap anyone for details.
- Game day check: pick a team and a date to see who may be on the bench that day.
- Share the roster as a PDF made on your phone, as a CSV, or copy it as text.

YOUR OWN POLICY
- Start from editable examples: background check, abuse-prevention training, concussion awareness training, CPR / first aid, coaching education / license and code of conduct acknowledgment. Rename them, change them or add your own.
- For each requirement: how long it stays valid (every N months, one-time, or a fixed date each year such as Aug 31), which roles need it, and how many days ahead it counts as expiring soon.
- Change the policy and every status updates right away.

PEOPLE AND DATES
- Add people one at a time, paste a list ("Jordan Lee, Head coach, U10 Hawks") with a preview, or import a CSV file.
- Roles such as head coach, assistant coach, team manager, volunteer, board member and referee/official, plus your own.
- For each requirement record completed, pending or waived (with a reason). The valid-until date is calculated from your policy, and you can override it.
- Renewals are kept as history.
- Search and filter by team, role and status. Deactivate people who have left.

ATTENTION LIST AND REMINDERS
- One list of everything expired, missing, expiring soon or pending, most urgent first, with "Record renewal" right there.
- "Send a renewal note" fills in a friendly message you can edit and send yourself through your phone's share sheet.
- Optional reminders on this phone: choose 60, 30, 7 days before, the expiry day and more, plus a weekly digest. Lock-screen text shows counts, not names, unless you change it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything stays on this device. No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.
- ClearToCoach makes no network connections. Code54 doesn't receive your data.
- Only names, roles, teams, short notes and dates are stored. There are no fields for birthdates, ID numbers, documents or background-check results.
- Optional 4-digit app lock.
- Back up to a file and restore or merge with a preview. Export people and statuses as CSV. Erase all data in Settings.

TRY THE SAMPLE LEAGUE
Explore a fictional youth soccer league with 30 adults on 6 teams to see the roster, the attention list and reminders in seconds. Remove it whenever you like.

Your organization sets its own requirements and is responsible for the accuracy of the dates it records. Exported files say: "Dates entered by your organization; not an official verification." Questions: support@code54.dev

name: Clefino
description:
Read music like you read words.

Clefino teaches you to read sheet music a few minutes a day: a couple of notes at a time, then real songs that use only what you've learned. No experience needed: you'll play your first song from real sheet music in about two minutes.

PLAY ON YOUR OWN PIANO
Put your phone on the music stand and play. Clefino listens through the microphone and hears each note you play, even when the last one is still ringing. Got a MIDI keyboard? Connect it by cable or Bluetooth for every note, instantly, chords included. No piano? Clefino has a real keyboard on the screen: hold keys, play chords, slide across.

LEARN, THEN PLAY
• Short lessons teach where each note sits, with a rhyme to remember it.
• Every chapter ends with a song: Quaver rides the music and you play each note as it reaches him. Hit it right on time for a Perfect.
• Treble clef, bass clef and alto clef; rhythm from quarter notes to dotted notes, rests and time signatures; real signs like repeats, D.C. al Fine and dynamics.
• Then both hands together on the grand staff.

100 SONGS THAT FEEL LIKE MUSIC
• Folk tunes, Christmas carols, campfire songs and classics, from Twinkle, Twinkle and Away in a Manger to Für Elise, The Blue Danube and Canon in D.
• Learn each song in steps: half speed, then ¾ speed, then full speed, then mastered.
• Backing chords play along with you, and sing-along songs show the words under the notes.
• Every note is a real recorded piano.
• Stuck on a passage? Clefino finds the bars you miss so you can practise just those, slower, then go back to the whole song.
• Early or late? Clefino tells you, so your timing gets steady too.
• Play songs with both hands once you've learned the grand staff.

REALLY READ, EVERY DAY
• Three brand-new tunes are made for you each day from the notes you know. You've never seen them, so you truly read them, not play from memory.
• Daily practice brings back the notes you miss or read slowly.
• The weekly challenge: how many notes can you read in 60 seconds?

SEE YOURSELF GET FASTER
Clefino times every note you read. Watch your seconds per note fall week after week, and see exactly which notes still slow you down.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Import any score as MusicXML (from MuseScore, your teacher or a free score library) and practise it like any song.

MELODY VILLAGE
Every note you read builds your village: seven note houses grow from tents to cottages as you read them right. Practice earns keys for music boxes full of outfits for Quaver and decorations, earned, never sold.

FOR EVERYONE
Adult beginners, returning players, students who want to read faster, singers, guitarists, violinists and cellists. Name the notes with letters (C D E) or Do Re Mi. Up to six learners on one device, each with their own progress. On iPhone and iPad. Calm, with no ads.

CLEFINO PLUS
Clefino is free to start. Clefino Plus unlocks every song pack, free revives, double coins and seasonal outfits, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://sarigames.com/clefino/privacy/

name: CliffsMe
description:
CliffsMe reads your email, messages, calendar and feeds, then hands you a private edition of only what matters: the birthday you'd hate to miss, the decision waiting on you, the one story your world is talking about.

YOUR WHOLE DAY, IN ONE VIEW
• Today: the one thing that needs you first, then what's moving in work, life, people and the world
• Personal and Work editions, each with a one-line pulse and the stories behind it
• To-dos pulled out of your messages for you, plus everything you're waiting on from other people
• Social: photos and updates from your people, without the endless scroll
• News: headlines grouped by the topics you follow, one card per story however many outlets ran it

CONNECT THE PLACES YOUR DAY HAPPENS
Gmail, Microsoft Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn and the news topics you follow. Connect several accounts of the same service and choose which ones count as work and which as personal. Every story links back to the original message, so you reply where it belongs.

BUILT TO READ, NEVER TO POST
• Read-only access wherever a platform offers it. CliffsMe never sends, posts, deletes or changes anything for you.
• Access tokens are encrypted on our servers and never stored on your phone.
• Raw items are deleted after 30 days by default. Disconnect a source and its data goes with it.
• Your data isn't sold, shared with advertisers or used to train AI models.
• Delete your account and everything in it from inside the app, any time.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT RESPECT YOUR TIME
Your morning edition when it's ready, critical items as they arrive, and the reminders you set, with quiet hours so evenings stay yours.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: Climb Kids: inglés en familia
description:
Climb Kids es la app de inglés de Climb para que cada niño de la familia aprenda a su ritmo, de 6 a 12 años.

Cada día, una aventura corta en Climb Peak: una historia con Cima y sus amigos, palabras con dibujos y audio, juegos para escuchar y tocar, frases para armar y misiones en el mapa. Y 10 juegos para practicar: Globos, Memoria, Atrapa la palabra, Cima dice, ¿Cuál se fue?, Letra a letra, Ship or sheep?, Sopa de letras, Carrera de frases y ¿Verdad o mentira? Las palabras vuelven en el repaso justo cuando hacen falta, y cada actividad da estrellas para vestir a tu personaje.

Para madres, padres y tutores:
· Creas los perfiles desde Climb → Familia y vinculas el dispositivo con tu PIN.
· Informe semanal: lo que ya puede hacer, lo que le cuesta y una idea para jugar juntos.
· Tiempo diario a tu medida.
· Sin anuncios, sin compras dentro de la app, sin chat y sin inteligencia artificial.
· Guardamos lo mínimo: apodo, edad, personaje y progreso. Nunca fotos, nombres reales ni grabaciones.

Requiere una cuenta de Climb. La primera aventura de cada niño es gratis; Climb Kids completo, para hasta 4 niños, está incluido en Climb Family.

name: Clip Repeater: Audio to WAV
description:
Turn one clip into a practice track. Choose an audio file, select a phrase, set how many times it repeats and how long to pause between repeats, and get a new WAV file that plays in any audio player.

Useful for practicing a spoken phrase, a line from a script, a language drill or a rehearsal cue: you hear the clip, you get a pause to say it back, and it repeats.

HOW IT WORKS
- Choose one M4A (AAC), WAV (PCM) or MP3 file from Files.
- Select the clip on the waveform strip, or type exact Start and End times.
- Choose 1 to 100 repeats and a pause of 0 to 30 seconds. The pause goes between repeats only, never after the last one.
- See the exact length and file size before anything is made. Five seconds repeated ten times with two-second pauses is exactly 1:08.000.
- Play a short example built the same way as the full file.
- Generate the WAV, play it, then Save WAV to Files or Share WAV.

PRECISE AND PREDICTABLE
- Start is included and End is not, both rounded to the nearest sample of your file.
- Output is standard 16-bit PCM WAV at 44.1 kHz. Mono stays mono, stereo stays stereo.
- Pauses are true digital silence.
- Optional soft edges add a 4 ms fade to each repeat so the joins don't click, without changing the length. Turn them off to keep every sample exactly as decoded.
- Every file is checked before you can save it: its WAV header, frame count and playback length must match the plan.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics, no uploads.
- The app reads only the file you choose in Files. No microphone, no recording, no music library access.
- Your original file is never changed. Working files are temporary, excluded from backups and removed when you clear them or the app next starts.

Audio Repeat File is a one-time paid download with everything included: no subscription and no in-app purchases. Generated files are limited to 30 minutes, a technical limit that keeps each job within the storage and time an iPhone handles comfortably.

Copy-protected, multichannel, damaged and unsupported files are not opened. Only use audio you have permission to use and share.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/audio-repeat-file/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/audio-repeat-file/terms

name: ClipWave Pro: Audio Editor
description:
Tired of audio editors that lock export behind a weekly subscription the moment you finish your work?

ClipWave Pro is a one-time purchase audio studio. Pay once and own every feature forever—zero subscriptions, zero in-app purchases, zero ads, and zero account sign-ups.

EVERY PRO AUDIO TOOL, UNLOCKED FROM DAY ONE

• 5-Track Audio Mixing & Editing
Layer voice recordings, background music, and sound effects across up to 5 independent tracks. Split, duplicate, ripple-delete, adjust clip volume, speed, pitch, fades, EQ, and reverb with 30-step Undo/Redo.

• Millisecond-Accurate Trimming
Zoom into high-contrast waveforms, set exact start/end points down to 0.001s with fine-tune steppers (+/− 300ms) or a precision minute/second/millisecond wheel picker.

• Seamless Audio Merge & Medley
Combine multiple recordings in any order, balance individual clip volumes, preview transitions, and apply automatic 0.2s micro-crossfades for click-free joins.

• Batch Video-to-Audio Extraction
Select videos directly from Photos or Files and extract crisp audio tracks in batches—with instant preview and custom sample rate or bitrate controls.

• Lossless & Universal Format Conversion
Import MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, ALAC, and AAC files, and export cleanly to M4A, lossless WAV, FLAC, Apple Lossless (ALAC), AAC, or M4R (ringtone workflow)—paired with a tactile Vinyl Super Player for instant preview and one-tap actions.

DESIGNED FOR PRIVACY & RELIABILITY

• 100% On-Device Offline Engine: Your private voice memos, lectures, and personal videos never leave your device. Works at full speed even in Airplane Mode.
• 5-Channel Fast Import: Import from Files, Photos, external app Share Sheets, built-in Voice Recorder, wireless sharing, or local Wi-Fi transfer.
• Local Auto-Saved Drafts: Interrupted mid-edit? Every multi-track and trim project saves automatically on your device.

PAY ONCE, USE FOREVER
• One upfront purchase unlocks the complete app permanently.
• No recurring subscriptions, no watermarks, no export limits, and Family Sharing supported.

name: Cliq Club
description:
Cliq Club is a small, private, invite-only club for friends aged 13 and over. You can only join with an invite link from a friend who's already in.

• Chats with friends, and group chats called Circles
• Voice and video calls, 1-to-1 or in a Circle, that ring on your lock screen like a normal phone call, with AirPods, Bluetooth and CarPlay
• Cliq Cam: take a photo with fun face filters and send it as a Cliq
• A feed, stories that disappear after a day, and little games to play together
• Cliqs: keep your streak going by chatting every day

Made to be safe:
• Only friends can message or call you. Block, unfriend or report anyone with a tap; reports go to the grown-ups who run the club and are looked at within 24 hours
• No ads, no tracking, no selling your information
• Messages and photos are deleted after 3 months, and you can delete your account at any time
• Calls go straight between phones and are never recorded

name: Clovis Coaching
CNC Dash Board
description:
CNC Dash Board tính chương trình tiện CNC từ chính các con số trên bản vẽ. Chọn biên dạng giống chi tiết, điền đường kính, chiều dài, góc, bán kính — app tự tính điểm tiếp tuyến, tâm cung, đường dao và in G-code, kèm mô phỏng dao chạy từng lớp.

KHÔNG CÒN TÍNH TAY
• Không phải ngồi tính tan, sin, điểm tiếp tuyến rồi gạch sửa: nhập số trên bản vẽ là có toạ độ mọi điểm.
• Hình xem trước vẽ lại ngay khi gõ, có ⌀, chiều dài, góc và tên điểm như bản vẽ.
• Tham số mẫu lấy từ chi tiết thật: chạm một lần là điền đủ ô.

THẤY ĐƯỜNG DAO TRƯỚC KHI CHẠY MÁY
• Mô phỏng 2D từng lớp cắt thô và lượt tinh; dòng G-code đang chạy được tô sáng.
• Bản vẽ 図 đủ kích thước, phóng to cung nhỏ để đọc điểm tiếp tuyến.
• Chi tiết 3D xoay, phóng to được.

29 BIÊN DẠNG
• Tiện ngoài: côn, cung, trụ, vai, rãnh, gờ tròn, vòng đệm cầu…
• Lỗ trong: lỗ côn, rãnh trong, ổ cầu.
• Tiện ren hệ mét M và ren inch UN, có đường kính trung bình, chiều sâu ren và dung sai 6g / 6H.
• Máy tính gia công: tốc độ cắt, vòng quay, độ nhám, bước tiến, công suất, mũi khoan ta-rô, dung sai lắp ghép, đối chiếu mác thép.

BẢN PRO (MUA MỘT LẦN, KHÔNG THUÊ BAO)
• Phay bằng trục C trên máy tiện: đa giác, mặt bích, chữ nhật, cung G19, lỗ ngang, chấu mềm, tiện lệch tâm — có mô phỏng 3D.
• Nhiều frame (tới 10 đoạn côn / trụ / vai) cho CR và NKE RCR.
• Thêm chương trình FANUC G71 / G70 và OKUMA (LAP G85 / G87) cho các biên dạng tiện.
• Ren ống R / Rc / PT, Rp / Ps, G / PF.
Bản miễn phí dùng đầy đủ các biên dạng tiện, ren M / UN và máy tính gia công.

Giao diện tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh. Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không thu thập dữ liệu.

AN TOÀN: luôn kiểm tra chương trình, số dao, M-code và gốc Z với máy của bạn, chạy thử không cắt trước khi gia công. CNC Dash Board là công cụ hỗ trợ tính toán; người vận hành chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng về chương trình chạy trên máy.

name: Cờ Tướng - Chinese Chess
description:
Erlebe klassisches Chinesisches Schach (Xiangqi / Cờ Tướng) in moderner, eleganter Holz-Optik.

Highlights:
• 3 Spielmodi: Lokaler 2-Spieler-Modus, herausfordernde KI-Gegner & Online-Multiplayer via Raum-Code
• Taktische Zughilfen: Klare Schritt- und Schlagmarkierungen
• Fischer-Zeituhr: Einstellbare Zeitmodi für schnelle oder strategische Partien
• Hochwertiges 3D-Design: Realistische Holz-Textur und detaillierte Spielfiguren
• Offline spielbar: Trainiere jederzeit gegen die KI

name: Co-Writer: Song & Vocal Hook
description:
Got a melody stuck in your head? Hum it. Co-Writer turns four bars of your voice into a hook you can sing, share, and build into a song.

HUM IT
Record a four-bar hum or a rough-sung line. Co-Writer reads your notes, fits chords to them, and loops your own voice over a studio band.

WRITE IT
Get four lyric lines sized to the rhythm you hummed, with the stressed syllables marked. Swipe a line to rewrite it, tap the lock to keep it, and pick a scene or a rhyme feel to steer the words.

FLIP IT
Hear your melody three new ways with Flip My Melody: Lift, Bounce, and Color. Change key, tempo, and band style in a tap: Dark-Pop, Pop-Rock, Nu-Funk, Acoustic, Alt-Rock, R&B, and EDM.

SHARE IT
Make a vertical video clip of your hook with the lyrics on screen. Save your hooks in My Hooks and come back to them.

BUILD THE SONG
Open Song Studio to write Verse 1, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Verse 2, Bridge, and Outro, then export a 44.1 kHz WAV or a 3-track MIDI file for your DAW.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your recordings are analyzed on your iPhone. No account is needed.

CO-WRITER PRO
Free: three hums, a preview of Lift, a few lyric spins, and one saved hook.
Pro: unlimited hums and spins, every Flip My Melody mode, Song Studio, WAV and MIDI export, and clips without the Co-Writer tag.

Co-Writer Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription ($11.99 per month in the US; price varies by region) with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the trial ends. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://velvetbluecreative.com/privacy

name: Codex Ticket
description:
Codex Ticket is the workplace help desk for companies with several offices and teams.

Staff open a ticket for IT, HR, Finance, Design or any department in seconds. The ticket goes straight to the right team, and everyone can follow it until it is resolved.

TICKETS
• Open requests to any department, with category, priority, photos, videos and files
• Replies, internal notes, assignment, forwarding and status changes
• Advanced search across ticket numbers, subjects, replies and file names

SLA AND OFFICE HOURS
• First-response and resolution targets per priority
• Each office uses its own time zone, business hours and holidays
• Warnings before a target is missed and alerts when it is

PROCESSES
• Reusable templates such as onboarding or month-end closing
• Each step becomes a ticket for the right team, in the right order
• Checklists and a linked Google Sheet for finance steps

DASHBOARD AND REPORTS
• Live figures per office, department, team and person
• Daily report and Excel (CSV) export

FOR ADMINISTRATORS
• Branches, departments, teams, categories, SLA policies and business hours
• Per-person permissions and manager scopes
• Each company’s data is fully separated

Accounts are created by your company administrator; there is no public sign-up. Sign-in uses your password plus a code sent to your email, or Google.

name: CofferDual
description:
CofferDual tidies up your iPhone and Mac. No ads, no account needed, and your data stays on your device.

WHAT IT DOES
• File and photo cleanup: finds exact duplicate photos, duplicate and unneeded files. It asks before deleting anything.
• Contacts cleanup and merge: deletes empty and exact duplicate entries and combines same-name contacts into one (phones, emails and addresses are kept; the notes field is not carried over). It saves a vCard backup first, and importing that file undoes the change.
• Notes and agenda: your notes and tasks in one place. Notifications arrive on time, and you can answer "Done" or "In 10 min" right from them.
• Widget access: Control Center buttons open meeting recording or note-from-image in one tap (iOS 18 and later).
• Password vault and 2FA codes: opens with Face ID or PIN and stays in the Keychain.

WHY COFFERDUAL
• No ads.
• Everything runs on-device. No server, and your data stays yours.
• Free every month: 50 deletes, 10 contact merges, 10 notes or reminders.
• No subscription: one optional one-time purchase unlocks everything. You pay once and can restore the purchase. The price is shown in the App Store for your country.

Requires iOS 17 or later, and macOS 14 or later for Mac. Available in ten languages.

name: coLAB Cowork
description: The coLAB app provides members and visitors with a convenient way to access and manage their coLAB accounts. Use the app to unlock doors with your digital key, reserve meeting rooms, manage your membership, communicate with fellow coLAB members and staff, stay informed about community updates, view billing information, and access your available account benefits. The app serves as a central place to manage your coLAB experience, providing easy access to the tools, information, and community connections you need to make the most of your workspace. Change the Way You Work.

name: College Football TV Schedule
description:
What's on, where to watch it and when it kicks off, in your time zone. Every FBS and FCS game, every week, through the bowls and the playoff.

- Each game's network or stream (ABC, ESPN, FOX, CBS, ESPN+, Peacock and more), with new channel picks tagged as they are announced
- Kickoff in Eastern, Central, Mountain or Pacific time
- Live scores and the game clock
- Filter by Power 4, Top 25, one conference, your team, free TV, cable or streaming
- Game alerts: tap the bell on any game, or follow a team, and get a notification at kickoff or 15, 30 or 60 minutes before
- Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: this week's schedule, every game on now, and close games worth switching to
- Spot a wrong channel? Tap "Wrong channel?" and tell us

Free, with no account and no ads.

name: College Futures League
description:
Draft college football schools with your league and follow the points every Saturday. Join with an invitation from your commissioner, manage your roster, and see how each game affects the standings.

Bid in a live auction or make picks in turn. Replay a draft to see where each school landed. Check school schedules and scoring details, compare owners week by week, and try different game outcomes to see how the league forecast changes.

Read the weekly league recap and talk with other owners in league chat.

name: Color Match - Eye Test
description:
Every tile is the same color. Except one. Can you spot it before time runs out?

Color Match is a quick, calm test of how well you see color. Each round shows a grid of tiles in one shade, with a single tile just a little lighter or darker. Tap it. Ten rounds per game, and the difference shrinks every round, so the last ones take a sharp eye.

THREE LEVELS AND A DAILY CHALLENGE
• Easy: 3×3 grid, 7 seconds a round
• Medium: 4×4 grid, 5 seconds
• Hard: 5×5 grid, 3 seconds
• Daily Challenge: the same 10 rounds for everyone, every day. Your first finish counts on the leaderboard.

FAST AND FAIR
• Find the tile for 100 points, plus up to 100 more for speed
• Colors are picked so every shade is equally fair, and only lightness changes, so it works for all common types of color vision
• Pause any time; the grid hides so nobody can peek

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Gentle sounds, light haptics and smooth animations
• Light and dark mode
• Pick up where you left off
• Stats and streaks sync across your devices with iCloud

GAME CENTER
A leaderboard for every level and for the Daily Challenge, and achievements from your first game to a perfect run on Hard.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNTS.
Your data stays on your devices. Free, with no in-app purchases.

name: ColorEscape
description:
Every color has a way out. Finding it is up to you.

Slide tactile pieces across a clean grid, clear paths around walls, and guide each shape through its matching exit. Every move counts, but there is no pressure: undo freely, ask the built-in solver for a correct hint, or take your time in relaxed play.

Explore a 500-level campaign that grows from simple one-block escapes into larger boards, directional pieces, unusual shapes and locked routes. Return for a deterministic daily puzzle or generate a fresh endless challenge.

ColorEscape is designed for focus: clear visuals, color symbols, haptics, light and dark appearance, iPhone and iPad support, and offline gameplay. Progress and preferences stay on your device, and no account is required.

name: Comet Merge: Number Puzzle
description:
Comet Merge is a fast number puzzle: drop blocks, merge three or more of the same number and watch chain reactions multiply your score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Move the falling block and drop it into one of 7 columns
• Three or more touching blocks with the same number merge into the next value
• Every new wave of merges raises your COMBO multiplier
• Four at once create a special block – five or more also clear the row
• Clear the whole board for a big bonus

POWER-UPS
• Bomb clears a 3×3 area
• Paint upgrades every block of one number
• Shuffle mixes the two bottom rows
• Undo takes back your last drop
• Earn a free power-up every 1,000 points

MORE TO PLAY FOR
• Daily challenge: the same block sequence for everyone, every day
• Shop: spend coins on power-ups and five block styles
• 12 achievements, local leaderboard and statistics
• Levels, coins and a daily play streak
• Optional daily reminder

COMFORT
• Light and dark mode, haptics and sound effects
• Short rounds, pause any time
• Works fully offline – no account, no ads, no tracking

name: Companion – KI-Assistent
description:
Companion ist dein persönlicher KI-Assistent – privat, schnell und direkt auf deinem iPhone, iPad und Mac. Er denkt mit Apples Sprachmodell auf dem Gerät: kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

FRAGEN, IDEEN UND TEXTE
Ob Wochenendplan, E-Mail-Entwurf oder eine schnelle Erklärung: Companion antwortet in natürlicher Sprache und behält den Gesprächsverlauf im Blick.

AKTUELLE ANTWORTEN MIT QUELLEN
Braucht eine Frage aktuelles Wissen, sucht Companion im Netz, liest die passenden Seiten und fasst sie zusammen – mit Quellen zum Nachlesen. Nachrichten bekommst du als kurzes Briefing.

EIN GEDÄCHTNIS, DAS DIR GEHÖRT
Sag „Merk dir, dass …“, und Companion behält es für spätere Gespräche. Im Gedächtnis siehst du alles, was er weiß: bearbeiten, anpinnen, einzeln oder gesammelt löschen – oder einfach „Vergiss, dass …“ sagen.

DOKUMENTE, FOTOS UND BILDER
Häng PDFs, Dokumente oder Fotos an und frag danach – auch gescannte Seiten liest Companion per Texterkennung auf dem Gerät. Mit „Mal mir …“ entstehen Bilder mit Image Playground.

EINFACH SPRECHEN
Im Sprechmodus unterhältst du dich freihändig: Companion hört zu, antwortet und liest vor. Spracherkennung und Vorlesen laufen auf dem Gerät.

STÄRKERE MODELLE, WENN DU WILLST
Für anspruchsvolle Aufgaben nutzt du mit deinem eigenen API-Schlüssel Claude, OpenAI oder OpenRouter – oder einen eigenen Server wie Ollama in deinem Netzwerk. Ohne deine Wahl verlässt dein Chat das Gerät nicht.

AUF ALLEN DEINEN GERÄTEN
Chats und Erinnerungen werden über deine private iCloud zwischen iPhone, iPad und Mac abgeglichen.

DATENSCHUTZ
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Analyse. Für die Websuche gehen nur Suchbegriffe und Seitenaufrufe ins Netz.

VORAUSSETZUNGEN
Ein Gerät mit Apple Intelligence und iOS 27, iPadOS 27 oder macOS 27, mit eingeschaltetem Apple Intelligence. Ohne Apple Intelligence funktioniert Companion mit einem Cloud-Modell und deinem eigenen Schlüssel.

name: Conecta - fun
description:
Conecta is a quiet logic puzzle for navigating island bridge repairs and restoring harbor supply routes.

Solve grid challenges, rotate ports, and review your steps in a personal navigation journal. Optional hints and detailed statistics help you plan each voyage.

name: Conflict Risk
seller_name: PUBLIC ORGANIZATION “DIGITALIZATION OF EDUCATION IN UKRAINE”
description:
Conflict Risk shows how risky the security situation is in any city, region or country, as one number from 0 to 100.

HOW IT WORKS
- Search for a place, or use your location once.
- See the risk level, the trend and the reasons behind it: armed conflict in the region, recent violent events and official travel warnings.
- Open the map to see risk calculated for cells of about 25 x 25 km.
- Save places (home, family, a trip) and follow how their risk changes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no login, no profile.
- No analytics, no advertising, no tracking.
- Saved places and settings stay on your device. Your location is used only to look up the risk for that place and is not stored.

TRANSPARENT
- The index is calculated by a fixed, rule-based formula from public sources: UCDP (Uppsala Conflict Data Program), GDELT, GOV.UK and U.S. State Department travel advice and GDACS. No AI is used. The same data for the same place always gives the same result.
- Every source is listed in the app with its status and the date of its data.

IMPORTANT
Conflict Risk is an informational index built from third-party data. It is not an official security warning and it is not the statistical probability of war. Always follow the instructions of local authorities and official government travel advice.

Conflict data: UCDP (Uppsala Conflict Data Program, Uppsala University), licence CC BY 4.0, ucdp.uu.se. Monthly releases of georeferenced events, so the newest events can be several weeks old. Cite: Davies, Pettersson and Öberg (2026), Journal of Peace Research; Sundberg and Melander (2013), Journal of Peace Research. We combine them with other sources into our own risk index; the index and its reasons are our calculation, not UCDP's.

name: Connect POS Pro
description:
Connect POS Pro is the point of sale for restaurants and cafés that run on Connect Restaurant.

FAST AT THE COUNTER
• Big, clear menu with photos, modifiers and favourites
• Dine-in, takeaway and delivery; split bills, discounts, voids and refunds with manager approval
• Cash, card, online and loyalty points in one payment

TABLES AND WAITERS
• Floor plan with live table status
• Waiters take orders at the table; orders go straight to the kitchen

KITCHEN AND PRINTING
• Kitchen screens and network printers for receipts and kitchen tickets
• Receipts in English and Arabic

LOYALTY
• Scan a guest's Apple Wallet or Google Wallet card with the camera
• Points, stamp cards and free items, applied automatically

WORKS OFFLINE
• Keeps selling when the internet drops; everything syncs when it is back
• One main till connects the branch's other tills and screens over the local network

SHIFTS AND CASH
• Open and close shifts, cash in and out, closing count and end-of-day report

Connect POS Pro needs a Connect Restaurant account: the restaurant pairs each device from Connect ERP → Devices.

name: ConstructionCalc: Feet & Inch
description:
A feet and inches calculator that works like a tape measure. Type 5' 3 1/2" + 2' 10 3/4" and get 8' 2 1/4", exactly.

EXACT FRACTIONS, NOT ROUNDED DECIMALS
Every length is stored as an exact fraction of an inch and only rounded when shown, to the precision you choose (1/2" to 1/64"). When rounding changes the answer, the app shows by how much.

A KEYPAD BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
Big keys you can hit with gloves on, dedicated ft / in / fraction keys, and a high-contrast display you can read in sunlight. Light and dark themes.

FREE
• Feet-inch-fraction calculator: add, subtract, multiply, divide, area (ft²) and volume (ft³, yd³)
• Results as ft-in, inches, decimal feet or metric
• Concrete bag calculator: slab, footing or round post, cubic yards, and how many 40, 50, 60 or 80 lb bags (or your own bag yield), with waste
• Right triangle and squaring check
• Board foot calculator
• History of your last 20 calculations

PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Stair stringer calculator: risers, treads, total run and stringer length, with an IRC riser and tread check
• Rafter length and roof pitch calculator
• Memory keys (M+ M− MR MC)
• Unlimited history
• No ads

Pay once and keep it. No account, no trial that turns into a charge, no renewal. Restore Pro on a new phone with the same Apple ID.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up. Your calculations and settings stay on your phone. The free version shows one banner ad, kept away from the keypad.

Results are for planning. Check your measurements and local building code before you build.

name: Contesa
description:
Sul tavolo c'è una parola di sette lettere, contesa fra te e l'avversario.

In mano hai quattro lettere gialle; l'avversario ne ha quattro azzurre, coperte. Al tuo turno rimpiazzi una lettera sul tavolo con una dalla tua mano e le riordini per creare una nuova parola. Fai tanti punti quante lettere gialle ci sono nella nuova parola. E se le lettere che rimpiazzi sono tutte azzurre, puoi cambiarne due, tre o quattro in una volta: è la mossa che ribalta la partita.

Vince chi arriva prima a 21 punti, o chi ha cinque lettere del suo colore nella parola.

• Un avversario a tre livelli
• Circa 50.000 parole italiane di sette lettere, con verbi coniugati e nomi propri
• Una parola del giorno uguale per tutti, anche come widget
• Statistiche delle tue partite
• Partite a tempo, se vuoi: 30 o 90 secondi per mossa
• Opzioni per cambiare la partita: lettere in mano che scadono, punti in più per le lettere difficili, lettere dell'avversario visibili
• Funziona senza rete e non raccoglie dati

name: Contextarcha
description: Contextarcha is a reading room for Open Context, the open-access archaeological data publisher. Search projects, object records, places and media by keyword, era or map extent; read provenance, chronology, observation attributes, creators and licenses; then save records, attach illustrated field notes and assemble collections that remain available offline. Searches, maps and exports all run against live Open Context data, with citations preserved.

name: ContourBay - Grid Contours
description:
Turn a rectangular grid of numbers into a heatmap, traceable contour segments, and reports you can reopen. ContourBay helps you inspect your own small numerical fields on iPhone.

BUILD OR IMPORT A FIELD
Create a grid with 2–64 rows and columns, edit every node, and set coordinate origins, positive spacing, and your own unit labels. Import a UTF-8 numeric CSV, review its complete matrix, and save it as a new grid without changing the source file.

EXPLORE THE VALUES
Combine Heatmap, Contours, and Nodes layers. Pinch to zoom, pan with two fingers, or enter exact probe coordinates. Inspect the selected cell, triangle, interpolated value, and weights. Browse saved nodes and view min, max, mean, segment counts, and contour lengths.

EXPLAIN EACH CROSSING
Set 1–20 distinct contour levels. Open a cell trace to see its corner values, high/low classifications, edge parameters, and crossing coordinates. Return directly to a crossing on the canvas.

KEEP A FROZEN REPORT
Save an independent snapshot of the input, revision, levels, model, segments, and statistics. Later edits or deletion of the source grid do not change the report. Search your saved grids and reports by name.

EXPORT REAL FILES
Generate actual contour vectors as SVG, or export node coordinates and values, sourced segments, and the original matrix as CSV. Preview supported files or save and send copies through the system share sheet. Matrix CSV can be imported again.

A CLEAR NUMERICAL MODEL
Each cell uses a fixed top-left to bottom-right split with linear interpolation inside its two triangles. Output consists of independent segments. The app does not smooth contours, merge enclosed areas, fill missing values, or infer geographic location.

Your grids, frozen reports, and generated files are stored in the app's local workspace. Manage up to 100 grids and 100 reports. Imports require a complete numeric matrix, without headers or blank cells, in a CSV or text file up to 1 MiB. Core grid tools do not require an in-app account.

name: ControlBoard Field
description:
ControlBoard Field is the labor and equipment app for construction companies that run on ControlBoard®, the scheduling and job cost system from Congistics Inc. Employees, foremen and superintendents track labor where the work happens.

Your company gives you your sign-in. Install the app, enter your company's ControlBoard address and sign in. There is no sign-up in the app.

WORKS OFFLINE
Keep working with no connection. Everything you enter waits on the device and is sent when you're back online.

LABOR TIME
• Punch in and out, or enter hours by job and cost code
• Regular, overtime, double time and travel
• Sign off your day
• Request time off
• Foremen enter labor for everyone on the job on one sheet: the day on a phone, the full week on a tablet

REVIEW AND APPROVAL
• Foremen and managers review and approve labor by job and by week

YOUR SCHEDULE
• See your jobs, times and addresses for today and the days ahead, with directions

ON THE JOB
• Log the day's production quantities, photos, videos and notes
• Scan tool tags, request tools and track what you have in hand
• Work through PM items
• Message the office

name: CoolPulse: Calm, Habit & Vault
description:
CoolPulse unites three science-backed daily tools in one calm, private offline space designed for teens and young adults.

KEY FEATURES
• Tactical Cooldown Breathing: 32s/64s box breathing with haptic heart-rate pacing and a 10-minute impulse draft lock.
• Daily RPG Micro-Challenges: Level up from LV.1 to LV.50 with 5-axis growth radar, 30-day heatmap, and zero-equipment routines.
• Positive Dialogue & Encrypted Vault: 45 healthy boundary affirmation cards plus a Face ID + AES-256 encrypted private journal.
• 100% Offline & Private: No accounts, no social comparison, no cloud tracking.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock all advanced RPG challenge protocols, full insight history, and custom themes.

name: Coresify AI Tools
description:
Coresify AI Tools brings practical AI tools together in one app, one account and one credit balance.

AUTO CLIPPER
Paste a YouTube link, describe the moments you want, and Auto Clipper creates short clips with subtitles, ready for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
- AI reads the transcript and picks the best moments for your prompt.
- Smart layouts: gameplay with a streamer face close-up, face-tracking crop, or blurred background.
- Automatic subtitles with the spoken word highlighted.
- Ratios 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9. Choose the number of clips, layout and plan.
- Save clips to your photo library or share them.

WEBSITE BUILDER
Get your own website and Coresify ERP business system (sales, CRM, inventory, point of sale and more), managed from your phone.
- Create an instance, pick the apps you need and start with a free trial.
- Edit your website and ERP screens just by chatting with the AI, with a plan mode to discuss changes first.
- Switch between mobile and desktop view, undo any change.
- Manage users, storage and automatic backups (with cloud copies and email-verified restore).
- Book a call with a Coresify ERP consultant.

CREDITS & TRIAL
- One credit balance works across every tool. Credits are bought in the app and never expire while your account is active.
- New accounts get 2 free videos and a 3-day Website Builder trial right away, no purchase needed.
- Credits are refunded automatically if a video job fails.

NOTES
- Only use videos you have the rights or permission to clip.
- Clips are stored for 1 day after completion, then deleted automatically.
- AI features send your request and the needed content to a third-party AI provider; you agree to this when you sign up.
- You can delete your account at any time under Profile.

Available in English, Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese and Arabic.

name: Corrcheck
description:
Corrcheck is the workshop app for vehicle inspections, defects, vehicles off road, and MOTs.

Sign in with the email address your workshop gave you. The app finds that workshop and opens the bay tools: inspection reports, defects, VOR, and MOT records.

Photos you choose from your library can be attached to an inspection, a defect, or an MOT. The app does not use the camera, microphone, or location.

There is no sign-up inside the app. A workshop administrator creates each login.

Privacy: https://corrcheck.co.uk/privacy

name: CourseQuébec
description:
CourseQuébec is the calendar of running races in Québec: marathons, half marathons, 10K, 5K, trail and ultra races.

NEAR ME
• The closest upcoming races, sorted by distance
• A map of every race, with your location
• Directions to the start line in one tap

YOUR FAVORITES, EVEN OFFLINE
• Save races as favorites: they stay available offline
• A reminder 7 days before and the day before the race
• A reminder the day before registration closes, when we know the date

NEVER MISS A DATE
• Add a race to your calendar in one tap
• Share a race with your running friends
• Search by name, town, region or distance

ALL OF COURSEQUÉBEC
• The full page of every race: distances, start times, course, practical info and lodging
• GPS routes, the runner's guide, the blog and tools (pace calculator and more)
• Your account: your routes and, for organizers, managing their race pages

In English and French.

name: CourtTap: Pickleball & Tennis
description:
CourtTap ends mid-match 'wait, what's the score?' arguments with a bold, one-tap offline scoreboard built for real court visibility.

KEY FEATURES
• Multi-Racket Rules Built-In: Pickleball (doubles serve #1/#2), Tennis (deuce/tiebreak), Badminton, and Padel.
• Huge Sunlit-Readable Digits: Tap either side to score with instant undo and automatic side-switch cues.
• Match History & Win-Rate Stats: Track opponents, set scores, and streaks 100% offline.
• Zero Ads, Zero Account: Opens straight to the court scoreboard in under a second.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited match history, custom rule presets, and CSV stats export.

name: CoverMesa
description:
Find the intervals where your defined capacity is short, exact or in surplus. CoverMesa compares demand bands with resource availability and preserves the sources behind every calculated segment.

DEFINE YOUR OWN UNITS
Create a named plan and choose the capacity unit. Enter non-overlapping demand intervals with required quantities, then add resources with a capacity and one or more availability intervals. The app does not assume an industry, employee role or legal staffing rule.

INSPECT EVERY CHANGE IN COVERAGE
Calculate coverage across all input endpoints. Each segment shows its start, end, minutes, demand, active capacity, deficit and surplus. Open it to trace the demand and participating resource intervals.

MEASURE QUANTITY OVER TIME
Read exact demand, capacity, deficit and surplus unit-minutes. Positive demand equal to capacity counts toward exact-coverage minutes. Capacity outside demand is retained as surplus; intervals with neither demand nor capacity are omitted and identified as such.

KEEP A FROZEN REPORT
Save an independent report containing the complete plan, source revision, segments and totals. Editing or deleting the source plan leaves that report intact. Generate a full segment CSV, complete JSON or an SVG timeline, then preview or share the actual files with byte sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints.

A CLEAR MINUTE MODEL
Plans use a single abstract day from 00:00 to 24:00 in whole minutes. Intervals include their start and exclude their end; 24:00 is an end only. Adjacent intervals are allowed. Overlapping demand intervals or overlapping intervals within one resource are rejected; capacities from different resources add together.

LIMITS
A plan supports up to 100 demand intervals, 30 resources and 20 availability intervals per resource. There is no overnight, date, time-zone or daylight-saving model. CoverMesa compares capacity; it does not assign tasks, recommend staffing, calculate payroll or guarantee operational safety.

Plans, reports and generated files are stored locally in the app. Delete records individually or use Clear all local data in About. Copies already shared outside the app are unaffected.

name: Cozy Bakery: Block Jam
description:
Welcome to Cozy Bakery — a warm, colorful Block Jam sliding puzzle where every tray of fresh pastries belongs in its matching oven!

Slide pastry trays across the kitchen board, plan the perfect sequence, and clear every order. Trays glide until they hit a wall or another tray, so every move counts — solve cleanly to earn 3 stars and golden coins.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE COZY BAKERY:
• 50 handcrafted campaign levels (5 chapters) + 393 Night Orders for endless puzzle fun.
• Clever mechanics that keep every level fresh: locked ovens & keys, icy glaze, sticky dough, color queues, and conveyor belts.
• My Bakery meta-game: spend earned coins on 15 cozy upgrades across 4 zones — display case, coffee corner, copper oven, and Brioche the Cat's cozy nook.
• Helpful boosters: use Hint to spot the next optimal move, or Oven Mitt to clear a tricky tray.
• 7-day login streak, Daily Quests, and Chef's Order of the Day.
• No energy limits and offline-friendly — relax and play at your own pace anywhere.

Open your cozy bakery today!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cozy Laundromat Tycoon
description:
You inherit a tiny corner laundromat: one washer and a sleepy cat. Your customers are the animal neighbors of the street, bears, bunnies, foxes, dogs and pandas, each with a basket of laundry. Fill the shop with machines, open new stations, hire attendants and turn it into the coziest shop in the neighborhood.
