A SHOP YOU CAN SEE GROW
Every machine you buy shows up in the shop. Drums spin, bubbles rise, customers come in with baskets and leave with folded stacks. More machines, a busier room.

FIVE STATIONS TO OPEN
Coin Wash, Tumble Dry, Fold & Pack, Steam Press and Dry Cleaning. Each one waits under a dust sheet until its Grand opening.

ATTENDANTS DO THE WORK
Tap a station to run a load, or hire an Attendant and it runs on its own, even while you're away (up to 2 hours).

RAINY RUSH
Every few minutes the sky turns grey, the lamps glow and a crowd with umbrellas hurries in. Cash ×1.5 while it rains.

MILESTONES
At 25, 50, 100 and 200 machines a station doubles its cash per load.

THE SHOP CAT
Always there, always asleep on the dryers. Pet it and it purrs.

CALM AND FAIR
• No energy, no pop-up ads.
• Ads only when you choose one: ×2 cash for 4 hours, or double what your attendants earned while you were away.
• Plays offline. Your shop is saved on your phone; no account needed.
• In English and Turkish.

name: CozyKeyboard: AI Translator
description:
A Korean and English keyboard that translates as you type.

• Pause typing to see the translation above the keys. Tap to replace.
• Three tones: Business, Neutral, Casual
• 9 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese
• Translate copied messages (clipboard button)
• Emoji search
• Works in every app
• Korean, English, numbers, symbols, and emoji in one keyboard
• Apple AI translation by default
• Connect the API key of an AI model you subscribe to
• No separate CozyKeyboard login, subscription, or ads

name: Crazy Rich Boy: Big Day
description:
Crazy Rich Boy: Big Day

It's a big day. A truck, a crew, and a house full of furniture that has to fit.

In Crazy Rich Boy: Big Day you run your own moving company and earn coins for every job. Pick a truck, hire your helpers, pack the client's belongings into the truck, then drive them across town to their new home. The better it arrives, the more coins you earn.

PACK SMART
Fit sofas, fridges, lamps, plants and boxes into a 3D grid. Rotate and stack items, keep heavy things on the floor, and watch out for fragile pieces that break under too much weight.

DRIVE CAREFULLY
Hit the road in a top-down drive. Dodge cars, cones, rocks and potholes. Every bump can damage something in the back.

GROW YOUR COMPANY
Spend your coins on bigger trucks, a stronger crew and crew training, garage upgrades and a bigger headquarters. From a tiny trike to a giant hauler.

FEATURES
- 50 levels across 5 neighbourhoods
- New puzzle rules as you go: low roofs, liquids, matching sets, living plants and more
- 16 trucks and 11 crew members to unlock
- Daily jobs with bonus coins
- Up to 3 stars on every job
- No ads

ABOUT THE MONEY
All money in Crazy Rich Boy: Big Day is virtual. Coins are earned only by playing and can only be used inside the game. They have no real-world value, cannot be bought, sold or cashed out, and the game involves no gambling or real money of any kind.

Pack it. Drive it. Get rich, in the game!

name: Cretinas do Pop
description:
O Cretinas do Pop é a rede privada de um grupo de amigas: o lugar onde ficam os rolês, as fotos, os scraps e as fofocas que antes se perdiam no meio das conversas.

SÓ PARA CONVIDADAS
Não existe cadastro aberto. A administração do grupo cria a sua conta e você recebe o convite por e-mail. Nada do que é postado aparece fora do grupo nem em buscadores.

O QUE TEM NO APP
• Rolês: conte como foi, com data, lugar, fotos, vídeos e áudios, e monte a linha do tempo do grupo
• Posts: textos com fotos, vídeos e vídeos do YouTube
• Scraps: o mural de cada uma, do jeitinho que a gente lembra
• Comentários, respostas, reações com emojis (inclusive os emojis do próprio grupo) e GIFs
• Notas de 0,5 a 5 estrelas pros rolês
• Cultura POP: indique filmes, séries, álbuns, livros e games, dê nota, diga se recomenda e veja quem também quer ver
• Notificações no celular de comentário, reação, scrap, menção e post novo
• Modo escuro
• Trava do app com Face ID ou digital
• Verificação em duas etapas pra proteger a conta

SEGURANÇA E RESPEITO
• Denuncie qualquer post, comentário, scrap ou perfil: a administração analisa em até 24 horas
• Bloqueie quem você não quer ver: o conteúdo e os avisos da pessoa somem pra você
• Exclua a sua conta e tudo o que você postou quando quiser, direto no app

Sem anúncios, sem rastreamento e sem venda de dados.

name: Crías AQHA Venezuela
description:
Crías AQHA Venezuela es la vitrina de los criadores de caballos Cuarto de Milla (AQHA) del país: contacto directo con el criador, una ventana al mundo.

• Caballos en venta con fotos, líneas de sangre, papeles AQHA, precio y WhatsApp del dueño.
• Padrotes de Venezuela y servicios de reproducción: semen, saltos y embriones.
• Criadores, veterinarios, herradores, talabarteros y transporte de caballos de todo el país.
• Medicinas y suplementos para caballos de alta competencia.
• Ranking de padrotes líderes por disciplina.

Genética AQHA · Orgullo Nacional.

name: Cricket Journey: 1v1 Online
description:
Real cricket, one over at a time. Face a real player online: you bat one over, then you bowl one over. Score more runs than your rival and the match is yours.

BAT LIKE IT MATTERS
Time your shot, pick your gap and go for the boundary. Drives, pulls, cuts, sweeps and lofted sixes all play the way they do on a real pitch. A good shot early is a single; a perfect one clears the rope.

BOWL TO A PLAN
Choose your line and length, drag to set the ball, then run in and bowl. Pace, swing and spin each ask a different question of the batter. Bowl straight, keep it tight and take wickets.

1V1 ONLINE
Every match is a short duel against another player. Six balls each, no long waits. Send a quick sporting word during play: Good Shot, Well Played, Great Catch.

SEVEN GROUNDS
Start on the rooftop and the street, then move up to the school ground, the club, the domestic ground, the league stadium and the international stage. Each ground has its own pitch, boundary and crowd.

YOUR OWN TEAM
Collect player cards, level up your batters and bowlers, name your team and build an eleven that suits how you play.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Play a Friend: share a code and play a friend directly
- Daily Six: one new challenge every day
- Weekly Cup and weekly leaderboard
- Challenges and a full career to climb
- Practice whenever you like

Fielders chase, dive and throw. Keepers take the ball behind the stumps. Batters run their runs. Every catch, every six and every run-out is played out on the field.

Short matches, real cricket. Pick up your bat.

name: CrossFit Mojo
description:
Welcome to the official CrossFit Mojo app—your all-access pass to Indianapolis' premier functional fitness community. Whether you're chasing a new PR, claiming your spot in the next WOD, or competing with your fellow athletes, this is your command center for crushing goals and staying connected to the Mojo family.

Book your classes with lightning speed and never miss a workout. Reserve your spot in daily WODs, specialty sessions, and open gym time—all from your phone. Get reminders, manage your schedule, and show up ready to attack the workout.

Track every rep, every lift, every victory. Log your workouts, record your PRs, and watch your progress skyrocket over time. See exactly how far you've come and where you're headed next. Your fitness journey, quantified and unstoppable.

Compete, connect, and celebrate with your tribe. Check the leaderboards to see where you stack up against your fellow Mojo athletes. Like and comment on teammates' performances, cheer each other on, and fuel the competitive fire that makes this community legendary. At CrossFit Mojo, we don't just work out together—we push each other to be better, stronger, and tougher every single day.

This is more than an app. It's your pocket coach, your competition tracker, and your direct line to the most badass fitness community in Indianapolis. Download now and bring the Mojo wherever you go.

name: Crosswords: Word Games
description:
Four classic word games in one calm, tactile app — no account needed, and every dictionary stays on your device so you can play offline anytime.

FOUR GAMES TO CHOOSE FROM
• Words from letters — swipe across the letter ring to connect words and fill the board.
• Word grid — fill the rows with letter tiles to uncover each hidden word.
• Scanword — arrow-word puzzles with clues placed right inside the grid.
• Crossword — classic numbered newspaper grids with Across and Down clues (and side-by-side clues in tablet landscape).

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Extra-words jar: in Words from letters and Word grid, valid bonus words go into the jar — every 5 give a free hint.
• Daily gift: return each day for a 7-day reward streak of hints, medals, a level skip and a Day 7 chest.
• Medals: earn medals for streaks and use them to unlock extra hints.
• Calm atmosphere: gentle nature backdrops that shift between levels, soothing music tracks, crisp sound effects and optional vibration.
• Plays in portrait and landscape on tablets.

SIX LANGUAGES
Follows your device language automatically: English, Russian, Hebrew (full RTL), Ukrainian, Turkish and Azerbaijani.

NO ACCOUNT · OPTIONAL REMOVE ADS
Open the app and start playing — your progress stays on your device. The free version shows a banner and short ads every few levels, plus optional rewarded ads for a hint. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the banner and between-level ads forever (watching an ad for a hint stays optional).

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cue Card Converter
description:
Turn any speech into clear, printable cue cards in seconds, then rehearse until you finish on time.

PASTE, OPEN OR SCAN
Paste your text, open a Word document, PDF or PowerPoint file (speaker notes become one card per slide), or scan printed pages with the camera.

CARDS THAT ARE EASY TO READ ON STAGE
Your words are split into cards where a sentence or topic ends, never rewritten. Names, events, places, dates, times, numbers and [STAGE CUES] are highlighted so you never stumble over them. On supported devices, on-device AI also finds topic changes, job titles and figures; you can undo it with one tap.

PRINT AT REAL SIZE
3×5 and 4×6 index cards, A6, A5 or half letter. Print one card per page on card stock, or several per A4 or Letter sheet with cut lines. Add a back side with your logo and event name, or export a PDF.

REHEARSE AND SEE YOUR TIMING
Swipe through your cards full screen with a timer. Afterwards you see how long each card took against your plan, and how your timing changes from one rehearsal to the next.

SPEAKING EXERCISES
• Learn by Heart: say each card with half the words hidden, then with only the names, numbers and first words left
• Teleprompter: your whole speech scrolls at your speaking pace in words per minute; tap to pause, drag to move
• English Speaking Test: interview, task card with one minute to prepare and two to speak, and discussion
• Impromptu Speaking: draw a topic and keep talking until the ring closes
• Diction Warm-Up: tongue twisters, three tries each, timed
• Speech Timer: amber and red signals, shown in words and symbols too

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. Everything runs on your device; your speech is never uploaded. Recordings stay on your device and can be deleted.

name: Cue Slip
description:
Cue Slip is a desk-side card for a livestream host. Before the next product, write the name, the words you will say, and how many are in the pile. Flip the card up. The phone writes the line you say.

The words you type are not a payment and not advice about what to charge. Cue Slip does not take money, open a shop, or collect a viewer's name. It does not connect to a network or an account. The cards stay on this iPhone.

name: CueLattice
description:
CueLattice helps presenters, facilitators and workshop hosts plan the running order and rehearse at a steady pace.

PLAN THE FLOW
Create named runbooks with ordered segments. Give each segment a duration and speaker notes. Reorder or remove segments as your plan develops.

TAKE THE STAGE
Load a runbook into the stage timer. Start, pause and move to the next segment. The active timer includes time spent in the background; it does not schedule alarms or notifications. It measures elapsed wall time while this process remains active, rather than guaranteeing background execution.

LEARN FROM REHEARSALS
Finish and save a rehearsal to keep its actual segment times. Compare the total against the planned duration. Sessions ended before the last segment are marked partial. Saved rehearsal history remains independent of later runbook edits. An unsaved active rehearsal is not restored after process termination.

KEEP IT PERSONAL
Business records stay on your device. No account, ads, purchases or subscriptions. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance and a persistent in-app language. Optional samples are available in Settings when your runbook library is empty.

The App includes English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Store materials are provided in English.

name: CuePup: Puppy Training
description:
Start your first month together with a practical, reward-based puppy training plan. CuePup breaks common skills into short sessions you can fit between walks, naps, and meals.

• Follow 30 step-by-step lessons on settling in, potty routines, recall, leash skills, and more.
• Use a three-minute practice timer and an optional soft audio marker.
• Customize the words everyone in your household uses for each cue.
• Log potty outings and export a cue sheet with recent notes for another caregiver.

One purchase. Your progress stays on your device, and you can use the app offline.

name: Cueweave
description:
Prepare a small demonstration, one cue at a time.

Cueweave helps you rehearse board game explanations, workshop demonstrations, and other hands-on presentations. Arrange what to say, which card to show, and which prop to pick up in three tracks, then follow your cues in order.

BUILD YOUR PLAN
Create steps, add cues, and set their execution order across Speech, Cards, and Props. Move cues between steps or split a busy step into smaller parts.

REHEARSE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Tap to complete each action, pause when needed, and mark moments where you stumble. Resume an unfinished rehearsal from your saved position.

REVIEW AND ADJUST
See step timings, skipped actions, and marked stumbles. Jump from a stumble to its current cue and adjust your plan.

COMPARE FULL REHEARSALS
Compare your last two completed full runs. Review timing changes, stumble counts, and how steps were split between runs.

PRACTICE A SHORT SECTION
Choose one step or include its split follow-up steps. Check the practice scope before starting, review the segment, and repeat it.

Start with editable board game and workshop samples, or create your own project.

All features are free. No ads, subscriptions, or account required. Plans and rehearsal records are stored locally, and the core workflow works offline.

name: Culture Passport North Cyprus
description:
Who knows more: the traveller or the reader? Culture Passport lets you be both. Read the story, go there, say “I was here” and press your stamp. Your passport fills with the history, culture and flavours of Northern Cyprus.

It is a keepsake passport. It is not an official identity or travel document. It is an independent app and does not belong to any government body, municipality or museum authority.

Discover the history
• 172 places: castles, ancient cities, inns, monasteries, villages, beaches and 34 museums
• A short story for every place, and a hidden detail that opens once you stamp
• Opening hours and fees, each with its source and the date it was checked; unknown hours are not invented but marked as varying

Live the culture, taste the food
• The Table: the covered market, carob, grapes, olives, citrus and dates
• Discover the spots behind the island’s own flavours
• Made by Hand: old-town shops, basket and pottery villages
• Meet local shopkeepers in the bazaar and craftspeople in the villages

Don’t miss the festivals
• The tulip, orange, grape and olive festivals have stamps of their own
• A festival stamp opens when the date is announced and can be made only at the festival

Complete your stamps, claim your rewards
• Step inside a place’s circle, then press and hold the stamp; you cannot stamp from home
• Each of the 11 routes earns you a title when you finish it
• After five different places your passport is issued in your name with the next number, and its cover changes as you travel
• Each season has its own ink: four stamps a year for the same place
• Your stamps are tied to your verified email and open on any phone

Memorials
• 24 memorials in a section of their own
• No points, ranking or celebration; instead of a stamp you lay a carnation in silence

Plan your day
• Six districts, places nearby and three suggested stops for the time of day
• The map of the north comes with the app; map, hours, stories and search work offline
• A stamp made without a connection waits on your phone and is recorded with its original time once you are online (within 72 hours)

The boundary
• The buffer zone, the boundary line and the crossing points are marked on the map
• While open, the app warns you when you come close to the buffer zone
• The map is for information; signs and officers on the ground come first

Languages
• Turkish, English, German, Russian, Greek and Urdu

Privacy
• No ads and no tracking
• Location is stored only when you stamp
• Your name appears in the feed only if you turn it on; you can delete your account in the app

The source of hours and fees is linked on each place page. Main source for museum hours: Department of Antiquities and Museums, https://eemd.gov.ct.tr
Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Curebar
description: Curebar is a soap-cure notebook. Each batch stores a name, an oil, a made date, a target of 21, 28, 42, or 56 days, and a bar count. Cured days are the midnights from the made date to today. A future made date counts as zero. Ready means cured days have reached the target. The bar fill is cured days divided by the target, capped at full, and the name sits under the bar. A turn is a dated sentence and does not move the made date. Nothing is uploaded, and ready does not mean the soap is safe to use.

name: Cursillo PSA
description:
Cursillo PSA is a simple, practical way to live your Fourth Day. It's for anyone who has made a Cursillo, or anyone who wants to be more intentional about piety, study, and action.

Record, track, and plan your piety, study, and action each day. When your weekly or bi-weekly group check-in comes around, everything is already written down, so you're sharing what you documented as you went instead of trying to remember it all at the end.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Plan your week: set your piety, study, and action goals for the days ahead.
• Log each day: check off your prayers and sacraments, note what you read and what struck you, and record the actions you took.
• Get ready for your PSA: see your week at a glance, ready to share with your group.
• Keep a confession log so your most recent confession date is always on hand.
• Keep a reading list of the books you're reading, want to read, or have finished.
• Get a daily reminder and an encouraging quote from the saints.

FREE, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Cursillo PSA is free, and everything works on your phone without signing up. If you'd like, you can create an account to share your log with the brothers or sisters in your group.

Questions or ideas? Write to aefairfield@gmail.com.

De Colores!

name: Cutedge: Background Remover
description:
Cutedge cuts out your photos: you choose a photo, your iPhone finds the subject and the background disappears. Then it becomes white, a color, a gradient, your own photo or transparent. All on your iPhone, with no account, no ads, no subscription and no watermark.

CUT OUT
• Remove the background automatically: the detection runs on your iPhone, nothing is uploaded
• More than one subject found? Tap the ones you want to keep
• Eraser and restore with a magnifier and zoom for fine work
• Magic wand: tap an area and similar colors next to it disappear
• Smooth the edge, make it tighter or softer
• Hold "Original" to see the photo before, plus undo and redo

DESIGN
• Background: white, any color, a gradient of two colors, your own photo from the photo picker or transparent
• Shadow: soft, hard or floating, with a strength slider
• Formats: original, 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16 (Story) or free; crop, rotate in 90-degree steps and center the subject with an adjustable margin
• Adjustments for the subject: brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, highlights, shadows and sharpness
• Presets: three presets set background, shadow and format at once, then you change everything separately

BATCH
• Edit many photos at once with the same style, then save all to Photos or share them
• Photos where no subject was found are marked, and you can refine them one by one
• Keep the app open until all are done

SAVE
• PNG (also transparent) or JPEG, at the original size of your photo
• Save to Photos, pass it on through the share menu or copy it
• No watermark and no credits

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
Cutedge is free, with no subscription, no ads and no account. There is no server: your photos are only read through the photo picker and never uploaded. The app only sees the photos you choose. Your edits are saved automatically on your iPhone so you can continue later; you remove them one by one or all at once in the settings. The app never deletes anything in your Photos app and only adds to it when you tap "Save to Photos". Light and dark mode, large text and VoiceOver are included.

For iPhone with iOS 18 or later, in English and German.

Ideas or bugs? Tap the gear icon at the top right in the app and then "Feedback and ideas" or write to kontakt@fairapps.at. Cutedge is part of FairApps, a series of fair apps from Vienna.

name: DadGo
description: DadGo ilə Sabirabadda sevdiyiniz yeməkləri rahatlıqla sifariş edin. Yerli menyuda burgerlərə, qəlyanaltılara, içkilərə və kombo dəstlərə baxın, məhsullar haqqında məlumatı nəzərdən keçirin, sevimlilərinizi yadda saxlayın və məhsulları səbətə əlavə edin. Xəritədə çatdırılma ünvanını seçin, məsafəni və yekun məbləği yoxlayın, sifarişinizi tamamlayın. Hesabınızda sifarişinizin vəziyyətini izləyin və profilinizi idarə edin. DadGo Azərbaycan, rus və ingilis dillərini dəstəkləyir.

name: Dairysense
description:
Dairysense, modern süt sığırcılığı işletmeleri için geliştirilmiş yeni nesil hassas sürü yönetimi uygulamasıdır. Çiftliğinizin sağım, üreme, sağlık ve sensör verilerini iPhone ve iPad üzerinden gerçek zamanlı olarak takip etmenizi sağlar.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Canlı Gösterge Paneli: Günlük toplam süt verimi, hayvan başına ortalama verim, sağıma gelmeyen hayvanlar, sürü envanteri ve günlük çiftlik görevlerini tek ekranda izleyin.
• Akıllı Tasma ve Pedometre Analizi: Geviş getirme süresi, yemleme, aktivite, dinlenme, uyku, solunum ve adım verilerini günlük ve saatlik grafiklerle analiz edin.
• Seri NFC Etiket Okuma: iPhone NFC okuyucu ile hayvan tasmalarını tek tek veya seri sepet modunda okutun; doğrudan hayvan kartını açın veya toplu olay (grup değişimi, tohumlama, tedavi, gebelik kontrolü vb.) kaydedin.
• Anlık Bildirimler: Kızgınlık, sağlık, sağım ve kritik çiftlik uyarılarını anlık bildirim olarak alın; bildirime dokunarak doğrudan ilgili hayvan kartına ulaşın.
• Detaylı Hayvan Kartı: Laktasyon özetleri, üreme geçmişi, süt ve sensör trend grafikleri, belge/fotoğraf yükleme ve rapor paylaşma/yazdırma özellikleri.
• Çoklu Çiftlik Yönetimi: Birden fazla işletmenin HTTPS bağlantısını tek uygulamada kaydedip aralarında güvenle geçiş yapın.
• Çoklu Dil Desteği: Türkçe, İngilizce, Almanca, Rusça, Fransızca, İspanyolca, Arapça, Farsça ve Türkmence.

Not: Uygulama, Dairysense çiftlik yönetim sistemi kullanan işletmeler içindir. Giriş için işletmenizin Dairysense HTTPS adresi ve kullanıcı bilgileri gerekir.

name: DalatEvent
description:
DalatEvent answers "What's on in Da Lat?" with an events calendar checked against official sources and updated daily.

• The Da Lat Flower Festival schedule plus events, exhibitions and live shows happening now and coming up
• Filter by today, tonight, this weekend or any date
• "Where to go today?" assistant: type one sentence and get a plan by time of day
• Your own plan: clash warnings, alerts when a programme changes, reminders 2 hours before
• Map near me and directions to every venue
• Weather and cloud hunting: which mornings are worth an early start, which afternoons to stay indoors
• Da Lat Passport: visit, get stamped, collect the full set
• Dalat Deals: offers from partner cafés and venues
• Vietnamese and English, works on a weak connection

No account needed to browse. Optionally sign in with Apple, Google or email to sync your plan across devices.

Schedules can change; please check before you go.

name: Dance & Style
description:
¡Descárgate nuestra app Dance & Style para tener siempre tu estudio favorito en el bolsillo!
Desde nuestra app, podrás planificar y programar tus clases, ver horarios, inscribirte, ¡y mucho más!
Maximiza tu tiempo y no te pierdas nunca la información más actualizada que tendrás siempre al alcance de tu mano. No esperes más y descárgate ya Dance & Style

name: Dangerous Escape: Trap Rooms
description:
Dangerous Escape is a platformer made of single-screen rooms. The goal is simple: reach the door. But the room will do anything to trick you!

HOW TO PLAY
• Walk with the left and right buttons, jump with the jump button
• Reach the door to finish the level
• When you die, you restart the same room instantly

TRAPS
• Hidden spikes that pop up when you get close
• Fake and crumbling floors that drop under you
• Doors that run away as you approach
• Rolling saws, falling crushers and lava
• Hidden triggers that reverse your controls

FEATURES
• 6 worlds, 30 levels: Sand Cave, Ice Hall, Jungle Temple, Lava Factory, Purple Dream, Night Castle
• Death counter for every level, your best is saved
• Available in 11 languages
• Plays offline, no ads

The door is right there. Sounds easy?

name: Darling Letters: Couples App
description:
Love letters for couples. Write each other a letter, then open them together.

Darling Letters is a letter app for two. You each write three letters to the same gentle questions. Nobody can read a word until you have both written, then you break the seal together.

HOW IT WORKS
• Write three short letters to your partner. Type them, or say them and we write them down.
• Send your partner a private link. They write theirs back, free, in about 5 minutes.
• When you have both sealed, open the first letters together.
• Keep going with a new question every week, opened at the same moment for both of you.

WHAT YOU GET WITH A SUBSCRIPTION
• Read all three first letters, on both sides.
• "You both wrote about…": what your letters have in common, and one question for tonight.
• A new sealed letter every week, and a letterbox that keeps every letter.
• One plan covers both of you. Your partner never pays.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Just two first names. No phone number, no contacts. Sign in with Apple or Google only if you want to keep your letters on a new phone.
• Letters stay sealed until you have both written. No one at Darling Letters reads your letters.
• An automated safety check makes sure nothing cruel is delivered.
• Delete your letters or your account at any time, for both of you.

SUBSCRIPTION
Darling Letters is free to start: write and send your first letters and read the first one. A subscription unlocks the rest: yearly or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. It renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://darlingletters.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://darlingletters.app/privacy

name: Darts Calc App: Score Counter
description:
Darts Calc App keeps score for your darts games with one tap per dart. Play Count-Up, X01 and Cricket, plus Medley, which combines X01 and Cricket legs, and 2 vs 2 team play. Use it for practice at home or for matches with friends. No account needed.

■ Games
・Count-Up: 1–4 players, 1–30 rounds
・X01: 301 to 1501, 1–4 players, with single, double or master out
・Cricket: 1–4 players
・Medley: 1 vs 1 matches. 3 legs (701 → Cricket → Choice) or 5 legs (701 → Cricket → 501 → Cricket → Choice), and you can change the game for each leg. A cork decides who throws first
・2 vs 2 team play: X01, Cricket and Medley
・Bull: FAT or SEPARATE

■ Entry and display
・Enter each dart by tapping a multiplier and a number
・Undo one entry at a time, even after the game ends
・Awards such as TON 80, HAT TRICK and 3 IN A BED
・Stats such as 3DA, PPD and MPR at the end of each game
・Remembers the settings you last started each game with
・iPhone and iPad. Dark, Light or System appearance

■ Records & Trends
Games you play solo are saved, and you can follow your 3DA trend for Count-Up and X01 and your MPR trend for Cricket in charts.

■ Free and Pro
・Only Count-Up is free. The other games and Records & Trends require Pro
・Count-Up records are saved on your device even on the free version, and with Pro you can see past games in your trends too
・Pro: X01, Cricket, Medley, 2 vs 2 team play, Records & Trends, and syncing records between iPhone and iPad (iCloud)
・Pro comes as a yearly or monthly auto-renewing subscription, or as Lifetime, a one-time purchase that is not a subscription
・Yearly and monthly subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and are charged to your Apple Account. You can cancel anytime in Settings under your Apple Account > Subscriptions

■ Privacy
・No login or account. The app never collects names or email addresses
・Records are stored on your device and, with Pro, in your own iCloud. They are never sent to the developer's servers
・To improve the app, it sends usage statistics and crash reports that don't identify you. You can turn off usage statistics anytime, and in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland the app asks before sending them

Terms of Use (Apple's Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hkdocs.com/en/darts/app/privacy/

name: Dawnbite: Fishing Log Journal
description:
Dawnbite is a fishing log and fishing journal that starts on your wrist. Tap Catch on your Apple Watch, its widget or the Live Activity, and the catch is saved with the time, GPS spot, barometric pressure, weather and moon phase. Add species, weight, length and bait later, when your hands are dry. Built for carp, bass, pike, trout and sea anglers who want a fishing app that stays out of the way at the water.

ONE-TAP CATCH LOG
• Start a fishing session, then log Catch, Bite or Miss with one tap
• Apple Watch app keeps logging with your iPhone in the bag, and syncs when they meet again
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a Catch button
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls and Siri: "Log a catch in Dawnbite"

A FISHING JOURNAL THAT FILLS ITSELF IN
• Timeline of every session, with weather and pressure at each catch
• Catch details: species, weight, length, bait, method, released or kept, photos
• Personal bests, catches per hour, and catches by month and species
• Season PDF of your fishing year (Pro)

FISHING SPOTS, MAP AND WEATHER
• Map of your catches and fishing spots, filtered by species, period and method
• Spots keep their own history and best baits
• Fishing weather: 48-hour forecast with wind, rain and pressure trend; moon phase on Home
• 7-day forecast, solunar periods and offline map areas with Pro

MADE FOR THE BANK
• Night session keeps the screen dim and amber
• Sun mode for bright daylight; big buttons for wet hands and gloves
• iPad: your session beside the map, and a sidebar with every spot

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking
• Your fishing log stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch
• Weather is fetched for a rounded area, never your exact spot
• Encrypted backup file you keep yourself

DAWNBITE PRO, PAY ONCE
Unlimited spots, swims and pegs; insights by spot and species; offline map areas; 7-day forecast and solunar periods; Season PDF; catch cards to share; your own event types. One payment, no subscription.

The iPhone app works on its own; an Apple Watch adds one-tap logging from the wrist.
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Weather data from MET Norway.

name: DaysPass: Countdown & Widgets
description:
DaysPass turns the dates that matter most into calm, architectural countdown cards right on your Home and Lock Screen.

Track upcoming trips, anniversaries, exams, paydays, and life milestones with zero ads and zero subscriptions.

KEY FEATURES
• Minimal Countdown & Count-Up Cards: See days remaining or days since meaningful life events.
• Crisp Home & Lock Screen Widgets: Glanceable progress bars and day counters styled to match iOS.
• Smart Event Reminders: Gentle local notifications on the day or days before important dates.
• 100% Offline & Private: No login required — all personal milestones stay on your device.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock unlimited events, custom color themes, and all widget layouts forever.

name: Daytrack: All-Day GPS Log
description:
Daytrack records where you go all day, every day. There is no start button: open it once, allow location access, and each day becomes one track on a map that you can export as GPX.

Made for runners, walkers and travelers who want a complete GPS log without thinking about it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Always recording: Daytrack starts on its own and keeps going in the background, after the app is closed and after a restart.
• One track per day: see each day's route, distance and duration.
• Save interval: drag a slider to save a point every 5 seconds up to once an hour. GPS always runs at full accuracy while recording.
• Schedule: choose the days to record and, for each day, hours not to record, such as overnight. Outside the schedule nothing is saved. One tap resets all settings.
• Export GPX: send any day to a mapping app, a photo app or an AI assistant.
• CSV files: every day is also a CSV in the Files app (On My iPhone › Daytrack) that opens in Numbers or Excel.
• iCloud Drive copy: if you turn it on, each day's CSV is also saved in the Daytrack folder of your own iCloud Drive, so you can open it on your Mac.
• Pause: stop recording any time with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your tracks stay on your iPhone and, if you choose, in your own iCloud Drive.
• No account, no server, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• One-time purchase, no subscription.

BATTERY
Daytrack keeps GPS on at full accuracy. When you stay in one place for more than five minutes, it slows its updates until you move again. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Support: sunjinpak.com/daytrack

name: DealKlar – Resale Calculator
description:
DealKlar helps with reselling: work out the most you can pay before you buy, and see what actually came back afterwards.

BEFORE YOU BUY
• Single item or a whole bundle with any number of items
• Selling fees in percent plus fixed fee, shipping, packaging and other costs
• Safety margin as an amount or a percentage
• Desired surplus as an amount or as a return on the purchase price
• Result: your purchase limit and the planned surplus at the asking price
• “What if you have to sell for less?” – scenarios at 10% and 20% lower
• Minimum selling price for a given asking price
• Fee templates for your selling platforms

AFTER YOU BUY
• Record the actual price paid and purchase costs
• Record sales and write-offs without proceeds
• Balance: how much of your outlay has come back?
• Plan versus actual, remaining stock per item
• Overview with overall balance and net inflows per month
• Search, filter, sort and duplicate purchases

YOUR DATA
• Everything stays on your device – no account, no ads, no internet
• Full backup to a file, restore with validation
• CSV export for spreadsheets
• App language: German and English (amounts in euros)

NOTE
DealKlar calculates with your own estimates. Results are scenarios, not buying advice and no promise of profit. No tax or accounting features.

name: Dean's Security+
description:
Dean's Security+ is practice for the CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 exam: questions in the exam's style across all five domains, with an explanation for every answer.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 2,000 practice questions across the five SY0-801 domains and their objectives, many built around evidence to read: logs, alerts, configurations and policy excerpts. Choose a domain or an objective, and practice untimed.
- An explanation for every answer, and a note on why each wrong choice falls short. Mistakes come back for review.
- Five timed practice forms of 90 questions each, weighted by domain like the exam. Each form shows how many you got right, by domain and objective. It gives no 100 to 900 score: CompTIA does not publish how it scores the exam.
- 250 concept and common-mistake cards, each linked to questions that practice the same idea.
- Interactive practice: match terms to their definitions, and triage log entries as normal or as the attack they attempt.
- Stats by domain and objective, and your practice form results.

START RIGHT AWAY
No account is needed to begin: 20 practice questions are ready as soon as the app opens. Have a Dean Prep account with Dean's Security+ access? Sign in to open all content and sync your progress across your devices.

EARLY ACCESS
Each question has passed an independent solve by someone who did not see the answer key, and is still waiting for review by our Security+ specialist and a security operations practitioner. Questions are labelled as early access in the app. If anything looks wrong, use "Report a problem" on the question.

PRIVACY
No ads, no advertising ID, nothing sold. Crash reports can be turned off, and usage statistics are off unless you turn them on.

CompTIA® and Security+® are trademarks of CompTIA, Inc., which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this product.

name: DecibelCraft: Sound & dB Meter
description:
DecibelCraft transforms your iPhone into a responsive, studio-grade SPL sound level meter for home, nursery, office, and studio noise checks.

Monitor real-time dB readings, min/avg/peak statistics, and live acoustic waveforms — calculated 100% on-device with zero audio recording.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time dB Meter & Waveform: Crisp digital readout with color-coded hearing safety zones.
• Min / Average / Peak Stats: Track ambient noise spikes over time with clear visual history.
• Microphone Calibration Offset: Fine-tune dB offset against reference hardware meters.
• Lock & Home Screen Widgets: Check your latest room noise level at a glance.
• 100% Offline Privacy: Audio is never saved or uploaded. Unlock long-term logs and calibration with one-time Pro.

name: Deckhand: Event Cards
description:
Put the dice away. Deckhand replaces them with a shuffled deck of 36 event cards, one for every roll of two dice, so the numbers even out over the game and every flip brings an event to the table.

FLIP A CARD, NOT THE DICE
• The full 36-card event deck, with New Year shuffled in near the bottom just like the printed cards
• Every event explained the moment it lands, with clear, ordered steps for the table
• Big, readable cards and numbers that everyone around the table can see

BARBARIANS ON THE HORIZON
• Full expansion support: an animated event die, the barbarian ship's voyage and progress-card gates
• Rising tension as the ship nears the island
• A step-by-step attack helper that counts cities and knights and names the winner
• The Alchemist, and an option to roll a physical event die instead

OFFICIAL RULES OR HOUSE RULES
• The official deck options, clearly labelled
• House rules for groups that want them: up to four decks shuffled together, 0 to 15 cards behind New Year, or a fully random mode with exact dice odds

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Turn tracking for 2 to 6 players, with 5–6 player prompts
• Undo, a full history of every flip, and roll statistics
• Keeps the screen awake while you play
• Saved after every flip: if the app closes, Resume puts you back on the exact card

JUICY, NOT NOISY
• 3D card flips, haptics and original sound effects and music, all made for this app
• A juice setting, from calm to full fireworks, plus Reduce Motion support

Deckhand is free with ads. Full-screen ads only ever appear before a game starts, never during play. A single purchase removes all ads for good.

Works with Catan® and Cities & Knights® (sold separately). Deckhand is an unofficial fan companion and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Catan GmbH or Catan Studio.

name: DeenCH
description:
DeenCH begleitet dich im muslimischen Alltag. Die Gebetszeiten in Version 1.0.0 sind für Orte in der Schweiz ausgelegt. Wähle deinen Ort selbst oder lass ihn vom iPhone bestimmen. Unter Heute findest du das nächste Gebet, den Countdown und einen Tagesimpuls.

Für jedes der fünf täglichen Gebete kannst du eine Erinnerung einstellen und wählen, wie viele Minuten vorher sie erscheint. Die Gebetszeiten und Erinnerungen werden auf deinem iPhone berechnet und geplant.

Der Qibla-Kompass hilft dir, dich zur Kaaba auszurichten. Im Quran-Leser kannst du eine Sure auswählen, den arabischen Text lesen und Verse mit einem Lesezeichen wiederfinden. Unter Wissen findest du unter anderem Gebetsanleitungen, Dhikr und Hadithe.

Auf der gekoppelten Apple Watch siehst du den Countdown zum nächsten Gebet, die heutigen Zeiten und die nächsten sieben Tage. Mit dem Tasbih kannst du am Handgelenk frei oder in drei Runden zu je 33 Wiederholungen zählen.

Die Bedienoberfläche ist auf Deutsch, Französisch, Englisch, Albanisch, Bosnisch, Türkisch und Arabisch verfügbar.

name: Deep-Zen Yoga
description:
Deep-Zen Yoga is the companion app for the Deep-Zen Yoga Block Set. It builds a weekly plan around your level, your goal and your blocks, and shows you exactly where the block goes in every pose.

DEEP-ZEN STUDIO
• 30 short lessons filmed with the Deep-Zen blocks, three poses in each
• Six programs: balance, backbends, twists, core and drills, hip openers, and arm balances with a closing rest
• Every pose shows where the block goes: under a hand, between the thighs, under the hips
• Finish a lesson to light a star, and finish a program to keep its constellation
• The first lesson of every program is free

FREE CLASSES
• Guided classes by independent teachers, from 3 to 45 minutes
• Flexibility, strength and balance, stress relief and wrist-friendly practice
• Picked for your level and for how you feel today

STAY ON TRACK
• A weekly goal that fills as you practise
• Streaks, total minutes and a chart of your recent weeks
• Milestones to unlock, from your first practice to five hours on the mat
• Optional reminders on the days you choose

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in so your plan, your practice and your Studio follow you to any phone
• Delete your account and your data at any time, from inside the app
• No ads and no tracking

DEEP-ZEN STUDIO SUBSCRIPTION
Studio Monthly is £4.99 a month, with the first month at £0.99 for new subscribers. Studio Yearly is £49.99 a year. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your account settings.

Free classes are videos by independent yoga teachers on YouTube, played through YouTube's standard player. An internet connection is needed.

Deep-Zen Yoga offers general fitness content, not medical advice. Move gently and stop if anything hurts.

Privacy policy: https://deep-zen.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Delight Shop
description:
Welcome to Delight Shop, a cozy color-sorting puzzle set in a little sweet shop.

Your shelves are full of mixed-up Turkish delight: rose, pistachio, lemon, orange, mint, classic, chocolate and pomegranate. Move the sweets between shelves until every shelf holds a single flavor, then box them up for your customers!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a shelf to lift the top sweets, then tap another shelf to place them, or simply drag them.
• Sweets can only go on the same flavor or on an empty shelf.
• Fill a shelf with 4 sweets of one flavor to close the box.
• Box every flavor to complete the order.

FEATURES
• Customer orders: every level comes with order tickets from regulars like Chef Omar and Aunt Leyla. Box their flavors to deliver.
• Sugar-dusted sweets: some sweets hide their flavor under powdered sugar until you uncover them.
• Rise through the ranks: start as an Apprentice and work your way up to Journeyman, Master and Grand Master.
• Hundreds of levels with carefully tuned difficulty, plus endless Grand Master challenges.
• Earn up to 3 stars by finishing within the target number of moves.
• Undo and Restart anytime, with no limits.
• Gentle tap sounds and haptics, with no background music.
• A charming little shop with striped awnings, wooden shelves and tiled walls.
• Plays great on iPhone and iPad.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Free to play, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
• Works fully offline, with no account or sign-in needed.
• No data collected.

Grab an apron and open the shop. Your customers are waiting!

name: DelsonAI
description:
DelsonAI is a meditation and dhamma companion grounded in Delson Armstrong's teaching: the TWIM and 6R method, hundreds of his talks and his book, refreshed every day with his latest talks. DelsonAI is an AI. It is not Delson himself, and it stays close to his words.

Bring it what is actually happening in your sitting. DelsonAI can:
work through the 6Rs with you
look at a hindrance with you
guide a meditation, or stay with lovingkindness or forgiveness
open the suttas beside you

Type or speak
Write to it, or tap the microphone and speak. Replies can be read aloud. It answers in the language you write in.

One conversation
It remembers your practice across the app, the web and WhatsApp, so you pick up where you left off. If you like, it checks in with you once a day at an hour you choose, and you can turn that off again at any time.

Delson's talks
The Library tab opens Delson's talks, and the talks DelsonAI points you to open in the app.

Who it is for
DelsonAI is for adults aged 18 and over. It is not a therapist and not a substitute for a teacher.

Your account
Sign in with your DelsonAI account. If you do not have one yet, create it on the DelsonAI site, delsonai.delsonarmstrong.com.

Your data
What is kept, where and for how long: kusala.eu/privacy. Terms of use: kusala.eu/terms.

name: Desk Wick
description: Desk Wick is a private reading log that stays on your iPhone. Write the title, a short note in your own words about what the book is about, and how many hours you hoped to give it. Each time you sit down, turn the wick to mark that sitting in five-minute steps, then leave the sitting. The shelf adds those minutes and shows them beside the hours you hoped for. Open a book to see every sitting and when you left it. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

name: DEV MENU
description:
DEV MENU هو البيجر الرقمي للمطاعم والمقاهي التي تستخدم منصة DEV MENU. يغنيك عن جهاز التنبيه الذي تحمله وأنت تنتظر طلبك: امسح رمز المنشأة بكاميرا جوالك، وخذ رقمك، وتابع يومك.

دون تحميل
يفتح البيجر من رمز المنشأة مباشرة عبر التطبيق المصغّر (App Clip)، دون الحاجة إلى تحميل التطبيق أو إنشاء حساب.

تنبيه لا يفوتك
• يرنّ جوالك بصوت مميز فور جاهزية طلبك، حتى وأنت تستخدم تطبيقاً آخر.
• يتكرر التنبيه حتى تؤكد استلام طلبك، أو يوقفه الموظف عند التسليم.
• يظهر رقمك وحالة طلبك على شاشة القفل وفي الجزيرة الديناميكية، مع الوقت المتوقع للتجهيز.
• عند بقاء التطبيق مفتوحاً، يرنّ حتى لو كان الجوال على الوضع الصامت.

أثناء الانتظار
• تصفّح منيو المنشأة وأضف إلى طلبك.
• اسأل عن طلبك واحصل على رد فوري.
• العب لعبة خفيفة إلى أن يجهز طلبك.

بطاقة الولاء
اجمع الأختام في بطاقة ولاء المنشأة واحفظها في محفظة Apple، ويمكنك حذف بطاقتك وبياناتك في أي وقت.

خصوصيتك
لا يطلب التطبيق اسمك أو رقم جوالك لأخذ رقم البيجر، ولا يصل إلى موقعك أو جهات اتصالك.

لأصحاب المطاعم والمقاهي: تعرّف على DEV MENU عبر devmenu.digital

name: DEV MENU business
description:
DEV MENU business هو تطبيق أصحاب المطاعم والمقاهي المشتركين في منصة DEV MENU، تدير منه منشأتك كاملة من الجوال أو الآيباد.

شاشة الكاشير
تظهر الطلبات وأرقام البيجر قيد التجهيز والجاهزة أمام موظفيك. اضغط «جاهز» فيرنّ جوال العميل فوراً حتى وهو في تطبيق آخر، وتبقى الشاشة مضاءة طوال العمل، ويصدر صوت تنبيه مع كل طلب جديد.

المنيو الرقمي
أضف الأطباق وعدّل الأسعار والصور والأقسام، وأوقف الصنف عند نفاد الكمية، فيظهر التعديل لعملائك مباشرة.

البيجر الرقمي
اختر ما يراه العميل أثناء الانتظار: رقم الفاتورة، والوقت المتوقع، وتسليم الطلب للسيارة، والإحصائيات اليومية.

بطاقة الأختام
صمّم بطاقة أختام بألوان منشأتك وشعارها تُحفظ في محفظة جوال العميل، وامسح بطاقته بالكاميرا لإضافة الختم أو صرف المكافأة.

قائمة الانتظار
سجّل العملاء في قائمة الانتظار، ونبّههم تلقائياً عند حلول دورهم.

الإشعارات
يصلك إشعار فور وصول طلب جديد أو تقييم من عميل، حتى والتطبيق مغلق.

يتطلب التطبيق حساب منشأة في DEV MENU، والدخول بالبريد الإلكتروني ورمز تحقق.

name: Dewloom: Snail Relay
description:
A little trail goes a long way.

Meet Pip, Moss, and Luma: three tiny snail couriers with a garden full of letters to deliver. Draw their routes, choose who goes first, and turn the trail one friend leaves behind into a helping hand for the next.

PLAN A CLEVER LITTLE RELAY
Fresh paths spend dew. Wet paths are free to follow, even in the other direction. A helpful detour today might be the shortcut your next courier needs. Think about the whole team, then watch your plan come to life.

MAKE THE GARDEN BLOOM
Prepare a wet approach so Moss can wake a flower bud or Luma can light a lamp. Open leafy bridges, connect garden gates, and discover how small actions create new possibilities.

READ THE WEATHER
Rain can wash a trail away. A protective spool can save it. Wind crossings open on a visible beat cycle. Add a little rest, change the order, and find your moment. Planning is never timed, so take all the thinking time you need.

100 DELIVERIES, TEN GARDENS
Travel from Dewdrop Porch to the Moonseed Festival across 100 fixed puzzles. Collect three optional stamps in each level, work toward three stars, and fill your postcard album along the way.

SMALL REWARDS, NO PRESSURE
Drop by for an optional Daily Visit gift. Missing a day never resets your collection. Shell patterns and keepsakes are decorative; they never change puzzle abilities.

YOUR OWN GARDEN RECORDS
Keep up to four local profiles and compare their real records on the same device. There are no invented competitors, online rankings, or accounts to create.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Undo a route, use a free hint, study a delivery plan, or replay a chapter lesson. Pause, step through a relay, or change the animation speed. Music, sound effects, haptics, motion, and trail contrast have their own settings.

Core gameplay works offline. There are no ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, or energy limits. Progress is stored locally on your device. Privacy and terms pages open online in Safari.

Draw a trail. Leave a little magic. Help the next snail home.

name: Di-Friend - Reading Helper
description:
Di-Friend makes reading on the web easier for people with dyslexia — and for anyone who gets tired reading on a screen. It works right inside Safari, on any website, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

READ-ALOUD MODE
Let Di-Friend read the text to you. Tap the round button on any page and choose:
• Read selection — listen to the text you highlighted.
• Read from here — tap any word and listen from that point on. A marker shows exactly where reading starts.
• Read focus window — hear just the lines you are looking at.
Works in English, Russian and Hebrew with your device's built-in voices. Adjust the speed to your pace.

A FONT MADE FOR DYSLEXIA
Every website switches to Comic Sans or the similar Comic Relief — fonts many readers with dyslexia find easier, because their letters have clearly different shapes. Add more space between letters, words and lines until the text stops "swimming".

FOCUS WINDOW
A bright reading strip that keeps your eyes on one or a few lines. Everything above and below is softly dimmed and blurred, so you don't lose your place. The strip stays still while the text scrolls under it. Drag it to move, pull its edge to make it taller.

WARM BACKGROUND
Swap glaring white for beige, cream, peach, rose or sand. Dark websites are left as they are.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Works on every website automatically — no copying text anywhere.
• Settings in English and Russian.
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything happens on your device.

SUBSCRIPTION
The first 7 days are free. After that, Di-Friend costs $0.99 per month or $9.99 per year. One subscription covers iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple ID. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sollisol.github.io/difriend/privacy.html

name: Diary Crumbs
description:
A memory, a doodle, a thought you want to keep. Diary Crumbs gives them a cozy place to live.

WRITE YOUR WAY
Start on your first page right away and name your diary when you're ready. Write by hand with pen, pencil, brush or highlighter, or type right on the page. Pick a font, size and color, save favorite styles, and move or resize text wherever it fits.

MAKE EVERY PAGE YOURS
Choose paper styles, templates and binder decorations. Add photos, videos, voice recordings, colorful boxes and playful stickers. Design your cover with drawings, text and pictures, or a short loop from one of your own videos.

CATCH A QUICK THOUGHT
Quick Notes hold passing thoughts and checklists. Pin them, tag them, search them, or open the full page when you need more room.

LOOK BACK ON ANY DAY
Open the calendar to revisit a day or write for a past date. Check in with your mood and see your month at a glance. Search your writing and recordings, and bookmark pages you love.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your diaries are saved on your iPhone or iPad. No account, no ads, no tracking. Lock individual diaries with Face ID or Touch ID, and choose whether their covers stay visible. Export pages or keep an editable backup.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Keep a gentle writing streak. Pick a 30, 60 or 90 day goal and earn a badge when you reach it. A missed day simply starts a fresh streak, and your best stays yours.

YOUR FAVORITE LIGHT
Choose Cloud Silk, Rose Glow, Baby Blue or Soft Aura, and warm up the screen for evening writing.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add a widget to jot a Quick Note, try today's prompt, or pick up where you left off.

Voice writing uses your device's on-device speech recognition and works in the languages your device supports. Diaries stay on the device they were made on; keep a backup of anything you'd hate to lose.

name: Did We Feed?
description:
Fed? Walked? Everyone already knows.

Three big buttons — Meal, Walk, Meds. One tap logs it; tap Walk again to end it — during a walk you see how long it's been. Add amount and notes later, and pick which entries get big buttons in Settings.

One tap. The whole family sees it. Home shows the family's latest entry, like "Dad · Meal · 12 min ago". See who fed and who walked, and when.

Invite a pet sitter for the weekend — they leave automatically when the invite period ends. Inviting family and pet sitters is free.

Send requests like "Please pick up pet food" and they answer Will do or Done. Pick "Me" to make it your own to-do, including one that repeats every day at the same time. Your to-dos don't show on family screens or in their notifications (they are still stored on family phones as part of your home's records).

Today chips at the top of Home show each kind of entry at a glance. Tap a chip to open the timeline filtered to it.

Charts show daily meal amounts (grams you entered), walk time and med counts; tap a bar to see that day. Gaps between meals or walks show usual and average side by side.

Track your pet's weight under Log › Weight and see it as a line over time. Enter a number over 150 in the kg box, or a weight more than 100 times off the one weighed before that date, and the app asks you to check the unit before saving (e.g. typing 35 for a 35 g hamster asks whether you meant 0.035 kg).

Add vet, vaccine, deworming and grooming dates and get a reminder that morning. After saving a date or marking it Done, tap In 1 month, In 3 months or In 1 year to save the next date too (only dates within a year; tap Undo if you picked the wrong one). Birthdays and adoption days are kept too.

Decorate a diary photo with a days-together badge and a speech bubble, choose shape, background and crop, then share it through your phone's share sheet to wherever you pick. Decorated photos aren't uploaded to our server. Sharing leaves one temporary copy inside the app, removed when you delete or change that day's diary photo, delete that day's diary, leave, or start fresh on this phone.

No internet? Entries stay on your phone and go to family phones when you open the app after you're back online. Entries your family made show up as soon as you open the app.

No sign-up needed. We never ask for your real name, phone number or email. No ads. We don't ask for location access, and diary photos are uploaded with location and device info removed. The family list shows only names, colors and roles. We don't sell or hand over your records.

Contact: ceo@nodex.co.kr

name: DiluteDesk
description:
Check dilution and mixture arithmetic with DiluteDesk.

Enter a stock concentration, a target concentration and a final volume to calculate the stock and diluent amounts. Review the formula alongside the result.

Mix calculates the weighted concentration of two input volumes. Serial dilution builds a step table for a repeated dilution factor, including the transfer and diluent amounts at each step.

• Use percentages from the same concentration basis.
• Work with volumes in mL.
• Inspect the arithmetic before saving a result.
• Keep up to 100 named summaries locally and share selected results.

No account is required. Calculations use an ideal model that assumes additive volumes. This is a general mathematical tool; it does not determine chemical compatibility, safe preparation or medical dosing.

name: Dimensio – Photo Dimensions
description:
Will the desk fit by the window? Which cabinet opening did you measure? With Dimensio, you can put the dimensions on a photo so the numbers and the object stay together.

Take a picture or choose one from Photos. Tap where a measurement begins and ends, enter the value, and drag either endpoint whenever you need to fine-tune it. Add angles and arrows, and use metric or imperial units.

Keep several views in one project. Use a JPG when you want to share a quick reference, or export a PDF with the annotated photos and a table of their dimensions.

On an iPhone with compatible LiDAR, you can switch on Measure in the camera to estimate a distance. Review or correct the result, then place it on a photo of the whole object.

Dimensio saves your projects on your iPhone. Open the sample desk project to see how a finished dimension drawing comes together.

name: Dishif
description:
Dishif helps busy professionals and households decide what to eat using meals they already know and love. Compare home-cooked dishes, takeout favorites, and leftovers side by side by time, cost, and past ratings, then add your pick to your meal plan.
Build a personal meal library with favorite dishes, cooking notes, and takeout preferences so you can remember exactly what to make or order next time. Scan menus or order screenshots to add dishes faster. Track leftover portions and save reheating notes so you remember what’s ready to eat.
Keep a searchable meal journal with photos, ratings, and notes. Use voice dictation for quick entries, and review meal reports to see what you eat most often, how much you spend, and how many leftover portions you use.

name: DiskKind: Free Up Space
description:
Your phone says your storage is full but you don't know what to delete. DiskKind is showing you.

It reads your photos and videos and lists them biggest first, so you can see which ones are the biggest on your iPhone. You can see for every video, screen recording and screenshot how much space it takes and how much you'll get back by deleting it, even if the original is in iCloud.

It also finds photos stored twice, byte for byte, and photos that look almost the same. You can also pick a folder in Files to see how big it is, and it tells you what System Data is. Nothing gets deleted by DiskKind on its own. Things end up in Recently Deleted in Photos, where you can put them back for 30 days. We don't require an account, and nothing DiskKind reads leaves your phone.

The Free version can do all of this and only move one item at a time. DiskKind Pro is a one-time purchase which lets you select and move many items at once.

name: DitherQuay
description:
Turn a selected image into an inspectable black-and-white raster with DitherQuay. Compare three deterministic methods, check individual pixels and keep a saved proof you can revisit.

THREE WAYS TO TWO TONES
Use Threshold, Bayer 4 × 4 or Floyd–Steinberg. See white/black counts, white coverage, signed mean error and mean absolute gray error. Compare methods on the same canonical source before adopting a candidate.

EXAMINE THE PIXELS
Select a working-image coordinate to read the source RGB, calculated gray, output 0/255 and signed difference. Pinch to zoom, or move through rows and columns. Parameter changes mark old results stale until you convert again.

KEEP SOURCES, PROOFS AND OUTPUTS SEPARATE
Name and search your sources and proofs. Edit a recipe, save a revision or make an independent duplicate. Frozen exports retain their pixels and recipe after later source or proof edits.

REAL OUTPUT FILES
Generate an opaque PNG at the working dimensions, with an optional proof-sheet PDF and recipe/statistics JSON. Preview and share the actual files. JSON includes recipe, statistics, dimensions and source/output PNG hashes; it is not a project backup or import format.

INPUTS AND LIMITS
Choose a static, single-frame PNG or JPEG in Files, up to 16 MiB and 40 million pixels. Orientation is normalized, transparency is composited onto white and the working long side is limited to 1024 pixels without upscaling. An explicit Gray study action provides a 4 × 4 example. Up to 30 sources, 60 proofs and 80 outputs share a 256 MiB payload allowance.

Results use declared code-value gray calculations. PNG output has black/white 8-bit channels, not hardware-packed 1-bit data. DitherQuay does not guarantee print quality, colorimetric calibration or hardware compatibility.

name: Divvy-en
description:
Divvy helps you plan and pack lunch boxes with a clear kitchen workflow. Build each bento with main, side, and snack seats, track macros, and keep a tidy archive of the meals you prepare.

Pack Lunch Boxes
Create a new lunch from the Boxes tab. Set the title and kitchen label, adjust calories and macros, and fill each partition with food names that match your prep. Stamp a finished box into your archive so today and prior packs stay easy to revisit.

Partition Photos
Add your own prep shots to Main, Side, and Snack seats with the camera or your photo library. Empty seats keep the default plate art so every box still looks complete while you cook.

Voice Dictation
Dictate partition titles and kitchen notes hands-free while you prep. Speech input is optional and only used when you tap the microphone for a field.

Weekly Plan Tools
Use the Plan tab to improve what you pack next week:
- Cold Spot Map: Log how much of each seat you finished, then generate a thermal-style reading that highlights leftovers.
- Seat Remix: Review layout proposals ranked by leftover risk and apply a remix to rearrange today seats.
- Plan Drift Reel: Generate a prep-versus-reality filmstrip and keep each run in Reel Archive.

Tray Credits
Tray Credits power selected prep actions such as stamping a new box, generating a Cold Spot map, applying a Seat Remix, or creating a Drift Reel. Buy consumable credit packs through Apple In-App Purchase. Credits never expire and work across supported prep tools.

Archive and Preferences
Browse recent boxes, pantry hardware notes, and legal links. Open Privacy Policy and Terms of Use in Safari. Manage tray credit balance, return to the welcome flow, or clear kitchen data when you want a fresh start.

Designed for Everyday Prep
Divvy is built for people who pack lunch regularly and want less waste, clearer partitions, and a calm place to review what they actually eat. English interface. Portrait-first layout that adapts across iPhone and iPad.

Start packing smarter. Open Divvy, build your next bento, and keep your prep rhythm organized.

name: Dizzy Crazy Hotel Door
description:
What happens if you spin a hotel's revolving door way too fast?
A businessman goes flying across the lobby with his suitcase.

Draw circles with your thumb to get the door moving. Let go, and it keeps its momentum. Every time a compartment sweeps past the entrance, waiting guests hop in, ride around, and drop off their room fare.

Then you spin it faster.

At top speed, guests get flung right out of the door. Some tumble across the rug. A granny loves it so much she cheers and asks for one more ride. Even the easy-going lobby jazz speeds up to match the chaos. Outside, a crowd gathers to watch the show, bringing in more guests and bigger tips.

Put those tips to work right before your eyes:
- Watch your plain wooden door transform into polished brass, then glowing solid gold.
- Attach a motor so it spins by itself while you take a breather.
- Roll out a red carpet, hang a buzzing neon sign, and bring in tour buses full of travelers.

Keep an eye out for rare VIPs mixed into the crowd. A steel-armored hero doesn't even roll—he just rockets straight out of the lobby. A golden tycoon showers the floor in coins. Collect all four members of a touring band in your guest album for a massive payout.

Work your way through five spots, from a cozy little guesthouse and a roadside motel up to a towering grand hotel. Fill every room to clear the stage. Each hotel takes just a few minutes to twenty minutes, and your first full run through all five takes around 45 minutes.

Finish fast to earn up to 3 stars, then spend them on permanent upgrades like smoother bearings and better grip. Once you beat all five hotels, your time goes into the Hall of Fame, and you can start a new playthrough keeping everything you unlocked to chase a faster record.

Good to know:
- Easy one-handed portrait play on phones and tablets.
- Paid game with no ads and no in-app purchases.
- Works completely offline.

name: DJ Vibe
description:
DJ Vibe is a free toolbox for DJs and people learning to DJ.

TOOLS
- Similar song finder: find tracks by vibe, BPM, key and energy
- Key & BPM analyzer
- Mashup finder
- Extended mix and auto mix makers
- Vocal remover and acapella maker
- Playlist converter for Rekordbox, Traktor and Serato
- Duplicate song finder and set sorter
- QR code maker
- Learn to DJ: a free beginner guide

COMMUNITY
- DJ Finder, DJ forum and private messages
- Report and block tools; you can delete your account in the menu

Available in English, Turkish, German, Finnish, Swedish, Russian and Spanish.
All tools are free. No in-app purchases.

name: Doclyra - PDF Scanner & QR
description:
Doclyra - PDF Scanner & QR

Doclyra is an all-in-one PDF scanner, document manager, PDF editor, QR code scanner, and barcode scanner designed to make document management simple and convenient.

Scan paper documents, create PDF files, edit documents, organize your files, extract text, and scan QR codes and barcodes—all from one application.

PDF Document Scanner

Scan documents using your camera.
Automatically detect document edges.
Crop, rotate, and enhance scanned pages.
Apply image filters to improve document quality.
Create multi-page PDF documents.
Import documents from your photo library.

PDF Creator & Converter

Convert images into PDF files.
Create PDFs in different page sizes.
Combine multiple images into one PDF.
Export PDF pages as images.
Organize your created documents.

PDF Editor & Tools

Merge multiple PDF files.
Split PDF documents.
Compress PDF files.
Reorder and rotate PDF pages.
Extract selected pages.
Add annotations and highlights.
Draw and add digital signatures.
Protect PDF files with passwords.

QR Code & Barcode Scanner

Scan QR codes using your camera.
Scan supported product barcodes.
Recognize UPC, EAN, Code 128, Code 39, PDF417, Aztec, and DataMatrix formats.
Copy scanned results.
Open detected website links.
Save scan results as PDF reports.

OCR Text Recognition

Extract text from scanned documents.
Recognize text from document images.
Make document content easier to search and manage.

PDF Reader

Open and view PDF documents.
Navigate through PDF pages.
Search document content.
Add bookmarks and annotations.
Read your documents conveniently.

Document Manager

Organize documents into folders.
Mark important documents as favorites.
Search documents quickly.
Sort and manage your files.
View recently accessed documents.
Manage your local document collection.

Storage Management

View document storage usage.
Manage saved documents.
Delete unwanted files.
Clear temporary files and cache.

Export & Share

Export PDF documents.
Share files through other applications.
Save documents to Apple Files.
Print documents using AirPrint.

Why Choose Doclyra?

Doclyra brings essential document scanning, PDF editing, file management, OCR, QR scanning, and barcode scanning tools together in one convenient application.

Whether you need to scan paperwork, manage PDF files, convert images, sign documents, or scan product barcodes, Doclyra helps you handle your everyday document tasks.

Download Doclyra and simplify your document management.

name: DocsDailyGames
description:
Four quick puzzles, new every day. Everyone in the world gets the same puzzles, so you can compare notes with friends and family.
LETTERLOCK Crack a letter padlock. Turn one dial at a time, and every turn has to spell a real word. Can you open it in as few turns as the Locksmith? New 3, 4 and 5-letter locks every day.
WORD SEARCH Find the hidden words, then uncover the day's hidden message or theme. Spot extra words along the way to earn hints.
SOLITAIRE A fresh deal every day, and every daily deal can be won. Tap or drag to move, and undo as much as you like.
SLIDEAROO Slide the tiles back into order. Play with numbers, or with a new public-domain painting each day, themed for the season and holidays.
ALSO
• A sky that follows your time of day, from sunrise to starry night
• Daily streaks, plus your best and average times for every game
• How to Play pages for every game
• No account needed, no ads

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oakbrightlabs.com/apps/docsdailygames/privacy

name: DoctorFile - Inventory & POS
description:
DoctorFile is the mobile companion for the DoctorFile shop management system. Connect your phone to your shop's computer and run your business from anywhere.

SALES & PURCHASES
• Fast point of sale with barcode scanning (all common barcode types)
• Cash or debt sales, units and cartons, custom prices
• Purchases with expiry dates

INVENTORY
• Full product list with stock, prices and images
• Stock count (inventory) and price check
• Expiry tracking and low-stock alerts

CUSTOMERS, AGENTS & STAFF
• Customer and supplier balances, debts and payments
• Customer, invoice and supplier statements as images or PDF, share via WhatsApp
• Employee salaries: deductions, fines, bonuses, advances and payments

MONEY
• Expenses with categories
• Bank and cash-drawer accounts, transfers and history

REPORTS
• Daily and period reports, profit, charts, best and worst sellers, losses and debts

WORKS OFFLINE
• All your data is available without internet
• Sales, payments and changes made offline are saved and sent automatically when the connection returns, recorded once with their real time

ALSO
• Home-screen widgets: today's sales, debts, banks, expiry, 7-day chart and more
• Smart notifications for sales, debts, expiry and changes
• Light and dark mode

DoctorFile works with your own DoctorFile system. A system code and password from the shop owner are required to sign in.

name: Dodii_الدودي
description:
الدودي إيجيبت تطبيقك للمشاوير والتوصيل في مصر.

• مشوار دودي: عربيات حديثة بكابتن محترف، وتختار الفئة اللي تناسبك: اقتصادي، مميز، عائلي، أو VIP. وكمان توكتوك وإسكوتر.
• شوف السعر قبل ما تطلب، والكباتن القريبين يبعتولك عروضهم وإنت تختار.
• تابع الكابتن على الخريطة لحد ما يوصلك، وكلّمه أو راسله من جوه التطبيق.
• مشوار بميعاد: احجز مشوارك قبلها، أو ذهاب وعودة.
• المطار: احجز عربية توصّلك المطار في ميعادك.
• الطرود: ابعت طرد من مكان لمكان بسعر واضح.
• السياحة والسفر: فنادق، وجولات سياحية، وعربية بسواق.
• ادفع كاش أو من المحفظة، واستخدم أكواد الخصم والعروض.
• نقاط ومكافآت على كل مشوار.
• أمان: زرار طوارئ، ومشاركة الرحلة مع أهلك.

name: Dominó Bravo
description:
Partner dominoes like back home, against real people.

Sit down with your partner and play 2 vs 2: double six, 7 tiles each, no boneyard, first to 100. Capicúa and pass-around are worth 25 extra, and blocked games are scored the right way.

• PLAY ONLINE IN SECONDS: tap Play and you're at a table. If players are missing, we fill the seats with bots (always marked BOT).
• PLAY WITH FRIENDS: create a table, share the code and pick your partner.
• OFFLINE PRACTICE against bots on 3 levels.
• 6 REAL TABLES: felt club, cantina, lit-up patio, grandma's kitchen, rooftop at night and beach at sunset. Bone tiles with a brass pin.
• QUICK PHRASES: “I'm out!”, “Capicúa!”, “Nice one, partner”… no free chat.
• Weekly and all-time LEADERBOARD.
• RECONNECTS BY ITSELF if your signal drops: you get your seat and tiles back.
• Nobody sees your tiles: the server deals and checks every move.

Free with ads only between games. Bravo Club (optional monthly subscription) removes ads.

Coins are earned by playing and unlock tables and cosmetics. This is not a gambling game.
