name: Doorlii — Home Food & Shops
description:
Doorlii brings you homemade food from real home kitchens, and everyday items from the shops in your neighbourhood, delivered to your door in Dhaka.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Order home-cooked meals from verified home kitchens, never restaurants
• Shop groceries, medicine, beauty and more from nearby shops
• Lunch Club meal plans: pick a kitchen, choose the days, and get lunch or dinner delivered on schedule
• Catering from home kitchens for your event: ask, get a quote, pay an advance
• Pay cash on delivery, or online with bKash, Nagad, Rocket, cards and banks through EPS
• Track your rider live on the map
• Bangla and English

FOR HOME COOKS AND SHOP OWNERS
Apply in the app, get verified, and manage your menu, orders, meal plans and earnings from your phone. New orders ring until you answer them.

FOR RIDERS
Go online, accept deliveries, navigate, and see your earnings and cash in hand.

Doorlii is built for Bangladesh: prices in ৳, Bangladeshi phone numbers, and support in Bangla.

name: DormStock
description:
DormStock is a campus marketplace built for college students to rent and buy everyday essentials from peers on campus.

Skip shipping delays and overpriced last-minute buys. Browse listings for textbooks, dorm room gear, calculators, lab equipment, electronics, and moving essentials, then coordinate local handoffs directly with other verified students.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ON DORMSTOCK
- Rent or buy items from fellow students on campus
- Post listings in minutes using photos from your camera or device
- Message buyers and sellers directly to coordinate handoffs
- Track active rentals, listings, and account activity in one place

BUILT FOR CAMPUS LIFE
- Student-focused marketplace tailored to campus needs
- Clear listing details so you know what you are renting or buying before you meet
- Designed for fast mobile browsing and easy handoff coordination

Account deletion and support details are available anytime in your account settings or at https://dormstockapp.com/delete-account.

name: DoseCraft: Pill & Med Reminder
description:
DoseCraft keeps your daily prescriptions, vitamins, and supplements effortlessly on track — 100% offline with zero account sign-up.

Clear dosage cards, one-tap taken logging, and Lock/Home Screen widgets make staying consistent simple for you or your family.

KEY FEATURES
• Flexible Medication Schedules: Daily, specific weekdays, interval doses, or as-needed logging.
• Gentle Local Reminders & Refill Alerts: Know before your bottle runs empty.
• Visual Adherence Log: Track taken, skipped, and snoozed doses with clean daily streaks.
• Home Screen Widgets: Check your next scheduled dose at a single glance.
• 100% Offline & Private: Health routines stay strictly on your device. Unlock unlimited meds with one-time Pro.

name: Doya-Share&Video
description:
Find your color story with Doya, a personal lipstick shade journal and video studio.

EXPLORE YOUR PALETTE
Browse curated shade videos and photos, search by brand or shade number, and filter by finish or undertone. Save favorites, follow curated creator profiles and browse comments and keep your own on your device.

MAKE A MOMENT YOURS
Import a video from Photos or Files, choose its start and end times, and save a highlight or a closer center crop. Create a three-frame palette from your video, preview your work and export it to Photos or the share sheet.

COMPARE AND CREATE
Compare lip and arm reference photos with a draggable divider. Select up to three shades and create a personalized comparison card against a choice of background tones. Try a translucent lip tint on a portrait using on-device face landmarks.

YOUR PRIVATE SHADE JOURNAL
No account is required. Journal entries, creator conversations and creations are stored on your device. Optional daily reminders help you revisit your collection.

Doya includes 3 welcome Slices. Browsing, saving shades and photo tint previews are free. Video highlights, macro crops and comparison cards use 1 Slice each; three-frame palettes use 2 Slices. Additional Slices are available through optional one-time in-app purchases. There are no subscriptions. Slices are deducted only when a creation is successfully saved.

Reference photos, color palettes and photo tints are illustrative. Lighting, application and displays affect color appearance. Use content controls to hide videos, block creators, filter words and save reports for sharing. Doya is not affiliated with the cosmetic brands shown.

name: Drift Tycoon: Idle Racing
description:
Build a drift empire from one muddy track in the Finnish forest.

Drift Tycoon is an idle tycoon game about running a drift venue. Your venue earns cash on its own, even while you are away. Spend it on grandstands, pit garages, food stalls, floodlights and staff, host drift events against rival teams, and move on to bigger tracks around the world.

RUN THE VENUE
- Upgrade buildings that earn more for every driver who comes to drift
- Hire staff and unlock milestones that double your income
- Collect what the venue earned while you were away

HOST DRIFT EVENTS
- Four heats judged on angle and line, live on your track
- Pick a plan for each event: steady, all out or clean runs
- Win prizes and Lug Nuts, and climb to the next track

BUILD YOUR GARAGE
- Original cars, each with its own look and feel
- Liveries, paint and parts that help your team win events

DRIVE IT YOURSELF
- Take any car out on your track and drift for cash
- Drag to steer, flick to throw the rear out, link corners for a bigger multiplier

TRAVEL THE WORLD
- Eleven tracks in different countries, each bigger and more rewarding than the last

Drift Tycoon is free to play. It shows optional rewarded ads and occasional ads at natural breaks, and offers optional in-app purchases. Players who make any purchase do not see the occasional ads.

Made by Fhatal Games, Finland.

name: DrillSlate
description:
DrillSlate helps you inspect round holes in a supported ASCII drill file on iPhone. Import a file, verify how its coordinates were interpreted, and trace each measured finding back to an original source line.

- Review source lines, tool diameters and round-hole coordinates in millimeters or inches.
- Pan and zoom the drill map, filter by tool, and open the source for a selected hole.
- Identify repeated centers, mixed diameters and edge gaps below your limit.
- Compare original and transformed positions with a mirror, rotation and translation preview.
- Freeze an inspection and reopen its PDF or share its CSV table.

The included panel sample lets you try each step. Supported sources use an M48 header, a declared unit, tool diameters and absolute X/Y coordinates for circular holes. Inspecting a file leaves its original source unchanged.

name: Driving Theory Test Global
description:
Build your understanding of driving theory, one practice session at a time.

Driving Theory Test Global brings original questions, explanations, country-specific road signs, saved questions, and learning progress together in one focused app. Explore the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, Spain, and Indonesia. The curated library includes 853 country sign entries covering 165 concepts and 332 original learning questions.

Use the interface in English (US), Indonesian, German, French, or Spanish. Study questions and explanations are available in English and Indonesian. Core material works offline; learning progress stays on your device. No MobiKraft account is required. This iOS version contains no ads.

GLOBAL PREMIUM
Choose monthly, six-month, or annual auto-renewable access for longer practice sessions and timed tests. US base prices: $2.99 per month, $7.99 per six months, or $12.99 per year. Actual localized prices and terms appear in the app and Apple checkout. A seven-day free trial is available only when offered for the selected plan and Apple determines eligibility. The free preview includes short, untimed five-question practice.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation or after an eligible free trial. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before renewal. Manage or cancel through Apple Account subscription settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Restore eligible access using Restore purchases.

Driving Theory Test Global is an independent educational app, not an official government, DMV, licensing-authority or examination-provider app. Country and regional coverage is curated, not an exhaustive legal catalogue or official question bank. Practice scores do not guarantee an examination pass. Consult your official local handbook.

name: Drohnenführerschein Training
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zum Luftfahrt-Bundesamt, zur EASA oder zu einer anderen Behörde.

Wer eine Drohne ab 250 Gramm oder mit Kamera fliegt, braucht in der EU in der Regel einen Kompetenznachweis. Mit Drohnenführerschein Training bereitest du dich auf die Online-Prüfung für den EU-Kompetenznachweis A1/A3 und auf die Prüfung zum Fernpiloten-Zeugnis A2 vor.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Luftrecht und Betriebskategorien
- Luftraum, Flugbeschränkungsgebiete und geografische Zonen
- Flugsicherheit und Flugvorbereitung
- Meteorologie
- Technik und Leistung der Drohne
- Datenschutz und Versicherung
- Für A2 zusätzlich: Flugleistung, Wetter und Risikominderung

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- EU-Drohnenführerschein A1/A3: Prüfungsvorbereitung
- EU-Drohnenführerschein A2: Prüfungsvorbereitung

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Drohnen und Verkehr

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zum Drohnenführerschein in dieser App:
- Luftfahrt-Bundesamt, Anforderungen an Fernpiloten: https://www.lba.de/DE/Drohnen/Fernpiloten/Anforderungen_Fernpiloten_node.html
- Luftfahrt-Bundesamt, Kompetenznachweis A1/A3: https://www.lba.de/DE/Drohnen/Fernpiloten/Neuregistrierung_A1_A3/Neuregistrierung_A1_A3_node.html
- EASA, offene Kategorie: https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/domains/drones-air-mobility/operating-drone/open-category-low-risk-civil-drones
- Österreich, Austro Control, Kompetenznachweis A1/A3: https://www.dronespace.at/drohnenfuehrerschein/a1a3_kompetenznachweis
- Österreich, Austro Control, Kompetenznachweis A2: https://www.dronespace.at/drohnenfuehrerschein/a2_kompetenznachweis

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Drone Briefing
description:
Can I fly now? Drone Briefing answers at a glance, for the drone you are taking and the height you will fly.

THE VERDICT
Good to fly, fly with care or don't fly: the app compares wind, gusts, rain, visibility, temperature, the Kp index and official warnings with the limits of your drone and type of flight. Tap a factor to see what weighed in, with the data source and time.

WIND AT FLIGHT HEIGHT
The 10 m forecast projected to 30, 60 and 120 m, with gusts, hour by hour. The wind up there is often much stronger than on the ground.

EVERYTHING YOU CHECK BEFORE TAKE-OFF
• Rain: chance and intensity, visibility and estimated cloud base
• NOAA Kp index, for the compass and GPS
• GPS, Galileo, GLONASS and BeiDou satellites in view by hour
• The best window of each day and hourly charts
• Times in the place's time zone, not the device's

BRAZIL'S AIRSPACE
A map of DECEA's aerodrome and heliport zones (ICA 100-40/2026) drawn on the real runways, prohibited, restricted and danger areas, and helicopter corridors. The verdict says how high you may fly at the place; tap the map to check any point. All worked out on the device.

RULES BY LOCATION
Height limits for the country where you fly, never by your phone's language. In Brazil, the 2026 DECEA and ANAC rules, INMET weather warnings and the SARPAS authorization check.

PILOT CENTRAL AND WALLET (PRO)
• In Brazil: ANAC exam, SISANT registration, insurance and risk assessment, with reminders before they expire, and the SARPAS protocol check
• Digital pilot wallet with photo, documents, aircraft and insurance
• Inspection mode to show an officer, even offline, and a PDF dossier
• Flight hours from DJI Fly records, read on the device, without signing in to DJI

ON YOUR WRIST AND LOCK SCREEN
Home and lock screen widgets, a Live Activity during the flight, an Apple Watch app with complications, and Siri: "Can I fly now with Drone Briefing?".

FREE TO FLY SAFELY
The verdict, wind at height, rain, Kp, the rules and warnings are free, with a 3-day forecast, 1 saved place and the small widget.

DRONE BRIEFING PRO
7-day forecast, unlimited places, satellites, every widget, Live Activity, Apple Watch, pilot central and wallet, and DJI Fly hours. Yearly with 7 days free, or a lifetime purchase with no subscription.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Only the place's coordinate, rounded to about 1 km, goes to Apple Weather. Your documents stay on the device.

IMPORTANT
Drone Briefing is a planning tool. It does not replace flight authorization (LAANC, SARPAS) or the pilot's judgment. Wind above 10 m is estimated.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in Settings ▸ your name ▸ Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account.

name: drop: Ski Tracker
description:
Record your ski days with the phone in your pocket, explore every slope in 3D and share your day as a story.

RECORD YOUR DAY
• One tap when you start: runs, lifts, speed, distance and vertical are measured on their own
• Works with the screen off (with “Always” location access)
• Pause at lunch, resume, finish when you are done
• Season stats, records and your personal bests on each slope

EXPLORE EVERY SKI AREA
• Thousands of ski areas on the map, with every slope in its colour and every lift
• 3D terrain for every one of them, from the Dolomites to the Rockies and Japan
• Snow on the ground, fresh snow and the forecast for your favourite mountains

PLAN AND FOLLOW
• Plan your day slope by slope: drop only offers what you can really take from where you are, lifts included
• Directions to any slope or lift, at your level
• Famous circuits ready to follow, like the Sellaronda, the First World War Ski Tour and the Tauernrunde
• Turn-by-turn navigation on the 3D map while your day keeps recording

SHARE YOUR DAY
• Turn a day or your season into an Instagram story: your runs on the 3D mountain, the numbers or your line, on your own photo
• Choose what to show

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Free, no account, no ads, no tracking
• Your days stay on your iPhone

Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors. drop is a guide, not a guarantee: slopes and lifts may be closed and data can be out of date. Always follow the signs and the ski patrol.

name: Drum School: Daily Technique
description:
Drum School plans a 20 minute session for you every day and brings each study up to tempo one clean set at a time.

Choose your tracks and your playing experience. Each day the app picks the studies, pairs a familiar setting with a new one, and keeps the reviews coming back. Play a short timed set after a count-in, rate it honestly, and the click moves up when the set was clean. Two clean days at the target tempo and a study is yours.

WHAT YOU PRACTISE
- All 40 standard rudiments: rolls, diddles, flams and drags, each with its own top tempo
- Stickings in eighth notes, sixteenths and triplets
- Rudiments moved onto the kit as grooves and fills, with the sticking printed
- Accents and dynamics, from stick heights to written crescendos
- 65 grooves in nine families, from eighth-note bass drum patterns to half time and ghost notes, plus feels such as train beat, one drop, swung sixteenths and gallop
- 30 fills of one, two and four beats, each with its sticking
- Bass drum, hi-hat foot and four-way coordination
- Rhythm reading, song forms and other meters
- Style tracks: rock, funk, blues and shuffle, jazz time and Latin
- Four tracks work on a practice pad alone

HOW IT WORKS
- Clear drum notation with the sticking written in
- Listen to a demo of any study before you play it
- Hand studies come right lead, left lead and over the feet; grooves on hi-hat and ride
- Later style steps move the click to two and four, or drop it out on alternate bars
- Belts from white to black, the same belts as every Shire Studios school

FREE TO START
Your first day needs no account. A free account keeps one daily session a day until you earn the Yellow Belt. Shire Studios Pro opens every belt and as many sessions a day as you like, and one membership opens every Shire Studios school: Singing School, Learn Tunes, Piano School and Drum School.

Pro is offered monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://shirestudios.studio/terms
Privacy policy: https://shirestudios.studio/privacy

name: DryTrayScale
description: DryTrayScale kertoo kotikuivurin käyttäjälle, mihin grammamäärään hedelmä-, liha- tai kasvitarjotin kannattaa lopettaa. Valitse aines, kirjoita märkä paino, aseta vedenpoisto 5 %:n askelin ja lue kuiva tavoite heti. Jokainen punnitus lisää rivin saman erän alle, näyttää edistymisen ja pudotuksen edellisestä; kahden rivin jälkeen erä arvioi jäljellä olevat tunnit. Kaksitoista ainesriviä listaa tavanomaiset vaihteluvälit ja tunnusteet. Välit ovat viitearvioita; vaaka ja ruoka ratkaisevat.

name: DualCam Sentry
description:
Turn a spare iPhone into a baby monitor that sees in two directions at once.

DualCam Sentry uses the front and back cameras of one iPhone at the same time. Put the phone between two cribs and you can watch both children from your own phone — no second camera, no extra hardware. When the kids are older, use the same app as a home security camera that covers both sides of a hallway, an entrance or a room.

MADE FOR SHARED NURSERIES
• Two live views from one phone: front and back camera side by side
• Hear the room live, even with your phone locked
• Cry alerts: get notified when it gets loud, with an adjustable sensitivity
• Soothe from anywhere: play white, pink or brown noise or a gentle "shush" on the camera phone, with a sleep timer
• Sounds fade in and out softly so they never startle
• Echo cancelling: you hear your child, not the white noise

ALSO A SECURITY CAMERA
• Motion detection on both cameras
• Optional automatic recording on motion or sound, with a few seconds before the event
• Clips are saved on your viewer phone and visible in the Files app

WORKS ANYWHERE
• Pair once by scanning a QR code — the phones don't need to share a Wi-Fi network
• At home the phones talk directly; away from home they connect over Wi-Fi or mobile data
• The camera phone's screen goes completely black while filming

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Video and audio are end-to-end encrypted between your two phones
• No account, no sign-up, no cloud storage, no ads, no tracking
• Recordings stay on your phone

WHAT YOU NEED
• Two iPhones with this app installed
• Using both cameras at once needs iPhone XS / XR or newer as the camera; older iPhones use the back camera only
• Keep the camera phone plugged in and the app open (iOS turns cameras off when an app is in the background)

DualCam Sentry is not a medical device and does not replace adult supervision.

name: DuBois Lakeside Church
description:
Stay connected with DuBois Lakeside Church in DuBois, Pennsylvania through sermons, teachings, and ministry content available right from your device. This app is designed to help you remain linked to the church and encouraged in your walk with Christ.

Listen to messages when it is convenient, revisit teachings that spoke to you, and share content with others who may benefit from it. Whether you attend regularly or are following from a distance, the app keeps the ministry accessible all week long.

With this app you can:
- Listen to and watch sermons on demand
- Join live services when the church is on air
- Read the Bible with the built-in reader
- Share messages with family and friends
- Get notified when the church goes live

name: DubPlay – Game Dubbing
description:
DubPlay reads the subtitles of a video game and says them out loud in your language. Handy for games that were never translated, if you read slowly, or when you would rather watch than read.

How it works
Put your iPhone or iPad on a stand in front of the TV and mark where the subtitles are, once. DubPlay reads every new line with the camera, translates it and speaks it.

Translation and voices
- Translation runs on the device and works offline after a one-time language download. You can also use DeepL or your own AI service with your own API key.
- 26 languages. The voices (5 female, 5 male) run on the device too.
- Subtitles in Latin-script languages work today. Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Greek and Cyrillic are not supported yet.

Privacy
No account. Camera images are processed on the device and never uploaded. The free version shows a small ad banner in History and Settings, never while you play.

DubPlay Plus is an optional one-time purchase: a separate voice for each character, a mode for learning English from games, unlimited game profiles, caption themes and no ads.

DubPlay Premium is a monthly subscription for games that already have prepared voices: instead of the device voice you hear voices made in advance, a different one for each character, starting as soon as the line appears. More games and lines are added as people play them. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://wenam.cz/dubplay/privacy/

DubPlay is open source (AGPL-3.0).

name: Ducko: Pocket Agent
description:
Ducko lets you watch and steer the AI coding agents running on your own computer — right from your phone. Leave your computer working at home or in the office; pick up your phone anywhere to see how far it got, tap "Allow", and send it the next instruction.

CHAT VIEW
Every agent session becomes a clean conversation: each step, every file it read or edited, every command it ran. Reply directly, and send photos and files.

A REAL TERMINAL
Switch to the full terminal in one tap. It is your own tmux session — keys, scrolling and menus work just like at your desk.

APPROVALS & ALERTS
When an agent needs you, your phone knows right away. Answer its questions, approve or deny commands, and get notified when the task is done. Live Activities show progress on your Lock Screen.

CONNECTS FROM ANYWHERE
No public IP, no router setup. On the same Wi-Fi Ducko connects directly; elsewhere it goes through a relay. Everything is end-to-end encrypted over SSH — the relay can't see a thing.

ALL YOUR COMPUTERS
Add your Mac at home, a Linux box at work and a Windows PC, and switch between them from the sidebar.

WORKS WITH
Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Pi, Kimi Code, Hermes and more.

GET STARTED
1. On your computer: npm i -g @dinoxx/ducko
2. Run: ducko pair — a QR code appears
3. Open Ducko, scan, connect

Ducko itself doesn't provide any AI service: it connects to the agents you already run on your own computer.

No account, no sign-up. Ducko doesn't collect your personal data.

Privacy Policy: https://ducko-relay.dinoai.fun/privacy/

name: Duftpalm Bayi

Duftpalm | Tarzını Yansıtan Özgün Detaylar

Duftpalm, sıradan araç aksesuarlarına özgün bir dokunuş katıyor. Eğlenceli, dikkat çekici ve karakter sahibi tasarımlarıyla aracına kendi tarzını yansıtmanı sağlıyor.

name: Dumbbell Strength Plan
description:
Build full-body strength and muscle at home with just a pair of dumbbells — from beginner foundations to advanced strength overload, with no gym, no weight bench, and no subscription.

Dumbbell Strength Plan gives you 53 animated exercises, 6 free home workouts, and 12 structured 21-to-30-day programs built around proven free-weight progression.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED AT HOME
- 6 free workouts ready on day one: 12-Minute Full-Body Starter, 10-Minute Dumbbell Express, Upper Body and Arms, Legs and Glutes, Back, Core and Carry, and 20-Minute Advanced Dumbbell Power.
- 53 exercises with clear looping demonstrations and 4-step form cues: goblet and front squats, Bulgarian split squats, deadlifts and RDLs, floor presses, hand-supported and high-plank rows, Arnold and Z-presses, thrusters, clean & press, curls, triceps presses, and loaded carries.
- No weight bench required: every workout and program works with a pair of dumbbells and a floor or mat (plus a sturdy chair for optional single-leg elevation).

12 STRUCTURED PROGRAMS (BEGINNER TO ADVANCED)
Follow a 2-days-on, 1-day-off schedule across 21 to 30 days, scaled across 6 difficulty levels so every plan grows with you:
- Beginner: Beginner Dumbbell Foundations (28 days), 15-Minute Dumbbell Express (30 days), Dumbbell Core and Stability (21 days)
- Intermediate: Full-Body Dumbbell Strength (30 days), Stronger Upper Body (28 days), Stronger Legs and Glutes (30 days), Stronger Back and Grip (28 days), Arms and Shoulders Hypertrophy (21 days)
- Advanced: Advanced Push, Pull and Legs (30 days), Advanced Upper and Lower Overload (30 days), Advanced Dumbbell Power and Conditioning (28 days), Advanced Full-Body Strength Overload (30 days)

BUILT-IN WEIGHT LOG & JOINT-AWARE SKIPPING
- Note the per-dumbbell weight you use for each exercise in kg or lb, change it mid-workout in one tap, and view your weight history — stored locally on your device with no account required.
- Tell the app how your joints feel today (low back, shoulder, wrist, knee, hip, or osteoporosis) to automatically skip exercises most likely to aggravate that area while keeping a full session.
- Includes peer-reviewed training sources, progression rules, and home lifting safety checklists right inside the app.

ONE-TIME PURCHASES — NO SUBSCRIPTION
- All 6 workouts, the full 53-exercise library, and the weight log are free.
- Unlock individual programs, the custom workout/program builders, or the all-access bundle with a one-time purchase. Buying any program removes ads from its sessions.

General fitness training only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Check adjustable dumbbell locks before every set and consult a doctor before starting if you have a medical or joint condition.

name: Dungeon Scavenger: Pawn RPG
description:
The heroic adventurers have slain the dragon and marched home in glory. But who cleans up the messy battlefield?

Welcome to Dungeon Scavenger: Aftermath & Pawn! Step into the boots of Dusty, a resourceful frontier scavenger and pawn shop manager. Equipped with nothing but a trusty wooden wheelbarrow, a worn broom, and an oil lantern, dive deep into the silent ruins left behind by epic hero expeditions. Salvage dented armor, sharpen notched blades, appraise mysterious arcane relics, and negotiate shrewd deals with colorful adventurers in your tavern shop to redeem your ancestral shop deed!

GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS 

【POST-BATTLE DUNGEON SALVAGING】
• Delve into the aftermath of legendary clashes across distinct biomes: Ancient Crypts, Sunken Catacombs, and Magma Foundries.
• Sweep through scattered battlefield debris, smash abandoned supply barrels, and scurry past subterranean dungeon vermin.
• Inspect fallen hero remains and harvest towering boss skeletons for legendary dragon scales and mystic amulets!
• Watch your step: dodge leftover poison dart traps that damage and slow your cart.

【CART LOGISTICS & LANTERN SURVIVAL】
• Manage both cart capacity slots and realistic weight limits: don't overload your wheelbarrow, or your wheels will screech and crawl!
• Keep your oil lantern lit! Harvest whale oil flasks to prevent darkness from creeping in and impairing your scavenging speed.
• Know when to pack up: find the extraction rope to haul your bounty safely back to town.

【WORKBENCH RESTORATION & APPRAISAL】
Tackle tarnished junk and transform it into dazzling treasures:
• Sponge Cleansing: Scrub muddy shields back to standard condition.
• Grindstone Polishing: Sharpen rusty knight swords into shining steel for massive value multipliers.
• Smithy Repair: Hammer cracked armor plates straight on the anvil.
• Ancient Mirror Appraisal: Reveal true attributes and hidden values of sealed arcane relics.

【TAVERN PAWN SHOP & DYNAMIC HAGGLING】
• Display your restored wares on custom tavern showcases and set your own asking prices.
• Bargain with distinct adventurer classes: righteous Paladins, shrewd Rogues, curious Mages, sturdy Town Guards, and eager Blacksmith Apprentices.
• Read customer patience and emotional cues: stand firm on your high price tag, or offer a friendly discount to seal the deal before they storm out!
• Complete daily Guild Bounty commissions for extra coin bonuses and town renown.

【WORKSHOP EXPANSION & THE ANCESTRAL DEED】
• Upgrade your gear: expand wheelbarrow slot capacity, reinforce bearing durability, extend lantern burn time, and widen broom sweeping range.
• Expand your tavern pawn shop from a modest 3-stand counter to a grand 6-stand trading emporium.
• Decorate your shop with cozy tavern fireplaces and golden Lucky Cats to attract high-paying connoisseurs.
• The Ultimate Goal: Earn 800 Gold and 25 Renown to pay off loans, tear up the mortgage, and reclaim your family's ancestral pawn deed!
• Endless Mode: Continue building your salvaging empire in post-game endless mode.

DESIGNED FOR MOBILE & OFFLINE 
• Fluid dual-mode mobile controls: dynamic virtual analog joystick + responsive tactile action buttons.
• Seamless offline play: fully playable without Wi-Fi or cellular network connections.
• Smart auto-save: your cart inventory, shop upgrades, and story progression are safely saved at every step.
• Zero forced pop-up interruptions: pure, immersive, atmospheric dungeon scavenging fun.

Grab your broom, light your lantern, and load up the wheelbarrow. There is a fortune buried in the dungeon debris!

name: Duo Doodle: Draw & Guess
description:
Duo Doodle is a quick draw-and-guess game for two.

You each get five secret words and ten seconds to draw each one. Then you swap: you see your buddy's drawings and type what you think they are, while they do the same with yours. You are on the same team, so every right guess adds to one shared duo score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Draw: five words, ten seconds each. No letters or numbers allowed.
• Guess: type what your buddy drew. You get a hint with the number of letters.
• Reveal: go through every drawing together, see who guessed what, and react with emoji.
• Score: up to 200 points per game, with bonuses for fast guesses and clear drawings.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Quick match pairs you with another player in seconds. If nobody is around, a doodle bot jumps in so you can always play.
• Create a room and share a four-letter code to play with a friend.
• Add friends with a friend code and invite them to a game.

MORE TO DO
• Over 500 words to draw, from cats and castles to tacos and tornadoes.
• Post your best (or worst) drawing sheet to the feed for 24 hours.
• Climb the weekly and all-time leaderboards.
• Sounds and haptics you can switch off.

NO SIGN-UP
Pick an animal and a nickname and you are playing. No email, no password, no ads.

KEPT FRIENDLY
You can report any drawing and block the player who made it. Drawings are deleted after 24 hours, and you can delete your data at any time from your profile.

name: DuoPlayer 2000
description:
Before playlists, we made mix CDs. DuoPlayer 2000 brings the whole ritual back.

Pick your songs, burn them onto an 80-minute disc, scribble a title on the label, slide it into a jewel case, and press play on a chunky portable CD player that looks straight out of 2000.

BURN YOUR OWN MIX CDs
• Search your music library, or browse by playlist or genre
• Add songs to the burn list and watch the disc burn
• Each disc holds up to 80 minutes, just like the real thing

DECORATE THE DISC
• Doodle on the label with on-screen markers in ten colors, plus a color picker for any shade
• Draw with your finger, or use Apple Pencil on iPhone Duo and iPad for extra precision
• Rotate the disc while you decorate, with undo, redo and wipe

DESIGN THE CASE
• Add a cover photo from your camera roll
• No photo? Choose from 16 retro preset covers, like Summer Hits 2000, Party Mix Vol. 1 and Slow Jamz, or plain holo foil, glitter and flames
• Pick an album color and a clear or neon jewel case
• Keep every mix in your CD organizer

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• Drag a CD from its case into the player
• Watch your own doodles spin as the music plays
• Restyle the player in eight colors, three finishes and four display lights

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
• Unfolded: your organizer and player side by side
• Tabletop: the disc up top, controls at your fingertips
• Folded: a pocket CD player on the outer display
• Also runs on iPhone and iPad

SHARE YOUR MIXES
• Send a mix to friends who have DuoPlayer 2000
• They can play it with Apple Music, or hear 30-second previews without a subscription

One-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Your music. Your memories. Your style.
Burn. Spin. Rewind.

Playing full songs requires music in your library or an Apple Music subscription.

name: DUSK Tools
description:
DUSK Tools is the internal workspace of DUSK Digital LLC, a lead generation and marketing agency. It is made for the DUSK Digital team and works with a DUSK Tools team account.

With the app, team members can:
- See every client at a glance: website health, rankings, Google Ads and Search Console numbers
- Get instant alerts when a client website goes down or comes back, when an SSL certificate is about to run out, or when client emails and forms stop getting through
- Open any client from iPhone search, and see unread alerts and sites that are down on the Home Screen widget
- Use the agency's SEO and local search tools: site health, local rank and grid checks, keyword research, competitor gaps and more
- Share a page with a teammate in one tap
- Keep the last numbers at hand when there is no signal

Sign-in needs an account created by a DUSK Tools administrator. The app has no public sign-up.

name: Duskra Online
description:
== Description: 1924 / 4000 characters
Duskra Online is a live space MMO: every pilot flies in the same shared world, in real time, on our servers.

Tap Play and you are in space in seconds. No form, no email, no password: your pilot is a guest account kept on this device.

FIGHT IN REAL TIME
Steer with the stick, hold the fire button to sweep the radar over your targets, release to lock and open fire. Lasers, shields and hull are worked out on the server, so every pilot nearby sees the same fight.

HUNT AND LOOT
Hunt drones near home, then raiders, haulers and their escorts, and marauders on the Frontier. Destroyed ships can drop loot boxes: fly over them to fill your cargo hold.

DOCK AT THE STATION
Sell your loot, buy upgrades, keep items in storage and repair your ship. The space around the station is a no-fire zone: a safe place to catch your breath.

UPGRADE YOUR SHIP
Fit a laser, a shield and an engine. Each comes in four tiers, and the best ones ask for a higher Gunnery level.

LEVEL UP
Gunnery grows with every kill, Repair when you rebuild a destroyed ship at the station. Your levels never drop: they open better gear and the way to the Frontier.

TWO MAPS AND A PORTAL
Home is calm and made for new pilots. Through the portal lies the Frontier: aggressive enemies, better loot, and the Warden, a boss that guards its far corner. If your ship is destroyed, the cargo you carried is left behind and you start again docked at the station.

A SHORT GUIDE
Five short steps teach the loop in your first minutes: fly, fight, loot, dock, upgrade. Skip it any time and restart it from the settings.

FAIR BY DESIGN
No purchases and no ads in Season 0. Every credit and item is recorded on the server, so nothing is lost when your connection drops.

SEASON 0
This is the first test season. Progress may be reset when it ends; we will tell you in advance. Tell us what you think: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}

Requires an internet connection. Landscape only.

name: Dusty Haul 3D
description:
How high dare you stack your flatbed before crossing the canyon bridges? Dusty Haul 3D is a tactile 3D physics cargo-packing & desert highway driving game.

FEATURES:
- Real 3D Physics Bed Packing: Drop supply crates, fuel drums, and golden relic chests onto your pickup bed and lock them down with ratchet straps.
- Canyon Bridges & Steep Mesas: Balance gas, brakes, fuel, and engine heat across 1,100m of washboard desert roads and wooden suspension bridges.
- Outpost Garage Upgrades: Cash in delivered cargo to build taller steel bed cages, coilover shocks, twin-turbo coolers, and extra strap kits.

name: DVX
seller_name: SETKIM KIMYA OTOMOTIV INSAAT SANAYI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
DVX, Divortex ürünlerini satan bayiler ve profesyonel oto bakım işletmeleri için hazırlanmış resmi katalog uygulamasıdır.

ÜRÜN KATALOĞU
• Yıkama şampuanları, pasta ve cilalar, seramik kaplama, iç temizlik, oto parfümleri, kış ürünleri, jant ve lastik bakımı, motor ve servis ürünleri, aksesuarlar, endüstriyel ve hijyen ürünleri dahil 330'u aşkın ürün
• Her ürün için açıklama, kullanım alanları, kullanım talimatı, uyarılar, teknik bilgiler, ambalaj seçenekleri, stok kodu ve raf ömrü
• Teknik föy (TDS) ve güvenlik bilgi formu (SDS) belgeleri
• Kategoriye göre gezinme, ürün adı ya da stok koduyla arama
• Ürünü bağlantı, e-posta ya da mesajla paylaşma

PDF KATALOGLAR VE BLOG
• Oto bakım kimyasalları ve ekipman kataloglarını PDF olarak açın, paylaşın
• Köpük seçimi, pasta cila, jant temizliği, araç içi koku gibi konularda uygulama rehberleri

BELGELER
• ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949 ve diğer kalite belgeleri, geçerlilik tarihleriyle
• Marka tescilleri ve ödüller

PRIVATE LABEL
Private label üretim yaptığımız firmalar, firmamızın verdiği hesapla giriş yaparak kendileri için ürettiğimiz ürünleri, içeriklerini, teknik bilgilerini ve belgelerini görür. Her firma yalnızca kendi ürünlerini görür.
