name: Ealifle
description:
Ealifle — Discover More, Share the Little Moments of Life

Life doesn't always have to be busy. Sometimes, it's nice to slow down and make a little time for yourself. On Ealifle, explore entertaining short videos and discover the little joys of everyday life, from travel and food to adorable pets and special daily moments. Capture your thoughts and feelings through photos, videos, and text, and turn everyday experiences into lasting memories.

Whenever you feel like relaxing, step into a voice room you enjoy. Listen to music, chat about everyday life, or simply spend some quiet time listening. Let music accompany your leisure moments and find a sense of comfort and connection through shared interests.

Save the content you love, follow creators who inspire you, and share the little things that make you happy. Whether you're taking a break after a busy day or enjoying a peaceful weekend, Ealifle gives you a place to slow down, unwind, and discover another beautiful side of life.

name: Earth Field Observatory
description:
You are on watch at a harbor. The steps are wet, yet the sea outside looks calm. Which step will flood first?

Investigate 20 cases across a harbor, a glacier lake, a volcanic valley and a geothermal village. Compare the incident log with 21-day station records, pin evidence and submit both your decision and its basis. Solved cases reveal an explanation and a historical source.

Choose among five levels, from elementary to doctoral, and play in English, Korean, Japanese or German. Progress and notes stay on your device. Maps and measurements are educational simulations.

name: Earth Rod
description:
Earth Rod reads a ground-rod fall-of-potential test on this iPhone.

The potential probe sits at 52, 62, and 72 percent of the distance to the current probe. The result is the 62 percent reading. A flat middle means the three readings stay within 5 percent, so the reading is outside both probes' reach. Pass means that middle is flat and the ohms are within the limit. Add rod means the middle is flat and the ohms are past the limit. No plateau means move the current probe to 1.5 times its distance, and not past 200 m. At 200 m with no plateau, the stamp is Area too small. Soil resistivity from a Wenner spacing predicts what one rod of the saved length and diameter can reach. Consistent means the prediction is within 30 percent of the measured ohms.

Tests stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Easy Background Remover
description:
Remove the background from a photo and save a clean cutout. Make a white-background product photo, choose another color, or export a transparent PNG.

Edit one photo or process up to 50 at a time. The app centers each subject automatically. The default batch export uses a white background and a 1200 × 1200 pixel canvas.

• Tap a color swatch to change the background.
• Choose a size for a social post or product listing, or enter your own pixel dimensions.
• Drag or pinch to adjust a subject. Use the erase and restore brushes to refine its edges.
• Apply a canvas or placement change to one photo or the whole batch.
• Save images to Photos as transparent PNGs or solid-background JPGs.

Background removal runs on your iPhone. The app does not upload your photos for processing.

Your first three exports are free. A successful batch save counts as one export. A monthly subscription or a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports.

Privacy Policy: https://justcompress.online/apps/cutout/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Easy Read Mahjong: Big Tiles
description:
Easy Read Mahjong is classic mahjong solitaire with big tiles you can read at a glance. Every tile shows a large number or letter in the corner, every board can be solved, and there is no timer - just relaxing tile matching at your own pace.

BIG, EASY-TO-READ TILES
Each tile has a large number or letter in its corner, so similar tiles are easy to tell apart. Tiles you can't pick yet are gently shaded, so you always know where to look.

EVERY BOARD CAN BE SOLVED
Every board is built so it can be cleared. If you get stuck, shuffle the remaining tiles - the board stays solvable after a shuffle. Your first shuffle on each board is free; after that, an optional video gives you another.

NO TIMER, NO PRESSURE
Take all the time you want. Undo is free and unlimited. You get 3 free hints every day, and you can watch an optional video for more.

EASY TO LEARN
New to mahjong solitaire? Match two identical free tiles to remove them. On your first boards, matching pairs light up to show you how. Tap a blocked tile and the game tells you why it can't be picked.

LEVELS THAT NEVER RUN OUT
Start with small 12-tile boards and work up to big 120-tile boards. 30 board shapes - hearts, butterflies, castles, crowns and more - with new levels that keep on coming.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Play the Daily Puzzle and build your streak.

• Play offline - your game is saved automatically
• Progress kept safe in iCloud - no account or login
• Large tiles that are easy on the eyes

ABOUT ADS
Easy Read Mahjong is free to play with ads: a banner, a full-screen ad after you clear a board or when you come back to the app after a while, and optional videos only when you choose them. No full-screen ads while you are playing a board. A one-time purchase of Remove Ads removes the banner and full-screen ads - no subscription.

name: Easy Read Solitaire: Big Cards
description:
Easy Read Solitaire is classic Klondike solitaire with big cards you can read at a glance. Large print numbers and suits, deals that can always be won, and simple tap-to-move play make it a relaxing card game for anyone who wants solitaire that is easy on the eyes.

BIG, EASY-TO-READ CARDS
The rank and suit in each corner are printed large, and the seven columns stretch across your screen. No more squinting at tiny cards.

4-COLOR DECK OPTION
Turn on the 4-color deck - black spades, red hearts, blue diamonds and green clubs - so spades and clubs never look alike. The classic two-color deck is the default.

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Each standard deal is checked before you play it, so there is always a way to win.

STUCK? START AGAIN FOR FREE
When there are no more moves, the game tells you. Replay the same deal or start a new one for free - no video required.

TAP TO MOVE
Tap a card and it moves to the best spot. Dragging works too. Large touch areas help prevent mis-taps, and undo is free and unlimited.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No timer and no score pressure. Free hints every day show you a helpful move, and if a card can't move, the game tells you why.

CLASSIC KLONDIKE RULES
• Draw 1 or Draw 3
• Unlimited passes through the deck
• Auto-complete when every card is face up
• Optional auto-move to the foundations
• Left-handed mode

A NEW DEAL EVERY DAY
Play the Daily Deal and build your streak. Missing a day never costs you anything.

YOUR STATS STAY SAFE
Games played, win rate, best streak and fewest moves are saved on your device.

• Works offline - no Wi-Fi or account needed
• Your game is saved automatically
• Also known as Patience in the UK

ABOUT ADS
Easy Read Solitaire is free to play with ads. While you play, the only ad is a small banner at the bottom. Full-screen ads appear only between games or when you come back to the app after a while - never in the middle of a game. A one-time purchase removes banner and full-screen ads - no subscription. Optional videos for extra hints stay available only if you choose to watch them.

name: EasyRate: Currency Converter
description:
Make sense of every price in a currency you know!

EasyRate supports over 1,000 currencies for traveling abroad, comparing prices on international shopping sites, and everyday currency conversion.

Works offline, too! Built-in reference exchange rates are ready to use the first time you open the app. When rates are updated online, EasyRate saves them on your device, so you can keep converting even without an internet connection.

Actual transaction amounts may vary depending on the exchange rates and fees applied by your card issuer or currency exchange provider.

- Offline currency conversion
- Exchange rates for over 1,000 currencies
- Fully optimized for iPhone Duo and iPad
- Supports Light & Dark Theme

name: EazyGo
description:
EazyGo منصة بتربط اللي عايز يشحن طرد بمسافر رايح نفس الوجهة — شحن أسرع وأوفر، بأمان ومتابعة لحد التسليم.

للعملاء — اشحن طردك بسهولة:
• أنشئ طلب شحن بتفاصيل الطرد ووزنه وصوره ووجهته.
• استقبل عروض من مسافرين موثّقين رايحين نفس المسار واختار الأنسب.
• تابع حالة الشحنة خطوة بخطوة لحد ما توصل.
• تسليم مؤمَّن برمز تأكيد (PIN) يضمن إن الطرد وصل للشخص الصح.

للمسافرين — اكسب من رحلتك:
• سجّل رحلتك (المطار، التاريخ، رقم الرحلة) والمساحة المتاحة.
• تصفّح الشحنات المناسبة لمسارك وقدّم عرضك بالسعر اللي يناسبك.
• استلم عمولتك في محفظتك داخل التطبيق بعد تأكيد التسليم.

أمان وثقة:
• توثيق هوية المسافرين قبل قبول الشحنات.
• شات مباشر بين العميل والمسافر بعد قبول العرض.
• دعم فني من داخل التطبيق في أي وقت.
• إشعارات فورية بكل تحديث على شحنتك أو رحلتك.

EazyGo — اشحن مع المسافرين بثقة.

—

EazyGo connects people who want to send a parcel with verified travelers heading to the same destination. Create a shipment, receive offers from travelers, track it until delivery, and confirm handover with a secure PIN. Travelers earn a commission from the spare space in their luggage.

name: Echo: AI Speaking Coach
description:
Speak clearly and get to the point, with a coach that listens.

Echo is an AI speaking coach. Talk with Echo like you would with a friend, or record a short speech. A minute later, Echo gives you three things to work on, not a wall of numbers:

• Start doing: one new habit to try next time
• Stop doing: the one habit that costs you the most clarity
• Keep doing: what is already working, so you keep it

Every tip points to the moment it is about. Tap it and hear yourself say it.

WHAT ECHO LISTENS FOR
• Filler words: um, uh, like, you know
• Pace: too fast, too slow, or easy to follow
• Pauses: thinking pauses in the middle of a sentence versus pauses that land an idea
• Repeated words and restarts
• Grammar slips, with the smallest correction
• Pronunciation of the words that matter

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap the mic to talk with Echo. It asks questions and keeps the conversation going.
• Hold the mic for a second to record a speech: a presentation, an interview answer, a pitch.
• Echo reads it in the background and tells you when your feedback is ready.
• Echo remembers its last advice and follows up on it next time.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Echo only celebrates what it actually measured. If a recording is too short or too quiet to measure, Echo says so instead of guessing. The full report with every measurement is one tap away when you want the details.

GOOD FOR
• Practising for job interviews and meetings
• Presentations and public speaking
• Speaking English with more confidence at work
• Anyone who wants to sound clear and sure of themselves

YOUR VOICE, YOUR DATA
Echo asks for your permission before any recording is analysed, and names every service it uses in the privacy policy. No ads, no tracking. Delete your account and every recording from inside the app at any time.

Questions? info@minhkimsolutions.com

name: Echo: Dictation & Notes
description:
Echo is dictation and meeting transcription for iPhone. Tap, speak, and your text is on the clipboard — paste it into any app.

DICTATION
• One tap and Echo listens. Stop, and the text is transcribed and copied.
• Improve: AI removes “um”, repetitions and typos and fixes punctuation using your instructions. Turn it on for every dictation or improve one later.
• Quick launch: the Action button, AssistiveTouch, Back Tap, Control Center, the Lock Screen, a widget and Siri.
• No connection? The recording is kept, and you send it when you’re back online.
• Dictation history with search.

MEETINGS
• Put your iPhone on the table and tap New recording: Echo records up to 3 hours, in the background and with the screen locked.
• A call in the middle of a meeting pauses the recording instead of ending it.
• Transcripts with speakers (Soniox): who said what, with timestamps. Name the speakers yourself.
• Meeting summaries: key points, decisions, action items and open questions.
• Share the text or the audio to notes, mail or chat.

YOUR OWN KEY, NO ACCOUNT
• OpenAI, Grok or Soniox — add your own API key and pay the provider directly.
• Pick a provider for each task: dictation, improving text, meetings, summaries.
• Your key stays in the Keychain on this iPhone.

PRIVACY
• No account, no sign-up.
• Audio and text go only to the provider you choose, and only after you allow it. There is no Echo server in between.
• Dictations and meetings stay on your iPhone.

Echo is also on the Mac, with a hotkey, call recording and clipboard history.

name: Eckenanalyse Hockey
description:
Eckenanalyse is the app for field hockey coaches who take penalty corners seriously. During the match you record every corner in a few seconds from the sideline; afterwards you see in black and white what works.

RECORD CORNERS – FAST AND OFFLINE
• Pick the variant, tap a player for every role, rate injection and stop, enter result and shot target
• The goal as a grid: nine zones plus left, right and over the goal
• Works without internet and syncs automatically once you're back online
• Field and indoor kept apart, each with its own roster and variants
• Edit corners afterwards

ANALYZE
• Success rates for injection, stop and finish, per player and per role
• Shot heatmap: where shots go and what they lead to
• The best variants and player combinations
• Stats for every match and every player
• PDF reports to share and export as an Excel file

AS A TEAM
• Several coaches per team, join with an invite code
• The owner manages team and members, every coach records and analyzes
• Several teams, quick switching

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Native design with Dark Mode and large text
• German, English and Spanish

ECKENANALYSE PRO
Recording new corners is part of Eckenanalyse Pro. One subscription covers the whole team: the owner subscribes, all coaches of the team get Pro. Try it free for 2 weeks, then €8.99 a month or €79.99 a year. Stats, roster, matches and reports stay available without a subscription. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://eckenanalyse.vercel.app/privacy

name: ECLIPSE with Vanya Silverten
description:
Inside the ECLIPSE with Vanya Silverten app, you can:

Access all of your videos in one easy to use app
Receive push notifications with the latest news and updates
Access to all of your videos without having to remember your password
Save your favorite posts so you can quickly find them later

name: EcoMont
description:
EcoMont brings environmental learning and real-world community action together. Discover local eco-tasks and events, report environmental issues, learn about sustainability, and follow your progress.

With EcoMont, you can:
• Report local environmental issues with photos and location when the feature needs it.
• Take part in individual and community eco-tasks and events.
• Explore lessons and quizzes about recycling and sustainability.
• Earn points and badges while following your activity progress.
• Join community discussions and share environmental activities.

EcoMont connects citizens, young people, schools and communities in Montenegro and beyond. Some features require an account. Location, camera and notifications are used only when you choose features that need them.

name: EdgeRegister
description:
Keep the details that make a software issue reproducible.

EdgeRegister is a private issue register for independent testers. Capture the environment, reproduction steps and expected result, then assign a severity and work through a deliberate retest process.

REGISTER AND TRIAGE
Create, search and filter issues. Open a detail page to read the complete reproduction notes. A separate triage view groups active issues by severity, so critical boundaries are easy to revisit.

FIX AND VERIFY
Mark an open issue as fixed. Closing requires retest notes, keeping the verification outcome attached to the record. Closed issues have their own history and can be reopened. Edit records or delete them with confirmation.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Your issue records stay on your device and work offline. There is no login, advertising or in-app purchase. Optional fictional examples help you explore; a new installation starts empty.

Choose light, dark or system appearance. Use English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian. The app falls back to English for an unsupported primary system language.

A read-only CloudKit startup configuration does not replace or hide the native tools and never opens external links automatically. Configuration failure returns to the same offline workflow.

name: Edios Exhale
description:
Edios Exhale is an active yoga posture and tension-release studio designed to help you move physical stiffness and pent-up stress out of your neck, shoulders, hips, and lower back—completely offline.

Whether you have 5 minutes between desk sessions or 14 minutes to unwind at the end of the day, Edios Exhale pairs clear anatomical posture illustrations with smooth breath-cadence pacing and gentle synthesized ambient audio.

KEY FEATURES
• 30 Guided Yoga Postures: Organized across Grounding & Standing, Heart & Shoulder Openers, Hip & Tension Release, Spinal Twists & Unwind, Seated Meditative Stillness, and Restorative Reset.
• Clear Alignment & Modifications: Every posture includes step-by-step physical cues, breath cadence timing, and a gentle modification for tight joints or props.
• 8 Curated Energy-Release Flows: Shake Off the Day, Morning Energy Wake-Up, 5-Min Desk & Neck Reset, Hip & Lower Back Unwind, Deep Meditative Stillness, Athletic Cool-Down, Breath & Spine Decompress, and Evening Tension Release.
• Interactive Mat Player: Live breath pacing ring, +15s hold extension, Next Pose preview chip, smooth transition buffers (5s or 10s), and before-and-after Tension Release Check-Ins.
• 100% Offline Procedural Soundscapes: Synthesized directly on your device—Tibetan Singing Bowl Drone, Warm Cedar Harmonic Pad, Soft Rain & Wind Chime, or Silent Timer + Soft Bell.
• Custom Flow Builder & Routine Cards: Reorder postures, tune hold durations (15s–300s), print clean Routine Cards, and share or import .exhale.json routines locally.

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
Zero accounts, zero cloud tracking, zero ads, and zero network permissions required.

name: Edudo - Escola
description:
O Edudo é um aplicativo para acompanhar de pertinho a rotina escolar das crianças. Assim os professores podem aproveitar o tempo com as crianças da forma que eles mais amam, estando perto deles.

Com a ajuda da escola essa jornada fica mais fácil e divertida!

Receba todas as informações escolares em seu celular.

O Edudo é um aplicativo de comunicação escolar que facilita a conversa entre os responsáveis dos alunos com a escola, fazendo com que os responsáveis estejam cada vez mais presentes na rotina escolar.

Como funciona?

A escola envia comunicados, eventos, atividades e resumo diário dos alunos entre outras informações e você recebe tudo em seu celular sem precisar se preocupar com agenda na mochila do seu filho.

Caso tenha alguma dúvida ou sugestão, nos envie um e-mail para contato@edudo.com.br

Acompanhe nossa rotina com carinho através das nossas redes sociais:
Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/edudorotina 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/edudoapp/ 


Edudo rotina de carinho =)

name: Ehtiya
description:
Ehtiya keeps your tasks on your own server – open source, with no trackers and no ads. And it plans them where your time is: in the calendar.

YOUR DAY IN THE CALENDAR
Give a task a time window and it sits in the calendar next to your appointments, by day, week or month. Add a timetable, public holidays or other calendars by ICS link.

YOUR DATA, YOUR SERVER
Ehtiya runs on an instance you host yourself or have been invited to. Every device carries all your data: even without a connection you can see and change everything, and it syncs later.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
iPhone and iPad, a standalone Apple Watch app with complication, a Home Screen widget – plus web and Android with the same data.

WHAT ELSE IS IN IT
• Quick add in one line: "Draft chapter 4 monday 10-12 #Thesis"
• Recurring tasks; what you ticked off stays visible in the calendar
• Deadlines, independent of the time window, with reminders of their own
• Projects, sections, labels, subtasks, comments and attachments
• Shared projects with roles
• Reminders scheduled on the device
• An app icon of your choice, also in a high-contrast version
• German and English

To try it out, leave the server field empty and the app opens the public demo for temporary use.

Free software: GNU AGPL 3.0 or later, with an additional permission for app stores. Source code: https://codefloe.com/Mila/Ehtiya

name: EIIET World
seller_name: European Institute of Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Technology GmbH
description:
EIIET World is the complete app for students enrolled at the European Institute of Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Technology (EIIET). It has everything in My EIIET, plus a German course, student guides, a calendar and campus services.

YOUR STUDIES
• Your courses, assignments, grades and live classes from my.eiiet.com
• A calendar with EIIET events and public holidays

LEARN GERMAN
• Short lessons at your own pace
• Practice decks, word look-up and a progress view
• Hear words and phrases spoken aloud

GUIDE
• Short reads on studying, careers, everyday student life and using EIIET services

CAMPUS SERVICES
• Ask the student office: semester break, matriculation certificate, campus change, fee receipt, visa or residence permit letter, transcript of grades and more. The office replies by phone or email.
• Shop: reserve EIIET items in the app, then pay and collect them at your campus.
• Contact: call, WhatsApp or email your campus office.
• Report a problem with the app and see the answer in the app.

SIGN IN
Sign in with your EIIET student ID and your own password. The first time, you set the password with a code sent to the email you gave EIIET.

EIIET WORLD AND MY EIIET
Both apps are only for enrolled EIIET students.
• My EIIET is our studies-only app. It has only your study tools from my.eiiet.com: courses, assignments, grades and live classes.
• EIIET World has everything in My EIIET, plus the German course, student guides, the EIIET calendar and campus services.
Choose My EIIET if you only want your coursework. Choose EIIET World if you want everything in one app.

name: Eilandrijk -  Island Strategy
description:
Eilandrijk is a turn-based strategy game for players who love to think ahead.

You start with a small castle on an island of hexagons. Every tile earns gold, but every soldier costs wages. Expand and you grow richer. Expand too fast and your army is stretched thin. Every turn is a real decision.

STRATEGY WITH DEPTH
• Four units, from the swift scout to the unstoppable catapult
• Forests, towers and castles defend, and only greater strength wins
• Farms, villages and wages: manage your economy or your army deserts
• Defense map: see at a glance where you are vulnerable

A CHALLENGE FOR TRUE STRATEGISTS
• 30 levels with growing islands and up to three rivals
• Three difficulties: Normal, Hard and Master
• On Master there are no take-backs, and every win earns a crown
• 8 achievements, such as "Win without losing a single tile"
• Stars for fast victories

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
• Short matches of 5 to 15 minutes
• Turn timer (adjustable or off)
• Auto-save: pick up right where you left off
• Fully playable offline
• English and Dutch

Levels 1 to 10 are free. Premium (one-time purchase) unlocks all 30 levels without ads. No subscription, no loot boxes.

name: Einbürgerungstest & Deutsch B1
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zum Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge oder zu einer anderen Behörde.

Wer sich in Deutschland einbürgern lassen möchte, braucht in der Regel zwei Nachweise: den bestandenen Einbürgerungstest „Leben in Deutschland“ und Deutschkenntnisse auf Stufe B1. Mit dieser App bereitest du dich auf beides vor.

Der Einbürgerungstest hat 33 Fragen mit je vier Antworten, du hast 60 Minuten Zeit und bestehst ab 17 richtigen Antworten. 30 Fragen kommen aus den Themen Leben in der Demokratie, Geschichte und Verantwortung sowie Mensch und Gesellschaft, 3 Fragen betreffen dein Bundesland. Der amtliche Katalog umfasst 310 Fragen.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Fragen zu Politik, Grundrechten und Demokratie
- Geschichte und Verantwortung
- Mensch und Gesellschaft
- Fragen zu den Bundesländern
- Deutsch auf Stufe B1: Lesen, Hören, Schreiben und Grammatik
- Für Fortgeschrittene: Deutsch C1, auch für den Beruf

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Einbürgerungstest Vorbereitung
- Einbürgerungstest Bayern Vorbereitung
- Einbürgerungstest NRW Vorbereitung
- Einbürgerungstest Berlin
- B1 Deutsch Vorbereitung
- Deutsch C1 Vorbereitung
- Deutsch C1 (Beruf) Vorbereitung

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Einbürgerung und Sprache

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zum Einbürgerungstest und zum Sprachnachweis in dieser App:
- Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge, Einbürgerung und Einbürgerungstest: https://www.bamf.de/DE/Themen/Integration/ZugewanderteTeilnehmende/Einbuergerung/einbuergerung-node.html
- Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge, Gesamtfragenkatalog „Leben in Deutschland“: https://www.bamf.de/SharedDocs/Anlagen/DE/Integration/Einbuergerung/gesamtfragenkatalog-lebenindeutschland.html
- Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge, Abschlussprüfung Integrationskurs (Deutsch-Test für Zuwanderer): https://www.bamf.de/DE/Themen/Integration/ZugewanderteTeilnehmende/Integrationskurse/Abschlusspruefung/abschlusspruefung-node.html
- Staatsangehörigkeitsgesetz, § 10: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stag/__10.html
- Einbürgerungstestverordnung: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/einbtestv/BJNR164900008.html

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: ekka
description:
Az ekka a keresztény zenekarok és kórusok közös kottatára. A közösséged dallistái, eseményei és üzenőfala egy helyen, a telefonodon és a tableteden.

• Kottatartó: a lista kottái egymás után, pedállal is lapozhatóan, iPaden két oldalt egyszerre. Mentsd az eszközre, és net nélkül is megnyílik.
• Dalok: kotta, akkordok és szöveg, bármelyik hangnembe transzponálva, a megszokott akkordírással (H/B, Am/am/a).
• Vetítés: a dalszövegek a kivetítőre, az iPad vagy a tablet kezelőnézet lesz, a telefonok távirányítóként lapoznak, a közelben internet nélkül is.
• Közös lapozás: ha egyvalaki lapoz, a többiek kottatartója követi.
• Események: ki jön, ki nem, melyik lista szól.
• Közösség: a közösséged üzenőfala, hozzászólásokkal.

Az ekka meghívásos: a közösséged adminja hív meg, vagy a zenekari fiókoddal lépsz be.

name: Ekoo
description:
Ekoo is a test app that sends and receives UDP and TCP messages, just like a messaging app.

Built for my interaction design classes. A UX you get without instructions — just Ekoo it.

Works great with TouchDesigner, Max/MSP, Pure Data, Unity, Processing, openFrameworks and Arduino.

• See your IP; receive UDP or run a TCP server with one switch
• A chat for every peer, like a messaging app
• OSC launchpad: pads, faders, XY and motion sensors
• Live values gathered in one bubble — tap for a graph
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, in 8 languages

Free, with no ads. Buy me a coffee and there's a small gift inside.

Made by mknw

name: Elevator Workshop
description:
Press a floor button in a 1995 apartment elevator. Step out at your chosen stop to earn coins. Get off at B1 and tap the left side of the landing to enter the workshop. Fit a faster motor, tune the doors and extend the route one floor at a time.

Move through the 2003 and 2015 models to the illuminated glass panel of 2025. Each generation has its own controls and sounds. Join the optional leaderboard to see how your highest floor compares.

name: Elezah
description:
elezah keeps your people close.

Message your friends one to one or in groups. Send photos, voice notes and short videos, react to messages, pin the chats you care about and mute the rest. When typing isn't enough, start a voice or video call right from the chat.

Eli is your feed. See posts, photos and stories from people you follow, save the ones you like and share them with a friend. Short videos sit in their own space, so you can watch them when you have time.

Search helps you find people with the same interests, from hiking and photography to music and books, and shows what people are talking about right now.

You decide who can reach you. Keep your profile private, approve follow requests, and block or report anyone with a couple of taps.

No ads, in the feed or in your chats.

Questions or feedback? Write to us from Settings in the app.

name: Elmna Student Application
description:
Elmna makes learning feel like play.

Elmna Student Application is a learning app for children in the early grades. Students can learn all their subjects in one place. Lessons, exercises and games come in small, friendly steps, so a child can open the app, find today's task and finish it in a few taps.

WHAT STUDENTS CAN DO
• Learn all their subjects with short lessons and clear pictures
• Hear every question read aloud
• Answer in different ways: choose, type a number, complete a pattern, put things in order, true or false
• Get kind feedback. A wrong answer shows the right one, with no punishment
• Earn coins, stars and badges for finishing exercises
• Reach a daily goal and see their place in the class rank
• Play short practice games
• Learn in more than one language, including right-to-left scripts

SIMPLE AND SAFE SIGN-IN
Students sign in with a short code from their teacher. No email address and no password for the child.

WORKS WITH THE TEACHER
Teachers give lessons and tasks to a whole group or to one student. When a student finishes a task, the teacher can see it. Learning time is recorded automatically.

DESIGNED FOR YOUNG LEARNERS
• Big buttons and few words
• Friendly characters and colours
• No advertising
• No in-app purchases

Elmna Student Application is part of the Tracking Elmna learning programme. A sign-in code from a registered teacher is needed to use the app.

name: Elmna Teacher Application
description:
Elmna Teacher Application puts your whole class in your pocket.

Elmna Teacher Application is the teacher app of the Tracking Elmna learning programme. See who is learning, who needs help and what is waiting to be marked, all from one phone.

WHAT TEACHERS CAN DO
• See your groups and students on a simple Today screen
• Browse the curriculum your programme office has published
• Give an exercise to a whole group or to one student, with a due date
• Mark spoken answers and add feedback. Other answers are marked automatically
• Track learning time, progress and students below target
• Compare groups and find students who need extra practice
• Register a new student and give them a login code
• Move a student to another group
• Download group reports as PDF or Excel
• Send a message to a whole group

ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH
Your programme office publishes the curriculum once. It appears in your app, you give it to your groups, and your students see it. When a student learns, you see it.

MORE THAN ONE LANGUAGE
Content and questions support more than one language, including right-to-left scripts.

ACCOUNT NEEDED
Elmna Teacher Application is for teachers and staff of the Tracking Elmna programme. Your programme office creates your account. Teachers cannot sign up inside the app.

name: Elride
description: Personal logbook of a field technician who services scooters

name: EmailGPT
description:
EmailGPT brings your work email and AI assistance together on your iPhone.

Connect Microsoft 365, Outlook or Hotmail with your Microsoft account, or another mailbox over IMAP, including Gmail with an app password. Keep multiple mailboxes in one app, read cached messages offline, search your mail, organize folders and compose replies with attachments.

Use AI to draft replies, summarize messages and conversations, translate email and create a summary table of correspondence. When your organization has configured a knowledge base, AI replies can use its documents and include source references. AI availability depends on access assigned to your account.

Your mail is stored on your iPhone. AI features stay off until you allow them. When you use one, the content of the mail involved is sent to the EmailGPT service and its AI provider. Background translation stays off until you turn it on in Settings. Internet access is required for synchronization, sending and AI.

Manage signatures, notifications and synchronization settings. Optional diagnostic uploads can be turned on or off in Settings. A supported email account is required; organizational access policies may apply.

Support: hello@aurelight.com
Privacy: https://emailgpt.aurelight.com/privacy/

name: Emtech Work Mobile
description:
Emtech is your workday on your phone.

Sign in once with your Emtech account. No second password, no separate account to keep.

THE CLOCK
The app opens on the clock. One press starts your time — it asks how you are working, and which work you are on when that is not already settled. While a punch runs, the card counts up; when you clock out it keeps your day on screen until midnight.

Lunch is a timer you start and end, so your worked time pauses while you are on it and nobody has to remember the minutes afterwards.

The day and the instant of a punch come from the office, so the record is the same whatever your phone's clock says.

YOUR HOURS
Today's punches sit under the clock, and My Time holds the rest: your fortnight a week at a time, each day with its shifts, its meal and its total.

If a time is wrong, say so from the same screen. A correction is yours to file — it shows as your time straight away, marked as waiting, until a supervisor decides on it. Nothing is quietly overwritten and nothing is lost while it waits.

TIME OFF AND SICK
Ask for a day off, or record a sick day, for any day past or future. Your balance is the office's number, shown exactly as it comes back.

APPROVALS
If you approve other people's time, it is a button in the bottom bar: days off, punch corrections, skill claims and the weekly time card, each with the detail behind it and approve or decline on the face of it. Open a time card to see the hours day by day before you decide. You never approve your own.

SUPPORT REQUESTS
File a Houston request from wherever you are and attach a photo or a video straight from the camera.

WHEN THERE IS NO SIGNAL
A punch is written to your phone before it is sent. Clock in and out in a basement or on a site with no bars, and the taps go up when you have a connection again, in the order you made them.

LOCATION
Location is asked for at the moment you punch and nowhere else — never in the background, never on clock-out. Declining never blocks a punch and never holds up your time. The app records only that a fix was present; no coordinate is ever shown, kept or sent on.

BUILT AROUND YOUR ACCESS
Emtech signs you in through Orbit, the same single sign-on as the web. You see only what your Orbit access allows — the phone never widens what you can reach. There is no advertising, no analytics and no tracking of any kind, and your sign-in stays in the device's secure store.

Emtech is for Emtech LLC personnel. An Emtech account is required to sign in.

name: Enchanted Chess Land
description:
Learn chess, solve tactical puzzles and enjoy a game against the computer in Enchanted Chess Land. A colorful fantasy board, clear move highlights and four difficulty levels give you room to start gently and grow your game on iPhone and iPad.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Start with free Easy and Medium opponents. Tap a piece to see its legal moves, then tap a highlighted square or drag the piece to make your move. Follow the move list, flip the board and pause when you need a break. Continue an unfinished game when you return.

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Explore the rules of chess, from how each piece moves to castling, en passant and pawn promotion. Move highlights and last-move feedback help you follow the position. Choose sounds, haptics and automatic queen promotion in Settings.

MAKE TACTICS A DAILY HABIT
Try the daily puzzle and track your solving streak. The free edition includes 10 Beginner puzzles. Work through positions on an interactive board, ask for a hint or reveal a move, and retry to understand the idea.

GO FURTHER WITH PREMIUM
A single optional, non-consumable purchase unlocks:
• Hard and Expert computer opponents, alongside free Easy and Medium play.
• All 45 puzzles across Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels.
• An opening trainer with move-by-move study and practice from memory.
• Move hints, undo and redo, plus game review with engine analysis.
• Saved games, board replay and PGN sharing.
• Statistics to follow your results and progress.
• Board themes and custom clocks, including increments and untimed games.
• Removal of interstitial advertisements.

STUDY YOUR NEXT GAME
Use Premium's opening trainer to follow familiar opening lines and practice from either side. Revisit a saved game on the replay board, inspect the moves and use the review tools to see where you might choose differently next time.

MADE FOR PHONE AND TABLET
Play in portrait or landscape, with a roomier board and move list on larger displays. Whether you have time for a quick puzzle or a longer game, Enchanted Chess Land brings playing, practice and review together.

Easy and Medium play are free. Additional features require the optional Premium purchase. Premium is a one-time purchase with no recurring subscription. The purchase price is shown in your local App Store currency before confirmation. Internet access is needed for purchases and advertisements.

name: End-Time Handmaidens Media
description:
This is the official app of End-Time Handmaidens and Servants International, founded by Gwen Shaw. ETH&S is a ministry for the family, focusing on carrying the love of God, as shown through Jesus Christ, to the nations, and walking victoriously through prayer and fasting.

With this app you can:
- Listen to and watch messages and Bible teaching on demand
- Join live services when the ministry is on air
- Read the Bible with the built-in reader
- Share messages with family and friends
- Get notified when the ministry goes live

name: ENGAID Formation
description:
ENGAID Formation est l'application des apprenants d'ENGAID SOFT. Sur iPhone, elle donne accès aux formations ouvertes sur votre compte par ENGAID SOFT ou par votre organisation.

Chaque cours est découpé en séances courtes, qui se suivent entre deux rendez-vous. Une leçon se lit, ou s'écoute. Un quiz clôt chaque séance et sa correction explique chaque réponse. Pour les certifications, un examen blanc chronométré reproduit les conditions de l'épreuve.

Le tuteur IA répond aux questions sur le cours à partir de son contenu, et cite la leçon d'où vient chaque réponse.

La progression est la même sur le site et dans l'application : une leçon commencée sur ordinateur se reprend sur le téléphone. Une notification arrive à chaque nouveau message ou correction, comme à chaque annonce de vos formateurs. Un certificat obtenu se vérifie en ligne grâce à son code.

Pour vous connecter, utilisez le compte créé pour vous par ENGAID SOFT ou par votre organisation. Votre profil contient aussi la suppression du compte, possible à tout moment.

name: EngineerNow
description:
Need an engineer for your home, your property or your project? Find the right one in minutes, not days.

EngineerNow brings together people who need an engineer and engineers from all over Greece. Search, chat, book. Simple and fast, from your phone.

FIND YOUR ENGINEER
• Search by service and city: building identity, energy certificates, legalising unauthorised works, permits, structural checks, land surveys, solar panels and more.
• Not sure what you need? Describe it in your own words and we tell you which service applies and which engineers can help.
• See indicative prices per service before you get in touch. The final price is agreed with the engineer.
• Profiles with discipline, services and reviews only from clients with a confirmed appointment.
• Chat with the engineer before you decide.
• Book at the office or by video call, at times that suit you.
All of this is free for you.

ARE YOU AN ENGINEER?
• A professional profile that puts you in front of new clients, with checks of your Technical Chamber (TEE) registration.
• Your services with an indicative price, so the people looking for exactly what you do can find you.
• Clients book on their own, at the hours you set.
• Conversations with clients and colleagues in one place.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Greece: site visits, surveys, visits to public offices, signed studies, supervision.
• Job listings: find an associate, review CVs and interview by video call.
• See who visits your profile, and share your rating as a story.

ENGINEERING STUDENT?
• Your CV in front of engineering offices.
• Internship listings, and a notification as soon as a position opens for you.

One account for the app and engineernow.gr: your conversations, appointments and notifications in sync, wherever you are.

The app is in Greek.

Contact: info@engineernow.gr

name: Enough It Works: Cozy Puzzle
description:
A little puzzle. A little peace. A cozy moment just for you.

Enjoy a relaxing sticker puzzle game featuring a man, his adorable cat, and the simple joys of everyday life.

Sort colorful stickers and place them where they belong. Watch each picture gradually come to life as you complete your own cozy album.

**Features**

• 54 charming puzzles across 9 album pages
• Handcrafted artwork inspired by everyday life and the changing seasons
• A variety of puzzle sizes, from quick and easy to satisfyingly large
• Simple and intuitive controls
• Helpful hints when you get stuck
• No time limits or energy restrictions
• Replay completed puzzles whenever you like
• Music Room with 4 selectable background music tracks

Enjoy a quick puzzle during your coffee break or settle in for a longer, relaxing puzzle session.

There is no need to rush. Take your time, enjoy the little details, and discover the joy of completing something beautiful, one sticker at a time.

Enough. It Works.

A little progress is enough for today.

name: eRadio!
description:
eRadio! is an internet radio player styled after a classic 2004 desktop app: a metal case, a blue screen, a clock and a spectrum analyzer – with a modern audio engine underneath.

• Thousands of stations from the public Radio Browser directory, grouped by country: UK, USA, Germany, Poland, Spain, Italy, France, Norway, Czechia, Ukraine, the Netherlands and more
• Favorite stations one tap away
• Background playback, also with the screen locked
• Lock screen, Control Center and headphone controls: play, stop, next and previous station
• Track title and artist on screen and on the lock screen
• Bluetooth speaker and AirPlay output with one tap
• Live spectrum analyzer and a background that pulses with the music
• Automatic resume after phone calls and dropped connections
• No account, no ads, no tracking

SUBSCRIPTION
The subscription pays for the eRadio! software and its upkeep: systematic maintenance of the station directory, cloud services and continuous development of new features. It does not sell the broadcasts themselves, which remain the free public streams of their stations.

eRadio! requires a subscription: USD 4.99 per month (or the local equivalent) after a 7-day free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Manage the subscription in your App Store account settings.

Station lists come from radio-browser.info; content is broadcast by independent stations.

Privacy Policy: https://www.ptasys.co/eradio/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Erik Ginsberg
description:
The Erik Ginsberg app puts the South Florida market in your hands, from your first search to the day you get the keys or close on a sale.

Neighborhood Know-How - Get guidance from an advisor who understands the pull of Boca Raton, from waterfront retreats to golf communities and everything in between.
Search Your Way - Browse listings by price, property type, and location, then save the ones that catch your eye so you can come back to them.
Instant Alerts - Be among the first to know when a new home hits the market or a price changes, so you can act on your own timeline.
Seamless Messaging - Send questions, favorites, and showing requests straight to Erik without the back-and-forth of email.
Selling Made Simple - Considering a move? Check in on the market and start the conversation about your home’s next chapter.

Whether you’re dreaming of life in South Florida or ready to make a move, the Erik Ginsberg app keeps every step of the journey within reach.

name: Escala 360 Equipo
description:
Escala 360 Equipo es la app de uso interno del equipo de Escala 360. Reúne en el iPhone las herramientas que usamos cada día en la plataforma web, con la misma cuenta y los mismos datos.

• Inicio: el día de un vistazo, con las tareas de hoy, lo atrasado, lo que espera aprobación y la próxima reunión.
• Tareas: lista del día, detalle completo con lista de verificación, subtareas, archivos, comentarios e historial.
• Aprobación: revisa las piezas de cada cliente una a una; desliza para aprobar o pedir cambios.
• Planificación y calendario de publicaciones y tareas.
• Chat del equipo con fotos, respuestas y reacciones.
• Videollamadas con el equipo y los clientes.
• Correo, notas compartidas y llavero de contraseñas protegido con Face ID.
• CRM: pipeline de oportunidades, contactos y empresas.

Requiere una cuenta del equipo de Escala 360.

name: ESCALA Edu
description:
ESCALA Edu es la plataforma de capacitación para agentes de viajes. Aprende a tu ritmo con cursos organizados por secciones y niveles, con videos, documentos y material de apoyo.

Con ESCALA Edu puedes:
• Avanzar por tus cursos y ver tu progreso en todo momento.
• Obtener tus certificados al completar cada sección.
• Consultar tus próximas sesiones y eventos, y agregarlos a tu calendario.
• Mantenerte al día con noticias, avisos y artículos del blog.
• Descargar archivos y recursos disponibles para ti.
• Conocer a los líderes que hacen crecer la comunidad.

Dirigida a agentes de viajes. Regístrate desde la app; tu cuenta será validada por nuestro equipo antes de activarse.

Si necesitas ayuda con tu cuenta, escríbenos a escala.admon10@gmail.com.

name: Estevão Passageiros
description:
Estevão Passageiros oferece a melhor experiência de viagem para o passageiro do transporte fretado da Estevão Transporte e Turismo.

Acompanhe suas rotas em tempo real e fique por dentro de todos comunicados da empresa.

Consulte a localização do veículo ao vivo no mapa e confira o tempo estimado de chegada no seu ponto.

Receba notificações relevantes para programar melhor o seu deslocamento.

Avalie sua viagem e envie sugestões diretamente pelo app.

name: Estudios Bíblicos
description:
Estudios Bíblicos es la app de audio de Asidicelabiblia para escuchar la Palabra de Dios en cualquier momento y lugar.

Escucha sermones, conferencias y estudios bíblicos de expositores como Dr. Adrian Rogers, Dave Hunt, J. A. Holowaty, Dr. J. Vernon McGee y muchos más. El contenido se organiza por expositor, álbum, playlist y categoría para que encuentres justo lo que buscas.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Reproducción en segundo plano: sigue escuchando con la pantalla apagada o mientras usas otras apps.
• Descargas sin conexión: guarda tus estudios favoritos y escúchalos sin gastar datos.
• Favoritos: guarda lo que más te bendice y retómalo cuando quieras.
• Búsqueda: encuentra sermones por título o expositor.
• Velocidad de reproducción: de 0.75× a 2× para aprovechar mejor tu tiempo.
• Temporizador de apagado: escucha antes de dormir sin dejarlo toda la noche.
• Saltos de 15 segundos y control de volumen.
• Tema claro, oscuro o automático.

La app es gratuita. Las cuentas son opcionales: puedes escuchar sin registrarte y crear una cuenta solo si quieres sincronizar tus favoritos.

Sobre Asidicelabiblia
Un ministerio dedicado a la enseñanza de la Biblia, con programación de radio y estudios en audio para edificación de la iglesia.

Contenido de terceros reproducido con autorización de sus respectivos expositores.

name: Eternia: Your Life in Weeks
description:
A 90-year life fits in fewer than 5,000 weeks. Seeing them all at once changes how you live this one: you stop putting things off, you savour, you choose. Eternia draws your life as a grid of weeks and invites you to give each one an intention.

YOUR WHOLE LIFE, WEEK BY WEEK
Enter your date of birth: Eternia draws one box per week, 52 per row, one row per year, with the current week highlighted in gold. See at a glance the days and weeks you have lived and the percentage of the road already travelled.
Choose a horizon and Eternia shows the weeks, summers and full moons that may still lie ahead. These figures are statistical: a tool for reflection, never a prediction. You can hide the time ahead at any moment.

LIFE CHAPTERS AND WEEKLY INTENTIONS
Name the chapters of your life (childhood, studies, a move, a new job…) and they colour the grid in bands. Each week, set one simple intention, such as “listen”, “slow down” or “dare”, keep your streak going and find them all again in your history.

6 GUIDED PRACTICES
Practices of 3 to 7 minutes, with a timer for each step.
• Back to the moment
• Gratitude for the road
• Savouring kairos
• Impermanence meditation
• The eternal witness
• What I leave behind

4 SHORT TEACHINGS
Memento mori, Seneca, impermanence and kairos: brief texts to bring you back to the present.
• Memento mori
• On the shortness of life
• Anicca, impermanence
• Chronos and kairos

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
A widget brings you the thought of the day. Daily reminder and optional evening reminder, at the time you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your data stays on your iPhone: nothing leaves the phone
• Works offline, available in 28 languages
• Free, no ads
Created by Tom · LA FORGE DIGITAL

Go further with sacred frequencies: my frequency generator accompanies your moments of presence with sounds for meditation, focus and serenity.
→ sacredfrequencygenerator.com

100% free app, follow me on Instagram: @tom_against_the_matrix

Eternia is a personal-growth and reflection tool. It makes no prediction about the length of your life and does not replace medical or psychological care.

name: Eucarl: Feedback for Business
description:
Eucarl helps businesses and teams hear what customers and staff really think, and answer it.

Customers and employees send feedback from your Eucarl feedback page, QR code or meeting link, with no name, account or app needed. The Eucarl app is where you run it all:

• Create your account and organization in minutes, and invite your team
• Create feedback pages and show their QR code straight away
• See new feedback as it arrives, with a notification (notifications never include what was written)
• Read suggestions, complaints, ideas, questions and compliments, sorted by type and status
• Reply privately: the sender reads your reply on their anonymous tracking page
• Review messages held by Safe-Mode screening, and block terms you never want to see
• Run Team Meeting Feedback sessions and read anonymous questions live
• Publish "You said, we did" updates so people see what changed
• See statistics by category, feedback page and status
• Protect your account with two-step sign-in, and the app with Face ID

People who give feedback never need the app.

name: EvenPlay: Fair Play Timer
description:
EvenPlay helps volunteer youth coaches give every player a fair share of the game. Plan a balanced rotation before kickoff, track every player's minutes or innings from the sideline, and share a clear fair-play report with parents afterwards.

EvenPlay works offline and keeps everything on your phone. There's no account to create, no ads and no tracking.

PLAN A FAIR ROTATION
- Mark who showed up and EvenPlay builds a rotation for every shift: who plays, who sits and, for sports with positions, who plays where.
- Playing time is spread evenly: nobody sits a second time before everyone has sat once, and projected minutes differ by at most one shift.
- Players who are owed time from earlier games get priority.
- Set a limit on shifts in a row on the bench, preferred positions and positions to avoid, and lock a goalkeeper or pitcher for a whole period.
- Tap two players to swap them. The plan re-checks instantly and shows each player's projected share.
- Baseball and softball keep a continuous batting order of everyone present.

RUN THE SIDELINE
- A big, easy-to-read game clock with start, pause, resume and period changes. Choose a running clock or a stop clock.
- Each player's time counts only while they're on the field and the clock is running.
- One-tap substitutions: tap who comes off, then who goes on. Or bring on the next planned shift in one tap.
- "Who goes in next" lists the bench with the players owed the most time first, with clear owed-time badges.
- Undo the last action, add a late arrival or mark someone who left early.
- The screen stays awake during a game, and the game survives the app being closed: time is recalculated from saved timestamps.

SHARE A FAIR-PLAY REPORT
- For each player: minutes or innings played, share of possible time, times on the bench and positions played.
- A configurable fair-play target (for example 50%) gently flags anyone under it, with neutral, positive wording for parents.
- A season view adds up every game and shows who is owed time.
- Share as plain text or as a tidy PDF created on your phone.

MADE FOR YOUR SPORT
Presets for soccer, basketball, baseball, softball, hockey, lacrosse, flag football and volleyball, plus a custom format. Track minutes or whole periods, set players on the field, number and length of periods and shifts per period.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
- Everything is stored on this device. Code54 doesn't receive your data.
- Players are entered by first name or nickname, with an optional jersey number. No photos, birthdates or contact details.
- Back up a team as a file through the share sheet and import it again later.
- Erase all data in Settings at any time.

TRY IT IN A MINUTE
Load the sample U10 soccer team with two finished games to see the planner, the sideline screen and the reports right away. Remove it whenever you like.

EvenPlay is a tool for coaches and team managers. Questions or ideas: support@code54.dev

name: Everyfret
description:
Everyfret shows you music the way a guitar player meets it. Pick a key and a scale, and you see it on the whole neck, on a piano and on the staff at the same time. Tap a note in any of them and the other two show you where it is, so the shapes your hand learns and the names of the notes grow together.

SCALES
Seventeen scales in every key: the major scale and its modes, the pentatonics and the blues scale, harmonic minor and its modes, and more. Each scale comes with its boxes, a line that climbs through the whole scale, and how far each note is from the root. Hold a note and slide along the neck to hear every note you cross.

CHORDS
Every chord of a key, drawn where it lives on the neck, as triads, sevenths, ninths or thirteenths. Sort the grid by hand position and you see every chord you can reach without moving your hand. Each grip tells you which note is in the bass, which notes are doubled and which inversion it is, with the same chord on the piano and the staff beside it. For any chord you also see every note of it on the whole neck, and every key it belongs to.

KEYS
Every key on the circle of fifths, with its chords marked, so you can see why they sit together and which one sits apart.

PROGRESSIONS
Play a progression the easiest way: each chord where your hand moves least, with a note on what your hand does at every change. A band plays under every progression, so you can hear how the chords move.

SOLO OVER THE CHANGES
Over a twelve-bar blues, the notes of your scale stay the same in every bar, but the best note to land on changes with the chord. Everyfret marks those notes for each chord, in every position on the neck.

INTERVALS
Every interval on every pair of strings, and why one pair of strings changes the shape.

TOOLS
A tuner that listens and finds the string you play, or tunes the one string you choose. A metronome and a drone that keep going with the screen locked. A drummer with sixteen styles in five families, which can follow your tempo as you play.

FOR YOUR INSTRUMENT
Guitar in standard and alternate tunings, bass and ukulele. Recorded piano, guitars, bass and ukulele play every note, and a MIDI keyboard or an audio interface works as well. Everyfret works with Dark Mode, VoiceOver, Spotlight and Siri.

WHAT IS FREE
Everything in the key of A, on a guitar in standard tuning, is free, and so are the tuner, the metronome and the drummer. One purchase, Unlock everything, opens the other eleven keys and every other tuning and instrument. It is a single payment with no subscription and no ads, and Family Sharing shares it with your family.

PRIVACY
Everyfret has no account and collects nothing. The tuner and the drummer listen on your device, and nothing they hear is recorded or sent anywhere.

name: Everyroll
description:
Your night, from everyone’s camera roll.

Start a private Roll, send one link, and friends add the photos they took — during the night or the next morning. Everyone uses their own phone. No extra device. No photographer.

COLLECT
One private Roll for everyone’s pictures. Friends can add from a link, even without the app, in the browser or with the App Clip.

MAKE
Open the camera. Shoot a photo, or four frames for a strip. Choose a film look, then save it, share it, or add it to the Roll. A Control Center and Lock Screen control can open the camera when your phone is locked.

FIND
See everything in one place, lined up by when it was taken. Filter by photos you added, strips you made, or hearts you saved. Download the originals at full size, with no watermarks.

HOST
Show the QR at the party, or drop the link in the group chat. Optionally require an access code, check guest photos before they appear, or wait until morning to let the Roll develop. A Live Activity on your Lock Screen keeps the count in reach, and you can get a notification when friends add photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Rolls aren't listed anywhere: only people with the link can see them. Anyone can report a photo or ask for a photo of themselves to be taken down, and hosts can hide any photo or block a guest. No ads, and no tracking across apps.

Everyroll is free.

name: Evolve Body Comp
description:
A simple, no-fuss body composition log for people who train.

Pinch three caliper sites, add a few tape measurements, and Body Comp works out your body fat, lean mass and fat mass, then tracks them week by week.

YOUR NUMBER. YOUR PROGRESS.
No body-fat method is perfect. Calipers, smart scales and even scans are all estimates. What matters is that your measurement is yours and yours alone. Measure the same way each week, and Body Comp shows you whether you're really moving forward.

HOW IT WORKS
- Jackson-Pollock 3-site formula for men (chest, abdomen, thigh) and women (triceps, suprailiac, thigh)
- A simple body diagram shows exactly where to pinch and where to measure
- Your weight comes straight from Apple Health, or directly from a supported Bluetooth scale
- Last week's numbers are shown as you type, so you can compare at a glance

MORE THAN ONE NUMBER
Optional tape measurements give you three extra indicators to work towards:
- Waist-to-height
- Waist-to-hip
- Thigh-to-waist (bigger legs, smaller waist)

HISTORY AND TRENDS
See your body fat, lean mass, waist and ratios over the last 12 weeks.

APPLE HEALTH
Body Comp reads your weight, height, age and sex from Apple Health, and saves your body fat percentage, lean body mass and waist measurement back to it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your health data stays on your iPhone. Body Comp never shares it with anyone, ever.

Designed for adults 18 and over. Body Comp is a fitness tracking tool, not a medical device, and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

From the Evolve series by Brian Royce. Free.

name: Exotherm: Epoxy Resin & Mix
description:
When you pour a 2:1 epoxy river table on a digital gram scale at a 2:1 weight ratio, you starve the amine cross-link reaction and leave a permanently sticky surface. Part A epoxy resin is denser (1.15 g/mL) than Part B amine hardener (0.95 g/mL), so true stoichiometric curing requires exact specific-gravity mass conversion alongside thermal depth limits.

Exotherm is an offline woodworking and composite casting workbench built for gloved shop hands:

CORE CASTING WORKBENCH (FREE)
• Live-Edge River Channel & Void Displacement: Step mold length, width, and pour depth alongside wood slab occupancy (15% to 100% open resin void) and cup-cling waste margin.
• Specific-Gravity Volume-to-Weight Scale Math: Convert standard 2:1 Deep Pour and 1:1 Tabletop volume ratios into exact Part A and Part B gram (g) and ounce (oz) scale targets alongside mL and fl oz volume readouts.
• Exotherm Risk Detector & Shop-Temp Limits: Check single-lift depth limits at 68 deg F and 74 deg F and flag deep-pour thermal runaway risk before mixing.
• 4-Stage Bench Cure Chronometer: Track Wall Mix, Torch Degas, Open Pot Window, and B-Stage Tack times on a single active bench mold profile with plain-text batch note sharing.

EXOTHERM PRO STUDIO BENCH PASS (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Multi-Lift Exotherm Split & 68F-86F Arrhenius Matrix: Split deep pours into thermal-safe per-lift gram batches and derate max lift depth and pot life across warm 80 deg F to 86 deg F shops to prevent exothermic cracking.
• Full 5-System Resin Chemistry Catalog: Unlock 3:1 Ultra-Deep Monument Cast, 4:1 Marine Fiberglass Hull Laminating, and 2:1 Art & Jewelry Coat formulas.
• 4-Slot Studio Mold Vault & B-Stage Recoat Schedule: Save and switch across four shop mold presets (Walnut River Dining Table, Maple Burl Entry Console, Live-Edge Bar Top Flood Coat, and Monument Burl Turning Block) with B-Stage chemical recoat schedules.

Upgrade to Pro with a single $4.99 one-time purchase for lifetime access. No subscriptions or recurring fees.

100% OFFLINE & PRIVATE SHOP STORAGE
All mold dimensions, resin batch calculations, and studio presets stay locally on your iPhone with zero cloud accounts and zero cross-app tracking.

name: Expecto - 통찰력 있는 숏폼 컨텐츠
description:
Expecto는 뉴스를 보고 가까운 미래를 예측하여 투표하는 숏폼 앱입니다.

• 한 표로 끝나는 예측
소식 바로 다음에 나오는 질문에 투표하면 전체 예측 결과가 공개되고 댓글을 달 수 있습니다

• 공식 자료를 통한 결과 확정
종가, 공식 순위, 기상청 관측처럼 누구나 확인할 수 있는 자료를 통해 결과가 확정됩니다. 맞히면 포인트를 얻으며, 소수만 고른 답을 맞히면 '역배 적중'으로 더 많은 포인트를 받습니다.

궁금한 미래를 직접 질문으로 올리고 친구에게 인스타그램 DM으로 보내 보세요.

애플과 구글 계정, 그리고 HourBinder 계정으로 바로 로그인 할 수 있습니다. 

*포인트는 돈이나 상품으로 바꿀 수 없으며, 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

name: ExpiryDesk: Document Tracker
description:
Never miss an expiration date again.

ExpiryDesk keeps your passport, visa, driver's license, insurance, contracts, certificates, permits and warranties in one organized place — and reminds you before anything expires. No account, no sign-up: start in seconds. Your documents stay on your device.

WHY EXPIRYDESK
• See what needs attention at a glance: active, expiring soon and expired documents
• Reminders 90, 60, 30, 14, 7, 3 or 1 day before — or on the day — at the time you choose
• Renew in a few taps and keep the full renewal history and costs
• Attach PDFs, photos and camera scans to each document
• Calendar of upcoming expirations
• Fast search by title, owner, issuer, tag or reference number
• Filters and sorting: nearest expiry, recently added, category and more
• PDF reports and CSV export (opens in Excel and Numbers)
• Share a document summary, attachment or report via WhatsApp, Mail, Messages and AirDrop
• Encrypted backup & restore (AES-256) to Files or iCloud Drive
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID app lock
• Light and dark mode, iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo

FOR EVERYONE WITH PAPERWORK
Individuals and families, freelancers, professionals, landlords, fleet owners, office admins, HR teams and small businesses use ExpiryDesk to track licenses, permits, certifications, insurance policies, vendor contracts, software licenses, equipment calibration and more. 30+ built-in categories plus your own.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
ExpiryDesk works offline and has no account system. Documents and attachments are stored only on your device and are never uploaded. Reference numbers never appear in notifications.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: up to 10 documents, 2 reminders per document, attachments, search, sharing, CSV export and backup — with ads.
Premium: unlimited documents, categories and reminders, recurring renewals, more attachments, advanced reports with your branding, agenda calendar, advanced filters, batch actions and no ads.

ExpiryDesk Premium is an auto-renewable subscription, available weekly, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Your documents stay available if Premium ends.

Reminders are local notifications and depend on your device's notification settings. ExpiryDesk is an independent organizer and is not affiliated with any government agency.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://diponten.com/2026/11/25/expirydesk-privacy-policy/

name: ezly
description:
Discover more ways to move, train, and feel your best with ezly.

ezly brings fitness, sports, and wellness experiences together in one place. Discover gyms, fitness studios, sports academies, spas, and wellness centers near you. Explore your options, compare services, and find experiences that match your interests, schedule, and lifestyle.

DISCOVER. COMPARE. BOOK.

With ezly, you can:

• Discover fitness and wellness venues near your location.

• Explore services, facilities, memberships, classes, schedules, prices, ratings, and available offers.

• Compare different options to find what suits your needs.

• Book available memberships, group classes, sports activities, and wellness services.

• Keep track of your bookings and receive important booking and account updates.

EXPLORE A WORLD OF ACTIVITIES

From gym workouts and CrossFit to yoga, Pilates, swimming, football, martial arts, dance, and more, ezly brings different fitness and wellness experiences together, making it easier to explore new activities and stay active.

ARE YOU A FITNESS OR WELLNESS BUSINESS?

ezly is built for businesses too.

If you own or manage a gym, fitness studio, sports academy, spa, or wellness center, you can apply to join the ezly network directly through the Join Us section in the app.

Simply submit your business details for review. Once your application is approved by the ezly team, you'll receive access to a dedicated Partner Dashboard where you can:

• Showcase and manage your business profile.

• Manage your services, memberships, and schedules.

• Handle bookings and customer requests.

• Create offers and promotional campaigns.

• Manage your business details and grow your presence.

ONE CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM

ezly connects people looking for fitness, sports, and wellness experiences with the businesses that provide them.

Whether you're discovering your next favorite activity or looking to grow your fitness and wellness business, ezly brings both sides together through one connected platform.

Discover more. Compare smarter. Book with ease. Grow with ezly.

name: FÆLLES AI
description:

PROGRAMMET

FÆLLESBOT
• Spørg til programmet, og få forslag til oplæg, der passer til dit arbejde

PRAKTISK
• Find vej, parkering, overnatning og tider

name: Fair Play: Lineup Maker
description:
Build a fair lineup in one tap. Fair Play gives every kid their share of innings, quarters or periods, rotates them through positions, and evens out bench time across the whole season.

No account, no sign-up, no internet needed. Everything stays on your phone.

GAME DAY
• Mark who's here, then tap Build rotation: every player, every position, every inning
• Youth-league rules built in: minimum play time, no one sits twice in a row, no one plays outfield all game
• Lock a spot or swap two players and the rest of the rotation adjusts
• See the plan as a grid or on a field diagram, plus the batting order
• Share the lineup as an image with parents and assistant coaches

LIVE MODE
• Big type and big buttons for the dugout or the sideline
• A player leaves hurt or arrives late? The rest of the game rebuilds around them
• Pitch counts with rest-day reminders for baseball and softball
• Sun mode: pure black on white for bright fields

SIX SPORTS READY TO GO
• Baseball, softball, soccer, basketball, hockey or lacrosse, and flag football
• Positions, segment counts and rules set for each, all adjustable per team

SEASON VIEW
• Play time and bench time for every player, least played first

FREE
Run a full team for free: rotations, live mode, pitch counts, image sharing and stats for your last 3 games, for one team of up to 20 players.

FAIR PLAY PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
• Season balancing: kids who sat more last game play more next game
• Full season stats, each player's game-by-game history and a position coverage grid
• Unlimited locks, shuffles and live undo, plus a segment timer for timed sports
• Batting order that rotates each game
• PDF dugout cards, printing and CSV export
• Unlimited teams, up to 30 players, custom sports and backup files
• Shared with your Family Sharing group

name: Faixa Certa: Apostila de Judô
description:
O Faixa Certa é a apostila digital para o seu próximo exame de graduação no judô.

Diga qual é a sua faixa hoje e o app monta a apostila da próxima, com as técnicas na ordem do exame. Marque o que você já domina e acompanhe quanto falta para estar pronto.

APOSTILA DA FAIXA
• Técnicas organizadas por grupo (nage-waza, katame-waza, ukemi e mais)
• Ordem do exame e contagem do que você já domina
• Busca que entende "osoto", "o soto" ou "o-soto-gari", com ou sem acento

CADA TÉCNICA, PASSO A PASSO
• Vídeo com câmera lenta (0,5× e 0,75×) para enxergar cada detalhe
• Passo a passo, pontos-chave e o erro comum que derruba candidatos
• O que o examinador observa
• Pronúncia do nome em japonês
• Técnicas relacionadas para estudar em sequência

GLOSSÁRIO
• Termos do dojô em japonês e português: comandos do árbitro, pontuação, uniforme e treino
• Ouça a pronúncia de cada termo
• Busque em japonês ou em português

SEU PROGRESSO
• Toque em "Já domino" e veja a barra da próxima faixa subir
• A técnica do dia sugere o que revisar
• Troque de faixa quando for aprovado

MINHA JORNADA
• Crie sua conta e guarde progresso e favoritas em qualquer celular
• Linha do tempo com graduações, campeonatos e seminários
• Cards prontos para postar nos stories, com a cor da faixa ou a sua foto

Não precisa de cadastro para estudar: abra e comece. Quer estudar sem anúncios? Compre uma vez e vale para sempre na sua conta.

O Faixa Certa é um material de apoio e não substitui as aulas e a orientação do seu professor. Os requisitos de cada exame podem variar conforme a federação e a academia.

name: Família 61
description:
Seja muito bem-vindo ao aplicativo oficial da Igreja Família 61!

Mais do que um aplicativo, este é um espaço para nos conectarmos, caminharmos juntos na fé e fortalecermos os laços que nos tornam uma família em Cristo.
Se você já faz parte da Família 61, este espaço é seu! E se está chegando agora, queremos que se sinta em casa. Será uma alegria conhecer você e caminhar ao seu lado!

Aqui, você encontra tudo o que precisa para estar ainda mais perto da nossa família:

 Encontre seu Liga: A vida cristã é ainda melhor quando caminhamos juntos! Encontre um grupo de discipulado próximo de você, compartilhe experiências, cresça na Palavra e construa amizades.

 Fique por dentro de tudo: Acompanhe nossa agenda de cultos, encontros, eventos e atividades especiais. Não perca nenhuma oportunidade de estarmos juntos!

 Compartilhe seus pedidos de oração: Queremos orar com você e por você! Compartilhe seus pedidos de oração e solicite visitas e acompanhamento quando precisar.

 Cresça na fé: Acesse conteúdos, mensagens, áudios e vídeos que vão fortalecer sua caminhada com Deus.

name: Fan Frenzy: Trophy Match
description:

Take your club through 36 levels in three leagues: Rookie League, Pro Circuit and Legends Cup. Each level sets a few goals and a move limit. Finish the goals before you run out of moves, then earn up to three stars for your score. Every league ends in a final, and winning it brings home the trophy.

Quick to pick up and satisfying to master. A level takes a few minutes, so you can squeeze in a round on the way somewhere or settle in for a whole league. Download FanFrenzy: Trophy Match and play for the cup.

name: Fangle: AI Widgets

name: Faz Sentido?
seller_name: Baldo Tech Tecnologia da Informacao Ltda
description:
Tutu é gíria de dinheiro ou comida mineira? Faz sentido?

Faz Sentido é um jogo de paciência com palavras, feito no Brasil para brasileiros. Em vez de naipes e números, as cartas trazem palavras. Você empilha as que combinam e completa cada categoria antes de acabarem as jogadas.

Parece fácil, até aparecer a pegadinha. "Quentão" vai para a festa junina ou para as bebidas? "Arroz" é do prato feito ou da festa? Cada fase tem armadilhas justas, escolhidas a dedo por gente que conhece o Brasil.

COMO JOGAR
• Arraste as palavras entre as colunas e empilhe as da mesma categoria
• Abra uma fundação com a carta da categoria e guarde nela todas as palavras do grupo
• Vire o monte para achar a palavra que faltava
• Complete todas as categorias dentro do limite de jogadas

POR QUE VOCÊ VAI GOSTAR
• 150 categorias brasileiras de verdade: festa junina, gírias, comida regional, futebol, música e muito mais
• Sem cronômetro e sem pressa: jogue no seu ritmo, no ônibus, na fila ou antes de dormir
• Errou? Tudo bem. Jogada errada não conta, só não é aceita
• Dicas, desfazer e coringa para quando a dúvida apertar
• Dificuldade que cresce aos poucos, com fases maiores e categorias em ordem
• Letra grande, bom contraste e símbolos além das cores, para jogar do filho ao avô
• Sem cadastro e sem login: abriu, jogou

Ideal para quem curte caça-palavras e paciência, e para quem gosta de provar que conhece o Brasil melhor que a família.

Faz Sentido é grátis e tem anúncios. Os vídeos para ganhar ajudas extras são sempre opcionais.

name: FE Civil Prep: Girdlark
description:
Prepare for the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Civil exam with Girdlark: a personal study coach that follows the official knowledge areas, checks what you know, and sends you to exactly the lesson, lab or question set you need next.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- All 14 knowledge areas and all 79 lettered subtopics of the current exam specification (July 2020 edition), each with a short lesson, a worked example and common traps.
- 1,093 original practice questions: 848 computed numeric problems (every answer checked two independent ways) plus scenario questions for ethics, materials, construction and more. Instant working and a "why not" note for the wrong choice you picked.
- Adaptive practice: quizzes build a private model of your strengths on your device; missed questions come back, and each set ends with links to the lessons and labs to study next, with a line explaining why.
- Two ways to learn, one tap apart: Syllabus (the official order) and Real-World (ten things to build or decide, such as sizing a floor beam, checking a retaining wall, piping a culvert, closing a survey lot, comparing bridge decks, planning a build, sizing a footing, designing a highway curve, treating town water, pumping uphill). Each step teaches only what it needs, then checks your number.
- Eight interactive labs: force polygon, beam shear and moment, Mohr's circle, effective stress, column buckling, open-channel flow, traverse closure and detention pond.
- Seventeen unit-aware calculators for SI and US customary units, and a 311-entry formula index written from first principles, with a find-it drill.
- Timed mock exams that follow the official blueprint: 110 questions in 6 hours, review screen, results by knowledge area and a personal study plan. A free 22-question mini mock is included.
- Coverage screen showing every subtopic, its questions and your progress. Text size 50% to 300% (A-/A+), phone and tablet layouts, works fully offline, no account. Optional usage sharing, diagnostics and feedback are under Me, Settings, Privacy and data.

FREE AND PLUS
Everything marked Free stays free: every lesson, about half of the practice questions, the mini mock, eight calculators, four labs, four Real-World builds and the formula index. Girdlark Plus is an optional monthly subscription that adds the other half of the questions and typed-answer practice, the three full 110-question mocks, four more labs, six more builds and nine more calculators. Cancel any time in your store account settings: cancelling stops the next renewal, you keep Plus until the end of the month you paid for and are not charged again. No free trial.

IMPORTANT
Girdlark is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NCEES. "FE" and "NCEES" are named only to describe the exam this app helps you prepare for. The FE Reference Handbook is not included. The calculators are study tools, not an NCEES-approved exam calculator. Questions are original and do not predict your exam result.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-fe-civil-girdlark.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-fe-civil-girdlark.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-fe-civil-girdlark.html

TODAY'S CHECKS

TEMPERATURE & FOOD SAFETY RECORDS

• Every record keeps who took it and when

KITCHEN TABLET MODE
• Turn a shared tablet into the kitchen's record station
• Staff record with their own PIN, so nobody shares a login
