• Works offline. Records are saved on the device and sent when the network is back

SCHEDULES & EQUIPMENT
• Set routines to repeat daily, weekly, monthly or every few days
• Keep a list of fridges, freezers and other units, each with its safe temperature range

HACCP & POLICIES
• Build and keep your HACCP plan and food safety policies

COMPLAINTS & INSPECTIONS

REPORTS

BUILT FOR TEAMS

Feazio Hygiene is for businesses with a Feazio account. Sign in with your restaurant name and the login your manager gave you.

Need help? Write to support@feazio.com.
Feazio is a product of Vigorous IT Private Limited.

name: Fenos
description:
A quiet record of the candles made by hand.

Fenos is a private candle journal for the studio. Record each candle with its wax, scent, form, pour, wick, minutes, weight, height, room, shelf, mood and one note, then watch a year of small pours gather into something worth keeping.

THE STUDIO
Open to the last candle, the waxes in hand and the pours that came before. Add a candle in a few taps, or step back into the studio year.

CANDLES, KEPT
Keep the minutes, grams and centimeters for every candle. Note the form, the pour, the wick, the room, the shelf, the mood and one honest line. Search the log by title, wax, scent, room, shelf or phrase, and filter by the mood of the day.

THE WAX SHELF
Catalog bags across soy, coconut, beeswax, rapeseed, paraffin and blend. Note the maker, texture, melt point and acquired year, and track full, in-use, low and out states with a manual kilogram count.

THE SCENT SHELF
Keep the blends you actually pour: floral, woody, citrus, herbal, spice, resin, fresh and gourmand. Note the maker, strength, family and color, and track the grams left in the jar.

THE YEARBOOK
Read the shape of a year: candles made, total weight, time at the table, making days, favorite candles, month bars, pour distribution, the top waxes and scents, the longest sitting and the scents that ran out.

YOUR STUDIO STAYS YOURS
No account. No cloud sync. No advertising. No analytics. No streak or score. The journal is a JSON file in the app's local Documents folder, and you can export a backup or a CSV whenever you choose.

DELIBERATE LIMITS
Fenos is a studio notebook, not a shop or a course. There are no prices, affiliate links or material recommendations. It does not scan a candle, calculate a fragrance load, deduct stock or turn your practice into a number to beat.

Made for one pair of hands, a quiet table and the candle under the jar.

name: FFMCIOS
description: The app tracks the expenses covered, coverage percentages, and maximum limits for each subsidy. It allows you to view how the application of one subsidy—based on the order of settlement—alters the calculation base for the next, and enables you to enter the final confirmed amount for each expense. The itemized view displays the net amount already paid, the confirmed amount yet to be received, and the final out-of-pocket cost. Upon receiving a payment, you can record it by the bank transaction date and then allocate it across different items. The annual limit page shows both the confirmed utilized amounts and the amounts currently under application, side by side. If a refund alters the calculation results, or if there is a discrepancy between the actual amount received and the previously confirmed amount, you can revisit the original expense and subsidy details to review, make corrections, or record the actual refund received.

name: Fiddling
description:
Fiddling listens while you play the violin and shows you, note by note, what was in tune and in time. It's free, with no ads and no account.

Put a piece on screen and its notes scroll past a playhead as you play. Fiddling hears you through the microphone in your iPhone or iPad and marks each note as it goes by. Above every note is the string and finger that plays it, so you always know where your hand should be.

PLAY ALONG
• Real notation that scrolls past as you play
• Keep time scrolls at a steady speed after a count-in. Wait for me waits until you play the next note
• Colour the notes by name or by string
• A live trace of your pitch against the note you're aiming for

PLAY FROM THE PAGE
• On iPad, your music stands as a page, in rows of bars like a printed part
• A cursor moves along the row you're playing, and the page glides up so the next rows are ready to read
• Each note is marked where it sits, and the marks stay for the rest of the run
• Prefer the scrolling lane? Choose Page or Lane before you start

HEAR IT FIRST
• Hear plays any piece, or just the bars you've marked, with a violin sound that phrases the music
• Slow it down while you learn it, then bring it back up to speed

SHEET MUSIC FOR EVERY PIECE
• See the whole piece as a page, with the string and finger names over the notes
• Tap the bars you want to work on, then hear them or play them
• Each note lights up as it sounds

LEARN TO READ MUSIC
• Reading is a game of 80 short lessons in 14 sections, about two minutes each
• From the four open strings to every note in first position, sharps and flats included
• Name each note by its letter, then find it on a fingerboard you can tap
• Three hearts a lesson, combos for answers in a row, and up to three stars
• Lessons open one at a time, and perfect first tries can open the next section early
• It needs no violin, so you can practise reading anywhere

A COURSE FROM THE VERY START
• Open strings and bowing rhythms, each with words to say as you bow, like Peanut butter and Cheese pizza
• Scales in first, second, and third position, from easiest to hardest
• Songs from Lightly Row to Minuet in G

YOUR OWN MUSIC
• Photograph a printed page and Fiddling reads it into a piece you can practise
• Check the reading against your photo, hear it played, and fix anything it got wrong
• Scan once a week, and bring in MusicXML files from Files whenever you like

MEET PIP
Pip listens with you. It cheers your good runs, picks out what went well or one thing to try, and helps you tune. Choose from seven Pips in Settings, each with its own face and its own made-up, babbling voice. Pip keeps quiet whenever Fiddling is listening to you.

A TUNER THAT SHOWS YOU HOW
See which string is out, whether it's high or low, and whether to turn the fine tuner or the peg. If your violin sits a little away from concert pitch, keep its A for practice.

KEEP GOING
• Stars, personal bests, and plain advice after every run
• XP for your runs, lessons, and tuning, with a goal for each day
• A profile with your Pip, a nickname, your XP, a calendar of the days you practised, and all you've earned
• A day streak, with badges, colour themes to earn, and rest days that cover a missed day
• A streak widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• An app icon that grows with your streak: sparkles at 7 days, a gold flag at 30, and a crown at 100
• A daily reminder, if you'd like one

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your playing is analysed on your iPhone or iPad and never leaves it. Your nickname, XP, and progress stay there too. There are no accounts, no ads, and no tracking. When you scan, the photos of your pages go to our sheet reader and are deleted once they've been read.

Fiddling works best in a quiet room with your iPhone or iPad on your music stand. On iPhone it works sideways, and on iPad any way up. It's a guide for practice and doesn't replace a teacher.

description:

Ferme les yeux et éclate une bulle : tu sens le « pop ». Pas une vibration générique, une sensation réglée à la main pour chaque objet.

CE QUI CHANGE TOUT

• Avec un son réaliste ou en silence complet : parfait en cours, en réunion, dans le métro
• Aucune pub plein écran, jamais : seulement une petite bannière, et zéro pub avec Premium

30 JOUETS À SENTIR

• Molette crantée, cadran de coffre-fort, potard d'ampli, téléphone à cadran

name: Fiendora Eris
description:
here's a valley tucked between a glowing glade and a ridge full of stars. Five regions wait to be explored, each with its own mini-game, its own quiet rhythm, and its own cast of real Appalachian wildlife.

Tap fireflies in order before the sequence goes dark. Stack river stones without letting them topple off the edge. Paddle the rapids, dodge boulders, catch whatever light is skimming the surface. Flip cards to find the shy residents of Mossy Hollow. Redraw a constellation from memory before the clouds roll in. Each game is short. Each one rewards a little more Glow.

Glow is the currency of the valley. Spend it at the cabin.

Back at the cabin, the pace slows right down. A brass lantern already burns on the table. The rest is yours to earn: a woven rug in ember and gold, an old guitar slightly out of tune, a sleepy cat that showed up one snowy night and never left. Spend your Glow on the things you want, one piece at a time.

There are four daily rituals too — brew mountain tea, stoke the fire, open the window for three breaths of ridge air, note one small good thing. They take about ten seconds each. The idea is just to pause before moving on.

The Field Guide fills out as you play. Synchronous fireflies that pulse in waves across a whole hillside. A river otter that vanished from these mountains for decades and quietly came back. A red-cheeked salamander found nowhere else on Earth. Fifteen species from the Southern Appalachians, each with a real fact and a note on where to look.

When an actual trip is coming up, the Stay section handles the logistics. Build a day-by-day itinerary, track who spent what, work through the packing list by category, and keep a journal with a mood tag for each entry. Everything together, nothing behind a sign-in wall.

No streaks to protect. No notifications pushing you back. Fiendora Eris keeps the light on. Come back whenever the valley calls you home.

name: Find My Kin
description:
They're more than pets, They're Kin.

Your lost-pet announcement, live in under a minute.

Lost dog? Lost cat? Find My Kin turns one photo into a lost pet flyer and a printable poster in moments — then puts it everywhere: print it with tear-off tabs, post it to every platform in one tap, and let finders reach you through its live QR code, sightings inbox, and last-seen map.

When a pet slips out, the clock is the enemy — most are found close to home, fast, by people who heard quickly. Find My Kin is the fast announcement when you need it most: profiles saved ahead, one tap, and your announcement is live and shareable on every platform in under a minute — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, Nextdoor, text, email — with the right image and the right words already written for each one. No blank page, no typing through tears — pick the look and it's out there, everywhere, now.

And unlike a paper flyer, it keeps working: sightings land in one inbox, finders message you privately, and the moment they're home, the same announcement carries the good news.

BUILD IT BEFORE YOU NEED IT
Save your pets' profiles now — photos, breed, colors, markings — while everyone is home safe. When the worst day comes, the announcement is one tap and under a minute away.

ONE BUILD, TWO FLYERS
• Print flyer: US Letter, big photo, big contact, plus a tear-off-tabs version for bulletin boards
• Live digital flyer: photo and video carousel, last-seen map, and a link you can share anywhere

FIVE LAYOUTS — PICK THE LOOK
It is a design tool: every flyer starts from your choice of five layouts — Classic, Bold Alert, Photo First, Clean Minimal, and High-Contrast Urgent. Preview each one live with your pet's own photo before you commit, and switch anytime, free, even after the flyer is out — the print sheet, the live flyer, and every share card restyle together. Your pet's photo is never cropped in any layout: their whole head, always in frame.

A QR CODE THAT STAYS ALIVE
Every flyer carries a dynamic QR code. Scan it — or tap it — and you land on the live flyer: report a sighting with a map pin and photo, or message the owner privately. The owner's phone number is never printed unless they choose to show it.

FIND MY KIN MESSENGER — THE CONVERSATION IS BUILT IN
A paper flyer gives a stranger one move: call a number printed for the whole street to see. Find My Kin gives them a better one. Anyone who finds your flyer — on a pole, on their phone, anywhere — can message you privately right from the flyer itself. No app to download. No account to create. And no phone numbers on either side, ever. Every message lands in Find My Kin Messenger, your inbox inside the app — one thread per flyer, unread badges up front — and you reply right from the app. The whole conversation stays on the flyer, working until they're home.

SIGHTINGS INBOX & LIVE STATUS
Sightings land in one inbox, newest first, with places, notes and photos. Update the flyer as the search moves: Lost → Sighted → Reunited — and when it's over, the same flyer becomes the celebration everyone who helped deserves to see.

SHARE EVERYWHERE IN ONE TAP
The moment the flyer exists, it's shareable everywhere — no extra steps. Story-shaped and square images are rendered for you, a video version too when your flyer has a clip, and every platform gets its post pre-written under its own rules: Facebook (feed and lost-pet groups), Instagram, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, Messenger, Nextdoor, text and email.

ENGLISH & SPANISH
Every flyer can be made in English or Spanish from the same build.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your pet's microchip number is private by default — owner's choice to show. It stays on their private profile, off the flyer entirely, unless you flip one toggle and choose to print it. Your call, and it starts off.

Find My Kin is made by KinsLe.

$9.99 once. No subscription. Unlimited pets, unlimited flyers — because nobody should have to think about price on the worst day.

name: FinLineage
description:
Plan which ornamental fish to keep with a clearer view of their expected family origins.

FinLineage is a local breeding planner for aquarium hobbyists and preservation groups. Record parentage, organize nursery batches and compare how different retention counts change the expected contribution of your chosen reference fish. Work through a complete retention round on your iPhone or iPad.

HOW A RETENTION ROUND WORKS

1. Start a project
Create a collection for your records, or explore one of three separate, editable examples: balancing shared founders, locating an unknown parent, and following one ancestor through two paths.

2. Register your broodstock
Give each fish a name, marking and notes, then connect its recorded parents. Stable identities keep fish with the same name separate. Search your records and review affected links before confirming an identity merge.

3. Create nursery batches
Choose a confirmed parent pair, add the batch date and record available fish and minimum retention. Enter separate sub-batches for different confirmed pairs. An unconfirmed parent position stays unknown.

4. Choose your reference sources
Select the fish that define the source layer for this project. Contribution calculations stop at those identities. Parentage and source checks help identify cycles, missing references and overlapping ancestor-descendant selections.

5. Set your retention target
Allocate whole fish across batches with direct input or steppers. Apply minimums, capacity limits and quantity locks. Preview a transfer from another batch, including both batches' limits, before confirming it. Save an unfinished plan as a draft.

6. Try a different source mix
Enter source targets totalling 100%, including unknown, and search for feasible integer batch counts. Review the candidate beside your current plan, inspect the gaps and adjust counts yourself. The app identifies complete searches and searches that reached their limit. Apply a candidate only after reviewing it; both plans are saved for comparison.

7. Follow shared ancestry
Explore parent and ancestor paths, inspect known path contributions in the common ancestor matrix and compare saved plans on the same reference layer. Historical snapshots retain their recorded pedigree, sources and counts. Trial edits are saved separately so you can resume later.

8. Take the plan to your fish room
Preview a readable checklist with batch names, parents, exact retention counts, minimums and items to verify. Share a PDF or CSV, archive completed projects and export a complete backup for restoration on another device.

UNDERSTAND THE NUMBERS

Each confirmed parent contributes one half. Multiple recorded paths to the same ancestor are combined, while missing parent positions retain separate unknown identities. Overall percentages are weighted by the fish currently allocated, including when a plan is unfinished.

Charts show expected contributions from recorded parentage. They do not predict an individual fish's appearance or measure inbreeding or genetic diversity. Source targets express a preference and may be unattainable with your records and limits.

YOUR RECORDS, ON YOUR DEVICE

Core calculations, pedigree records and drafts work locally. No account, ads, analytics or network connection is required. Exported files leave the app through destinations you choose. Feedback supports a local draft and optional system sharing. English and Simplified Chinese are supported.

name: firelit camera
description:
a raw camera loaded with one film, for good.
each press of the shutter takes a quick burst of raw frames, and firelit merges them on your iPhone into one cleaner raw. then it develops that through its film look and keeps the DNG, so you can develop it again.

the viewfinder stays plain on purpose. it shows the scene, not a guess at the photo. tap the thumbnail and the developed frame is there, like picking up prints, minus the week at the lab. it cleans up a few seconds later, once the burst is merged.

the look
built from the measured behavior of color-negative and slide film.
highlights roll off softly and stay just under white.
blacks are dense, not crushed.
greens lean olive. skies stay pale.
a faint halation around lamps and bright edges, and grain.

the deck
· capture: a burst of up to 8 Bayer raw frames, merged into one DNG on your iPhone. a single frame with flash
· shutter: large, the main control
· readout: shutter speed and ISO, lit amber
· EV knob: exposure compensation
· lens: by focal length. 13, 24 and 100 mm on iPhone 17 Pro
· focus: AF with tap to focus, or ∞ for skylines and landscapes. the first ∞ on a lens may ask you to aim at something far
· flash: where the lens can fire it with raw
· auto exposure: never slower than 1/15 s

only lenses that shoot raw are listed, so the set varies by iPhone.

the edit
· presets: eight small prints of your photo, each a variation on the look, with an amount slider. pastel, moss, silver (black and white), cross, bleach, shoebox, pushed, frost
· contrast
· exposure
· white balance: temperature and tint
· film: halation and grain
· crop: free, original, 1:1, 4:5, 2:3, 9:16, whole photo. tilt up to 45° either way

nothing is burned in. the original DNG and a small settings file stay with every photo, so an edit can be changed next week, or undone.

the gallery
one plain grid, newest first.
· save to Photos as a 10-bit HEIC, or share
· import DNG files from your photo library, up to 20 at a time. photos without a DNG are turned away.

what it leaves out
no account. no ads. no tracking. no subscription.
your photos stay inside firelit until you save or share them.

MAKE THE FIRE YOURS

PLAYS ALONGSIDE YOUR AUDIO

KEEPS CRACKLING

SETTLE IN

Fireside includes professionally recorded, commercially licensed fire audio. No account is required, and Fireside does not collect personal data.

name: Flickroll: Photo Cleaner
description:
Flickroll helps you clean your camera roll with a flick. Swipe left or tap the red trash button to toss a photo, swipe right or tap the green check to keep it, and swipe up to favorite it. Labels stay on screen, and a short demo shows the directions the first time you open the app.

Photos never leave your iPhone. There is no account and no ads.

Clean up old screenshots and duplicates, see how much space you have freed, and keep going at your own pace. Everyone gets 40 free flicks a day. Flickroll Plus unlocks unlimited flicks, with a weekly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Restore purchases anytime.

Pricing: Flickroll Plus Weekly is $3.99 per week, Flickroll Plus Yearly is $24.99 per year, and Flickroll Plus Lifetime is $34.99 once. Subscriptions auto-renew until you cancel in your Apple ID settings.

name: Flip to Fuse
description:
Every tile has two sides. Every swipe flips them all.

Flip to Fuse is a calm, one-more-try puzzle. Swipe and every tile rolls one cell and flips over, showing its other color. When two matching colors meet, they fuse into one.

Fuse on every swipe to build your combo: ×2, ×3, ×5… ×10. Each fuse plays a rising note, so a long streak sounds as good as it feels. Miss once and the combo resets.

It starts easy. The longer you last, the trickier new tiles get, so every move needs a plan.

• Easy to learn, hard to master
• Combo chains with rising musical notes
• Quick games on a cozy 4×4 board
• Warm, quiet design. No flashing, no clutter
• Track your best score, best combo and recent games
• Play offline, anytime
• No ads. No accounts. No data collected

How long can you keep the combo going?

name: Flooded: Car Flood Alert
description:
Flooded or dry can come down to which side of the street you parked on.

Flooded tells you whether your parking spot is likely to flood, and alerts you in time to move.

• Built on laser-surveyed elevation maps detailed down to one meter, live radar, rain forecasts and city flood records
• Tuned on years of real street-flood sensor data
• Tested against New York City flood sensors: it warned before the water got deep enough to damage a car in up to 94% of floods

No app can promise a dry car. Flooded gives you the warning and the time to act.

Flooded works across the United States and Canada.

name: Flowkern: Micro Habit Tracker
description:
Small steps. Real flow.
Flowkern helps you check off tiny habits every day, focus deeply and see your progress – fully offline and without an account.

App language: German. The app interface is currently available in German only.

TODAY
• Your habits as a stack – one tap to check off
• Satisfying feedback with haptics and small effects
• A bonus when you finish the whole stack
• Your energy core grows with every level

FOCUS
• Focus timer with a shrinking ring
• Calm sounds: brown noise, rain or a soft drone
• Partial minutes count too

PROGRESS
• 52-week overview
• Streaks with shields: one missed day doesn't break everything
• Levels and experience points

60-SECOND CHECK-IN
Morning: what matters today and how is your energy? Evening: what went well and what's your plan for tomorrow?

QUICK START
Pick a goal in three screens – focus, ADHD-friendly structure, morning routine or calm – and start with matching micro habits.

PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no trackers, no internet needed.

Flowkern is a self-organization tool and not a medical product.

name: Flowmory
description:
Trasforma foto e video in montaggi da condividere. In Flowmory puoi creare un video dai tuoi ricordi oppure montarlo clip per clip sulla timeline. Scegli foto e video dalla libreria o dai File, dividi e riordina i segmenti e regola la durata e l’audio. Aggiungi una base musicale, un titolo e sottotitoli quando il riconoscimento offline è disponibile.

Ritrova i tuoi ricordi per data, luogo e soggetto. Conserva i progetti sul dispositivo e riprendi il montaggio quando vuoi. Esporta il risultato in MP4 e condividilo dalle opzioni del sistema.

name: FlowWeir
description:
Build and explain a small directed capacity model with FlowWeir. Define your nodes, directed channels and source/sink, then inspect a reproducible maximum-flow solution and one minimum cut.

MODEL THE NETWORK
Create a named model with your own quantity/horizon label. Add and reorder nodes and channels, enter whole-number capacities and choose distinct terminals. Move canvas nodes for visual clarity without changing the mathematical model. An explicit Two handoff lanes sample provides a starting example.

FOLLOW EVERY AUGMENTATION
Solve the single-commodity directed maximum source-to-sink flow. Walk through the augmentation trace, bottleneck and value before/after each step. Reverse residual operations name the original channel whose earlier assignment is reclaimed; they are not new physical channels.

CHECK THE CUT AND CERTIFICATE
See final flow/capacity for every original channel, residual-reachable sides and all original channels crossing the reported cut. Inspect capacity, conservation and flow/cut equality checks. Multiple optimal allocations or cuts can exist; FlowWeir reports one deterministic result for the saved input order.

FREEZE AND EXPORT
Save a solved report independently of the editable model. Generate complete CSV and JSON with the flow, cut and trace, or a paginated PDF with the graph and numeric tables. Preview and share actual files. Export model JSON separately and import it as a new editable model; report JSON is not model input.

DECLARED LIMITS
Up to 26 nodes and 120 original channels per model; capacities are integers from 0 to 1,000,000. Zero-capacity and distinct antiparallel channels are supported. Store up to 100 models and 100 reports within a 128 MiB owned-payload allowance. Model imports use FlowWeir schema 1 JSON up to 2 MiB.

The app calculates an abstract capacity model using user-entered quantities. It does not measure infrastructure or simulate physical pipes, electricity or traffic, and does not model edge costs, travel times, losses, storage, fairness, multiple commodities or node capacities.

name: FluxDex: Nozzle Flow Rate
description:
FluxDex measures spray nozzle flow rates with a measuring cylinder and your phone. Collect the water from each nozzle, type the volume, and the app compares it with the manufacturer's table: right away it shows which nozzles are worn, clogged or within range.

How it works
• Pick the nozzle from the catalog (or add your own) and the working pressure.
• Hold the cylinder under the nozzle and tap Start: the stopwatch times the collection and signals with a beep and vibration.
• Type the volume. The app works out the flow rate in mL/min and shows whether the nozzle is normal, low or worn.
• Go nozzle by nozzle to the end of the boom.

The result
• How many nozzles are out of range and which ones to replace.
• Average flow, coefficient of variation, minimum, maximum and standard deviation.
• Boom map, 10 nozzles per row, and a chart of the flow along the boom.

PDF report
• Two layouts: dashboard (landscape A4) and full (portrait A4).
• Built on the phone itself, even without internet.
• With your logo, your colors and your contact details in the footer.

Clients and schedule
• Add your clients and each one's machines.
• Schedule the next calibration or nozzle change and get a reminder on your phone.

Made for the field
• Works offline: analyses upload to your account when you're back online.
• Catalog with factory flow rates from the main nozzle manufacturers.
• In English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Every new account comes with a sample analysis, so you can see the report before heading to the field.

An app by the Spraydex team.

name: Fly a Rocket
description:
How far can you fly?

Launch your rocket, earn coins and UPGRADE!

Every coin counts, so upgrade strategically. Build a stronger launcher, power up your rocket or boost your income to earn more on every flight.

• Choose the right upgrades to go farther
• Many worlds to explore
• There WILL be crashes along the way

name: Fmsmnsup
seller_name: IPEKYOLU EGITIM KURUMLARI SAGLIK HIZMETLERI VE TEKSTIL TURIZM GIDA SANAYI TICARET LIMITED
description:
Welcome! We take every piece of feedback seriously and look forward to hearing from you.



Coaches, this one's for you. Fmsmnsup puts your training cones exactly where the drill says they go, on your actual field, at true distance.

Drill diagrams are great until someone asks "how far is that?" Fmsmnsup answers it. Pick a drill, tap where cone A goes, tap which way it faces, and the AR view shows every cone on the grass with running arrows sliding along the path. Distances float above each leg in metres or yards. Walk out, drop the cones on the marks, done.

WHAT'S IN THE BAG
- AR field view: anchor the start and direction on the ground, see each cone at its real spot with animated path arrows, undo, reset, save the layout and take snapshots that stay on your phone.
- 2D planner: the same drill on a space you size yourself, a clear "it fits" or "needs more room" call, a 90 degree turn button, and step-off directions in paces and metres ("7 paces toward 2 o'clock").
- Drill builder: tap a grid to place cones, link them with arrows (sprint, shuffle, backpedal, jog, weave, dribble, pass) and set exact distances.
- 20 bundled drills: agility, conditioning and ball control, from the T-Drill and Illinois Run to the slalom dribble and passing triangle, each with how-to steps, reps and rest.
- Run timer: whistle, go! Tap a split at each cone, see per-player splits, best times and a leaderboard, with personal bests flagged.
- Session planner: stack drills with minutes and changeover time, and Fmsmnsup shows when each block starts and the total length.
- Squad list: add players and see their best, latest and how much quicker they got on every drill.

Saved layouts can be searched, filtered, renamed, copied and deleted (with undo).

WORKS ON EVERY IPHONE
The AR view needs a device with an A9 chip or later. The planner works everywhere, so every feature is usable even without AR.

YOUR CALL ON ACCOUNTS
Everything works without an account. If you'd like a backup or to use Fmsmnsup on a second phone, create a free optional account and your layouts, drills, squad, runs and sessions sync. You can delete the account inside the app at any time. The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded.

Fmsmnsup is a coaching guide. Distances come from the drill cards and your own settings, so always check your space is safe before the first whistle.

Enjoy now

name: Focus Farmer: Phone-Down Farm
description:
Focus Farm turns focused time into a farm you'll want to come back to.

Plant seeds, start a focus session and put your phone down. Your crops grow 5× faster while you focus. When the session ends, open your harvest crates for coins, seeds and shop restocks, then harvest your crops and grow your farm.

HOW IT WORKS
• Plant: pick a seed and tap a plot, or drag across plots to plant a whole row.
• Focus: choose 5 to 60 minutes and put your phone down. Your farm rests while you work.
• Harvest: open a crate for every 5 minutes you focused, then harvest what's ready.

GROW YOUR FARM
• Seven crops, from quick wheat to slow-growing peppers and watermelons.
• Crops keep growing while you're away, and grow 5× faster during focus.
• Send the tractor across the field to harvest everything at once.
• Buy more land as your farm grows, up to 60 plots.
• The shop restocks itself every two hours.
• Earn Farm XP for every focused minute and unlock new things for your farm.

STAY ON TRACK
• A countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• A Home Screen widget that shows your session and what's ready to harvest.
• A notification when your session ends.
• Focus history with daily minutes and streaks.

name: FocusTrellis
description:
Create a focus session with a clear title, a duration from 1 to 240 minutes and notes. Open the timer, start, pause or resume it, then finish the session to save the time actually spent. The countdown uses saved timestamps, so leaving the app does not lose the session. Reset to start again. Browse sessions, search and filter unfinished work, then review completed sessions and focused minutes in the journal. No background alarms, notifications or distraction blocking.

Free, no ads, no purchases and no login. Core records work offline and stay in local app storage. Eight interface languages and persistent System, Light or Dark appearance. Optional fictional samples can be loaded in Settings.

name: Fograph
description:
One sentence a day. That's the whole app.

Fograph is a quiet daily check-in: write a single sentence about today and it's stamped with the year, month, day and time you wrote it. Tomorrow, do it again.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• One sentence, no more — a 140-character focus that keeps the habit small
• A 7:00 AM reminder that skips itself the moment you've already checked in
• Every entry saved and grouped by month in a clean, readable log
• A daily quote and a Bible verse to sit with while you write
• Black, white and warm gray. No feeds, no likes, no streaks to gamify

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD

Fograph keeps your entries on your device. There's nothing to sign up for, nothing to sync, and nothing to lose track of. Your days stay yours.

MADE FOR THE SMALL HABIT

Open it once a day, write one line, close it. That's it.

name: For My Kids: Custody Journal
description:
You keep track because your kids come first. For My Kids is a private custody journal for one parent: write down what happens when it happens, and turn months of notes into a clear, dated report for your lawyer, your mediator or the court.

No account. No server. Your co-parent is never invited and never notified. Everything stays on your iPhone.

A CUSTODY LOG YOU CAN FILL IN A MINUTE
• Exchanges and visitation: on time, late (and by how many minutes), no-show, cancelled or refused
• Messages and calls: what was said, by text, phone, email or in person
• Incidents: what happened, where, and who saw it
• Expenses: the amount, who paid, each parent's share, and whether you've been paid back
• Health and school: appointments, meetings, absences
• Your own parenting: meals, homework, activities, bedtimes

Every entry saves two times: when it happened and when you recorded it. If you change an entry later, the change is noted. That's what makes a journal easy to trust.

SCHEDULED EXCHANGES, CONFIRMED WITH ONE TAP
Enter your regular pickup and drop-off times once. After each one, For My Kids asks how it went: on time, late or didn't happen. You can answer straight from the notification, and every answer becomes a dated entry. Over time you get a plain count of how many exchanges were on time, late or missed.

PHOTOS, SCREENSHOTS AND FILES
Attach screenshots of texts, receipts, PDFs and other documents, or take a photo on the spot. For My Kids keeps its own copy, so it's still there if the original is deleted.

PARENTING-TIME CALENDAR
Set your custody schedule once: week on/week off, 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5, 3-4-4-3, every other weekend, or your own. Then mark only the days that go differently. The calendar counts the overnights and shows your share by month and year, and how many days changed from the schedule.

A CLEAR, DATED PDF REPORT
Pick the dates and what to include. You get a numbered report in date order with a cover page, parenting-time totals, an exchange summary, an expense summary, your entries and your photos. Email it, AirDrop it or print it. A spreadsheet (CSV) export is included for attorneys who want to sort and filter.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Stored only on your iPhone and in your own device backups
• Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode
• Records are hidden in the app switcher
• Notifications never mention custody or your case
• Save a backup file with every entry and photo whenever you like

YOUR RECORDS STAY YOURS
If your plan ends, you can still read, export and delete everything you wrote.

MADE FOR ONE PARENT
Co-parenting apps need both parents to sign up. This one doesn't. It works for divorce, separation and parents who were never married, and whether your case is in court now or you just want documentation in case it ever is.

PLANS
For My Kids requires a purchase to start logging. There is no free trial.
• Lifetime: one payment, no subscription
• Yearly: billed once a year
• Monthly: billed every month

Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://npidzarko-art.github.io/formykids-support/privacy.html

For My Kids is a record-keeping tool. It is not legal advice and not a substitute for an attorney. Courts decide what evidence they accept.

name: ForkStack AI
description:
ForkStack AI is the owner's app for restaurants that run on ForkStack. Ask a question the way you would ask a manager — "how did lunch go?", "what's running low?", "who sold the most this week?" — and get the answer in plain words, with the charts and tables behind it.

The answers come from your own ForkStack records. Every total, margin and average is computed by ForkStack's servers from your data; the assistant chooses what to look up and explains the result. It can only read: it cannot create, change or delete anything.

Alongside the assistant:
• Home — today, any period or all time: revenue, bills, the average bill and what needs your attention.
• Sales — every bill with its status, type and cashier, staff sales, customers and the day close.
• Stock — stock against reorder levels, kitchen orders, vendors, purchases, menu and waste.
• Finance — expenses, payables, accounts and profit & loss, staff, events and payroll.

Built for owners with one outlet or many: see every outlet together, or one at a time.

ForkStack AI requires a ForkStack account. Accounts are created by your business's administrator in the ForkStack ERP.

name: Fotomory: Old Photo Scanner
description:
Turn a box of old family photos into an archive your family can keep – right on your iPhone. Scan album pages, prints, negatives and slides, fix faded color, and save the story behind every photo: who is in it, when and where it was taken, and the voice of the person who remembers.

SCAN THE WHOLE BOX
• Point at an album page – Fotomory finds every photo on it, crops each one and straightens it
• Auto-capture takes the shot when your phone is steady, so you can go page after page
• Glossy print or album film? Scan without glare takes several shots and keeps the clear parts of each
• Adjust any crop by hand, or turn auto-crop off
• Import scans you already have from Photos or Files

NEGATIVES AND SLIDES
• Color and black-and-white negatives, and 35 mm slides in their mounts
• Lay the film on a light – a second iPhone with Fotomory, a laptop screen or a light pad – and every whole frame is saved as its own photo
• Negatives become positives, with the orange film mask taken out

GENTLE CORRECTION
• Every scan gets a corrected version right away: levels, faded color, a little noise reduction and sharpness
• The original is always kept – hold the photo to compare
• Rotate and crop at any time without losing anything

THE STORY BEHIND EVERY PHOTO
• Add names, a date – exact or "about 1975" – a place and a caption
• Record a story in your mother's or grandfather's own voice. It is transcribed into text on your iPhone
• Find any photo by name, place, decade or a word from a story

ORGANIZED LIKE YOUR BOX
• Every scanning session becomes an album
• Browse by album, by person or by decade

SHARE WITH FAMILY
• Copies go to your Photos library on their own date – a photo from 1975 lands in 1975
• Export a folder with full-size photos, voice stories, transcripts and a spreadsheet of names and dates – or send it all as one ZIP file
• Dates, places, captions and names are written into every photo file
• Share a story as a video: the photo with the voice

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and voice recordings stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, so your archive is there on your other iPhones and after you reinstall. Fotomory has no servers and no account, and the developer never sees your photos. Faces are found on your iPhone; only where a face is on the photo and the name you give are kept – no face prints.

FREE TO START, PAY ONCE
Your first 20 photos are free, with every feature. After that, one purchase unlocks unlimited scanning forever – no subscription, no ads. Family Sharing is supported. Everything you have scanned stays yours: you can view, caption, record stories and export it at any time, even without buying.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fotomory.app/privacy

name: Foul Shot
description:
Take the shot. Sink it.

Foul Shot is fast-paced arcade basketball, made for iPhone Duo. Bend your Duo into tabletop mode and set it down: the flat screen is the hardwood, the upright screen is the hoop. Swipe up to shoot and watch the ball lift off at the hinge, arc into the arena and drop through the net. No Duo? It plays great on any iPhone or iPad too, with the hoop on top and the court below.

ONE SWIPE. THAT'S THE WHOLE GAME.
Swipe speed sets the arc, swipe angle sets your aim, and a curved swipe adds spin. Real physics means rim rattles, bank shots off the glass and clean swishes you can hear. A meter after every shot shows whether you were soft, perfect or hard, so you get better with every round.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• 60-Second Arcade – Score all you can in a minute. Gold money balls, streak multipliers and double points in the final 10 seconds. Five levels, from a still hoop to a fast one that slides and bobs.
• Hot Streak – Keep shooting until you miss. Six in a row and the ball catches fire.
• Around the World – Seven spots around the arc. Make one to move on; three misses and you're out. Chase your fastest lap.
• Challenge – Multiplayer against a random opponent or a Game Center friend, in Arcade, Hot Streak or Around the World. You shoot first, they get a notification and have 24 hours to beat it. Or pass the phone and play head to head.

FEELS LIKE GAME NIGHT
A real arena crowd that cheers your makes and roars for your streaks, a buzzer at the horn, and haptics on every rim, net and backboard hit. Turn the crowd or effects off any time.

UNLOCK AND COLLECT
Earn 24 achievements and collect 10 balls and 10 courts, from Gold Rush to The Finals. Every one can be earned by playing. Your progress is kept safe with private iCloud sync.

FREE FOR EVERYONE
Hot Streak as much as you like, 3 Arcade and 3 Around the World runs a day, 5 Arcade Challenges a day, and 5 free tries each of Hot Streak and Around the World Challenges. Accepting a Challenge is always free.

GO FURTHER WITH ONE-TIME PURCHASES
• Premiere – unlimited solo play and unlimited Challenges in every mode
• All-Access – everything in Premiere, plus every ball and court
• Single balls and courts in the Locker

No accounts, no ads and no tracking.

name: FoxFace Diving
description:
FoxFace Diving is the app for members of dive clubs that run on FoxFace Diving. Find your club once, sign in with the name and code your club gives you, and everything your club does is on your phone.

SEE WHAT'S ON AND BOOK YOUR PLACE
Club dives, trips, expeditions, training days and pool sessions, with the site, depth, meeting time and who is running each one. Put your name down in one tap and see how many places are left.

BORROW CLUB KIT AND THE BOAT
Ask for cylinders, regulators, suits and more, and the Equipment Officer approves it. Need several things for a trip? Add them to your basket and send them as one request. The club knows what is already spoken for, so two people never book the same kit for the same weekend.

CLUB NOTICES IN ONE PLACE
Club news, committee minutes and trip details, all in one place, so nobody misses a deposit date or a change of plan.

YOUR KIT BAG
Keep the details your club needs from you up to date: emergency contact, next of kin and qualification. Add your own kit and see at a glance when a test or service is due. Only you can see your own kit list.

EMERGENCY CONTACTS FOR THE DIVE MANAGER
Whoever is running a dive can open an emergency sheet with every diver's emergency contact and next of kin, each number ready to ring with its international code. It is saved on the phone, so it still opens with no signal on a boat or a remote shore, and it is deleted five days after the dive. Every opening is recorded for the committee.

FOR THE COMMITTEE
Officers run the club from the same app: the dive calendar, members and their sign-in codes, kit requests, the boat log and the club's notices.

JUST LOOKING?
Tap "Try the demo" on the first screen to look round a made-up club. Tap one of the people at the top and their sign-in is filled in for you.

Can't find your club? Tell us which one from the first screen and we will get in touch with them.

FoxFace Diving is free for members. Your club's committee sets it up and gives you your sign-in.

name: Foxtune: Ear Training Games
description:
Foxtune turns music lessons into games. Fenn the fox, a little fennec with very big ears, guides you through six worlds — each one is its own game that trains one skill.

NOTE STAIRCASE — hear do, then a mystery note, and jump to its step. Your ear learns where every note of the scale lives.

BIRD SONGS — a bird sings a short tune; play it back on the xylophone. From single notes to whole melodies.

NOTE MOUNTAIN — read notes on the treble staff and climb ledge by ledge to the summit.

RHYTHM TRAIN — rhythms are drawn as trains: ta, ti-ti and rests. Guess the train in the tunnel, play it at the signal, and echo Fenn’s drum over a metronome.

INTERVAL POND — two notes, one jump: from small steps to big leaps, each remembered by a famous tune.

CHORD CAFÉ — every guest orders a mood: major sounds bright, minor sounds sad, and more.

LEARN, DON’T JUST GUESS
• A short playful lesson before every world: you touch, listen and try — no walls of text.
• Review brings back what you got wrong — tomorrow, in three days, in a week — until it sticks.
• Note names your way: do-re-mi or C-D-E.

A GAME YOU WANT TO COME BACK TO
• Stars, coins, combos and three hearts per level.
• Daily quests with a chest, a day streak with freezes.
• Twelve achievements in bronze, silver and gold.
• Fenn’s wardrobe: hats, glasses and scarves for your coins.

FREE AND PRO
The whole Note Staircase, the first two levels of every game, lessons and review are free. Foxtune Pro opens every level of every game. Monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial), or a one-time lifetime purchase.

No ads. All sound is made in the app — no microphone needed.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: frameby.
description:
frameby. turns your screen into someone else's window for a while.

Each frame stays for four minutes. The corner shows only a place and a time: Karaköy, 21:05. Behind it, a radio plays live. No likes, no counts, no comments, no endless feed. Twelve frames a day, then the day starts over.

The frames belong to photographers. Each photographer has their own layer, with their name in the corner. The rules are simple: place, light, time; no recognisable faces.

Layers
· Day: city frames that change every day. Free.
· Old Istanbul: the city through 19th-century photographers. Free.
· Berkay's Istanbul and Night Shore: with frameby+.

On every screen
· Apple TV: the living-room wall.
· iPad and Mac: a window left open beside the desk.
· iPhone: a frame while it charges; the frame of the day in StandBy.

frameby+
A yearly subscription. All photo layers, and new ones as they are added. The radio and the Day layer are always free. Half of net subscription income goes to the photographers, shared by how long their frames stay on screen.

No account, no ads, no idea who you are.

Terms: berkaydogan.co/en/frameby/terms
Privacy: berkaydogan.co/en/frameby/privacy

name: FramePure - EXIF Frame & GPS
description:
The refined final step before sharing your photography to Instagram, Xiaohongshu, or Moments.

FramePure pairs museum-grade minimalist framing with automatic privacy metadata scrubbing — built for iPhone, Fujifilm, Sony, and Ricoh photographers. No filters, no beauty retouching, no tacky stickers, no ads, and no subscriptions.

KEY FEATURES
• 30 Museum-Grade & Darkroom Templates: Classic Gallery White, Auto-Color Frosted Dusk & Mist, Glass Card, 35mm Film Sprocket, Vertical 35mm Twin, 120 Medium Format, Optical Blueprint, Japanese Zine, Museum Exhibition Placard, Travel Postcard, and 5-Chip Color Swatch Specimen. 100% pure typography with zero third-party logos.
• 6 Fine-Art Paper Textures & 8 Archival Mattes: Cotton rag, warm linen, silver film grain, concrete stone, and washi fiber — plus 6 one-tap curated lookbook recipes.
• 9-Grid Batch Export (Zero Cropping): Import up to 9 mixed landscape and portrait shots at once and unify them into 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, or 9:16 social ratios without ever cropping your composition.
• Automatic GPS & Serial Scrubbing: Audits and strips exact GPS coordinates, device/lens serial numbers, owner names, and proprietary MakerNotes on export — with optional safe city-only captions. 100% offline on-device processing.
• True Color & Creative Workshop: Preserves Display P3 wide gamut and Apple HDR Gain Maps, supports Live Photo framing, RAW/DNG import, Diptych & 35mm Contact Sheet layouts, 64-bin RGB Histogram & #HEX extraction, and transparent PNG handwritten signatures.
• Deep Apple Integration: Photos Share Extension, Apple Shortcuts automation, iPad split studio layout, and iCloud preset sync.

name: FreeCircuits
description:
FreeCircuits is a clean, no-fuss interval timer for circuit training. Build a workout once, press start, and let the timer do the counting while you do the work.

BUILD YOUR OWN CIRCUITS
• Add exercises, each with its own duration and number of sets
• Set rest between exercises and rest between rounds
• Choose how many rounds to run
• Start straight away with three example circuits

TRAIN WITHOUT WATCHING THE CLOCK
• A large countdown ring shows exactly how long is left
• Beeps signal each change between work and rest

DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
• A sleek dark design that's easy to read mid-workout
• Your circuits are stored on your phone

OPTIONAL ACCOUNT
• No sign-up needed to use the app
• Sign in with Apple or email if you'd like an account
• Delete your account at any time from inside the app

Whether it's 30 seconds of push-ups and 30 seconds off or a full-body routine, FreeCircuits keeps you moving.

name: FreezerLedger: Food Inventory
description:
Know what you froze, where you put it, and what’s reserved for dinner.

FreezerLedger is a freezer inventory for the food you pack at home, from bulk meat and garden harvests to leftovers and make-ahead meals.

• Keep separate batches with packing dates, freezer compartments, quantities and optional photos.
• Reserve food from a specific batch for a meal. See what’s on hand, what’s reserved and what’s still available. Mark the meal cooked to use the reserved quantity.
• Use one with a tap, undo a mistaken entry, and see moves and stock changes in history.
• Set stock targets and share a restock list.
• Choose your own target dates and optional local reminders.
• Share an inventory CSV or save a full backup with photos and reservations.

Works offline without an account. One purchase includes all features. Each device keeps its own inventory.

name: Freq
description:
FREQ is your own local radio break.

Keep listening to whatever you like: your music, a podcast, an audiobook. Every so often, FREQ steps in with a short spoken update about where you are, then hands your audio right back.

WHAT YOU HEAR
• Weather: current conditions for your town
• Traffic: the most important incident near you, by road name
• Local news: a fresh headline for your town or province, never the same one twice in a row
• Markets: the tickers you follow, or the TSX and S&P 500 by default
• Sports: scores and upcoming games for your NHL, NBA, MLB and NFL teams

YOUR SCHEDULE
Choose a break every 15 minutes, 30 minutes or hour, or set any custom interval with the time picker. Want an update right now? Tap Play a briefing now.

DESIGNED TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
• Each briefing runs about 20 to 30 seconds
• Podcasts and audiobooks pause during the break and resume after it
• Music lowers underneath the briefing, then comes back up
• Works with any audio app, and on its own when nothing else is playing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. FREQ uses your location only to make briefings local, and it never sells or shares your data for tracking.

Breaks continue while your phone is locked. Continued use of location in the background can decrease battery life.

name: FreshRadar: Fridge Expiry Log
description:
FreshRadar helps you track every item in your fridge, freezer, and pantry so nothing quietly expires in the back corner.

Built for fast everyday use with color-coded freshness rings, gentle expiry reminders, and Home Screen widgets.

KEY FEATURES
• Instant Freshness Radar: See what needs to be eaten today, this week, or later at a single glance.
• Smart Expiry Reminders: Local notifications warn you days before food or skincare products expire.
• Fridge, Freezer & Pantry Zones: Organize groceries, leftovers, and cosmetics (PAO) effortlessly.
• Home Screen Widgets: Keep urgent expiring items visible without opening the app.
• 100% Offline & Buyout Pro: No account required. Unlock unlimited items and JSON backup with one purchase.

name: Frietchalet Rotselaar
description:
Officiële app van Frietchalet Rotselaar. Bestel nu bij De Frietchalet Rotselaar via onze app!

Bekijk het menu, bestel eenvoudig online en profiteer van onze acties. Met deze app heb je Frietchalet Rotselaar altijd op zak.

name: Frontline Events
description:
Frontline is the events calendar for veterans, military, law enforcement, firefighters, EMS and their families.

FIND EVENTS FOR THOSE WHO SERVE
Ceremonies and memorials, job fairs and hiring events, fundraisers and galas, reunions, honor flights, toy drives, stair climbs and community gatherings. Filter by community, browse this weekend or this month, and search by city, organization or keyword.

NEAR YOU
Use your location or type a city or ZIP and see what's happening within 10 to 250 miles, on a list or a map.

NEVER MISS WHAT MATTERS
Save events or tap I'm going. Frontline reminds you a week before and the day before. Follow a community, a state or an organization and get an alert when something new is posted. Get told when next year's date is posted for an event you went to.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
A free resource directory built into the app: crisis lines, peer support, counseling, jobs, education and scholarships, legal aid, housing, benefits and claims help, family and caregiver programs, emergency financial help and survivor support, plus your state's veterans office. Every number and link is checked.

In crisis? Veterans and service members can call 988 and press 1, any time.

MORE
Observance pages for Veterans Day, Memorial Day, National Police Week, Pearl Harbor, Wreaths Across America and 9/11. News, hero-friendly businesses with offers for those who serve, and an easy way to submit your own event for free.

No password needed: sign in with a link sent to your email, or with Apple or Google. Browsing never needs an account.

Frontline is not affiliated with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs or any government agency.

name: Fruit attack
description:
In a sunny fantasy orchard, underground insect forces are marching to steal the Life Tree’s power. As the kingdom’s guardian, place unique fruit towers along winding garden paths, manage sunlight, upgrade your lineup, and survive tougher waves with every chapter.

Features

12 Fruit Towers — Apple, Strawberry, Watermelon, Pineapple, Blueberry, Lemon, and more, each with its own attack style, projectiles, and upgrade forms
12 Bug Enemies — Swarming ants, armored beetles, flying mosquitoes, burrowing worms, shield bugs, and epic bosses
120 Levels / 6 Chapters — From Apple Meadow to Dragon Fruit Castle, with rising difficulty and boss battles
Miniature Garden Battles — Isometric orchard battlefields with juice explosions, frost, lightning, and lively particle effects
Strategy That Matters — Choose tower placements, balance resources, upgrade or sell towers, and use battlefield skills
Collection & Rewards — Unlock towers, earn stars, and fill your Trophy Garden with achievements
Perfect for quick sessions or long strategy runs—fun, bright, and packed with fruit-powered defense.

name: Fry to Fish
description:
Fry to Fish helps small fish farm and pond owners replace notebooks and spreadsheets with one simple tool. Keep track of your ponds, tanks and cages, stock batches of carp, silver carp, grass carp, trout, sturgeon and catfish, and see headcount, average weight and biomass at a glance. Every morning, enter the water temperature and get a daily feed plan based on species, fish size, temperature and oxygen, split into feedings, with the right pellet size picked from your own feed stock.

Log water readings for temperature, oxygen, pH, clarity, ammonia and nitrite. Fry to Fish calculates toxic ammonia from pH and temperature and shows every value on a clear safety scale. When something goes wrong, you get a plain list of actions. Dawn and evening oxygen reminders become more frequent in hot weather and under ice. Track control catches against a growth plan, follow feed conversion and growth rate, record mortality, treatments and withdrawal periods that block sales, and attach photos of ponds, fish, catches and invoices.

Running a fishing pond or selling your harvest? Record sales, customers and fishing tickets with the catch, and see cost per kilogram, revenue and profit for every batch and season. Feed stock shows how many days are left and reminds you to reorder. All guidance values are editable defaults you can adjust to your farm. All data stored on your device.

name: Fuel: Calorie & Macro Tracker
description:
Fuel is a calorie and macro tracker that learns how your body actually works.

LOG FOOD FAST
• Scan a barcode and see calories and macros instantly
• Photograph a nutrition label and Fuel fills in the values for you
• All 2,600 foods from Livsmedelsverket built in and available offline, plus millions of products from Open Food Facts, with products sold in Sweden first
• Recipes, saved meals and quick add for the things you eat often

TARGETS THAT ADAPT
• Starting targets from your height, weight, age and activity
• A smoothed trend weight that filters out water and food swings
• Adaptive expenditure: Fuel compares what you eat with how your trend weight moves and adjusts your targets at a weekly check-in
• Choose a macro split, or set your own calories and macros

MORE THAN CALORIES
• 20 vitamins and minerals as a share of your daily reference intake
• Intermittent fasting from 13:11 to 23:1, with a live timer, fasting phases and a reminder when you reach your goal
• Water tracking, daily quests, a streak and a plant that grows as you stay consistent
• A weekly report on calories, macros, weight and habits

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
• Widgets for calories, macros, fasting, water, streak and trend weight
• Log water and start or end a fast right from a widget
• Your fast on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Controls for Control Center and the Action button, and Siri shortcuts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything you log stays on your iPhone. Apple Health is optional: Fuel can import weigh-ins and save your calories and macros.

Fuel gives general guidance, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before changing how you eat or fasting if you're pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, have diabetes or another medical condition, or have had an eating disorder.

name: FuName: Chinese Name & Meaning
description:
A Chinese name with meaning, made personal.

FuName helps people exploring Chinese language and culture choose a name for themselves. Discover qualities you would like to nurture, meet three meaningful names, and keep a name card that feels like you.

START WITH FIVE SIMPLE QUESTIONS
Choose a Chinese family name and a name style, then answer five short questions about qualities you would like to cultivate. Your optional nickname helps personalize your card. No birthday, birth time, or app account is needed.

EXPLORE YOUR FIVE-ELEMENT REFLECTION
Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water offer a playful way to think about growth, warmth, steadiness, clarity, and openness. See a symbolic balance illustration and an explanation of the qualities your answers highlight.

MEET THREE CHINESE NAMES
A one-time purchase unlocks one collection of three names matched to your answers and style. Each includes Chinese characters, complete pinyin with tone marks, English character meanings, and an explanation of the name as a whole. Learn which part is your family name and which part is your given name.

KEEP A NAME CARD
Switch between all three candidates and create a card for each. Save or share through the iOS share sheet. Revisit your purchased collection in My Names and export it again on the same installation without another purchase.

TRY THE EXPERIENCE FIRST
Explore a free sample collection and name card. Your questionnaire and five-element reflection are also free. Buying a new collection is a separate one-time purchase, with the price shown before you pay. There is no subscription.

SIMPLE AND LOCAL
Your nickname, answers, and name collections stay on your device. FuName has no app account or cloud sync. Collections may be lost if you delete the app or change devices, so export your cards to keep a separate copy.

CULTURAL INSPIRATION
The five-element illustration and name meanings are cultural interpretations for reflection and personal expression. They are not a birth-chart calculation, a scientific assessment, or a promise that a name will change your fortune.

Questions or feedback? Contact applesandbox@sailforai.com.

name: Further Maths Prep: Argandwick
description:
Further Maths Prep: Argandwick is an adaptive revision app for A Level Further Mathematics. It covers the whole of the compulsory Core Pure content and selected parts of Further Statistics, Further Mechanics and Decision Maths, written for the DfE subject content that AQA, Pearson Edexcel and OCR share.

What you get
- 65 topics: 40 Core Pure (proof, complex numbers, matrices, vectors, polar curves, hyperbolic functions, further calculus, differential equations, numerical methods, conics), 7 Further Statistics, 8 Further Mechanics and 10 Decision Maths.
- Clear lessons with typeset equations, worked examples and common slips.
- 910 original questions with instant feedback. Every numeric answer was checked by two independent computations before it was included.
- Quizzes that adapt: your results set the next question, bring missed topics back for review and point you to the lesson or prerequisite you need.
- Timed mock papers with marks by topic and a repair list.
- Interactive labs: Argand diagram with loci and roots, matrix transformations on a grid, polar plotter, slope fields with Euler's method, Maclaurin series convergence, hyperbolic functions, volumes of revolution and Poisson tests.
- Real-World builds: spin a logo with complex numbers, build a tiny graphics engine, model a car suspension and more. Switch between Syllabus order and Real-World at any time.
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is and is not included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level Maths, IB and AP topics.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, tablets with multi-pane layouts, works offline.

Free and Plus
About half of the topics, three labs, two mock papers and three builds are free. Argandwick Plus is a monthly subscription that unlocks the rest. You can cancel any time in your store account settings; access continues to the end of the month you have paid for.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR or the Department for Education. All content is original; check your own specification with your teacher.

Privacy: optional usage and diagnostic information is described in the first-run notice and in Settings, under Privacy and data.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-alevel-further-maths-argandwick.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-alevel-further-maths-argandwick.html

name: Galegrove Puzzle
description:
Tap a group, then watch the wind carry everything else.
In Galegrove the weathervane turns as you play. Pieces drift down, left, up or right, so each tap changes what you can reach next. Read the coming winds and plan ahead.
- 500 levels across 20 groves, each checked to be beatable within its moves
- Blow seed puffs to the meadow edge, lift moss, cut back brambles
- Make Gusts, Thistles and Blooms from bigger groups
- Use Calm to skip a wind at the right moment
- A new Daily breeze board every day
- Every piece has its own shape as well as colour
- Made for iPhone and iPad, in light and dark
No ads, no purchases, no lives or timers, no account, no tracking. Plays offline.

name: Gambites
description:
Gambites makes tracking what you eat feel less like a chore and more like a game.

LOG FOOD FAST
• Search millions of foods from the Open Food Facts database
• Scan barcodes with your camera to log packaged foods instantly
• See calories, protein, carbs and fat at a glance

HIT YOUR GOALS
• Personalized daily calorie and macro targets
• Water tracking to stay hydrated
• Clear daily progress so you always know where you stand

COOK AND PLAN
• Browse recipes with step-by-step details
• Plan your meals for the week
• Estimated nutrition for recipes

STAY MOTIVATED
• Build streaks by logging every day
• Earn playful rewards for staying consistent
• Friendly reminders, only when you want them

WIDGETS
• Home Screen widgets show your calories and water at a glance

APPLE HEALTH (OPTIONAL)
• Read weight and activity to personalize your plan
• Write meals and water to Apple Health when you enable sync

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your data stays on your device
• No third-party analytics, no ads
• No account required

Food data by Open Food Facts (ODbL). Recipes by TheMealDB.

Gambites is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional before changing your diet.

name: Gamecast: Discover Games
description:
Your next game starts here.

Gamecast brings game discovery, multiplatform browsing, and your personal game library into one experience built for people who love games.

DISCOVER GAMES FOR YOU

Explore personalized recommendations and find titles that match your taste.

EXPLORE ACROSS PLATFORMS

Browse games from different platforms. Dive into game details, screenshots, and available trailers.

SAVE WHAT CATCHES YOUR EYE

Keep your favorite titles together in your personal library and return to them anytime.

From new releases to timeless favorites, Gamecast helps you find what to play next.

name: Ganbaru: Learn Japanese
description:
Learn Japanese the way it is really used: short lessons, real speaking practice, JLPT courses, kanji and videos with tap-a-word subtitles. Start free and go as far as you want.

JLPT COURSES, N5 TO N1
• 6 step-by-step courses: Kana, JLPT N5, N4, N3, N2 and N1 (110 lessons)
• Each lesson teaches one idea, then tests it at once: grammar, reading, listening and voice questions
• Mock tests for every level with a score report that shows your weakest section

KANJI COURSES FOR EVERY LEVEL
• 1,448 kanji in 487 lessons, from JLPT N5 to N1
• Trace every stroke, learn on and kun readings, build the readings and read example sentences with furigana

LEARN WITH VIDEOS
• Watch Japanese videos with synced subtitles
• Tap any word for its reading, romaji, meaning and JLPT level, and save it
• Furigana, romaji and translation on or off, loop a line, pin it and see a short grammar note
• Practice with dictation and shadowing

SPEAK JAPANESE FROM DAY ONE
• 198 speaking lessons: basic and daily conversation, travel, and interviews for Japanese schools and jobs
• Hold the microphone, say the phrase and see at once if it matches
• Scripted chats for restaurants, hotels, taxis and shopping, plus career roles

LEARN STEP BY STEP
• 38 topics and 228 short lessons: greetings, numbers, food, shopping, transport, hotels, emergencies and more
• Every lesson mixes picture matching, sentence building, fill in the blank, speaking and kana tracing
• Romaji, meaning and Japanese audio for every phrase
• Stars, points, a daily streak, ranks and quests keep you going

MADE FOR YOU
• English and Bahasa Indonesia
• Optional daily reminder
• Optional Sign in with Apple to sync progress through your own iCloud

FREE AND PREMIUM
Start free with the first lessons of every course and one new topic each day. Go Premium to open every topic, course, kanji lesson, speaking lesson and video feature. Plans: yearly (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers), every 3 months, or monthly. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

name: GatherHostbr
description:
Make room for daylight.

GatherHostbr helps you explore when direct sunlight may reach your window, balcony or favorite outdoor spot. Save a place, describe its view, and find useful moments in your everyday light.

YOUR SPACES, YOUR VIEW
Choose a reference city, enter coordinates or use your current location. Confirm the local time zone, set your window’s direction, and add known obstructions such as buildings, trees or an overhang.

EXPLORE YOUR DAYLIGHT
View the sun’s path, sunrise and sunset, and estimated direct-sun periods for a selected date. Compare two dates to see how available sunlight changes throughout the year.

PLAN TIME IN THE LIGHT
Choose a continuous sunlight window for your own activity. Create a plan, add an optional local reminder, and keep track of completed or canceled plans.

KEEP AN OBSERVATION JOURNAL
Record when you actually noticed direct sunlight or its absence. Add notes and photos, then compare your observations with the estimate for that saved view.

KEEP YOUR LIBRARY
Organize and archive your spaces, export PDF summaries, and create backups of your spaces, observations, plans and photos.

No account is required. Sunlight calculations work offline, and your library is saved on your iPhone. 

Estimates assume clear skies and the view you enter. Clouds, glass, foliage, reflections and approximate inputs can affect actual sunlight. GatherHostbr is not a weather forecast or an indoor light meter.

name: Gauge Calculator for Knitting
description:
Turn your swatch into a stitch count. Enter the width and height of your measured swatch, the stitches and rows you counted, and the size you want. Knit Gauge Math shows the stitches and rows to work and the width and length they will actually make after rounding.

ROUND TO YOUR PATTERN REPEAT
Need a multiple of 6 plus 2 edge stitches? Switch on a stitch repeat and the count jumps to the nearest valid total, for example 68 instead of 70, with the predicted width shown right next to it. Choose Nearest, Up or Down yourself. Nearest rounds an exact tie up, and the rule is written on screen. Rows are rounded on their own unless you add a row repeat.

HOW IT WORKS
- Stitch gauge = stitches counted divided by swatch width; row gauge = rows counted divided by swatch height.
- Stitches needed = target width times stitch gauge; rows needed = target length times row gauge.
- Example: 20 stitches and 28 rows over a 10 x 10 cm swatch, target 35 x 25 cm, gives 70 stitches and 70 rows.
- Centimeters or inches (1 in = 2.54 cm). Switching units never changes a result through display rounding.
- Works the other way too: enter a stitch and row count to see the size it makes at your gauge.
- Clear prompts for empty fields and plain messages for impossible values such as a zero width.

SAVE, BACK UP, SHARE
- Save named calculation cards with their inputs, unit and rounding rules, then open, edit, rename or delete them.
- Export a readable PDF calculation card through Save to Files or the share sheet.
- Back up every card to a JSON file and import it again. Imports are checked first and never duplicate or overwrite cards.
- Clear All Saved Calculations, with confirmation, from the info screen.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
All math runs on your iPhone and works offline, with no account, ads, analytics or uploads. Saved cards stay on your device; files leave only when you save or share them.

PLANNING ARITHMETIC
Measure your swatch in the condition you will use the piece, for example after blocking. Results depend on your measurements and are not a promise of garment fit. The app does not recommend needles or yarn treatments and does not resize a whole pattern's shaping.

Knit Gauge Math is a one-time paid download with everything included: no subscription and no in-app purchases.

name: GCSE English Lit: Quillara
description:
Quillara is a revision companion for GCSE English Literature. Read concise lessons, test yourself with questions that explain every answer, and practise the skills examiners reward in interactive labs.

WHAT YOU GET
- 33 text lessons: seven Shakespeare plays, seven 19th-century novels, four modern texts and the fifteen poems of the AQA Power and Conflict cluster.
- 13 skills lessons on the assessment objectives, thesis and essay structure, extract questions, quotations, comparison, unseen poetry, verse and form, and exam craft.
- 537 original questions, each with a short explanation and a link back to the exact lesson part. Questions you miss return on a spaced schedule.
- Ten labs: Tension Arc, Character Web, Quote Lens, Essay Planner, Context Timeline, Terminology Trainer, Verse Meter, Paragraph Builder, Poem Compare Grid and an Unseen Poem Workbench.
- Two ways to learn: Syllabus order, or Real-World builds such as building a thesis or rescuing a weak paragraph.
- A curriculum map showing which board lists each text, and a Coverage screen that states exactly what is and is not included.
- Text size from 50 to 300 percent and layouts for phones and tablets.

FREE AND PLUS
Many texts, all skills lessons and four labs are free. Quillara Plus is one optional monthly subscription that opens the remaining texts, the other labs and timed mini mocks. Cancel any time: Plus then continues until the end of the month you have paid for and you are not charged again.

HONEST LIMITS
Quillara is an independent app, not connected with or approved by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, WJEC Eduqas or any other body. It does not cover every set text of every board. Poems are covered one by one for the AQA Power and Conflict cluster only. For works still in copyright it uses original summaries and never reproduces their text. It cannot mark your writing. Check your own board's current texts and papers.

PRIVACY
An optional setting shares anonymous usage and device information; you can turn it off and send diagnostics or feedback only when you choose.

name: GCSE French Prep: Marnelle
description:
GCSE French Prep: Marnelle is a revision companion for GCSE French in England. It is organised into 91 specification points that run from sounds and numbers through the three themes, core language, Foundation and Higher grammar, and the four skills, so you can see what you have covered and what is left.

LEARN YOUR WAY
- Syllabus order by default, or a Real-World route built around everyday missions in French
- Short lessons with worked examples, exam tips and common mistakes
- Original questions with an explanation for every answer; a wrong answer points to the lesson card to revise, and the app says why it chose each next step
- Foundation and Higher content is marked clearly

VOCABULARY, VERBS AND SOUNDS
- 1,915 vocabulary rows with example sentences, built around the word list in the AQA 8652 specification, with spaced-repetition flashcards and generated word quizzes
- Conjugation tables for 70 verbs, typed verb drills, a clock lab for telling the time in French and a sound lab for spelling, accents and liaison

SPEAKING, LISTENING, WRITING AND TRANSLATION
- Listening practice read aloud by voices on your device, with a transcript after each answer
- Speaking studio: role-plays, photo cards, read-aloud and conversation tasks. You record yourself, play it back and self-mark against a model answer and checklist. Your recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded
- Writing, translation and dictation tasks with model answers and marking units
- Sentence builder and agreement lab that make word order and agreement visible

MOCK PRACTICE
- Timed multiple-choice mock sections with the paper timings of AQA, Pearson Edexcel or WJEC Eduqas. Speaking and writing are practised and self-marked, so no automatic grade is given for them

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen that shows exactly what is in the app, and an Other boards map to A Level, IB and AP

FREE AND PLUS
A large part of the app is free: the first half of the course with lessons and quizzes, all vocabulary cards and word quizzes, every verb table and drill, the clock lab and the sound lab, and the translation tasks from French into English. Marnelle Plus is one optional monthly subscription that adds the speaking studio, dictation and writing tasks, the verb forge, agreement lab, tense timeline and sentence builder, paper-style mocks, and all remaining topics. It renews monthly until you cancel it in your store account settings.

WHAT IT COVERS, STATED PLAINLY
The 91 points are mapped to the Department for Education GCSE subject content for French, German and Spanish, and to AQA 8652, Pearson Edexcel 1FR1 and the WJEC Eduqas French specification (the Eduqas text used was its 2024 draft). Other boards are not mapped. Boards differ in vocabulary lists and assessment, so check your own board's current specification. This is practice, not a guarantee of a grade.

Marnelle is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, WJEC Eduqas, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Content is original and is not a past paper, recording or mark scheme. Speech comes from voices on your device and is not examination audio.
