name: GCSE Psychology: Psychlark
description:
GCSE Psychology: Psychlark is a complete study companion for GCSE Psychology. It covers the content areas of AQA 8182, Pearson Edexcel 1PS0 and OCR J203 in 12 units and 139 short topics, with 139 lessons, 43 key studies and 1286 original practice questions.

LEARN
Every topic is one short lesson: a big idea in plain words, what to know, key terms, the named studies, a weigh-it-up section, a worked scenario, common slips and an exam tip. Switch between Syllabus order and Real-World problems, where you start from an everyday question and build something as you learn.

PRACTISE
Quizzes choose questions from your weakest and newest topics, then send you straight to the part of the lesson that fixes a mistake. Multiple choice, short written answers that you mark against the mark points, and calculations for research methods. Spaced review brings questions back when they are due.

EXPERIMENT
Run the classic experiments yourself in ten interactive labs: a serial-position memory test, a Stroop test, a statistics bench, a tappable brain map, a multi-store memory simulator, a conformity task, conditioning, sampling, a study designer and a sleep-cycle explorer.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
A mastery map, streaks, unit progress rings and a study plan built around your exam month. A coverage screen shows exactly which board references every topic carries, and an optional Curriculum map shows where each unit sits in A Level, IB and AP.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
Text size from 50% to 300%, a light, easy-on-the-eyes design, and purpose-built layouts for phones and tablets.

Psychlark Plus is an optional monthly subscription that adds the remaining lessons and questions, six more labs, timed paper-style mocks, all Real-World builds and deeper analytics. Cancel any time: if you cancel, Plus stays until the end of the month you paid for and you are not charged again.

PRIVACY
Everything works offline. The app can optionally share anonymous usage information to improve learning features; you can change this at any time in Settings, Privacy and data, and you can send feedback and diagnostics when you choose.

INDEPENDENT STUDY AID
Psychlark is not produced by, affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, Ofqual or the Department for Education. It supports, and does not replace, your teacher and your own specification. Boards and papers differ, so check your own course documents; no grade is promised.

name: GCSE Relig Studies: Creedwren
description:
GCSE Relig Studies: Creedwren is an independent revision companion for students taking GCSE Religious Studies. It follows the AQA GCSE Religious Studies A (8062) specification: Component 1 beliefs and practices for Christianity, Catholic Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, Hinduism and Sikhism, and Component 2 thematic studies (Themes A to F) with the two St Mark's Gospel themes.

WHAT YOU GET
- Short lessons for every specification point, with key terms and the teachings and sources to know, written in our own words
- Beliefs and practices described fairly and attributed to the groups that hold them ("Many Christians believe...", "Sunni Muslims teach..."), with differences inside traditions shown where the course asks
- Quizzes, unit tests and mock quizzes mixing recall (AO1) and analysis (AO2) questions; a wrong answer links straight to the lesson that fixes it
- A study route that adapts to you: weak points come first, then spaced review, then new material
- Answer builders: choose the strongest sentence at each step to build a 12-mark answer (point, evidence, development, counter-view, judgement)
- Syllabus or Real-World order: study in specification order or start from everyday situations
- Coverage screen with exact counts and honest limits, plus an optional Other boards guide
- Text size from 50% to 300%, built for phones and tablets, works offline

FREE AND PLUS
Part of the course is free: five beliefs packs, four themes, a sample of every other pack, answer builders for the first topics, quizzes and unit tests. Creedwren Plus is one optional monthly subscription that unlocks every religion's practices, the remaining themes, all answer builders and mock quizzes. Cancel any time: you keep Plus until the end of the month you have paid for and are not charged again.

HONEST COVERAGE
This is AQA GCSE Religious Studies A (8062) content. name: GCSE Spanish Prep: Tildara
description:
GCSE Spanish Prep: Tildara is a revision companion for GCSE Spanish in England. It is organised into 87 specification points that run from sounds and numbers through the three themes, core language, Foundation and Higher grammar, and the four skills, so you can see what you have covered and what is left.

LEARN YOUR WAY
- Classical order by default, or a Real-World view with guided builds
- Short lessons with worked examples and common mistakes
- Original questions with feedback; a wrong answer links to the idea to revise, and the app tells you why each next step was chosen
- Foundation and Higher content is marked clearly

VOCABULARY AND VERBS
- A vocabulary trainer with spaced review, built around the word list in the AQA 8692 specification
- Verb drills with full conjugation tables, a tense timeline and a sound lab for spelling, accents and stress

SPEAKING, LISTENING, WRITING AND TRANSLATION
- Listening practice with slow and normal speech from voices on your device, so you can repeat and shadow
- Speaking studio: role-plays, photo cards and read-aloud tasks. You record yourself, play it back and self-mark against a model answer and checklist. Your recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded
- Writing and translation tasks with model answers for self-marking
- Sentence builder with grammar-aware tiles

MOCK PRACTICE
- Timed mock papers in listening and reading. The mocks are multiple choice questions; speaking and writing are practised and self-marked, so no automatic grade is given for them

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is in the app, and an Other boards map

FREE AND PLUS
Much of the app is free: every lesson, every quiz with fix-it links, the vocabulary trainer, verb drills, the tense timeline, the sound lab and two guided builds. Tildara Plus is one optional monthly subscription that adds the speaking studio, listening lab, writing and translation workshop, sentence builder, four more builds, and timed mock papers. Cancel any time in your store account settings.

WHAT IT COVERS, STATED PLAINLY
The 87 points are mapped to the Department for Education 2025 GCSE subject content for French, German and Spanish, and to AQA 8692, Pearson Edexcel 1SP1 and WJEC Eduqas C810. OCR J731 is not mapped: we could not verify its specification, so we do not claim it. Boards differ in vocabulary lists and assessment, so check your own board's current specification. This is practice, not a guarantee of a grade.

Tildara is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, WJEC Eduqas, OCR, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Content is original and is not a past paper, recording or mark scheme. Speech comes from voices on your device and is not examination audio.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-gcse-spanish-tildara.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-gcse-spanish-tildara.html

name: GCSE Statistics: Quartwren
description:
GCSE Statistics: Quartwren is a personalised, adaptive revision app for GCSE Statistics in England. It follows the Department for Education subject content and maps every point to the AQA 8382 and Pearson Edexcel 1ST0 specifications, with Higher-tier content marked.

LEARN
- 39 short lessons in syllabus order with worked examples, key terms and exam technique
- Switch to Real-World mode to learn by solving small fictional enquiries step by step
- Eight units: planning and collecting data, sampling, representing data, averages and spread, time series and index numbers, correlation and regression, probability, estimation and quality control

PRACTISE
- 856 original questions across 104 specification points, from recall to stretch
- Adaptive quizzes of any length pick your weakest and unseen points first
- Wrong answers link straight to the lesson that teaches the idea, then a short retry
- Unit tests and timed mock papers; calculation answers are checked by two independent routes

EXPLORE
- Hands-on labs: histograms and frequency density, box plots and outliers, probability simulator, sampling (free)
- Scatter and regression, the Normal curve, moving averages, capture-recapture (Plus)
- Guided builds: design a questionnaire, draw a fair sample, clean a messy data set, run a statistical enquiry (Plus)

CHECK
- A Coverage screen lists every specification point with its DfE, AQA and Edexcel reference and question count
- An Other boards map shows where each unit continues in A Level, IB and AP Statistics

QUARTWREN PLUS (optional)
One monthly subscription (US$2.99). Cancel at any time in your store account settings: cancelling takes effect from the next billing period, so you keep Plus until the end of the month you paid for. The free part stays free: units 1 to 3 with their lessons, quizzes, unit tests and four labs.

Text size from 50% to 300%, on phones and tablets. Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Original practice material; check your own board's specification.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-gcse-statistics-quartwren.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-gcse-statistics-quartwren.html

name: Gemduck Kartvessa: Kart Racing
description: Race along island roads, find a clean line through tight bends, and pick up items to challenge the pack. Quick Start puts you on the track immediately. Choose a course to practice offline, share the screen in local two-player mode, or join a friend in an online room. Adjust the touch controls, camera motion and audio in Settings.

name: Gemstone Canyon
description:
One hundred lost gems are scattered across Gemstone Canyon. Take jobs from the locals, outwit Buckbeard and help Lily-Rose return the canyon to its people.

Load a moving train at Canyon Junction, slide gems to clear rockfalls in the Collapsed Mine, and build both halves of Canyon Bridge against the clock. The Old Mines, Sorting House and Canyon Fine Gems each have their own puzzle to master. Play a destination on its own or take a job that sends you across the map.

Between jobs, cast a line, rummage for hidden Finds and decorate your Gem Garden with your discoveries. Your cat or dog can keep you company while you plan your next trip.

Keep exploring after the story ends with more jobs, free play and Finds to collect. Progress is saved on your device. Optional in-app purchases unlock and stock extra power-ups.

name: Genius Career
description:
Genius Career brings your college admission counselling into one app, from Genius Career Consultancy, Srinagar.

FIND COLLEGES
Search colleges across India by name, state, stream and course.

NEET AND JEE PREDICTORS
Enter your rank, category and quota to see which colleges you could get, based on past closing ranks.

APPLY WITH YOUR COUNSELLOR
Apply to colleges in a few taps. Your counsellor takes it from there, and you can follow every stage from submitted to enrolled.

DOCUMENTS IN ONE PLACE
Upload your marksheets, scorecards and ID once and share them securely with your counsellor.

LIVE CLASSES AND NOTICES
Join live counselling sessions and see important notices and exam updates.

Sign in with just your email. No password needed.

name: geoAMS
description:
geoAMS puts your organization's asset maps in your pocket: park benches, statues, signs, trees, playgrounds, buildings, utility lines, or anything else you need to map and manage.

Sign in with your geoAMS account and open the same maps your team uses on the geoAMS website: every asset drawn with its real symbols, layers you can turn on and off, and street, satellite and topographic backgrounds.

In the field you can:
- Find assets on the map and open their full details, every attribute shown, filled or not.
- Edit attribute values and save them straight to geoAMS.
- Take or pick photos of an asset (saved as JPG) and attach them.
- Add new points, lines and areas, placed by tapping the map or from your position.
- Move points and reshape lines and areas.
- See your tasks and work items and update their status.

Accurate positions:
- Use the iPhone's GPS, or a Trimble GNSS receiver through Trimble Mobile Manager (TMM) and Catalyst for survey-grade accuracy.
- The horizontal accuracy of every collected position is saved with the asset.

Built for teams:
- Accounts, maps, permissions and plans are managed by your organization on the geoAMS website.
- Optional email verification at sign-in when your organization requires it.

geoAMS accounts are created by your organization on geoams.com. A geoAMS account is required to use this app.

name: Geoatlasa
description: Geoatlasa turns the CountriesNow dataset into a browsable pocket atlas with population, capital, currency, coordinates and city lists for every country. Search the world, filter by continent, compare two countries side by side, and save the places worth a second look. Build a travel log from wishlist to visited, annotate each country, and export your shortlist or journey as CSV, with the full dataset cached for offline reading.

name: GeoControl Satelital
description:
GeoControl Satelital shows the position of your GPS vehicles and your own location on the map, so you can get to them. It calculates distances and sends you notifications from your account.

To use it you need an account with GPS devices linked to it. If you do not have an account yet, contact your service provider.

The app uses your location to show your position on the map and calculate distances.

name: georgette
description: 'georgette' is an app that lets you mix and match your wardrobe to create new outfits. Our name is inspired by the fabric — georgette — a lightweight crepe fabric popular in 20th-century France. We hope you’ll love it!

name: GestABLE
description:
GestABLE porta in tasca il telefono dell'ufficio e il gestionale Odoo della tua azienda.

TELEFONO AZIENDALE
• Chiama e ricevi con il numero dell'ufficio, anche ad app chiusa (schermata di chiamata di iPhone)
• Tastierino con suggerimenti dai contatti di Odoo
• Chiamate recenti, trasferimento a un collega, note sul contatto a fine chiamata

CONTATTI
• Cerca per nome, azienda, email o numero; filtri Aziende e Persone
• Scheda con chiama, messaggio, email e mappa
• Nuovi contatti salvati direttamente in Odoo

CALENDARIO
• I tuoi appuntamenti di Odoo giorno per giorno
• Luogo, videochiamata, partecipanti e risposta all'invito
• Nuovi appuntamenti in pochi tocchi

MESSAGGI E ATTIVITÀ
• Chat e canali di Odoo, notifiche
• Attività in ritardo, di oggi e prossime: un tocco per segnarle fatte
• Entrata e uscita delle presenze

ODOO SEMPRE A PORTATA
• Tutte le app del tuo Odoo in una vista ottimizzata per il telefono

REQUISITI
GestABLE funziona con i server Odoo (17, 19 e 20) abilitati da ticinoWEB. Le telefonate richiedono il modulo VOIP AI di ticinoWEB e un numero Twilio della tua azienda; senza, l'app offre contatti, calendario, messaggi, attività e Odoo. Calendario e Contatti si attivano se le relative app sono installate nel tuo Odoo.

Informazioni e attivazione: ticinoWEB, Locarno – info@ticinoweb.net

name: Get Up! Get Down!
description: Use time based estimates of your workload to track push ups, sit ups, and squats. Allow for recovery and optimal performance!

name: GhostAlign
description:
GhostAlign is the 100% offline Before & After camera and client PDF proof report builder engineered for auto detailers, landscapers, pressure washers, painters, and tradespeople.

NEVER EYE-BALL AN AFTER PHOTO AGAIN
Line up your "After" shot with millimeter precision using a live, semi-transparent Ghost Overlay of your original "Before" photo directly inside the camera viewfinder.

KEY FEATURES:
• Live Ghost Overlay Camera: Adjust ghost opacity (0–100%), alignment grid, and tilt leveling crosshairs to match exact camera angles and distances.
• Trade Job Vault: Organize jobs by client, trade category, and completion status with zero personal camera roll clutter.
• Client PDF Proof Reports: Generate print-ready Before & After inspection proof sheets with your company name, logo watermark, scope notes, and timestamps — save directly to local storage or email to your client in one tap.
• Collage & Export Studio: Export side-by-side, stacked, or diagonal transformation comparisons.
• 100% Offline & Private: All project data and high-resolution photos stay locally on your device. No cloud accounts, no tracking.

1-JOB TRIAL & FULL APP LIFETIME UNLOCK:
• Trial Mode: Explore the 2 pre-loaded trade samples and create 1 custom Job Folder with up to 2 photos (1 Before & 1 After) and full Client PDF Report generation (download & email included).
• Full App Unlock (One-Time Purchase — $29.99 Until New Year, $49.99 Thereafter): Pay once, own forever with no subscriptions. Unlocks unlimited job folders, unlimited photos per job, photo re-takes & deletion, and 4K exports.

name: Gif Export
description:
Turn a video from Photos or Files into an animated GIF. Trim your clip, preview the result, and save or share it. Everything happens on your device. Try the included example to get started.

TRIM AND PREVIEW
Choose the moment you want with visual trim handles or fine time adjustments. Switch between the source video and the first three seconds of the encoded GIF.

CONTROL THE RESULT
New clips start with a 2 MB target, 360 px and 10 FPS. Change file size, resolution and frame rate with a tap. Play forward, reverse or bounce, and adjust speed and color detail. Choose a 1, 2, 5, 10 or 20 MB target, or set your own quality. The app can reduce dimensions or frame rate to meet a size target.

SAVE AND SHARE
GIFs stay in your Library and automatically save to Photos after you grant add-only permission. Tap the Saved to Photos message to open Photos when supported. Use the system share sheet to send your GIF elsewhere.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your current video and editing settings are saved locally. To send a clip from another app, share it to Gif Export, then open Gif Export to confirm the import.

name: GlamLife Admin
seller_name: Candas Yatirim Medikal Gida Insaat Ticaret  Limited Sirketi
description:
GlamLife Admin, Glam Life Epilasyon & Cilt Bakım şube yöneticileri ve merkez ekibi için geliştirilmiş yönetim uygulamasıdır. Hesaplar GlamLife merkezi tarafından oluşturulur; uygulama içinden kayıt yapılmaz.

• Sipariş ve ödeme takibi
• Müşteri listesi
• Hizmet, kategori ve kampanya yönetimi
• İndirim kodları ve toplu mesaj gönderimi
• Anlık bildirimler — yeni randevu talepleri ve siparişler

Giriş için GlamLife tarafından tanımlanmış bir yönetici hesabı gereklidir.

name: Gleamly: Storage Cleaner
description:
Running out of iPhone storage? Gleamly helps you find unnecessary photos, videos and duplicate contacts, so you can reclaim valuable space without losing the memories that matter.

**SMART PHOTO CLEANUP**

Find and review:
- Duplicate photos and identical copies
- Similar photos and burst sequences
- Blurry and out-of-focus shots
- Forgotten screenshots
- Large photos and ProRAW images

Gleamly automatically identifies the Best Shot in each group, helping you keep the sharpest, highest-resolution photo while reviewing unnecessary copies.

**VIDEO STORAGE CLEANUP**

Take control of large videos:
- Find your largest videos
- Identify screen recordings
- Sort by file size, duration or date
- Find videos longer than two minutes
- Compress compatible videos with the HEVC optimizer (Pro)

**SMART CLEANUP**

Spend less time organizing your library with curated cleanup suggestions:
- High-impact screen recording cleanup
- Duplicate photo detection
- Similar burst sequence review
- Blurry photo detection
- Old screenshot review

See your estimated storage savings before confirming a cleanup.

**CONTACT ORGANIZER**

Keep your address book organized:
- Find duplicate contacts
- Identify contacts without phone numbers or email addresses
- Preview merged contact information
- Review changes before merging or deleting

**STORAGE INSIGHTS**

Understand how your media library grows:
- View storage usage by category
- Track photo and video library growth over eight weeks
- See an estimated four-week storage growth forecast
- Monitor your Storage Health Score
- Track your weekly cleanup streak

**100% ON-DEVICE PRIVACY**

Your privacy matters.

- Photo and video analysis happens locally on your iPhone.
- Contact scanning happens locally on your device.
- No cloud uploads.
- No account registration.
- No advertisements or tracking.
- Your personal library stays on your device.

Powered by Apple's PhotoKit, Vision, Contacts and AVFoundation frameworks.

**SAFE CLEANUP, ALWAYS IN YOUR CONTROL**

Gleamly never deletes your photos or videos automatically.

You review every selection and confirm deletion through Apple's native iOS confirmation dialog. Deleted photos and videos are moved to Recently Deleted, where they can be recovered for up to 30 days.

**GLEAMLY FREE**

Get started with:
- On-device photo analysis
- Unlimited manual review and deletion
- One one-tap Smart Cleanup per day

**UNLOCK GLEAMLY PRO**

Get more control over your storage with:
- Unlimited one-tap Smart Cleanup
- HEVC video optimization
- A 7-day free trial on the eligible annual plan

**SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION**

Gleamly Pro offers the following subscription options:

• Annual: $29.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers.
• Monthly: $6.99 per month, with no free trial.

Prices may vary by country or region and are displayed in the App Store before purchase.

Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. The annual subscription automatically renews after the 7-day free trial unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Paid subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current billing period ends.

You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
