Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Support:
https://pvhung1403.github.io/gleamly/support.html

Gleamly. A cleaner library, more room for memories.

name: Glucosaur
description:
Glucosaur puts your glucose on your Apple Watch, the moment you raise your wrist.

Set Glucosaur as the app your watch returns to, and it works like a watch face: the time, the date, your battery and your current glucose from LibreLinkUp, fresh every minute while it's on screen. Or add it as a complication to any watch face you love.

Meet Glucosaur
A small, friendly dinosaur who reacts to your numbers. Happy when you're in range, worried when you're high, sipping apple juice when you're low, sleepy at night, and celebrating when you're back in range.

Earn hats
Every day with 70% or more in range is a dino day. Dino days earn Glucosaur hats: a sprout, a flower, a crown, a wizard hat and more, all the way to a golden halo after a year. Hats show on the watch and widgets too.

Everything at a glance
• Big, clear number with a trend arrow and the age of the reading
• A short line about the moment: "Steady", "Rising fast", "In range 3h"
• A dot that shows the connection is alive, and a clear note when it isn't
• Chart for 3, 6 or 12 hours, time in range and average
• Complications for any watch face, including the corners
• Lock Screen, Dynamic Island and Smart Stack with Live Activity
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, StandBy at night
• Tap Glucosaur, or Double Tap, for a fresh value
• mg/dL or mmol/L and your own target range
• Follow more than one person and pick who to show (great for parents)
• English and Hebrew

Private by design
No server, no account, no analytics, no ads. Your sign-in stays in your iPhone's Keychain and goes only to LibreLinkUp.

Free, forever
Glucosaur is made by a person with type 1 diabetes. Living with diabetes shouldn't come with a monthly bill. If it helps you, you can leave a tip; tips unlock nothing, and everything stays free for everyone.

Important: Glucosaur is a companion display, not a medical device. It does not alert you to low or high glucose, and values can be delayed. Do not make treatment decisions based on it. Requires a LibreLinkUp follower account. Not affiliated with Abbott.

name: Glyph Tide
description:
Turn the carved stone rings. Lead the sea to the pearl. Beat the tide.

Glyph Barnacle Tide is a calm, clever puzzle game set in round tide pools seen from above. Each pool holds three to five concentric stone rings carved with channel glyphs: straight runs, bends, forks and sealed stone. Drag around a ring to turn it, line up the channels, and watch sea water pour in from the rim and flow ring by ring until it reaches the glowing pearl at the centre.

A TIDE THAT KEEPS YOU MOVING
The tide meter rises while you think. Reach the pearl before the tide turns. Every solve feels like a little splash of relief.

CREATURES OF THE POOL
New mechanics arrive gently as you progress:
- Barnacles clamp a ring in place. Tap them three times to pry them loose.
- Starfish turn their ring on their own every few seconds.
- Crabs sit on a channel and block the water until they scuttle off, or until you shoo them away.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Tide Rush: endless pools that grow harder. Each solve adds time to the clock and fast solves earn bonus points.
- Lagoons: 36 handcrafted pools on a winding map, each with three stars to earn for turns and speed.
- Daily Challenge: five pools, the same for every player today, with its own leaderboard. Resets at 00:00 UTC.

COLLECT AND CUSTOMISE
Unlock pool themes such as Coral Reef, Moon Lagoon, Kelp Forest, Sunset Shoal, Abyss Trench and Sea Glass Cove, and pearl styles from Rose Pearl to Ember Conch. Preview and equip them in the Locker.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
- 18 missions with coin rewards
- A 7-day daily reward calendar
- Leaderboards for Tide Rush, Daily and Lagoon stars, all-time and today
- A stats page that tracks every pool, turn and barnacle
- A hands-on tutorial and an illustrated How to Play guide

HELPFUL BOOSTS
Glyph Glow lights up the ring to turn next. Tide Freeze holds the tide still for 10 seconds. A continue buys 20 more seconds when the tide turns.

MAKE IT YOURS
Take or choose an avatar photo, record a short victory cheer that plays when you win, and save a score card of your best runs to Photos.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play as a guest with no sign-up, or create an optional email account to keep your progress, coins and stars safe on any device. You can delete your data or account at any time from Settings.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
No ads. Coins are earned by playing, and optional coin packs are available for players who want to unlock items faster. Everything in the game can be earned without paying.

Soothing water sounds, droplet plips, shell chimes and a gentle surf ambience make every pool a small moment of calm.

name: Go-Taller:Predict your height
description:
GoTaller helps parents and teens see where growth is heading and build the daily habits that support it.

FORECAST ADULT HEIGHT
• Uses the growth chart for your country: CDC (US), WHO, China, UK, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, Mexico or Türkiye.
• Finds your child's height percentile for their age and reads the same percentile at adult age.
• Shows the likely range and the genetic target from both parents' heights.
• See how much growth window is left and how far there is to go.

FULL GROWTH CHART
• Every measurement on the complete height-for-age chart, blue for boys and red for girls.
• Percentile curves from the 3rd to the 97th, your current percentile and the projected path to the adult target.
• Height, weight and BMI-for-age with year-on-year change.

DAILY GROWTH HABITS
• Sleep 9+ hours, protein at every meal, calcium + vitamin D, sports and posture + stretch.
• Check off each day, keep streaks going and see months of history at a glance.

JUMP TRAINING
• 21 follow-along jump training videos, about two minutes each, in English or Chinese.
• Finish a video and it is logged automatically, with streaks and weekly totals.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Several profiles on one phone: a teen tracking themselves, or a parent tracking several kids.
• Metric or imperial units.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device and syncs through your own private iCloud.

GOTALLER PRO
Free: the forecast, habits, the first 3 workout videos and 1 growth record per profile. GoTaller Pro unlocks all 21 workout videos and unlimited growth records.
• Pro Monthly: $4.99 per month
• Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year
Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://taller.dajax.com/privacy

GoTaller gives estimates from published growth charts. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. Talk to your doctor about growth concerns.

name: Gobonuki Ekiden: Relay Run
description:
You run just one leg of a ten-leg Japanese relay race.
Take the tasuki sash, run for about a minute, and hand it to the next runner.

- One-finger control: hold to speed up, release to recover stamina. Push too hard and you fade.
- "Gobo-nuki": sweep past runner after runner while the commentator and the roadside crowd roar.
- Every leg runs differently: sea headwinds, a mountain climb, a fast descent, the city finish. Use water stations, drafting, cheer zones and the last spurt.
- Tap at the right moment to hand over the tasuki, then watch the rest of the relay and your team's final rank.
- Walk more, start stronger: today's step count boosts your starting stamina (if you allow motion access).
- Collect shoe, headband and tasuki colors.

Free to play with ads. The No-Ads Pass (in-app purchase) removes the ads between runs.

The races and teams in this game are fictional and not related to any real event or organization.

name: God Morning
description:
At your wake-up time, an angel calls.

Answer, and your angel opens the day in prayer, reads a passage of God's word, and lifts up your own dream, goal and wish. Say "Amen" and the morning begins.

THREE ANGELS, IN ORDER
- Drill Angel calls on time. Brisk and bright, and keen to get your feet on the floor.
- Standard Angel calls 5 minutes later if you decline or sleep through. Soft and patient.
- Archangel calls last. Inside the app there is no decline button, only Amen.

YOUR PRAYER, NOT A GENERIC ONE
Write a dream, today's goal, and a wish or prayer request. Your angel prays for them just before Amen.

SAY AMEN
Your iPhone listens for one word. Can't speak? Press and hold instead.

RINGS WHEN IT MATTERS
On iOS 26 and later, morning calls use Apple's alarm system, which rings through Silent mode and Focus. On iOS 18 to 25 they arrive as ringing notifications, so leave your ringer on and allow God Morning in your Sleep Focus.

KEEP THE DAY
- 21 passages to read or hear in any angel's voice
- A verse to carry all day
- Evening reflection and tomorrow's goal
- A calendar of every morning, your streak, and how often the Archangel had to come

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no server. Your prayers, reflections and voice stay on your iPhone, and it works with no connection.

SUBSCRIPTION
Calls need God Morning Monthly or Yearly. New subscribers get 7 days free, then $2.99 per month or $12.00 per year in the US (prices vary by country). It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Reading, reflections and your calendar stay free.

Scripture is from the World English Bible, British Edition, in the public domain.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: GoGo AI Labs
description:
Need an app? GoGo AI Labs turns ideas into real apps.

Describe your idea in one page: name it, say what it should do, list a few features, or attach a full spec as a markdown (.md) file. Pick where it should run: iPhone, the web, or more than one.

AI DECIDES
Every request gets an AI viability score out of 100, looking at demand, how it can make money, early traction, scope and clarity. You see your score and what would make it stronger.

AI BUILDS. FOR FREE.
Ideas that score 80 or more join the daily build contest. Each day at 8 PM Nepal time the best idea wins and gets built for free. Below 80, you can still ask us to build it as a paid project.

BROWSE THE MARKET
See every app in the pipeline: requested, building, published and claimed. Open any app for its links, demo, features and details.

CLAIM OWNERSHIP
Like an app in the market? Claim it. We'll talk with you in the app about handing over ownership.

TALK TO THE TEAM
Every request and claim has its own chat, so you can follow progress and answer questions.

No sign-up needed. Your name and contact details are never shown publicly.

name: Goldfish Scoop
description:
Try the classic Japanese summer-festival game of scooping goldfish with a paper scoop.

Goldfish Scoop is a 3D festival arcade game. Move the paper scoop through the water, catch goldfish of different weights, and keep the paper from tearing. A light touch lands the small fish; the big ones need patience.

• Traditional poi paper-scoop play
• Several goldfish varieties with different weights
• Paper durability and score tracking
• 3D water, bowl, and festival stall
• Chinese and English UI

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Golf Side Games: Skins, Nassau
description:
Score Nassau, Skins, Wolf, and Dots simultaneously on one sunlight-readable golf scorecard—with automatic handicap pops, 9- or 18-hole rounds, and an instant 19th Hole summary. 100% offline, zero sign-up, and built for weekend foursomes.

Enter gross scores once per hole with oversized one-handed buttons and let Golf Side Games calculate every active match automatically—no scribbled napkins or 20-minute clubhouse math.

FOUR CLASSIC SIDE GAMES—RUN ONE OR ALL AT ONCE
• Nassau: Front 9, Back 9, and Overall (or a single 9-hole match) for 1v1, 2v2 Best Ball, or 3-player groups, with Shuffle Teams, Manual Presses, and Auto-Press at 2 down.
• Skins: Net or Gross Skins with an optional Carryover toggle so tied holes roll forward.
• Wolf (4-Player): Automatic tee-box rotation with Partner, Lone Wolf (2x), and Blind Wolf (3x).
• Dots / Junk: One-tap Birdie, Greenie, Sandie, and Barkie points alongside your main games.
• Built-in Rules: Tap "?" beside any game to confirm exact rules right on the first tee.

AUTOMATIC HANDICAP POPS, 9-HOLE ROUNDS & COURSES
• Convert Handicap Index to Course Handicap automatically using Slope & Course Rating—or enter Course Handicap directly.
• Play Off the Low Man with 80% or 100% allowance; pop dots appear beside each player's name on every stroke hole.
• Play 18 Holes, Front 9, or Back 9 with Standard Par 72 & Executive Par 60 templates, or save custom courses (Par, Stroke Index 1–18, Slope, Rating).
• Pick your preferred point unit: Points, $ USD, C$ CAD, £ GBP, or € EUR.

BUILT FOR BRIGHT SUNLIGHT & CART-PATH SPEED
• Clubhouse ivory-and-green contrast stays crisp in direct midday sun.
• Extra-large "-" and "+" buttons pre-filled to Par—plus one-tap Pick Up (net double bogey)—score a foursome in seconds.
• Live Standings update after every hole, 100% offline with instant on-device saves and zero account required.

19TH HOLE SUMMARY, REMATCH & SEASON LEADERBOARD
• Combines every active game into a single verified zero-sum settlement tally.
• Debt simplification reduces 4-player cross-totals into the fewest possible transfers (typically 2–3 lines).
• Share a crisp 19th Hole summary card or tap Copy as Text for iMessage or WhatsApp.
• Tap Rematch to replay with the same players, handicaps, games, and course in seconds, and track cumulative totals on the Season Leaderboard.

FRIENDLY POINTS CALCULATOR ONLY
Golf Side Games is strictly an offline scoring and friendly points-tally calculator. The app does not accept, hold, process, or move money and contains no payment or transfer functionality of any kind.

TRY IT ON THE COURSE & PRO ACCESS
Play your first 2 full rounds at no cost with all 4 side games and a shareable 19th Hole summary card (test rounds deleted before 3 holes automatically refund your free credit; completed rounds always remain viewable). Upgrade to Golf Side Games Pro for unlimited rounds, multi-game stacking, custom course templates, Season Leaderboard history, and watermark-free share cards:
• Pro Annual: $24.99/year (includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers)
• Pro Lifetime: $39.99 one-time purchase

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the 7-day free trial if you do not cancel beforehand. Your Pro Annual subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged $24.99 for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://tzuwentsou-hash.github.io/golf-side-games-legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tzuwentsou-hash.github.io/golf-side-games-legal/privacy.html

name: Gom: Save Links, Photos, Ideas
description:
See it. Save it. Find it again in seconds.

Gom is one home for everything you want to keep: articles, videos, products, screenshots, photos, documents, voice notes and ideas. Save in 2 taps, and Gom sorts it for you.

SAVE EVERYTHING
• Links from Safari, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube or any shop, straight from the Share menu. Gom grabs the title, image and article text.
• Just copied a link? A "Just copied" box is waiting when you open Gom.
• Screenshots, camera photos, and videos from your photo library.
• Speak to save: hold the + button and talk, Gom turns it into text.
• Rich notes with bold, italics, checklists and images.
• Scan multi-page documents with the camera.

LINK GONE? GOM STILL HAS IT
Gom keeps the article text and cover image on your device. If the post is deleted or the link dies, your card is still there.

SORTED FOR YOU
• One category per item, as many hashtags as you like, keywords extracted automatically.
• Category and hashtag suggestions as you save.
• Reads text in images on your device: a screenshot of a post gets its title, author and link.
• Reads QR codes in images and warns you about suspicious links.

FOUND IN A BLINK
• Search ignores accents and finds text inside images, notes and articles.
• Filter by type, source, category or hashtag.
• Smart collections: save a search and it keeps itself up to date.
• A Photos-style grid — pinch to change the number of columns.

SAVED, NOT FORGOTTEN
• The "Unseen" card stack: swipe right for seen, left for later.
• Review: things you haven't opened in a while come back, to revisit or archive.
• Set a reminder on any card.
• Track product prices and get told when they drop, with a 30-day chart.

MARK UP IMAGES
Pen, highlighter, shapes, arrows, text, and blur for private info. The original image is always kept.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account needed: everything stays on your device.
• No ads, no tracking, no selling data.
• Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or a PIN.

ON EVERY DEVICE
Built for iPhone and iPad. Get Gom for Mac and Windows at gom.life: quick save with a keyboard shortcut, and drag links, images and text into the window.

PRO AND PREMIUM
Gom is free with every saving, searching and review feature. Upgrade when you need more:
• Pro: sync up to 300 cards across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Windows; price tracking; Postage stamp, Notebook and Autumn themes.
• Premium: unlimited sync and every theme.
Plans are monthly or yearly, renew automatically and are charged to your Apple ID unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gom.life/privacy.html
Support: https://gom.life/support.html

name: Gonfetti
description:
Gonfetti is a set of quick party games for up to 8 people.

Play the way that suits the evening:
• Everyone on their own phone, side by side or from different homes.
• All together on one screen (a TV, tablet or laptop), with phones, gamepads or keyboards as controllers. Friends' phones join by scanning a QR code: they need no app.
• Alone: bots fill the empty seats.

17 games, each a few minutes: shove the other shapes off a crumbling floor, close a loop to claim the floor, dodge, aim and outsmart. Play them one at a time, or as a tournament that plays them back to back. 30 challenges to earn stars.

The games: Polygone, Tessellate, Outlier, Frictionless, Radian Sweep, Siegeometry, Fuse Box, Infectagon, Dodecaball, Golden Ratio, Shadow Drop, Tipping Point, Dodgecahedron, Blast Radius, Perimeter, Collinear and Ray Tracer.

• No account, no ads, no purchases.
• Plays offline with bots: the games are inside the app.
• English and Arabic.

Game night in one link.

name: GradeLens: Card Centering Tool
description:
Measure true border ratios and grading profit before paying submission fees. GradeLens is an offline card centering tool and trading card grading calculator built for sports card and TCG collectors, trade-night buyers, and bulk submitters on iPhone and iPad.

Flat rectangle guides misread centering whenever a card photo is tilted by even a few degrees. GradeLens uses a 4-corner planar perspective homography solver to correct camera angle across exact physical card dimensions, paired with an 8.0x optical corner loupe and a net Expected-Value (EV) calculator.

4-CORNER PERSPECTIVE CENTERING & 8X LOUPE
• Align all four outer card corners and inner frame lines on tilted photos from your camera, photo library, or built-in calibration cards.
• Docked 8.0x optical corner loupe automatically shifts to the opposite side so your thumb never blocks the crosshair.
• Accessible +/-0.5% fine-nudge steppers let you dial in sub-millimeter border positions with precision.
• Supports Standard (63.5x88.9mm), Japanese (59.0x86.0mm), and Vintage (66.7x95.3mm) card proportions.

55/45 GEM MINT & DUAL-SIDE BORDER STANDARDS
• Inspect both Front and Back Left/Right (L/R) and Top/Bottom (T/B) centering in exact percentages and millimeters.
• Compare borders against Pristine 50/50, Gem Mint 55/45 centering (75/25 back), Mint 60/40, and NM-MT 65/35 grading profiles.
• Log 4-corner whitening, edge chipping, and surface print-line notes on the darkroom checklist for an honest pre-grade ceiling.

SUBMISSION ROI & NET EV CALCULATOR
• Decide whether to submit or sell raw using transparent math instead of guesswork.
• Enter raw card value, grading plus shipping cost ($19 bulk, $25 standard, $40 express presets), expected Gem 10, Mint 9, and NM-MT 8 values, and estimated Gem 10 odds.
• Instantly read Net EV (+$/-$), Expected ROI %, expected payout, and exact break-even Gem rate %.

BATCH VAULT, SPEC STAMP PNG & PDF MANIFEST
• Save evaluated cards into a local Submission Batch Vault showing aggregate batch Net EV and Gem-ready count.
• Share a ticket-notched PNG Spec Stamp card with Front L/R, Front T/B, Back max, and EV metrics for trade listings.
• Share a clean printable PDF batch packing sheet before shipping your order.
• Evaluate up to 5 new cards per day free (with unlimited edits on saved cards), or unlock GradeLens Pro once with 100% local on-device storage.

INDEPENDENT ESTIMATE DISCLAIMER
GradeLens provides independent geometric centering measurements and Expected-Value math for collectors. GradeLens is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any third-party card grading company or trading card publisher.

name: Graha Mitra
description:
Graha Mitra (గ్రహ మిత్ర) is your personal astrology companion. Enter your date, time and place of birth once, and Graha Mitra casts your horoscope and gives you predictions made for your chart — not generic sun-sign readings.

PREDICTIONS FOR EVERY PERIOD
• Today — your outlook for the day, with ratings for career, money, love and marriage, health, home and travel
• This week — the best days and the days to go carefully
• This month — favourable dates at a glance
• This year — a month-by-month view of the year ahead

COLOUR TO WEAR
• A personal colour for each day, based on the planets supporting you
• A colour of the week for important meetings and new beginnings

YOUR BIRTH CHART
• Lagna, Moon nakshatra and pada
• House cusps and planet positions with their star and sub lords
• House significators
• Your Vimshottari dasha and bhukti periods with dates

DAILY NOTIFICATION
• Optional morning notification with your day's outlook and colour

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up
• Your birth details stay on your iPhone

Graha Mitra is free with a small banner ad. A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes ads forever.

Predictions are based on traditional Vedic astrology and are for guidance and entertainment.

name: Gravity Rift – 3D Puzzle
description:
Two portals, one way out: In Gravity Rift you shoot portals onto bright walls, step through and come out on the other side of the room. Reach every checkpoint to complete the level.

THE YELLOW PORTAL TURNS THE WORLD
Next to the blue portal there is the yellow gravity portal. Step out of it and the wall becomes the floor – you walk along walls and ceilings and see every room from a new angle.

60 LEVELS IN SIX CHAPTERS
• Basic Training: learn step by step in 10 levels how portals and gravity work.
• Journeyman's Test: towers, mazes and open halls with everything you have learned.
• Unknown Checkpoints: you have to find out yourself where the goals are.
• Energy Walls: you walk through them, your portals don't.
• Trapdoors: some holes lead into hidden rooms below.
• Moving Surfaces: panels and platforms move back and forth – and your portals move with them.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
One joystick to walk, one for the camera, two buttons for the portals. The joysticks appear wherever your thumb touches the screen. In the settings you can swap sides if you prefer to look on the left and walk on the right.

FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
Gravity Rift plays in landscape on iPhone and iPad, and on iPhone Duo both folded and unfolded. The controls adapt to the screen.

FULL VERSION
The first 10 levels are the Basic Training. The full version unlocks all levels – including every level added in future updates. A one-time purchase, no subscription, shared with your family.

Original music, no ads, no tracking.

name: Greenfield Analysis
description:
Where should your distribution centers go? Greenfield Analysis answers from where people live: every US county, weighted by its population. No customer data needed.

Pick an area: the lower 48 states, the Northeast, Midwest, South or West, or one state, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico. Greenfield places your DCs and shows which counties each one serves, how many people that is, and the demand-miles: people times miles to their nearest DC.

Then try your own ideas:
- Drag a DC to move it. It becomes a pin, and Greenfield places the rest around it.
- Tap a DC to pin or unpin it.
- Tap a row in DC scenarios to change how many DCs there are, from 1 to 10. Each row shows its demand-miles, so you can see how much each extra DC saves.

Every placement and every number comes from the Greenfield Analysis engine, the same one that runs greenfieldanalysis.com. The app computes nothing on its own, so it needs an internet connection.

Population is a stand-in for demand. Your own customer volumes give a different answer: upload them at greenfieldanalysis.com to run the same analysis on your real customers.

Free, with no account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. County data: US Census Bureau.

Greenfield Analysis is a ChiAha product.

name: Greetiz: AI Receptionist
description:
Greetiz is the AI front desk for small businesses. It answers your phone, replies to your customers on every channel and helps you win more reviews, so you never miss a customer again. This app is your Greetiz account in your pocket.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP
• Today: see at a glance what your AI handled: calls, new leads, bookings and messages.
• Calls: listen to calls your AI receptionist answered, read the transcript and the summary, and call back with one tap.
• Inbox: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, website chat and more in one inbox. Read what the AI replied and jump in whenever you like.
• Reviews: read new reviews, approve the AI's reply in one tap, and see which reviews still need you.
• Alerts: get a phone notification for missed calls, new messages, bookings and low-star reviews, and open the right page straight from the alert.
• Face ID: keep your calls and customer messages private with Face ID.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create your Greetiz account at greetiz.com and tell the AI about your business (or paste your website).
2. Connect your phone number and channels.
3. Your AI receptionist starts answering. You follow along and take over from this app whenever you want.

Greetiz speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and more, and works for plumbers, salons, clinics, restaurants, shops and other local businesses.

You need a Greetiz account to use the app. Plans and prices: greetiz.com/pricing.

Questions? hello@greetiz.com · greetiz.com/help

name: Grid Console: Watch Sync
description:
Grid Console is a fast, no-nonsense Bluetooth companion for the GBD-200 series (module 3506). Connect once and control the settings the watch buries behind button combos - straight from a clean, tactile iPhone interface.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Set the time and sync it to the second
- Create and toggle alarms
- Configure the countdown / interval timers, with names
- Pick World Time cities from 300+ options
- Flip watch settings: 24-hour time, button tone, Auto Light, key vibration
- Read status, firmware, and today's step / calorie totals

KEEP AUTO LIGHT ON
The GBD-200 firmware turns Auto Light (tilt-to-illuminate) off by itself after about six hours, and there is no watch setting to stop it. Grid Console quietly turns it back on whenever it lapses. A built-in Sleep Schedule releases the Bluetooth link during the hours you choose, so the watch is not kept awake overnight.

BUILT TO BE EFFORTLESS
- Pairs with the watch itself - the official Casio app is not required
- Remembers your watch and reconnects on its own
- One screen per feature, big controls, instant feedback

COMPATIBLE WATCHES (module 3506 - the GBD-200 series)
GBD-200-1, -2, -9, -7, -1A1, RD-4, LM-1, UU-1 and UU-9 (Urban Utility), SM-1A5 and SM-1A6 (Street Spirit), plus regional and special editions. If the caseback or manual says module 3506, it works.

Grid Console is an independent companion app and is not made by, affiliated with, or endorsed by Casio. Casio, G-SHOCK and the watch model names are trademarks of their respective owners, used only to describe compatibility.

name: Grid Royale: Race Predictor
description:
Grid Royale is a private prediction league for motorsport fans. Before every Grand Prix, put the drivers in the order you think they'll finish, lock in your call, and compete with your friends across the whole season.

PREDICT
• Once the provisional starting grid is out, rank the drivers for the positions your group plays (top 10 by default).
• Change your picks until your group's lock time, and copy a prediction to your other groups in one tap.

PRIVATE GROUPS
• Groups are invite-only: share a link or QR code and approve who joins.
• Admins set the rules: how many positions count, points per position, bonuses and the lock time.

SCORE AND COMPARE
• Points come from exact positions in the official classification, and update automatically if results are corrected.
• Follow the season leaderboard, open any race to see everyone's picks after the lock, and go head-to-head with any member.

NEVER MISS A RACE
• Race-day and missing-prediction reminders, a heads-up when the official grid moves one of your picks, and a ping when results are in.

EXPLORE THE SEASON
• Browse the calendar, every team's line-up and each driver's career.

Available in English and Spanish. Grid Royale is free, with no ads and no real money involved: points are for bragging rights only.

Grid Royale is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Formula 1, the FIA, or any team or driver.

name: Grid to Picture
description:
Turn number clues into pixel art in Grid to Picture, a single-player nonogram puzzle game for iPhone.

The numbers beside each row and above each column tell you how many squares to fill in each group. Leave at least one empty square between groups, and use an X to mark squares you know are empty. Check where row and column clues intersect to figure out your next move.

Get started with four interactive clue exercises. Practice reading clues across rows and down columns, and see how the spaces between filled groups can vary. Then put what you learned into practice in a guided first puzzle that takes you all the way to your first picture reveal.

name: Grip Span
description:
Dear friend,

I got tired of guessing which racket or club still had a sticky wrap and which one was overdue for a new overgrip, so I made Grip Span. It is a small on-device notebook for gear and grip wraps: what is on each piece, when it was last regripped, and when it should come up again. Here is what's inside.

1. Gear library
Register each racket, club, or handle you care about. Give it a name, an optional note, and a simple use count so the board can track wear by use as well as by calendar.

2. Grip wraps with intervals
Add a grip to a piece of gear. Record the spec note, an optional position or layer note, and a replace interval in months and/or uses. You can also set the last regrip date and the use count at that time.

3. Due board
Open Due to see grips sorted into Overdue, Soon, and Later. Each row shows the gear name, spec, remaining uses or days when that track is active, and a one-tap Mark regripped control. Marking writes a regrip log and refreshes the schedule.

4. Search and review
On Gear, search by name or note. On Grips, specs are grouped so you can see which wraps appear on more than one piece. Open a gear detail to edit, add another grip, read the regrip history, or delete the piece when you are done with it.

5. About, Privacy, and Support
About has a short getting-started path, Privacy text, Support with the contact email, and Erase library with a two-step confirmation if you want a clean slate on this device.

A few more things you might like to know. Everything works offline. Your gear, grips, and logs stay on this iPhone. There is no account to create, no ads, and nothing to buy. The layout is built for landscape so the due board and lists stay readable on a wide screen.

Keep the wraps honest and let me know how it reads.

Warmly,
Allen

name: GripCast: BJJ Scoreboard
description:
GripCast turns your phone into a small TV truck for jiu-jitsu. Film a match and the scoreboard is part of the picture: names, belts, points, advantages, penalties and the match clock, in a slanted broadcast bar. Everything you need to score is one tap away while you film.

FILM WITH A LIVE SCOREBOARD
• Scan the referee's scoreboard with the camera, or type the names. Belt, team, division and time are filled in when they can be read.
• One-tap scoring with the standard BJJ points (2, 3, 4), advantages and penalties. Automatic penalty rules and a full undo. The standard BJJ rules are built in, plus two sets of your own (points, advantages, penalties, match time).
• START begins the recording and the match clock together. PAUSE stops the clock when the referee stops the fight. END saves the video and takes you to your recordings.
• Tap the picture to focus, press and hold to lock focus and exposure.
• Choose 1080p at 30 or 60 fps, or 4K at 30 fps (iPhone models that support it).
• Warnings for low storage and low battery, right on the filming screen.

SCORE A VIDEO YOU ALREADY HAVE
• Pick any video from Photos, play it and tap the points as they happen. Export a copy with the scoreboard burned in.

HIGHLIGHTS THAT CUT THEMSELVES
• Every point you tap is remembered with its place in the video. Tap a chip to jump straight to it.
• Something great without points? Tap the star. The moment is set 2 seconds back so you see what just happened.
• Make a highlight reel in one tap, with a smooth transition between clips: cross-fade, dip to black or slide.
• Put a song of your own under the reel (from your Files).

FOLLOW A FIGHTER
• Import one fighter's matches from a tournament schedule: open the page in the app, add screenshots or paste the text. Names, teams, mat, time and match number are filled in for you.

SHARE
• Share any recording or highlight reel straight to your socials, with a caption that names the fighters and the score.

FREE AND PRO
• Free to download: film with the live scoreboard in 1080p, view, share and manage your recordings.
• GripCast Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription) unlocks highlights and highlight reels, 4K and 60 fps, scoring any video from Photos, following a fighter, and removes the small GripCast logo and the "Made with GripCast" intro from your videos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone and in your own photo library.

Available in English and Dutch.

name: Grudge: Angry Habit Tracker
description:
Grudge is the habit tracker that's most fun when you skip.

Pick a mascot: Spike the hedgehog, Momo the cat, Gabi the goat or Pip the penguin. Add a few habits. Check them off right from your Home Screen. Then try skipping and see what happens.

SKIP A DAY, LOSE YOUR WIDGET
Your mascot slowly takes over your widget. Spike stabs it with quills and cracks the glass. Momo pushes your habits off the edge. Gabi eats it, bite by bite. Pip tips the whole thing over. Do one thing and everything snaps back.

DO IT, AND THEY HATE IT
Every check-off gets a grudging reaction. Collect rare and legendary lines in your Grudging Praise book. Hit streaks, come back after a lapse, or finish at 11:58 PM and see what they say.

LIVING WITH A WEIRD LITTLE CREATURE
• Rare events: your mascot goes on strike, sends an impostor, oversleeps, gets audited, goes missing
• The Grudge Court: every Sunday, your week goes on trial
• A monthly Grudge Receipt and WANTED posters made to share
• The Proof: everything you've piled up, in glasses, pages and minutes
• Year of walls: twelve months side by side. Old messes stay.

12 WIDGET DESIGNS
Classic, Large wall, Minimal, Sticky notes, Polaroid, Pet cam, Newspaper, Roommates, Grudge Boy, Safety board, The room and Letters. Plus Lock Screen widgets and a Live Activity in the evening.

KIND WHEN IT MATTERS
• Choose how strict they are: Soft, Salty or Savage
• Bare minimum counts. One sip is still a sip.
• "Today is hard" and Pause never break your streak
• Coming back is always celebrated, never punished

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your habits stay on your device.

GRUDGE PRO
Unlimited habits, all four mascots, every widget design, light & dark widget colors and your full year of walls.
• Yearly: 1-week free trial, then billed yearly
• Lifetime: one-time purchase

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Grudge reminds you 2 days before your free trial ends.

Terms of Use: https://app.notion.com/p/Terms-of-Use-Grudge-42308908e8d9800a9157cc729a5c45f1
Privacy Policy: https://app.notion.com/p/Privacy-Policy-Grudge-42308908e8d98092a665fbe81d480a88

name: GSA Smart Connect
description:
Thanks for installing; each bit of feedback points us toward clearer updates.

This is a calm one-line money journal for the spends and shares you want to keep straight.

A free-text line without structure is hard to review later. Short notes become tagged entries, with a Month statement, optional trip tags, and split helpers for shared outings. It is a personal on-device journal only—no broker and no bank login.

YOUR JOURNAL, AT A GLANCE
- Type a plain line such as “coffee 4.50 card” and send it
- Smart suggestions while you type, plus Line examples in the menu
- Filter all lines, lines that still need a detail, or the active trip
- Month statement for in, out, and net

TRIPS AND SPLITS
- Open a trip so new lines tag to that place until you close it
- Split helpers for shared outings and roommate pieces
- Edit any line later: amount, kind, category, who, note, and when

KEEP A COPY YOU CONTROL
- Share CSV when you want an export
- Pick a backup folder in Files for an ongoing CSV copy
- Optional receipt photos from Camera or Photos stay on this iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Never links a bank and never moves real money
- Lines, trips, and notes stay on this iPhone unless you export them
- Open Privacy from the menu any time
- Erase the journal on this phone whenever you want a clean start

name: GTA VI GodCheats
description:
Want to change the weather in GTA VI or find out how to unlock the fisheye filter? GodCheats is an independent fan guide to 61 cheats for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Pick your console, search for an effect or browse the Character, Combat, Vehicles and World categories. Open an entry to see the known button sequence, read its unlock conditions and check the sources. Bookmark the codes you use most and keep them handy on your device.

The catalog is available in English, German, French and Spanish. It loads online when you open the app, so additions and corrections appear the next time you open it with an internet connection.

name: GTLYS Mobile
description:
GTLYS Mobile est l'application des coursiers qui travaillent avec le logiciel de gestion de transport GTLYS. Elle réunit dans votre poche tout ce qu'il faut pour réaliser vos courses : les adresses, les consignes, la validation des étapes et la preuve de livraison.

L'application est réservée aux coursiers des entreprises utilisatrices de GTLYS. Vos identifiants (passerelle, email et mot de passe) vous sont fournis par votre exploitation.

VOS COURSES DU JOUR
• La liste des courses qui vous sont attribuées, avec leur état : à enlever, à livrer.
• Un accueil qui résume votre journée : nombre de courses, enlèvements et livraisons restants.
• Les courses futures des prochains jours, pour anticiper votre planning.

TOUTES LES INFORMATIONS DE LA COURSE
• Adresses d'enlèvement et de livraison, contact, étage, porte et instructions.
• Appel du contact en un geste.
• Itinéraire dans Plans, Google Maps ou Waze.
• Type de transport, nombre de colis et plage de température lorsque la marchandise l'exige.

VALIDATION ET PREUVE DE LIVRAISON
• Validez l'enlèvement puis la livraison directement depuis la course.
• Photo de preuve prise avec l'appareil photo ou choisie dans la photothèque.
• Signature du destinataire sur l'écran, avec son nom.
• Observations libres pour signaler un incident ou une précision.
Votre exploitation voit la course avancer en temps réel.

NOTIFICATIONS
• Une alerte et un son dédié vous préviennent dès qu'une nouvelle course vous est attribuée, même application fermée.
• Vous êtes aussi prévenu quand une course vous est retirée ou quand le dispatch vous écrit.

MESSAGERIE AVEC LE DISPATCH
• Échangez avec votre exploitation depuis l'onglet Messages.
• Écrivez au dispatch depuis une course : votre message y est rattaché.
• Les messages non lus sont signalés sur l'accueil et dans l'onglet Messages.

HISTORIQUE
• Les courses terminées dans la journée, avec les heures d'enlèvement et de livraison.
• Recherche par adresse, client ou numéro de course.
• Export de l'historique en PDF.

GÉOLOCALISATION (FACULTATIVE)
• Si vous l'activez et si votre exploitation l'autorise, votre position est partagée avec elle pendant vos tournées, pour mieux organiser les courses.
• Vous pouvez la désactiver à tout moment depuis « Mon compte ».

MON COMPTE
• Votre profil, le changement de mot de passe et le réglage des notifications.

Une interface claire, en thème clair et sombre, pensée pour être utilisée d'une main entre deux courses.

name: GTPRT
description:
GTPRT is a sample ledger you can read offline. Six horizons share one set of books: a house, a workshop, study, a gathering, later years, and a passage. Every dollar in the sample is already assigned.

Open a horizon to see what is saved, what is left, and whether the monthly pace clears the target. Tune the pace with steppers. The line redraws at once. Keep it on this device, or restore the sample.

The books show each leaf, the change since the money went in, and an annualized figure for the whole ledger. A reading names the strongest leaf, the softest, and where the mix sits against a calm yardstick. The tide draws two futures: every horizon pace funded, and only the moorings still running.

The session is a teaching tape, made on this device from the date. It is not a live quote. The docket places sample prints and remarks around today and says, in plain words, what each one is, which sleeve of these books usually listens, and what a stronger or softer print often means. That reading is not advice, and Harborline never tells you to buy, sell, or wait.

Nothing here is a bank or a broker. There is no account, no login, and no network. Paces, pauses, a nominee word, and the wires you have read stay on this device. You never type. Reset returns the sample books whenever you want a clean page.

name: Guess The Room
description:
Guess The Room is a party game about how well you know the people around you. One phone, 3 to 20 players, no setup.

On your turn you draw a ballot, like "Have you ever pushed a door that said pull?" or "Beach holiday or city break?", and guess how many of the others will answer it the first way. Then the room votes, the tally goes up stroke by stroke and the stamp comes down: SPOT ON for 3 points, SO CLOSE for 1. Whoever reads the room best wins.

TWO WAYS TO VOTE
• Pass the phone: the phone goes round like a sealed envelope and each player ticks a box in private, so nobody knows who said what.
• Show of hands: the guesser covers their eyes, hands go up, and one person taps in the count. Fast enough for a big group.

347 QUESTIONS IN SIX DECKS
• Warm-up: easy openers
• Fess up: harmless little secrets
• Hot takes: what does the room think?
• Would you rather: pick a side
• Can you…?: party tricks and skills
• Real talk: for teens and grown-ups
Tick the decks that suit the crowd, draw a different ballot if you don't fancy one, or write your own.

MADE FOR PARTIES
• 1, 2 or 3 turns each, from about five minutes to an evening
• A pause menu to skip a turn or end early
• Games save as you go, and the screen stays awake while you play
• Sounds and haptics, with sound easy to switch off

There are no ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases and no tracking. It works offline.

name: GXT智慧机场配送端
description: GXT智慧机场配送端是一款专为各大物流企业打造的高效B2B配送协同平台。核心功能涵盖：物流配送任务、抢单接单模式、实时状态更新、单据拍照上传、数据报表查看等。无论您的企业规模大小，均可联系我们开通专属企业账号，提升物流配送效率。

name: GYKL
description:
**Plan your roof. Track every drop. Manage water with confidence.**

GYKL is a professional rainwater collection and roof drainage management app designed for homeowners, DIY enthusiasts, property managers, and rainwater harvesting system owners.

From planning roof catchment areas and organizing drainage networks to recording rainfall, monitoring tank levels, and tracking maintenance, GYKL brings practical rainwater management tools together in one intuitive iOS workspace.

### Roof Catchment Planning

Create interactive roof layouts with editable catchment zones. Draw roof boundaries, calculate projected collection areas, configure surface properties, and organize water drainage directions.

### Drainage Network Management

Build visual drainage networks connecting roof sections, gutters, downpipes, filters, and storage tanks. Inspect individual components, record blockages, and organize drainage system information.

### Rainwater & Tank Tracking

Record rainfall measurements and water tank levels. Estimate potential rainwater runoff based on roof area, rainfall, and runoff factors. Compare calculated volumes with actual tank readings.

### Maintenance & Inspections

Create maintenance checklists for gutters, downpipes, filters, and rainwater tanks. Record cleaning activities, document repairs, attach photos, and schedule follow-up inspections.

### System History & Reports

Keep a detailed history of rainfall events, tank readings, drainage inspections, and maintenance activities. Review recurring issues, compare before-and-after results, and export structured reports.

### Key Features

- Interactive roof catchment editor
- Roof area and runoff calculations
- Custom drainage network diagrams
- Gutter and downpipe inspections
- Rainwater tank profiles and level records
- Rainfall and water volume tracking
- Estimated runoff comparisons
- Water usage and overflow records
- Maintenance checklists and repair logs
- Before-and-after inspection records
- Historical trends and PDF reports
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Practical Rainwater Management

GYKL combines visual planning, practical measurement tools, and organized maintenance records to help you better understand and manage your rainwater collection system.

Whether you're designing a new rainwater harvesting setup, inspecting existing drainage components, or tracking water storage over time, GYKL keeps every detail organized and accessible.

Calculations are estimates based on user-provided measurements and system configurations. GYKL does not automatically measure rainfall, monitor water levels, or control physical equipment.

**Plan. Inspect. Measure. Maintain.**

name: Habitness: AI Habit Tracker
description:
Build habits that actually stick — just type one sentence and AI turns it into a habit plan you can review and save. Your to-do list, calendar and focus timer live right next to your habits, so your whole day is in one place.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Start in seconds — write "read 20 pages after dinner" and get a ready-to-edit habit draft, or pick from about 40 templates.
• Never break the chain — streaks, a 7-day strip and a gentle "Don't miss twice" nudge after a slip. Streak freezes keep a busy day from wiping your progress.
• Make it easy — every habit has a 2-minute version and an "I will… at… in…" plan, plus an identity line like "I am a reader".
• Check in fast — swipe cards on Today, tap a widget or Control Center button, or ask Siri.
• Plan your day — tasks with subtasks, due dates, priorities, tags and reminders, smart lists, and a Day / Week / Month calendar for tasks and habits together.
• Stay focused — a Pomodoro-style focus timer with Live Activity, linked to a task or habit.
• See what works — completion rates for 7 / 30 / 90 days, monthly calendar, best days and times, plus a weekly AI review with suggestions you can apply in one tap.
• Private by default — no account needed, optional iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad, Face ID app lock, JSON / CSV export, dark mode and 13 languages.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type a goal or habit in plain words, or choose a template.
2. Check in each day from Today, a widget or Siri.
3. Review your week and tweak what isn't working.

EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Every feature is open to everyone: unlimited habits, full history and insights, the full weekly AI review, recovery mode, level-up suggestions, streak freezes, unlimited task lists, Week and Month calendar views, custom smart lists and focus stats. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases.

Start small today and let Habitness help your habits grow.

Privacy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicy-kientran/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: HabitQuest:Hayatını Oyunlaştır
description:
HabitQuest: Hayatını Oyunlaştır

Sıradan yapılacaklar listelerinden ve monoton rutinlerden sıkıldınız mı? HabitQuest, kişisel gelişiminizi ve günlük hedeflerinizi ödüllendirici bir RPG macerasına dönüştürür. Tamamladığınız her görevle seviye atlayın, statlarınızı geliştirin ve gerçek potansiyelinizi ortaya çıkarın.

TEMEL ÖZELLİKLER:

- Haftalık Zindan Bossu ve Raid Savaşları:
Alışkanlıklarınızı aksatmadan tamamlayın; vurduğunuz her darbeyle Boss canını eritin ve efsanevi ganimet sandıklarını fethedin.

- 30 Aşamalı Zindan Kulesi Seferi:
Zindan canavarlarıyla tur bazlı stratejik savaşlara girin, kritik vuruşlar yapın ve her katta yeni ganimetler elde edin.

- 21-Gün Meydan Okuma Arenaları:
Dopamin Detoksu, Sabah 06:30 Şampiyonu ve Bilgelik Arenası gibi seçkin disiplin meydan okumalarına katılarak rozetler kazanın.

- Derin Odak Zindanı (Pomodoro):
Dikkat dağıtıcıları susturun, ambiyans sesleri eşliğinde kesintisiz odaklanma seanslarıyla ertelemeyi hayatınızdan kalıcı olarak çıkarın.

- Rutin Kuşakları ve Kombo Zinciri:
Sabah, Öğle ve Akşam rutinlerinizi zamanında tamamlayarak kombo çarpanlarını ateşleyin; ekstra XP ve Altın kazanın.

- Yetenek Ağacı ve RPG Ekipman Sistemi:
Kuşanılabilir zırh, kılıç ve ekipmanlarla gücünüzü yükseltin, yeni yetenek düğümlerini aktive edin.

- %100 ÇEVRİMDIŞI VE GİZLİLİK GÜVENCESİ:
Tüm verileriniz yalnızca cihazınızdaki yerel veritabanında saklanır. Harici sunuculara hiçbir veriniz aktarılmaz. İnternet bağlantısı olmadan da tüm özellikleri sınırsızca kullanabilirsiniz.

name: Habits by OpenApps
description:
Habits helps you keep the habits you want, one day at a time. Check a habit off with one tap and watch your streak grow. There is no sign-up, no ads, nothing to buy and no limit on habits.

What you get
- Habits that repeat every day, on chosen weekdays, a number of times a week, or every few days.
- Yes or no habits like "Meditate", counted habits like "8 glasses of water", and days without, like "No sugar".
- Today shows what is due, with one-tap check-off and undo.
- Every habit has its current and best streak, a completion rate, a month calendar, a year of days and notes on any day.
- A week view with all your habits side by side.
- Streaks count only the days you planned a habit for, so a rest day never breaks one.
- Share one habit with a friend by link, and you both see each other's streak for it. Nothing else is shared.
- Reminders through your calendar: Habits adds a repeating event to the calendar app you already use, and your calendar does the reminding.
- Download all your habits as a CSV file.

Your habits
Habits starts you as a guest, so your habits save on your phone right away. Sign in with your email only if you want the same habits on another device. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time.

Habits is made by OpenApps. It also works in a web browser at habits-free.openapps.xyz.

name: Hacks
description:
Hacks is a photo feed for golfers.

Post a picture or a short clip from your round and tag the course and the hole. Your course is not in the list? Write it in. See what the people you follow are playing, and browse any course to find everyone's photos from it, with a card of all eighteen holes.

FEED
Holes, Swings, Discussion and Tips. Double-tap a photo to plant a flag. Hold a photo to turn it over and read the details on the back.

REELS
Full-screen video from the course. Swipe up for the next one, hold to scrub.

YOUR PROFILE
Your newest photo runs full-bleed, with your handicap index (plus handicaps like +2.6 included), your home course, an eighteen-hole sheet of the holes you have posted, and a gallery of framed prints.

YOUR RULES
Keep a private club's name off a post and it reads as A private club. Report anything that breaks the community rules, block anyone you like, and delete your account and everything you posted from Settings.

No scorecards. No ads. No handicap required.

name: Hadis Yaprağı: Daily Hadith
description:
Three short pages a day. A hadith arrives in the morning, another at midday and a third in the evening, each one showing where it comes from: the collection, the book and the number.

THE HADITH ITSELF, NOT A NUDGE
The notification doesn't ask you to open anything. It carries the meaning of the hadith, with the time of day as the title and the source underneath. Press and hold to see the Arabic as well, if you like. Save keeps it without opening the app; Share opens a sourced card.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT TURN UP
Everything is scheduled on your phone, two weeks ahead, so there's no server to fail and no account to sign into. Pick a time for each page, and set quiet hours when nothing should arrive.

A SOURCE AND A GRADE ON EVERY PAGE
Notifications only ever carry hadith graded sahih or hasan. Every page lists its collection, book, number and grade, with a link to the original on sunnah.com. Each text is reviewed by a scholar, and a page still under review says so.

THE ARABIC, AND CAREFUL ENGLISH
The vowelled Arabic sits at the top of each page. The English meanings were written for this app directly from the Arabic, in plain, modern language.

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
The widget shows the very same page your notification brought, so today's hadith is there before you even unlock.

SHARE WITH THE SOURCE, COPY FREELY
Make a card in square, portrait or story size. The source is always printed on it, and anything you copy comes with its source too.

ARCHIVE, THEMES AND THE FORTY HADITH
Every day you've read stays in your archive. Browse themes such as intention, speech, anger, family, neighbours and repentance, and read Imam al-Nawawi's Forty Hadith in the book's order. Search in English, Turkish or unvowelled Arabic, or type "bukhari 6114" to jump straight to that hadith.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No ads. No account. No streak counter and no guilt. A page you've read gets a folded corner, and that's all. What you read and save stays on your phone.

name: Hagah: Scripture Memory
description:
Hagah (hah-GAH) is the Hebrew word for meditating on God's Word: to murmur it, to speak it under your breath. Hagah helps you do just that, until whole passages are yours word for word.

Record yourself reading a passage from your own Bible, up to a whole chapter. Hagah turns your voice into text on your phone, recognizes which passage you read, and marks any word it isn't sure of so you can fix it. The recorded words you confirm become your answer key, in whatever translation you read.

How to use the app:
• Read Along: hear your own recording while each word lights up.
• Practice: start anywhere. Hagah plays the lines before a verse you're still learning, and you carry on from there.
• Recite: say the whole passage from memory. Words appear as you say them. Stuck? Tap for the next one.

Hagah grades word for word and shows exactly which words you dropped, added, or swapped. "Counted" for "credited" is a miss, not a pass. If it mishears a word you said right, tap the word and say so.

Lock a passage for a few hours, then recite it cold. Only that first try, from memory alone, moves your progress. Strong memory, over time, is the goal.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your recordings and words stay on your iPhone, and speech is recognized on the device.

Free. Requires iOS 26 or later.

Privacy policy: https://hagah.josiahswanson.com/privacy.html
Support: https://hagah.josiahswanson.com/support.html
Marketing: https://hagah.josiahswanson.com

name: Haggle Hustle: Flip & Resell
description:
"What last price?" Welcome to Kramfunk, the classifieds app where people really sell everything: a bucket of freshly fallen snow, an army of 34 garden gnomes and a vacuum that comes with a spider.

You have €100 and an empty basement unit. You buy cheap, haggle in chat, pick things up and sell them on for more. From a basement unit to a garage, a flea market stall and finally your own junk shop.

HAGGLE LIKE IN REAL LIFE
"Still available?", "What last price?", "FIRM PRICE!!!": every seller writes differently. The grandma who offers cake, the stressed mover, the dealer who knows every price, the firm-price guy who only types in capitals. Push too hard and you get blocked.

HANDWRITTEN CHATS, NOT RANDOM ONES
Detlef asks for the last price. And the very last price. Autocorrect calls you a sheep. Murat pays in chicken nuggets and half a bottle of fabric softener. Buyers message you on their own, some never show up. 65 chats in the base game, over 160 with all expansions.

SPOT THE SCAMMERS
Payment links, pay in advance, "my courier will come": learn the tricks before they get you. Real people pay cash.

YOUR OWN SHOP
Put your finds on the shelf, decorate your space, fill your sticker album, answer wanted notes and level up step by step.

FAIR PRICE
The first 3 game days are free. After that, the full version keeps you trading for a one-time €3.99. No subscription, no ads. Expansions are sold one by one or in the complete bundle. Your progress stays.

NO DATA
No account needed, and the game sends nothing to the internet.

Playable in English and German.

name: hairsalon RG
description:
■hairsalon RG■
丁寧な施術で毎日のスタイリングが感動するほど楽に。

【アプリで出来ること】
このアプリでは、hairsalon RGの最新情報の受け取りや便利な機能を使う事ができます。
本アプリを利用して以下のことが行えます。

①.マイページで情報を確認！
hairsalon RGのご利用状況が確認できます。

②.最新情報をチェック！
お店からメッセージが届くので、サービス内容やお知らせなどの最新情報を確認できます。

③.友達に紹介！
hairsalon RGのアプリをSNSを通じてお友達に紹介する事ができます。

④.他にも便利な機能満載！

name: hajz.om
description:
Hajz is one app for every booking in Oman: chalets, farms and rest houses, football and padel courts, gyms and classes, events, workshops and trips, halls and majlis.

Discover
- Nine sections and over forty kinds of place.
- Search by name, place, date and number of people.
- Places near you, with prices on the map.
- Photos, guest reviews and every detail before you book.

Book
- Choose the nights, the day and time, or the session and tickets, in a few taps.
- The full price before you pay, with the deposit and the cancellation policy.
- Weekly bookings at the same time, and a waitlist when a time is full.
- Split a court with your players: each one pays their share from a link.

Pay safely
- Apple Pay and cards through Thawani.
- Your Hajz credit, gift cards and points at checkout.

Your tickets and bookings
- A QR code for every ticket, shown offline, and in Apple Wallet.
- Send a ticket to a friend; change or cancel a booking under the place's policy.
- A notice for every confirmation, reminder and reply.

Stay in touch
- Message the place directly, with photos.
- Hajz support in the app, by the topic of your request.

Your account
- Save the places you like.
- Invite friends: you both get credit after their first booking.
- Browse without an account; sign in with a WhatsApp code or with Apple when you book.

name: Haldor
description:
Haldor is a private field journal for chalk downland walks.

It keeps a fixed catalogue of 24 kinds of ground — close-cropped turf, chalk scarps, dry combes, dew ponds, beech hangers and old ridge tracks — and a simple record of every walk you take across them.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

· Browse 24 downland grounds in six groups, each with a short note and a where-to-walk hint.
· Log a walk in under a minute: date, route, time on foot, pack, and the grounds you passed.
· Record the conditions as you found them: shape, light, weather and footing.
· Add counts and a sentence to each ground you crossed.
· Revisit every walk, edit it, or delete it.
· See quiet totals: downland days, ground records, grounds seen, hours on foot, group balance and the last 35 days.
· Read five short field notes on reading a chalk slope, choosing a month and leaving the turf as you found it.
· Set your usual route and pack so a new walk starts half-written.

WHAT IT IS NOT

Haldor is not a map, a route planner, a weather forecast, a GPS tracker, a plant identifier or a fitness log. It does not measure distance, pace or elevation. It does not know the wind on the scarp or the state of the turf. Check a local forecast and the ground itself before you go.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

· No account, sign-in or cloud sync.
· No location, camera, microphone, contacts or notification permission.
· No advertising, analytics, tracking or third-party SDK.
· No network connection required. The whole catalogue and all five notes are inside the app.
· Your journal is one JSON file in the app's Documents folder. Clear it at any time in More.

The app is in English (U.K.) and designed for iPhone in portrait.

The chalk downland is a fragile place. Keep to the path where access allows, close gates, leave the turf as you found it, and take the view home in your notes rather than in a bag.

name: Half Knot
description:
Half Knot is a tally for two cords you are tying by hand. You write the piece name and how many half knots you want, from 2 to 24. Then you drag the cord that should move across the other one. Each cross that passes the other cord adds one half knot, and the next knot has to come back from the other side. When the count is met, the piece is tied.

The Cords tab shows the two cords and whether a piece is still in hand. The Knot tab is where you make the cross. The Pieces tab lists what you have already tied, and opening a row shows the name, the count, and the time. Taking a piece apart removes that record. Nothing leaves the phone. There is no account, no sign-in, and no payment.

Half Knot does not teach sailing, climbing, or medical knots, and it does not sell cord. It is a personal count for the piece in your hands.

name: Hand Maze Race: Steer by Hand
description:
Hold up both hands like you are gripping a steering wheel, and race a sports car with nothing but the front camera.

DRIVE WITH YOUR HANDS
• Tilt your hands to steer, just like a real wheel
• Make fists for full speed, open your hands to ease off
• Squeeze twice fast for a nitro boost
• No camera handy? Drag to steer and tap for nitro

COLLECT AND CHOOSE
• Coins 10, gems 25, stars 50 and crowns 100
• At every fork: take the gold shortcut lane for big prizes, or the safe road

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Solo time trial: beat your best score on every track
• You vs a friend: share one phone, split screen, each player holds up both hands

FOUR TRACKS
Meadow Dash, River Bends, Zigzag Canyon and Mountain Pass, with tunnels, bridges and hills.

A synthesized engine with a 6-speed gearbox, exhaust pops on nitro, a mini track map and an F1-style wheel with shift lights.

• English and 中文
• No ads, no account, no data collected
• Camera frames are processed on your device and never saved or sent

name: Hands Up DJ: Mixer & Beat Pad
description:
Prop up your phone, step in front of the camera and throw your hands up: the music follows your moves. Raise a hand and the echo kicks in, touch your fingertips and a new layer drops in, throw both hands up and the drop hits. A crowd going wild in front of you, you on stage: the feeling of playing to a real crowd like a real DJ.

Hands Up DJ gives you the rush of a DJ booth without gear or cables. Play with your hands, build sets with the pads in a two-deck booth, or test your timing in the built-in rhythm game.

THREE MODES
• Booth: Tap the pads and the music builds layer by layer. Spin the jog to scratch. Blend between the two decks with the crossfader. The tighter you are on the beat, the more the crowd warms up, goes wild and explodes on the drop. Stop the music and the crowd waits.
• Mirror: Prop up your phone, face the front camera and play with your hands. Raise a hand: echo. Touch your fingertips together: toggle a layer. Throw both hands up: DROP. Pump your fist to the beat. Swipe a hand sideways: cut. Hold both hands at one side: crossfader. A real DJ shows every move on video, step by step.
• Drop: A tour of ten different tracks, from disco to techno, afro house to drum and bass. Press START and the notes rush toward you; tap the pad right on the beat and every hit adds a layer to the song. As your combo grows, the stage fills with light.

FOUR STAGES
A night-time festival, a beach club at sunset, a valley full of hot air balloons at sunrise, or your own camera. On the Camera stage, put yourself on stage with the front camera, or the crowd in front of you with the back camera. The crowd dances to your energy and waits when you stop the music.

RECORD AND SHARE
Press REC and your 15-second set becomes a clip. Share it with one tap.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOLDABLE SCREEN
Open iPhone Duo halfway and set it on the table: the upright half is your stage, the flat half is your booth. The same booth is waiting on iPhone and iPad.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account, no ads, no internet needed.
• The camera is used only to track your hands in Mirror and to show you on the Camera stage; the image never leaves your device. It only goes into a clip if you press REC.
• The music is generated inside the app; you can't load your own tracks.

name: Hapso
description:
Welcome to the world of Hapso — 10 free, ad-free games for kids, parents, and anyone who loves cheerful dogs!

Where does the name Hapso come from? Happy + Apso (from the Lhasa Apso dog breed). Meet our two shaggy brothers with golden topknots:
• Mischief — the older black-and-tan pup who causes trouble with a big smile,
• Thinker — the younger black-and-white daydreamer with a white chest patch and white paws.

10 games in one cozy app:
• Hapso Turf — claim territory with a swipe, outsmart playful cats, and reveal 16 illustrated regions of Poland.
• Hapso Bump — a goofy belly-bump showdown on a tilting podium with a soft landing on a quilted dog bed.
• Puppy Adventure — three colorful chapters hunting for a missing ball with platforms, jumps, and keepsakes.
• Hapso Dash — 14 crystal caves packed with boulders, traps, and diamonds (Arcade or Relaxed mode).
• Hapso Jumper — ski jumping arcade fun: time your takeoff and soar to a new hill record.
• Catch Treats — it is raining snacks, catch as many as you can!
• Coloring Book — calm, creative coloring pages starring the Hapso pups.
• Bone Batter — grab the giant bone and send the ball flying.
• Hapso Chess — friendly chess matches for beginners and puzzle fans alike.
• Hapso Racer — fast finger-steered racing fun.

Why families love Hapso:
• Zero ads — no pop-ups, no banners, no forced video breaks.
• No accounts or sign-up — tap a game and play right away.
• Intuitive direct finger controls built for iPhone and iPad.
• Playable offline (except leaderboards and online chess).

Meet our real Lhasa Apsos and explore more at https://hapso.pl
Contact: biuro@hapso.pl

name: HashFolio
description:
HashFolio records file fingerprints and compares handoff revisions on your iPhone.

FINGERPRINT REAL FILES
Import files through the system Files picker. SHA-256 is calculated from streamed file bytes. Each manifest stores filenames, byte counts and hashes; it does not copy the original files. You can also fingerprint the exact UTF-8 bytes of a text note. The note text itself is not retained.

SAVE YOUR HANDOFFS
Name and save manifests, inspect complete hashes, edit names and file lists, search your archive and delete records with confirmation. Each manifest supports up to 100 uniquely named files.

COMPARE REVISIONS
Select two saved manifests to see added, removed, changed and unchanged filenames. Matching is by filename. Renamed files appear as removal and addition. SHA-256 describes content, not its origin, trust or safety; this is not a malware scanner.

EXPORT EVIDENCE
Share a plain-text manifest containing filenames, sizes and hashes, or export a readable comparison report.

PRIVATE WORKSPACE
Business records stay on this device. No account, advertising, subscription or purchase. Light, Dark and System appearance are supported. Optional samples are available in Settings while the archive is empty.

The App includes English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Store materials are provided in English.

name: Hashiriate: Drive & Guess
description:
Drive along streets built from real photos and guess where you are.

All you can see is the road ahead through the windscreen and your two door mirrors. Read the signs, junctions, buildings and street widths as you drive, then drop a pin on the map. The closer your pin - and the shorter the distance you drove - the higher your score.

DRIVE
- Drive on the roads only. Use the indicators to turn left or right at the next junction
- Stop or make a U-turn. Watch out for one-way and closed streets
- Tap a door mirror to look behind you
- The view moves like a real drive: speeding up, slowing down and swinging round corners

GUESS
- Drop a pin on the map. Scored by distance and by how far you drove
- 3 rounds per game (150 seconds each), each from a random start
- Your personal best is kept for every course

COURSES
- Sapporo, Japan: the grid streets of the city centre on a snowy day (inside the app, ready to play)
- Cities across Japan. Pick one on the course screen and the app downloads its photos (about 10-25 MB per course); after that it plays offline
- More courses are added over time and appear in the list without an app update
- Every view is a real photo taken from the road. People and vehicles in the photos have been removed

PRIVACY
Free, no ads, no purchases, no account. The app goes online only to fetch the course list and course photos, and sends no personal information. The game is in Japanese and English.

Photos: Mapillary contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), listed under Photo credits.
Map data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

name: Hashlookupa
description: Hashlookupa is a portrait-mode forensic console for tracing MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 digests against the CIRCL hashlookup service. Paste a digest to inspect file names, package metadata, trust scores, parent objects and first-indexed dates, then keep that context with notes, tags, favourites and CSV or JSON exports. Batch lookups, side-by-side comparison and an offline cache keep the work moving when the network does not.

name: Havalubi
description:
Havalubi is an offline notebook for the days your pet stays with someone you trust. Prepare the little routines, pack what is needed and keep the handover clear from departure to homecoming.

PREPARE THEIR FAMILIAR ROUTINE
Save reusable pet files with a photo, meal times, food portions, water, cleaning, favorite habits and things to avoid. Each handover keeps an independent copy of the instructions you chose.

PACK AND CHECK THE REAL SUPPLIES
Organize food and shared items with quantities and storage locations. Confirm what you actually handed over. Record later additions and count corrections with their reasons.

LEAVE A CLEAR CARE CARD
Create numbered, read-only care-card versions. Preview the instructions, save an HTML or PDF copy, or use the system share and print controls. Phone numbers are excluded unless you choose to include them. Previous copies remain unchanged when you edit a routine.

NOTE THE LITTLE MOMENTS
Record meals, water, cleaning, walks and observations with the actual date and time. Switch between Owner and Carer as local organizing views on the same device. Review notes by pet and day; a missing note is shown as unrecorded care, not as a completed routine.

WELCOME THEM HOME
Count remaining supplies, review each companion’s notes and add your return observations. Archive the handover while preserving its history, then reuse the plan for another trip.

YOUR DEVICE, YOUR CARE BAG
Open directly without an account. Care information and photos are stored locally. Export your data as a JSON file, clear only the demonstration data, or reset your local care bag after confirmation. This version does not import JSON backups.

Havalubi does not provide veterinary advice or remote monitoring. Exported care cards are independent copies; the app does not send invitations, sync notes between devices or confirm that someone has read a card.

name: HearGlow: Live Large Captions
description:
HearGlow bridges everyday face-to-face conversations with instant, ultra-legible giant captions and tactile sound alerts.

KEY FEATURES
• Instant Giant Captions: Live speech-to-text rendered in crisp, high-contrast typography.
• Haptic Sound Cue Alerts: Subtle CoreHaptics vibration feedback when voices or loud cues begin.
• Two-Way Quick Reply Cards: Show large-print replies back to doctors, family, or cashiers.
• 100% Private & On-Device: Conversations are never recorded or uploaded to external servers.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited conversation transcripts, custom font sizes, and full history export.

name: Heart Tracker: Pulse & HRV
description:
Take a fingertip pulse reading in about 30 seconds and see how your readings change over time. Keep your pulse, blood pressure, and blood oxygen records together.

• Check your pulse with the rear camera and light. Each saved report shows estimated BPM and the share of usable signal. When the signal supports it, see pulse-derived HRV (RMSSD).
• Explore 7- and 30-day pulse and HRV trends. Tap a day to revisit the readings behind that day's average.
• Log blood pressure from your monitor and oxygen saturation (SpO2) from your oximeter. Review your history, averages, and reading ranges.
• View available blood pressure and oxygen readings from Apple Health with optional read-only access.
• Keep manual entries and camera reports on your iPhone. Share an individual report when you choose.

For general wellness and personal record keeping. Camera-based estimates are for informational use. Use an external blood pressure monitor and pulse oximeter to obtain those readings. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.

Membership and Automatic Renewal

1. Paid membership. Monthly and annual subscriptions are billed in advance and renew automatically unless you cancel or the service ends. Lifetime Membership is a one-time purchase.

2. Cancel your subscription. Cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends to avoid renewal. On your iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, then tap Subscriptions. Select your Heart Tracker subscription and tap Cancel Subscription.

3. Restore purchases. To recover an eligible purchase, sign in with the Apple Account you used to buy it and look for Restore Purchases in the app.

Membership Service Agreement and Automatic Renewal Agreement
