Privacy Policy
https://gcn1s2rmayw3.feishu.cn/wiki/SGBIwmUWCiPWoWktE5sclLRgnol?from=from_copylink

name: HearthCatalog: Home Inventory
description:
Build a room-by-room record of what you own. HearthCatalog puts photos, serial numbers, recorded values, and packing details in one searchable inventory.

• Add a photo and the details that matter for each item.
• Group items by room and give each packed item a box label.
• Find a possession by its name, serial number, box, or note.
• Filter to what still needs packing and see the total recorded value.
• Export a PDF with photos or a CSV for a spreadsheet.

Try the sample inventory to see how it works. The app keeps your inventory on your device, with no account or subscription.

name: HeatBoosts
description:
HeatBoost warms up one room quickly using the radiator valves and thermostats you already have in Apple Home.

Tap a cold room and HeatBoost turns it up. If you like, it also turns the other radiators down for a while, so the hot water from your boiler goes to that room first instead of being shared around the whole house.

When the room reaches temperature, or after the time you choose, your home hub puts every other room back exactly as it was. That happens automatically, even if HeatBoost is closed.

FEATURES
• See every room at a glance: temperature, setting and whether it's heating
• Boost a room to the temperature you choose (2 °C above its setting by default)
• Prioritise a room by turning the others down while it warms up
• Rooms are put back automatically when the boosted room is warm, or at a time limit
• Protected rooms – such as a nursery – are never turned down
• Swipe a room to switch its heating off or on
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Boost the bedroom with HeatBoost", "End HeatBoost", "Heating status in HeatBoost"

WHAT YOU NEED
• Radiator valves or thermostats added to the Apple Home app
• An Apple TV or HomePod set up as a home hub, so rooms are put back while the app is closed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
HeatBoost talks only to Apple Home on your own devices. It has no account, no servers, no tracking and no ads, and it collects no data.

name: HeatGate
description:
Το HeatGate ειναι επαγγελματικος βοηθος για ρυθμιστες μηχανων εγχυσης που επιβλεπουν συστηματα θερμου δρομεα. Συγκρινει σε καθε ζωνη την επιθυμητη με την πραγματικη θερμοκρασια. Οταν η αποκλιση παραμενει περα απο το κρισιμο οριο για καθορισμενο χρονο ενεργοποιει προστατευτικη διακοπη ωστε να μειωνονται καμενα υλικα κρυα υλικα και ελλιπης πληρωση.
﻿
Τι μπορειτε να κανετε
﻿
1. Πινακας ζωνων
Δημιουργηστε και επεξεργαστειτε ζωνες ακροφυσιων και πολλαπλων με επιθυμητη θερμοκρασια πραγματικη ενδειξη και ενεργοποιηση η απενεργοποιηση.
﻿
2. Διπλη ζωνη αποκλισης
Ξεχωριστα ορια προειδοποιησης και κρισιμου οριου για εγκαιρη προσοχη και ισχυρη προστασια.
﻿
3. Διακοπη με χρονο κρατησης
Η σκληρη διακοπη γινεται μονο οταν η αποκλιση παραμενει πανω απο το κρισιμο οριο για τον ρυθμισμενο χρονο. Ετσι μειωνονται ψευδεις συναγερμοι απο στιγμιαιες αιχμες.
﻿
4. Κατασταση μηχανης
Υπαρχουν καταστασεις Λειτουργια Ηπια διακοπη Σκληρη διακοπη και Αναμονη. Μετα απο κρισιμο συμβαν απαιτειται ρητη επαναφορα πριν την εκκινηση.
﻿
5. Συνταγες υλικων
Γρηγορη εφαρμογη προεπιλογων PP ABS PC PA6 POM στις επιθυμητες θερμοκρασιες κατα την αλλαγη υλικου.
﻿
6. Ζωντανη παρακολουθηση
Ανα ζωνη βλεπετε επιθυμητη και πραγματικη θερμοκρασια μπαρα αποκλισης και χρονο μεχρι τη διακοπη.
﻿
7. Ημερολογιο συναγερμων
Χρονολογημενες καταγραφες με επιπεδα προειδοποιηση η κρισιμο και επιβεβαιωση για παραδοση βαρδιας.
﻿
8. Τοπικη προσομοιωση
Μπορειτε να δοκιμασετε αποκλισεις χωρις συνδεση PLC ιδανικο για εκπαιδευση ρυθμιστων.
﻿
9. Συγχρονισμος ανακτησης
Μετα απο διακοπη ευθυγραμμιστε τις πραγματικες θερμοκρασιες με τις επιθυμητες και επανεκκινηστε με ασφαλειας.
﻿
Το HeatGate λειτουργει τοπικα στη συσκευη σας. Δεν αντικαθιστα πιστοποιημενο βιομηχανικο ελεγκτη ασφαλειας. Ειναι εργαλειο εποπτειας και εκπαιδευσης για το δαπεδο παραγωγης.
﻿
Διεπαφη Ελληνικα.
Απαιτειται iOS 15.0 η νεοτερο.

name: Helion
description:
Το Helion είναι σταθμός εργασίας για ραντάρ γραμμής στομίου υψικαμίνου. Δείχνει την επιφάνεια του φορτίου από έξι σταθμούς στον λαιμό και κρατά σάρωση, ανάλυση, φόρτωση, σήματα και έκθεση βάρδιας σε ένα κλειστό κύκλο στο iPhone.

Χωρίς λογαριασμό. Χωρίς δίκτυο. Μόλις ανοίξεις την εφαρμογή, υπάρχει έτοιμη κάμινος επίδειξης.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
1. Εστία — μέση γραμμή, ομοιομορφία, ζωντανοί σταθμοί, τελευταία σάρωση, ανοιχτά σήματα. Πάτα σάρωση ή νέα φόρτωση.
2. Στέμμα — ξεκίνα πολική σάρωση. Οι έξι κεραίες μαζεύουν ηχώ και αποθηκεύουν το προφίλ. Άνοιξε παλιές βολές από το ιστορικό.
3. Μαντείο — μετά από κάθε σάρωση: κέντρο και στεφάνη, οκτώ δακτύλιοι, κλίση, και σύντομη υπόδειξη. Η προτεινόμενη φόρτωση γεμίζει τη φόρμα.
4. Υφαντό — διάλεξε συνταγή ή γράψε μετάλλευμα, κωκ, συσσωμάτωμα, πελλέτες, συλλιπάσματα ή μείγμα με τόνους, χοάνη, περιστροφή και γραμμή πριν/μετά.
5. Σήματα — συναγερμοί για χαμηλή/υψηλή γραμμή, άνιση κατανομή, καθίζηση κέντρου, απότομη κλίση, απώλεια ηχούς. Επιβεβαίωσε, γράψε την ενέργεια, κλείσε. Μπορείς και χειροκίνητο σήμα.
6. Δέλτος — σύνταξε PDF από τις τελευταίες 12 ώρες και μοίρασέ το. Άλλαξε διάμετρο στομίου, στόχο και όρια· η επόμενη σάρωση τα εφαρμόζει.

name: Helix Fall: Tower Ball Drop
description:
Spin the tower and guide the bouncing ball all the way down!

Helix Fall is a fast, satisfying one-finger arcade game. Drag left or right to turn the tower so the ball drops through the gaps. Watch out for the red parts: touching them breaks the ball. Fall through three rings in a row and the ball turns into a fireball that smashes the next ring.

FEATURES
• Simple drag controls, easy to learn
• Fireball combos and smashing rings
• Hundreds of levels with spinning rings later on
• Colorful tower themes to unlock
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Play offline

Helix Fall is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Helixar
description:
Το Helixar είναι κινητή βιβλιοθήκη τεχνολογιών αντιστάθμισης παραμορφώσεων για μεγάλα μεταλλικά τεμάχια. Δουλεύει στον πάγκο ή στο εργοτάξιο, χωρίς δίκτυο.

Πώς χρησιμοποιείται
1. Ανοίξτε τη Συλλογή. Δώδεκα εκθέματα (PRT, WLD) με υλικό, κλάδο και βήματα. Ψάξτε ή φιλτράρετε κατά τύπο, κράμα και κλάδο. Καρφιτσώστε ό,τι ξαναχρειάζεστε.
2. Μπείτε στο έκθεμα. Δείτε παραμέτρους, ανοχές, ασφάλεια και σημείωση πάγκου. Πατήστε «Στον πάγκο» για να φορτωθούν οι συντελεστές, ή καρφιτσώστε το.
3. Στον Πάγκο συμπληρώστε μήκος, πλάτος, πάχος, ΔΤ, όριο διαρροής και μέτρο ελαστικότητας. Πατήστε «Υπολογισμός». Παίρνετε γραμμική και γωνιακή αντιστάθμιση, περιθώριο και σύντομο συμπέρασμα. Κρατήστε το ως έργο.
4. Στα Έργα ξανανοίγετε την καρτέλα, ξανατρέχετε τον υπολογισμό ή μοιράζεστε αναφορά από το μενού «Κοινοποίηση».
5. Στην Σύγκριση βάζετε δύο εκθέματα ή δύο έργα απέναντι και βλέπετε τη διαφορά στις βασικές τιμές.

Το Helixar μένει στη συσκευή. Οι τιμές είναι ενδεικτικές για προετοιμασία εργασίας και δεν υποκαθιστούν πιστοποιημένο υπολογισμό.

name: HerdReady360
description:
HerdReady360 helps cattle producers manage herd records from their iPhone. Find animals by tag or tattoo, review individual records, and see which cattle are assigned to each pasture or group.

Record pregnancy checks as cattle come through the chute. Save the result, enter days bred when applicable, and add a note when needed.

Sign in with your HerdReady360 account to access your herd.

name: HERITAGE BARBER
description:
Prenota il tuo prossimo taglio da HERITAGE BARBER in pochi tocchi.

Con l'app HERITAGE BARBER puoi:
- Vedere tutti i servizi con prezzo e durata
- Scegliere l'orario che preferisci e prenotare subito
- Ricevere un promemoria prima dell'appuntamento
- Annullare o spostare la prenotazione quando cambiano i tuoi piani
- Avere tutti i tuoi appuntamenti in un unico posto

Barbiere esclusivamente maschile a Trebaseleghe: tagli, sfumature e barba con rasoio. Installa l'app e prenota la tua prossima visita.

name: Heritage Hill Scheduler
description:
Heritage Hill Scheduler is the staff scheduling app for the Heritage Hill Events team.

• My Shifts – see this week's shifts, upcoming work, and event staff details at a glance
• Schedule – week and month views of every shift, with open shifts you can claim
• Swap & drop – request a shift swap with a coworker or drop a shift in a couple of taps
• Availability – set the days you can work so managers can schedule around you
• Chats – message your event crew and share photos
• Calendar sync – add your shifts to Apple, Google, or Outlook Calendar
• Notifications – reminders before your shifts, plus alerts for new shifts and swap requests
• Face ID / Touch ID – unlock the app quickly and securely

For managers: post and edit shifts, manage events, employees, roles, teams, and rotations, and see team availability.

Accounts are created by Heritage Hill Events. If you work for Heritage Hill, ask your manager for an invite.

name: Hevlo – Baby Focus Camera
description:
Hevlo is a baby camera designed for parents. Open the camera, select an animal sticker, and play a soft animal sound to gently capture your baby’s attention on the lens.

---

Photos, Burst Shots, and Short Clips  
· Capture a single expression or a quick movement  
· Take up to 4 burst shots at a time and choose your favorite  
· Record up to 15 seconds of video with sound to preserve laughter and family reactions  

---

Animal Companions and Gentle Sounds  
· Choose from a variety of animal stickers that you can move, rotate, and position in your frame  
· Preview and adjust the animal sounds  
· Enable quiet mode to automatically lower sound and sticker animations during calmer moments  

---

Moments Playback  
· Review photos and short clips by timeline  
· Save and favorite your cherished moments  
· Create keepsake cards from your photos  
· View photos, dates, and notes on the special days’ summary page  

---

Hevlo focuses purely on capturing, reviewing, and treasuring memories. It does not include public communities or interactions with strangers. Every small moment of your baby deserves to be captured with care and gentleness.

name: heyAlicia: AI tutor
description:
Your notes. Your tutor.

heyAlicia teaches from the material you already have. Snap pages of your notes, pick a PDF, Word document or slide deck, paste text, or add an audio or video recording of a lecture. Alicia, your friendly tutor, turns it into a study path with lessons, flashcards and quizzes, section by section.

LEARN FROM YOUR OWN MATERIAL
• Add photos of notes and textbook pages, PDFs, EPUB, Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), plain text or Markdown files, or pasted text.
• Add a lecture: audio or video recordings (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, WebM, MP4, MOV) are transcribed and split into sections.
• Each material becomes a study path: a lesson, flashcards and a quiz for every section.

LESSONS THAT MAKE SENSE
• Short lesson cards with the big idea, key points and worked examples.
• Maths and chemistry are written properly, with step-by-step working.
• Tap Listen to hear a lesson read aloud.

QUIZZES CHECKED AGAINST YOUR TEXT
• Multiple choice, numbers with units, equations, ordering, matching, fill-in-the-blanks, code exercises and more.
• Questions are checked against your material before you see them, and after you answer you see the line from your material the question came from.
• Written answers get AI feedback against a rubric. It is feedback, not a mark.

ASK ALICIA
• Ask anything about your material by typing or talking.
• Answers cite your sources: the section of your notes, or the minute in your lecture recording.
• Push to talk, and have answers read aloud.

REMEMBER IT FOR LONGER
• Spaced review brings back what is due across your materials and flashcards.
• Daily goal, XP, levels, streaks with freezes, and badges.
• Home-screen widgets for your streak, reviews due and what to study next.
• Optional study reminders and a study planner for deadlines and daily study time.

FOR TEACHERS
• Create classes and share a join code or link.
• See assignment progress, class mastery by section and question reports.
• Full class management (rosters, shared materials, assignments) is on heyalicia.app.

FOR PARENTS AND GUARDIANS
• A learner creates a one-time code to link a parent or guardian, and chooses exactly what is shared.
• Guardians see a weekly summary: study minutes, active days, quizzes, streak, tasks done and how each subject is going.
• Guardians never see conversations with Alicia, voice recordings, uploaded materials, exact answers or points.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your materials stay in your account. heyAlicia does not train AI on your materials.
• Usage analytics are off unless you opt in. No ads.
• Export your data or delete your account from the app.

PLANS
Start free. Student Pro, Student Plus and Teacher Pro subscriptions raise daily limits for messages, voice and materials. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe.

AI can make mistakes. Check important facts against your material.

Terms: https://heyalicia.app/legal/terms
Privacy: https://heyalicia.app/legal/privacy

Powered by crazinerd.com

name: HeyBias: Learn Korean Alphabet
description:
Start learning Hangul, the Korean alphabet, from your very first letter.

HeyBias is a gentle Hangul starter for English speakers, made with K-pop and K-culture fans in mind. Hear every letter, trace it stroke by stroke, snap letters together into blocks, and read real words, all in English with romanization.

HOW IT WORKS
  • Letters: Meet the 24 basic letters. Hear the sound, see the romanization and an example word, and trace the strokes with your finger.
  • Blocks: Choose a consonant, snap a vowel onto it, write the block, then read real words that use it. 140 blocks to start.
  • Final sounds: See how the letter under a block works. Just seven sounds cover them all. Listening only, with more to learn later.
  • Fan Board (just for fun): Once you know a few letters, put them together into a short message and show it on a full-screen LED banner. Romanization appears under your text.

GOOD TO KNOW
  • iPhone only, in landscape mode.
  • Works fully offline. Sounds and words are built in, spoken by a synthetic Korean voice.
  • No accounts, no ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.
  • A starting point, not the whole language: the letters, blocks without a final consonant, and an introduction to final sounds.
  • HeyBias is an independent app and is not affiliated with any artist, group, or agency.

Support and privacy: https://heybias.mumuworks.app

name: Hi Bamboo Flute
description:
Hi Bamboo Flute is an interactive 6-hole C5 bamboo flute simulator, fingering guide, and step-by-step learning companion designed for iPhone.

Whether you are picking up the Vietnamese bamboo flute (Sáo Trúc C5) for the first time or practicing melodies on the go, Hi Bamboo Flute turns your iPhone screen into an expressive, low-latency acoustic woodwind instrument.

KEY FEATURES

• Expressive Touch-Optimized Virtual Flute
Overcomes mobile multi-touch limitations with intelligent playing modes:
- Dual R1/R2 Flutes: Side-by-side low-octave (R1) and high-octave (R2) bamboo tubes for instant two-octave melodies without octave-button switching.
- 2-Finger Flow (Cascade): Touch the lowest closed hole and all upper holes close automatically for effortless sliding.
- Smart 5+6 Bridge & Dedicated Si (○) Blowhole: Play all 14 notes (C5 to B6) comfortably on any screen size.

• 6 Distinct Flute Voices (4 Pure-Code DSP Synths + 2 CC0 SoundFonts)
- Trúc Diệp · Dizi Membrane (Synth v4): Traditional bamboo flute with vibrating dimo membrane harmonics and expressive vibrato.
- Sơn Cốc · Pan Flute Pipe (Synth v3): Hollow closed-pipe acoustics with warm odd-harmonic resonance and gentle chiff attack.
- Ngân Tiêu · Concert Flute (Synth v2): Rich concert flute harmonic envelope with 3D phase dispersion.
- Mộc Trúc · Pure Bamboo (Synth v1): Warm, organic fundamental bamboo tone.
- Real CC0 Sampled Dizi & VSCO Concert Flute voices.

• 30 Structured Step-by-Step Lessons
- 4 progressive chapters taking you from your first notes (Si, La, Sol) to full two-octave transitions and folk melodies.
- Anti-skip step lock and mistake tracking with 1–3 star accuracy ratings.

• 21 Built-In Folk & Classical Songs + Custom Song & MIDI Importer
- Practice with scrolling 5-line Treble Sheet Music (complete with rests, dotted notes, slurs, and grace/trill articulations) or Falling Notes view.
- Switch notation labels anytime between Western (C D E), Vietnamese Solfège (Đô Rê Mi), and Numbered Jianpu (1 2 3).
- Import your own Vietnamese "Cảm âm" notation or Standard MIDI (.mid) files.
- Record your flute performance directly inside the app and replay anytime.

100% Offline • No Account Required • No Ads or Tracking.

name: Hide: Photo, Video & Doc Vault
description:
Your iPhone passcode opens your iPhone. It shouldn’t open your private life.

Hide is a calm, beautiful place for the photos, videos, documents and notes that are only yours. Behind a lock of its own, and safely backed up in the EU.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE HIDE
• A lock of its own: Face ID or your Hide password, never your iPhone passcode
• An extra 4-digit code for your most private folders
• Locks the moment you leave – the app switcher shows only the logo
• Lose your iPhone, not your memories: sign in on a new one and everything comes back
• No ads. No tracking.

EVERYTHING PRIVATE, IN ONE PLACE
• Move photos, Live Photos and videos out of your library
• Hide checks every copy before you delete an original
• A built-in camera: shots go straight into Hide, never into Photos
• IDs, contracts and PDFs from the Files app
• Notes with checklists, colors and pins
• Folders with ready-made templates for IDs, health, travel and more
• Search, favorites and a 30-day trash

DISCREET BY DESIGN
• Veil the covers on your start page with one switch
• Content disappears from screen recordings
• Painted app icons that don’t look like a vault (Hide Plus)
• A short guide to hiding Hide from your Home Screen

MADE TO FEEL LIKE A QUIET GALLERY
Impressionist paintings, gentle motion and a design that feels at home on iPhone. Opening Hide feels like a deep breath, not like opening a safe.

FREE OR HIDE PLUS
Start free with 50 photos, 10 videos, 10 files, 10 notes and 2 GB. Hide Plus gives you unlimited items, 25 GB of storage, the document scanner and the painted icons. Viewing, exporting and backing up always keep working – your memories are never locked away from you.

Try Hide Plus free for 7 days with the yearly plan.

• Hide Plus is available monthly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

name: HIIT Rounds: Interval Timer
description:
Rounds is the interval timer that stays out of your way. Press Start, then let go: voice cues, haptics and sound carry the whole workout, and huge full-color numerals are readable from across the room.

READY-MADE WORKOUTS
Tabata (20/10 × 8), Classic HIIT, EMOM 10, Boxing Rounds, Sprint 30/30, Core Burner, Quick Sweat and Endurance. Start one in a tap or tweak it in seconds.

BUILD YOUR OWN
Stack named exercises, each with its own work and rest intervals and number of rounds. Add a warm-up and cool-down, repeat the whole circuit, and give every workout its own icon and color. See the full timeline before you start.

READABLE FROM THE MAT
The whole screen changes color with every phase, so one glance tells you whether to push or recover. Pick from six timer layouts and five color themes.

VOICE, HAPTICS AND SOUND
Spoken cues announce every phase and the next exercise. Countdown beeps and haptic taps keep you on time with the phone face down, and your music keeps playing.

APPLE WATCH AND LIVE ACTIVITIES
Follow the current interval on your wrist, on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

HISTORY, STREAKS AND SHARING
Every session lands in a calendar with total time, work and rest split, effort and notes. Keep your streak alive and share a summary card with friends.

ROUNDS PRO
Free: every preset, up to 3 custom workouts and the last 7 days of history. Pro unlocks unlimited custom workouts, voice cues, all themes and timer layouts, full history, Live Activities and the Apple Watch app. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://dzionis.by/rounds/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://dzionis.by/rounds/terms.html

name: Hijri Calendar 2027 – Ayyam
description:
Ayyam is a Hijri calendar for 2027 (1448 AH) that keeps the Islamic date and the Gregorian date side by side, so you always know what day it is in both.

Open the app and today's Hijri date is the first thing you see, along with the Gregorian date, the current week and how many days are left in the month. No sign-up, no location permission, and everything works offline.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Hijri date today: the day, the month and the year in large type, with the matching Gregorian date.
• Hijri and Gregorian calendar: browse by month or by year in either system. Every day shows both dates.
• Islamic months: the whole Hijri year, Muharram to Dhu al-Hijjah, with the Gregorian start of every month.
• Ramadan 2027 and Eid countdown: see how many days remain until the first of Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, the Day of Arafah, Eid al-Adha, the Hijri New Year, Ashura, Mawlid, Isra and Mi'raj, Mid-Sha'ban and Laylat al-Qadr.
• Sunnah fasting days on the calendar: Mondays and Thursdays, the White Days (13th to 15th), Arafah, Ashura, the six days of Shawwal and Ramadan are marked for you.
• Islamic date converter: convert a Gregorian date to Hijri or a Hijri date to Gregorian, and get the weekday too.
• Hijri age calculator: enter a birth date in either calendar and see your age in Hijri years and in Gregorian years.
• Home screen widget: today's Hijri date without opening the app.
• Reminders on your device: a notice at 6 pm the evening before a new month, an event or a fasting day. You choose which ones.

A CALENDAR THAT MATCHES WHERE YOU LIVE

Hijri months do not start on the same day everywhere. Ayyam lets you pick the source you follow and uses it for the calendar, the converter, the events, the reminders and the widget:

• The Umm al-Qura calendar, the civil calendar of Saudi Arabia, for the years 1356 to 1500 AH.
• Indonesia: the Ministry of Religious Affairs (Kemenag) calendar and the Muhammadiyah global Hijri calendar (KHGT) for 1448 AH.
• Published announcements for France, Saudi Arabia, Morocco and Algeria.

Dates that have not been announced yet are labelled "Estimated", and each event links to the publication it comes from. If your community saw the moon a day earlier or later, shift every date by one day in Settings.

MADE TO BE READ

A clean, paper-like design with large numerals, light and dark themes, and full support for English, French, Indonesian and Arabic, including right-to-left layout.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Ayyam needs no account and never asks for your location. The calendar tables are stored in the app, so it works without an internet connection.

Ayyam is a date tool. Estimated dates can change after a local moon sighting, so please confirm important dates with your local authority.

name: hikeNocular
description:
hikeNocular is binoculars for hikers. Point your iPhone at the mountains and see the names of peaks and the lines of nearby hiking trails drawn right on your camera view.

HOW IT WORKS
- Hold your phone flat, line up the nearest compass direction, tap Ready, then lift your phone.
- Peak names and trails appear over the real mountains.
- If a label is off, tap Orient and swipe to line the green ridge line up with the real skyline.
- Tap a trail to see its name, distance, and difficulty.
- Tap a peak to see it in 3D terrain.

BUILT FOR THE TRAIL
- Covers the lower 48 states and loads only the area around you.
- Save an area for offline use before you leave signal.
- No account. No ads. No tracking. Free.

HONEST LIMITS
hikeNocular is not a navigation tool. Always carry a map, check the weather and trail conditions, and tell someone where you are going. Compass accuracy varies by phone, and trail data can be incomplete or out of date. Alaska and Hawaii are not included yet.

DATA CREDITS
Trails and peaks: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Terrain: USGS 3DEP and Mapzen/Terrarium. Weather: Open-Meteo and the U.S. National Weather Service.

name: Hill Barn Golf Club
description:
Discover Hill Barn Golf Club

Whether you're looking to enjoy a round of golf, learn more about the club or stay informed about what's happening, the Hill Barn Golf Club app is your convenient connection to the course.

Download the official Hill Barn Golf Club app today and enjoy being part of our golfing community in Worthing, West Sussex.

name: HIN It: Free Boat VIN Check
description:
HIN It decodes a boat's Hull Identification Number (HIN) — the 12-character "VIN" stamped on every boat — right on your phone, free, with no account.

Thinking about a used boat? In seconds you get:
- The builder's code and likely builder
- The month and year it was built
- The model year
- A validity check that flags a mistyped — or altered — hull number (an altered HIN can be a stolen-boat red flag)

Then one tap takes you to the official, free government sources for the records a paid "boat history report" charges for:
- USCG builder (MIC) registry — who a builder code belongs to
- USCG documented-vessel search
- USCG boat recalls and safety defects
- Your state's boating agency for registration, title and liens

Honest about the limits: there is no free national boat-history database. HIN It does not provide ownership, accident, title or theft history — no free source does for boats — and it tells you plainly where to check (your state agency, a marine survey, law enforcement).

Free forever. No ads, no account, nothing to buy. Works offline. Not affiliated with the US Coast Guard, the NICB, or any report seller.

name: HingeSweep
description:
HingeSweep turns measured panel geometry into an interactive two-dimensional sweep check.

Create a project with a pivot point, panel length, starting angle and travel. Add rectangular obstacles and a chosen clearance, then move through the rotation on a scaled plan. Read current contacts, inspect each contact interval and compare saved alternatives.

Keep a frozen report of the geometry and results. Reopen reports independently of later project edits, preview a PDF and share a CSV containing the recorded values.

FEATURES
• Metric and inch inputs with a consistent coordinate system
• Interactive angle controls, panel endpoint coordinates and contact intervals
• Searchable local projects and independent report snapshots
• Editable Cabinet corner example with checkable results
• PDF and CSV exports using the system sharing controls

HingeSweep uses a zero-thickness line segment and axis-aligned rectangles. Entered clearance expands the obstacle along both axes. Results describe a planar geometric model. Material thickness, deformation and hardware specifications require their own evaluation.

name: History Tiles
description:
History Tiles is a gentle daily quiz about what happened on this date in history. Each date is a board of nine tiles, one for each year, running from oldest to newest. Turn a tile over, read the clue, and pick one of four answers. The tile turns green if you are right and red if you are not, and a short note tells you more about the moment.

Some rounds show an old photograph or painting; others ask you to pick the right portrait from four. A full board takes about three minutes, and you will often learn something you can tell someone at dinner.

What you get:
• Nine moments for each day, each with four clear answer choices
• A short note after every answer, with its sources named
• Historic pictures, each credited in the app
• A calendar on the front page, so you can go back and play days you missed
• Your days played, current streak and best streak, kept on your phone
• A score you can share with family and friends, without spoilers
• Its own music and sounds, with a button to turn the music off
• Light and dark looks that follow your phone's setting

No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. Your scores stay on your phone. The games already in the app play without an internet connection.

Questions are written in our own words from published sources.

History Tiles is made by Olivia Beauty LLC, the team behind Heads or Tiles.

Terms: https://headsortiles.com/tiles-terms/
Privacy: https://headsortiles.com/tiles-privacy/

name: Hitron
description:
HİTRON ile yeni nesil interaktif 3B oyun duvarlarını keşfet, arkadaşlarınla yarış ve rekorları kır!

HİTRON mobil uygulaması, parklar, AVM'ler, spor merkezleri ve eğlence alanlarındaki HİTRON interaktif oyun duvarlarıyla saniyeler içinde bağlantı kurmanı sağlar.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER
• Haritada Saha Keşfi: Sana en yakın HİTRON oyun duvarlarını anlık çevrimiçi durumuyla harita üzerinde görüntüle ve tek dokunuşla yol tarifi al.
• 13 Farklı 3B Duvar Oyunu: Kalede Hedef Avı, Uzay İstilası, Balon Patlatma, Dev SOS, Canavar Şef, Refleks, Sürat Şampiyonu ve daha fazlası.
• QR ile Anında Bağlan: Duvardaki QR kodu okut, oyun modunu ve süresini seç, saniyeler içinde oyuna başla.
• Misafir Olarak Keşfet: Giriş yapmadan haritayı, sahaları ve tüm oyun kurallarını incele; yalnızca oyun başlatmak istediğinde SMS doğrulamasıyla güvenle giriş yap.
• Kişisel Bildirimler: Yeni oyun duvarları, etkinlikler ve skor bildirimlerinden anında haberdar ol.

name: Hlanemkt
description:
Our app is the studio book for money you are still waiting on, and for renewals you want to remember.

Today opens on what is still to collect. Jobs live on a client file, grouped by the day they come due or by the person who owes them. When money arrives, log a receipt and place every cent on the jobs you include. Oldest due date first, or an even split. The receipt cannot be saved until it is fully placed. Void it later and those amounts return to the jobs. The line stays in the history.

Renewals are reminders at the price written in the book. They are not charges to a bank. Mark how often you use one, pause it, or change the amount and the next date. Only the book changes. The calendar marks a job in blue and a renewal in amber, and a day can carry both. The read turns the year into categories, shows what you have collected, and adds up what the rarely used plans would leave in the year.

The first launch is a sample studio for Andrea Cole, already filled with clients, jobs, receipts, and renewals, so the book is full before you change it. Settings can switch the greeting among four studio names, the currency sign, the week start, a night desk, haptics, and motion. Reset the sample studio puts the original book back.

Folio stays on this device. There is no account, no cloud copy, and no place to type a note. Amounts use the on-screen pad. Client and service names come from the sample studio and the service list.

name: Hoagie Haus App
description:
Hoagie Haus is a food truck serving pizza, hoagies and rolls, made fresh to order. We serve New Braunfels, San Marcos, Seguin and San Antonio, at lunch spots, parks, breweries and events all week.

The Hoagie Haus app shows you where to find us and what's cooking.

FIND THE TRUCK
- See whether we're open now, later today, or where our next stop is, right on the home screen.
- Browse the whole week's schedule, day by day, with times and addresses.
- Tap any address to get directions in your maps app.

THE MENU
- Hoagies, pizza and pizza rolls, with descriptions and prices.
- See our most popular items, including the Tejano Cheesesteak and our 14 inch New York style pizzas.
- Tap Order online to order ahead on hoagiehaus.com.

NEVER MISS A STOP
- Turn on alerts and we'll let you know when a new stop is added to the schedule.

HOAGIE HAUS REWARDS
- Create a free Rewards account with your first name and email.
- Tap Order with Rewards, order on hoagiehaus.com with the same email, and earn points on every dollar.
- Rate your order and tell us how we did.
- Reach 100 points and claim a free hoagie or pizza.
- Delete your account any time from Your account.

LEAVE US A REVIEW
- Enjoyed your food? Leave a Google review in a tap, or show a QR code so a friend can scan it.

Rewards is optional: you can browse the menu and schedule without an account. The app doesn't ask for your location and has no ads.

Have a food allergy? Please tell us before you order.

name: Holiday Crowds
description:
Holiday Crowds shows how busy Central Ohio's favorite holiday events are before you leave the house.

See at a glance which events are quiet right now, which are packed, and when tonight should calm down. For each event you get:

• Crowd now: a live reading as a percent of that event's usual peak, from anonymous phone data and check-ins by people who are there
• Tonight hour by hour: the quietest and busiest times
• The week ahead: the next seven open nights, adjusted for weather
• Traffic on the roads in: every approach colored green, yellow or red by its delay right now
• Drive time from you, only when you ask
• Weather from the National Weather Service

This season: Christkindlmarkt Dublin, Wildlights at the Columbus Zoo, Legendary Lights of Clifton Mill, and Fantasy of Lights at Alum Creek State Park.

At an event? Check in and tap how busy it is. It takes two seconds, helps everyone else, and needs no account.

Season Pass (optional, one-time purchase): get a notification when an event you pick gets quieter, all season long.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location is used only on your iPhone, and only when you check in or ask for your drive time.

Holiday Crowds is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any event, venue or organizer.
