Terms of Use: https://poller-production-ba065189.up.railway.app/terms

name: Home Cleaning Schedule: Britey
description:
Britey is a calm, simple house cleaning schedule. Add your rooms and chores, tick things off with one tap, and see at a glance what needs attention. No overwhelming checklists, no guilt.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your rooms and a few chores for each. Britey suggests short, hand-picked chores; you choose what to keep.
• Every chore repeats on your schedule: every few days, weeks or months.
• Each room shows a simple bar of how much needs doing, so you can see where to start.
• Tap "Just did it" when you finish a chore. Made a mistake? Undo it right away.
• The Due tab gathers everything that needs doing today, across all your rooms.

GENTLE REMINDERS
• One daily reminder at the time you pick, only on days when something is due. No nagging on quiet days.

A STREAK THAT'S KIND
• Build a streak with skip days that protect it when life gets busy.
• Celebrate milestones along the way.

KEEP YOUR HOME SAFE
• Your home is saved automatically and works offline.
• Optional Sign in with Apple lets you get your home back on a new phone. No passwords, no account needed to start.
• Export your history any time, and delete your data from Settings whenever you like.

FREE
• Up to 3 rooms with unlimited chores
• Due list, daily reminder, chore history
• Streak with skip days
• Backup and restore with Sign in with Apple
• Export your data

BRITEY PREMIUM
• Unlimited rooms
• Add people to give chores to, even kids without a phone, and see who did what
• Reminders for any chore, at the time you choose
• Vacation mode: pause everything while you're away, without breaking your streak
• Insights: see what got done by week, room and person
• Color themes with matching app icons
• More to come

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial, if you start one). The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Everyone in your Apple Family can use Premium on their own iPhone with Family Sharing.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://britey.app/privacy/

Questions? hello@britey.app, a real person answers within 48 hours.

name: Home Friday
description:
Home Friday connects your iPhone to your private Friday workspace. Reopen conversations, organize notes and board cards, and check scheduled and manual workflow runs from one place.

Hosted access is invite-only. Sign in with Apple or Google, then connect the private GitHub repository assigned to your workspace. Friday remembers the workspace on this device and lets you sign out from Settings. AI replies require a model provider configured for your workspace.

name: Hominin Wars
description:
45,000 years ago, six kinds of human meet on the same land.
Send gatherers out for food and wood, build a village, advance through the ages, raise warriors and drive the other peoples away. Everything happens in real time.

Hominin Wars is a real-time strategy game set in the Stone Age. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. It plays fully offline, start to finish.

The game is in Korean.

SIX HUMANS, SIX WAYS TO FIGHT
- Homo sapiens: fast, cheap research and ranged warfare. Unique unit: Atlatl Hunter
- Neanderthals: the strongest at close quarters. Unique unit: Cave Bear Hunter
- Denisovans: masters of hills and stone, with strong watchtowers. Unique unit: Snow Stalker
- Homo erectus: cheap gatherers, big numbers, and attacks that set buildings on fire. Unique unit: Torchbearer
- Homo floresiensis: small, fast islanders who hit and run. Unique unit: Shadow Hunter
- Homo naledi: cheap, tough buildings and walls to hold behind. Unique unit: Cave Guardian

GATHER, BUILD, ADVANCE
Gather food, wood, stone and flint from forests, berry bushes, game, fish and rock piles. Raise 15 kinds of buildings, from huts and gathering camps to the warriors' fire, hunters' lodge, wolf pen, toolmaker, watchtowers, palisades, stone walls and the painted cave, and advance from the Lower Paleolithic through the Middle and Upper Paleolithic into the Neolithic. 17 technologies include hide clothing, cooperative hunting, the Levallois technique, blade tools, wolf taming and farming.

KNOW YOUR COUNTERS
Clubmen, spearmen, javelin throwers, archers, tamed wolves, log rams and shamans who convert enemies. Spears beat wolves and beasts, wolves beat archers, archers beat infantry, rams break buildings. Woolly mammoths and steppe bison are big game; cave bears and cave lions attack first.

TWO WAYS TO WIN
- Drive out every other people
- Build the megalithic temple in the Neolithic and hold it for 200 seconds

YOUR KIND OF MATCH
One to three opponents, three difficulty levels and three maps: Rift Valley Plains, Lake Country and Ice Age Forest. Computer opponents build different armies for each species and gather into waves before they attack.

MADE FOR FINGERS
Tap to select; with something selected, tap the ground, a resource or an enemy to move, gather or attack. Drag with one finger to move the view and pinch to zoom. Buttons for idle gatherers, the whole army and an all-out attack are always on screen. Turn on the Advisor and it handles the village chores (placing gatherers, training more, building huts) so you can focus on the fight. Designed for iPhone held sideways.

ALSO
- A short guide for your first game (close it any time, replay it from the menu)
- Saves every 30 seconds and when you leave the app; continue where you left off
- Game speed control and pause
- High, medium and low graphics; steps down by itself if your iPhone struggles
- In-game help with all controls and rules

The six humans living side by side, and their abilities, are adapted for the game.

name: Hoodsight: OBD2 Car Scanner
description:
Hoodsight reads what your car's computers report through an OBD-II adapter, explains each fault with the evidence behind it, and says plainly when it cannot see something.

Connect
Plug a Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi ELM327-compatible adapter into the OBD-II port under the dashboard. Hoodsight finds it and tests it with Adapter Doctor. Clone adapters that misbehave stay read-only. Classic Bluetooth adapters cannot work with iPhone or iPad.

Fault codes
• Stored, pending and permanent codes from every emissions-related control unit
• Freeze frame data saved at the moment a fault was set
• Readiness monitors, to see whether the car is ready for an emissions test
• A safe clear that refuses while the car is moving and then checks which codes came back

Live data
Gauge dashboards for the readings your car supports, such as RPM, coolant temperature, fuel trims and oxygen sensors, plus a browser for every supported parameter.

AI Mechanic
Rules built into Hoodsight connect codes, freeze frame and live readings into likely causes, and each cause lists the evidence it rests on. On devices with Apple Intelligence the summary is written on device. Your scans and readings are not uploaded.

Used-car inspection
Before you buy, Hoodsight compares the VIN across control units, looks for recently cleared codes and incomplete monitors, checks the odometer against the ECU where the car reports it, and records calibration IDs.

History
Every scan, clear and inspection is saved per vehicle, on your device.

Try it without a car
A labelled simulator with six scenarios, including a misfire, a lean mixture and recently cleared codes, shows every screen before you own an adapter.

What it reads
Generic OBD-II reaches the engine and emissions control units. ABS, airbag and body modules are shown as not accessible instead of guessed.

Hoodsight Pro
Hoodsight Pro adds the Fuel & air and Temperatures dashboards, your own dashboard with any parameter, unlimited safe clears and unlimited AI Mechanic questions. Without Pro you get the Daily dashboard, one safe clear and three AI Mechanic questions per day.

Use Hoodsight only with the car parked. Results show what the car's computers report and are not a professional inspection.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.cihat.dev/hoodsight/privacy-policy/

name: Hook Stub
description:
Hook Stub is a coat-rail tally you keep on your iPhone. You write a coat name and a stub number from 1 to 40 on one ticket, drag that stub onto an open hook, and later flick a plate up or down until the number matches. The phone then shows which hook is holding that coat.

The rail has six hooks. A hook that already has a coat will not take another stub. The stub you have not hung yet stays in hand, and its number cannot be reused by a coat that is already hanging. Taking a stub down returns that hook to open. Nothing is sent off the phone. There is no account, no sign-in, and no payment.

Open the Rail tab to see every hook. Write a stub, hang it, then look at the Stubs list for the coat, the hook, and the number. The Dial tab is the plate: drag it up to add one and down to subtract one. Forty-eight points of travel change the number by one, and the plate springs back. When the number matches a hanging stub, the sentence names the hook.

name: Hoop Flick: Basketball Shots
description:
Pull back, aim and shoot for the perfect swish!

Hoop Flick is a simple, satisfying basketball shooting game. Drag back from the ball, see where it goes and let go. Make the goal number of baskets before you run out of balls. Clean swishes build combos, and later levels bring hoops that move up and down.

FEATURES
• Easy pull-back shooting with a short aim guide
• Swish combos and satisfying net physics
• Moving hoops for a real challenge
• Fun ball skins: beach ball, melon, galaxy and more
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Play offline

Hoop Flick is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Hop Bitter
description:
Hop Bitter reads each addition, the kettle gravity, and the volume.

Bitterness for a late addition is smaller than the same hop at the start of the boil. A zero-minute addition is aroma only. The total is marked in range, below, or above the style band.

Hops and saved boils stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Hoppin Club
description:
Hoppin is one shared place for a group trip.

The people you approve can see the days, the map, the money, and the documents. Someone who is not in the trip cannot.
Days is the plan, one day at a time. The map shows the stops. Money is who paid and who owes whom. The amounts are notes the group types. Nothing is charged. Documents are tickets and other files for that trip.
A copy of the trip stays on the phone, so the plan still opens with no signal.
SOS lets you alert your group if you need help. It includes your location only if you choose to share it.
Share my plan makes a read-only page of your days for family back home.
Posters are drawn on the phone. Photos picked for a poster stay on the phone and are not uploaded.

You sign in with your email and a password. You can delete the account from Account, then Delete my account. The privacy page says what that removes, and what stays with the group.

name: Horseshoe Forge
description:
Step into a traditional blacksmith workshop and replace a horse's shoe.

Horseshoe Forge is a hands-on 3D simulation. Remove the old nails, clean and file the hoof, shape the new shoe on the anvil, punch the nail holes, and set the shoe with fresh nails. Follow the full sequence at your own pace.

• Complete six-step farrier workflow
• 3D tools, hoof, anvil, and forge
• Guided tool switching and camera control
• Original workshop atmosphere
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Hotel Elsewhen
description:
Every clock in the lobby tells a different time. Under the chandelier, the concierge holds out the last room key. Take the night shift at Hotel Elsewhen. Somewhere in its 200 rooms, morning has gone missing.

Explore before you fight. A glint under a desk might be a tool. A carving in the next room might be the clue that opens a keepsake cabinet. Your satchel keeps what you find as the hotel slips further from the familiar. Listen for tubular bells as you search. When the guests turn on you, the music changes with them.

Move freely in first person. Slide your left thumb to dodge behind furniture and swipe with your right to turn and aim. Hold FIRE to keep shooting as guests emerge from cabinets, doorways and hatches. Earn eight weapons as you progress through ten wings.

Take the night shift alone or pass one iPhone or iPad among two to four players. Everyone faces the same room. Defeated enemies and damage dealt decide the winner. The Rogues’ Gallery keeps local scores, and you can delete individual entries.

One purchase includes all 200 rooms. Play offline. Your campaign, clues and keepsakes save on the device you play on.

name: Hotel Kefi
seller_name: ASPECT BILISIM HIZMETLERI VE DANISMANLIK ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
The first guests are on their way to Hotel Kefi. Get their keys ready, give them a room, and bring a little life back to a hotel by the sea.

Swipe matching pieces together at reception to make the room keys your guests need. Check them in and see them settle into their rooms. When a stay ends, collect the bill and put the earnings back into the hotel.

• Furnish rooms with new bedding and open up more places for guests to stay.
• Work a restaurant shift, merging ingredients into the snacks and drinks your guests have ordered.
• Get to know the regulars as their visits unfold, from Kyria Daphne to Captain Nikos.

name: Hours for Good
description:
Hours for Good was founded on a simple idea: finding somewhere to volunteer should not be difficult.

As high school students, we know how challenging it can be to find meaningful volunteer opportunities. Many students want to give back to their communities but simply do not know where to begin. We created Hours for Good to change that.

Our platform connects high school students with nonprofits across five areas of service: Hunger, Education, Care, Environment, and Connections.

With Hours for Good, you can:

• Discover volunteer opportunities in your community
• Track the status of your applications 
• Log and verify your community service hours
• Earn badges and celebrate your volunteering milestones
• Recommend nonprofits to be added to our growing network

Nonprofits can also join our platform to connect with student volunteers, manage applications, and verify service hours.

Founded in Greenwich, Connecticut, Hours for Good aims to make volunteering more accessible to students across the country while supporting the organizations that make our communities stronger.

We believe that volunteering should be more than fulfilling a school requirement. It should be an opportunity to discover your interests, build meaningful connections, and make a lasting impact in your community.

name: HouseBuddies App
description:
Stop forgetting what’s in your fridge—and stop buying duplicates. HouseBuddies is the all-in-one household pantry, grocery run, and gathering planner built for couples, roommates, and families.

Whether you share a condo with a partner, split groceries with housemates, or manage a busy family kitchen, HouseBuddies keeps everyone’s supplies, shopping cart, and meal plans in sync in real time.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH HOUSEBUDDIES

• FEFO Pantry & Batch Expiry Tracking
Organize food, toiletries, and cleaning supplies by location and labels. Batch-level First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) badges highlight what to use first, with quick Use 1, Use amount, and Out of stock actions so nothing spoils unnoticed at the back of the shelf.

• Smart Shopping Cart & Budget Estimates
Out-of-stock essentials and items expiring soon can land on your Shopping Cart automatically. Add extra items manually with preferred store and expected price, track your estimated checkout budget, and mark items bought as you shop.

• Grocery Run Transactions & Store Price History
Back from the store? Log an entire grocery trip as a single auditable run (#GR-XXXX) with purchase date, expiry dates, store, and prices. Review past runs anytime, compare store prices, and revert accidental checkouts in one tap.

• Real-Time Household Sharing & Switcher
Invite a housemate or partner with a 6-character invite code (HB-XXXXXX) or share link (up to 2 members free per household). Belong to multiple homes? Switch between households anytime and track a clear per-item activity trail of Used, Restocked, and Deleted actions.

• Buddy AI Cooking Assistant
Staring at an open fridge wondering what to cook? Buddy AI reads your live pantry—prioritizing expiring-soon food and skipping non-food items—to suggest tailored recipes with Smart Swaps, follow-up tweaks, YouTube recipe search, one-tap missing-ingredient cart additions, and FEFO stock deduction. Every account starts with 5 free AI Cooking trial generations and 5 free saved recipes.

• HouseBuddies Events (Gathering Planner)
Planning a dinner, potluck, or weekend trip? Create an event (up to 2 active events free), invite guests via link without exposing your household inventory, delegate items and tasks (My Run & My Tasks), track actual costs, and wrap up with a Final Report.

• Interactive Guest Preview
Not ready to sign up yet? Browse the interactive sample pantry right away as a guest to see how HouseBuddies works.

Need help or have feedback? Reach us at dev.rhymartmanchus@gmail.com or visit https://housebuddies.app.

name: HousUp: Property Reports
description: HousUp shows homeowners what the property they already own could become — a backyard home, an addition, a garage conversion — with a free preliminary report built from public records: what the city allows, what could fit, and a planning cost range. Real estate agents use the app to request reports for clients, track them, and stay their clients' agent from the first question to the finished project. When a homeowner asks, HousUp introduces a licensed participating builder for their area. HousUp doesn't build and sets no price; any price comes from the builder, in writing. HousUp is operated by HousUp LLC, Everett, Washington. Privacy: housup.com/privacy · Terms: housup.com/terms.

name: HR On-Prem
description:
HR On-Prem is the mobile companion for organisations that run their HR system on their own server (on-premise). Your company's data stays on your company's server — the app connects directly to it.

GETTING STARTED
Enter the company code or server address your HR administrator gives you, then sign in with your work email and password. The app shows your company's own name and branding.

ATTENDANCE
• Clock in and out from your phone
• See your distance from the office and whether you are inside the allowed range
• Monthly attendance calendar: present, late, half day, leave and holidays
• Request regularisation for missed or wrong punches

LEAVES
• Check your leave balance by type
• Apply for leave in a few taps and follow its status
• Managers approve or reject team requests on the go

PAYROLL
• View your monthly salary slips with gross and net pay
• Download salary slips as PDF

SHIFTS & HOLIDAYS
• Your shift schedule for the week and month
• Company holiday calendar

RECRUITMENT (for HR teams)
• Jobs, applications, interview schedules and offer letters in one place

TEAM
• Employee directory with departments and designations
• Employee profiles, letters and appreciations

NOTIFICATIONS
• Get notified about approvals, requests and updates

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Works only over HTTPS with your organisation's own server
• Your account is created and managed by your HR administrator

HR On-Prem requires an account from an organisation that uses the on-premise HR system. Contact your HR administrator for your company code and login.

name: Huella: mapa de viajes
description:
Huella es tu mapa de viajes. Marca los países y las ciudades que conoces y mira tu mundo en un globo, con tus cifras.

TU MAPA
• Marca cada país como conocido, donde viviste o al que quieres ir.
• Agrega ciudades y pueblos (más de 200 mil, también los chicos), con la fecha, una nota y tus fotos.
• Regiones, estados y provincias de 25 países: Chile, Argentina, Perú, México, Estados Unidos, España, Italia, Japón y más.

TUS VIAJES
• Huella arma tus viajes con tus lugares y sus fechas.
• Cada viaje tiene su mapa con la ruta, sus ciudades y tus fotos.
• Ponles nombre, días y ordénalos como quieras.

TU MUNDO EN NÚMEROS
• Cuántos de los 195 países conoces y qué parte del mundo.
• Por continente, tus récords y cuántas vueltas al mundo llevas.
• Tu pasaporte, con sellos que ganas al viajar y una imagen para compartir.

QUIERO IR
• Arma tu lista de destinos y mira qué tan lejos te quedan.

TU MAPA, SEGURO
Tu mapa se guarda en tu cuenta: lo ves igual en tu iPhone y en tuhuella.vercel.app, y funciona sin internet. Sin anuncios y sin rastreadores.

Hecho en Chile

name: Hummr: Hum to Song
description:
Hummr turns the ideas in your head into songs.

Hum a melody, beatbox a beat or sing a line. Hummr hears the notes as you make them and turns your take into an instrument: piano, strings, guitar, synths, drums and more.

Build it up track by track. Add chords that fit your key, play drum pads and keys, chop samples and shape the sound with effects.

Ask the AI co-producer when you're stuck: "make it darker", "add a bassline", "tension before the chorus". It suggests a change you can preview, apply or try again.

Your songs are saved to your account and open on your computer too. Export WAV, MIDI or stems for your other music apps.

Free to use. Hummr Pro adds more co-producer requests and AI accompaniments.

name: Hungry Hole: Swallow It All
description:
Start as a tiny hole, swallow the city and become the biggest hole on the map!

Hungry Hole is a fast io-style arena game. Hold and drag to steer. Anything smaller than you falls in: apples, bikes, cars, houses and finally whole buildings. But you are not alone. Rival holes roam the same city. Swallow the smaller ones and run from the bigger ones before they swallow you!

Each round is a race against the clock. Finish in the top 3 of the live leaderboard to win and unlock the next city.

FEATURES
• Easy one-finger joystick controls
• Rival holes with their own tactics: they hunt, flee and grow
• Live leaderboard and a crown for the biggest hole
• Red arrows warn you about big holes nearby
• City, autumn, desert and snowy maps that grow with every level
• Unlock hole styles: Lava, Toxic, Ice, Candy and Gold
• Play offline

Hungry Hole is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Hurdle Slip
description:
Hurdle Slip keeps a men's 110 m hurdles rep on this iPhone.

Stand the gates and choose the hurdle height: 0.914 m, 0.991 m, or 1.067 m. Lay the marks at 13.72 m to the first, 9.14 m between, and 14.02 m to the tape, or write your own distances. Keep the lane.

Write the finish you are training toward. A mark is a number, not a diagnosis.

After the rep, write one slip: name, reaction, time to the first hurdle, takeoff, touchdown, steps, lead leg, finish, wind, and the gates you hit. The slip adds takeoff and touchdown into the hurdle stride, and it says whether a tailwind above 2.0 m/s is a legal mark.

Open the list and read that slip: the finish, how it sits against your mark, the stride, the wind, and the hits. Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and no network.

name: Hxjy Prit
description:
Build a titan whose next move begins with your decisions.
Hxjy Prit is a puzzle strategy game about assembly, movement patterns and careful testing.

BUILD A TITAN WITH PURPOSE
Choose the parts that shape your titan.
Decide how those parts respond to commands.
Prepare a configuration for the goal of each trial.

NINE CELLS, MANY POSSIBILITIES
Use a three-by-three grid to plan movement.
Arrange a pattern before putting it to the test.
Discover how command choices influence the titan's response.

TEST THE PATTERN
Run a trial and watch the titan react.
Study what worked and where movement went off course.
Keep the titan steady within the trial's limits.
Adjust the setup rather than repeating the same mistake.

SAVE WHAT YOU LEARN
Keep useful movement patterns for later challenges.
Try alternative arrangements when a puzzle becomes harder.
Compare your choices through the results of each test.

NEW ARENAS, NEW DECISIONS
Advance through different arenas as your skills improve.
Work toward the clear objective set by each trial.
Refine part choices, command behavior and grid patterns.
Every success in Hxjy Prit is built one deliberate move at a time.

name: HXZC
description:
HXZC is a paper desk for reading markets and studying how a household book works.

Open on the board. Sixteen invented workshops — a ferry, a kiln, a lamp works, a farmland trust — move on a candle chart drawn on your phone. Sort them by trending, fresh, most held, settled, or the names you keep. Read a bench, open a lane note, and decide whether a name belongs on the shelf at all.

Weigh a name to see how a paper amount would sit inside a $10,000 study book: its share, the spread, and a ten percent step. Pair two workshops and read which one moved more, which swing is calmer, and which float is thinner. Slide to keep the sketch or the pair. Nothing is reserved, nothing is filled, and nothing becomes real money.

The study is a separate shelf: twelve short leaves on balance sheets, candles, spreads, size, drawdown, and leaving a name alone. Each leaf ends in a four-question drill. Marks, streaks, and pinned lines stay in a local ledger beside your paper week.

Harbor Folio is offline. Quotes, sketches, and study progress live on this phone. There is no account, no chat, and no place to enter a message. It is a calm practice book, not advice and not a brokerage.

name: Hydravia
description:
Hydravia turns your daily water into one calm, living glass.

Open the app and a full-screen glass shows today's progress — the water surface moves gently, the percentage floats in large, airy numerals, and every drink you log pours in with a small splash. Bubbles drifting around the glass open everything else: Log, History, Schedule, Stats and Settings.

POUR IN ONE TAP
• Quick-pour chips with your own cup sizes (ml or fl oz)
• Drag the water level inside the glass to preview a drink, then pour it
• Undo any pour from the toast that confirms it

YOUR DRINKS, YOUR WAY
• Water, sparkling, tea, coffee, milk, juice — or add your own with a colour and glyph
• Give each drink a hydration factor you choose, so it counts the way you prefer
• Log any amount, drink, time and an optional note; edit or delete entries any time

A GOAL THAT FITS
• Set your own daily goal, or see a suggestion from your weight, activity and climate (general guidance, not medical advice)
• Goal changes apply from today — past days keep the goal they had

REMINDERS INSIDE YOUR DAY
• Create schedules with a wake-to-sleep window, an interval and the days they apply
• Gentle local reminders arrive only inside your window
• See every reminder time on a 24-hour strip before you save

SEE YOUR RHYTHM
• Weekly bars — tap a day to inspect it
• Monthly heatmap calendar with totals, goal days and your longest run
• Streaks, daily averages and your drink mix
• Share a PDF report, or export CSV and JSON

PRIVATE, OFFLINE-FIRST ACCOUNT
• Create an account with your name, email and password
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works without a connection
• Syncs to your private cloud space when you're online, so a new iPhone picks up where you left off
• Edit your profile, change your password, sign out, or delete your account and its data from Settings
• No ads, no tracking

Need help? Visit the support page or email hydravia1673@gmail.com.

Designed for iPhone in portrait (iOS 13 or later), with light and dark appearances, Dynamic Type-friendly text and Reduce Motion support.

Hydravia is a general wellness app. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition and does not provide medical advice.

name: HydroHalf: Water Drink Tracker
description:
HydroHalf makes building a daily hydration habit feel calm and effortless — no nagging popups or bloated fitness subscriptions.

Log water, tea, or coffee in a single tap and watch your clean hydration ring fill throughout the day.

KEY FEATURES
• One-Tap Custom Cups: Save your favorite bottle, mug, and glass sizes in ml or oz.
• Smart Gentle Reminders: Quiet local notifications scheduled only during your awake hours.
• Clean Daily & Weekly Progress: Visual hydration streaks and intake history at a glance.
• 100% Offline & Private: No login, no ads, no tracking.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock custom beverage hydration factors and full history analytics with one purchase.

name: I Am Sheru Bhai
description:
WELCOME TO THE WORLD OF SHERU BHAI!

Live like a billionaire. Fight like a gangster. Rule like a king!

Enter a massive open-world city as Sheru Bhai, a rich and fearless gangster ready to dominate the streets. Experience the ultimate combination of gangster action, luxury lifestyle, thrilling adventures and free-roaming exploration.

EXPLORE A MASSIVE OPEN WORLD
Discover the city, explore different locations and experience complete freedom.

LIVE THE LUXURY LIFESTYLE
Enjoy the rich gangster lifestyle with luxury surroundings, expensive cars and stylish living.

DRIVE POWERFUL VEHICLES
Get behind the wheel of amazing cars and cruise through the city streets.

EXPERIENCE GANGSTER ACTION
Take on exciting challenges, battles and missions as you build your reputation.

BUILD YOUR CRIME EMPIRE
Rise through the world of crime and establish yourself as a powerful city boss.

YOUR CITY. YOUR RULES. YOUR EMPIRE.

Are you ready to become the legendary Sheru Bhai?

Download now and rule the streets!

name: I-5 Design
description:
I-5 Design is the client portal for I-5 Design Build. It gives casino, restaurant, and hospitality clients a live view of their project — without a pile of emails or a separate login for every tool.

Open the app to see every project you have been invited to. Each one has a clear overview: where the job stands, important dates, and the latest design images. A schedule tab shows the work by day or by week, so you can see what is happening now and what is next. Photos and design renderings appear in the app as they are issued, so you are looking at the same material the project team is using. Project documents stay in one place instead of arriving as attachments. When you need to get in touch, the people on the I-5 team for that job are listed with their roles.

If your project includes a 3D construction-phasing model, you can walk through the planned sequence right on your iPhone or iPad, including a full-screen view. The model is published by I-5 for that job; the app displays it and does not change it.

You can come back anytime to check progress without calling the office for an update.

Access is invite-only. I-5 staff create your login and assign the projects you should see. There is no sign-up in the app. You will only ever see the projects assigned to you — never another client's job. If you work with I-5 on more than one job, they all appear in the same list.

The app is free for invited I-5 clients and staff. It is the companion to the website at portal.i5design.com, and it uses the same login.

name: IA Portafolio ID
description:
IA Portafolio ID es la llave de tu cuenta de IA Portafolio.

Cuando entras a una aplicación de IA Portafolio, la pantalla te muestra un número. Lo escribes aquí, confirmas con tu huella o tu rostro, y entras. Nadie entra por ti aunque conozca tu contraseña.

Con la app puedes:

• Aprobar o rechazar cada inicio de sesión.
• Sacar un código cuando el celular no tiene internet.
• Ver dónde tienes sesiones abiertas y cerrarlas.
• Abrir tus productos sin volver a escribir la contraseña.
• Administrar las personas y los roles de tu organización, si eres administrador.

Las llaves de tu cuenta se crean en el chip de seguridad de tu celular y no salen de él.

Necesitas una cuenta de IA Portafolio que te haya dado tu empresa. La app no crea cuentas.

name: IB Biology Prep: Genemere
description:
IB Biology Prep: Genemere is practice and revision for IB Biology SL and HL. It works offline, with no account.

WHAT IT IS
A study aid with 176 short lessons, 549 original practice questions, 10 interactive labs, 4 guided builds, paper-style mock sets and an Internal Assessment coach. Everything is our own writing, made for revision and practice.

SYLLABUS COVERAGE, HONESTLY
All 40 topics named in the IB Biology subject brief are here, in four themes: A Unity and diversity, B Form and function, C Interaction and interdependence, D Continuity and change. A further section covers skills and the scientific investigation. Every SL topic has at least 8 questions at SL and more at HL; topics that are HL only are marked. This is topic-level coverage in our own words. It is not the official guide, so check the current guide with your teacher.

LEARNS HOW YOU LEARN
- Short quizzes after every lesson. Wrong answers link straight to the idea you missed, with a one-line reason.
- A next-best step on the home screen that tells you why it was chosen: a gap to repair, a recall check, or the next idea in order.
- Mastery estimates for every concept, and recall prompts when something you knew is fading.
- Command-term coach: Define, Explain, Compare, Evaluate and 20 more, with model answers.
- Switch any time between Syllabus view and a build-led Real-World view. Progress is shared.

SEE IT WORK: LABS
Osmosis and water potential, enzyme kinetics, Hardy-Weinberg and selection, protein synthesis in 3D, photosynthesis limiting factors, population models, genetics crosses with chi-squared, membrane transport, the action potential and the Calvin cycle. Change a setting and watch the biology respond.

BUILD SOMETHING
Design a controlled enzyme experiment, model an ecosystem with a limiting factor, trace a trait from DNA to phenotype, design a sampling investigation. Use your own numbers and keep the result on your Made-it shelf.

INTERNAL ASSESSMENT COACH
Stages, a research-question checker, a variables planner and uncertainty basics. It helps you plan your own investigation and never writes it for you.

SL AND HL
Choose your level. HL-only topics and extension questions appear only at HL.

PRACTICE FORMATS
Quick mixed check, Paper 1A style multiple choice, Paper 1B style data-based sets and Paper 2 style short and extended response, with a mark report and study plan.

READABLE
Text size from 50 to 300 percent. An optional Other boards chip shows similar content in GCSE, A Level and AP courses.

FREE AND GENEMERE PLUS
About half of the app is free: all lessons, all questions with feedback and revision links, quizzes of 5 and 10, four labs, one build, quick check, Paper 1A style practice, the command-term coach, the IA coach, Coverage and the Other boards map.
Genemere Plus is a monthly subscription, cancel any time. It adds the other six labs, the other three builds, full Paper 1B and Paper 2 style mocks, quizzes of 20 and all questions, topic unit tests, a daily study plan and the IA statistics helpers. Cancel any time: cancelling takes effect from the next billing period, so you keep Plus until the end of the month you have paid for and are not charged again. Manage or cancel in your store account settings.

Optional: you can choose to share how you use the app and send feedback from Settings. Details are in the Privacy Policy.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-ib-biology-genemere.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: IB Chemistry Prep: Reagmere
description:
IB Chemistry Prep: Reagmere is a revision companion for IB Chemistry at standard and higher level. It follows the current course topics, Structure and Reactivity, with HL extensions clearly marked.

LEARN YOUR WAY
- Syllabus view in classical order, or Real-World view with guided builds
- Lessons with worked examples, common mistakes and real-world hooks
- Original questions: multiple choice, calculations, short answer and explain, each with marking-style feedback
- Adaptive plan: wrong answers lead to the idea to revise, and the app explains why each step is next

PRACTISE LIKE THE EXAM
- Quizzes by topic, by command term or by your gaps
- Timed mock papers in the style of Paper 1A, Paper 1B and Paper 2 with a report and study plan
- Command term trainer and an internal assessment coach with an uncertainty tool

LABS AND BUILDS
- Ten interactive simulations: moles, gas laws, molecular shapes, equilibrium, emission spectra, energy cycles, collision theory, pH and titration curves, voltaic cells and curly-arrow mechanisms
- Four guided builds: check the acid in vinegar, compare a fuel, plan an ester synthesis, identify an unknown from its data

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level and AP equivalents

FREE AND PLUS
Much of the app is free. Reagmere Plus is an optional monthly subscription that adds more labs and builds, full mock papers and longer quizzes. Cancel any time in your store settings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization. Content is original and is not a past paper or the official guide.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-ib-chemistry-reagmere.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-ib-chemistry-reagmere.html

name: IB Computer Science: Nodewren
description:
Revise IB Computer Science with a study plan that adapts to you. Nodewren covers every learning statement of the Diploma Programme Computer science guide for first assessment in 2027: 112 statements, 68 at standard level and higher level and 44 at higher level only. Topics include computer fundamentals, networks, databases, machine learning, computational thinking, programming, object-oriented programming and, at higher level, abstract data types.

HOW IT HELPS
- Adaptive practice: every quiz updates a mastery map. Wrong answers lead to the lesson and a short fix-it set, then the app picks your next best step.
- Two ways to study: follow the syllabus order, or switch to Build-it order and learn through real problems.
- 1,048 original practice questions, at least eight for every learning statement. Numeric and trace answers are checked by running code.
- 39 hands-on labs: CPU cycle, number bases, logic gates, packet routing, sorting and searching traces, SQL, regression and more.
- Internal Assessment planner with a self-check for each criterion, case-study method cards and command-term cards.
- Timed practice in the style of Paper 1 and Paper 2, plus a short mini mock.
- Other boards: see where each topic meets A Level, GCSE and AP content.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, built for phones and tablets, works offline.

WHAT YOU GET
Free: 62 of the 112 lessons with their questions, 12 labs, the planner's first two criteria, the case-study method and a mini mock.
Nodewren Plus: one monthly subscription unlocks the remaining lessons, 27 more labs, the rest of the planner, further case-study challenges and the timed papers. Cancel any time in your store account settings.

COVERAGE
Each learning statement has its own lesson and at least eight original questions. Study material is written in our own words and is not copied from IB papers, past papers or mark schemes. The annual pre-seen case study is not reproduced; the app teaches a general method on invented systems.

IMPORTANT
Nodewren is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization. Practice results do not predict a grade.

A short notice appears on first opening. Optional usage information helps us improve the course and can be changed at any time under More, Settings, Privacy and data. Diagnostics and feedback are sent only when you tap Send.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-ib-computer-science-nodewren.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-ib-computer-science-nodewren.html

name: IB Economics Prep: Scarvane
description:
IB Economics Prep: Scarvane is a revision companion for IB Economics at standard and higher level. It follows the four units of the current course (introduction, microeconomics, macroeconomics and the global economy) with HL extensions clearly marked.

LEARN YOUR WAY
- Syllabus view in classical order, or Real-World view with guided builds
- 136 short lessons with worked examples, common mistakes and real-world hooks
- 585 original questions: multiple choice, calculations, short answer and explain, each with marking-style feedback
- Adaptive plan: wrong answers lead to the idea to revise, and the app explains why each step is next

PRACTISE LIKE THE EXAM
- Quizzes by topic, by command term or by your gaps
- Timed mock papers in the style of Paper 1, Paper 2 and the HL Paper 3, with a report and study plan
- Command term trainer and an internal assessment coach for your three commentaries and their key concepts

LABS AND BUILDS
- Eleven interactive diagram labs: production possibilities, supply and demand with surplus, elasticity and revenue, aggregate demand and supply, tax and subsidy incidence, externalities, monopoly, the multiplier, Lorenz curve and Gini, tariffs and quotas, and exchange rates
- Four guided builds: advise on a carbon tax, plan a recession response, judge a trade deal, explain a currency move

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level and AP equivalents

FREE AND PLUS
Much of the app is free. Scarvane Plus is an optional monthly subscription that adds more labs and builds, full mock papers and longer quizzes. It renews monthly until cancelled; cancel any time in your store settings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization. Content is original and is not a past paper or the official guide.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-ib-economics-scarvane.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-ib-economics-scarvane.html

name: IB History Prep: Chronelle
description:
Chronelle is an independent study aid for the IB Diploma History course first assessed in May 2028: short focused lessons, quizzes that adapt to you, and hands-on labs for the skills the papers reward.

HOW YOU STUDY
- Two ways in. Follow the course in its Classical order (concepts, skills, focused studies, thematic studies, regional study), or switch to Real-World order and start from a problem or question first, then work back to the content.
- Adaptive practice. Every quiz updates a mastery estimate for each topic. A missed question links straight to the part of the lesson that fixes it, and the app suggests what to study next. You choose how long each quiz is.
- Timed mocks in the style of Paper 1 and Paper 2 (and Paper 3 for HL), with a per-topic breakdown.
- Source Lab: judge the origin, purpose, value and limitations of practice sources, with feedback.
- Timeline Builder: put events in order and see how well you understand the sequence.
- Essay Bay: choose a claim, add evidence and a counter-argument, and check the balance of your plan. Your writing stays on your device.
- Cause Web: rank causes and the links between them for cause and consequence questions.
- Level switch: SL or HL (HL adds Paper 3 and the regional study).
- A- and A+ controls scale all text from 50% to 300%, and layouts use the full screen on iPad.

WHAT THE APP COVERS (EXACT, NOT A BLANKET CLAIM)
- The new IB History course, first assessed May 2028. The previous course (prescribed subjects and the world history topics, last assessed 2027) is not covered.
- The four concepts, and skills for Paper 1, Paper 2, Paper 3 and the historical investigation.
- Focused studies: all five options, with both case studies of each option.
- Thematic studies: all four themes, at the level of the inquiry strands.
- Regional study: Europe only (twelve studies). The other three regions are not covered yet.
- The Coverage screen lists exact counts of topics and questions and marks case-study, strand and regional titles taken from teacher resources (the full guide is not public) as UNVERIFIED. Check them against your school's guide.
- All questions, summaries and practice sources are original and written for this app. They are not past papers, mark schemes or extracts from the guide.
- An optional Other boards chip on each topic opens a Curriculum map of related material in other systems.

FREE AND CHRONELLE PLUS
A large part of the course is free to use, with no sign-up. Chronelle Plus unlocks everything else: the remaining topics, all labs, longer quizzes and the full mock papers. Chronelle Plus is USD 2.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically each month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings; cancelling takes effect at the end of the current period and the free part of the app stays available. Restore Purchases is on the Chronelle Plus screen.

WORKS OFFLINE
All study content is in the app, so it works without a connection.

PRIVACY
An optional setting shares anonymous usage and device information to help us improve the app; it starts off in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland and you can change it any time under Settings, Privacy and data. Feedback and diagnostics reports are sent only when you choose.

description:
Inspektor — ta'lim bo'limi xodimi uchun maktab davomatini kunlik nazorat qilish ilovasi.

Ilova biriktirilgan maktablardagi o'quvchilar davomatini bir joyda ko'rsatadi: kim keldi, kim kechikdi, kim kelmadi. Ma'lumot maktab tizimidan avtomatik keladi — hech narsani qo'lda kiritish shart emas.

ASOSIY IMKONIYATLAR

• Bosh sahifa — barcha maktablar bo'yicha kunlik yakun: keldi / kechikdi / kelmadi va har bir maktabning davomat foizi.
• Sana tanlash — istalgan o'tgan kun kesimida ko'rish.
• Smena — birinchi, ikkinchi yoki ikkalasi bo'yicha filtr.
• Maktab sahifasi — kunlik ko'rsatkich, 7 / 30 / 90 kunlik trend va shu maktabning muammoli o'quvchilari.
• Xronik davomat — muntazam kechikadigan va sababsiz kelmayotgan o'quvchilar ro'yxati, kechikishlar soni va umumiy daqiqasi bilan.
• O'quvchi kartasi — 30 / 90 / 180 kunlik davomat kalendari: qaysi kuni kelgan, kechikkan, kelmagan.
• Ota-ona bilan aloqa — kartadan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'ng'iroq qilish yoki Telegram orqali yozish.
• Qidiruv — ism, sinf yoki maktab bo'yicha o'quvchi topish.
• Hisobot eksporti — tanlangan davr uchun Excel fayl, uni ulashish mumkin.
• Push bildirishnoma — xronik holatlar va tayyor hisobotlar haqida xabar.

XAVFSIZLIK

• Kirish parolsiz: telefon raqami va Telegram orqali keladigan bir martalik kod.
• Ilova har ochilganda 4 xonali PIN so'raydi; xohlasangiz barmoq izi yoki yuz bilan ochasiz.
• PIN kodni 5 marta xato kiritilsa sessiya tugatiladi.
• Ma'lumot faqat sizga biriktirilgan maktablar bo'yicha ko'rinadi.

QO'SHIMCHA

• O'zbek va rus tili.
• Yorug' va tungi rejim.
• Telefon va planshetga moslashgan interfeys.

Ilova faqat vakolatli inspektorlar uchun. Foydalanish uchun tizimda ro'yxatdan o'tgan telefon raqami talab qilinadi.

name: IntelliCamp AI:Smart Exam Prep
description:
Welcome to IntelliCamp (www.intellicamp.in) — an intelligent, AI-powered assessment and revision platform designed to turn any textbook chapter into a comprehensive practice test in minutes.

Most tests simply give you a final score and stop there. You know how many marks were scored — but not why, and not where to focus next. Without diagnostic feedback, revision becomes re-reading every textbook page and hoping for the best.

IntelliCamp closes this gap. More than just a testing tool, it shows users exactly what is strong and what is weak — chapter-wise, subject-wise, and question-type-wise — so every user can prepare with a clear plan instead of panic.

==================================================

WHAT USERS DISCOVER AFTER EVERY TEST

==================================================

 Chapter-Wise Mastery: Identify which chapters are fully understood and which need further revision — so you know exactly what to revisit and what to skip.

 Subject-Wise Balance: Spot strengths and gaps across all subjects, ensuring study time goes where it is needed most rather than spread randomly.

 Question-Type Insights: See whether you struggle with MCQs, Fill-in-the-Blanks, or Long Descriptive answers to sharpen test technique alongside subject knowledge.

 Difficulty-Level Analysis: Understand how performance holds up as difficulty rises across Easy, Medium, and Hard questions.

==================================================

KEY FEATURES & CAPABILITIES

==================================================

• Instant Chapter-Wise Tests: Select your curriculum board, grade, and subject, and generate a balanced test on any chapter in minutes.

• Multi-Format Question Bank: Practice a diverse range of formats including Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), True/False, Fill in the Blanks, and Descriptive problems.

• Handwritten Answer Sheet Evaluation: Solve descriptive questions on paper, take a photo with your device camera, and receive step-by-step rubric-based evaluation.

• Step-by-Step Explanations: Review instant, clear solutions and explanations for every question right after submitting.

• Diagnostic Heatmaps & Progress Trends: Color-coded reports highlight exact weak spots, strong areas, and score progression over time.

• Curriculum Textbooks & Study Materials: Access textbooks, chapter-wise worksheets, formula guides, and solved exercises anytime inside the app.

• Interactive Voice-Based Viva Sessions: Practice answering conceptual questions aloud with real-time voice feedback to reinforce clarity and confidence.

==================================================

HOW IT WORKS (SIMPLE & FAST)

==================================================

1. Select Your Syllabus: Choose your curriculum board, grade, and subject.

2. Pick Any Chapter: Select the topic or unit you want to practice.

3. Attempt on Any Device: Take the timed test smoothly on your phone or tablet.

4. Review Instant Results: Get immediate scoring with detailed step-by-step answer breakdowns.

5. Follow Your Revision Plan: Use your diagnostic report to focus time only on the chapters and question types that need attention.

==================================================

WHY INTELLICAMP MATTERS

==================================================

• Early Support: Spot concept gaps well in advance of major examinations so no topic gets overlooked.

• Less Exam Stress: A structured, diagnostic revision plan replaces last-minute cramming and uncertainty.

• Efficient Study Hours: Users focus their energy and effort where it truly makes an impact.

Plan your preparation, eliminate guesswork, and test with confidence. Download IntelliCamp today!

Website: https://www.intellicamp.in

Support: support@intellicamp.in

name: İnternet Kafe Patronu
description:
Yıl 2003. Mahallenin bodrum katında altı tüplü monitörle kendi internet kafeni açıyorsun. Hedef: 2030'a kadar mahallenin bir numaralı netcafe'si olmak!

İnternet Kafe Patronu'nda Türkiye'nin internet kafe tarihini baştan yaşıyorsun. Modemin cızırtısı, Siper sırası bekleyen çocuklar, “Abi bi saat daha!” diye yalvaran müdavimler... Sonra paradan altı sıfır atılıyor, ADSL herkesin evine giriyor, espor patlıyor, VR gözlükleri geliyor. Her dönem yeni oyunlar, yeni müşteriler ve yeni dertler.

◆ 2003'TEN 2030'A 8 DÖNEM
• Modem yılları, YTL, ADSL, akıllı telefon, espor, salgın ve kur, oyun merkezi, bulut ve hologram
• Tüplü monitörden LCD'ye, ışıklı oyuncu kasalarından bulut terminallerine 9 kasa seviyesi
• Eski milyonlardan YTL'ye, oradan ₺'ye: enflasyon da hikâyenin parçası

◆ KAFENİ BÜYÜT
• Kafene isim ver, adın neon tabelada yansın
• Orta sıra, arka oda, üst salon: duvarları yık, 28 bilgisayara kadar büyü
• Konsol köşesi kur, kantini geliştir, çaycı, teknisyen ve komi tut, ekibini eğit
• Saat ücretini sen belirle, reklam ver, mahalle payını büyüt

◆ RAKİBİN: SÜPER NET
• Cengiz her hafta bir hamle yapar: fiyat kırar, müdavim ayartır, afiş savaşı başlatır
• Cuma turnuvalarında kapış, kupayı vitrine koy
• Dönemin sonunda Süper Net'i satın alıp mahallenin patronu ol

◆ HER GÜN BİR OLAY
• “Annesi geldi!” Çocuğu sakla mı, teslim et mi?
• Virüs salgını, eski parayla ödeyen dede, LAN partisi rezervasyonu, ekran kartı madencileri, çay robotu isyanı...
• 60'tan fazla olay ve her hafta yeni bir tema: sınav haftası, derbi, yaz tatili, Ramazan, kar tatili

◆ MAHALLENİN HİKÂYESİ
• 9 müdavim, 50'den fazla hikâye bölümü
• Okul kaçağı Emre'nin espor yıldızlığına uzanan yolculuğu, Selin'le Barış'ın modem ışığı aşkı, Hacı Amca'nın vedası
• Seçimlerin kafeni kalıcı olarak değiştirir

◆ NOSTALJİ DOLU PİKSEL DÜNYA
• Sıcacık piksel sanat ve retro sesler
• Dekor dükkânı: akvaryum, langırt, atari makinesi, neon renkleri, hologram afiş
• Rahat oyun: karar verirken oyun durur, acele yok

İnternet Kafe Patronu ücretsizdir. İsteğe bağlı uygulama içi satın almalar (Jeton paketleri, Başlangıç Paketi) ve Patron Kartı aboneliği içerir. Jeton oyunda da kazanılır; ilerlemek için satın alma gerekmez. Oyun reklam içerir: gün sonlarında bir reklam gösterilir, ödüllü reklamları ise yalnızca istersen izlersin. Herhangi bir uygulama içi satın alma reklamları tamamen kaldırır.

PATRON KARTI ABONELİĞİ
• Aylık, otomatik yenilenen abonelik
• Her gün 25 Jeton, bütün kazançlar +%20, altın neon tabela ve reklam izlemeden ödüller
• Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple hesabından alınır. Dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse abonelik aynı fiyattan otomatik yenilenir. Aboneliğini App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetebilir ve istediğin zaman iptal edebilirsin.

Kullanım Koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gizlilik Politikası: https://kafepatronu.ugurkadirkarahan.online/gizlilik/

Oyundaki tüm kişi, kafe, marka ve oyun adları kurgusaldır.

name: Invoss | Invoice & Manager
description:
Invoss makes invoices and estimates, keeps track of who has paid, and holds your business expenses and receipts in one place. No ads, no account, nothing to buy, and everything stays on your iPhone.

Make an invoice in a minute, send it as a PDF, and mark it paid with one tap.

INVOICES
• Pick a client, add what you did, and the tax, discount and total add up for you
• A price book for the things you sell, added in one tap
• Due dates from your payment terms, and overdue invoices flagged
• Tap the circle beside an invoice to mark it paid. Tap the check to undo.
• Record deposits and partial payments by cash, check, bank, card, Venmo, Zelle, PayPal or Cash App
• Filter by all, unpaid or paid, and search by client or number
• Duplicate an invoice to start the next one

ESTIMATES
• Quote a job before it starts, with a "valid until" date
• Mark it approved or declined
• Turn an estimate into an invoice in one tap, every item carried over

SEND, SHARE, PRINT
• Send opens Mail with the PDF already attached
• Share it as a PDF or an image, or print it
• Always on white paper, whatever colors the app uses
• Ten printer-friendly invoice styles and six colors
• Your logo and business details on every invoice

EXPENSES AND RECEIPTS
• Add expenses month by month, sorted into 14 categories
• Take a photo of a paper receipt, or add screenshots of online receipts from Photos
• Rent, software and other bills can repeat every month

CLIENTS
• Everyone you work with, and what they still owe
• Each client's invoices, estimates and payments in one place
• Call, text or email them in a tap
• Give a client their own invoice notes, or leave your logo or business name off their invoices

REPORTS
• Income, expenses and profit by month and quarter, for any year
• Income counts on the day the money came in
• Export invoices, payments and expenses as CSV, and your expenses with their receipt photos as one PDF, for your accountant or tax software

MAKE IT YOURS
• Five color themes, including a light one
• Ten currencies
• Short tips behind the ? on every tab, or turn them off
• Deleted something by mistake? Undo.
• Back up everything, receipt photos included, to one file you keep where you like, and restore it on a new phone

Private by design: no account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Invoss makes no network requests. Your invoices, clients, expenses and receipts stay on your iPhone, and only leave it when you send or share them.

name: invpls
description:
invpls is the fastest way to find a party for any game, and then actually talk to them.

POST AN INVITE
Pick the game, mode, platform, region and language, say whether a mic is required and how many players you need, and post. Players browsing Discover tap "inv pls" to ask in.

ACCEPT, AND YOU'RE A PARTY
Accept requests (or make the invite open), and everyone lands in a party with its own chat and a voice and video room. No friend codes, no extra voice app. Voice keeps going when you switch apps.

KEEP THE SQUAD IN A SERVER
Turn a good party into a server with roles, text channels, voice rooms you can drop into (camera optional), events with RSVPs and invite links.

POST AND SHARE
Post to your timeline for friends or everyone, add a picture, react and comment. Share a post into a chat or a server channel, or post straight to a server.

MESSAGE FRIENDS FAST
See which friends are online at the top of Messages, tap to chat, press and hold to call with voice or video.

PROFILES THAT HELP
Show your platform handles, main games, rank and links, and collect commends (friendly, skilled, great leader, chill) from the people you play with.

SAFE BY DESIGN
invpls is for adults (18+). Report any player, message, post, comment, invite or server; block anyone, including from inside a voice room; mute people for yourself. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

Free, no ads, no tracking.

name: IoyClub - Just Connections
description:
Keep your personal connections, memories and private reflections in one secure iPhone diary. IoyClub - Just Connections is built for one adult user who wants to record dates, intimate encounters, BDSM events, club nights and personal notes without accounts, chats or public profiles. Everything stays on your device, so your history remains private and entirely under your control.

Key features
- Timeline of your own events - log dates, intimate encounters, club nights, BDSM events, personal notes and more, then view everything in reverse chronological order by month.
- Manual links between records - connect a meeting to the event where you met, while keeping each entry separate with its own date, type and details.
- Private people profiles - save nicknames, notes, context, manual contacts and a full history of shared events for each person.
- Photo gallery and albums - import photos from your library, link them to people or events, and build albums from saved memories without duplicating files.
- Face ID protection - lock the app with Face ID and device passcode backup, then hide content when the app goes into the background.
- Local-only storage - no account, no cloud sync, no public listings and no contacts access, just a diary that lives on one device.

Perfect for
- Tracking social nights, dates and private meetings in one place
- Keeping a discreet record of people, notes, photos and follow-up reminders
- Separating the event where you met from the later encounter or conversation
- Organising memories by person, event type, tag or date range

Why choose us
IoyClub - Just Connections gives you a clean, focused way to store personal memories without turning them into social content. You decide what is linked, what stays separate and what gets remembered later in Reflection notes. A single photo can appear across your diary, people profiles and gallery, yet still be stored only once on the device.

There are no demo profiles, no web login and no unnecessary clutter. Just a private, local-first diary designed for clarity, discretion and fast entry when the moment matters.

Download IoyClub - Just Connections and keep your memories private, organised and easy to revisit whenever you want.

name: Iya — Learn Yoruba
description:
Iya is a Yoruba-language learning app for young children — built by parents, for parents who want their kids to grow up hearing their mother tongue.

WHY IYA IS DIFFERENT

Every word is recorded by YOU. Not a stranger's voice on the internet — YOUR voice, the voice your child already knows and loves. Sit with your child for 5 minutes a week, record a few words, and Iya becomes a personal, living connection to your family's language.

HOW IT WORKS

• Tap a category flashcard — Family, Home, Food, Talking, ABC & 123, Body, Animals
• Swipe through big, bright flashcards designed for small fingers
• Audio plays automatically on every card you've recorded
• Tap the mic badge to record your own pronunciation
• Long-press any card to re-record instantly

7 CATEGORIES, 185+ WORDS

Each card shows the Yoruba word + emoji illustration + your recorded audio. Categories use Ankara-inspired colors so kids learn to navigate by color, not just text.

4 MINI-GAMES

• Drag & Drop — match emojis to words
• Quiz — listen and pick the right picture
• Spell It — tap letters in order
• Memory — find the matching pairs

DAILY CHALLENGE

A 7-step quest that cycles through all categories. Complete it to earn 50 gems. Builds a daily learning habit without nagging.

MY WORDS — YOUR PRIVATE DECKS

Create custom word lists for family names, birthdays, daily routines, anything you want your child to learn. Each list gets its own emoji. All stored on your device — no accounts, no cloud, no sharing.

PRIVACY FIRST

• No accounts. No login. No email.
• No tracking. No analytics. No third-party SDKs that follow your child.
• All word lists and recordings live on your device.
• The only network calls are the optional ads (which you can remove for $0.99).
• Settings and list management are parental-gated.

DESIGNED FOR THE CULTURE

Iya means "mother" in Yoruba. The mascot is a Yoruba mother in Ankara print, welcoming your child by name (if you record a welcome voice during onboarding). The color palette is Ankara-inspired — deep indigo, mustard, magenta, teal.

PRICING

• Free to download and play
• Watch a rewarded ad to earn 50 gems (used for recording new words)
• Remove Ads — $0.99 (one-time, removes all ads forever)
• Freedom Pass — $3.99 (one-time, removes all ads + makes recording and word-adding free forever)

name: J2daH
description: Take to the skies in J2daH, a tap-to-steer arcade flying game. Guide your plane past airborne obstacles, fly through rings, and try to beat your personal best. Keep your flight clean to build a score multiplier, and pass obstacles to charge your boost.

name: J316 Bible
description:
J316 Bible brings books of the Bible to life with a hand-drawn picture for every verse. Read Ruth, Jonah and James verse by verse, with each picture beside the words, for readers of all ages, from 5 years old to grandparents.

READ IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Simple English, an easy-to-read text in line with the King James Version
• The King James Version (KJV), word for word
• English together with Tamil, Spanish, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam or Marathi, side by side

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
• The app is free to download.
• Chapter 1 of every book is free to read, with no sign-in and no credit card.
• To read the rest, buy the book once through the App Store. No subscription, no monthly fee.
• Each language edition is its own purchase.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No ads and no tracking.
• No account or sign-in.
• A grown-up check before any purchase or link that leaves the app.
• Parent settings let you hide the Buy button and choose what children may do, with an optional parent PIN.

MORE THAN READING
• The story in brief, for each book
• A quiz for each book
• Search the verses
• Write your own notes on any verse (kept only on your device)
• A "Presented To" certificate to fill in and give
• Choose verse colors and your own theme color
• Read without internet once a book is downloaded

MORE BOOKS ARE COMING
New books of the Bible and new languages appear on your bookshelf automatically, marked "New". No app update is needed.

Every picture is drawn by hand by an artist; none are made by AI.

J316 Publications, LLC publishes illustrated Bible books in print and in this app. Questions? Email comments@j316publications.com or visit j316publications.com.

"For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life." John 3:16 (KJV)

name: JabalPay Admin Chat
description:
JabalPay Admin Chat is the support inbox for authorized JabalPay staff.

Follow the conversations customers start with JabalPay on WhatsApp from one place, with a separate inbox for each business line:
• Global · 6788
• Canada · 5559

WHAT STAFF CAN DO
• See every conversation and who is handling it: the automated assistant, you, or a colleague
• Open a chat and read its history
• Take over from the automated assistant, and hand the chat back when you are done
• Reply to the customer, or continue in WhatsApp Business where a line requires it
• See which chats are waiting for a person, and why
• See new customer messages as they arrive, with private notification text
• Work in English or Arabic, with full right-to-left layout

BUILT FOR THE TEAM
• Sign-in uses a JabalPay staff account with two-step verification
• Each person sees only the conversations they are allowed to handle
• Verification codes are hidden from previews and notifications

This app is for JabalPay employees and authorized support agents only. It is not for customers. To send money with JabalPay, use the JabalPay app.

name: Jagdschein & Jägerprüfung üben
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zum Bayerischen Landesamt für Maß und Gewicht, zu einer Jagdbehörde oder zu einer anderen Behörde.

Den ersten Jagdschein bekommst du nur mit bestandener Jägerprüfung. Sie besteht aus einem schriftlichen Teil, einem mündlich-praktischen Teil und einer Schießprüfung. Mit Jagdschein & Jägerprüfung üben lernst du das Fachwissen für den schriftlichen und den mündlichen Teil. Der Kurs folgt den sechs Sachgebieten der bayerischen Jägerprüfung: Dort beantwortest du schriftlich 100 Fragen in 100 Minuten. Das Grundwissen zu Wild, Waffen und Jagdbetrieb gilt für die Jägerprüfung in allen Ländern.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Jagdwaffen, Munition, Jagd- und Fanggeräte
- Biologie der Wildarten
- Jagdrecht, Waffenrecht und weitere Vorschriften
- Wildhege, Jagdbetrieb und jagdliche Praxis
- Jagdhundewesen
- Naturschutz, Landbau, Forstwesen und Wildschadensverhütung
- Waffensachkunde nach § 7 Waffengesetz

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Jägerprüfung Bayern: Vorbereitung auf die staatliche Prüfung
- Waffensachkunde § 7 WaffG: Prüfungsvorbereitung

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Jagd, Natur und Sachkunde

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zur Jägerprüfung und zur Waffensachkunde in dieser App:
- Bundesjagdgesetz, § 15 Jagdschein und Jägerprüfung: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bjagdg/__15.html
- Waffengesetz, § 7 Sachkunde: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/waffg_2002/__7.html
- Allgemeine Waffengesetz-Verordnung, § 1 Umfang der Sachkunde: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/awaffv/__1.html
- Allgemeine Waffengesetz-Verordnung, § 3 Anderweitiger Nachweis der Sachkunde: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/awaffv/__3.html
- Jäger- und Falknerprüfungsordnung Bayern: https://www.gesetze-bayern.de/Content/Document/BayJFPO
- Jäger- und Falknerprüfungsordnung Bayern, § 10 Sachgebiete: https://www.gesetze-bayern.de/Content/Document/BayJFPO-10
- Jäger- und Falknerprüfungsordnung Bayern, § 12 Schriftlicher Teil: https://www.gesetze-bayern.de/Content/Document/BayJFPO-12
- Bayerisches Landesamt für Maß und Gewicht, Jägerprüfung: https://www.lmg.bayern.de/aufgaben_leistungen/jaegerpruefung/index.html

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: JaMaTennis – AI Tennis Coach
description:
JaMaTennis is the coach in your pocket. Put your iPhone by the fence and play as usual – the app watches, recognises every stroke and tells you between rallies what to work on.

SET IT DOWN AND PLAY
No sensor, no racket gadget: the camera is enough. A setup assistant checks that you are in the picture from head to toe. After that you never have to touch the phone. Raise both hands above your head and you get an interim summary.

EVERY STROKE IS RECOGNISED
Forehand, backhand, serve, overhead and volley are detected and counted automatically, even in the middle of a rally. For each stroke the app measures your posture: shoulder turn, knee bend, arm extension at contact, follow-through, head stability, balance and split step; on the serve also the tossing arm and contact height.

ONE FOCUS PER SESSION
Instead of ten tips at once, the coach picks exactly one thing after your first strokes. You see live how often you are in the green zone. Next time you train, the app re-measures whether it has improved.

COACHING BETWEEN RALLIES
During a rally you only hear a soft tick per stroke. In the pause you get one sentence that helps – spoken, in a natural voice. Best with a Bluetooth speaker or an earbud.

REVIEW AFTER TRAINING
A verdict, your strengths and three tips, each with a concrete drill. Plus numbers per stroke type, stills of your best and weakest strokes and clips of your rallies with a skeleton overlay.

ALSO
• Six practice modes: free play, forehand, backhand, serve, volley and shadow swings for home
• Analyse an existing tennis video
• Progress over weeks per stroke type
• A drill library that matches your focus
• Ask the coach: speak your question, listen to the answer
• Note from your own coach: the AI coach follows it
• For right- and left-handers, one- or two-handed backhand
• In English and German

YOUR DATA
Pose detection runs on your iPhone; your video never leaves the device. The AI coach is optional: only after you agree are metrics and, for the review, a few downscaled stills sent encrypted to our server in Frankfurt and on to Anthropic (Claude); for the natural voice the spoken sentences go to ElevenLabs. Our server stores nothing. No account, no ads, no tracking. Without the AI coach, stroke detection, focus and the fixed cues keep working.

GOOD TO KNOW
The app sees your body, not the ball or the racket: it cannot tell whether a shot went in and measures no spin. All values are estimates from one camera. JaMaTennis complements your coach and does not replace one.

name: Japanese History Dates Quiz
description:
Learn the key dates of Japanese and world history with "goroawase" — the Japanese number-wordplay mnemonics students use to remember years, like "Nakuyo uguisu Heian-kyo" (794).

* The questions, mnemonics and explanations are in Japanese. The menus and buttons are available in English, so this app is best for people who read Japanese, such as Japanese learners and students at Japanese schools.

■ 1061 four-choice questions in 6 areas
Ancient, Medieval, Early Modern, Modern and Contemporary Japan, plus World History. Practice 10 questions at a time and see the answer, the mnemonic and an explanation right away. Wrong choices also show what happened in that year, so you learn the surrounding events too.

■ Date practice exam
30 questions in 20 minutes from all areas (24 correct to pass). You can stop and resume later.

■ Today's review
Questions you missed or marked "unsure" come back just before you forget them (spaced repetition).

■ Stats and glossary
Accuracy by area, exam history and your study streak. Tap a term in an explanation to open the glossary.

■ Notes
・All questions, explanations and mnemonics are original. Dates follow standard Japanese high school textbooks; some events have other dates depending on the theory.
・No account and no in-app purchases. Your study history stays on your device.
・Ads are shown with Google AdMob. Watching an optional rewarded ad hides banner ads for 24 hours.

Terms of Use: https://st.arkid.jp/apps/rekishiGoro/terms
Privacy Policy: https://st.arkid.jp/apps/rekishiGoro/privacy

name: Jarnez – Pill Reminder
description:
Jarnez is a pill reminder made for people who find ordinary apps too small, too busy or too confusing – older adults, people with Parkinson's disease or memory problems, and the family members who look after them.

The screen looks like a real pill organizer. Each medicine sits in its own box, with the pills drawn in their real color and shape, the amount written in big letters, and halves and quarters shown exactly as you break them. When it's time, a loud alarm rings. Tap each box as you take the pill – the lid closes with a green tick. That's it.

WHAT THE PATIENT SEES
• One calm screen with the next dose, how long until it, and the boxes to take
• Big, high-contrast text and large touch targets for shaky hands
• A loud alarm that keeps ringing until it's silenced
• "Today's plan" with every dose of the day: green for taken, orange for late, red for missed
• Tap any past dose to see exactly which pills were taken or missed
• A big red Help button that calls a family member or caregiver with one tap
• Optional reading aloud of what to take

THREE WAYS TO SEE THE DAY
• List – the boxes for the next dose
• Day clock – all doses around a 24-hour dial
• Weekly plan – the whole week at a glance, like a weekly pill box

MADE FOR REAL MEDICINE ROUTINES
• Up to 10 times a day, each set to the exact minute
• Whole, half and quarter tablets (1¼, 1½, 1¾ …)
• Tablets, capsules, drops, syrup, inhalers, creams and more
• Pill color, shape or your own photo, so every medicine is easy to recognize
• Food rules: "take with food", "don't eat 30 minutes before" or after, with lists of what is and isn't allowed
• A grace period (30 minutes by default) to confirm a late dose; after that it's marked as missed
• Repeated reminders if a dose isn't confirmed
• On iOS 26 and newer, real system alarms that ring even when the app is closed

SAFE FROM ACCIDENTAL CHANGES
Settings are hidden: hold the gear for 2 seconds, and protect them with a PIN or Face ID if you like. The patient sees only what they need.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on the device; nothing is sent anywhere.

Available in English, Slovak, Czech and German, with 12- or 24-hour time.

Important: Jarnez is a reminder, not a medical device. It does not give medical advice. Always follow the instructions of your doctor or pharmacist.

name: Jay Notes
description:
Jay is a simple, complete notepad: you write, it keeps things tidy, and everything is there on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO WRITE
• Title, heading, subheading, body and code block; bold, italic, underline, strikethrough.
• Checklists, bulleted, dashed and numbered lists, with indents: numbers put themselves back in order.
• Text colours and highlighting in eight shades.
• Format as you type: “-”, “1.”, “[]” or “#” at the start of a line.
• Inline calculations: type “12 × 45 =” and Jay writes the result.
• Images at the size you choose; photos and documents scanned with iPhone or iPad.

ORGANISED YOUR WAY
• Coloured folders and subfolders, tags (#idea) and notes pinned to the top of the list.
• A list grouped by date, as in Mail: today, yesterday, this week…
• Search across all your notes.
• Links between notes: type “[[” to mention another note, and see where a note is mentioned.
• Reminders: Jay notifies you at the date and time you pick.

YOUR NOTES STAY YOURS
• No account, no server: your notes are files, on the device or in the iCloud Drive folder of your choice.
• The same notes on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in the same folder.
• Locked notes: their text is encrypted and opens with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Shared folders: write together using iCloud Drive sharing.

MADE FOR EACH DEVICE
• iPhone and iPad: Home Screen widget, with your pinned note always in sight.
• iPad: several columns, keyboard shortcuts and menus, drag a note onto a folder.
• Mac: notes pinned to the desktop, quick note from any app, Share menu, export to PDF and Markdown.
• Light or dark mode.

Try Jay free for 14 days, then buy it once (€2.99 or local equivalent) for iPhone, iPad and Mac: no subscription, no ads. It is available in English, French and Spanish.

name: JDM 25: Import Countdown
description:
JDM 25 tells you the day a Japanese car meets the age rule for import: 25 years for the USA, 15 years for Canada.

Enter the car's build year and month (and the day, if you know it). The app shows the exact date it becomes eligible and counts down the days. If the car is already old enough, it shows the date it crossed the line.

Features
- Exact eligibility date and day countdown from a build date
- USA (25-year rule) and Canada (15-year rule)
- Garage: save the cars you are watching and see every countdown in one list
- Model list: 60 well-known JDM models with production years and their US status (all years legal, partly legal, upcoming)
- Search and filter the model list
- Copy a result to share
- Works offline. English and Japanese

Private by design
Everything is calculated on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, and nothing you enter is sent anywhere.

Important
This app is a date calculator, not legal advice. Age is only one condition for importing a vehicle. Customs entry, emissions, state or provincial registration and inspection, and duties must be checked separately. Production years in the model list are year-level guides; the real date depends on each car's own build month. Always confirm with the authorities (NHTSA, EPA and CBP in the US; Transport Canada and RIV in Canada) or a customs broker before you buy or ship a car. The app is not affiliated with any government agency or car manufacturer.

name: JFT Pass
description:
JFT Pass is a Bengali-first study app for the JFT-Basic exam, built by AIC Japan for Bangla speakers who are preparing to live and work in Japan. The JFT-Basic test measures Japanese at CEFR A2 level, and every lesson, explanation and practice question in this app is written in simple Bangla so you can focus on the Japanese, not on the textbook language.

Learn, review, then practise. That is the loop the whole app follows.

WHAT IS INSIDE

- 36 lessons mapped to Irodori Elementary 1 and 2, the main JFT textbook series, with original examples and Bangla explanations
