- A grammar library of 47 patterns, each with form, meaning and example sentences
- 6 full mock tests, 300 questions in total, in the real exam format (about 50 questions, 60 minutes, 4 sections), with a Bangla explanation for every answer
- A drill bank of 200 extra questions for daily practice
- 284 kanji (JLPT N5 and N4 sets) with readings, Bangla meanings, example words and the radical of every kanji
- A 300-word N5 vocabulary deck with readings and example sentences
- 125 listening audio tracks recorded for the mock tests and drills
- A booking guide that explains the JFT-Basic application steps

Your progress is saved on your phone, and the study content works offline, so you can prepare on the train, at work breaks, or at home without a connection.

COMPLETELY FREE

Version 1 of JFT Pass is completely free. Every lesson, mock test, drill and deck is open, and there are no purchases inside the app.

AN HONEST NOTE

JFT Pass is a practice tool. Your practice scores inside the app are not official exam results and do not predict or guarantee your result in the real JFT-Basic exam, which is run by the Japan Foundation through Prometric.

AIC Japan is a Bengali-language information service for people living, studying and working in Japan.

name: Jigsaw Moment Puzzle AI+
description:
Puzzles, now endless.

You say it, Apple Intelligence paints it, and it becomes a puzzle
Describe anything you like: a little fox reading under cherry blossoms, a cabin at the foot of snowy mountains, your dream house by the sea... Apple Intelligence creates the picture right inside the app, and Jigsaw Moment cuts it into a puzzle on the spot. A new idea means a brand-new puzzle, so you never run out.

1000+ hand-picked artworks
Landscapes, cities, architecture, flowers, animals, fairy tales, art, amusement parks and food: nine categories. Every picture is rich in detail, full of color and chosen one by one.

Puzzle your way
• Pick from 36 to 576 pieces on every picture, seven sizes, perfect for a five-minute break or a whole evening
• Drag or tap to place; matching neighbours join together automatically. Pause and pick up again any time
• A new daily puzzle every day and a 10-minute weekly challenge
• 250 achievements to unlock, level by level, for a real sense of progress
• Stuck? Spend the points you earn in the game and let the puzzle helper place a few pieces for you

Designed for every screen
iPhone and iPad each get their own layout. On iPhone Duo, half folded: the board sits on the upper screen and all the pieces on the lower.

Your puzzles are never lost
Your progress and every picture you create are backed up automatically to your private iCloud, and come back in full on a new phone.

Free to try, one purchase unlocks it all
Download for free and play 30 hand-picked puzzles; the daily puzzle and weekly challenge are chosen from those 30. You can also create 20 puzzles of your own with Apple Intelligence for free. One purchase, "Unlock All", opens all 1000+ artworks, Apple Intelligence picture creation and the full daily and weekly rotation forever. No subscription, no ads.

17 languages
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Portuguese, Polish, Swedish, Danish and Norwegian.

Please note: creating your own pictures requires a device with Apple Intelligence (such as iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 16 or later, or an iPad with M1 or later), with Apple Intelligence turned on in Settings. All built-in puzzles work on every supported iPhone and iPad.

Privacy policy and support: https://app.17ai.de/puzzle/

name: Joloo (Жолоо)
description:
ЗХД-ийн онолын шалгалтад утсан дээрээ бэлдээрэй. Асуулт бүр тайлбартай. Бүртгэлгүй, интернэтгүй ажиллана.

БЭЛДЭХЭД ХЭРЭГТЭЙ БҮХЭН
• 40 карт, 800 асуулт, хариулт бүрийн тайлбартай
• Шалгалтын горим: 20 асуулт, 20 минут
• Алдаагаа давтах: буруу хариулсан асуултууд тусдаа хадгалагдана
• Онол: замын тэмдэг, тэмдэглэл, таних тэмдэг, дүрмийг хайж уншина
• Асуултын зургийг томруулж харна
• Цайвар, бараан горим

БАГШ, СУРАГЧДАД (сонголттой)
Багш анги үүсгэж, сурагчид кодоор элсэнэ. Элссэнээс хойшхи дасгал, шалгалтын дүн багшид харагдана. Бүртгэл зөвхөн энэ хэсэгт хэрэгтэй.

НУУЦЛАЛ
Аппад сурталчилгаа, ашиглалтын шинжилгээ (analytics), хэрэглэгчийг мөрдөх код байхгүй. Бүртгэлгүй хэрэглэгчийн явц зөвхөн утсан дээр хадгалагдана. Бүртгэлээ аппаас эсвэл вэбээс өөрөө шууд устгана.

МЭДЭГДЭЛ
Жолоо нь бие даан хөгжүүлсэн суралцах хэрэгсэл бөгөөд төрийн албан ёсны апп биш, ямар ч төрийн байгууллагатай холбоогүй. Дүрэм, хавсралтын бичвэрийг албан ёсны эх бичвэрээс (legalinfo.mn) авсан, тайлбарыг бид өөрсдөө бичсэн. Аппад сайн дүн авсан нь албан ёсны шалгалтад тэнцэх баталгаа биш.

Санал, асуулт: support@joloo.space

name: Journeyman Years
description:
Day 1. At the town gate of Hobelheim I am handed a staff and a travel book with empty pages. I am a carpenter, and the roads were not mine to choose: they are drawn on the map, each with the number of days it costs.

Day 41. Rain. The road across the river is shut, and the map had warned me. So the detour, more days and fewer coins. A master in the town ahead offers me a job, and I decide how to go about it. How many days and how much strength it takes is on the page beforehand; what it brings in coins and standing only shows once it is done.

Day 290. The pass is closed, winter has painted the map grey. I wait at the inn, count my stamps and read what the masters have written in my book.

Day 1081. Three years and a day are over. Only now may I step up to the masterpiece.

This game tells one complete trade from start to finish: the carpenter's. More trades will follow later with an update.

name: JSI Career Explorer
description:
JSI Career Explorer helps students in the Justice Scholars Institute (JSI) discover careers that match their interests and plan the steps to get there.

TAKE THE INTEREST PROFILER
Answer 30 quick questions (or 60 for more accurate matches) about activities you'd enjoy. Your results show your top interest areas, Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising and Conventional, and what they say about the kinds of work you might like.

EXPLORE MATCHED CAREERS
Choose how much preparation you're willing to do, then see careers matched to your interests. Every career shows real data from O*NET OnLine: what the work involves, the skills it uses, median pay and whether it has a Bright Outlook. A link to O*NET opens the full details.

SEARCH, BROWSE AND SEE WHAT'S TRENDING
Search careers by keyword, browse by industry, or see a list of careers in high demand right now.

GET A LEARNING ROADMAP
Pick a career and get a personalized, step-by-step roadmap: what to learn, actions to take and habits to build. Save it, email or download it as a PDF, or share its link with family or a counselor.

YOUR WORK FOLLOWS YOU
Sign in with the email address or phone number your JSI navigator set up, and your results, saved careers and roadmaps are there on any phone, tablet or computer.

FOR JSI STAFF
Staff accounts can create student accounts, reset passwords and see a report of completed assessments, top interests and careers chosen, with a CSV export for program reporting.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No names, no ads and no tracking. Students can delete their account and all their data from Settings at any time.

Accounts are provided by the Justice Scholars Institute to students and staff in its programs.

Career data comes from O*NET Web Services, sponsored by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration. JSI Career Explorer is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Department of Labor or any government agency. Roadmaps are created with AI and are a starting point; check details with your JSI navigator or school counselor.

name: Juice Sort-Blend Master
description:
Juice Sort is a calm, colorful water-sort puzzle. Tap a bottle, pour the top juice into another bottle, and keep pouring until every bottle holds a single color. Easy to learn, satisfying to master.

SORT, POUR, BLEND
- 3,369 handcrafted water-sort levels, from 3-bottle warm-ups to 100+ bottle brain teasers
- Extra-tall bottle stages mixed into the main journey every 5 levels from stage 21
- Three boosters when you get stuck: Undo, +Bottle, and Reset
- No timer, no pressure — take as long as you like

A JOURNEY THAT KEEPS GROWING
- Clear a level to unlock the next one automatically
- Hard stages every 10 levels and Super Hard stages every 50, each with its own red and purple look
- Level select lets you replay any cleared level whenever you want

DAILY CHALLENGE & TROPHIES
- One new tall-bottle board every day
- Fill the month calendar and earn a trophy for every completed month
- 12 unique trophy designs, rotating each year
- Build a win streak and collect streak gifts

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Level Legend, Perfect Play, Unstoppable, and Highest Win Streak
- Track records, medals, and monthly trophies in one place

MADE TO RELAX
- 100% offline — play on a plane, on the subway, anywhere
- No time limits or lives — solve each board at your own pace
- Simple tap controls — one-handed portrait play
- Gentle sound and a family-friendly look

Whether you have two minutes or two hours, Juice Sort gives you a tidy little puzzle to unwind with.

name: Jungle King Botanist
description:
Explore the shrubs of tropical rainforests through plant profiles, articles, quizzes, and interactive discovery tools. Learn how different shrubs grow, where they thrive, and what makes each one unique.

Browse 12 tropical shrub profiles with images and key details. Open each profile to learn about the plant’s appearance, natural habitat, and distinctive characteristics. Save your favorite plants or share their profiles with others.

Test your knowledge with quizzes based on the articles. Each quiz includes 10 questions with three answer choices. Review your score and correct answers on the results screen.

Use the interactive magnifier to explore four randomly placed shrubs in a rainforest scene. Identify the plant named at the top of the screen by moving the magnifier over the plants and selecting the correct one. Continue discovering plants until you make an incorrect selection.

Discover 20 short botanical facts and share the ones you find interesting. Expand your botanical vocabulary with a glossary of 50 terms and their definitions, and mark terms as learned to track your progress.

Explore tropical plants, develop your botanical knowledge, and discover the diversity of rainforest vegetation through educational content and interactive activities.

name: Just Daily Goals
description:
Just Daily Goals does one thing: it keeps the few goals you want to do every day in front of you.

Add your goals once. Every morning they are all waiting again. Tap one when it is done and the whole card turns green.

THE SAME GOALS, EVERY DAY
• Big, clear cards. Nothing else on the screen.
• Everything resets at midnight, by itself.
• Hold a goal to rename it, reorder it or delete it.

SEE HOW YOU ARE DOING
• History shows every past day at a glance, with a dot for each goal.
• A streak counts the days in a row you did everything.

REMINDERS THAT KNOW WHEN TO STAY QUIET
• One to three daily reminders, at the times you choose.
• A reminder for a single goal, at its own time.
• You only hear from the app if something is still left to do.

A WIDGET YOU CAN TAP
• Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets.
• Tick a goal from the widget without opening the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Your goals never leave your iPhone.

Light and dark mode. English and Portuguese.

name: Just Swing
description:
Hold to grab a ring. Let go to fly. That’s the whole game, and it’s harder than it looks.

Just Swing is a one-button rope-swing racer. Every run takes 10 to 40 seconds and retry is instant, so “one more try” turns into twenty.

Race your friends
• Every run leaves a ghost. Race your own best, your friends or the top players of the day.
• Send a challenge link: “Beat my 7.42 s on Rock Garden”. Friends can play it straight in the browser.
• Start a crew with your class or your friends and fight for the most stars this week.

Seven worlds, 105 levels
• Lava Canyon: bright daylight, sharp rocks, lava below.
• Dusk Canyon: sunset runs with breaking rings and boost rings.
• Neon Heat: night, neon, bounce pads and wind.
• Midnight Storm: rocks that move, and a wave of lava chasing you.
• Frozen Dawn: falling icicles, rings that melt in your hand, and a shield.
• Orbit: low gravity, gates to open, and a hook that grabs thin air.
• Deep Reef: dive through water, ride the currents, swing on a longer rope.
Hit the star times for 3 stars. Stars open the next world. New levels arrive without an update.

More to chase
• A hidden gem in every level of the four newest worlds. Bring home all the gems of a world and its trophy trail is yours.
• Mirror mode: finish one of the newest worlds, then play it flipped.
• Long Run: one long track a week, the same for everyone. Unlimited tries, your best time counts.

Daily Track
A new track every day, the same one for everyone in the world. Your first finish goes on the board. After that, practise as much as you want.

Your rider, your look
Play as Classic, Athlete, Hoodie or Scarf, and pick ropes, trails and crash effects. Coins come from clearing levels, stars, gems, the Daily Track, the Long Run and the daily chest. Looks never change your speed: every time is pure skill.

Play anywhere
• Works offline: on the bus, at break, anywhere. Your progress syncs when you’re back online.
• Small download, tiny data use.
• No chat. Names are made up by the game, so nobody can type anything to you.
• Sign in with Apple or Google if you want to keep your progress on a new iPhone.
• English and Hebrew.

Questions or ideas? justswing@cluberr.com

name: Justeunkiff
description:
Justeunkiff_ is a mother and her daughter cooking for you on Instagram and TikTok. Their app brings all their recipes together, written step by step, so you can make them at home.

From our kitchen to yours.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• All the account's recipes: pastries, mains, breads and viennoiseries, starters, soups, sauces…
• Tunisian, Jewish and world cuisine.
• For each recipe: ingredients, steps, tips and preparation time.
• The recipe video on Instagram, one tap away.

FIND THE RIGHT RECIPE
• Search by ingredient: type "apple" or "onion" and the app finds the recipes that use it.
• Browse by country.
• Filter by kashrut: dairy, meat or pareve.
• Find recipes for Shabbat and the Jewish holidays.

IN THE KITCHEN
• Tick off ingredients as you go.
• The screen stays on while you cook (adjustable).
• Save your favorite recipes.

IN FOUR LANGUAGES
French, English, Spanish and Hebrew.

SIMPLE AND RESPECTFUL
• Free, no ads, no account needed.
• No personal data collected: your favorites and settings stay on your phone.

Follow Justeunkiff_ on Instagram and TikTok: @justeunkiff_

name: Jyutping.io
description:
Type Cantonese by heart.

Jyutping.io is a calm, focused typing practice app built to help you internalize Jyutping—the standard Cantonese romanization system—until typing and pronouncing Cantonese feels effortless.

Whether you are learning Cantonese from scratch, breaking ad-hoc Hong Kong English spelling habits, or sharpening your Jyutping input speed, Jyutping.io turns practice into a fluid daily habit.

HOW IT WORKS
• Direct, Distraction-Free Typing: Type the Jyutping letters for each Chinese character (no tone numbers required) and press Space to confirm.
• Component-Level Corrections: When you slip up, Jyutping.io splits the syllable into initial, final, and coda—striking through only the part you missed and revealing the exact fix above it.
• Tap-to-Hear Native Audio: Tap any character at any time to hear its context-accurate Cantonese pronunciation with instant, pre-cached playback.
• Visual Pitch Contours & Tone Numbers: Watch each character's Cantonese tone (1–6) draw in after you confirm it, displayed as pitch contours, tone numbers, or both.
• Built for Flow: Swipe up anywhere above the keyboard to skip a sentence, drag horizontally to look ahead, or practice with a hardware keyboard (including Command–Right Arrow to skip).

INCLUDED FOR FREE
• Interactive Hands-On Tutorial: Learn the core gestures in seconds—type your first word, tap to listen, and swipe up to skip.
• 1,000 Everyday Cantonese Sentences: Practice natural Hong Kong Cantonese across real-life conversations and scenarios.
• Guided Course Foundations (Stages 1–2): Start with trap-free everyday words, open "aa", and high-frequency initials (j = y, z, c, s).
• Streaks, Session Stats & All-Time Milestones: Track your daily streak, 7-day activity strip, live speed (characters/min) and accuracy, all-time words typed right, sound mastery ring, top weak sounds, and 200-sentence history.
• Customizable Comfort: Switch between Serif (Noto Serif TC) and Sans (Noto Sans HK) character fonts, scale sentence text size with Dynamic Type, and use the app in English or Traditional Chinese.

UNLOCK JYUTPING.IO+ (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Upgrade once—no subscription—to unlock the complete toolkit:
• Full 11-Stage Guided Course: Progress through Stages 3–11 to master Cantonese vowel traps (aa vs. a, ai/ei, ung/uk vs. ong/ok, o/ou/au, eo vs. oe, yu/jyu), lazy sounds and gw/kw, crisp nasal and stop endings (-m/-n/-ng, -p/-t/-k), and everyday spoken sentences.
• Adaptive Weak-Sound Selection: Automatically prioritizes sentences rich in the initials, finals, and codas you miss most.
• Practice Your Own Texts: Paste or type lyrics, articles, dialogue, or notes—or generate custom Hong Kong Cantonese practice sentences on-device with Apple Intelligence on supported devices.
• Share from Any App & Shortcuts: Send Chinese text directly from Safari or other apps via the iOS Share Sheet, or automate imports with Apple Shortcuts and Siri.
• Custom Modes & Timed Rounds: Combine built-in sentences and your own texts, drill specific sounds, and run timed sprints or fixed-sentence rounds with end-of-round mistake reviews.
• Inline Jyutping Hints & Auto-Pronounce: Reveal live ghost-letter hints above the active character as you type, and automatically hear each character spoken before you type it.
• 30-Day Progress Charts & Full Sound Chart: Track week-over-week speed and accuracy curves and inspect your balance across every Cantonese initial, final, and coda.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account or sign-up required. Your practice history, custom texts, and saved modes stay on your device.

Privacy Policy: https://jyutping.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kalachakra Y Covenant
description:
A hand of cards. A ticking automaton. One moment to change everything.

Kalachakra Y Covenant is an offline, turn-based poker adventure where making a strong hand is only the beginning. Decide how to use it: Strike for damage, Brace behind a shield, or Delay the enemy's next move. Read the visible clock and choose your moment.

- Explore nine encounters across three chapters, including bosses with their own rules.
- Begin with one of three distinctive mechanisms and combine 18 clockwork modules.
- Repair your hull, calibrate your power and make consequential choices between battles.
- Rewind your previous action while accepting a growing, permanent temporal debt.
- Return for a daily seeded expedition or resume your saved adventure.
- Study module blueprints, automaton lore, poker hand strengths and your own expedition chronicle.
- Choose English or Simplified Chinese, light or dark appearance, and optional sound effects.

No accounts, advertisements.

name: Kalimba: Thumb Piano & Songs
description:
A kalimba that sounds as soon as your thumbs touch it.

SEVENTEEN KEYS
The tines are laid out as on a real kalimba: the lowest note in the middle, the others going up to the left and to the right in turns. Touch as many as you like at once, or slide across them. Each one rings, glows and swings as it dies away. The notes are written on the keys as letters or as numbers, or not at all.

SONGS, KEY BY KEY
Choose a song and the key to touch next turns gold. Touch it and the next one lights up, at your own speed, with the notes to come shown above. Tap Listen to hear how the song goes first. Six songs are free, among them Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, Ode to Joy and Brahms's Lullaby.

THE SOUND IS MADE BY THE APP
No recordings are loaded: every note is made on the spot, and it plays even when the ring switch is off. Two tunings are free: C major on 17 keys and on 8.

KALIMBA PRO: THE WHOLE SONG BOOK
Thirty melodies that belong to everyone: Happy Birthday, Amazing Grace, Silent Night, Jingle Bells, Auld Lang Syne, Sakura, Canon, a minuet and more.

KALIMBA PRO: THREE MORE INSTRUMENTS
A tongue drum with a long, round ring. A lyre with sixteen strings that you can strum. A glockenspiel with bars in the colours of the rainbow. Each has its own sound and its own tunings.

KALIMBA PRO: MORE TUNINGS
The kalimba in G, D and F major and in A minor, a pentatonic scale where nothing sounds wrong, the Japanese Akebono scale, and 21 keys.

KALIMBA PRO: RECORD WHAT YOU PLAY
Press the red button, play, press it again. Your tune is kept with a name and plays back on the instrument, key by key.

FOR SMALL AND LARGE HANDS
There is nothing to lose and no score. It is an instrument.

PRIVATE
No account. The app does not use the microphone: a recording keeps which keys you touched and when, not sound. Nothing leaves your iPhone.

Kalimba Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/kalimba/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kapış: Grup Oyunları
description:
apış'ta her gün tek oyun var ve tek bir kazanan.

ARKADAŞ GRUBUNU KUR
Davet koduyla arkadaşlarını gruba çağır. Grubun oyun saati gelince ilk giren çarkı çevirir, çıkan oyunu herkes oynar.

18 MİNİ OYUN
Yeşil Işık, Balon Patlat, Kat Kat, Hafıza Izgarası, 1'den 16'ya, Köstebek ve daha fazlası. Refleks, hafıza, hız ve dikkat.

GÜNLÜK SIRALAMA VE SEZON
Günde 2 hakkın var, en iyi skorun sayılır. Podyum, seri ve sezon puanı: kim zirvede, herkes görsün.

1V1 DÜELLO
Bir arkadaşını seç, oyunu ve bahsi belirle, jetonları kap.

JETONLAR VE AVATARLAR
Oynadıkça jeton kazan; stickerlar, isim renkleri ve efsane rozetlerle profilini süsle. Gerçek para yok, satın alma yok.

GRUP DUVARI
Grubuna laf at, rövanş iste. Uygunsuz mesajı bildirebilir, yazanı engelleyebilirsin.

Google, Apple ya da misafir olarak gir. Hesabını istediğin an Ayarlar'dan silebilirsin.

name: Kapsle
description:
Everything you hear. Nothing more.
Kapsle captures audio straight from your iPhone, iPad or Mac. No microphone, no room noise. Just the sound itself.

Every detail counts.
Uncompressed WAV keeps the quality of the original sound. On Mac, with 24-bit recording too.

One button is enough.
No complicated setup. On iPhone and iPad you can start recording right from Control Center. On Mac, a small floating capsule is always at hand.

For your creative ideas.
Capture a melody from a synth, your own musical experiment, sound from an app you're building or a sample for your next project.

Your recordings. Your device.
All recordings stay with you. On iPhone and iPad they're in the Files app; on Mac, in the folder you choose.

Simply free.
No account. No subscription. No third-party ads. No analytics. No data leaves your device.

Whether a recording is possible depends on system restrictions and on the protection of the content being played.

name: Kaset | OldPod
description:
Kaset brings back the joy of a pocket music player: an amber backlit screen, a wheel you spin with your thumb, and nothing between you and your music.

YOUR MUSIC
• Plays MP3, AAC, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, OGG, Opus and AIFF, lossless included
• Albums, artists, genres, songs and playlists, read from your files' tags
• Covers: flip through your albums on a 3D shelf
• Covers in retro amber or in full color
• Gapless playback, shuffle, repeat and a sleep timer

FROM HOME AND FROM THE WORLD
• Your own server: Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin, Emby or Plex
• Internet radio: thousands of stations by country and genre
• Podcasts: search or add any RSS feed; episodes remember where you stopped

THE WHEEL
• Spin to scroll, with a soft tick under your thumb
• Slide from the center, hold for song options, hold ⏭ to fast-forward
• Turn it on Now Playing to change the volume

SIX MINI GAMES
Highway, Rally, Drag Race, Snake, Brick and Pong, all steered with the wheel.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your library stays on your device.

Kaset speaks 31 languages and runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: Katowice i okolice
description:
Odkryj Katowice i okoliczne miasta Aglomeracji Śląskiej w jednej, przejrzystej i całkowicie bezpłatnej aplikacji!

„Katowice i okolice” to Twój codzienny przewodnik po wydarzeniach kulturalnych, koncertach, festiwalach, zabytkach, parkach oraz lokalnych inicjatywach na Górnym Śląsku i w Zagłębiu (m.in. Katowice, Gliwice, Zabrze, Tychy, Chorzów, Sosnowiec, Bytom i inne miasta regionu).

NAJWAŻNIEJSZE FUNKCJE:

• Kalendarz Wydarzeń – przeglądaj nadchodzące koncerty (NOSPR, Spodek, MCK), festiwale, spektakle, wystawy i wydarzenia sportowe. Filtruj wydarzenia po wybranych miastach, wyszukuj interesujące Cię imprezy i sprawdzaj wydarzenia z bezpłatnym wstępem.
• Złote Wyróżnienia – krótkie, konkretne podsumowania przy wydarzeniach i miejscach, które od razu podpowiadają, dlaczego warto je odwiedzić.
• Wyjątkowe Miejsca i Oznaczanie Odwiedzonych (GPS) – poznawaj ikony architektury, zabytkowy Nikiszowiec, muzea, parki i szlaki industrialne. Gdy jesteś na miejscu, potwierdź wizytę jednym kliknięciem dzięki weryfikacji GPS i buduj własną kolekcję odwiedzonych miejsc.
• Zgłaszaj Wydarzenia i Ogłoszenia – widziałeś plakat ciekawego wydarzenia lub chcesz dodać lokalne ogłoszenie? Wyślij propozycję bezpośrednio z aplikacji.
• Ulubione i Synchronizacja – zapisuj interesujące Cię wydarzenia i ogłoszenia, aby mieć je zawsze pod ręką.
• 100% Za Darmo i Bez Reklam – aplikacja nie wyświetla żadnych reklam i nie wymaga zakładania konta, aby przeglądać pełną bazę wydarzeń, miejsc oraz ogłoszeń. Opcjonalne logowanie (Sign in with Apple / Google) służy wyłącznie do synchronizacji ulubionych wydarzeń, odwiedzonych miejsc oraz wysyłania zgłoszeń.

name: Katyaayani Astro & Purohit
description:
Katyaayani Astro & Purohit is a comprehensive Vedic Astrological, Hindu Panchang, and Devotee Spiritual companion engineered by WebVibez Software Developer. Designed for devotees, families, and priests (Purohits/Shastrijis), it bridges sacred Sanatan Dharma rituals with modern digital convenience.

KEY FEATURES:

1. DAILY VEDIC PANCHANG & TITHI
- Real-time calculation of Tithi, Vaar, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana.
- Precise sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and moonset timings based on local geolocation.
- Rahu Kaal, Yamaghanda, and Gulika Kaal warnings to ensure positive endeavors.

2. REAL-TIME CHOGHADIYA
- Live Day and Night Choghadiya with countdown timers.
- Instant color-coded indicators for Auspicious (Amrit, Shubh, Labh, Char) and Inauspicious (Rog, Kaal, Udveg) hours.

3. AUSPICIOUS MUHURAT TIMINGS
- Vedic Muhurats for Griha Pravesh (Housewarming), Vivah (Marriage), Vahan Kharidi (Vehicle Purchase), Mundan, and Business / Shop Inaugurations.

4. KUNDALI & HOROSCOPE CHART GENERATOR
- Precise Vedic birth chart generation with Lagna Kundali, Navamsha, and planetary degrees.
- Detailed astrological insight into planetary dashas and auspicious gemstone recommendations.

5. VEDIC BABY NAMES FINDER
- Traditional Hindu baby names directory organized by Rashi (Zodiac) and auspicious starting alphabets/syllables.

6. DIGITAL JAPA MALA COUNTER
- Sacred digital counter for 108 Japa chants with haptic feedback vibrations and bead sounds for distraction-free mantra meditation.

7. AUTHENTIC PUJA CEREMONIES DIRECTORY & BOOKING
- Comprehensive list of traditional Vedic Pujas including Satyanarayan Katha, Rudrabhishek, Mahamrityunjaya Japa, Navchandi, and Vastu Shanti.
- Complete Samagri (ritual ingredients) checklist for devotees.

8. SHASTRIJI & PUROHIT MANAGEMENT (PRIEST MODE)
- Dedicated priest workflow: Puja appointment scheduling, Yajman (devotee) directory, Dakshina ledger, and ritual calendar management.

Experience the purity of ancient Vedic wisdom combined with seamless technology. Download Katyaayani Astro & Purohit today!

name: KavkazGo
description:
KavkazGo — сервис для поиска попутчиков и отправки посылок. Основное направление — Грузия, Армения, Азербайджан и Россия, а также поездки и передача посылок по остальному СНГ и Европе.

Что можно делать в приложении:
• Находить поездки по датам и направлениям
• Публиковать поездки и брать попутчиков в дорогу
• Передавать и получать посылки по пути следования
• Смотреть профили, детали транспорта и рейтинги пользователей
• Входить через аккаунт Google или Apple

Подходит для регулярных и разовых междугородних и международных поездок, где нужно быстро найти попутчика или передать посылку по маршруту.

name: kdykam: Events across Czechia
description:
kdykam shows what is happening across Czechia today, tomorrow, and this week. Open the app and immediately see events in your city: Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Pilsen, Olomouc, Liberec, České Budějovice, Hradec Králové, Pardubice, Karlovy Vary, Zlín, and dozens of other towns. No sign-up, no ads, no pop-up banners.

Browse concerts (rock, pop, jazz, electronic, folk, metal, classical), theater, musicals, opera, ballet, festivals, exhibitions, cinema, stand-up, lectures, markets, and sports. Looking for family and kids events, a date idea, an outdoor program where dogs are welcome, or free entry? Tap a topic filter to narrow the feed. Search finds specific events, venues, artists, or films, while the event calendar lets you check the schedule day by day for weeks ahead.

Every event card gathers the practical details in one place. You get the date, start time, upcoming dates, program summary and line-up, background on the venue and performers, age guidance, and ticket price or a Free entry badge. Each page also includes the venue address with a map, a weather forecast for outdoor events, Spotify previews or trailers, and a direct link to buy tickets from the organizer. One tap adds any event to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar.

Tap Going on any event to save it to My events so your plans stay in one list, and recently viewed pages remain accessible offline on the metro or train. You can switch the entire interface and event descriptions at any time between five languages: Czech, English, German, Russian, and Ukrainian.

name: KeepPad
description:
KeepPad is a notepad you talk to.

Tap the microphone and say your note. The words show as you speak, and KeepPad files the note in the right group, so a thought in the car or the kitchen lands in your notes in a few seconds.

• Live words: see the text while you talk, then fix it by hand if you like.
• Sorted for you: To do, Shopping, Ideas, Work, People, Health, Money, Travel, Home and Thoughts. On iOS 26 Apple Intelligence sorts smarter, right on the iPhone.
• Keep the sound: each note keeps its recording, so you can listen again.
• Text from a recording: turn a saved sound into text later.
• Share by link: send a note, and you both edit it live. No account, no sign up.
• Goes where you work: a new note can land in Notion or Todoist on its own.
• Search: find any note by its words.

Speak English, Russian, or both in one note. KeepPad speaks 9 languages: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Norwegian.

Your notes stay on your iPhone. Only a note you share or send to another app leaves it.

name: Keepsake Escape
description:
Keepsake Escape turns what you remember about someone you love into a small escape room made just for them.

Pick the occasion: an anniversary, a birthday, or a family holiday. Answer a short set of questions about the person, such as how you met, a date that matters, a favorite song, or an inside joke. Add up to five photos if you like.

The app builds a room of six to eight doors from your answers. Doors include a date padlock, a word scramble, a cipher, riddles about your memories, a photo sliding puzzle, and a final lock that spells out your message to them.

On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, the story text and hints are written on the device by Apple's on-device model. On other iPhones, the app uses written story text and hints, and every room plays the same way.

Making a room and playing its first door are free. To send a room, unlock it with a one-time purchase for that room. Then share the gift file by Messages, AirDrop, or another app you choose. The person you send it to opens it in Keepsake Escape, which is free, and plays it on their iPhone. No internet connection is needed to play.

There are no accounts and no ads. Your answers, photos, and rooms stay on your phone, and a gift file goes only where you send it.

name: Keepsake: The Little Things
description:
Some days deserve more than a spot on your calendar.

Keepsake is a beautifully simple birthday, anniversary and event calendar designed for the moments that make life meaningful. From celebrating the people you love to remembering the days that shaped your life, Keepsake gives every special date a place of its own.

**All your special days in one place**
- Birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, memorials and personal milestones.
- Annual and one-time events.
- Countdowns to upcoming occasions.
- Birthday ages and anniversary milestones.
- Upcoming and past events, beautifully organized.

**Make every celebration a little more thoughtful**
- Save gift ideas alongside your events.
- See what's coming up this month and over the next three months.
- Quickly find important dates with built-in search.

**Make it yours**
- Six carefully designed color themes: Champagne, Petal, Apricot, Violet, Pistachio and Midnight.
- A beautiful home screen widget that keeps your next special day in sight.
- English and Russian language support.

**Personal by design**
No accounts, no ads, no unnecessary distractions. Your events and gift ideas stay on your device.

Whether it's a birthday, a wedding anniversary, a favorite holiday or a quiet day of remembrance, Keepsake helps you hold on to the little things.

Because the little things are often the big things.

name: Kettlemark
description:
Kettlemark is a focused logbook for home coffee. Record the beans, method, grind size, coffee dose, water weight, water temperature, and brew time for every cup you make.

Add a 1 to 5 cup rating, write tasting notes in your own words, attach a photo of the pour, and organize entries with tags you define yourself. Kettlemark keeps only what you enter and never judges your coffee or gives dietary advice.

LOG EVERY CUP IN SECONDS
Record pour-over, espresso, French press, AeroPress, Moka pot, cold brew, or custom methods. Edit past entries or tap Brew Again to repeat a recipe with the same starting parameters.

CHALKBOARD BREW TIMER
Follow editable pre-wet, pour, wait, and finish steps with subtle haptic cues at each transition. Kettlemark keeps the screen awake while the timer runs and prefills a new brew entry when you finish.

LIVE RATIO CALCULATOR
Adjust coffee dose, water volume, ratio, or cup count and see every measurement update right away. Send the scaled values straight into a new brew entry.

BEAN BAG SHELF
Track bag name, roaster, origin, roast date, bag weight, and price. Kettlemark subtracts each logged dose to estimate remaining grams and days left at your own pace.

BEST BREWS AND COMPARISON
Review your highest-rated cups and compare two or three brews side by side, field by field, with differences highlighted.

LOCAL EXPORTS AND FULL CONTROL
Export your records as CSV or a printable PDF through the iOS share sheet, or save and restore a full JSON backup. Units for weight, volume, temperature, currency, and dates follow your device locale with manual overrides in Settings.

Kettlemark works offline with no accounts, no ads, no subscriptions, and no tracking. You can remove all local data at any time from Settings.

name: Keystoned Steel Fishing Guides
description:
Keystoned Steel is the living-edition guide library for Great Lakes steelhead and trout anglers — 283 guides covering 154 waters across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio, Michigan, Minnesota and Ontario's Georgian Bay.

Every guide is a living edition. Unlock it here with the key from your delivery email, and every update lands free — access changes, posted-land closures and seasonal playbooks stay current all season. Guides open right in the app and work fully offline on the creek.

INSIDE EVERY GUIDE
• Live USGS gauges — real flow readings, stamped with the time the gauge took them
• Flow bands — the exact windows that say go, wait, or stay home, and how fast each creek clears after rain
• Access points & parking — where to get in, pool by pool, with posted vs. open water marked
• Live weather & radar built into the guide
• Verified stream cameras where they exist — and an honest note where a water has none
• Baits, rigs and drifts keyed to water color and flow

THE FLAGSHIP
The Guide — Erie Steelhead covers all twelve Pennsylvania Lake Erie tributaries — Walnut, Elk, Conneaut, Trout Run and the rest of Steelhead Alley — in one living edition, with techniques in depth and the history of each water woven through.

FREE IN THE APP
• Today's Conditions — the Morning Call read off live gauges: which creek is worth the drive
• A free Walnut Creek sample chapter — no charge, no card
• Steelhead Fight — our creek fishing game, free on the Pennsylvania waters

NO ACCOUNT, NO SIGN-IN
Your unlock key is your library. Type it once; the guide stays unlocked on your device. Keys never expire — re-enter yours on a new phone or after a reinstall to restore your guides.

Every guide and pack is covered by our 7-day satisfaction guarantee.

name: Khổng Minh Thần Số: Khong Minh
description: Khổng Minh Thần Số (hay Khổng Minh Thần Toán) là phương pháp gieo quẻ, luận đoán sự việc chuẩn xác theo cổ thư của Khổng Minh Gia Cát Lượng. Ứng dụng giúp bạn gieo quẻ tĩnh tâm, tra cứu 384 quẻ thần toán chi tiết và đầy đủ lời thơ luận giải.

name: Kids Checkers: Animal Friends
description:
Checkers made for kids aged 5–10. A bright wooden board, cheerful sounds and animal opponents to beat one after another.

SIX OPPONENTS
The Chick has just learned the moves, the Bunny grabs whatever it sees, the Kitten looks one move ahead, the Fox is sly, the Owl thinks far ahead and the Lion plays for real. Win a game, earn a star and meet the next opponent.

TWO PLAYERS
Play with a friend, a sibling or a parent on one iPhone or iPad. The opponent's name plate faces them, so you can sit across from each other.

RULES IN PICTURES
Seven short pages: the board itself shows how to move, how to capture, how a checker becomes a king and how to win.

HELPS, NEVER SCOLDS
• Dots show where you can move.
• When a capture is required, the right checkers light up.
• Unlimited Undo and Hint buttons.
• An unfinished game is saved automatically.

BEAUTIFUL AND FUN TO HEAR
Checkers hop, captured ones burst into sparkles, kings get a golden crown and every win ends in confetti. Each capture in a row sounds a note higher.

HONEST FOR KIDS
Free. No ads, no purchases, no links to outside websites. Works offline and collects no data.

The game uses Russian draughts rules: men capture both forward and backward, kings move any distance along a diagonal, and capturing is mandatory.

name: Kima Embouteillage
description:
Kima Embouteillage est l'assistant de navigation et de départ proactif conçu spécialement pour la réalité de la circulation urbaine à Kinshasa (République Démocratique du Congo).
Ne restez plus bloqué des heures dans les bouchons aux heures de pointe. Kima Embouteillage analyse les points d'étranglement stratégiques de la capitale et vous propose instantanément la meilleure stratégie de contournement.

    FONCTIONNALITÉS PRINCIPALES :

    • Double Stratégie d'Itinéraire : Voie Royale vs Passe Kinoise Comparez en un coup d'œil l'artère principale directe (Voie Royale : Boulevard du 30 Juin, Boulevard Lumumba...) avec l'itinéraire tactique de contournement (Passe Kinoise : Boulevard Triomphal, Avenue de la Libération, Sendwe, Kasa-Vubu...) pour gagner un temps précieux.

    • Modélisation des Bouchons de Kinshasa Anticipation intelligente des heures de pointe (matin 06h30–09h30 et soir 16h30–20h30) et surveillance des points chauds : Rond-point Mandela, Socimat, Rond-point Victoire, Rond-point Ngaba, Échangeur de Limete / Pont Matete, Kintambo Magasin, Rond-point Huileries et Pompage.

    • Copilote IA Kinois avec Guidage Vocal Recevez des conseils de circulation proactifs, vivants et adaptés à votre trajet en français kinois et lingala, avec synthèse vocale intégrée pour garder les yeux sur la route.

    • Recherche Hybride Instantanée (Hors-ligne & En ligne) Accédez sans attente aux 24 communes de Kinshasa (Gombe, Limete, Bandalungwa, Lemba,Matete, Kintambo, Ngaliema...) et à plus de 35 repères incontournables (Pullman, Fleuve Congo Hotel, Palais du Peuple, UNIKIN, Marché Central, Hôpital du Cinquantenaire, Aéroport de N'djili), complétés par la recherche d'adresses en direct via OpenStreetMap.

    • Routines Quotidiennes en 1 Tap & Alerte de Départ
    Configurez vos trajets fréquents (Boulot, Maison, École). Le moteur proactif évalue le trafic et vous recommande soit de partir immédiatement (DEPART MAINTENANT), soit de patienter quelques minutes pour éviter le pic de congestion.

    • Cartographie Sombre Haute Lisibilité
    Interface cockpit sombre optimisée pour la conduite de jour comme de nuit avec suivi GPS en temps réel.

name: Kin Alarm
description:
Type one line. It lands on their calendar, with an alarm.

Write something like "Pick up laundry at 3 today" and the app splits it into date, time, place and to-do before you send. Not sure about AM or PM? Tap once to switch, then Send. Send it to the whole family or to one person.

The plan lands on their calendar. In "Ring an alarm?" they pick On time, 30m early or No alarm, and the phone alerts them then. Your phone shows Received and Alarm set.

If your family also uses NODEX's baby or pet app in the same home, requests, milestones and the days a diary was written show up on this calendar. Diary text, photos and health entries are never shown or kept here.

Useful alone. No nagging invites.

No family yet? Add plans to your own calendar and set alarms anyway. Invite people only when you want to.

Past plans stay unless you delete them. Not used to train AI.

Plans stay on our server while your home exists. New phone? Make a reconnect code on your old phone and bring them over. Your plans are not sent to any AI company.

No sign-up, no login. We never ask for your real name, phone number or email. No ads.

When you set your first alarm, we’ll ask to turn on “Alarms” — then they ring even in silent mode and Focus. Until then, they play the notification sound once.

Contact: ceo@nodex.co.kr

name: Kin Album: Share Family Photos
description:
Add a photo of your kids and Grandma, Grandpa, Mom and Dad can see it in the family album. A family album only your family can see.

Grandparents just tap one link. No sign-up, no password. Invite them to view — they can see photos and leave hearts and comments. Invite others to add photos too.

Photos are grouped by month. Add your child's birthday and their age shows next to each month. With two or more kids, you can show one child at a time.

Add up to 100 photos at a time, with an optional child tag and a short note. Each photo lands on the date it was taken.

Hearts and comments on every photo, just for family.

Tap Save · share to open your phone's share sheet and send or save a photo.

Select several photos to delete them or change the child tag at once (up to 50).

If your family also uses NODEX's Fed & Changed or Did We Feed?, photos added there show up in the album too.

Offline? Photos you picked wait and upload by themselves if you're back online within a day.

Before a photo of your child is uploaded, the person adding it agrees once to the child photo consent. Photos are resized (long side 2048) and location and device info are removed before sending. Children's faces are never sent to AI.

Deleting a photo removes it from family phones and widgets; the original in your phone's gallery stays. When you leave, you can also delete the photos, hearts and comments you added.

No ads. We don't ask for your real name, phone number or email. Only your family sees your photos.

Contact: ceo@nodex.co.kr

name: King Arthur's Quest
description:
Ride with King Arthur through the real places of North Cornwall in a match-3 adventure.

Start at Tintagel Castle, where Arthur was born, and fight your way along the coast and over the moor: Merlin's Cave, Trebarwith Strand, St Nectan's Glen, Boscastle, Crackington Haven, the Delabole slate quarry, St Teath, Port Isaac, Camelford, Rough Tor, Bodmin Moor, Dozmary Pool, King Arthur's Hall and Padstow, all the way to Camelot.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe gems to make rows of three or more
• Swords and dragon fire hurt the enemy, shields block, grails heal, crowns bring gold and potions charge Merlin's lightning
• Match 4 for a line blast, an L or T shape for a bomb, and 5 in a row to forge Excalibur
• Every few moves the enemy strikes back, so plan ahead

64 BATTLES, 16 BOSSES
Saxon raiders, piskies and spriggans, wreckers, quarry knockers, the Kraken, Sir Mordred, the Beast of Bodmin, Giant Bolster and the White Dragon.

THE ROUND TABLE
Win battles and eight knights join you, including Sir Tristan of Cornwall. Each one makes Arthur stronger.

A FEAST AT SMUGGLERS
Stop at Smugglers in Delabole for fish and chips. A Smugglers Feast heals Arthur in the middle of a battle, and there's a free one every day.

Free to play, with adverts. Optional purchases: gold, and removing adverts.

name: Kings Casino
description:
Kings Casino is a companion app for members of Kings Casino venues in Ireland.

Access your digital membership card, manage your membership details, view your recent visits and check available member vouchers. Keep up to date with club news, venue information and house rules.

Features:
• Digital membership card with a scannable membership code
• Membership registration and account management
• Member vouchers and recent visit history
• Club news, venue information and house rules
• Privacy, security and account support

Membership is subject to eligibility, identity verification and the rules of the relevant venue. This app is intended for adults.

name: Kip: Pill Reminder
description:
Starting a new prescription, and worried you will forget a dose — or take one twice?

Kip is the simple pill reminder. Set your times once, get a reminder for every dose, and mark it Taken, Skipped, or Snoozed in one tap — right from the notification.

It shows you, at a glance:
- What is due now, and what is next
- What you have already taken today, so there is no guessing
- How many doses you have left, with a warning before a bottle runs out

Schedules can be daily, on specific days, every few hours, every few days, tapering down step by step, or as-needed — set up in plain language, in your own words from your prescription label.

No subscription. No account. No ads.

Most medication apps charge every month, fill the screen with trackers you did not ask for, or show ads next to your medicines. Kip is free to download for up to three medications, with a single $4.99 lifetime unlock for unlimited medications, full refill tracking, full history, and export. That is it.

Free includes:
- Reminders for up to 3 medications, with one follow-up if a dose gets no answer
- One-tap Taken, Skipped, and Snoozed, including from the notification
- Refill countdown for 1 medication
- The last 14 days of history

Lifetime unlock ($4.99, once) adds:
- Unlimited medications
- Refill countdowns and low-supply warnings for every medication
- Full history and adherence summary
- CSV export to take to a clinician or pharmacist appointment

Your medication data stays on your phone. There is no sign-up, no account, and nothing is uploaded.

Kip is a reminder and a log. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. It does not check whether medicines interact. Always take medication as directed by your prescriber or pharmacist, and ask them what to do if you miss a dose.

name: Kira Freight Fleet
description:
Kira Fleet is the work app of Kira Freight.

For drivers:
• Link the phone once with your personal inspection link from the office - scan its QR code or paste the link.
• Film the pre-trip or post-trip walk-around with the phone camera.
• Tick only what has a problem, add a note and sign.
• Send to the office. On a weak signal the video keeps sending from where it stopped.
• Report a repair on the road with the receipt and photos, and see what the office answered.
• English, Russian and Spanish.

For the office and fleet managers:
• Write a handover act next to the truck: issued or returned, odometer, place, defects, photos and two signatures.
• Open the fleet dashboard: trucks and trailers, inspection videos, map.

Kira Fleet is for Kira Freight drivers and staff. It needs a personal link or an office sign-in from Kira Freight.

name: KitScribe
description:
Prepare repeatable work without rebuilding the same list.

KitScribe turns reusable equipment and preparation lists into separate checkable runs. Keep a template for recurring work, then track each occasion independently.

BUILD YOUR KITS
Create a kit with a name and notes. Add items, organize them into groups and set quantities. Edit a kit as your needs change or delete it with confirmation. Search the library by kit or item name.

RUN A CHECKLIST
Start a run from a kit to create an independent snapshot of its items. Check and uncheck each item as you prepare. See progress immediately and complete the run when every item has been checked. Later template edits do not rewrite existing runs.

KEEP A HISTORY
Review active and completed runs, filter the history and inspect what was checked. All templates and runs are stored on your device and remain available after relaunch.

No account, advertising, subscription or in-app purchase. Choose light, dark or system appearance. The app supports English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Optional fictional examples show a field-recording kit and a workshop setup.

An optional remote startup configuration can open a configured HTTPS destination externally and keep the app covered in white for the current process. Native lists are shown for the native configuration or when configuration cannot be read. Any enabled destination must be disclosed and consistent with the product.

name: Kıvılcım: Robotik Eğitim
description:
Kıvılcım; robotik, elektronik, kodlama ve yapay zekâyı kısa dersler, canlı laboratuvarlar ve oyunla öğreten bir öğrenme uygulaması. Yolun sonunda hedef belli: bir drone'u kendin tasarlayıp dengeleyip güvenle uçurmak.

9 AŞAMADA DRONE MÜHENDİSLİĞİNE
Düşünmeyi Öğren → Elektriğe Merhaba → Kod Yaz → Bilgisayarın İçi ve Güvenlik → Kartı Programla → Robot Kur → Akıllı Robotlar → Yapay Zekâ → Drone Mühendisliği. Her aşama bir öncekinin üstüne kurulur; 12 konu, 77 ünite ve 350'yi aşkın ders tek bir devre kartı yolunda.

BİTMEYEN SORULAR
Her ders bir soru üretici. Tekrar ettikçe sorular değişir, zorluk artar, ustalığın 1'den 5'e yükselir. Sonsuz Mod zayıf olduğun konulara ağırlık verir.

ÖNCE ANLA, SONRA DENE
Her ders kısa bir anlatımla başlar: yeni bilgi, adım adım çözüm, birlikte çözülen örnek. Cevaptan sonra animasyon etkileşimli bir laboratuvara dönüşür; kaydırıcıları oynat, sonucu kendin gör.

17 LABORATUVAR
LED yak, direnç hesapla, mantık kapılarını bağla, robot programla, gerilim bölücü kur, PWM ile motor sür, kondansatör şarj et, perceptron eğit. Bozmak serbest.

MİKRO İŞLEMCİ ATÖLYESİ
Ekrandaki kartta kabloları kendin tak, programı yaşına göre yaz: çocuklar için sürükle-bırak bloklar, gençler için mantık blokları, ileri seviye için gerçek Arduino kodu. Işık, servo, DC motor, ses ve sensör bölümlerinde 54 alıştırma.

DRONE ATÖLYESİ
Gövde, motor, pervane ve bataryayı seç; itki, ağırlık ve uçuş süresi anında hesaplansın. Gaz koluyla uç, PID ayarıyla rüzgâra karşı dengede tut, tasarım görevlerini tamamla.

HER YAŞA GÖRE
7 yaşındaki çocuktan üniversite öğrencisine ve yetişkine kadar: yaş grubuna göre ayrı ders seçimi, zorluk ve dil.

OYUN GİBİ
XP, seviyeler, günlük hedef, seri, elmaslar, ödül sandıkları, başarımlar, haftalık lig ve kendi tasarladığın robot karakter.

İNTERNETSİZ ÇALIŞIR
Uygulamanın tamamı çevrimdışı kullanılabilir. İstersen Google ya da Apple ile girip ilerlemeni yedekler, başka cihazda devam edersin.

KIVILCIM PLUS
Sınırsız batarya, 2 kat sandık ödülü, seri kalkanı ve Sonsuz Mod'da 5 can. Aylık ya da yıllık abonelik; dilediğin zaman Ayarlar'dan iptal edebilirsin.

Gizlilik politikası: https://186-241-26-13.sslip.io/gizlilik
Kullanım koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kkodagi Playground: Minigames
description:
Play with Kkodagi every day! Kkodagi Playground is a bundle of cute minigames starring Kkodagi, the little chick.

THREE MINIGAMES
- Hop: tap to jump! Time your hops on the platforms and climb to the sky.
- Peek: find the one hidden Kkodagi in a busy crowd.
- Rhythm: tap to the beat! Big combos light up the stage.

SHARED WARDROBE
- Open eggs with the coins you earn in games and collect 45 outfits: hats, glasses, clothes and shoes.
- Mix and match your own look, and complete a set for a bonus.
- Odds for every grade are always shown in the wardrobe (View odds). Eggs use in-game coins only and are never sold for money.

ONLINE LEADERBOARD (OPTIONAL)
- Pick a nickname and climb the ranks in each game and overall.
- No sign-up needed, and you can delete your record at any time.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Play right away without an account. Your progress is saved on your device.
- Rewarded ads only when you choose to watch (no interstitials). Buy "Play without ads" to get rewards instantly.
- Coins, eggs and outfits are never sold for money.

Contact: contact@kkodagi.com
Privacy Policy: https://play.kkodagi.com/privacy
Terms: https://play.kkodagi.com/terms

name: Klava: Voice Keyboard
description:
Talk instead of typing. Klava is an iPhone keyboard that types like the standard one and turns your voice into text in any app.

• Swipe on the space bar to switch languages. 67 layouts to choose from.
• Tap the microphone key to dictate: Klava records on its own screen with Start over, Done and Cancel, then goes back to your app and types the text.
• Whisper on iPhone recognizes speech on the device, with no account and no key.
• Prefer the cloud? Use OpenAI, Whisper (cloud) or Google Gemini with your own API key.
• AI cleanup fixes punctuation and drops filler words (with your OpenAI key).
• Translate between English and Russian in one tap (with your OpenAI key).
• Emoji panel, snippets, clipboard history and undo.

No account, no ads, no tracking. What you type stays on your iPhone. A recording goes to OpenAI or Google only when you pick their engine, and text only when you use AI cleanup or Translate, always with your own key.

Turn it on in Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard › Klava, then allow Full Access for voice input, snippets, clipboard history and translation. Typing works without Full Access.

name: Know Your Sh*t
description:
The knowledge round is where good engineers get filtered out. Know Your Sh*t drills you on it for five minutes a day.

Page faults, TCP internals, isolation levels, memory ordering, Raft, kernel bypass, KV caches. The things quant, HFT, infrastructure and backend interviewers actually ask, in short daily sessions that adapt to you.

HOW IT WORKS
- A daily session of multiple choice, flashcards and "explain it" questions
- A skill score for every topic. Get TCP right and TCP gets harder. Miss DNS and DNS eases off.
- Spaced-repetition reviews bring back what you got wrong before you forget it
- Explain answers are graded against a rubric, so you see exactly what an interviewer would want to hear and what you skipped

NEED CONTEXT?
New topic? Gary or Tyler pops in before you answer. Tap for the 30-second background: a short explainer, a diagram and the key terms. Never the answer.

ASK THE AI TUTOR
Still fuzzy after the explanation? Ask a follow-up. The tutor answers in plain English and can draw a live diagram: request flows, protocol exchanges, Git branches, orders of magnitude. AI can make mistakes, so every question also ships with a written explanation and a deep dive.

Smart grading is on by default. Switch it off in Settings and check your own answers against the rubric instead.

START FROM ZERO
Five free beginner courses, each opening with short lessons before the questions:
- How Computers Work
- Terminal & Linux
- Git & GitHub Basics
- How the Internet Works
- Cloud & AWS Basics

CORE TRACKS
Systems · Infrastructure · Networking · Full-Stack (Deep) · Databases · C++ & Low Latency · ML Systems & Inference · Distributed Systems

COMPETE
- Streaks, XP and ranks, with streak freezes for the day life happens
- A weekly leaderboard that resets every Monday
- Live rooms: same questions, same clock, fastest right answer wins. Share a code with your study group.

MAKE IT YOURS
Dark, light and paper themes. Voice answers for explain questions. Optional daily reminders.

FREE AND PRO
Free: one daily session, the beginner courses, the core tracks, 3 tutor follow-ups and 1 graded answer a day.
Pro adds unlimited sessions, drills on any track or topic, review mode, the System Design and Behavioral interview sections, every answer graded, 30 tutor follow-ups a day and bigger daily goals.

- Pro Monthly and Pro Annual are auto-renewing subscriptions. Annual may include a 1-week free trial for eligible new subscribers.
- The Interview Sprint is a one-time purchase of 8 weeks of Pro. It doesn't renew.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://knowyourshit.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://knowyourshit.app/privacy

name: KNWN: AI Visibility
description:
Know what AI says about your brand.

People now ask AI assistants which product to buy, which agency to hire and which tool to try. KNWN tracks the answers. It asks AI assistants the questions your customers ask, records every answer, and shows how often your brand comes up, who gets recommended instead, and which websites the AI relies on.

The KNWN app puts your brands' numbers in your pocket.

OVERVIEW
• Your AI visibility: the share of answers that mention you, and how it changed over the last 7, 30 or 90 days
• The trend against your competitors
• Each AI assistant on its own, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers, depending on what your plan tracks
• "No clear change" when a move is within normal variation, so you only react to real changes

QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
• Every question you track, with how many answers mention you
• Read the full answer each assistant gave, with your brand highlighted, the competitors it named and the sources it cited
• See the answers for one question or one assistant, and show only those that mention you or leave you out

SOURCES
• The websites and pages AI assistants cite when they answer
• The sources that cite your competitors but not you: your best places to be mentioned next

BUILT FOR CHECKING ON THE GO
• Opens on your last numbers and refreshes in the background
• Light and dark mode, iPhone and iPad
• Switch between brands in one tap

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Tap "Explore a sample brand" to see every screen with sample data.

You need a KNWN account to see your own brands. Add brands, questions and competitors on the KNWN website; changes appear in the app automatically. Sign in with your email and password, Apple, Google, GitHub or LinkedIn.

KNWN is not affiliated with OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Perplexity, Microsoft, xAI or Meta. Product names belong to their owners.

name: Komawari - ストーリー動画コラージュ
description:
複数の動画を、レイアウトに並べて1本の縦長動画にするアプリです。
ストーリーにそのまま投稿できる9:16（1080×1920）で書き出します。

■ 使い方
1. 9種類のレイアウトから選ぶ
2. 写真アプリから動画を選ぶ（まとめて選ぶと順番に入ります）
3. 指でドラッグして見せたい位置に、ピンチで大きさを調整
4. 「完成」で書き出して、保存またはシェア

■ できること
・2分割〜6分割の9種類のレイアウト
・すべての動画を同時に再生しながら編集
・動画を長押しして、別の枠へ入れ替え
・動画の間の余白と、背景色（白／黒）を変更
・短い動画に合わせるか、長い動画に合わせるかを選択（短い動画は繰り返し再生）
・動画ごとに音のオン・オフ
・縦向き、横向きの動画のどちらにも対応

■ Komawari Pro（買い切り）
一度の購入で、ずっと使えます。
・広告なし
・書き出した動画に透かしが入りません
・最長60秒まで書き出し（無料版は15秒まで）

※選んだ動画はアプリの中だけで使われ、外部に送信されることはありません。アカウント登録は不要です。
※無料版では広告が表示されます。

name: Konseq
description:
Konseq brings the tasks, projects and decisions of all your companies into one place – for people who run several businesses or projects at the same time.

PERSONAL – NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
• Tasks with due dates, duration, subtasks and reminders
• Projects with a goal and a deadline; "Path to the goal" shows what is done and what is missing
• "Up next" names your next task
• Capture ideas and decide: pursue, park, discard or adopt
• Without an account, everything stays encrypted on your device

COMPANIES
• Sign in to every company that uses Konseq and switch between them with one tap
• Team tasks with assignee, status and comments
• Decisions with options, recommendation and reasoning
• Questions and notifications in one place
• Each company can set its own look; the app follows it
• Sign in with email and password, or with your company's Google or Microsoft account if your company has set it up

AI WITH YOUR OWN KEY
• In "Personal", talk to the AI of your choice (Anthropic or OpenAI) about your day, your projects and your companies' knowledge
• You enter your own API key; requests go directly from your device to the provider, not through Konseq
• The AI suggests tasks; only what you accept is created. In your companies it only reads and changes nothing
• In companies, Konseq uses the AI the company has set up itself

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Widget for today
• Shortcuts and Siri
• Face ID or Touch ID lock

PRIVACY
• No tracking, no ads
• Delete your account and data directly in the app

name: Korean Lock Screen: Hangul
description:
Learn Korean every time you check your phone. Hangul Lock puts a Korean word on your lock screen and changes it every hour, so the words you need find you, not the other way round.

Your Korean era starts here:
• A new Korean word on your lock screen every hour, with how it sounds and what it means
• A round lock screen widget with your streak, so you never forget today's quiz
• Daily check-in: stamp your week with fire stamps, hit 3, 7, 14 and 30-day streak milestones
• Optional streak reminders at 8pm, only on days you haven't done your quiz yet
• Combos, sounds, haptics and confetti that make every right answer feel good
• Today's quiz is made from the words your lock screen showed you
• Words you miss come back on the lock screen more often until they stick
• Tap any word to hear it, with a simple example sentence for each one
• 894 essential words for beginners, from hello to everyday verbs (TOPIK I level)
• Fluent mode: hide the romanization and read Hangul like a native for 2× XP
• Level up from trainee to debut, idol and icon as your XP grows

Made for K-pop fans, K-drama lovers, travelers and TOPIK learners who want Korean to be part of their day, not another app they forget to open.

Hangul Lock Pro unlocks the widgets, the daily quiz and all words. Choose a yearly subscription with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your App Store account settings.

Word list: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Learning Vocabulary List (2003), KOGL Type 1.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hangul-web.8tools.workers.dev/privacy
Support: effy.sohn@gmail.com

name: Kostari Craft - Cosplay Plan
description:
Bring a costume idea through the making process with Kostari Craft. Organize projects by character, track the parts you need to build, note fitting changes, and keep material costs in view from the first plan to the final adjustment.

Keep Each Costume Project Together
Create a project for a character or original design and record its measurements. See the number of parts, open tasks, progress, and planned material cost at a glance.

Work Through the Build Queue
Break a costume into individual pieces, list the materials each one needs, and update its status as you work. The build queue brings unfinished parts from different projects into one view.

Note Changes During Fittings
Write down fit issues and adjustments while trying on a costume. Mark the related parts for fitting so you can return to them before calling the build complete.

Follow Materials and Costs
Record material quantities, units, and prices for each project. Compare the planned total with actual spending, then export a material list when you need it for shopping or preparation.

name: KTO: Kingdom Trails Oxford
description:
See Oxford through the buildings that give the city its character. KTO: Kingdom Trails Oxford brings together 16 illustrated locations from four architectural periods, from medieval chapels to contemporary university buildings.

Browse by period or search for a building by name. Read about styles, materials and details to look for when you visit. Explore the interactive map, save your favourites for later and share places with anyone planning a visit.

Find the two nearest locations based on your coordinates. Use your current location or enter coordinates yourself to see approximate walking and driving distances and travel times. Open a destination in your maps app when you are ready to plan the route.

How much did you notice? Choose five or ten questions from a collection of 48 and explore one period or all four. Check your score and read the explanations at the end of each round.

Find a suggested viewpoint and shooting direction for each building in the guide. Save your photographs in a personal gallery with titles, coordinates and notes, and add places you discover on your own.

name: Ku Snack Merge
description: A merge game with a hungry monster. Drop snacks into the jar; two of a kind merge into the next one up. A monster leans on the jar craving one snack at a time: merge into that snack and its tongue snatches it out of the jar for big points (and room to breathe). Keep it waiting and it gets grumpy and stomps the jar.

name: Kulki: Color Lines
description:
Kulki ist der Klassiker „Color Lines“ – modern, klar und ohne Ablenkung.

So geht's: Bewege eine Kugel auf ein freies Feld – der Weg dorthin muss frei sein. Bilde Reihen aus 5 oder mehr gleichfarbigen Kugeln (waagerecht, senkrecht oder diagonal), dann verschwinden sie. Ohne Treffer kommen neue Kugeln aufs Brett. 10 Linien = Brett geschafft, jedes neue Brett ist voller und schwerer.

• 3 Schwierigkeitsstufen – von entspannt bis richtig knifflig
• Wandernde Steine blockieren Wege – jedes Brett bleibt aber lösbar
• „Zurück“ und „Brett neu“ für den Notfall
• Wochenligen: 12 Ligen, Gruppen mit 30 Spielern, Auf- und Abstieg jede Woche (Computer-Gegner sind klar als KI gekennzeichnet)
• Ruhmeshalle mit den besten Ergebnissen
• Ohne Anmeldung – nur ein frei wählbarer Nickname, jederzeit löschbar
• Funktioniert offline
• Sanfte Klänge, abschaltbar
• Deutsch, Polnisch, Englisch

Kostenlos, ohne fremde Werbung und ohne Tracking. Zwischendurch stellen wir kurz unsere eigenen Apps für Handwerk und Betriebe vor (Angebix, XMS Tools, XMS Rechnung, XMS Calendar, XMS PI).

Ein Spiel von getxms.com.

name: Kura: Document & Family Vault
description:
IDs, insurance cards, warranties, loyalty cards, coupons, screenshots and your family's certificates. Bring everything scattered across your iPhone together in one vault.

SNAP, PICK OR SHARE
• Scan with the camera (shadows and skew fixed automatically)
• Import photos, screenshots, files and email attachments
• Save from any app's Share button — just choose Kura

ORGANIZED FOR YOU
• Reads the text and detects the type (ID, warranty, receipt…)
• Finds expiry dates and sets them automatically
• Splits out names, numbers and addresses so you can copy them with a tap

EXPIRY CHECKER (NEW)
• See expiry dates of documents, cards, coupons and tickets on a calendar or in a table
• Expired, within 30 days, within 90 days — at a glance
• Get a notification before anything expires

YOUR FAMILY IN ONE PLACE
• Keep each person's certificates and insurance cards together
• Suggestions for documents you haven't saved yet
• Copy the whole family's numbers and emails as a table

KURA AI (on Apple Intelligence devices)
• Just ask “What's expiring soon?” or “What's my license number?”
• Shows what it's thinking and which tools it uses, and checks answers against your documents
• Source cards open the document instantly
• Everything runs on your iPhone

MAP AND BRANCHES
• See where you saved things on a map
• Organize with branches like “Home” or “Car” in a mind map

HANDY TOOLS
• HEIC → JPEG / PNG, images to PDF, PDF to images
• Remove photo location, shrink images, copy text from images

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Data is encrypted and stored on this iPhone
• Passcode and Face ID lock, plus per-document locks
• No ads, no tracking, nothing sent to the developer's servers

Available in English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese.

name: Kymora
description:
Η Kymora είναι τοπική κονσόλα λειτουργίας για υδροηλεκτρικό σταθμό. Βλέπετε τον ταμιευτήρα, ρυθμίζετε τις θύρες, ελέγχετε τις μετρήσεις και κρατάτε ιστορικό εντολών — χωρίς σύνδεση σε πραγματικό εξοπλισμό.

Πώς τη χρησιμοποιείτε

1. Κονσόλα
Ανοίγετε την εφαρμογή και βλέπετε αμέσως στάθμη, παροχή και υγεία σταθμού. Ορίστε στόχο παροχής και πατήστε «Κατανομή» για να μοιραστεί στις ελεύθερες θύρες.

2. Θύρες
Επιλέξτε σχέδιο (Άρδευση, Πλημμύρα, Ισορροπία, Κράτηση) ή ανοίξτε μία θύρα. Σύρετε το άνοιγμα, δείτε την εκτιμώμενη παροχή και επιβεβαιώστε την εντολή. Η άμεση στάση παγώνει τη θύρα. Το κλείδωμα συντήρησης την εξαιρεί από τα σχέδια.

3. Μετρήσεις
Παρακολουθήστε ανάντη/κατάντη στάθμη, παροχή, εισροή, πίεση, θερμοκρασία και δονήσεις. Οι καμπύλες ανανεώνονται κάθε 3 δευτερόλεπτα.

4. Συμβάντα
Όταν ξεπεραστεί όριο, εμφανίζεται ειδοποίηση και σήμα στο εικονίδιο. Αναγνωρίστε ή απορρίψτε. Στο ημερολόγιο φιλτράρετε εντολές θυρών, ορίων και βάρδιας· μπορείτε να τις εξάγετε.

5. Σταθμός
Γράψτε όνομα σταθμού, χειριστή και σημείωμα παράδοσης. Ρυθμίστε κατώφλια και το ομαδικό όριο ανοιγμάτων. Η επαναφορά γυρίζει τον προσομοιωτή στην αρχική κατάσταση.

Κλειδωμένες θύρες και το ομαδικό όριο εμποδίζουν επικίνδυνες εντολές. Κάθε ενέργεια καταγράφεται με ώρα και όνομα χειριστή.

name: La Hora Pico
description:
Saliste tarde y el jefe ya está escribiendo. En Hora Pico corres por el andén en plena hora punta: cambia de carril, salta charcos y mochilas, agáchate bajo los carritos y esquiva al vendedor ambulante y al ladrón que quiere tus monedas.

• Pasa por las paradas para ganar segundos antes de que se acabe el tiempo.
• Café para el turbo, tarjeta para los torniquetes y monedas en el aire para los valientes.
• Desbloquea a La Profe, El Artista y La Deportista con tus monedas.
• Música de cumbia y cumbiatón, y un jefe con excusas para todo.
• Controles sencillos: desliza para moverte, saltar y agacharte.

Sin anuncios, sin compras y sin conexión a internet.

name: LabelCairn
description:
LabelCairn is a paper workbench for small studios, makers and anyone organizing labels.

BUILD YOUR SHEET
Choose A4 or US Letter paper. Set columns, rows, margins and gaps in millimeters. Label dimensions are calculated from your layout.

WRITE EACH LABEL
Add and edit text for individual cells. Keep several named layouts, search your saved sheets and see how much of each sheet is filled.

PREVIEW BEFORE PRINTING
Inspect a real PDF, include or omit cutting guides and share the PDF to your chosen destination. Print at 100% scale and test alignment on plain paper before using label stock. Text fit depends on label dimensions; check the preview before printing.

YOUR WORKSPACE
Business records are stored locally. There is no account, advertising, subscription or in-app purchase. Choose a light or dark appearance and an in-app language. Optional sample records are available from Settings when your library is empty.

The App includes English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Store materials are provided in English.

name: LabelPeek: Label Maker Print
description:
LabelPeek designs and prints labels, QR codes, notes and photos on your Bluetooth label maker or pocket thermal printer. One app for many printers, with no account, no ads and no cloud: your labels stay on your phone.

PRINTING IS ALWAYS FREE
No paywall before printing, no cap on printed labels, no templates that vanish. Pro only adds extras.

LABELS YOUR WAY
• Multi-line text, alignment, auto-fit size, vertical text
• Bold, outline, white-on-black, frames, lines and shapes
• Rotation by 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees plus mirror, done in the preview: what you see is what prints
• 1:1 preview in the print head's real pixels, so nothing prints in a corner or cut off

THE RIGHT PAPER
• Ready-made profiles for the most common rolls and labels
• Custom profile: width, length, continuous paper or gap labels, adjustable offset

QR CODES AND BARCODES
QR, Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39 and Data Matrix. A Wi-Fi QR code takes one tap: guests scan it and they're online.

PHOTOS YOU CAN SEE
Several dithering algorithms (threshold, Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson, Bayer) with brightness, contrast and gamma, and a faithful preview before you waste paper.

EDITABLE TEMPLATES
Cable flags, jars and pantry with name and date, folders, price tags, addresses, Wi-Fi QR, shopping list, notes and to-dos. Every template is a normal label: change anything.

HANDY EVERY DAY
• Label series with a counter and dates (such as "opened on")
• History of recent prints, reprint in one tap
• Share an image or text from another app to LabelPeek
• Multiple copies, density and speed
• Printer battery, paper and lid status, where the model reports them

TRY IT WITHOUT A PRINTER
Demo mode adds two virtual printers, 58 mm and 12 mm, and shows the paper strip with the exact image that would print.

PRIVACY
No account, no analytics, no ads. Bluetooth is used only to connect to your printer; photos come from the system picker, with no access to your library.

LABELPEEK PRO
Free: every supported printer, text, QR codes and barcodes, photos with one dithering algorithm, 5 templates, your last 10 prints and the demo.
Pro unlocks every template, every dithering algorithm and photo adjustment, unlimited saved labels and history, series and counters, and extra fonts.
Pro monthly €1.99, yearly €9.99 with a 7-day free trial, or lifetime €19.99 with one payment. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them in your account settings.

COMPATIBILITY
Works with many Niimbot and Phomemo printers and GB/MX pocket thermal printers. Up-to-date list at neurafit.it/labelpeek

LabelPeek is an independent app by NEURAFIT S.R.L. and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by NIIMBOT, Phomemo, Marklife or any other manufacturer. Trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Privacy: https://www.neurafit.it/labelpeek/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Labelsmith: Exact-Size Labels
description:
Labelsmith draws your label at its real size in millimeters, turns it into the same black and white dots your printer makes, and shows you that bitmap before you print. What you see in the preview is exactly what comes out of the printer.

Design
Text in 35 typefaces with curved text, outline, underline and letter case. Shapes with pattern fills, 23 decorative frames, tables, and more than 1,000 line icons, on a canvas with rulers and snapping. Rotate for tape direction, see the margins the print head can't reach, undo anything.

Barcodes that scan
Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14, QR, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. Labelsmith checks the data and the check digit as you type, and snaps every bar to whole printer dots, so thin bars don't blur.

Photos and logos
Images are converted with your choice of threshold, Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson or ordered dithering. Text and barcodes always stay sharp.

215 templates
Pantry jars and spice tins, kitchen prep and day dots, freezer bags, jam, wine and home brew bottles, bakery ingredient and nutrition labels, candles and cosmetics, thank-you stickers, clothing and hang tags, cable flags, breaker panels, warehouse bins and pallets, workshop parts, file folders, office and visitor labels, shop and shelf tags, product labels, asset tags, address and shipping labels, moving boxes, name badges, party and holiday tags, pets, classroom, books, travel and lab samples.

Batch printing
Import a CSV file, map its columns to {variables} in your design, preview every row and print a range. Serial numbers count up on their own.

Shipping labels
Open a shipping label PDF or image, crop it and fit it to 4×6 in or 100×150 mm. The file stays on your device.

Printers
Bluetooth LE label printers from NIIMBOT (D11, D110, D101, B21, B1, B3S, B18) and Phomemo (M110, M120, M220, M02, T02, D30, D35, Q30, PM241-BT), plus any AirPrint printer. Each model page in the app says how it was tested. Labelsmith respects printers that require original label rolls. Brand names describe compatibility only; Labelsmith is not affiliated with or endorsed by these manufacturers.

Also
Print queue with retry, density and offset settings saved per printer, PDF and PNG export, Shortcuts actions to print a design or a line of text, iPhone, iPad and Mac.

No account and no server. Designs are files on your device.

Labelsmith Pro adds images, batch and shipping printing, serial numbers and variables, every template and more than one printer. Text, shapes, icons and barcodes work without it.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.cihat.dev/labelsmith/privacy-policy/

name: Labor Log: Contraction Timer
description:
Contraction Timer is a labor log with one big button. Press it when a contraction starts, press it again when it ends. The app keeps the start, the length and the gap to the one before, and shows how they add up. The Watch app lets you start and stop from your wrist.

TIME FAST
- One big Start and Stop button on the first screen. No account, no sign-in, no setup before the first tap.
