- A clock runs while the contraction lasts. Your contractions are stored with real times, so a locked screen or a closed app loses nothing.
- Rate each one Mild, Medium or Strong and add a short note.
- Undo after every press.
- Keep the screen on while the timer is open, if you want.
- Lock Screen timer: a running contraction shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island on iPhones that support Live Activities.

HISTORY
- Every contraction in a list, grouped by session.
- Edit a time, or add one you missed. Free.
- A long break starts a new session by itself. Nothing is deleted.

PATTERN
- How many contractions, the average time apart and the average length, with a chart of the last 20.
- Share a text summary, free.

YOUR RULE
- Your midwife or doctor may have given you a rule such as 5-1-1, 4-1-1 or 3-1-1. Pick it, or set your own numbers, and the app shows whether your numbers match it. No rule is chosen until you choose one.

APPLE WATCH APP
- Start and stop a contraction from your wrist. The Watch app and a Watch complication are one of the extras.

EXTRAS (one optional purchase)
- Apple Watch app, Home Screen widget, iCloud sync and a PDF summary with the chart.
- The timer, history, editing, notes, rule readout, sharing as text, saving and restoring a copy, the Lock Screen timer and dark mode are free, with no limit on the number of contractions.

PRIVATE
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your contractions stay on your devices. If you turn on iCloud sync (an extra, off until you do), they go only to your own iCloud, never to us.
- Save a copy of your log to a file and restore it later. Free.
- Looks follow your phone: light or dark, 12 or 24 hour time.

A TIMER AND A LOG
Contraction Timer times and records. It is not a medical device and gives no medical advice. Follow what your midwife or doctor told you.

PRICE, PLAINLY
Free to download. One optional one-time purchase, shown in Settings from the first launch, unlocks the extras above. No subscription, no ads, and nothing you have logged is ever locked or hidden.

name: Lad — Personal Finance
description:
Money in order. Room to think.

Lad makes everyday money tracking simple. Record your salary, groceries, journeys and other spending, then see what is left in your accounts.

QUICK TO RECORD
Enter an amount, choose a category and save. Your last-used account is selected automatically. Today, Yesterday, 2 days ago and the calendar help you record a purchase on the right date.

ACCOUNTS AND CURRENCIES
Add cards, cash and savings, set opening balances, and record transfers between your own accounts. Choose your main currency when you start; each account can use a different one. Lad supports Ukrainian hryvnia, US dollar, euro, Russian ruble, British pound, Chinese yuan, Moldovan leu, Georgian lari, Belarusian ruble and Kazakhstani tenge.

CATEGORIES YOUR WAY
Create your own categories, choose a color and pick from 140 icons. Arrange categories in the order that suits you, so frequent purchases are easy to find. Archive a category while keeping its past transactions.

A CLEAR VIEW
See daily or monthly expenses, find transactions in your history and compare categories in charts. Monthly summaries show income, expenses, and the difference. Compare two completed months using your records and follow changes in monthly charts. Light and dark themes, large icons and an option to hide amounts make your ledger comfortable to use throughout the day.

OPTIONAL LOCAL NOTIFICATIONS
Use the Analytics bell or Settings → Notifications to enable monthly-report invitations and weekly original money-habit tips. Notifications are off by default and require iOS permission. Text is prepared on your iPhone, without a push server. Amounts are off by default; amounts hidden in the app are also omitted from notifications.

BANK EXCHANGE RATES
View available bank buy and sell quotes, with their source and update time. Choose a rate for your ledger separately: refreshed quotes do not overwrite saved rates on past transactions. Internet is needed to load quotes; everyday bookkeeping works offline.

YOUR LEDGER ON YOUR IPHONE
Accounts and transactions are stored locally. You do not need an account to keep your ledger. You can enable the device's access lock and save a backup through Files, including your personal iCloud Drive. Backups are started manually.

The interface is available in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

ADS AND SUBSCRIPTION
Versions with Google ads limit how often they appear. Monthly and yearly auto-renewing ad-free plans are supported; an active subscription removes all ads. The available offer, selected term, and current price are shown through StoreKit and Apple before purchase. Renewal is for the selected period, monthly or yearly, until cancelled in Apple Account settings.

Privacy policy: https://lad-finance-support.bereznai9-92.chatgpt.site/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Lamp & Trail: Seeking Jesus
description:
The King James Bible for seeking Jesus. Walk journeys and reading plans one day at a time, meet Jesus from Genesis to Revelation, trace the prophecies He fulfilled, follow cross-reference trails, and dig into the Hebrew and Greek.

Everything is built in. The whole Bible, every note and every cross-reference live on your iPhone, so Lamp & Trail works anywhere, even with no signal. No account, no ads, no tracking.

VERSES FOR EVERY DAY
• A verse of the day, the same for everyone
• Channels for what you are facing: fear and anxiety, temptation, anger, hope, God’s love and more
• A short note on each verse’s context, so you know who said it, to whom, and why

THE WHOLE BIBLE
• All 66 books of the King James Version
• Plain words: turn “thee” and “thou” into “you” with one switch, or keep the King James wording
• Highlight, save, write notes, and listen to any verse or chapter read aloud
• Cross-references under every verse, from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge
• Search every verse, or jump straight to a reference

MEET JESUS
• His life in order, with the four Gospels side by side
• Walk with Him on a map, from Nazareth to the Mount of Olives
• 138 prophecies spoken before He came, and where they came true
• Jesus in the Old Testament, His names, His words, His prayer and His passion
• Revelation in a mirror: the book’s pairs walked from the outside in

THE HEBREW AND GREEK
• The Treasury: over a hundred original words such as hesed, shalom, agape and logos
• Follow each word’s thread through every verse where it stands behind the English

TRAILS AND JOURNEYS
• Named trails through Scripture: the Lamb, the Bread from Heaven, the Scarlet Thread
• Reading plans from three weeks to a whole year, including M’Cheyne and a 40-day wilderness journey
• One Story: every cross-reference in the Bible drawn on a single screen

YOURS, PRIVATELY
Your saved verses, notes, highlights and progress stay on your iPhone. Export a backup file whenever you like.

name: Lâmpada: Bíblia em Feed
description:
Lâmpada mostra a Bíblia como um feed: um versículo por tela, para rolar como numa rede social, só que com a Palavra. "Tua palavra é lâmpada para meus pés e luz para meu caminho" (Salmos 119:105).

O QUE VOCÊ PODE FAZER
• Rolar versículos um por tela, curtir, salvar e compartilhar como texto
• Ler a Bíblia completa por livro e capítulo, sem internet
• Receber o versículo do dia com um lembrete local no horário que você escolher
• Manter a sua sequência de leitura diária
• Buscar por palavra (com ou sem acento) ou por referência, como "Jo 3:16" ou "sl 23"
• Explorar temas: ansiedade, medo, esperança, gratidão, perdão, força, paz, amor, fé e propósito
• Guardar favoritos e ver tudo o que curtiu
• Ajustar o tamanho da letra

LÂMPADA PREMIUM
• Estudo do versículo: contexto ao redor, outra tradução e uma pergunta para refletir
• Comparar traduções lado a lado
• Anotações pessoais em cada versículo
• Compartilhar versículos como imagem
• Cores de fundo, cores de texto e fontes

TRADUÇÕES
Bíblia Livre (BLIVRE), © 2018 Diego Santos, Mario Sérgio e Marco Teles, licença Creative Commons Atribuição 4.0 Brasil. Bíblia Portuguesa Mundial (BPM), domínio público. As duas ficam no aparelho e funcionam offline. Os tradutores não endossam o app.

SEM CADASTRO E SEM RASTREAMENTO
Não há login, servidor nosso, anúncios nem SDKs de análise. Curtidas, salvos, anotações e sequência ficam só no seu iPhone.

ASSINATURA
O Lâmpada Premium é cobrado pela Apple na sua conta do ID Apple e renovado automaticamente até ser cancelado.
• Semanal: R$ 14,90 por semana, com 3 dias grátis no início
• Anual: R$ 99,90 por ano, sem período de teste

O preço e o período aparecem na tela de compra da Apple antes da confirmação. A renovação é cobrada nas 24 horas anteriores ao fim do período. Para não renovar, cancele pelo menos 24 horas antes em Ajustes do iPhone > seu nome > Assinaturas. Reembolsos seguem as regras da Apple e o Código de Defesa do Consumidor, quando aplicável.

TERMOS E PRIVACIDADE
Termos de uso: https://twinslabs.github.io/lampada-site/termos.html
Política de privacidade: https://twinslabs.github.io/lampada-site/privacidade.html

name: Lantern - Night Stories
description:
Lantern is the 23:41 to Marenne, in your pocket.

One compartment, one locked case, thirteen clear steps and no timer. Light the lamp, read what the courier left behind, work the three brass wheels of the case, set the wall clock to the stopped watch, and take the Midnight Star before the train arrives at 00:17.

Then switch back to the social side of the train: chat with the passengers who were on board, read the logbook of other runs, and learn the trick with the stopped watch before you try it yourself. Everything is bundled and offline. Guest play requires no account, contacts or tracking.

name: Lantern Siege
description:
Two players. Two sides. One lantern.

In Duskmaster versus, one of you is the hero defending the lantern. The other is the Duskmaster, commanding the Gloom: dropping packs of creatures onto the dark, giving them orders and planting runes. Every pack shows a warning rune before it lands, so a sharp defender can read the ambush. Swap roles for round two. Prefer to team up? Co-op ties you together with a line of light. Either way, your friend joins free from an invite link.

DUSKMASTER VERSUS
You see the whole map from above and spend Gloom on brood packs. Give each pack an order: hunt the hero, besiege the lantern, smash the lamps, or lie in ambush. Raise your Herald, a champion you steer yourself, and cast dark arts: Grasp roots a hero who does not step out of the ring, Blight silences a lamp, Rally sends the creatures around your Herald charging. Land your plays together for an Onslaught. Packs can only land on dark ground, so every lamp the defender plants shrinks your board. A short interactive lesson teaches the controls, a match is two rounds with swapped roles, and PLAY THE DUSKMASTER lets you practice solo against a bot hero.

TETHERED DUET CO-OP
Two heroes joined by a Lightline. The line lights the ground it crosses and burns creatures that cross it, so walking apart spreads the light and staying close earns a Duet bonus. Revive a downed partner by standing next to them, and call things out with pings instead of voice chat. Good hero pairs earn a bond.

LAMPS ARE TERRITORY
Light is the only safe ground. Pick a Lamp card and plant a lamp where you stand: it pushes the light outward and shoots, slows, heals and taunts on its own. Lamps near each other link into a network that hits harder, and the horde hunts your lamps, so you decide which to defend, repair or let fall. Four lamp evolutions: Thorn Battery, Dawn Font, Bastion Totem and Tempest Rod. Light 12 percent of the land and hold it, and the dawn comes. The lantern can dim but never goes out in solo or co-op.

ONE TAP TO PLAY TOGETHER
Send an invite link or show a QR code and your friend joins in one tap, with no account and no chat. Rematch in one tap, let up to four friends watch a live room, or share a replay of any run as a link that holds no names.

FLYING SOLO
A solo run is a horde survival game where your lamps work like towers. You steer one hero and the weapons fire on their own. Six heroes (Sparkhorn, Cinderfox, Thornwolf, Frostbear, Rootkin and Tidewolf) each have a weapon, a passive and a role.

REAL CREATURES, EVERY RUN DIFFERENT
Dozens of creatures from the studio's own Battle Creatures set fill the horde, and each region has two rulers. The roster and ruler you face are rolled from the run's seed, and mid-run events such as a falling star, a lantern merchant, a cursed lamp or a drake sweeping across the map keep you on your toes. Every day brings a challenge with a leaderboard, the same for everyone. Nothing you earn changes gameplay.

PREMIUM, NOT PAY TO WIN
Free to download: all of Wildroot Hollow, solo play, online co-op and versus, the Duskmaster lesson, the daily challenge and leaderboard, replays, and every hero and camp upgrade. One purchase, the Full Game, unlocks Frostfall Pass (deep winter: cold, frozen beacons, blizzards) and Sunscar Dunes (shifting sands: burrowers, mirage oases) and their weekly challenges. Try each for three minutes first. If the host owns the Full Game, everyone in the room plays those maps for that match.

No ads, no energy timers, no gems, no loot boxes, no account. Landscape play with a floating thumb stick; a game controller or keyboard works too. Made by South View Studios.

name: Last Call Riot
description:
A mug is sliding back. A customer wants another. Somewhere behind you, a pigeon has made a decision. Welcome to Gio’s shift.

Hold to fill a mug, release to slide it, then tap a faucet or an empty mug to send Gio after it. A well-timed beer sends a guest toward the door. Miss the empty on its way back and you’re down a mug. Let a guest reach the tap and the next thing sliding down the bar is you.

Eight venues, eight ways for a shift to go sideways. A rolling ship gives the mugs a mind of their own. In orbit, you have until gravity returns to grab the floating empties. On the rooftop, the pigeons work for nobody.

Grab a tip and the band plays. Grab another during the show and the crowd dances backward. Chain clean catches for a combo, earn coins, and choose the gear that suits your hands.

Lefties, we saved you a seat. Switch on left-handed mode and Gio moves the taps and controls to the other side. Most bars make you move your stool.

Play all eight levels of the first tour free. A single purchase unlocks unlimited tours and endless shifts in the venues and layouts you reach. Work your way up to four and five counters, then see how long your favorite bar can stay open. The unlocked game plays offline.

name: Last Spot – Where's my Bike?
description:
Do you remember where you parked your bike?

Last Spot answers exactly that. Take a photo after you park, and the app saves the address and time with it. Later it shows you the photo, how far away it is and how long the walk takes. One tap opens Apple Maps with the way back.

HOW IT WORKS • Snap a photo: the address and time are saved automatically. • Find your way back: photo, address, distance and walking time at a glance. • Route: Apple Maps walks you back to your bike. • History: every stop sorted by day, with photo, address and time.

ALWAYS AT HAND • Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen. • “New Spot” in Control Center, on the Lock Screen or on the Action button. The camera opens even without unlocking. • A built-in camera with lens switching, zoom and flash. You can also use the volume buttons to take the photo.

YOUR PHOTO LIBRARY STAYS CLEAN Photos stay inside the app and never end up in your photo library. You choose how many spots to keep: only the current one, the last 7, the last 30 or all. Older ones are cleaned up automatically.

PRIVATE No account, no ads, no tracking. Photos, locations and settings stay on your iPhone. Last Spot only asks for your location when you take a photo or have the app open.

Works offline too: the location is saved, and the address is added automatically once you are back online.

name: Latin Tuner
description:
Latin Tuner is a precise, beautiful tuner made for the instruments of Latin music. Choose your instrument, play a string, and the tuner shows you which string it hears and whether to tune up or down.

19 INSTRUMENTS
• 6-String Guitar, 12-String Guitar (Docerola)
• 12-String Requinto Sierreño, Requinto de Trío
• Bajo Sexto and Bajo Quinto
• 4, 5 and 6-String Bass
• Guitarrón, Vihuela and Violín Mariachi
• Tres Cubano, Cuatro Puertorriqueño and Cuatro Venezolano
• Charango Ronroco and Charango Quirquincho
• Mandolin and Ukulele

MADE FOR DOUBLE STRINGS
Each course shows its two strings with their own notes, octave or unison, so you can tune both strings of a bajo sexto, docerola, tres or cuatro with confidence.

THREE DISPLAYS
• Analog: a VU meter with a real moving needle
• Digital: note, cents, frequency, light bar and strobe
• Combined: both together

THREE MODES
• Auto finds the string you are playing
• Manual stays on the string you choose
• Chromatic shows any note

DEEP BASS
Reads low strings down to the B0 of a 5-string bass, and learns the noise of the room so you can tune at normal volume.

MORE
• Reference tone for every string
• Calibration from A4 = 430 to 450 Hz
• Half-step and whole-step-down tunings, drop D, low G and more
• Note names in English (A B C) or Latin (La Si Do)
• English and Spanish
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• Works with the built-in microphone or an audio interface

No ads, no account, no subscription. Works without internet. Sound is analyzed on your device and is never recorded or sent anywhere.

name: LayerFlux
description:
Compare heat flow through a layered wall or enclosure panel. Enter an area and the temperatures on each side, add layers that cover the whole panel, and describe the share of area and material stack for each repeating path. Enter thickness with conductivity or specify a direct resistance.

Inspect a cross-section to see temperatures at layer boundaries, the effective resistance and how much each path contributes. Make an independent alternative and compare both results under the same boundary conditions.

Freeze a calculation or comparison and reopen it later in Reports. Preview PDF or export a reproducible CSV with the original inputs and results. The editable Workshop panel example demonstrates the process with known values.

The tool provides steady-state comparisons in SI units for iPhone. It needs no account for the workspace.

name: LayerTrace
description: LayerTrace is a forensic workspace for contracts, scans, and exports. Import a file, split it into inspectable layers, and walk through text blocks, layout regions, and embedded metadata without leaving one timeline. Open Compare to highlight drift between revisions: wording shifts, spacing changes, and field updates appear as a structured diff you can read side by side. The Evolution graph links versions and evidence cards so a review path stays visible from first import to final export. Forensics tools help you validate what you are seeing. Check file hashes, review capture permissions before camera or microphone use, and open integrity summaries alongside your case notes. Visual heatmap output marks algorithmic variance zones as guidance only, not a legal finding. Build cases around documents you already manage on device. Attach findings, verify snapshots, and keep a technical trail ready when you need to explain how a file changed over time. LayerTrace is built for analysts, paralegals, and power users who need clarity inside complex PDFs and image exports. Tips: grant Photos or Files access when you import; use Compare after every new revision; export your case summary before archiving a matter.

name: LBS
description: LBS è un’app di prenotazioni intuitiva e facile da usare. Con questa app potrai prenotare tutti i tuoi appuntamenti con semplicità, da qualsiasi luogo e in qualsiasi momento. Grazie alla sua interfaccia utente moderna e dinamica, potrai cercare e prenotare i tuoi servizi preferiti con una semplice pressione del dito. L’app di LBS ti permette di avere il controllo completo delle tue prenotazioni, visualizzando le date disponibili e molto altro ancora. L’app di LBS ti aiuta a risparmiare tempo e a organizzare la tua routine in modo semplice ed efficiente. Scarica l’app di LBS oggi stesso e inizia a prenotare i tuoi appuntamenti con tranquillità!

name: LE SAS
description:
LE SAS est l'espace des membres de LE LABO IA.

L'app te donne accès, sur ton iPhone, à ce que ton compte ouvre déjà sur le web.

MES FORMATIONS
Reprends une formation là où tu t'es arrêté, chapitre par chapitre, en vidéo ou en texte.

REPLAYS
Retrouve les sessions en direct que tu as manquées et regarde-les quand tu veux.

MESSAGES
Écris à l'équipe et aux autres membres, et reçois une notification quand on te répond, si tu l'as choisie.

COMPTE
Gère ton profil, tes préférences et tes données, y compris l'export et la suppression de ton compte.

L'app est réservée aux membres de LE LABO IA, elle s'ouvre avec l'adresse et le mot de passe de ton compte.

name: Le Solitaire – Card Game
description:
Le Solitaire is the patience game everyone knows: classic Klondike, just like on the family computer. Seven columns, a stock, four foundations to build from Ace to King. Free, no ads, no account, no connection needed.

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
• Every deal is checked by our solver before it reaches your table, so you never get a game that was lost from the start.
• The hint follows a winning line: it never leads you into a dead end.
• Undo and hints are free and unlimited, all the way back to the deal. No coins, no video to watch to carry on.
• If a move makes the deal impossible to win, a small, discreet notice tells you and offers to undo (a setting).
• When no useful move is left, a bar offers Undo, Restart or New game.
• For purists: random deals, like real cards (some cannot be won).

THE RULES YOU KNOW
• Draw 1 card (the default) or Draw 3.
• Unlimited passes through the stock.
• Only a King goes into an empty column.
• Nothing moves to the foundations by itself: you play. A setting turns it on.
• Once every card is face up, a button finishes the game for you (or it finishes by itself, if you turn that on in Settings).

EASY TO READ
• Large numbers by default, twice as tall as on a classic deck: you know every card at a glance, even on a small phone.
• The cards span the full width of the screen.
• Prefer the classic deck with its double-headed court cards? A setting brings it back.

IN A PARISIAN CAFÉ
• Cards are played on the mahogany panelling of a Parisian café, under a gilt mirror and two brass sconces.
• Classic court figures (in French, the Jack, Queen and King read V, D and R).
• A lovely win animation: the cards fly off the foundations and bounce across the wood.
• Soft card sounds and light haptics, both easy to switch off.

THREE SPEEDS
• Fast, Medium or Relaxed: you choose the pace of the animations. The rules never change.

THE DAILY DEAL
• One deal a day, the same for everyone, a calendar of the days you won, your streak, and your result to share in one line.

YOUR WAY
• Tap a card to send it to a good place, or drag it.
• Left-handed layout: the stock moves to the other side.
• Optional timer and score, hidden by default.
• Statistics for each draw mode: games played and won, streaks, best time, fewest moves, best score, games won without assists.
• Assists never cost you a win, a streak or a record.
• Your game is saved after every move: pick it up whenever you like.
• Plays in portrait, one-handed. In French and English.

SIMPLE AND RESPECTFUL
• No ads, no purchases, no coins.
• Works offline, no account, and collects no data.

name: Lead SYLO
description:
SYLO puts every enquiry your business receives in one place, so nothing gets missed and every lead gets a reply.

Your leads from Google Local Services, your website forms and Facebook arrive in the app as they happen. You get a notification, open the lead, and call, text, WhatsApp or email the customer in one tap.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See every new lead the moment it arrives, with the customer's details and what they asked for.
- Reply fast: call, text, WhatsApp or email straight from the lead.
- Move each lead through its stages: new, contacted, quoted, booked, completed.
- Set a follow-up and get a reminder when it is due.
- Add notes, the quote you gave and the final price.
- Add a lead yourself after a phone call or a chat on site.
- See how you are doing: leads by source, how many you won and how quickly you replied.
- Approve website updates your agency has prepared for you.
- Keep a review QR code in your phone's wallet, so a happy customer can leave a Google review on the spot.
- Unlock with Face ID or your fingerprint.

WHO IT IS FOR
SYLO is for trades and local service businesses whose marketing agency uses SYLO. Your agency sets up your account and gives you your sign-in details. There is no sign-up inside the app.

Need help? Visit leadsylo.com/support.

name: Leafy – PDF Editor & Sign
description:
Leafy is a fast, beautiful PDF editor for iPhone and iPad. Fix a typo in a contract, sign an agreement, swap a photo or reorganize pages, right where the PDF is.

EDIT WHAT'S ALREADY THERE
• Tap any line of text to change it. Leafy keeps the original font, size and color.
• Tap any image to move, resize, replace or delete it.
• Add new text anywhere, with your choice of font, size, bold, italic and color.

SIGN IN SECONDS
• Draw your signature with a finger or Apple Pencil, type it, or import a photo. Leafy removes the paper background automatically.
• Signatures stay razor-sharp at any zoom.

ORGANIZE PAGES
• Page sidebar with thumbnails: drag to reorder, rotate, duplicate, insert blank pages or pages from other PDFs and images, delete.
• Search the whole document and jump between results.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• Two pages side by side on iPad in landscape and on the inner screen of foldable iPhones.
• Open several documents in separate windows on iPad and switch between them in one tap.
• Clean, distraction-free layout: the toolbars hide while you read.
• Night reading mode.

SHARE YOUR WAY
• Share, print or email the finished PDF.
• Capture any area of a page and copy it as an image.
• Export the current page as PNG or JPEG.

LEAFY PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Convert PDF to Word (.docx) while keeping the original layout
• Compress PDFs for email and upload limits
• Password protection: lock opening, or restrict copying and printing
• Unlimited saved signatures
• Export every page, or any area, as PNG or JPEG

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your documents never leave your device. No account, no tracking, no data collected.

Also available: Leafy for Mac, at leafy.macplanet.vn.

name: Learn Chess: Daily Puzzles
description:
Start with a rook and learn your first checkmate. See which squares each piece controls, then make the move on the board.

When you’re stuck, reveal a hint one step at a time. See where to look, which piece to use, why the move works, and where to play it. Take back a mistaken move and try again.

Use what you learned in a different position. Earn a stamp for solving it without help. Revisit lesson notes while you solve.

Play a daily puzzle offline. The app includes 385 positions that open in sequence and cycle after the last one. Play a solo game for practice and resume it where you left off.

Chess Pro is an optional purchase (a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase) that opens the past-puzzle archive. It starts with the last 30 puzzles and adds one per day from the built-in collection. Purchasing and restoring may require an internet connection.

Terms of Use (EULA)

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy

https://indieway.xyz/en/games/learnchess/privacy

name: Learn Salah With Meaning
description:
You pray five times a day. Learn Salah with Meaning helps you understand every word you say, from the first takbir to the final salam.

Five minutes a day. Each lesson teaches a few words of your prayer. You hear each word, see its root letters and meaning, and find out where else it appears. Then you practise, and walk through the prayer position by position with real photos.

WHAT YOU LEARN
‚Ä¢ Takbir, the opening dua and seeking refuge
‚Ä¢ Al-Fatiha, word by word, and Amin
‚Ä¢ The surah you recite after it: choose from 13 short surahs (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas, Al-Kawthar, Al-Asr and more)
‚Ä¢ Ruku, rising, sujood and sitting between the sujood, with the ruku and sujood duas
‚Ä¢ The tashahhud, the durood Ibrahimi, the duas after it and the salam
‚Ä¢ A last lesson that walks you through the whole prayer, every word in order

HOW IT WORKS
‚Ä¢ Learn: each word with audio, its meaning, its Arabic root and a related word you may already know
‚Ä¢ Practise: quick questions with instant feedback
‚Ä¢ Before you pray: see each position with a photo, tap any word for its meaning, and listen to the whole phrase
‚Ä¢ Progress: watch how much of your salah you understand grow from 0% to 100%
‚Ä¢ Roots: build a collection of the Arabic roots you know

TARAWEEH COMPANION
For each of the 30 nights of Ramadan: which surahs the imam will recite, a short summary, and a word from your lessons to listen for.

ENGLISH AND URDU
All meanings and the whole app are available in English and Urdu.

No account needed. Your progress stays on your phone.

Quran text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), used under CC BY 3.0.

name: Leftwise: Fridge to Dinner
description:
What's for dinner? Snap your fridge and Leftwise works it out.

Take a few photos of your fridge, door and drawers. Leftwise reads the food it can see, including labels and printed dates, and you check the list before anything is saved. Then choose how to plan:

• Use what I have: dinners you can cook without shopping, with the food closest to its date used first.
• Plan a full week: 7 dinners, and a shopping list of only what's missing, in whole packs with estimated prices.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Snap your fridge (or add food by hand).
2. Check the list: untick anything wrong, fix amounts and dates.
3. Get your dinners, planned for your household, your diet and the foods you avoid.
4. Cook, tick it off, and your kitchen updates.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 121 home-cooking recipes, from quick weeknight dinners to Swedish classics, each with a level (Easy, Medium, Challenging), time and estimated nutrition.
• Swap any dinner for another that uses the same food.
• Ask Leftwise: ask what to cook, how to use something up or how to store it.
• Cook mode: big, step-by-step instructions with the amounts for your portions.
• Ratings from other cooks, saved dinners and "Cooked before".
• Diets and foods to avoid: everything, mostly vegetarian, fish, vegetarian or vegan; gluten, dairy, eggs, nuts, fish, shellfish and soy.
• An estimate of each dinner's climate impact (kg CO₂e per portion), if you're curious.
• English and Swedish, light and dark mode.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. Your kitchen, plans and history stay on your phone.
• Photos are sent securely to be read by Anthropic's Claude AI, only after you allow it, and we don't store them.
• Analytics only if you say yes, and never your food, photos or questions.

Good to know: prices are Swedish supermarket estimates (shown in your currency if you choose), and nutrition and climate figures are estimates. Photo reading can miss hidden food, so you always check the list. Always check food safety yourself.

name: Leonida Hunt: GTA 6 Map
description:
Every secret in Leonida on one fast map. Leonida Hunt is a fan-made companion for GTA 6 that shows where everything is and keeps your progress while you play.

• 4,687 locations: hidden packages, stunt jumps, cards, meteorites, weapons, vehicles, shops, activities and more
• Tap to mark a find, undo a mistake, and watch your progress per category
• Next Nearby: set where you are in the game and get the 5 closest finds as a route
• Trophies and the 100% checklist, counted from your marks on the map
• Hints for thousands of spots
• Quick filters and per-category checkboxes to show only what you hunt for
• Your own pins, notes and lists, plus separate playthroughs
• 3D view of the map and spoiler protection for story content
• Cheat codes as they are confirmed, pinned to the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad, no account needed

No ads, no tracking. New locations and fixes arrive without app updates.

Leonida Hunt is an unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and related marks belong to their owners.

name: Letrio: Image to Text
description:
Turn images into editable text with Letrio. Capture a photo or choose one from your library, then extract the words you need to edit, copy, and share.

Whether it’s a page from a book, a note, a sign, or a screenshot, Letrio helps you get the text without typing it all over again.

IMAGE TO TEXT, MADE SIMPLE
• Take a photo or choose an image from your library
• Crop and rotate your image before scanning
• Extract text and make edits directly in the app
• Copy or share your text in a few taps

KEEP YOUR SCANS ORGANIZED
Your scans are saved on your device, so you can find them again later. Search your scan history or rename a scan to keep things organized.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Text recognition happens on your device. Your images and scans stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

TRY LETRIO FOR FREE
Extract text from up to 3 images each day for free. Upgrade to Letrio Pro with a one-time purchase to unlock unlimited scans.

Questions or feedback? Contact us at info@apphaus.com.tr.

Privacy Policy -> https://apphaus.com.tr/privacy-policy.html
Terms Of Use -> https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LEXORA
description:
LEXORA is a fresh way to train your brain and grow your vocabulary. Every puzzle is created by AI, so you will rarely see the same challenge twice. Whether you have five minutes or an hour, LEXORA has a word game ready for you.

WHAT YOU CAN PLAY

• Word Guess: Use the clue to find the hidden word.
• Scramble: Unscramble the letters and beat the puzzle.
• Missing Letters: Complete words by filling in the gaps.
• Riddle: Solve clever word riddles that make you think.
• Word Connect: Build as many words as you can from one set of letters.
• Timed 60s: Solve as many puzzles as possible before the clock runs out.
• Daily Challenge: A special puzzle every day, with bonus coins and XP.
• Picture Word: Identify the word from the picture clue.
• Word Detective: Follow the clues and uncover the answer.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT

• Endless puzzles: AI creates new puzzles in many categories, so there is always something new.
• Build a streak: Play every day to grow your streak and keep your momentum.
• Earn rewards: Collect coins and XP as you solve puzzles, and watch your level go up.
• Achievements: Unlock badges as you complete puzzles and build your collection.
• Gentle hints: Stuck on a puzzle? Use a hint to get a nudge in the right direction.
• Beautiful design: A colorful, easy-to-read interface that feels great on iPhone.
• Learn as you play: Every answer comes with a short explanation, so you learn new words along the way.

FOR EVERYONE
LEXORA is made for students, word lovers, puzzle fans, and anyone who wants to keep their mind sharp. No account or sign-up is needed. Just open the app and start playing.

name: LexPrism
description:
LexPrism is a workbench for checking a grammar and replaying named tokens. Paste rules, choose a start symbol and see how nullable alternatives affect FIRST and FOLLOW. Inspect a populated prediction cell to see which alternatives can be selected and where they come from.

Run the included Sum expression sample or enter your own token sequence. Step through expansions, token matches and the first error with a visible stack and input cursor. Freeze an analysis or replay to keep its actual rules and results together. Reopen reports and share a PDF or CSV from the Reports library.

LexPrism checks LL(1) grammars using one named token of lookahead. It accepts up to 120 tokens per replay. A conflict or diagnostic affecting the start rule can be inspected before replay.

name: LexRing
description:
LexRing for iPhone and iPad brings your firm's clients, cases, tasks, calendar and e-mail with you. It is for people at law firms that use LexRing: sign in with Microsoft using your work account.

• Home: today's tasks, overdue tasks and what comes next.
• Clients and cases: find a client or case and see its overview, people and documents.
• Time: record a Quick-Bill the moment the work is done.
• Tasks: complete, reschedule, edit or delegate to a colleague.
• Calendar: your Microsoft 365 calendar, with events linked to clients and cases.
• E-mail: read, reply and write from your Microsoft 365 mailbox, with attachments.
• LexAI: ask by voice or text; LexAI prepares a task or case item for you to confirm.
• Voice memos: dictate after a call; LexAI suggests next steps and you decide.
• Documents: open case documents, or create one from your firm's templates.
• Face ID lock.

Requires a LexRing account set up by your firm.

name: Lhenice
description: Aplikace městyse Lhenice obsahuje důležité informace o městysu. Najdete v ní informace o veškerém dění v městysu, potřebné kontakty, aktuality a mnoho dalšího. V aplikaci naleznete nezbytné odkazy, úřední hodiny, ale i kam se vydat za kulturou a sportem. Aplikace nabízí kontaktní formulář, rychlé psaní e-mailu či snadné volání.

name: Lido: A short retreat
description:
Lido helps you make mindfulness a daily habit, a few minutes at a time.

You don't need experience, a quiet room or half an hour. Lido finds the time in the day you already have. Breathe on your own, guided by a gentle buzz you feel in your hand, or let one of three teachers lead a short session wherever you are: at home, at your desk, on the bus, on a walk, or in bed.

NEW TO THIS? GOOD
Lido was made for people who have never done this before, and it explains everything in plain English. How to breathe, through your nose or your mouth, and why. What to do when your mind wanders (it will, and that's fine). Where to sit. How much is enough. The guide is always there when you want it, and never in your way.

A HABIT THAT FITS YOUR DAY
Every session is short, and most are under five minutes.
One quiet reminder a day, at a time you choose, and only if you ask for it.
Every session counts towards your week, whether you breathe on your own or with a teacher.
Five days in seven makes your week, so two can be missed. A missed day costs nothing.

BREATHING YOU CAN FEEL
Press the button, put the phone in your pocket and close your eyes. A short countdown, then the phone leads your breath by touch alone: a swell to breathe in, a soft beat as you hold, a falling away as you breathe out. Nothing to watch and nothing to listen to, so it works anywhere.

SIX BREATHS, ALL FREE
Box breathing, before something that matters.
Slow breath, for any spare moment.
4-7-8, for the end of the day.
Long out, for letting the day go.
Double breath, for when things pile up.
Morning breath, for the start of the day.
Each one tells you exactly how to do it, and you can feel it before you choose it.

THREE TEACHERS, EACH WITH THEIR OWN WAY
Rowan teaches stillness through the senses. His six sessions take two or three minutes, and suit a desk, a train seat or a quiet corner at home. He speaks plainly, then leaves you space to practise.

Nell is for bedtime. Her sessions slow down as you do, with longer and longer silences, and none of them asks you to open your eyes at the end.

Arjun walks with you. Five-minute sessions for the street, the park or the way home, with your eyes open.

Every session says what you'll do, when it helps and how to listen before you start. One session from every teacher is free. They all live on your phone, so they work offline, and the voice carries on with the screen locked. New sessions and teachers are added regularly.

A PLACE WORTH COMING BACK TO
Lido is a sunlit swimming pool seen from above, lit by the real time of day where you are: bright at noon, gold in the evening, lamps glowing after dark. Each day you practise leaves a flower on the water. As the weeks build, new things arrive: a paper boat, a rubber duck, a coconut. What you have built stays built.

THE LIDO PASS
The Lido pass opens every teacher's sessions and every place still to come. Monthly, for you alone or for your whole family through Family Sharing. Cancel any time.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
No account. No ads. Nothing tracked. Everything stays on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
Lido is for everyday wellbeing. It is not medical care and doesn't replace it.
The teachers are characters. Their voices are generated with AI from scripts written for Lido: lidoretreat.app/voices

The Lido pass is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://lidoretreat.app/privacy/

name: Liftiary
description:
Liftiary is a fast, distraction-free strength training log built for lifters who want to plan workouts, track progressive overload, and hit new personal records without accounts, subscriptions, or clutter.

**PLAN & LOG EVERY SESSION**
• Build daily workout plans or load a full split (Push, Pull, Legs, or your own custom splits) with one tap.
• See your previous session's weight and reps right beside each set so you always know what to beat.
• Check off sets as you lift to automatically log volume and check in for the day.

**ANIMATED MOVEMENT CATALOG**
• Browse 21+ built-in strength exercises filtered by muscle group (Chest, Back, Shoulders, Biceps, Triceps, Legs).
• Watch looping form demonstrations with target muscle breakdowns and form cues.
• Add unlimited custom movements tailored to your routine.

**PERSONAL RECORDS & VOLUME**
• Track daily total lifting volume at a glance.
• Automatically detect PRs and view your best lifts and estimated 1-Rep Max (e1RM) across every exercise.
• Switch seamlessly between KG and LB anytime with a quick 3-finger triple-tap.

**SMART GYM REMINDERS**
• Schedule custom daily motivational notifications.
• Automatically silence remaining notifications for the day once you log a set or check off "Went to the gym today."

**100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE**
• No sign-up, no tracking, no ads. All your workout data stays locally on your iPhone.

name: Lightness — Weekly Meal Plan
description:
Plan what to cook this week and get one grocery list with the amounts you’ll need. Lightness suggests meals for your household, adds up the ingredients, and puts the recipes right in your plan.

Plan a week that fits your kitchen

Start with dinners for the week, then add breakfast, lunch, or both. Set up meals for one, two, or four people, choose your cooking equipment, and set a time limit for each dish. Filter by vegetarian, vegan, or pescatarian preferences, or leave out specific ingredients. Pin a dish you want to keep. If your plans change, preview what a meal swap will do to your grocery list before you save it.

Take one list to the store

When two recipes call for rice, the list shows the combined amount. It also shows how many packages to buy when package sizes are available. Check off items as you shop or record how many packages you bought. The list keeps track of what’s left to buy, even when you change the servings in your plan or swap a dish.

Estimate grocery costs in Russian rubles (RUB)

Set a weekly grocery budget and see how the estimated cost of priced items compares. Choose from 13 grocery chains and services in Russia. Eleven have dated reference prices for some items, and the other two use prices you enter. You can enter your own package size and price for any item. The total is a planning estimate, and items without prices are listed separately.

Find a recipe and cook it step by step

Browse 39 everyday recipes or search by dish or ingredient. If you have carrots to use up, search for carrots and see which recipes call for them. Check the cooking time, adjust the servings to recalculate the ingredients, and open the step-by-step instructions when you’re ready to cook.

When a week works well, repeat it from your history or start fresh with the same settings. Meal plans, recipes, and shopping lists work offline. The app is free to use, with no ads, subscriptions, or sign-up. Available in English and Russian.

name: LightningWatch: Delay Timer
description:
LightningWatch is a lightning delay timer, field status board and incident log for the adults who run youth sports: coaches, field marshals, league and facility admins and tournament directors. It answers one question for everyone at the venue: is the game on?

IMPORTANT: LightningWatch is not a weather service. It has no weather data and no lightning sensor, and it doesn't sense, forecast or track storms. It is a timer, log and checklist for decisions people make. It does not replace official forecasts and warnings (such as the National Weather Service), your league's or facility's emergency action plan, or the judgment of the person in charge. Times are based on what you log.

LIGHTNING DELAY COUNTDOWN
- Tap "Lightning! Log strike" when thunder is heard or lightning is seen. Choose the fields (or all fields at the venue) and the countdown starts.
- Every new strike restarts the wait from that strike. A large dial shows the time left, the last strike, the number of strikes and how long the delay has run.
- The screen shows the earliest resume time "if no further lightning or thunder". When the countdown is complete, the person in charge decides whether to resume.
- The countdown is calculated from the times stored on your phone, so it stays correct if you close the app.
- Ending a delay means choosing Resume or Cancel for each game. Resuming before the countdown is complete is blocked unless you turn on an override and write a reason, which is kept in the log.

FLASH-TO-BANG TIMER
- Tap FLASH when you see lightning and THUNDER when you hear it. LightningWatch shows the seconds and an estimated distance in miles and kilometers, and the guidance from your policy.
- "Thunder only" for when you hear thunder without seeing a flash.
- Log the strike in one tap to start or restart the delay.

IS THE GAME ON? STATUS BOARD
- Every field and today's games and practices with large status labels: On, Lightning delay, Suspended, Resumed, Cancelled, Completed, Scheduled. Each has an icon and a word, never just a color.
- Live countdowns for fields in a delay.
- Share a short plain-text update (or a PDF) through your phone's share sheet to your group chat, email or league app. LightningWatch never sends anything by itself.

VENUES, SHELTER PLANS AND CHECKLISTS
- For each field: designated shelter (building, vehicles or other), walk time, route, who has keys and emergency contacts.
- An editable emergency checklist per venue, ticked off with times during each delay.
- Teams and today's schedule, with who made each call.

INCIDENT LOG
- Every delay is recorded: fields, games affected, each strike with flash-to-bang time, checklist times, outcome, total delay minutes, notes and any early-resume reason.
- Filter the history and export CSV or a PDF report.

ALERTS ON YOUR PHONE
- Optional local notifications 10 minutes before the countdown ends and when it ends, and "check the official forecast" reminders before games. They come only from what you log; there are no weather alerts.

YOUR POLICY
- Wait time after the last strike (30 to 60 minutes, never less than 30) and a flash-to-bang threshold. The defaults are examples: set them to your league's or facility's own policy.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics, no location.
- Everything stays on this device. LightningWatch makes no network connections; Code54 doesn't receive your data.
- Backup and restore with a file you control. Erase all data in Settings.

TRY THE SAMPLE VENUE
A fictional sports complex with four fields opens with a lightning delay in progress, so you can see the countdown, the status board and the log in seconds. Remove it whenever you like.

If you can hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck. Move everyone to a safe shelter: a fully enclosed building with plumbing and wiring, or a hard-topped metal vehicle with the windows closed. Questions: support@code54.dev

name: LightPeek: LED Strip Remote
description:
LightPeek is one remote for cheap Bluetooth LED strips and lamps and for Magic Home Wi-Fi controllers at home. It recognises the controller by itself and runs it from your phone, locally: no account, no ads, no data collected.

WHAT IT DOES
• On and off, colour from the wheel or 12 ready colours, brightness
• Warm, neutral and cool whites, on the real white channel when the controller has one
• Ready scenes: Relax, Reading, Cinema, Night, Party
• Rooms on a floor plan of your home and estimated power draw of each strip
• Music mode with automatic sensitivity and three effects, using the microphone without recording audio
• Switch-off timers and weekly schedules on compatible Magic Home controllers
• Built-in effects with their speed, with clear names instead of numbers
• Colour order fix (RGB, GRB, BRG…), for when yellow looks green
• Rename devices and forget the ones you don't use: you control only the lights you saved, never your neighbour's
• Automatic reconnection and a clear message when another app is already connected to the strip
• Demo mode to try everything without a device
• Free compatibility test: find out whether your controller is supported before you pay

WORKS WITH
Bluetooth LED controllers that show up with these names: ELK-BLEDOM, ELK-BLEDOB, MELK, LEDBLE, Triones, LEDBlue. Magic Home Wi-Fi controllers on your home network. LightPeek works with many controllers used by the Lotus Lantern, duoCo Strip, HappyLighting, LED LAMP and Magic Home apps. After a scan each device is marked as supported, experimental or not supported.

DOES NOT WORK WITH
• Branded Wi-Fi or cloud bulbs and strips: Philips Hue, Govee, WiZ, Tuya / Smart Life
• Control away from home and voice assistants

PRICE
Free: 1 device, every basic feature, 3 favourites, demo mode and compatibility test. No ads.
LightPeek Pro: unlimited devices, whole rooms in one tap (groups), unlimited favourites, saved scenes, timers and music mode. Choose a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The app shows local prices before you buy. You can cancel your subscription in your store settings.
Terms: https://www.neurafit.it/lightpeek/terms/
Privacy: https://www.neurafit.it/lightpeek/privacy/

PRIVACY
No account, no analytics, no server. Bluetooth and the local network are used only to control your lights; the microphone only in music mode, and audio is never recorded.

LightPeek is an independent app by NEURAFIT S.R.L. and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the controller makers or the apps mentioned. All trademarks belong to their respective owners. Names are used only to describe compatibility.

name: Lingo by OpenApps
description:
Lingo teaches a language in short lessons you can finish in a few minutes. Open it and start your first lesson right away: there is no sign-up, no ads and nothing to buy.

What you get
- Courses in 44 languages, from Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi and Indonesian to Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Gujarati, Tamil and Swahili. Learn from any of 43 starting languages. Course depth varies by language.
- Tap-first lessons: build sentences from word tiles and pick the right meaning. Typing is there when you want the extra practice.
- Phrases spoken aloud, so you hear how each word sounds.
- Practice that brings back the words you got wrong.
- A daily goal and a streak to keep you going, with an optional daily reminder.
- A weekly league that ranks everyone learning on Lingo by XP, under a nickname you choose.

Your progress
Lingo starts you as a guest, so your progress saves on your phone right away. Sign in with your email only if you want the same progress on another device. You can delete your account and your progress from your profile at any time.

Lingo is made by OpenApps. The same lessons work in a web browser at lingo-free.openapps.xyz.

name: LinguaTravel
description:
LinguaTravel, Türkçe konuşanlara İngilizceyi dünyayı gezerek öğretir. İstanbul'dan yola çıkarsın; her şehirde iki kısa ders, şehrin kendi cümleleri, yemeği, kültürü ve orada her gün duyacağın sözler seni bekler. Dersleri bitirince yeni şehre uçarsın.

İNGİLİZCE, TÜRKÇENİN EKLERİYLE
"Gidiyorum", "gitmeliydim", "gitmiş olacağım"... Türkçede eklerle kurduğumuz her şeyi İngilizce ayrı kelimelerle söyler. LinguaTravel bu eşleşmeyi renklerle gösterir: Türkçedeki her ek, İngilizcedeki karşılığıyla aynı renkte. Neyin neden öyle söylendiğini ezberlemeden görürsün.

MERDİVEN YÖNTEMİ
Tek bir cümle, basamak basamak bütün zamanlardan ve kalıplardan geçer: olumlu, olumsuz, soru; şimdi, geçmiş, gelecek; -meli, -ebilir, -miş. Her basamak bir öncekine tek bir parça ekler.

107 ŞEHİR, 214 DERS
Türkiye'nin 12 şehrinden Avrupa'ya, Amerika'dan Afrika ve Asya'ya; gerçek 3B dünya üzerinde rotanı izlersin. Her şehrin fotoğrafları, tanıtımı, kültür kartları ve gündelik bir konuşması var. Konuşmalarda "sıra sende": karşı tarafı uygulama okur, sen kendi rolünü okursun.

DOĞAL SES, KENDİ SESİN
Bütün dersler ve şehir metinleri doğal sesle okunur; okunan kelime ekranda işaretlenir, istersen yavaşlatırsın. Kayıt düğmesiyle kendi sesini kaydedip okuyucuyla karşılaştırırsın. Bir kelimeye dokununca anlamı açılır.

VALİZİN
En sık kullanılan İngilizce kelimelerin hepsi derslerde ya da şehirlerin Valiz'inde: her şehirde o şehre özgü cümlelerle yeni kelimeler, deyimler ve phrasal verb'ler. Valizine koyduğun kelimeler 1, 3, 7 ve 14 gün sonra tekrar karşına çıkar.

PASAPORT VE KARTPOSTAL
Bitirdiğin her şehir pasaportuna damga olarak basılır. İstersen şehrin kartpostalını adınla paylaşırsın.

DEFTERİM
Kaydettiğin cümleler, kelimeler ve ses kayıtların tek yerde. İstersen akşam hatırlatması kurarsın; istersen her şeyi tek bir dosyaya yedekleyip yeni telefonuna taşırsın.

ÜCRETSİZ, HESAPSIZ, ÇEVRİMDIŞI
Kayıt yok, abonelik yok, reklam yok. Bütün dersler açık. İlerlemen ve ses kayıtların yalnızca cihazında durur; internet gerekmez.

İngilizce seslendirmeler yapay zekâ ile (ElevenLabs) önceden üretilmiş kayıtlardır. Fotoğrafların sahipleri ve lisansları her şehrin sayfasında yazılıdır.

Paste any URL to capture its metadata, HTTP status and a rendered screenshot, then keep timestamped snapshots that can be compared side by side. name: Links by OpenApps
description:
Free short links and QR codes that never expire. Paste a long link and get a short one with its QR code. Change where it goes any time, even after printing. No ads, no monthly cap, no sign-up.

What you get
- Unlimited short links, QR codes and custom endings.
- Change where a link goes after you print its QR code.
- Clicks per day for every link.
- No ad page or countdown before your link opens.
- Download the QR code as PNG or SVG, in your own color.
- Export your links as CSV.

Your links
Each link has a private edit link that works on any device. This phone also keeps your links under Your links, and you can copy them to another device.

Your data
Links starts you as a guest on this phone and never asks for an email. Links counts opens only: it does not record who opened a link, where or on what device. You can delete your links and your account from the home screen at any time.

Links is made by OpenApps. It also works in a web browser at links-free.openapps.xyz.

字卡以外的字也查得到：約 6,000 字，附中文與英文釋義，可用手機語音朗讀。

所有字卡、字典與發音都內建在 App 裡，沒有網路也能用（只有購買與恢復購買需要網路）。不需帳號、沒有廣告、不蒐集任何資料。

看西班牙文選中文、看中文選西班牙文、選冠詞（el／la）、聽發音選單字、聽例句選意思、拼字、聽寫等。答錯的字會記下來，可以挑出來再考。學習時間、連續天數、三條線各走到哪裡，一頁看完（只存在手機裡）。

字卡以外的字也查得到：約 1.1 萬字，附中文與英文釋義，可用手機語音朗讀。

■ 離線、不用註冊
所有字卡、字典與發音都內建在 App 裡，沒有網路也能用（只有購買與恢復購買需要網路）。不需帳號、沒有廣告、不蒐集任何資料。

資料來源：估計級數與字典選字依 wordfreq 詞頻（不是官方 DELE 字表）；字型 Cormorant、Zen Old Mincho、教學手寫字霞鶩文楷 TC（SIL OFL 1.1）。字卡例句、中文解釋、文法課文與字典釋義由 AI 撰寫，經規則檢查與另一個 AI 交叉審稿；國際音標依卡斯提亞拼讀規則由程式產生。

name: Little Painter: Kids Coloring
description:
A simple, happy coloring book for little artists.

Pick a picture, pick a color and tap a part to fill it. Little Painter is made for small hands: big color buttons, big shapes and no way to make a mistake. Every finished picture gets a cheer and stays in the gallery.

FEATURES
• 16 cute pictures: sun, fish, house, rocket, butterfly, cat, rainbow and more
• One tap fills a whole part, perfect for toddlers
• 12 bright colors
• Friendly voice says the picture name and cheers at the end
• No timers, no scores, no failing
• Purchases and links sit behind a parent check
• Play offline

For parents: Little Painter shows only child-directed, non-personalised ads and never tracks your child. A one-time Remove Ads purchase (behind a parent check) turns ads off.

name: Little Parables: Bedtime Tales
description:
Little Parables makes cozy picture-book bedtime stories with animal friends.

Type any idea, like "a dragon who is scared of the dark" or "puppies in space", and a new story with a picture on every page appears in moments. Or switch to Bible story for a gentle retelling with animals that ends with its verse.

- Stories from any idea, with a picture on every page
- Bible stories retold with animals: the Good Samaritan, the Lost Sheep, the Prodigal Son, David and Goliath, Jesus Calms the Storm and more
- Put your family in the story: children, Mom, Dad and grandparents each become an animal
- Read to me: the built-in storyteller reads each story aloud
- Read in your own voice: read five short lines once, and stories can be read in a copy of your voice. The copy is made and kept on your device.
- Ready-to-read stories are built in
- Keep the stories you love, and send one to family with a link

Privacy first
Your family's names stay on your device. To write a new story, the app sends your idea to a free story-writing service, with made-up names in place of real ones. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Made for parents and grandparents to share with children at bedtime.

name: Liturgy: The Church's Year
description:
Liturgy follows the Catholic Church's year one day at a time, using the calendar of the Diocese of Fort Wayne-South Bend, Indiana, from Sunday, September 20, 2026 through Saturday, November 27, 2027.

Some feasts and holy days fall on different days in other dioceses. For example, some provinces keep the Ascension on Thursday, May 6, 2027; this calendar keeps it on Sunday, May 9, 2027. The About this day pages cover Wednesday, September 30, 2026 through Monday, May 31, 2027, and later months are planned for updates. After November 27, 2027, a new calendar is planned as an update.

Liturgy is not an official publication of the Diocese of Fort Wayne-South Bend or of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (USCCB).

No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. Everything works without an internet connection except the links and the iCloud copy of your check-offs.

TODAY
• Where we are in the year: the season, the week, the liturgical color, the day's celebration and its rank, and any optional memorials.
• Sundays, holy days of obligation, and the days of fast and abstinence.
• The day's Mass reading references, with a link to the full readings for that date on the US bishops' website.
• The Next card shows the next practice due today, with its check box.
• Go to any other day with the arrows or the date chooser.

PRAY
• Morning, Evening and Night Prayer from the Liturgy of the Hours: what each one is and how to pray it, with links to the day's prayer on the web and to prayer videos.
• Prayers word for word: the Morning Offering, the Angelus (the Regina Caeli in Easter Time), the Te Deum, the Examen of St. Ignatius, the Act of Contrition and more.
• The Rosary, with the mysteries for the day.

LEARN
• This week: one saint or feast for each week, with a public-domain painting most weeks, the Life from Butler's Lives of the Saints (1894) where the book has one, and a Reading from a Father or other writer of the Church.
• About this day: words from Scripture, the Church Fathers and the saints for each day.
• Saints: the ones coming up, and every saint in the calendar from A to Z.
• Short explanations of the parts of the day, the prayers, the mysteries of the Rosary, the colors, and obligations and penance. Text written for the app is marked "Written for this app".

PROGRESS
• Check off your daily practices and keep streaks, with a 30-day grid.
• A home screen widget shows today's feast and the next practice.

REMINDERS
• Optional reminders for Morning, Evening (examen, then Night Prayer) and Lights out, set in About Liturgy on the Learn tab. They stay off until you turn them on and choose a time.

YOUR CHECK-OFFS
Your check-offs are kept on your device and, if iCloud is on, copied to your own private iCloud account. The developer cannot see them, and the app sends nothing to the developer.

SOURCES
The prayers, Scripture, the Lives of the Saints and the other quoted texts come from public-domain printings, with the source named under each. The one exception is the five short titles of the Luminous Mysteries, quoted with citation from Rosarium Virginis Mariae (2002). The paintings are public-domain works, each shown with its credit. The Mass readings and the Liturgy of the Hours are not in the app: Liturgy links to them. Web links open in your web browser and videos open outside the app.

name: LiveryLoop
description:
LiveryLoop connects everyone on a livery yard in one simple app: yard managers, staff and horse owners.

FOR YARD MANAGERS AND STAFF
- Today's plan for every horse: turnout, feeds, exercise, medication and more
- Tick jobs off as they are done, with a note and a photo or video as proof
- Approve or decline owner requests in one tap
- Handover notes with priority, so nothing gets lost between shifts
- Record chargeable extras as you go, with a monthly statement for each owner

FOR HORSE OWNERS
- See your horse's day as it happens
- Photo and video updates straight from the yard
- Ask the yard for extra services and see when they are approved
- A full timeline of care, medication and notes for each horse

BUILT FOR UK LIVERY YARDS
- Works with poor yard signal: updates save and send themselves when you are back in range
- Everyone sees what their role needs, whether manager, staff or owner
- Invite your team and your owners to your yard

No more chasing. No horse left out of the loop.

name: Location IOT CAM
description:
LOCATION IOT es la app oficial de LOCATION IOT para monitorear tus vehículos y equipos GPS desde el celular, estés donde estés.

Con LOCATION IOT puedes:
• Ver tus vehículos en tiempo real en el mapa, con su estado en colores: en movimiento, ralentí, estacionado o desconectado.
• Revisar el historial de recorridos y reproducir rutas.
• Recibir notificaciones al instante: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, entrada y salida de geocercas y más.
• Generar reportes en PDF o Excel y compartirlos.
• Bloquear y desbloquear tu vehículo y activar el parqueo seguro (si tu plan lo incluye).
• Compartir la ubicación en tiempo real con un enlace.
• Ver el video en vivo de tus cámaras (si tu plan lo incluye).

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta del servicio de rastreo de LOCATION IOT. Si todavía no la tienes, contáctanos:
+16012053839 · support@locationiot.net · https://support.locationiot.net

name: Loci: Flashcards & Study
description:
Loci is a flashcard maker and study app that helps you memorize anything with spaced repetition. It works fully offline and opens straight to your cards: no account, no ads, no pop-ups.

Study what's due
Loci schedules every review with FSRS, a modern spaced repetition algorithm, so each card comes back around the time you'd otherwise forget it. Flip a card, rate how well you knew it, and Loci picks the next review. Rated too fast? Undo it. Spotted a typo? Edit the card without leaving the session; its schedule stays as it was.

Quiz yourself with multiple choice
Practice turns a deck into short multiple-choice quiz rounds, with answers drawn from the deck's other cards. A card is mastered after two correct answers in a row, and the deck shows how many you've mastered. Practice never changes your review schedule.

Make cards your way
• Type cards with line breaks, any language and emoji
• Add an image to either side, from your photos or the camera
• Study a card in both directions with one switch
• Paste a list, or import a CSV, TSV or text file from a spreadsheet or another flashcard app, with a preview before anything is saved

Your cards stay on your device
Loci has no account and no servers. Your decks, reviews and stats live only on your phone or tablet; nothing is collected or shared. Back up everything, images included, to one file you save wherever you like, and restore it on a new device. Export any deck as a TSV file to take it elsewhere.

Stay on track
• A daily streak that counts both reviews and practice
• Cards due today, your retention and 30 days of activity
• Study reminders, only if you turn them on

Made with care
• Light and dark mode
• Layouts made for phones and tablets
• Larger text, screen readers and reduced motion supported
• A short walkthrough that teaches the app by letting you study it

Free forever
Everything Loci does is free, with no limits on decks, cards or study sessions. Read the pledge: https://metodi-yanev.github.io/loci-site/pledge.html

Use it to learn vocabulary and languages, prepare for exams and tests, keep up with school and university courses, or remember anything else that matters to you.

name: LogicaAI
description:
Logica AI is a structured academy for thinking better. Instead of random puzzles, you learn a skill, practise it at the right level, and see exactly where you are improving.

SEVEN SKILL ACADEMIES
• Logical reasoning: deduction, induction, conditionals, syllogisms, analogies, cause and effect
• Critical thinking: assumptions, arguments, evidence, logical fallacies and comparing viewpoints
• Problem solving: a step-by-step method for everyday, analytical and multi-step problems
• Mathematical reasoning: percentages, ratios, averages, probability and algebraic thinking
• Pattern recognition: number sequences, missing numbers, shape sequences and visual grids
• Memory and focus: short-term recall, sequence memory and attention exercises
• Decision making: priorities, expected value, trade-offs and common thinking biases

LEARN, THEN PRACTISE
• 20 lessons with clear explanations, worked examples and key points
• 140 original exercises, each checked for a single correct answer, with a hint and a full explanation
• Beginner, intermediate and advanced levels in every academy
• Nine question types: multiple choice, true or false, statement evaluation, number answers, short answers, putting steps in order, shape sequences, visual grid puzzles and memory recall
• Hints before answers, a second try when you're close, and step-by-step solutions only when you ask

BRAIN TRAINING
• A daily challenge with five questions from five skill areas and a countdown
• Daily workouts, focus challenges and timed challenges with a fair scoring system
• Memory games: number memory, sequence memory and word recall
• Retry the questions you missed and save favourites

YOUR AI THINKING TUTOR (optional, internet required)
• Ask any reasoning question and get a hint first, then the reasoning behind the answer
• Explanations adapted to beginner, intermediate or advanced level
• AI puzzle generator: every puzzle is solved again by an independent check before you see it, so the answer key can be trusted
• Mistake analyzer: finds the thinking patterns behind your wrong answers and suggests what to practise
• A personalised 7-day learning plan built from your accuracy and unfinished lessons

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• XP, six learning levels from Beginner Thinker to Master Strategist, and a daily streak
• Accuracy by skill and difficulty, response time, learning time, and weekly and monthly charts
• 21 achievements and a ranking of your own best sessions
• Gentle, optional reminders for your daily goal, streak and daily challenge

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Points come only from correct answers, never from just opening a lesson
• Scores describe your practice in this app. Logica AI is not an IQ test and never claims to measure intelligence

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE-FIRST
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Lessons, exercises, challenges and progress work fully offline and stay on your iPhone
• AI features are off until you give permission, and your name is never sent

Logica AI is designed for students, university learners, professionals, exam candidates and anyone who wants to reason more clearly.

name: LookAlive: Daily Photo Dares
description:
LookAlive is an app for friend groups who want a daily photo challenge.

You make a group, invite people with a link, and every day there’s a new dare. Take the photo in the app, then vote on the others. Results show up when the round ends.

Groups can use the built-in dare ideas, or make their own. That means you can keep it light, weird, competitive, or whatever fits your group.

Groups are private - you join with a link or code from someone already in.

name: LoomVista
description:
Turn your threading, tie-up and treadling into an inspectable weaving drawdown. LoomVista derives a front-face interlacement diagram from your inputs and lists the finite float runs behind it.

BUILD YOUR DRAFT
Choose 1-8 shafts, 1-8 treadles and 2-128 ends and picks. Enter warp and weft colors, assign a shaft to each end, define the shafts raised by each treadle, and enter the treadling sequence. Edit individual entries or complete vectors, and repeat an explicit treadling segment to fill the picks.

TRACE THE DIAGRAM
The fixed rising-shed model puts warp above weft exactly when the pick's treadle raises the end's assigned shaft. Tap a cell to inspect its end, pick, shaft, treadle and lifted-shaft set. Colors affect the drawing, not this binary result.

EXAMINE FRONT-FACE FLOATS
See every consecutive warp-up run down each end and every consecutive weft-up run across each pick, together with the longest runs. Runs stop at the finite draft edges; there is no repeat wrap-around or reverse-face analysis.

PRESERVE AND EXPORT
Freeze a diagram with its complete draft and float results. Later edits or deletion of the source draft leave that snapshot intact. Generate an opaque PNG, an SVG, a CSV with the full threading, tie-up, treadling and drawdown sections, or complete JSON. Preview or share the actual files.

EDIT WITH CLEAR CONSEQUENCES
Search, duplicate and delete drafts. Before a resize removes inputs or resets out-of-range references, the app shows the affected entries and asks you to apply those changes. Cancel leaves the saved draft unchanged.

MODEL LIMITS
LoomVista does not predict material behavior, fabric strength, tension, density or shrinkage, and does not verify loom compatibility or safety. It does not import WIF files or generate loom-control commands.

Drafts, frozen diagrams and generated files are stored locally in the app. Clear local data in About removes the app's saved records and files; copies shared elsewhere remain separate.

name: Loteria Thanksgiving
description: Play the classic lotería with a Thanksgiving twist! 54 beautifully illustrated cards, a traditional caller who calls the cards, and boards for everyone. Mark your board with the red bean and be the first to complete a row, a diagonal, or the full board to win. Bilingual in English and Spanish, with computer players included so you can play solo or with family. Perfect for Thanksgiving dinner and game night!

name: Loupehold: Magnifier & Reader
description:
Loupehold turns your iPhone's back camera into a magnifying glass for the things that are hard to read: pill bottles, menus in dim restaurants, warranty cards, serial numbers, crossword clues and the back of a ticket.

MAGNIFY
- Smooth zoom from 1x up to the most your camera allows, with large plus and minus buttons, a slider or a pinch
- On iPhones with more than one back lens, iOS can move to the telephoto lens when you zoom in, or to the ultra wide lens for pages held very close; Loupehold shows which lens is in use
- Tap to focus on a word, then lock focus and exposure so the picture stops hunting
- Torch with low, medium and high brightness
- Brightness and contrast boost

FREEZE
One tap holds the picture still at full resolution. Pinch and drag around the frozen page at your own pace, with no camera shake.

THE LOUPE
On a frozen page, touch and hold to pick up a brass-rimmed jeweler's loupe and slide it over the words. It floats just above your fingertip so your finger never hides what you're reading, and adds 2x, 3x or 4x on top of the page zoom. Let go and it stays where you set it, moving with the page; double-tap to lift it off.

READING COLORS
White on black, yellow on black, black on yellow, grayscale or inverted, applied to the live picture, the frozen page, the loupe and the reading view.

READ ALOUD
Tap Read and Loupehold finds the text on the frozen page, on your iPhone, and sets it in large type you can make even larger. Listen with the voices on your iPhone, at the speed you like, with each word marked as it is spoken. Copy or share the text.
Text recognition can misread small or curved print, especially on medicine labels. Always confirm dosage and medical information with the original label or a pharmacist.

SNAPSHOT SHELF
Keep pages you want to look at again, newest first, up to 50. Delete any of them, or save a copy to Photos.

MADE FOR LOW VISION
Large controls, high-contrast colors, VoiceOver labels and actions throughout, and Dynamic Type.

Loupehold is free, with no ads, no subscription, no account and no tracking. The camera picture is never recorded or uploaded, and nothing leaves your iPhone unless you share it.

name: Loves Me, Loves Me Not: Petals
description:
He loves me, he loves me not?

Pluck the petals of a little pixel flower, one by one, and find out. A cosy 8-bit game you can play with one thumb.

- 61 flowers to discover, each with its own petals and tricks
- 29 worlds, from a meadow at dusk to places far stranger
- 12 mini games, each with its own leaderboard
- A garden that grows with every flower you finish
- Your own plot of land: decorate it, and buy more land block by block
- Pets that keep you company beside the flower
- A profile that is yours: picture, banner, colours, music and showcase
- A daily puzzle: the same flower for everyone, one try a day
- Duels and races against other players
- Ask someone: send a flower link and let them pluck the answer
- Friends, gifts and garden visits
- Seasons with badges to earn
- Chiptune music and haptics

Play without an account, even offline. Create a free account to save your progress to the cloud, climb the leaderboards and play with friends.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No trackers.

Available in English, Arabic, Kurdish (Sorani) and Kurdish (Kurmanji).

name: LT - personal coaching
description:
Ben je klaar om je gezondheid te verbeteren? Met de By LT - personal coaching app heb je alle tools tot je beschikking om je doelen sneller en efficiënter te bereiken.

Wat kun je met de app doen?
Volg je voeding: Krijg een duidelijk overzicht van je dagelijkse consumptie en maak bewuste keuzes voor een gezonde levensstijl.

Bekijk je trainingsschema's: Volg je trainingen, bekijk je trainingsgeschiedenis en blijf gemotiveerd met gedetailleerde schema's.

Boek je favoriete lessen: Gebruik de duidelijke agenda om al je favoriete lessen te bekijken en direct te boeken.

Volg je voortgang: Meet je voortgang met regelmatige check-ups, voortgangsfoto's en metingen. Bekijk hoe ver je bent gekomen!

Communiceer met je coach: Heb je vragen of opmerkingen? Stel ze eenvoudig via de chatfunctie en krijg direct antwoord van je coach.

Met deze app heb je altijd en overal toegang tot de begeleiding die je nodig hebt. Download nu en begin vandaag nog met het bereiken van je fitnessdoelen!

name: Ludo Voice: Talking Ludo
description:
Ludo Voice is the dice-and-token board game with a narrator who reacts to what happens on the board. Pick Nepali, Hindi or English, then choose Dai (a male voice) or Didi (a female voice). The narrator stays quiet on ordinary rolls and speaks up at the moments people shout about at home: a capture, a token reaching home, a near miss, a second 1 in a row.

WHEN THE NARRATOR SPEAKS
• Captures, tokens reaching home and the final win
• Close calls, when a token stops just behind an opponent or slips past one
• A teasing line when the same player rolls 1 again
• A gentle "your turn has come" if someone forgets to roll
• A reaction if you poke the board while a pawn is still moving
• Every line also shows in a speech bubble, with an English subtitle for Nepali and Hindi
• Turn reminders, big moments and fun reactions each have their own switch, plus a separate voice volume

WAYS TO PLAY
• Against the computer on Easy, Normal or Hard, with 2 to 4 players
• Pass and Play: 2 to 4 people sharing one iPhone or iPad
• Teams: 2 against 2, and partners never capture each other
• Classic: bring all four tokens home
• Quick: the first token home wins
• Master: capture an opponent before you can enter your home column
• House rules you can switch on or off: enter on 1 or 6, bonus rolls, safe stars, three sixes

A BOARD YOU CAN HANDLE
The board sits at a tilt in 3D. Drag it to spin it around and it springs back into place when you let go. Tokens hop from square to square and the die tumbles before it lands.

FAMILIAR FACES
16 cartoon avatars drawn for this game: Hajurba and Hajurama, Dai and Didi, Aayush and Priya, a yak, a red panda, a tiger, a rhino and more. Board, dice and token themes such as Teak Wood and Midnight are unlocked with coins you earn by beating the computer and from the daily reward. Your stats keep count of wins, captures and streaks.

PLAYS OFFLINE
• No account and no sign-up
• No internet connection needed to play
• Menus in English, Nepali and Hindi
• Progress and stats stay on your device

The game is free and shows ads: a banner on the home screen, an occasional ad between matches, and reward videos only when you choose to watch one. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off the banner and between-match ads. Coin packs are optional; every mode can be played without paying.

name: Ludworks Browser
description:
Ludworks Browser is a fast, private web browser. Use it on its own, or sign in to your Ludworks server to fill passwords from your encrypted vault and keep bookmarks, history and open tabs in sync with Ludworks Browser on your other devices.

BROWSE
• Tabs, and private tabs that forget everything when you close them
• A smart address bar with the search engine of your choice
• A new tab page with your most visited sites, your server's apps and the tabs open on your other devices
• Bookmarks with folders, history with search, and downloads to the Files app
• Find on page and desktop websites

PASSWORDS FROM YOUR VAULT
