• Fill logins from Ludworks Passwords with a tap above the keyboard
• Logins are matched to the exact site, and the browser won't fill insecure pages
• The vault unlocks with your master password and locks itself while you're away

SYNC, END-TO-END ENCRYPTED
• Bookmarks, history, open tabs and settings are encrypted on your device before they reach your server

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Websites use your camera, microphone or location only when you allow it
• Warnings about fraudulent websites, and WebKit's protection against cross-site tracking

Works without an account. Sync and password filling need a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: Ludworks Kanban
description:
Ludworks Kanban brings the boards on your own Ludworks server to iPhone and iPad. Plan a project, a move or the week ahead with columns and cards, and see your team's changes as they happen.

BOARDS
• All your boards, with their open and overdue cards at a glance
• Create, rename and archive boards
• Columns side by side: swipe across them on iPhone, see several at once on iPad
• Work-in-progress limits that show when a column is too full

CARDS
• Drag a card to another place or column, or move it from its menu
• Priorities, due dates with or without a time, labels and done
• Descriptions in Markdown with checkboxes you can tick
• Subtasks you can turn into cards, comments, attachments and the card's activity

FIND
• Search across all your boards
• See what is overdue, due in the next 24 hours or in the next 7 days

TOGETHER
• Board members see each other's changes within seconds
• Viewers read and comment, editors change cards, admins manage the board
• An edit made by someone else in the meantime is never overwritten without asking

SHARE TO A BOARD
• Turn text or a web page from Safari or any app into a card with the share extension

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your boards live on your server. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

Requires a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: Ludworks Music
description:
Ludworks Music plays the music library on your own Ludworks server, wherever you are. Browse albums and artists, build playlists, follow synced lyrics and download music to listen offline.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Home with recently added and played, most played and your favourite albums
• Albums, artists, songs, genres and playlists, sorted the way you like
• Search as you type, also offline across your downloads
• Favourites, five-star ratings and listening history

PLAYLISTS
• Create, reorder and edit playlists, with your own cover images
• Smart playlists from your server, and playlists other people on your server share with you

LISTEN
• Now Playing with synced lyrics: tap a line to jump to it
• A queue with play next, reorder, shuffle and repeat
• ReplayGain volume levelling and a sleep timer that fades out
• Background playback with lock screen and Control Center controls, AirPlay and Bluetooth
• Plays MP3, AAC, ALAC, FLAC, WAV and AIFF directly; your server converts other formats

OFFLINE
• Download albums, playlists and songs, on Wi-Fi only if you like, in the quality you choose

CAST
• Send music to Chromecast and AirPlay devices through your server, when it has casting turned on

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your music and listening history stay on your server. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

Requires a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: Ludworks Notes
description:
Ludworks Notes keeps your notes on your own Ludworks server, the self-hosted home server for your files, media and passwords. Write in Markdown, organise with folders and tags, and keep working offline: everything syncs when you're connected again.

WRITE
• A fast editor with a formatting bar: headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, checklists, bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, code blocks, links and dividers
• Lists continue when you press Return; keyboard shortcuts on iPad
• The first line becomes the title; notes save as you type, with word and character counts

READ
• A clean Markdown preview with tables, syntax-coloured code and checklists you can tick
• Photos and files attached to a note open right in the app

ORGANISE AND FIND
• Nested folders, tags, pinned notes and Recently Deleted
• Full-text search across all notes, with the matches highlighted
• Sort by date edited, date created or title

SYNC AND OFFLINE
• Syncs with your server automatically; when a note was changed on two devices, both versions are kept
• Your notes stay on the device, so you can read and edit them without a connection
• Save text, links and Markdown files from other apps with the share extension

IMPORT AND EXPORT
• Share a note as text or as a Markdown file
• Import Markdown, text and ZIP files; export a note as Markdown, or a folder or all notes as a ZIP archive

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your notes go only to the server you sign in to. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Finds your server on your home network, or connect by address. A self-signed certificate is trusted only after you confirm its fingerprint.

Requires a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: Ludworks Passwords
description:
Ludworks Passwords is the password manager for your own Ludworks server. Everything in your vault is encrypted on your device, with a key only your master password unlocks, before it is uploaded. The server, and anyone with access to it, sees only encrypted data.

AUTOFILL EVERYWHERE
• Fill passwords and passkeys in apps and websites with iOS AutoFill
• Two-factor verification codes fill in too
• Save new and changed passwords as you sign in (iOS 26.2 or later)
• Logins match by domain, host, exact address or your own rule

ONE VAULT FOR EVERYTHING
• Logins with several websites, two-factor codes, custom fields and password history
• Secure notes, payment cards and identities
• Folders and favourites, and a fast search that ignores case and accents

SAFE BY DEFAULT
• A generator for strong passwords and memorable passphrases, with a strength meter
• Unlock with Face ID or your master password; the vault locks itself after the time you choose
• Hidden in the app switcher and during screen recording; copied passwords leave the clipboard after 30 seconds
• Detects outdated or replayed copies of items on the server and never fills them

WORKS OFFLINE
• Unlock the encrypted copy on your device when the server can't be reached

YOURS
• Your vault lives on your server. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Nobody can recover your master password, so keep it safe.

Requires a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: Ludworks TV
description:
Ludworks TV turns the videos on your own Ludworks server into live channels with a TV guide, and puts your whole movie and show library on your iPhone and iPad.

LIVE CHANNELS
• Channels your server schedules from your shows, movies and playlists, playing like live TV
• A TV guide for the next 72 hours: tap a program to watch it
• Change channels with a swipe or by typing the number, with a banner that shows what's next

YOUR LIBRARY
• Movies and shows with posters, seasons and episodes
• Search, and filter by genre, year and watched
• Continue watching where you left off, on any of your devices
• Subtitles and a choice of audio tracks

OFFLINE
• Download movies and episodes to watch without a connection

BIG SCREEN
• Picture in Picture
• Cast to Chromecast and AirPlay devices through your server

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your library and viewing history stay on your server. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

Requires a Ludworks server (version 0.2 or later) and an account on it.

name: LumaProof: HDR Photo Check
description:
Check an image before you deliver it. Open an original JPEG, HEIC, PNG or TIFF from Files and compare the HDR rendering with its standard-range rendition. Inspect resolution, color profile, bit depth and gain-map presence.

Switch preview modes, zoom into the image and share a text report of the detected file properties. Includes a locally generated HDR sample and a guide to interpreting the results. Rendering depends on the display and on the image decoder. The app works offline.

name: Lumi: Times Tables & Clock
description:
With Lumi, children from kindergarten to grade 4 learn times tables, math, telling time, reading and writing through play. Short rounds, instant praise and a sticker album keep kids motivated – and parents see what has been mastered in the protected parent area.

NO ADS. NO PURCHASES. NO DATA.
Lumi Learning is completely free, has no ads, no in-app purchases, no account and works fully offline. All progress stays on the device.

4 LEARNING WORLDS, 51 LEVELS

TIMES TABLES
• All tables from 1 to 10, step by step and mixed
• Division and missing-number facts (3 × ▢ = 12)
• Pro training: Lumi picks exactly the facts that still need practice
• Times table map: green = mastered, yellow = almost, red = practise
• Dot pictures as hints – kids see what multiplying means

MATH
• Counting, addition and subtraction to 10, 20 and 100
• Number bonds, greater/less/equal
• Doubling and halving, number patterns
• Colourful counters help with bridging ten

TELL TIME
• Child-friendly clock with colour-coded hours and minute numbers
• Read the time and set the hands yourself
• O’clock, half past, quarters, 5-minute steps, to the minute
• “Quarter past three”, “twenty-five to four”
• 24-hour time and “What time will it be in 30 minutes?”
• Free clock to explore

READ & WRITE
• Letter sounds A to Z with pictures
• Trace capital and small letters with your finger
• Clap syllables, read words and build words from letters
• “a or an” and simple sentences (“True or false?”)
• Andika font – designed for beginning readers

MOTIVATION KIDS LOVE
• Stars for every level and a sticker album with 48 stickers
• 15 badges, daily goal and learning streak
• Lumi the little owl cheers along, levels up and gets new hats
• Tasks can be read aloud
• Mistakes are okay: Lumi gives a hint and shows the answer

FOR PARENTS
• Up to 6 child profiles
• Parent area behind a parental gate: learning time, accuracy, weekly overview, facts to practise
• Daily goal, break reminder, sounds, read-aloud and vibration settings
• Unlock all levels for older kids
• English and German

Lumi Learning is a practice app for home and does not replace school lessons.

name: Lumina Astral: tarot por chat
description:
Lumina Astral te pone en contacto con expertos en tarot, videncia y astrología para hablar por chat, con calma y con total discreción, cuando lo necesites.

TU PRIMERA CONSULTA ES DE REGALO
Crea tu cuenta gratis, elige a la persona con la que quieres hablar y escríbele. Tu primera consulta por chat no tiene coste.

EXPERTOS DE CARNE Y HUESO
Cada experto tiene su ficha con su foto, su especialidad, sus técnicas (tarot de Marsella, Rider, astrología, runas, péndulo…), sus años de experiencia y su presentación. Ves quién está en línea en ese momento y quién te responderá en cuanto se conecte. Todos los expertos son revisados por Lumina Astral antes de atender.

UN CHAT PRIVADO
Lo que hablas con tu experto queda entre vosotros. Puedes retomar la conversación cuando quieras desde la pestaña Chats, y te avisamos cuando te responden si activas las notificaciones.

TU CARTA DEL DÍA
Cada día una carta de los arcanos mayores con su mensaje para el amor, el trabajo o el dinero. Si quieres profundizar, la consultas con un experto en un toque.

PREGUNTA GRATIS A LA COMUNIDAD
Haz una pregunta pública y gratuita: una experta la responde y se publica sin tu nombre ni tu email. Lee las preguntas de otras personas, con la respuesta completa, y habla con quien respondió si su lectura te ha llegado.

PARA EXPERTOS
Si colaboras con Lumina Astral, entra con tu cuenta de experto para atender tus chats, responder las preguntas pendientes y decidir cuándo estás disponible.

TU CUENTA, BAJO TU CONTROL
Puedes eliminar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde Perfil.

Lumina Astral es un servicio de entretenimiento para mayores de 18 años. El tarot, la videncia y la astrología no sustituyen el consejo médico, psicológico, legal ni financiero.

¿Dudas? Escríbenos a hola@luminaastral.com.

name: Lumvero Chess – Offline Chess
description:
Lumvero Chess is a clean, ad-free chess app that works completely offline.
Play classic chess or Chess960 (Fischer Random) against a strong computer opponent or with a friend on one device.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Classic chess and Chess960 with all castling rules
• Computer opponent with 5 levels, from very easy to very hard
• Two players on one device: fixed board, rotating board or hand-over screen
• Chess clock from 1 to 30 minutes, with increment per move

LEARN AND IMPROVE
• Hint: shows a strong move when you are stuck
• Take back your last move
• Captured pieces and material balance at a glance
• Replay finished games move by move and evaluate any position
• Statistics: wins, draws and losses per computer level
• Full rules explained right in the app

YOUR BOARD, YOUR STYLE
• Six board designs and two piece sets
• Light and dark mode, coordinates, last-move highlight
• Optional move confirmation, sounds, haptics and reduced motion
• Export games as PGN or copy a position as FEN

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking, no internet. Your games stay on your device.

OPEN SOURCE
Lumvero Chess is free software under the GNU GPL v3. The computer opponent is Stockfish (GPL v3). The source code is available – see “Privacy & licences” in the app.

name: Lumvero Fit: Training & Timer
description:
Lumvero Fit is a private training log for the gym and home. Everything stays on your iPhone – no account, no ads, no tracking. The app interface is in German.

TRAIN
• 8 ready-made plans and 8 programs (full body, push/pull/legs, 5×5, GZCLP, upper/lower, home bodyweight, mobility)
• Create, duplicate and edit your own plans, including supersets
• Exercise library with 79 exercises, each with an illustration and step-by-step instructions, plus custom exercises

LOG SETS
• Weight and reps prefilled, with a progression suggestion (double progression)
• Set types: warm-up, working set, drop set, failure
• RPE with reps in reserve (RIR)
• Automatic rest timer after every set (±15 s, skip)
• Plate calculator and warm-up ramp
• New personal records are detected and celebrated

TIMER
• Tabata, HIIT, 7-minute, EMOM, circuit or your own interval
• Sound and vibration on every phase change

BODY & DAILY
• Body weight with moving average, body measurements
• Quickly log water, calories, protein, steps and active minutes

PROGRESS
• Workout history with details, records and estimated 1RM (Epley/Brzycki)
• Weekly volume, activity calendar, streak and weekly goal
• Recovery overview per muscle group

YOUR DATA
• Export and import as a JSON file
• Light and dark mode, kg or lbs

Note: Lumvero Fit is a training log, not a medical product. The recovery overview is a simplified model, not medical advice.

name: Lumvero Pure: Ingredient Scan
description:
Scan the barcode of a food or cosmetic product and see in seconds what's really inside.
Lumvero Pure shows additives, oils, sugar and notable cosmetic ingredients – clearly explained and backed by sources.

App language: German. The app interface is currently available in German only.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan a barcode with your camera or type the number
• A score from 0 to 100 with a clear explanation
• Every note names the rule and its source
• Search by product name

YOUR GOALS
Choose what matters to you: clean eating, seed-oil-free (e.g. canola or sunflower oil), low sugar, vegan or non-toxic cosmetics. The score adapts to your goals.

KNOWLEDGE, NOT FEAR
• Glossary of more than 700 E-numbers with EFSA information
• More than 60 scoring rules with sources
• Factual explanations instead of blanket bans

YOUR HISTORY
• History and favorites stay on your device
• Badges and streaks keep you going
• Share results with friends
• Light and dark mode

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no trackers. Product data comes from the open databases Open Food Facts and Open Beauty Facts (ODbL). Only the barcode or search term is sent to these databases when you look something up.

NOTE
Lumvero Pure is an information aid and does not replace medical or nutritional advice. Scores are based on the data in the open databases, which may be incomplete.

name: LunaPure: Offline Period Track
description:
LunaPure is a calm, architectural period and ovulation calendar built for absolute privacy.

Unlike cloud apps that require logins and monetize sensitive health data, LunaPure stores everything strictly on your device — with optional Face ID / Touch ID lock.

KEY FEATURES
• Accurate Cycle & Ovulation Forecast: Clear calendar view with fertile window and next period countdown.
• Effortless Daily Logging: Track flow intensity, cramps, mood, and custom body symptoms in seconds.
• Home Screen Widgets: Glanceable, discreet cycle status right on your Home Screen.
• 100% Offline & Private: No account, no tracking SDKs, no ads — ever.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock full cycle analytics, unlimited history, and local encrypted JSON backup with a single purchase. No subscriptions.

name: Lunoa: Baby Tracker
description:
Lunoa is a calm, simple baby log for the first months. Made for one hand and tired eyes at 3 AM.

TRACK IN TWO TAPS
• Breastfeeding timer with left and right side, switch and pause
• Bottle (formula or breast milk), pumping, sleep and diapers
• Growth, temperature, medicine, vaccines and milestones
• Last feed, last sleep and last diaper always at the top

SEE THE PATTERNS
• Daily timeline with totals
• 7- and 30-day charts for feeding, sleep and diapers
• Growth chart for weight, length and head circumference

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline. Your data stays on your phone
• Share with your partner through your own iCloud (iOS 17 or later)

ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Free: every log type for one baby, with the last 3 days of history.
Lunoa Premium is a one-time purchase. It adds your full history, charts, more than one baby, feeding and daily reminders, PDF and CSV reports for your doctor, and partner sharing.

Available in 23 languages. Choose ml or oz, kg or lb, °C or °F.

Lunoa is a logging tool and does not give medical advice. Ask your doctor about your baby's health.

name: Lynx Post
description:
High in the mountains, a lynx postmaster runs the busiest little sorting office in the valley. Letters, postcards and parcels slide down the conveyor one after another, and you have a split second to swipe each piece into the right chute. The catch: the rule card keeps changing.

SORT BY THE RULE CARD
The lynx holds up a big rule card that decides where every piece goes: by stamp colour, by envelope shape, by district icon, by odd or even house number, or by a combo such as "Parcels go UP, everything else by house number". Swipe LEFT, UP or RIGHT to send the glowing piece into its chute.

ADAPT IN AN INSTANT
Every few pieces the lynx stamps a brand new rule card with a fanfare. The belt slows for a heartbeat, then the new rule applies straight away. Reading fast and switching fast is the whole game.

SPECIAL MAIL
Gold EXPRESS mail rides faster and scores double. FRAGILE parcels must be swiped slowly and gently or they crack. RETURN TO SENDER always goes DOWN, whatever the card says.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Rush Hour: endless sorting that speeds up as you go. Three slips end the shift.
- Routes: 36 handcrafted levels across Saffron Market, Pine Ridge, Harbor Quay and Summit Pass, each with quotas and one to three star goals.
- Daily Mail Bag: the same 40 pieces for every player, new every day at 00:00 UTC, with its own leaderboard.

STREAKS, MISSIONS AND REWARDS
Build streaks for a multiplier up to x5. Complete 19 missions for coins, claim a 7-day reward calendar, and track your service record in Stats.

YOUR OWN SORTING DESK
Spend coins in the Locker on desk themes, stamp sets and lynx uniforms, and on boosts: Rule Peek shows the next card early, Slow Belt halves the speed for 15 seconds, and Spare Stamp forgives one slip.

PLAY YOUR WAY
A short hands-on training shift teaches everything. Play as a guest or create an optional free account with email and password to keep progress across devices. Leaderboards for every mode, cloud save, a victory cheer you can record, and a postcard of your best shift to save.

Optional coin packs are available, but every desk, stamp set, uniform and boost can also be earned by sorting mail. No ads. Original art, chiptune sounds and music made for this game.

name: Lypta: Strength Training Log
description:
Lypta is a plain logbook for strength training. You write down what you lift; it shows you where you stand. For people who already know their program and want to log it without fuss.

IN THE GYM
• Every set is already filled in with what you did last time
• If the numbers are right, one tap logs the set and the rest timer starts
• Machine taken? Swap in a substitute; Lypta remembers it for next time
• Warm-up sets, working sets, drop sets
• Weight and reps, bodyweight with added weight or assistance, or time

PLANS
• Build a plan from training days, exercises and sets
• Rep ranges, target weights and rest times per set
• More than 700 exercises, most with two photos of the movement, or add your own
• Or train without a plan

PROGRESS
• Your best lift for every exercise, large enough to read at arm's length
• A chart per exercise: best weight, estimated one-rep max, volume
• Personal records, marked when you set them
• A calendar of the days you trained
• Your training in numbers: workouts, hours, sets and weight moved

YOUR DATA
• Works without an account and without a connection
• No ads, no tracking, no feed, no streaks
• Export a plan or everything as one file, at any time
• An account is only needed to sync between devices and to share a plan by link
• No password: you sign in with a link sent by email
• Delete your account in the app whenever you like

kg or lb. Light and dark. English and German.

Lypta is free.

name: MacroPure: Protein & Macro Log
description:
MacroPure focuses on what actually drives fitness results: fast, frictionless protein, carb, fat, and calorie tracking.

No bloated social feeds, no paywalled basic logging, and no expensive annual subscriptions — just clean daily macro rings.

KEY FEATURES
• Protein-First Macro Dashboard: Clear remaining targets for protein, carbs, fat, and total calories.
• Quick-Add & Custom Meal Presets: Log your go-to shakes, chicken bowls, and snacks in two taps.
• Clean Progress & Weekly Trends: See consistency across cutting, bulking, or maintenance phases.
• 100% Offline & Ad-Free: Zero account required — your nutrition diary stays private on-device.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock unlimited meal templates, weekly analytics, and CSV/JSON export forever.

name: Macrowise
description:
Macrowise is a simple, fast food log built around your macros.

SNAP IT Photograph a plate of food or a nutrition label, say how much you're having, and send it to the AI app you already use, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Copy the reply, come back, and Macrowise fills in the calories, protein, carbs and fat for you to check.

SCAN IT Scan a barcode to look the product up in Open Food Facts, then choose a portion, a pack or a weight.

SAY IT No photo? Type something like "two coffees with 50 ml skimmed milk" and get the macros back the same way.

HIT YOUR TARGETS Set a daily calorie target and a protein, carbs and fat split. The Log screen shows what you've had and what's left, with a percentage for each macro.

LOG IT AGAIN IN ONE TAP Re-add recent foods with adjustable amounts, save meals such as your morning coffee, or repeat yesterday's breakfast.

REVIEW YOUR WEEK See each week's calories and macros against your targets.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH Every entry writes dietary energy, protein, carbs and fat to Apple Health, so other apps can use it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no ads, no tracking. Your log stays on your iPhone.

Photo and description reading needs a separate AI app installed on your iPhone. Barcode scanning and manual entry work without one.

name: Magnet Marble Sweep Attach
description:
Sweep the workshop clean in Magnet Marble Sweep!
Drag your magnet to collect golden marbles and deliver them to the green tray.
Carry up to eight marbles while avoiding tricky red washers.
Beat the clock across 30 carefully designed levels.
Earn stars and coins to unlock colorful magnet skins.
Play offline with free retries and no energy limits.

name: Mago Squish
description:
Mago Squish é um jogo de combinar peças com batalhas fofinhas: junte 3 ou mais runas iguais para atacar, se proteger, se curar e encher sua magia. Cada bichinho bravo que você vence vira seu amigo.

• 40 fases em 5 mundos: Reino de Algodão, Baía de Gelatina, Observatório das Estrelas, Cozinha dos Sonhos Doces e Parque das Nuvens
• Batalhas, fases de Coleta, de Resgate, mini-chefes e chefões
• Power-ups: Almofada Listrada, Ursinho Voador e Algodão-Doce Arco-Íris
• 4 Bichinhos Ajudantes com poderes especiais
• 6 chapéus mágicos que deixam o Pipo mais forte a cada estrela
• Mecânicas novas a cada mundo: bolhas, gelo, tinta, caramelo, rodopio e mais
• Músicas e sons fofinhos
• Funciona sem internet, sem anúncios e sem coletar dados

Feito para todas as idades.

name: Mahjong Solitaire XMS
description:
Mahjong Solitaire von getxms.com – klar gestaltet, gut lesbar und mit echtem Anspruch.

So geht's: Finde zwei identische freie Steine und räume das Brett ab. Ein Stein ist frei, wenn nichts auf ihm liegt und links oder rechts Platz ist. Oben gibt es eine Ablage für 3 Steine – parke dort einen Stein, um einen anderen freizulegen.

• Ohne Schwierigkeitsstufen: zwei leichte Bretter zum Einstieg, danach wird es Schritt für Schritt schwerer (bis zu 5 Ebenen)
• Jede Ebene gut sichtbar – du siehst sofort, wie viele Steine übereinander liegen
• Jedes Brett ist lösbar
• Hilfen: Tipp, Tauschen, Neu mischen, Zurück
• Belohnungen für schnelles Abräumen: 3 Sterne = Bonus nach Wahl
• Wochenligen: 12 Ligen, Gruppen mit 30 Spielern, Auf- und Abstieg jede Woche (Computer-Gegner sind klar als KI gekennzeichnet)
• Ruhmeshalle
• Ohne Anmeldung – nur ein Nickname, jederzeit löschbar
• Funktioniert offline
• Deutsch, Polnisch, Englisch

Kostenlos, ohne fremde Werbung und ohne Tracking. Alle paar Bretter stellen wir kurz unsere eigenen Apps vor (Angebix, XMS Tools, XMS Rechnung, XMS Calendar, XMS PI) – einige davon findest du auch als Steine im Spiel.

name: Maireth
description:
Paste this block as plain text. The section headings are uppercase, not Markdown.

A quiet place for the bottles you keep and the days you wear them.

Maireth is a local scent wardrobe for the iPhone. Record each bottle by house, family, concentration and note pyramid, keep the level left by hand, then log the days you wore it. Over a year, the small facts become a wearing log, a house index and a yearbook.

name: Mairyn
description:
Paste this block as plain text. The section headings are uppercase, not Markdown.
A quiet place for the inks you keep and the pages you fill.
Mairyn is a local ink journal for the desk. Record each writing sitting with the ink, the pen, the paper and the place, then watch a year of small pages gather into something worth keeping.
THE DESK
Open to the last page, the inks in hand and the sittings that came before. Write a page in a few taps, or step back into the yearbook.
PAGES, KEPT
Keep the minutes, the pages and the word count for every sitting. Add the paper, the place, a mood and one honest note. Search the log by ink, pen, paper, place or phrase, and filter by the mood of the day.

name: Manifest & Meditation AI Pro
description:
AI,SLEEP BETTER. BREATHE EASIER. LIVE MINDFULLY.

Your complete wellness companion for better sleep, mental clarity, and daily mindfulness. Track your sleep patterns, practice guided meditation, journal your thoughts with AI assistance, and master breathing techniques—all in one elegant app designed for your iPhone.

GUIDED MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS
• Customizable meditation timer for any duration
• Ambient sounds and nature soundscapes
• Track your meditation streak and progress
• Beautiful visualizations to enhance focus
• Sessions automatically saved to your history
• Perfect for beginners and experienced meditators

AI-POWERED PERSONAL JOURNAL
• Express your thoughts with intelligent writing assistance
• AI rewrite suggestions to improve clarity and flow
• Mood tracking with every entry
• Text-to-speech for reviewing your entries
• Secure, private, and stored only on your device
• Beautiful, distraction-free writing experience
• This is a fully functional AI Doctor that analyze documents, photo, video, and audios.

BREATHING EXERCISES
• Scientifically-backed breathing patterns
• 4-7-8 relaxation technique for stress relief
• Box breathing for focus and calm
• Customizable session durations (1-20 minutes)
• Visual and audio guidance
• Real-time breathing animations
• Perfect for anxiety relief and bedtime relaxation

DAILY WELLNESS CHECKLIST
• Track medications and supplements
• Build healthy habits with daily tasks
• Set reminders for important activities
• Visualize your progress over time
• Customizable for your personal routine

SECRET CALENDAR TO RECORD JOURNAL AND EVENT.
• Voice imputing events. 
• Add repeating events easily.
• Smart alarm that reminds you at the optimal time
• Record journal in private calendar
• Map in calendar to avoid traffic when you commute.
• Add video and photo into calendar with Journal

SMART SLEEP TRACKING
• Intelligent sleep monitoring using device sensors
• Smart alarm that wakes you at the optimal time
• Comprehensive sleep analytics and trends
• Sleep quality scoring and insights
• Seamless Apple Health integration
• iCloud sync across all your devices

COMPREHENSIVE ANALYTICS
• Sleep trends over 7, 14, or 30 days
• Meditation statistics and streaks
• Sleep efficiency and quality metrics
• Movement and restlessness tracking
• Detailed charts and visualizations
• Identify patterns in your wellness journey

PRIVACY FIRST
• All data stored locally on your device
• No third-party tracking or analytics
• Optional iCloud sync with your private container
• Apple Health data governed by strict privacy policies
• You control your data—export or delete anytime

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Unlimited sleep tracking sessions
• Advanced sleep analytics and trends
• AI-powered journal writing assistance
• Full access to all meditation soundscapes
• Premium breathing exercise patterns
• Unlimited journal entries
• Priority customer support

PERFECT FOR:
• Anyone struggling with sleep quality
• Meditation practitioners at any level
• Journaling enthusiasts seeking clarity
• People managing stress and anxiety
• Health-conscious individuals
• Anyone building better daily habits

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT:
Beautiful, modern interface
Seamless integration with Apple Health
Works completely offline
No ads or distractions
Regular updates and new features
Thoughtfully designed for iOS
Local and Private AI is available.
Multiple popular AI providers that you can choose from.
AI can analyze documents, photo, video, and audios.
AI can rewrite and improve journal ideas.

Transform your sleep, calm your mind, and live more mindfully. Download now and start your wellness journey today.

REQUIRES:
• iOS 17.0 or later
• iPhone (physical device for sleep tracking sensors)
• Optional: iCloud for sync across devices
• Optional: Apple Health for enhanced insights

Follow us for wellness and AI education. Use this AI to learn history, science, politics, and food. Please rate it so we can build with more features that are important to you!

name: Maplemeet
description:
Maplemeet is a dating app made for your campus — starting with the Claremont Colleges.

It's for the person you've seen a thousand times but never said hi to.

HOW IT WORKS
• Private likes — like someone without them knowing. They only find out if they like you back.
• Shared-routine matching — Maplemeet surfaces people whose day overlaps yours, so you actually cross paths.
• Mutual-only — you match only when it's both ways. No cold DMs, no swiping on strangers.
• Smart date planning — when you match, Maplemeet suggests a spot and a time that works for both of you.
• Afterparties — got a code from a party or event? Join it and connect with everyone who was there.

BUILT FOR STUDENTS
• Verified by your school email — everyone is a real classmate.
• Blind by default — profiles stay hidden until you open a card, so you focus on the person, not the thumbnail.
• You're always in control: block or report anyone, and delete your account anytime, right in the app.

Maplemeet is for the Claremont Colleges to start. Your school next.

name: Mapwise: Learn World Geography
description:
Mapwise teaches you world geography the way good teachers do: a few places at a time, with a quiz right away, and review until you really know them.

HOW IT WORKS
• Short narrated lessons, each about 5–10 minutes
• Learn three places, then answer questions on them, then mix them with what you already know
• Every country is shown on a real map you can pinch and zoom
• Memory tricks for the hardest groups, like Europe's tiny countries and the Pacific islands
• A 10-question review picks the places you're most likely to forget, with optional reminders every few days

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• The 7 continents and 5 oceans
• The world's major seas, gulfs and bays
• Every country in the world, region by region
• All 50 U.S. states and their capitals
• Canada's 10 provinces and 3 territories
• Printable blank maps with answer keys, for practice on paper

FREE TO START
The Continents, the Oceans and all of the Americas are free. One purchase unlocks everything else, for good. No subscription, no ads, no accounts.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Mapwise collects no data. Your progress stays on your phone.

name: Mara’s Map
description:
A letter. A lost compass. An island full of stories.

Step onto Sunshore Island and follow the trail left by your aunt Mara, a cartographer who kept this place a secret. Each clue points to a landmark. Explore, look closely and dig to uncover a keepsake and another piece of her story.

START WITH A COMPLETE FREE ADVENTURE
A Letter in the Sand includes 10 clues, a collection of illustrated keepsakes and its own ending. Take your time: there are no lives or countdowns.

EXPLORE THREE MORE STORIES
Complete a video to unlock the next two clues of an extra adventure, or pay once to unlock the whole story immediately. Three hunts await on the same island:
• Shipwreck Cove — follow Captain Sera’s last crossing.
• Waterfall Grotto — find the listening stone and a forgotten seed archive.
• Mountain Sanctuary — complete the cartographer’s promise.
Each additional adventure contains eight clues and a complete ending. Four completed story videos unlock all eight clues from the beginning. Videos never interrupt your exploration automatically.

KEEP YOUR DISCOVERIES
Revisit found letters and keepsakes in Mara’s field journal. Your hunt progress and video-earned clues are saved on your device. Restore purchased adventures with the Apple Account used to buy them.

A LITTLE NUDGE, WHEN YOU WANT ONE
Every clue has a free landmark hint. Rewarded videos can reveal an exact search spot. Exact-location videos are never needed to solve a clue. Paid adventure unlocks let you play the whole story without videos.

Make the island your own pace with a left or right joystick, separate music and effects controls, reduced motion and 30 or 60 fps settings. No game account is required.

name: Marble Orb Shooter: Match 3
description:
A moving chain of marbles is headed for the end of the track. Aim your shot, match three or more of the same color, and clear the chain before it gets there. Time your shots to open gaps and set up satisfying combos as the marbles roll through tight turns.

• Aim, match and blast through winding tracks with different layouts.
• Set off chain reactions and use boosters to help clear tricky sections.
• Unlock new levels and collect cards as you progress.
• Claim daily rewards and put them to work on your next run.

Optional in-app purchases are available.

name: Marblinco: Robot Run
description:
Marblinco is a robot who quit his job. Now every security drone in the city wants him back.

Run, jump, slide and switch lanes through busy streets, a neon district and the harbor. Tap a car to hack it out of your way. Call a ROUTE ride and surf the roof while it clears the road.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP RUNNING
- One-thumb controls that feel instant: swipe to dodge, tap to hack
- Three districts with their own music and hazards
- Power-ups: magnet, shield, propeller, 2X coins, hack chips and a ride on a car roof
- Daily quests, a daily chest and a 7-day reward streak

MAKE HIM YOURS
- Swap his whole head: Retro TV, Diver, Kitty and more
- Paint every part separately: head, body, arms, legs
- Hats from a party cone to a gold crown
- Fix his backwards waving hand (the factory did that)

HE HAS OPINIONS
Marblinco talks back, taunts the drones and complains when you poke him. Poke him ten times. See what happens.

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases for gems, a starter pack and removing ads.

name: Marinespecia
description: Marinespecia is a personal marine species register that lets you search WoRMS by scientific or vernacular name, inspect taxonomy, synonyms and distribution, and keep your own annotated collection. Favourites, side-by-side comparisons, notes, offline caching and JSON/CSV export keep every observation organised in one calm, ocean-toned workspace.

name: MarverOS: Voice Keyboard
description:
MarverOS is a keyboard you can talk to. Tap the waveform, say what you want to write, and the words appear where you are typing: in Messages, Mail, Notes or any app. Speech is written down on your iPhone or iPad, by a speech model that runs on the device. The sound is never uploaded.

TALK INSTEAD OF TYPING
- Tap the waveform on the keyboard and speak. Tap again, or just stop talking.
- Writes down 25 languages with an on-device speech model, once it has downloaded (about 600 MB, on Wi-Fi). Until then, Apple's on-device recogniser does it.
- Your dictionary: names and words you add come out right.
- Your history: every dictation is kept on the device, to copy again or delete. Switch it off whenever you like.

A KEYBOARD THAT LEARNS YOUR TYPING
- Corrections on space, with the word you typed one tap away to put back.
- Words to pick as you type, and the word you usually write next.
- Emoji by name: type a colon and a word.
- Type @ and a name to add a person's number or email from your contacts.
- Swipe to type, number pads for number fields, and English and Dutch at once.
- It learns on the device, as single words and pairs, never sentences, and never in password fields. See what it learned and remove any of it in Settings.

NOTES OF YOUR MEETINGS
- Record a meeting in the app and see its words as they are said.
- The whole transcript is written down on the device afterwards.
- With your own Claude key, MarverOS writes the notes: a summary, decisions and what to do next.

YOUR AGENT, FROM THE KEYBOARD
- With MarverOS for Mac on your Mac, Ask on the keyboard hands your question to the agent you run there, such as Claude Code or Codex, through your own iCloud account. The answer comes back to the keyboard, or as a notification.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no sign-up.
- No analytics, advertising or tracking.
- Nothing you say or type leaves the device unless you choose to: tidying and meeting notes go to Anthropic under your own key, and Ask goes to your own Mac. MarverOS asks before it sends anything, and says who gets what.

The keyboard asks for Full Access so it can receive what the app wrote down and type it for you. Typing, corrections and the globe key work without it.

Privacy: https://www.marveros.com/privacy
Support: https://www.marveros.com/support

name: Master Ring ASMR : Puzzle Game
description:
Untangle sculpted 3D ceramic rings, align color-coded latch pins, and master 200+ handcrafted spatial puzzles designed for calm focus and tactile satisfaction.

Whether you want a fast-paced mental workout or a quiet moment of zen, Master Ring combines precision mechanics with silky 60fps rotation, crisp haptics, and soothing ASMR soundscapes.

KEY FEATURES
• 200+ Handcrafted Stages: Progress through 4 themed chapters featuring Circles, Rounded Squares, Triangles, Hexagons, and Octagons.
• Smart Mechanical Twists: Solve multi-layer ring locks, steel chains, one-way ratchets, frozen ice rings, meshing gears, and timed hazards.
• Two Ways to Play: Beat the clock for 3 Stars in Challenge Mode, or switch to Zen Relax for untimed, stress-free flow.
• 4 Soothing ASMR Soundscapes: Unwind with Velvet Rain, Zen Bamboo, Midnight Drift, and Crystal Aurora—plus smart auto-rotation and Zen-only audio mode.
• 6 Luxury 3D Board Skins: Collect coins from stages, Daily Challenges, and Level Chests to unlock Pearl Porcelain, Cyber Midnight, Royal Gold, Artisan Walnut, and more.
• Helpful Boosters: Use Undo, Rocket Blast, +20s Time Freeze, and our optimal shortest-path Hint solver whenever you need a hand.
• 100% Offline & Private: Play anywhere on airplane mode. No ads, no accounts, and no personal data collected.

TERMS OF USE (EULA):
Apple Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Matattal - Car Help Kuwait
description:
Matattal ("ما تعطل؟") connects you with mobile car services across Kuwait, wherever you are.

Flat tyre? Dead battery? Keys locked inside? Pick the problem, choose your area, and Matattal shows the providers who are available right now first.

Why Matattal?
• Every service in one place: mobile tyre and repair, tow trucks and flatbeds, car keys and locksmiths, and car wash at your door.
• All of Kuwait: 133 areas across all six governorates.
• Available first: see who is free now, who is busy and when they will be free.
• Clear prices: see services and estimated prices before you call.
• Direct contact: call or WhatsApp the provider in one tap. No middleman, no fees for drivers.
• Free for drivers, no sign-up needed.

Services:
- Mobile tyre: patching, changing and inflating tyres.
- Batteries: jump start and battery replacement on the spot.
- Towing: within your area or anywhere in Kuwait, hydraulic flatbeds.
- Keys: damage-free car opening, key copying and remote programming.
- Car wash: exterior, interior and polish at home or at work.

Run a mobile car service? List it on matattal.com and reach drivers in your area.

Contact and feedback: matattal.com/contact

name: Matematică gimnaziu 5-8
description:
Matematică 5-8 te ajută să înțelegi matematica de gimnaziu și să exersezi în ritmul tău. Alege clasa, deschide un capitol și pornește de la teorie sau de la un exemplu rezolvat. Dacă ai nevoie de o formulă, o poți căuta în toate cele patru clase.

Ai la dispoziție 356 de lecții, 1.068 de exemple rezolvate și 80 de fișe cu formule. La exerciții poți lucra independent, poți cere un indiciu sau poți urmări rezolvarea pas cu pas. În caietul de greșeli regăsești ce merită repetat.

Pe ciornă poți scrie cu degetul sau poți tasta calculele. Când revii la o lecție, îți găsești progresul și răspunsurile salvate pe dispozitiv. Lecțiile și exercițiile funcționează offline, fără cont și fără reclame.

name: Math Stones
description:
MathStone is a 4-player turn-based strategic math tile game where every calculation counts and a single stone can flip the entire match.

Each round features a rotating leader. Every 5-stone chain played on the mystic board adds its final total — positive or negative — directly to the leader’s score! When you are the leader, build high-scoring chains and protect your lead; when an opponent leads, use clever subtractions, divisions, and negative multipliers to sabotage their score.

KEY FEATURES
• Strategic Arithmetic Gameplay: Play +, −, ×, and ÷ runic stones to steer the board total in your favor.
• Leader vs. Rivals Dynamic: The leader commands a 2-tier rack of opening and closing stones, while rivals counter from a sleek single-tier rack.
• Smart AI Opponents: Compete against 3 tactical bots that know when to burn multipliers and block dangerous chains.
• Tactical Depth & Zero Rule: Plan ahead around special zero-score rules that keep every turn tense and rewarding.
• 10 Mystic Runic Themes: Switch effortlessly between 10 handcrafted stone, rack, and board themes at any time.
• Personalize Your Table: Choose your player name and avatar, enjoy atmospheric background music, and play in English or Turkish.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet connection required — jump into a quick match wherever you are.

Trust your math, sharpen your strategy, and outplay the table in MathStone!

name: MatInk - EXIF Photo Frames
description:
MatInk adds gallery-style frames and camera details to your photos. Import a photo and use its EXIF metadata to place camera, lens, and exposure information in the frame.

• Start with a frame preset and adjust spacing, colors, typography, and layout.
• Choose which capture details to show, fill in missing information, or add a signature or custom logo.
• Preview the result on iPhone or iPad and save the finished photo to your library.
• Export at the original long-edge resolution, with GPS location metadata removed from the exported file.

Your photos are processed on your device from import to export.

name: Matlume
description: Keep a clear record of the mats you use every day. Create a profile for each mat, record observations across nine surface regions, and note changes along each edge. Add photos, compare them over time, and keep a history of inspections, cleaning, and care. Review trends based on your own entries, set optional inspection reminders, and explore practical care guidance. Your records and photos are stored on your device, and no account is required. Export your archive when you want to keep or share a copy. Observation grades are entered by you and are not an automated assessment or safety certification.

name: Maximum Video Editor
description:
Maximum is a video editor that does all of its work on your iPhone. Your clips never get uploaded, there’s no account to make, and there are no ads.

SLOW MOTION THAT STAYS SMOOTH
Slow a clip down and Maximum builds the missing frames from the real movement in your footage, so the slow parts glide instead of stuttering. For a speed ramp, drag your thumb while the clip plays and Maximum turns the motion into a curve you can fine-tune afterwards.

A REAL TIMELINE
Stack video, photos, text and sound on separate layers. Trim, split and line clips up with snapping that makes them click into place. Animate position, scale, rotation and almost any effect setting with keyframes, and shape the easing on a graph when the default feels too stiff.

250+ EFFECTS AND 64 TRANSITIONS
Glows, glitches, blurs, colour looks, light leaks, distortions and more, all adjustable and all able to stack. Text has more than 100 animations of its own.

EFFECT LAB
Build your own effects. Stack existing ones into a new look, or write a shader from scratch and get live sliders for its settings. Maximum also opens common shader formats, so effects made elsewhere can come in too. The best creations from the community can be added to a shared library that everyone can use.

REMOVE BACKGROUND
Cut the background out from behind people with no green screen, using the cutout built into iOS. Before it starts, Maximum checks your phone and tells you plainly whether it can do the job and how long your clip will take. On photos it can also cut out pets and objects.

PERSON-AWARE TOOLS
Blur or darken only what’s behind you with Portrait Background. Light a face after the fact with Relight. Smooth skin and even out tone with Retouch, from a light touch to a full look.

SOUND
Mix music, voiceover and the sound from your clips. Clean up dialogue with Enhance Voice, add sound effects, and save the audio from any video as its own M4A file.

CAPTIONS
Make captions from speech right on your phone, then restyle and animate them like any other text.

Projects save as you go, and Maximum offers to pick up where you stopped if it ever closes mid-edit. When you’re done, your video goes straight to Photos.

name: Mazoom Employee
description:
تطبيق معزوم الموظف يساعد الموظفين المصرّح لهم على إدارة دعوات المناسبات ومتابعة حضور الضيوف بسهولة.

من خلال التطبيق تقدر:

• تطّلع على تفاصيل المناسبات وإحصائيات الضيوف.
• تستعرض قوائم المدعوين وحالات الدعوات.
• تمسح رمز QR الخاص بالدعوة للتحقق من دخول الضيف.
• تتابع حضور الضيوف أثناء المناسبة.

سجّل دخولك باستخدام حساب الموظف المقدم من جهة عملك.

name: MBingo
description:
MBingo turns the moments everyone sees coming into a game.

Pick a theme (video meetings, football Sundays, wedding showers, conference keynotes) and MBingo deals every player their own card of 25 things that might happen. Share the game code, mark tiles as they happen, and the first to finish a row, column or diagonal wins.

- Start a game in seconds from a library of ready-made genres
- Invite anyone with a short 8-letter game code
- Everyone gets a different card, so no two boards match
- Watch other players' boards fill in live
- Create your own genres and let MBingo write 100 tiles for you
- Jump back into live games, or look back at past ones and who won

MBingo is free to play, with up to three new games a day, and joining a game is always free. Your account works on the web at mbingo.app too.

name: MBO Newsroom
description:
MBO Newsroom brings a news production studio to your iPhone and iPad. Arrange your camera, microphone, local videos and photos in Host, Host + Content or Content Full Screen layouts. Customize channel identity, studio backgrounds and headlines. Prepare media in the editor, record the composed program with audio, play it back and save it to a file. Compatible devices can combine front and rear cameras. Turkish and English interfaces and PDF guides are included.

Send your composed picture and audio to one user-configured RTMP/RTMPS destination. An external streaming account, platform eligibility and a valid server address and stream key are required. You control when sending starts and stops; the receiving platform controls broadcast visibility and viewer availability. Internet guest connections are not included.

Studio access requires a monthly auto-renewable subscription. The app shows your localized price and renewal terms before purchase. Restore Purchases and subscription management are available in the app.

Privacy: https://mbonewsroom.com/privacy?dil=en
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Measure Twice: Jobsite Tools
description:
Measure twice, cut once, and let the math take care of itself. Type feet, inches and fractions the way you read them off a tape, and get answers you can cut to.

FEET, INCHES & FRACTIONS
• A keypad built for the jobsite: one-tap 1/8 to 7/8 keys, ft and in keys, nudge by 1/16
• Add, subtract, multiply and divide lengths: 12' 3 1/2" + 4' 7 3/4" = 16' 11 1/4"
• Answers rounded to the nearest 1/16" (or 1/8", 1/32", 1/64"), and metric too
• The answer updates as you type. No "equals" to hunt for

33 CALCULATORS
• Framing: stairs, common rafters, hip and valley rafters, roof pitch, roof area and shingles, wall framing
• Decks and fences: deck boards and joists, baluster spacing, fence layout, post-hole concrete
• Concrete and masonry: slabs, footings and columns in yards and bags, rebar grids, block and brick, pavers, bulk fill
• Finish: drywall, paint, flooring, tile and grout, trim, compound miter
• Layout: square-up diagonal, right triangle, equal spacing, arch radius, slope and grade, room area, unit conversion
• Money: board feet, markup and margin, material cost, job estimate

BUILT TO BE QUICK
• Opens straight to the keypad on the first empty field
• Remembers what you typed last time
• Pin the calculators you use most
• Big type and high contrast for bright sun, plus dark mode
• Works with no signal. No account, no ads, no tracking

FREE TO TRY
The feet-inch calculator, unit conversion, concrete and board feet are free. One small purchase unlocks the other 29 calculators, plus pins, saved jobs and sharing, for good. No subscription.

name: MechStack: Puzzle Mech Duel
description:
Forget standard match-3 rules: in MechStack, connecting 4 same-colored blocks (or a 4-color line) blows up on YOUR own side!

Separate colors carefully, race your rival for pieces from a shared queue, fill bottom rows to forge giant mechs, and launch them across a live battlefield to destroy the enemy base.

KEY FEATURES:
- Reverse-Puzzle Tactical Combat: Easy to learn in 1 minute with Stage 0 training, deep to master — trigger top-row color bonuses to summon Special Mechs, Store robots in your Hangar to intercept attacks, drag-to-Merge up to LV9 ultimates, and unleash column-based Power skills.
- 52-Stage Journey & 6 Factions: Master Steel Alliance, Red Wolves, Forge, Prism Guild, Mirage Moths, and Rust Swarm — each with distinct traits, Power skills, and LV9 faction ultimates.
- Robot Logbook & Collectibles: Unlock full dossiers for 54 mechs (LV1–9), 17 Special Mechs, Shiny cards, and 45 medals.
- 2 Players on 1 Device: Instant split-screen couch versus on iPad or iPhone with all 6 factions unlocked, free match items, fun rule modifiers, and HP handicaps.
- Daily Challenge: One shared daily seed for everyone.
- Built for iPhone & iPad: Up to 120Hz ProMotion support, full 4-way rotation on iPad (landscape split-screen for 2 Players), and Swap Hands layout support.
- 100% Free Forever: Zero ads, zero in-app purchases, zero personal data collection, and fully playable offline (requires iOS 18 / iPadOS 18 or later).

name: MEDRoute: Protocolos Clínicos
seller_name: MEDROUTE EDUCACAO E SERVICOS MEDICOS LTDA
description: Para médicos e internos: ache o protocolo pelo cenário, ande pelo fluxograma, calcule a dose e monte a prescrição sem sair da tela. +140 protocolos (urgência e atenção primária), +70 calculadoras, bulário próprio e o MED.Bot, assistente de IA com a base clínica validada. 7 dias grátis.

name: Meeting Summary: AI Transcribe
description:
Meeting Summary turns any meeting into clear notes. Put your phone on the table, tap Record, and get a transcript with speaker labels, a short summary, the decisions made and every action item — ready to share.

RECORD WITHOUT WORRY
• One tap to record. Lock your phone — it keeps recording.
• Every recording is saved as it happens, so nothing is lost if a call comes in or the app is closed.
• Recording never stops when your free minutes run out. Transcribe later.
• Pause and resume, and mark important moments as they happen.

TRANSCRIPTS AND SUMMARIES
• Word-for-word transcript with speaker labels.
• Summary, key points, decisions and action items with who owns them.
• Summary styles for 1:1s, sales calls, interviews, stand-ups, lectures and more.
• Add your own notes while recording — they're kept in the summary.
• Tap any line to hear exactly how it was said.

ASK ABOUT ANY MEETING
• "What did we decide on the budget?" — get an answer with links to the moment it was said.
• If the meeting didn't cover it, it says so plainly.

IMPORT RECORDINGS
• Phones don't let apps record other apps' calls. For Zoom, Teams or Meet, record the call there and import the file — audio or video.

SEARCH AND SHARE
• Search every title, note and transcript.
• Export to PDF, text or audio and share anywhere.

YOUR PRIVACY
• Recordings are stored on your phone.
• Audio is sent to our transcription provider only to make the transcript and is deleted there straight after; transcripts are sent to an AI model to write summaries and answers. You choose whether to allow this, and the app still records and plays back if you say no.
• Delete any meeting, or your whole account, at any time.

FREE TO TRY
New accounts get 60 free minutes of transcription. Meeting Summary Pro gives you 10 hours of transcription a month with summaries, action items and Ask.

SUBSCRIPTION
Meeting Summary Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription (US$9.99 a month in the US; local prices may vary). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings. Unused minutes don't carry over.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Always tell people when you record them — some places require everyone's permission.

name: Memoire: English & Russian
description:
Memoire teaches English to Russian speakers and Russian to English speakers. A few times a day it shows a short batch of word cards, right before a word slips away.

• Word batches: due words first, new words between them.
• Ways to ask: a card asks for the meaning, the word, what you heard or the spelling.
• Built in words: about 8,000 English words with CEFR levels and Russian translations.
• Add a word: type it and get cards with translations and examples.
• Pictures: a card shows the photo from the word's Wikipedia article.
• Level test: a few rounds of yes or no on real and made up words set your level.
• Topics such as travel and food.
• Reminders at the times you set, only when words wait.
• My words: a list of your cards with search, stars and delete.
• Light and dark themes, and the screens in 9 languages.

Free, with ads. No account and no sign up. Your cards and answers stay on your phone.

Word data: Wiktionary through kaikki.org (CC BY-SA), CEFR-J and Octanove.

name: Memories – Souvenirs photo
description:
Il y a un an, jour pour jour, tu étais où ?

Memories fouille toute ta pellicule pour te montrer les photos et vidéos prises le même jour les années précédentes. Un an, trois ans, dix ans : chaque matin, tes souvenirs t'attendent.

TES SOUVENIRS, CHAQUE JOUR
• Les photos du jour, année par année : « Il y a 1 an », « Il y a 5 ans »…
• Une capsule de dates pour voyager jour par jour, ou sauter directement à une date
• Les Live Photos s'animent au toucher, les vidéos se lisent en plein écran
• Zoom au double-tap, swipe pour passer à la suivante, photo en grand en paysage

TOUTE TA GALERIE, BIEN RANGÉE
• Recherche par mois ou par année : « septembre », « 2023 »
• Photos et vidéos séparées en un geste
• De 1 à 10 photos par rangée, selon que tu veux admirer ou retrouver vite
• Favoris et albums personnels, sans rien copier ni dupliquer

FAIS LE MÉNAGE
Ta pellicule contient bien plus que des souvenirs. Memories repère pour toi :
• les captures d'écran
• les photos reçues par messagerie
• les rafales, dont on ne garde qu'une image
• les vidéos les plus lourdes
Tu vois ce que chaque groupe pèse, tu regardes avant de décider, et rien ne part sans ta confirmation. Les éléments supprimés restent 30 jours dans « Supprimés récemment ».

TA VIE SUR UNE CARTE (Memories Plus)
• Ton année en un écran : chaque jour devient une case, plus colorée quand tu as beaucoup photographié
• Tes souvenirs par lieu : tous les endroits où tu as pris des photos, ville par ville puis quartier par quartier
• Le plus loin de chez toi : ton voyage le plus lointain, avec sa distance

TES PHOTOS RESTENT CHEZ TOI
Memories n'envoie jamais tes photos sur internet. Pas de compte à créer, pas de cloud : l'appli affiche ce qui est déjà sur ton iPhone, et tes albums et favoris restent sur l'appareil.

MEMORIES PLUS
La version gratuite est complète pour revivre tes 30 derniers jours, faire le ménage et créer 3 albums. Elle est financée par une publicité discrète. Memories Plus débloque :
• aucune publicité
• les souvenirs de n'importe quelle date
• des albums illimités, protégés par code ou Face ID
• cinq thèmes exclusifs
• Ton année en un écran, tes souvenirs par lieu et le plus loin de chez toi
• des filtres avancés : tes vraies photos ou celles reçues, heure de la journée, année, panoramas, Live Photos, ralentis

Deux formules : un achat unique, à vie, ou un abonnement mensuel. Tu peux aussi essayer gratuitement certaines fonctions pendant une heure en regardant une courte vidéo.

L'abonnement mensuel est facturé sur ton compte Apple et se renouvelle automatiquement au même prix, sauf s'il est résilié au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu peux le gérer et le résilier à tout moment dans Réglages › [ton nom] › Abonnements.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://kos5454.github.io/memories-legal/conditions.html
Politique de confidentialité : https://kos5454.github.io/memories-legal/confidentialite.html

name: Memories: NAS Photo Flashback
description:
Memories shows what happened on this day in earlier years, from the photos and videos on your home NAS.

Your photos stay at home. The app reads them from the NAS over WebDAV, with no cloud in between and no account.

• A daily reminder, such as "3 years ago in Japan", at the time you pick.
• Today: the photos of this day in each earlier year, split by place.
• Trips: one tap opens every photo of a trip abroad, with its route on a map.
• Archive: any year and month, with the countries you visited.
• Viewer: full screen photos, streamed videos and a small map.
• Sort the NAS: the app moves stray photos into the folder of their date and place.

Place names come from a database inside the app. The small map loads its tiles from OpenStreetMap for the spot it shows.

Works with any NAS that serves WebDAV: QNAP, Synology and others. Away from home, the app reaches the NAS over Tailscale or a remote address.

name: Mendwell Lane
description:
Your grandad has left you his repair workshop on Mendwell Lane. It has been shut all winter: dust sheets over the benches, a bucket under the roof, cobwebs in every corner. Come home with Pip, who is seven and notices everything, and bring the old place back to life.

RESTORE HEIRLOOMS BY HAND
The village brings you the things that matter to them: a mantel clock, a teddy bear with a split seam, a teapot in pieces, a rocking horse, a valve radio and many more. Clean away the grime, mend the cracks, service the works, match the original paint and polish until it shines. Every heirloom has its own story, and its owner's reaction when they get it back.

MAKE THE PARTS
Every job needs parts. Tap the drawers on the parts bench and slide two of the same together to make the next one up, from taper pins to a whole clock movement. The bench always shows you how to make what an order needs.

PUT THE WORKSHOP BACK TOGETHER
Earn Hearts from every repair and spend them putting the workbench, the tool wall, the lamps and the tea station back where Grandad kept them, then the cottage and the garden too.

A STORY OF HOME
Seventeen chapters unfold as the workshop comes back: a neighbour over the back wall, an ex who emptied your old shop overnight, a postcard that says "Don't sell the workshop", and the question of who really took the roof fund.

Mendwell Lane is free to play, with optional in-app purchases.

name: MEP THC – Electrical & HVAC
description:
MEP THC is a set of preliminary calculation tools for electrical, HVAC and plumbing engineers. Works offline, no ads.
• Electrical: load and design current, cable sizing (IEC 60364-5-52), voltage drop, breaker–cable coordination, lighting (lumen method), motor current, conduit fill. Pro: 3-phase short circuit (IEC 60909), power factor correction, earth rods, transformer/generator sizing, maximum cable length (TN), UPS backup time, rooftop solar PV.
• HVAC: preliminary cooling load, outdoor air (ASHRAE 62.1), air changes, psychrometrics, chilled/condenser water flow. Pro: duct sizing, duct pressure loss, fan power. Also chilled water pipe sizing, anti-condensation insulation, exhaust ventilation, expansion tanks, cooling tower make-up, generator room ventilation.
• Also: EV charging load (IEC 60364-7-722), lightning protection (IEC 62305). Pro: motor starting voltage dip, water hammer.
• Substations: transformer current, main ACB, metering CT, document checklist. Pro: MV short circuit, MV cable checks, earthing grid (IEEE 80), Word test and acceptance records.
• Plumbing: supply pipe sizing (Hazen-Williams), gravity drain capacity (Manning), water heating. Pro: booster pump head and power, roof stormwater.
• Quantities: concrete, rebar weight, bricks and mortar.
• Unit converter: kW/RT/BTU/h/HP, flow, pressure, AWG.
• 73 tools in total, including quick tools: Ohm's law, kW ↔ A, power triangle, PE size, fan/pump affinity laws, COP/EER, pipe volume, slope, static head, excavation, formwork, tiles.
• Pro: Word/PDF reports with your logo, saved projects, backup. Monthly, yearly or lifetime, billed through the App Store.
Results are preliminary and for reference only. Not a government app; standards are cited, not reproduced.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://thaihuycuong.vn/chinh-sach-bao-mat-co-dien/

name: Merchmix Atlas
description:
Atlas by MerchMix puts your retail and merchandising reporting in your hands. Open saved reports, check live dashboards, present slide packs and ask questions about your data in plain English, wherever you are.
REPORTS
• Browse your saved report library and open any report as a clear, scrollable table.
• Filter, sort and explore any value to see exactly what sits behind a number.
• Tap a row to see every field in a clean details sheet.
• Switch a report between table and chart views, including bar, line, area, pie, donut, scatter, waterfall, combo and heatmap.
• Tap a chart point for a tooltip with the exact values.
• Share and export reports, and schedule them to be delivered automatically by email.
• Set up alerts to monitor thresholds that matter to you.
DASHBOARDS
• Open live, multi-widget dashboards built from your saved reports.
• Refine a whole dashboard with shared date and filter controls.
• Pull to refresh for the latest data.
PPT PACKS
• View and present PowerPoint packs as a slideshow, right from your phone.
• Edit slides, insert text and saved reports, and undo or redo changes.
• Track generations and delivery health, and download finished decks.
ADVANCED OPERATIONS
• Digital Twin: monitor key nodes and operational metrics against plan, with recent events.
• Time Machine: rewind to a past snapshot and compare it with today.
• Scenarios: model “what if” branches from any baseline.
• Decisions and Sealed history: keep a record of what was decided and when.
• Meetings: capture notes, decisions and actions in your workspace.
ASK ATLAS
• Ask a question in plain English and get an answer grounded in the data you are allowed to see, with the sources it used.
• Run deeper evidence analysis across up to three saved reports.
ADMINISTRATION
• Manage users and teams, review integrations and audit logs.
• Role-based access means everyone sees only what they should.

name: Mercurio: App Shots
description:
App Shots turns raw screenshots of your app into finished store listings.

Pick a template and one of its three colourways, drop in your screenshots and change the texts. Every slide gets a 3D device, a background and the elements a listing needs: badges, numbers, review cards, stickers and your own images.

EVERY STORE, EVERY SIZE
Export for the App Store (iPhone 6.9" and 6.5", iPad 13"), the Mac App Store, other app stores for phones and tablets, and the Shopify App Store. Switch between portrait and landscape and the layout rebuilds itself, keeping your screenshots, texts and elements.

EVERY LANGUAGE
Add the languages of your listing. Translate each text next to the original, or copy all texts out and paste them back in. Use other screenshots for a language where your app looks different. Several images come as one ZIP with a folder per language and size.

READY TO UPLOAD
Images are flat RGB PNG or JPEG files without an alpha channel. The store check names what a store would refuse or what looks unfinished: placeholder screens, more screenshots than the store takes, missing translations.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your screenshots and projects stay on your device. No account, no analytics, no internet connection needed. Save a project file to keep a project or open it on another device.

FREE AND PRO
Free has every template, device, element and language, unlimited slides and projects, and exports one size at a time with a small mark. Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: every size for every store in one ZIP, without the mark. It works on every Mac, iPhone and iPad signed in with your Apple Account.

name: Mercurio: Motion Cues Sensor
description:
Motion Cues Sensor turns your iPhone into the motion sensor for Motion Cues on your Mac: dots at the edges of the Mac screen that move with the car, train or plane.

HOW IT WORKS
• On your Mac, open Motion Cues and choose iPhone as the motion sensor.
• Open this app and lay the iPhone flat, for example on the seat or a tray.
• Your Mac and iPhone pair once over Bluetooth. From then on the iPhone sends its motion about 50 times a second.
• A live level in the app shows the motion your Mac receives.

WHEREVER IT LIES
Choose where the top edge of the iPhone points: forward, backward, left or right. A slight tilt does not matter.

KEEP SENDING WHEN LOCKED
Optional: with your location, iOS keeps the app running while the iPhone is locked, and your Mac also learns your speed, so the dots stay on at a steady speed. Only the speed goes to your Mac; your location stays on the iPhone. Continued use of location in the background uses more battery.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no purchases, no analytics, no internet connection. Motion goes only to your own Mac over an encrypted Bluetooth link.

DYNAMIC ISLAND
Status, speed and a button to turn the sensor off, in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.

SETTINGS
Sensor on or off, language, speed in km/h or mph, a short vibration when your Mac connects, and dimming the screen on long rides. Eight languages.

Requires Motion Cues for Mac (free 14-day trial in the Mac App Store, then a one-time purchase).

name: Merge Guardians: Celestial War
description:
A merge tower defense game. The Celestial Gate has cracked, and corrupted spirits are pouring into the mortal realm. Build an alliance of guardians inspired by Chinese mythology, merge them into stronger heroes and hold the gate.

How it plays
• Spend mana to summon a guardian onto a free tile of the board
• Drag a guardian onto another of the same rank to merge them into the next rank
• Every third merge you choose the result from two guardian cards
• Guardians attack enemies on the path automatically; tiles near the path matter
• Pick your commander power: Celestial Pulse, Frost Seal, Flame Rain or Jade Ward

Twelve guardians
Sun Wukong, Nezha, Chang'e, Ao Guang, Jiang Ziya, Lei Gong, Erlang Shen, Baihu, Hou Yi, Zhong Kui and two legendary guardians: Guan Yu with his Dragon Wave and Nüwa, who empowers every other guardian. Each has a distinct ability: staff clones, burn, moonlight slows, chain lightning, piercing sun arrows and more.

Equipment
• Give every guardian a weapon, a robe and a charm: damage, attack speed, crit chance
• Win gear from levels, forge it at the Smith for gold, upgrade or salvage it

Resonance and stones
• Neighbouring guardians resonate: Steam Burst, Storm Current, Heavenly Rivalry, Sun and Moon, Exorcist Seal and more
• Haste and Power Stones boost whoever stands on them, so placement counts

Four regions, 60 levels
• The Jade Bamboo Forest, the Flaming Lotus Valley, the Moon Palace and the Celestial Rift, 5 waves per level with a boss or elite on the final wave
• Telegraphed boss skills: the Grove Spirit's sapling call, the Ash Qilin's Ember Shield, Tiangou's Eclipse that slows your guardians, Taotie's Devour that swallows your mana
• Lotus Acolytes that heal, Eclipse Priestesses that shield other spirits, armored Magma Brutes, blinking Rift Stalkers and Chaos Colossi that split when they fall
• Pick battle-only blessings between waves
• Earn stars, gold and card fragments; upgrade guardians and build your deck
• Hero difficulty: replay cleared levels against larger, tougher hordes for better rewards

Endless Tower
• Opens after Chapter 1: every floor is harder than the last, with no top
• The region and boss change every 5 floors; the climb restarts every Monday
• Weekly rewards at floors 5, 10, 15 and beyond: gems, gold and gear; your record is kept on your device

Daily quests
• Three new quests every day and a bonus chest for finishing them all
• A 7-day login calendar that never resets if you miss a day

Market
• Permanent gold upgrades and daily guardian-fragment offers
• Gems are earned in play or can be bought; they unlock legendary guardians
• Mystery Boxes are opened only with gold earned in play; their odds are shown in the game

An illustrated story
• A journey told in comic panels, from the cracking Celestial Gate to Taotie's rift at the top of the sky
• Guardians talk before and after key battles
• Read each guardian's short lore in the deck

Fair and calm
• Controlled randomness: merge choices and predictable rules
• Plays offline; progress is saved only on your device
• A second chance after defeat and double victory gold, by watching an ad
• No account; the game contains ads and optional in-app purchases; Remove ads turns off the ads between battles
• 16 languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai and Hindi; music, sound, haptics and reduced-motion settings

Merge Guardians is an original fantasy inspired by Chinese mythology; the character designs and the interactions between characters were created for the game.

name: Merly's Parfüm
description:
Merly's Parfüm ile sana en çok yakışan kokuyu notalarıyla keşfet, sipariş ver ve her alışverişinde hediyeye bir adım yaklaş.

KOKUNU KEŞFET
• 100'ü aşkın parfümü kadın, erkek ve unisex olarak incele.
• Her kokunun üst, kalp ve dip notalarını nota piramidinde gör.
• Kod, ad ya da nota ile ara: "vanilya" yaz, vanilyalı kokular gelsin.
• Sevdiğin kokuya benzeyen diğer kokuları, neden benzedikleriyle birlikte gör.

HAVAYA GÖRE ÖNERİ
• Bulunduğun yerin hava durumuna ve mevsime göre günün kokuları.
• Önce kendi koleksiyonundan, sonra henüz denemediğin kokulardan öneriler.

SADAKAT KARTI
• Mağazadaki her alışverişinde verilen kodu gir, her 50 ml bir damga olsun.
• Uygulamadan verdiğin siparişlerde damgalar teslimatta kendiliğinden eklenir.
• 10 damgada istediğin 50 ml parfüm hediye.

KOKU GÜNLÜĞÜ VE KOLEKSİYON
• Elindeki kokuları koleksiyonuna ekle.
• Hangi gün hangi kokuyu sürdüğünü kaydet.

KOLAY SİPARİŞ
• 15 ml ve 50 ml boylar.
• Kapıda nakit, EFT/havale ya da kredi kartı ile öde.
• Türkiye'nin her yerine kargo; Ceyhan içine aynı gün kurye.
• Siparişini adım adım takip et, durum değişince bildirim al.

Merly's Parfüm · Crafted to linger.

name: Merum: Text notes
description: Plain-text notes, as many and as long as needed: a note of ten million characters opens, scrolls and types like a short one. Anything pasted becomes text: a picture its recognized words, a file its path. Notes sync with Merum for Mac through iCloud.

name: MetaBall - Physics Slingshot
description:
Test your precision, timing, and physics mastery in MetaBall, the ultimate minimalist slingshot arcade puzzle game.

Stretch, pull, aim, and release your sleek metal ball to launch it across challenging levels and land it cleanly inside the target glass. Easy to learn in seconds yet deeply rewarding to master, MetaBall delivers pure, satisfying physics gameplay designed for quick sessions or hours of addictive play.

HOW TO PLAY
Touch and pull back on the metal ball to build tension. Adjust your angle and power to calculate the perfect trajectory, then release to send the ball flying through the air. Sink the shot into the glass to clear the stage and advance to trickier challenges. Every shot counts, so plan your angles carefully and master the rebound.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE METABALL
Satisfying Slingshot Physics
Experience smooth, responsive touch controls with realistic momentum, gravity, and bounce mechanics. Every pull feels crisp, and every clean landing inside the glass feels rewarding.
Minimalist Visuals and Clean Design
Enjoy a distraction-free, modern aesthetic built around sleek metallic visuals, smooth motion trails, and crystal-clear targets. Zero clutter means total focus on your aim and skill.
Challenging Arcade Puzzle Levels
Progress through dozens of handcrafted stages featuring moving targets, tricky angles, obstacles, and precision trick shots that test your reflexes and spatial thinking.
Quick Pick Up and Play Sessions
Whether you have thirty seconds in line or an hour to unwind, MetaBall is built for instant fun. Jump straight into the action with fast restarts and zero waiting time.
Skill Based Gameplay
No luck required. Your accuracy, patience, and control determine your success. Perfect your bank shots, master long-range launches, and chain together clean clears to set new personal records.
Play Anywhere Anytime
Designed for smooth performance on both iPhone and iPad. Play offline without an internet connection whenever and wherever you want.

KEY FEATURES
1. Intuitive one-finger stretch, pull, and release controls
2. Realistic ball physics, trajectory arcs, and glass target mechanics
3. Minimalist high-contrast design for effortless visibility
4. Progressive difficulty from relaxing warmups to intense trick shot puzzles
5. Instant retry loop for fast-paced arcade action
6. Lightweight download optimized for all iOS devices
Can you master the angle and land every shot? Download MetaBall today, pull back, and take your best shot!

name: MetaSnow – Snow & Slopes
description:
Where is the best snow? MetaSnow shows every ski resort in the Alps on a 3D map – with fresh snow, snow depth and weather for the coming days, sharp piste maps, routes across slopes and lifts, and a ski tracker that analyses your day automatically.

3D SNOW RADAR
• Fresh snow of the last 24 hours, snow depth, temperature, freezing level, wind gusts, clouds and sun – for over 450 ski resorts in Austria, Switzerland, Italy, France, Germany and Slovenia
• Timeline: hour-by-hour forecast for the coming days
• Several weather models (ICON, ECMWF, GFS, Météo-France) side by side
• Cloud cover at its real altitude: where are you above the clouds?
• “Weather right here”: long-press the map – forecast for exactly this spot and this altitude

SLOPES, LIFTS AND ROUTES
• All slopes and lifts in the Alps as sharp lines, stored in the app and updated weekly
• Route from A to B across slopes and lifts – by difficulty (up to blue, up to red, all)
• Optionally with ski routes, touring ascents or cross-country trails (classic and skating)
• Satellite image, winter satellite image, night and topo map

SKI TRACKER
• “Start ski day”, phone in your pocket – done
• Detects runs, lift rides, ascents and car rides on its own
• Distance, vertical metres, top speed, time on skis, time on lifts and queuing time
• Every ski day on the map with replay and a season overview
• Export as a FIT file – e.g. for Strava or Garmin Connect, with runs as laps – and as GPX

PLANNING
• Driving time from your home, ski pass, toll and fuel costs compared
• Season starts: when each resort opens

AVALANCHES – PLEASE READ
MetaSnow shows the regional EAWS danger levels and an experimental avalanche calculator based on weather forecasts.
