This is NOT an avalanche warning and does not replace the official avalanche bulletin, training or your own assessment on site. Weather and snow data are forecasts without guarantee. The app links to the official warning services.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your ski days stay on your device.

Languages: English, German, French, Italian.

Data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), OpenSkiData / © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), EAWS / avalanche.report, Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX, NASA GIBS.

Note: continued use of GPS in the background during a recording can decrease battery life.

name: MeteoPro It
description:
Quanto manca alla pioggia? Da dove arriva il vento? A quale quota potrà nevicare? Con MateoPro It puoi controllare il tempo nella tua località in pochi secondi e poi esplorare le carte per capire come cambierà nelle prossime ore.

Apri l’app su iPhone o iPad e trovi temperatura, vento, precipitazioni e previsioni ora per ora. Scorri i prossimi giorni, salva le località che segui e porta il meteo che ti interessa sulla schermata Home con il widget.

Sul radar animato puoi spostarti con le dita fino alla tua zona e seguire la direzione della pioggia. Dal satellite, nel visibile e nell’infrarosso, puoi osservare la struttura delle nubi. Con Eye360 passi dalla carta alle webcam per vedere il cielo sul territorio e puoi seguire il percorso dei cicloni tropicali.

Atmosfera 3D ti porta dentro una perturbazione. Ruota la scena, guarda le nubi dal basso e fai avanzare il tempo per esplorare l’evoluzione prevista dal modello ECMWF. Puoi osservare le correnti alle diverse quote, distinguere le aree di pioggia e neve e vedere come sale o scende lo zero termico tra una valle e l’altra.

La sezione Aviazione riunisce aeroporti ed eliporti d’Europa e del Mediterraneo. Scegli un aeroporto per leggere i bollettini METAR e TAF disponibili e vedere come cambia il vento rispetto all’orientamento di ogni pista. Le carte GFS ed ECMWF e i profili atmosferici ti permettono di approfondire venti in quota, umidità e condizioni favorevoli ai temporali.

Per una giornata in montagna puoi confrontare la probabilità di neve con l’evoluzione dello zero termico. Per un’uscita in mare trovi onde, vento e avvisi ai naviganti. Se vuoi approfondire una previsione, le radiosonde mostrano le condizioni misurate durante la salita e i grafici d’insieme aiutano a capire quanto concordano i diversi scenari.

Con MeteoRadio puoi esplorare la propagazione radio, seguire l’attività solare, consultare le carte meteo ricevute via radio e sintonizzare il ricevitore SDR online. Le notizie e il forum completano l’esperienza con approfondimenti e uno spazio dove condividere ciò che osservi nella tua zona.

name: Meteria – Sensor Meter
description:
Meteria turns the sensors of your iPhone into a measuring instrument. Read them live on clear analog gauges, record what happens and share the data as a CSV file.

FREE – AND IT STAYS FREE
Meteria is our gift to engineers, technicians, makers, students and teachers. No ads, no account, no subscription, no in-app purchases and no "pro" version. Every feature is available to everyone.

SENSORS
• Accelerometer – with and without gravity, up to 100 samples per second
• Gyroscope – rotation rate on three axes
• Magnetometer – magnetic field in µT on X, Y, Z and the total
• Compass and bubble level – heading, pitch and roll
• Barometer – air pressure in hPa and the change in altitude
• GPS – position, speed, altitude, accuracy and your track
• Sound level – a dB meter with peak hold
• Bluetooth LE – devices advertising nearby and their signal strength

RECORD
• Choose the sensors and the sample rate, add a description, press record
• Watch every sensor live on its own tile while recording
• Recordings are saved on your iPhone with date, duration and number of samples

ANALYSE AND SHARE
• Zoom and scroll the charts, see min, max and average of every channel
• Share any recording as a CSV file – by mail, AirDrop or to Files – and open it in a spreadsheet, Python or any other tool

FOR EXAMPLE
• Check the vibration of a machine, a pump or a washing machine
• Find hidden steel, screws and magnets
• Level a shelf or a camera
• Measure lift speed, stairs or floors with the barometer
• Log a bike ride, a drive or a walk
• Physics lessons and experiments at school
• Find the Bluetooth beacon or sensor you are looking for

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. Meteria collects no data, has no analytics and does not contact any server. Bluetooth only listens – it never connects. The microphone only measures the level – no audio is recorded.

Made with care by Polbyte. Ideas and problems: info@polbyte.com

name: Metro Tycoon: Türkiye
description:
You are the city's transit planner! Build metro networks on the real geography of Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Eskişehir, Antalya, Bursa and Trabzon, starting in 2010, before the big rail investments began.

RACE AGAINST TIME
• Local elections follow the real calendar: March 2014, 2019, 2024, 2029… Win half the vote or you are out of office.
• Make a campaign promise: new lines, more riders or happier commuters. Keep it, and voters reward you.
• Real events are announced months ahead: a NATO summit and the Republic's centenary in Ankara, G20, EXPO 2016 and COP31 in Antalya, the Istanbul Marathon and a European cup final… Serve the venue in time for a reward, or face traffic chaos.

A LIVING MAP
• Metro, tram, BRT, commuter rail, funicular, gondola and ferries.
• Dig deep tunnels under the Bosphorus, cross the Golden Horn, link both shores of a bay by ferry.
• On derby day roads lock up, bridges jam and crowds stream to the stadium, live on the map.
• Day and night, snow, rain and fog; gulls, ferry horns and tram bells.

THE CITY TALKS ABOUT YOU
• Every decision gets a reaction on the in-game social network; important posts pop up on screen.
• Strikes, earthquakes, breakdowns and tough decisions.

DEPTH
• Research: contactless fares, CBTC signalling, driverless metro…
• Budgets, loans, fares and maintenance policy.
• Scenarios, a weekly challenge, sandbox mode and achievements.

No ads. No in-app purchases. Plays fully offline.

name: Mexican Train: Fair Dominoes
description:
The classic double-twelve dominoes game, the way families play it at the kitchen table, with deals anyone can check.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each round starts with a double in the hub: 12-12, then 11-11, down to 0-0
• Build your own train from the hub, or play on the shared Mexican Train
• Can't play? Draw one. Still stuck? Your train opens to everyone
• Play a double and it must be covered
• Go out first; lowest total after the last round wins

PLAY THE COMPUTER
Up to three computer players (seven with Pro) that see only their own tiles, like a person. Easy or Standard, at the speed you like.

PASS THE PHONE
Playing with family? Set more than one player to "person" and pass one phone around. The app hides your tiles until it's your turn.

THE TABLE YOUR WAY
• Tracks: the engine in a hub with a rail out to every train
• Star: the engine in the middle and the trains as spokes, like the hub on a real table. Tap a name to see the whole train
• Rows: one row per train
Switch anytime from the game menu.

ON THE TV
Put the whole table on a TV with AirPlay or a cable: every train, whose turn it is and the scores, big enough for the room. Everyone's tiles stay on the phone. Your first TV game is free.

FAIR DEALS
Every round's shuffle comes from a random seed. Its fingerprint is shown during the round, and the whole seed and fingerprint at the end, with Copy and How to check, so the deal and every draw can be checked. The computer can't peek or stack the boneyard.

• Free for up to 4 players: 13 rounds or a quick 7
• House rules free: double-blank counts 50, or doubles that don't need covering
• In English and Spanish
• No ads, no coins, no account, no data collected

MEXICAN TRAIN PRO (one-time purchase)
• Up to 8 players
• The table on a TV, every game (the first one is free)

name: Meža Tirgus
description:
Meža Tirgus is the MezaTirgus.lv app for forest owners in Latvia. Find your forest by cadastral number or address, plan the work and compare what timber buyers pay. A saved property opens without mobile reception. No account is needed. The app's screens are in Latvian.

YOUR FOREST ON YOUR PHONE
• Enter a cadastral number or an address to see the land unit's plan with its stands from the Forest State Register: main species, age, area and an estimate of the growing stock, with the date of the register data.
• «Kas ir šeit, kur stāvu?» (What is here, where I stand?) finds the land unit from your location.
• Save a property, and its stands, species and ages stay available in the forest where there is no reception.
• No stands in the register for your land? The app explains why and what to do next.

FULL LAND REPORT («PILNA IZPĒTE»)
Cadastral value, an indicative value range from comparable sales, sales nearby, nature protection, encumbrance and forest restrictions, and felling guidance per stand. These are estimates and guidance, not a valuation or a felling permit.

MEŽA PASE (FOREST PASSPORT) FROM THE PHONE
Describe your forest for buyers and a valuation, one question at a time; «Nezinu» (I don't know) is always an answer. Add photos in the forest, even without reception. The passport is your forest's page on MezaTirgus.lv: only you send it to buyers, and they never see your wished price.

TIMBER PRICES
Purchase prices published by buyers, by assortment, each with its source and date. Follow the assortments that matter to you: when a price moves by your threshold or more (3 % to start), you get a notification, at most once a week. A price is a guide; an offer depends on quality, volume and delivery point.

FOREST DIARY AND WORK
Photograph or write down what you see; the diary keeps it with the property and stand in time order, with the work done. Plan thinning, planting, felling and other work with due dates; a reminder arrives the day before and on the due day at 8:00. Once a month the app prepares an overview of your forest. The diary stays on your phone.

FOR CONTRACTORS («UZŅĒMĒJAM»)
If you work in other people's forests: clients, sites by cadastral number, crew, work orders with checklists, plan against actual, costs and margin, a photo report for the client and a monthly CSV table. This data stays on your phone. The money lines are a bookkeeping aid, not accounting.

LOG PILES AND WORK REQUESTS
• Measure a log pile from a photo: mark the pile face and a known length, and the app shows an approximate volume as a range.
• «Pārdot krautni» (sell a pile): send the assortment, volume, municipality and a photo to MezaTirgus.lv, and we pass it to buyers of that assortment. We do not publish your contact details; a buyer receives them only with your consent.
• «Meklēju darba veicēju» (looking for a contractor): describe the job, and with your consent MezaTirgus.lv passes it to companies so they can reply with an offer.

AI PHOTO REVIEW (BETA)
Photograph a stand or a log pile, and an AI model describes what the photo shows. Photos are sent only after you agree; the review is prepared by Anthropic's Claude model, and Meža Tirgus does not keep the photos. The review is approximate and can be wrong; it does not replace a visit on site.

PRIVACY
Your properties, work, notes and photos are stored on your phone. The app sends MezaTirgus.lv only what you choose to send: a search, your location if you choose it, Meža pase answers and photos, requests with your contact details, and photos for review. There are no ads, analytics or tracking in the app.

ABOUT THE DATA
Meža Tirgus is not a government agency and does not replace the State Forest Service's e-services. The data come from public sources — the State Forest Service's Forest State Register, the State Land Service's Cadastre Information System and the Nature Conservation Agency's nature data system «Ozols»; each has its own date. The app is run by Brain Club SIA.

name: MG SPINO Table Tennis
description:
The official member app of the MG SPINO table tennis hall. Check your balance, pick a table and start playing in seconds, while the timer keeps exact track of your time.

YOUR BALANCE AND MEMBERSHIP AT A GLANCE
• Hours and minutes left on each package, with clear expiry dates.
• A digital membership card showing your tier at the hall.

BOOK YOUR TABLE IN ONE TAP
• See every table live: free, in use or under maintenance.
• Start your session from the list, or scan the QR code on the table.
• All tables busy? Join the waitlist and we hold the first free table for you, with an instant alert.

LIVE SESSION TIMER
• Playing time and remaining balance update second by second, even on your lock screen and in a home-screen widget.
• End the session with one tap; time is deducted automatically from the package that expires first.

KEEP SCORE
• Count points game by game with your opponent; the score shows live on the hall's screen.
• The hall ranking and your rating among members.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND MONTHLY SUMMARY
• Unlock achievements as you play.
• A summary every month: your hours, sessions and favourite table.

INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
• The moment your hours are activated at reception.
• When your balance is running low during play.
• Before a package expires.

HISTORY AND STATS
• Every past session: table, time and minutes charged.
• Total hours played, longest session and your activity over the last 12 weeks.

PRIVACY FIRST
• No ads, no tracking, no data sharing.
• The camera is used only to read the table code, on your device.
• Your location is checked only when you start a session, to confirm you are at the hall, and is never stored.
• Delete your account and personal data at any time from inside the app.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign up with your phone number, or ask reception to create your account.
2. Buy an hours package at the hall's reception desk; it shows up in the app instantly.
3. Pick a table or scan its code, and play.

Note: this app is for members of the MG SPINO hall. Hours packages are bought and paid for at the venue only; there are no in-app purchases. The app is in Arabic.

name: Miami Discovery Preview MM
description:
Where should we go tonight? Explore places across Miami-Dade, from Miami and Miami Beach to Hialeah and Homestead.

Open a place to see its details. Save the ones you like and come back to your list when it’s time to head out.

For a suggestion that fits the occasion, ask Concierge a question like “Where can two people have a casual dinner in Miami?” Concierge uses the Miami catalog to suggest places. You choose whether to turn on its AI features in Settings.

Available in English and Spanish. For adults 18 and older.

name: Midnight Parcel
description:
Take the night shift at Midnight Parcel, a packing puzzle game. Arrange unusual cargo inside each box, follow the order’s packing rules, and see how your layout holds up on the way to delivery.

The first six orders are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the remaining 18 orders, for a total of 24. Use Restore Purchases on the unlock screen to recover a previous purchase.

name: Milion Dollar Barbershop
description:
Milion Dollar makes it easy to book, manage, and track your barber appointments anytime, anywhere.
        
        Hassle-Free Booking:
        
            
                View available time slots and book your next haircut in seconds.
            
            Reschedule or cancel appointments with ease.
        
        Stay on Top of Your Grooming:
        
            Get reminders for upcoming appointments.
            View your past haircuts and favorite styles.
        
        Personalized Experience:
        
            Save your favorite styles for future visits.
        
        
            The Milion Dollar app is free to use for clients of Milion Dollar. Simply log in to book your next appointment or

name: MIMHSBFort
description: MIMHSBFortThe system is designed to handle unpaid balances by carrying them over to the next billing cycle. You can record both the carried-over amounts and any new charges from each statement, while also logging the actual payments deducted from your account. Upon receiving payment confirmation, you may allocate a single payment across charges from different months, or choose to hold the funds as an unallocated balance. Credits that span multiple billing periods can be linked to the original charges; any excess credit can be recorded as a balance available for future use or as an amount pending a refund. At the end of the month, you can review your statements side-by-side and drill down into any balance to trace its origin—identifying when it first appeared and how subsequent payments were applied. If the outstanding balance at the end of a period does not match the amount carried forward to the next, a reconciliation page will highlight the discrepancy. A periodic summary provides a clear breakdown, distinguishing between recurring carry-over balances and actual net charges.

description:

Find your calm in the Great Marsh.

About: Learn about the artist behind the work and the photographs, audio, and video throughout the app.

Beautiful, dark, distraction-free design lets the nature take center stage.

Step outside the noise and into the calm. Press play and breathe.

description:
Make uchiwa fan signs, name boards, split letters and cue cards, then print them at true size at a Japanese convenience store. Fans going to the same concert share their designs with each other.

USE OTHER FANS' DESIGNS

name: Miru: Baby Monitor & Nanny Cam
description:
Your baby is finally asleep. Now you want to cook, shower or sit down for a minute without tiptoeing back to the door. Miru turns a spare iPhone or iPad into a baby monitor and nanny cam, with live video and sound on your own phone, all night long.

Miru is a free baby monitor that works phone to phone. No new gadget, no account, no cloud, and no internet needed at home. The free version stays free forever, with no ads and no time limit. It works with the phones and tablets you already have, including your partner's.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Place the spare iPhone near the crib, plug it in and choose "Baby camera". Keep Miru open on it.
2. On your phone, choose "Parent phone" and scan the code on the baby phone.
3. Watch and listen live. Next time, reconnect with one tap.

FREE FOREVER: NO ADS, NO TIME LIMIT
• Live video and audio for as long as you need
• 1 parent phone per baby camera
• Loud noise alert when your little one wakes up
• Connection lost alarm, so Miru never goes quiet without warning you
• Low battery alert for the baby phone
• Keeps alerting you while your phone is locked
• Audio only mode to save battery
• Dim night light on the baby phone
• Snapshots of your sleeping baby
• Video quality you choose: Auto, HD, Standard or Data saver

MIRU PREMIUM
Start with a 7 day free trial on the yearly plan, or choose weekly or lifetime.
• Smart cry detection: on device AI that tells crying apart from other sounds
• Motion alerts when your baby moves in the crib
• Night vision boost for dim rooms
• Two way talk, so your voice can soothe your baby
• Lullabies and white noise, with auto soothe when your baby stirs
• Watch on a TV or computer in its web browser
• Watch from anywhere over 4G, 5G or another WiFi
• Record clips that stay on your phone, kept 1 to 30 days or forever
• Up to 4 viewers at once
• A morning Night Report with snapshots of the night

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Video and sound travel straight from the baby phone to yours, encrypted end to end, at home or away. Nothing is uploaded or stored in a cloud, video never passes through our servers, and only the phones you pair can watch. No account and no sign up.

NO INTERNET NEEDED AT HOME
At home, both phones connect over your WiFi, so your baby monitor keeps working when the internet is down.

WATCH FROM ANYWHERE (PREMIUM)
At work while a sitter or grandparent has the baby? With Premium, Miru becomes a remote baby monitor over mobile data (4G or 5G) or another WiFi. Sound and alerts stay on, and video plays when you tap Watch. The two phones still connect directly, end to end encrypted. Some strict networks, like certain mobile carriers, offices or hotels, block direct connections, and Miru tells you when that happens.

MORE THAN A BABY MONITOR
Use Miru as a nanny cam at home, a pet camera for your dog or cat, or to check on an elderly parent in another room. That old phone in the drawer becomes a home camera again.

Miru is not a medical device and does not replace adult supervision.

Give your spare phone a new job tonight. Get Miru, the free baby monitor and nanny cam, and rest a little easier.

Premium subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

name: Misread: Do You Know People?
description:
Put one phone flat on the table and find out how well you actually know the people sitting across from you.

NEW THIS WEEK — THANKSGIVING SPECIAL (15 FEAST & FAMILY CARDS)
Passing the gravy boat? Debating whether sides are allowed to touch? Swearing you have zero room left right before three pies hit the table? Jump straight into 15 illustrated Thanksgiving Feast & Family cards built for ages 15 to 84 around the holiday table — plus a 15-card Holiday & Xmas pack ready for December.

4 SECONDS OF SLIDING. 40 SECONDS OF LAUGHS.
Misread isn't trivia and it isn't heavy therapy questions. Every card is an everyday micro-habit or harmless dilemma on a playful spectrum — from when you sneak down to hotel breakfast to how long it takes you to actually leave after slapping your knees and saying "We should head out!"

One person locks their honest answer in Cool Teal. Everyone else predicts where they landed in Warm Gold. Hit Reveal to see who's a certified Mind-Reader, who triggered a Plot Twist, and where Most People really land.

6 WAYS TO PLAY (ZERO ACCOUNTS OR LOGINS)
• Thanksgiving & Holiday Specials — 30 seasonal feast & family cards ready in 1 tap.
• First Impression (2 Players) — 1 tap from the home screen straight onto Card #1. Built for dates, coffee shops, bars, and new friends.
• Know Me? (2–10 Players) — Pass one phone or leave it flat on the dinner table while friends and family guess your secret habits.
• Face-Off 180° (Across the Table) — True split-screen tabletop duel where both sides read right-side-up and slide at the same time.
• Today's 5 (Solo Daily) — Lock your own answers on 5 daily cards and test your read on what Most People actually do.
• 5-Card Friend Packs & Live Video-Call Rooms — Text a 5-card challenge link to a friend or host 8–12+ players on a family or team video call.

BUILT FOR EVERY GENERATION AT THE TABLE
• 90 bespoke hand-illustrated comic cards (including 2-frame visual gags).
• 4 full languages with warm studio Read-Aloud voices: English, Swedish (Svenska), Polish (Polski), and Estonian (Eesti) — no reading glasses required.
• Shareable Dinner & Table Receipts to save your sharpest Mind-Reads and funniest Plot Twists.
• 100% Free. Zero ads, zero subscriptions, zero accounts, and full offline play for bundled decks.

name: MissionPulse
description:
Ora is an AI chief of staff for your church. She reads the apps your church already uses, answers your questions, and drafts the follow-ups, so your staff can spend more time with people.

Ask Ora about people, giving, attendance and Sundays. Then let her draft the welcome texts, volunteer reminders and thank-you notes. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

ASK ABOUT YOUR CHURCH

- Who might need a call this week

DRAFTS YOU APPROVE
Ora writes welcome texts for first-time guests, reminders for volunteers and thank-you notes for givers. You review each one, change what you want and approve it before anything goes out.

WORKS WITH YOUR CHURCH'S APPS

SHAPED BY YOUR CHURCH
Ora learns your church: its tradition, statement of faith and the way you do ministry. Bible quotes come from real Bible text, not from memory.

Built by a pastor, for the people who carry the week of a church.

name: Mite Tally: Varroa Wash Log
description:
Count mites, see the trend, act before winter.

Mite Tally is a varroa log for hobby beekeepers. After every alcohol wash, sugar roll or CO₂ test, tap once per mite and the app does the rest: mites per 100 bees, coloured against your own levels, saved to that hive's season trend.

COUNT AT THE JAR
• A big tap pad: one tap is one mite, with a click you can feel, so your eyes stay on the jar.
• Or type the number if you've already counted.
• Choose alcohol wash, sugar roll or CO₂ test, and set how many bees were in the sample.
• It remembers your usual method and sample size for each hive.

SEE EVERY HIVE AT ONCE
• Your bee yard as a comb: the hives above your action level come first.
• Each cell shows the latest count and how long ago you counted.
• A Due badge appears when a hive hasn't been counted for a while (you choose how long, or turn it off for winter).

THE SEASON TREND
• A chart for each hive, with your watch and action levels shaded.
• Add dated notes ("treated", "split", "new queen") and they show on the chart, so you can see how counts changed afterwards.
• Full history, with swipe to delete.

YOUR LEVELS, YOUR CALL
• Starts at watch 2 and action 3 mites per 100 bees, a common US rule of thumb for the active season.
• Change them to whatever your local extension service or bee club recommends.
• Mite Tally records and compares numbers. It doesn't give treatment advice.

EXPORT
• Share every count and note as a CSV file for your spreadsheet, inspector or club.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.
• Works with no signal at the out-yard.
• Your counts stay on your iPhone.

One price. Unlimited hives. No subscription.

name: Mockaby: Memorize Poems & Text
description:
Memorize poems, speeches and passages by saying them out loud.

Mockaby listens as you recite, word by word, right on your iPhone. Words you say light up. A word you miss turns orange, and if you stall, the next word appears as a hint. Pieces then come back on a simple review schedule, so they stick.

BUILT FOR HOMESCHOOL FAMILIES

- Recite: say it from memory while Mockaby follows along
- Fade: more words hide at each step
- Echo: hear a line, say it back, and build up the whole piece hands-free
- Silent: think it through and mark what you knew

YOUR OWN TEXT, OR OURS

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE

name: Moet mijn paard een deken op?
description:
Moet mijn paard een deken op? geeft je elke dag een persoonlijk dekenadvies voor je paard, voor overdag én voor 's nachts.

De app combineert het actuele weer bij jouw stal met het profiel van je paard en de dekens die je zelf hebt hangen. Zo weet je in één oogopslag welke deken past, of dat een deken niet nodig is.

WAT KAN DE APP?

• Het weer bij jouw stal: kies je stal, plaats of postcode en zie temperatuur, gevoelstemperatuur, wind en regen.
• Advies voor overdag en 's nachts: twee aparte adviezen, zodat je weet wat je paard in de wei en in de stal nodig heeft.
• Met de dekens uit jouw kast: voeg je eigen dekens toe (vulling in gram, waterdicht, halsdeken). Het advies noemt de deken die je echt kunt pakken.
• Een profiel per paard: leeftijd, geschoren of niet, vacht, huisvesting, kougevoeligheid en meer. Meerdere paarden of stallen? Geen probleem.
• 5 dagen vooruit: zie alvast welke deken je de komende dagen nodig hebt.
• Dagelijkse meldingen: elke ochtend om 07:00 en elke avond om 19:00 het dekenadvies per paard. Aan en uit te zetten in Instellingen.
• Hoefbevangenheid risicometer voor de wei: een indicatie op basis van het weer, voor paarden die hier gevoelig voor zijn.
• Back-up: exporteer je gegevens en zet ze op een ander toestel terug.

PRIVACY

Je hebt geen account nodig. Je gegevens staan op je eigen telefoon. Alleen als je meldingen aanzet, bewaren we op onze server wat nodig is om de melding te sturen: de plaats van je stal (afgerond op ongeveer een kilometer) en je paardengegevens. Zet je meldingen uit, dan wordt dat verwijderd.

Het advies is een praktische indicatie en geen veterinair advies. Kijk altijd goed naar je paard.

Weergegevens: Open-Meteo.com.

name: Moj Osijek

ZA SVE GENERACIJE Mod za starije s većim slovima i gumbima, tamna tema, podrška za čitače zaslona.

PRIVATNOST Lokacija samo dok koristiš aplikaciju. Preuzimanje i brisanje svih podataka jednim dodirom.

name: MOLLY - Manifestation

MOLLY fait de tes désirs une réalité. Écris ce que tu veux manifester : MOLLY crée une manifestation personnalisée, comme si ton désir s'était déjà réalisé, et te la lit d'une voix douce et envoûtante. Ferme les yeux, écoute, et ressens ta nouvelle vie.

DES MANIFESTATIONS RIEN QUE POUR TOI
Chaque jour, de nouvelles manifestations « Pour toi » inspirées de tes désirs : argent, amour, carrière, maison de rêve, confiance, voyages… Elles parlent de toi, de ta ville, des personnes que tu aimes.

ÉCRIS TON DÉSIR, MOLLY LE MANIFESTE
Une envie précise ? Écris-la en une phrase. En quelques instants, MOLLY la transforme en une manifestation audio à écouter quand tu veux.

UNE VOIX QUI TE TRANSPORTE
Choisis la voix qui te parle le plus, ou enregistre quelques secondes pour écouter tes manifestations avec ta propre voix. Le texte défile en même temps que la voix.

UNE BIBLIOTHÈQUE POUR ÉLEVER TA FRÉQUENCE
• Des manifestations de 2 à 4 minutes : aimant à argent, corps de rêve, job de rêve, amour, vie de luxe…
• Des fréquences (432 Hz, 528 Hz, 888 Hz…) pour méditer, te concentrer ou dormir
• Des chansons de manifestation
• Des manifestations du soir pour t'endormir dans l'abondance

UNE AFFIRMATION CHAQUE JOUR
De nouvelles affirmations à aimer d'un geste et à partager en image.

PARTOUT AVEC TOI
Le lecteur audio reste disponible dans toute l'app, même écran verrouillé.

ABONNEMENT MOLLY
L'accès au contenu nécessite un abonnement :
• Annuel : 7 jours gratuits, puis 39,99 €/an
• Hebdomadaire : 6,99 €/semaine
Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat (ou à la fin de l'essai gratuit). L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf résiliation au moins 24 h avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu peux le gérer et le résilier à tout moment dans les Réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://mavie-app-2026.web.app/fr/cgu
Confidentialité : https://mavie-app-2026.web.app/fr/confidentialite

MOLLY est un outil d'inspiration et de bien-être : elle ne remplace pas un avis médical, psychologique ou financier.

name: Momul: Timestamp Camera
description:
Press the shutter and a photo stamped with the date and time is saved right away.

· Photos are kept inside the app. Delete them from Photos and your record stays.
· 31 stamp designs in 6 colors. Drag to place.
· 10 film-look cameras (5 free, the rest free to try for 90 days).
· Sort by category, like meals or workouts, and add a one-line note.
· See every day at a glance on the calendar.
· A "Today" card that gathers the day's photos into one image.
· Deleted photos can be restored for 30 days.
· No account, no ads, no data collected.

name: MONREEL
description:
MONREEL — монгол орчуулгатай богино драм үзэх апп.

Нэг анги хэдхэн минут. Утсаараа босоо дэлгэцээр, хаана ч хамаагүй үзнэ.

• Эхний ангиуд үнэгүй
• Монгол дуу оруулалттай
• Шинэ драм тогтмол нэмэгдэнэ
• Найзаа урихад та найзтайгаа нэмэлт анги үнэгүй үзнэ

Драм нээх:
• PREMIERE — онцгой драмуудыг дангаар нь нээж, 72 цаг үзнэ
• MONREEL+ — сарын багц, PREMIERE драмуудыг оролцуулаад бүх драмыг сарын турш үзнэ

Утасны дугаараараа бүртгүүлнэ. Нэг бүртгэлээр апп болон monreel.mn хоёуланд нь үзнэ.

name: Moonbubble Lullabies
description:
No ads. No tracking. Works offline.

Moonbubble Lullabies is a calm last step in your child's bedtime routine. Pick a scene and a song, tap Launch, and your iPhone or iPad becomes a slow, gentle world with soft lullabies on a seamless loop. After the time you choose, the scene fades to black on its own, so the room stays dark. You set it up; your child just sees something calm.

SLOW, GENTLE SCENES
• Fish Tank, Night Sky, Jellyfish, Space, Crib Mobile and Rainy Window
• Soft colors and slow movement; nothing flashes
• Warm, low-blue night colors and a brightness limit

LULLABIES THAT NEVER SKIP
• Eight classic melodies, newly arranged, including Brahms' Lullaby, Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, Hush, Little Baby and All Through the Night
• A music box over a soft harp, or a soft piano
• A seamless loop with no gap or click
• Add white, pink or brown noise, a heartbeat, a soft shush or the scene's own sounds, each with its own volume

FADES TO BLACK ON A TIMER
• Separate timers for the screen and the music; the music eases away gently
• Infant: sound only (a few seconds of the scene, then a dark screen), lullabies for 45 minutes, then soft pink noise all night, with a volume cap
• Toddler: gentle tap reactions, the screen dims after 10 minutes, the music fades after 45
• Everyone: brighter, interactive, with a visible exit button
• Change any setting; nothing is locked in

MADE FOR GUIDED ACCESS
• Moonbubble walks you through turning on iOS Guided Access, so little hands can't leave the app
• In the Infant and Toddler presets, leaving takes a long press in the corner and a quick math question

CONTROL IT FROM YOUR PHONE
• Use a second iPhone or iPad as a remote over your home Wi-Fi: fade or stop the music, dim or wake the screen, add 15 minutes, change the song or scene
• Pair once by scanning a QR code. The connection is encrypted and never leaves your home network

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
• Say "Start Moonbubble", or add a session to a bedtime automation in the Shortcuts app

FREE TO TRY
The Fish Tank and Night Sky scenes, Rock-a-bye Baby, Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, both instruments, every sound layer, every preset and Siri Shortcuts are free. Unlock Everything is a one-time purchase that adds every other scene and song (including ones added later) and the remote. Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers the nursery device and your own phone.

PRIVACY
No ads, accounts, analytics or tracking. Moonbubble collects no data and needs no internet connection. Purchases sit behind a parental check.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep the device at least 2 m (6 ft) from the crib, out of reach, and the volume low.
• Moonbubble is part of a bedtime routine, not a medical device.
• For iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later.

name: Moonlight Kitchen: Cozy Café
description:
Welcome to a little café that opens when the moon comes up.

Moonlight Kitchen is a turn-based cooking puzzle. Nothing happens until you move: put the tea on, slice the bread, flip the pancakes — and every move lets the whole kitchen cook one step. The puzzle is the order.

• Plan, don’t rush: no timers, no reflex tests, just a clear goal and a smart order
• See the cost of every move: dishes say when they’ll burn, guests show who leaves first
• Undo freely and try another route
• Three stars per level: feed everyone, waste nothing, and find the shortest solution
• 45 hand-made levels: plates run out, burners go out, pancakes need flipping, one big pot feeds three
• A new daily puzzle — the same for everyone — and an endless night shift
• The guest book fills with every dish you serve just right
• Moti the café cat sleeps on the counter. You can pet him.

Chapters 1–2 are free. “The Whole Town” opens the bakery, the pancake house and the feast: 25 more levels with one purchase. No ads, no subscription, no account. Plays offline.

Languages: English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), 日本語, 한국어, Русский.

name: Moral Hub
description:
Moral Hub puts your work day in your pocket: the tasks assigned to you, your shifts and everything your team changes, in one simple app.

MY TASKS
• Every task assigned to you across all projects, grouped as overdue, today, later and no date
• The due date with year and time, who created the task and when
• Three status circles: gray to do, yellow in progress, green done. Tap one to change the status right from the list
• Open a task to read its description, subtasks and comments, and write a comment to your team

NOTIFICATIONS
• New tasks, comments, mentions, due date reminders, absence decisions and shift changes in one list
• An unread counter on the bell, and a tap opens the task or the month it is about
• Alerts on your phone about new assignments and comments, checked in the background whenever iOS allows

SHIFT
• Start and end your shift with one big button
• See how long you have been working today and all of today's shifts
• A reminder if a shift has been open for more than 12 hours
• My month: worked hours, the month's norm and the difference, absences and holidays, and any change a manager made to your shifts with the reason

PRIVACY
When you start and end a shift, the app saves where it happened, so you and your managers can see it. The location is taken only at those two moments and kept for one year. The app asks for permission first and works without it.

WHO IT IS FOR
Moral Hub is the work app of organizations that use Moral Hub on the web. You sign in with your Moral Together ID, and you see only what your organization has given you access to. If you cannot sign in, ask your manager or your Hub administrator.

The app speaks English, Hebrew (right to left) and Russian, and follows your phone's light or dark theme.

name: Mosaic Canopy
description:
Mosaic Canopy is an engaging block puzzle game that challenges your spatial reasoning and strategic thinking. Place colourful blocks on an 8×8 grid, complete rows and columns, and clear space to keep the game going.
Progress through 10 uniquely themed levels in Classic Adventure or challenge yourself in Festival Rush, where every move counts.
Key Features:
	•	Intuitive drag-and-drop gameplay
	•	10 progressively challenging levels
	•	Two distinct game modes
	•	Exciting combo streaks and clearing animations
	•	Smart placement hints
	•	Star-based achievements and level progression
	•	Personal records and performance tracking
	•	Vibrant visuals and responsive controls
	•	Offline gameplay with iPhone and iPad support
Plan your moves, discover new block combinations, and challenge yourself to achieve higher scores in a vibrant puzzle experience.

name: MoShu – Dictation & Spelling
description:
MoShu helps Hong Kong primary pupils revise for English spelling and Chinese dictation. Snap the dictation list from school and start practising straight away.

■ Snap the list
・Photograph the dictation list or worksheet – MoShu reads the text and turns it into a dictation
・Prices, numbers and other noise are skipped automatically; anything uncertain is highlighted in yellow
・Reads the dictation date on the list and plans revision days up to the test
・Import PDF lists from school email directly
・Or paste WhatsApp text or a share code, or type the words in yourself

■ Read aloud, just like at school
・English, Cantonese and Mandarin voices, with adjustable speed, repeats, pauses and random order
・Sentences are read with their punctuation – "comma", "full stop" and more
・Parents and teachers can record the dictation in their own voice

■ Practise and check
・Tap-to-spell (great for P1–P2), handwriting or typed dictation, and a word quiz
・Look-alike Chinese character hints (己 / 已 / 巳)
・Check answers after the dictation, or snap a photo for AI marking
・Mistakes go into the mistakes book and come back before the test

■ Chinese character practice
・Jyutping, Pinyin, radicals, stroke counts and look-alike characters
・Trace each character on screen

■ Teacher mode (free)
・Create a class and send the dictation list to every parent by QR code or WhatsApp
・Export PDF test sheets (blank, answers, copying practice)

■ MoShu Pro (auto-renewing subscription or one-time purchase)
・Import up to 9 photos at a time
・Unlimited AI photo marking (3 a week on the free plan)
・Fill in the blanks, learning report, premium Cantonese voice
・Up to 4 child profiles
The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial, or pay once for lifetime access.

■ Safe for families
・No ads, ever
・Your data stays on your phone; photo text recognition happens on the device
・Photos or words are only sent to an AI service when you use AI marking, word stories or fill in the blanks
・A parent check is required before any purchase or subscription change

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions at any time in your account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps4market.com/moshu/privacy_policy.html

name: Mosolis: Sunrise Alarm Clock
description:
Mosolis — from moss and solis, the shade and the first light — is a quiet alarm for people who dislike being startled awake.

No bright bedside clock. No sleep scores. No subscription. Just a calm place to set tomorrow, and nature sounds to bring you back.

WHY MOSOLIS FEELS DIFFERENT

Tomorrow at a glance
The next alarm is the first thing you see: its time, its day, and the sound waiting for you. Your other alarms and a quick countdown stay one level down, out of the way.

Alarms that fit real mornings
Weekdays, weekends, every day or just once. Each alarm keeps its own time, name, repeat days and wake sound. Switch one off without deleting it, and keep several mornings running side by side.

Eight nature scenes
Dawn Chorus, Dawn Valley, Finch Lake, Moraine Wetland, Mountain Stream, Shore Waves, Campfire and Woodstove. Every scene is a recording bundled inside the app, so waking up never depends on a signal. Prefer silence? Choose No sound and let your iPhone's own settings decide about vibration.

A countdown for the small things
Tea, a nap, a focus session, a face mask. Save the timers you actually use as one-tap scenes, then follow the remaining time on a single progress ring. Add or remove five minutes without starting over, and undo if you end it too early.

Gentle on the eyes, day or night
System, dark, pure black or light appearance, with three colour temperatures — moss, warm sand and mist. Pick what feels calm at 11 p.m. and stays readable at 6 a.m.

Runs on the system alarm
Mosolis hands each alarm to iOS, so it can ring even after the app is closed. The alarm screen, snooze and stop are provided by the system; leaving that screen silences the alarm, which is how iOS behaves.

Private by design
No account, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads. Core features work without a network connection, and your alarms stay on this device.

Free for a week, then yours
Use everything for seven days: every appearance, every nature scene, every alarm. When the trial ends, one purchase unlocks Mosolis for good. No subscription, no auto-renewal, no ads, and no later upsell.

An alarm is the last thing you touch at night and the first thing you hear in the morning. Mosolis tries to make both moments quieter.

name: MossWhisper--Forest Ring
description:
Astu rauhalliseen metsämiljööseen, jossa pienet sienet lähettävät lempeitä itiöaaltoja mutkittelevia sammalpolkuja pitkin.

Jokainen sieni kasvaa omaan tahtiinsa. Napauta sientä kasvattaaksesi sen vartta ja välittääksesi itiöitä läheisille sienille. Täysikasvuiset lakit vapauttavat kaksi itiöpurkausta, ja ylikasvanut varsi palaa takaisin pienimmäksi aluksi.

Paina sientä pitkään avataksesi Mycelium Lens -näkymän, jossa voit ennakoida seuraavan ketjureaktion ennen siirron tekemistä. Tutki kasvun aikajanaa, palaa aiempiin kuvioihin, vertaile erilaisia lopputuloksia ja palauta aiempi rengasmuodostelma milloin tahansa.

Matkaa Fern Hollow'n, Dewdrop Ridgen ja Twilight Groven halki. Jokainen napautus muovaa seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta, jokaisella yhteydellä on tarkoituksensa, ja jokainen valmis sienirengas paljastaa uuden kerroksen metsän arvoituksesta.

name: Motherboard: Run Your Agents
description:
Your own Claude Code and Codex agents on your Mac, answered from your phone. When one needs you, the question comes here, and your answer goes straight back to the agent.

Answer what's waiting. Questions, approvals and picks from every agent sit in one list. Tap an answer, or write your own, and the agent picks up where it stopped.

Talk to any agent. Open an agent's chat to see what it's doing, send it a message, or stop a turn that's going the wrong way.

Keep your todos and notes. Add a todo in plain words, like "Call the plumber Tue 9am", and give it to an agent. Read and edit the notes your agents keep.

See your day. Today shows what each agent is working on, what's due, and what finished.

Private by design. Everything that passes between your Mac and your iPhone is encrypted with a key only those two devices hold. Motherboard's server can't read it.

Motherboard for iPhone needs Motherboard on a Mac. To pair, open Motherboard's Settings on your Mac, choose iPhone, and scan the code. To look around first, tap Try it with sample agents.

name: Mottoloji:Günlük Motto & İlham
description:
Her Gune Ilham Veren Bir Dusunceyle Basla!

Mottoloji; gunluk odaklanmanizi artiran, ruh halinize gore sekillenen kisisellestirilmis bir motto, ilham ve dusunce akisi uygulamasidir.

TEMEL OZELLIKLER:

- Akilli ve Kisisellestirilmis Akis:
Motivasyon, disiplin, kariyer, ozguven, cesaret, farkindalik ve huzur dahil 12 farkli kategoriden secilmis binlerce motto.

- Gunluk Odak Secimi:
O gun neye ihtiyaciniz varsa onu secin; akisiniz aninda gunluk odaginiza gore sekillensin.

- Kendi Mottolarini Olustur:
Akliniza gelen guclu sozleri ve kisisel notlarinizi kendi ozel koleksiyonunuza kaydedin.

- Sik Kart Tasarimlari ile Paylas:
17 farkli renk temasiyla mottolari tek dokunusla gorsel kart olarak kaydedin veya sevdiklerinizle paylasin.

- Akilli Gunluk Hatirlaticilar:
Istediginiz saatlerde cihaz ici yerel bildirimlerle gun icinde kisa ilham molalari verin.

- %100 Cihaz Ici Gizlilik:
Hesap veya giris gerekmez. Favorileriniz ve kisisel mottolariniz tamamen cihazinizda saklanir.

name: Mountain Log
description:
Mountain Log is a logbook for people bagging the Munros, the Corbetts or the Wainwrights.

Tick a hill when you have climbed it and add the date if you want to. The map shows what you have done in red and what is left in blue. Your record is kept on your own device and backed up with it.

WHY IT EXISTS
I was tracking my Munros on a website. The website closed, and my record of every hill I had climbed went with it. A hill list can take years, and a record that long should not depend on someone else keeping a server running. Mountain Log keeps your record on your device, includes it in your normal device backup, and lets you export it to a spreadsheet whenever you like.

THREE LISTS
• The 282 Munros
• The 222 Corbetts
• The 214 Wainwrights
Each hill has its height in metres and feet and its grid reference. Each list keeps its own count.

A MAP OF WHAT IS LEFT
Every hill is a pin on an outdoor map with contours and hill shading. A hill still to climb is blue and a hill you have climbed is red. Tap a pin to open the hill and tick it. Show one list, or two, or all three together. The map needs a data connection. The list does not.

TICK NOW, ADD THE DATE IF YOU HAVE IT
Tap the circle beside a hill to mark it as climbed. Open the hill to add the date, chosen from a calendar. The date is optional, which suits a hill climbed years ago on a day nobody wrote down.

GROUPED THE WAY THE LISTS ARE
The Wainwrights are grouped by the seven books of the Pictorial Guides. The Munros and the Corbetts are grouped by region. You can also order a list by height or by name, search it, and show only the hills you have climbed or only the ones still to do.

BACKED UP WITH YOUR DEVICE
Your record is part of your device backup, whether that goes to iCloud or to a computer. Restore the backup to a new device and your climbs come with it.

EXPORT AND IMPORT
Export your whole record as an Excel spreadsheet, with one tab for each list and each round. Import reads that file back in. Deleting the app deletes your record from the device, so export first if you plan to uninstall and want to keep it.

START A NEW ROUND
When you finish a list and decide to do it again, start a new round. Its count goes back to zero and the round you completed is kept, with its own tab in the export.

ONE LIST FREE
When you first open the app you choose one list to have free, with every feature. The other two lists can be unlocked with a one-time purchase. It is not a subscription.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADVERTS, NO ANALYTICS
Mountain Log needs no login. It does not ask for your location. Your climbs are stored on your device and are not sent to us.

A list of summits is not a route. Check the weather and the ground before you set out.

Hill names, heights and summit positions are from The Database of British and Irish Hills v18.6, used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Maps are Mapbox Outdoors, built on OpenStreetMap data.

Support: https://mountainlog.app/support.html
Privacy Policy: https://mountainlog.app/privacy.html
Apple's standard Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: MPU Vorbereitung & Test
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Begutachtungsstelle, einer Fahrerlaubnisbehörde oder einer anderen Behörde.

Die Medizinisch-Psychologische Untersuchung entscheidet darüber, ob du deinen Führerschein zurückbekommst. Mit MPU Vorbereitung & Test lernst du, wie die MPU abläuft, und bereitest dich Schritt für Schritt auf die einzelnen Teile vor.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Ablauf der MPU
- Die ärztliche Untersuchung
- Das psychologische Gespräch
- Leistungstests, zum Beispiel den 9-Kästchen-Test
- Aufmerksamkeit und Konzentration
- Wissen für den Straßenverkehr

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- MPU Vorbereitung
- Verkehrspsychologische Untersuchung (VPU) in Österreich

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Teilen der MPU
- Übungsaufgaben mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem MPU-Termin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um Führerschein und Verkehr

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zur MPU in dieser App:
- Bundesministerium für Verkehr, MPU: https://www.bmv.de/SharedDocs/DE/Artikel/StV/Strassenverkehr/mpu-untersuchung.html
- Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen, MPU: https://www.bast.de/DE/Themen/Sicherheit/U1-MPU/MPU_node.html
- Fahrerlaubnis-Verordnung, § 11 und Anlage 15: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/fev_2010/anlage_15.html
- Österreich, Führerscheingesetz-Gesundheitsverordnung (VPU): https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10012726
- Österreich, oesterreich.gv.at, Führerscheinentzug: https://www.oesterreich.gv.at/de/themen/persoenliche_dokumente_und_bestaetigungen/fuehrerschein/7/Seite.041020

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Mr. Seoul
description:
Craving Korean comfort food? Order from Mr. Seoul right from your phone.

• Browse the full menu: bulgogi bowls, Korean fried chicken, dup bap, mandu, kimchi jjigae, ramyun and more
• Customize your order with sizes and extras
• Choose store pickup at the time that works for you, or delivery
• Pay securely by card (processed by Square) or in cash
• Follow your order status and get notified when it's ready
• Save your addresses and reorder in a tap

Order as a guest or create an account, including Sign in with Apple or Google.

name: MTD Truck Repairs
description:
MTD Truck Repairs - the Masters of Truck Disasters - has serviced fleets since 1972: three generations of 24/7 mobile heavy-duty truck, trailer and tire repair across South Jersey, Philadelphia, Delaware and Maryland, from Deptford, NJ.

FOR FLEETS AND OWNER-OPERATORS
- Request service from your phone with the unit and the location.
- Your PO or authorization number, the unit or trailer number and the repair location go on the invoice.
- With a fleet account you see every invoice and every unit's service history.
- Dispatchers and accounts-payable staff can share one company account.

WHAT WE FIX
- Truck repair: air leaks and brakes, electrical, no-starts and engine trouble on tractors.
- Trailer repair: doors, landing gear, liftgates, air bags and reefer trailers - at the yard, the dock or on the road.
- Tire service: steer, drive and trailer tires, repaired or replaced where the truck sits.
- On-site repairs: PM service and annual DOT inspections at your yard.

FOR MTD STAFF
Mechanics and the office sign in to the same app for jobs, dispatch, work orders and invoices. Staff screens are for MTD employees only.

One number, day or night: 856-845-8448. No phone menus.

name: Mudi: Guilt-free cleaning
description:
Housework, without the thinking and without the guilt.

Tell Mudi how much time you have on each day of the week. Every morning, Mudi builds a small cleaning plan that fits in that time, never more. No more wondering what to clean: open the app and start.

WHY MUDI IS DIFFERENT
• Your time first: 10 minutes on Monday, nothing on Wednesday, 30 minutes on Saturday? Mudi fits your real week. A day at zero is a rest day, and that's fine.
• Nothing piles up: a task you skip isn't overdue. Mudi suggests it again later, with no red counter and no blame.
• No endless list: only what fits in your day.

THREE KINDS OF TASKS
• Every day: dishes, tidying the living room… They come first.
• Some days: sheets on Monday, bins on Thursday — every week, every other week or once a month.
• Now and then: windows, oven, fridge… When you have time left, Mudi suggests them, each in turn.
When you create a task, you see right away when it would come with your current time.

A DAY WITH MUDI
• Today: your plan for the day, to check off.
• A gentle timer for each task: the screen stays on, pause and resume whenever you like, and an alert when the planned time is up, even with the phone locked.
• Running a little over? You choose: extend your day, or let it go this time.
• My week: a forecast of the next 7 days that adjusts to what you actually do.
• A daily reminder at the time you choose, if you want one.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads. Your tasks stay on your phone. Mudi only sends anonymous technical information to fix problems, never your tasks.

Mudi is free. Available in French and English.

name: Muscle Heat Map
description:
Log your workouts and the muscles you trained glow red on a 3D body. As the days pass they cool down to blue, so neglected muscles stand out at a glance.

“I keep training chest and arms… when did I last do back or legs?”
Muscle Heat Map shows how well each muscle has been trained in color, and tells you what to train next.

- TRAINED MUSCLES GLOW RED
Just log the exercise and the number of sets. Primary muscles count fully and assisting muscles count as half, and the 3D body changes color to match.

- THEY COOL DOWN OVER TIME
The heat fades to blue as the days go by. Muscles you haven’t trained for a while show up at the top under “Needs work”.

- TODAY’S WORKOUT PLAN
Builds a plan starting from your most neglected muscles, for the gym (weights and machines) or for home (no equipment). Log the whole plan with one tap.

- SEE THE MOVEMENT IN 3D
Pick an exercise and the figure performs it for you, with the muscles it works shown in color.

- “NEEDS WORK” REMINDERS

Training levels and workout plans are estimates calculated from your log, not medical advice.

name: Mutual: Equipment Rental
description:
Mutual is the equipment-sharing network for the trades.

Contractors, landscapers, painters, electricians and other trade businesses rent idle equipment to each other: pressure washers, trailers, generators, mowers, ladders, power tools and more.

VERIFIED BUSINESSES ONLY
Every member applies with their business details and is reviewed by the Mutual team before they can rent or list. You always know you're dealing with a real trade business.

EARN FROM IDLE GEAR
That trailer or pressure washer sitting in your yard can pay for itself. List it in under a minute with a photo, a daily price, a deposit and the days it's available.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED NEARBY
Search by equipment or city, see the daily price and deposit up front, pick your dates and send a request with a simple rental agreement.

MESSAGE AND COORDINATE
Accept or decline requests, message the other business to arrange pickup, and mark gear as returned when the job's done.

FREE TO USE
No 15–35% rental commissions like other platforms. During the beta, renters pay owners directly.

Mutual is in beta. Tell us what you think: 19bhuynh@gmail.com

name: Mutuals: Bump to Connect
description:
Mutuals is the fastest way to add someone you just met.

Make your card: a photo, your name, a handle, a short bio, your interests and your socials.

Meet someone and shake your phones together, on any screen. You land in each other's deck instantly. No usernames to spell out, no QR codes, no searching.

Your deck keeps everyone you met, with where and when. Bump a friend again and it counts as another hangout. Tap a card to flip it and see their bio and links.

Earn badges from real meetups and show up to 3 on your card.

Only in person. There is no search and no public profile: the only way to add someone is to be there.

You stay in control. Remove and block anyone, report a card, turn off saving where you met, and delete your account at any time.

name: Muxevio Play
description:
Muxevio Play is a player for the live TV, TV guide and video club of your IPTV operator. The app contains no channels or content of its own: after you activate a license from your operator, it connects to the portal your operator has assigned to you.

name: MVP Studio

MVP: Client Portal is the companion app for clients of MVP, the software and AI studio in Harare, Zimbabwe. Everything about your project lives in one place, so you always know where things stand and what's been agreed.

FOLLOW YOUR PROJECT

QUOTES AND INVOICES

BUILT FOR ZIMBABWE

name: My Career Mountain
description: A financial commitment encourages accountability, motivates consistent engagement, and supports the ongoing development of features, security, and customer support.

name: My Little Baby: Pet Diary
description:
Keep the little moments of life with your pets. Add photos, write a few words and decorate the memories you want to keep with cute stickers.

My Little Baby is a private pet diary shared with the people you invite. Sign in with Apple, Google or an existing app email account.

Every pet has a story
• Add dogs, cats, birds and other companions with their names and photos.
• Choose several pets in one memory. See everyone together or browse one pet's memories.
• Choose kg, g or lb yourself for an optional weight, whatever the species.

Make a scrapbook of ordinary days
• A warm paper-and-tape diary design
• Up to 6 photos per memory, with illustrated stickers for each photo
• Open photos for a closer look
• Calendar, album and story/pet-name search
• Optional food, water, walk, play and grooming notes

Share with the people you choose
Owners can share an invitation link or code from notebook home. Recipients sign in, review the invitation and explicitly accept it. Editors can add and change memories; viewers can read them. Owners manage invitations and member access.

Keep a copy of your memories
Export a backup with photos. Only an owner can confirm replacing a shared notebook from a backup. An owner confirms upgrades to an older notebook's photo or multiple-pet features, and every participant needs an app version that supports those features.

English and Korean are supported. This version has no ads, purchases or personalized AI sticker generation.

Shared memories are stored in the cloud and shared with invited members. The service is not end-to-end encrypted, and exported backups are not encrypted. Removing access cannot erase copies already saved or exported. Start app-account deletion in the app or request deletion through support. This diary does not provide veterinary diagnosis or treatment.

Support: makingsoulstudio@gmail.com

name: My Smart Rest
description:
Rest is part of your training. Rest too little and your next set suffers. Rest too much and your workout loses intensity. My Smart Rest tells you exactly how long to rest between sets, based on your heart rate and today's recovery.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start your workout on iPhone and it opens on your Apple Watch automatically.
• After every set, My Smart Rest looks at how hard your heart worked and calculates your rest.
• On days when your recovery is lower, it gives you a little extra time.
• A gentle haptic on your wrist tells you when you're ready to go again.

IT LEARNS FROM YOU
After each rest, tell the app if it felt Too Short, Just Right or Too Long. Your next rests adapt to you.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Today: your recovery score and the workout planned for today.
• Workout: build your own routines, with days and exercises.
• Progress: resting heart rate and workout trends from Apple Health.
• Coach: why your rest is what it is, explained simply.

BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH
Big, readable timer. No scrolling during your workout. Add 15 seconds with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your health data stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

REQUIREMENTS
An Apple Watch paired with your iPhone is required to start a workout.

My Smart Rest is a fitness app, not a medical device. Talk to your doctor before starting a new training program.

Made by Team Tieneme Ca T Teng: Denis, Francesco, Sidrish, Mofeez and Morteza.

name: My Wardrobe Calendar
description:
The cardigan you love. The jeans that go with it. The photo from the last time you wore them together. My Wardrobe Calendar keeps them in one place, so it’s easy to decide what to wear next.

Make a lookbook of your own clothes
Take a photo or choose one from your library. The app helps remove the background and suggests a category and color. Adjust either, then flip through your pieces like the pages of a magazine. Give a favorite its own close-up, right down to the stitching.

Lay out the week
See each day’s outfit, piece by piece. Drag a jacket from Friday to Saturday, or copy it to wear it both days. Looking for a particular pair of jeans? Search by name or narrow your closet by category and color. For a little inspiration, pick one piece and try a color pairing from your own wardrobe.

Pack for the outfits you’ve planned
Choose your trip dates to see what to bring. A pair of loafers worn on three days appears once on the packing list, with all three dates beside it.

Remember how it looked on you
Mark the outfits you actually wore to keep a wear count for each piece. Link a photo to the clothes in it, then use that photo to plan the combination again. When a piece leaves your closet, archive it as a keepsake with its photos and history.

Your wardrobe stays on your iPhone. Start with 10 pieces free, including archived pieces. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited wardrobe space.

name: Myanmar Community
description:
A global family in Christ for Myanmar believers, wherever you live.

Myanmar Community brings Christians from Myanmar and the diaspora together in one warm, safe place. Share what God is doing, pray for one another and grow in the Word, in English and Burmese.

COMMUNITY FEED
Share blessings, testimonies, prayer needs and Scripture references with the whole community. Say Amen, comment and save the posts that encourage you.

PRAYER WALL
Post a prayer request for everyone, a group, your church or only you. Tap Praying to stand with others, follow updates, and celebrate answered prayers together.

THE BIBLE IN ENGLISH AND BURMESE
Read in English, Burmese or both side by side. Start each day with the Verse of the Day, follow reading plans, keep highlights and notes, and explore people, places and themes in Insights.

WORSHIP
Browse hymns and worship songs and open the lyrics to sing at home or project in church.

GROW TOGETHER
Ask questions and learn in the forum, join groups, find upcoming events, read devotionals, and discover churches in the directory. New to faith? Know Jesus explains the good news in six simple steps.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
Report or block anyone at any time, use Safe Mode, and choose who can message you. Our moderators review every report. You can delete your account and everything you shared from Settings.

Browse freely without an account. Sign in with Apple, Google or Facebook when you want to post, pray and comment.

Join your family in Christ today.

name: MyMoonSky: Astrology
description:
MyMoonSky makes astrology simple, personal and beautiful. Enter your birth date, time and place and see the sky you were born under, explained in plain words. No jargon, no experience needed.

YOUR BIRTH CHART, EXPLAINED
• Your Sun, Moon and Rising signs (your "Big Three") and what they say about you

• A beautiful chart wheel you can explore and share

YOUR DAY, WRITTEN FOR YOUR CHART
• "My Sky" dashboard: today's planets crossing your own chart
• Daily horoscope for your chart, not just your Sun sign
• Today's Moon phase and the Moon's sign
• Gentle reminders for your daily horoscope, plus heads-ups when a Full or New Moon, a retrograde or a lucky day touches your chart (you choose what and when)

LOVE AND PEOPLE
• Compatibility between two birth charts: where you click and where you clash

EXPLORE

name: MyTrainingPlatform
description:

Elle réunit en un seul endroit ce qu'un organisme de formation, un service RH ou un formateur indépendant utilise d'habitude dans plusieurs outils : visioconférence, diapositives, quiz, évaluations, certificats et budget.

Quatre espaces de travail
• Formations : parcours en plusieurs sessions avec attentes des participants, supports, quiz, évaluations, certificats et budget.
• Webinaires : présentation à un public en une séance, micros des participants bloqués au démarrage, questions écrites et mains levées.
• Réunions libres : réunion en visio avec ordre du jour, documents partagés et enregistrement.
• E-learning : cours à suivre à son rythme (modules, leçons vidéo, lectures, quiz), avec progression, évaluation finale et certificat.

Animer une session en direct
• Visioconférence intégrée, avec un moteur de secours si le service principal est indisponible.
• Diapositives synchronisées en pleine résolution chez chaque participant, avec annotations et pointeur du formateur.
• Quiz en direct, réactions, mains levées, questions votées et salles de sous-groupes.
• Modes de qualité automatique, économique ou audio seul pour les connexions faibles.

Après la session
• Replay avec sommaire (une entrée par diapositive) et transcription.
• Certificats PDF vérifiables par QR code, avec page publique de vérification.
• Budget de préparation, honoraires et frais de participation.

Pour toute l'équipe
• Quatre niveaux d'accès : super-administrateur, administrateur, formateur et participant.
• Questionnaires préalables, y compris par lien anonyme sans compte.
• Interface en français et en anglais, thème clair, sombre ou automatique.
• Identité personnalisable : nom et logo de votre organisme.

Un compte MyTrainingPlatform est nécessaire : votre organisme de formation vous invite, ou vous créez votre compte depuis l'application. Vous pouvez supprimer votre compte à tout moment depuis votre profil.

name: Nakhatra: Vedic Astrology
description:
Nakhatra is your comprehensive Vedic astrology companion, casting your Kundali (birth chart) to the arcsecond with the precision of the Swiss
    Ephemeris. Experience authentic Jyotish wisdom combined with an intelligent AI Astrologer that reads your true planetary positions and answers

name: Namipochi: Mood Wave
description:
Notice how you feel. Tap a number. That's it.

Namipochi is the simplest mood log we could make, built for people who have never managed to keep one going.

- TAP YOUR MOOD
Pick a number from 1 to 10. The middle, 5–6, means "like my usual self." Above that is wired and restless; below is low and sluggish. Higher is not better. You can notice when you're running too high just as easily as when you're low.

Tap as many times a day as you like. If your mood shifts between morning and night, that shift is kept too.

- TAP YOUR SLEEP
Only after your first tap of the day, Namipochi asks "Did you sleep last night?" with three choices. No bedtimes, no hours to enter. Close it if you'd rather not answer.

- SEE YOUR WAVE
View your entries over 7 or 30 days. A bar shows each day's lowest to highest, a line shows the daily average, and small bars below show your sleep. Days you didn't log stay blank.

- TAP FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the widget and log without opening the app, whenever you glance at your phone.

- PRINT A MONTH
Turn the last 30 days into a single printable page, with a key to what the numbers mean. Easy to bring to an appointment or show someone who supports you.

- REMINDERS, ONLY IF YOU WANT THEM
Turn on a daily reminder at a time you choose. It just says "How are you right now?" Reminders are off until you turn them on.

- WHAT'S NOT HERE
No cheerful messages. No streaks or badges. No characters.
Nothing that adds pressure on a hard day. If you skip a day, Namipochi says nothing.

- YOUR ENTRIES STAY ON YOUR iPHONE
No account needed. Everything is stored only on your device and never sent to a server.

- FREE
Every feature is free, with no ads.

Namipochi is a tool for keeping a record of your mood. It is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. If you have concerns about your health, please talk to a doctor or someone who supports you.

name: Natively Mahjong
description:
Natively Mahjong is a calm tile-matching game with big, clear tiles, made to be easy on the eyes and easy to play.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap a tile that has nothing on top of it and it moves into the tray. Three of the same tile in the tray clear away. The tray holds seven tiles, so choose with care. Clear every tile on the board to finish the level.

MADE TO BE EASY TO PLAY
• Big, clear tiles drawn for this game, with clean lines and strong colors
• Tiles you cannot pick yet look darker, so the free ones stand out
• No timer unless you want one
• Your game saves as you play, so you can stop at any time and pick up where you left off

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Undo, Set aside, Shuffle and Hint, with one free use of each on every level
• Set aside lifts three tiles out of the tray into a waiting row
• A hint rings a good tile to pick in red
• If the tray fills up, you can keep going, try the level again, or come back later

LEVELS, STARS AND WEEKLY BOARDS
Play the levels in order, each a little bigger than the last. Earn up to three stars on every level, and replay any level to earn more. Every Monday brings three new boards, easy, medium and hard, the same for every player.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Bolder tile lines, for tile pictures that are easier to see
• Small numbers in the tile corners, if you like them
• Soft sounds when you pick and match tiles, or none at all

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
On iPad the tiles are even larger, and you can play with the screen upright or sideways.

FREE, WITH ADS
The game is free to play. Ads show between levels and in a strip below the board, never on top of the tiles while you play. One purchase removes those ads for good. You get 10 lives every day. Extra items and lives come from watching a short ad, or as in-app purchases.

Plays without an internet connection.

name: NavGlass: GPS, HUD & Waypoints
description:
NavGlass is a GPS speedometer, HUD (head-up display), compass and altimeter in one clear dashboard, with waypoint navigation for the car, the boat, the plane and the trail. Big numbers you can read at a glance. No account, no ads, and the essentials work offline.

MADE FOR THE ROAD, THE WATER, THE AIR AND THE TRAIL
• Road: a digital speedometer for your car, motorcycle or RV, with a HUD for night drives
• Water: speed in knots for boating, sailing, kayaking and fishing, with ports and marinas worldwide
• Air: ground speed, altitude and the nearest airports from your seat
• Trail: coordinates, altitude and an arrow back to camp or the car for hiking and off-road trips

GPS SPEEDOMETER AND DASHBOARD
• Speedometer in mph, km/h, knots, m/s or ft/s, in ten gauge designs
• Altimeter: your altitude in feet or meters
• Compass heading, GPS course and direction, in 8 or 16 points
• GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude) in decimal degrees, degrees and minutes or DMS, ready to copy or share
• GPS accuracy, signal strength, local time, UTC, sunrise and sunset

HUD, DRIVE AND FLY VIEWS
• HUD: a head-up display that mirrors your speed onto the windshield at night, in five colors
• Drive view: a huge speed readout with the street you're on and the way to your destination
• Fly mode: ground speed, altitude and the bearing to the airport, picked automatically when you fly
• Red night look to protect your night vision, and Daylight for bright sun

WAYPOINTS AND NAVIGATION
• Save where you are with one tap: your parked car, a campsite, a fishing spot or a trailhead
• Add places by coordinates, Plus Code or map link, or share a place from your maps app straight to NavGlass
• Navigate to any waypoint: a compass arrow, distance, bearing, arrival time and trip progress
• Arrival alert with vibration and a chime, and an automatic stop when you get there
• Speed alert: set your own limit and feel a vibration when you pass it
• Weather where you are and at your destination
• Folders, favorites, nearest first, and GPX import and export
• Share a waypoint or your location, or open road directions in your maps app

AIRPORTS AND PORTS, OFFLINE
• Airport finder: more than 48,000 airports by city, country, name or code, with no internet
• Port finder: 13,800 ports, harbors and marinas, with depths, tides and fuel where known
• See the nearest ones first, navigate to any of them or save them as waypoints

MORE
• Trip meter: distance, moving time, top and average speed
• Speed adjustment to match your car's speedometer

NAVGLASS PRO
The speedometer, coordinates, altitude, compass heading and up to 3 waypoints are free. NavGlass Pro unlocks the rest: unlimited waypoints, Drive, Fly and HUD views, airports and ports, street names, weather, alerts, trip meter, Red night, gauge designs and GPX. Pro is a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription; monthly and yearly start with a 3-day free trial. Cancel any time in your Apple Account settings, at least 24 hours before renewal.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your waypoints stay on your phone. Location is used only to show your readings and, when you ask for them, to look up a street name or the weather.

SAFETY
Set up NavGlass before you move, or let a passenger use it. Directions are straight lines, not road routes. GPS and compass readings can be wrong; NavGlass is not certified for aviation, marine or vehicle navigation, so always use official instruments and charts.

Questions or ideas: support@toughclimber.com

Terms of Use: https://toughclimber.com/navglass/terms
Privacy Policy: https://toughclimber.com/navglass/privacy
Apple standard license agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
