name: Neo-S Assistant
description:
Your voice is one of the most powerful tools you have. Neo-S Assistant turns everyday practice into steady, visible progress, so you can speak with clarity, warmth and confidence wherever it matters most: in meetings, interviews, classrooms, video calls and every conversation in between.

Start with Techniques, a library of 27 guided lessons created to strengthen the skills great speakers rely on. Explore pacing, strategic pauses, breath and phrase coordination, intonation, articulation, vocal projection, storytelling and much more. Every technique explains what it is, what you gain, where it helps and how to practise it step by step. When you are ready, start a timed session and move through each exercise with a calm countdown that keeps you focused. A fresh Today's Focus is waiting for you every day, and your favourite techniques stay one tap away in Saved.

Step into the Reading Studio and rehearse with a teleprompter that paces every word for you. Choose from 35 carefully written texts across everyday speech, public speaking, storytelling, news bulletins, expressive reading, articulation drills and advanced reading. Set your tempo with a smooth slider or a quick preset, watch the highlight guide you through each line and tap any paragraph to jump right where you want to practise. When the session ends, you see your time, words read and average pace. Have a toast, a speech or a script of your own? Paste it in and rehearse it exactly the same way.

Plan with precision using two thoughtful calculators. Speaking Pace tells you the words per minute you need to finish on time, along with active speaking time, pause ratio and a clear visual scale. Structure Planner splits your talk into introduction, main sections and conclusion, then shows the time and word count for each part. Save any result to review later or send it to a coach, a colleague or a friend.

Build better habits with Speaking Tips. Compare 36 helpful habits with 36 common mistakes, each one explained in plain language with the reason it matters. Then put your knowledge to the test with a friendly quiz drawn from 40 questions on pacing, breath, articulation and vocal care. Pause whenever you like, resume later and watch your best score grow.

Grow a richer vocabulary, one word at a time. Discover a new Word of the Day, explore 45 expressive words with pronunciation, definitions, usage notes, synonyms and real examples, and bookmark the ones you love. You can even add your own words with a definition and an example sentence to build a personal dictionary that speaks your language.

Neo-S Assistant is designed to feel calm and rewarding. A refined dark interface, gentle animations and helpful hints guide you through every screen, so you always know what to try next. Everything you save stays private on your device. There is no account to create and nothing to set up. Just open the app, choose a session and start speaking.

Whether you are preparing for an important talk, polishing your interview answers or simply want to sound more confident every day, Neo-S Assistant gives you the structure, tools and encouragement to get there. Download it today and let your voice be heard.

name: Neon Horizon: Synthwave Racing
description:
A gap opens in traffic. Hold the steering pad to change lanes, lift your thumb to hold your line, and save your boost for a clear stretch of road. Neon Horizon puts a neon boulevard under your wheels.

Race through 25 worlds, from city lights to cosmic landscapes. Skim past traffic to build your score, take a ramp, or aim for a repair lane to keep your run alive.

Spin the four cars in the garage and compare their speed, acceleration, handling and durability. Spend the watts you earn on the road to upgrade your car, then head back out to beat your record.

Swap the pad and pedals for left-handed play. The music responds as the run unfolds.

name: Neon Viper: Overdrive
description:
Steer a glowing neon viper through cyber arenas, eat energy orbs, outsmart rival snakes and escape through the EXIT portal before the clock hits zero.

THREE GAME MODES
• Portal Run – hit the round score target, unlock the exit portal and extract in time.
• Survival – longer rounds, escalating maze waves and huge scores.
• Blitz 60s – fast sprints with extra rivals and a 1.5x credit multiplier.

SIMPLE TOUCH CONTROLS
• Drag anywhere to steer with a 360° floating joystick.
• Hold BOOST to speed up, release to recharge.
• Haptic feedback on every orb, power-up and takedown.

POWER-UPS
Magnet, Shield, Phase, Frenzy and Cryo Freeze orbs change every run.

CUSTOMISE YOUR VIPER
• 20 snake skins, 12 character heads and 20 arena themes.
• Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary items – Legendary skins are animated.
• Earn credits in every run, or top up with optional credit packs.

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily reward with a 7-day streak bonus.
• 3 new daily missions every day.
• Game Center leaderboard and 8 achievements.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Kids/Easy, Normal and Hardcore difficulty.
• Chill, Standard and Turbo speed.
• Wide, Balanced or Tight maze corridors.
• Works fully offline. Progress is saved to iCloud.

name: Nephelis
description:
A current slips between marble towers, with a sea of clouds below the broken bridges. Somewhere beyond the next relay, a silent sanctuary is waiting for power. Set the route, balance its Charge and send a packet of ether across a city suspended in the sky.

There are 25 network puzzles across five regions. Begin at the Shrouded Quay, climb the Laurel Steps and work your way through glass cisterns and wind courts toward the Open Meridian. Lysa, Theron and the mechanical bird Pip accompany the journey. The first three puzzles introduce the rules through guided lessons, then the networks ask you to combine what you have learned.

Every crossing spends one unit of Charge. Climbing spends more, according to the difference in height, so a short route can be surprisingly expensive. Draw extra Charge from reservoirs in the amount you choose. The receiving sanctuary accepts only its stated range. Reaching the destination with too much power can be just as unhelpful as arriving with too little. Read the levels, turn the dials and find a route that fits.

Energy is only part of the problem. Seals must be collected in the right order. Gates open at particular phases, and each crossing advances the phase. A shelter lets the packet wait without spending Charge. Sometimes a pause solves what another detour cannot. Follow the phase cycle and coordinate each arrival with the gate ahead.

Send a trial current before committing a restoration. Step through the resulting trace to see where Charge was spent, which phase reached a gate and which seal was collected. Undo a dial change or ask Pip for a hint without a penalty. The experiment panel compares a single proposed adjustment with your current setup, so you can inspect the consequence before applying it. Restored puzzles also let you examine other successful routes.

Move around the network, zoom in or fit the whole diagram on screen. A relay list offers another way to inspect the same route without relying on the chart alone. The Observatory brings your first successful restorations together, showing the balance between source Charge, reservoir draws, crossing costs, climbs and delivery. It keeps the arithmetic visible after the puzzle is finished.

Between sanctuaries, follow 15 replayable story scenes and uncover eight discoveries. The city has practical questions as well as old mysteries: how much to share, what to keep in reserve and which promise should guide its future. Complete the campaign and choose one of three endings. Replaying a restored sanctuary preserves its first recorded success and the ending you chose.

The Journal holds your own notes alongside discoveries, scenes and imported research. Give a note a title, edit it later or remove it when it is no longer useful. Search for an exact phrase, exclude a word or narrow the results to a title, text or source. Notes keep the language in which you write them.

Import supported research archives from Files and keep their original JSON copies. Repeated imports skip records already present. Export notes and readable research as JSON, or make a multipage PDF journal with route diagrams. Campaign progress stays on the device, and imported material remains separate from earned restorations and endings. File destinations are chosen through the system picker.

Play offline without an account, advertising or in-app purchases. Saved progress and an unfinished route let you return to the same dials later. Haptic feedback is optional, Quiet motion reduces chart movement, and the system Reduce Motion setting is respected. The interface, lessons and story are currently in English. Your own notes keep their original language.

name: Nereye Koydum?: Eşya Takip
description:
Esyalarini Nereye Koydugunu Asla Unutma!

Nereye Koydum?; evinizdeki, ofisinizdeki veya deponuzdaki onemli esyalarin yerini kolayca kaydetmenizi ve ihtiyaciniz oldugunda saniyeler icinde bulmanizi saglayan hizli ve sade bir kisisel envanter uygulamasidir.

name: NetPrep 200-301
description:
Prepare for the CCNA 200-301 exam in a few minutes at a time. NetPrep generates fresh questions on the topics that trip people up, explains every answer, and schedules reviews so what you learn sticks.

PRACTICE THAT NEVER RUNS OUT
Subnetting, routing, ACL and wildcard questions are generated with the answer calculated, so you get new variations every time instead of memorizing a fixed bank.

12 FOCUSED DRILLS
• Subnetting: network, broadcast, host ranges and masks, with an optional keypad mode
• Routing Lookup: longest prefix match and administrative distance
• ACL Evaluation and Wildcard Masks
• OSPF Elections: DR, BDR and router ID
• STP Elections: root bridge, root ports and designated ports
• Route Summarization and IPv6
• Spot the Misconfig: find the one broken line in a real config
• Command Recall and Rapid Fire facts
• Put in Order: DHCP, OSPF states, the OSI model and more

EXAM-STYLE PRACTICE EXAMS
Take 20, 50 or full 100-question timed exams weighted like the 200-301 domains, including "choose two" and drag-to-order questions. No feedback until the end and no going back, just like the real thing. Then review every miss.

LEARN, DON'T JUST GUESS
Every question comes with an explanation that shows the working. Questions you miss come back in minutes; ones you know come back days later. Flashcards add recall practice on the same schedule.

KNOW WHEN YOU'RE READY
Set your exam date for a countdown and a suggested daily goal. Track readiness by exam domain, accuracy over time and your weakest concepts, then drill them with one tap.

STUDY ANYWHERE
• Quick 5: five questions picked for you, perfect for a spare minute
• Audio mode: hands-free study with questions read aloud and spoken answers
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, including an exam countdown
• Start from Control Center, the Action Button or Siri

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
NetPrep works fully offline. There's no account, no ads and no tracking, and your progress never leaves your iPhone.

Supports Dark Mode, larger text sizes and Reduce Motion.

NetPrep is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Cisco Systems, Inc. CCNA is a registered trademark of Cisco Systems, Inc.

name: News Tiles
description:
News Tiles is a short, friendly quiz about real news. Each news day is a board of nine tiles, and new days arrive with app updates. Turn one over, read the headline, and pick one of four answers. The tile turns green if you are right and red if you are not, and then you see a sentence or two about the story and the name of the outlet that reported it.

A full board takes about three minutes. It is a pleasant way to see what happened in sports, business, science, the world and close to home, and to find out how much of the news you already caught.

What you get:
• Nine questions per news day, each with four clear answer choices
• A short note after every answer, with the news source named
• A calendar on the front page, so you can go back and play days you missed
• Your days played, current streak and best streak, kept on your phone
• A score you can share with family and friends, without spoilers
• Its own music and sounds, with a button to turn the music off
• Light and dark looks that follow your phone's setting

No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. Your scores stay on your phone. The games already in the app play without an internet connection.

Questions are written in our own words from published news reports. News Tiles is a game, not a news service: for the full story, read the outlet named under each answer.

News Tiles is made by Olivia Beauty LLC, the team behind Heads or Tiles.

name: Nexa To Do
description:
Nexa To Do is a to-do list that starts from your email.

Most of what you have to do arrives as mail: a request, a deadline, a meeting, a promise you made in a reply. Nexa To Do reads your new mail for you, finds what is asked of you and by when, and puts it where you will see it.

TO-DOS FROM YOUR EMAIL
- Clear requests are added to your list. Everything else is offered as a suggestion that you keep or dismiss with one tap.
- Each to-do shows who asked, the sentence that asked it and a short summary, so you do not have to open the mail again.
- An email that asks several things becomes one to-do with steps.
- When your own reply settles a request, the to-do is ticked off for you.

PROMISES
- What you told people you would do is kept on its own screen until it is done.
- You see when the other person has replied.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
- A reminder, a due date and a repeat on every to-do.
- Reminders you can answer from the notification: Done, In 1 hour, Tomorrow morning.
- A morning plan at the time you choose.
- Today shows what is planned and what is due.

MEETINGS INTO YOUR CALENDAR
- A to-do or a promise with a set day and time goes into your calendar with one tap.

LISTS YOUR WAY
- Lists, groups of lists, colours and backgrounds.
- Steps, notes, files and categories on a to-do.
- Important, Planned, Assigned to me, and search across everything.

WORK TOGETHER
- Invite someone with a link.
- Share a list with the people you choose and assign to-dos to each other.
- Your Today, your stars and your reminders stay your own.

ON YOUR IPHONE AND YOUR MAC
- The same lists on both.

YOUR MAIL STAYS YOURS
- Reading mail for to-dos is a switch that you turn on, and can turn off at any time.
- Before you turn it on, the app tells you which AI service does the reading. Your mail is not used to train AI models.
- You can delete your account, with everything in it, in Settings.

Sign in with Apple or with Google. To-dos from your email need the mail of a Google account, which you can connect at any time; lists, reminders and working together work without it. If you use Nexa Mail, sign in with the same Google account and your to-dos and promises are already there.

name: Next Up Scanner
description:
Next Up Scanner picks your next song from your own Serato library, fast, so you can keep your eyes on the floor.

Tell it what's playing and tap a mode:
1 KEEP IT GOING: songs that sound like what's on (the same scene, like yacht rock or 70s disco), in key and in BPM.
2 SWITCH IT UP: move the floor to a different genre without a train wreck. The AI knows each song's real genre, even when your tags are wrong.
3 DANCE FLOOR CPR: the proven floor fillers from your own play counts, when the floor is dying.

Every card shows the key (Camelot), the BPM change, how many times you've played it, and why it fits. NEW 4 shows 4 more, BACK goes back. Old live-drum songs that drift off the beat are marked. New imports get a shot.

REQUESTS: snap a photo of a request list (paper, napkin, text message). AI reads it, finds the songs you have, and the ones that mix with what's on come first.

Works with your Serato DJ library file ("database V2"): copy it from your Mac to iCloud Drive and pick it in the app. Read only, nothing in Serato changes. Works with no Wi-Fi after the first launch; only AI needs the internet. 25 free AI answers on each device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Try it right away with the built-in sample crate.

name: Nexto: Focus & Number
description:
Find the numbers in order on a spinning disc before the clock runs out.

Nexto starts simple: count from 1 to 10 on a slowly turning disc. Then the disc speeds up, changes direction, pulses, goes dark and hides its numbers. Every chapter adds one new idea, so it always feels fair and never the same.

• 80 levels in 8 chapters, each ending in a boss level
• Count up, count down, evens, odds, steps of 3, numbers and letters in turn
• Chaos events: direction flips, swaps, fake red numbers, a flashlight in the dark, memory rounds
• Daily challenge: one disc for everyone, one attempt a day
• Fair leaderboards: every score is replayed and checked on our server
• Combos, stars and perfect runs to chase
• Kids mode: big tiles, gentle timing, no ads and no leaderboards
• Play offline; one optional purchase removes ads

Short rounds, real focus. Ready? Find the next number.

name: NibbleBase
description:
Nibble Base is a fast, quiet converter for anyone who works with numbers in more than one base.

INSTANT MULTI-BASE READING
- Type in binary, octal, decimal or hexadecimal and all four forms update as you type.

- Tap any result to copy it.

BITWISE PANEL
- AND, OR, XOR, NOT, left shift and right shift.

- Every bitwise result is shown in all four bases.

KEEP WHAT YOU USE
- Save conversions as favorites, name them, and reuse with one tap.

BUILT TO STAY SMALL AND PRIVATE
- No account, no network, no ads, no tracking.

- Light and dark mode with four accent colours.

Useful for developers, students and anyone reading memory addresses, colour values or permission masks.

name: NightCam: Night Light Camera
description:
Take clear photos in the dark — without a harsh flash.

NightCam turns your iPhone's own lights into a soft, steady light you control. The rear flash stays on as a dimmable light, and for selfies the screen glows around the viewfinder in the color you choose. You see exactly how the shot will look before you take it.

REAR LIGHT

name: Nightwick
description:
Nightwick is a lantern walk on a foggy hill. Drag the pad, or drag the hill itself, and the glass melts the fog where you step. Seal the night when the veil along the path meets the contract, the beacons are joined by a clear ribbon, and the pockets you were asked for are in hand — before the wick goes out.

Each hill is a real ridge in three dimensions. Tilt the rail and the camera rises, so a crest can hide the next lamp until you climb or look over it. Wide glass sweeps and spends. Needle glass lasts and paints a tighter thread. Pulse glass breathes. Hold Beam to widen the pool. Tap Flare for a short burst. A still flame spends wick faster than a walking one.

Ten hills sit on the Valley Shelf, from Hearth Orchard up to Dawn Crown. A hill opens when the one below it has a seal. Wind pushes fog back onto the slopes that face it. Some nights refill their low bowls. Some wicks are cut short on purpose. Echo lamps help, and they do not walk the gap for you. If the flame dies, one taper can relight the glass where you stand. The veil you already lifted stays lifted.

Tonight's Contract is grown from the date on this phone and stands until midnight. Ramble grows a new hill whenever you ask. Grades are Ember, Glow, Flare, and Dawn — a thrifty seal, not a race. Curios, places, and badges stay in the cabinet, the index, and the rail on this device.

name: Nihongo Easy: Learn Japanese
description:
Nihongo Easy is a complete, step-by-step path to learn Japanese - from your very first hiragana to JLPT N3.

START WITH THE ALPHABET
- 12 lessons for hiragana and katakana, including voiced sounds and combined sounds

- Learn what furigana is, so you can read any word in the app

FOLLOW REAL JLPT LESSONS
- 100 themed lessons for N5, N4 and N3, in the right order

WRITE KANJI ON YOUR PHONE
- Trace with a guide or write from memory
- Every stroke is checked for order, direction and shape, with a score and hints

HEAR NATURAL JAPANESE
- Native-like AI voices for every word, kanji reading and example sentence

PRACTICE FOR THE EXAM
- JLPT mock tests for N5, N4 and N3 with real question types, a timer and JLPT-style scoring

REMEMBER FOR LONGER
- Picture flashcards with meaning, reading and example

- Smart suggestions for what to study next, plus a full learning history

name: Nina: Skate Hub&Meet Friends
description:

Follow someone whose style you like, leave a question about a trick, or reply to a comment that made you look at a shot differently.

DISCOVER

CLIPS

INBOX

Send a quick message when a friend finally lands that kickflip, catch up over a voice call on the way home, or hop on a video call to show them exactly where you place your front foot. Tap their portrait whenever you want to see what they've been working on lately.

YOUR PROFILE AND CREW

SESSIONS

FREE TO SKATE
Browsing posts, chatting, and logging practice are free. Optional Grip packs unlock profile prints and journal covers, or let you compare two runs one trick at a time.

Download Nina and find your skate crew.

name: NM Maintenance
description: NM Maintenance is the internal maintenance-operations app for NM Residential staff. A property's maintenance team signs in with the property's maintenance-line account and gets: the property's outstanding issues — open emergencies and escalations from the answering service — with the resident's name, unit, and what was reported; one-tap acknowledgment ("I'm on it") and completion, recorded against the team; masked calls to residents placed through the property's own line, so a resident always sees the property's number, never a personal cell number; resident lookup by name or unit, with call and text history and post-call notes; the property's call log and the current on-call schedule; text and email to residents from inside the app, logged on the resident's record. Access is restricted to authorized NM Residential employees. Accounts are created by the company — there is no public sign-up, and the app is not offered to consumers. Each account only sees the property (or properties) assigned to it.

name: No Nonsense Family Jigsaw
description:
No Nonsense Family Jigsaw is a simple, friendly jigsaw app for iPhone and iPad, made for the whole family, from little ones of three to grandparents. There are no ads, and it works completely offline: every picture is already in the app, ready for road trips, flights and cozy evenings at home.

CHRISTMAS IS HERE
The Christmas pack is full of festive scenes: Santa's workshop, elves wrapping presents, reindeer, snowmen, the North Pole, gingerbread villages and Christmas markets. There are nativity pictures too, with Mary, Jesus, the shepherds and the three kings. Then ring in the New Year with the Fireworks pack, and light the menorah with the Hanukkah pack.

A PICTURE FOR EVERY SEASON
18 picture packs follow the year: Spring, Food, Christmas, Winter, Sports, Birthdays, Valentine's, Easter, Summer, Autumn (fall), Halloween, Fireworks (Bonfire Night, Hogmanay and New Year), Lunar New Year, Diwali, Hanukkah, Ramadan & Eid, World Festivals and Special Days, from pancake races to parades.

Every picture is original artwork, in lots of styles: photos, picture-book cartoons, watercolor, claymation, toy bricks, felt, knitting, pixel art, oil painting, stained glass, papercraft, seek-and-find and kawaii.

A NEW PICTURE EVERY DAY
Picture of the Day brings a fresh puzzle every day, following the seasons and festivals.

FROM 16 TO 1000 PIECES
Seven sizes, from Starter to Master: 16, 32, 64, 120, 250, 500 and 1000 pieces. Little ones get big, easy pieces; jigsaw fans get a real challenge.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Real interlocking piece shapes, like a jigsaw from a box
• Pinch to zoom in on the tricky bits
• Edge filter, so you can do the edges first
• A hint when you're stuck
• Do a Piece places one for you, corners first
• Peek at the picture whenever you like
• Pick up where you left off

MADE FOR YOUR FAMILY
• Tell it who's puzzling and what you love, and it suggests a starting size, themes and styles
• Search every picture, even with a typo or two
• Keep your favorites together
• Turn your own photos into puzzles
• Create with AI: describe a picture and make it with Apple's Image Playground (Jigsaws Pro, on devices with Apple Intelligence)

FREE TO START
Download it free and play the Spring and Food packs, plus 2 free pictures in every other pack. Jigsaws Pro unlocks every pack and picture, as a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. With Family Sharing, up to five family members can enjoy Pro too.

No ads, no tracking and nothing to sign up for. Just jigsaws.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://addjam.com/privacy/

name: No Snooze Alarm: Feet First
description:
Can't wake up on time? Look at this.
Feet First is an alarm that keeps ringing until you're actually up.
Stopping it only buys you a minute. It rings again until you finish your morning routine.

You pick what the routine is:

• A reaction check. Tap the moment the light turns on. Groggy brains are slow, and it knows.
• A wake-up call (Pro). Morning calls you, asks what's going on today, and keeps talking until you sound awake.
• The shower (Pro). Your phone listens for running water. Once the shower's on, you're up.

While you're working through the routine, the alarm holds off. Put the phone down and go back to bed, and it comes back in a few minutes.

Pro also checks in 10 minutes after you finish. If you went back to bed, it rings every minute until you get up and do a quick reaction check.

It rings like a real alarm, on silent and on the lock screen. It's the same system the Clock app uses.

Your voice and the sound of your shower are processed on your phone. Nothing is recorded or uploaded, and there's no account.

Feet First Pro
Pro adds the check-in, the wake-up call and the shower check. It's $7.99 a month, or $49.99 a year with a free week to try it, or $89.99 once. Start the free week and Feet First sends you a reminder 2 days before it ends. A subscription keeps renewing until you cancel it, which you can do any time in your Apple account settings, at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

Questions or something broken? Email support@rowhousesoftware.com.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rowhousesoftware.com/privacy

name: NoBonk
description:
Your home crew knows where you are. Your support crew knows when to be there.

Track your ride with the NoBonk app and share one link with your home crew. They see your live position, your progress and the estimated arrival time at every stop, right in their browser. They don’t need to install anything.

name: NODE: Talent Network
description:
NODE is the talent and opportunity network built by ITP Prizren to connect students, mentors, and organizations in one place.

If you are a student, NODE helps you discover activities, challenges, workshops, and mentorship opportunities tailored to your interests. Build your profile, showcase your skills, submit your work, and get feedback from mentors and peers. Track your progress with XP, levels, and achievements as you grow.

If you are a mentor, NODE lets you guide students, review their submissions, and share your expertise. Confirmed mentors can evaluate applications and help shape the next generation of talent.

If you represent a business, NGO, university, or public institution, NODE helps you reach motivated students and young professionals. Post activities and challenges, review applications and submissions, and connect directly with the talent you need.

NODE also brings the community together through forum discussions, endorsements, and peer-to-peer connections, so members can support and learn from each other.

Join NODE and take the next step in your career journey.

name: NoForget: Where Did I Park?
description:
That moment of panic when you can't remember where you parked your car in a huge lot, or which street you left your bike on. NoForget is the simple, elegant solution to remember where you left anything important.

With just a single tap and a quick photo, you can save where you left your car, keys, bike, glasses, or any other item.

- Instantly save a location: Tap a category, take a photo on the spot, and NoForget saves the GPS point and the street address.
- Refined GPS location: The app refines the GPS for up to 30 seconds and shows the estimated accuracy in metres with a simple color code.
- Add helpful details: Note your parking space number, the floor in a garage, or add a custom title and note for any item.
- Get back to it: see the place on a map with the distance, then open directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps.
- Parking timer: get a reminder before your parking time runs out.
- Quick access: start remembering a place from the home-screen widget or with a Siri shortcut.
- Your history, organized: Easily search and filter your saved places by category or whether you've found them.
- Make it your own: Create custom categories for anything you might forget, with your choice of name, symbol, and color.

NoForget is free for up to 12 saved places. NoForget Premium, an auto-renewable subscription (monthly or yearly), adds unlimited places and the parking timer.

Your privacy is paramount. NoForget does not require you to create an account. All your saved places and photos stay securely on your iPhone. If you choose, you can use iCloud to sync them privately across your own devices, but no account is needed and your places are never shared.

Privacy Policy: https://mythadubiz.github.io/noforget-legal/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Nokomi Print
description:
Nokomi Print turns your iPhone or iPad into a focused, private printing tool.

Print PDFs, images, text files, Office documents, OpenDocument files, EPUB books, RTF and HTML, or open a web page and turn it into a print-ready PDF. Preview the result, choose paper size and orientation, page ranges, copies, N-up layout, margins and quality, then send it to an AirPrint or Wi-Fi (IPP) printer on your network.

KEY FEATURES
• Automatic printer discovery with Bonjour and IPP capability detection
• AirPrint support through the system print dialog
• Direct IPP printing with UNIRAST (URF) raster output
• A4, A5, A6, Letter, Legal, 4×6 and other paper sizes
• Portrait and landscape, fit-to-page, actual size and custom scale
• Page ranges, copies, N-up (1/2/4/6/9), margins, rotation and alignment
• Document preview that matches the print layout
• Recent documents and print job history stored on device
• Text editing for text-based documents
• Nokomi Studio: create a page with text and photos and export it as PDF
• Web-to-PDF with a built-in browser
• Network Doctor for Wi-Fi, local network, Bonjour and IPP checks
• English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish interfaces
• Dark Mode, Light Mode, iPhone and iPad layouts

PRIVACY
No account, ads, analytics or cloud uploads. Documents stay on your device and are sent only to the printer you select. Recent documents, printer settings and Studio drafts are stored locally and can be cleared in Settings.

iOS LIMITATIONS
iOS supports AirPrint and Wi-Fi (IPP) printers. USB-OTG and Bluetooth Classic printers are not available to third-party apps on iPhone and iPad. Office and OpenDocument previews are approximations; export to PDF for exact layout. Password-protected PDFs and some legacy Office formats are not rendered.

Support: https://honestsoftware.github.io/nokomi-print-site/support.html
Privacy: https://honestsoftware.github.io/nokomi-print-site/privacy-policy.html

name: Norwegian Test – Norskprøven
description:
Norwegian Test (norskprovetest.no) is the complete native iOS simulator for Norway's official Norskprøven (A1–B2), combining all 4 exam skills, interactive story games, and AI explanations in 11 languages.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO PASS:
• Reading Simulator (A1–B2): Adaptive placement routing and all 8 official task types including Click-on-Image, Calendar, Drag-and-Drop, and Multiple Choice.
• Listening Simulator with Studio Bokmål Audio: 200+ natural Norwegian audio tracks with B1 (2x) and strict B2 (1x) playback rules plus synced transcripts.
• Writing & Speaking AI Examiner in 11 Languages: Instant CEFR rubric grading and explanations in your native language (Norwegian, Simple Norwegian A2, English, Ukrainian, Polish, Arabic, Turkish, Russian, Spanish, Thai, and Somali).
• Interactive Story & Game Modes:
  – Dønna Troll Story (Nordland): Multi-voice Norwegian adventure with branching dialogue and offline support in 11 languages.
  – Adrenalinveien (Trollveggen): Fast-paced A0–B2 vocabulary and grammar climbing challenge.
• Themed Expansion Packs: Healthcare & Work Life (B1–B2) and Citizenship & Childcare (A2–B1).

ONE-TIME PASSES — ZERO AUTO-RENEWAL:
Choose 24-Hour Express Pass, 7-Day Exam Sprint, or 30-Day Full Prep with Pass Guarantee (free one-time extension to the next exam window upon sharing your HK-dir result — free access extension, not a monetary refund).

Independent practice tool. Not affiliated with HK-dir or UDI.

name: Nota Proxima Mobile
description:
See which notes fit the next chord before it arrives. Nota Proxima Mobile helps you practice guitar soloing over chord changes on iPhone and iPad.

Play a short phrase over a looping backing track. The fretboard highlights notes for the current chord and previews notes for the next chord in the same area of the neck. Choose a nearby note and hear how it brings out the new harmony.

Use your device’s microphone to see the notes you play light up on the fretboard. Slow down the loop to work on a tricky transition, then repeat it until the phrase flows naturally through the change.

Explore arpeggios and chord scales, with color cues that distinguish chord tones from tensions.

name: NousDeux Agenda Duo
description:
Nous Deux réunit vos deux emplois du temps dans un seul agenda, pour savoir d'un coup d'œil qui fait quoi et quand vous êtes libres ensemble.

UN AGENDA À DEUX
• Une couleur par personne, une autre pour vos moments à deux
• Vues Liste, Jour, Semaine et Mois, avec défilement fluide
• La vue Jour place vos deux journées côte à côte

COURS, TRAVAIL, EXAMENS
• Affichez le calendrier de votre école en vous y abonnant
• Ajoutez vos cours, vos heures de travail et vos examens
• Chaque type a sa couleur et son icône

PROPOSER UN MOMENT
• Proposez une sortie : votre partenaire accepte ou refuse d'un geste
• Recevez une notification quand une proposition arrive
• Retrouvez les créneaux où vous êtes libres tous les deux

AJOUT RAPIDE
• Un formulaire en quelques touches
• Un raccourci Siri qui pose les questions sans ouvrir l'app
• Des widgets pour l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé

ET AUSSI
• Une liste de tâches commune
• Le partage d'un événement à vos amis, qui l'ajoutent à leur calendrier

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT LES VÔTRES
Nous Deux enregistre tout dans vos calendriers, vos rappels et votre compte iCloud. Aucun compte à créer, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée.

name: NOW – Meet Your Friends
description:
Less planning. More living. The best time is NOW.

NOW is a social networking app that brings friends together in real life. See who's nearby, discover who's available and turn spontaneous moments into unforgettable experiences.

LIVE FRIENDS MAP
See where your friends are, share your location and discover opportunities to meet up.

SPONTANEOUS MEETUPS
Let your friends know when you're available. Whether it's a quick coffee, lunch, a walk or a night out, make plans without endless messaging.

STAY CONNECTED
Enjoy private and group chats, voice messages, voice calls and video calls, all in one place.

SHARE YOUR MOMENTS
Share photos and let your friends experience what's happening around you.

NOW FIND
Navigate to your friends and spend less time figuring out where to meet.

DISCOVER LOCAL PLACES
Explore nearby restaurants, cafés, entertainment venues and places to spend time together.

YOUR PRIVACY, YOUR CHOICE
Control who can see your location, manage your friendships and activate Ghost Mode whenever you want privacy.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
A modern, intuitive experience designed to connect friends across countries, languages and devices.

NOW is free to download and use.

Stop waiting for the perfect moment. Create it.

The best time is NOW.

Privacy Policy: https://nowapp.now/privacy
Terms of Service: https://nowapp.now/terms
Support: support@nowapp.now

name: NOW: Structured Workouts
description:
NOW turns a training session into a structured workout your watch can guide you through: warm-up, intervals, recoveries and cool-down, each with its own goal and target.

CREATE IT YOUR WAY
• Describe the session in your own words and NOW builds the steps.
• Attach a PDF or a photo of a plan from your coach and NOW reads it.
• Or build it by hand: add steps, repeat blocks, set time or distance, and choose a pace, heart rate, power or cadence target.

RUN, RIDE, SWIM, LIFT
Running, cycling, pool swimming and strength training, indoors or outdoors.

ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
Add a workout to your Apple Watch from your iPhone and start it in the Workout app. Your watch tells you what to do at every step.

A CALENDAR THAT REACHES YOUR WRIST
Place workouts on your calendar, once or every week. NOW can schedule the coming days on your Apple Watch so each session is waiting for you on its day.

TRAINING PLANS
Build a plan week by week, or start from an example, and add it to your calendar from the date you choose.

SHARE AND EXPLORE
Share a workout with a link. Publish it to Explore if you want others to find it, and save workouts and plans that other athletes and coaches have published.

GOOD TO KNOW
• NOW is free. Creating with AI has a daily allowance.
• You can browse, build a workout and send it to your watch without an account. Saving, AI and publishing need Sign in with Apple or Google.
• AI can be wrong. Review every workout before you train. NOW is not medical advice or coaching.
• NOW does not read your Health data.
• An Apple Watch paired with your iPhone is needed to follow a workout on the watch.

Privacy: https://trainwith.now/privacy.html
Terms: https://trainwith.now/terms.html

name: NSE Teachers
description:
NSE Teachers is the internal app for the teaching team at North Star English, an English language academy in Morata de Tajuña, Spain.

Accounts are created by the academy administrator, so the app is for North Star English staff only.

What you can do:
• Chat: send messages, photos and files to colleagues, in one-to-one chats and in groups, with delivery and read ticks, polls and scheduled messages.
• Groups: any teacher can create a group and choose its members. Group creators and the administrator can manage their groups.
• Academic calendar: see school holidays, closures and events for the year, kept up to date by the administrator, with notes on each day.
• Timetable: see your classes, or the whole team's, updated automatically when the timetable changes.
• Hours: record the classes you teach and see your weekly and monthly totals.
• Notifications: get notified about new messages, with an unread badge on the app icon. You can mute individual chats or everything.

Your privacy matters. You can block other users, report messages to the administrator, and delete your account from Settings at any time.

name: Number Drop - Merge Puzzle
description:
Tap a column and a numbered tile drops in. If it lands on the same number, the two merge into the next number up: two 1s make a 2, two 2s make a 3, and you can guess the rest.

The good part is what happens next. That new 3 drops onto whatever was underneath it. If that's a 3 as well, they merge too. Then the 4 lands on a 4. Every merge in a chain bumps your multiplier (x2, x3, x4, x5 and up), and one well-placed tile can turn a messy board into a very good score.

Number Drop is a number merge puzzle with real gravity. Tiles actually fall and land, so every drop has a bit of weight to it.

You can always see which tile is coming next, so it pays to plan. Stack a 2 on a 3 on a 4 and leave it alone. Then, when another 2 turns up, drop it on top and watch the whole column fold into a 5.

The game ends when a column stacks up past the line. Until then nothing is rushing you. There's no timer and there are no lives, and nothing tells you to come back in four hours.

ONE DAILY CHALLENGE, ONE GO
Every day there is a new Daily Challenge with its own set order of tiles, the same for everyone who plays it. You get one attempt. Play today, play again tomorrow, and before long your streak counter is a number you'd hate to lose. When you finish, share your result and see who can beat it.

CHAINS ARE THE WHOLE POINT
Each merge in a chain is worth more than the one before it. The game remembers your longest chain and shows it to you at game over, which is either a proud moment or a reason to go again.

EASY TO FIT INTO YOUR DAY
- Plays in portrait with one thumb
- Close the app mid-game and your board is waiting when you come back
- Works offline, so trains and planes are fine
- A short How to Play gets you going
- Your best score is always there to beat

NEW LOOKS TO EARN
Everyone starts with Classic tiles. Reach score milestones to unlock Dusk, Circuit and Prism. They only change how the tiles look. Same game, different outfit.

HOW THE ADS WORK
Number Drop is free to play and ads pay for it. Here is what to expect:
- A banner on the menu and game-over screens
- A full-screen ad between games now and then
- Never an ad in the middle of a game
- Two optional ones that you choose yourself: watch an ad to continue once per game, or to score double for the first 60 seconds

Rather skip them? Remove Ads is a one-time purchase that takes away the banner and the full-screen ads. The two optional ones stay, because they only ever play when you ask. Score Pack unlocks the three extra tile themes straight away if you don't feel like waiting.

Number Drop is made by Signal8 Games, a small indie studio in Australia. If something is broken, or you just want to tell us your longest chain, the support link on this page reaches us.

name: Numismatica
description: Numismatica is a catalogue for collectors and students of ancient Greek and Roman coinage. Record each specimen's type, mint, metal, weight, diameter and legends, link it to live Nomisma.org reference data, and compare two coins side by side. Built-in charts, field notes, offline caching and CSV / JSON export turn a private cabinet into a study aid.

name: nups — Boda y mesa de regalos
description:
nups es tu boda en el teléfono: tus invitados y sus confirmaciones, tu mesa de regalos de cualquier tienda, tus fondos y tus pendientes. Es la misma cuenta que usas en nups.mx, así que lo que cambias aquí ya está allá.

Ya saben quién viene
Tus invitados confirman desde tu invitación y tú lo ves aquí al momento: quién viene, con cuántas personas y qué te escribieron. Si alguien no ha respondido, recuérdaselo por WhatsApp desde su ficha.

Tu lista, por familia
Agrega a cada persona, pareja o familia con sus pases. Elige a tus invitados de los contactos de tu teléfono y júntalos en una sola invitación. Solo se guardan los que tú eliges.

Regalos de cualquier tienda
Busca en Liverpool, Amazon, Palacio de Hierro, Mercado Libre o la tienda que quieras, toca «Agregar a nups» y el regalo queda en tu mesa con su foto y su precio. También puedes compartir un producto desde el navegador de tu teléfono directo a nups.

Fondos en pesos
Luna de miel, nuevo hogar o una experiencia. Tus invitados aportan desde tu mesa de regalos en nups.mx y tú ves cada aportación con su mensaje. Recibes el 100% de tus fondos; quien aporta cubre la cuota de servicio.

Cada mañana, tu boda
Inicio te dice cuántos días faltan, cuántos han confirmado y lo que sigue. Un widget lleva la cuenta regresiva a tu pantalla de inicio, y el día de la boda la tienes en tu pantalla de bloqueo.

Pendientes
Una lista de tareas pensada para bodas en México, con una fecha para cada tarea.

Para los dos, y para quien los ayuda
Tu pareja y quien los ayude a organizar pueden entrar a la misma boda, cada quien con su cuenta.

¿Solo quieres ver cómo se siente? Abre la boda de ejemplo sin crear cuenta.

La app es gratis. Hecho en México, en español y en pesos.

name: NutriLedger
description:
NutriLedger is a calm, private food diary that keeps calorie tracking simple. Log what you eat, watch your daily allowance add up, and see your progress over weeks and months - all on your own device, with no account and no ads.

SEARCH REAL FOODS
Find branded products and everyday staples through the Open Food Facts database, or scan a barcode and log a product in seconds. Every food shows its source, so you always know where a number came from.

YOUR DIARY, YOUR WAY
Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks are laid out on one clear page, with your remaining allowance worked out for you: target, food, exercise, what's left. Move, copy and save meals, repeat yesterday, and jot notes as you go.

COOK AND LOG RECIPES
Build recipes from ingredients, weigh what the finished dish gives you, and log by serving or by cooked weight. A raw-to-cooked calculator keeps portions honest.

TRACK WHAT MATTERS
Log weight, body fat and waist to see lean mass, fat mass and trend lines. Nutrition analytics show your averages, adherence and daily calories over 7 to 90 days or a custom range.

STAY IN CONTROL
Set daily targets in grams or percentages, choose metric or imperial, and pick your food-search region. Your data never leaves your device unless you export it - as CSV for spreadsheets or a full JSON backup.

No sign-up, no subscription, no tracking. Download NutriLedger and start your first entry today.

name: NuvaDuo
description:
Convierte tu iPhone en un portátil con un escritorio de ventanas, teclado táctil y trackpad. En modo portátil, las ventanas y el Dock ocupan la parte superior y los controles quedan al alcance de tus dedos en la parte inferior. También puedes usar el escritorio a pantalla completa.

• Trabaja con tus archivos. Abre las carpetas que elijas, edita archivos de texto y consulta PDF e imágenes.
• Navega con pestañas. Guarda tus páginas favoritas y vuelve a los sitios que visitaste desde el historial.
• Ten a mano tus fotos, contactos, calendario y música. Puedes dar acceso a cada función cuando la necesites.
• Personaliza el escritorio. Elige entre seis apariencias desde el icono de pantalla junto al trackpad.

En iPhone Duo, puedes usar el escritorio y los controles con el dispositivo abierto como un portátil.

name: Nyvan
description:
Paste this block as plain text. The section headings are uppercase, not Markdown.

A quiet place for the pieces you keep and the firings that made them.

Nyvan is a local kiln book for the iPhone. Record each ceramic piece by studio, form, clay, glaze and surface, keep its state and size by hand, then log the firings that formed it. Over a year, the small facts become a firing log, a studio index and a yearbook.

THE STUDIO
Open to the last firing, the pieces you keep close and the days at the kiln. Log a firing in a few taps, or step back into the yearbook.

THE COLLECTION
Catalogue pieces across bowls, cups, vases, jars, plates and sculptures. Note the studio, clay body, glaze family, surface finish and dimensions. Track in-use, on-shelf, resting and archived pieces with a state that never changes behind your back.

THE FIRINGS
Keep the date, time, kiln, cone, atmosphere, load, hours and one honest line for every firing. Search the log by piece, studio, kiln or phrase, and filter by atmosphere or favourite.

THE STUDIOS
See the makers behind the shelf: city, founding year, studio style, pieces, firings and the glazes they tend to fire, grouped into quiet cards.

THE YEARBOOK
Read the shape of a year: firings and hours, pieces, studios, days and load, month bars, the most-fired pieces, the studios you fired with and the longest firing.

YOUR KILN BOOK STAYS YOURS
No account. No cloud sync. No permissions. No advertising. No analytics. No scores or streaks. The kiln book is one JSON file in the app's local Documents folder. Export a JSON backup or a CSV firing log whenever you choose, and restore a backup on the same device.

DELIBERATE LIMITS
Nyvan is a shelf, not a shop. There are no prices, affiliate links, appraisals or recommendations. It does not control a kiln, invent a firing schedule or turn your pieces into a rating.

Made for the piece you reach for, and the firing that made it.

name: Oathline: US Citizenship Test
description:
Oathline helps you prepare for the U.S. naturalization interview with the official 2025 civics questions.

STUDY SMARTER
• All 128 civics questions and every accepted answer from the 2025 USCIS list
• Flashcards with spaced repetition: missed cards come back soon, known cards later
• Readiness score and progress by topic
• 65/20 mode: study only the 20 starred questions if you qualify

PRACTICE LIKE THE REAL INTERVIEW
• Practice test that stops like the officer does: pass at 12 correct, or 6 of 10 in 65/20 mode
• Mock interview: an officer voice reads each question aloud and you answer out loud
• Reading test sentences and a writing test with word-by-word checking
• Official reading and writing vocabulary lists, read aloud
• Plain-English meanings of hard words from the Form N-400

MADE FOR YOU
• Your state: capital, plus your senators, representative and governor with links to the official lookup pages
• Interview countdown and a daily goal with streaks
• Light and dark mode, adjustable voice speed
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Oathline is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by USCIS or any government agency, and it does not provide legal advice. Questions come from the public USCIS “128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version)”.

name: Odak: Focus Planner
description:
Odak is a visual day planner made for minds that wander. Your day appears as colorful blocks on a timeline, so you finally see time instead of guessing it.

WRITE IT, AND YOUR DAY TAKES SHAPE
Type or say whatever is on your mind, in any order. Odak turns it into a day: order, durations and breaks fall into place. You can change everything afterwards.

SMALL STEPS, NO GUILT
Big tasks are split into small, doable steps. Missed tasks are not failures; Odak offers to move them to a free slot or to tomorrow.

FOCUS MODE
Start a task and see the time you have left at a glance. Sounds like brown noise, rain and ocean help you stay with it, and a short breathing exercise is always one tap away. With Live Activities the countdown stays on your Lock Screen.

LOW ENERGY DAYS
Tell Odak how your energy is. On hard days it lightens the plan: the tasks you pick move to tomorrow and the rest get shorter.

MORE TOOLS
- Inbox: empty your head in seconds by text or voice, then place things in your day.
- Routines: morning and evening routines that add themselves to your plan on the days you choose.
- Dopamine menu: small, pleasant things to pick without thinking when you don't feel like doing anything.
- Exam countdown and practice test scores.
- A gentle streak and a focus garden that grows with every task.
- Work together: focus at the same time as others, without showing your name or task.

name: Oddload Ridge Run
description:
A sofa, a suitcase and a chair all fit in the back of your pickup. Will they still be there after the first pothole? Oddload Ridge Run is a physics puzzle about packing a truck and getting every piece to the drop shed intact.

PACK THE TRUCK
Drag cargo into the bed and turn each piece to find a fit. Lay a tall fridge on its side, brace a beach ball between sturdier pieces or use the space under a table. Heavy cargo can shove lighter pieces aside, and a fragile TV can crack on a hard landing. Tether a piece with a strap, cushion it with a felt pad or slow it down with chocks.

DRIVE THE LOAD
Hold the pedal to drive and release it to coast. Ease over crests, time short bursts of throttle across bridge joints and watch for crosswinds and ice. The load shifts as the truck pitches and bounces, so how you drive matters as much as how you pack.

WORK YOUR WAY UP THE RIDGE
Haul 37 kinds of cargo across 100 campaign routes in 12 illustrated districts, from cedar passes and apple orchards to lantern-lit villages and snowy ridges. Replay deliveries to chase three stars and beat the personal bests saved on your iPhone.

TAKE THE DAILY DISPATCH
Pick up a fresh cargo order in Special Dispatch each day. Claim a daily stamp to earn a pass for an extra gear fitting on a delivery.

Play offline with no account, ads or in-app purchases.

name: Offer Ready: Interview Prep
description:
Prepare for business job interviews the way people learn a language: a few minutes a day, one short lesson at a time.

Pick the role you're interviewing for, and Offer Ready gives you a learning path built for it:

• Investment Banking: accounting, enterprise value, valuation, DCF, M&A, LBO
• Consulting: case interviews, market sizing, case math, profitability
• Sales & Trading: markets, options, mental math, pitching a trade
• Asset Management: valuation, portfolio basics, the stock pitch
• Wealth Management: investment products, financial planning, retirement accounts, client scenarios
• Sales Development (SDR): the sales process, cold calling, objection handling
• Business Development: partnerships, market analysis, business metrics, negotiation

Every track also includes behavioral questions, like "Tell me about yourself" and "Why this role?"

PRACTICE IN SHORT LESSONS
Each lesson takes about three minutes. Answer multiple-choice questions and see right away whether you were right, and why. Open-ended questions use flashcards: think through your answer, reveal a model answer, and grade yourself honestly.

LEARN, NOT JUST TEST
Every unit has a study guide: short chapters that explain the ideas behind the questions, with worked examples, interview tips and common mistakes. Read a chapter, then practice it.

REMEMBER WHAT YOU LEARN
Questions you miss go into your mistakes notebook and come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Get one right every time and it's mastered.

BUILD A DAILY HABIT
Keep your streak going, hit your daily goal, and answer the daily question to start every day with one quick rep.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone, and the app works offline.

All questions and study guides are written for Offer Ready: 620 practice questions and 124 study-guide chapters across 31 units.

name: Office Microwave Simulator
description:
It is a microwave.

You work in an office. The office has a microwave. You have lunch.

Pick something from the fridge, close the door, tap in a time, press Start. Then watch the turntable and hope.

• Heat things properly. Every item has a hidden outside and a hidden centre. Get both right for a Perfect and three stars. Get it wrong for Frozen Centre, Lava, Exploded or On Fire.
• Pop the popcorn by ear. Stop when the pops are about two seconds apart. Not later.
• Press Stop at 0:01. It is tracked. Facilities has noticed.
• The fork. You were told. The sparks are very good.
• Break room drama. Coworkers leave sticky notes about your fish, your soup and your behaviour. Collect five complaints and HR gets involved.
• Clean up after yourself. Scrub the inside with a sponge using your finger. Management is watching.
• A daily order. A coworker asks for something specific. Sometimes with a silly condition.
• 29 in-game achievements, including heating a phone, a sealed can, and nothing at all.

The fridge unlocks as you go. Fast-forward is on by default, because nobody has time for 6 minutes of soup.

One screen. No fail state. Made for iPhone, played in landscape. Plays offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.

name: OG Keyboard
description:
OG Keyboard is a private, classic-style keyboard for iPhone and iPad. It never tracks your keystrokes, and once it's installed it works completely offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Many keyboards ask for "Full Access," which lets a keyboard reach the internet. OG Keyboard never asks for it. Without Full Access, iOS keeps the keyboard sandboxed with no network connection, so what you type can't leave your device. That includes messages, card numbers, and payment details.
• No Full Access requested
• No network, no account, no sign-in
• No ads, analytics, or tracking
• Settings stay on your device
• App privacy: Data Not Collected

PAY ONCE
OG Keyboard is a one-time $1.99 purchase. No subscription and no in-app purchases.

BUILT FOR FAST TYPING
• A wide spacebar that's easy to hit
• Small 123 and globe keys, so the keys you use most get the room
• Swipe down on a key to type the number or symbol shown above it (swipe down on Q for 1)
• Long-press a letter for accents (é, ñ, ü and more)
• Undo, redo, and cursor arrow keys in the toolbar; hold the arrows to keep moving
• Tap shift for one capital, double-tap for caps lock
• Double-tap the spacebar for a period
• Auto-capitalization at the start of sentences
• Light and dark appearance
• Built-in emoji panel that works offline

ON IPAD
A full-size layout with tab, caps lock, two shift keys, number hints on every letter, and a dismiss key.

ON IPHONE
A compact layout with the same big spacebar and swipe-down hints. On foldable iPhones, OG Keyboard picks its layout from the screen width, so it uses the phone layout when folded and a wider layout when unfolded.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No dictation. Third-party keyboards can't use the microphone. Switch to Apple's keyboard when you want to dictate.
• No autocorrect or word suggestions. What you type is what you get.
• Password and other secure fields always use Apple's keyboard. iOS does this for every third-party keyboard.
• On iPhones with Face ID, iOS shows its own globe key below the keyboard, so OG Keyboard hides its globe and makes the spacebar even wider.
• Some apps choose to block third-party keyboards. In those apps iOS shows Apple's keyboard.

SET UP IN 30 SECONDS
1. Open Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards.
2. Tap Add New Keyboard and choose OG Keyboard.
3. In any app, tap the globe key to switch to OG Keyboard.
You don't need to turn on Full Access. OG Keyboard works without it.

OUR MISSION
We will never track your keystrokes. Your purchase supports our work building more apps that don't track you or sell your data to data brokers.

name: Olpera
description:
Olpera is a filling-line companion for shift leads, process staff, and quality. It keeps tank level, fill command, and lot precision on the phone — from recipe to bottle to shift card.
﻿
How to use it
1. Line — add tanks (capacity, level, density, min/max) and stations (nozzles, cycle, bound tank).
2. More → Recipes — set target ml, plus/minus tolerance, viscosity, drip, and foam factor. A lot always takes its target from the recipe.
3. Production → New lot — pick recipe and station, then log measured ml per nozzle. Each reading deducts litres from the bound tank and flags out-of-tolerance fills.
4. Overview — see today’s in-spec rate, lot Cpk, open alarms, time-to-empty, and the live fill command (target minus calibration offset, plus foam and temperature compensation).
5. Quality — mean, standard deviation, Cp/Cpk, nozzle drift. If Cpk is below the plant goal, run a three-reading calibration; the offset writes back to the station.
6. More → Alarms / Shift reports — acknowledge level, off-spec, foam, and calibration alerts. Close a lot to write a shift card you can share as text.
﻿
Olpera stores everything on device. No account, no cloud. It is a line-watch aid, not a certified meter or PLC.

A MATCH LOG BUILT FOR BETWEEN ROUNDS

FIVE TOURNAMENT TOOLS, FREE

REPORTS FROM EVERY MATCH

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE

• Export everything to one CSV file, and import it back

FREE TO TRY
All five tools are free. So are your first 25 games, with your lifetime record, event records, full history and CSV export. One purchase, once, lifts the cap and opens the full reports, filters, play notes, more than one game and more than one active deck. No subscription.

description:

KNOW WHEN IT'LL BE DONE

A GRAPH YOU CAN READ

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN

BUILT FOR RFX

NOTES AND HISTORY

name: Otter Forge
description:
Welcome to the riverside forge! You are an otter blacksmith with a warm hearth, a trusty anvil and a queue of friendly river folk who need horseshoes, ferry bells, lanterns, garden keys, kettles, trowels, little rakes and sparkling crystal charms. Nothing sharp, nothing scary: just cosy craft and satisfying timing.

THREE STATIONS, ONE PERFECT PIECE
Every order flows down the forge in three quick stations.
- HEAT: hold to pump the bellows and keep the temperature needle inside the glowing band until the bar fills. Too hot and the metal cracks, too cold and nothing happens.
- HAMMER: rings sweep in toward the anvil. Tap on the beat for Perfect, Good or Miss and watch the item's silhouette take shape.
- QUENCH & POLISH: swipe the swinging piece into the water right over the cool glow, then rub the quartz inlays until they sparkle.

SERVE THE RIVER FOLK
Ducks, frogs, beavers, herons, turtles, kingfishers, voles and newts wait at the window with patience bars. Quality stars and speed earn points, coins and happy customers. Special requests keep you on your toes: Two-Tone heats, Double Quartz polishing and Rush Orders.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- MARKET DAY: an endless rush that gets busier with every customer. Three unhappy customers close the stall.
- COMMISSIONS: 36 handcrafted levels across six chapters, from Riverbank to Moon Harbor, each with one to three star goals.
- DAILY CHALLENGE: the same seeded order list for everyone, resetting at 00:00 UTC, with its own leaderboard.

MAKE THE FORGE YOURS
Spend coins in the Locker on forge themes, anvils, hammers and otter outfits, preview them and equip your favourites. Golden Bellows widen the heat band for an order, Patience Tea calms the whole queue, and a continue can save a busy Market Day.

GOALS EVERY DAY
18 missions with coin rewards, a 7-day reward calendar, a first-run tutorial you play by doing, and a stats panel with your best scores, perfect beats and quartz polished.

RIVER BOARD AND CLOUD SAVE
Compare scores on All-time and Today leaderboards for every mode. Play as a guest straight away or create an optional email account to keep your forge safe across devices. You can delete your data or your account at any time in Settings.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY

ASK ABOUT YOUR BOAT

• Snap a receipt or a data plate and have it read for you. Nothing is added until you confirm it. AI features ask your permission first.

WORK DONE RIGHT
• Find captains, crew and service pros near you, ask for quotes, compare and hire.
• If a company manages your boat, approve work in a few taps and see every job in your boat's history.

FOR CLUBS, MARINAS AND MANAGERS

• Marina tenants: your slip contract, bills and launch requests.
• Yacht managers and marinas run their whole operation from the same app and the web.

Life is better outsea.

ALSO

ONE PRICE

GOOD TO KNOW
• Track facts come from Tasmania Parks and Wildlife Service pages, each with a link and the date it was last checked. This is an independent app, not made or endorsed by PWS. Check current conditions and alerts with PWS before you go.

Pageant AI Club is a payroll manager for small business owners, founders, HR teams and accountants. Keep your team, salaries, payslips and business expenses organised on your iPhone, without spreadsheets and without creating an account.

RUN PAYROLL

ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE

PAYSLIPS AND PAYMENT RECORDS

SALARY CALCULATOR

EXPENSES AND BUDGETS

REPORTS AND EXPORTS

AI PAYROLL ASSISTANT (OPTIONAL)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

MORE

Tax results are estimates based on rules you enter; no country's official tax tables are built in. AI responses can be wrong and are not tax, legal or accounting advice. Always verify before paying anyone.
