name: PairLedger
description:
Explore one-to-one stable matching from two complete sets of preferences. PairLedger makes every proposal, acceptance, rejection and replacement available for inspection, then checks the result for blocking pairs.

DEFINE BOTH SIDES
Create equally sized left and right groups with 2-20 abstract objects per side. Give every object a unique label on its side and a complete, strict ranking of all objects on the other side.

CHOOSE WHO PROPOSES
Run deferred acceptance with either side proposing. Inspect each final pair, both preference ranks and the proposal-by-proposal trace. Switching the proposing side may produce a different stable result from the same preferences.

CHECK THE RESULT
PairLedger independently examines unmatched combinations for blocking pairs. A complete one-to-one result is marked stable only when this check finds zero blocking pairs. Stable does not mean unique, fairest, or suitable for a particular real-world decision.

PRESERVE THE FULL RECORD
Freeze a result with its complete project, preferences and trace. Source edits or deletion leave existing reports unchanged. Generate pairs CSV, proposals CSV, complete JSON or a detailed text report, then preview or share the actual files.

MANAGE YOUR PROJECTS
Search, edit, duplicate and delete saved projects. Renaming objects preserves their identities. Changing the object count requires confirmation and resets the preference lists so an incomplete ranking cannot be silently reused.

LIMITS
Both sides must have the same size. Rankings must include every opposite-side object exactly once, with no ties or omissions. There is no many-to-one capacity model, unequal-group matching, personnel rating or automatic preference recommendation.

Projects, reports and generated files are stored locally in the app. Delete a record or use Clear local data in About. Copies already shared elsewhere remain under the recipient's control.

name: PairVerdict: Blind AI Review
description:
Run a blind review of two AI outputs using your own prompts and answers. Enter both source names and responses. PairVerdict hides their names and randomizes the reading order. Choose which response is stronger, record a tie or mark both as needing work.

Check accuracy, clarity and instruction following while reviewing. Reveal sources only after you save a verdict. Keep cases together and share the case results as CSV. Includes a practice suite. The app stores text locally and does not generate or send prompts to any AI service.

name: Palace Arrow Escape
description:
Palace Arrow Escape is a quiet logic puzzle set in a palace garden. Colorful worms rest on the sand. Each one can only slide straight out the way its eyes are looking. If the path is clear, it leaves. If another worm is in the way, it stays — and a blocked tap costs one of your three potions.

Clear every worm to open the next level. There are 24 levels in four wings: Gate Court, Flower Path, Maze Gallery, and Crown Garden. Early gardens are short and open. Later ones pack longer worms into tighter paths.

How a turn works
• Tap a worm to send it straight off the board.
• Hold your finger down to preview the path. Green dots mean it can leave. A red cross means it is blocked.
• The star wand highlights one worm that can leave right now.
• The ribbon shows the level. The counter shows how many worms have already left.
• Run out of potions and the garden returns to the start of that level.

The whole game is on your phone. There is no account, no network, and no purchase. Progress stays on the device.

name: Panfluter
description:
Jot a melody, then export the notes.

Play a tune on the on-screen piano or whistle one. Panfluter writes it on a staff as you go, plays it back as a pan flute, and exports sheet music, Markdown, or MIDI.

• Record on the keys or by whistling
• Watch a live staff as you play
• Edit notes, then replay them as a pan flute
• Export a one-page PDF, Markdown you can paste into a chat, or a MIDI file

No accounts, ads, analytics, or cloud. If you whistle, the audio is listened to on your iPhone and is never recorded or sent anywhere.

Requires iOS 17 or later. iPhone, landscape.

name: Panta: Notes & Reminders
description:
Write it. Let it go. It comes back.

Panta is a chat with yourself that brings your thoughts back at the right time. Type a note like you would text a friend: no titles, no folders. Panta remembers it for you and reminds you when it matters.

JUST TYPE, PANTA REMINDS YOU
• Write "Call mom tomorrow at 6 pm" and the reminder sets itself.
• Notes without a time come back in your daily evening round, spaced out so nothing gets lost: 1 day, 3 days, a week, two weeks, a month.
• Snoozed something three times? Panta asks if it is still important: keep it or let it go.

SWIPE TO DECIDE
• Review your notes as cards: Done, Tomorrow, Weekend or Later.
• Act right from the notification, without opening the app.

YOUR NOTES SORT THEMSELVES
• On-device AI sorts every note into Thought, To do, Idea, Link or To check out.
• Links open inside Panta with a preview.
• Add photos, camera shots, voice and any file (up to 50 MB each).

CAPTURE IN A SECOND
• Siri: "Add a note in Panta"
• Action Button, Control Center and Lock Screen controls
• Share any link, text, photo or file to Panta from other apps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sorting and summaries run on your iPhone.
• A password vault locked with Face ID.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

PANTA PRO
• iCloud sync
• Your own rhythm: a morning round, quiet weekends, your own pace
• Place reminders: "when I get home" reminds you at home
• Weekly recap: a private AI summary of your week, on device
• Home Screen widgets
• Apple Watch: send a thought from your wrist
• Markdown export for Notion, Obsidian and more

Pro is available as a monthly subscription, a yearly subscription with a 1-week free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://gestures.design/apps/panta/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gestures.design/apps/panta/privacy

Panta rhei. Everything flows and comes back.

name: Paperloom - PDF Tools
description:
Paperloom puts the PDF tools you reach for every week on your iPhone: scan paper, turn photos into a PDF, merge, split, reorder, compress and sign. Everything runs on your iPhone with Apple's PDF technology, so your documents are never uploaded to a server.

SCAN TO PDF
Point your camera at a receipt, contract or letter. Apple's document scanner finds the edges, straightens the page and cleans it up. Add as many pages as you need.

IMAGES TO PDF
Pick photos, put them in order and get one tidy PDF.

MERGE PDF
Combine several PDFs into one, in exactly the order you choose.

SPLIT & EXTRACT PAGES
Tap the pages you need, or type a range like 1-3, 5, and save them as a new PDF.

ORGANIZE PAGES
Reorder, rotate and delete pages, then save a clean copy.

COMPRESS PDF
Shrink big PDFs for email and upload forms. Choose Light, Balanced or Strong and see exactly how much smaller the file got.

SIGN PDF
Draw your signature with your finger, tap where it goes, resize it and save. Your signature isn't stored anywhere else.

SHARE ANYWHERE
Save to Files, AirDrop, or send by Mail, WhatsApp or any app with the share sheet. Recent files stay in the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Every tool runs on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
- No account and no analytics. Pro has no ads; free users can choose to watch an optional reward video.
- Your originals are never changed: every tool saves a new file.

PAPERLOOM PRO
The free version includes 3 tasks per day, and you can watch an optional reward video for 1 more task, up to 3 times a day. Paperloom Pro unlocks unlimited use of every tool:
- Weekly: $4.99/week with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
- Yearly: $29.99/year
Prices may vary by region. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://fauzanid.github.io/paperloom/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://fauzanid.github.io/paperloom/privacy.html

name: PAPSAC
description:
PAPSAC is the app for participants of the PAPSAC conference at Harvard. It is for invited participants only: sign in with your email address and your personal access code.

The app includes:
• Program – the sessions by day, with times, rooms and speakers
• Participants – who is attending, with photos and short biographies
• Readings – background readings for each session
• Logistics – venue, travel and contact details

After you have signed in once, everything except outside links is available without an internet connection. Updates to the program appear automatically.

If you are a participant and have not received an access code, contact the organizers at globalfood@hks.harvard.edu.

name: Paraph: Sign Documents
description:
Documents come in. You sign. They go out.

Paraph is the quickest way to sign a document someone sent you. No account, no upload, nothing to set up.

GET THE DOCUMENT IN
• Share a PDF or a photo to Paraph from Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Files or Safari. One tap and it is in your inbox.
• Scan paper with the camera.
• Open any PDF with Paraph.

SIGN IN SECONDS
• Paraph finds where the document asks for a signature, a date or a name, and highlights each spot.
• Draw your signature once with your finger, or type it. After that, signing takes one tap.
• Add initials, dates, your name, text and checkmarks anywhere. Drag to move, drag the corner to resize.
• Not your line to sign? Remove it with a tap.

NEVER SEND IT HALF-FILLED
• Every spot has to be filled or removed before a document can be finished, so nothing goes out with a blank left behind.

SEND IT BACK
• Email or message the signed copy without leaving the app.
• Share it to any other app, or save it to Files.
• The signed PDF is flattened: your signature becomes part of the page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Your documents and your signature are never uploaded.
• No account. No tracking. No ads.
• Works without a connection.

Paraph adds a simple electronic signature to your document. Whether that is enough for a particular document depends on the document and on the law that applies to it.

name: Park Coach
description:
Park Coach teaches you to park the way a driving instructor would, one move at a time.

Steer with a real wheel, shift between Drive and Reverse, and watch the coach line show where the car should go next. A parking sensor beeps as you get close, and a touch counts against your score, just like on a road test.

LESSONS
- Controls and first bay park
- Reverse into a bay
- Parallel parking: big gap, normal gap, left side and a tight space
- Backing into a garage
- Road test exam with no coach line

HOW YOU ARE SCORED
Every park is scored on touches, angle and how centred you are, so you always know what to fix.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
- No ads, ever.
- The first five lessons are free.
- One purchase unlocks the full course, with no subscription. Future lessons are included.
- Restore Purchases works on any device signed in to your Apple Account.

A daily streak keeps practice going until the real test.

Park Coach is a practice tool. It is not affiliated with any government licensing agency.

name: Park Kapmaca
description:
The mall garage is packed and everyone is after the same free spot!

In Park Kapmaca your job is simple: find an empty parking bay before time runs out and park your car neatly. But you are not alone. Other drivers are looking too, and they will try to take the bay you have your eye on.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drive with the gas, brake and steering controls; use the handbrake in tight corners.
• Watch for cars leaving: an alert tells you when a car pulls out of its bay.
• Get into the bay, straighten up and hold still until the ring fills.
• The faster and cleaner you park, the more stars you earn.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 40 levels across 8 different garages that get harder as you go
• Two floors: P1 is close to the entrance and worth more, P2 is quieter
• Drivers who search for bays, pull out and sometimes drive in a hurry
• 4 cars to choose from
• Chase and bird's-eye camera views
• Honk the horn — but honk too much and the other driver may lose their temper!
• English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French

PLAY IN PEACE
• No ads, no in-app purchases
• Works offline
• No account needed, no data collected

Can you find a spot?

name: ParkAble UK
description:
ParkAble UK helps Blue Badge holders, and anyone who needs accessible parking, find accessible bays and EV charging across the UK — with real data, never guesses.

MAP
- A live map of on-street disabled bays, car parks, EV charge points and accessible EV charging
- Search by postcode, street, town or a place such as a hospital, station or supermarket
- Filters for parking type, charges (free or paid), operator (council or private) and destination
- Every marker pairs a shape with a colour, so nothing relies on colour alone

REAL DATA, CLEARLY LABELLED
- Official council open data appears with a Verified badge, showing the council it came from
- OpenStreetMap places stay Unverified until a council's own record replaces them
- EV charging from Open Charge Map, with network, connectors and charging speed
- Where a detail isn't in the data, we say "Not recorded" — we never invent it
- Availability shows as unknown unless there is a live source; we never claim a space is free

DETAILS THAT MATTER
- Accessibility facts first, then bays, rules, charges and opening hours
- Blue Badge rules and charges explained in plain English
- Navigate in Apple Maps or Google Maps
- Save the places you use again and again

ACCESSIBILITY BUILT IN
- VoiceOver labels on every marker and control
- Dynamic Type up to the largest sizes
- High-contrast and reduced-motion support

DATA SOURCES AND LICENCES
- OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
- UK council open data (Open Government Licence v3.0)
- Open Charge Map
Every place keeps its source, so you always know where it came from.

PARKABLE AD-FREE
- The map and directions never show ads, for anyone
- Optional ParkAble Ad-free subscription removes ads everywhere: £1.99 a month or £19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your account settings

ParkAble UK is an independent service and is not affiliated with any council. Always follow the signs and markings at the bay.

Terms of Use: https://parkable-site.rork.app/terms

name: Parkery - Car Jam Puzzle
description:
The parking lot is jammed and the red car is stuck. Slide the cars, trucks and buses along their lanes to open a path, then drive the red car out through the gate.

Simple to learn, hard to master. Every vehicle only moves along its own lane, and every slide counts as one move. Finish in the fewest moves to earn three stars.

HUNDREDS OF LEVELS, EASY TO LEGEND
• 315 checked levels, from a two-move warm-up to Legend puzzles that need more than 40 moves
• Seven tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, Expert, Master and Legend
• Every level has a known best solution, shown as your target
• The game keeps going after level 315 with the Legend puzzles in new orders

CHALLENGES AND REWARDS
• A challenge every five levels with a move limit and double coins
• Daily gift on a seven-day streak
• Ten kinds of vehicle join the traffic as you progress: taxi, city bus, pickup, camper van, patrol car, tanker, sports car, ice-cream truck and more
• Pillars that never move appear in later levels

NEVER STUCK
• Free, unlimited undo and restart
• Hints that show the best next move
• A tow truck that lifts one vehicle off the lot

MADE TO PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works completely offline
• No ads, no accounts, no data collected
• English and Arabic
• Sound effects, music and haptics, each with its own switch

Clear the jam. Free the red car.

name: Parkible: Bible
description:
A quiet Bible reader — no ads, no account.

• The King James Version and the Korean Revised Version are built in and work offline.
• Compare two translations side by side, or verse by verse on narrow screens.
• Tap verses to copy, bookmark, or share them as a verse image card.
• Two card styles: Vanilla paper and Chocolate night.
• Search, or type a reference like "John 3:16" to jump straight there.
• Text size, line spacing, one verse per line, and Light, Sepia and Dark themes.
• Import Bible files you already have (SWORD .zip, .txt, .xml).
• For iPhone, iPad and Mac.
• No data collected. Everything stays on your device.

name: Parlo Moon
description:
Parlo Moon shows you tonight's moon, when it rises and sets where you are, and a calendar of every phase. Everything is calculated on your iPhone, so it works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking.

SEE THE MOON
• A real photo of the Moon, turned to match your sky, with the current phase, percent lit and distance
• Moonrise and moonset for your exact location, with a horizon setting for hills, trees and buildings
• A compass showing where to look when it rises and sets

PLAN YOUR SHOT
• Golden hour notes when the Moon rises near sunset or sets near sunrise
• Supermoons, perigee and apogee, micromoons and king tide potential
• A week of cloud cover forecasts for the United States
• Print or save a one-page calendar for any month

STAY UP TO DATE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that follow your location
• Optional moonrise and moonset reminders
• Phases, eclipses and moon events in a calendar view
• Phases and perigee/apogee run through 2050

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location stays on your phone. There are no accounts, ads or analytics.

Cloud cover forecasts come from the National Weather Service and are available in the United States only. Parlo Moon is an independent app and is not affiliated with Apple or the National Weather Service.

name: Parlorbox: Cosy Classics
description:
Pull up a chair in the Parlorbox – a cosy collection of timeless games, beautifully made for iPad.

THREE CLASSICS IN ONE BOX

• Mahjongg Solitaire – Clear the classic 144-tile turtle by matching free pairs. Every deal is guaranteed to be solvable, so a win is always possible. Choose from three tile sets: Parlour (clear, friendly pictures), Four Seasons (spring, summer, autumn and winter on softly tinted tiles) or Traditional Chinese tiles.

• Solitaire – Classic Klondike. Drag cards or simply tap to move them, build each suit from Ace to King, and let Auto-Complete finish the job once every card is turned.

• Noughts & Crosses – Play against Parlorbox on Easy, Medium or Hard. On Hard it never loses – can you hold it to a draw?

MADE TO BE EASY ON THE EYES

• Zoom slider in every game for bigger tiles and cards
• Pictures on Mahjongg tiles chosen so no two look alike
• Large, comfortable buttons and clear, high-contrast cards
• Respects Reduce Motion

HINTS WHEN YOU'RE STUCK

Tap Hint for a helpful move. In Mahjongg it finds the closest matching pair; in Solitaire it shows exactly which cards to move and where; in Noughts & Crosses it suggests the best square.

PLAY AS YOURSELF

Create a player for everyone in the house, with a picture from iCloud Drive or your files. Parlorbox keeps each player's best times and wins, and the Leaderboard shows who's fastest.

A LITTLE CELEBRATION

Glossy 3D tiles, glowing neon touches and a shower of confetti every time you win.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPad.

**Support URL** (required): a page on your site, e.g. `https://christopherwatts.tech/parlorbox` *(any page with a way to contact you)*

**Marketing URL** (optional): same page is fine.

**What's New**: not needed for version 1.0.

name: PartSnap Mechanics
description:
Snap a photo of a mechanical part and find out what it is, in seconds.

PartSnap Mechanics helps DIY mechanics, farmers, riders and technicians identify parts for ATVs, cars, motorcycles, heavy machinery, tractors and equipment. Take a photo or pick one from your library, choose the category and your vehicle, and get a clear answer.

HONEST IDENTIFICATION
Every result is labeled Confirmed, Probable or Uncertain, with visible wear or damage notes. Likely part references and names are shown when the photo allows it, never invented.

SEARCH AND LEARN
Search for the part by name or reference, browse a sample parts catalog, and follow step-by-step guides in the Learn section to replace it yourself.

AI MECHANIC
Ask questions about symptoms, maintenance or a repair and get clear answers adapted to your vehicle.

YOUR GARAGE
Save your vehicles, scans, favorites, measurements, parts lists and repair history in one place, synced to your account.

PLANS
Free: 5 identifications per day.
Premium: up to 100 identifications per day, multi-part scanning and compatibility checks. Available monthly or yearly as an auto-renewable subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple account settings.

Results are generated automatically and can be inaccurate: always confirm a part with the manufacturer or a professional before buying or repairing.

Terms of Use: https://partsnap-saa9gr8.rork.app/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://partsnap-saa9gr8.rork.app/en/privacy

name: Party Host 51
description:
Party Host 51 turns one iPhone or iPad into the host of a party game. Friends in the room join from the browser on their own phones, on the same Wi-Fi. They don't install an app or create an account.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Start a party. The host screen shows a QR code, a link, and a 4-letter room code.
- Three to eight players scan the code, type a name, and they're in.
- Each round, two players get the same prompt and write a short answer on their phones.
- Everyone else votes for the answer they like best. Each vote is worth 100 points.
- Three rounds, a scoreboard after each one, and a winner at the end.

The host screen shows the prompt, the timer, each pair of answers, the vote, and the scores, so the whole room can watch together.

WRITTEN FOR THE ROOM
More than 160 original prompts, written for this game. Names and answers are checked for strong profanity and slurs, and the host can hide an answer or remove a player.

YOUR PARTY STAYS IN THE ROOM
Party traffic stays on your Wi-Fi. Names and answers are kept on the host device only for the party and are cleared when it ends. Nothing is uploaded. If Apple Intelligence is available, short host lines can be written on the device. Otherwise the app uses its own host lines.

Paid up front. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no accounts.

For iPhone and iPad.

name: Paslago: File Sharing
description:
Paslago sends files and text straight to devices near you. Your files are not uploaded to a server and you do not need an account.

Works between iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows PCs and other phones. Paslago must be installed on the other device too.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Send photos, videos, documents and any other file
• Send the same files to several devices at once
• Send text and links, and copy them on the other device with one tap
• Drag and drop files into the window on a computer
• Accept from trusted devices without being asked
• Connect with a QR code when there is no router
• Connect by IP address if a device is not listed
• Light and dark appearance, six languages

SECURITY
Every transfer is encrypted. Both screens show the same six-digit code, and nothing is saved until you accept. Trusted devices are recognised by their own signature, not by their name.

HOW TO USE IT
1. Join both devices to the same Wi-Fi and open Paslago on each.
2. Pick the device from the list and add files or type text.
3. Press Send. The other person compares the code and accepts.

GOOD TO KNOW
To get a new request, Paslago must be open on screen on iPhone and iPad. A transfer that has started can continue in the background on iOS 26 and later.

No ads, no tracking, no account.

name: PassageLoop: Music Practice
description:
Practice the exact part that trips you up. Import a local audio file or open the included example, then choose the start and end of a passage on the waveform.

• Loop a passage and slow it to 40% or speed it up to 125% while preserving pitch.
• Save several named passages per track.
• Mark clean repeats to increase the tempo in five-point steps.
• Record your playing, listen back, and share individual takes.

Use your own local audio files up to 30 minutes. Imported tracks and practice recordings stay on your device. There is no account or subscription.

name: Patriot Bolt Toolbox
description:
Patriot Bolt Toolbox puts the engineering reference tables and calculators from patriotbolt.com in one app for iPhone and iPad. Everything is built into the app and works offline on the job site.

Reference tables
• Bolt and screw dimensions: hex bolts, heavy hex bolts, hex cap screws, flange screws, 12-point flange screws, tap bolts and socket head screws
• Nut dimensions: hex, heavy hex, jam, thick, slotted, castle, flange, coupling and square nuts
• Washer dimensions: plain, ASTM F436, fender, helical spring lock and DIN disc spring washers
• Stud bolt dimensions and tolerances, thread data and nut and wrench sizes
• Gasket dimensions: spiral wound per ASME B16.20 and international standards, Kammprofile, ring type joint and non-metallic ring and full face gaskets
• Flange bolting charts, ASME PCC-1-2026 assembly guidance, fastener materials, pipe dimensions and thread lubricants
• A Find box on large tables to jump to a size

Tools
• Fastener drawing generator: scaled drawings of bolts, studs, nuts and washers with a 3D model and PDF, STL and OBJ export
• Thread designer and spiral wound, RTJ, Kammprofile, soft and heat exchanger gasket drawings
• Bolting list builder: stud size, length and count for ASME B16.5, B16.47 and API 6A flanges, with a quote request PDF
• Stud bolt length, stud bolt and nut weight, gasket stress by flange size and the flange and bolting workbench
• Torque calculator: gasket stress, bolt stress and the ASME PCC-1-2026 Appendix O joint check, with stress gauges, workable ranges and tightening passes
• Tightening sequence, tightening pass table, turn-of-nut, bolt elongation, tensioner pump pressure and VDI 2230 bolted joint tools
• Flange gap log and flange joint tag
• Materials matrix, metallurgy selector, material cross-reference, hardness conversion and a unit converter

Easy to navigate
• Search across every tool and table
• Tools grouped by task, plus a step-by-step flange joint workflow
• Favorites, recently opened pages and saved torque calculations
• Print, share or email drawings and results, or send a request for quote to Patriot Bolt from your own Mail app

Results are for reference and planning. Verify against the current edition of the standards and your site's bolted-joint procedures.

name: PausePlay
description:
PausePlay הופך שיעור תכנות חי לשיעור שכל תלמיד מתקדם בו בקצב שלו.

המורה כותב קוד בזמן אמת, והתלמידים רואים כל שורה מיד על המסך. רוצים לנסות משהו? עוצרים, משנים את הקוד בעותק משלכם, מריצים ורואים מה קורה. כשמוכנים, לוחצים "חזרה לשידור" וממשיכים יחד עם הכיתה.

לתלמידים
• מצטרפים עם קוד חדר או סריקת QR, בלי הרשמה
• עוצרים את השידור בכל רגע ומנסים בעצמכם
• מריצים Python, JavaScript, SQL ו-C ישירות באפליקציה
• לוחצים "נתקעתי" כשצריך עזרה
• פנקס הערות, ציור על שקפים ושמירה ל-PDF

למורים
• פותחים שיעור בעשר שניות ומשתפים את הקוד
• רואים מי עצר, מי מתקדם ומי נתקע
• מציגים שקפים (PDF או PowerPoint) שהתלמידים יכולים לעצור ולדפדף בהם
• קבוצות עבודה, הקלטת שיעור ומבחנים בכיתה

PausePlay עובד בעברית ובאנגלית, בטלפון, בטאבלט ובמחשב.

name: Paverly: Paver Calculator
description:
Quote hardscape jobs faster. Paverly measures the area, works out every material, and turns it into a professional quote you can send from the driveway.

MEASURE FROM SATELLITE
• Search the customer's address and tap the corners of the patio on the satellite map
• Get square feet and perimeter instantly, then fine-tune by hand
• Or enter rectangles, circles and L-shapes manually

EVERY MATERIAL, ROUNDED UP FOR ORDERING
• Pavers by size, pavers per sq ft, or modular kits by sq ft per pallet
• Border / soldier course as a separate line
• Gravel base and bedding sand in cubic yards and tons
• Polymeric sand bags, edge restraint and geotextile fabric
• Excavation depth and haul-away volume with soil swell
• Retaining walls: blocks (including buried courses), caps, base and drainage stone
• Concrete footings and pads in cubic yards and 60 lb / 80 lb bags
• Free gravel, sand, soil and mulch calculators

PATTERN & WASTE GUIDE
• Running bond, stack bond, basket weave, herringbone 90° and 45°
• Waste % adjusts with the pattern, and you can edit it

LAYER DIAGRAM
• A clean cross-section of pavers, bedding sand and gravel base that updates as you type
• Attach it to your quote to show the client how the job is built

BRANDED QUOTES IN MINUTES
• Your logo, business details and licence number
• Materials, labour, delivery and haul-away fees, discount, tax and deposit
• Markup is built into your unit prices and never shown to the client
• Tax on materials only, or on materials and labour
• Share the PDF by Messages, Mail, AirDrop or print — US Letter or A4

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
• Works offline (satellite measuring needs a connection)
• Save jobs with customer details, notes and site photos
• Big buttons and high-contrast screens for bright sunlight
• Imperial and metric units
• No account, no ads, no tracking — your data stays on your iPhone
• Export a backup file of all your jobs anytime

PAVERLY PRO
All calculators are free to use. Paverly Pro unlocks clean branded PDF quotes with your logo, markup and unlimited saved jobs.
• Yearly (with free trial), Monthly, or Lifetime one-time purchase

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Estimates only. Verify site conditions, local codes and supplier quantities before ordering materials.

Terms of Use: https://qaswaapps.com/paverly/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://qaswaapps.com/paverly/privacy/

name: Pavilion Putt
description:
Play a modern indoor mini-golf course in 3D.

Pavilion Putt turns a calm indoor pavilion into a five-hole putting course. Drag to aim, set the power, and read the break as the ball rolls across the green. Each hole has its own layout, par, and celebration.

• Five indoor holes with par scoring
• 3D physics and a top-down camera
• Drag-to-aim and power control
• Stroke counter and hole progression
• Chinese and English UI

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Pawstop
description:
Better stops. Happier dogs.

Pawstop helps you plan breaks for your dog along the road trip you’re already taking. Enter your start and destination, tell Pawstop how often you’d like to stop, and set how far you’re willing to detour.

See suggested stops near each planned break, how much driving they add, and why Pawstop picked them. Pawstop flags details it couldn’t verify, like dog access, so you know what to check before you go.

Use your current location or enter an address. Check your starting point on the map, then open directions with your selected stop in Google Maps.

name: PawVault: Pet Health & Vet Log
description:
PawVault is a dedicated offline health binder for your dogs and cats so critical medical details are always at your fingertips.

Whether at an emergency vet clinic, groomer, or boarding facility, pull up vaccination dates, microchip numbers, and allergies in one tap.

KEY FEATURES
• Complete Pet Medical Profile: Microchip ID, breed, blood type, allergies, and vet contact card.
• Vaccine & Deworming Reminders: Timely local alerts for rabies, boosters, flea/tick, and checkups.
• Weight Curve & Visit History: Spot subtle health changes early and store clinic notes offline.
• One-Tap Vet PDF Summary: Export a crisp medical summary sheet to share with vets or sitters.
• 100% Offline & Buyout Pro: No subscriptions — unlock unlimited pets and full backups with one purchase.

name: PDF Booklet & Zine Maker
description:
Turn a PDF into sheets you print on both sides and fold into a small booklet.

Choose a PDF in Files, pick US Letter or A4, and PDF Pocket Booklet arranges its pages onto landscape sheets in the right order for a left-bound, folded booklet. Print double-sided, fold the stack in half, and the pages read in order from the cover to the back.

HOW IT WORKS
- Choose a PDF of 1 to 80 pages from Files.
- See the page count, the booklet page count and how many sheets of paper you need. When the page count isn't a multiple of four, blank pages are added at the end; nothing is duplicated.
- Choose US Letter or A4, printed landscape. Each page is scaled to fit half a sheet without stretching, with even outer margins and a small gap at the fold.
- Preview the front and back of every sheet, drawn from the exact PDF you'll save. Sheet and page labels appear on screen only, never on the paper.
- Save to Files or share the booklet PDF, then print it from any app that prints.

PRINT HELP
Booklet sheets are usually printed double-sided with "flip on short edge", but printers word this differently. The app includes a numbered test sheet: print it first, fold it, and check that the pages read 1 to 4 with every arrow pointing up.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Left-bound booklets only in this version.
- Pages are placed as vector PDF content, so text and line art stay sharp.
- Password-protected, restricted and dynamic (XFA) form PDFs aren't supported. Form fields, comments and links print as they look and stop being interactive.
- The app saves a PDF and doesn't print directly. Double-sided support depends on your printer.
- Arranging pages isn't redaction: content hidden by a PDF crop can remain in the file.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics. Your original PDF is never changed, and working copies are temporary.

A one-time paid download with everything included: no subscription and no in-app purchases.

name: Peacock Dictionary
description:
Peacock Dictionary is a plain, fast English dictionary that works without an internet connection.

Type a word, or press Paste to look up whatever you last copied. You get every definition, grouped by part of speech, and you can hear the word spoken aloud.

Every word you look up is saved to your own dictionary. The Flash Cards tab then quizzes you on those words in random order: the card shows a word and says it, and you turn it over to check the definition.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• About 1.4 million English words and phrases, stored on your device
• Definitions for every sense of a word
• Spoken pronunciation, plus the phonetic (IPA) spelling for many common words
• Suggestions as you type
• One-press Paste to look up a copied word
• A personal dictionary of the words you have looked up, A to Z
• Flash cards made from your own words

NO FUSS
• Works offline
• No ads
• No account
• No data collected

Definitions are from Wiktionary, by Wiktionary contributors, used under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence.

name: Pebble
description:
Release a little pebble from its orbit and relay it ever higher into the cosmos. Pebble Comet Relay is a calm, glowing one-tap space game about timing, aim and the perfect slingshot.

ONE TAP, PURE ORBITAL TIMING
Your pebble rides a planet's glowing gravity ring. Tap anywhere and it flies off along its tangent. Get caught by the next ring above and you hop up. Miss, and it drifts into the dark.

CHAIN PERFECT RELAYS
Aim straight at the next planet's centre for a RELAY! bonus. Chain them for a growing combo while soft pentatonic chimes climb with every perfect catch.

A LIVING GALAXY
Gas giants with wide, lazy rings. Tiny moons that spin fast. Planets that slide side to side and violet rings that pulse in size. Asteroids drift through the gaps, and black holes bend your flight path with real gravity. Catch streaking comets for bonus points and coins.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Deep Relay: endless climb, chase your best height.
- Constellations: 36 hand-tuned levels across six chapters, each with three stars to earn, from catching comets to finishing without a save.
- Daily Challenge: one seeded galaxy, the same for every pilot, with its own daily leaderboard.

MISSIONS, REWARDS AND STATS
18 missions with coin rewards, a 7-day reward calendar, detailed stats and global leaderboards for Deep Relay, the Daily Challenge and total stars.

YOUR LOCKER
Collect 12 pebbles such as Moonstone, Lava Pebble, Geode, Ice Comet and Starcore, plus 7 glowing trail effects. Arm boosts before a run: Tractor Beam saves one miss, Comet Magnet pulls comets in, Slow-Mo eases the first 10 seconds.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play instantly as a guest, or create an optional free account to keep your progress in the cloud and on every device. Add a pilot avatar, record a victory cheer, and save score cards to Photos.

FAIR AND QUIET
No ads. Everything can be earned by playing. Optional coin packs are available in the Shop if you want to unlock things faster.

Built for portrait play on every iPhone, with soft synthesized space music, haptics and a gentle, airy glass interface.

name: Pedra Funda: Os Esquecidos
description:
O rádio da Lia chamou da velha casa dos Arantes. Desde então, Pedra Funda não é mais a mesma.

Pedra Funda: Os Esquecidos é um jogo de terror em primeira pessoa. Você tem uma lanterna com pouca bateria, esconderijos espalhados e o som como melhor aliado. Cada lugar da cidade guarda um esquecido diferente — e cada um caça de um jeito.

• 100 fases em 10 capítulos: a casa, a escola, o hospital, a mata, as galerias, a tecelagem, o hotel, a mina, a igreja e o cemitério
• 10 criaturas com comportamentos próprios: umas ouvem, outras veem só no claro, outras sentem você na água
• Lanterna com bateria, armários com fresta para espiar, sinalizadores que espantam o monstro
• Som 3D: ouça as pisadas e descubra para onde ele foi
• Enigmas, bilhetes e uma história para descobrir
• Controles de toque e três níveis de gráfico

Use fones de ouvido. O som é metade do medo.

Aviso: contém sustos repentinos, sons altos e luzes piscando.

name: PenPalConnect
description:
PenPalConnect is a calm place to write letters to people around the world. No swiping, no endless chat: just thoughtful letters between two people who want to know what life is like somewhere else.

FIND A PEN PAL
Discover members from every corner of the world. See which languages you share, which interests you have in common and how well you match, then send a friendly request.

WRITE LETTERS, NOT MESSAGES
Every conversation is a stack of letters. Take your time, add photos, and send it by airmail if you like the anticipation of a letter that is still on its way. New letters arrive in your inbox with a stamp.

LEARN A LANGUAGE
Write to native speakers of the language you're learning while helping them with yours. Profiles show which languages someone speaks and which they're learning.

ASK THE LOCALS
Every country has its own hub. Ask locals anything, read their answers, swap recipes and tips, and answer questions about your own country.

BUILD YOUR CIRCLE
Keep your pen pals, requests and conversations in one place, and get a gentle notification when a new letter lands.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Profiles are reviewed, you decide who can write to you, and you can block or report anyone at any time. Teenagers only connect with other teenagers.

PenPalConnect is free. Make a friend in another country today.

name: Penviora
description:
Read, mark up, and share documents from your iPhone or iPad. Keep everything from meeting handouts to handwritten notes in one workspace.

• Open PDFs, HWP and HWPX files, DOCX documents, and photos. Use pens and highlighters with your finger on iPhone or Apple Pencil on a compatible iPad.
• Scan paper with your camera, review the preview, and save it when you’re ready. Use OCR to find text in photos and scans.
• Export annotated pages as a PDF or images. Keep your original files and work together in a backup.
• Share a screen in Chrome on your computer, then scan the QR code in Penviora. The annotations you draw appear in the presentation in real time.

Start without an account. Everyday document tasks, including markup and scanning, run on your device. Live presentations and purchases require an internet connection.

Keep up to five active projects for free and start each day with five minutes of live presenting. Penviora Pro removes ads and lifts the project and presentation limits with a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Check availability and local pricing in the app.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Perch: Wild Birds
description:
Perch is a quiet spot in the woods, in realistic 3D: a mossy branch, a floor of fallen leaves and a pool where the stream slows. Wild birds fly in on their own to feed, preen, call and make room for each other.

SCATTER, WAIT, HOLD STILL
Tap the ground to scatter seeds, fruit or mealworms. Hold your finger still on the branch and the birds that really take food from a hand will land on it. Move too fast and they fly off, then come back a little later. Tilt the device and the branch sways and the water ripples.

TRUE TO THE BIRDS
Birds only do what they do in real life. Only robins, tits and sparrows land on a finger; the cardinal and the blue jay do not; the kingfisher stays by the water.

FIELD GUIDE
Every bird you have seen gets a short entry with its name and habits, some with a real recorded call, in English, Japanese and Chinese.

A CLOCK FOR YOUR DESK
There is no separate mode to switch on. Stand your phone or iPad on the desk and leave it: the buttons fade away and a clock stays over the scene. It lowers the frame rate while nothing moves and the picture quality when the device warms up, so it can stay on all day. Touch the screen and you are feeding the birds again.

NOTHING TO KEEP UP WITH
No tasks, no streaks, no energy, no notifications, no ads and no account. Leave it for a week and nothing is lost.

FREE, ALL OF IT
All 9 birds, the woods, feeding, the desk clock and the field guide are free. No in-app purchases, no subscription and no ads.

name: Perfect Pitch Melody
description:
A game for kids to build perfect pitch for melodies while they play.
The goal: hear a melody, then play it back on the keys in the same order.

- Melody Quiz (63 levels)
Notes play one after another (for example, Do then Re).
1. Pick the picture that matches the melody. First, tap the pictures to hear each melody.
2. Then "Now play it in order": press the keys in the order you heard them. One wrong key and the question is missed and the game moves on; the correct melody plays again first while the keys light up.
Get 8 of 10 right to go to the next level.
  - 2 notes (levels 1-33): every move between two different notes, all 132 of them. Each kind of move ("2 up", "1 down" ...) has its own family of pictures (vehicles, fruits, vegetables ...).
  - 3 to 16 notes (levels 34-61): for each length, an easy-to-sing melody using mostly white keys, and one using more black keys.
  - Levels 62 and 63 mix every melody from the whole game.
Except in the mixed levels, the 4 melodies in a level have the same shape at different pitches, so children can't answer just by comparing notes (relative pitch); they learn to hear the pitch itself.

- Note Name
Listen to a note and tap it on the keyboard. Start with the white keys; get 8 of 10 right to unlock all 12 notes.

- Melody Play
Tap and compare all 244 melodies freely. Each note lights up on the keyboard as it plays.

- Free Piano
Play freely with real piano sounds.

- Stats
See the accuracy and answer time for each note and melody.

- For parents
  - Press and hold the gear on the home screen for 2 seconds to open Settings (language, note names, choose a level).
  - Each key has exactly one name. English names: Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Ti / Di Ri Fi Si Li, or C D E F G A B / C# D# F# G# A#.
  - Japanese is also available.
  - No ads, no in-app purchases, no outside links.
  - The app works offline. Progress is saved only on the device. No personal information is collected.

name: Perlita: Cycle Plan & Food
description:
Perlita helps you follow your cycle with a practical daily plan — not another overwhelming tracker.

Each day you’ll see which phase you’re probably in (menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, or luteal) based on your last period and average cycle length, clearly labelled as an estimate.

Your plan includes:
• 2–3 food ideas or simple recipes for the day
• A suggested workout intensity and style
• 2–3 habits for sleep, energy, and mood check-ins

Choose a goal that matters to you — more steady energy, fewer cravings, smarter training, or understanding your cycle — and follow guidance that shifts with each phase.

Important: Perlita is for general wellness and education only. It does not treat, heal, or balance hormones. It is not birth control, not a fertility tool, and does not diagnose PCOS, endometriosis, or any condition. Talk to a qualified clinician for medical questions.

Your cycle inputs stay on your device in v1 — no account required.

Subscriptions and purchases
• Perlita Premium Yearly — $34.99 USD per year (or equivalent in your local currency)
• Perlita Premium Weekly — $5.99 USD per week (or equivalent in your local currency)
• Perlita Lifetime — $69.99 USD one-time purchase (does not auto-renew)

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The weekly and yearly subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price. You can manage and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.

name: PetCat: Virtual Cat Companion
description:
Some days, you just want to pet a cat. Meet PetCat: a virtual cat whose fur ruffles under your fingers, whose ears twitch when you touch them, and who purrs when you find the right spot. No account or ads. Just you and the cat.

PET IT YOUR WAY
Stroke from head to tail, scratch behind an ear, or rest a finger and see what it does. Hear it purr and feel the gentle rumble on devices that support haptics. Tap the floor to call it over, drag a laser dot for it to chase, or offer it a treat.

ONE CAT, DIFFERENT VIEWS
Watch it pad around the living room, get nose to nose, or look down at it on your lap. On devices that support AR, you can bring the same cat into your own room. AR needs camera permission; the other views don't.

A LITTLE TIME TOGETHER
Spend a quiet minute with your cat, read a diary entry from its point of view, or let its purr and the room sounds play as it dozes off in Bedtime mode. Record short clips of your cat to share when you like.

WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT'S PRO
Petting, play, purrs, built-in rooms, three coats, the diary, AR on supported devices, and a 15-minute Bedtime timer are free. PetCat Pro is an optional one-time purchase. It adds three more coats, your own photos as room backgrounds, longer or untimed Bedtime sessions, and Chest mode. No subscription.

name: Photo Recap 2026: Year Review
description:
Your year in photos, wrapped up.

Photo Recap turns your iPhone camera roll into a beautiful, animated story of your year. Meet Click, your little camera buddy, who reads your photo library right on your device and shows you what your 2026 really looked like.

YOUR RECAP INCLUDES
• Total moments: every photo and video you captured, and how many per day
• Your biggest month, with the highlight shot that defined it
• Your best shots of the year, ranked by on-device AI for composition, light and focus
• Every place and country you photographed, on a map
• What you loved to shoot most: food, pets, sunsets, beaches, cities and more
• Your camera's favorite hour and day of the week
• Your biggest day and your longest photo streak
• Fun numbers: selfies, screenshots, Live Photos, minutes of video and favorites
• Your photo personality: Globetrotter, Night Owl, Foodie Critic, Golden Hour Chaser and more
• A summary card that sums up your year

MADE FOR SHARING
Every slide becomes a story-ready card in one tap. Post your year to Instagram Stories, TikTok, WhatsApp or send it to friends.

REWIND ANY YEAR
Go back in time and see your recap for every year in your library, back to your very first photo.

100% PRIVATE
All analysis happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded, there is no account and no tracking.

FREE TO TRY
Watch your 2026 recap for free. Unlock Photo Recap Pro with a single one-time purchase (no subscription) to see every slide, every past year, and share them all.

Privacy Policy: https://photorecap-app.vercel.app/privacy

name: PhotoLog - 写真日記
description:
撮った写真に、ひとことを添えるだけ。
PhotoLog は、写真で毎日を残していく日記アプリです。

長い文章を書かなくても大丈夫。写真を撮って、そのときの気持ちをひとこと。それだけで、あとから見返したくなる日記ができあがります。

■ 写真で日記をつける
・写真を選ぶか、その場で撮って、ひとことを添えるだけ
・1日に何枚でも、写真をまとめて記録できます
・タグをつけて、旅・ごはん・散歩など、あとから見つけやすく

■ カレンダーでふりかえる
・撮った写真で、カレンダーが少しずつ埋まっていきます
・ひと月をながめるだけで、その月の思い出がよみがえります

■ 地図でふりかえる
・写真を撮った場所が、地図の上に表示されます
・たくさん撮った場所ほど色が濃くなり、行った場所がひと目でわかります
・県を選ぶと、市区町村ごとに写真を見られます

■ さまざまなフィルムで撮る
・ノーマル、フィルム風、使い捨てカメラ風、シネマ風の4種類
・いつもの景色を、自分好みの雰囲気に

■ 好きな色で、つづける
・6つの配色から選べます
・ダークモードにも対応
・配色に合わせて、ホーム画面のアイコンも変わります

■ PhotoLog Pro
・一度買えば、ずっと広告なし
・フィルム風・使い捨てカメラ風・シネマ風の加工を、いつでも使えます
・買い切りなので、月額料金はかかりません

PhotoLog は無料で使えます（広告が表示されます）。
フィルム風・使い捨てカメラ風・シネマ風の加工は、広告を見るか PhotoLog Pro で使えます。

name: Photy: Analog Film Camera
description:
See the film look in your viewfinder before you shoot. Choose from over 170 film looks and 52 lens emulations. Move the side dial to your left or right thumb. Pro controls include ISO, shutter speed, focus and white balance. Keep a RAW original on compatible devices and settings.

In Studio, compare your edit with the original, fine-tune color, light and grain, and copy the edit to other photos. Import photos from Apple Photos whenever you like. Your private album encrypts photos on your iPhone and opens with device authentication.

With Photy Lifetime, host a Together roll in your iCloud and invite friends by link or QR code. Invited guests can contribute for free.

Activate a free 24-hour trial for the camera, import and Studio. It ends without a charge. One purchase unlocks these features permanently and adds Together hosting.

name: Piano School: Daily Technique
description:
Piano School plans a 20 minute technique session for you every day and brings each study up to tempo one clean set at a time.

Choose your tracks and one of five playing levels, from Beginner to Advanced. Each day the app picks the studies: something new, something in progress, and a review of what you already have. You play a short timed set after a count-in, rate it honestly, and the click moves up when the set was clean. Two clean days at the target tempo and a study is yours.

WHAT YOU PRACTISE
- Scales: major, natural minor, harmonic minor and melodic minor in all twelve keys, from one octave hands separately to four octaves hands together, with fingering for both hands
- Arpeggios: major and minor triads and five seventh-chord qualities in twelve keys, through every inversion
- Chords and cadences: inversions, cadences, Alberti bass and waltz bass
- Hand independence, keyboard awareness, and left- and right-hand technique
- Styles: pop accompaniment, blues, jazz harmony and stride
- Sight reading: a new phrase every time, so you never read the same one twice
- Études: sixteen-bar studies that put the technique to work

HOW IT WORKS
- The staff and the keyboard highlight together, or show the staff alone
- Listen to a demo of any study before you play it
- Tempos rise in small steps and settle where you are, never past what the study needs
- Reviews come back after 10, 30, 90, 180 and 365 days, in the key you played longest ago
- Belts from white to black, the same belts as every Shire Studios school

FREE TO START
Your first day needs no account. A free account keeps one daily session a day until you earn the Yellow Belt. Shire Studios Pro opens every belt and as many sessions a day as you like, and one membership opens every Shire Studios school: Singing School, Learn Tunes, Piano School and Drum School.

Pro is offered monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://shirestudios.studio/terms
Privacy policy: https://shirestudios.studio/privacy

name: PickleHub - Pickleball
description:
PickleHub helps you organize pickleball sessions and keep games moving.

• Plan one-time or weekly sessions with RSVP, waitlists, and check-in.
• Generate round robin schedules for singles, fixed teams, or rotating doubles. Track results, standings, and playoffs.
• Keep score point by point with serve calls and undo. Start a practice game straight from Apple Watch.
• Create groups, share messages and photos, and poll your crew.
• Compare court costs, set reminders, and save a video highlight.

Scheduling and scoring work on your device. Shared events and group chat require a connected account. Apple Watch can keep practice scores on the Watch itself. Phone session scoring uses the companion connection.

PickleHub Pro is an optional one-time purchase. Run two-pool doubles tournaments with cross-pool playoffs, create single or double round robin league schedules, and show live court assignments and standings on iPad. Print tournament schedules, score sheets, standings, and playoff brackets as PDFs. Export league results and session standings to CSV, or add a score overlay to video highlights.

name: Pidge - London Trains
description:
Pidge is a plump London pigeon who rides the tube every day, and now rides it with you. Open the app and Pidge tells you how your lines are running, when the next train is in at your platform, and which lifts are working, in plain, calm words.

YOUR LINES FIRST
Pick the lines you ride and they sit at the top: good service, a bit slow, part closed, or done for the night. The rest of London follows, worst first, with what's wrong and until when.

EVERY PLATFORM, LIVE
Save your stations and see every platform's next trains counting down, grouped by line and direction, with where each train is now. No signal underground? Pidge keeps counting down from the last board, then tells you how often trains run.

LIFTS AND STEP-FREE
Live lift outages on every board and trip, and step-free routes that keep to lifts all the way. Tell Pidge you need lifts and it shows them everywhere.

TRIPS AND WHEN TO LEAVE
Save the journeys you take and Pidge gives you one number: when to leave. It shows the route, where to change and when you'll arrive, planned from live times, or from the stations on board when there's no signal.

LEAVE NOW
Tap Leave now and the journey sits on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island: which train, where to change, when you're there.

PIDGE'S OWN MAP
A map of London's rail lines drawn from real station positions, with every station tappable for its live board.

PERCHES
Every station where you start or end a trip becomes a perch. Collect them line by line, with golden feathers at 25, 100 and every station.

WIDGETS
How your lines are running on your Home Screen, the next train at your station, and a Control for Control Center.

COVERAGE
Underground lines, the Elizabeth line, DLR, all six Overground lines and Trams.

FREE, NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
Status, every board, lift outages and one saved trip are free. Your stations, trips and perches stay on your iPhone.

PIDGE PLUS
Unlimited saved trips, a heads-up 30 minutes before your usual time if anything on the way changes, Leave now on your Lock Screen and the Next train widget. Weekly, monthly or yearly (with a free first week), or once for lifetime. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings at least 24 hours before the period ends.

name: Piecering
description: Piecering is a jigsaw notebook. Each puzzle stores a title, the piece count on the box, how many pieces you have placed, how many are missing, and where the box sits. A ring shows placed pieces divided by the box count. Sessions are dated notes of how many pieces you added. They do not change the placed count by themselves. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Pilates Workout: Daily Flow
description:
Build a Pilates routine that fits your day.

Pilates Workout: Daily Flow brings guided mat sessions, animated movement illustrations, structured programs, and personal progress tools together in a calm, easy-to-read app for iPhone and iPad.

MOVE WITH CLEAR GUIDANCE
Explore 28 movement guides with starting positions, step-by-step instructions, breathing cues, common mistakes, and lighter options. Looping illustrations help you follow the movement without workout videos.

FIND YOUR PRACTICE
Choose from 24 workouts for core strength, full-body movement, mobility, and recovery. Filter by level, focus, and duration, or build your own workout from the exercise library.

FOLLOW A ROUTINE
Use 6 programs and 3 challenges to bring structure to your practice. Schedule sessions, save favorites, and set optional reminders.

PRACTICE AT YOUR PACE
Follow the workout timer with adjustable rest, pause and resume, and optional spoken guidance. Choose a comfortable range of motion and take breaks whenever you need them.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Keep workout history and personal notes, view your calendar, and optionally record measurements. Your saved fitness information stays on your device. Export and import your own backup when you choose.

MAKE ROOM FOR EVERYDAY WELLNESS
Read practical articles and explore 12 recipe ideas, a meal planner, and a shopping checklist.

OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Choose Continue free on the welcome paywall to use the app without subscribing. Optional Apple auto-renewable subscriptions support your daily practice:
• Monthly: US$2.99 per month
• 6 months: US$7.99 every 6 months
• Yearly: US$12.99 per year

A 7-day free introductory trial is available only for eligible Apple accounts and configured offers. Apple confirms eligibility. After an eligible trial, the selected plan renews at its subscription price unless canceled. Prices may vary by country or region; the App Store displays your local price before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before renewal. Restore purchases and manage your subscription from the app or your Apple subscription settings.

General fitness and wellness information only. This app does not provide medical advice or treatment. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort, and seek appropriate professional advice about exercise when needed.

name: Pilfer: Word Stealing Game
description:
Pilfer is a live word game for two to six players, each on their own iPhone.

Each turn you draw one tile. Use it and the tiles in the pool to make a word of three letters or more. Or steal someone's word by adding at least one letter to make a different word, and it moves to your side of the table. CAT and an S can become CAST. Adding just S or ES for the plural or verb form doesn't count.

Add letters to your own words to make them harder to steal. When you reach the target of 5, 7 or 10 words, everyone else gets one more turn to take a word from you. If you still hold enough words when play comes back to you, you win.

Start a table and invite people with a link or a five-letter code. Tables are private, and there are no accounts. Add computer players at Easy, Medium or Hard, or play the computer on your own.

The game is set on a walnut table under a lamp. Words land on felt mats, steals fly across the table, and the tile you draw stays hidden from everyone else until you play it.

A short demo shows how a turn works, and How to play has the rules whenever you need them.

Every game, including one against the computer, needs an internet connection. Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: Pilgrim: Follow the Light
description:
A man with a burden on his back sees a light far off. And he begins to walk.

Pilgrim is a platform and puzzle game inspired by John Bunyan's "The Pilgrim's Progress" (1678), one of the most widely read books in history. You play with one finger: hold to follow the light, release to stop. The rest you learn on the way.

• From the City of Destruction to the Celestial Gate, chapter by chapter
• Each chapter brings a new mechanic: the slough that sinks, the stone that rolls, the fight with Apollyon, the dark valley that only clears with prayer, the giant who cannot bear the sun, the mountain that turns under your feet, the river of faith
• Verses to complete along the story (King James Version)
• Clean visuals, original music, no ads
• In English, Portuguese and Spanish
• Progress is saved on your device

The first chapters are free. The whole journey is unlocked with a single in-app purchase, no subscription.

"Do you see that light far off? Keep it in your eye."

name: Pingzy
description:
Pingzy makes you easier to recommend.

One page shows who you are, what you do, and who trusts you. Share it with a QR code or a link, so the next time someone asks "who do you know?", the answer is you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Make your free page in a few minutes: your photo, what you do and how to reach you.
• Show your QR at any meeting, even with no signal. Press and hold the Pingzy icon and tap Show my QR.
• Ask the people you have worked with to recommend you. One honest sentence is all it takes.
• Save the pros you trust, and add any of them to your phone's contacts in one tap.
• Get a phone alert when someone recommends you.

REAL PEOPLE, REAL WORDS
Every recommender confirms their email. No stars. No paid placement.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report anything that does not belong. Pros can block someone from recommending them. Delete your account any time in Settings.

Pingzy is free. Questions? hello@pingzy.com

name: Pink Pare-Brise Tech
description:
Pink Pare-Brise Tech est l'application des techniciens du réseau Pink Pare-Brise, spécialiste du remplacement et de la réparation de vitrage automobile.

Consultez votre planning du jour, de la semaine ou du mois, ouvrez chaque intervention et suivez-la de bout en bout : informations client et véhicule, itinéraire, photos obligatoires avant et après la pose, pièces utilisées, VIN, kilométrage et signature du client sur l'écran.

Scannez les QR codes des dossiers et des pièces, créez un nouveau dossier depuis le terrain et continuez à travailler même sans réseau : vos actions sont envoyées dès que la connexion revient.

Application réservée aux techniciens disposant d'un compte Pink Pare-Brise.

name: PinLog: Photo & Voice Notes
description:
Pin your photos to a cork board and talk about them. PinLog writes down what you say and gathers it on sticky notes beside each photo and in the board's note.

Add the story of the day to your travel photos, notes to photos of a repair job, or what your child said about their drawing. No typing, just talk.

■ Pin your photos
· Pick several photos from your library at once, or take them with the camera straight onto a board
· Photos and videos both work
· The originals in Photos stay untouched; boards hold copies

■ Just talk
· Press the record button and speak; it is written down as you talk
· Each recording is kept as a cassette tape you can play again
· Type the things that are hard to say, like phone numbers
· Transcription works offline, on your device, and nothing is sent anywhere

■ It gathers in the note
· What you say about each photo comes together in the board's note
· Edit the note yourself, or fill it again from the recordings
· Search every board by words or dates

■ Your own bookcase
· Arrange boards on shelves, with favorites and a storage box
· 10 board themes: cork, chalkboard, grid notebook, blueprint and more
· Handwriting note fonts and text sizes
· Move or copy several photos to another board at once
· Export and import everything to back up or move to a new iPhone

■ Free and Unlimited
Every feature is free. The free version holds 3 boards, 5 photos per board, and the default board theme and font. A one-time purchase removes the limits and unlocks every board theme and font. No subscription.

■ Privacy
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos, recordings and notes stay on your device.

name: PinScribe: Dovetail Layout
description:
Plan the marking lines for a hand-cut through dovetail before putting a pencil to wood. Enter the board width, mating board thickness, number of tails, edge half-pin width, full pin width, and slope ratio. PinScribe draws the end and baseline geometry and gives the measurements from one reference edge.

Review both facing parts, check for overlaps before marking, and keep the layout with your project name and notes. View the dimensions in millimeters or inches and share them as a text cut reference. Two example boards are included.

Measurement tables are the reference. The screen drawing is a diagram, not a physical ruler. The app works offline.

name: Pinwire
description:
Pinwire does one thing: it sends your location to the map or service you choose.

There is no map inside, no account, no ads and no tracking. Add your service, slide to share, done. Slide back and it stops.

WHY PINWIRE 
One small app that sends to the services you already use, instead of a big app for every service. Less than 1 MB.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

* Your location goes only to the services you add
* The developer never receives it
* No location history on your iPhone
* Keys are kept in the iPhone's keychain

SIMPLE
* Slide to share, slide to stop
* You always see what happened: sent, received, no movement or failed
* Sends nothing while you do not move, unless you choose to

WHAT YOU NEED 
A service that receives locations, such as Traccar or Home Assistant, your own webhook, or your own server. Pinwire does not include one. Step by step guides are on the About page.

PINWIRE PRO, A ONE-TIME PURCHASE

* Share to several services at the same time
* Choose the interval, or how far you have to move
* Stop sharing automatically

FOR YOUR OWN SERVER UDP, HTTPS, HTTP, WSS and WS. With a secret, every location is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it leaves your iPhone. Other services do not support this: they can read your location.

Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.

name: PipQR
description:
Stop renting your printed QR codes. PipQR is a tactile, local-first QR code studio, 1D barcode label press, and Hostage QR Rescue tool built for cafes, studios, makers, and everyday sharing.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED — FREE FOREVER
• 6 Permanent Payload Generators: Direct URL, Guest Wi-Fi, vCard 3.0 Contacts, UPI Merchant Payments, 1D Warehouse SKUs (Code 128-B & EAN-13), and Self-Hosted Dynamic Redirects.
• All 5 Curated Ceramic Palettes: Terracotta Rose, Espresso Clay, Pop Tangerine, Sage Ceramic, and Minimal Ink — with live WCAG contrast & scannability verification.
• 5 Tactile Geometry Dials: Square, Soft Clay, Pip Bead, Squircle, and Bullseye finder eyes.
• Hostage QR Rescue & Live Camera Scanner: Point your camera at any printed flyer or restaurant menu QR code to detect expiring third-party redirect traps (qrco.de, qr.io, bit.ly, etc.), unmask the real destination URL, and convert it into a 100% permanent QR code in one tap.
• Offline Saved Plaques Wallet: Save your Wi-Fi signs, vCards, and UPI payment plaques locally on your iPhone for instant full-screen scanning with zero internet connection.
• Standard 1× PNG Export & Native iOS Share Sheet.

PIPQR PRO (OPTIONAL ONE-TIME UPGRADE)
For commercial printing, designers, and hospitality/warehouse teams:
• Infinite Vector .SVG Export & Copy SVG to Figma / Illustrator.
• 3× High-DPI Commercial Print PNG export.
• Custom Hex Color Pickers (Ink, Corner Eyes, Card Surface) & Custom Center Badge Text.
• Batch {1..N} Serialization & CSV Mail-Merge Print Imposition Sheets (Avery 5160 30-up SKU sheets, 6-up Restaurant Table Plaques, and 2"×1" Thermal Roll labels).

100% LOCAL & PRIVATE
Every QR code, Wi-Fi password, contact card, and barcode is encoded directly on your iPhone with zero tracking and zero expiration dates.

name: Pipstart: Tiny First Steps
description:
Starting is the hard part. Pipstart makes it small enough to do.

Type what you've been putting off. Pipstart gives you one tiny first step, about two minutes of effort, then a short focus sprint to do just that. Not the whole task. Just the start. Stopping still counts as showing up.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap "Help me start" and type the thing you're avoiding
• Get one tiny first step, chosen on your iPhone, so it works offline
• Still too much? Tap "Make it smaller" for an even smaller step
• Pick a 2, 5, 15 or 25 minute sprint and begin
• Finish, keep going for 5 more minutes, or call it a day. All of it counts

BUILT TO BE GENTLE
• No streak shaming. Progress is "starts this week", not a chain you can break
• Today keeps your list short: up to three tasks, so it never becomes a wall
• Reminders are yours to choose and you can switch them off completely
• Pip, your companion, wakes up when you start and never scolds you when you don't
• Pip gets little things to wear as you start more things

MORE
• Home Screen widget showing Pip and your starts this week
• Light and dark appearance
• Export all of your data any time, free (JSON and CSV)
• Works on iPhone and iPad

FREE, WITH NO CATCH
• No ads
• No account or sign-up
• No subscription, and nothing locked behind a payment
• Optional one-time tips if you'd like to support the app. They never unlock anything

YOUR PRIVACY
What you type stays on your iPhone. The first steps are chosen on your device, not by a server. Anonymous usage statistics and crash reports are off until you choose to turn them on, and you can switch them off again any time in Settings. Read the full policy at zynlore.in/apps/pipstart/privacy

Pipstart is a self-help tool, not a medical device or a substitute for professional care.

name: Pirinola: Toma Todo
description:
The spinning top Mexican families play at posadas, birthdays and family nights, now with the beans counted for you.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Everyone starts with 10 beans and puts 1 in the pot
• Spin: Pon 1, Pon 2, Toma 1, Toma 2, Toma todo or Todos ponen
• Empty pot? Everyone antes again
• Run out of beans and you're out
• Last player with beans wins, or the most beans when the spins run out

SPIN IT YOUR WAY
Tap the top, swipe it, or shake the phone.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Count for us: the app keeps everyone's beans and the pot. Pass the phone around the table.
• Real beans: just the spinner, for beans or candy on the table.

GAMES THAT FIT THE PARTY
Choose 5, 10 or 20 spins each, or play until one is left.

FAIR SPINS
Every spin comes from a random seed. Its fingerprint is shown from the start and the seed at the end, so anyone can check every spin.

• Free for up to 4 players, and Real beans mode is free
• In English and Spanish
• No ads, no account, no data collected

PIRINOLA PRO (one-time purchase)
• Up to 10 players
• House rules: 5 to 50 starting beans, 1 to 5 beans per pot

name: Pisteway: Ski Navigation
description:
Pisteway gets you to the run or lift you want without leaving the ski area. Pick a resort, tap a run or a lift on the map, and Pisteway works out a route that goes down runs, up lifts and along connecting paths. It never sends you in a straight line across the mountain.

While you ski down, Pisteway talks you through each move, so the phone can stay in a pocket or strapped to your arm: "In 500 feet, keep left onto Blue 12." Hold the phone up and the camera works like a sat nav: a banner shows the next move and how far away it is, and a trail of chevrons over the live view bends the way the route goes. Lower the phone and the same banner shows with a drawing of the next junction. Time left, distance left and your arrival time sit along the bottom.

HOW IT WORKS
• Find your resort. Pisteway suggests the nearest one, or you can search 51 resorts with maps built into the app and more than 3,600 ski areas from OpenStreetMap.
• Choose where to go. Tap a run to head for its start, or a lift to head for its bottom station. The route card shows the time, the lifts and runs on the way, and a switch to avoid black runs.
• Follow the voice and the chevrons. They come from where you are and where the camera points, so turning the phone shows which way to go. Take a different run and Pisteway finds a new route from where you are.
• On a lift, it tells you where to get off.
• Pick the voice you like: American, British, Australian, Irish, Indian or South African English, using the voices on your iPhone.

SET YOUR LEVEL
Choose beginner, intermediate, advanced or expert. Beginners stay on the easiest runs, each level up adds the next grade, and the Avoid blacks switch keeps black runs out of any route.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up.
• Your location stays on your iPhone. Pisteway has no server.
• The camera only shows a live view behind the arrow. Nothing is recorded or saved.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Piste and lift data comes from OpenStreetMap. Pisteway can't see which lifts and runs are open today, so always follow piste markers, signs and closures.
• Directions for the built-in resorts work without cell signal. The 3D map needs a connection to load, and other ski areas need one the first time you open them.
• Keep your eyes on the slope. If you want to look at the screen, stop at the side of the run where people above can see you.

Maps © Mapbox. Piste and lift data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: PixelWitness
description:
Compare two images at the same pixel coordinates and keep the numeric evidence. PixelWitness provides explicit RGB differences, a strict change threshold, pixel probes and complete region counts.

IMPORT AND CHECK BOTH SOURCES
Choose single-frame PNG or JPEG files through Files. Source orientation is applied, transparency is composited onto white, and the comparison uses explicit 8-bit sRGB copies. Their normalized width and height must match exactly. Images are never resized, aligned or cropped to force a match.

SET A PRECISE THRESHOLD
Choose an integer from 0 to 255. A pixel is changed only when its largest absolute RGB-channel difference is strictly greater than that threshold. Read the changed count and fraction, maximum channel difference, RGB root mean square error and mean absolute error.

INSPECT THE COORDINATES
Switch between A, B, absolute difference and the black-and-white threshold mask in a shared zoom and pan view. Probe integer coordinates for both RGB values and all three differences. Inspect every 32 by 32 region, including partial edge regions.

FREEZE AND EXPORT
Preserve both normalized input buffers and the exact result in an independent snapshot. Generate four PNG copies: normalized A, normalized B, absolute difference and threshold mask. Export a full region CSV or JSON with the normalized RGB inputs, source information, parameters and result. Preview or share actual files with byte sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints.

INPUT LIMITS
Each source may be up to 8 MiB, with at most 2,048 pixels on either side and 1,048,576 total pixels. Only single-frame PNG and JPEG are supported. Results describe normalized RGB bytes; they are not an image-authenticity verdict, visual-quality score or promise of identical appearance on every display.

Pairs, source copies, frozen comparisons and generated files are stored locally in the app. Deleting a source pair does not erase frozen comparisons. Clear local data removes the app's saved records and files; external originals and shared copies remain separate.

name: PizzaPivot--Dual Ring Align
description:
Palauta järjestys levottomasti pyörivään kaksirenkaiseen pizzapulmaan.

Jokaisella pöydän sektorilla on oma kiinteä täytetilauksensa, joka ei pyöri pohjan mukana. Ulompi rengas ja sisempi keskiosa liikkuvat eri tahtiin, joten yksi harkittu käännös voi korjata yhden pizzapalan mutta sekoittaa samalla toisen. Vain yläreunan vaihtokohdassa täytteet voivat siirtyä renkaiden välillä.

Suunnittele siirtosi tarkasti rajatun siirtomäärän puitteissa. Lue tilaus, pyöritä oikea kohta vaihtopaikkaan, vaihda täytteet ja seuraa, kuinka oikein täsmäävät sektorit syttyvät. Pelaa lukuja uudelleen, tavoittele taitavaa ratkaisua ilman vihjeitä ja pidä keittiömuistiinpanot lähellä, kun haluat kerrata pelin sääntöjä.

Lämpimät keittiön sävyt, käsin tunnusteltavilta tuntuvat puiset ohjaimet ja hillityt lyhyet äänimerkit pitävät huomion itse pulmassa.

name: PlainPage: PDF Scanner & OCR
description:
PlainPage is a document scanner and PDF toolkit that does all its work on your device. Scan a page with the camera or import a photo or PDF, and PlainPage finds the edges, straightens the page and cleans it up. On-device OCR makes every scan searchable. There are no ads, no watermarks, no account and no scan limits.

Scan in seconds
A live outline shows the detected page, and PlainPage captures it automatically when you hold steady. Use batch mode for many pages in a row, drag the corners to adjust a crop, and re-crop later from the original.

Clean, readable pages
Ten filters, including Auto, No Shadow, B&W, Eco and Whiteboard, help remove shadows and uneven light. Erase Ink removes blue, red or green pen marks while keeping printed black text.

Eleven scan modes
Pick Document, ID Card, Book, Whiteboard, QR Code, To Text, To Excel, To PPT, Erase Ink, Translate and ID Photo. ID Card puts both sides of a card on one page, Book splits a two-page spread into two pages, and the QR code scanner reads barcodes too, even from a saved image. ID Photo makes passport-size photos with size presets and a new background.

Text recognition and searchable PDFs
PlainPage reads printed text in Latin, Chinese, Japanese and Korean scripts without uploading it. Copy the text, or search for a word across your whole library. Exported PDFs get an invisible text layer you can select and search. To Excel finds the rows and columns of a printed table and saves an Excel (XLSX) or CSV file.

Scan to PDF, Word and more
Export to PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text, JPG, PNG, one long image or ZIP. Set the PDF page size, margins and page numbers, and protect it with a password. Then share it, save it to Files or print it; images can go to Photos too.

PDF tools and signatures
Seventeen PDF tools merge, split, compress, rotate and reorder PDFs, extract or delete pages, add a password or remove one you know, add watermarks and page numbers, and convert images to PDF or a PDF to images, text or Word. Annotate with a pen, highlighter, text and shapes, and place a saved signature on any page.

Stay organized
Use colored folders, tags and favorites, and move pages between documents. Deleted documents stay in the trash for 30 days by default.

Private by design
