Your scans stay in PlainPage's private storage on your device and are never uploaded. There is no analytics or crash reporting and no sign-in. An optional app lock uses a PIN with Face ID or Touch ID, can lock single documents and can hide its content in the app switcher. Back up your library to a ZIP file. You buy PlainPage once: no in-app purchases or subscriptions, and every feature is included.

Works offline
Scanning, OCR, search, exports and every PDF tool work without internet. The one exception is translation: it uses Apple's on-device language packs, which iOS downloads the first time you use a language, and then it works offline too.

iPhone and iPad
On iPhone, auto-capture keeps scanning quick. On iPad, a navigation rail and a wider layout give documents more room, in portrait or landscape. On both, share photos or PDFs to PlainPage from other apps or open them from Files, and PlainPage still finds the edges of imported photos. Available in English, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese.

Good to know
OCR is made for printed text, so handwriting may not be recognized, and you choose the script in Settings. Word export contains the recognized text rather than the original layout, and Excel files come from the To Excel tool, one page at a time. Signatures are image stamps, not certified digital signatures, and ID photos should be checked against your country's rules. The app lock does not encrypt your library, and backup files are not encrypted.

name: Plank & Abs: 30-Day Challenge
description:
Build real core strength, trunk stability, and longer plank holds at home in 8 to 20 minutes a day — with zero equipment and no subscription.

Plank & Abs: 30-Day Challenge gives you 46 animated floor exercises, 6 free daily workouts, and 12 structured 21-to-30-day plank and ab challenges built around steady, spine-friendly progression.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED ON A FLOOR MAT
- 6 free workouts ready on day one: 8-Minute Daily Plank Starter, 10-Minute Forearm Plank Express, 10-Minute Floor Core (No Planks), 12-Minute 360-Degree Core, 12-Minute Plank and Abs Mix, and 15-Minute Advanced Plank Test.
- 46 bodyweight core exercises with clear looping demonstrations and 4-step form cues: forearm, knee, high, posterior-tilt, long-lever, bear, dolphin, body-saw, and side planks, plus dead bugs, bird-dogs, glute bridges, hollow holds, leg lowers, and slow bicycle crunches.
- Built-in workout timer with clear rest intervals, left/right side cues, and continuous breathing reminders on every isometric hold.

12 STRUCTURED PROGRAMS (BEGINNER TO ADVANCED)
Follow a sustainable 2-days-on, 1-day-off schedule across 21 to 30 days, scaled across 6 difficulty levels so hold times and reps grow with you:
- Beginner: 30-Day Beginner Plank Plan (30 days), 21-Day Daily Plank Habit (21 days), 30-Day Forearm Plank Plan (30 days)
- Intermediate: 30-Day Plank & Abs Challenge (30 days), 30-Day Longer Plank Plan (30 days), 28-Day Side Plank & Obliques (28 days), 28-Day Neutral-Spine Core (28 days), 30-Day Dynamic Plank Plan (30 days)
- Advanced: 30-Day Advanced Plank Plan (30 days), 28-Day Deep Abs & Hollow Hold (28 days), 30-Day Athletic Core Plan (30 days), 30-Day Peak Plank Challenge (30 days)

JOINT-AWARE SKIPPING & VERIFIED SOURCES
- Tell the app how your body feels today (wrist, shoulder, low back, neck, knee, or osteoporosis) to automatically skip exercises most likely to aggravate that area while keeping a complete session.
- Includes peer-reviewed training sources, progression rules, and isometric breathing safety guidelines right inside the app.

ONE-TIME PURCHASES — NO SUBSCRIPTION
- All 6 workouts and the full 46-exercise library are free.
- Unlock individual programs, custom workout and challenge builders, or the all-access bundle with a single one-time purchase. Buying any program removes ads from its sessions.

General fitness training only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Breathe steadily during every hold and consult a doctor before starting if you have high blood pressure, a heart condition, a hernia, a joint or spine condition, or are pregnant or recently postpartum.

name: Plate Scale
description:
Plate Scale turns a camera and a focal length into arcseconds per pixel on this iPhone.

Sampling is seeing divided by that scale. From the low bound to the high bound is OK. Below is Under. Above is Over. Field of view is the pixel count divided by binning, times the scale, divided by 60. A strip shows the same rig at other seeing and at fixed multiples of the current focal length.

Rigs, cameras, and night notes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: PlateIFR: IFR Plates & Holds
description:
Prepare for the FAA Instrument Rating Airplane (IRA) knowledge exam and stay sharp for checkrides and IPCs with interactive cockpit simulators, authentic FAA approach plates, and a 492-question FAA-cited question bank.

Built for student instrument pilots and current IFR aviators who want hands-on mastery instead of memorizing static flashcards:

INTERACTIVE FAA APPROACH PLATES & 19 SUPPLEMENT FIGURES
• Pinch-zoom 12 authentic public-domain FAA-CT-8080-3F charts: ILS/LOC, RNAV (GPS), VOR/DME, LDA, SID, STAR, and Enroute Low Altitude.
• Tap highlighted callout regions to decode briefing strips, stepdown fixes, VDPs, remote altimeter adjustments, minimums, and missed approach instructions.
• Includes 7 additional weather and instrument supplement figures (Winds & Temps Aloft, 12/24-hour Low-Level Significant Weather Prog Charts, Dual VOR/VOT checks, HSI presentations, and 15 DME holding diagrams).
• 3 interactive plates are completely free to explore right away.

LIVE COCKPIT SIMULATORS (ALL INCLUDED FREE)
• Holding Pattern Radar & Speed Drill: dial any inbound course, aircraft heading, or turn direction to visualize the exact 70-degree Teardrop, 110-degree Parallel, and 180-degree Direct entry sectors (AIM 5-3-8).
• VOR, Glass HSI & ILS Glideslope Lab: switch between slaved HSI and standard CDI across VOR, ILS with glideslope diamond, and Localizer Back Course reverse sensing.
• IFR Weather & 1-2-3 Alternate Calculator: tap METAR tokens to decode or fetch live airport METARs, and verify 14 CFR 91.169 alternate requirements and 600-2 / 800-2 legality instantly.

FAA-S-ACS-8C EXAM PREP & MOCK EXAMS
• 492 FAA-cited questions mapped to current FAA-S-ACS-8C codes, including 85 figure-backed questions and 137 high-yield frequently missed traps.
• Full 60-question, 2.5-hour timed IRA mock exams with realistic supplement-figure weighting, inline zoomable figures, flashcards, and SM-2 spaced repetition.
• Start free with 100 questions, all cockpit labs, 3 interactive plates, and 1 full mock exam.

PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTIONS. NO ACCOUNTS.
• Works 100% offline in the cockpit or on the ground.
• Unlock PlateIFR Pro once for lifetime access to all 12 interactive plates, all 492 questions, and unlimited mock exams.

PlateIFR is an independent training aid using public-domain FAA figures and standards. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA. Training use only, never for navigation.

name: Platine
description:
Platine is the native player for DroppedNeedle, the music server you host yourself. Your collection, your quality, your rules, with the care of a real turntable.

YOUR COLLECTION
• Albums, artists, tracks and playlists from your server, with big beautiful artwork
• Recently added, instant search, complete artist pages
• Daily Mixes and decade mixes built from your own collection
• Artist radio

PLAYBACK
• High-quality playback, FLAC included, streamed straight from your server
• A vinyl turntable player, with synced lyrics when available
• Background playback, Lock Screen and Control Center

DISCOVER
• Suggestions and new releases from the artists you follow
• Upcoming concerts near you
• Request albums from your server and follow their progress

EVERYWHERE
• iPhone and iPad, with a layout designed for each screen
• Mac, with a mini player
• Apple TV, for listening on your living-room speakers
• CarPlay: your crate, recent albums and playlists in the car
• Siri and Shortcuts: play your crate, pause, next track, without opening the app

Platine requires a DroppedNeedle server (free, open-source, self-hosted) and an account on it. The app is currently in French.

Platine collects no data: it only talks to your server.

name: Playground Tracker
description:
Playground Tracker is a simple log for parents who want to know how much time the kids really spend outside, and who took them.

LOG A VISIT IN SECONDS
Tap Morning or Evening, choose who went, which kids, how long and what they did. Once you have a routine, "Same as usual" repeats your last visit with one tap.

FILL IN THE DAYS YOU MISSED
Tap any past day in the week strip, or pick an older date, and log or change it like today.

DAYS NOBODY WENT COUNT TOO
Mark them with a reason, such as rain, sick or busy, or write your own. When only one parent went, note why the other couldn't. History shows the reasons add up over time.

PLANS
Set up activities that repeat on fixed days, or a one-time event, with an optional reminder. Mark each one done or skipped. Every plan keeps its own history, so you can see how often it really happened.

ADD PLANS TO YOUR CALENDAR OR REMINDERS
Add a plan to your iPhone calendar, repeat included, and invite people from there. Or put it in the Reminders app with an alert at the plan's time.

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
Invite your partner with a link. Your visits and plans stay in sync on both phones through iCloud. Reminders and the goal are set on each phone.

MAKE IT YOURS
Seven color themes or your own colors, 12- or 24-hour time, and five languages: English, Spanish, German, Bosnian and Czech.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your log stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, and we never see it.

One purchase, no subscription.

name: Pliegue
description:
Pliegue reúne tus recordatorios en una agenda para iPhone. Abre Hoy para ver qué sigue, completar una tarea o posponerla diez minutos. En Próximos puedes consultar tus recordatorios por fecha. En el calendario, desliza para cambiar de mes y toca un día para ver sus tareas o añadir una nueva.

Elige cuándo quieres recibir cada aviso. Puedes pedir que te avise minutos u horas antes, decidir cuántos avisos recibir y ajustar el intervalo entre ellos. Para tus rutinas, programa recordatorios diarios o semanales.

Con Siri puedes crear un recordatorio o preguntar «¿Qué tengo pendiente hoy en Pliegue?». Encontrarás las frases en Ajustes. La cuenta atrás en vivo te permite seguir un recordatorio desde la pantalla bloqueada.

Tus recordatorios se guardan en el iPhone. Puedes empezar a usar Pliegue sin crear una cuenta.

name: Plugg.ing
description:
Plugg.ing is a community where people who share your interests talk things through in posts and comments.

■ Features
• Posts and comments — Post with photos and keep the conversation going in comments and replies. The best comments show right in your feed.
• Topics — Browse posts by hashtag topic and pick your topics to see more of them in For You.
• Explore — See what's popular right now, the topics people talk about, and live NOWs at a glance.
• NOW (live audio) — Speak and listen in real-time voice rooms. Audio keeps playing when the app is in the background.
• Pages — Share your day with photos and videos that disappear after 24 hours.
• Books — Collect your favorite Pages and keep them on your profile.
• Follow and real-time notifications — Follow the people you like and hear about new comments as they happen.
• Privacy — Go private to show your posts only to the followers you approve.

Start the conversation on Plugg.ing today.

Signing up takes a mobile number. For now, it takes a South Korean mobile number.

name: Pochade
description:
Paint outdoors. Watch the light. Keep every sitting.

Pochade is a field log for plein-air painters, the artists who paint outside, in front of the subject. It times each painting session (a "sitting"), tracks how far the sun moves while you work, and keeps a record of where you painted, the light, your palette and a photo of the finished panel.

AT THE EASEL
• Tap Set up the easel, name your spot and choose the subject, medium and support.
• A large clock shows how long you've painted and how much of your light window is left.
• Optional light checks every 15, 20 or 30 minutes tell you how far the sun has moved and how high it is, so you know when your shadows have shifted.
• Note the tubes on your palette as you go, and play field sounds without leaving the easel.
• If you close the app, the sitting is still on the easel when you return.

YOUR SITTINGS
Save each sitting with its duration, light, wind, palette, notes and optional field photos from the camera or your photo library. Mark it a Keeper, a Study or Wiped, and filter by verdict. See your totals of sittings, hours outdoors, keepers and spots, and share any sitting with its photos.

LIGHT
Plan around the sun for your painting place. See the sun's arc for any day, with sunrise, high noon, sunset, and the morning and evening golden and blue hours. Right now shows the sun's height, bearing and shadow length, with a tip on what the light is doing. Pick from 26 painting places or type your own coordinates. Pochade never asks for your location.

PAINTBOX
29 common artists' colours with their Colour Index codes, opacity and a painter's note. Mark the tubes you own, see how often each one comes out with you, and compare your box against four classic limited palettes, including the Zorn palette and split primary.

FIELD SOUNDS
Meadow breeze, hedgerow birds, a harbour wall, a stream over stones, midday cicadas and rain on the umbrella. Choose one of five scenes or mix your own, with a sitting timer that fades out gently. Sounds keep playing with the screen locked.

INTRO FILM
"Your First Sitting" is a one-minute, five-part guide: pack light, find your view, squint for the values, block in the big shapes, and stop while it's fresh. Cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV for a club or a class.

PAINT-OUT
Painting with a group? Everyone opens Paint-Out on the same Wi-Fi or personal hotspot and uses one code, like OCHRE42. See who is painting what and how long each painter has left, and send timing calls such as "10 minutes to brushes down" or "Meet at the wet-paint wall". Then log the paint-out as a sitting.

FIELD GUIDE
A light kit list, a simple five-step method, and staying safe outdoors: weather, tides, roads, sun and leaving no trace.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account or login. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your sittings, notes and photos stay on your device.

name: Pocket Links
description:
Golf, pocket-sized. Drag down to power up and flick to swing; the flick shapes the shot.

EXPLORE THE COURSES
Tee it up across 21 courses, from Kiwi parkland and Scottish links to the Outback, a volcano, a coral island and snowy alpine scenery. Play quick 6- or 9-hole rounds by day, at dusk or under the floodlights, in sunshine or rain.

BUILD YOUR CAREER
Climb four tours to the Pocket Pro Tour. Play majors, sign sponsors and take on your rivals. Follow your world ranking, stats, form and milestones in Your Journey.

FIND YOUR WAY TO PLAY
Enjoy stroke play, Stableford, skins and match play. Try Power Golf, drive the cart in Real Golf, or tackle Mini Putt courses with loops, chips, ice and gravity wells. Return for the daily hole and weekly featured event, or challenge a friend with a code.

MAKE IT YOURS
Grow your golfer’s skills, earn new traits and build your bag. Choose clubs, balls, shot tracers and stand bags, then dress your golfer in relaxed 90s golf style with classic swings and celebrations.

FOLLOW EVERY SHOT
See shot stats, watch replays, track your handicap and chase Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

Pocket Links includes optional in-app purchases and advertising.

name: Pocket Purr
description:
Need a quiet moment? Pet the cat. Feel it purr.

Pocket Purr is a small, calming app with one simple idea: a cat on your screen that you can stroke with your finger. Slide your finger over the fur, and it ruffles and settles back. Find the spot your cat likes, and the purr starts soft, then grows the longer you keep petting. Let go, and it slowly fades away.

VERY SPOT IS DIFFERENT
• Chin and cheeks: pure bliss
• Forehead and back: happy purring
• Ears: pleasant, but not too much
• Belly: careful, it may be a trap
• Tail: just don't

A PURR YOU CAN HEAR AND FEEL
The purr is a real-time sound made right on your device, paired with soft vibration (on iPhones that support haptics), so it feels like a cat is purring in your hand. Turn the volume up and put it in your pocket if you like.

CHOOSE YOUR CAT
Pick from six cats: British Blue, Siamese, Ginger Tabby, Black, White and Grey Tabby.

A CAT ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the widget, choose a cat, and tap it right on your Home Screen to make it purr — without even opening the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and no internet connection needed. Pocket Purr collects nothing about you.

Take a breath. Pet the cat. Feel it purr.

name: Pocket Vending Machine
description:
Your own vending machine, right in your pocket.

Start with a single bottle of Spy Water. Fill your slots, sell snacks while you play or while you're away, and spend your profits on new products, new slots and more capacity. Before you know it, your machine is stacked with 50 of the funniest snacks you've never heard of.

FILL, SELL, REPEAT
• Unlock 50 snacks and drinks, from Spy Water to Swagnum, each worth more than the last
• Upgrade your slots so they hold more and earn more
• Your machine keeps selling while you're away, as long as there's stock
• Fully animated, with real vending sounds

A SECOND MACHINE
• Save up and open the toy machine, packed with toys that are almost, but not quite, the ones you know
• Two machines, more to come

GOALS AND REWARDS
• Daily missions with bonus coins and a jackpot that puts your machine in overdrive
• A daily reward for coming back
• Reminders when your machine is running low (only if you want them)

MAKE IT YOURS
• Paint your machine in one of five colors, more to come
• Buy the Cartoon style: every snack and toy hand-drawn, machine and menus too
• Try any style on your own machine before you buy it
• Work your way up to the ultimate 24K Gold machine with golden products

FAIR AND RELAXED
• No ads. Ever.
• No account needed
• Your progress is backed up to your own iCloud
• Optional boosts for players who want to go faster: 2x Profit, 2x Sell Speed and +2 slot capacity

Tap, fill, collect. How rich can you get with vending machines?

name: Pointe: Voice Coding
description:
Pointe is a voice layer for your coding agents. Talk to every Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode session on your Mac from your iPhone: ask what a session did, send another one work by saying its name, and answer permission prompts away from the keyboard.

The app needs Pointe on your Mac, which is free and open source: github.com/ballerine-io/pointe. Install it there, then pair this iPhone by scanning the code your Mac shows. No Mac yet? Tap "No Mac yet? Try a demo" on the first screen to use the app with sample sessions.

• Ask "what's billing doing?" and hear the answer. Say a session's name to talk to that session alone.
• See the exact command a session wants to run before you answer. Approve it with Face ID, or deny it with a tap.
• Read the conversation as it happens. Fix a misheard word, or type instead of talking.
• Mute Pointe to read its replies instead of hearing them, and skip to the next message.
• Start a new session, or add one that is already open on the Mac.
• Meeting notes, a briefing of what happened while you were away, Drive mode for the car, and the night shift for work that runs overnight.
• Start talking from the Lock Screen, Control Center, the Action button or a widget. Alerts tell you when a session needs you.

Privacy: the app connects only to your Mac, over an encrypted connection pinned to that Mac's certificate. There is no account, and the app has no analytics or tracking. Your Mac uses your own model keys, or models that run on the Mac.

Pointe is open source (MIT). Built and open-sourced by Ballerine Engineering.

name: Poker Rules: Learn to Play
description:
Poker Rules: Learn to Play and Interactive Rules (Updated for 2027)

Learn how to play poker, then settle any dispute at your table in seconds.

LEARN TO PLAY
• How to play 14 games: Texas Hold’em, Omaha, Omaha Hi-Lo, 5-Card Omaha, Big O, Short Deck Hold’em, Seven-Card Stud, Razz, Stud Hi-Lo, Five-Card Draw, A-5 Lowball, 2-7 Single Draw, 2-7 Triple Draw and Badugi.
• Watch a hand dealt for every game, step by step: the blinds, the deal, the flop, turn and river, every street and every draw, then the showdown.
• See which cards play. The showdown picks out the winning cards, and the Omaha pages show the two-plus-three rule.
• Start with Poker basics: the button, the blinds, betting and the showdown.

HAND RANKINGS
• Every ranking with drawn cards: high, Short Deck, A-5 low, 8 or better, 2-7 low and Badugi.

THE COMPLETE RULEBOOK
• 361 numbered rules in 17 chapters, for cash games and tournaments, with a glossary of poker terms.
• Standard rules in plain English. Tournament rules follow the 2026 rules of the Poker Tournament Directors Association (Poker TDA). Other rules follow Robert’s Rules of Poker, the most widely used rulebook for cardrooms.
• Worked examples with card illustrations.
• Save the rules you use most, and share a rule with a link.

SETTLE DISPUTES FAST
• Search every rule, term and game. Type “string bet”, “misdeal” or a rule number such as 5.8.
• Common disputes are one tap away: string bets, verbal declarations, acting out of turn, cards speak, showing your hand, misdeals and the dead button.
• Showdown: choose a game, deal in the cards, and the app reads every hand and names the winner. It splits hi-lo pots too.

FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with layouts for the Duo half open.
• Liquid Glass on iOS 26 and later.
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription. Pay once.

Poker Rules is written by Alex Scott, a poker writer and eGaming executive. You can also read the rules at scott.co.im/rules.

This app is not endorsed by the Poker TDA or by Robert Ciaffone.

name: Polar Drift
description:
Polar Drift turns a timed star drift into a polar-axis correction on this iPhone.

A star near the meridian checks azimuth. A star low in the east checks altitude. The error in arcminutes is 3.8197 times the drift in arcseconds, divided by the minutes and the cosine of the declination. Within 2 arcminutes is Aligned. From 2 to 5 is Close. Past 5 is Adjust. In the northern hemisphere a meridian star drifting south means the axis is too far east, so the correction is to turn west. The southern hemisphere reverses that. The longest exposure that stays inside one pixel is the pixel scale divided by the drift per minute.

Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Polarity Merge Actor
description: Every magnet has a number and a temper. Guide the red queen’s scattered charges across sixty compact courts, joining equal numbers with opposite poles until one charged crown remains. Matching poles push instead of merging, so a troublesome piece can become the space you need. Reverse a charge, thread a mirror cell, or slip through paired orbit doors. Each district introduces tighter arrangements and new decisions. Swipe individual magnets or use precise directional controls. Undo freely, chase three stars, and return for a daily circuit. No timers interrupt your thinking. Your unfinished court and personal records stay on your device.

name: Pom Pom Island
description:
Pom Pom Island is a cozy arena game where every round is a small, loud party.

Place a bomb, step out of the way, and watch the blast clear a path. Blow up blocks to uncover power-ups, corner your rivals, and try to be the last one standing before the arena starts to shrink.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Four players per round. Empty seats are filled by computer players that dodge, hunt for power-ups and fight back.
• Three power-ups: carry one more bomb, make blasts reach further, or move faster.
• Rounds are short. When time runs low, the arena closes in from the outside.

FOUR ARENAS
• Pom Pom Island — a green island in a turquoise sea
• Sand Ruins — brick walls and clay jars among the dunes
• Frozen Lake — ice blocks and packed snow
• Lava Heart — basalt and barrels above glowing lava
Wall layouts are reshuffled every round, so no two rounds are the same.

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
• Pick your animal: bear, bunny, cat or frog.
• The camera follows your character, so everything stays readable on a phone.
• Touch controls, game controllers and hardware keyboards are supported. With controllers, up to four people can play on one device.
• Calm original music for each arena.
• Ten languages.

NO STRINGS
• Free. No ads, no purchases.
• Works offline.
• Collects no data.

name: Ponder: Sermon & Church Notes
description:
Ponder records the sermon and writes it up for you: the big idea, the main points with the moment each one was said, every verse mentioned, and questions for your small group.

Record the whole message
• Keeps recording with your screen locked
• Saves every 5 minutes, so a phone call or a dead battery never costs you the sermon
• Tells you straight away if a call or another app pauses the recording
• Type your own notes while you listen, each one linked to that moment

Scan the slide
• Point your camera at the pastor's slide and the text goes into your notes, at that moment of the sermon
• Scan a bulletin, a sermon outline or a book page into a note of its own
• The text is read on your iPhone, and the photos never leave it

Missed Sunday, or watching online?
• Find your church's podcast and get notes from any episode
• Or import a recording you already have
• Watching the livestream? Set your iPhone next to the TV or laptop and record

The notes
• The big idea and a short summary
• Main points with times, so you can tap to hear that part again
• Every verse mentioned, with the text from a real Bible translation
• A transcript you can search and correct
• Edit anything in the notes

For your small group and your week
• Discussion questions and one step to take this week
• Share the group guide as a link anyone can open, no app needed
• Flashcards for the verses worth remembering
• A 5-day follow-up and a Sunday reminder, if you want them
• Share any verse or sermon quote as an image, or the whole notes page for your story

For kids
• A kids' version of every sermon: the big idea in simple words, the Bible story, three questions for the ride home and something to draw
• Print it on the kids' sheet, or send it to whoever has the kids

Print or save as PDF
• The full notes, laid out like our free sermon notes template
• A small group handout with room to write under each question
• The kids' sheet, filled in

Ask about the sermon
Ask a question and get an answer from what was actually preached, with the moment to replay.

Read the Bible
World English Bible, King James Version and Reina-Valera 1909 are built in and work offline. A verse of the day waits on the home screen, and can come as a morning notification if you want it.

In English and Spanish.

Your recordings stay on your iPhone
Recordings, slide photos and your own notes live on your device. Audio only leaves your phone when you ask for notes on a sermon, and it is deleted from our server once the notes are made. Signing in with Apple is optional and backs up your notes, never your recordings. No ads and no tracking.

Pricing
Recording, your own notes, scanning and the Bible are free, and so are the notes for your first sermon. After that, notes, the transcript and Ask are part of Ponder Pro, with a 7-day free trial. In the US Pro is $49.99 a year or $7.99 a month. There are no weekly plans. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

The notes, transcript and answers are written by AI from the recording and can contain mistakes. Check them against the recording and your Bible.

Terms of use: https://pondernotes.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://pondernotes.com/privacy

name: Pop & Learn: Kids Balloons
description:
Pop balloons and learn colors, numbers and shapes!

In Pop & Learn balloons float up the screen and a card at the top asks for something: a color, a number or a shape. A friendly voice reads it out. Pop five right balloons to fill a star. A wrong balloon is not a mistake: the voice simply says what it was, so children keep learning.

FEATURES
• Learn 7 colors, numbers 1 to 10 and 5 shapes
• Friendly voice in English or Turkish
• Nobody loses, no timers
• Big balloons that are easy to tap
• Purchases and links sit behind a parent check
• Play offline

For parents: Pop & Learn shows only child-directed, non-personalised ads and never tracks your child. A one-time Remove Ads purchase (behind a parent check) turns ads off.

name: Pop or Keep: Dating App
description:
Pop or Keep is a free dating app for people who want a serious relationship.

No endless swiping. You see 6 real singles near you at a time, each in a balloon with their photo. Open any balloon to see their full profile first: photos, answers, voice and video.

Remove the ones you don't like. Keep the ones you do. The last one you keep gets your request. If they say yes, you can chat.

WHY PEOPLE USE POP OR KEEP
• See 6 singles at a time, not one face after another
• See the full profile before you choose
• Real people with a verified selfie badge
• See who picked you
• Send a heart or a flower with a note about one photo or answer
• Ask them out for coffee, drinks, a walk or dinner in one tap
• Hear their voice and watch their profile video
• Chat with photos, voice notes and read receipts

SAFETY
• Report or block anyone from their profile or chat
• Hide words you never want to read
• A check in when you meet someone in person
• Photos are checked automatically before anyone sees them
• Delete your account any time, right in the app

Pop or Keep is free. New people every 12 hours.

You must be 18 or older to use Pop or Keep.

Terms: https://poporkeep.com/terms
Privacy: https://poporkeep.com/privacy

name: PortCairn
description:
Know where your cables and adapters belong. Record both connectors, cable length in centimetres, storage location and notes. Browse a parts grid, search the collection, filter by connector or packed status and group items by storage place. Mark a cable packed for travel and return it to storage with a tap. Edit or delete records at any time. This is a manual inventory: it does not detect connected devices or certify cable compatibility.

Free, no ads, no purchases and no login. Core records work offline and stay in local app storage. Eight interface languages and persistent System, Light or Dark appearance. Optional fictional samples can be loaded in Settings.

name: PortoGPS PRO
description:
PortoGps Pro es la app del servicio de rastreo GPS de PortoGps Pro. Muestra la ubicación, los recorridos, los reportes y las alertas de los vehículos que el cliente tiene contratados.

Las cuentas las crea PortoGps Pro para sus clientes: la app no permite crear cuentas.

Cuenta de demostración: (complétala en el panel, sección «Cuenta de demostración»)

Al entrar se ve el mapa con los vehículos de la cuenta. Los reportes están en el menú (Reportes) y las alertas llegan como notificaciones.

name: Posette: Pose Ideas & Camera
description:
Never wonder how to pose again.

Posette puts a pose guide right on your camera. Pick a pose, line yourself up with the see-through outline, and take the photo. It works whether a friend is holding the phone, your partner is, or the phone is propped against a water bottle.

78 POSES, READY TO COPY
• Standing, sitting and leaning poses for full-body shots
• Selfie poses for half-body and close-up photos
• Back-view poses for viewpoints and sunsets
• Couple poses for date nights and trips for two
• Besties poses for you and a friend
Every pose has a short description and a tip, so you know what to do with your hands, hips and feet.

A CAMERA THAT COACHES YOU
• The pose appears over the live camera as a guide
• Drag to move it and pinch to resize it until it fits the scene
• Fade it from barely there to solid
• Flip it left to right to match your good side
• Switch to a clean white silhouette when you only need the shape
• Hide it with one tap when you are ready to shoot

MADE FOR REAL PHOTOS
• Self-timer with 3, 5 and 10 second countdowns for hands-free shots
• Rule-of-thirds grid for better framing
• Front and back cameras, with quick zoom buttons
• Photos save straight to your library at full quality
• Save your favourite poses so they are one tap away

Hand your phone to anyone. The guide shows them the framing and shows you the pose, so you get the shot you had in mind on the first try.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. The camera runs on your phone and your photos go to your own library and nowhere else.

Perfect for travel photos, outfit pictures, couple photos, photoshoots with friends, and anyone who freezes the moment a camera comes out.

name: Pour Line: Water Glass Puzzle
description:
Fill each glass exactly to the line. Not a drop over, not a drop short.

Pour Line is a calm, satisfying water pouring game about one simple skill: knowing when to stop. Hold anywhere to pour, let go to stop, and watch real physics carry the water into the glass. Stop right on the dotted target line for a Perfect pour.

It sounds easy. Then the glass changes shape.

HOW TO PLAY
• Hold anywhere on the screen to pour water from the tap
• Let go when you think the water will settle on the line
• You get one pour per try: once you let go, the tap is done
• Remember: the water still falling will land in the glass too
• Hit the line for a Perfect, earn up to three stars, and never let it overflow
• Missed it? Retry in one tap and pour again

EVERY GLASS POURS DIFFERENTLY
A tall Highball rises fast and steady. A wide Bowl barely seems to fill. A Hurricane glass narrows and swells, a Flute tests your patience, and a Wine glass fools your eye. Each glass, from Pint and Jar to Carafe, Tumbler and Vase, asks you to read its curve before you pour. Wide at the top? The water level slows down. Narrow neck? It shoots up in a moment. Learning each shape is half the fun.

REAL WATER PHYSICS
Every pour is simulated live, so no two pours are exactly alike. The water flows from the tap, splashes into the glass, sloshes and slowly settles. You judge it by eye, the same way you would pour a drink at home. Precision and timing win, not luck.

A SATISFYING PUZZLE FOR SHORT BREAKS
Each level takes seconds to play and a lifetime to master. Pour Line is a relaxing game for a coffee break, a commute or winding down before bed. There are no timers rushing you and no lives to run out of. Just you, a glass and the line.

CHASE THE PERFECT POUR
• See your accuracy after every pour
• Earn up to three stars on every glass
• Collect stars to unlock new levels
• Replay any level from the level map to beat your best

FEATURES
• Fill the glass puzzle with realistic liquid physics
• One-touch controls: play with one hand, anywhere
• Hand-shaped glasses, each with its own curve and challenge
• Accuracy score, star ratings and Perfect pours to chase
• Calm, warm visuals and gentle pouring sounds
• Haptic feedback on every pour (can be turned off)
• Sound and haptics settings
• Plays offline: no Wi-Fi needed and no account required
• Free to play with ads; one purchase removes them for good

WHO IS IT FOR?
Pour Line is for anyone who enjoys satisfying games, physics puzzles, brain teasers and games of skill and precision. If you like casual games you can pick up in a second, or you are the friend who always pours the drinks just right, this water puzzle is for you. It is simple enough for anyone to learn and tricky enough to keep you coming back for one more pour.

TIPS FOR A PERFECT POUR
• Watch the shape of the glass, not just the line
• Let go a little early: the stream in the air still has to land
• Wide glasses forgive, narrow glasses punish
• You get one pour per try, so commit to the moment you let go

PRIVACY
Pour Line asks for your consent to personalized ads and anonymous play stats where required, and lets you change your choices at any time in Settings. You can also restore your Remove Ads purchase from Settings.

Grab the glass, steady your hand and fill it to the line. How many Perfect pours can you make?

name: PourCraft: Pour-Over Coffee
description:
PourCraft guides every bloom, swirl, and pour with calm tactile precision so you dial in cafe-grade filter coffee at home.

Scale any V60, Chemex, Kalita, or AeroPress recipe automatically by coffee dose and keep tasting notes for every bag of beans.

KEY FEATURES
• Guided Multi-Stage Brew Timer: Subtle haptic cues tell you exactly when and how much to pour.
• Smart Dose & Water Ratio Scaling: Adjust grams of coffee and every pour step recalculates live.
• Bean & Grind Tasting Journal: Log roaster, origin, grind click setting, water temp, and flavor notes.
• 100% Offline & Ad-Free: Built for peaceful morning rituals with zero login.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock unlimited custom recipes, bean cellar log, and full brew history.

name: Practicebox: Tuner & Metronome
description:
Practicebox is a tuner, a metronome and a practice timer in one iPhone app. Tune your instrument, keep the beat and work through your practice in sections, all in one place. No account, no ads, no subscription, no purchase.

TUNE
• Chromatic tuner: hears any note through the microphone, including low ones
• 9 instruments: guitar (6 and 12 strings), bass (4 and 5 strings), ukulele, violin, viola, cello and mandolin
• More than 20 alternative tunings such as Drop D and DADGAD, plus your own tunings, saved on your iPhone
• Reference pitch from 415 to 466 Hz, saved the moment you change it; seven temperaments from equal to Werckmeister III
• Reference tone to play along with, note names as C D E, C D E with B, or Do Re Mi, and transposition for B-flat, E-flat and F instruments
• Cents and Hz, plus a short trace of the last seconds
• The microphone listens only while you tune. The sound is analyzed on your iPhone and never recorded or stored

KEEP THE BEAT
• Tempo from 30 to 300 beats per minute, time signatures and subdivisions (eighths, triplets, sixteenths)
• Accent every beat: strong, medium, soft or silent
• Tap tempo and 8 built-in sounds, all generated in the app
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Vibration on the beat while the app is open
• Tempo trainer: a bit faster every few bars until you reach your target tempo
• Polyrhythm with two layers, for example 3 against 4
• Stage mode: big display, screen stays on, protection against stray taps
• Save rhythms and sort them into setlists

PRACTICE
• Practice timer with sections, for example warm-up 5 minutes, technique 10 minutes, piece 15 minutes
• Practice time, streak and weekly goal, with no levels and no badges
• Optional reminder as a notification from your iPhone, no server involved
• Widget with your streak and practice time, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Practicebox is free, with no subscription, no ads and no account. There is no server: your settings, tunings, rhythms and practice time stay on your iPhone and are never sent to us. Create a backup file whenever you like and load it again on any iPhone. Light and dark mode, large text and VoiceOver included.

For iPhone, in English and German.

Ideas or bugs? Tap "Feedback & Ideas" in the app or write to kontakt@fairapps.at. Practicebox is part of FairApps, a series of fair apps from Vienna.

name: Prava 24: Prava Imtihon YHQ
description:
Prava 24 — подготовка к теоретическому экзамену на водительские права в Узбекистане.

В приложении все 61 билет и 1 212 вопросов экзамена с картинками и правильными ответами. Учите правила по темам, проверяйте себя на пробном экзамене и повторяйте темы, в которых ошибаетесь чаще всего.

ЧТО ВНУТРИ
• Все билеты — 61 билет по 20 вопросов, как на настоящем экзамене.
• 42 темы — дорожные знаки, разметка, проезд перекрёстков, обгон, остановка и стоянка и другие разделы ПДД.
• Пробный экзамен — 20 вопросов в формате настоящего экзамена.
• AI-объяснения — разбор, почему правильный ответ именно такой.
• Слабые места — видно, какие темы даются хуже всего и что повторить в первую очередь.
• Офлайн-режим — занимайтесь без интернета.
• Три языка — узбекский (латиница и кириллица) и русский.

Prava 24 не является официальным приложением государственных органов. Вопросы соответствуют экзаменационным билетам ПДД Республики Узбекистан.

name: Prava Mashq
description:
Prava Mashq помогает подготовиться к теоретическому экзамену на водительские права в Узбекистане и потренироваться на автодроме перед практикой. Всё на телефоне и без рекламы. Приложение полностью бесплатное.

Это независимое учебное приложение. Оно не связано ни с одним государственным органом и не является официальным ресурсом. Текст правил дорожного движения взят из открытой публикации на lex.uz, редакция от 30.10.2026.

Что внутри

Билеты. По 20 вопросов, как на экзамене.
Темы. Можно тренировать только то, что получается хуже.
Настоящий экзамен. 20 вопросов, 25 минут, для сдачи нужно 18 верных ответов.
Ошибки. Приложение собирает вопросы, в которых вы ошиблись, и возвращает к ним.
Сохранённые вопросы. Отмечайте то, что хотите повторить.
Марафон. Вопросы подряд, пока хватает сил.
Статистика. Видно, как идёт подготовка и какова вероятность сдать.
Дорожные знаки. Справочник со значением каждого знака.
3D автодром. Симулятор 12 упражнений практического экзамена. За ошибки начисляются штрафные баллы, и вы сразу видите, за что. Держите телефон горизонтально.

Узбекский на латинице, узбекский на кириллице и русский. Язык можно менять в любой момент. Тренироваться можно без интернета.

Приложение полностью бесплатное: все билеты, темы, режим настоящего экзамена и автодром. Покупок внутри приложения нет.

Начать можно без аккаунта. Чтобы сохранять прогресс на нескольких устройствах, войдите через Apple или Google. Удалить аккаунт и синхронизированные данные можно прямо в приложении.

Нашли ошибку в вопросе? Нажмите «Xato bormi?» и отправьте сообщение. Видеоуроки скоро появятся.

В приложении нет рекламы, сторонней аналитики и трекеров.

Права с первой попытки.

-----

Prava Mashq haydovchilik guvohnomasi nazariy imtihoniga tayyorlanishga va amaliy imtihondan oldin avtodromda mashq qilishga yordam beradi. Hammasi telefoningizda va reklamasiz. Ilova to'liq bepul.

Bu mustaqil o'quv ilova. U hech qanday davlat organi bilan bog'liq emas va rasmiy manba hisoblanmaydi. Yo'l harakati qoidalari matni lex.uz saytidagi ochiq nashrdan olingan, 30.10.2026 tahriri.

Ichida nima bor

Biletlar. Imtihondagidek 20 tadan savol.
Mavzular. Faqat qiyin kelayotgan mavzuni mashq qilish mumkin.
Haqiqiy imtihon. 20 savol, 25 daqiqa, o'tish uchun 18 ta to'g'ri javob kerak.
Xatolar. Ilova xato qilgan savollaringizni yig'ib, qayta ham ko'rsatadi.
Saqlangan savollar. Qaytarmoqchi bo'lganingizni belgilab qo'ying.
Marafon. Charchamaguncha ketma-ket savollar.
Statistika. Tayyorgarlik qanday ketayotgani va imtihondan o'tish ehtimoli ko'rinadi.
Yo'l belgilari. Har bir belgining ma'nosi bilan ma'lumotnoma.
3D avtodrom. Amaliy imtihonning 12 mashqi simulyatori. Xatolar uchun jarima ballari beriladi va nima uchun ekani darhol ko'rinadi. Telefonni yonboshlatib ushlang.

O'zbek lotin, o'zbek kirill va rus tillari. Tilni istalgan payt almashtirish mumkin. Internetsiz ham mashq qilasiz.

Ilovada hamma narsa bepul: barcha biletlar, mavzular, imtihon rejimi va avtodrom. Reklama yo'q.

Mashqni ro'yxatdan o'tmasdan boshlash mumkin. Taraqqiyotni bir necha qurilmada saqlamoqchi bo'lsangiz, Apple yoki Google orqali kiring. Hisobni va sinxronlangan ma'lumotlarni ilovaning o'zida o'chirish mumkin.

Savolda xato topdingizmi? «Xato bormi?» tugmasini bosib yuboring. Video darslar tez orada qo'shiladi.

Ilovada reklama, uchinchi tomon analitikasi va kuzatuvchi vositalar yo'q.

Pravaga birinchi urinishda.

name: Prayer Time Plus -KW
description:
Prayer Time Plus shows accurate daily prayer times, a live Qibla compass and map, and optional alerts. It is built in Kuwait by Smart Tech.

Kuwait City is the default place, using the Kuwait calculation method: Fajr at 18°, Isha at 17.5°, Maghrib at sunset, and standard Asr. You can use your iPhone’s location instead, or choose any place on the map. Each place uses its own time zone. The method can follow the country automatically, or you can pick one yourself: Kuwait, Muslim World League, ISNA, Egypt, Umm al-Qura, Karachi, UAE (GAIAE), Qatar, Morocco (Habous), Diyanet, or Kemenag. Hanafi Asr and high-latitude rules are available.

Times are calculated on your device. No account is required.

Optional prayer alerts are off by default. You can turn on a notification for each prayer, set how many minutes earlier it should fire, and also enable Friday prayer, Sunrise, and Midnight.

The Qibla screen has a compass with a Kaaba marker at the top and a satellite map. The arrow turns green when you are facing the Qibla. Indoors, or near metal and electronics, the compass can be less accurate; the app can point you to the map in those cases.

Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, an Apple Watch app with corner complications, and Mac widgets keep the next prayer in view. The app is in Arabic and English, including right-to-left layout, and supports light and dark appearance. The iPhone app is portrait only.

Prayer Time Plus is from Smart Tech for Devices & Security Systems Co. S.P.C, Kuwait.

name: Prayer Times by Mr. Asad
description:
Your salah times, to the minute, for exactly where you are.

Prayer Times by Mr. Asad is a simple, calm prayer times app. Open it, see the next prayer and how long until it starts, and close it. No adverts, no feeds and no account.

What you get:
- The five daily prayers worked out on your iPhone for your exact spot, including your height above sea level, so sunrise and Maghrib land on the right minute
- Separate Hanafi and Shafi switches for Asr and Isha, one tap each
- Sunrise and zawal shown quietly, so you know when Fajr ends and when not to pray
- Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets with a live countdown to the next prayer
- An alert the moment each prayer starts, chosen prayer by prayer
- Times that follow you when you travel, or pick any town by name
- Made for every iPhone, including the folding iPhone, open or closed

How the times are worked out:
Fajr when the sun is 18 degrees below the horizon. Sunrise and Maghrib when the sun's edge meets your horizon. Zuhr at solar noon. Asr by the shadow rule, twice an object's length for Hanafi and once for Shafi. Isha at 18 degrees for Hanafi and 12 degrees for Shafi. On summer nights when the twilight never fades, Fajr is the darkest point of the night and the app tells you there is no Hanafi Isha time.

Free: today's prayer times in the app.

Membership: £8.99 a month in the UK. Widgets, prayer alerts and tomorrow and the days ahead. No free trial. It renews every month until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before it renews in Settings, then your name, then Subscriptions.

Your location stays on your iPhone. Made by Huddle Duck Ltd.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://prayer.asadshah.co.uk/terms
Privacy: https://prayer.asadshah.co.uk/privacy

name: PrenotaUnCampo.eu
description:
Il campo è libero? Prendilo.

Con PrenotaUnCampo vedi in tempo reale gli orari liberi dei centri sportivi e prenoti il campo in trenta secondi: padel, tennis, calcetto, calcio, beach volley, basket e altro, in tutta Italia.

• Orari liberi in tempo reale, campo per campo
• Nessuna commissione: paghi in struttura, oppure online se il centro lo prevede
• Regole di disdetta chiare prima di prenotare
• Le tue prenotazioni sempre a portata di mano, con promemoria
• Trova giocatori per completare la partita, o unisciti a una partita aperta
• Tornei e ranking del circolo: sfide, risultati e classifiche
• Notifiche quando qualcuno ti scrive, ti sfida o si libera un orario

Gestisci un centro sportivo? PrenotaUnCampo è gratuito anche per te: calendario, prenotazioni online e telefoniche, ore fisse, tornei e incassi, senza canone.

name: Prep Book | Recipe Calculator
description:
Enter today's quantity on a saved recipe and get a production sheet.

Prep Book is a recipe scaling app for owners and head chefs of small restaurants and bakeries. Save a standard recipe once, then change only the day's quantity to get per-batch amounts and a production sheet.

SAVE YOUR RECIPES
Set a base yield in portions, pieces, weight, or volume, and add ingredients and sub-recipes. You can also set a maximum batch yield for your equipment and a loss allowance for what dividing and shaping lose. Mark an ingredient as flour to see each ingredient weighed by mass as a percentage of flour.

IMPORT A RECIPE YOU ALREADY HAVE
Tap Import recipe to paste a recipe's text, choose a screenshot or a photo of a printed recipe, or take a photo. The text in an image is read on the device. The camera is optional: you can paste text or choose from photos without it. Every line is shown next to what was read, and every value read waits for you: nothing is saved until you confirm it or remove its line. On supported devices with iOS 26 or later, Suggest values asks the on-device model for values on lines that need a fix. A suggestion is used only when you choose it, and you still confirm the line yourself.

CHOOSE HOW EACH INGREDIENT SCALES
Tell apart ingredients that scale with the quantity, that go into every batch in the same amount, that go in once per run, and that have no fixed amount, such as "to taste." When you round up an amount, the exact value is kept and shown beside it.

ENTER A QUANTITY AND REVIEW THE RESULT
Enter a target quantity to see the number of batches, the amounts in each batch, and any sub-recipes. Items that need a look are flagged, and you can use a different amount for this run only.

SHARE OR PRINT THE SHEET
Make a one-page PDF production sheet to share or print. A saved production run stays as it was, even after you edit the recipe.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
No account is needed, and your recipes and production history stay on the device. Back up your recipe library to a file and restore it later. Phones and tablets, landscape, and split screen are all supported.

SEE WHAT A RECIPE COSTS
Enter ingredient purchase prices to see what a recipe costs.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE TO UNLOCK
The free version holds one recipe, archived recipes included, and every feature works on it. A one-time in-app purchase lets you save as many recipes as you need. There is no subscription.

name: PrepDesk by Zulfah
description:
Your next chapter starts with a little practice.

PrepDesk brings school assessments and independent exam preparation into one simple learner app. Practise at your own pace, find your next step and keep track of your progress.

PREPARE FOR YOUR NEXT EXAM
Explore original samples and preparation activities for JAMB/UTME, WAEC/SSCE, NECO, BECE/JSCE, Post-UTME and other supported exam categories. Set a preparation goal and use free diagnostics to find a starting point.

STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR SCHOOL
Find invitations and assigned assessments in My School. Join using the account or access details your organiser provides. Eligible school-sponsored tests are available without a personal payment; your organiser controls enrolment, availability and attempt limits.

MAKE PRACTICE A HABIT
Try daily challenges and topic activities. Earn XP through eligible practice activities and see your progress as you learn. Available activities depend on your account access.

LEARN FROM EACH ATTEMPT
Take timed assessments, review available results and explanations, and save useful revision material. Results and feedback depend on the assessment settings chosen by your organiser.

A CALMER LEARNING SPACE
Move between My School and Exam Prep, choose light or dark appearance, and keep your learning in one place. An internet connection is required for sign-in, live tests and synchronisation. Previously saved revision material can be reviewed offline where available.

PrepDesk is intended for learners aged 13 and over. A learner account is required. Schools and organisers may see results for assessments they administer.

PrepDesk's original mock questions and samples support preparation. PrepDesk is not affiliated with JAMB, WAEC, NECO or other examining bodies, and does not administer official examinations or guarantee exam outcomes.

Support: https://prepdesk.ng/support
Privacy: https://prepdesk.ng/privacy
Account deletion: https://prepdesk.ng/delete-account
Contact: info@zulfahgroup.com

name: PrimePrixLab
description:
Primeprixlab is a private desk for shared costs and supplier bills. It stays on your iPhone. There is no account, no upload, and no public board.

Open a ledger for a trip, a flat, a gathering, or a small workshop bench. Add a line, choose who paid, and split it equally, by ratio, or with custom amounts. Private lines stay out of the pot. On-behalf lines give the payer a zero share. Held lines wait until you confirm them. The clearing then says who pays whom. Mark a payment when the money actually moves.

Bills keep supplier invoices and household dues, with unpaid, past due, and paid marks. The tally reads the month against budgets. File a statement when the month looks right. Search, the household list, and the log all stay on this phone.

A sample desk is already loaded so you can see a full book. Edit it, or clear it in On this phone. Receipt photos, if you add them, remain in the app’s private folder.

Faircove does not move money and does not replace a bank. It is the book you keep beside the table.

name: Prinio
description:
Turn an idea into a print you can picture on a real garment. Prinio gives you a practical place to create artwork, decide where it belongs, and prepare a clear design to share with your printer.
Start with a blank canvas or a template, then add text, shapes, and your own photos. Arrange the elements until the design feels right. Try it on a T-shirt, hoodie, sweatshirt, tank top, tote bag, or cap, and adjust the print’s position and size. You can also see supported front designs on male and female models to get a better sense of the finished look.
Use size references to compare common print dimensions and check your color choices as you work. When you are ready to share, export your artwork, a garment mockup, or a print specification PDF with the details your printer needs.
Your designs stay . Prinio helps you move from a rough idea to a print plan you can see and discuss with confidence.

name: PrintNest: Printer App & Scan
description:
PrintNest turns your iPhone into a simple print and scan station. Choose your Wi-Fi printer once, then print with a single tap.

PRINT ANYTHING
• Photos: full page, 2, 4 or 9 per page, with crop and rotate
• Passport photos and ID cards at real size
• Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images
• Web pages and notes, with a large-text option
• Anything you share from other apps with the Share button

SCAN, SIGN AND CREATE
• Scan paper documents to PDF with the camera
• Extract the text from scans, then copy or share it
• Sign PDFs and add text, dates and check marks
• Ready-made templates: monthly and yearly calendars, weekly and daily planners, to-do and shopping lists, habit tracker, meal plan, lined, grid, dot and music paper
• Address label sheets, contact pages and business cards

MADE TO BE EASY
• Works with Wi-Fi printers that support AirPrint: no cables, no drivers
• See exactly what will print before you print
• Home screen widgets and Siri shortcuts
• A4 and Letter paper
• Step-by-step printer setup and troubleshooting help

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and documents are processed on your iPhone and sent only to your printer. No account needed.

PRINTNEST PRO
Your first 3 prints are free. PrintNest Pro unlocks unlimited printing with a weekly or yearly subscription. New subscribers may get a free trial on the weekly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://printnest.megstudio.xyz/privacy/

name: Printslot Passport Photo Booth
description:
Make a passport or ID photo on your iPhone. Choose the country issuing your passport and Printslot sets the print size or tells you where the photo needs to be taken.

Take your time in the booth. Use the camera, set a three-second timer, or choose a portrait from Photos. Zoom in on the preview and retake as often as you like.

For a passport
Printslot covers 15 issuing countries. Each supported print route has its own framing and background checks. Passport prints keep the original scene and lighting. If your application needs a passport office, approved booth or photographer, you can open the issuing authority’s instructions.

For another ID
Choose 2 × 2 in, 35 × 45 mm, 40 × 50 mm or 50 × 70 mm. For IDs that allow edits, Printslot places you on white and can correct a small tilt or uneven lighting. Switch between Original and Booth photo to inspect your hair, shoulders and expression.

For the print
One in-app purchase unlocks the photo you choose. Save a watermark-free JPEG to Photos, share it, or print two copies on a 4 × 6 inch sheet with corner marks. You can export it again from My photos while it’s saved on that iPhone.

Your iPhone processes the image locally. The booth checks the finished print and flags problems that call for another shot. Your issuing authority makes the final decision on acceptance.

name: Prismivo
description:
Drag. Link. Strike.

Prismivo is a color-linking battle puzzle where every connection decides the fight. You and a CPU rival share one board of glowing crystals. Drag across three or more touching crystals of the same color to unleash their power, then watch your rival answer back. Out-think the board, protect your core and shatter theirs.

SIX CRYSTALS, SIX POWERS
Each crystal has its own color, shape and symbol, so you can read the board at a glance:
- Red: Attack - damage your rival's shield, then their core
- Blue: Shield - build a barrier up to 60 points
- Green: Recovery - heal your core
- Yellow: Energy - charge your Prism power up to 100
- Purple: Pierce - slip damage straight through shields
- Orange: Disrupt - tear down enemy shields, and drain their power on long links

LONGER LINKS, BIGGER COMBOS
Connect in any of 8 directions without reusing a crystal. A 4-link adds 25%, a 5-link adds 50%, and a 6+ link doubles the effect and forges a rainbow Prism wildcard. Climb from NICE LINK to POWER CIRCUIT, PRISM SURGE, CHROMATIC BURST and the legendary MEGA COMBO.

THREE SPECIAL ABILITIES
When your power reaches 100, choose your moment:
- Prism Blast - a heavy strike of 30 damage
- Crystal Fortress - +40 shield and +15 health
- Spectrum Break - remove up to 25 shield and deal 15 direct damage

40 LEVELS, 4 CHAPTERS
Fight your way up a glowing journey map:
- Chapter 1: learn the circuit on a compact 5x5 board
- Chapter 2: frozen crystals appear and must be thawed
- Chapter 3: locked positions change how the board falls
- Chapter 4: 7x7 expert boards where frozen and locked crystals combine
Face a unique boss at levels 10, 20, 30 and 40, each with its own layout and battle strategy. Earn up to three stars per level based on how much health you keep.

A SMART, FAIR RIVAL
The CPU plays by the same rules as you. It never peeks at hidden information and never cheats. Early rivals play casually, while later rivals plan ahead, defend, disrupt and punish mistakes. Bosses each have a distinct personality: aggressor, fortress, disruptor and tactician.

NEVER STUCK
If the board runs out of valid links, it reshuffles itself automatically at no cost to either side.

PRISM VAULT
Track your journey in the Vault: win rate, streaks, damage dealt, your largest connection and performance charts. Unlock 15+ achievements, and tune sound, music and haptics to your taste.

FEATURES
- Fast, tactical, portrait-friendly play for all iPhone sizes
- Polished animated visuals with crystal shapes that stay readable for color-blind players
- Interactive tutorial for new players
- Continue Battle: pick up exactly where you left off
- Fully offline, no account, no ads, no data collection
- Original synthesized sound and music with haptic feedback

Ready your core. Link the circuit. Break the prism.

name: Prismora: Gem Match Puzzle
description:
Prismora is a polished match-3 puzzle game built for quick, satisfying sessions.

Swap two neighbouring gems to line up three or more of the same colour. Clear them, set off chain reactions and climb through 30 handcrafted levels, each with its own goal.

POWERFUL SPECIAL GEMS
- Match 4 to create a Line Gem that clears a whole row or column.
- Match in an L or T shape to create a Bomb that blasts a 3x3 area.
- Match 5 to create a Color Bomb: swap it with any gem to clear every gem of that colour.
- Swap two special gems together for an even bigger blast.

A FRESH CHALLENGE ON EVERY LEVEL
- Reach the target score, collect the gems you need, or break all the ice.
- Thin ice and thick ice that needs two hits.
- Stones that crack when you match next to them.
- Boards in new shapes: hearts, crosses, pillars and more.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Earn up to three stars on every level and replay to beat your best.
- Leftover moves turn into bonus points once you complete the goal.
- A hint appears if you get stuck.
- Play offline, anywhere.
- No ads and no tracking. Prismora does not collect any data.

How far can you go? Start matching today.

name: ProCheckChecklist
description:
**ProCheck Checklist — Interactive Aircraft Checklists**

**Tap it. Check it. Reset it.**

ProCheck Checklist brings interactive aircraft checklists to your iPhone and iPad.

Unlike traditional paper checklists, ProCheck connects checklist items directly to related procedures, performance charts, and aircraft operating information, helping pilots access useful references without searching through multiple pages.

**Key Features:**
- Interactive normal and emergency checklists
- Direct links to related procedures and performance charts
- Aircraft-specific checklist packages
- Offline access for cockpit use
- Day and night display modes
- Simple checklist completion and reset
- Quick navigation between procedures

Choose your aircraft and purchase its checklist directly within the app.

Designed to complement your aircraft's approved operating documents, ProCheck makes cockpit checklist navigation straightforward and convenient.

**Important:** ProCheck is a supplemental reference tool and does not replace the approved aircraft flight manual, required operating documents, or pilot judgment.

name: Proguessive
description:
Describe it. Act it out. Say one word.

Proguessive is the team guessing game for a room full of friends. Grab 4 to 20 people and everyone's phone: you write the phrases, the game picks the teams, and every screen keeps the timer, the turn and the score in step.

HOW IT WORKS
• Host a game and share the 5-character code. Friends join on their own phones with just their name. No accounts.
• Everyone adds 5 people, places or things to the hat.
• The game splits you into Team Alpha and Team Bravo, with a turn order, so nobody gets picked last.
• Teams take turns giving clues against the clock. A guessed card scores and leaves the hat. Skip up to twice a turn, and the card goes to the back.

THREE ROUNDS, ONE HAT
The same phrases come back every round, with fewer ways to clue them.
• Round 1, Describe: say anything except the words on the card. 60 seconds a turn.
• Round 2, Gestures: act it out. No talking, no sounds. 45 seconds a turn.
• Round 3, One Word: exactly one word. 30 seconds a turn.
You'll know every card by round three. The trick is getting your team there with one word.

EVERY PHONE, ONE GAME
• Only the clue-giver sees the card. Everyone else watches the clock and the score.
• Turns, the countdown and both scores update on every phone the moment they change.
• Your screen stays awake for the whole game.
• When the last round ends, the host starts a rematch and everyone follows into the new game.

Made for game nights, parties and family get-togethers. No ads, no in-app purchases.

Privacy: https://proguessive.com/privacy

name: Propin Campo
description:
Propin Campo es la app de terreno de Propin para los equipos de venta de las empresas que usan la plataforma Propin. Cada vendedor ve su día y registra lo que pasa en cada visita. El equipo comercial lo recibe al instante en el panel web.

Qué podés hacer:

• Ver tu día de un vistazo: rutas, paradas en orden y cuánto llevás visitado.
• Seguir la ruta en el mapa, con tu ubicación y cómo llegar a cada parada.
• Registrar una visita en tres pasos: qué pasó, cómo fue y si la oportunidad avanza.
• Dictar la visita por voz. La app completa el formulario y vos solo revisás.
• Calificar cada sitio, agendar la revisita y mover la oportunidad de venta en el momento.
• Cargar fotos, contactos y sitios nuevos que encontrás en el camino.
• Trabajar sin señal: la ruta y el mapa quedan en el teléfono, y lo que cargás se envía solo cuando vuelve la conexión.

Propin Campo es para usuarios de empresas clientes de Propin. Necesitás una cuenta que te da tu empresa; no se crean cuentas desde la app.

Más información: https://www.propin.ai

name: ProTradesMax
description:
ProTradesMax Tech is the field app for technicians on a ProTradesMax team. Your day, your work orders and your time are in your pocket, and everything you do in the field lands in the office as you do it.

MY DAY
• See today's work orders in order, with the customer, address and what's wrong
• Clock in, drive, arrive on site, take a break and clock out from one card
• A Live Activity keeps your clock on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Look ahead at the next seven days and review your hours in My Time

ON THE JOB
• Open a work order for the site's access notes, contacts and equipment
• Work through procedures and checklists step by step
• Log the parts you used and request the ones you need
• Write the service report: complaint, cause and correction
• Take photos of the work and file them on the work order
• Leave notes for the office and @mention a teammate
• Capture the customer's signature to sign off the job

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Basements, rooftops and rural sites don't stop you. Every change is saved on the phone first and syncs on its own when you're back online, and the sync tray shows what's still waiting.

PRIVACY
Location is only recorded while you are clocked in, so dispatch can see where the team is and plan the next job. It stops the moment you clock out.

ProTradesMax Tech requires a ProTradesMax company account. Your office invites you from the ProTradesMax web app at app.protradesmax.com.

name: Provelta
description:
Provelta is a football academy platform for coaches, academy directors and club staff who develop young players over seasons, not single sessions.

It replaces the usual scatter of spreadsheets, notebooks and group chats with one record per player — so a decision about a 13-year-old can be traced back to the training, matches, tests and coach observations it actually came from.

SQUAD AND CLUB
• Players, teams, age groups and positions in one roster
• Player profiles with photo, physical details and development history
• Role-based access for academy directors, coaches, parents and players
• Multi-club architecture with isolated data per club
• A shareable pre-registration form and follow-up of incoming prospects

TRAINING AND MATCHES
• Plan training sessions and record attendance
• Drill library: share drill cards across the club and add them to a session plan
• Build match lineups, log minutes, goals and assists
• Capture coach observations against the specific session or match they belong to

PERFORMANCE LAB
• Run movement tests using the device camera: sprint, counter-movement jump, 5-0-5 agility, single-leg balance and reaction time
• Record results manually or import them from existing measurements
• Review sessions, measurements and benchmark comparisons over time
A camera-based test uses your device's camera on-device to time and track the movement. Results support coaching judgement; they do not replace it.

GOALKEEPER DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY
• A goalkeeper-specific test battery: reactive agility plus left and right lateral movement tests, including the difference between sides (asymmetry)
• Catching, one-on-one, cross handling, kicking and throwing accuracy measured as a percentage over a fixed number of attempts
• Measured values and coach ratings are labelled separately and never blended
• Post-match behaviour observations are visible only to the player's own coaches and club management; no scores or colours, and never shown in the parent or player portal

ATHLETIC DEVELOPMENT
• Track development areas and focus points per player
• See squad-level coverage across physical development areas
• Connect test results to the area they inform

PROVELTA ASSISTANT
• Speak an observation after a session instead of typing it
• The assistant identifies the player from the spoken full name and turns the note into structured development evidence
• Every interpretation is reviewed by the coach before it is saved — accept, edit or reject

PARENT AND PLAYER PORTALS
• Parents follow their own child's schedule, matches, announcements and payments
• Parents report absences, give or withdraw event and photo/video consent, and book a meeting in a slot the coach has opened
• Players see their own training, matches and development
• Each portal is scoped to that family's data only

REPORTS AND COMMUNICATION
• Development reports built from recorded evidence
• Club announcements and messaging
• Dues and payment records for club administration
• Optional phone notifications for training, matches, reports, announcements and messages. A notification shows only a general heading — never a child's name, an amount or message content

BUILT FOR REAL USE
• Full Turkish and English interface, switchable in the app
• Light, dark and system appearance
• Works on iPhone and iPad

ACCOUNT AND DATA
You can delete your account and its data from inside the app at any time (profile menu → Delete account), or at https://provelta.app/account-deletion.

Provelta requires an account provided by your club. It is a professional tool for football academies, not a consumer game or fitness tracker.

Privacy policy: https://provelta.app/privacy
Terms: https://provelta.app/terms

name: Prox Games
description:
Eleven games. Endless possibilities. One purchase.

Prox Games brings classic favorites and original strategy games together in one exciting collection. Challenge a friend across the room, compete online from miles away, or sharpen your skills against a computer opponent.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

• Computer — Play offline against a challenging but beatable computer opponent.
• Nearby — Challenge a friend or family member on a nearby device.
• Internet — Invite friends to play from wherever they are using an Internet connection.

ELEVEN GAMES INCLUDED

• Prox Recon — Deploy your forces and outsmart your opponent in a tactical game of search and strategy.
• Prox Bags — Enjoy a virtual game of cornhole with 3D graphics and interactive throwing controls.
• Prox Chess — Challenge your strategic thinking in the timeless game of chess.
• Prox Checkers — Capture opposing pieces and work your way toward victory.
• Prox Four — Drop your pieces and connect four in a row before your opponent.
• Prox Dots — Connect dots, complete boxes, and claim more territory than your opponent.
• Prox TicTacToe — Enjoy the classic three-in-a-row challenge.
• Prox Flip — Surround and flip opposing discs to take control of the board.
• Prox Stones — Distribute and capture stones in a classic Mancala-style strategy game.
• Prox Cipher — Crack secret launch codes before your opponent unleashes a hilarious surprise.
• Prox Grid — Build electrical networks, power districts, capture territory, and outmaneuver your opponent.

ONE PURCHASE. ALL THE GAMES.

• All eleven games included.
• Future game additions included at no additional cost.
• No advertisements.
• No subscriptions.
• No in-app purchases.
• No annoying review prompts.

Designed for iPhone and iPad, Prox Games offers something for everyone, from quick casual challenges to engaging strategic battles.

Play your favorites, discover something new, and enjoy a growing collection of games with friends, family, or the computer.

Get close. Connect. Compete.

Prox Games — an IndieCodr creation.

name: Pryio ：Memory
description:
Prylo is a logbook for people who measure sundial shadows by hand. If you build, adjust, or check a sundial and still write readings on paper, it keeps those numbers organized and comparable — entirely on your device, with no account and no network connection.

Work from a dial profile: record the sundial's gnomon length in millimetres plus its origin and positive X/Y directions, with up to three reference photos. Each observation accepts up to 60 shadow points. For each point you type the local clock time, the dial reading, and hand-measured X/Y coordinates in millimetres, then tag the shadow clear, blurry, or obstructed; obstructed points need no numbers. Photos from your library can carry a shadow-tip marker for visual reference only — it is never converted to millimetres.

Prylo derives each point's deviation in minutes, mean drift across the observation, and a plotted shadow path. Two observations sharing one dial reference can be compared side by side. Drafts, follow-up flags, archiving, and built-in sample observations on first launch round out the workflow. Made for sundial owners, makers, and gnomonics hobbyists.

name: PSCINMKT
description:
PSCINMKT brings market tracking, stock research, and paper trading together in one iPhone app. Follow the markets you care about, look up the numbers behind a stock.

- **Follow the markets.** Track major benchmarks in the U.S., Hong Kong, the U.K., Japan, and Germany. Build a watchlist and keep up with earnings dates and economic releases.
- **Research stocks.** Explore price charts, earnings history, financial ratios, analyst ratings, and price targets. Compare stocks side by side.
- **Read and save financial news.** Open articles in the app and bookmark stories for later.
- **Practice trading.** Place simulated orders, track your paper portfolio, and record your decisions in a trade journal.
- **Run your own calculations.** Size a position, model compound growth, convert currencies, and explore how assets move together or how far they’ve fallen from a peak.

name: Psikotes Kerja 2027: Kraepelin
description:
Psikotes Kerja 2027 adalah aplikasi latihan mandiri untuk pencari kerja yang akan mengikuti psikotes. Aplikasi ini tidak berafiliasi dengan perusahaan, instansi, atau biro psikologi mana pun, dan hasil latihan di sini bukan hasil psikotes resmi.

Tes koran menuntut kamu menjumlahkan angka terus-menerus selama puluhan menit, jadi tangan dan mata perlu dibiasakan sebelum hari tes. Di aplikasi ini kamu berlatih di layar HP dengan batas waktu seperti pada tes sebenarnya, lalu melihat sendiri apakah kecepatan dan ketelitianmu naik dibanding tes sebelumnya.

APA SAJA ISINYA

• Tes Koran Kraepelin lengkap, 40 kolom dengan 30 detik per kolom atau 50 kolom dengan 15 detik per kolom. Waktu per kolom bisa dibuat lebih longgar kalau kamu baru mulai berlatih.
• Tes Koran Pauli 60 menit. Garis ditandai otomatis setiap 3 menit, seperti saat pengawas memberi aba-aba garis.
• Latihan singkat 1, 3, atau 5 menit untuk pemanasan.
• Hasil tes koran berupa empat angka, yaitu kecepatan, ketelitian, keajegan, dan ketahanan, beserta grafik per kolom dan perbandingan dengan tes sebelumnya.
• Tes Kecermatan angka hilang, huruf hilang, dan simbol hilang.
• Latihan soal per topik, antara lain sinonim, antonim, analogi, deret angka, deret huruf, hitungan, soal cerita, silogisme, dan figural, lengkap dengan pembahasan.
• Simulasi Psikotes empat bagian, masing-masing dengan batas waktunya sendiri.
• Panduan singkat tentang cara mengerjakan tes koran, tes Wartegg, tes gambar orang dan pohon, serta persiapan di hari tes.

TOMBOL ANGKA BESAR

Tombol angkanya besar dan cukup ditekan satu kali untuk setiap jawaban. Kalau hasil penjumlahannya dua angka, tekan angka belakangnya saja, sama seperti aturan menulis di kertas tes koran. Sebelum tes pertama ada contoh yang bisa kamu coba dulu.

TANPA IKLAN, TANPA AKUN

Tidak ada iklan dan kamu tidak perlu mendaftar. Semua latihan bisa dipakai tanpa internet.

BISA LATIHAN SETIAP HARI

Setiap hari kamu bisa mengerjakan satu tes lengkap dan 20 soal latihan, sedangkan latihan singkat tes koran bisa diulang kapan saja. Akses Penuh cukup dibeli satu kali dan bukan langganan. Isinya tes lengkap tanpa batas harian, latihan soal tanpa kuota harian, pembahasan semua soal simulasi, riwayat lengkap dengan grafik perkembangan, dan kumpulan soal yang pernah kamu jawab salah.

TENTANG HASIL LATIHAN

Angka yang kamu lihat adalah hasil latihanmu sendiri dan bukan penilaian resmi dari psikolog. Aplikasi ini tidak menjanjikan kelulusan.

Ada pertanyaan atau menemukan soal yang keliru? Kirim email ke contact@purplecompassdigital.com.

name: PTH Home
description:
PTH Home là ứng dụng đọc Kinh Thánh tiếng Việt mỗi ngày của Thanh Niên Phú Thọ Hoà.

• Đọc trọn Kinh Thánh trong 365 ngày với bài đọc, câu gốc và chuỗi ngày đọc.
• Đọc Bản Truyền Thống 1925 khi không có mạng và mở lại đúng câu đang đọc dở.
• Tìm câu hoặc từ khoá tiếng Việt, có dấu hoặc không dấu.
• Tô màu câu yêu thích và lưu ghi chú ngay trên thiết bị.
• Chỉnh cỡ chữ, kiểu chữ và giao diện sáng hoặc tối.
• Tải Bản Hiện Đại một lần, sau đó đọc ngoại tuyến.

Miễn phí, không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản.

name: PTOPT
description:
ptopt is a household book that stays on your iPhone. Write down what came in and what went out, keep a monthly plan for the categories you care about, and fill a goal one block at a time.

Open the book and you are already in it. A sample book for Alex is there so the first screen is a real ledger, not a tour. Add a line and the book becomes yours. Settings can start fresh or bring the sample back.

Safe to spend is the number on the front of the book. It starts with the bank and cash you can use today, then holds back what this month's plans have not spent and what your goals still ask you to set aside. Money already moved into a goal has left those accounts, so it is not counted twice.

Goals are piles. Each goal is split into blocks that add up to the amount you named. Tap a block to fill it from an account, or tap again in Withdraw to bring that block back.
