Change the goal amount and the saved balance stays; the blocks are recut around it. A short journey marks the way from the first block to the last.

Plans watch a category for the month. When spending runs past the plan, the bar turns, and the Budgets tab keeps a count. Accounts remember a bank, cash, a savings tin, or a card, with a sparkline of the month. Transfers move money between two accounts as a pair, so deleting one removes both. Repeats can post a paycheck or a rent line when the month turns.

Insights and the statement read the month back to you. Search finds a line by a note, a category, or an account. Everything is kept in a private file on this iPhone. There is no account, no sign-in, and no upload. Airplane mode is a normal way to use ptopt.

name: Public Housing Center
description:
PHC is the mobile app for staff of public housing authorities that use Public Housing Center. Sign in with the account your housing authority gave you, see the work assigned to you, and get it done from the field.

The app is built around housing inspections:

ASSIGNED INSPECTIONS
• See every open inspection assigned to you, soonest first.
• Know at a glance what's today, scheduled, past due or still waiting to be scheduled.
• The list stays up to date on its own, so new assignments show up without extra steps.

EVERYTHING BEFORE YOU KNOCK
• Appointment time and window, shown in your housing authority's time zone.
• Unit address, head of household, property owner, bedrooms and program.
• Notes from the office and the results of earlier visits.

ROOM-BY-ROOM CHECKLIST
• Work through the unit one area at a time, using your housing authority's own inspection checklist.
• Mark each item Pass or Fail with one tap, or pass the rest of a room at once.
• On a failed item, choose the deficiencies, who is responsible (owner, tenant, both or management), and flag health-and-safety or emergency items.
• Add comments and set the days to cure.
• Your answers are saved on your phone as you go, so an interruption never costs you an inspection.

REVIEW AND RECORD
• See the proposed outcome and cure-by date, based on your housing authority's rules.
• Choose the final outcome and record the results in one step. Your office sees them right away.

NO-SHOW AND NO ENTRY
• If the tenant isn't home or you can't get in, close the visit as a No-Show or No Entry so the office can reschedule.

BUILT FOR HOUSING AUTHORITIES
• Uses the same accounts, roles and permissions as Public Housing Center on the web.
• Every action is recorded in your housing authority's audit trail.
• You only see the inspections assigned to you, at your housing authority.

PHC is for staff of housing authorities that use Public Housing Center.

name: Puck: Hundred-Year Cabinet
description:
Puck is a hundred-year-old cabinet, with the wisdom of a whole human life. It is there for anyone with a question from daily life: about yourself, your partner, a friend, a neighbour or your work, about the family or a parent growing old, or about a child.

Puck has no opinions and never tells you what to do. It looks with you, drawer by drawer, and brings knowledge from Maria de Ridder's books and reading guides.

The six drawers
You come with what is on your mind and choose which drawer to begin with. There are no points or stars, and nothing is right or wrong.

Blue: looking at what is there
Red: feeling
White: a little space
Yellow: discovering what it means
Green: the first small step
Purple: wisdom to keep

Talking with Puck
In a drawer you can talk further with Puck. Puck is an AI.

Who it is for
The books about AnnaMaria and Puck are picture books for children. The app is for adults aged 18 and over and is not made for children.

What happens to your data
What you share with Puck is yours. Exactly what is kept where is at puck.kusala.eu/en/privacy.

Dutch and English.

name: Puffbonk: Sky Pet Slingshot
description:
Pull back. Let go. BONK! Sling your Puff across floating sky islands and knock grumpy clouds off the edge. Every Puff hatches with its own Cloudprint: raise it, dress it, and race your friends' ghosts in a new challenge every day.

SLING, BONK, REPEAT
• Drag back and let go. Time slows down while you aim
• Pull harder to hit harder, but you can slide off the edge too
• Short runs of five islands, ending with the Cloud King
• Pick a Boon after each island and use Skills like Wind Sneeze, Cloud Brake and Twin Bonk

A PUFF ALL YOUR OWN
• Hatch an egg and meet a Puff with its own colors, eyes, patterns and traits
• Every Puff has a Cloudprint, a one-of-a-kind code, and a rarity shown as 1 in N
• When you are online, your Puff also gets a number: Puff #N ever hatched
• Grow your Puffs, fill the Cloud Book, share a card of your favorite

TWIN NEST
• Pair two grown-up Puffs and let them nap for 8 hours
• A new egg appears, with looks mixed from both parents
• Coming back late is fine. Nothing is lost

HOME ISLE
• A cozy island that keeps going while you are away: Candy collects, visitors arrive with small requests and leave an egg as thanks
• Decorate the island with lamps, benches, windmills and more, and dress your Puff in hats, glasses and scarves
• Your Puff wanders over to visit its favorite decorations

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Today's Challenge: the same five islands for everyone, with a new wind rule each day
• Race the ghost of yesterday and dare a friend with a link
• The Cloud Lantern Festival: every BONK lights a lantern, and festival gifts are yours forever

Plays offline, and online features are optional. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Grab a Puff. Pull back. BONK!

name: Puffin Peck: Aim Puzzle
description:
Load the cannon, launch a puffin, and watch the pixels fly!

Puffin Peck is a color puzzle with a twist: you don't do the shooting, your puffins do. Fire each puffin onto a perch and it blasts every pixel of its own color it can see. Pick the right perch at the right time and the whole picture melts away.

HOW TO PLAY

Aim the cannon and launch your puffin to an open perch.
Each puffin shoots only its own color. The number on its back is how many shots it has.
A puffin that can't see its color just sits there, taking up a perch.
Fill every perch with stuck puffins and it's game over.
Clear every pixel to win!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

Simple to pick up: aim, launch, done.
Real strategy underneath. Which puffin goes where, and which color do you open up first?
Bounce shots off the walls to reach tricky perches.
Charming pixel art to take apart, one color at a time.
Satisfying chain reactions when one cleared layer sets the next puffin free.
Levels that grow from relaxing to truly brain-teasing.

Think ahead, line up your shot, and let the puffins do the rest.

Download Puffin Peck and start pecking!

name: Pulp Hotel
description:
A radio host leaves a waterfront hotel just before midnight. By morning, the reel for her final broadcast has vanished. Can you find it before the first ferry leaves?

In Pulp Hotel, explore the fictional Hotel Marlow, question witnesses and inspect objects. Keep track of clues in your notebook, then choose the evidence that explains what happened.

Play The Last Broadcast offline from your first visit. Download The Return Envelope from the case library for another mystery. Your progress stays on your device.

name: PumpBench: Pump Calculator
description:
Free. No sign-up. Calculates on your device, no internet needed.

The pump calculations you repeat for every quote and selection, in one app. Flow and head entered in ① carry through to the other tabs and the English datasheet.

• ① Power — hydraulic and shaft power (kW, HP) from flow, head, efficiency and specific gravity. Head from two pressure gauges
• ② Pipe loss — velocity and friction loss (m, bar) from diameter, length, material and 16 fitting types. Link suction loss straight to ③ NPSH
• ③ NPSH — NPSHa from liquid level, suction loss, tank pressure, altitude and temperature, with a margin check against NPSHr
• ④ Speed and 50/60 Hz — how flow, head and power change with speed, frequency or impeller trim (affinity laws)
• ⑤ Motor and energy — preliminary IEC motor size with service margin, annual energy cost, VFD savings estimate
• ⑥ Duty point — intersection of a 3–6 point pump curve and the system curve, two pumps in parallel or series, with a chart
• ⑦ Nameplate — find flow, head, speed and more in a nameplate photo and apply them to ① (iPhone/iPad: camera or photo; Mac: file). Text recognition runs on-device
• ⑧ Units — flow, head, pressure and power
• English datasheet — one page, print or save as PDF
• Keeps your 10 most recent calculations · Copy results · Korean and English
• Your input stays on your device. No account, ads or tracking

One app for Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Estimates from public formulas (Darcy–Weisbach/Colebrook, affinity laws and more). Fluid properties are for water and fitting losses use typical values. Always confirm pump and motor selection with the manufacturer's curves and data.

name: Punctum: One moment a day
description:
Roland Barthes called it the punctum: the small detail in a photo that pierces you. Punctum is a quiet daily ritual built around it. Each evening you choose one moment from your day and write one line on why. Over weeks and years those moments become your own archive of what mattered.

• A few candidates each evening, picked on your iPhone from the day's photos. Your photos are never uploaded for them.
• One moment a day: no feed, no streaks, no penalties for a quiet day.
• Your archive, month by month and year by year. A moment from a week, a month or a year ago comes back now and then.
• An optional backup in your own iCloud. Your sentences are end-to-end encrypted; your photos are too with Advanced Data Protection.
• Share a moment as a card to the app you pick, or to Instagram Stories.
• Punctum Plus, a one-time purchase: your year as a print-ready poster and a PDF year book.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Push Ups: 100 Pushup Challenge
description:
Go from your first push-up to 100 in a row with a simple plan that adapts to you.

Push Ups: 100 Pushup Challenge builds your strength step by step. Tell us how many push-ups you can do today (or that you can't do one yet) and you get a personal programme: a few short workouts a week, five sets each, with the reps rising a little every time you hit your targets.

START WHERE YOU ARE
• Can't do a push-up yet? Start with wall push-ups, move to incline, then knee push-ups, then full push-ups.
• A quick re-test every two weeks moves you up the levels.
• Missed a target? The day simply repeats. No guilt, just progress.

EVERY REP COUNTED
• Tap the big counter, or put your phone on the floor and touch it with your nose or chest on every rep.
• Built-in rest timer between sets.
• Can't finish a set? Drop to your knees and the plan adjusts.

PERFECT FORM
• 15 push-up variations with video demos: wall, incline, knee, negative, classic, wide, diamond, close-grip, decline, pike, staggered, archer, Spiderman, Hindu and plank holds.
• Clear form cues and the most common mistakes for each one.

STAY MOTIVATED
• Your path, day by day, with a projected finish week.
• Medals, streaks, your best set over time and your lifetime push-up total.
• Extra challenges: a 30-day challenge and "100 today".
• Daily reminders at the time you choose.

Workouts take about 10 minutes and need no equipment.

SUBSCRIPTION
Push Ups needs a subscription to use: monthly or yearly, renewing automatically until you cancel. There is no free trial. You can cancel any time in your store account settings.

Stop if you feel pain, and check with a doctor before starting if you have a health condition.

Privacy policy: https://deepblue.org.uk/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: PuxVoice — Teleprompter
description:
PuxVoice is an iPhone teleprompter for reading beside a camera or through a beam splitter. Your script follows what you say and stops during pauses.

Voice tracking
• On-device recognition for English and Russian. The script determines which language is used.
• The prompter advances as you read and can move back when you repeat a passage.
• Fixed-speed scrolling is available when on-device recognition is unavailable.

Set up your display
• Mirror horizontally or vertically, invert colors, and crop the reading area to fit your equipment.
• Adjust text size, width, alignment, line spacing, reading highlight, and uppercase.
• Save equipment profiles, set a countdown, and lock screen orientation.
• With an external keyboard, Space starts or pauses and Up Arrow rewinds three lines.

Manage your scripts
• Use the library and editor with autosave and a reading-time estimate.
• Import TXT, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, PDF, and HTML. PDF import uses the available text layer.
• Send documents and text to PuxVoice from the iOS share sheet.

Audio is processed on your iPhone. Scripts and settings are stored on the device. No account is required.

name: PuzzlePair
description:
Puzzle Pair is a hyper-casual puzzle games build for iOS.
Arrows – Puzzle Escape: Tap arrows so they slide off the board. An arrow that would hit another one bounces back and costs a heart.
Pixel Flow!: Tap shooters so they ride a belt around a pixel picture and pop every pixel of their colour they can see. Don't run out of waiting slots.

name: PX: Lumen Latch
description:
Turn a crystal and watch a world begin to glow.

Move mirrors, split a beam into color and guide wandering light to a grove of little flowers. Rotate with two fingers, pinch an iris to spread its glow and hold the gates to let the colors meet. Every flower needs the right color and brightness, together.

Explore thirty constellations, ten open trials and three playable lessons. Enjoy a free light garden, build your own local constellation, collect six cosmetic crystal finishes and revisit real light-path memories.

English, portrait and fully offline on iPhone and iPad. No accounts, advertisements, purchases or gambling.

Before publishing either listing, provide actual support/privacy URLs and contact details, confirm the chosen name, answer the current age-rating/privacy questions accurately and use screenshots from the running submitted build. Concept art is not a replacement for gameplay screenshots. New major gameplay changes to an existing listing should be disclosed in review notes and What's New.

name: PyPath: Learn Python
description:
PyPath teaches you to program in Python, the world's most popular programming language, with short lessons and hands-on challenges you solve on your iPhone or iPad.

Every line of code you write runs on the real thing: the official CPython 3.15 interpreter, built into the app. No simplified "Python-like" language, no internet connection needed.

LEARN BY DOING
• 65 lessons in 13 chapters, from your first print() to classes and generators
• Every lesson has runnable examples: tap Run to see what they do, or Edit to change them
• Each lesson ends with a challenge. Tap Check and PyPath tells you whether it works, and if not, exactly what to fix
• Hints when you're stuck, and the solution when you really need it

THE WHOLE LANGUAGE
• Variables, numbers and strings
• if, elif, else and match
• while and for loops
• Lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets and comprehensions
• Functions, lambdas and recursion
• Exceptions: try, except, raise and your own error types
• Classes, inheritance, special methods and dataclasses
• Iterators, generators and itertools
• The standard library: math, random, collections, datetime, json, regular expressions and files
• Four final projects: a guessing game, a text analyzer, a to-do list and a tic-tac-toe referee

ERRORS THAT MAKE SENSE
• The line with the mistake lights up, with its line number
• Every common error comes with a plain-English hint: "You can't add text and a number. Use str(n) or an f-string."
• The full Python traceback is one tap away when you want it

A REAL CODE EDITOR
• Syntax colors, line numbers and automatic indentation
• A row of keys for ( ) : " = [ ] and the other symbols code needs
• input() works: your programs can ask questions and you answer them
• A Stop button for loops that run forever

PLAYGROUND
• Write and save your own programs, and share them
• The full Python standard library is there to explore

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
• No tracking and no data collection: your progress stays on your device
• Works completely offline

Made for iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode.

Python is a trademark of the Python Software Foundation. PyPath is not affiliated with the PSF.

name: Q Volt - كيو فولت
description:
كيو فولت (QVolt) هو التطبيق الرسمي لشركة كيو فولتس للطاقة الشمسية في كركوك – العراق.

• صمّم منظومتك بنفسك: أدخل استهلاكك بالنهار والليل وعدد ساعات التشغيل، والحاسبة الذكية تقترح لك الإنفرتر والبطاريات والألواح المناسبة مع السعر الكامل.
• تسوّق المنتجات: إنفرترات وبطاريات وألواح من علامات تجارية معتمدة مع الضمان.
• منظومات متكاملة جاهزة: باقات بالأسعار شاملة التركيب.
• التقسيط الميسّر: تعرّف على مبادرة البنك المركزي العراقي بفائدة 0% ولمدة تصل إلى 5 سنوات، وفريقنا يساعدك بكل الإجراءات.
• اطلب بسهولة: أضف للسلة وأرسل طلبك، وفريقنا يتواصل معك لتأكيد الطلب وموعد التركيب. الدفع نقداً عند التركيب أو بالتقسيط.
• تابع طلباتك من حسابك، وتواصل معنا مباشرة عبر واتساب.

التطبيق يدعم العربية والإنجليزية والكردية والتركية، مع الوضع الليلي.

name: Qilno
description:
Qilno points one kettle at the coffee sack with the shortest gap of at least 4 days from roast day to opening day.

Open the rack and the sack on the kettle is already there. Nyeri was roasted on 20 Oct 2026 and opened on 24 Oct 2026. That is 4 days, so Nyeri is on the kettle. Huila is also 4 days, but it was opened later, so the line names Nyeri. Yirga is only 1 day and stays off the kettle. Sidama is still sealed.

File this sack adds a name, a roaster, a process, and the two days. Crack this sack sets the opening day to today. Pour a cup writes a cup for any sack, including one that is not on the kettle, and the kettle does not move. Marks, grams, photos, and a short voice note stay on that sack.

Keep this kettle spends 1 Husk and freezes the name, both days, and the gap on a card. The same kettle does not spend a Husk again. Get Husks lists Degas Hatch, Burr Collar, Kettle Neck, Spout Nub, Carafe Seam, Parchment Wrap, Screen Mesh, and Basket Weave.

name: Qivika Pro
description:
Unlock the full potential of your telescope with Qivika Pro.  Whether you are charting deep-sky wonders or capturing distant wildlife, Qivika Pro transforms your smartphone into a precision-engineered optical camera—delivering effortless, pro-level results right through your eyepiece.

Why You’ll Love Qivika Pro:

Pro-Grade Manual Controls: Fine-tune focus, exposure, and shutter speed with surgical precision to eliminate blur and capture razor-sharp details.

STAR SEEKER — Effortless Astrophotography: Ditch complex camera setups. Our dedicated Astro-Mode lets you photograph the Moon, the Sun (with proper solar filters), and deep-sky objects with a single tap.

Lunar Challenge: Track and capture all 8 phases of the lunar cycle to complete your personal cosmic gallery.

BIRD SPOTTER — Smart Wildlife & Birding: Bring distant nature into crystal-clear focus without disturbing the habitat.

Instant Species ID: Identify birds in real time right through your lens.

Telephoto Enhancement: Custom algorithms preserve rich feather textures and true-to-life colors at extreme distances.

Digital Life List: Automatically log sightings, geotag locations, and organize your wildlife field notes in one place.

Built for Every Explorer
From backyard beginners to seasoned astrophotographers and birders, Qivika Pro bridges the gap between your eyes and the wonders of the natural world.

name: QuadList: Oxford Colleges
description:
QuadList turns exploring Oxford into a collection.

Every college and Permanent Private Hall is pinned on a 3D map of the city, 43 places in all. Tap a pin to open the college, then mark it Visited or add it to your Wishlist.

TRACK YOUR VISITS
• Mark colleges Visited or add them to your Wishlist with one tap
• Record how you got in: a tourist visit, a garden walk, Formal Hall, a ball, Evensong, a tutorial, the library and more
• Add the date of your visit and your own notes
• Star your own college

LEARN AS YOU GO
• Tap Learn more for a fun fact about each college, plus famous alumni for many
• See when each college was founded

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Watch the map fill up as you go
• Browse and filter every college in the Colleges list
• Unlock milestones from Explorer to Master
• See how you've visited, and share your progress with friends

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your progress is saved on your iPhone only.

Whether you're a student, an alum or a visitor, QuadList keeps track of every college you've stepped inside.

Opening times and visitor rules vary, so please check with each college before you go. QuadList is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the University of Oxford or any of its colleges.

name: Quadrangular Barreiro
description:
Olá seja bem-vindo Este é App oficial da QUADRANGULAR BARREIRO .
O APP permite o relacionamento entre a Igreja e seus membros ou visitantes.

 Encontre um Grupo de Conexão próximo a sua casa. E se já participa de um Grupo de  Conexão perfeito Você poderá fazer o gerenciamento completo do seu grupo

name: Quarry for Factory
description:
Quarry for Factory is the end-of-line test station for Marble, Workstream's wearable camera. It is used by the line staff of our manufacturing partner, not by consumers, and it does nothing without a Marble in hand.

Each phone acts as a test station. For every Marble that comes off the line it:

• connects to the Marble over Bluetooth and the Marble's own Wi-Fi
• sets and verifies the Marble's clock
• runs a self-test of memory, power, cameras, sound, motion sensor and radios
• shows the four live camera feeds and both microphones for a visual and sound check
• records the factory calibration
• writes the result to the Marble and files it with Workstream
• gives a verdict, ready to ship or not shippable, with the reasons

The Marbles tab lists every Marble tested at the station, filtered by verdict.

name: Quelea Tool
description:
Quelea is a quiet cheese journal for the cheeses you make.

It records the milk, the culture, the form, the make, the hoop, the minutes, the weight and the rind they keep. There is no shop, no score, no streak and no cloud account. The journal is a single file on this iPhone, and it stays there unless you choose to export it.

**THE CREAMERY**
Open to the last cheese, the milks in hand and the shape of the year. Add a cheese in a short form, then return to a clean table of what was made.

**THE CHEESE LOG**
Search by title, milk, culture, room, shelf or note. Filter by mood — Still, Patient, Bold, Exact, Curious, Tired. Every cheese keeps its form, make style, hoop, date, minutes, weight, height, cave, shelf and one note.

**THE MILK SHELF**
Keep cow, goat, sheep, buffalo, mixed and plant milks across raw, pasteurized, cream, skimmed, homogenized and whole treatments. Record a fat point and a manual kilogram count. Full, in use, low and out are read from the shelf you keep.

**THE CULTURE SHELF**
Mesophilic, thermophilic, meso-thermo, mould, blue, surface, natural and adjunct cultures, each with a strength, a colour and a batch weight. The colour tile is the small visual signature of the culture you keep.

**THE CHEESE YEAR**
See the cheeses, weight, minutes, making days, typical minutes and weight, make-style distribution, month bars, top milks and cultures, the longest make and the cultures that ran out.

**A QUIET HOUR**
Turn on one optional local morning reminder if you want it. No account, no push server, no marketing message.

**YOUR FILE**
Back up the full journal as JSON, export a CSV, share it, or restore a backup. The file lives at Documents/quelea-cheese-journal.json. Deleting the app removes the local file, subject to normal iOS backup behaviour.

**PRIVATE BY DEFAULT**
No account. No analytics. No advertising. No third-party SDK. No journal upload. The only network-backed page is the hosted Privacy & Support page at priapps.netlify.app/quelea, and it opens only when you ask.

name: QueueReplay
description:
QueueReplay helps you compare how jobs move through a renderer, export queue or print station.

Create a workload with job names, arrival times and processing durations. Assign one to three identical stations and choose First In, First Out or Shortest ready job. Run the replay, move through the timeline and review the jobs waiting, in progress or finished at a selected time.

Compare average and longest waits, the time of the last completion and overall station utilization. Use the event ledger to inspect arrivals, dispatches and completions. Freeze the results to keep an independent PDF and CSV that you can share.

Try Render bench, the included four-job workload, to see how dispatch order changes waiting. QueueReplay is a deterministic planning model. Running jobs are never interrupted, and stations are treated as identical. It works offline and needs no account.

name: Queuevia
description:
Queuevia is a local-only visit receipt app for logging errand queues on this iPhone. Record task type, optional venue alias, timestamps, wait and service pauses, status, private notes, and optional reference photos. Everything stays in the app sandbox on this device. There is no cloud sync and no account password.

After you agree to the Privacy Policy and User Agreement, tap One-Tap Login. Visits lists published receipts. Log Visit opens the editor. Save Draft is free and keeps unfinished work under Drafts on the Visits home screen. Save Active publishes a visit into Visits, Stats, and Export after confirmation and uses Credits. Stats shows medians for completed active samples. Drafts are excluded from Stats and Export.

Optional photos: Take Photo uses the camera for a still image; Choose Photos imports from the system library. Dictate Note can transcribe spoken private notes; you can always type instead. Export Visit or Export Archive builds a local package and opens the system share sheet. Including photos spends Credits after you confirm; declining exports text only.

Credits top up through Apple consumable In-App Purchases on the Top Up screen. A small starter grant is local only and is not an App Store product. Remaining Credits are not restored after uninstall, Clear Data, or Delete Account. Logging draft visits does not spend Credits.

name: QuickPoll - Poll Maker
description:
QuickPoll is a free online poll maker. Write a question, add options and share one link on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, X or Telegram. Votes show up live as a pie chart, percentage bars and a ranking.

You can create polls in any language, including English, Hindi, Punjabi and Marathi. Voters do not need an account. Anyone with the link can vote in one tap. Optional "one vote per device" protection helps stop repeat votes from the same phone.

QuickPoll is built for everyday questions and for unofficial public opinion polls, including assembly and election-related questions that users choose to publish. Results are user-generated opinion tallies from people who voted on this app. They are not official election results, exit polls or results published by the Election Commission of India or any government body. QuickPoll is not affiliated with any government, political party or election authority.

Creating polls, sharing them and collecting votes is free. The website may show ads.

Features
- Create a poll in seconds, on your phone
- Live pie chart, percentages and a ranking
- One link that works in WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and more
- Optional one-vote-per-device protection
- No name or phone number required to vote
- Hindi, Marathi, Punjabi and other languages

Privacy
Voters are not asked for a name or phone number. If you create an account, we store your name, email and a hashed password. See our privacy policy: https://quickpoll.in/privacy

Support: admin@quickpoll.in
Website: https://quickpoll.in
Developer: GROK MEDIA PVT LTD

name: Quietcrate
description: Quietcrate is a record-shelf notebook. Each record stores an artist, an album, a year, a shelf, and a condition of Mint, Good, or Fair. The bin is a row of sleeves you flip. A spin is a date you played the record. Quiet lists records with no spins. Fair lists records you marked Fair. Nothing is uploaded and no music service is used.

name: QuotasBNB
description:
QuotasBNB is the app for Brazil's first fractional-ownership (timeshare) marketplace: a cheaper way to spend a full week in complete resorts and hotels, for up to 70% less than the regular daily rate.

Browse the live catalog from your phone: available weeks in resorts across Porto de Galinhas, Olímpia, Gramado, Foz do Iguaçu and 20+ other destinations, each with price, dates and photos. Search by city or resort and save your favorite listings to follow.

Found the right week? Finish your reservation securely on the official QuotasBNB website — payment stays protected until the owner confirms, as part of the usage-transfer process already used on the platform.

In the app you can:
• Browse and search weeks by city, resort and date
• See full listing details, price and stay period
• Save favorites so you never miss a good window
• Check My Reservations and each booking's status
• Manage your profile, including account deletion

On iPhone, add home screen widgets to see the countdown to your next trip, your favorite listing's next open week, a featured resort, the catalog's lowest price, and a quick shortcut to explore resorts.

Available in Portuguese, English and Spanish, for iPhone and iPad.

name: QV Audio
description:
QV Audio is background music for hotels, restaurants, cafés, spas and lobbies — without music licence fees.

A small QV Audio box connects to your speakers or TV and plays music from its own storage, so the music keeps going even when the internet drops. With this app you manage every box at your location.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add a new box in minutes: the app finds it over Bluetooth and connects it to your Wi-Fi or network cable.
• Choose one or more genres per area — lounge, smooth jazz, bossa nova, chill, spa & wellness, Italian restaurant and more. Several genres are mixed together.
• See what is playing, pause, skip to the next track and set the volume.
• Record or upload your own announcements, such as a welcome message or "the bar closes in half an hour", and schedule when they play on which boxes.
• Give every box a name and an area, such as Lobby, Bar or Terrace.

LICENCE-FREE
All music in QV Audio is made for QV Audio and licensed for public playback in your venue. You do not need a separate licence from a music collecting society for this music.

NEW MUSIC EVERY DAY
Each genre holds many hours of music, and the box rotates what it plays so guests and staff do not hear the same tracks every day.

QV Audio needs a QV Audio box. More information: audio.quantumvikings.com

QV Audio is a product of Quantum Vikings I/S, Denmark.

name: Qvinto
description:
Qvinto brings the traditional Catholic liturgical calendar, saints’ feast days, and sacred art into your daily routine.

• View the day’s celebration, liturgical class, and saints’ titles.
• Check fasting and abstinence guidance.
• Explore other dates in the calendar.
• Choose the universal calendar or one of the available country calendars.
• Discover paintings related to each celebration and view their sources.
• Add a widget to your Home Screen to see the date and celebration of the day.
• Report problems or possible errors from within the app.

An internet connection is required to download content and images.

Fasting and abstinence information is provided as a reference to the traditional calendar and may vary according to local rules.

name: Rabbit Crossing Bridge
description:
Rabbit Crossing Bridge is a stick-bridge game. Hold to grow a stick from the pillar under the rabbit, then release. If the stick reaches the next pillar, the rabbit walks across. A miss ends the run.

Twelve levels are listed. Level 1 is open on a fresh install. Clearing a level opens the next one. Endless mode can be played at any time and continues until a fall. Coins from landings, collectibles, cleared levels, and achievements buy four items that each last for one pillar. There is no account, no payment, and no network use.

name: Radio Fórmula 24
description:
Radio Fórmula 24 is the radio of the number ones: the biggest hits of the 80s, the 90s and today, playing 24 hours a day since 2014.

IN THE APP
• Three live stations: Fórmula 24 (the number ones), Fórmula Classics (timeless classics) and Fórmula CAT (music in Catalan).
• What's playing now and what just played.
• “News in 60 seconds”: today's bulletins, whenever you want to listen.
• Fórmula 24 TV: the live music video channel, full screen too.
• Music and current affairs news, comfortable to read on your phone.
• Optional notifications when a new bulletin is out, for top stories and for station news. You choose which.

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center.
• AirPlay, CarPlay and Siri: “Hey Siri, play Fórmula 24”.
• A widget to play your station with one tap.
• Sleep timer.

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNTS
No sign-up needed, no ads and no tracking. Radio Fórmula 24 is a non-profit station.

In Spanish, Catalan and English.

name: Radio Hugin
description:
Radio Hugin brings Old Norse myth, poetry, and Nordic folk music together in one focused listening app.

LIVE SYNCHRONIZED RADIO
Join the shared 24/7 broadcast where every listener hears the same track at the same moment. Between songs, relax into brief Old Norse instrumental interludes with an optional on-device Local Text to Speech announcer. Choose from four announcer hosts (Freya, Odin, Frigg, or Thor), switch voices anytime, or turn the announcer off whenever you want pure music.

FULL CATALOG & CUSTOM LISTS
Browse, search, and sort the complete Radio Hugin catalog. Save favorite tracks with a tap or swipe, build custom playlists, and keep listening seamlessly from the Lock Screen and Control Center. Played tracks are cached automatically for smoother replays.

OPTIONAL AMDIRION ACCOUNT
Radio Hugin works immediately without an account. Sign in with an optional Amdirion account to sync your favorites, playlists, and announcer preferences across devices, and manage or permanently delete your account anytime from inside the app.

name: RadTerm
description:
RadTerm is a free, open-source, zero-telemetry SSH and SFTP client built for developers, sysadmins, and DevOps engineers.

No subscriptions, no ads, and no tracking. Your servers, credentials, and private keys stay strictly on your device.

KEY FEATURES
• Native Rust SSH Core: Powered by russh for fast, reliable, and low-latency connections.
• Full-Featured Terminal: xterm.js PTY emulation with customizable extra keys (ESC, TAB, CTRL, ALT, arrows) and colour themes.
• Built-in SFTP Browser: Browse remote directories, inspect permissions, and upload or download files effortlessly.
• Port Forwarding: Run Local (-L), Remote (-R), and Dynamic SOCKS5 (-D) encrypted tunnels right from your phone.
• Jump Hosts & SSH Config: Connect through bastion/jump hosts and import existing OpenSSH config files in seconds.
• Key Manager: Generate Ed25519, ECDSA, and RSA keys, or import OpenSSH, PEM, PKCS#8, SEC1, and PuTTY (.ppk) keys.
• Snippets: Save frequently used commands and execute them with a single tap.

SECURITY & PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• Hardware-Backed Vault: Passwords and private keys are stored exclusively in iOS Keychain / Android Keystore.
• SQLCipher Database: Hosts, snippets, and forwarding rules are encrypted locally with 256-bit AES.
• Encrypted Backups: Export and restore password-protected backups encrypted with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305.
• Strict Host Key Verification: Automatically blocks connections and warns you if a server host key changes.
• Biometric App Lock: Protect access with Face ID or fingerprint authentication.
• Zero Telemetry: No analytics SDKs, no crash trackers, and no cloud servers.

name: Rail & Baluster
description:
A practical field tool for stair installers, carpenters, and railing work. Plan baluster layouts, measure the rail pitch, and work out two-piece miter settings from your iPhone or iPad.

LEVEL AND RAKE LAYOUTS
Enter the opening, actual baluster width, and maximum horizontal gap. Get a baluster count and cumulative center marks in 1/16-inch increments. Each opening is checked after the center marks are rounded, and the largest opening is displayed rounded up.

LIVE DEGREE FINDER
Rest the device’s long edge against the rail, wait for a steady reading, and tap Hold. Send the held angle directly to your rake layout or rail-cut calculator. The iPhone and iPad Angle screen stays upright automatically while measuring.

RAIL MITER CUTS
Calculate rake-to-horizontal and rake-to-vertical joints, with a choice of an upward or downward vertical leg. See the cut on each piece and the shared seam in a side-view diagram. Settings use 0 degrees as a square cut and apply to matching-width, matching-profile rails joining in one plane.

KEEP YOUR JOBS HANDY
Save named sections on your device, reopen them later, and copy or share the layout text. Calculations and saved sections work offline. Choose light or dark mode.

One purchase. No subscription.
No app account. No advertising. No third-party analytics SDKs.

Designed for straight level or rake sections with vertical balusters and plumb posts. Rake layouts support angles up to 85 degrees. The app does not calculate compound turns, tread-mounted patterns, or baluster cut lengths.

Verify site measurements, installed openings, saw setup, and applicable project requirements. Sensor readings depend on the device and contact surface; display precision is not an accuracy guarantee.

name: Rail Pieces
description:
Fit pieces of track into the board and send every train to the station of its color.

Drag to place, tap to turn. When the board is full, press Depart. When every train arrives, the puzzle is cleared.

300 puzzles in five modes. Each mode has 20 Beginner, 20 Intermediate and 20 Advanced puzzles, and a new daily puzzle arrives every day.

No timer, no ads, no connection needed. Your board is saved as you play.

All Beginner puzzles and the daily puzzle are free. The first 4 Intermediate and Advanced puzzles of each mode are free too. One purchase unlocks the other 160 for good.

name: Rainv
description:
Welcome! We’ve poured our hearts into refining this product and look forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas.


A mirror only needs to be half your height. The catch is where it hangs: a hand too high and your feet vanish, a hand too low and the top of your head is cut off. Rainv takes everyone's measure and tells you exactly where the glass should go.

HALF-HEIGHT, PROPERLY APPLIED
Light leaves a mirror at the angle it arrives. So the glass you need is half the height of what you want to see, and its lower edge belongs halfway between your eyes and the lowest point you want in view. Rainv shows each person's minimum for head to toe, waist up or face and shoulders.

ONE HEIGHT FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
Add the people who will use the mirror. Each one gets a window of good hanging heights; where the windows overlap, everyone sees what they asked for. A small solver weighs those wishes together with the wall's sill and ceiling and picks the fairest spot. If the glass is too short for all of you, it says so and settles on the best compromise.

WHAT YOU SEE FROM WHERE YOU STAND
Move the standing distance and tilt the glass. The planner traces the reflection rays and lights up the slice of each person the mirror returns, plus what shows of the wall behind you.

FOUR CUTS AND A FRAME
Tall, wide, round and arched mirrors, each with its own frame width. See the glass size, the area and how much a round or arched mirror loses when you stand off-centre.

SAVED WALLS AND PEOPLE
Keep walls with their height, sill and room depth, and household members with height and eye height. Save fittings, search them, rename, duplicate, and delete with undo.

ON YOUR OWN WALL
With AR, tap the floor, tap the wall, and a virtual mirror appears at the solved height with each person's outline and the rays that reach their eyes. Capture a snapshot (kept on this phone) or freeze the layout into the fitting. AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The 2D planner works on every device, and a sample hallway lets you try everything in seconds.

YOUR DATA
Everything works without an account and guest data never leaves the phone. An optional account adds backup and sync of your walls, people and fittings. The camera picture is never recorded or uploaded.

Rainv gives placement guidance from the measurements you enter. Check fixings and weight limits with the mirror maker's instructions before you drill.

name: Rally Legends: Blocks
description:
Rally Legends: Blocks is a blocky rally game about one thing: being faster than everyone else.

Drive 15 special stages in Finland, France, Sweden, Wales, Greece, Monaco, Spain, Poland, Japan, the USA, China and Brazil, forwards or reversed, in rain, fog, storm, at dusk or at night. Your co-driver calls every corner, and the gravel, snow and tarmac all feel different under the wheels.

RACE REAL DRIVERS
Every time you set goes to the online ranking. Pick any driver on the board and race their ghost: you see exactly where they brake and where you lose time. Or race your own best run and shave off the last tenths.

NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
• Stage of the day: a new stage every day, one ranking for everybody
• Rally of the day: a new rally every day
• Weekly Cup: points every day, a podium every week
• A championship with service between stages
• Send a friend a link and dare them to beat your time

CARS FROM FIVE ERAS
12 cars from 1960s classics to Group B monsters and Group A evolutions. Earn your driver's licence to open new stages and cars, collect medals and paint your car.

MADE FOR YOUR THUMBS
Three touch styles: Classic buttons, Simple (one thumb steers, the throttle is automatic) or Tilt (turn the phone like a wheel). A gamepad works too.

An optional account keeps your progress on every device: the app, the browser and your other phones.

name: Ranchera Skin Care
description:
Ranchera Skin Care brings our whole shop to your phone, along with a simple how-to guide for everything we sell.

SHOP THE COLLECTION
Browse face care, hand and body care, hair care, makeup, bath and candles, lip and sun care, men's and baby products. See photos, prices and full ingredient lists, add items to your cart, and check out securely through our store at rancheraskin.care.

A GUIDE FOR EVERY PRODUCT
Not sure how to use something? Every product has its own guide with:
- Step-by-step directions for how to use it
- When to use it, morning, evening or both
- The benefits you can expect
- Helpful tips and things to keep in mind

BUILD YOUR ROUTINE
See the order to apply your products so each one can do its job, from cleanser to moisturizer to sunscreen.

MADE SIMPLE
- Search the whole catalog
- Shop by category
- Your cart is saved between visits
- No account needed to browse

Ranchera Skin Care products are cosmetics and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Always patch test a new product and follow the directions on the label.

name: Ranchero Coffee
description:
Shop Ranchero Coffee, then make something with it.

SHOP
• Single origin coffees, blends and flavored coffees, plus tea, mugs and apparel
• Choose whole bean or ground (coarse, standard or espresso) and the bag size you want
• Search the whole store
• Your cart is saved between visits
• Pay with the same secure checkout as ranchero.coffee
• Free US shipping

RECIPES
322 recipes in 13 categories, every one built around coffee:
• Brew Guides: French press, pour-over, AeroPress, moka pot, cold brew, cowboy coffee and more
• Espresso Bar, Brewed Classics and Around the World
• Iced & Cold Brew, Frozen & Blended and Zero-Proof drinks
• Coffee Cocktails, for adults of legal drinking age
• Desserts and Baking, from tiramisu to Texas sheet cake
• Breakfast, and Savory & BBQ: coffee rubs, brisket, chili and red-eye gravy
• Syrups & Basics: vanilla syrup, cold foam, creamer and coffee ice cubes

Search by name or ingredient, save your favorites, and tick off ingredients as you cook. Every recipe suggests a Ranchero coffee to make it with.

No account is needed to browse the shop or the recipes.

name: Rascunho Notes
description:
Rascunho is a typewriter for your ideas. Open it and write.

The screen is a blank sheet with a carriage that follows every letter, with the sound of the keys on each tap. No menus in sight and no distractions: just you and the text.

WRITE YOUR WAY
• Typewriter mode, with the paper moving up on every line.
• Day and night themes.
• Font size, line spacing and alignment in one tap.
• Insert images and paste links into the draft.
• Scroll the paper to reread what is above, and select any passage to copy.
• Export the text when you are done.

WRITE TOGETHER
• Share a draft by link, including on WhatsApp.
• Whoever gets the link signs in with their own account and writes in the same text.
• Only the draft you share is visible to other people.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Your drafts are kept on your device.
• Only what you choose to share goes to our servers.
• You can delete your account at any time, inside the app.

IN 30 LANGUAGES
The app follows your device language. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

Rascunho is a product of CAIXA LIMITED.

name: Ratiocup
description: Ratiocup is a pour-over ratio notebook. Each brew stores a name, a method, a dose in grams, a yield in grams, and a clock in seconds. The ratio is yield divided by dose, shown as 1 to that number. Pace is seconds divided by dose. A brew is marked slow when pace is 12 seconds per gram or more, or when the clock is 180 seconds or more. Grind notes are text and do not change the ratio. Nothing is uploaded.

name: ReadOut
description:
ReadOut laver dine dokumenter om til lyd, så du kan lytte til dem, mens du går en tur, kører bil eller laver mad.

LÆG OP ELLER SCAN
• Læg en PDF, en EPUB eller en tekstfil op
• Scan en bog eller en artikel med kameraet, side for side
• Appen finder selv titel, forfatter og kapitler

LYT, HVOR DU ER
• Naturlig oplæsning på dansk og engelsk
• Følg med i teksten, mens du lytter
• Hop mellem kapitler, skift hastighed, og brug sleep-timer
• Hent lyden ned, og lyt uden net
• Appen husker, hvor du er nået, på alle dine enheder

HOLD STYR PÅ DET HELE
• Søg, sortér og filtrér i dit bibliotek
• Se, hvor langt du er, og giv stjerner
• Lyt til det, andre har delt med dig

SÅDAN BETALER DU
Det er gratis at hente appen og lytte til det, der er delt med dig. Det koster sider at få lavet dine egne dokumenter om til lyd: én side pr. side i dokumentet eller pr. scannet side. Du får tre gratis sider til at prøve, og du kan købe flere i pakker i appen. Der er intet abonnement.

Lyden laves af kunstig intelligens, og der kan forekomme fejl i oplæsningen. Det, du scanner, er kun til dig selv.

Privatliv og vilkår: https://larsjul.dk/apps/read/privatliv.html

name: Ready For YC?
description:
Would YC accept you? Find out in about 10 minutes.

Ready For YC? is an AI startup mentor that interviews you the way an accelerator partner would, then gives you a straight answer. No sign-up needed: tap the button and start talking.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tell your story by typing or just talking. One sharp question at a time: you, your cofounders, your startup, your customers and your traction.
• Vague answers get follow-ups. "Lots of users" becomes "how many used it last week?"
• When the mentor knows enough, tap "Get report".

YOUR REPORT
• A readiness score out of 100 and a clear verdict: Likely interview, Borderline or Unlikely today.
• Your story, matched: the real YC startups whose story is most like yours, with their batch.
• Seven scores at a glance: founders, team, urgent demand, market, insight, traction and fit with what accelerators fund today.
• What to fix this week, ranked by impact.
• What has to be true, and the risks most likely to kill it.
• A sharper one-liner for your application, ready to copy.

KEEP GOING
• Keep chatting after your report. The mentor remembers your startup.
• One true founder story every day, at a surprise time.
• Sign in with Apple only if you want to keep your history across devices.

Built on the principles in Paul Graham's essays and on what accelerators fund today. Advice is AI-generated: use it to think harder, and decide for yourself.

Ready For YC? is an independent app by Lamida. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Y Combinator.

name: ReadyWeft
description:
Turn a personal project into a practical readiness checklist. Create a project with a target date and notes, then add your own items to Plan, Make and Check stages. Edit, complete or remove individual items; progress is calculated from your real checklist. Browse projects, search their titles, notes and tasks, inspect the stage board, and archive finished projects with an option to restore them. No team accounts, reminders or automatic project decisions.

Free, no ads, no purchases and no login. Core records work offline and stay in local app storage. Eight interface languages and persistent System, Light or Dark appearance. Optional fictional samples can be loaded in Settings.

name: Rec Bracket Maker
description:
Run game night without the whiteboard. Paste the team names, tap Start, and the bracket is drawn for you. Enter scores as games finish: winners move on, losers drop to the losers bracket, standings update.

Made for cornhole nights, office ping-pong, trivia leagues, pickleball ladders and backyard tournaments. Everything works offline, with no account and no sign-up.

FORMATS
• Single elimination, 2 to 64 teams, with byes placed for you
• Double elimination, 3 to 32 teams, with the grand-final reset
• Round robin, single or double round, with rest rounds for odd counts
• Pools into a bracket: 2 to 8 pools, and the bracket fills itself when the last pool game ends

TEAMS AND SEEDING
• Paste a whole list at once, one team per line
• Drag to reorder, lock seeds, or shuffle with a random draw
• Duplicate names are flagged
• Save rosters and reuse them next week

SCORES
• Tap a match from Up Next and enter the score or just the winner
• Best-of-3 and best-of-5 games
• Change an early result and the app shows exactly which later games it clears, then lets you undo
• Standings with head-to-head and point-difference tiebreakers

SHARE AND PRESENT
• Share the bracket or standings as an image
• Print or save a PDF, split across pages for big brackets
• Print a blank bracket for paper-only events
• Presentation mode for a tablet on the table or a TV: large type, the screen stays on

BUILT FOR IPAD TOO
• Event list, bracket and Up Next side by side
• Works in Split View and with a keyboard: Return saves a score, Command-Z undoes

ACCESSIBLE
• Every match is read aloud by VoiceOver, and a List view shows all matches by round
• Light and dark appearance

FREE AND PRO
Free: unlimited 4-team single-elimination brackets, live scoring, image sharing and presentation mode. No ads, no time limits.
Pro, a one-time purchase: up to 64 teams, double elimination, round robin and pools, PDF and printing, the third-place game, all 8 accent colors and backup to a file. No subscription.

PRIVACY
Team names stay on your device. The app collects nothing.

name: ReceiptSnap PDF Expense Log
description:
Scan paper receipts, check the details, and keep a copy for your records. ReceiptSnap reads the merchant, date, total, and currency on your iPhone. You can correct fields and choose an expense category before saving.

• Scan a paper receipt or import a photo.
• Review detected fields and fill in anything missing.
• Keep receipt images and totals together on your phone.
• Export an annual A4 PDF with an expense summary, totals by currency, and receipt images.

ReceiptSnap is a one-time purchase. No subscription or account is required.

name: RechteRaster
description:
RechteRaster hilft Ihnen, ein selbst erfasstes Rollenmodell zu prüfen. Ordnen Sie Personen und Rollen zu, halten Sie erlaubende oder verweigernde Regeln fest und sehen Sie, welche Regel über welchen Vererbungspfad zu einer Entscheidung führt.

- Prüfen Sie die Zugriffsmatrix nach Person, Ressource und Aktion.
- Öffnen Sie einzelne Felder und sehen Sie die zugehörigen Regeln und Vererbungspfade.
- Halten Sie zwei Revisionen desselben Projekts fest und prüfen Sie die Änderungen.
- Öffnen und teilen Sie gespeicherte PDF- und CSV-Berichte.

Das Beispiel Redaktionsfreigabe zeigt eine widersprüchliche Regel, ihre Wirkung und die Änderung nach dem Deaktivieren. Projekte und Berichte werden lokal gespeichert.

name: Recorder Star
description:
Learn to play the recorder the fun way! Recorder Star turns practice into a game: notes fly toward you on a glowing music highway, your iPhone listens as you play, and every right note lights up with points, streaks and sparkles.

PLAY ALONG WITH YOUR REAL RECORDER
Recorder Star uses your device's microphone to hear the notes you play — no cables or extra gear needed. Play the right note and the song moves on. Play the wrong one and you'll see exactly which note you played, so you know how to fix it.

SEE EXACTLY WHICH HOLES TO COVER
Every note comes with a clear recorder diagram showing which holes to cover, including the thumb hole and half-holes. An "Up Next" strip shows the fingerings for the next few notes, so you're always ready for what's coming.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Learn Mode — The song waits for you. Find each note at your own pace, perfect for beginners.
• Perform Mode — Keep the beat! The song keeps moving and rates every note Perfect, Good or Miss.

40 SONGS FROM BEGINNER TO CHALLENGE
Start with just three notes (B, A and G) and work your way up. Songs include Hot Cross Buns, Mary Had a Little Lamb, Happy Birthday, Jingle Bells, Ode to Joy, When the Saints Go Marching In, Canon in D, Minuet in G, Silent Night and more — plus original tunes like Pixel Quest, Lazy Cat Blues and Neon Highway.

SCORES, STARS AND HIGH SCORES
Build streaks to earn up to a 4× multiplier, collect up to three stars per song, and chase your best score. High scores and a full play history let you see how much you've improved.

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Listen to any song before you play it
• Tap any note to hear how it should sound
• Built-in tuner shows if you're sharp or flat
• Full fingering chart for every note
• Slow songs down to 50% or speed them up to 125%
• Pause, restart or stop any time
• Adjustable note accuracy and microphone sensitivity for any room

ADD YOUR OWN SONGS
Import new songs from simple song files and keep growing your library.

Great for kids learning recorder at school, music teachers, homeschoolers, and adults picking up their first instrument.

Recorder Star uses Baroque (English) fingerings for soprano (descant) recorder. Audio from the microphone is analyzed on your device only to detect the notes you play — nothing is recorded or saved.

name: RecToVid: Voice Over Studio
description:
Record voice-over to picture on iPhone and iPad. Keep the video, script and recording controls together so you can watch a cut, read the next line and capture another take.

RECORD TO PICTURE
Import a reference video from Files or Photos. Rehearse at your own pace, scrub to a frame and mute the reference automatically when you arm the microphone. Record with your built-in mic or a compatible USB microphone or interface.

READ AND COMPARE
Paste a script or import TXT, PDF, DOCX, SRT or WebVTT. Adjust type size, mark preferred performances and keep each original recording.

DELIVER YOUR TAKES
Free includes one active project, eight takes, up to three minutes per take and individual 128 kbps MP3 export. Name each delivery with its project and take.

RecToVid Pro is a one-time purchase. It adds 320 kbps MP3, WAV and Broadcast WAV, on-device voice noise reduction, extended recording, cue and ADR modes, batch delivery and editable project archives.

name: Red Barn Diner
description:
Skip the fees. Skip the wait. Order Red Barn Diner straight from your phone.

Save More on Every Order
Order direct, pay less. No third-party markups or hidden fees. Get first access to exclusive deals, discounts, and coupons. The same great food, no extra fees.

Ordering Made Ridiculously Easy
Reorder your favorites in seconds, no scrolling, no hassle. Your order skips the line and goes straight to our kitchen. We use your location to find the right spot and get it there fast.

Built to Be Trusted
Real-time push notifications from confirmed to ready. Pickup and delivery windows you can actually count on. Secure checkout, every time.

Real Support for a Real Local Favorite
Every order goes straight to Red Barn Diner, not a delivery app, not a middleman.

Download the Red Barn Diner app now. Taste the difference. Support the local spot you love.

Official app of Red Barn Diner, published by Popmenu on its behalf

name: RefBoard: Assign & Pay
description:
RefBoard is an assignment board, confirmation checklist and pay log for the adults who staff youth sports games: assignors, referee coordinators, and referees keeping their own schedule and pay record.

IMPORTANT: RefBoard does not send text messages, emails or any message by itself, and it never contacts a referee for you. You share an assignment through your own messaging app with your phone's share sheet, then log the reply in RefBoard. Reminders are local reminders on this device, for you. RefBoard is also not a payroll, tax, employment, contracting or payment-processing product and does not pay anyone: pay totals and payout-ready records are a log of what you entered, not payroll or tax advice.

UNCONFIRMED GAMES, FIRST
- The home screen is a grid of large cards with live counts: unconfirmed positions, today's games, open positions, referees, outstanding pay.
- The unconfirmed-games dashboard lists every upcoming game with an open or unconfirmed position, soonest kickoff first, with counts such as "3 games, 5 positions still open/unconfirmed". Filter to the next 48 hours, the next 7 days or all upcoming.

ASSIGNMENT BOARD
- Each game shows its crew like a lineup card: position, referee and status (Open, Unconfirmed, Confirmed, Declined, Released, No-show), always with an icon and a word.
- Pick a referee and RefBoard checks first: overlapping games (using kickoff, expected duration and an optional travel buffer), blackout dates and unavailable times are flagged as conflicts; "maybe" days and a second game the same day are warnings.
- Assign despite a conflict only with an override and a reason, which is kept in the assignment history.
- Change a game's time and every assigned referee is checked again.
- Game status from Scheduled to Completed, Cancelled or Postponed, with timestamps.

CONFIRMATIONS YOU LOG
- "I contacted the ref" (timestamped), "Mark confirmed" and "Mark declined" with an optional reason.
- Share assignment: a short plain-text message (or a PDF crew card) for the whole crew or one referee, sent by you through the app you choose.
- Optional local reminders on this phone 7 days and 48 hours before kickoff (both adjustable) while a game still has open or unconfirmed positions, plus an optional game-day reminder. They stop when every position is confirmed or the game is cancelled, and move when the kickoff changes.

REFEREES AND AVAILABILITY
- Name, certification or grade, preferred positions, default game and travel fees, active or inactive, notes.
- A month calendar per referee: available, maybe and unavailable dates or weekly time windows, plus blackout dates.
- Phone and email are optional notes kept on this phone only; RefBoard never uses them to contact anyone.

PAY LOG AND PAYOUT SHEETS
- Game fee, travel and labeled extras per assignment; paid or unpaid with date and a method label (cash, check, other).
- Reports by date range, referee and league: earned, paid, outstanding and game count, plus a payout sheet per referee.
- Mark one, several or all listed items paid. Export CSV or PDF through the share sheet; every report carries the footer "Totals are based on what was logged in RefBoard; not payroll or tax advice."

LEAGUES AND SETTINGS
- Keep more than one league or season. Position templates per sport (soccer Center, AR1, AR2; basketball Referee, Umpire; and more), all editable.
- Light, dark or system theme, travel buffer, reminder lead times, JSON backup and restore (merge or replace), erase all data.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics, no location, no contacts access.
- Everything stays on this device. RefBoard makes no network connections; Code54 doesn't receive your data.

TRY THE SAMPLE LEAGUE
A fictional youth soccer league opens with unconfirmed games in the next 48 hours, so you can try everything in a minute. Remove it any time.

For adults. Use team names and age groups; don't enter children's names. Questions: support@code54.dev

name: Reggae Fever
description: Reggae Radio hailing from Novi Sad, Serbia. True and original roots, rockers, rub-a-dub and dubwise. Both old school Jamaican style and old school-influenced modern style. Dedicated to true messages and true music.

name: Regulator: Watch Accuracy
description:
How many seconds a day does your watch gain or lose, and is that normal for its movement?

Regulator answers both. Tap when the seconds hand reaches 12, do it again tomorrow, and you get the daily rate. Then Regulator compares it with the factory range the movement maker publishes, for example −20 to +40 seconds a day for many popular automatic calibres.

HOW IT WORKS
• Reference time from time.apple.com, so your iPhone clock does not need to be perfect.
• Tap at 12. Regulator proposes the minute your watch showed; correct it with one tap if needed.
• Two readings at least 6 hours apart give a rate. 24 hours gives a reliable one. Regulator shows how precise the result is.
• "I Set My Watch" starts a new run, so setting the time never spoils a rate.
• An optional reminder tells you when to measure again.

THE MOVEMENT CHECK
Choose the movement from the list (Seiko, Miyota, Sellita, ETA, Seagull and more), or enter your own range. Regulator tells you if the rate is inside the factory range, and gives the common reasons when it is not.

FREE, FOREVER
• One watch
• Unlimited readings, the daily rate and the movement check
• Reminders

REGULATOR PRO — ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlimited watches
• Drift chart and the history of every run
• Position test: rest the watch dial up, dial down or crown down overnight and compare the rate in each position
• CSV export for a spreadsheet or your watchmaker

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Regulator saves your readings on your iPhone and never sends them to the developer.

Regulator measures timekeeping. It does not listen to the watch and it does not replace a timegrapher or a watchmaker.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://daria-kopaliani.github.io/regulatorwatch/privacy/

name: RemindCall
description:
스마트폰을 쓰다 보면 상대의 이름만 보이고 번호도, 지난 대화도 기억나지 않습니다. RemindCall은 연락처의 번호·생일과 내가 남긴 메모를 한 장의 카드로 보여 줍니다.

■ 연락처 카드
- 이름, 번호, 회사, 생일 D-day, 메모, 태그, 마지막 연락을 한 화면에
- 카드에서 바로 전화 걸기
- 오른쪽으로 밀거나 아래로 끌어 내려 닫기

■ 키패드 조회
- 번호 뒷자리만 눌러도 일치하는 연락처가 나타납니다
- 연락처에 없는 번호도 바로 전화할 수 있어요

■ 즐겨찾기와 정렬
- 자주 연락하는 사람을 카드로 모아 보기
- 이름순, 최근 연락순, 연락 오래된 순, 생일 임박순

■ 내 방식대로 표시
- 목록과 즐겨찾기 카드에 보여 줄 정보와 순서를 직접 선택
- 미리보기를 보며 바로 확인

■ 필요한 기능만 켜기 (설정에서 선택)
- 통화 후 메모 알림: 알림을 길게 눌러 앱을 열지 않고 메모 남기기
- 생일 알림: 당일 또는 하루 전
- 모르는 번호 이름표: 연락처에 없는 번호에서 전화가 올 때 이름표 표시

■ 개인정보
- 광고·분석·추적이 없고 계정도 필요 없습니다
- 연락처는 기기 밖으로 나가지 않으며, 메모와 설정은 나의 iCloud로만 동기화됩니다
- 통화 내용을 녹음하거나 문자·시스템 통화 기록을 읽지 않습니다

※ iOS 정책상 시스템 전화 앱의 통화 기록과 수신 화면에는 개입할 수 없습니다. 앱의 통화 기록은 RemindCall에서 전화 버튼으로 건 통화만 표시합니다.

name: Remont AI: projekt wnętrz
description:
Zrób zdjęcie pokoju i zobacz go po remoncie. Remont AI zostawia okna, drzwi i układ ścian, a zmienia to, co chcesz: podłogę, ściany, meble i oświetlenie.

JAK TO DZIAŁA
• Zrób zdjęcie albo wybierz je z galerii. W Zdjęciach możesz też nacisnąć Udostępnij i wybrać Remont AI.
• Wskaż, co jest na zdjęciu: salon, kuchnia, łazienka, sypialnia, pokój dziecka, przedpokój, gabinet, jadalnia, balkon albo elewacja domu.
• Wybierz zakres: pełny remont, odświeżenie, urządzanie od zera, nowe meble albo własny pomysł.
• Styl wybierasz na trzy sposoby: krótki quiz, własny opis (możesz go podyktować) albo jeden z 9 gotowych stylów.

WYNIK PO OKOŁO MINUCIE
• Przed i po na jednym zdjęciu: przesuwasz palcem wałek malarski.
• Lista zmian: dopisz „ściany w kolorze szałwii” albo „bez dywanu”, a powstanie kolejna wersja. Reszta zdjęcia zostaje bez zmian.
• Wszystkie wersje zostają w projekcie.

DLA RODZINY I EKIPY
• Zapisz wizualizację w Zdjęciach.
• Wyślij rodzinie kolaż przed i po.
• Pokaż fachowcom, o jaki efekt Ci chodzi.

9 STYLÓW
Nowoczesny, skandynawski, japandi, nowoczesna klasyka, glamour, loft, rustykalny, boho i minimalizm. Do tego kolory, budżet i to, co ma zostać bez zmian.

GWIAZDKI I ABONAMENT
Jedna gwiazdka to jedna nowa wizualizacja. Pierwszy projekt przygotujemy na Twoim zdjęciu jeszcze przed zakupem, a pełną wersję odblokujesz abonamentem albo pakietem gwiazdek.
Abonament daje 20 gwiazdek co miesiąc: plan miesięczny z 3 dniami za darmo na start albo plan roczny. Gwiazdki z abonamentu odnawiają się co miesiąc. Gwiazdki kupione osobno nie wygasają.
Subskrypcja odnawia się automatycznie, chyba że wyłączysz odnawianie co najmniej 24 godziny przed końcem okresu. Zarządzasz nią w Ustawieniach, w sekcji Apple ID > Subskrypcje.

Wizualizacje tworzy sztuczna inteligencja. To podgląd pomysłu, a nie projekt techniczny: wymiary, instalacje i koszty sprawdź z fachowcem.

Regulamin: https://remontai.xyz/regulamin/
Polityka prywatności: https://remontai.xyz/polityka-prywatnosci/

name: Reppl
description:
Products get a launch. You should too.

Everywhere else, you're a flat profile: a photo, a title, a list. Nobody remembers a list.

Reppl gives you a launch scene. Meet someone, show your code, and your name plays on their phone: a departures board flipping to you, a moon-landing broadcast, a terminal typing you out, and more. They remember the moment, and they remember you.

Be memorable. One screen, in the Scene that's you.

Stay in touch. They give theirs back, and you keep each other. Message the people you've actually met.

Introduce people you'd rep. Put two people you know in touch. They connect only if both say yes.

No follower counts. No ads. No strangers in your inbox.

Delete your account any time, in Settings or at reppl.one/delete-account. Questions: support@reppl.one.

name: Reps: Workouts Log
description:
Reps is a simple workout log for iPhone. It is free, with no account and no ads, and your workouts stay on your phone.

• Log sets fast, with last time's numbers
• Rest timer on your Lock Screen
• Optional targets: your next weight and reps
• Personal bests, charts and a year in review
• Warm-up, drop and timed sets, supersets
• Training plans, or paste one from a chatbot
• Import workouts from other apps (Hevy, Strong, etc.)
• Saves to Apple Health, backs up to Files
...and many more!

Questions, bugs or ideas: mohammad@morad.io

name: ReserveNature
description:
Popular campsites, huts and permits sell out in minutes. Then people cancel — and those spots go to whoever finds out first.

ReserveNature watches the places you care about around the clock and pushes an alert to your phone the moment a cancellation opens. Tap the alert and you land right on the booking page, so you can grab the spot in seconds.

ALERTS THAT ARRIVE FIRST
• Instant push notifications when a spot opens, with SMS as a backup
• Tap an alert to jump straight to the booking page
• See every alert we've sent, with the dates and spot that opened

YOUR TRACKERS IN ONE PLACE
• See everything you're watching: dates, party size and the sites you picked
• Pause a tracker while your plans are up in the air, and resume it anytime
• Stop trackers you no longer need
• Check each tracker's alert history, including how long each spot stayed open, so you know how fast you need to be

WORKS ACROSS THE PLACES PEOPLE WANT MOST
National park campgrounds, backcountry permits, lottery hikes, huts and Great Walks, state parks, cabins and lookouts in the US, Canada, New Zealand and beyond.

Sign in with the phone number you use on ReserveNature. Your account stays signed in on this device, and you can delete it from the Account tab at any time.

ReserveNature is not affiliated with Recreation.gov, Parks Canada, the NZ Department of Conservation or any park agency.

name: Restaurante - Qymera
description:
Qymera Restaurante es la app del mesero y de la cocina para los restaurantes que trabajan con Qymera ERP en Modo Restaurante.

Toma el pedido en la mesa y envíalo a la cocina o a la barra sin caminar hasta la caja. Mira qué mesas están libres, ocupadas o por cobrar, abre cuentas, agrega platos con sus opciones y recibe el aviso cuando un plato está listo para llevar.

• Mapa y lista de mesas por zona (salón, terraza), con el estado de cada una.
• Cuentas por mesa: varias cuentas en la misma mesa y división de la cuenta.
• Menú con búsqueda y categorías; elige guarnición, salsas y otras opciones del plato.
• Envía cada plato a la cocina o a la barra que le corresponde.
• Aviso cuando un plato está listo y entrega con un toque.
• Pide la cuenta para que la caja cobre.
• Reservas del día, con la mesa asignada.
• Tableta de cocina: ve los pedidos por mesa o por plato, del más antiguo al más nuevo.
• Desbloqueo con tu huella, tu cara o el PIN del teléfono.

Para usarla, tu restaurante debe tener Qymera ERP en Modo Restaurante. El administrador te da un código QR para vincular tu celular o la tableta de la cocina.

name: RevRing.com
description:
RevRing for iPhone puts your RevRing workspace in your pocket. Sign in with your existing RevRing account and keep working between the office and the field.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Home: see your calls, talk time, sales and appointments for today, and compare them with earlier periods.
• Calls: call your contacts from your RevRing business number, review your call history and listen to voicemail.
• Contacts: look up a contact, read their history, or add a new contact on the spot.
• Calendar: check your appointments and what is coming up next.
• Field: load doors from a contact list or an area (ZIP codes, a city or a state), plan a door-to-door route on the map, log each visit and review the session afterwards.
• Quotes: run insurance quotes while you are with a client: Medicare Supplement, Medicare Advantage, final expense, term life, dental and hospital indemnity.
• Notifications: get alerts for new leads, messages, missed calls and voicemail.

GOOD TO KNOW

• A RevRing account is required. There is no sign-up in the app, and your organization's plan decides which sections you see.
• Signing in takes your password and a 6-digit code.
• Location is used only by the Field tools: while you use them, and during a knock session you start, so the route keeps recording with the screen locked until you end the session.
• The microphone is used only during calls.

Questions? Email support@revring.com
Privacy policy: https://www.revring.com/privacy-policy
Delete your account: https://www.revring.com/account-deletion

name: RF Scout
description:
RF Scout tells production sound mixers which wireless mic bands to favor, watch and avoid at a location, before you get there.

Type an address, venue or city. RF Scout looks up the TV stations and other licensed transmitters around it in public FCC data and scores every UHF channel: Recommended, Caution or Avoid. You see the result in the blocks your gear actually tunes, not just raw frequencies.

• Any address, venue or city in the US, plus the wireless mic band rules for Canada, the UK and Mexico
• Your gear, your blocks: add your transmitters once and the advisory shows what they can tune
• Map of nearby transmitters with distance, power and estimated signal
• One-page PDF cheat sheet to save, print or send to the crew
• Works on set with no signal: advisories you've run are saved on your phone
• Field Notes: plain-English guides to wireless mic frequencies, the 600 MHz repack, TV channel 37 and more

No account, no ads.

RF Scout is a planning tool, not a scanner. It estimates likely congestion from public data, which can be incomplete or out of date. Always scan with your own receivers on location, and operate within your license and the rules where you are.

Made by Joe Giannotti (Florida Sound Man), a production sound mixer since 2008.

name: RideSync Indoor
description:
RideSync brings your indoor rides into Apple Health, second by second.

Zwift and MyWhoosh save every ride as a .fit file. RideSync reads those files and writes a complete indoor cycling workout to Health: heart rate, power, cadence, speed, distance and active energy for every second you rode, with pauses and laps. Fitness then counts the ride towards your rings, trends and training load.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the iCloud Drive folder where your .fit files arrive. With Desktop & Documents in iCloud turned on, Zwift's Activities folder syncs from your Mac on its own.
• New rides appear in the list every time you open the app. Import them one by one or all at once.
• Preview each ride before importing: duration, distance, average and normalized power, heart rate, cadence, calories and charts of power and heart rate.
• Prefer to do it by hand? Open any .fit file from Files, Mail or AirDrop with Share › RideSync.

BUILT FOR TRAINING
• Effort: set your FTP and RideSync estimates an effort score (1–10) for each ride, so Fitness can calculate your training load.
• No duplicates: importing the same file twice never creates a second workout.
• Overlap check: if Strava or your Apple Watch already recorded the ride, RideSync asks whether to skip it or import it anyway.
• Choose what to write: turn off any series before importing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no servers, no ads, no tracking. Your files and your health data stay on your iPhone.

RideSync is an independent app and is not affiliated with Zwift, Inc., MyWhoosh or Apple. Zwift and MyWhoosh are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: RideTrigger
description:
RideTrigger for CarPlay – Unified GoPro & Insta360 Camera Control on Your Dashboard!

Never miss a moment on the road. RideTrigger brings seamless, hands-free control of both your GoPro and Insta360 action cameras directly to your Apple CarPlay screen. Purpose-built for motorcyclists, adventure riders, overlanders, and drivers who cannot safely reach a helmet camera or handle an iPhone while moving.

No more guessing whether your helmet or handlebar camera is recording, struggling with tiny camera buttons in motorcycle gloves, or relying on voice commands in wind noise. With an oversized, distraction-free cockpit interface engineered specifically for Apple CarPlay, full camera control is always one tap away.

Key Features:
• Unified Multi-Camera Dashboard: Connect GoPro and Insta360 cameras in one app. View your paired cameras in a single CarPlay list and control front, helmet, or rear-mounted setups without switching apps.

• One-Tap Recording & Shutter: Start or stop video recording, capture instant photos, or trigger time-lapses with a single tap on your Apple CarPlay touchscreen or handlebar/steering wheel controls.

• Mode & Lens Switching: Toggle effortlessly between 360° and Single Lens modes on supported Insta360 cameras, and switch between Video, Photo, and Time-Lapse modes directly from your dashboard.

• Live Camera Vitals & Standby Control: Check real-time recording status, battery percentage, remaining SD card storage (in GB), active capture mode, and wake or put your camera to sleep remotely.

• Battery-Friendly Bluetooth (BLE) & Auto-Connect: Operates over Bluetooth Low Energy without power-hungry Wi-Fi video streaming, keeping your camera cool and extending battery life all day. Automatically reconnects when CarPlay launches.

• Built for Riders & Gloves: High-contrast visuals and large touch targets designed for quick, safe glances so your eyes stay on the road.

Perfect For:
• Motorcycle riders with helmet, handlebar, or tail-mounted cameras
• Adventure tourers, overlanders, and road-trip travelers
• Motovloggers, automotive creators, and 360° storytellers

Compatible Cameras (Apple CarPlay / iOS):
• GoPro: HERO 13, HERO 12, HERO 11, HERO 11 Mini, HERO 10, HERO 9, Mission 1, Mission 1 Pro, Lit Hero, and Max 2
• Insta360: X6, X5, X4 Air, X4, X3, ONE X2, ONE X, ONE RS, and ONE RS 1-Inch

System Requirements:
• iPhone running iOS 16.0 or later
• Apple CarPlay compatible motorcycle display, head unit, or vehicle

Easy Setup in 3 Steps:
1. Turn on Bluetooth and pair your GoPro and/or Insta360 camera once inside the RideTrigger iPhone app.
2. Connect your iPhone to your motorcycle or car Apple CarPlay display.
3. Open RideTrigger on CarPlay, tap to record, and enjoy the ride!

Important Compatibility Notes:
• Insta360 Ace Pro, Ace Pro 2, GO 3S, and GO Ultra are currently NOT supported on iOS / Apple CarPlay due to official iOS SDK limitations.
• GoPro HERO 8 and older models (as well as original GoPro MAX) are not supported.
• Available modes and features may vary by camera model and firmware version. For best reliability, update your camera to the latest official firmware.

Disclaimer: GoPro and HERO are trademarks or registered trademarks of GoPro, Inc. Insta360 is a trademark of Arashi Vision Inc. Apple, Apple CarPlay, and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc. RideTrigger is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by GoPro, Inc., Arashi Vision Inc., or Apple Inc.

name: RIDEVERSE
description:
RIDEVERSE es la app del off-road en Chile: motocross, enduro, mountain bike, BMX y automovilismo en un solo lugar.

ENCUENTRA DÓNDE RODAR
• Mapa de pistas de todo Chile con disciplina, región y precio de entrada.
• «Abiertas hoy»: los circuitos socios publican si la pista está abierta, con precaución o cerrada, antes de que cargues la moto.
• Ficha de cada circuito con horarios, servicios, tarifas y próximos eventos.

CRONOMETRA TUS VUELTAS
• Marca la meta y la app detecta cada paso con el GPS del teléfono, o cronómetro manual con un toque.
• Tu mejor vuelta por pista y el historial de cada sesión.
• Funciona sin señal: se guarda en el teléfono y se respalda en tu cuenta cuando vuelve la conexión.

TU MOTO TE AVISA
• Cada sesión suma horas de motor a tu moto o bici.
• Plan de mantención con aceite, filtros, cadena, pastillas y pistón, con aviso antes de que toque.
• Registro de gastos y total de los últimos 12 meses.

ENTRA SIN FILAS
• Pase QR personal: en la portería te registran sin tipear.
• Firma el descargo de responsabilidad una vez por temporada desde el teléfono.
• Inscríbete en carreras y jornadas.

PARA DUEÑOS DE PISTA
• Portería en el teléfono: escanea pases, registra entradas y mira los ingresos del día.
• Abonos, descargos, eventos y finanzas en el panel web.

Crear una cuenta es gratis para pilotos.

name: Rift Remote
description:
