Rift Remote turns your iPhone into a remote for the League of Legends client running on your own Windows PC. Step away from the desk and keep your match under control.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Start the queue and accept the match from your phone, even from the notification
• Ban, pick and swap in champion select
• See runes and builds for your champion and apply them with one tap
• Set up the autopilot: accept, ban and pick from your own list per lane. You can always change the choice before it locks
• See the rank and history of the players in your game
• Answer lobby invites and messages from friends
• Follow the queue and champion select on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

HOW IT WORKS
Install the free Rift Remote connector on your Windows PC (riftremote.com), sign in with the same account on the PC and on the phone, and they find each other. No ports to open and no codes to type.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
Nothing is played or bought for you inside the game. The app does not read the game's memory and does not change the game.

REQUIREMENTS
A Windows PC with League of Legends installed and the Rift Remote connector running. Without them the app only offers the built-in simulator.

FREE PLAN AND SUBSCRIPTION
The free plan starts the queue and accepts the match from your phone, and shows ads. The subscription unlocks everything else (bans and picks, runes and builds, scout, chat and invites, autopilot, opening the game from afar and automatic login) and removes the ads. There are three Premium plans: Monthly, Yearly and a Monthly Offer, each with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. The subscription is tied to the e-mail you sign in with.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://riftremote.com/privacy

Rift Remote isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.

name: Rigway Driver
description:
Rigway Driver is the driver app for trucking companies that run on Rigway. Your company invites you, you sign in, and your loads are right there.

YOUR LOADS
- See every load dispatched to you: pickup window, stops, addresses, dock numbers, commodity, weight and miles.
- Get a notification when dispatch assigns you a new load or sends you a message.
- Check in and check out at each stop with one tap. Your dispatcher sees it right away.
- Open any stop in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.

LOCATION THAT KEEPS WORKING
- While you have an active load, Rigway shares your truck's location with your dispatcher, even with the phone locked, so they know when you will arrive without calling you.
- You turn sharing on and off in the app. It is only used for your loads.

PAPERWORK
- Scan the BOL and POD with the camera: the page edges are found and each page is straightened automatically, then attached to the load.
- Keep your CDL, medical card and other documents in one place, with reminders before they expire.

PAY
- See your next payday and what you have earned, load by load.
- Open your weekly pay statements and ask for an advance.

MESSAGES
- Message dispatch and fleet from the app, with quick replies like "On my way" and "Arrived, waiting for a door".
- Ask for time off.

Rigway Driver needs an account from a trucking company that uses Rigway. Drivers never pay. To start Rigway for your company, visit rigwayapp.com.

name: Rim Slip
description:
Rim Slip is for the moment you are standing beside a home aquarium with the siphon bucket still on the floor. Name the one glass, drag the water line for the liters you took out, and match the bucket for the liters you put back. The rim shows what share of the glass that was. Write the new water's temperature, the conditioner drops, whether you siphoned the gravel, and a short note.

On the dish, write the food, tap once for each pinch, and mark whether they ate. Every water change and every feeding stays in a slip list on this iPhone. Open a slip to read it again. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

The result is the record itself: liters out, liters back, the percent of the glass, the food, and the pinches. It stays on the phone for the person who keeps the tank.

name: Rimeglide
description:
A small rabbit in a coral scarf has a long winter ahead. Slide into Stillwater and gather the golden frost seeds that wake each pond.

Glide until the shore stops you. Rest in a snowbank, use the wind arrows to change direction, and plan your route around thin ice that breaks behind you. Collect every seed to open the frozen gates and reach the bloom.

- Thaw 48 ponds across six chapters.
- Meet each pond’s turn target for three frost marks.
- Swipe on the ice or play with the direction buttons.
- Undo a glide, restart a pond, or resume a saved expedition.
- Revisit unlocked ponds and share a completed result.

name: Ring Recall: Dog Agility
description:
Get the course into your head before you step into the ring. Study a numbered agility map, rotate the board to match your view, then tap the next obstacle from memory. When an entrance matters, choose the end where your dog should go in.

Bring a map from Photos or Files, choose a page from a PDF, scan a paper map with your camera, or lay out the obstacles yourself. Ring Recall suggests visit numbers on your device. Open the original at a visit to check the printed number, repeated equipment and approach side. Confirm the course before you practice.

At the end of a run, see which visits you got right on the first try. Practice the missed visits again and revisit your results in History. Your library and practice records stay on your device.

Free to download. Three practice courses and space for one personal map are included. A one-time Personal course library purchase unlocks unlimited personal map storage.

name: RingEscape: Rings Puzzle
description:
Rotate. Align. Release every ring.

RingEscape is a calm, tactile logic game built around coherent geometry. Rotate colorful open rings with one finger, discover which contacts are blocking them, and free the board in the right order.

FIND YOUR FLOW
• Progress through 1,000 deterministic, solver-verified levels
• Return for a shared, seeded daily challenge
• Relax in Zen mode or generate an Endless puzzle
• Use optional hints when you need a new perspective
• Collect stars and coins and unlock cosmetic themes

BUILT FOR COMFORT
• One-finger rotation with clear geometric feedback
• Nine visual themes
• Offline play with local progress
• No account, life limits or pay-to-win advantages

Optional purchases provide hints, cosmetic themes and a Premium unlock. There is no mandatory subscription.

name: Ringflut: Ring & Gear Puzzle
description:
A spring bubbles up in the middle, surrounded by colorful rings, each with one gap. Turn the rings until all gaps line up. Then the water shoots out through every ring.

Sounds easy. At first, it is.

GEARS MAKE IT TRICKY
Gears sit between the rings. Turn one ring and its neighbor turns too. With one gear it turns the opposite way, with two gears in a row the same way. Silver rings can't be touched at all, they only move through a gear. So you think first about which ring to turn.

150 LEVELS, EACH A LITTLE HARDER
It starts with two rings and slowly grows: three, four, then five rings, more gears, locked rings. Anything new is briefly explained the first time it shows up. Every level is guaranteed to be solvable.

STARS, NOT TIME PRESSURE
Every level has a best possible number of moves. Match it and you get three stars. You can't lose: no timer, no lives. If you get stuck, "Hint" shows you the next correct move. As often as you like, without watching an ad for it.

FOR A SHORT BREAK
Levels are short and fit into a coffee break. Ringflut works offline, needs no account and remembers where you left off. Sound and vibration can be turned off.

BUY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The first 15 levels are free. The full version unlocks all 150 levels with a single purchase. No ads, no data collection. Shareable with your family.

name: Rinse: Photo Cleaner
description:
Rinse is a photo cleaner that you buy once and keep forever. There are no subscriptions.
It works on device so your photos and videos are 100% private.

Rinse finds the duplicates, accidental shots and old screenshots filling up your library. It keeps the best of each and helps you clear out the rest.

AUTO CLEAN
Rinse goes through your library and sorts what it finds into simple groups. The sure things are already selected for you. The rest wait for you to take a quick look.

Similar shots and duplicates, with the best one kept. If people are in the photo, the one with the clearest faces wins. With cats and dogs, Rinse keeps the shot where your pet's face shows and the pet is sharpest.
Burst leftovers: the frames you didn't pick.
Accidental shots: pocket photos, black frames and pictures of the floor.
Old screenshots and screen recordings, like tickets and maps you no longer need.
Large videos, biggest first, and clips under two seconds.
Memes and images saved from other apps.
Old photos of receipts, labels and whiteboards.

MANUAL
Prefer to decide for yourself? Go through your library one week at a time. Swipe left to delete, right to keep.

COMPRESS
Make videos and photos smaller without changing how they look. Photos keep their original format. You can also turn Live Photos into still photos and drop the short video that comes with each one.

If you need help, please don't hesitate to reach out at hello@solidapps.co

name: Rippa Cam
description:
Turn your iPhone into a camera for your Rippa studio.

Scan the Cards QR code in Rippa to show your card table from above, or scan a Face code to send your camera and your voice. Rippa Cam connects straight to your studio and shows LIVE when your studio has the picture.

- Full HD video using your iPhone's hardware encoder
- Back camera for cards, front camera and microphone for your face
- Restart or flip the camera, and mute the microphone, with one tap
- Reconnects by itself if the network drops
- Keeps your screen awake while you're live

Requires a Rippa studio camera code. No account, no ads, no tracking and no purchases.

name: Rock Blaster: Retro Arcade
description:
Rock Blaster is a retro arcade space shooter inspired by the vector arcade games of the 1980s. Hold the left or right third of the screen to turn, and the center to thrust and fire.

Split rocks, blast alien saucers, and climb through harder waves. Earn an extra life every 10,000 points. Arcade mode is about the score, while Adventure mode adds levels and bosses.

Versus lets you race a friend's score over Game Center. Game controller and keyboard support is included, along with captions, colorblind colors, easy mode, and Reduced Motion.

name: Rocket Dash: World Domination
description:
You are Ruckus, a cocky super-missile who just blew his way out of General Grimjaw's lab. Now you're tearing through Baron Vex's empire one world at a time.

Swipe to switch lanes, hop and dive, smash anything small enough to smash and dodge everything that isn't. Fill up your energy, kick into Overdrive, and finish every world by ramming a giant boss right in the reactor. It's loud, it's fast, and it's seriously hard to put down.

EVERY RUN IS A RIOT
- Swipe to survive: three lanes, one missile. Switch, hop over trouble and dive under it.
- Smash everything: plough through grunts, tanks and drones, and read the telegraphed fire before it reads you.
- Hit Overdrive: grab energy cells, fill the meter and go supersonic.
- Ram the boss: every world ends with a giant commander. Dodge the barrage, then go straight for the reactor.

7 WORLDS, 42 MISSIONS, 7 GIANT BOSSES
Skullstone Fortress, Sunscorch Dominion, Jungle Fallout, Polar Panic, Neon Lockdown, Molten Machineworks and Orbital Override, where your replacement, MIRROR-X, races you all the way to the top.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Endless Conquest: all seven worlds back to back, for as long as your hull holds out.
- Challenge Missions and a fresh Daily Challenge every day.
- Chase three stars on the War Map. Mayhem difficulty is not kidding.
- Boot Camp: learn every move and weapon.

LOAD UP THE ARMORY
Grab weapon canisters on the road or stock up in the Armory between runs. When things get really loud, call in Wingnut to smash the screen or ACE for air cover. Spend your coins in the Hangar on new skins and pilots.

FREE TO START
Skullstone Fortress, all six missions up to General Grimjaw, is free. One purchase unlocks the full game: all seven worlds, unlimited Endless Conquest and Challenge Missions. No ads.

Your progress backs up to the cloud automatically. Sign in with Apple or Google to play on all your devices.

name: Rolewise: Jobs that fit you
description:
Find jobs that fit you.

Rolewise shows live job listings ranked by how well they fit you. No sign-up and no resume needed to start.

Jobs in Australia and New Zealand, plus job search in Canada, the USA, the UK, Ireland, South Africa, India, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, the UAE, Qatar and Kuwait.

SEARCH IN PLAIN ENGLISH
Type the job you want the way you'd say it: "nurse in Parramatta", "project manager in Sydney over $150k" or "chef within 5 km of 2000". Jobs are scored and sorted by fit.

ADD YOUR RESUME FOR BETTER MATCHES
Upload your resume (PDF or Word) and your skills are compared with every ad, so the best fits rise to the top.

FREE FIT CHECK ON ANY JOB
See what you match, what's missing and, where your resume has the detail, two of your lines rewritten for that job. Found an ad somewhere else? Paste it in and check your fit.

AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT JOBS
Includes federal government (APS) and Queensland Government jobs.

FILTER BY FIT SCORE
Only see jobs scoring 50%, 70% or 85% and over.

WEEKLY JOB ALERTS
Save a search and get new matching jobs by email every Monday. Every email has a one-tap unsubscribe.

WATCH EMPLOYERS
Follow the employers you'd like to work for and see their new jobs that fit you.

SHARE A JOB
Send a job to a friend in one tap.

Your privacy:
- No account needed.
- Your resume is used to match you to jobs and isn't kept unless you choose to save it.
- Your information is never sold.
- Rolewise never applies for jobs on your behalf.

Rolewise is for people aged 18 and over. Questions? hello@rolewise.com.au

name: Rollleft
description: Rollleft is a film-frame notebook. Each roll stores a film name, an ISO, a camera name, a capacity of 24 or 36, and frames already shot. Frames left are capacity minus frames shot. Spent means left is zero. A shot record adds a batch of frames when there is room, and deleting that shot subtracts them again. Changing capacity to a number smaller than frames already shot is refused. Nothing is uploaded, and the app is not a light meter.

name: Rollr
description:
Arabanın fotoğrafını yükle, yapay zekâ onu sinematik bir "rolling shot" videosuna çevirsin: yan yana giden kamera, otoyol, gece şehri, dağ yolu, sahil ve daha fazlası.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
1. Bir video türü seç (otoyol, gece şehri, dağ yolu, sahil yolu, sonbahar ormanı, şehir merkezi).
2. Arabanın fotoğrafını yükle. Her tür için önerilen açıyı gösteririz.
3. Süreyi seç ve başlat. Videon hazır olunca kaydet ve paylaş.

ÖZELLİKLER
- Altı farklı sahne ve ortam
- 6 ve 10 saniyelik videolar
- Plaka bulanıklaştırma (varsayılan olarak açık)
- Videoyu galerine kaydet, paylaş ya da sil
- İlk videon ücretsiz (Rollr filigranlı)

Videolar yapay zekâ ile üretilir. Sonuçlar gerçeğe birebir uymayabilir; renk ve araç detayları farklı çıkabilir. Yalnızca sana ait ya da kullanma hakkın olan fotoğrafları yükle. Rollr'ü kullanmak için 18 yaşında olmalısın.

name: Rollsort: Camera Roll Cleaner
description:
Open Rollsort and start with one photo. Swipe right to keep it, left to put it in the review bin, or up to bookmark it for later. Close the app mid-stack and pick up where you left off. Undo brings back your last decision.

When several shots look alike, open the group, zoom in, and choose your keepers together. You can also compare two photos side by side. For a more focused pass, switch to screenshots or videos, open a month, revisit On This Day, or try a shuffled set.

Putting a photo in the bin leaves it in Apple Photos. Open the bin to preview your picks and check exactly which items to delete. You can cancel before confirming in Photos.

Try the built-in sample roll before connecting your own library. Rollsort supports full or limited Photos access and stores your sorting progress on your device. One upfront purchase includes all features.

name: Roomspecpro
description:
Standing in the hardware store wondering which bulb fits your kitchen light? Trying to remember the exact paint color from the bedroom wall? Roomspec keeps every small detail of your home in one place, organized room by room.

ORGANIZE BY ROOM
Create rooms like Kitchen, Bedroom or Living Room, each with its own icon and color. Everything you save lives inside the room it belongs to.

SPEC CARDS FOR EVERYTHING
• Bulbs – base type, wattage, warm or cool light
• Paint – brand, color code, finish
• Measurements – walls, windows, doors, beds, curtains
• Appliances – model number, serial number, filter size
• Custom – anything else you want to remember

ADD PHOTOS
Snap a photo of a label, model plate or paint can so you always have the exact reference.

SHOPPING MODE
At the store? Open Shopping Mode to instantly see the specs you need, such as every bulb in the kitchen, in a clean, easy-to-read list.

QUICK SEARCH
Type "E27" or "filter" and find every matching item across your whole home.

YOUR UNITS
Switch between centimeters, inches and feet anytime.

EXPORT A HOME SPEC SHEET
Create a neat PDF of your home's details. Useful when moving, renovating or handing over to a landlord or tenant.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline
• No account or sign-up needed
• Your data stays on your device

Roomspec is the simple home notebook you'll be glad you started. Save it once, find it forever.

name: Rotr
description:
Rotr turns an iPad into a clocking-in point for your workplace. Staff tap in, tap out. Managers see who's on site, sort timesheets and run fire roll calls from their phone.

SHARED KIOSK
Mount an iPad at the entrance and pair it with your site using a code from the Rotr portal.
• Staff clock in and out with a 4-digit PIN. The same PIN toggles in and out.
• Works offline. Clock-ins are saved on the iPad and sent as soon as it's back online, so nothing is lost if the Wi-Fi drops.
• Forgot your PIN? Find your name on the kiosk and your manager is asked to set a new one.
• Optional photo on each clock-in, so entries can be checked. Photos are deleted automatically.
• Your logo, brand colour and welcome message on the kiosk screen.

VISITORS
Guests sign themselves in at reception with their name and, if they like, their business, email and phone number. They sign out by finding their name. Visitor details are deleted automatically after 90 days.

FIRE REGISTER AND ROLL CALL
In an emergency, everything is on the manager's phone.
• See everyone on site right now: staff who are clocked in and visitors who are signed in.
• Start a roll call and tick people off as they reach the assembly point. Several managers can tick at once and see each other's progress.
• Share a summary when you're done.

FOR MANAGERS
Sign in with your Rotr portal email and password to see every site you look after: who's in, who's out and who missed a clock-out.

Rotr works with a Rotr account. Timesheets, CSV exports, people and PINs, devices and integrations are managed in the Rotr web portal.

PRIVACY
PINs are never stored in plain text. Clock-in photos are deleted on a schedule your business sets, and visitor details after 90 days.

name: Roundpass: Party Games
description:
Roundpass is a collection of ten party games for a single iPhone. Sit in a circle, pass the phone around and play. No account, no ads, no subscription, no internet needed.

THE TEN GAMES
• Find the Impostor: everyone knows the word except the impostor. Bluff well and you win.
• Who's the Spy? Everyone knows the place and their role there, except the spy, who has to figure it out.
• Who's Got the Bomb? Name a word for the task and pass the phone. Whoever holds it when it goes POOF takes a penalty point.
• Only Wrong Answers: easy questions, but you have to answer wrong, instantly. Harder than it sounds.
• Who Am I? Hold the phone to your forehead while the others explain or act it out (or only answer yes or no questions). Tilt the phone to score.
• Who's Most Likely To? On three, everyone points at the person who fits best.
• Would You Rather? Two options, thumbs left or right, and the argument starts.
• Sketch It: one person draws with a finger, the next guesses, the next draws that guess. At the end you laugh at the chain.
• 10/10, But …: they are a perfect 10, but … how much is left? Topics like date, crush, roommate or boss.
• $20 Draft: everyone gets the same play money and bids on burger toppings, superpowers or vacation spots. Who builds the best collection? (Play money only, nothing is ever bought.)

ONE PHONE FOR EVERYONE
• 2 to 20 players; names and groups (like "Roommates" or "Family") are saved
• Privacy screen: when you pass the phone, it only shows a name. You see the secret only while you hold the button.
• More than 2,200 words, questions, places and ideas, cheeky but youth-safe, and they do not repeat for a long time
• Your own packs: write your own words, questions and places and play them
• Content in English or German, independent of the app language
• Timers, scores you can adjust, and rules for every game right in the app
• Self-made retro-style music and sounds, with a button to turn them off
• Large text and VoiceOver are supported; Sketch It can also be played as "Describe" instead of drawing

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Roundpass costs nothing and has no subscription, no ads and no account. There is no server and no tracking: names, groups and your own packs stay on your iPhone and are never sent to us. A backup file takes everything with you to a new iPhone.

For iPhone, in English and German.

Ideas or bugs? Tap "Feedback & Ideas" in Settings or write to kontakt@fairapps.at. Roundpass is part of FairApps, a series of fair apps from Vienna.

name: Rover Hangar
description:
Rover Hangar on your phone is where you talk to your rovers, follow their work and approve what they ask, wherever you are.

Rovers are AI agents that look like plush toys. They research, compare prices, sort files, handle tasks and routines, and come back with the result. They work on a computer: yours, with the Rover Hangar app installed (Mac, Windows or Linux), or a cloud computer linked to your account. From your phone you ask, follow along and decide.

BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD
You need a Rovemark account, which you can create when you open the app. Rovers run in the Rover Hangar app on your computer or, on paid plans, on a cloud computer, and then your phone is all you need. The free plan includes a time-limited cloud trial.

CHAT
• Send text, photos, files or voice messages to any rover.
• See the step a rover is on and the reply arriving while it works on your computer.
• Talk to several rovers in one channel and follow the debates between them.
• Stop a run from your phone when you change your mind.

APPROVE
• Payments and sensitive actions wait for you. The approval card shows what the rover wants to do, on which site and how much it costs.
• To approve, press and hold the button and confirm with Face ID. The rover never sees your card number.
• Questions from rovers arrive with the options ready to tap.

FOLLOW ALONG
• Inbox: approvals, questions and deliveries to review, in one place.
• Tasks: your rovers' board, with new tasks, comments, change requests and delivery approval.
• Missions: multi-day work, with the plan and the progress of each day.
• Routines: turn on, turn off or run now the routines you created on your computer.
• Notifications when a rover finishes or needs you.

ALSO IN THE APP
• Apple Watch: see who is working, approve everyday requests, talk to a rover and run routines from your wrist. Payments are still approved on the iPhone with Face ID.
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.
• App lock: Rover Hangar opens only with Face ID or your iPhone passcode (Settings > Security).
• Rover's computer: watch its screen live and pinch to zoom.
• Vault: see the items, the rules and who used each one. Creating items stays on the computer.
• Rover email, files, memory, teams, receipts for every run and the AI engine of each rover.
• Where requests run: on your computer or, on plans that include the cloud, on the rover's cloud computer.
• iPhone and iPad, light and dark themes, 12 languages.

PRIVACY
Conversations, rovers and the vault live on the computer where your rovers work: yours, or the cloud computer linked to your account. With the app lock on, widgets and the watch show only counts and names. The phone signs in through the Rovemark page and never sees your password. Location stays off until you turn it on in Settings, at the level you choose.

The app is free to download. Some features depend on your Rovemark account plan.

Terms of use: https://roverhangar.com/en/terms
Privacy policy: https://roverhangar.com/en/privacy

name: Rowan Room Studio
description:
Download the Rowan Room Studio app to easily book classes and manage your fitness experience - anytime, anywhere. Make a reservation, get added to a wait list, check your profile and membership status, and more – all from your device.

Visit https://www.therowanroomstudio.com/ to learn more.

name: RowQuest: Rudern am Fluss
description:
RowQuest macht aus dem Training auf dem Heimrudergerät eine Fahrt auf dem Fluss. Die App verbindet sich per Bluetooth mit deinem Rudergerät, liest Tempo, Schlagzahl, Strecke und Leistung und bewegt dein Boot im Takt deiner Schläge. Kein Abo, kein Konto, keine Werbung.

DEIN RUDERGERÄT, DEINE WERTE
RowQuest spricht den Bluetooth-Standard FTMS, den viele Heimrudergeräte nutzen, zum Beispiel von Merach. Im Training siehst du Zeit, Strecke, Tempo auf 500 Meter, Schlagzahl, Watt und Puls. Bietet dein Gerät es an, stellst du den Widerstand direkt in der App. Ohne Rudergerät kannst du alles in der Demo ausprobieren.

NEUN REVIERE, VIER ECHTE FLÜSSE
Rudere auf dem Mittelrhein von Lorch nach St. Goar, auf der Mosel, der Oberen Donau oder der Elbe durch die Sächsische Schweiz. Der Flusslauf stammt aus echten Kartendaten, Ortsschilder zeigen, wo du gerade bist, und jede Fahrt setzt deine Reise dort fort, wo du aufgehört hast. Dazu kommen fünf erfundene Reviere vom Alpenfluss bis zum Fjord. Tageszeit und Wetter wählst du selbst oder übernimmst sie vom echten Fluss.

PROGRAMME FÜR JEDES ZIEL
Freies Rudern, Einstieg, Ausdauer, Intervalle, Pyramide, Sprints, der 2000-Meter-Test und 5000 Meter. Die App sagt jeden Abschnitt an und zeigt dir ein Zieltempo, das sie aus deinen Bestzeiten ableitet. Eigene Programme stellst du aus Abschnitten selbst zusammen.

GEGEN DICH SELBST
Lass dein letztes oder dein bestes Training als Geisterboot mitfahren und sieh während der Fahrt, wie viele Meter du vorn oder hinten liegst.

ERFOLGE, LEVEL UND MEDAILLEN
29 Abzeichen in Bronze, Silber und Gold für Strecken, Serien, Bestzeiten und Flussreisen. Erreichst du im Training einen Erfolg, wirbelt die Medaille ins Bild. Wer das nicht mag, schaltet es aus.

DEIN BOOT
Gestalte Boot und Ruderer: Farben, Rennstreifen, Aufkleber, Startnummer und ein Name auf dem Deck.

PULS VON DER APPLE WATCH
Die Uhren-App misst deinen Puls und schickt ihn an das iPhone. Ruderst du mit dem iPad, reicht das iPhone den Puls per Bluetooth weiter. Ein Brustgurt mit Bluetooth geht ebenso. Mit Geburtsjahr und Ruhepuls zeigt RowQuest deine Pulszonen.

VERLAUF UND BESTZEITEN
Jedes Training landet im Verlauf mit Strecke, Zeit, Tempo und Kurven. Du siehst deine Woche, deine Bestleistungen und deine Serie. Auf Wunsch speichert RowQuest Trainings in Apple Health. Den Verlauf kannst du als Datei sichern und wieder einlesen.

FÜR IPHONE UND IPAD
Auf dem iPad im Querformat vor dem Rudergerät, auf dem iPhone hoch oder quer.

RowQuest sammelt keine Daten. Es gibt keine Anmeldung und keine Analyse-Werkzeuge. Dein Verlauf bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

name: RulviRest
description: Beoordeel uw nachtrust en noteer hoe u zich voelde toen u wakker werd in RulviRest. U kunt de levensstijlgewoonten selecteren die u wilt blijven observeren en voor elke beoordeling een aparte notitie achterlaten. Nadat u de begin- en einddatum hebt geselecteerd, kunt u de gemiddelde scores van de twee perioden vergelijken met hetzelfde aantal dagen ervoor en erna, en vervolgens per dag door de notities bladeren om te onthouden wat er gebeurde toen de scores veranderden.

name: Rummy 500: Classic Cards
description:
Rummy 500 is the classic family card game, made simple and clean for iPhone and iPad.

Dig deep into the discard pile, build sets and runs, and lay off on anyone's melds. Every card you put down scores for you, and every card left in your hand counts against you. First to 500 wins.

PLAY THE COMPUTER
• 1 to 3 computer opponents who play a smart, human-like game
• Call "Rummy!" when an opponent misses a play, and steal the points
• Your game saves automatically, so you can pick up where you left off

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Turn-based online games for 2 to 4 players through Game Center
• Invite friends anywhere in the world and take your turn when it suits you
• The player who starts the match chooses the rules for everyone

YOUR RULES
• First meld 30 or more: on by default, or switch it off for a looser game
• Play to 500 or a quicker 250
• Traditional card values, or simplified scoring where 2 to 9 are worth 5

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Clear, easy-to-read cards on iPhone and iPad
• Sort your hand by suit or by rank, with runs kept together
• Coloured edges show who scores each card on the table
• A short How to play guide built in

No ads. No accounts. No data collected.

name: Rutint.
description:
Rutint is a skincare planner and journal for people who rotate products or follow different morning and evening routines. It helps you remember what you used, how your skin felt, and which products earned a place on your shelf.
Build a routine for each day of the week and arrange your products in the order you use them. Did you use that serum? Would you buy it again?When you follow the plan, log it with one tap. If you skip a step or swap a moisturizer, save the change just for today or make it part of your schedule.
Add a photo, voice memo, or quick note while the details are fresh. When you finish a bottle, look back at when you opened it, how often you used it, and what you paired it with before deciding whether to repurchase.

name: RV Travel Planner Pro
description:
Navigation built for the vehicle you actually drive. RV Travel Planner turns the trip you planned into turn-by-turn guidance that respects your rig's height, width, weight and propane limits, on your iPhone and on your car's CarPlay screen.

PLAN ONCE, DRIVE ANYWHERE
Build your trip on the web at thervtravelplanner.com: stops, campgrounds, reservations, day trips and your RV's dimensions. Open the app and your plan is there, with today's next leg ready the moment CarPlay connects.

ROUTES THAT FIT YOUR RIG
• Routing that respects your RV's height, width and weight
• Pick the right vehicle for each leg: the whole rig, the truck, the towed car or the motorhome on its own
• Avoid unpaved roads, tolls, ferries, motorways and tunnels closed to propane
• Choose between alternative routes before you go
• Arrive at your campground's entrance, with site number, gate code and arrival notes on hand

SEE THE ROAD AHEAD
• Weather along the route, re-checked every 30 minutes while you drive
• Wind alerts tied to your RV's own wind limit, with a calmer departure time suggested
• Steep grade profile with climbs and descents marked, so there are no surprises
• Weather radar on the map and in CarPlay (United States)
• Areas with no reported mobile coverage flagged before you leave

BUILT FOR LONG DAYS
• Fuel stop prompts when a confirmed fuel stop is close to your route
• Upcoming list in CarPlay for fuel, rest areas, dump stations and water
• Driver break reminders after the time you choose
• Booking-window reminders so you never miss a campground opening

CARPLAY AND VOICE
• Full CarPlay navigation: browse your trip, start guidance and see upcoming stops
• Voice search that works on the device, so it keeps working offline
• Phone and CarPlay stay in sync: pause on one, pick up on the other

WORKS WHEN THE SIGNAL DOESN'T
• Download offline maps along your route, with offline routing where the map covers it
• A generous offline grace period, so a gap in coverage never stops your guidance

PLANS
RV Travel Planner needs a Pro plan to navigate. New accounts start with a free trial. A Pro subscription is also available in the app.

RV Travel Planner Pro is an auto-renewing subscription.
• Pro Monthly: $14.99/month. Pro Annual: $149/year.
• (14-day free trial if you set one, then the price above.)
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel it.

Terms of Use (Apple standard license): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.thervtravelplanner.com/privacy-policy

Available in the United States and Canada. Always follow posted signs and local restrictions; route data can be incomplete, and you remain responsible for the safe operation of your vehicle.

Questions? support@mail.thervtravelplanner.com

name: Ryze Order Tracking
description:
Ryze Order Tracking shows you where your restaurant order is, from the moment you pay until it's in your hands.

Order from a restaurant that uses Ryze, then open the tracking link from your order confirmation. You'll see:
• Your order's status: received, preparing, ready, on the way, completed
• The restaurant, your items and the total, with your receipt
• For pickup and curbside, when your order is ready to collect
• For delivery, when your order is on the way

Live on your Lock Screen
Tap "Track on Lock Screen" after you pay, and the Ryze App Clip keeps your order on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with the expected time and a progress track. It updates by itself as the restaurant prepares your order. No app install needed.

Your orders
Every order you track is listed on your phone, so you can check it again with one tap. Your list stays on your phone only, and you can remove any order with a swipe.

No account needed
No sign-up, no password. The app only uses the order link you open.

Available in English and Arabic.

name: Saai
description:
Saai يساعد فرق العمل الميدانية على تنظيم يوم العمل ومتابعة الزيارات والمهام.

• عرض المهام وتفاصيل العميل وموقع الزيارة.
• استخدام موقع الموظف الحالي لبدء يوم العمل وعرض المسار.
• توثيق الوصول وإتمام المهمة بالصور.
• حفظ سجل أيام العمل والمهام المنجزة.
• إدارة الموظفين والمهام والمنتجات من حساب الإدارة.
• واجهة عربية وإنجليزية.

يتطلب التطبيق حساباً توفره جهة العمل. تُستخدم بيانات الموقع أثناء يوم العمل النشط، بما في ذلك عند تشغيل التطبيق في الخلفية، لتمكين جهة العمل من متابعة العمل الميداني. يمكن إيقاف التتبع مؤقتاً أو إنهاء يوم العمل من داخل التطبيق.

name: Sabados Rinkven
description:
Sabados is een eenvoudige scorekaart voor golfvrienden die graag een wedstrijd n hun ronde steken. Je vult per hole de brutoscores in, en de app rekent meteen de punten en de stand uit.

TWEE SPELFORMULES

High-Low (4 spelers, 2 tegen 2)
• Low: de beste bal van elk team tegen elkaar, goed voor 2 punten
• High: de slechtste bal van elk team tegen elkaar, goed voor 1 punt
• Bij gelijkspel vervalt het punt

Amerikaantje (3 spelers, ieder voor zich)
• Op elke hole worden 6 punten verdeeld: 4-2-0
• Twee spelers delen de eerste plaats: 3-3-0
• Twee spelers delen de tweede plaats: 4-1-1
• Alle drie gelijk: 2-2-2

BRUTO OF NETTO
Speel bruto, of netto met de volle handicap van elke speler, verdeeld volgens de stroke index van de baan. Ook plus-handicaps worden correct verrekend. Je kan tijdens de ronde nog wisselen, en op de scorekaart zie je meteen op welke holes iemand een slag krijgt.

SPELERS EN BANEN
Bewaar je vaste medespelers met hun handicap en voeg je eigen banen toe met par en stroke index per hole. Rinkven North en South staan er al in. Je kan 9 of 18 holes spelen en spelers ook tijdens een ronde nog wisselen.

DELEN
Na de ronde maak je met één tik een overzichtelijke scorekaart als afbeelding, klaar om te delen via WhatsApp, Berichten of mail.

PRIVACY
Geen account, geen reclame, geen tracking. Alles wat je invult blijft op je eigen iPhone en de app werkt ook zonder internetverbinding.

name: Sabbath School Planner
description:
Sabbath School Teacher Planner keeps a teacher's class in one private place: who is in the class, who came, whose birthday is near, and what to teach next.

Key features:
• Class roster with first names only — keep children's information minimal on purpose
• Attendance marking by class (preschool, elementary, upper) with here/absent/late
• Birthdays at a glance, so no child's week is missed
• Lesson planning with ideas that cite a scripture reference — the app does not paste verse text
• Parent notes kept with the class record
• Print-friendly views for the roster and the week's plan
• Sign in with an email and passphrase — the class opens only for your account

Made for Sabbath school teachers who prepare on paper, in a notes app, and in their head — and want it in one place instead.

Support: Questions? Contact support@lsbapps.com

Full access is a subscription: $9.99/month or $59.99/year (save 50%). It renews automatically until you cancel, and you can cancel anytime.

name: Sachkundefit – 34a Prüfung
description:
Bereite dich gezielt auf die Sachkundeprüfung nach § 34a GewO für das Bewachungsgewerbe vor, ohne Abo und ohne Werbung. Teste 63 Fragen kostenlos und schalte die Vollversion mit allen 500 Fragen und der Prüfungssimulation einmalig frei.

Aktuelles Prüfungsformat
Seit Juli 2025 besteht die schriftliche Prüfung aus 82 Aufgaben mit 120 Punkten. Bei Mehrfachauswahl gibt es für jede richtige Antwort einen Teilpunkt. Sachkundefit übt genau dieses Format: Einfachauswahl mit fünf, Mehrfachauswahl mit sechs Antworten, Auswertung in Punkten, bestanden ab 50 Prozent.

Rechtsstand 2026
Alle Fragen und Erklärungen sind auf dem aktuellen Stand, unter anderem mit dem Konsumcannabisgesetz und den neuen Messerverboten im Waffengesetz. Jede Erklärung nennt die Rechtsgrundlage.

500 Übungsfragen mit Erklärung
Alle Sachgebiete: öffentliche Sicherheit und Ordnung, Gewerberecht, Datenschutz, BGB, Straf- und Strafverfahrensrecht, Umgang mit Waffen, Unfallverhütung, Umgang mit Menschen und Sicherheitstechnik. Überwiegend Fälle aus dem Wachalltag wie in der echten Prüfung.

Prüfungssimulation unter echten Bedingungen
82 Aufgaben in 120 Minuten, gewichtet nach Sachgebieten wie in der schriftlichen Prüfung. Du kannst pausieren und später weitermachen. Für zwischendurch gibt es einen Kurztest mit 20 Aufgaben.

Mündliche Prüfung
Leitfaden zum Ablauf und zum Aufbau einer guten Antwort, dazu typische Fragen und Fälle mit Stichpunkten: Jedermannrechte, Hausrecht, Festnahme, Deeskalation und mehr.

Lernen, was noch nicht sitzt
Die App merkt sich jede Antwort. Falsch beantwortete Fragen kommen wieder, bis sie sicher sitzen. Der Lernstand zeigt dir je Sachgebiet, wo du stehst. Tagesziel, Lernserie und Wochenverlauf helfen beim Dranbleiben.

Dein Lernstand auf allen Geräten
Wenn du möchtest, meldest du dich mit Google oder Apple an. Dann ist dein Lernstand gesichert und auf Handy und Tablet gleich. Ohne Konto funktioniert alles genauso, dann bleiben die Daten nur auf deinem Gerät.

Erst testen, dann einmal freischalten
63 Fragen aus allen Sachgebieten, der Kurztest, die Statistik und der Bereich zur mündlichen Prüfung sind kostenlos. Die Vollversion schaltest du mit einem Einmalkauf frei. Kein Abo, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

Hinweis: Alle Fragen sind eigens erstellte Übungsfragen, keine Originalaufgaben der IHK. Sachkundefit ist ein unabhängiges Angebot und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Industrie- und Handelskammer.

name: Sadorra Audio
description:
Sadorra Audio reads articles and other text aloud, with natural voices that run entirely on your iPhone or iPad.

Share a story from Safari, your local news app, a blog or any app with a Share button, and it starts playing. You can also paste a link or any text into the app.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Follow along as each sentence is highlighted while it's read
• Change the speed from 0.75x to 2x
• Set a sleep timer for listening in bed
• Turn on Autoplay to move on to the next article by itself
• Play, pause and skip from the lock screen and your AirPods

FOLLOW NEWSLETTERS
Follow newsletters made with Sadorra, and new posts arrive in your library. When a publisher makes an audio edition, you hear it in their own voices, with read-along, or switch to a voice of your choice. Following is free.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Pick up right where you left off
• Sort articles into your own groups, and archive what you've finished
• Play all your saved articles, or just one group

27 VOICES, INCLUDING DORRA
Dorra, the default voice, is named after Sadorra's AI assistant. Try each American and British voice with a sample before you choose, use your device's own voices, or listen in your own Personal Voice.

EVEN IN APPLE NEWS
Some apps, like Apple News, don't share an article's text. Sadorra Audio adds six of its voices to Speak Screen on your iPhone or iPad, so you can hear any screen in a Sadorra voice. The app walks you through setting it up.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Ask Siri to read what you copied, play a group, pause, resume or skip to the next article.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Every voice runs on your device. The text being read never leaves it.
• No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking
• Your library and the publications you follow stay on your device
• Saved articles play without a connection

FREE TO TRY, PAY ONCE
Listen to 3 articles a day with Dorra and Michael, plus your device's own voices. A single in-app purchase removes the limit and unlocks all 27 voices and the Speak Screen voices. No subscription.

Voices are built on open models: Kyutai Pocket TTS (CC BY 4.0), the Alba voice by Alba MacKenna (CC BY 4.0) and Kokoro (Apache 2.0).

name: SafeSpace
description:
Keep your distance. Read the path.

Safe Space is a minimalist strategy game about observation, prediction, and timing. Stay at the center as people move around you. Watch their paths, identify who is most likely to approach, and use limited cues to redirect them before they enter your two-meter circle.

Simple controls make every decision count. Will you wait for a clearer signal, or act before the crowd closes in?

• Explore 30 levels across five chapters, from Quiet Park to Night Gallery.
• Adapt to curved paths, crossing lanes, crowd waves, and pulsing trails.
• Take on a Daily Challenge with changing gameplay modifiers.
• Test your endurance in Endless mode as the crowd grows.
• Practice prediction, cue timing, and crossing patterns in three focused courses.
• Discover movement behaviors in the Path Archive.
• Track your prediction accuracy, best times, and level badges.
• Customize sound, haptics, motion effects, distance labels, and trail contrast.

Play entirely offline, with no accounts, ads, or tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

Watch closely. Choose carefully. Hold your space.

name: Saidan: Merch Shelf & Binder
description:
Snap your merch. It lifts out of the photo and lands on your shelf.
Badges go into your ita bag, photocards slide into binder pockets, acrylic stands line up in a row.
Holo and acrylic shine as you tilt your phone.

CAPTURE
• Photograph a can badge, keychain, acrylic stand or photocard.
• The cut-out lifts out on its own, or frame a photocard with rounded corners in one drag.

THREE WAYS TO DISPLAY
• A glossy shelf for stands and figures.
• An ita bag grid for badges.
• A photocard binder with sleeve pockets.

FOR EVERY FAVE
• A colour and a "fan since" day for each one.
• Prices per item and totals per month, so you know what you spent.
• Countdowns to your next event.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your collection stays on your iPhone.

PAY ONCE
Start free. Saidan Plus is a one-time purchase for unlimited items and faves and three extra shelf themes. No subscription.

Saidan includes no official images. You photograph your own goods.

name: SAIOn
description:
SAIOn: Connect. Communicate. Together.

SAIOn brings your conversations, calls, meetings, notes and tasks into one beautiful app, so you can stay in touch and stay on top of your day.

CHAT YOUR WAY

Send messages, stickers and emojis to friends, family and colleagues
Share sensitive details as confidential messages that stay hidden until the recipient taps to view
Format your text, record voice messages and attach files
See at a glance who is online, away or busy

VOICE & VIDEO CALLS
------------------------------------------------------
Make crystal-clear voice and video calls with one tap
Call directly from any chat
Review your full call history, including missed calls and talk-time stats for the week

MEETINGS MADE EASY
------------------------------------------------------
Start or join meetings with your team
Set your join defaults and streaming quality to suit you
Keep your meeting history alongside your calls

NOTES & TASKS, ALL ORGANIZED
------------------------------------------------------
Capture ideas as notes and plan your day with tasks
Set priorities and categories, and pin what matters most
Track your progress with a daily summary
Share tasks and notes with others, as view-only or editable
Set reminders so nothing slips through

AUTO REPLY
------------------------------------------------------
Set up reply templates for different kinds of contacts
Organize people by relationship: family, friends, boss and colleagues
Train your auto-replies so they sound like you

A HOME SCREEN THAT WORKS FOR YOU
------------------------------------------------------
See unread chats, pending requests, tasks due today and reminders in one dashboard
Jump straight to Gallery, Remote, Notes & Tasks, Meetings, Auto Reply and Appearance with Quick Actions

MAKE IT YOURS
------------------------------------------------------
Choose your theme and accent colour
Control notifications for messages, calls and mentions
Set your screen timeout

SIMPLE AND SECURE SIGN-IN
------------------------------------------------------
Log in with your User ID or mobile number
Or scan a QR code to sign in quickly
Get verified to confirm your identity

name: Sairex
description:
A quiet record of the pots made by hand.

Sairex is a private kiln journal for the studio. Record each pot with its clay, glaze, form, firing, cone, minutes, weight, height, kiln, shelf, mood and one note, then watch a year of small firings gather into something worth keeping.

THE STUDIO
Open to the last pot, the clays in hand and the firings that came before. Add a pot in a few taps, or step back into the kiln year.

POTS, KEPT
Keep the minutes, grams and centimeters for every pot. Note the form, the firing, the cone, the kiln, the shelf, the mood and one honest line. Search the log by title, clay, glaze, kiln, shelf or phrase, and filter by the mood of the day.

THE CLAY SHELF
Catalogue bags across stoneware, porcelain, earthenware, raku, paper clay and slip. Note the maker, texture, cone and acquired year, and track full, in-use, low and out states with a manual bag count.

THE GLAZE SHELF
Keep the surfaces you actually mix: celadon, shino, tenmoku, ash, copper red, clear, matte and crystalline. Note the maker, finish, cone and color, and track the grams left in the jar.

THE YEARBOOK
Read the shape of a year: pots made, total weight, time at the wheel, making days, favorite pots, month bars, firing atmosphere, the top clays and glazes, the longest sitting and the surfaces that ran out.

YOUR STUDIO STAYS YOURS
No account. No cloud sync. No advertising. No analytics. No streak or score. The journal is a JSON file in the app's local Documents folder, and you can export a backup or a CSV whenever you choose.

DELIBERATE LIMITS
Sairex is a studio notebook, not a shop or a course. There are no prices, affiliate links or material recommendations. It does not scan a pot, calculate a glaze recipe, deduct stock or turn your practice into a number to beat.

Made for one pair of hands, a quiet bench and the pot under the kiln.

name: Sakan Al-Rooh: Quran & Azkar
description:
Sakan Al-Rooh is your comprehensive daily Islamic companion for reading the Holy Quran and keeping up with your daily Azkar and worship with ease and tranquility, completely free of annoying ads.

Key Features:
• Complete Holy Quran: Comfortable reading with fast voice search, simplified Tafsir, audio recitations, and a Khatma planner.
• Morning, Evening & Sleep Azkar: Authentic Azkar with a smart counter and daily reminders.
• Astronomical Prayer Times: Accurate calculation based on your city with Adhan notifications.
• Qibla Direction: Precise AR Qibla compass with a 2D digital compass fallback.
• Digital Tasbih & Daily Wird Tracker: Daily statistics to track your progress.
• Islamic Radio, Stories of the Prophets, Hadith, and Names of Allah.
• Optional cloud sync via Sign in with Apple.

name: Sakinah: Quran & Reflection
description:
Daily Quran with tafseer and translation at your pace.

Sakinah shows you one ayah at a time: the Arabic, up to two translations you choose, and a tafseer. Mark it read and the next one is ready. Read a little every day, or a lot on some days; your finish date simply moves with you. Nothing resets and there are no streaks.

- Today's ayah with recitation, your translations (English, Urdu and more) and a tafseer in the language you prefer.
- Progress: how much of the Quran you've read, your daily goal, the last 7 days, and when you'll finish at your goal or at your real pace.
- Log reading: read from your own mushaf? Add it, and every ayah still counts once.
- Journal: look back by day or by surah, open any ayah again, and mark ayahs unread if you made a mistake.
- Bookmarks with private notes, kept only on your phone.
- Finished the whole Quran? Alhamdulillah. Start a new reading; your journal and chart stay.
- Lock Screen widgets: today's ayah, your Quran progress and today's reading.
- Urdu in Nastaliq, Arabic right to left, dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your reading stays on your phone.

Quran text, translations, tafseer and recitation are provided by the Quran Foundation API.

name: Salah Platform - MS Mastery
description:
MS Mastery – محمد صلاح
منصة تعليمية شاملة في مادة الرياضيات، يقدمها الأستاذ محمد صلاح؛ صُممت لتبسيط المفاهيم الرياضية ومساعدة الطلاب على التفوق بثقة.

يوفر التطبيق شروحات منظمة وسلسة من خلال مقاطع فيديو تعليمية واضحة، إلى جانب اختبارات تفاعلية لقياس مدى الاستيعاب، وملفات بصيغة PDF للمراجعة والتدريب المستمر، مما يساعد الطلاب على استيعاب الدروس خطوة بخطوة.

مميزات التطبيق:
 شروحات مبسطة ومنظمة لجميع أجزاء المنهج الدراسي
 اختبارات تفاعلية لترسيخ المعلومات
 ملفات PDF للمراجعة في أي وقت
 دروس مرتبة لتسهيل الفهم المتدرج
 دعم للطلاب لتحقيق أفضل الدرجات

يُعد MS Mastery رفيقك الأمثل لإتقان الرياضيات وتحقيق نتائج أكاديمية متميزة، بأسلوب سهل واحترافي.

name: Salah: Quran, Azan & Qibla
description:
Salah is a free prayer app for iPhone: prayer times, Azan alerts, the Quran with a daily reading streak, and a Qibla compass. No ads, no account and no tracking.

Prayer times are calculated on your iPhone for about 13,000 cities in 244 countries, so they keep working without internet.

READ THE QURAN EVERY DAY
• All 114 surahs, one ayah at a time, in the IndoPak (South Asian) script or the Uthmani script
• Daily goal of 100 ayahs with a streak: read every day to keep it, miss a day and it goes back to 0
• Your streak and today's ayahs at the top of the home screen, plus an evening reminder
• Hasanat counter, reading time and 7-day progress
• English meaning under every ayah (Pickthall)
• Listen to 15 well-known reciters, or repeat an ayah to memorise it
• Save and share ayahs, browse by surah or juz, and continue where you stopped

NEXT PRAYER ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• A live countdown to the next prayer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets: next prayer, Quran streak and good deeds, Ayah of the day
• Widgets keep counting down even when the app is closed

GOOD DEEDS EVERY DAY
• A daily checklist: five prayers, your Quran goal, morning and evening adhkar, charity, dua for your parents, salawat, seeking forgiveness and one kind act
• Your good deeds for the last 7 days
• Ayah of the day: a short ayah with its meaning, new every day

PRAYER TIMES AND AZAN
• Prayer times (salah / namaz) for your city or your current location
• Azan alert for each prayer with 18 Azan voices (listen before you choose), a beep or silent, plus reminders before each prayer
• Time Sensitive alerts, so the Azan reaches you even when a Focus is on
• Countdown to the next prayer
• Sunnah times and forbidden (makruh) times
• Friday Surah al-Kahf and voluntary fast reminders

MORE FOR EVERY DAY
• Qibla compass, with the direction and distance to the Kaaba
• Hijri calendar with Islamic events and white days, with a ±2 day correction
• Prayer tracker: mark each prayer on time, late or missed
• Tasbih counter
• Morning, evening and everyday duas
• The 99 Names of Allah with meanings
• Light and dark mode

MASJID TV
• Control your masjid's Masjid TV prayer-times screen from your iPhone over the masjid Wi-Fi: scan the QR code on the TV and change Iqamah times, notices and more

PRAYER TIMES YOUR WAY
• 12 calculation methods
• Standard or Hanafi Asr
• High-latitude rules for the far north and south
• Adjust any prayer time by minutes
• 12- or 24-hour clock

QUESTIONS
Does Salah need internet?
No. Prayer times, Azan alerts, Qibla and the Quran text all work offline. Only Quran recitation needs internet, because it is streamed.

Is Salah free?
Yes. It is free, has no ads, needs no account and does not track you. Your location, streak and tracker stay on your iPhone.

Salah is made by Poweredly (Pvt) Ltd. It is also available on Android.

name: Sales Perch
description:
Sales Perch is the field sales app for teams that sell in person. Reps see today's route, check in at each stop, log what happened, and move on to the next account. Managers see where the day stands without asking.

For reps
• Today: your stops in order, with directions and the accounts to see this week
• Check in and out of visits, with notes you can type or dictate
• Photos, files and follow-up reminders on every client
• Prospects and leads with statuses and a pipeline board
• Face ID sign-in

For managers
• Routes planned for each rep, and a map of the team's day
• Visit history, an activity feed and per-rep breakdowns
• Sales goals and pace
• Alerts when a visit needs a look

Sales Perch is for companies with a Sales Perch account. Your company's administrator invites you; sign in with the account they set up.

name: SalesWorks
description:
SalesWorks runs AI phone agents that call your leads for you, so you can spend your day with the people who are ready to buy.

Add your leads from a spreadsheet, or connect Google Sheets, HubSpot, Salesforce, Meta lead ads and more. Pick an agent, start a campaign, and SalesWorks starts calling. Every call is recorded, transcribed and summarised.

WHAT IT DOES
• Calls every lead with a natural-sounding AI voice you choose
• Books appointments straight onto your Google Calendar
• Pulls out the details you care about: service, budget, when to call back
• Shows each call with a summary, score, recording and full transcript
• Takes callbacks, so a lead who rings back reaches your agent or your own phone
• Works through your do-not-call list and checks every number before it dials

RUN IT FROM YOUR PHONE
• See today's calls, bookings and leads left at a glance
• Pause or resume a campaign in one tap
• Ask the assistant what happened today, or to add leads, and confirm each change before it happens
• Try any agent by talking to it yourself, free of charge

BUILT FOR BUSINESSES
SalesWorks is for businesses that call their own leads: clinics, home services, agencies and sales teams. You bring the leads and the offer. Your agent does the calling.

Sign in with the account you use on the SalesWorks website. Plans and billing are managed in your account.

name: SALFETCH NI
description:
SALFETCH-NI for phone brings the alerts and scheduled summaries from your organization's SALFETCH-NI server to your pocket.

This app needs a SALFETCH-NI server run by your organization. An administrator links your phone on that server; until then the app has nothing to show.

SEE WHAT IS WRONG RIGHT NOW
• Overview: the share of your network that is healthy, with Down, Degraded and Up counts and how they changed since the last summary
• Open now: every device that is currently down or degraded, and for how long
• Tap any count to see the devices behind it

EVERY ALERT, IN ORDER
• A timeline grouped by day, color-coded by state
• Filter by state or by monitor: Infrastructure, Circuits, Bandwidth, ACI Fabric, SLA
• Open an alert for its management IP, site, monitor, neighbor and history

SCHEDULED SUMMARIES
• Totals and a per-monitor breakdown for each summary
• Switch between recent summaries with one tap
• A trend of how many devices were not up
• A home-screen widget with the latest totals

BUILT FOR SENSITIVE NETWORKS
• One-way by design: the server sends, the phone receives. The app has no login, no server address and no access token, and it cannot change anything on your network
• End-to-end encrypted: each alert is encrypted to a key created on your phone, so the push service cannot read it
• The private key is kept in the phone's secure hardware and never leaves it
• Locked on every opening with face recognition or your own 6-digit code. The lock cannot be turned off
• Alert details can be hidden on the lock screen
• No analytics, no advertising, no tracking

YOUR OWN ALERT SOUND
• Choose from a set of electronic alert sounds, or let the phone speak the state: Down, Degraded or Up
• Use one sound for every alert, or a different one for each state

QUIET WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Mute alerts for an hour, four hours or until tomorrow morning. Muted alerts are still saved
• History is kept for 90 days and can be cleared at any time

LINKING YOUR PHONE
Open the app, share the link code shown on screen with your SALFETCH-NI administrator, and wait for the test alert. Nothing else to set up.

name: Salla: TV Remote
description:
Turn your iPhone into a fast, simple remote for your TV.

FREE REMOTE
Arrows and OK, touchpad pointer, volume, channels, numbers, color buttons, media controls, menu, info and inputs.
• Type on your TV with the iPhone keyboard
• See the apps installed on your TV with their icons and open them with one tap
• Switch inputs
• Finds your TV on the Wi-Fi network automatically
• Demo mode to explore the app without a TV
• No ads, no account, no tracking

SALLA PRO
• Simple mode: a large trackpad and just the buttons you use (Back, Home, Play/Pause, Mute, Volume and 4 app shortcuts)
• Shake to point: shake your phone and steer the TV pointer by moving it
• Choose your own 4 shortcuts
Pro is available as a yearly subscription (with a free trial for new subscribers) or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel it in your account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://salla.kerimsahin.net/privacy

REQUIREMENTS
Your iPhone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Compatible with LG webOS TVs. Turning the TV on over the network depends on your TV settings and network. Salla is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LG Electronics.

name: Salvo Command
description:
Salvo Command is a naval strategy game of hidden fleets and well-aimed shots. Place five ships on a 10 by 14 grid, then take turns firing at the enemy's waters. Sink all five of their ships before they sink yours.

FIVE SHIPS, ONE SEA
Command an aircraft carrier, a battleship, a light missile cruiser, a fast attack sub and a special operations craft. Place each one yourself, or let the game scatter them for you.

ADVANCED WEAPONS, IF YOU WANT THEM
Turn on advanced weapons and both fleets get more than guns. Launch attack squadrons to search the sea in an X or plus pattern, and strike the first ship they find. Shoot enemy squadrons down with your antiaircraft battery. Fire a Tomahawk at a whole block of sea, send harpoons down a line, run a torpedo across a row, or ping with sonar. Lose a ship and you lose its weapons.

TARGET PLUS 1
An optional rule for faster, fiercer games: every hit earns another turn.

A COMPUTER THAT PLAYS FAIR
The computer opponent only knows what you would know: the results of its own shots and searches, and which of your ships have sunk. It never peeks at your fleet.

PLAY A FRIEND ONLINE
Host a game and share a four-letter code or an invite link. Each of you places your fleet on your own device. Leave and come back whenever you like: the game is waiting.

MADE FOR VOICEOVER
Salvo Command was designed from the start to be fully playable with VoiceOver. Every square reads what's on it, every shot is announced, and a battle log keeps the whole game in order. Type a square to place a ship or fire, check your fleet's status at any time, and repeat the last message with one tap. With a keyboard, arrow keys move around the grids.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
Games against the computer work offline. No ads. Nothing to buy. No accounts. No tracking.

name: SAM Lite
description: SAM Lite銀行カードによる支払い、自己負担分、およびプロモーション用クレジットについては、それぞれ個別に記録を管理してください。 ライドやクラス、トレーニングセッションが終了した後は、領収書に基づいて利用料金の内訳を記録します。 詳細が不明な取引については、後で確認できるよう一時的に保留しておいてください。 キャンセルの場合は、元の銀行カードへの返金、残高の復元、あるいはクレジットバウチャーの発行といった形で処理を行います。 各取引グループの詳細を確認することで、元の資金源、利用制限、有効期限などを追跡できます。 また、サービス提供者からの請求書との照合や、複数回にわたる返金の追跡、さらには残額を将来の利用分に割り当てることも可能です。 月末には、予算の残額と実際の支出を照らし合わせ、各アカウントの残高を確認した上で、精算済みのデータを月次明細書として保存してください。

name: SamplePad Studio
description:
The original SamplePad (2016) is back – rebuilt from scratch.

Polbyte SamplePad turns your iPhone or iPad into a live instrument. Load samples onto pads, play them with your fingers and shape the sound with effects in real time.

PADS
• Grid from 1×1 up to 8×8 pads with real multitouch
• Loop, sustain, retrigger and choke groups
• Volume and colour per pad

LIVE EFFECTS
• Reverb, tempo-synced delay and high-pass filter
• Varispeed, distortion and pitch ±24 semitones
• Hold a button for an instant effect, release to go back – echo and reverb ring out
• Reset all effects at once or right on the next bar

PRESETS AND SOUND PACKS
• Demo, House, Synthwave, E-Piano and Scratch packs included
• Swipe across the pads to switch presets in the middle of a set

RECORD
• Record your own sound from the microphone straight onto a pad and trim it on the waveform
• Record your whole performance and play it back

TURNTABLE
• A turntable with volume fader, cue point and pitch ±50%
• AUTO scratch: classic scratches played in time with the loops
• Built-in scratch samples or record your own

SYNTH
• 16 sounds: leads, pads, basses, e-piano, bells, organ and more
• Touch keyboard with glide between keys
• Knobs for volume, waveform, filter, attack, release, glide, vibrato and wobble

LOOPS
• Loop grid from 1×4 up to 6×6, play as many loops as you like together
• Tap an empty slot to record the pads, the turntable or the synth – it starts and stops on the bar line
• Record for 4, 8 or 16 beats, with a count-in when nothing is playing yet
• Step sequencer, adjustable loop start, projects saved automatically and exported as ZIP

YOUR OWN SAMPLE PACKS
• Copy a folder of samples into the SamplePad folder – over the cable in Finder, with AirDrop or from iCloud Drive, Dropbox or Google Drive in the Files app – and it becomes a preset
• Recordings are saved to the same folder

Works offline. No account needed.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
The free version includes the Demo preset, a scratch sample and two synth sounds. The full version (all presets and sound packs, your own files and folders, microphone recording, all scratch samples) is a yearly auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; the subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://store.polbyte.com/en/legal/privacy/

name: Sancakötesi
description:
Sancakötesi, dalga tabanlı bir strateji oyunudur. Ordunu kur, savunma kulelerini geliştir ve savaş alanındaki değişimlere göre planını yenile.

Tek oyunculu Sefer’de farklı görevleri tamamla, yıldız topla ve Akademi’de gelişim seçeneklerini aç. Karakol Nöbeti’nde birliği tarafsız karakola yönlendirerek savaşın dengesini değiştir.

Aynı Wi‑Fi ağında arkadaşınla oda kurup savaş. İkiniz de hazır olduğunuzda aynı odada rövanşa geç.

name: SanctuaryGlass: Focus & Sleep
description:
SanctuaryGlass turns your iPhone into a calm acoustic sanctuary for deep work, reading, meditation, and restorative sleep.

Mix multiple lossless offline nature and ambient layers with independent volume sliders and a gentle fade-out sleep timer.

KEY FEATURES
• Studio-Quality Offline Audio: Rain on glass, coastal waves, warm brown noise, forest wind, and fireplace.
• Custom Soundscape Mixer: Layer multiple atmospheres and save your favorite focus or sleep scenes.
• Gentle Fade-Out Timer: Drift off naturally while audio smoothly fades to silence.
• 100% Offline & Ad-Free: Works on flights and offline anywhere — no streaming lag, no login.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock every soundscape and unlimited custom mixes forever.

name: Sandy Gems: Sand Sort Puzzle
description:
Every picture is made of crystal sand. Can you clear it?

Sandy Gems is a relaxing sand puzzle with real falling-sand physics. A colorful picture made of sparkling sand sits in the hopper. Below it, mine carts wait on the board. Drag a cart under the sand and every grain of its color pours in. Full carts roll away, the picture slowly disappears, and the last grain lands with a happy little chime.

POUR THE SAND
• Drag a cart under the hopper and watch the sand flow in, grain by grain.
• Each cart takes only its own color, so the order matters.
• Clear the bottom colors first to free the ones above them.
• Satisfying pours, sparkling streams and carts that roll away when they are full.

REVEAL PIXEL ART
• 200+ levels: fruit, sweets, animals, toys, gems and more.
• Visit famous places made of sand: the Eiffel Tower, the Statue of Liberty, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Taj Mahal and others.
• Every level is a new picture to pour away.

TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
• Easy levels to relax, then brain puzzles with stones, shaped hoppers and tight boards.
• Plan your moves: one wrong cart can block the sand.
• No timer and no lives. Stuck? Undo, rewind or try again.

HELPFUL BOOSTERS
• Undo: take back your last move, sand and all.
• Pickaxe: break a cart into small blocks.
• Magnet: fill a cart with its color at once.
• Dynamite: blast a hole in the sand to free a stuck color.

MEET THE MOLE
• A cheerful mole miner digs through the crystal caves with you.
• Collect coins, open the daily gift and keep his gem cart full.

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• One finger to play. Levels take a minute or two.
• Calm sounds, bright colors and smooth physics.

Pour the sand, reveal the picture, relax your mind. Welcome to the crystal mine!

name: Santa Cruz Capital Cultural
description:
Promotional text:
Santa Cruz de La Palma in your pocket: what's on today, walking routes with GPS audio guide, festivals and history. Free, no sign-up.
Keywords:
la palma,events,whats on,walking tour,history,museums,festivals,canary islands,cruise,culture
Description:
Everything happening in Santa Cruz de La Palma, in one app. Concerts, theatre, exhibitions, festivals and plans for today, tomorrow or the weekend.
WHAT'S ON
• City events with poster, time, place and price.
• Filters: live now, today, tomorrow, this week or this weekend.
• Remind me that day: a notification on the morning of the event.
• A notification every Thursday with the weekend plans.
• Save your plans and add them to your calendar.
TODAY IN SANTA CRUZ
• Weather, on-duty pharmacy, cruise ships in port and cinema.
• Museums, libraries and cultural centres open today.
WALKS AND HISTORY
• “I have some free time”: walking routes of 1, 2 and 3 hours.
• GPS audio guide: at each stop your phone vibrates and reads it aloud.
• The city then and now, routes with children, rainy-day routes and the dark-history route.
• Heritage Passport: collect a stamp at each place.
FESTIVALS AND TRADITIONS
• Holy Week, Cruces y Mayos, the Bajada de la Virgen and every neighbourhood’s festivals.
• The memory chest: photos and memories shared by residents.
FOR RESIDENTS AND VISITORS
• Where to eat, shop and park; buses, ferries, taxis and flights.
• Local classes and groups, photo spots and useful contacts.
• A quiz with 200 questions and a treasure hunt for children.
In Spanish, English and German. Free, no ads, no sign-up.
Santa Cruz Capital Cultural is a non-profit citizen initiative. It is not an official app of the Town Council.

name: Santa's Hat: Secret Santa
description:
Santa's Hat makes Secret Santa simple. No sign-ups, no email addresses, no ads. Just one phone, passed round the room.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name your draw, set a spending limit and a swap day
2. Add everyone's names
3. Keep couples or housemates apart if you like
4. Shake the hat (really, shake your phone)
5. Pass the phone round. Everyone taps their own name and holds the screen to see who they're buying for. Let go and it's hidden again.

THOUGHTFUL TOUCHES
• Gift hints: add one line so your Santa knows what you'd love
• Forgot who you got? Just tap your name again
• "Can't draw" pairs, and the hat always finds a fair draw
• Run several draws at once: office, family, friends
• Spending limit, swap day and a note for everyone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no adverts. Names, hints and matches stay on your phone. One price, everything included.

Made in the UK by Coffeehouse Productions.
Questions or ideas? support@coffeehouseproductions.co.uk

name: Sask
description:
ساسك مكانك الخاص للأسئلة والسوالف.

اسألني بمجهول
• خذ رابطك وحطه بالستوري، وأصحابك يسألونك بدون ما تعرف مين
• جاوب على الأسئلة اللي تعجبك، والباقي تحذفه أو تتجاهله
• تحكم مين يقدر يسألك: الكل، أو أصحاب الحسابات بس، أو باسمهم بس

شارك بستوري
• كل جواب يطلع بطاقة جاهزة للستوري، تشاركها بضغطة وحدة

غرف وألعاب
• غرف سوالف مع أصحابك، وألعاب بلوت وأونو ولودو وغيرها داخل الغرفة

تغريدات وريلز وستوري ورسائل
• تابع أصحابك، شارك يومك، وراسلهم على الخاص

أمانك أول
• بلاغ وحظر بضغطتين على أي سؤال أو رسالة
• فلتر تلقائي للكلام المسيء
• قفل التطبيق بالبصمة أو الوجه
• ما نكشف هوية المرسل المجهول لأحد

للعمر ١٣ سنة وفوق.

name: SBOT Controller
description:
SBOT Controller is the companion app for SCIPIA's SBOT2, an educational two-wheel balancing robot. Connect over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), then drive forward and back or spin on the spot with a joystick.

■ What you need
• An SBOT2 robot (firmware 1.1 or newer) with a BLE Bluetooth module on its board
• An iPhone or iPad with iOS 16 or newer
• No robot yet? Use "Try the screens without a robot" to explore every screen.

■ Features
• Joystick: push up to go forward, down to go back, and at an angle to turn while moving. Let go and it stops.
• Spin on the spot: push the joystick only sideways and the robot turns in place.
• Speed: choose Slow or Normal.
• Three modes
  - Balance only: the robot goes where you steer it.
  - Avoid obstacles: driving forward, it stops 30 cm before an obstacle, and it backs away when something comes within 20 cm.
  - Follow: it keeps about 20 cm from a hand or object in front of it. The joystick only turns it.
• Robot status: balance (on, fallen over, lifted), tilt and distance ahead, as reported by the robot.
• Stop button: always in the same place on every screen. It stops driving and sets the mode back to Balance only.
• If the connection drops, the robot stops joystick driving by itself; Avoid obstacles and Follow keep running until the robot gets Stop or is switched off.
• Reconnect to your last robot with one tap.
• Portrait and landscape screens.
• Korean and English.

■ Try the screens without a robot
Tap "Try the screens without a robot" on the Connect screen to connect to a demo robot inside the app. You can use the Connect and Drive screens without any hardware. The demo robot does not move a real robot.

■ Getting started
1. Fit the Bluetooth module on the robot's board and check that the BT PWR jumper is in place.
2. Switch the robot on and keep it close to the phone.
3. On the Connect tab, allow Bluetooth and pick your robot from the list.
4. Stand the robot up and it balances by itself.
5. On the Drive tab, drive it with the joystick.

■ Good to know
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts. The app does not use the internet; it talks only to your robot over Bluetooth.

■ Contact
SCIPIA · https://scipia.co.kr/
Email: osc95@hanmail.net

name: Scan&Tap
description:
Scan&Tap es la app de caja para negocios que usan tarjetas de lealtad Scan&Tap en Apple Wallet y Google Wallet.
Escanea la tarjeta de tu cliente y atiéndelo en el mostrador:
 • Pon sellos y entrega premios.
 • Cobra y recarga saldo.
 • Vende gift cards.
 • Da y canjea cupones.
 • Maneja puntos.

Cada cajero entra con su PIN. El dueño conecta y desconecta los dispositivos desde su panel.

La app es para negocios que ya son clientes de Scan&Tap. Para conectar un dispositivo necesitas un código de tu negocio. Algunas funciones dependen de los productos que tu negocio tenga activos.

name: Scenivo Frame - Shot Timing
description:
The length of a shot can change the feel of an entire scene. Scenivo Frame gives you a place to set frame counts, arrange cuts, and check the pace of a sequence before moving on.

Set the timing
Create a scene document and add shots to its timeline. Choose a frame rate and view the resulting timecode and duration. You can reorder shots as the sequence develops; changing the frame rate adjusts the duration without altering the frame counts.

Check the drawings
Add a title and note for each shot, then use Cut Review to mark drawings you’ve checked. The review screen shows unchecked drawings and their time ranges, so you can find work that still needs attention. These checks do not affect shot order.

Watch the cut
Open a saved sequence in the screening room to rehearse its pacing. Compare the displayed duration and frame rate, play the cut, and decide whether a moment needs more or fewer frames.

Return to earlier scenes

name: Schaltwerk: Logic Gate Puzzles
description:
Place gates, pull wires and watch the signal run. Schaltwerk is a logic puzzle game about real digital circuits: you get switches on one side, lamps on the other, and you work out what goes in between.

You do not need any background in electronics. The first levels start with a single wire, a short guide shows the moves, and new gates arrive step by step. Along the way you build a full adder, the part a computer uses to add.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag gates onto the board and connect them with your finger
• Flip the switches and see the current light up live
• Run the test: every switch combination is played through in front of you
• Earn three stars by finishing with few gates and without spoilers

120 LEVELS
Ten chapters take you from AND, OR and NOT to XOR, NAND, NOR, XNOR, IMPLY and NIMPLY. Build a washing machine control, make everything from NAND alone, multiply binary numbers and drive a digit display. Many levels have more than one good answer. Can you beat the reference circuit?

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Everyone gets the same daily puzzle. Solve it on the day to keep your streak going.

THE LAB
Endless puzzles in three difficulties. Build a circuit from a target table, or repair one with swapped gates. Share the code and challenge a friend with the same puzzle.

SANDBOX
Build whatever you like, without a goal. Switches, lamps and all nine gates are there.

MADE WITH CARE
• Signal view: compare target and result for every case
• Three hints per level, from a nudge to the full solution
• Reference section with every gate to try out
• Board designs, light and dark mode, iPhone and iPad
• VoiceOver labels and Dynamic Type
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device

FREE AND PRO
Free: 21 levels, the daily puzzle, easy lab puzzles and one sandbox circuit.
Schaltwerk Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It adds 99 more levels, the full lab, the daily archive for the last 60 days, unlimited sandbox circuits with templates and import, three more board designs and solution statistics.

name: ScreenFam
description:
ScreenFam is where you and your people talk about what you are watching.

Keep a watchlist, mark what you have watched, and rate shows and movies from one to five stars. Post in the feed, join groups built around the shows you love, and get suggestions with a plain reason for each one.

Spoilers stay hidden until you are ready. Posts with spoilers are blurred by default, and you can set how far you have watched in a series, episode by episode, so a post only opens for you once you have actually seen that part.

Plan watch parties and show events with your group. Everyone watches on their own streaming service at the same time and talks in the event chat. ScreenFam does not stream shows or movies.

Bringing your history with you is easy: import a TV Time or IMDb CSV export, and your watched episodes, movie diary, and ratings come over with you.

name: ScrollInk - Local EPUB Reader
description:
Steal half a page of quiet in a busy day.

ScrollInk is a tranquil, 100% local e-book reader inspired by traditional Xuan rice paper and bookbinding craft. No built-in bookstore, no scrapers, no ads, no feeds — strictly dedicated to the EPUB, TXT, Markdown, and PDF books you already own.

KEY FEATURES
• Publication-Grade Typography: Kinsoku Shori line-breaking, punctuation compression, optical hanging punctuation, uniform justification, Pangu CJK/Latin spacing, traditional right-to-left vertical reading, and custom TTF/OTF/TTC font import.
• Five Tactile Page Turns & iPad Spread: Realistic page curl, paper slide, handscroll, vertical roll, and serene fade — plus true two-page landscape spread with center spine shading on iPad.
