• Effortless Local Import: Import via Files, AirDrop, the iOS Share Extension, or built-in LAN Wi-Fi transfer straight from your computer browser. Smart TXT chapter workbench, encoding auto-detection, and filename cleanup included.
• Quiet Reading Sanctuary: Six paper themes with organic grain texture, procedural rain/hearth/wind ambient soundscapes, live TTS sentence highlighting with auto page-turn, and optional volume-button page turning.
• Annotations & Quote Studio: Four ink highlight colors, emphasis dots, Markdown export, personal carved seal stamps, and four exhibition-grade quote poster templates.
• Private & Native: Home Screen Widgets, personal iCloud Key-Value progress sync, and one-tap portable JSON backup & restore.

name: Season Teller
description:
Take a picture of a menu and find out what on it is in season where you are.

Season Teller reads the menu on your phone, picks out the fruit, vegetables and nuts, and checks each one against the months it is usually harvested where you are. In Florida, Georgia and Alabama that means your county: the crops its farms grow, and the months they harvest them.

FOR EVERY INGREDIENT IT TELLS YOU
• In season where you are
• Or being harvested nearby or farther away: the nearest county or state harvesting it this month, and about how many miles away that is
• Or out of season everywhere, so it most likely came from storage, a greenhouse or another country, and when its next harvest begins

WHAT IS IN SEASON NOW
Pick your state (and your county in Florida, Georgia or Alabama) and a month to see what is being harvested there, and what starts next month.

COUNTY BY COUNTY IN FLORIDA, GEORGIA AND ALABAMA
All 293 counties. The crops each county grows come from the latest national farm census, and its harvest months are worked out from its state's planting guide for the north, middle or south of the state. Collard greens, okra, field peas, sweet potatoes, eggplant, kale, and turnip and mustard greens are covered there too. Other states are checked state by state for now.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The picture is read on your phone and is never uploaded
• You pick your state and county from a list, so the app never asks for your location
• No account, no ads, nothing collected
• Works with no signal

68 fruits, vegetables and nuts. Outside Florida, Georgia and Alabama, harvest months come from national crop surveys of the main commercial growing states. They are the usual months, and weather moves them from year to year. They are a guide to how far food like this usually travels, not a statement about where any plate came from.

SUBSCRIPTION
Season Teller Monthly gives you the whole app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://seasonteller.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://seasonteller.app/privacy.html

name: SeasonWeave--Garden weaving
description:
SeasonWeave kutsuu sinut elvyttämään elävän puutarhan muovaamalla itse maata.

Valitse kevät, kesä, syksy tai talvi napauttamalla neliterälehtistä vuodenaikapyörää. Vaihda sitten vierekkäisten maa-alueiden paikkoja, jotta jokainen vuodenaika muodostaa yhtenäisen istutusalueen, joka vastaa maahan merkittyä kiinteää mallia.

Jotkin alueet liikkuvat vain oman vuodenaikansa aikana. Tavalliset alueet toimivat askelkivinä, kun taas juurtuneet kulmat pysyvät paikoillaan. Jokainen sallittu siirto on selkeä ja yksinkertainen. Voit myös perua ja tehdä siirtoja uudelleen sekä pyytää luotettavan vihjeen seuraavasta askeleesta tarvittaessa.

Tutustu 24 puutarhaan kolmessa luvussa, kerää omia ennätystuloksiasi, harjoittele vapaasti ja palaa muistiinpanoihin, jotka havainnollistavat vierekkäisyyttä, siirtosääntöjä ja kuvioiden yhteensovittamista. Pehmeän pyöristetty grafiikka, miellyttävät lyhyet äänet ja rauhallinen, valoisa värimaailma luovat miellyttävät puitteet harkitsevalle tilalliselle pulmapelille.

name: Second Ring
description:
Second Ring from Hallmark Logic UK Ltd puts internet voice calling on your iPhone. The app is free and supports incoming and outgoing calls over Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Keep your phone close and your conversations closer, with one app for personal calls and work discussions. Second Ring gives you the flexibility to call from wherever you have an internet connection.

name: Segue Install
description:
O Segue Install é o aplicativo de campo para instaladores e técnicos da rede Segue Rastro. Ele organiza o trabalho do profissional que executa a instalação, a manutenção e a desinstalação de equipamentos de rastreamento veicular — do recebimento do veículo à conclusão da ordem de serviço, tudo pelo celular.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS

• Minhas ordens de serviço: lista com busca e filtros (aguardando recebimento, agendadas, em execução e concluídas).
• Três tipos de atendimento: instalação, manutenção e desinstalação, com o fluxo certo para cada um.
• Checklist configurável: marque os itens obrigatórios de cada serviço.
• Fotos e evidências: registre imagens do atendimento pela câmera ou pela galeria.
• Testes de instalação: confirme bloqueio, ignição e comunicação do rastreador.
• Comandos do rastreador: envie comandos ao equipamento pela rede ou por SMS, conforme o modelo.
• Vínculo de equipamento: informe o IMEI/número de série e vincule o equipamento ao veículo na conclusão.
• Aguardando recebimento: visualize os serviços agendados antes do recebimento do veículo.
• Tema claro e escuro: escolha a aparência ou siga a configuração do sistema.

PARA QUEM É

O Segue Install é uma ferramenta profissional, de uso exclusivo dos instaladores e técnicos vinculados a uma central/empresa de rastreamento que utiliza a plataforma Segue Rastro. O acesso é feito com login e senha fornecidos pela empresa responsável — não é um aplicativo de autoatendimento para o consumidor final.

name: SEI Dashboard for Staff
description:
SEI Dashboard is the company app for staff of Security Engineering of Pensacola, Inc. and Ceres Building Technologies. It is shared with staff through a private link and is not for the public; signing in requires a company Microsoft account.

Technicians use it to run their day: see their schedule, tell the office they're on the way or on site, rearrange their appointments, request purchase orders, look up parts, and keep their certifications current. Phone notifications let them know when a ticket is added to their schedule, taken off it, or moved.

Managers also see the sales pipeline.

Everyone signs in with their company Microsoft account, and the app shows only the pages their role allows. The app locks with Face ID when it starts and after five minutes in the background.

name: Selvedge Atlas
description:
Make room for what you’re making.

Selvedge Atlas is a fabric-cutting workspace for home sewists and makers of cushions, tote bags, runners and other rectangular fabric projects. Bring your measurements together in one clear, reusable plan.

START WITH YOUR FABRIC
Record the full width, available length, selvedge reserves and space between cuts. Work in centimeters or decimal inches.

ACCOUNT FOR EVERY PIECE
Add mixed rectangular panels, quantities and seam allowances. Keep grain direction locked, or allow a quarter-turn where your fabric permits. Finished dimensions and seam-inclusive cut sizes stay distinct.

SEE A PRACTICAL LAYOUT
Review a scaled cutting map, required length, usable-area percentage and any length shortage. Numbered pieces correspond to a readable cut list.

KEEP YOUR PLACE
Mark individual pieces after cutting and return to saved progress later. Layout-changing edits explain when checks need to be reset.

TAKE YOUR PLAN WITH YOU
Export a readable cutting guide or a project JSON file. Import exported projects as separate copies. Core planning works locally without an account. All planning features remain available if tracking permission is declined. This version does not display ads or offer in-app purchases.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Use a dedicated sidebar workspace on iPad, light and dark appearance, and scalable text. Explore the editable cushion example to get started.

IMPORTANT SCOPE
This is a rectangular, single-layer planning tool. Its bounded shelf layout is a practical estimate, not a guarantee of the shortest possible layout. Pattern repeats, shrinkage, fabric defects, irregular shapes and multilayer cutting are not modeled. Verify physical fabric and all measurements before cutting.

name: Semana de Férias
description:
Semana de Férias is the app for more vacation and more stories: a full week in a resort for up to 70% less than the regular daily rate.

The platform works through usage-rights transfer: owners of timeshare weeks list their available periods, and you secure a full resort week with owner-level access to the amenities, not a guest pass.

Browse the catalog right from the app: destinations like Gramado, Caldas Novas, Olímpia, Maceió, Penha, Porto de Galinhas, Águas de Lindóia, Angra dos Reis, Barretos, Búzios and Campos do Jordão, each with price, dates and photos. Search by city or resort and save the weeks you want to follow.

Found the right week? Finish your reservation securely on the official Semana de Férias website — payment stays protected until the owner's documentation is verified.

In the app you can:
• Browse and search weeks by city, resort and date
• See full listing details, price and stay period
• Save favorites so you never miss a good window
• Check My Reservations and each booking's status
• Manage your profile, including account deletion

On iPhone, add the Semana de Férias widget to your home screen to jump straight into the catalog and start exploring resorts in one tap.

Available in Portuguese, English and Spanish, for iPhone and iPad.

name: Senobi: Stretch Break Reminder
description:
Senobi gives you a gentle cue to step away from the screen and stretch. Set how often you want a nudge, and the app reminds you during your work hours so a short break never slips your mind.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
• Choose an interval: 15, 20, 30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes
• Set your start and end time for work hours
• Pick the weekdays you want reminders
• Quiet hours keep notifications silent when you need them to be
• A "Skip today" button for days when breaks just are not possible

A SHORT BREAK, GUIDED STEP BY STEP
Each reminder opens a quick posture check, followed by six short stretches of 10 to 20 seconds each:
• Big stretch (reach up)
• Neck tilt
• Shoulder rolls
• Chest opener
• Upper-body twist
• Wrist stretch
An animated stick-figure guide, three-line instructions and a countdown timer show you what to do, so you can simply follow along.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR BREAKS
Tap "Done" to log each break. The history screen shows a 7-day bar chart, today's count, your streak, your total and your 50 most recent entries.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• Your data stays on your device only
• The only permission requested is notifications

ABOUT ADS
The free version shows banner and interstitial ads (Google AdMob). A one-time "Remove ads" purchase hides them for good.

Made for desk work, remote work, long study sessions, gaming or phone time - anytime you want a regular reminder to pause and move around a little.

DISCLAIMER
Senobi is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. It is a reminder tool for taking short breaks. If you feel pain or discomfort while stretching, stop right away and consult a qualified professional.

name: SEO Analiz - Sıra Bulucu
description:
Sitenizin Google'da kaçıncı sırada olduğunu saniyeler içinde öğrenin, SEO analiz raporu alın ve yeni anahtar kelimeler keşfedin. halil.com.tr'nin 37 ücretsiz SEO ve dijital pazarlama aracı artık telefonunuzda.

SEO Analiz - Sıra Bulucu, halil.com.tr ekibinin kendi ajans işlerinde kullandığı araçları herkese açar. Sıra takibinden teknik site analizine, anahtar kelime analizinden reklam bütçesi hesaplamaya kadar ihtiyacınız olan araçlar tek uygulamada.

GOOGLE SIRA BULUCU
Alan adınızı ve anahtar kelimenizi girin; Google Türkiye'de ilk 100 sonucu tarayarak sitenizin kaçıncı sırada olduğunu gösterir, ilk 10'daki rakipleri listeler. Masaüstü ve mobil sonuçları ayrı ayrı kontrol edebilirsiniz.

ANAHTAR KELİME ANALİZİ
Tek bir tohum kelimeden popülerlik sırasına göre 50-200+ arama önerisi çıkarın. Konu araştırması ve hedef kitle önerici ile içerik fikirlerinizi genişletin.

SEO ANALİZ VE SİTE İÇİ SEO
SEO analiz aracıyla hedef kelimelerinizdeki sıralama potansiyelini ve tahmini etkiyi görün. Site içi SEO aracı tek URL'de title, meta description, başlık yapısı, canonical, robots, görsel alt etiketleri ve schema işaretlemesini kontrol eder.

TEKNİK SEO ARAÇLARI
• Web sitesi hız testi: mobil ve masaüstü için Core Web Vitals skoru
• SERP analizi ve Google AI Overview takibi
• İndekslenebilirlik, HTTP durum kodu, canonical ve başlık hiyerarşisi kontrolü
• Sitemap kontrolü, robots.txt oluşturucu ve robots.txt test aracı
• Schema doğrulayıcı ve yapısal veri oluşturucu
• llms.txt oluşturucu, iç linkleme aracı, Whois sorgulama
• Google Maps konum bulucu

İÇERİK VE META ARAÇLARI
Meta etiketi oluşturucu, meta açıklama üretici, görsel alt metin üretici, yapay zeka içerik tespit aracı ve sosyal paylaşım önizleme.

REKLAM ARAÇLARI
Google Ads bütçe hesaplayıcı, ROAS kâr simülatörü, negatif anahtar kelime temizleyici, reklam metni kontrol aracı ve Meta reklam metni üretici.

BACKLINK ANALİZİ (SEO PANEL)
Daha derin çalışmalar için SEO Panel'de backlink analizi, yönlendiren domainler, anchor ve IP analizi, organik rakipler ve içerik açığı raporları bulunur.

HALİL.COM.TR HAKKINDA
halil.com.tr; SEO danışmanlığı, Google Ads, Meta Ads, yerel SEO ve içerik pazarlaması hizmetleri veren bir dijital pazarlama ajansıdır. Uygulamadan hizmetlerimizi inceleyebilir ve SEO rehberlerimizi okuyabilirsiniz.

KİMLER İÇİN?
• Google sıralamasını takip etmek isteyen işletme sahipleri
• SEO uzmanları ve dijital pazarlamacılar
• E-ticaret siteleri, yerel işletmeler ve içerik üreticileri

SEO Analiz - Sıra Bulucu'yu indirin, sitenizin Google'daki yerini hemen görün.

name: Seoul Quest: Self-Guided Tours
description:
Seoul Quest is a local's self-guide to Seoul, from the moment you land to the day you fly home. Get from the airport to your hotel, walk the city's old eateries and markets, and head to departure with the tips you need.

The walks are the heart of it: soup houses, noodle counters, covered markets and the lanes in between, put together into routes you can follow on your own. Pick a walk, go stop to stop, and collect a stamp at each one. Every stop has a short mission, and one tap opens your map app for real walking directions.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Arrival help: step-by-step transport from Incheon Airport Terminal 1 to hotels around City Hall, Myeongdong and Jongno. For everywhere else we link to the official guides.
• More than 20 walks, most of them in central Seoul: Namdaemun, Gwangjang, Tongin and Cheongnyangni markets, Euljiro's printing alleys and wholesale markets, Seochon, Samcheong-dong and more. 3-hour walks and 6-hour walks.
• A map for each walk. The dotted lines are straight lines between stops, not walking routes. For directions, tap through to your map app.
• "Show where I am" on the walk map, if you want it. Your location is used only on your phone. It isn't sent anywhere or saved.
• A food map with filters and "Cheap eats near me".
• Luggage storage and departure tips, with links to official pages.
• A shopping bag list, a stamp book, and a share card made on your phone.
• 10 languages: English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), German, French, Spanish, Thai, Vietnamese and Arabic.

FREE DURING LAUNCH, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Every walk is free during launch. There is no sign-in and nothing to buy. Your trip settings, saved places, stamps, mission photos and shopping bag stay on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Opening hours and prices change. Check the official page linked on each place before you go.
• Maps and photos load online, so you'll want a data connection.
• Some evening ideas include places that serve drinks. Drinking is always optional. In Korea you must be 19 to drink.

name: Sermon Prep Studio
description:
Sermon Prep Studio is a study aid for pastors: study the passage, plan the series, and keep your own voice.

Two ways to prepare:
• Study companion — a worksheet you fill in yourself: observation, interpretation, application, a word notebook, an outline, and prayer. Nothing on that page is written for you.
• Series calendar — the calendar remembers the series, which text was preached when, and how far along you are. Copy a brief into the chat tool you already use.

Key features:
• Sermon outline from a passage, timed to your length — twenty minutes gets three points, forty gets four
• The big idea in one sentence, free to preview
• Sermon series planner: split a Bible book into weekly passages, or lay a theme across a calendar
• Year planner with preaching dates, reminders, a reading plan, and an archive of past sermons
• Sermon documents: every manuscript in one searchable list
• Small group discussion questions that follow the sermon passage
• Cross-references are citations only — the app does not write out verse text, and illustrations are labeled as ideas to adapt, never as events that happened
• Set your preaching day to Sunday, to Saturday for a Sabbath congregation, or to any other day

A study aid — your prayer, study, and voice come first.

Support: Questions? Contact support@lsbapps.com

Full access is a subscription: $9.99/month or $59.99/year (save 50%). It renews automatically until you cancel, and you can cancel anytime.

name: SetMosaic
description:
Turn explicit lists of text elements into set results you can inspect and keep. SetMosaic shows where each member came from, retains the original source lines, and saves independent reports.

BUILD AND REVIEW SETS
Type one element per line or import a UTF-8 text file. Review the number of unique members, ignored blank lines, duplicates and normalized lines before saving. Open a member to inspect all of its original source lines.

CHOOSE THE OPERATION
Calculate union, intersection, A minus B, B minus A, symmetric difference, or U minus A. Complement requires a Universe you explicitly choose and checks that A is its subset. Empty sets and empty results are valid.

FOLLOW EVERY MEMBER
Inspect complete result membership in A, B and, when applicable, the Universe. Elements are trimmed and NFC-normalized, remain case-sensitive, and use a fixed Unicode scalar order. Search saved sets and reports without changing the calculation rules.

KEEP THE INPUTS WITH THE ANSWER
Freeze a result to preserve its source copies and revisions. Later edits or deletion of a source set leave that report intact. Generate a complete member CSV or a JSON report containing the inputs, rules and result, then preview or share the actual files.

LIMITS
Each set supports up to 5,000 unique elements, 10,000 input lines and 512 KiB of UTF-8 text. A normalized element may contain up to 160 UTF-16 units. This is a tool for explicit string sets; it does not infer missing elements or invent a universal set.

Saved sets, reports and generated files are kept in the app's local storage. Delete individual records or use Clear local data in About. External originals, shared copies and device backups are managed separately.

name: Sevenir
description:
Sevenir is a game you play on location in the United Arab Emirates. Go to real places across the seven emirates, check in when you arrive, and turn your visits into XP, missions and memories.

A check-in uses your phone’s location at the place itself, so you play by being there. Outside the UAE you can browse places and plan visits, but you cannot check in.

How it works
• Find a place worth visiting: browse the map, or search by name across all seven emirates.
• Go there and check in: your location confirms the visit and you earn XP.
• Keep the memory: add a photo, a few words or a rating, finish missions and watch your level grow.

What’s inside
• 9,300+ places: cafés, restaurants, museums, galleries, parks, beaches, landmarks, viewpoints, malls, souks, heritage sites, zoos and aquariums, theme parks and water parks.
• Place pages with photos, short descriptions, opening hours and contact details where available, and ratings from players who checked in there.
• Weekly missions that start fresh every week, landmark missions, friend missions and routes that link several places into one outing.
• XP, 40 levels, badges and a daily streak with bonus XP at each milestone.
• A weekly league for every emirate, a UAE-wide ranking and the Race of the Seven between the emirates.
• Hidden premium places: they stay off the map and appear only when you pass close by with the app open.
• Memories: keep a photo, a short note and a rating from each visit, and choose who sees it: Only me, Friends or Everyone.
• Stories: share a photo or a video of up to 30 seconds that disappears after 24 hours.
• Majlis: chat rooms for all players and for your own emirate.
• Together: an optional profile with your interests and languages, connection requests, private chat with friends, small plans at public places that the host approves, and live location with the friends you choose, for 15 minutes to 3 hours.
• English, Arabic and Turkish.

Fair play and safety
• Points decide, never luck. Visits are verified by location, and XP is game progress, not money.
• Sponsored places are always labelled.
• Sevenir is for adults aged 18 and over. You can report content and block players, and our team reviews reports.
• Never use Sevenir while driving. The search for premium places pauses above 25 km/h.
• Location is used only while the app is open, to show places near you and to confirm check-ins.

Privacy: sevenir.ae/privacy
Terms of Use: sevenir.ae/terms
Community Guidelines: sevenir.ae/guidelines
Help: sevenir.ae/help

Sevenir is made by FluxOrbit, a company in the United Arab Emirates.

name: ShakerPro
description:
ShakerPro turns your iPhone into a real shaker. Move the phone and the grains inside the instrument move with it – soft moves play soft, a firm stop gives a clear accent, a loose wrist rolls between the beats.

No static samples: the sound is simulated grain by grain while you play, so no two strokes are ever the same.

INSTRUMENTS
• Egg shaker – short, crisp and tight
• Fine shaker – a soft, silky wash of tiny grains
• Maracas – round and woody
• Cabasa – bright steel beads
• Tambourine – brass jingles in a wooden frame
• Sleigh bells – for winter songs
• Rainstick – turn the phone over and the grains trickle down like rain

RHYTHM PLAYER
Quarters, 8ths, 16ths, samba, crescendo, swell and more, 60–160 BPM, soft (p), medium (mf) or loud (f). Hear the instrument without shaking, practise along, or shape its sound while it plays.

SHAPE YOUR SOUND
Level, hit, grains, grain size, attack, pour, tone, ring and stereo for every instrument. Export your settings as text and import them on another iPhone.

MADE FOR MUSICIANS
Native audio with very short buffers and motion read 200 times a second keep the sound in time with your hand.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
The egg shaker and sleigh bells are free, together with the rhythm player. The full version is a one-time purchase – no subscription – and adds the other five instruments, the sound settings and import / export.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: ShapeScan
description:
ShapeScan turns a photo of a flat part into a precise, true-to-size outline you can cut, print or machine.

Lay the part on a backlit panel, take a photo, and ShapeScan finds the panel, corrects the lens and the camera's angle, and traces every edge, holes included, at 1:1 scale. Straight edges become clean lines, curves become smooth splines, and an adjustable offset adds clearance or a cutter path.

CAPTURE YOUR WAY
• iPhone and iPad: use the built-in camera.
• Raspberry Pi camera: mount it over the ShapeScan light box for repeatable, hands-free scans with live view, autofocus and backlight control.
• No Wi-Fi in the workshop? ShapeScan finds the Pi over Bluetooth and can switch it to its own Wi-Fi hotspot.
• Or open any photo you've already taken.

MEASURE PRECISELY
• Sub-pixel edge detection and automatic lens and perspective correction.
• Outline and offset sizes shown as you go, in millimetres or inches.
• Adjustable curve-fit tolerance: follow the photo closely, or get smoother curves with fewer points.
• Every capture is saved with its settings, so you can come back to it later.

SHAPESCAN PRO (one-time purchase)
• Export DXF files: editable splines and lines for AutoCAD, Fusion and most CAD programs, or polylines for laser and CNC software, on OUTLINE and OFFSET layers.
• Build your own ShapeScan light box: 14 printable 3D parts with a 3D preview of each, the complete parts and screw list, an illustrated step-by-step assembly guide, the wiring diagram and full Raspberry Pi setup. All available offline.
• One purchase unlocks Pro on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Try it in seconds with the built-in sample photo.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your photos and drawings stay on your device.

name: Sharky's NSB
description:
Skip the fees. Skip the wait. Order Sharky's NSB straight from your phone.

Save More on Every Order
Order direct, pay less. No third-party markups or hidden fees. Get first access to exclusive deals, discounts, and coupons. The same great food, no extra fees.

Ordering Made Ridiculously Easy
Reorder your favorites in seconds, no scrolling, no hassle. Your order skips the line and goes straight to our kitchen. We use your location to find the right spot and get it there fast.

Built to Be Trusted
Real-time push notifications from confirmed to ready. Pickup and delivery windows you can actually count on. Secure checkout, every time.

Real Support for a Real Local Favorite
Every order goes straight to Sharky's NSB, not a delivery app, not a middleman.

Download the Sharky's NSB app now. Taste the difference. Support the local spot you love.

Official app of Sharky's NSB, published by Popmenu on its behalf

name: SHARP: Detail Camera
description:
SHARP tries to take the sharpest photo your iPhone can make. Instead of sharpening filters or hidden upscaling, it combines several real captures on the device and tells you honestly what it achieved.

AUTO: one high-quality photo, exactly as the iPhone processes it.

SUPER DETAIL: a short burst at locked exposure, aligned with sub-pixel precision and fused into one image with less noise and more fine detail. Optional higher-resolution outputs when your hand movement provides the extra information.

NO BLUR: picks the frame in which your subject is sharpest. Faces and eyes are taken into account, and the shutter speed adapts to how much you move.

ALL FOCUS: sweeps focus from near to far and stacks the sharp parts into one image. Ideal for close-ups and product shots.

Every result comes with a side-by-side comparison against a normal single photo, so you can see the difference yourself.

Everything runs on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, no account, no tracking.

name: Sharptalk: Speaking Coach
description:
You know the moment. The interviewer waits, the customer says "too expensive", the room goes quiet. Your mind goes blank, and out comes "um… I think… sorry." Sharptalk is a speaking coach that takes you from unsure to confident, one short step at a time.

PICK A GOAL. GET A SHORT PATH.
• Sell with confidence: build your pitch, then practice a sales call.
• Interview ready: practice a mock interview and fix your weakest answer.
• Talk ready: make your talk stronger, then rehearse it.
• Sound sure every day: answer on the spot, share an idea in a meeting, tell a short story.
• Speak smoothly: hear your "um"s and pause instead of filling.
Each path is 5 to 7 short steps. Go at your own pace.

HEAR HOW SURE YOU SOUND
You practice out loud. Sharptalk scores how confident you sound: hesitant words like "I think" and "just", filler words, pauses and pace. Then it tells you the one thing to fix next. Watch your level climb from Steady to Sure, Confident, Commanding and Inspiring.
Your fox grows with you: a new look as your level climbs, and a halo when you reach your goal.
Take one calm breath with your fox before you practice.
See your last 7 days and your ums per minute, before and now.

PRACTICE BEFORE IT COUNTS
• Live interview: answer mock interview questions out loud, with feedback on every answer. Choose General job, Tech, Sales, Customer service, Leadership, University, Scholarship or Promotion review.
• Sales call: hear realistic objections and reply out loud. Practice a cold call, a follow-up, in person or a 30-second pitch. It is practice only, and no real call is made.
• Upgrade speech: turn your answer into a clearer one, then say it yourself.
• Quick practice: free talk, quick answers, stories and ear training with your own recordings.
• Sales playbook: tips before and after every practice call.

YOUR BIG DAY, PLANNED
Add your interview or talk with a date and a name you choose. Sharptalk builds a get-ready plan up to the day, with optional reminders the evening before, an hour before or that morning.

GO DEEPER
An optional 6-week program builds a daily habit. In its sessions, a soft tap nudges you to pause when you hesitate, and the taps fade as you improve.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Speech is turned into text on your iPhone, your recordings stay on it, and you can delete them any time.

With Apple Intelligence, on-device AI coaches every answer: a stronger way to say it, a sample answer and a follow-up question. It runs on your iPhone. On other iPhones you still get your score and built-in tips.

FREE AND PRO
Free: your first path, quick practice, one practice sales call with the basic playbook tips, and your first get-ready plan.
Sharptalk Pro: every path and any new goal, unlimited get-ready plans, unlimited sales calls and the full playbook, and the 6-week program.
Early subscribers keep their price.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Sharptalk Pro is $4.99 a month, or $19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Sharptalk is a speaking practice tool. It gives no medical or therapy advice.

Terms of Use: https://onelabsllc.com/sharptalk/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://onelabsllc.com/sharptalk/privacy/

name: Sheets by OpenApps
description:
Free sign-up sheets for volunteer shifts, potlucks, team snacks, carpools and conferences. Make a sheet, share the link, and people tap a slot, type their name, and they are on it. A slot never takes more people than you set. No ads, and nobody needs an account, not even you.

What you get
- Time shifts, item lists and weekly dates in a few taps.
- Say how many people each slot needs; slots are never overbooked.
- Ask for an email, a phone number or your own questions if you like.
- People see who took what and can remove their own name later.
- Your organizer view shows names, emails and answers as they come in.
- Export a CSV, remove a sign-up, close the sheet, or add a slot to your calendar.

Sharing
Tap Share and send the link. Whoever makes a sheet also gets a private admin link to manage it from another device.

Your data
Sheets starts you as a guest on this phone and never asks you to sign up. You can delete your sheets, your sign-ups and your account from the bottom of the home screen at any time.

Sheets is made by OpenApps. It also works in a web browser at sheets-free.openapps.xyz.

name: Shift & Tip Tracker: Shiftbook
description:
Not sure your paycheck is right? Look at this.
Shiftbook logs your shifts and tips and shows what your next check should be.
Clock in when you get there. It does the math. Overtime and breaks too.

Clock out when you leave. Shiftbook handles the rest: unpaid breaks, overtime, tips, and what you've made so far this pay period, before taxes.

If a check ever comes up short, you'll have the receipts. Every shift is saved with the time you came in and the time you left, and you can send your manager a clean timesheet as a PDF or a spreadsheet.

What it does:
• Clock in and out with one tap
• Unpaid breaks that don't count toward your hours
• Overtime after 40 hours a week, or after 8 hours a day if your state works that way
• Tips, if you get them. It asks when you clock out.
• Tip-out to the bussers, bar or kitchen, as a set amount or a percent of tips or sales. Set it once and it's filled in every shift, so you see what you actually kept.
• Weekly, every 2 weeks, twice a month, or monthly pay periods
• A reminder if you forget to clock out
• Fix a shift you got wrong, or add one you forgot
• Type in what your check paid and see if it matches your hours

Your shifts stay on your phone. There's no account to make and no ads.

Shiftbook Pro
When a check comes up short, Pro shows where the money went, down to each shift and rate, and writes it up so you can send it to payroll. Pro also adds timesheet exports, a tip report with what you tipped out and kept each pay period, your full history (free keeps the current and last pay period), more than one job, and controls on your lock screen and home screen. It's $4.99 a month, or $29.99 a year with 14 days free to try it, or $89.99 once. The monthly and yearly plans renew on their own. To stop one, cancel it in your Apple account settings at least 24 hours before it renews.

Something broken, or a feature you want? Email support@rowhousesoftware.com.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rowhousesoftware.com/privacy

name: Shiwake Game: Swipe & Sort
description:
Items fall from the top. Swipe each one left or right to sort it.
You'll get the rules in ten seconds — and still find yourself hesitating.

■ How to play
・Swipe each falling picture or word to the correct side
・The higher up you sort it, the more points you get (up to 400)
・Get several right in a row for combo bonuses
・Each game has 20 items. Get 16 or more right to clear the stage

■ 5 levels, 29 topics
Level 1 (Ages 6+)
  Land or sea animals, coloring (red or yellow), odd or even, and more
Level 2 (Ages 9+)
  Chinese zodiac animals, flags (Asia or Europe), herbivore or carnivore, individual or team sports, and more
Level 3 (Ages 12+)
  Element symbols, prime numbers, landlocked countries, string or wind instruments, and more
Level 4 (Ages 15+)
  Capital cities, expert flags, real or made-up world cities, and more
Level 5 (Adults)
  Moons or planets, perfect squares, spelling, Shakespeare or Dickens, Fibonacci numbers

■ Great for
・A quick game in a spare minute
・Trivia and quiz fans
・Competing for high scores with family and friends
・Checking your geography, science and math knowledge the fun way

■ Share your score
From the results screen you can share an image with your score, accuracy and max combo. Send it to a friend and ask: can you beat my score?

■ Languages
English and Japanese. You can switch languages from the home screen. The Japanese version has extra topics about kanji and Japan.

■ Pricing
Free to play all the way through. From your second game, an ad is shown before each game starts.
Buying "Remove ads" in the app (one-time purchase) turns the ads off.

name: Shloka: Gita Verse Feed
description:
Shloka is a verse-by-verse reader for the Bhagavad Gita: swipe through all 701 verses, one verse per screen, with the Sanskrit alongside Annie Besant's public-domain 1922 English translation.

On any verse, like it to keep it, add a private note that stays only on your device, or turn it into a shareable image card for a quick plain-text share. Open the chapter browser to search by translation or Sanskrit, jump straight to a chapter, or revisit everything you've kept or noted.

There is no account, no server and no sync: everything you like, note or keep lives only on your phone. Text size is adjustable for comfortable reading.

Shloka is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: ShopiChat
description:
ShopiChat is your business inbox to sell and support customers on WhatsApp, with an AI assistant that knows your products.

WORK AS A TEAM FROM ONE NUMBER
- Every conversation in one inbox: open, pending and done.
- Assign each chat to a teammate and leave internal notes with mentions.
- Labels, quick replies with "/" and search inside the conversation.
- Photos, videos, documents, voice notes and locations, like any chat.
- iPhone notifications when a message arrives.

AI THAT SELLS WITH YOU
- Suggests replies with your prices and stock, or rewrites what you typed.
- Summarizes the conversation in one tap.
- Proposes the payment link, the order or the invoice, and you confirm.
- Pause the AI in a chat whenever you want to take over.

SELL WITHOUT LEAVING THE CHAT
- Send products from your catalog with photo and price.
- Create orders with variants, shipping, coupon and payment method.
- See what each customer bought and how much they have spent.
- Connect your store and your payments.

REACH YOUR CUSTOMERS
- Broadcasts with approved templates, scheduled, with the estimated cost before sending.
- Contacts with labels, custom fields and CSV import.
- Automations: welcome, after hours, chat routing, survey and keywords.

ShopiChat works with Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform. To get started, create your account and connect your business number. Available in English and Spanish.

name: Short Cast
description:
Short Cast is an offline atelier for short-drama writers, casting teams, and directors who need to benchmark hit character personas and plan casting with clarity.
BENCHMARK HIT DRAMAS
Pin breakout short-drama covers, capture hooks, tropes, visual tone, and archetype notes. Search and filter by genre so your reference board stays sharp.
BUILD ROLE BLUEPRINTS
Create character dossiers with personality, backstory beats, visual cues, chemistry notes, and trait meters. Link each role to a benchmark title when you need a clear target.
SCORE CASTING FIT
Keep a talent pool with look and range notes, then write fit briefs that score look, vibe, and age match. Shortlist, callback, or pass — decisions stay with the project.
COMPARE IN THE ATELIER
Place two blueprints side by side, export a plain-text summary via the system share sheet, and restore sample data anytime.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything lives on this device. No account. No cloud sync for your casting notes. Photo Library is used only when you choose a cover still.
Built for real production prep: figure out who the character is, who can play them, and why — before the camera rolls.

name: ShowLater
description:
ShowLater is a private photo space where you can capture casual moments with each other.

Take a casual photo of a friend, a gathering, a trip or a moment in daily life without immediately picking, editing or Posting it on a public social media platform. Photos and short videos will first be kept on your phone and quietly placed in a private shared space.

Create a Reveal Party and invite people around you to join. Everyone can casually record the same moment: you can see yourself in others' lenses and also share what you see of them. All the content belongs to this small space and only those who have joined can view it.

ShowLater makes taking photos natural again - less staged shots and more authenticity. Less public display and more memories that belong only to you.

name: Showline: Choir at hand
description:
Showline is a private app for an amateur choir. You sign in with an invitation from the director: rehearsal and concert schedule, voice parts in recordings made by choir members, homework recordings, section chat and the attendance journal
A searchable repertoire catalog: every song has lyrics and four voices — soprano, alto, tenor and bass; some songs also have a video breakdown. For each voice you see the latest recording made by choir members. You can record your part with your voice or film it on video, or pick an existing clip from your library. Recordings and videos play right on the song card, and you can replace your own recording. Audio keeps playing when the screen is locked, with pause and 15-second skip controls on the lock screen
Video is shot with the camera or picked from the library. The app prepares it for upload: 720p, no longer than 90 seconds and no larger than 60 MB. Everyone in the choir sees a part video; homework videos are visible to the director and your section. Playback opens in the system player: full screen on iPhone, as a card on iPad; closing the player stops playback
When you join the choir you pick your voice: soprano, alto, tenor or bass. Your part defines which line of the song you record; all four voices can be listened to and watched
Record your part with your voice or on video and attach a text note: the recording and the note live separately. The director and your section can see them; a recording can be played right from the song card
Upcoming and past choir events: a rehearsal is added to your calendar with one tap, and the venue is shown on the map with directions. The venue Wi-Fi connects via a QR code from the front desk. When you are on the venue network, the app shows "You are at the rehearsal — mark your attendance": marking is one tap, and there is also an "I'm here" button
Your section's own conversation: messages and photos, with automatic retry when the network fails. No private chats — the choir only
Reporting a post, comment, message, homework or part recording or a profile hides it for you immediately and permanently; you can also block the author. The director manages sections and membership, keeps the attendance journal and invites members by code or QR. An account is deleted in Profile: together with its recordings, posts and messages
Showline shows no ads and shares no data with ad networks

name: Shuttrix: Pro Camera
description:
Shuttrix is a camera in two modes. Simple mode has big sliders for light, warmth and colour. Pro mode puts lens, focus, white balance, ISO and shutter on dials.

• Simple: lens icons beside a zoom slider, then Light, Warmth and Color sliders. The shutter sits alone under the thumb.
• Pro: manual ISO, shutter speed, focus distance, white balance in kelvin and exposure, each on a dial.
• RAW and ProRAW next to the JPEG or HEIF photo.
• Night builds the photo from several frames while a bar shows.
• Astro: a night sky held in the hand, with sharp stars and a dark sky.
• Moon zooms in and exposes for the moon, so its seas and craters show.
• Portrait keeps the subject sharp and blurs the rest.
• Long exposure, Panorama, focus stack and Mini.
• Video, slow motion and time-lapse.
• Face focus, tap to lock focus and light, and QR codes.

Each shot lands in the Shuttrix gallery and in Photos. The app speaks 9 languages.

name: Şifreli Söz: Türkçe Kriptogram
description:
Sayılarla şifrelenmiş sözleri çöz, beynini her gün çalıştır!

NASIL OYNANIR?
Sözdeki her harfin yerine bir sayı yazılmıştır. Aynı sayı her yerde aynı harfi gösterir. Bir kutuya dokun, doğru harfi seç; harf o sayının geçtiği her yere birden yazılır. Türkçenin harf sıklığını ve kısa kelimeleri kullanarak şifreyi adım adım kır.

HER GÜN 5 YENİ ŞİFRE
Her gece yarısı 5 yeni şifre gelir: 2 kolay, 1 orta, 1 zor ve 1 usta. Aynı gün herkes aynı şifreleri çözer.

SEVDİĞİN SÖZLER
Atasözleri, Atatürk'ün unutulmaz sözleri, Yunus Emre'nin dizeleri, Nasreddin Hoca'nın nükteleri ve şaşırtıcı "Biliyor muydun?" bilgileri. Her şifrenin sonunda sözün anlamını ve kaynağını öğren.

TÜRKÇEYE ÖZEL
Ç, Ğ, I, İ, Ö, Ş ve Ü dahil 29 harfli Türkçe alfabe ve Türkçe klavye. Çeviri değil, Türkçe için tasarlanmış bir kriptogram.

İPUCU VE CAN
Takıldığında ipucu al, seçili sayının harfi açılsın. Yanlış harfler can götürür; dikkatli ol!

SERİNİ BÜYÜT
Her gün en az bir şifre çöz, serini büyüt. Hatasız ve ipuçsuz çözümlerini istatistiklerinde gör.

PRO (TEK SEFERLİK ÖDEME, ABONELİK YOK)
Reklamsız oyna, 30 günlük arşivi aç, her gün 5 ipucu al.

Hesap yok, kayıt yok. İlerlemen yalnızca cihazında saklanır.

name: Sifted.
description: A recipe’s suggested timing may not match your oven, and after baking it is easy to forget how long it took, which ingredients you used, or how the result looked. Sifted helps you stay with the current step while you bake and keeps a record you can refer to the next time you make the recipe. Browse 12 dessert recipes or narrow the rack by baking time, skill, oven, or type of dessert. Follow one step at a time, start a timer for steps that need one, and check the recipe’s visual cues for oven stages. Scale ingredient amounts by batch size or by an ingredient amount you have. Save step photos and spoken notes as you work, then record the finished bake’s actual time, ingredients, oven, photos, and notes. Mark the result as under, on point, or over, and find finished bakes in the oven log and monthly calendar.

name: SignPure: Offline PDF E-Signer
description:
SignPure lets you sign PDF agreements, add dates, initials, and custom stamps in seconds — completely offline on your iPhone.

No account walls, no per-document fees, and zero cloud uploads so confidential contracts stay 100% under your control.

KEY FEATURES
• Natural Vector Signatures: Draw smooth, crisp signatures and initials with realistic ink feel.
• Fill Forms & Add Stamps: Place text fields, dates, checkmarks, and reusable approval stamps anywhere.
• Instant Clean PDF Export: Save or share flattened, ready-to-send PDFs with zero watermarks.
• 100% Offline Security: Confidential legal and business documents never leave your device.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: Unlock unlimited signatures, custom stamp library, and batch signing forever.

name: Silent Blade: Stealth Assassin
description:
You have one blade and nobody knows you are here. Keep it that way.

Silent Blade is a top-down stealth game you play with one finger. Tap to move. Tap a guard to take it down. Stay out of the vision cones, because the moment a guard sees you the whole floor comes looking.

READ THE ROOM Every guard shows you exactly what it can see. Wait for a patrol to turn its back, slip round a crate, strike, and be gone before the next one comes round the corner. Chain takedowns for a kill streak and a bigger payout.

GUARDS THAT THINK Guards hear footsteps and come to check. They find the mess you leave behind. They stop to chat, and that is your moment. Later levels add snipers with long sight lines, armoured heavies you must take from behind, commanders who rally everyone nearby, and bosses guarding the way.

MORE THAN GUARDS Security cameras sweep the corridors and call for help if they catch you: creep along the wall and smash them. Laser tripwires blink on and off across doorways. Some levels come with a twist: a gold rush, an elite squad, a full lockdown.

HEROES AND BLADES Unlock heroes with their own styles: a quiet assassin, a tank who shrugs off bullets, a ghost that guards are slow to notice, a berserker who heals with every takedown, and more. Rank each one up as you play. Collect blades with their own perks.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO FIND Gems, hearts, cloaks and speed boosts lie in every level. Collect keys to open the treasure room and pick your chests. Come back each day for a bigger daily reward.

LEVEL AFTER LEVEL Hand-tuned levels across warehouses, offices, labs, vaults, museums and more, then a long road of new ones beyond them. Each level is the same every time you play it, so you can learn it and earn all three stars: complete, unseen, untouched.

Play offline, in short sessions, in several languages.

name: Silicio Challenges
description:
Observe, remember, and solve. Silicio Challenges brings 444 memory, logic, and focus puzzles to a chessboard across seven games. No chess experience is needed.

• Remember where the pieces were in Vanishing Memory.
• Find routes using knight moves and place queens so they cannot attack one another.
• Cover marked squares, swap knights, navigate mazes, and build capture chains.

Learn with interactive tutorials and play at your own pace. Use hints, try again, bookmark favorite puzzles, and track your progress. Adjust sound, reduce motion, or export a backup of your progress.

Start free with 58 puzzles and one rotating daily challenge. An optional one-time purchase unlocks the full catalog and all three daily challenges. No ads, subscriptions, or user accounts.

Play offline. Purchases and restoration require internet access and the same Apple Account. Available in English and Spanish.

name: SiliconLens
description:
Inspect real hardware telemetry, display specs, diagnostic logs, and physical sensors with complete transparency.
SiliconLens is a native, instrument-grade hardware telemetry, factory OEM reference atlas, offline diagnostic log visualizer, and 16-point physical inspection lab for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. One-time $1.99 paid download—every feature is unlocked out of the box with zero in-app purchases, zero subscriptions, and zero ads.

CORE CAPABILITIES:

1. Real-Time Telemetry & Public Display Spec Audit
• Inspect exact device identifiers, P/E-core CPU load, segmented unified memory pressure (Active / Wired / Compressed), storage usage, Metal GPU capabilities, and thermal state.
• Audits live display refresh rate, Display P3 gamut, and HDR EDR headroom against factory baselines—alerting you to refresh-rate or gamut discrepancies while clearly respecting iOS sandbox boundaries.

2. 2.5D Architecture View & Factory OEM Reference Atlas
• Covers 20 Apple hardware families across iPhone 11–17 / Air / SE, iPad, and Mac M1–M5.
• Includes an offline model-number decoder (Retail M / Replacement N / Refurbished F / Demo) and reference comparison matrices for display panel and battery cell lots.

3. 16-Point Physical Hardware Inspection Lab
• Display Optics: ProMotion frame-cadence scope, 8-color dead pixel matrix, 5% low-gray OLED uniformity check, burn-in grid, and color banding test.
• Touch & Biometrics: Multi-touch tracker, perimeter edge-swipe dead-zone grid, and Face ID / Touch ID verification.
• Acoustics & Barometer Seal: Cavity micro-pressure press test (to help evaluate waterproof seal resilience), isolated stereo channel sweep, 165Hz acoustic dust ejection, and Taptic Engine resonance check.

4. 100% Air-Gapped Diagnostic Log Visualizer
• Import your own Analytics or panic-full diagnostic files locally on device to read real battery cycle counts, physical mAh capacity, and plain-language hardware fault diagnostics. Zero cloud uploads.

5. macOS Bus Topology & Menu Bar Telemetry
• Inspect built-in and external display EDID panel makers, USB-IF vendor IDs, and live menu bar telemetry with zero kernel extensions, plus .spx system report import.

6. Objective Inspection Reports & Gear Garage
• Export factual local telemetry and completed lab inspection summaries as crisp vertical posters or A4 sheets.

ONE-TIME PAID APP — NO IN-APP PURCHASES, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• Pay $1.99 once for Universal Purchase across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Family Sharing. Every feature included upfront.
• 100% offline on-device processing. Data Not Collected.

Privacy Policy: https://www.356668.xyz/siliconlens/privacy/
Support: https://www.356668.xyz/siliconlens/support/
Terms of Use: https://www.356668.xyz/siliconlens/terms/

name: Silver Star
description:
Silver Star — официальное приложение магазина серебряных украшений Silver Star (Yulduzxon) в Ургенче. Всё серебро 925 пробы. Раньше украшения выбирали по фото в Instagram и заказывали в сообщениях — теперь весь каталог магазина у вас в телефоне.

• Кольца
• Цепочки и кулоны
• Браслеты

В приложении:
— фото, цена и описание каждого украшения, проба 925
— выбор размера, таблица размеров и наличие
— избранное, чтобы не потерять понравившееся
— корзина и оформление заказа за минуту
— вход по номеру телефона и SMS-коду, без паролей
— сохранённые адреса и выбор точки на карте
— статус заказа и чат с магазином
— уведомления о новинках (по желанию)

Доставка через Яндекс Доставку: стоимость зависит от адреса, её оплачиваете водителю. Украшения оплачиваются наличными при получении. Приложение на узбекском и русском языках.

Магазин: г. Ургенч, сторона Даритал, здание «DATA», 1-й этаж (напротив BYD и Pizza Center). Телефон: +998 91 434 25 25. Instagram: @silver_star_kumush.

name: Silverlake Aerospace CorteX
description:
CorteX is the mission companion for Silverlake Aerospace flight computers.

Your Little Hero board flies perfectly well on its own. Connect it to CorteX and it gains a memory, a screen, and a community.

CONFIGURE
Set every deployment event over Bluetooth — no cable, no dongle, no guesswork on the pad.

REPLAY
The full profile is on your screen before you have walked back to the rocket: apogee, velocity, and every deployment event.

MEMORY
CorteX remembers your boards and your performances, so your flight history builds itself. Raw telemetry stays attached to each flight.

COMMUNITY
Compare performances, share flights, and see what the rest of the field is flying. You choose what you make public.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Your boards and flights follow your account. Pick up wherever you left off.

STANDALONE BY DEFAULT
Silverlake Aerospace boards fly standalone. CorteX adds to them — it is never a dependency for getting off the pad.

CorteX is free. No licence, no subscription — just a free Silverlake Aerospace account.

Recording a new flight requires a Silverlake Aerospace flight computer: Little Hero Core or Little Hero DUAL.

name: Sing a Little Christmas
description:
Make singing fun.

Sing along to familiar Christmas carols and use your voice to guide characters through snowy stories. Your pitch moves your character as the song plays. Follow the on-screen lyrics, collect surprises, and see what you earn in each finale. Every completed song has a welcoming ending.

YOUR VOICE GUIDES THE JOURNEY
Changes in your singing pitch move your character up and down as the music carries the scene forward. Follow the melody path, reach song-specific collectibles, and see your accomplishments become part of each finale.

CHRISTMAS FAVORITES, DISTINCT WORLDS
Explore twelve core carols, including Jingle Bells, Silent Night, Joy to the World, Deck the Halls and We Wish You a Merry Christmas. Each song brings its own characters, discoveries and festive setting.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose Easy, Standard or Hard, adjust the song pitch to suit your voice, and use optional voice setup and melody guidance. On-screen lyrics help you follow along. Save stars, personal bests and progress on your device, then return for another short singing adventure. A listening option lets you enjoy the songs without using the microphone.

FREE SONGS AND CHRISTMAS COLLECTION
Play Silent Night and Joy to the World in full for free. One permanent in-app purchase unlocks ten more illustrated Christmas journeys. Earn the Auld Lang Syne encore by earning at least one vocal star on each of the twelve core songs in the same difficulty. Listening does not earn vocal stars.

Headphones are recommended. The game analyzes singing on your device and does not save or upload voice recordings. No in-game advertising.

This is playful musical recreation, not professional vocal training.

Support: info@billaicher.com

name: Sip – Water Tracker
description:
Watch your water rise. Sip shows your day as a real glass that fills as you drink, so one look tells you where you stand.

LOG IN ONE TAP
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with +250 ml buttons
• Control Center button and Siri: "Log a drink in Sip"
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Apple Watch app and complications

A GOAL THAT FITS YOUR DAY
• Turn on the smart goal and Sip adds water for exercise minutes from Apple Health
• On hot days Sip adds 250–500 ml more, from today's local high
• Tap the chip under the glass to see how Sip got the number

FIX MISTAKES FAST
• Undo right after you log
• Tap any drink to change its amount or time; swipe to delete

REMINDERS THAT KNOW YOUR PACE
• Sip reminds you only when you fall behind, and only in your active hours

APPLE HEALTH
• Saves each drink to Health as Water, with no duplicates

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Your drinks stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch

name: Sit Breathe Flow
description: Sit Breathe Flow is a free, six-minute moving meditation you can do seated or standing. Follow an animated guide through gentle whole-body movements, with spoken cues and quiet pauses. Close with a Namaste bow, then jot down a reflection in your private journal.

name: SiteSnag: Site Inspections
description:
Walk the site, capture every snag, and hand your client a professional, signed report before you've left the car park.

SiteSnag is built for contractors, surveyors, property managers and facilities teams who need defects recorded properly, not scribbled on a notepad and typed up that evening.

Capture it once, on site
• Organise each job into projects and areas, such as flats, floors, rooms or plant.
• Photograph an issue and mark it up with arrows, rings and measurement lines so there is no ambiguity about what needs fixing.
• Set the priority and status (open, in progress or resolved) so you can see at a glance what is still outstanding.
• Dictate notes, or use New snag by voice to log a defect hands-free as you walk, including a spoken priority (critical, high, medium or low).

Pin issues on a 3D room scan
• On iPhone and iPad Pro models with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro or later, and iPad Pro), scan a room to build a 3D model, then tap a wall or surface to pin the exact location of a snag.
• Measure real-world distances on the model, and save a view of the scan with the issue.
• All other devices can still photograph, mark up and report issues as usual.

Reports your clients will trust
• Export a clean, branded PDF with photos, markups, priorities and status in one tap, then share it by email or save it to Files.
• At handover, the client signs on the screen, accepted items are recorded with the date and time, and a signed sign-off page is added to the PDF.

Win back hours every week
• No more re-typing site notes at the office or chasing missing photos.
• Everything is stored on your device and works fully offline, so a poor signal on site never stops a walk-round.
• The project dashboard shows open, in-progress and resolved issues at a glance.

Up and running in a minute
• A short one-time tutorial on first launch shows you the four steps: create a project, photograph the issue, mark it up and set its status, then export the report. After that it stays out of your way.
• A sample inspection is included, so you can see a finished job before you start your own.

One price, no subscription
Pay once and use SiteSnag on every job. There are no per-user fees and no monthly bills.

name: Sınavı Geç: Ehliyet Sınav 2026
description:
Ehliyet sınavına hazırlanmanın en kolay yolu! Sınavı Geç: Ehliyet ile MEB e-sınav formatına uygun deneme sınavları çöz, eksiklerini gör ve sınava hazır ol.

GERÇEK SINAV DENEYİMİ
• 50 soru, 45 dakika, 35 doğru ile geçme: gerçek e-sınavın birebir aynısı
• Her biri farklı sorulardan oluşan 6 deneme sınavı
• Her seferinde rastgele sorularla karışık deneme
• Gerçek sınavdaki konu dağılımı: 23 Trafik, 12 İlk Yardım, 9 Motor, 6 Trafik Adabı

395 AÇIKLAMALI SORU
• Trafik ve Çevre Bilgisi, İlk Yardım, Motor ve Araç Tekniği, Trafik Adabı
• Her sorunun altında neden doğru olduğunu anlatan açıklama
• Cevabını verdiğin anda doğru mu yanlış mı hemen gör

RESMİ TRAFİK İŞARETLERİ
• Karayolları standart levhalarından 95 trafik işareti
• "Bu işaret neyi ifade eder?" tarzında görselli sorular
• Tehlike uyarı, trafik tanzim, bilgi, duraklama ve park işaretleri için kart destesi
• Kategori kategori işaret testleri

AKILLI TEKRAR
• Yanlış yaptığın sorular "Yanlışlarım" bölümünde birikir, doğru bilince çıkar
• Sınava hazırlık yüzdesi ile ne kadar hazır olduğunu gör
• Geçmiş sınavlarında tüm sonuçların ve yanlışların

TAMAMEN ÜCRETSİZ VE GİZLİ
• Üyelik yok, hesap yok
• İnternet bağlantısı gerekmez
• Hiçbir veri toplanmaz; ilerlemen sadece telefonunda saklanır

Not: Bu uygulama Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı ile bağlantılı değildir. Sorular e-sınav konularına göre özgün olarak hazırlanmıştır. Trafik işareti görselleri Karayolları Genel Müdürlüğü'nün standart trafik işaret levhalarından alınmıştır.

name: SkeinBath: Fiber Dye Recipes
description:
Translate fiber weight and dye depth into a repeatable yarn dye formula. Enter dry fiber weight and a target depth of shade, assign shares to the dyes in your formula, and see the dry dye mass and stock solution volume for each color. Use a different stock concentration for each dye.

Save original formulas and your color notes. Open a saved formula, enter a new fiber weight, and calculate the scaled batch without changing the original. A sample three-color formula shows the workflow and the share sheet exports the quantities as text.

SkeinBath calculates measurements and stores recipes offline. Follow your dye supplier's instructions for dye chemistry, handling and process settings.

name: Skeinlog
description: Skeinlog is a knitting row notebook. Each piece stores a name, a yarn, a needle size in millimetres, rows done, and rows planned. The percent is rows done divided by rows planned. Early means that percent is under 25. Minus stops at zero and plus stops at the plan. A dye lot is a dated note and does not change the row count. Nothing is uploaded.

name: SkillBuilder: Skill Videos
description:
SkillBuilder helps you get better at any skill, one short video every Thursday.

Tell it one skill you want to get better at and how long each video should be. Your first clip comes right after you pick, then a new one every Thursday: one short clip, cut to just the part that teaches it, with three things to watch for and why it matters.

HOW IT WORKS

• Pick a skill. Type anything you can practise, in your own words: hockey, card tricks, juggling, cooking. Change it whenever you like in Settings.
• Pick a length. 30 seconds, 1 minute, 3 minutes or 10 minutes. Only that part of the video plays, so a 1-minute clip is really a minute.
• Watch. Your first clip arrives right away, then a new one every Thursday morning, each with three things to watch for and why it matters.
• Tune it. Thumbs up or down shapes the next pick.
• Share it. "Copy link to this clip" gives you a link that plays just that part, ready to paste into a chat.

SKILLS, NOT TOPICS

SkillBuilder sends videos that show you how to do something, so it asks for a skill. If what you type isn't something a short video can teach, it says so and suggests something close that is.

HOW THE CLIPS ARE PICKED

SkillBuilder searches YouTube for your skill, has AI rate each video for how well it teaches, and checks the chosen part fits your length. Your thumbs count towards the next pick, and you never get the same video twice. If there's no clip at your length, you get the nearest one and the page tells you so.

The clip plays right on your page, in YouTube's own player. You don't need a YouTube account. Earlier weeks are listed underneath, with a link to each on YouTube.

INVITE-ONLY FOR NOW

SkillBuilder is invite-only while we make sure the picks are good. Ask for an invite at skillbuilder.firminlabs.com. Once you're on the list, sign in with your email address: we email you a sign-in code, and there is no password.

PRIVACY

SkillBuilder keeps your email address, the skill you asked for, and which videos you were sent and how you rated them. It never asks for your name. It has no ads of its own and no tracking, and nothing is sold. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

SkillBuilder works the same in the app and at skillbuilder.firminlabs.com, with the same login.

name: Skipi Bunker Survey
description:
Skipi Bunker Survey determines the quantity of fuel on board from tank gaugings, tank by tank, and produces a report ready for signature. Intended for chief engineers, chief officers and independent bunker surveyors attending bunkering, on-hire and off-hire surveys.

SURVEY PROCEDURE
1. Survey: vessel name, port, drafts forward and aft at the time of gauging; the trim is calculated and selects the column of every tank table.
2. Tank by tank: tank name, fuel grade and density at 15 °C. Photograph the page of the tank's sounding or ullage table that covers today's reading: the table is read from the photo and presented for verification and correction before use, and it stays with the tank for the next survey. Tables can also be typed in.
3. Sounding or ullage and temperature: the volume at the survey trim, the volume correction factor, the volume at 15 °C and the weight in air are shown at once.
4. Report: totals per grade and a PDF report — one line per tank, the tables used and signature blocks for the Chief Engineer, the surveyor and the supplier's representative. Save the PDF or share it.

CALCULATION
• Volume from the vessel's tank tables at the survey trim by linear interpolation in level and trim; no extrapolation beyond the table
• Volume correction to 15 °C: ASTM D1250-80 / API 2540 Table 54B (generalized products), VCF to four decimals
• Weight in air: GSV × (density at 15 °C in vacuum − 0.0011), Table 56
• Every figure on the report can be recomputed by hand from the line before it

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADVERTISING, NO TRACKING
Calculations run on the device. The network is used only to read photographed tank tables; photos are not stored. For iPhone and iPad.

Published by SKIPI LTD, London. Support: info@skipi.app

name: Skirting Planner
description:
Plan skirting boards for one room, from the first measurement to a cut sheet for the workshop.

Enter width and depth for a rectangle, or measure wall by wall for alcoves, chimney breasts and angled corners. Use the L-shape shortcut or build a custom outline with 3–20 straight walls.

Add doorways and compare two stock lengths by board count and the position of joins. The cut sheet groups blanks by board and shows the fitted length and what each end meets.

• Enter measurements in millimetres or decimal inches
• Adjust the saw cut width and fitting allowance
• Save one room on your device
• Preview and share a printable PDF

Planning and PDF creation work offline. Check the measurements and mark the end angles on site before cutting.

name: Sky Altar: Star Map
description:
Sky Altar shows the stars, the Sun, the Moon, the planets and the constellations behind your phone, over a dimmed camera picture.

Each theme draws the sky the way an old culture might have seen it: Ancient Greece, Rome, the Vikings, the Slavs, the Aztecs, the Maya, the Inca, China, India, Japan, Egypt, Sumer, Babylon, the Stone Age and the peoples of North America. A glowing picture lies over each of the 28 main constellations, with its story.

What you get:
• Camera mode: hold the phone up and the sky follows it.
• Browse mode: drag to turn the sky and pinch to zoom.
• Tap a planet, a bright star or a constellation for its name and height above the horizon.
• Search a constellation by name, and the sky turns to it.
• Your stars: a birth chart, tips for today, a match with friends, the Chinese year and the life path number.
• Calm music on the old instruments of each culture, or your own tracks.
• A quiet clock at the top of the sky.
• 9 languages.

Sky Altar uses your rough position only to place the stars right. The camera picture stays on your phone.

Ancient Greece, the Vikings, the sky view and the birth chart are free, and ads stay off the sky. Sky Altar Pro, a one time purchase, opens all 20 cultures, your own music and the rest of Your stars, and hides the ads. Remove ads, a smaller one time purchase, hides the ads alone.

name: Sky Hunter: Hunter of Skies
seller_name: luiz filipe fernandes e silva de castro
description:
Take the controls and defend the skies!

In Sky Hunter you fly a fighter jet over the sea and face waves of drones, squadrons of enemy jets and huge bosses, each with its own way of attacking. Drag your finger to fly; shooting is automatic.

REAL BOSS FIGHTS
• Battleship: a warship with rotating turrets that fire spreads of bullets.
• Phantom Wing: a fast flying wing that unleashes laser curtains and missiles.
• Mothership: launches drones, missiles and bursts everywhere.
The order changes every game, so no two flights are the same.

10 JETS TO UNLOCK
From the Tucano to the Raptor-X, every jet has its own speed, firepower and toughness, plus exclusive paint jobs. Earn medals by playing and build your hangar.

DIFFICULTY THAT GROWS WITH YOU
The longer you survive, the faster and more aggressive the enemies get. New enemy types show up as you pass 50,000 points, 100,000 points and beyond.

COLLECTION AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Record every drone, jet, ship and boss you take down in the Collection and complete 18 achievements.

PLAY OFFLINE
No sign-up and no internet required. Your progress is saved on your iPhone and in your iCloud.

• 4 difficulty levels: Recruit, Pilot, Ace and Legend
• Combos up to x8, triple shot, shields and bombs
• A changing sky: sunset, night, dawn, day and storm
• Pixel art visuals and an original soundtrack
• Play in English or Portuguese

name: Skylane: Flying Car Racing
description:
Hit the ramp, fold out the wings and race into orbit.

Skylane is an arcade racer where every lap leaves the ground. Race closed circuits against AI rivals, launch off the ramp, climb through the sky, slingshot around orbit, then dive back through re-entry and land on the strip for the run to the finish. Miss the ramp and you stay on the ground road, which rejoins after the landing strip. Every lap is a choice.

DRIVE / FLY / ORBIT / LAND
- Launch, wing deploy and landing are timed and rated. Nail them for speed.
- In flight, steer through gate chains, boost rings and orbs.
- Double-tap left or right to barrel roll past asteroids.
- Turbo, slide boosts and drafting on the road.

CAREER: RISE TO LEGEND
- Four chapters: Street Circuits, Chrome League, Aurora Series and Zenith Tour.
- 51 events: races, duels, flight challenges, time attacks, eliminations, endurance runs, style events, cups and boss races.
- Seven named rivals, sponsors and a story told between races.
- Four championship circuits (Rookie, Pro, Elite, Legend) with 12 hand-picked tracks. Each tier opens when you finish the circuit before it and your car reaches the required Performance Rating.

MORE WAYS TO RACE
- Continuous Racing: a new track every race, with rivals matched to your rating.
- Daily and Weekly races: the same seeded track, field and car for everyone.
- Quick Race: pick the tier, field size (4 to 8 cars) and laps (1 to 5).
- Time Trial: solo laps against your own ghost.
- Practice at the Proving Ground.

A NEW TRACK EVERY TIME
Tracks are generated from nine layout types, from classic circuits and figure-8 crossovers to mountain passes, city grids and coastal runs. Race through Neon City, Canyon, Ocean Highway, Mountains and Space Station at sunset, night, dawn or in a midnight storm, with weather from neon rain and fog banks to aurora, meteor showers, sandstorms and lightning. Modifiers like Reverse, Mirror, Low Gravity, Boost Frenzy and Rival Ambush shake things up.

YOUR GARAGE
- 10 cars, from the free Comet to the Rocket and the Zenith.
- Upgrade Engine, Boost, Grip, Wings and Hull. Upgrades are capped, so skill wins races.
- Free customization: paint, finish, decals, underglow, wings, spoiler, wheels, flame colour, trails and your own license plate. Cosmetics never change stats.
- Every race pays Shards, with bonuses for clean races, overtakes, fastest laps and threading the gates.

PLAY ONE-HANDED
- One-thumb drag: up to accelerate, down to brake, left and right to steer.
- Optional tilt assist, left- or right-handed layout, or button controls.
- Steering assist for beginners.
- Reduce flashing, reduce motion, haptics, HUD scale and graphics quality settings.

PLAY OFFLINE
No account and no sign-in. Your progress is saved on your device and races work without a connection.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Skylane is free to play with ads. Watching a rewarded ad is always optional and only ever gives Shards. Sponsor breaks play between races, never before one. Optional Premium removes sponsor breaks and adds the Aurora car and 3,000 Shards. Shard packs are also available. Nothing you can buy skips a championship gate.

Privacy policy: https://thinknewgames.com/privacy-policy/

name: SkyStack Striker
description:
Fly a stacked-sprite fighter through layered skies and hold the line.

SkyStack Striker is a top-down arcade shooter built from stacked pixel sprites. Weave through rivers, clouds, and changing weather, rotate your heading, and keep firing as waves close in. Switch auto-fire on for a cleaner run.

• Stacked-sprite fighter and layered terrain
• Day/night and weather shifts
• WASD, mouse, and touch controls
• Wave, score, shield, and weapon upgrades
• Chinese and English UI

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Slept Well: Morning Check-In
description:
For anyone fighting insomnia, and the family cheering them on.

Slept Well keeps you company when sleep won't come and shows, week by week, that you're getting better. Then it lets you share that progress with your grown-up children, so they can cheer you on.

A CALM VOICE WHEN SLEEP WON'T COME
• Woke up and can't fall back asleep? Tap once. A warm voice guides 4-7-8 breathing, with a glowing circle that counts with you, or a simple word game that quiets a busy mind.
• A dark, amber screen that won't wake you up more. The voice keeps going with the screen off.
• "Not sleeping is okay too." No scores, no rules, no scolding.

SEE YOURSELF GETTING BETTER
• Each morning, two taps: how you slept, and how long it took to fall asleep.
• Week and month views show restful days, wake-ups and days you fell asleep quickly, side by side.
• Only good news and effort are put into words: "3 restful days this week, 1 more than last week." Harder weeks are simply not dwelled on.

A MORNING CARD YOUR FAMILY CAN CHEER FOR
• A warm card is made each morning, with today's small win: "Slept through without waking, a first", "Slept well 5 days in a row".
• Send it with the messaging app you already use. Your family doesn't need to install anything.
• You choose what's on the card. Your worries are never shared.

FAMILY PACK
• Leave today's worries: say a worry out loud before bed. The key words are crossed out and set aside, and the ones you can act on wait for you in the morning.
• Family cheer voice: your child records a few words, and the sleep guide starts with their voice.
• Send the whole week, with your progress, on one card.
• A plain two-week record to show your doctor (PDF).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything stays on your iPhone. Speech is turned into text on the device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE, AND $4.99 ONCE FOR THE FAMILY PACK
The voice guide, morning check-in, progress views and morning card are free forever. The family pack is a one-time purchase. No subscription, ever.

Slept Well is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat sleep problems. Please talk to your doctor about sleep and medicine.

name: Slipway
description:
Το Slipway είναι το τετράδιο ποιότητας της δεξαμενής. Κρατάς εργασίες σε πορθμεία, αλιευτικά και ρυμουλκά: εξαρτήματα με σειριακό, ροπή, υδραυλική πίεση, ευθυγράμμιση άξονα, αποκλίσεις και έκδοση θαλάσσης. Χωρίς λογαριασμό και χωρίς δίκτυο.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς

1. Άνοιξε το Προφίλ και γράψε όνομα, σήμα και βάρδια. Οι καταγραφές υπογράφονται με αυτό το όνομα.
2. Πάτα Νέα εντολή. Συμπλήρωσε σκάφος, τύπο, IMO ή σειριακό, πελάτη, θέση δεξαμενής και ημερομηνία απόπλου.
3. Μέσα στο δελτίο βάλε εξαρτήματα: κωδικό, σειριακό, θερμότητα, προμηθευτή και παρτίδα.
4. Πέρνα τους σταθμούς από την καρίνα ως τη δοκιμή θαλάσσης. Γράψε τιμή (Nm, bar ή mm), κωδικό εργαλείου και αποτέλεσμα.
5. Αν ένας σταθμός απορριφθεί, άνοιξε αναφορά απόκλισης, πρόσθεσε τεκμήριο και κλείσε την με διάθεση (επανεργασία, απόρριψη υλικού ή παρέκκλιση).
6. Όταν όλοι οι σταθμοί είναι πράσινοι και οι αποκλίσεις κλειστές, υπέγραψε το πιστοποιητικό δοκιμής θαλάσσης.
7. Στην Ιχνηλάτηση ψάξε οποιοδήποτε σειριακό — σκάφους ή εξαρτήματος — και μοίρασε το δελτίο.

Το αρχείο μένει στο iPhone. Κάμερα και άλμπουμ χρησιμοποιούνται μόνο για φωτογραφία τεκμηρίου σε απόκλιση.

name: SlotWise
description:
SlotWise to aplikacja dla firm prowadzących atrakcje turystyczne i ich pracowników: wypożyczalni, przewodników, organizatorów spływów, wycieczek i warsztatów. Najważniejsze rzeczy z systemu rezerwacji SlotWise masz w telefonie, także w terenie, z dala od komputera.

REZERWACJE
• Lista rezerwacji z wyszukiwaniem, statusem i informacją o płatności
• Szczegóły rezerwacji, edycja, anulowanie i dodawanie rezerwacji ręcznych
• Bilety klienta i lista uczestników terminu, także w PDF

KALENDARZ
• Przegląd miesiąca z zajętością każdego dnia
• Terminy dnia: liczba miejsc, blokowanie i odblokowywanie, notatki wewnętrzne
• Dodawanie nowych terminów do oferty

WEJŚCIA
• Skanowanie kodów QR z biletów aparatem telefonu
• Wpisanie kodu biletu ręcznie, gdy kod jest nieczytelny
• Lista dzisiejszych wejść

OFERTY I SPRZĘT
• Podgląd ofert i ich terminów
• Wypożyczenia sprzętu i blokady sprzętu

Każdy pracownik widzi tylko to, na co pozwala mu rola nadana przez właściciela firmy.

Do logowania potrzebne jest konto SlotWise założone przez firmę. Właściciel zaprasza pracowników do zespołu w panelu SlotWise.

name: Slow Country: Coloring Book
description:
Color cozy cottages, winding lanes, and vintage towns in your own colors. Slow Country is a coloring book for adults who enjoy detailed countryside scenes and coloring at their own pace.

Start with three free pages. Explore English villages and gardens, rustic farmhouses, British canals and seaside towns, vintage American Main Streets, and countryside railways.

MAKE IT YOUR COLORS
Pick a shade and tap to fill. Create a custom palette, zoom in to color small details, and undo or redo as you go.

COLLECT THE SCENES YOU LOVE
Choose from ten themed collections, each with 50 coloring pages. Collections are sold individually as one-time purchases. There are no subscriptions or ads.

COME BACK WHENEVER YOU LIKE
Save your progress on your device and return to your work in My Gallery. Export your pictures as PNG or JPEG to keep or share.

name: Small Writer Plus
description:
Small Writer Plus is a writing app for organizing a novel into chapters, keeping reference notes, and exporting the finished manuscript.

It builds on Small Writer's writing, automatic saving, search, and backup features, with additional tools for planning and publishing. Available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Manuscripts are saved on your device. No separate app account is required.

VERTICAL PDF AND MANUSCRIPT GRIDS
Choose A4, A5, or B5 paper, text size, margins, line spacing, a cover, and an author name. Preview before saving. Set characters per line and lines per page for a manuscript grid, with optional grid lines. Flowing vertical text supports explicit Japanese ruby notation and upright one- or two-digit numbers.
