EPUB AND WORD EXPORT
Export chapter headings and body text as EPUB3 with a table of contents, or as a Word-compatible DOCX file. Choose vertical or horizontal text, language, title, and author. Appearance and pagination depend on the reading or editing app.

EXCERPT IMAGES
Turn a passage into a 1080 x 1080 PNG. Choose vertical or horizontal text, a light or dark background, a title, and a pen name. Preview and save the result.

PLANNING NOTES
Keep characters and settings in reference cards and events in a timeline. Consult them beside the manuscript on wide screens. Link scene cards to chapters and track progress. Set work and daily targets, a deadline, and review daily net changes in manuscript length.

READING MODE
Read vertically or horizontally without editing the manuscript. Adjust text size, spacing, and background, turn pages, switch chapters, add bookmarks, and return to editing at the current passage.

OPTIONAL WORK LOCKS
Require OS-provided Touch ID, Face ID, a device passcode, or other accepted device authentication for individual works. Locked works hide their titles, manuscripts, notes, and search results until unlocked. This controls app access; it does not encrypt stored manuscripts or exported files.

MARKDOWN IMPORT AND EDITING
Import a UTF-8 .md file as a new work, edit its source text, and export the chapter as Markdown without directly changing the original file.

EVERYDAY WRITING
- Single-level chapters and character counts
- Plot, Ideas, and Notes
- Bookmarks and saved reading positions
- Search and replace across works
- Work duplication and TXT export
- Full-library backup and restore
- Japanese and English interfaces

Use your manuscript alongside reference notes on wide screens. Supported iPhone Duo and iPad layouts provide two independently selectable reference panes. On Mac, use the reference panel beside the manuscript.

The standard Small Writer app already includes the core writing and saving tools. Plus is a separate app for writers who also want planning tools and PDF, ebook, document, and image exports. Import a standard Small Writer backup to move your works to Plus. The two apps do not automatically share a library.

Check exported manuscripts against your destination's formatting requirements. PDF, EPUB, and DOCX export chapter headings and body text. Use TXT to include notes, and a dedicated backup to restore complete works.

name: Smart Stavba
description:
Smart Stavba je aplikace pro stavební firmy. Nahradí papírové výkazy, chaty a tabulky: pracovníci zapisují hodiny a práci přímo na stavbě, vedení vše vidí online a schvaluje jedním klepnutím.

DOCHÁZKA A HODINY
• Začátek a konec směny jedním tlačítkem
• Hodiny podle staveb, přestávky, poznámky
• Schvalování a měsíční přehledy pro mzdy
• Export do Excelu a Google Sheets

ÚKOLOVÁ MZDA (VÝKON)
• Pracovník zapíše, co udělal (m², ks, bm)
• Ceník prací, automatický výpočet výdělku
• Schválení vedoucím, přehled za měsíc

STAVEBNÍ DENÍK
• Denní záznamy s fotkami a počasím
• Úkoly pro pracovníky a jejich splnění

NÁŘADÍ, QR A NFC
• Každé nářadí má QR štítek nebo NFC tag
• Výdej a vrácení naskenováním
• Vždy víte, kdo má kterou vrtačku

MATERIÁL A SKLAD
• Objednávky materiálu přímo ze stavby
• Sklad, pohyby a zásoby na stavbách

DALŠÍ FUNKCE
• Firemní chat s fotkami a hlasovými zprávami
• Push oznámení o schválení a úkolech

Aplikace je určena pro firmy, které používají Smart Stavba. Účet pro pracovníky zakládá administrátor firmy. Novou firmu můžete zaregistrovat na smart-stavba.com.

name: SmartSafariAI - Web Copilot
description:
SmartSafariAI transforms your Safari browsing experience with instant, intelligent page analysis. Stop wasting time reading endless articles, confusing terms of service, or thousands of product reviews.

KEY FEATURES:
• TL;DR Executive Summary: Condense long articles, news, and documents into 4–5 sharp, actionable bullet points.
• Red Flag & Trap Detector: Automatically scan contracts, policies, and checkout pages to expose hidden fees, auto-renewal traps, and non-refundable clauses.
• Smart Review Verdict: Get an unbiased summary of product pros, cons, and a final buying verdict before you spend a dime.
• Ask Any Webpage: Ask specific questions about the open page and get instant answers based strictly on its content.
• Bilingual Intelligence: Seamlessly understands and responds in crisp English or natural Arabic.

HOW TO ACTIVATE:
1. Open iPhone Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions.
2. Enable SmartSafariAI and select "Allow All Websites".
3. Open any webpage in Safari, tap the Extensions icon in the address bar, and start exploring!

Start with 3 free AI analyses, then upgrade to SmartSafariAI Pro for unlimited access.

name: SMSCity - SMS Verification
description:
Receive SMS verification codes online, without putting your own SIM in the loop. SMSCity works like a temporary inbox for the one-time codes that apps and websites text you.

The flow is simple: pick a service and a country, wait for the code to land, tap once to copy it. Done.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Get a fresh code for a new sign-up in seconds
- See the incoming SMS the moment it arrives
- Copy any code with a single tap
- Choose numbers across many countries, with live stock

WHEN PEOPLE USE IT
- Trying out a new app before handing over a primary number
- Signing up for a service only offered in another region
- Keeping one-off sign-ups separate from everyday accounts

CREDITS AND IN-APP PURCHASES
SMSCity runs on credits. Each code request uses credits from your balance, so a purchase is required to receive verification codes. If no code arrives, the credits go back to your balance automatically. Purchased credits never expire.

Available in-app purchases (U.S. prices; prices in other regions may differ):
- 50 Credits: $4.99, one-time purchase
- 250 Credits: $24.99, one-time purchase
- Weekly Auto Refill: $4.99 per week, adds 50 credits every week
- Monthly Auto Refill: $24.99 per month, adds 250 credits every month

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.

name: Snail Trail: Zip Path Puzzle
description:
Draw one glowing trail. Reveal a hidden painting.

Snail Trail is a relaxing number path puzzle with a magical twist. Guide your little snail from 1 through every number in order, filling every square on the board. As your trail grows it uncovers a hidden picture, and when the last square lights up the whole painting blooms across the board.

HOW TO PLAY
• Start on 1 and drag through the numbers in order: 1, 2, 3…
• Your trail must fill every square on the board
• Walls block your way and rocks are skipped, so plan ahead
• Took a wrong turn? Drag back over your trail to undo

A NEW PICTURE EVERY DAY
• The Picture of the Day is the same puzzle for everyone
• Easy on Monday, expert by Sunday
• Build a daily streak, protect it with Streak Shields, and share your time with friends
• Daily pictures are only found in the daily puzzle. Collect all 30

200 LEVELS, 230 PAINTINGS
• A Journey through 10 glowing worlds: Night Garden, Moon Marsh, Crystal Cave, Ember Woods and more
• Every level hides its own hand-painted picture: owls, foxes, dragons, whales, lanterns and moonlit lakes
• Gentle breather levels and big boss boards keep it fresh
• Fill your albums and replay any picture you love

RELAX AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No lives and no game over
• Hints draw your trail to the next number when you're stuck
• Daily missions and a bonus chest for coins
• Unlock new trail and shell glows for your snail
• Soft sounds and haptics that rise as your trail grows
• Plays offline, no account needed

FREE TO PLAY
Snail Trail is free with optional ads between Journey levels. Today’s Picture of the Day never shows an ad. Remove Ads is a one-time purchase.

SNAIL PASS
Snail Pass is an optional monthly subscription with a 3-day free trial: no ads, 100 coins every day, a Streak Shield every week, and the Galaxy shell and trail. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial, if one applies). The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms: https://www.cognitolabs.io/snailtrail/terms
Privacy: https://www.cognitolabs.io/snailtrail/privacy

name: SnapClean: Swipe Photo Cleaner
description:
Make room in your photo library with SnapClean. Swipe through your photos, find similar shots, and review what you want to remove before confirming in Apple Photos.

• Sort your library one photo at a time, or focus on a month, screenshots, blurry shots, or large videos.
• Compare similar photos side by side, then review your selections in the Review Bin.
• Compress photos and videos. Compare the original and compressed image, then save a separate copy.
• Convert images to JPEG, PNG, or HEIC. Remove EXIF metadata, combine images into a PDF, add a watermark, crop or rotate, and extract text from an image.

Media processing takes place on your device. Use the Photos access you prefer, or choose individual items in the Toolbox. No app account is needed.

name: Sneha Graphics & Solutions
description:
Welcome to Sneha Graphics & Solutions — your trusted partner in industrial printing, packaging, and finishing machinery.

Sneha Graphics & Solutions provides complete machinery solutions and high-precision equipment for printing presses, commercial printers, rigid box manufacturers, and packaging industries.

Key Features & Offerings:
• Machinery Catalog: Browse a wide range of Automatic & Semi-Automatic Die Cutting Machines, Thermal & Water-based Film Lamination Machines, Folder Gluers, and Rigid Box Makers.

name: Snooze by The Sleep Concierge
description:
Snooze brings your baby and toddler sleep support into one app.

Open your Snooze Library to watch your courses and guides wherever you are, pick up where you left off and mark lessons complete as you go. Join the conversation in Snooze Village, where parents share what is working and get answers from the Snooze team.

Snooze was created by Sally, The Sleep Concierge, internationally certified sleep consultant and former paediatric nurse. Sally has helped thousands of families find calmer nights.

Log in with the email you already use for Snooze. Need a hand? Tap Help to contact the Snooze team.

name: Snowrush: Avalanche Escape
description:
Snowrush is a winter arcade game in the spirit of the classic downhill ski games. Your skier races down an endless slope while an avalanche rolls in behind. Slow down and it catches you.

ONE-FINGER CONTROLS
Drag left and right — the skier follows your finger. Dodge trees, rocks, snowmen and fences on the fly while the speed keeps climbing.

THE SLOPE CHANGES EVERY 20 SECONDS
• Deep Forest — walls of trees with a single gap.
• Ice — slippery patches that make you slide.
• Slalom — narrow gates; miss one and the avalanche gains.
• Night — you only see what is close.
• Blizzard — the slope comes out of the white.
• Snowballs — they roll on their own, so watch them.
Every stage is faster, and the avalanche stays closer and sometimes surges.

HOW TO STAY AHEAD
• Gates in a row multiply your points up to ×5 and give a quick boost.
• Brush past an obstacle for a risk bonus.
• Hit a ramp to fly over a fence.
• Cocoa gives a burst of speed.

SNOWRUSH PLUS
The game is free to play with no limits. A one-time Snowrush Plus purchase adds a second chance in every run and 10 characters with their own abilities: the snowboarder jumps further, Santa pulls in snowflakes from afar, the penguin never skids on ice, the robot has a shield and the polar bear smashes snowmen.

FAIR
• No ads, no subscriptions, no in-game currency.
• Works offline.
• Sound and haptics answer everything on the slope.

The game collects no data.

name: Snupi - Frame it. Learn it.
description:
Snupi teaches you to see a good photo before you press the shutter.

Take a shot, and the AI mentor tells you what works, what gets in the way and what to change. Then retake it and watch the photo get better.

A REVIEW OF YOUR SHOT
• A composition score and clear advice about your photo
• Notes right on the picture: where to move the subject, what to crop, how to level the horizon
• Crop and straighten the photo on the spot and save the result

A CAMERA THAT HELPS
• 14 composition grids: thirds, golden ratio, spiral, diagonals, triangles and more
• Live tips while you frame: subject, horizon, symmetry, balance and empty space
• Focus and exposure with a touch

SHORT LESSONS
• 14 composition lessons with examples and practice
• Articles on why each technique works, the common mistakes and when to break the rule
• A new daily challenge to keep you shooting

CHALLENGES
• Same scene, better shot: retake a photo and compare before and after
• One scene, five ways: shoot one thing in five completely different ways
• Personal mistakes: the mentor finds what repeats in your photos and gives you exercises for it

PROGRESS AND FEED
• XP, 10 ranks and a streak
• All your shots and reviews in one place
• Share your best shots, like and comment

FREE
The camera with three grids, the daily challenge task, the feed, your shots, your progress and one AI review.

SNUPI PRO
• Weekly: 10 AI reviews a week
• Monthly and yearly: 40 AI reviews a month
• Every plan opens all lessons, articles, grids, live camera tips, challenges and personal mistakes

Photos in lessons and daily challenges, challenges and personal mistakes use the same AI reviews.

Reviews are written by an AI service (Claude by Anthropic): the photo you choose to review is sent to it. AI can be wrong, so treat its advice as a mentor’s opinion.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The payment is charged to your Apple Account. The price for your country is shown before you buy. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sóc Nhỏ English
description:
Sóc Nhỏ English giúp học sinh tiểu học Việt Nam, từ lớp 1 đến lớp 5, học tiếng Anh mỗi ngày một ít.

MỖI NGÀY MỘT NHIỆM VỤ NGẮN
• Con mở ứng dụng và bấm một nút để bắt đầu nhiệm vụ của ngày.
• Mỗi nhiệm vụ có điểm kết thúc. Không có dòng nội dung cuộn mãi.
• Con nghe, chọn hình, ghép câu, đọc truyện ngắn, viết và nói.

ỨNG DỤNG NHỚ CON ĐÃ NẮM ĐƯỢC GÌ
• Xong một bài chưa có nghĩa là đã thuộc. Sóc Nhỏ hỏi lại vào những ngày sau, để con nhớ lâu.
• Bài hôm nay được chọn theo những gì con đã làm được và những gì cần ôn.
• Có góc phát âm, góc truyện, sổ từ có hình và câu ví dụ, và phần "Thử lại câu khó".

BỐ MẸ THEO DÕI ĐƯỢC
• Khu vực phụ huynh cho biết con đang học gì và tiến bộ ra sao, kèm báo cáo mỗi tuần.
• Gợi ý vài câu để bố mẹ luyện cùng con trong ba phút.
• Bố mẹ đặt mục tiêu số ngày học mỗi tuần và bật lời nhắc giờ học.

AN TOÀN CHO TRẺ
• Không quảng cáo.
• Không trò chuyện với người lạ, không tin nhắn giữa các trẻ, không bảng xếp hạng.
• Phần hội thoại do người soạn bài viết sẵn. Không có AI trò chuyện tự do với con.
• Tài khoản do bố mẹ lập và quản lý. Con không có tài khoản riêng.

QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ
• Ứng dụng chỉ cần biệt danh và khối lớp của con. Không hỏi tên thật, trường học hay địa chỉ.
• Khi con luyện nói, đoạn ghi âm được gửi đi chấm phát âm rồi bỏ. Ứng dụng không lưu giọng nói của con.
• Micrô chỉ bật khi con bấm nút nói. Không có micrô, con vẫn học được.
• Bố mẹ xin xoá tài khoản hoặc dữ liệu ngay trong Cài đặt.

MIỄN PHÍ, ĐANG HOÀN THIỆN
Sóc Nhỏ English miễn phí và vẫn đang được làm tốt hơn mỗi tuần. Bố mẹ có góp ý thì gửi ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Softwrench
description:
Softwrench brings maintenance work to the phone: work orders, assets, inspections and service requests, live from your team's Softwrench workspace.

WORK ORDERS
• Assigned work for you and your groups, with status, priority and due dates
• Move each work order through its workflow steps
• Track labor with a running timer, record materials and complete tasks
• Add notes, photos, videos and files from the camera or the gallery
• See assignments, history and e-mail communication in one place

CHECKLISTS AND INSPECTIONS
• Complete checklists and inspection forms, with readings, photos and signatures
• Scan QR codes and barcodes on assets and equipment

ASSETS AND LOCATIONS
• Asset and location details, open work and maintenance history
• Sort sites by distance and see them on a map
• Preventive maintenance schedules and job plans

SERVICE REQUESTS AND LOGS
• Create and follow service requests
• Record operator logs

NOTIFICATIONS
• Push notifications for new assignments, approvals and changes to your work

SECURE ACCESS
• Single sign-on with your company account, or a password with two-step verification
• Each person sees the records their role allows

LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Arabic.

Softwrench requires an account from a company that uses Softwrench. Available features depend on how each company has set up its workspace.

name: Soilmates: Plants With Faces
description:
Snap a photo of a houseplant, drag a face onto its pot, and it becomes a character. Name it, pick a personality, and tell Soilmates how often it needs water.

Your plants talk back. A thirsty plant gets grumpy. Water it on time and it cheers up, earns XP, levels up and keeps a streak going.

WATER WITH PHOTO PROOF
Take a photo of the soil before and after watering. Soilmates checks that the soil got darker and gives you bonus XP.

GROWTH TIMELAPSE
Take a growth photo every few days. The camera shows a faint copy of the last shot so every photo lines up. Play them back and watch a seedling grow.

REMINDERS
A nudge the morning a plant is due for water.

SHARE
Send a card with your plant, its mood and its level to anyone.

Free for up to 3 plants. One purchase unlocks unlimited plants for good. No subscription, no account, no ads. Your photos stay on your phone.

name: Sokko: Calendar Alarm Clock
description:
Your calendar, as real alarms.

A calendar notification is a banner you can swipe away without deciding anything. An alarm is not. That difference is why meetings you fully intended to attend still pass without you.

Sokko turns the meetings you choose into true system alarms — the kind that sound through Silent mode, through every Focus, and keep ringing whether or not the app is open.

HOW IT WORKS
• Reads the calendars already set up on your iPhone — iCloud, Google, Exchange, Outlook
• Every meeting arms itself, at that meeting's own reminder time
• Silence what you don't want: one occurrence, a whole series, or an entire calendar
• Declined invitations stay quiet automatically

BUILT SO IT CANNOT FAIL QUIETLY
• If a meeting reaches your phone after its reminder time has passed, Sokko rings at the meeting's start rather than not at all
• If it genuinely cannot ring, it says so in red — never a switch implying you're covered
• Every past alarm carries a verdict from the system itself: fired, or stuck

WHEN YOU'RE RUNNING LATE
• Once a meeting starts and you haven't arrived, the app turns red and counts up
• A widget and Live Activity count down on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island

PUNCTUALITY, WITHOUT LOGGING ANYTHING
• Notices when you join and builds an honest picture: how often you're on time, your average delay, which recurring meeting slips most

NO MARKETING NOTIFICATIONS. EVER.
Sokko will never send a marketing notification, an announcement, or a re-engagement nudge. Everything it sounds is about one of your own meetings: the alarm you armed and, if you keep it on, a quiet heads-up before it. That's permanent, not a setting.

PRIVACY
No account. No server. Nothing about you is sent to us, because there's nowhere to send it. No analytics, no advertising, no trackers, no third-party SDKs. The one network connection the app can make is optional, switched on by you, read-only, and goes straight to Google.

Requires iPhone on iOS 26.1 or later.

name: Sola: Travel Companions
description:
Sola helps you find travel people who match the plan, not just the destination.

Compare budget, pace, and sleep habits before you book. Browse trips looking for companions, see who is already in, and talk through expectations before flights are bought. When you are ready, post your own trip with the destination, dates, budget, and travel style.

PLAN THE TRIP
Search trips by place and style — Europe, Asia, hiking, weekend, rail. Open a trip to see the route, the cost, and the people already joined.

TALK BEFORE YOU BOOK
Every trip has a conversation. Ask about early starts, long lunches, and one good meal a day before you commit.

POST A TRIP
Share your destination, dates, budget, and pace. Your trip appears at the top of the list for other travelers.

YOUR DEVICE, YOUR DATA
Sola 1.0 is local-first. Your account, profile, trips, chats, reports, and blocks stay on your iPhone. There is no Sola social backend, no advertising, no analytics, and no in-app purchases. Sign in with Apple is handled by Apple.

ABOUT THIS BUILD
The trips and people included in 1.0 are sample content. This version does not connect to a live social network or deliver messages to another person.

Sola is for adults 17 and over. Sola does not run background checks or guarantee who you meet.Meet in public places, tell someone your plans, and trust your judgment.

name: Solar Return
description:
Solar Return is a diary for your home solar station. Type in what your inverter produced and the app compares it with the output your panels should have delivered under a clear sky, calculated from panel tilt, orientation and capacity. You mark the weather yourself, so there is no account to create, everything stays on your device. 

When production slips, Solar Return explains why. It spots a run of weak sunny days and ranks the possible causes by confidence, with the evidence shown for each: dirt on the panels, shading, a panel or string fault, an inverter problem, snow, clipping or normal ageing. Log panel cleanings with before-and-after photos and see how many kilowatt-hours each wash brought back. Keep a record of inverter error codes and shade sources, and see them on a sun path diagram of your roof. 

The app also tracks what your station earns. It adds up feed-in income and savings from the power you use yourself, follows changing tariffs, and forecasts the month your system pays for itself. A built-in planner shows the best time of day to run the washing machine, dishwasher, water heater, dryer or EV charger, so more of that energy comes straight from your roof. Reminders help you log readings and remind you when it is time to clean.

name: Solitaire Pairs: Raja
description:
Step into an illustrated palace and see how many moves it takes to find every pair. Solitaire Pairs: Raja is a single-player memory game where you turn over two playing cards at a time. Two queens of hearts make a pair and stay face up. A queen of hearts and a queen of spades turn face down again after a short pause. Remember where you saw each card to make your next move count.

CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY
Start with 6 pairs on Easy, try 8 on Normal, or take on 12 on Hard. The timer starts when you flip the first card, and the board shows your time, moves, and matched pairs as you play.

TRY THE DAILY CHALLENGE
Solve an 8-pair board based on the day's date. Your progress is saved on your device, so you can pick up the same challenge later that day.

REVISIT YOUR RESULTS

name: SOME Islam
description:
SOME Islam
Islam, explained — its story, its book, its branches.

A map, not a pulpit. SOME Islam explains Islam the way a good atlas explains a country: what is there, who holds what, and where the borders are argued about — with every claim labeled with whose claim it is.

Most explainers quietly adopt one tradition's voice and teach it as the whole. This one doesn't. Every card in SOME Islam is printed in one of three labeled bands:

• THE TEXTS SAY — the narrative as the Qur'an and the hadith and sira literature present it. The label names the source; the app adds nothing.
• HISTORIANS GENERALLY HOLD — points of broad scholarly consensus, stated with the consensus's strength, including where scholars disagree.
• THE FAITH PROCLAIMS — claims held as faith, printed at full strength in the traditions' own terms — neither endorsed nor reduced by the app's voice.

There is no fourth band. The app has no voice with which to add one. Where a card is pure mechanics — a date, a count, a book's shape — it carries the label THE RECORD, and its numbers carry their sources.

INSIDE — 58 cards on 10 shelves:

• The Story — from the Hijaz before Islam to the present map of some 2.0 billion people (Pew Research Center, June 2025).
• The Book — what the Qur'an is physically, how it is arranged and kept, why every quotation in this app names its translator — plus a searchable explorer of all 114 surahs: name, meaning, Meccan or Medinan as the tradition assigns it, verse counts.
• The Split — the beginner's first question, answered mechanics-first: the split started with a succession, not a scripture. Sunni, Shia, and Ibadi; the madhhabs; why there is no Muslim pope.
• The Hard Cards — the communities the map refuses to verdict, including the Nation of Islam and the Ahmadiyya, each printed in three layers: the community's self-understanding, attributed; other traditions' positions, attributed; and no third layer. There is no app verdict to find, because the app does not keep one.
• The Characters — the people of the story, told in text only. The traditions' aniconism means there are no faces to draw, and the app draws none — here or anywhere.
• The Tenets As Held — each tenet printed as the branches hold it, side by side.
• Black Muslim History — at full rank: Bilal ibn Rabah, the enslaved Muslims who wrote their lives in Arabic on American soil, Malcolm X, the Moorish Science Temple, and today's demographics.
• What It's Not — the standard conflations (Islam / Muslim / Arab; what "Allah" means; jihad and sharia as attributed literacy), corrected with their receipts.
• The Seeker's Path — where the traditions themselves tell a beginner to start reading, what a mosque visit looks like, Ramadan from inside the day. Orientation only: this app walks nobody down an aisle.
• The Honest Ledger — history straight, every actor's claims attributed to the actor. No graphics, no editorial heat.

THE MAP — a 12-node timeline from 610 to today. Every node opens its card, and the American nodes stand on the same tree, at the same rank, as 680.

THE CODE — the app's constitution is printed inside the app, where any reader can hold it to account: the Attribution Law, the three bands, no persona (no simulated religious figure, no rulings issued as from an office), no adjudication, the Image Rule, quotation discipline (every Qur'an quotation names its translator; hadith carry the grades their own traditions' scholarship assigns), and the money refusals.

PRIVACY, BY CONSTRUCTION: no account, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads, no tracking, no network calls. Your saved cards live only on your device and erase in one tap. An explainer of a faith should know nothing about its readers — this one knows nothing.

Free, complete, and offline. SOME Islam is an educational reference work from Reginal Polk Technologies. It is not a devotional app, a prayer utility, or a Qur'an reader, and it is not affiliated with any mosque, movement, or religious body.

name: SOME Jesus
description:
Christianity, explained — its story, its book, its people.

SOME Jesus is a map, not a voice. It explains Christianity for the first-time reader — how it started, the books, the characters, what happened — in plain language, with every claim labeled by who holds it: the texts, a tradition, or the scholars. It is not a church, a ministry, or a devotional — and not an argument against the faith either. Its claims are printed at full strength, in the faith's own attributed words.

THE NAME
The name is a sentence the culture already says. In Black church tradition, and in Black vernacular far beyond it, people say "you need some Jesus" — said with warmth and pleasurable acceptance when somebody needs to get their mind right. The app quotes it; it never points it at you. Your interpretation is your interpretation.

HOW TO READ THIS APP: THE THREE BANDS
Every story is told in three labeled voices — and no fourth band: the app has no voice of its own to add one.
• THE TEXTS SAY — the narrative as the texts present it.
• HISTORIANS GENERALLY HOLD — what historians of the period broadly agree on, labeled with its strength.
• THE FAITH PROCLAIMS — the traditions' own claims at full strength — neither endorsed nor explained away by the app.

THE STORY
Eight chapters: the world he was born into; the two beginnings, which Matthew and Luke tell differently; baptism, teaching, and the parables; the road to Jerusalem and the cross; the resurrection, in all three bands side by side; Paul and the first generation; the first "who is in" fight; what happened next.

THE BOOK
The Bible is a library, not a book — and the traditions bind different libraries. All 66 Protestant-canon books in seven groups, each with a content line and an authorship note — disputed authorships printed as debates; the nine-book deuterocanonical shelf other traditions bind in; canon formation; the manuscripts; the translations.

THE CHARACTERS
Fourteen cards, Abraham to Thomas, as the texts present them. Hebrew Bible figures carry dual readings — Jewish and Christian — each attributed to its own tradition.

THE CREEDS
The Apostles' Creed and the Nicene Creed, printed in full — with the filioque, the disputed word, printed and attributed, never settled by the app.

THE MAP OF DISPUTES
Seven live arguments, every side attributed, no verdict: the Trinity — and who gets counted; baptism; communion; faith and works; Scripture and tradition; salvation and judgment; the end times.

THE FAMILY TREE
Ten nodes, first generation to today: the Temple destroyed; legal, then established; the Great Schism of 1054; the Reformation from 1517; the Radical Reformation; England's break; the AME Church organized in 1816, at full rank; Azusa Street, 1906 — and today's global-south center, in the demographers' counts.

THE SEEKER'S PATH
Thinking of walking in? Where the traditions say to start, six service walkthroughs with per-tradition communion etiquette, a ten-word vocabulary wall, and five newcomer questions. No church finder, no funnel: the path informs, and routes you nowhere.

THE HONEST LEDGER
The history, straight, in both columns: nine documented, attributed entries — the Fourth Crusade, the slavery-era Bible fights, the rise of the "nones," and the rest of the record.

THE CODE
The app's written constitution: the Attribution Law; Fence One — no persona (no one to talk to in this app: no chat, no AI Jesus, no pastor, no confessor); Fence Two — no adjudication (no grading denominations, no certifying who is truly Christian); the no-funnel rule; and the refused-money list — no donations or tithing mechanics, no paid prayer, no paid prophecy, no sale of seeker data.

FREE
SOME Jesus is free. No in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no accounts, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Bookmarks live only on your device. It collects no data at all and works fully offline.

description:
SOME Moorish Science is the newcomer's explainer of the Moorish Science Temple movement — its story, its teachings, its people. A map, not a temple.

"A name is the first thing they took — so a name is where he started." That is how the movement's own tradition tells its founding: Noble Drew Ali, who taught that a people misnamed could be made whole by being named again. This app explains the whole movement he founded — and it explains it the way a good atlas explains a country: what is there, who holds what, and where the borders are argued about, with every claim labeled with whose claim it is.

THE MAP
• The Founder — the biography in two bands: the faith's account and the documentary record, side by side, unsmoothed
• The Teachings — the nationality doctrine, the restored name, and the civic teaching, in the movement's own terms
• The Book — the Circle Seven Koran: what it is, what it contains, and what scholarship has documented about its composition, with the movement's answer printed beside it
• The Symbols — the five principles, the nationality card as an explained artifact, the flag, the fez
• The Bodies Today — the movement's present landscape, each body by its own published name
• The Map of Disputes — the 1929 succession and the classification question: every side printed, none resolved
• What It's Not — what the Temple itself says about the "Moorish sovereign" fringe, and what courts have held about those claims
• The Footprint — the Nation of Islam's lineage, El Rukn, the Moorish Orthodox Church, and the movement's place in American religious history
• The Seeker's Path — where the movement's own texts tell a beginner to start
• The Honest Ledger — what the record cannot show, including what this app holds back

HOW IT WORKS
Every claim carries its band: THE TEXTS SAY, HISTORIANS GENERALLY HOLD, THE FAITH PROCLAIMS, or THE RECORD. Disputed questions print in layers — each side attributed — and the app keeps no verdict. The full constitution is printed inside the app, where any reader can hold it to its word.

name: SoundProof: Decibel Meter
description:
Is the neighbor's renovation really that loud, or is it just you? Open the meter and see the answer in decibels, with a color zone and a familiar comparison like "a library" or "a vacuum cleaner". Then save it, so the numbers back you up later.

The meter shows the current level on a large scale, a graph of the last 30 seconds, plus the average, the peak and the quietest moment. Zones run from quiet and moderate to loud, very loud and harmful.

Record a measurement, pause it, resume it, and save it with a name, a place and a note. Need proof? Take a photo of the room or the source of the noise, and the sound level, date and time are stamped right onto the image. You can also attach a picture from your gallery.

Every measurement goes into a diary sorted by day. Search, filter by place, sort, and pin the entries that matter. Each one keeps its graph, the share of time spent in each loudness zone, your notes and photos. Edit or delete anything.

Compare days over 7, 14 or 30 days and see how things changed against the previous period. Rank your places from loudest to quietest, or put two measurements side by side with a plain explanation of how noticeable the difference really is.

Export a report with graphs and photos for a single measurement, a summary report for a period, or tables of readings that open in any spreadsheet editor. Easy to show or forward to someone.

Create your own list of rooms and spots with icons and colors. In settings, choose a mode closer to how the human ear hears or one without corrections, set the response speed, add a loudness threshold with a warning, adjust readings against a reference device, and read a short guide to the decibel scale.

For anyone dealing with a noisy home, a busy street under the window or a loud open office.

Everything a sourdough baker keeps in their head, kept in one place.

YOUR STARTER IN ITS JAR
Give it a name. The jar on the screen shows how it is doing: rising after a feeding, at its best, past it, or hungry. The app tells you how long ago it was fed, when the next feeding is due, and about how many hours after a feeding it is usually at its highest in a kitchen as warm as yours. A reminder when a feeding is due, if you want one.

FEEDING, WITH THE AMOUNTS
One part starter, two parts flour, two parts water, or whatever your ratio is: the grams are worked out. Baking tomorrow? Say how much starter the dough needs, and the app says how much to feed so that there is enough for the dough and some left to keep.

THE DOUGH CALCULATOR
Say how many loaves and how heavy, how much water, starter and salt in per cent of the flour, and read off what to weigh: flour, water, starter, salt. The flour and water inside the starter are counted, so the hydration is the dough's true hydration. Add oil, sugar or seeds. For pizza, count in dough balls, with starter or with dry yeast.

TWELVE DOUGHS TO START FROM
A country loaf, a first loaf, whole wheat, rye, a sandwich loaf, focaccia, baguettes, bagels, and four kinds of pizza dough. Change one and keep it as your own.

FREE
One starter with all its feedings and its reminder, the calculator, the twelve doughs, two recipes of your own, and three pages in the journal.

SOURDOUGH PRO: THE BAKE PLAN
Say when the bread should be ready to cut. The plan works back from there: feed the levain, mix, first rise with folds, shape, prove, heat the oven, bake, cool, each with its hour. Choose a warm or a cool kitchen, a levain fed the evening before, a night in the fridge. A reminder at the start of every step.

SOURDOUGH PRO: THE JOURNAL
A page for every bake: a photo, the dough it was made from, stars, and your notes on crumb and crust.

SOURDOUGH PRO: MORE OF EVERYTHING
As many starters and as many recipes of your own as you keep.

HONEST ABOUT TIME
Rising times in the app are a guide. Flour, starter and kitchen all differ: watch the dough, not the clock.

PRIVATE
No account. Your starters, recipes, notes and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: Sovely
description:
It’s 3:14 AM. You’re operating on four broken hours of sleep and one free thumb. The last thing you need is a blinding white app asking you to create an account, verify your email, and sign up for an expensive yearly subscription—just to log a 27-minute nap.

Meet Sovely. A calm, dead-simple, 100% offline baby sleep tracker built for tired eyes, dark rooms, and parents who refuse to rent a glorified timer for the next two years.

Pay once. Own it forever. No subscriptions, no accounts, no ads, and no tracking. Just you, your baby’s rhythm, and a little more peace of mind.

WHY PARENTS SWITCH TO SOVELY

• Actually Dark at 3 AM
Designed on pure #000000 OLED black with warm amber accents so checking the timer won’t light up the nursery like an interrogation room. Includes automatic Star Mode (22:00–06:00) and a high-contrast colorblind mode.

• One-Thumb, Zero-Fuss Logging
Press and hold the sleeping moon to start or end sleep—with gentle haptic feedback so you know it registered without even looking closely. Baby stirred for two minutes and drifted right back off? Tap Pause and Resume without ruining the nap log.

• Learns Your Baby’s Rhythm
No rigid schedules or guilt-tripping "sleep coaching." The more daytime naps and nights you log, the better Sovely calibrates to your baby’s unique patterns—giving you calm, realistic estimates for the next nap window and expected wake-up time.

• Built-In Warm Nightlight
Tap the moon icon to turn your screen into a soft, warm nightlight for midnight feeds, pacifier hunts, or stealthy room checks.

• Native iOS: Dynamic Island, Lock Screen & StandBy
Watch the sleep timer tick live on your Dynamic Island and Lock Screen without unlocking your phone. Dock your iPhone in StandBy mode for a cozy bedside display, or start and end naps straight from the interactive Home Screen widget.

• Calm, Anti-Spam Reminders
Get a gentle heads-up before the next nap window (15, 20, or 30 minutes ahead), a sleep-time nudge, and a lifesaving "forgot to stop the timer" guard—with quiet hours built in so your phone stays silent overnight.

• Private Partner Handover—Zero Cloud Required
Switching shifts with your partner, grandparents, or babysitter? Sync sleep history privately in seconds by scanning a local QR code or sending a file via AirDrop. No accounts, no servers, no one else’s cloud.

• Clear Patterns & Pediatrician-Ready PDFs
Spot trends in daytime naps, night sleep, and total rest at a glance—and export a clean PDF summary whenever you want to bring your log to a check-up.

• Built for Real Families
Track multiple children effortlessly, back up your entire history locally anytime, and use Sovely in 9 languages: English, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean.

YOUR BABY’S DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Sovely works 100% offline. Everything is stored exclusively on your device. We don’t have a server, we don’t want your email, and we certainly don’t think exhausted parents should be locked into recurring subscriptions.

Sleep tracking, minus the nonsense. Welcome to Sovely.

name: Sparkle Squish
description:
Sparkle Squish is the squishy toy you design yourself!

Pick a shape, choose colors and glitter, paint your own patterns, and give your squishy a face. Add tails, horns, antennas, arms and even cool glasses. Then squeeze, stretch and spin it in 3D and feel it wobble, bounce and squish back.

Make it yours

Design squishies in all kinds of shapes, colors, textures and faces
Paint on your toy with a brush and watch the pattern wrap all the way around
Unlock new parts and styles as you level up
Squish, tilt and shake it, with soft sounds and gentle haptics

Meet the Squish Pals
You're never playing alone. 100 friendly Squish Pals make their own squishies, share their creations and trade swaps with you. Join auctions, race to the finish, and build a collection you're proud of.

Show it off
Save a picture of your squishy on a colorful background or in a scene like the beach, forest, space or a snowy hill. Pictures never show names.

Made for families

No accounts and no sign-up
No ads and no tracking
Nothing is collected, and everything stays on your device
Picture saving is protected by a grown-up check

Sparkle Squish works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later. The Squish Pals are made-up characters, and all trading and auctions are just for fun, with no real money.

name: Speechless: Voice Keyboard
description:
Speechless is a voice keyboard. Hold the pad, talk, let go, and what you said is in the text field, in whatever app you're using, without leaving it.

It provides the keyboard, not the AI. You add your own AI service with your own API key and choose the models. The service bills you directly; Speechless is free, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases.

TALK
• Hold to talk, or tap to start and tap to stop
• Slide up while holding: left cancels, right sends (where the field has a Send, Search or Go key)
• Mix Chinese and English in one sentence
• Undo the last sentence, or say it again

CLEAN TEXT
• Filler words and false starts removed, punctuation added
• Optionally, a second model hears the same recording, so a word one of them misheard can be caught
• Add names and products to your dictionary

THE KEYS YOU STILL NEED
• Punctuation, space, delete, return or send
• Hold space to move the cursor
• An ABC keyboard with numbers and symbols is one tap away. It works offline and without Full Access

YOUR SERVICE, YOUR MODELS
• OpenRouter is the default
• Or use OpenAI, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen), Volcengine Ark (Doubao), SiliconFlow, or another service with OpenAI-compatible endpoints
• Pick one model for recognition and one for cleanup; each is tried once so you know it works

PRIVACY
• Nothing is sent before you agree, per service, and you can withdraw at any time
• Recording happens only while you dictate, with the system's microphone indicator on
• With OpenRouter, every request asks for zero data retention and no training. Other services handle data under their own terms, and the app says so before you agree
• The developer has no server and receives nothing. No analytics, no tracking
• What you type on the ABC keyboard is never stored or sent
• Keys stay in the iOS Keychain

GOOD TO KNOW
• Voice needs an internet connection, microphone permission and "Allow Full Access", which is what gives a keyboard the network and the microphone on iOS
• In some apps Send is the app's own button, which a keyboard can't press; there the key says Return
• Recognition isn't perfect; check what matters

Speechless is made by an independent developer and is not affiliated with any AI service it can be used with. Product names are trademarks of their owners.

name: Splicra
description:
**Inspect every frame. Preserve every detail. Keep film history alive.**

Splicra is a professional film inspection and maintenance app designed for analog film enthusiasts, collectors, projectionists, and film preservation specialists.

From organizing physical film reels and documenting frame damage to planning splices and tracking projection sessions, Splicra brings essential film inspection tools together in one intuitive iOS workspace.

### Film Reel Management

Create detailed profiles for 8mm, Super 8, and 16mm film reels. Organize film formats, lengths, frame references, storage locations, and physical condition records.

### Frame & Perforation Inspection

Inspect film frames using an interactive filmstrip editor. Mark scratches, damaged perforations, dirt, and other visible issues. Record affected frame ranges, attach reference images, and maintain inspection histories.

### Splice Planning & Repair

Plan film splices with visual alignment tools. Record joining positions, trimmed frames, splice methods, and repair materials. Document completed repairs and track changes to film segment sequences.

### Projection Run Tracking

Organize projection sessions with timers, frame position estimates, and event records. Log film jitter, scratches, stops, and other observations during screenings.

### Film History & Reports

Maintain a searchable history of inspections, damage records, splices, and projection sessions. Compare before-and-after conditions, trace frame positions, and export detailed reports.

### Key Features

- 8mm, Super 8, and 16mm reel management
- Interactive filmstrip inspection
- Frame and perforation damage mapping
- Scratch and defect annotations
- Frame range and position tracking
- Visual splice alignment planning
- Trimmed frame and repair records
- Film segment history and version tracking
- Projection timers and event logging
- Before-and-after repair comparisons
- Film condition history and PDF reports
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Analog Film Care

Splicra combines practical film inspection, precise recordkeeping, and organized repair workflows to help you document and manage physical film collections.

Whether you're inspecting a vintage film reel, recording damaged frames, planning a splice, or reviewing projection history, Splicra keeps every detail organized and traceable.

Inspection and repair results are based on user-recorded observations. Splicra does not automatically scan physical film, control projectors, or certify film condition.

**Inspect. Repair. Prepare. Preserve.**

name: SplitPunch: Orienteering
description:
Record split times on a marked orienteering practice course. Enter your ordered control codes and start the timer. At each control, tap the displayed code to record the split. A finish screen shows each leg, cumulative time, and the change from your last run on the same course.

Keep multiple courses and runs on your device. Open the included example to see the comparison, undo an accidental punch, or share a run as CSV. Timing continues if you switch apps or lock your screen.

SplitPunch works offline and does not use GPS or verify that a control was visited. It is for personal training and small club practice, not official race results.

name: Spoggle
description:
Spoggle is your daily 5 minute brain workout. Every day you get a fresh set of quick puzzles: a Word Guess plus four rotating games covering words, maths, memory and logic.

Today's Workout: done in about five minutes
Build a daily streak and share your score with friends
Over a dozen games, including Word Guess, Quick Maths, Memory, Link Up, Pipe Flow, Untangle, 2048, Block Fit, Unscrew and more

name: Spotlight: Music Discovery
description:
Spotlight finds one artist or song you'd never reach by scrolling, and tells you why it's worth your time.

Tap the Aura. Color swirls, the light lands, and someone new steps out: a short preview to hear straight away, and the reason they were picked. Never a made-up one. If it was random, it says so.

DISCOVER, YOUR WAY
• For You starts from the genres you like and stays close to them.
• Explore steps just outside them, into the neighbors.
• Random goes anywhere in the catalog.
• Filter by genre, country, era or scene, and choose how known: emerging, established or anything in between.

FOLLOW THE THREAD
Every find is a doorway. Go into the artist's story, their genres, their city's scene and their era, and on to whoever comes next.

DRIFT
A song at a time, each one step from the last. Lock it to a genre or a whole family and see where it goes.

THE CRATE
Ten records every Friday, picked around your taste with a couple of wildcards. Pull one out, put it on, listen.

YOUR MAP
Every genre laid out like a city. Watch the places you've been light up as you listen further out.

BUILT FOR THE OVERLOOKED
78,000 artists, 393 genres, 162 scenes, from Lagos to Seoul to Buenos Aires. Emerging artists are part of every search, and no one can pay to be picked.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no account needed. Your taste and history stay on your iPhone, and in your own iCloud if you sign in with Apple to sync.

Previews provided courtesy of Apple Music. Full songs open in Apple Music.

name: SpotMaker
description:
Circling the block while a car sits three feet too far from the curb cut? SpotMaker fixes that.

When a parked car is just a few feet from leaving room for one more, enter its plate (or scan it with your camera) and send its driver a polite, anonymous request to pull forward or back up. They never give up their spot. They just make room for yours.

HOW IT WORKS
• Spot the gap: a car is parked a few feet too far forward or back.
• Send a nudge: enter or scan the plate, pick a direction and distance.
• They shift, you park: the driver gets a notification and replies with one tap.

ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN
No names, emails, or phone numbers are ever shared. Messages are friendly presets only, with no free-text chat, so every nudge stays polite.

BE A GOOD NEIGHBOR
Earn points every time you shift to help someone park, and climb from Rookie to Parking Legend.

Free to join. Sign up with your email and license plate.

Only send requests when parked or as a passenger. Never use SpotMaker while driving.

name: SpotRide
description:
SpotRide is your all-in-one transportation and delivery platform designed to get you moving conveniently and safely. Whether you need a quick ride across town, a rental vehicle for the day, a pre-scheduled trip, or reliable package delivery, SpotRide connects you with verified drivers in minutes.

• Instant Ride Booking: Get picked up quickly by nearby drivers with upfront, transparent pricing.

• Scheduled Rides: Plan ahead by scheduling trips for early morning flights, meetings, or events.

• Real-Time GPS Tracking: Track your driver or courier live on the map from pickup to dropoff.

name: SpotRide Driver
description:
SpotRide Driver is the official partner app for professional drivers and courier riders looking to earn reliable income on their own terms. Drive passengers, deliver packages, or provide rental services across town with complete flexibility and transparent payouts.

WHY DRIVE WITH SPOTRIDE?
• Instant Trip Requests: Receive nearby passenger ride and package courier delivery requests directly on your screen.

name: Stake Bed
description:
Stake Bed is for a gardener at an open bed. Write the bed, the length and width in feet, and the depth in inches. Drag the stake down. The phone writes how many bags.

Bags are the length times the width times the depth in inches, divided by 4, then rounded up. One bag covers 4 square feet at 1 inch. This is not an order. Stake Bed does not sell mulch, diagnose a plant, or plan a garden. It does not use a network or an account. The beds stay on this iPhone.

name: Stamp Master: Solitaire Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Stamp Master, the most relaxing and cozy postage-stamp solitaire puzzle adventure! 

Step into a warm, vintage post office where charming postage stamps and clever card puzzles await. If you love classic Solitaire, TriPeaks, Spider, Klondike, or relaxing match puzzle games, Stamp Master delivers a refreshing twist you will instantly fall in love with!

-MEET YOUR COZY MAIL COMPANION
Join our adorable cat mail carrier in a heartwarming journey! Sort vintage stamps featuring lovely illustrations of animals, famous world landmarks, delicious pastries, and nostalgic postage postmarks.

- HOW TO PLAY
• Sort & match matching stamp cards by categories and values.
• Clear the desk and unveil hidden envelopes and secret cards beneath.
• Plan your moves wisely to solve intricate puzzle stacks!

- EXCITING GAMEPLAY FEATURES
• 100+ Handcrafted Levels: From easy, calming puzzles to clever brain-teasing challenges!
• Unique Puzzle Obstacles: Melt frozen ice cards, collect brass keys, and unlock wax-sealed secret envelopes!

   - Magnifier Hint: Instantly spots the smartest card move.

• Relaxing & ASMR Experience: Soft card flips, soothing postmark stamps, and gentle ambient music that melts stress away.

- TRAIN YOUR BRAIN WHILE RELAXING
Whether you want a quick 3-minute mental break or hours of serene card-sorting enjoyment, Stamp Master is the perfect companion for your daily routine.

- Download Stamp Master today and start your cozy stamp collecting solitaire journey!

name: Star Battle: Logic Grid Puzzle
description:
Star Battle is a logic puzzle with three short rules and no arithmetic.

THE RULES
Every row and every column holds the same number of stars: one in the small puzzles, two in the large ones. Every coloured region holds that number too. And stars never touch each other, not even at a corner. That is all, and it is enough to keep you thinking for a long time.

ONE ANSWER, NO GUESSING
Every puzzle in the app has exactly one answer, and each one was solved by reasoning alone before it went in. So there is always a cell that the rules decide. You never have to try something and see.

A PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The daily puzzle grows through the week: six by six on Monday, ten by ten with two stars at the weekend. The same puzzle for everyone, and a count of your days in a row.

660 PUZZLES
520 in six packs, from five by five with one star to ten by ten with two, and 140 more that take their turn as the puzzle of the day. Inside a pack the puzzles go from easy to hard.

HINTS THAT EXPLAIN
A hint does not just fill in a cell. It shows the next step and gives the reason: this row has only one cell left, these two rows hold two whole regions, a star here would leave that column without room. If one of your marks is wrong, it tells you that first.

MADE FOR FINGERS
Tap a cell once to rule it out, a second time to place a star, a third time to clear it. Slide to rule out several cells at once. A small dot marks the cells your stars already rule out, and a star that breaks a rule turns red; both can be switched off. Undo as far back as you like. A half-done puzzle waits for you.

FREE
The puzzle of today, the first ten puzzles of every pack, three hints a day, two looks for the board.

STAR BATTLE PRO
Every puzzle of every pack. The daily puzzles of the days you missed. Hints without limit. Four more looks: Paper, Candy, Forest and Ink.

PRIVATE
No account, no advertising. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and the app sends nothing anywhere.

Star Battle Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. name: Star Swarm: The Galaxy Wars
description:
The Swarm has swallowed ten worlds. One pilot is flying back in.

Star Swarm is an arcade space shooter where your fleet is your health, your firepower and your strategy. Fly through gates to recruit wingmen, double your squad, upgrade your guns or thicken your hull, then choose: keep forty ships firing at once, or merge them into a single armoured Flagship.

TEN WORLDS
Fight across ten hand-painted planets, from the burning suns of Ignis to the clockwork rift of Chronos and the Swarm's homeworld at the End of Stars. Every world has its own species, its own enemy fire and its own sky.

FIFTY BOSSES
Every five waves a boss drops out of warp: sirens, a hazard band, a rift tearing open, and its name slamming onto the screen. Each of the fifty bosses has its own theme, its own voice and its own way to kill you: hydras that regrow their heads, a devourer that eats your fleet, a wraith that rewinds time, and the Galaxy Ender waiting at the very end.

GATES, NOT GRINDING
Every gate is a split-second choice under fire. +10 or ×2? A bigger gun or a tougher hull? Some gates lie. Read them right and your fleet swells; read them wrong and it shrinks.

POWERS WORTH SAVING
Collect eighteen powers, from Nova and Black Hole to the Serpent and the Blade Crown, and fire them when the screen is at its worst.

FAIR AND READABLE
No pay-to-win, no energy timers, no ads. Enemy fire is always the brightest thing on screen, and nothing hides a bullet.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Fully offline. Leave mid-run and pick up exactly where you left off. Unlock six ships in the hangar by clearing planets, or play the Classic arcade mode for pure score chasing.

name: StarBracket: Visual Estimates
description:
Estimate a variable star's visual magnitude between two known comparison stars. Enter the bright and faint magnitudes and the visual step counts on either side of the target. The estimate updates as you adjust the bracket.

Keep target, UTC time, chart reference, conditions and comparison values with each result. Filter observations by target, view estimates on a light curve with the magnitude axis inverted, and export your notes as CSV. An example star demonstrates the workflow.

Use your own sky chart and comparison magnitudes. StarBracket works offline and has no catalog, online reporting or location requirement.

name: StatStep
description:
StatStep shows you how to solve statistics problems, one clear step at a time.

Type in your numbers, or paste raw data, and StatStep walks through the whole solution the way your instructor would: the hypotheses, the formula with your numbers plugged in, the test statistic, the p-value, and a conclusion written in the context of your problem. You see the answer first, then exactly how to get there.

WHAT STATSTEP SOLVES
• Hypothesis tests: one mean (t), one proportion (z), two means (Welch t), two proportions (z)
• Confidence intervals for means and proportions (90%, 95%, 99%)
• Descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode, standard deviation, five-number summary, IQR and outliers
• Normal probability and percentiles, and binomial probability
• Linear regression: correlation, least-squares line, r², predictions and a t-test for the slope
• Chi-square tests: goodness of fit and two-way tables

BUILT FOR LEARNING
• Every answer comes with five numbered steps you can follow and check
• Conditions are stated for every test, so you know when a method applies
• Conclusions are written in plain language, ready to compare with your own
• Results use exact t and normal distributions, checked against statistical software

ENGLISH AND 中文
Switch between English and Chinese at any time. Every step, label and explanation changes language, which helps Chinese-speaking students learning statistics in English.

FREE AND PRO
StatStep is free to download with 3 full solutions per day. StatStep Pro gives unlimited solutions.
• StatStep Pro Monthly: $4.99 per month
• StatStep Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year
New subscribers get a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (after the free trial, if one applies). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://claude.ai/artifact/3f38JNQqajN7weVTVADHAQ

name: Status by OpenApps

What you get

- Incidents with a timeline of updates, from investigating to resolved.
- Scheduled maintenance, with the times in each visitor's own time zone.
- 90 days of uptime history for every component.

Managing your page
Your page is managed from this phone. You also get a private admin link to manage it from another device or share it with a teammate.

Your data
Status starts you as a guest on this phone and never asks for an email. You can delete your pages and your account from the bottom of the home screen at any time.

name: Stax Card Wallet
description:
Stax keeps all your cards in one dark, easy to read wallet.

Point the camera at the barcode and Stax captures it on its own, with a buzz when it is done. It reads the common retail and membership barcode types, so your gym, library, grocery and coffee cards all fit.

- Auto capture from the camera, with vibration feedback
- Barcode type detected for you
- Family profiles: keep each person's cards together
- Search and favourites to find a card fast
- Screen brightness rises when you open a card so the barcode scans at the till
- Dark design that looks good on OLED screens

Private by design: your cards stay on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: StayShield: Stay Proof Camera
description: StayShield was crafted specifically to give Airbnb hosts, Airbnb guests, and Resolution Center teams a trusted, objective standard for visual evidence-eliminating edited screenshots, fake timestamps, and Al-fabricated damage claims. Built to stay 100% offline, battery-friendly, private, and effortlessly smooth on every mobile phone and tablet worldwide.

name: Stichos
description:
Stichos is a daily Bible reading app built around one idea: read one passage a day, not an overwhelming feed.

Each day unlocks the next step of a 1,189-day reading plan through the World English Bible, starting at the Gospel of John. Open the app and read today's passage, with no account, no sign-up and no sync required.

Tap Study on any verse to see the verse just before and after it, plus a short note on the book you're reading, without leaving the page.

Keep the verses that move you, and add a private note that stays on your device. Jump to any of the 66 books at any time with Books, or search the text directly.

A daily reminder brings you back at a time you choose. Text size is adjustable. Everything you keep or write is stored only on your phone.

Stichos is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: Still by OpenApps
description:
Still is a quiet place to breathe, meditate and fall asleep. Open it and start: there is no sign-up, no ads, no subscription and nothing locked.

What you get
- Breathe: box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing or your own pattern, for 1 to 20 minutes, with a shape to follow, soft tones and vibration if you like.
- Meditate: a timer with soft bells, and twelve guided sessions read aloud with quiet pauses, including a body scan, breath focus, loving kindness and a 3 minute reset.
- Sounds: rain, ocean, wind, a stream, a fireplace, a fan, and white, pink and brown noise. Mix them, save your mixes, and set a timer that fades out slowly.
- Sleep: a dark screen for the night, with sleep sounds, a timer, and six slow stories read aloud or shown as text.
- Progress: your streak, minutes and sessions, and an optional mood check-in before and after a session.

Guided sessions and stories are read by your phone's own voice, so they work offline and cost nothing. Sounds keep playing with the screen off.

Your data
Still makes a guest account on your phone with no email and no password, to keep your practice days. Mood check-ins, saved mixes and settings stay on your phone. You can delete your account and data under Progress, Your data, at any time.

Still is not medical care. If you are in crisis or feel unsafe, contact your local emergency services.

Still is made by OpenApps. It also works in a web browser at still-free.openapps.xyz.

name: StitchGrid: Cross Stitch Maker
description:
StitchGrid is a calm, tactile offline pattern studio for cross-stitchers, knitters, crocheters, and pixel-craft makers.

KEY FEATURES
• Precision Grid Canvas: Draw, flood-fill, mirror, and pan smoothly with numbered 10×10 major grid lines.
• Automatic Thread & Color Palette: Real-time stitch counts per color so you always buy the right floss.
• Progress Tracker Mode: Mark completed rows and stitches without losing your place.
• Print-Ready Vector PDF Export: Export sharp symbol-coded charts directly from your device.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited projects, large canvas sizes, and watermark-free PDF export.

name: StormWatch: Barometer & Alerts
description:
StormWatch reads your iPhone's hardware barometer directly on-device — alerting you to rapid pressure drops before migraines or sudden storms strike.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time Hardware Barometer: Crisp hPa / inHg / mmHg readout with 3-hour and 24-hour pressure trend curves.
• Migraine & Rapid Drop Alerts: Get notified when pressure falls faster than your personal sensitivity threshold.
• Built for Outdoors & Fishing: Track steady highs and incoming fronts completely offline.
• 100% Private & Zero Subscriptions: No weather API accounts or location tracking required.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited pressure history logs, custom drop thresholds, and CSV export.

name: StreamBridge Remote
description:
The iPhone companion for StreamBridge on your Mac. Browse, pick a TV and press Watch. StreamBridge on your Mac gets it ready in your own Plex library.

• Movies, TV Shows and Collections, each a board of rows, with Search at the end of the tab bar.
• Each film's story, cast and More Like This. Press and hold any poster to Watch, Send or Share it.
• Make a collection from a few words, like "heist films of the 70s", with the + in Collections.
• Watch on the screen you pick: your TV, a SHIELD or the Mac, with subtitles in one language or two at once.
• Follow each film from Preparing to Ready, just above the tab bar.
• Away from home, send a film ahead and it's ready when you get in.
• From Safari, IMDb, Letterboxd or Messages, tap Share, then StreamBridge.

StreamBridge Remote is a one-time purchase in the app, not a subscription.

Already have StreamBridge Pro on your Mac? The app is included, with nothing to buy. Pro also adds to StreamBridge on the Mac: collections you make by typing, subtitles in two languages, your Letterboxd watchlist in Plex, unlimited lists, and search by meaning.

Requires StreamBridge 3.4.0 or later on a Mac with macOS 15 or later, Plex Media Server on that Mac, and StreamBridge's own requirements, listed at streambridgeforplex.com. Sending from away from home uses your Plex account.

name: Streamio Live
description:
Streamio Live makes it easy to broadcast live from your iPhone. The app streams with SRT or RTMP to the service you use. Enter the server URL and stream key, tap the red button and you’re live.

EASY TO GET STARTED
• Enter the server URL and stream key, or scan a QR code
• The details are stored encrypted on the phone
• No account needed in the app

STABLE BROADCASTS
• SRT, which handles unstable networks best, or RTMP/RTMPS
• Quality is lowered automatically when the network gets weak
• Reconnects automatically if the connection drops
• The broadcast continues with a pause screen when you take a call, lock the screen or switch apps

PICTURE AND SOUND
• 480p, 720p or 1080p, landscape or portrait
• Switch camera and lens, zoom, and tap to set focus and exposure
• Audio level meter and gain
• External microphone via cable, USB-C or Lightning

PEACE OF MIND WHILE LIVE
• A backup copy is recorded on the phone and saved to Photos or Files
• Warnings for weak network, low battery and heat
• A reminder to turn on Do Not Disturb before you go live

MADE FOR STREAMIO
Streamio Live comes from Rackfish and is made for Streamio, our video platform for businesses. With Streamio, you scan the live channel’s QR code and everything is set up. When you broadcast to another service, a Streamio Live mark is shown in the picture.

Questions or problems? Email support@rackfish.com.

name: StreamMe: Live Studio
description:
StreamMe puts you in live shows from your iPhone.

When a host invites you to their StreamMe show, tap the invite link and you're in. Check your camera and microphone, pick your name, and join the backstage green room. The host sees you're ready and brings you on stage with one tap, and their show goes out live to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Kick, LinkedIn and more.

JOIN AS A GUEST IN SECONDS
• Open any streamme.net invite link and it opens right in the app
• Preview your camera and mic before you go on
• Flip between your front and back cameras
• Wait backstage, then see when you're on stage
• Watch the host's live preview so you know exactly what viewers see
• Private studio chat with the host and other guests
• Your screen stays awake while you're in the studio

FOR HOSTS
• See all your studios in one place
• Create a new studio and share the invite link with guests
• Watch your cloud recordings on the go

StreamMe is a professional live-streaming studio that runs at streamme.net. Hosts produce their show from a computer with layouts, branding, banners, scenes and 9:16 vertical output, and guests can join from anywhere, now including this app.

Free to download. Sign in with your streamme.net account, or create one in the app.

Questions? support@streamme.net

Privacy: https://streamme.net/privacy

name: Stred: Link in Bio Store
description:
Turn your bio into a link in bio store. Stred gives creators one mobile storefront where followers can buy digital products, book coaching and pay for services, without ever leaving the page. It's free to start and takes 0% platform fees.

A plain list of links sends people somewhere else, and you lose sales every time they have to hop to a separate checkout, booking tool or email form. Stred keeps your products, bookings and links together on one page, so a follower can go from tapping your bio to paying you in seconds.

SELL DIGITAL PRODUCTS IN MINUTES
Upload a file, set a price and publish. Stred builds the product page, takes the payment and sends the file to your buyer automatically. Sell ebooks, guides, Notion templates, Lightroom presets, printables and any other digital download, and get paid while you're busy making the next one.

GET BOOKED AND PAID FOR COACHING
Sell 1:1 coaching calls, session packages and consultations right from your bio. Clients pick a time, pay upfront and get a calendar invite, so you don't need a separate scheduling or invoicing app. Offer free discovery calls to turn curious followers into paying clients.

TAKE BOOKINGS FOR YOUR SERVICES
Freelance designers, personal trainers, tutors and beauty pros can take paid bookings and deposits from one link. Reminders go out automatically, which means fewer no-shows.

SELL COURSES AND MEMBERSHIPS
Sell anything from quick mini-courses to live group cohorts, and add a membership for steady monthly income from your most loyal fans.

KEEP EVERY LINK IN ONE PLACE
Your YouTube, podcast, newsletter and socials all sit on the same page, without burying the things you sell. One bio link works on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Threads, LinkedIn and Pinterest.

GROW YOUR EMAIL LIST
Use free lead magnets, waitlists and launch sign-ups to capture emails straight from your bio, so you build an audience you own.

SEE WHAT SELLS
Track clicks, conversion rate, revenue and your top traffic sources for every product, so you know what to promote next.

BUILT FOR CREATORS WHO SELL
- Digital product sellers
- Coaches and consultants
- Course creators
- Service providers and freelancers
- Influencers sharing affiliate picks, a media kit and brand collab requests

HOW IT WORKS
1. Claim your free link: stred.store/yourname

SIMPLE PRICING
Free: a storefront, unlimited links, 3 products, bookings and 0% platform fees

name: Stride Folio
description:
Dear friend,

I kept mixing up which pair still had life left and which pair was ready to retire, so I made Stride Folio. It is a small on-device folio for running shoes: what you own, how far each pair has gone, and when a model plan says it is time to replace. Here is what's inside.

1. Shoe library
Register each pair with a name, optional note, and mileage so the board can follow distance as well as the calendar.

2. Model plans with intervals
Attach a model plan with size or model notes and a replace interval in mileage and/or months. Keep the last replaced date when you have it so Due can stay honest.

3. Due board
Open Due to see pairs sorted into Overdue, Soon, and Later. Each row shows the shoe, model notes, remaining mileage or days when that track is active, and controls to Mark replaced or Mark retired when the pair's job is done.

4. Search and review
On Shoes, search by name or note and open a pair to edit it or update mileage. On Models, browse plans across your shelf. Retire or replace a pair and the board refreshes so the next pair can take the load.

5. About, Privacy, and Support
About has a short getting-started path, Privacy text, Support with the contact email, and Erase library with a two-step confirmation if you want a clean slate on this device.

A few more things you might like to know. Everything works offline. Your shoes, models, and logs stay on this iPhone. There is no account to create, no ads, and nothing to buy. The layout is built for landscape so the due board and lists stay readable on a wide screen.

Keep the pairs honest and let me know how it reads.

Warmly,
Allen

name: String Bay
description:
Dear friend,

I keep more than one racket in the bag, and I kept forgetting which frame was still on which string. String Bay is a quiet local ledger for that: note the string model and tension, set a restring interval by play sessions and/or months, and see which jobs are due before the next match.

1. Due board
Open Due to see restring jobs grouped into Overdue, Soon, and Later. Each card shows the racket, the string note, and a short due line. Tap Mark restrung when fresh strings are on; the board refreshes from the local library.

2. Rackets
Add each racket with a name, optional note, and current play-session count. Open a racket to attach string jobs, edit sessions, or review restring history. Search finds a frame by name or note.

3. Strings
Browse string models aggregated across your jobs. See how many setups use a model and which rackets carry it, then open a model to jump into the related racket details.

4. Mark restrung
From Due (or a job on a racket), mark a restring with today’s date and the current session count. A short log stays on the device so you can see what was done.

5. About on this device
Getting started steps, in-app Privacy and Support (mailto), and Erase library with two confirmations. There is no account and nothing to buy.

Everything stays on this iPhone or iPad. There are no ads. Portrait and landscape both work for reading the board and editing notes.

String it, mark it, and let me know how the board reads.

Warmly,
Allen

name: Stripmote: LED Strip Lights
description:
Stripmote is the remote your LED strip lights deserve. No subscription. Ever.

Most Bluetooth LED strips come with a clunky app. Stripmote replaces it with one fast, beautiful remote that works with the strips you already own.

COLOR, INSTANTLY
• A smooth color wheel that keeps up with your finger
• Brightness, warm-to-cool white and quick colors
• Save your favorite colors and apply them with one tap
• Your screen glows in the color of your lights

SCENES AND ROOMS
• One-tap scenes: Movie, Gaming, Relax, Party and Sunset, or save your own
• Group strips into rooms and control them together

MUSIC SYNC, CAMERA COLOR AND SLEEP TIMER
• Lights pulse to the music around you, and keep going while you use the rest of the app
• Audio is analysed on your phone and never recorded or sent anywhere
• Point your camera at anything and copy its color to your lights
• Sleep timer fades your lights out and turns them off

WIDGETS, CONTROL CENTER AND SIRI
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• A Control Center toggle
• "Turn on bedroom lights" and "Run Movie scene" with Siri and Shortcuts

MADE TO JUST WORK
• Finds compatible lights automatically
• Fixes strips with swapped red and green in two taps
• Clear help when a light won't connect

WORKS WITH
Bluetooth LED controllers that show up with names such as ELK-BLEDOM, ELK-BLE, MELK, LEDBLE, QHM, BJ_LED, L7161, BR-01B and LEDnetWF — plus several more. The full list is on our support page. Infrared-only and Wi-Fi-only strips are not supported.

No account, no sign-up, no cloud. Your lights, rooms and scenes stay on your phone.

FREE, AND STAYING FREE
Every feature is free. One small banner ad keeps it that way. Remove it forever with a one-time purchase. Never a subscription.

name: Stroking
description:
Trace a finger along your cat’s back and watch the fur shift under your touch. Switch on purring to hear it change as you stroke.

 from a ginger tabby to a long-haired Ragdoll. Make yours a little rounder, or give it more room to wander by making it smaller. Your choice of cat and its proportions are saved for your next visit.

Leave your cat to its own devices and watch it stretch, yawn, or settle down again. For a quieter view, switch to moonlight and pet your cat in landscape until the controls fade away.

name: Study Butler: Class Schedule
description:
Study Butler keeps school organized for students and teachers — on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

TIMETABLE & REMINDERS
• Snap a photo of your timetable and AI turns it into a weekly schedule, or import it from Excel, CSV or your calendar
• A/B weeks, rotating cycles and custom periods
• Reminders before each class, with your own lead time and sound
• See what's on now and next on Today, with the weather
• Your next class on your Apple Watch face

FOR STUDENTS
• Photograph homework and get it checked question by question, with explanations
• Mistakes are saved to a mistake notebook automatically, with handwriting removed so you can redo them
• Practice similar questions on your weak points
• Print a clean mistake sheet for revision
• Track exam results and grades over time

FOR TEACHERS
• Class rosters imported from Excel, Word or a photo
• Random name picker, also on Apple Watch
• Enter scores by hand or from a photo, see averages, rankings and question analysis
