YOUR AI, YOUR CHOICE
Study Butler works with the AI provider you choose — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and many others, or a server on your own network. Paste your API key and Study Butler recognizes the provider. Your key stays in your Keychain, and requests go straight from your device to your provider. AI results can be wrong, so please check them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device and syncs through your own iCloud. We run no servers and never see your data.

30 LANGUAGES
Fully translated into 30 languages, with Dark Mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

SUBSCRIPTION
All features need a subscription: $4.99 per month or $49.99 per year, each with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices vary by country. The subscription does not include the cost of AI usage, which your AI provider bills you for directly.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

name: StudyDeck: Flashcards & Notes
description:
StudyDeck turns your classes into flashcards and helps you remember them. Everything is processed on your device, and nothing is sent to us.

FLASHCARDS THAT STICK
• Spaced repetition shows each card again just before you'd forget it

• Share a deck with a classmate by AirDrop, Messages or email

• Tap a hint to hear that moment, or turn the hints into flashcards
• Hear it in class: flashcards made from a lecture play the moment the fact was said

RECORD YOUR LECTURES (newer iPhones)

• Tap any line of the transcript to hear that moment again
• Play back at up to 2× and search every word you've recorded

SCAN YOUR NOTES
• Scan notes, whiteboards, slides and textbook pages with the camera or from Photos

AI STUDY TOOLS (iPhones with Apple Intelligence)
• Summarise a lecture or scan into short bullet points
• Turn a lecture or scan into flashcards you check before saving

ORGANISED BY SUBJECT

• Backed up to your own iCloud and synced to your iPad

StudyDeck Pro unlocks unlimited lectures, scans and AI tools, quizzes and searchable PDFs:

name: Stylepack: AI Photo Styles
description:
Stylepack is an AI photo generator built on one idea: your photo, every style, still you. Turn a selfie into a professional AI headshot, an anime character, an oil portrait or a holiday card, and every version still looks like you.

Pick a style, add a photo, and your image is ready in about 30 seconds. There is no prompt to write: Stylepack has more than 50 ready-made styles, each made to keep the person in the photo recognisable. It does more than an AI photo editor or a filter: each style redraws the whole picture, from the light and the clothes to the background.

AI HEADSHOTS AND PORTRAITS
Studio headshots for your CV or work profile, golden hour and black-and-white portraits, a film snapshot, Old Hollywood glamour or a dating profile picture, all from one selfie.

PHOTO TO ANIME AND CARTOON
See yourself as an anime hero, in a painted anime film, as a 3D cartoon, a comic book character, a chibi sticker or pixel art. It is a quick way to make an AI avatar for your socials.

AI ART AND PAINTING
Become an oil portrait, a watercolor, pop art, ukiyo-e, a charcoal sketch, art nouveau or stained glass.

PRODUCT PHOTOS
Turn a phone snapshot of your product into a studio product shot, a splash shot, or a marble, pastel or nature scene. Food photos too.

PETS, FUN AND SEASONAL CARDS
Your pet as a royal portrait. You as an action figure, a trading card, an astronaut or a superhero, plus Y2K glam and a retro yearbook photo. Seasonal cards for winter, summer, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Diwali, Eid, birthdays, graduation and more.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a style, or describe the look you want in a few words and Stylepack finds the closest match.
• Add one clear photo: a selfie, a pet or a product. Add a short detail if you like, such as a place or a message.
• Choose Standard or HD quality.
• Your image is ready in about 30 seconds. Save it to your photos, share it, or make another version.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
• Your uploaded photo is used only to make your image, and it is deleted within a day.
• Only you can see your images. Delete any of them at any time.
• Delete your account and all its images from the Account screen.
• Your photos and images are never used to train AI models.

HOW CREDITS WORK
• Your first 3 images are included, in Standard quality, with a small stylepack mark in the corner.

• If an image fails or is blocked, its credits go back to you automatically.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Stylepack is for adults 18 and over.
• Sign-in is required, so your images and credits stay with your account.

name: Stylish Keyboard: Cool Fonts
description:
tylish Keyboard gives every chat cool fonts, keyboard themes, stickers and emoji that fit your words. Type in Hindi, Hinglish and 80+ languages, and keep what you type private: it stays on your phone.

name: Sulfite Add
description:
Sulfite Add reads the barrel volume, the pH, and the free SO2 already in the wine.

White and rose use one molecular target. Red uses another. The chart draws both as straight lines. A pH above the hold line is marked Hold and does not show a weight. A target above the high line is marked High and still shows the weight.

Barrels and the addition log stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sumai - journal
description:
Sumai is a propagation archive for succulent growers. Every mother plant gets a record, every propagation run becomes a numbered cohort, and every seedling keeps its own photo timeline. Everything works without an account, and an optional email account adds a private text backup you can restore later.

MOTHER PLANTS
- Variety library of sixty common succulents, or type your own
- Source, pot, substrate, light position and a dated status timeline
- Short specimen codes you can print as labels and scan back into the app

COHORTS
- Leaf cutting, beheading, division or seed, with substrate, container and position
- Automatic numbering such as S01-S24 that never reuses a retired number
- Reusable templates for the setup you repeat every season

CHECK-INS AND COMPARISON
- Viewfinder with a ghost overlay of the anchor photo from 0-60% and a rule-of-thirds grid, remembered per specimen and per angle
- Top, side and root angles, imports that keep their EXIF capture date, three thumbnail sizes
- Side-by-side pairs with day labels, a quarterly quad, two-frames-per-second playback, and height, leaf and crown curves

COUNTING HONESTLY
- Survival, viability and rooting shown with the denominator on the same screen
- Percentages suppressed below five eligible specimens, with counts shown instead
- Method, substrate, season and mother comparisons, plus loss attribution by reason

JOURNAL
- Watering, light, temperature, feeding, repotting and spraying, one plant or a whole cohort in a single entry
- Monthly hydration strip with average and shortest interval
- Today queue built from your own intervals, with one daily reminder

ACCOUNT AND TEXT BACKUP
- No account needed: records, photos, spoken notes and credits stay on this iPhone
- Optional email account keeps one private text backup of specimens, cohorts, check-ins and measurements
- Restore adds records that are missing here; photos and spoken notes are never uploaded
- Sign out, delete the backup or delete the account from Settings

LEAF CREDITS
- Eight consumable tiers at App Store list prices
- 1 credit for a cohort report, 1 for a dated comparison sheet, 3 for a PDF album
- Reports, sheets and albums are generated on this device

PRIVACY
- No analytics SDK, no advertising, no tracking
- With an account, only the email address, account ID and text archive are stored by Google Firebase
- Photos and spoken notes stay in the app's private storage and leave only through the share sheet you open
- JSON, CSV and a photo folder export stay free

Sumai does not identify species, diagnose plants or recommend treatment. Seasonal notes are general experience, not advice for your exact climate.

name: Summed. Everyday digests.
description:
Point your iPhone at text you don't have time to read, and Summed gives you a short, machine-made digest in English.

A poster. A magazine page. A sign at a museum. A page of a book. Tap the white dot and Summed reads the text and writes a title and a digest of one to three sentences.

Digests are written by a machine and can be wrong or leave things out. Read the original before relying on one for anything important.

CAPTURE TEXT
• Opens straight to the camera. One tap takes the photo.
• Reads text in many languages and gives you a machine-made digest in English.

CATEGORIZE
• Every digest gets a title and a suggested category: Signs, Menus, Mail, Manuals, Books, Magazines, Posters, Receipts and more.
• Change the category with a tap, or add your own.

SAVE AND SORT
• Add a digest to your Library with one tap. Nothing is kept unless you choose to keep it.
• Filter by category, language and place.
• Swipe to share, rename or delete.

BY GEO, BY DAY
• Map: see where each digest was captured. This is optional and only works if you share your location.
• Calendar: a running calendar with a dot for every digest. Tap a day to see what you captured.

EDIT AND SHARE
• Each saved digest keeps a small black-and-white copy of the photo, as a reminder of what you captured.
• Edit the title. Share the title, the digest and its notes as text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Apple's text recognition reads the text and Apple Intelligence writes the digest. Your photos are not uploaded to us.
• No account. No ads. No tracking. We collect no data.
• Location is optional. If you share it, place names and the map come from Apple and need a connection.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A digest is a shortcut, not a substitute for reading. Don't rely on one for medicine, allergens, safety instructions, legal or official mail, or money.
• Any translation is a machine translation, not a professional one.
• Digests are written in English.
• With very long text, the digest covers only the first part, and Summed tells you so.

REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone with iOS 26 or later.
• Digests need Apple Intelligence: iPhone 15 Pro or later, with Apple Intelligence turned on. Without it, Summed shows the text it read in place of a digest.

Terms, privacy policy and support: https://analog.design/Summed/

name: Summoria
description:
Reúna sua equipe e explore o mundo de Summoria, um RPG de fantasia com criaturas e combates por turnos.

INVOQUE E EVOLUA
Descubra criaturas de diferentes elementos. Evolua sua equipe, aprimore habilidades e equipe runas para enfrentar novos desafios.

PLANEJE CADA TURNO
Combine as habilidades da sua equipe e as vantagens entre elementos. Explore regiões, enfrente chefes e conquiste masmorras.

CONSTRUA SUA ILHA
Organize construções, produza recursos e personalize seu lar entre uma aventura e outra.

DESAFIE OUTROS JOGADORES
Prepare sua equipe para a arena e avance com sua estratégia.

É necessária conexão com a internet para jogar.

Contém compras opcionais dentro do app.

name: Sunblue: Cyanotype Camera
description:
Develop your photos in real colour, printed by real light.
Hold your iPhone to a lamp or a bright sky, then shake to develop.
How much light the print gets decides how it turns out.

Take a photo or choose one, and it rests faintly on light-sensitive paper. Hold your iPhone toward real light – a lamp or a bright sky, never the sun. The camera measures how bright it is, and the brighter the light, the faster the print exposes. When you are ready, shake to develop: the colours come up slowly in the developer, with the feel of a darkroom print – a poured edge, grain and developer marks.

YOUR EXPOSURE DECIDES
• Too little light: a pale, washed-out print
• Just right: rich, natural colour
• Too much: a dark, heavy print with burned edges
The colour of the light shows too: a warm lamp leans the print amber, a cool sky leans it blue. Rock it evenly for an even print; a few gentle shakes leave developer streaks.

ON THE LINE
Each print hangs on the drying line at its own slight tilt, and its colours keep maturing for about a day, in the app and on a Home Screen widget. Then it goes into your print box, ready to save to Photos or share.

PREFER PRUSSIAN BLUE?
Cyanotype is one tap away in Paper and toner: the photo prints in Prussian blue, and you shake to wash the yellow away.

FOR EVERYONE
• Tap Develop (or Wash, for cyanotype) instead of shaking, or turn shaking off in Settings
• Works with VoiceOver and Switch Control
• Built-in samples – lemons in a blue bowl, fern and ginkgo, lace, oat grass – so you can print without your own photos

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no analytics. Your photos never leave your iPhone.

FREE, AND DARKROOM
Real colour and cyanotype on cotton are free. Free prints carry a small corner stamp, and the free print box keeps your latest 12 prints. Sunblue Darkroom is a one-time purchase, not a subscription: it removes the stamp, keeps every print, and adds the washi, double coat and tea-toned cyanotype papers.

name: Sundial Tactics
description:
Every move turns the shadows. In Sundial Tactics, each piece casts a shadow that blocks the next square. The board tells you where the shadows point now and where they’ll turn after your move. To win, hold all three sundials at once.

In Puzzle Levels, solve nine positions within a move limit. Tap Hint to see a suggested move, and clear each level to unlock the next.

In Local Match, two people take turns on one iPhone. Choose who goes first, then plan a route around the shifting shadows.

Play offline. Your puzzle progress and settings are saved on your device.

name: SunPathAR: Golden Hour & Sun
description:
SunPathAR gives photographers, filmmakers, architects, and homebuyers exact solar trajectories anywhere on Earth — computed 100% offline.

KEY FEATURES
• Live Solar Arc & Azimuth Compass: See exactly where the sun rises, peaks, and sets on any day of the year.
• Golden Hour & Blue Hour Planner: Minute-accurate magic hour windows for landscape and portrait shoots.
• Home & Balcony Sunlight Check: Preview winter vs. summer sun angles before buying or renting an apartment.
• 100% Offline Astronomy Engine: Works in remote mountains and national parks with zero cell signal.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro ($5.99): Unlock unlimited saved scouting locations, full-year date scrubber, and shadow charts.

name: Sunripe Trio
description:
The peaches are ripe, and the crows have noticed. Pick first or chase them off?

In Sunripe Trio’s magical orchard, switch between three heroes on the fly. Tap ripe peaches to pick them with Momo the monkey, or have Biscuit the puppy bark at incoming crows to scare them off. One call from Cocky the rooster ripens every bud and freezes the crows midflight for a few seconds. Use that window to pick peaches, then switch back to Biscuit to guard what’s left.

You have one minute in each of the 12 main levels. Ripe peaches spoil if you leave them too long, and every stolen peach costs you a heart. Reach the harvest goal before time runs out and keep all three hearts to earn three stars. Later levels ask for bigger harvests as the crows swoop in faster and more often.

A set of four challenges rotates every Monday. You might have just 35 seconds, start with a single heart, or find the rooster asleep for the whole round. For slower, less frequent crows, choose the Relaxed pace in Settings. Play both the main levels and weekly challenges offline.

name: SuperChord
description:
Tap a chord with one hand and sweep the strumplate with the other. SuperChord is a free electronic instrument for iPhone and iPad with ten strum voices, ten drum patterns, and a separate sound for the chord pads.

Hold a chord while you strum, pulse it with a gate, or send its notes up and down with the arpeggiator. Pick a key to highlight chords that fit. The other chords stay playable when you want to step outside the scale.

Record a two-bar or four-bar progression, then play over it. Each loop length has its own memory on your device. Switch to the piano keyboard to play a melody or tap out a drum part.

On iPhone, step through compact chord banks with your thumb. On iPad, the full chord grid sits beside the strumplate for two-handed playing.

SuperChord works offline. No ads, accounts, or in-app purchases.

name: Svoi24 — Свої для Своїх
description:
Svoi24 (Свої для Своїх) — платформа для пошуку перевірених українських спеціалістів та послуг у всіх містах Польщі (Варшава, Краків, Вроцлав, Познань, Гданськ, Лодзь, Катовіце, Люблін, Щецин та ін.).

Основні можливості додатку:
• Каталог перевірених майстрів у понад 150 категоріях: ремонт та будівництво, б'юті-послуги (манікюр, перукарі, косметологи), автосервіс, прибирання, репетитори, юристи, бухгалтери, медицина та перевезення.
• Інтерактивна карта спеціалістів поруч із вами з фільтрацією за районами міста.
• Швидке створення заявки за 30 секунд — опишіть завдання, і вільні майстри самі запропонують вам свої ціни.
• Реальні відгуки, портфоліо виконаних робіт, прайс-листи та калькулятори вартості послуг.
• Система захисту клієнтів («Безпечна угода») та генератор двомовних договорів (UA/PL).
• Прямий зв'язок зі спеціалістом у Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp або за телефоном без посередників і комісій.

name: SVPS LEAD PROGRAM
description:
Welcome to the L.E.A.D. PROGRAM – Learn, Explore, Achieve, Develop.

L.E.A.D. PROGRAM is a learning platform designed to help students and trainers stay connected and make learning more organized and accessible.

Whether you are a student or a trainer, the app brings essential learning activities and resources together in one convenient place.

KEY FEATURES

• Learning Resources: Access educational materials and resources shared through the program.
• Student Dashboard: View your learning information and stay connected with your program.
• Trainer Connection: Connect with your assigned trainers and access relevant guidance.
• Progress Tracking: Keep track of your learning journey and activities.
• Notifications and Updates: Stay informed about important program updates.
• Learning Community: Stay connected with the L.E.A.D. PROGRAM.

OUR MISSION

We aim to make learning more accessible, organized, and engaging through technology.

Download the L.E.A.D. PROGRAM app and take the next step in your learning journey.

Learn. Explore. Achieve. Develop.

name: SWAHD
description: SWAHDKeep your account balances and pending bills on the same dashboard; simply tap on a bill to view any funding shortfalls, the designated payment account, and individual transaction limits. You can lock a specific payment account to a bill and see how that choice affects your other obligations. Before executing a transfer, compare various transaction fees and estimated arrival dates, then record the actual transfer once it’s complete. Log your income and expenses as they occur, organize your bills by payment cycle, and set up installment plans for items like course fees. At the end of the month, reconcile your records against your actual bank statements, review your monthly cash flow, and use the financial calendar to schedule your next set of payments.

name: Sweet Pet Rescue
seller_name: Chongqing Jincheng Meiyu Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Feed sweet treats. Fill every order. Bring every pet home.

Sweet Pet Rescue is a cozy one-tap puzzle game about preparing desserts for hungry animal friends. Each level gives you a board of layered treats. Tap the top dessert to collect it, complete the order, and keep the tray under control before time runs out. When an order is finished, the pet is fed and moves one step closer to home.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Tap and collect desserts from a layered puzzle board
- Fill animal orders before the tray fills up
- Plan each move to reach the treats you need
- Unlock new pets and desserts as you progress
- Send pets home and watch your collection grow

COZY PROGRESSION
- 48 levels across 6 chapters
- New animals, desserts, and challenges unlock over time
- Journey Map shows your progress at a glance
- Pet Album collects the friends you unlock
- Daily tasks and achievements add small goals
- Decorate your own cozy pet corner
- Create and share a postcard from your album

EASY TO PICK UP
Simple one-tap controls, short levels, and a warm playful style make this game easy to enjoy in a quick break. The puzzle becomes more interesting as you learn how to clear layers, manage the tray, and complete orders faster.

PLAY YOUR WAY
No account is required. Your progress is saved locally on your device, and no internet connection is required. The game is designed for portrait play on iPhone and iPad.

If you enjoy gentle puzzle games, cute animal collections, and cozy progression, Sweet Pet Rescue is ready for your first order.

name: SwingCloset
description:
SwingCloset is the wardrobe on your iPhone. Keep clothes by season, then look at one outfit suggestion before you leave. There is no account. Clothing records, photos, and voice notes stay on this device.

BY SEASON
Swipe through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The season follows today’s date. Pieces marked for all seasons appear in every season. Search by name, brand, color, or fabric. Filter by occasion and status, then change the season or status of several pieces at once.

TODAY’S OUTFIT
You set the weather, occasion, and temperature yourself. SwingCloset does not go online for weather and does not ask for your location. A suggestion is only a reference. You decide what to wear. Log what you wore, save the outfit, or save an outfit image to Photos.

STILL ON THIS PHONE
Idle clothes, laundry, a wish list, packing lists, and an outfit calendar are in Me. A wish is a note on this device. It does not open a store. Marking a piece as given away only records that it left the closet on this phone. It is not a sale.

PHOTOS AND VOICE
Take a photo or choose one from Photos, and add a voice note of up to 60 seconds. They stay in the app until you clear them or delete the app. A backup does not include them unless you keep the files yourself.

REMINDERS
Reminders for today’s outfit, idle clothes, and a change of season stay off until you turn one on. They are scheduled on this device. There is no server push. Season-change days are March 1, June 1, September 1, and December 1.

UNLOCK AND BACKUP
Unlock on open can use Face ID, Touch ID, or the device passcode. SwingCloset cannot see your biometric data. Export a JSON backup of the text records and move it to another device. Importing replaces the wardrobe on that device after you confirm.

SwingCloset is not a shopping or social product, and it has no in-app purchases

name: Swipie: Photo & Video Cleaner
description:
Swipie helps you review your photos and videos, one decision at a time. Swipe right to keep an item and left to add it to the in-app trash. Nothing is deleted from Apple Photos until you review the trash and confirm.

REVIEW YOUR WAY
• Work through a month or start a quick review of 10 items.
• Choose oldest first or newest first.
• Focus on one card, or review four cards on the same screen.
• Jump into screenshots, videos or a random mix.

TAKE A CLOSER LOOK
• Open photos and videos full screen.
• Zoom into details and play videos.
• View a whole month with keep and trash decisions marked.
• Undo a swipe or change an earlier decision.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your review progress is saved on your device. Optional monthly reminders help you return when it suits you. Confetti and haptic feedback can be turned off in settings.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
Swipie processes your photos on your device. No accounts, advertising or analytics SDKs. Apple Photos may download originals from iCloud when needed.

Deletion confirmed in Swipie applies to Apple Photos and may sync to other devices through iCloud Photos.

Available in English and Russian. For iPhone and iPad running iOS 17 or later.

name: Symmetry Bloom
description:
Symmetry Bloom turns every stroke into a pattern found in nature. Inspired by a museum exhibit on symmetry in plants, it lets you draw in a circle while your line is copied live around the center, the way petals repeat around a flower.

Explore the symmetries plants use
• Mirror symmetry, like an orchid
• 3-fold like a trillium, 4-fold like a mustard flower, 5-fold like an apple blossom
• 6-fold like a lily, 7-fold like a starflower, 8-fold like a cosmos
• Tap the lightbulb to draw a real plant example and learn why it looks the way it does

Make it yours
• Any color and any background color
• Eight brush textures: solid, gradient, dots, dashes, dash-dot, squiggle, zigzag and double line
• Kaleidoscope mode adds mirror lines to any rotation
• Undo, redo, and a gallery to save, reopen and copy designs to remix
• A separate gallery for each person in the family, no accounts needed

Watch it come alive
• Play turns your drawing into a slow 12-second animated loops
• A gentle lo-fi beat, generated on your device, follows the mood of your drawing
• Export the loop as a video with music, or as a GIF

Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your drawings stay on your device.

name: Synatra Client
description:
A login prompt is on your laptop. The password is on your iPhone. Synatra helps you find the right entry and type even a long password without losing your place.

Find the login from a screenshot

Open Other Screen and choose a screenshot saved on your iPhone that shows the website address. Synatra reads the address on your iPhone and looks for a matching entry in your saved logins. Pick the entry you want, or search manually if the address is missing or unfamiliar.

Read one group at a time

Open Enter in groups to see the password in short sections. Type the current group, then tap Next. If you lose your place, step back or jump straight to the group you need.

Keep the logins you use close at hand

Save a website, username, password and private note together. Sort entries into collections, keep frequent logins in Favorites and generate a password for a new account. Check for reused passwords on your iPhone.

Keep your vault on your iPhone

Synatra works offline. Unlock the encrypted vault with Face ID or your device passcode. There's no Synatra account or cloud sync. Delete a single entry or clear the vault from Settings whenever you choose.

name: SyncJot
description:
SyncJot is a fast, quiet place to write things down, and find them again on any device.

WRITE IN BLOCKS
• Type / for headings, checklists, bullet and numbered lists, quotes, dividers and toggles
• Bold, italic, indent and outdent from the format bar
• Tuck long sections into toggles until you need them

STAY ORGANISED
• Folders inside folders, in list, grid or column view
• Pin the notes you use most
• Drag a note onto a folder to file it
• Save any note as a template for meeting notes, daily plans and more

READ MODE
• Read a note aloud and SyncJot follows along, highlighting where you are and scrolling for you
• Great for scripts, speeches and presentations
• Tap any word to jump there

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Folded, SyncJot fits the outer display for quick one-handed notes
• Unfold it and your notes list and editor sit side by side
• Looks just as good on iPhone and iPad

SYNCS EVERYWHERE
• Sign in with Apple or Google and your notes follow you across your devices

FORGIVING BY DESIGN
• Undo almost anything
• Deleted notes wait in Trash for 7 days before they're gone
• Gentle haptics and a calm dark mode

name: SyncNow
description:
SyncNow 是一款专为多设备协同打造的本地优先、端到端加密剪贴板管理与低延迟桌面/窗口投屏工具，支持 Mac、iPhone 与 iPad 无缝互联。

核心功能
• 强大的剪贴板历史与收藏夹：支持文本、富文本、链接、色值（一键复制 HEX/RGB/SwiftUI 代码）、图片与文件历史，随时全局快捷键（⌘⇧V）搜索调取并分类收藏。
• 局域网自动发现与扫码配对：基于 Bonjour 自动发现同一 Wi-Fi 下的设备，同时支持二维码一键扫码配对与手动 IP / Tailscale 直连。
• 全链路端到端加密：采用 6 位安全配对码 + X25519/Ed25519 双向身份认证 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 加密通道，保护每一条剪贴板与文件传输。
• 60fps 硬件级屏幕与单窗口投递：依托苹果原生 ScreenCaptureKit 与 VideoToolbox 硬件编解码，将 Mac 桌面或单个应用窗口以低延迟投屏至其他 Mac、iPhone 或 iPad。
• 可选跨网自托管加密中继：支持填写您自建的加密中继地址与本地同步组密钥，跨网络同步全程密文传输，服务端零明文可见。
• 零遥测、零强制登录：App Store 版默认本地直连，不收集任何用户隐私或统计数据。

name: Szuper: Language Flashcards
description:
Szuper turns the words and phrases from your own lessons into short, game-like practice. Bring a deck from your teacher, your course or your own notes and practice it five minutes at a time.

YOUR MATERIAL, NOT A FIXED COURSE
• Open any Anki-compatible .apkg file, review history included
• Create and edit cards right on your phone
• Try the built-in Hungarian café lesson first

PRACTICE THAT FEELS LIKE A GAME
• Nine exercise types: type the answer, choose a translation, build a phrase from words, match pairs, fill the gap and more
• Answers are checked for you, so there is no self-grading
• Prefer the classic way? Flip cards and grade yourself in Classic review

REMEMBER FOR GOOD
• Spaced repetition schedules every review at the right moment
• A daily goal, streaks and streak freezes keep you coming back
• See which cards are strong and which need more work

LISTENING AND THEORY
• Decks can include recorded dialogues: replay a single phrase, slow it down, tap for a translation, then answer comprehension questions
• Short theory chapters lead straight to the cards that drill them

YOURS TO KEEP
• Works fully offline
• No account, no ads, no subscription, no data collected
• Export your deck with progress, or as a clean copy for another learner
• Home Screen widget and optional study reminders

Szuper is an independent app and is not affiliated with Anki.

name: Table Check DE
description:
Table Check DE puts Delaware's public restaurant inspection records on a map and makes them easy to read.

Browse the inspections Delaware currently publishes for restaurants across New Castle, Kent, and Sussex counties. See when a place was visited, what kind of inspection it was, the official result, and each cited violation grouped by Food Code chapter, so food-handling findings stand out from other violations.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Explore a map and a searchable list of Delaware establishments
• Switch between New Castle, Kent, and Sussex
• Read each inspection's date, type, official result, and cited violations
• Filter by inspection type, result, date, and food-finding count
• Save favorites, keep private notes, and compare favorites side by side
• Follow trends and recurring violations across a restaurant's history
• Share a clean summary card
• Jump to the state's official source for any record

BUILT FOR DELAWARE
Delaware publishes citations, not letter grades or numeric scores. Table Check DE shows what the state reports and does not invent a rating. An inspection describes one visit. It is not a guarantee of today's conditions, and records may lag behind a restaurant's latest visit.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Favorites, notes, your profile, selected counties, and saved filters can sync through your own private iCloud account. Your location is used on the device to find your county and sort by distance. Notes are never included in shared summaries.

FREE TO EXPLORE, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Maps, search, inspection outcomes, favorites, notes, and county coverage are free. Your first full restaurant report is free too. Table Check Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks full reports, the full published history, trends, and recurring violations for every restaurant. No subscription.

Table Check DE is an independent tool built on Delaware's public inspection data. It is not affiliated with the State of Delaware or with any restaurant. The state's published records remain the official source.

name: Table Check NY
description:
Table Check NY puts official New York restaurant inspection records on a map you can actually read.

PICK YOUR COUNTIES
Start with your county and add more whenever you like. New York City boroughs load NYC Health (DOHMH) inspection records; the rest of the state loads New York State Department of Health records.

MAP AND LIST
• Every inspected restaurant pinned nearby, with dashed pins where an address could only be approximated
• Sort by distance, most recent inspection, or name
• Filter by food service type, inspection result, inspection date, and critical violation counts
• Favorites, county filters, and place-by-place comparisons of the spots you're deciding between
• Countywide inspection trends where the published data allows

READ A REPORT
• Critical and non-critical violation counts from the most recent visit
• The inspector's violation list, with categories and dispositions
• Full inspection history, so you see a pattern rather than one bad day

KEEP YOUR DATA
• Choose which counties to keep; new locations are matched automatically after an update
• A saved copy on your device, so your last county results appear right away on the next launch and then update in the background
• Optional iCloud sync of favorites and settings across your devices

FREE TO START
Open your first restaurant's complete report at no cost. Unlock Table Check Pro once and every restaurant's full report, history, and details open from then on. One-time purchase, no subscription.

WHAT IT ISN'T
An inspection result describes what an inspector recorded on a given visit. It is not a score, a rating of today's conditions, or a guarantee. Table Check NY shows published counts and notes as they appear in the official feeds.

Your location is used on your device to find your county and sort by distance. It isn't sent to us.

Not affiliated with the New York State Department of Health, NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, or any county health department. Data comes from their published open data feeds.

name: Tai Chi at Ease
description: Practice tai chi at your own pace with Tai Chi at Ease, a free app for seated or standing practice. Follow an animated guide and spoken cues through simple movements, returning to a neutral posture between moves. Choose a five-minute session or keep going at your own pace. Afterward, jot down how you feel in the built-in journal.

name: Take Me Home by CuraOnes
description:
Take Me Home helps a person living with memory loss get home.

A caregiver sets it up once. After that, the app shows just two big buttons:

• TAKE ME HOME - opens walking directions to the saved home in Google Maps (or Apple Maps)
• CALL - a family member's photo. Tap it to call them.

That's all. No menus, no accounts, nothing to remember.

FOR CAREGIVERS
• Setup takes about two minutes
• Find the home automatically while you are there, or type the address
• Check the home on a map before saving
• Add a family member's photo, name, and phone number
• A 4-digit PIN keeps the settings from being changed by accident
• Choose whether the home address is shown on the main screen

11 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Tagalog, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, Armenian, Russian and French. The app follows the phone's language, or the caregiver can pick one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-in
• What you enter stays on the phone
• No ads and completely free

Take Me Home is a free app from CuraOnes, makers of products for families caring for someone with dementia.

Take Me Home is a helper tool, not a safety or emergency service. Walking directions may not always be safe or accurate. In an emergency, call 911.

name: Take&Find: Where I Put It
description:
"Where did I put it?"

Take&Find helps you remember where everyday things are when words, lists, and inventory apps are too much work.

One photo. One voice. Find it easily.

Take a photo and say where it is. A short voice note is required for every memory.

Then see the photo and hear your own voice say where it was.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Tap Take.
2. Take a photo of the thing you want to remember.
3. Tap the microphone and say where it is. Tap again to stop. Recordings can be up to one minute.
4. Listen to the recording, check the recognized words, and tap Fix words or Re-record if needed. Then tap Save.

When you need it later, tap Find and ask a question. Take&Find shows matching photos. Tap Play to hear the voice note you recorded.

WHY PEOPLE USE TAKE&FIND

• Two large choices on the home screen: Take and Find
• Large buttons and large text designed for older adults
• One photo and one required voice note per memory
• Voice questions instead of typing
• Photos first, so results are easy to recognize
• Your own recorded voice, not a computer-generated answer
• Medicine search that recognizes names and doses
• Timeline for browsing saved memories
• A simple way to put memories away and undo by mistake

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• No account
• No ads
• No tracking
• Photos, voice notes, and search indexes stay on this device
• Optional encrypted backup with a password you choose
• Family Sharing for the one-time purchase

SIMPLE PRICING

Save 10 memories for free. Unlock unlimited memories with one $6.99 purchase. No subscription.

name: Tally Counter: Click & Tasbih
description:
Tally counter is a multifunctional app that makes it easy to count anything with a simple tap on the screen. Count people, sports activities, scores, points, steps, inventory, events, days without bad habits, or use it as a digital tasbih counter.

The counter app is useful in many cases. Count any daily activity, for example the glasses of water you drink, the apples eaten, or the pages of the book you are reading. Tally counter helps with more serious tasks as well: traffic analysis, inventory, counting people who attended an event, or the pills taken. The click counter can also count prayers, replacing the traditional prayer beads, also called tasbih.

Features:
• Unlimited counters (create as many as you need)
• Home Screen widgets that count with one tap, without opening the app
• Count from Control Center, the app icon's quick actions or Siri
• Export and import counters to a file (back up or move to a new iPhone)
• Export counters in CSV format
• Light and dark themes, app icons
• Choose the color of each counter
• Full screen mode (count with taps or swipes)
• Rounds mode for tasbih and prayer beads (33, 99, 100 or your own number)
• Flexible counter settings (step, start value, maximum and minimum value)
• Feedback on every count (click sound, vibration, number read aloud)
• Counter history (saved automatically, with calendar and notes)
• Manual sorting of counters (drag and drop) and pinning to the top
• Tags to organize your counters
• Select several counters to reset, tag, export or delete them at once
• Fast count mode (press and hold the count button)
• Complete information about each counter (created date, last reset, highest value and more)
• Archive for counters you don't need right now
• Daily, weekly or monthly goals with reminders
• Stats: streaks, best day, daily average
• Automatic reset every day, week or month
• App lock with Face ID or a PIN
• Your counters stay on your iPhone, no account needed

Use the counter just for fun or for serious tasks: whatever you count, you will never lose count again!

COUNTER PREMIUM
The basic app is free with ads. Premium removes ads and adds stats, goals, reminders, auto reset, quick buttons, all widgets, App lock, app icons and more. Choose Premium Monthly or Premium Yearly (auto-renewable subscriptions; the yearly plan may start with a free trial) or Premium Forever (one-time purchase).

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. A subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://yaroslavgorbach2.wixsite.com/mysite-4

name: Tally Stitch: Row Counter
description:
Tally Stitch is a simple, friendly row counter for knitting and crochet. No ads, no account, no subscription.

COUNT WITHOUT FUSS
• The whole top of the screen is the +1 button: tap it with a knuckle or the end of a needle
• −1 and Undo for when you miscount
• The screen stays awake while you're counting
• A second counter for stitch repeats, which starts again after the last one

PATTERN ALERTS
• "Decrease every 6th row" or "Change colour at row 60"
• Your phone buzzes and shows your note when you reach the row
• See your next alert at a glance

EVERY PROJECT IN ONE PLACE
• Keep as many projects as you like: a cardigan sleeve, a blanket, a hat
• Set the total rows to see how far you've got

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your projects stay on your phone. One price, everything included.

Made in the UK by Coffeehouse Productions.
Questions or ideas? support@coffeehouseproductions.co.uk

name: Tandeméo: Couples Card Game
description:
Tandeméo is the card game for couples: every day, a moment just for the two of you to laugh, discover each other and talk about what really matters.

15 GAMES TO (RE)DISCOVER EACH OTHER
Dilemmas, "Which of us two?", guess my partner, quizzes, rankings, memories, stories written together, riddles, challenges, speed rounds. Each game has simple rules and can last 2 minutes or a whole evening.

100,000+ CARDS
Discovery, humor, memories, plans, romance, travel, everyday life, communication. Pick your mood or let yourselves be surprised: cards adapt to your tastes thanks to a short questionnaire. Plus seasonal packs: Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day.

TOGETHER, SIDE BY SIDE OR FAR APART
- On one iPhone: placed between you, secret answers stay hidden until the reveal.
- Side by side: each on your own phone, the same card at the same moment.
- Far apart: taking turns, whenever you can.
- Want to change your answer? You can edit it until your partner plays.

ONE QUESTION AND ONE CHALLENGE A DAY
A small habit for two, to stay connected even during busy weeks.

SHARED PLANS
Goals broken into steps ("who's on it?"), and 3 to 30-day journeys to move forward together.

RESPECTFUL OF YOUR PRIVACY
No account required: without one, everything stays on your phone. An account is only used to link your two phones. An adults-only "Seduction" space that you turn on only if you want to.

A KIND SPACE
A swear word in an answer? Your partner gets a heads-up and chooses to read it or report it. A report unlinks the accounts right away, and repeated abuse leads to suspension.

FREE
Every card and every game is free. At most one ad every 12 cards, never in the middle of a turn, or one video for a whole ad-free evening. Want peace for good? The "ad-free" option (one-time lifetime purchase, shared with your linked partner) removes them forever.

Tandeméo doesn't grade your relationship or give a "compatibility score": what matters most isn't always agreeing, but keeping the conversation open.

Terms of use: https://tandemeo.com/conditions.html#en
Privacy: https://tandemeo.com/confidentialite.html#en

name: Tank Battle: Phantom Column
description:
Tank Battle: Phantom Column is a top-down tank game and war shooter you can play offline. One thumb to drive, one thumb to aim: you lead a single armored vehicle against an occupying army.

The Protectorate has held the valley for twenty days. From behind the counter of Sorène post office, Odile guides you over the radio. Morvan, the mechanic, repairs whatever you bring back. It is up to you to burn the fuel depots, sink the freighters, blow up the tunnel and take the town back street by street.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• 20 long, multi-stage missions across 5 regions: the valley, the harbour, the snowy passes, the occupied town, the plain.
• 10 vehicles and their drivers: fast jeep, cannon-armed armored car, rocket buggy, amphibious truck, flamethrower, armored railcar, war tractor…
• One special ability per vehicle: artillery strike, armored charge, minefield, wall of fire.
• An upgrade tree for every hero: defence, attack, tactics.
• Destructible scenery: watchtowers, fuel tanks, cranes, hangars, barricades.
• Command tanks to bring down at the end of each mission.
• A story told over the radio, fully voiced in English.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Offline war game: no connection needed to play.
• Twin-stick touch controls built for phones.
• Sessions of 5 to 10 minutes, pause at any time.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
The first 2 missions and 3 vehicles are free. A single purchase unlocks the full game: 20 missions and 10 vehicles. No ads, no subscription, no virtual currency.

name: TankSheet — Aquarium Log
description:
TankSheet — Aquarium Log is a productivity app.

• Simple, focused and easy to start

• Your data stays on your device

We keep TankSheet — Aquarium Log small and fast. If you run into any problem, contact us from the support page — we usually reply within 2 business days.

name: TaperForm
description:
Make a full-size paper template for a tapered circular sleeve. Enter the large and small rim diameters and the axial height. Review the developed sector, check its rim lengths and set the seam side and tab width. Equal diameters produce a rectangular wrap.

Plan a print on A4 or US Letter with portrait or landscape orientation, a chosen margin, overlap and optional 90 degree rotation. The PDF includes numbered tile marks and a 100 mm calibration bar. Save a frozen report and retrieve its PDF and CSV from the Reports library.

The editable Cup collar example guides you through the complete workflow. Pattern records and saved reports can be managed independently.

TaperForm models straight-sided sleeves with concentric circular openings. Print at actual size, verify printer scale and test fit on scrap.

name: TapFlow Rhythm
description:
Tap Flow is a rhythm game built for touch. Notes arrive on the beat, and every one asks for its own move: tap it, hold it, drag along it, flick it or spin around it. String them together and the song starts to flow under your thumb.

FIVE GESTURES, ONE FLOW
• Tap the diamond, hold the square, follow the bead trail, flick the arrow, circle the ring
• Every gesture has its own shape and color, so you can read a chart at a glance
• Notes fill from the middle and hit the edge on the beat: no counting, just feel it

32 SONGS INCLUDED
• Rock, hip-hop, electronic, upbeat, heavy groove, drums and jazz
• Four difficulties per song: Easy, Normal, Hard and Expert
• Every song has a one-hand portrait chart and a two-thumb landscape chart
• Clear Normal to open Hard, clear Hard to open Expert

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Hold the phone upright for one-handed play, or turn it sideways for two thumbs
• Seven short lessons teach each gesture on a click track
• Audio calibration lines the notes up with what you hear, on headphones or speaker
• No Fail mode, a High Contrast theme and adjustable volume

EARN STARS, MAKE IT YOURS
• Earn up to three stars on every chart
• Spend stars on themes and moving backgrounds; stars are earned by playing and are never sold
• Grades, best scores and badges for every song and difficulty

MORE MUSIC
Seven optional song packs add seven songs each: EDM, Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, Dance, Synthwave and Drum & Bass. Buy them in the Store; tap any pack song there to hear a preview first.

No ads. No account. No internet needed to play. Your progress stays on your phone.

name: Tasbeeh Counter: Dhikr
description:
Tasbeeh Counter: Dhikr is a simple digital tasbeeh counter designed for daily zikr, tasbih, and Islamic remembrance. Count your recitations, save your progress, and personalize your counting experience.

Key Features:

• Digital tasbeeh counter  
• Daily dhikr and azkar tracking  
• Save and resume tasbih counts  
• Custom dhikr counting  
• Multiple counter styles and themes  
• Full-screen counting mode  
• Daily and weekly progress insights  
• Reminders for daily dhikr  
• Simple and easy-to-use interface  

Make every dhikr count and stay consistent with your daily remembrance, wherever you are.

name: Tasbeeh Counter: Zikr & Duas
description:
A digital tasbih (tasbeeh) counter that stays out of the way: Muslim prayer beads on your iPhone.

Tap the dome and the count rises as the ring fills. No ads, no account, and it works offline.

• Dhikrs and duas with Arabic, transliteration and meaning, in the order you choose
• Morning and evening azkar (21 and 20) and bedtime duas (14), read one at a time, each with its count and timed to the prayers: after Fajr, Asr and Isha. Salawat, Sayyid al-istighfar and Ayat al-Kursi are among them
• Dua audio: the morning and evening azkar recited in Arabic by Dr. Mohammad Al-Barrak. Play one dua at a time, or tap “Listen to all” to hear the whole set in order, each dua ticked off as it is recited; a slower pace if you like
• Surahs from the Quran: Al-Fatiha, Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, each with its number in the Quran
• The tasbih after prayer: 33 Subhanallah, 33 Alhamdulillah, 33 Allahu akbar, then “La ilaha illallahu wahdahu…” once
• Missed prayers (qada, qaza): a running count of what is still owed for each of the five prayers and Witr. Enter how long prayers were missed (years, months, days) or two dates and the app works out the numbers; take one off each time you make a prayer up
• Your own dhikr: add it in the Duas tab with its words, Arabic and meaning, and a daily goal if you like
• Qibla: on the Prayer tab, hold the phone flat and the arrow points toward the Kaaba, while the ring tells you which way to turn. Pick your city from the list or tap “Find my location”
• Prayer times: the Prayer tab shows all six of the day's times (sunrise included) and “Additional times”: Duha, midnight and the last third of the night; above the counter, the next prayer and the time left. For 43 cities and districts in Uzbekistan, from the calendar published by the Muslim Board of Uzbekistan; for 96 cities and towns in Kazakhstan and Türkiye's 81 provincial centers, calculated on the phone with the method of each country's religious authority
• Home Screen widgets: the next prayer, the day's six prayer times, and a tasbih you count on without opening the app
• Reminders, only if you turn them on: when the time for the morning, evening or bedtime duas comes, and at each prayer you choose, in the way you pick for it: silent or with sound
• Every dua shows its source: the hadith collection and number or the surah and ayah, with the narrator and what the hadith says about it; one tap opens it on sunnah.com or quran.com
• Dhikr counter with rings of 33, 99 or 100, sound and haptics, and a soft tone at the end of each round
• Daily and weekly stats, your streak, a 30-day calendar and milestones at 7, 30, 40 and 100 days
• Save your counts to a file and move them to another phone
• Text size: five sizes each for the Arabic, the transliteration and the meaning; four colours (Blue, Samarkand, Emerald, Lapis), each light and dark
• Six languages: Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian, English, Kazakh, Turkish

No data is collected; everything stays on your phone. The app goes online only to refresh Uzbekistan's prayer times once a week and, when you ask for it, to download the duas' voice (about 6 MB). Nothing about you is sent, and the weekly refresh can be turned off in Settings. Your approximate location is read only when you tap “Find my location”, and it never leaves the phone.

Zikr is not an app of any official body and is not affiliated with them: the times follow their published calendar or method.

name: Taskwright
description:
Taskwright is a calm, offline-first task manager for iPhone and iPad. Buy once, own forever — no subscription, no account, no cloud, no tracking.

FEATURES
• Natural-language capture — type "Pay rent every 1st at 9am !high" and Taskwright detects the date, time, repeat rule and priority on your device.
• Today and Upcoming — see what matters now, with overdue items first and a 14-day view grouped by day.
• Smart lists, custom lists and projects — Starred, All, Someday, progress rings and color-coded organization.
• Recurring tasks — daily, weekly on chosen weekdays, monthly on a specific day, yearly, or every N days. The next occurrence is scheduled automatically.
• Subtasks, notes, flags and priority badges.
• Local reminders with lead time and quiet hours.
• Focus timer with a calm countdown and completion feedback.
• Insights — seven-day completion chart, completion by list, streak and focus minutes.
• App Lock with Face ID / Touch ID.
• Full backup export and import.

PRIVACY
Your tasks stay on your device. Taskwright has no servers, no analytics, no ads and no third-party SDKs. It does not collect personal data. Local notifications are scheduled only on your device. Export a backup whenever you like and keep it wherever you want.

SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Email tiansuqun@outlook.com. Taskwright is designed and developed by Suqun Tian.

name: TatLedger
description:
TatLedger is a private, offline tattoo journal for iPhone and iPad. Keep a beautiful record of your collection and follow your healing journey — without an account, a subscription, or a single byte leaving your device.

COLLECTION
• Log every piece with title, artist, studio, city, date, style, placement, and personal notes
• Add photos from your library; images are stored only in the app's private container
• Browse a photo-first grid, filter by artist, and sort by date
• Edit or delete any entry with confirmation

AFTERCARE
• Start a 21-day plan for a fresh tattoo with a daily five-step checklist
• Track progress day by day, log healing photos, and set a one-off touch-up reminder
• Plans move from Healing to Healed automatically, and can be deleted at any time

ARTISTS & STUDIOS
• See artists and studios aggregated from your collection, with piece counts
• Save contact notes for each artist

INSIGHTS
• Explore your collection with style, placement, and per-year charts

PRIVACY FIRST
• 100% offline. No account, no analytics, no cloud sync, no data collection
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID lock with passcode fallback
• Export a PDF report, a CSV file, or an AES-GCM encrypted .tatledger backup, and restore it locally
• Local reminders only — notifications never carry your data off the device

TatLedger is a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads.

General aftercare information only — not medical advice. For concerns about a healing tattoo, consult a qualified professional.

name: TDB Mail
description:
TDB Mail is the app for business email hosted with The Domain Base. Read, write and organise mail on your company's own domain, with your calendar and contacts in the same place.

WHY TEAMS CHOOSE IT
• Mail that reaches the inbox: SPF, DKIM and DMARC are set up for you, and the app shows your sender health in plain words.

TDB Mail works with mailboxes hosted by The Domain Base (thedomainbase.com). Your company admin creates mailboxes in the Domain Base dashboard.

name: Teamsheet Team Generator
description:
Teamsheet builds two fair sides for 5-a-side or larger games.

Create an account, add your players, and tick who is in today. Balance teams splits an even number of players into two sides with the closest ratings. Ten players becomes 5 v 5. Twelve becomes 6 v 6.

Record the score after the game. Ratings move, so the sides stay fair next week. You can also share the league table, or pick the teams yourself.

name: Tekir: Ukraynaca Öğren
description:
Ukraynalı sevgilinin annesiyle sofrada sohbet etmek ister misin? Tekir, biraz şımarık bir Türk tekiri; sana Ukraynacayı gerçek hayattan, sesli ve animasyonlu sahnelerle öğretir.
Reklam yok. Klavye değiştirme derdi yok. Ezber tablosu yok.
Kiril alfabesinden ilk sohbetine kadar, her gün birkaç dakika.

■ SESLİ SAHNELERLE ÖĞREN
• Ana dili konuşanların seslendirdiği kısa, animasyonlu diyaloglar. Her karakterin tek ve hep aynı sesi var; kulağın alışır.
• A1'den A2'ye 7 ünite, yaklaşık 58 sahne. Yenileri yolda.

■ KİRİL ALFABESİ, ADIM ADIM
• Kiril alfabesi dersleriyle harfleri sıfırdan tanı.
• Her kelimede otomatik okunuş ipucu: привіт → privit.
• Harf kartlarıyla yaz: telefonuna Kiril klavye eklemene gerek yok.

■ GERÇEKTEN İŞE YARAYAN ALIŞTIRMALAR
• Boşluk doldurma, hâl ekleri çalışması, cümle kurma
• "Rolü sen oyna": sahnedeki karakterin yerine sesli konuş
• Aralıklı tekrar: hem kelimeleri hem cümleleri tam unutmak üzereyken yeniden önüne getirir

■ ZATEN BİLİYORSUN
Türkçe ile Ukraynaca sandığından yakın. Ortak kelimeleri ve sahte arkadaşları keşfet. Dikkat: кавун "kavun" değil, karpuz demek!

■ KAYINVALİDE SINAVI
Halyna seni akşam yemeğine çağırdı. Sesli rol oyununda doğru sözleri söyle, kültür puanını topla, karneni arkadaşlarınla paylaş.

■ ÇİFT MODU
• Ortak seri: ikiniz çalıştıkça seri büyür.
• Günlük çift cümlesi: sen sesini kaydet, Ukraynalı partnerin dinleyip puanlasın ve doğrusunu kendi sesiyle kaydetsin.

■ TEKİR'İN DEFTERİ
Gerçek hayat için 120 hazır cümle: kafe, ulaşım, eczane, pazarlık, aile yemeği, aşk, acil durum. Ana dili konuşanın sesiyle, internetsiz çalışır.

■ MOTİVASYON, KEDİ USULÜ
• Keşfet akışı: sesini paylaş, ana dili konuşanların telaffuzunu puanla
• Haftalık lig, günlük görevler ve sandık
• Tekir'e bak: çalıştıkça onu besle
• Van kedisi ve Ukrayna Levkoy'u dahil 9 koleksiyon kedi ırkı
• Kültür dükkânı: вишиванка, kaftan, İznik çinisi, рушник ve fazlası
• Instagram ve TikTok için sesli video kartları, kültür kartları

■ KİMLER İÇİN?
• Ukraynalı sevgilisi, eşi ya da ailesi olanlar
• Ukraynalı misafir, müşteri ya da iş arkadaşıyla çalışanlar
• Ukrayna diline ve kültürüne merak salan herkes

■ TEKİR PREMIUM
• Tüm üniteler
• Seri koruma
• Çift modu
• Sınırsız ses paylaşımı
• Premium eşyalar

description:
