name: Telugu Lipi: Script & Grammar
description:
Telugu Lipi (తెలుగు లిపి) helps you learn to read and write the Telugu script through a rare, digitally preserved handwritten Telugu grammar manuscript.

For generations, Telugu grammar was taught from carefully handwritten notebooks passed from teacher to student. Telugu Lipi brings one of these manuscripts to your iPhone, transcribed line by line into clear, readable Telugu and arranged as simple lessons you can follow at your own pace. Whether you are a beginner learning your first letters, a student preparing for exams, a parent teaching children at home, or someone reconnecting with your mother tongue, Telugu Lipi gives you a calm, focused place to learn.

15 GRAMMAR LESSONS FROM THE MANUSCRIPT
• Letters (అక్షరాలు): the 16 vowels, 37 consonants and the special signs ం, ఁ and ః
• Alphabet System, Words, Sentences and Sentence Construction
• Grammar Rules and Grammatical Terms (సంజ్ఞలు)
• Parts of Speech (భాషా భాగములు): nouns, pronouns, adjectives, indeclinables and verbs
• Sandhi (సంధి) and Samasa (సమాసము): how words join and combine
• Cases (విభక్తులు), Persons (పురుషములు), Genders (లింగములు) and Tenses (కాలములు)
• Figures of speech (అలంకారములు)
Every lesson keeps the manuscript's own wording and its original examples, so you learn grammar the traditional way.

-EXPLAIN IN SIMPLE ENGLISH
Not sure what a line means? Turn on 'Explain' and tap the button under a line to see a short, clear explanation in plain English. Each explanation is written by hand for that exact line and built into the app, so it appears instantly and works even without an internet connection. Tap again to hide it and keep reading.

QUIZZES TO TEST YOURSELF
• Over 150 questions across the grammar topics
• Pick the topics you want, choose Easy, Medium or Hard, and decide how many questions to answer
• Every answer option is shown in full, with instant feedback after each question
• See your score at the end and try again whenever you like

HISTORY OF THE TELUGU SCRIPT
• A timeline showing how the Telugu script developed over the centuries
• Short profiles of the poets, grammarians and scholars who shaped the Telugu language
• Notes on historic manuscripts and further resources for deeper study

DESIGNED FOR COMFORTABLE READING
• A beautiful Telugu typeface that is easy on the eyes
• Adjustable text size, so lessons are comfortable to read for every age
• A clean, calm design that keeps the focus on learning
• Smooth, native iPhone experience

HELP US KEEP IT ACCURATE
Spotted a mistake? Use "Report a mistake" at the end of any lesson, or "Send feedback" in Settings. Every report is read by our team and used to correct and improve the lessons.

FREE, PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No account, no login and no sign-up
• No tracking or analytics
• Your settings stay on your device

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Telugu Lipi is a free, non-commercial cultural and educational project by Cortexa Technologies. Our goal is to preserve a traditional handwritten Telugu grammar manuscript and make it easy for anyone, anywhere in the world, to learn the beauty of the Telugu script.

More lessons and features are on the way. Visit https://telugulipi.cortexatech.in to read the lessons on the web.

మన భాష, మన లిపి — learn it, love it, share it.

name: TempoKeep - Simple Metronome
description:
TempoKeep is a free, simple metronome that just works.

Set the tempo, tap it in, and press Start. A clear, steady click and nothing in your way. No account, no sign-up, no clutter.

• Free to use
• 30–300 BPM
• Plus and minus buttons, a slider, or tap tempo
• A solid, even click, the same sound every time
• Keeps clicking with the screen off
• Remembers your last tempo
• Optional one-time $1.99 to remove the small banner ad. No subscription.

Great for practice, lessons, rehearsals, and everyday playing.

name: Tend the Fire: Evening Ritual
description:
A calm game for the last few minutes of the day. You carry a light home across a small dark island, then write one line about how your day went.

No ads, no account, no internet.

Here is what an evening looks like.

You tap your way across the island tile by tile, light the fires you pass and bring your light home. It takes a few minutes and nothing is timed.

At home there is a tree. Every light you bring back hangs on it, and with every evening it grows fuller.

Then you put the day down. Three breaths with a warm light, then one question about your day. You answer with a tap, something like "A conversation did me good." If you feel like it, you finish the sentence in your own words. It stays with that evening's light on the tree. Then the game says good night, and you put your phone away.

If you miss a few evenings, the tree's glow gets softer. It comes back when you do, and nothing is lost.

If you want, the game reminds you in the evening with a line you wrote yourself.

You hear the sea, the wind, an owl now and then, and a duduk. It is best with headphones, and you can set each sound separately.

Your evenings and your lines stay on your iPhone.

Maybe you have started a journal before and dropped it after a week. This asks for less: a few cozy minutes of play at bedtime, three breaths, and one line to wind down with. Some nights it will be gratitude and some nights just a sentence about the day.

name: Tension Bolt
description:
Pop pins. Release the tension.

A little workshop. A beautifully tangled jig. Pull or tap a clear spring collar and watch its acrylic plate snap free. Inspect each rocker's swing path: release it over an uncleared collar and it can wedge. Use Undo or Free Restart to try another order.

Clear 100 fully free jigs, from First Spring to intricate mechanical lattices. Progress from single rockers to overlapping assemblies with multiple interference points. There are no color trays, waiting slots, or timers. Free Restart lets you experiment. Hints and undo use visible booster counts.

Optional VIP Pass: one purchase for a golden crown and brass workshop theme, plus daily +2 Hints and +2 Undos. The US starting price is $2.99; the app displays the App Store's localized price. This release has no ads for anyone. VIP also includes permanent ad immunity if advertising is introduced later.

Build 1.0.0 (1). Every mechanical assembly runs completely offline without paywalls or mandatory transactions.

name: Tents: Logic Puzzle
description:
Pitch a tent beside every tree. Each tree gets its own tent right next to it, tents never touch each other (not even at a corner), and the numbers outside the grid say how many tents stand in each row and column.

Tents is a logic puzzle with three simple rules and surprisingly deep deductions. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 CAMPSITES, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 6 × 6 meadow to a 15 × 15 summit
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each campsite unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 6 × 6 to 15 × 15, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for a tent, tap again to mark it as grass; drag to mark many cells at once
• Auto grass: placing a tent marks the empty cells around it as grass (can be turned off)
• Numbers of complete rows and columns are ticked; touching tents and rows with too many tents are marked (in amber, or blue if you prefer)
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: ten techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards
• A solved board links every tree to its own tent

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: TermBeacon
description:
Keep terminology decisions explicit. TermBeacon checks plain-text documents against a glossary you create, lets you approve individual findings, and saves new copies with a complete review record.

WRITE THE RULES
Create preferred terms and list their exact variants. The matcher uses fixed ASCII case folding and ASCII word boundaries. It does not guess meaning, grammar, spelling or translation.

REVIEW MULTIPLE DOCUMENTS
Write documents in the app or import UTF-8 text through Files. Select a glossary and up to 30 documents for a scan. Each finding shows its matched text, preferred replacement, context and source position.

APPROVE EACH CHANGE
Approve a finding or keep the original. Preview the new copies before saving. Unapproved text is preserved, and overlapping approvals must be resolved rather than being silently dropped. Applying changes creates new text copies; it does not overwrite imported originals.

KEEP AN INDEPENDENT REVIEW
Saved reviews retain the exact glossary, document revisions, findings, choices and resulting copies. Editing or deleting the source glossary or document leaves the saved review intact. Search reviews and filter changed or unchanged records.

EXPORT THE DETAILS
Generate one UTF-8 TXT copy per document, a complete CSV finding log, and JSON containing the frozen inputs and results. Preview or share the actual files, with their byte sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints.

CLEAR LIMITS
A glossary supports up to 50 rules, with 1-5 explicit variants per rule. Terms use 1-60 printable ASCII characters. Each document supports 50,000 UTF-16 units; a scan supports 200,000 units in total and up to 2,000 findings. A scan that exceeds the finding limit is rejected instead of being truncated.

Glossaries, documents, reviews and generated files are stored locally in the app. Delete individual records or use Clear local data in About. External originals, shared copies and system backups are separate.

name: TerminOrt
description:
TerminOrt bringt dich ohne Anruf zu deinem Termin – beim Friseur, Barber, im Nagelstudio, bei Kosmetik, Massage oder Tattoo. Eine App für alle: für Kundinnen und Kunden, für Mitarbeiter im Laden und für Salonbetreiber.

FÜR KUNDEN
• Salons in deiner Nähe entdecken, nach Kategorie filtern und nach Name, Straße oder Ort durchsuchen.
• Auf der Salonseite siehst du Adresse, Öffnungszeiten, Leistungen mit Dauer, den Bewertungsschnitt mit Anzahl, das Team und ob es eine Treuekarte gibt.
• Leistung, Mitarbeiter, Tag und Uhrzeit wählen und eine Anfrage senden. Der Salon nimmt sie an oder lehnt ab – du siehst den Stand sofort.
• Jeder Termin ist ein Ticket unter „Termine“. Mit „Ich komme“ sagst du zu, du kannst eine Verspätung melden, absagen oder den Termin in deinen Kalender übernehmen.
• Im Salon zeigst du deinen QR-Code zum Einchecken und bekommst deine Wartenummer. Du siehst live, wann du dran bist.
• Nichts frei? Trag dich auf die Warteliste ein, wir melden uns, wenn etwas frei wird.
• Digitale Stempelkarten: Bietet ein Salon ein Treueprogramm an, bekommst du für jeden abgeschlossenen Termin automatisch einen Stempel. Ist die Karte voll, löst das Team die Prämie ein.
• Nach dem Termin bewertest du mit Sternen und kurzen Aussagen. Öffentlich ist nur der Durchschnitt, keine Einzelbewertung.
• Mitteilungen zu deinen Terminen, z. B. Erinnerung vor dem Termin oder wenn auf der Warteliste etwas frei wird – jede Art einzeln abschaltbar.
Für Kunden ist TerminOrt kostenlos.

FÜR MITARBEITER
Wer von einem Salon eingeladen wird, bekommt in derselben App den Bereich „Arbeit“:
• Die Warteschlange steuern: aufrufen, vorziehen, überspringen, abschließen, als nicht erschienen austragen.
• Anfragen annehmen oder ablehnen, die eigenen Termine des Tages sehen.
• QR-Codes der Kunden scannen, Laufkundschaft als Nummer anlegen.
• Eigene Arbeitszeiten und Termin-Intervalle einstellen, Prämien von Stempelkarten einlösen.
Dein Profil gehört dir: Wechselst du den Salon, nimmst du deine persönlichen Bewertungen mit.

FÜR SALONBETREIBER
Im Bereich „Salon“ pflegst du Stammdaten, Geschäftszeiten, Leistungen und Kategorien, Logo und Titelbild, lädst dein Team ein, schaltest ein Treueprogramm ein und reichst die Unterlagen zur Verifizierung ein. Die Warteanzeige für den Laden läuft im Browser jedes Bildschirms, den du schon hast (Smart-TV, Tablet) – gekoppelt über einen kurzen Code aus der App. Sie zeigt Nummern, keine Namen.

GUT ZU WISSEN
• TerminOrt ist reines Zeitmanagement: Salons hinterlegen Leistungen mit Dauer, die App zeigt keine Preise.
• Öffentlich erscheinen Menschen nur mit Vorname und Initial („Ben K.“).
• Ein Konto für alles, Anmeldung mit E-Mail-Adresse und Einmalcode – kein Passwort.
• Sprachen: Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch, Türkisch, Arabisch, Farsi und Chinesisch (vereinfacht). Hell- und Dunkelmodus.

name: Terniq: Learn Python & Java
description:
Build programming skills, one short lesson at a time. Terniq guides you through Python and Java with clear explanations and hands-on challenges.

Predict program output, fix bugs, arrange code, and write your own solutions. Follow two beginner learning paths, from variables and loops to functions, objects, and practical problem solving.

Set a daily goal, build a streak, and revisit skills that need practice. Lessons, quizzes, coding challenges, and the freeform Code playground all work offline, and progress stays on your iPhone without an account. Enter source and standard input, run or stop your program, and review output and errors. Language libraries and resource limits are described in the app.

Eight units and forty lessons in each language. Eighty focused lessons. No subscriptions, ads, or account required.

name: Tessa F. Grayson Reader
description:
Psychological thrillers that begin where other stories end.

The reading app for the novels of Tessa F. Grayson. Read samples on iPhone and iPad in English, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

Read your way: turn pages or scroll, four backgrounds from light to black, three typefaces including one for dyslexic readers, adjustable text size, line spacing and margins.

Keep what matters: bookmarks, coloured highlights and notes. Sign in to have them on all your devices.

Switch languages mid-chapter and land in the same place in the other edition.

No ads, no tracking. No account needed to read.

name: Tetherline: Camera Remote
description:
Tetherline turns your iPhone into a wireless shutter release and intervalometer for long nights with a camera on a tripod: star trails, city lights after dark, clouds rolling over a ridge.

Remote
Fire one frame per tap or a burst of a few seconds, lock focus with a half press, run a self-timer with a delay and a set number of shots, and start or stop video. With several cameras paired, Fire all cameras triggers them together.

Timelapse
Start from a preset for Clouds, City night, Stars or Star trails, then set the interval, the number of shots, the exposure and a start delay. Tetherline checks that each exposure ends before the next shot is due and tells you when it would not.

A log of every shot
Each timelapse keeps a session log: which shots were planned, which ones the camera acknowledged, and how far each one drifted from its planned time. If a frame is missed, you see it in the log instead of finding a gap in the sequence at home.

Made for the dark
Red Night turns the whole interface red so your eyes stay adjusted to the sky, and it can start at launch. Large buttons work with gloves on. Silent mode turns off every haptic for wildlife and quiet sets. Keep the screen awake during a timelapse and the timing stays exact.

Field tools
Star exposure gives the NPF value for sharp stars with your sensor, focal length and aperture. ND filter exposure works out the shutter time behind a filter of up to 20 stops. Depth of field shows the hyperfocal distance and the near and far limits of sharpness. Every calculation runs on your iPhone.

Cameras
GoPro HERO9 Black to HERO13 Black connect over Bluetooth through the published Open GoPro interface. This support is marked Experimental in the app until it passes our own hardware tests. Other camera brands are listed in the app with their testing status. A demo camera, labeled as simulated everywhere, lets you try every control before you pair a camera.

Tetherline Pro
Tetherline Pro is an optional in-app purchase. With your own camera it runs timelapses longer than 10 shots and pairs more than one camera, so Fire all cameras can trigger them together. The remote, self-timer, session logs, field tools and the demo camera work without it.

No account, no analytics, no advertising. Your cameras and session logs stay on your iPhone.

Tetherline is not affiliated with GoPro. Brand names describe compatibility only.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.cihat.dev/tetherline/privacy-policy/

name: Texas & Jack
description:
Texas & Jack is a futuristic cyberpunk tactical probability calculator and strategy lab engineered for Texas Hold'em and Blackjack enthusiasts. Powered by an offline native Swift math engine, it delivers instant equity simulations, exact dynamic programming EV, live shoe counting, and interactive strategy charts—all wrapped in a crisp neon HUD interface.

TEXAS HOLD'EM NEURAL ENGINE
• Hybrid Exact & Monte Carlo Solver: Instant 100% exact board enumeration for postflop heads-up spots, plus high-speed Monte Carlo sampling (3K / 10K / 30K runs) for preflop and multi-way pots (1–8 opponents).
• Dual Opponent Modes: Simulate against random hand pools or specify exact hole cards for up to 3 opponents.
• Outs & Draw Scanner: Automatically identifies clean outs on the Flop and Turn, highlights Flush, Straight, and Combo Draws, and calculates exact Turn and By-River hit probabilities.
• Pot Odds & EV Solver: Dial in pot size and call amount to compute break-even equity, pot odds ratio, net expected value (+EV / -EV), and tactical recommendations.
• Full River Hand Distribution: Visual probability breakdown across all 9 poker hand categories from High Card to Royal Flush.

BLACKJACK EXACT DP SOLVER
• True Expected Value Engine: Computes exact EV for Stand, Hit, Double Down, Split, and Late Surrender via memoized dynamic programming.
• Customizable Table Rules: Configure 1–8 decks, S17 vs H17, Double After Split (DAS), Late Surrender, and 3:2 vs 6:5 payouts with real-time House Edge impact.
• Next-Card Risk & Dealer Odds: Inspect safe-draw, exact-21, and bust percentages alongside the dealer's complete final outcome distribution (17–21, Blackjack, Bust).
• Live Shoe Link: Sync directly with the Card Counter to factor real remaining shoe composition and True Count deviations into your EV calculation.

NEURAL SHOE COUNTER & KELLY ENGINE
• 4 Classic Counting Systems: Switch seamlessly between Hi-Lo, KO, Hi-Opt I, and Omega II.
• Rapid Card Entry: Record dealt cards with a 3-Zone Speed Pad or Exact Rank Grid (2–A) with remaining card counters, Undo, and Shoe Penetration tracking.
• Kelly Criterion Bet Sizing: Dynamic unit spread recommendations based on bankroll, base unit, and selectable Kelly fraction (1/4, 1/2, or Full).
• Illustrious 18 Deviation Radar: Real-time index alerts when the True Count crosses key strategy deviation thresholds.

STRATEGY MATRIX LAB & ANALYTICS HUB
• 169-Hand Preflop Matrix: Interactive 13×13 Texas Hold'em range heatmap by position (UTG, HJ, CO, BTN, SB, or raw equity) with one-tap import into the calculator.
• Rule-Synced Blackjack Basic Strategy Charts: Hard Totals, Soft Totals, and Pair Splits that dynamically update to match your active table rules.
• Odds & Rule Codex: Quick reference for Rule of 2 & 4 draw odds, classic preflop matchups, and Blackjack rule house-edge deltas.
• Bankroll Variance & RoR Simulator: Visualize simulated bankroll trajectories and Risk of Ruin estimates, plus archive and replay saved hand analyses locally.

Note: Texas & Jack is strictly an offline mathematical probability calculator and strategy study tool. It does not offer real-money gambling, wagering, or prizes.

name: Tezio
description:
Tezio gives you one great idea at a time from the classic books that shaped how we think: Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus, Montaigne, Franklin, Thoreau, Schopenhauer and more.

Each card puts the author's point in one sentence, explains it in plain words and shows how to use it today. Flip the card to see the original quote, the exact place in the book and the edition it comes from. When an idea grabs you, open the deep dive: a three-minute read on what the author really meant.

TODAY'S IDEAS
Five cards every day, about three minutes of reading. Ideas you have already read don't come back.

LIBRARY
27 classics and 356 ideas. Browse by book or by topic: time, money, habits, decisions, relationships and manipulation. Shake your phone for a random idea.

WHO SAID IT?
A short quiz: read an idea and its original quote, then guess the author.

SAVE AND COLLECT
Save the ideas you want to keep and sort them into your own collections. The home screen widget shows the idea of the day.

READ IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Cards, deep dives and the whole app in English, Czech, Spanish, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Polish. Tezio follows your phone's language.

HONEST ABOUT SOURCES
All books are in the public domain. The cards and deep dives are written with the help of AI from the original texts and checked against them, and every card links to the edition it is drawn from.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Everything stays on your phone and the app works offline.

From want it, the makers of Publiqum.

name: The Beauty Education
description:
The Beauty Education is where hairstylists learn, practise and grow together, with Adriana Dobre and her team of trainers.

LEARN STEP BY STEP
Video lessons filmed in the salon, from the first section to the finished style. Courses are split into short chapters you can follow at your own pace, on your phone, between clients.

GUIDES THAT EXPLAIN THE WHY
Illustrated guides on the theory behind hairstyles: shapes, lines, volume and finish, so every style you build has a reason.

A COMMUNITY OF HAIRSTYLISTS
Share your work in the feed, ask questions, get answers from the trainers and from hairstylists around the world. Message other members privately.

STAY ON TRACK
Your week at a glance, points for what you learn and post, and notifications when someone answers you.

Created by The Beauty Education, the largest community of hairstylists in Romania, with more than 3,500 students trained by Adriana Dobre.

name: The Hindu Book
description:
The Hindu Book is your daily companion for Sanatana Dharma: prayers with meaning, today's Panchang, every festival explained, and a guide to more than 34,900 temples. Free, with no ads.

PRAYERS YOU CAN READ ALONG
• Hanuman Chalisa, Aartis, Mantras, Stotras, Suktas and the Bhagavad Gita (all 700 verses)
• The original Sanskrit or Hindi, an easy transliteration, and the meaning in Hindi and English

EVERY FESTIVAL, EXPLAINED

34,900+ TEMPLES

The app is free and has no advertising. Your data is never sold.
Website: https://thehindubook.com

name: The Key Wall
description:
Every key has a place. Every guest leaves a clue.

Welcome to The Key Wall, an atmospheric logic puzzle game set in a vintage hotel. Behind the front desk, misplaced keys, forgotten letters, and conflicting records await your attention. Read the evidence, connect the details, and work out where everything belongs.

THINK LIKE A DETECTIVE
Study guest records, luggage tags, breakfast logs, and letters. Deduce each guest’s status and link the evidence that supports your conclusions. Placing the right key is only part of the solution.

WORK THROUGH 32 SHIFTS
Explore four chapters with eight shifts each. Progress from room assignments to puzzles involving travel companions, master keys, and connecting doors.

RETURN FOR TODAY’S SHIFT
Take on a different starting layout each day, complete the daily challenge, and build your streak.

REFINE YOUR SOLUTION
Use hints when you need a nudge, undo a mistaken move, or restart a shift to try another approach. Replay cases to improve your move count and earn challenge goals.

SETTLE INTO THE ATMOSPHERE
Dark wood, antique brass, and warm lamplight bring the hotel to life. Arrange items by dragging them or use tap controls. Adjust sound, haptics, contrast, and motion to suit your preferences.

PLAY OFFLINE
No account or internet connection is required. There are no ads or in-app purchases, and your progress and settings stay on your device.

Your shift is about to begin. What will the key wall reveal?

name: The Loop Mug Club
description:
Download the Loop app for access to NOTW and Three 3’s Mug Club & special perks!

With the Loop Mug Club App you will find:

- The Three 3’s and Neck of the Woods Brewing shared mug club
- Members Only Rewards
- Tap Lists 
- Notifications

Stay connected to both Neck of the Woods and Three 3’s Brewing! Check out our tap lists, and join the Loop Mug Club and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: The Midnight Post
description:
A mailbag turns up in a floating postbox. Inside is a single request: find 199 more letters and bring the bag back. Join Mara and Pip aboard The Midnight Post.

Swipe to change the tide. Every boat glides until something stops it. Bring each numbered boat to its matching dock, and plan ahead: once a letter is delivered, the boat that blocked your way disappears.

Sail through 200 puzzles with illustrated letters from winter and summer ports. Meet the families, cooks, musicians and night-shift workers celebrating Hanukkah, Christmas, Kwanzaa, Yaldā, Dongzhi, Hogmanay, Junkanoo, Shōgatsu and more. Read their letters at your own pace.

Chase a better score in the on-device Rogues’ Gallery. Replay a favorite voyage or tackle the final twenty, where four boats must finish in the shortest possible number of moves.

The first 20 letters are free. A single Full Game purchase opens the remaining 180.

name: The Night Guest
description:
Something fell from the sky tonight. It is small, it is hungry, and nobody invited it.

The Night Guest is a hand-drawn tap-puzzle horror game with a dark sense of humour. You are the creature. Tap the things around you, work out the right order, and make each scene end the only way it can: badly, for everyone else.

• Seven hand-painted scenes, from a muddy puddle to the farmhouse bedroom
• One tap is all you need: no inventory, no timers, nothing to read
• Start as a worm and grow into something much worse
• Cartoon blood, grim jokes and plenty of ways to get it wrong
• Stuck? The eye button gives you a hint, but it costs you skulls
• A final score that tells you what kind of guest you were
• No ads, no purchases, no account. Plays offline.

Best played at night, with the sound on.

name: The Plaice Chase
description:
Swim the streets of Bude as a plaice from The Plaice, the fish and chip shop on Queen Street, in a fast seaside chase.

Eat every chip on the streets, then race back into The Plaice to finish the level, while pirate gulls sail out from their ship and try to catch you.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe or use the arrows to steer your plaice
• Eat every chip, then swim back into The Plaice
• Grab a Bude Light: the lighthouse beam dazzles the gulls, and you can bump them back to their ship
• Swim along the Bude Canal: you're faster in the water and the gulls are slower

THE BUDE TOUR
12 levels through real Bude streets: Lansdown Road, The Strand, Belle Vue, Morwenna Terrace, Kings Hill, Summerleaze Crescent and more. The town changes every level and the pirate gulls get faster.

BUDE STAMPS
The Castle, the Sea Pool, the Breakwater, Crooklets, Compass Point and more pop up for a few seconds. Reach them to collect all 8 stamps.

Play upright or turn your phone sideways.

Free to play, with adverts. Optional purchases: fish credits (carry on without an advert) and removing adverts.

name: The PSS Oric Collection
description:
THE PSS ORIC COLLECTION

Five arcade games that PSSreleased for the Oric-1 in 1983,
recreated in MonoGame and rebuilt for modern screens — with the same rules, sharper
sprites and synthesised sound.

INVADERS — the classic descent. Shields, a mystery ship across the top, and a
formation that speeds up as it thins out.

CENTIPEDE — a mushroom field, a centipede that splits when you hit it, a spider that
drops in, and a flea that repairs the field.

HOPPER — four river lanes of logs and diving turtles, a patrolling snake, three
traffic lanes and five home bays. Tilt the phone to hop.

ELEKTRO STORM — six cities, three batteries and a sky full of missiles. Drag to aim,
tap to burst.

LIGHT CYCLE — Tron-style trails, rival cycles and rounds that get faster. Tilt to
turn; the bike will not let you reverse.

EVERY GAME, PROPERLY TUNED
Four skill levels — Novice, Skilled, Veteran and Ace — change enemy speed, numbers
and the score multiplier (x1, x1.25, x1.5, x2). Skilled is the 1983 challenge.

HIGH SCORES THAT STAY
Each game keeps its own top ten, with the skill level, the level reached and the date.
Nothing is lost when you close the app.

BUILT FOR PHONES AND TABLETS
Landscape play, on-screen pads for the games that need them, tilt steering for Hopper
and Light Cycle, and a tap-to-aim crosshair in Elektro Storm. iPad gets the full
1280x720 board at native sharpness.

No adverts. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected.

The original games are ©PSS. This collection is an independent
recreation: all code and artwork are new.

name: The S.K.E. Universe Voyage
description:
The S.K.E. Universe Voyage turns your iPhone or iPad into a window on a slow voyage through space.

Set it on a stand and leave it running. The voyage travels through 40 stops, from the worlds near home to the Orion Nebula, the Pillars of Creation and on across the Milky Way, with a tour guide's line at every stop: what you are looking at, how far it is from home and how to find it in your own night sky.

• A gold-framed window onto a live 3D universe
• Ahead of you, Where you are and The journey: the stop, a map, the distance and the speed
• Works offline: everything is inside the app, nothing is downloaded
• No account, no adverts, no tracking: the app collects no data
• The screen stays on while the voyage plays

Made by S.K.E. Media Ltd in the United Kingdom.

name: The Study & Society
description: Some places are simply made for good work. The Study & Society is a boutique community-working space in Portland's Pearl District, and this app is your key to it. Reserve a quiet study for deep focus, gather your team in a beautiful room, or settle in for the day, all in a few taps. Your day, beautifully arranged: • Book meeting rooms, day desks, and private studies • Unlock the door and check in on arrival • Manage your membership, bookings, and invoices in one place • See what's happening, and stay close to the community Whether you come to focus, to create, or simply to be among people doing the same, everything here is designed to make your best work feel effortless. The Study & Society. A beautiful place to get things done. Focus. Create. Connect. Belong.

name: THEOI - Greek Gods Tarot
description:
Seventy-eight gods, heroes and monsters. Every card is a god with a tone of voice, a myth and a single line to say.

THEOI is a tarot deck built on Greek myth. The 22 Major Arcana are Olympian gods and primordial forces — Dionysus for the leap, Athena for craft, Hades for endings, Gaia for the whole. The 56 Minor Arcana follow four myth families from beginning to end: the love of Eros and Psyche, the twelve labours of Heracles, the curse on the house of Atreus, and the marriage of Hades and Persephone.

READ A CARD, NOT A SYMBOL
Turn a card and the god speaks first: one line in their voice. Then the upright meaning, the reversed shadow, the myth behind it, and one concrete thing to do this week.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Card of the day — one god, one line, every morning
• Three-card spread: past, present, future
• All 78 cards with meanings, myths, keywords and shadow sides
• Your own journal of readings, kept on your device
• Works offline, installs to your home screen
• English and Turkish

FREE AND FULL
The 22 Major Arcana are free. A one-time purchase unlocks the remaining 56 cards and the five-card cross spread. No subscription, no account.

WHAT IT IS NOT
THEOI does not predict the future and is not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice. A reading is a structured pause: you bring one question, the deck brings a point of view.

Original illustrations. No accounts required. No ads. No third-party tracking.

name: Therapy Room for Therapists
description:
The Therapy Room helps you create a calm, safe space for your clients in seconds.

Made by OLIP Therapy, an award-winning hypnotherapy and counselling practice, it brings together original soothing music and natural sounds that you can mix together and play quietly in the background of your sessions.

Pick a piece of music, add a natural sound like gentle rain or a crackling fire, set the balance, and let the room settle. Everything loops smoothly, so there are no sudden stops or jarring silences while you work.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Counsellors and psychotherapists
• Hypnotherapists
• Coaches and mindfulness teachers
• Massage, holistic and wellbeing practitioners
• Anyone who wants a calm, peaceful room

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Nine original pieces of calming music, composed for therapy and relaxation
• 18 natural sounds, including rain, ocean waves, crackling fire, woodland birds, mountain stream, distant thunder, wind chimes, a singing bowl and a peaceful train journey
• Beautiful scenes that change to match the sound you choose

SIMPLE TO USE
• Tap a picture to play. Music and sound play together.
• Separate volume sliders for music and sound, so you get the balance just right
• Seamless loops, or play each track once and fade out gently
• Move to any point in a track with the slider
• One button pauses and restarts everything
• Your mix is remembered for next time

WORKS OFFLINE
Save any track, or everything at once, inside the app. Saved tracks play straight away, even with no internet, so a weak signal never interrupts a session.

MADE FOR THE THERAPY ROOM
The sounds are gently softened and evenly balanced, so nothing is harsh, sudden or distracting. Sounds sit quietly under the music and never take over the conversation.

No account. No adverts. No subscription.

The Therapy Room is a tool for creating a relaxing atmosphere. It is not a medical treatment and does not replace professional care.

name: THH
seller_name: The Hillingdon Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description: The THH Staff App has specifically been produced and designed to offer both current and future employees relevant information related to their work. Whether seeking information about policies and procedures, following us on Twitter or even taking advantage of special offers, all can be found here

name: Thicket: Nature around you
description:
Point your camera at a bird, a flower, a beetle or a mushroom, or pick a photo you already took. Thicket lifts it out as a die-cut sticker. Then choose its name from the species people see where you are, at this time of year.

YOUR JOURNAL
Every find sticks to the day you found it. Pinch to fold days into months and years, or look back by trip.

A PAGE FOR EVERY SPECIES
When to look for it near you, what it sounds like, what it's often mistaken for, and where it was seen lately.

PRACTICE
Quick decks from your own finds, against their look-alikes.

RARE FINDS
Thicket counts how often your find's species had been recorded near where you found it. Rare finds get a gold star, and a first record nearby gets a flag.

AROUND YOU
What lives near you this month, a species to look for each day, and a widget for your home screen. Save an area for places without signal.

SEARCH IN YOUR OWN WORDS
"Venomous snakes", "edible mushrooms", "what's flowering now", "birds I haven't found". Answers come only from what people have recorded near you.

STAY SAFE
Venomous snakes, spiders and scorpions, plants that poison or burn skin, and deadly mushrooms carry a red mark, and their pages say why. Fungi pages say whether a species is known to be edible or poisonous. Never eat or touch a wild plant or mushroom because an app named it.

SHARE AND POST
Share a find as a card or a sticker. Post it to iNaturalist through iNaturalist's own app, so others can confirm the name.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your finds stay on your phone.

Species, photos and sounds come from iNaturalist and the people who share there. Thicket isn't made by iNaturalist.

name: Thimble Stack Union
description:
One little sprout can hop. A whole tower can open a greenhouse.

GROW THE STACK
Move through a waiting sprout to add them to your crew. Everyone travels together. Stand under a high flower so the top sprout can reach it and open the vine gate. Each shelf asks for a taller crew. At the summit, watch the stack fan out into separate flower entrances.

CATCH THE UPDRAFT
Explore 50 routes through five districts. Move into the rising air between platforms and let a spinning fan lift the whole crew. Wait for a ribbon gate to lift, ride a Petal Ferry across a gap, jump from Crackle Moss before it breaks and time your steps around falling dew.

PICK UP AND GO
Tools work automatically. Touch a Bloom Coil for a high jump, grow a Vine Bridge as you approach a gap or catch a second lift with Sky Vine. Bloom Tonic restores a missing heart, and a Pocket Hourglass returns the crew to a checkpoint after a fall.

CLIMB YOUR WAY
Drag across the playfield to steer, up to hop or diagonally up to do both together. Collect dewdrops for extra stars and replay cleared routes to improve your personal best. Daily check-ins earn petals to reserve a Tall Seed for a future climb.

Play offline with no account, ads or in-app purchases.

name: ThinPlace
description:
Where the veil wears thin.

The Thin Place has two halves: a real investigation kit that measures your room with your phone's own sensors, and a creepy AR game where something is hiding in your house.

THE KIT

EMF METER: Your phone's real magnetometer as an analog needle and five lights. It reads magnetic fields: wiring, speakers, chargers, magnets, metal. Zero it, walk slowly, and find the source before you blame the house.

EVP RECORDER: Record the room, and it marks every place a sound rose above the room's own quiet. Play any piece back normal, slowed and boosted, or reversed.

NIGHT VISION: The camera, green and grainy like real gear, with a motion flag that outlines anything that moves between frames.

SPIRIT BOX: A sweep of static with fragments flicking past too fast to catch. Ask a question, listen, and log what you heard.

INVESTIGATION LOG: Every reading and recording from a session, with its time, kept on your phone.

THE HUNT

A game. Five restless ones are hidden around your room in AR. The meter heats up as you get close, the spirit box catches their words, and if you look straight at one from close by, it shows itself. Catch all five before they find you. They creep. They lunge. Sometimes they're behind you. Jump scares can be turned off for little ones.

HONEST BY DESIGN

Every Kit tool tells you exactly what it measures. None of it can prove a ghost, and nothing here pretends to. Most of what you'll find is the house. Finding what it is, is the hunt. The Hunt's ghosts are made up for the game.

Nothing is uploaded. Recordings stay on your phone. No accounts. No ads. Free.

name: Thousand Wings
description:
You don't fly one bee. You are the swarm.

Thousand Wings is an exciting adventure where you lead a living swarm of bees across five worlds and bring them safely home. Battle a giant hornet, a garden spider, a bee-eater, a brown trout, a pipistrelle bat, a praying mantis and, finally, the grizzly.

Every bee is alive, and every bee counts.

ONE SWARM, FOUR MOVES
• Drag to lead the swarm over meadows, rivers, rooftops and storm clouds.
• Pinch in to squeeze the bees into living armor that shrugs off rain and punches through spider webs.
• Spread your fingers to scatter, dodge a diving bird and forage every flower.
• Pull far apart to split the swarm in two, then bring your fingers together to regroup.

COOK A HORNET IN A HEATBALL
Squeeze tight around a giant hornet and the swarm heats up until it can't survive, just like real Japanese honeybees do. Watch the thermometer: hold too long and you cook your own bees.

Five Amazing and Dangerous WORLDS
• Meadow & Orchard: bloom the meadow and beware the hornets.
• River & Forest: leaping trout, lily pads and spider webs.
• Storm Fields: shelter from rain, ride out the wind, dodge the lightning.
• Farm & Night Town: outrun the crop duster, resist the glowing bug zappers, hide from bats.
• Honey Thief: autumn falls, and a grizzly is raiding the hive.

CLOSE-UP 3D DUELS
When a predator gets close, tap BATTLE and the world drops to bee scale. Read the wind-up, dodge at the last moment and punish the opening with a storm of stings. Face a giant hornet, a garden spider, a bee-eater, a brown trout, a pipistrelle bat, a praying mantis and, finally, the grizzly.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• The first two levels are free, with a guided first flight.
• One purchase unlocks the full journey: every world, every duel and the final reward.
• No ads, no subscriptions, no energy timers.
• Plays offline. No account. No data collected.

Earn three stars on every level, unlock checkpoints, and bring a thousand wings home.

name: THXO Guard
description:
THXO Guard is the gatehouse app for security guards of housing estates, condominiums and workplaces that use the THXO business system. One device is shared by every shift, and everything recorded at the gate reaches the system at once, so the estate office and the security supervisor see it too.

At the gate
• Scan a visitor QR, a vehicle sticker, or type a plate. The app answers in colour: green to pass, yellow to check, red to stop
• Log resident vehicles in and out with one tap
• Let in visitors who hold a pass issued by a resident
• Register walk-in visitors, find the unit or resident, and ask the resident through the app or LINE
• Warns on watch-list matches and records the reason when entry is denied
• See who is still inside and check them out when they leave

Patrol
• Today's patrol rounds and the checkpoints to visit
• Scan the QR at each checkpoint and mark it normal or abnormal

Parcels
• Receive parcels for a unit; the resident is notified
• Hand over with the resident's 6-digit pickup code
• See the permits valid today, such as contractors and moving

Shift handover
• Check the gate equipment against a list and pass on open issues
• The next shift acknowledges in the app

Incidents and emergencies
• Record incidents with a severity level
• When a resident calls for help, a red bar appears on every screen: acknowledge, arrive and close the case
• Guards can raise an emergency alert themselves

Works when the network drops
• Vehicle logs, checkpoint scans and incidents are kept on the device with the real time of the tap and sent automatically once the connection is back

Signing in
• The security supervisor pairs the device with a gate once, by QR or code
• Each guard taps their name and enters a 6-digit PIN; shifts change without pairing again

Requires your organisation's THXO system (th-xo.com).

name: THXO Resident
description:
THXO Resident is the app for residents of housing estates and condominiums whose juristic office runs on the THXO system. Deal with the office and the guard post from your phone.

Common fees
• See your outstanding balance and every bill
• Pay with the estate's PromptPay QR and send the transfer slip in the app

Visitors
• Register guests in advance and send them a QR to show at the gate
• When someone arrives unannounced, the guard asks you in the app — allow or deny in one tap
• See 30 days of visits to your home

Requests
• Report repairs, complaints or questions, follow the status and reply
• Report problems in common areas

Parcels and facilities
• Know when a parcel arrives, with a pickup code
• Book the clubhouse, meeting room or courts
• Apply for renovation, moving or contractor permits

Notices and meetings
• Read and acknowledge notices from the office
• Register for general meetings, vote on agenda items and view disclosed financial statements

Security alert
• Press and hold the alert button and choose the kind of incident; the estate's guards are notified at once
• This app does not replace emergency numbers. In a life-threatening emergency call 191 or 1669 (Thailand).

How to sign in
• Ask your estate's juristic office for a sign-in QR or link, then scan or paste it once
• Sign out or delete your account yourself under "บัญชีของฉัน" (My account)

Works only with estates whose juristic office uses THXO (th-xo.com).

name: Thyrion
description:
Thyrion είναι το έδρανο βάρδιας για θυρίδες, φράγματα και διώρυγες.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
1. Άνοιξε τον Πίνακα. Οι σταθμοί είναι ήδη εκεί· διάλεξε αυτόν της βάρδιας σου.
2. Στείλε εντολή. Όρισε στόχο 0–100%, φύλλο (Μαζί / Αριστερό / Δεξί), αιτία, και τσεκάρισε τα δύο κλειδώματα ασφαλείας.
3. Παρακολούθησε την κίνηση. Τα φύλλα κινούνται με τον χρόνο διαδρομής της θυρίδας. Το Στοπ τα σταματά αμέσως.
4. Κατάγραψε. Διελεύσεις, βαθμονόμηση, συναγερμοί και παράδοση γράφονται στο ημερολόγιο.
5. Πλάνα. Ένα έτοιμο πλάνο φέρνει σταθμό και στόχο κατευθείαν στο έδρανο.

Τι κρατάς στο χέρι
• Ζωντανό άνοιγμα αριστερού και δεξιού φύλλου, μαζί ή χωριστά
• Υδρολογία: ανάντη, κατάντη, πτώση, παροχή και όγκος θαλάμου
• Συναγερμοί για υψηλό άνοιγμα, χαμηλή πτώση και ασυμφωνία φύλλων
• Μητρώο θυρίδων με αναζήτηση, αγαπημένα και φίλτρα
• Εξαγωγή καταγραφής ως κείμενο

Το Helikon δουλεύει εξ ολοκλήρου στη συσκευή, ως ψηφιακό δίδυμο για άσκηση βάρδιας, επιτόπια σημείωση και ιχνηλασιμότητα. Δεν συνδέεται με εξωτερικό σύστημα SCADA.

name: Tick-a-Lot: Shared Lists
description:
Tick-a-Lot keeps the lists two people share: the weekly shop, the suitcase, the sights of the next trip.

Send a list as a link. The other person opens it, in the app or in a browser, and every tick shows on both phones at once. No account, no sign up.

• Base list: everything you usually buy. Make this week's list from it in a few taps.
• Say it: "croissants 2 packs of 3, organic eggs" becomes two items with amounts and notes.
• Pictures by themselves: each item gets an emoji from its name. Add a photo in one tap.
• Your store's aisles: type once which aisle each section is in, and the list follows your walk.
• Packing: copy your usual list for each trip and tick what is in the bag.
• Things to see: name a town, get its best known sights with photos, split into days with a walking route.

Lists stay on your phone. Only a list you share goes to the cloud.

name: TICKLETOAST
description:
Something small is living on your phone.

It's hungry. Or sulking. Or chasing a fly. Or fast asleep with its light still on. TICKLETOAST is a pocket creature on a glowing dot-matrix screen straight out of 1997, and it is quietly paying attention to you.

IT LEARNS YOU
It notices when you usually feed it and starts waiting at the door. It gets bored of the same dinner. It figures out where you always look in hide-and-seek, then hides somewhere else, looking very pleased with itself. Poke it too hard and it remembers. It never tells you any of this. You just watch, and slowly get to know each other.

TICKLE IT
Every creature has one secret ticklish spot. Find it.

RAISE A ONE-OF-A-KIND
Crumb, Bun, Loaf, then a grown-up shaped by how it lived: playful, social, curious, cozy, easygoing or a bit rough around the edges. Six grown-ups to discover, an elder with bushy eyebrows, and no two personalities alike.

TEACH IT TRICKS
Catch it doing something cute (a spin, a bow, a little song), give it a treat, and it learns. Practice makes it reliable. Stubborn ones make you work for it.

A WORLD OF ITS OWN
Mornings, nights, seasons and different weather every day. It chases snowflakes, watches the rain, finds treasures, gets visits from birds and draws on the walls while you're out.

FRIENDS
Swap a code with a friend and your creatures visit each other, trade treasures, wave hello and have live playdates on one shared screen. Close friends can even help hatch the next egg. Messages between friends are end-to-end encrypted and deleted once delivered.

FOUR LITTLE GAMES
Guess which way it'll turn, hide-and-seek, Copy me and Catch. Every one of them learns how you play.

NO GUILT, EVER
Being away isn't neglect: after a while it curls up and rests, so holidays are safe. Nights are safe too. No streaks, no nagging notifications, no ads, no account, no loot boxes. It works offline.

A LIFE WORTH REMEMBERING
A life lasts about two weeks and ends gently of old age. Each one leaves a page in your keepsake book, written only from what really happened: its name, its best friend, the gifts it kept, what it loved. Then there's a new egg.

THE WARDROBE
One optional purchase, once: beanies, crowns, specs and more, all hand-made in dots, plus every outfit added later. Your creature loves one, wears most, and shakes off the one it can't stand. Clothes are looks only. They never change care, health, mood or visits.

Your creature lives on your phone, not on a server. Move it to a new phone any time with a move code.

Made in Melbourne. Say hello: hello@tickletoast.com

name: Tickoo: To-Do List & Diary
description:
Head full of stuff? Just say it.

Tickoo turns whatever you say, type or paste into clear little to-dos: today, a certain day, or someday. Each lands where it belongs.

Close the day each evening. Check off what you did, move the rest to tomorrow with one tap, or simply let it go. No completion rates, no nagging. Unfinished isn't failing.

Through it all, your buddy (Radish Bunny, Mushroom Cat, Potato Pup or Blueberry Bear) is quietly by your side. Each night it keeps your day as a little hand-drawn page, with it doing what you did. Had ramen? It might be lounging in a giant bowl of noodles. Day by day, the pages fill an album of the days you spent together.

· Speak or type, and AI sorts it into to-dos
· Evening review: tomorrow / someday / let it go
· A little page for every day you spend together, kept in a monthly album
· A gentle evening reminder you can move or turn off
· Optional sync between iPhone and Mac, end-to-end encrypted, no account

Tickoo Pro: sorting to-dos with AI and the daily doodle need Tickoo Pro. New users get a 7-day free trial. Pro renews monthly or yearly and can be canceled anytime in Settings.
Terms of Use: https://tickoo.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tickoo.app/privacy

name: Tickpoint: Exact Time
description:
Hit the exact moment.

Ticket drops, flash sales, limited releases — when everyone taps at once, a split second decides it.

Tickpoint syncs with the global time servers of Apple, Cloudflare and Google plus public time servers in your region, keeps the fastest reply, and shows you the sync accuracy — so you know how precise it really is.

DYNAMIC ISLAND
Go to the Home Screen or any app and the time sits beside the Dynamic Island, down to 0.1 second. Requires an iPhone with the Dynamic Island (iPhone 14 Pro and later models that have it).

FLOATING CARD
A clock that floats over any app, in four sizes — from an unobtrusive thin strip to a large card with network speed.

COUNTDOWN
Set the start time and a lead time; zero is the moment to tap. By default the beeps sound like a radio time signal: one pip at 10 s, a short pip each of the last 5 seconds and a long tone at zero. A classic style is also available.

ALSO
• Follows your phone's time zone, or pick a fixed one
• Works in landscape, with a two-column layout on an unfolded foldable iPhone
• 7 languages
• No data collected, no account, no ads

Free: precise sync, floating card (medium), time zone, network speed.
One-time unlock: Dynamic Island, all card sizes, countdown. No subscription.

name: TideTrail Journey
description:
Explore 16 coastal locations across Washington State and discover the marine life you may encounter at each one. Check each location’s difficulty, open detailed descriptions, save favorites, and share places you’d like to visit. Mark spots as visited as you go. Each location includes a photo, a list of local fauna, and a short guide to what makes the area worth exploring.

Use the map to find all 16 locations or add your own. Place a pin, upload a photo, and add a name and description to save a personal spot on the map. Your custom locations are marked separately, so they’re easy to recognize.

Browse 16 marine species and learn where they can be found. Save species to your favorites, mark them as seen, and share interesting discoveries. Test what you’ve learned with a short fauna quiz. Plan an outing with the seasonal tide utility: choose a season, time range, and location to explore estimated water levels, snorkeling suitability, potential time in the water, plus sample weather and wind. These estimates are for informational purposes only and do not represent real-time tide or weather conditions.

Prepare for your trip with an editable checklist of essential items. Mark the eight default items as packed and add your own. Keep saved locations and marine species together in Favorites, organized into separate tabs for convenient access.

name: Tidewell Rhythm
description:
Tidewell is a calm, private wellness journal for logging your daily rhythm and cycle patterns on your own device.

Daily Overview & Rhythm Guide
Check today's cycle window and personal planning estimates at a glance. Log mood, symptoms, or BBT in seconds, or draft an entry with Rhythm Guide.

Visual Cycle Atlas & Trends
Explore confirmed periods and estimated windows in Cycle Atlas, tap Log Day on any date, and follow Cycle Length History plus recurring signals by phase for calm cycle trends.

Discreet On-Device Storage & Reminders
Schedule custom local notifications and reminders days ahead of upcoming estimates. Tidewell uses private on-device storage with zero public feeds.

Wellness Disclaimer
Tidewell provides personal estimates for everyday wellness tracking only and is not a medical device or contraception tool.

name: Tidy Up: Room Sort Puzzle
description:
Turn a cluttered little house into a tidy one, room by room.

Tap everyday objects to fill the matching basket orders. Pieces that don’t match an active order go onto a shelf with limited space, so the order of your picks matters. Look through layered piles and pinch to zoom in on the items you need.

Work through 30 handcrafted rooms, from a sunny sitting room to a busy laundry room. Each room has its own layout and assortment of objects. Clear the last order to see the finished room, then move on to a new space. Finish the campaign to unlock Encore.

Optional coin packs are available through in-app purchases.

name: Tierdrop: Photo Cleaner
description:
Tierdrop is a photo cleaner for iPhone and iPad that lowers your iCloud+ storage bill: it shows what it takes to move to a cheaper plan, or how long until you'd have to pay for a bigger one, and helps you get there safely. Everything runs on your device: no account, no uploads, no tracking.

STOP PAYING FOR PHOTOS YOU DON'T WANT
Tell Tierdrop your iCloud storage plan, paid or the free 5 GB. It measures your photo library and gives you a goal you can actually reach:
• Drop a plan: how much to clear to fit the next plan down, and what you'd save each year
• Stay on your plan: when you'll fill it at the pace your library is growing, and what each cleanup buys you in months
• Stay free: how to keep the free 5 GB from filling up

SHRINK INSTEAD OF DELETING
Videos are where the gigabytes are. Tierdrop re-encodes big ones on your device at up to 1080p (4K videos usually come out 40–75% smaller) and keeps the date, place, favorite and albums. Compare before and after first.

Every Live Photo hides a short video. Turn the ones you only want as pictures into stills: the photo itself isn't touched, and the video goes.

Either way, the original waits in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

WHAT TIERDROP FINDS
• Exact duplicates, even copies saved months apart
• Similar shots and bursts, with the best faces and focus marked Best
• Blurry photos, judged by the sharpest part of the picture, so portraits with a soft background aren't flagged
• Screenshots
• Your largest videos, biggest first

SUGGESTIONS YOU CAN TRUST
Only the sure things start out selected: exact copies, near-identical burst frames and photos that are blurry beyond doubt. Everything else is shown as your call. Tierdrop never asks about a photo you chose to keep.

SWIPE YOUR CAMERA ROLL CLEAN
Go month by month: swipe left to send a photo to the Bin, right to keep it. Undo any swipe.

NOTHING DELETED BY SURPRISE
• Everything waits in a Bin you review first
• Favorites and photos in your albums are protected
• Smart Merge: before a duplicate is deleted, its favorite, albums and location move to the copy you keep
• Deleted items stay in Photos › Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Cleanup History keeps a private receipt of every cleanup

A SAFE DOWNGRADE, AND PROOF IT PAID OFF
Downgrading while you're over the smaller plan can leave photos unsynced. Tierdrop tells you when it's safe and lists the exact steps in Settings. Confirm the downgrade and it keeps a running total of what you've saved.

PRICING
Cleaning is free and unlimited: scanning, every category, swiping and deleting, with no ads. Tierdrop Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks the full path to your goal and unlimited shrinking (2 videos and 20 Live Photos are free). No subscription, no weekly charges.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
How do I lower my iCloud storage plan?
Clear enough photos and videos to fit under the smaller plan, empty Recently Deleted, check your total in Settings, then downgrade in Settings › [your name] › iCloud. Tierdrop calculates the target and guides each step.

How do I avoid paying for more iCloud storage?
Free up space before your plan fills. Tierdrop forecasts when that will happen and shows what to clear or shrink first.

Does Tierdrop upload my photos?
No. All analysis happens on your iPhone or iPad. Tierdrop has no servers and no account.

Is Tierdrop a subscription?
No. Cleaning is free. Tierdrop Pro is a single one-time purchase.

Can I undo a deletion?
Yes. Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted in the Photos app for 30 days, and Cleanup History shows what changed and until when you can recover it.

Tierdrop measures your photo library; backups, iCloud Drive and other data are entered by you, and the forecast is an estimate. Savings depend on your plan and region. iCloud and iCloud+ are trademarks of Apple Inc.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://trdventures.net/apps/tierdrop/privacy

name: Tiferet - AI Outfit Planner
description:
Tiferet turns the clothes you already own into outfits for every day and occasion, from Monday at work to Sunday service to a Saturday owambe.

SNAP YOUR WARDROBE
Take or pick photos of your clothes. Tiferet cuts each piece out of its background and tags it for you: type, colour, pattern, material, style and how formal or warm it is. Check the tags in one tap and fix anything it got wrong.

YOUR OWN 3D AVATAR
Build an avatar that looks like you, or start from a selfie and let Tiferet suggest your skin tone, hair and face shape. See every outfit on your avatar before you put it on.

AN OUTFIT FOR TODAY
Each morning, Today picks an outfit from your wardrobe for your local weather and your plans. Not feeling it? Swap a piece or get a new pick, and log what you wore so Tiferet keeps your rotation fresh.

PLAN FOR EVENTS
Add church every Sunday, a wedding next month or a naming ceremony; set the dress code, and Tiferet plans outfits for every date. Western or traditional: senator, agbada, ankara gowns and more. Lock the looks you love, and get a reminder the evening before so you can get ready.

STYLE ROULETTE
Swipe through outfit ideas from your own clothes. Keep the ones you like, and Tiferet learns your taste.

PLAY AND LEVEL UP
Earn XP for adding clothes and logging what you wear, finishing weekly challenges, keeping your streak going and unlocking new poses for your avatar.

SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Invite friends with a code, share a look and let them vote. Only friends you accept can see what you share; nothing is public.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads and no tracking. We use your photos only to build your wardrobe; we round your location to about 1 km and use it only for weather, and you can delete your account at any time.

Tiferet is free. You must be 18 or older to use it.

name: TiffinBuddies: Tiffin Manager
description:
TiffinBuddies keeps every subscriber of your tiffin or mess service in one place: their meals, the days they skip, what they owe and what they have paid. Each morning it tells you how many of each dish to cook and where every tiffin goes, and each subscriber gets their own page to skip a meal, pick a dish and pay you by UPI.

Made for home cooks, tiffin services, mess and PG kitchens, and office lunch suppliers.

TODAY'S COOK AND DELIVERY LIST
• For each meal: how many tiffins of each dish to cook, by plan, after the skips
• The notes to cook by: "no onion", "less spicy", "one without chilli"
• The delivery list by area, with call and directions buttons, and "delivered" as each one goes out
• Give deliveries to your team: each delivery person sees their own list
• Print the lists on a receipt printer, or share them

SUBSCRIBERS AND THEIR ACCOUNTS
• Each subscriber's plan, meals, days, number of tiffins, price and address
• Every meal sent is added to their account at the meal's last time to skip; skipped meals never are
• See who owes money and who has paid ahead, and how many days it covers
• Record payments in cash or UPI, and adjust for an extra roti or a discount
• Add what someone owed or paid ahead before they joined

A MENU THEY PICK FROM
• Keep your dishes and a weekly menu for lunch and dinner, and change any single day's menu
• Subscribers pick a dish before the meal's last time to skip, or get the regular one
• A special dish can cost extra, and dishes can be for one plan only, like Jain
• Someone with several tiffins can have a different dish in each

SKIPS, HOLIDAYS AND DAYS OFF
• Subscribers skip a meal on their page, or every meal while they are away
• You set the last time to skip each meal; after it, the list is final
• Close a meal or a whole day for a festival: nobody is charged for it
• Each subscriber can have their own days: Monday to Saturday, weekdays only, and so on

EACH SUBSCRIBER'S OWN PAGE
• No app to install: send the link in one tap
• Their balance, next meals, the menu, skip and pick buttons, and two months of meals and payments
• A statement for any month, to print or save as PDF, with GST for services with a GSTIN
• They can ask to stop or change their tiffin, and you are told

PAYMENTS BY UPI, STRAIGHT TO YOU
• Subscribers pay your own UPI ID from their page, with the amount filled in
• They tap "I've paid", and you confirm it once the money reaches you
• No payment gateway and no fee from us: the money comes straight to you

NOTIFICATIONS
• To subscribers who turn them on: the day's menu when there is a dish to pick, "your lunch is here", payments received, a reminder when they owe money or their advance is running out, and the monthly statement
• To you and your team: payments to confirm, same-day skips and requests to stop or change

BRANCHES, TEAM AND REPORTS
• Run more than one kitchen from one account; staff only see the branches you give them
• Reports for each month: tiffins by day, dish and plan, money received, skipped meals and what is still to collect

SIMPLE AND SECURE
• Log in with your mobile number and password, or with a one-time SMS code
• Works on iPhone and iPad, and in any web browser on a computer
• Subscribers' phone numbers and addresses are never shown on their pages

TiffinBuddies is made by CarryBuddies.

name: Tijera
description:
Tijera es la agenda de tu barbería, pensada para el barbero que corta todo el día y no tiene tiempo para planillas.

HOY, DE UN VISTAZO
• El marcador del día: quiénes vinieron, quiénes no y cuánto cobraste, en guaraníes.
• El próximo turno siempre arriba, con el teléfono del cliente a un toque.
• Filtrá por silla para ver la agenda de cada barbero.

AGENDÁ EN SEGUNDOS
• Elegí servicio, barbero, día y hora, y listo.
• Mandale al cliente la confirmación y el recordatorio por WhatsApp.
• Marcá "Vino" o "No vino" para llevar la cuenta real del día.

TU BARBERÍA, ORDENADA
• Clientes: historial y contacto de cada uno.
• Servicios y precios en ₲, sin centavos.
• Horarios de atención, bloqueos y feriados.
• Equipo: sumá barberos y recepción, cada uno con su permiso.

RESERVAS ONLINE
Tus clientes reservan solos desde el mini-sitio de tu barbería (tijera.com.py/tu-barberia) y el turno aparece en la app al instante, con aviso.

Hecho en Paraguay, con horario de Asunción.

name: Tile Joy
description:
Pick a tile, make a triple, and clear your way through 100 layered puzzles in Tile Joy.

Tap uncovered tiles to move them into a seven-slot rack. Match three identical designs to clear them and make room for your next move. As you remove tiles, new choices appear underneath. Plan ahead so your rack doesn't fill up before your next match.

• Explore 100 levels, from small stacks to boards with up to 192 tiles.
• Match colorful toy designs, including rockets, crowns, and doughnuts.
• Use Undo to reverse your last eligible move, Pocket to set aside up to three tiles, or Shuffle to rearrange the tiles still on the board.
• Unlock new levels and replay completed puzzles to improve your star ratings.
• Pick up where you left off with automatic saves, and adjust sound and haptics separately.

Play offline, with no ads and no account required.

name: Timbral — Pitch & Voice
description:
Timbral is a real-time singing pitch trainer and speaking voice analyzer built for iPhone.

TRAIN YOUR INTONATION
- Match Mode: Hear a target note in your vocal range and lock onto it on a 60 fps scrolling pitch ribbon with a ±20¢ target lane, cent meter, hold-steady lock bar, and automatic octave-offset cues.
- Guided Drills: Practice 6 vocal exercises — 5-Note Scale, Major Triad, Octave Leap, Major Scale, Interval Jumps, and Chromatic Slide — automatically transposed to fit your range, with an end-of-drill accuracy scorecard.
- Free Studio Tuner: Sing or hum freely with live note and frequency readout plus a scrollable reference piano bar.

MEASURE YOUR SPEAKING VOICE
- 10-Second Voice Check: Speak naturally to measure your median pitch, speaking octave, octave distribution, and where your voice sits on adult male and female speaking pitch curves.
- Vocal Quality Metrics: Inspect register-calibrated clarity (HNR), pitch steadiness (jitter), volume evenness (shimmer), expressiveness, tonal balance, and vocal fry — plus play back your clip and match your singing range in one tap.

BUILT FOR EVERY VOICE
- Presets from Bass (E2–E4) to Soprano (C4–C6), custom note bounds, and live microphone range calibration.
- Choose Warm Piano, Soft Hum, or Pure Sine reference tones, adjust pitch tolerance (±10¢ to ±35¢), and tune A4 from 432 Hz to 448 Hz.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All microphone capture, pitch detection, and voice analysis run locally on your iPhone. No account, no cloud upload, no ads, and no tracking.

name: Time Machine: Hebrew Trivia
description:
Please note: the game is in Hebrew only (questions, buttons and stories) and was made in Israel. It is also a fun way to practice your Hebrew, three minutes a day.

Everyone knows it happened. But when?

What year was the first mobile phone call? If you said "oh, the eighties", welcome to the club. It was 1973, and the phone was as big and heavy as a brick.

Time Machine is a short daily game for everyone who is sure they remember. Every day there are six moments from history, from Israel and the world. You get 30 seconds for each: scroll the timeline, stop, and find out whether you remembered or just sounded convincing.

No homework, three minutes a day
Six moments, the same for everyone, and new ones tomorrow. Faster than finding parking.

The street changes with you
One woman (or one man) on one Israeli street. Scroll the years, and the clothes, shoes, cars and signs change before your eyes. In 1920 she holds a record, in 1988 a phone the size of a shoe, and in 2100 the cars are already in the air.

Even a wrong answer wins you a story
After every answer you see how many years you were off and what really happened, in a short story you can drop at dinner and look clever.

Your history teacher is grading again
The leaderboard is an old school notebook: names in blue pen, remarks in red pen, and a yellow marker on you. Yes, there is also "Parents' signature!".

Family arguments, finally with a score
Open a group for family, friends or work, send a WhatsApp link, and find out who really remembers and who is just loud. Every group is a cassette with a handwritten name.

The closet
Hit the year? The outfit of those years comes out of its bag and goes on a hanger. 34 looks, from 2500 BCE to the future, and you can wear them on the home screen.

Four more eras
Antiquity, the Middle Ages, the Age of Discovery and the near future, with events that can be calculated, like eclipses and round anniversaries. Each era has its own moments, closet and leaderboards. One era opens for free when you fill 12 looks in the closet.

What is free and what is not
The daily game, leaderboards, groups and closet are open to everyone. "Unlimited" opens free play, the archive and all the eras, with no ads. You pay once, and it is yours for life. In a time machine, that is a serious commitment.

No sign-up and no password. Pick a name and off you go, with sound or in total silence in the middle of a meeting.

So when did the Berlin Wall fall? When did the first person walk on the moon? And when did Israel first win Eurovision?
The engines are warming up. Download, scroll and find out.

Know a moment that must be in the game? Write to me from the app. I read and answer everyone.

name: TipScore: Rate & Tip
description:
TipScore helps you decide what to tip at a restaurant. Rate the service to get a suggested tip, then enter your check total to see what you’ll pay.

Choose cash or card, round the final payment if you like, and see both the recommended tip and the tip you’ll actually leave. Dining with a group? Let diners rate the service, split the bill, and save the meal for later.

name: Title City: City Builder
description:
Build a city on a real spot on Earth and grow it from a few homes into a skyline.

Pick any place on the map. The water, woods and parks around your city come from the real place you choose. Then lay roads, zone homes, shops and industry, and watch your people move in.

RUN THE CITY
• Power, food, fire, police, schools and hospitals all matter
• Set taxes, balance the budget and keep your approval up
• Real-time construction: big buildings take hours and keep going while you're away
• Natural disasters, traffic jams and a city newspaper that reports on you

WIN ELECTIONS
• Every few days your people vote. Shake hands, hold rallies and run ads
• Build the Mayor's Mansion and run for Governor against real players in your state

BRING PRO SPORTS HOME
• Build a soccer field, arena, ballpark or stadium
• Put a pro team on the ballot, name it, and train it up
• Your teams play real players' cities, and every Sunday night the top teams play for the title

PLAY WITH THE WORLD
• Real cities from real mayors in the rankings
• Weekly skyline challenge, landmark auctions and fresh building drops

Champ, your advisor, tells you what to build next, and the Next button always points to the most useful thing to do. Small towns are safe from disasters while you learn.



Questions? regentathletegroup@gmail.com

Free to play. Title Tokens can be bought in the City Store if you want to move faster. Tokens buy time and style; they never decide who wins. All money in Title City is play money: nothing in the game can be cashed out or exchanged for anything of value.

PASSES (OPTIONAL AUTO-RENEWING SUBSCRIPTIONS)
• Council Pass: $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year. 150 tokens right away, 25 tokens every day you play, buildings go up twice as fast, +1 construction crew.
• Mayor's Pass: $9.99 a month or $79.99 a year. 300 tokens right away, 50 tokens every day you play, buildings go up twice as fast, +2 construction crews, gold nameplate in the rankings.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A pass renews automatically for the same length and price unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel a pass any time in your App Store account settings. Prices are in US dollars and may differ in other countries.

Terms of Use: https://titlecity.titleshotgames.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://titlecity.titleshotgames.com/privacy.html

name: Tivelle: M3U & IPTV Player
description:
Bring your live channels, movies and series into one library. Tivelle is an IPTV player for your own sources. Add an M3U playlist, connect with Xtream Codes, or open a direct media URL.

Subscription required for playback. A one-time lifetime purchase also unlocks playback. Adding playlists, browsing and searching are free.

Find something to watch
Browse recently added movies by poster and see episodes grouped by season. Search your library, explore your provider’s categories, or add an XMLTV program guide to see what’s on now and what’s next.

Pick up where you left off
Resume movies and episodes from Continue Watching on the same device. Save favorites and choose from available subtitle tracks.

On iPhone and iPad, open an SRT or WebVTT subtitle file in the player.

Access and purchases
Tivelle Premium unlocks playback and favorites. Choose an auto-renewing weekly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Eligible subscribers can try the weekly plan free for three days. It renews at the local weekly price shown before purchase unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial or current billing period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings.

Bring a source you have permission to use. Tivelle does not supply channels, movies, series or an IPTV service. Artwork, program listings and subtitle tracks depend on your source.

Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy
https://maalsaleh0.github.io/Tivelle-Policies/privacy/

name: Tmp Camera
description:
A camera for photos you only need for a little while: where you parked, a printer test page, a label, a receipt you will type in later.

Shots stay inside the app and delete themselves after 24 hours, or a time you choose. Nothing to clear and nothing to confirm. They never go into your photo library unless you tap Save to Photos.

Apps like this already exist. I wrote this one because I did not want to hand my photo library to an app from a developer I knew nothing about. Tmp never reads your photo library, and it is open source, so you can read all of it: github.com/NelsonScott/tmp-pics

- The camera stays open so you can take a few shots. Done takes you back.
- Tap a shot to share the full-size photo, save it to Photos, or delete it now.
- Pick how long shots last: 1 hour, 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or never.
- Delete them all at once, or open straight to the camera.

No ads, no account, no analytics, no network code.

name: Toca el Ritmo: Notas y Música
description:
Toca el Ritmo es un juego musical rápido y adictivo: bajan barras de colores y tienes que tocar solo las que corresponden. ¡Cada toque suena una nota de la canción!

• Toca las barras de color y no dejes que se escape ninguna.
• Cada nivel va más rápido. ¿Hasta dónde llegas?
• Gana monedas mientras juegas y úsalas para seguir cuando pierdes.
• Canciones gratis: Himno a la Alegría, La Cucaracha y Cumpleaños Feliz.
• Paquetes de canciones: Clásicas y Navidad.
• Comparte tu récord y reta a tus amigos.

Descarga gratis. Incluye compras opcionales dentro del juego.

Un juego de Libertad Legal Group.

name: Tokenwacht: Authenticator 2FA
description:
Tokenwacht creates the 6-digit sign-in codes for two-factor authentication (2FA). Scan the QR code a website shows you, and Tokenwacht shows a fresh code every 30 seconds. Tap a code to copy it.

No account with us, no phone number, no server. Your secret keys stay in the iPhone Keychain and never leave your devices.

NEVER LOSE YOUR CODES
- Optional iCloud Keychain sync, end-to-end encrypted by Apple
- Encrypted backup file that you keep (AES-256, your password)
- Check backup: open your file with your password and see that every account is in it, before you need it
- A reminder when new accounts are not in a backup yet

NOT LOCKED IN
- Import transfer QR codes from other authenticator apps, plus 2FAS and Aegis exports and otpauth links
- Export to another app with a transfer QR code or a file, whenever you want

FAST WHEN YOU SIGN IN
- Large, clear codes with a countdown
- Tap to copy; the clipboard clears itself after 60 seconds
- Search, pin your most used accounts, folders
- Scan from the camera or from a screenshot in Photos

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Lock with Face ID or your passcode
- Codes are hidden in the app switcher
- Time-based (TOTP), counter-based (HOTP) and Steam codes, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512
- No ads, no tracking, works offline

TOKENWACHT PRO (one-time purchase)
- Emergency sheet: a printable PDF with every account as a QR code, for your safe
- Store each account's recovery codes next to it
- AutoFill: Tokenwacht offers the code above the keyboard in Safari and apps

Everything you need for daily use and backups is included without Pro.

Privacy: https://tokenwacht.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy
Support: https://tokenwacht.sanghuynhxuan.com/support

name: Tokyo Park Radar
description:
A wait-time helper for Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea. This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with The Walt Disney Company or Tokyo Disney Resort.

• One trip per park day: pick Disneyland or DisneySea, set the date, and family members join with an invite code
• Live wait times for every attraction, plus what’s paused or closed
• Where now: rides you haven’t done, short waits and your likes come first
• Family sync: check off rides, like, and leave notes on everyone’s phone
• DPA booking time: enter it after buying in the official app and the whole family gets a reminder 10 minutes before
• Show reminders 30 and 10 minutes before curtain
• Map and walking directions on Apple Maps with distance and walk time
• Filters: height, type, area, DPA / SP / EP
