• How-to guides: buying DPA, getting a Standby Pass, entering show lotteries
• Review summaries from blogs and parents: 5 stars is a must-do, 1 star you can skip
• English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese

Wait times come from themeparks.wiki; check the official app for the day’s show times. No account needed. Photos and location stay on your phone.

name: Tonepath: One Line Puzzle
description:
Tonepath is a puzzle about drawing one unbroken line through every cell of the board. The rule fits in a sentence. Putting it down is harder.

EVERY STEP HAS A SOUND
As the line grows, the note climbs. Each cell answers with a crisp haptic tick, and a solved level resolves into a chord. It feels good even with the sound off — the phone answers your finger.

SIX SETS OF RULES
• First Line — simply cover every cell.
• Waypoints — numbered cells must be visited in order.
• Portals — the line dives into one ring and comes out of its twin.
• Twice — marked cells must be crossed two times.
• One Way — you can only leave a cell the way its arrow points.
• Everything — all the rules on one board.

360 LEVELS AND A DAILY PUZZLE
Each module has 60 levels, growing from a 3×3 board to 6×8. A new puzzle arrives every day — keep your streak going.

NO RUSH, NO PUNISHMENT
• No timers, no lives, no move limits.
• Undo and hints are unlimited and free.
• Progress is saved after every move: close the game mid-level and come back to the same line.
• Works offline.

FAIR PRICE
The first module (60 levels) and the daily puzzle are free forever. The other five modules — 300 levels — unlock with a single one-time purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-game currency.

The game collects no data.

name: Tonerlog
description: Tonerlog is a printer page notebook. Each printer has a name and a place. Each cartridge stores a code, a yield in pages, the page count when you installed it, and the latest page count on the printer. Pages used are the latest count minus the installed count. Remaining pages are the yield minus pages used. Low means 20 percent or less of the yield is left. Nothing is uploaded and no printer is contacted.

name: Tonni - Müllkalender
description:
Tonni sagt dir, welche Tonne wann rausmuss – und erinnert dich rechtzeitig daran.

Importiere den Abfuhrkalender deines Abfallbetriebs einmal als ICS-Link oder -Datei. Danach siehst du auf einen Blick, was als Nächstes abgeholt wird: Restmüll, Biotonne, Papier, Gelber Sack und mehr. Tonni erkennt die Tonnen automatisch und gibt ihnen Farbe und Symbol.

SO EINFACH GEHT'S
1. Auf der Webseite deines Abfallbetriebs den Abfuhrkalender als ICS-Link oder -Datei suchen
2. In Tonni importieren
3. Fertig – Widget auf den Home- oder Sperrbildschirm legen und erinnern lassen

DAS KANN TONNI
• Übersicht mit der nächsten Abholung, Wochenstreifen und allen kommenden Terminen
• Widgets für Home- und Sperrbildschirm: Heute, morgen oder in ein paar Tagen
• Erinnerung am Vorabend zu deiner Wunschzeit
• Live-Aktivität auf dem Sperrbildschirm: „Tonne rausstellen“ – mit einem Tipp auf „Draußen“ erledigt
• Siri und Kurzbefehle: „Welche Tonne kommt morgen?“
• Eigene Tonnen mit Farbe und Symbol, jederzeit bearbeitbar
• Backup als Datei exportieren und wieder importieren
• Deutsch und Englisch

DATENSCHUTZ
Keine Konten, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Termine bleiben auf deinem Gerät. Nur wenn du einen Kalender-Link einträgst, lädt Tonni diese eine Adresse deines Abfallbetriebs.

HINWEIS
Tonni funktioniert mit jedem Abfallbetrieb, der seinen Abfuhrkalender als ICS-Datei oder -Link anbietet. Die Termine werden aus diesem Kalender übernommen.

PREIS
Die ersten 7 Tage kannst du Tonni kostenlos und vollständig testen. Danach schaltest du die App mit einem einmaligen In-App-Kauf frei – ohne Abo.

name: Too Low: Shakotan
description:
Too Low: Shakotan is a one-finger arcade game about a car that sits far too close to the road.

Hold the screen to raise the ride height. Let go to drop it again. Speed bumps need you up. Height bars need you down. The lower you ride, the faster your score climbs, up to 3x, so the safest line is never the best one.

Features
- One-touch control: hold to lift, release to drop
- Score multiplier that rewards riding as low as you dare
- Near-miss bonuses for clearing obstacles by a hair
- Three lives, then the repair bill arrives
- Four cars to unlock by beating your best score
- World ranking: post your score with three letters
- Copy your result to share with friends
- English and Japanese

No account, no ads, no tracking. Posting to the ranking is optional.

Shakotan is Japanese slang for a car lowered as far as it will go. Please keep the scraping in the game and drive safely on real roads.

name: Toot Raft
description:
Toot Raft is a silly river game where your raft has one engine, and it's your bum.

Hold TOOT to push, steer with the stick, and stay ahead of the giant cloud. In Rope Run your raft is tied to another one with a stretchy rope: pull your buddy past the spikes, tow them when they go flat, and grab the snack lane before they do.

ROPE RUN
• Tie up with a friend: share a link or a 5-letter room code and play together on two phones
• No friend online? Rope up with a BOT. Each BOT has a bad habit you will learn to blame
• After every run, the Blame Board shows who popped, who towed, and who cut the rope

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Solo run: a new river every time, with three snacks to pick at every stop
• Today's River: everyone gets the same river and sees where other players popped
• Time Trials and Bomb Brawl in Extras

KIND TO YOUR PHONE
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account
• Friends can only send preset emotes like "Sorry!" and "Pull!". There is no chat
• Solo modes play offline

Hold TOOT. Blame someone else.

name: Top Draw
description:
Top Draw is a place to colour, paint and learn to draw, for all ages. It starts with big, simple pictures and goes all the way to intricate pages for a quiet hour.

A COLOURING BOOK IN FOUR LEVELS
209 pages, from "Big and simple" to "Intricate": animals, dinosaurs, vehicles, gardens, reefs, birds, buildings and more. Tap to fill a shape or colour it in by hand. Colour stays inside the lines until you choose otherwise, and you can zoom right in for the fine parts.

REAL BRUSHES
Crayon, pencil, marker, watercolour, oil, glitter and rainbow, with fill and an eraser. Fifty colours, colour harmonies, or any colour you like. Mirror drawing, a steady-hand setting, undo and redo.

LEARN TO DRAW
25 lessons on two tracks. Little steps begins with dots and lines and builds up to simple pictures. Big steps goes from confident lines and shapes to animals, proportion, light and shade, and perspective. Each stroke is shown first; then it is your turn, and the app looks at what you drew and moves on by itself.

YOUR OWN PICTURES
Turn one of your photos into a line drawing to colour, from a fine pencil sketch to bold ink. Copy a picture beside your paper, or trace over one. Start from a blank sheet whenever you like.

THE FRIDGE DOOR
Finished pictures are pinned up in a gallery. Watch a picture being made again, or save a short film of it.

CALM AND PRIVATE
No adverts. No account. Nothing you draw leaves your device unless a grown-up chooses to save or share it. Buying and sharing sit behind a question for grown-ups.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL UNLOCK
Free for good: blank paper, copying and tracing, every brush, 39 colouring pages plus a new one in each level every day, the first three lessons on each track, and three pages from your own photos. A single one-off purchase unlocks all 209 pages, all 25 lessons and unlimited pages from your photos. It is not a subscription.

name: Toqq : Menus de la semaine
description:
Choisis ton magasin et ton budget : Toqq prépare tes repas de la semaine et ta liste de courses, avec le total estimé avant même de pousser le caddie.

Plus besoin de chercher une idée chaque soir ni de découvrir l'addition à la caisse. Tu sais ce que tu manges, ce que tu achètes et combien ça coûte.

TA SEMAINE, SOUS TON BUDGET
• Des repas pour toute la semaine, calés sur le budget que tu t'es fixé
• Le coût de la semaine affiché face à ton budget, en un coup d'œil
• Un plat ne te tente pas ? Remplace-le en un geste, ou régénère toute la semaine

DES COURSES SANS SURPRISE
• Une liste rangée par rayon, avec un prix estimé pour chaque article et le total
• « Déjà dans ma cuisine » : ce que tu as au placard sort de la liste et du total
• Coche tes articles au fil des rayons et partage la liste en un geste

DES RECETTES QUI TE RESSEMBLENT
• Des étapes claires et un mode cuisine plein écran, une étape à la fois
• Des portions calculées pour ton foyer, adultes comme enfants
• Les calories et les macros de chaque plat
• Ton régime respecté : flexitarien, pescétarien, végétarien, végan, halal ou sans porc
• Tes allergies et les aliments que tu évites ne finissent pas dans l'assiette
• Le temps que tu as et l'équipement de ta cuisine pris en compte

UN RAPPEL LE DIMANCHE
Chaque dimanche, à l'heure de ton choix, Toqq te rappelle de préparer ta semaine et tes courses.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
1. Indique ton pays, ton magasin, ton foyer et ton budget.
2. Dis à Toqq ce que tu aimes, ce que tu évites et le temps que tu as.
3. Découvre ta semaine de repas et ta liste de courses, avec le prix total.

Les prix sont des estimations établies pour chaque enseigne : le montant en caisse peut varier. Toqq n'est affilié à aucune enseigne. En cas d'allergie, vérifie toujours l'étiquette des produits.

ABONNEMENT TOQQ PREMIUM
Toqq se télécharge gratuitement. Ta semaine de repas, ta liste de courses chiffrée et les recettes sont accessibles avec l'abonnement Toqq Premium, en deux formules :
• Annuel : 39,99 € par an (soit 3,33 € par mois), avec 3 jours d'essai gratuit
• Mensuel : 9,99 € par mois, sans essai gratuit
En Suisse : 39,90 CHF par an ou 9,90 CHF par mois. Le prix applicable est toujours affiché avant l'achat.

Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat, ou à la fin de l'essai gratuit pour la formule annuelle. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement pour la même durée et au même prix, sauf si tu désactives le renouvellement automatique au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Le renouvellement est facturé dans les 24 heures qui précèdent la fin de la période. Tu peux gérer ou résilier ton abonnement à tout moment dans Réglages > ton nom > Abonnements. Toute partie inutilisée de l'essai gratuit est perdue si tu souscris un abonnement pendant l'essai. Supprimer l'app ne résilie pas l'abonnement.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://toqq.app/terms
Politique de confidentialité : https://toqq.app/privacy

name: Torquill: FAA A&P Test Prep
description:
Study for the FAA Aviation Mechanic written tests with 1,068 original questions across 40 subjects, timed mock tests, and an oral drill read aloud by an AI voice. Torquill is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the FAA.

TODAY'S WORK CARD
- Three short tasks picked for you every day, based on what you miss and what is weakest.
- Every answer is explained inline, with the handbook it comes from.

GENERAL, AIRFRAME AND POWERPLANT
- All 40 subjects follow the AMT Airman Certification Standards.
- Pick one test or all three. Set your test date and see the days left.

MOCK TESTS
- Same question count and time limit as the real written test. Answers show at the end.
- Results by subject and the report codes you missed, with a review of every answer.

YOUR TEST REPORT
- Got your Airman Knowledge Test Report? Type the missed ACS codes, or scan a photo of the report. Torquill builds questions for exactly those codes.
- Codes you drill and get right are signed off.

ORAL DRILL
- Hear the examiner question read by an AI voice, answer out loud, then flip the card to check the key points.

KEEP GOING
- Missed questions come back for review. A daily reminder at the hour you choose, and a home screen widget with today's Task Card.
- Meet Rivet the griffin, who changes outfits as you really learn subjects.
- Export your progress to a file before you change phones.

WORKS OFFLINE
All questions are on your phone. No account, no ads.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 8 questions per subject, one General mock test, 3 report codes, and the report code drills. Torquill Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks every question, unlimited mock tests, every report code, random oral sets and custom quizzes up to 100 questions. No subscription.

Questions are written from public FAA handbooks and the AMT ACS, and each explanation names its source. Support: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: Torvik: Gym & Home Workout
description:
Lift with good form from your first rep.

Torvik is a gym and home workout app with a 3D coach that shows every move and a camera form check that counts your reps and tells you what to fix. Follow a ready-made plan, build your own workouts and watch your strength grow. No account, no ads.

3D COACH
• Watch every exercise performed by a 3D coach you can turn and view from any side
• Slow it down to learn each phase of the move
• Muscles light up as they work, so you know what you're training

CAMERA FORM CHECK
• Your iPhone's camera counts your reps as you train
• Get a form score and a clear tip, like "Stop at shoulder height"
• Video is analyzed on your iPhone and never saved or uploaded

PLANS AND WORKOUTS
• Ready-made programs for beginners and up, at the gym or at home
• Today shows your next workout, your weekly goal and your streak
• Build your own workouts with your choice of sets, reps and rest
• Train with dumbbells, a bench or just your bodyweight

DURING YOUR WORKOUT
• Log each set in one tap, with last time's weight and reps ready
• Rest timer starts after each set
• Voice coaching and countdown beeps, with your music lowered for cues
• Haptics on each rep and when rest ends

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Weekly goal and streak to keep you consistent
• See which muscles you've trained this week
• Personal records and strength trends
• A full history of every workout and set
• Trained without your phone? Log it later

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Workouts stay on your iPhone and sync through your own iCloud
• Export every set to a CSV file any time
• Workout reminders on the days you choose

Torvik gives general fitness guidance and is not medical advice. Check with your doctor before starting a new exercise program, and stop if anything hurts.

Terms of Use: https://kunalvmore.github.io/torvik/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://kunalvmore.github.io/torvik/privacy/

name: TrackMyInvites
description:
TrackMyInvites is an office diary for invitation visits. Photograph an invitation card with the camera or choose one from your photo library. The server reads the date, time, place, hosts and phone numbers, including text in Marathi and Hindi. You check the reading, save it, and see the day's programs in time order.

The Home tab shows today's visits and what is up next. The Calendar tab lists programs by date. The Invitations tab keeps the cards you have saved, with search and the option to delete a card. On a program, mark the visit as visited, not visited or cancelled, and add a remark.

Reports cover the day, week, month and year, and can be shared as PDF, Excel or CSV. WhatsApp reminders are optional: you can turn them off in Profile, and you can choose English, Hindi or Marathi for those messages. You can delete your account from Profile.

Sign in with WhatsApp, or with an email or phone number and a password. The app is available in English, Hindi and Marathi.

TrackMyInvites is operated by GROK MEDIA PVT LTD.
Privacy policy: https://grokmedia.in/invitations/privacy

name: Tracks of Frontier: Rail Route
description:
Stoke the furnace, sound the whistle, and lay the tracks of destiny across the uncharted frontier!

"Tracks of Frontier" is an immersive steampunk railway route building and real-time train dispatch puzzle game. Build steel tracks across untamed wilderness, construct soaring trestle bridges over roaring canyons, bore through granite mountains with dual tunnels, and coordinate complex railway networks to deliver passengers and precious freight safely to their destinations!

 GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS

STRATEGIC ROUTE LAYING & RAILWAY ENGINEERING
Lay tracks tile-by-tile within strict steel budgets! Connect starting depots to terminal stations with a versatile engineering toolset:
• Straight & 90° Curved Brass Rails
• Interactive Track Switches & Passing Loops
• High Trestle Bridges spanning raging rivers and ravines
• Mountain Tunnel Bores slicing through towering cliffs
• Semaphore Block Signals to halt or clear train traffic
• Track Demolisher & Quick Undo to refine your layout

REAL-TIME TRAIN DISPATCH & SWITCH CONTROL
Hit "Blow Whistle" to set your locomotives into motion! As trains barrel down the line:
• Manually throw switch levers mid-transit to re-route trains on the fly
• Toggle semaphore signals to hold trains on sidings and avert catastrophic head-on collisions
• Coordinate multi-train logistics: passenger coaches, timber flatcars, gold armored bullion cars, and coal hoppers
• Speed up gameplay seamlessly with 1x, 2x, and 3x steam-boost acceleration!

16 HAND-CRAFTED CAMPAIGN STATIONS
Challenge your engineering intellect across 16 meticulously designed frontier scenarios:
• Station 1–5: Canyon turns, river crossings, mountain bores, and basic switch junctions
• Station 6–10: Passing loops, multi-train freight routing, diamond crossings, and triple trestles
• Station 11–15: Three-way sorting hubs, dual mountain corridors, and grand junction interchanges
• Station 16: The Continental Divide — the ultimate test of frontier dispatch mastery!

ENDLESS WILDERNESS DISPATCH MODE
Looking for infinite railway challenges? Take on the Endless Dispatch Mode! Face procedurally generated railway terrains, randomized train lineups, and unpredictable station requests. Build up your dispatch streak and claim the title of Frontier Railway Baron!

3D STEAM DIORAMA & LOCOMOTIVE CHASE CAM
• Switch effortlessly between top-down 2D engineering blueprints and a vibrant 3D steampunk tabletop diorama
• Full 360-degree camera orbit and smooth zoom controls
• Jump straight into the Locomotive Chase Camera to ride along the rails with your steam train!

100% CLEAN, AD-FREE, FAIR GAMING
• Zero intrusive pop-up advertisements
• Zero forced video commercials
• Zero predatory microtransactions or energy timers
• Full offline playability: your progress and stars are saved securely on your device!

 CORE FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Satisfying route planning and train dispatching mechanics.
• Dual visual modes: 2D Blueprint for precision, 3D Diorama for visual splendor.
• Dynamic audio: custom locomotive chuffs, steam whistles, and mechanical sound effects.
• 3-Star achievement system: earn stars for completion, budget efficiency, and swift transit.
• Fully optimized for iOS: native support for iPhone Notch, Dynamic Island, and iPad Retina screens.

Can you conquer the frontier and keep every train strictly on time?
Download Tracks of Frontier today and start laying your railway empire!

name: TRADO LMD
description:
TRADO LMD is the official app for TRADO drivers, making cold-chain last-mile delivery quick, organized and easy to manage, from pickup to delivery.

• Dashboard showing your shipments, deliveries, COD totals, earnings and balance.
• Track pending, accepted, in-vehicle and delivered shipments.
• Scan shipment barcodes with your camera to pick up and update their status.
• Contact customers in one tap: call, SMS or WhatsApp.
• View addresses on the map.
• Available in Arabic and English.

For registered TRADO drivers only.

name: Traffic Driving, Serit Racer
description:
Drive through highway traffic in Serit. Choose one-way traffic, two-way traffic, a 90-second time trial or free practice.

Build your garage with ten cars. Earn coins by driving, complete sequential challenges, and upgrade each car’s engine, maneuvering and brakes across five levels. Change paint and choose coast, desert, winter or night roads.

Use touch steering or tilt your phone. Hold the center to brake, or choose manual gas. A short, skippable introduction explains the controls.

The game is free to play. Optional one-time coin packs unlock cars and upgrades sooner. No subscription and no ads. Coins do not expire. Purchases use your App Store account and local prices.

Garage progress and coin balance are stored on your device. Spent consumable purchases cannot be restored. Deleting the app may remove local progress and coins.

Support: cagrikocank@gmail.com

name: Trail Social
description:
Trail is where public issues get seen, answered and resolved.

A broken streetlight, a stalled project, a road that floods every rain or a complaint that has gone unanswered: raise it as a trail, tag the agency, assembly or company that can act on it, and follow it through in public until it is fixed.

HOW IT WORKS
• Raise a trail. Describe what needs attention, add photos or video, choose a category and pin the place.
• Tag who is responsible. They are notified, and the trail stays in public view until they respond.
• Follow it through. Every update, note and status change is added to the trail's timeline: Open, Acknowledged, In progress, Resolved and Closed.
• Close it yourself. An agency can mark a trail as resolved, but only you, its author, can confirm the outcome and close it, or reopen it.

A RECORD THAT STANDS
A trail's timeline is append-only. Entries are never edited or removed, so the account of who said what, and when, remains intact.

ONE STORY, ONE PLACE
When several people report the same issue, Trail brings the reports together so the response reaches everyone.

VERIFIED ACCOUNTS
Agencies carry a gold check and individuals a blue one. Officials holding a current appointment at an agency carry a green check. Handles for ministries, assemblies, public figures and well-known organisations are reserved for their real owners.

MORE THAN REPORTS
• Share posts, photos and videos, quote others and comment.
• Follow people and agencies, and see what is trending near you and across the country.
• Post statuses that last 24 hours.
• Message people privately and make voice calls.
• Add music to your posts from the sound library.

YOU ARE IN CONTROL
• Choose who can message you, and block any account.
• Sign in with a passkey and protect your account with two-factor authentication.

SAFE FOR EVERYONE
Trail has zero tolerance for objectionable content. Report any post or account from within the app; reports are reviewed and acted on within 24 hours.

Questions or feedback: info@trailofficial.com

name: Trailix
description:
Trailix – Trace Every Path with Precision
Intelligent GPS trajectory correction for anti-loss tracking, asset monitoring and outdoor logging.
For valuables, pets and device tags. Real-time location, smooth playback of movement trails.
A tiny tag, for constant peace of mind

name: Train Table: Model Railway
description:
Build the model railway you always wanted – right on your iPhone or iPad. Lay the track, set up a village, put your trains together and watch them run in 3D.

BUILD THE TRACK
• Draw a line with your finger and the track follows it, or add straights, curves and switches piece by piece
• Switches, signals and crossings are added for you
• Bridges and ramps with smooth gradients
• Four gauges with true-to-scale track pieces: H0, TT, N and G
• Choose the size and shape of your board, even round "around the tree"

SCENERY
• Over 150 objects: stations, houses, churches, factories, trees, cars, people and animals
• Draw roads with your finger – level crossings with gates and warning lights appear by themselves
• Draw fences, hedges and rivers as lines, platforms snap to the track
• Ready-made scenes: village, station, farm and Christmas market

TRAINS
• Steam, diesel and electric locomotives plus more than 45 cars, from coaches to freight, circus and Christmas cars
• Build your own trains by dragging cars into place
• Up to four trains on the layout at the same time

DRIVE
• Control speed and direction, throw switches and set signals
• Autopilot sets the switches and keeps the trains from running into each other
• Trains stop at platforms and slow down on gradients
• Five cameras: top view, free, chase, driver's cab and cinema mode
• Snowfall, rain, night mode with lit windows and sounds for steam, diesel and electric

PLAN AND SHARE
• Parts list with the track pieces you need, as a PDF shopping list
• Save as many plans as you like and share them as a file

Made for children and adults alike. No account, no ads, no tracking – everything stays on your device.

name: TrampList
description:
TrampList keeps track of your hiking gear and what it weighs, so you know exactly what you're carrying before you head out.

ONE INVENTORY FOR ALL YOUR GEAR
Add each item once, with its weight, a link and notes, and organise it into categories and groups. Every trip and packing list uses the same Inventory.

TRIPS AND PACKING LISTS
Plan a trip with dates and a place on the map, then tick off gear as you pack. Save reusable packing lists, such as "Overnight Hut Trip", and start a new trip from one in a tap.

KNOW YOUR WEIGHTS
See totals by category, your base weight (without food, water and worn clothing) and the weight on your back. Set quantities per trip and mark clothing as worn.

SHARE AND PRINT
Send a packing list by Messages, Mail or AirDrop, print a checklist, or export to text, CSV, HTML or XML. Share a trip file and the other person gets the gear on its list.

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
TrampList is a native app on each. Files open on any of your devices and bring their gear with them.

TRAMPLIST PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
The free version includes the whole Inventory, 3 trips and 3 packing lists, sharing, export and printing. Pro adds:
• Unlimited trips and packing lists
• A pack weight limit based on your body weight, which you can read from Apple Health
• Packing reminders before each trip
• Add to Calendar
One purchase unlocks Pro on all your devices.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
TrampList doesn't collect any data. Your gear and trips stay on your devices, and your body weight from Apple Health is only used to work out your pack limit.

name: Transfer Jeri
description:
O Transfer Jeri reúne as opções de traslado entre Fortaleza e Jericoacoara num só lugar.

Informe origem, destino, data e passageiros, compare as operadoras e reserve pelo app. O pagamento é por Pix ou cartão, e a confirmação chega no e-mail com o voucher.

Você acompanha a reserva pela sua conta e pode cancelar sem custo até 24 horas antes do transfer.

— Comparação de operadoras
— Ida e volta
— Pagamento por Pix ou cartão
— Cancelamento grátis até 24h antes
— Suporte pelo WhatsApp

Site: https://transferjeri.com

name: Trash Today - Bin Day Reminder
description:
See at a glance which trash goes out today and tomorrow. A simple bin day calendar that reminds you the night before and on the morning of collection.

ADD EACH TYPE OF COLLECTION
- Trash, recycling, bottles & cans, paper, yard waste - add any type you need
- Weekly (one or more days), nth weekday of the month (e.g. 2nd and 4th Wednesday) or every other week
- Colors and icons make each type easy to spot
- Keep sorting notes for each type (how to bag it, where to put it out)

NEVER MISS BIN DAY
- Reminders the night before (8:00 PM by default) and on the morning (6:30 AM by default); change the times anytime
- All of the day's types combined into one notification

HOME SCREEN AND WIDGETS
- Today and Tomorrow cards plus the next 7 days
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show what goes out without opening the app

HOLIDAYS AND BREAKS
- Add any days with no collection, such as public holidays or year-end breaks
- Built-in Japanese public holidays with a per-type "collected as usual / no collection" setting

NO ACCOUNT, DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No sign-up needed. Your collection types and settings are stored only on your device and are never sent anywhere (except the connection needed to show ads).

PRICING
Free to use with a banner ad. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase (no subscription) turns ads off for good.

Note: Collection days vary by area and can change. Always check your local government's or waste collector's official schedule.

name: TrastePlano
description:
Calcula dónde cae cada traste en dos cuerdas de referencia. Introduce las coordenadas de la cejuela y la selleta, elige divisiones por octava o define tus intervalos en cents y revisa las cotas en el plano.

Selecciona un traste para ver su distancia desde la cejuela y la separación respecto del anterior. Filtra los pasos por debajo de tu umbral o compara la posición original con un desplazamiento que alinea un traste en ambos lados. Conserva el proyecto original y, si lo necesitas, guarda la alineación como una copia.

Prueba Muestra de dos escalas para comparar cuerdas de 650 y 660 mm. Guarda el plano o la comparación como un informe congelado y vuelve a abrir sus PDF y CSV. Las medidas se calculan para dos cuerdas ideales en planta. El plano es una referencia con cotas, y la entonación real se comprueba en el instrumento.

name: Tre Fragranze Fidelity
description:
Tre Fragranze Fidelity è la tessera fedeltà della profumeria Tre Fragranze di Gela.

Niente più tessera di plastica: in cassa mostri il codice a barre dal telefono e ogni acquisto diventa punti.

Cosa puoi fare:
- Tessera digitale con codice a barre e saldo punti, sempre con te
- Punti a ogni acquisto in negozio
- Ruota della fortuna: un giro gratuito al giorno per vincere punti o piccoli omaggi da ritirare in negozio
- Movimenti dei punti sempre aggiornati
- Volantino con le offerte del negozio
- Avvisi sulle novità e sulle promozioni
- Accesso con Apple, Google o email, e sblocco con Face ID

Hai già la tessera del negozio? Collegala con il codice tessera o con il tuo numero di telefono e ritrovi subito i tuoi punti.

name: Treadkeep
description:
Treadkeep is a straightforward mileage logbook for your running and walking shoes. Keep every active pair on one visual shoe wall, log outings in seconds, and see how your distance adds up across your rotation.

Each shoe box displays the pair's name, total distance, and an outsole illustration that reflects your logged distance against the target you choose. Leave the target blank if you simply want a counter. Treadkeep counts what you log or import and never judges shoe condition or gives advice.

What you can do with Treadkeep:
- Add any pair in under 15 seconds with a name, optional brand and model, category, size, box colour, purchase date, price, photo, and your own target distance.
- Log distance quickly using recent or preset chips (3, 5, 10) or a custom number, with automatic default shoes per activity type.
- Import running, walking, and hiking workouts from Apple Health on demand, read-only, with automatic duplicate protection.
- Review monthly distance columns, yearly totals, rotation share by period, pair rankings, and cost per kilometre or mile.
- Set local reminders when a pair crosses percentages of your chosen target, plus an optional weekly reminder to log distance.
- Move finished pairs to the retired shelf with their final totals, dates, and cost per distance, or restore them later.
- Export your entire log as JSON, CSV, or a printable PDF summary, import a backup, or delete all local data with one confirmation.

name: Trendril 短影音陪跑
description:
沒時間拍片、也不知道發什麼？跟 Trendril 聊 3 分鐘你的品牌，之後每天幫你找題材、做好直式短影音，時間到就自動發到 Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Threads 和 Facebook。

・聊天開始：賣什麼、誰會買、喜歡的口吻，用點的就好，最後整理成你的品牌檔案
・固定樣式：從風格庫選一種，之後每支都照這個樣子，大家一看就知道是你
・每天找題材：同行最近的爆款、你自己表現最好的貼文，整理成下一支可以拍的
・安心自動發：發前 2 小時通知你，可以取消或換一支；提到價格、品牌名寫錯會先停下來等你看
・每週成效：觀看、追蹤、看完率、各平台表現，告訴你下週怎麼調
・桌面小工具：今天要發幾支、下一支什麼時候發，打開手機就看得到

方案依每天發幾支與影片樣式計價，自己拍片的創作者也有只看成效與題材的方案。

name: Tria Smart office
description:
Smart Office is the mobile companion to your organization's Smart Office platform. It replaces paper correspondence with a fast, traceable digital workflow, so you can handle official letters, documents and plans wherever you are.

Choose your company, sign in with the account your organization gave you, and pick up where you left off on the web.

Smart Office is for employees of organizations that use the Smart Office platform. You need an account from your organization to sign in. The features you see depend on what your organization has turned on.

name: TrialRibbon
description:
Keep a clear trail from a process idea to an observed outcome.

TrialRibbon helps designers and independent workers document small process trials. State a hypothesis, record a numerical baseline and choose your own unit before making a change.

RECORD WHAT CHANGED
Append dated intervention notes, numerical observations and conclusions to a vertical timeline. Open any event to inspect it, and edit or remove events while the trial is active.

COMPARE WITH YOUR BASELINE
The most recent observation by date is compared with the trial’s baseline. The difference is shown in your chosen unit. It is a descriptive calculation, not a claim of statistical significance or causation.

CONCLUDE AND REVISIT
A trial needs an observation and a conclusion before it can be completed. Completed trials move to an archive. Reopen a trial to continue recording; edit its definition or delete it with confirmation.

Core functions are offline. Trial records stay on your device. No login, advertisements or purchases. Optional fictional examples are available, and first launch starts empty. Choose light, dark or system appearance and any of the eight supported App languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.

The read-only CloudKit startup integration cannot change or hide trial tools and never opens external links automatically. It does not synchronize your private trial records.

name: TRIo by Trigent - iOS
description:
TRIo makes attendance simple, accurate and secure. Check in and check out in a few taps, with your location and a quick selfie confirming each entry, so your attendance record is always reliable.

TRIo works with your organization's TRIo account. Sign in with the employee ID and password issued to you by your organization to get started.

CHECK IN WITH ONE TAP
• Start and end your day with a single tap from the home screen
• Your location is checked against your assigned work site when you check in and check out
• If you are outside your site, TRIo shows how far you are and your nearest assigned site
• See your check-in time, check-out time and total work hours for the day

VERIFIED AND SECURE
• A quick selfie and liveness check confirm it is really you
• Your session is stored securely on your device
• Location is used only at check-in and check-out — TRIo does not track you in the background

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR RECORDS
• Forgot to check out? Resolve a missed check-out and add the reason
• Explain a missed check-in so your record stays complete
• Clear success screens confirm every check-in and check-out

TEAM VIEW FOR SUPERVISORS
• Supervisors can see their team's attendance for the last 7 days
• Open any team member's profile to view their details

YOUR PROFILE
• View your profile, role and assigned sites
• Upload your signature from your camera or photo library
• Change your password, or reset it if you forget it
• Light and dark themes that follow the time of day

TRIo needs your organization's account to sign in. If you do not have login details, please contact your organization's administrator.

name: TripCerrah Hub
description:
One workplace. One connected experience.
TripCerrah Hub is a workforce and operations app designed for office employees, drivers, field workers, and teams.
Whether you're working at a desk, on the road, or in the field, TripCerrah Hub helps you manage your workday with everything you need in one convenient place.
Everything you need for your workday
Time & Attendance
Clock in and out, monitor your working hours, and view your attendance progress in real time.
Shifts & Scheduling
View assigned shifts, check upcoming work schedules, and stay informed about schedule changes.
Lunch & Break Management
Track lunch and short breaks alongside your working time.
Live Activities
Keep track of your workday directly from your iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island on supported devices.
Notifications & Reminders
Stay informed about upcoming shifts, attendance reminders, schedule updates, and important workplace notifications.
Work Hours & Insights
View your working-hours summary and access useful information about your attendance and shifts.
Built for every kind of workplace
From corporate offices and professional services to transportation, logistics, and field operations, TripCerrah Hub brings employees and daily operations together.
Work smarter. Stay connected. Move forward.
TripCerrah Hub is designed for organizations using the TripCerrah platform. Available features may vary depending on your organization's configuration and device capabilities.

name: Tripforge: Trip Planner
description:
Type a place and a rough date. Tripforge finds the cheapest flights around it, the days that cost less, and the top sights and secret spots of the city.

• Cheap flights around your date: Type a place and a rough date, such as October. Tripforge lists the cheapest round trips for your nights away, each with a booking link.
• Days that cost less: A calendar shows the cheapest fare for each departure day. You see at once when the same trip costs less.
• Priced for the whole group: Add the adults and the ages of the children. Fares come from recent Aviasales searches, and the booking site shows the live price.
• Top sights and secret spots: For each city, Tripforge lists the sights that most Wikipedia languages cover, and quiet places that Wikivoyage editors suggest.

Tripforge Pro
• No daily limit on searches. Free has 10 a day.
• Shift the dates by up to 30 days. Free has 7.
• Saved trips on this phone
• No ads
Pay once. Pro works on each iPhone with your Apple Account.

name: Tripsack Packing
description:
Packing isn't just about remembering to bring enough; it's also about knowing if your bag exceeds the weight limit. Tripsack helps you create a suitable packing list, estimate the weight of each item, and adjust your luggage before you pack.

Create your trip with the number of days, weather, purpose, and the type of bags you'll bring. Tripsack automatically suggests the amount of clothing and items based on your itinerary and laundry frequency, instead of just using the number of days as a basis. You can change the quantity and weight of each item, mark items to wear on the flight, or add personal items.

Important items like passports, medications, and chargers are prioritized on the list so you don't forget anything. When packing, simply mark each item you put in your bag.

For the weight section, Tripsack calculates the total luggage weight, subtracts the weight of items you'll be wearing, and compares the result to the airline's weight limit. You can also see how changing your laundry schedule affects your weight, identify items that are taking up a lot of weight, and use Make it fit to adjust your load accordingly.

The app also helps you check liquid regulations for cabin baggage, with 1-liter bags and bottles no larger than 100 ml. Before leaving home, a separate checklist helps you check for easily forgotten items like keys, potted plants, or phone chargers.

After your trip, assess what you used, what you had in excess, or what you need. Tripsack will use these observations along with your usual packing list to improve your list for future trips.

name: Tripstamp: Travel Map & Days
description:
Tripstamp is a travel map that keeps itself up to date. Stamp the countries you've visited, log your trips with dates, and always know how many days you've spent abroad and how many Schengen days you have left.

YOUR TRAVEL MAP
• Tap a country to stamp it: visited, lived or want to go
• See your stats: countries, % of the world, continents, days abroad this year
• Add cities and places, or tap "I'm here" to check in to the country you're in
• Log trips with dates. One trip can cross several borders
• Every country, worldwide, with no caps on countries, trips or places

NO ACCOUNT. YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No sign-up, no email, no marketing opt-in
• Syncs through your own iCloud
• Export everything to JSON or CSV at any time, and import it back
• Your trips, photos and location never leave your devices

TRIPSTAMP PRO
• Find trips in your photos: Tripstamp reads the date and place of your photos on your iPhone and suggests the trips it finds. You review them before anything is saved
• Schengen 90/180 counter: see how many days you've used in the rolling 180-day window, how many are left, and how long you can stay from any entry date
• Your own day limits: track rules like 183-day tax residency or any visa limit
• Alerts before you reach a limit, and automatic trip detection as you travel

The map, countries, trips, places, stats, iCloud sync and export are included without a subscription. Day counts are estimates to help you plan; they are not legal or immigration advice.

SUBSCRIPTION
Tripstamp Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. The yearly plan may include a free trial for eligible users. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.streamlinedstudios.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.streamlinedstudios.com/privacy/

name: Trivia Slots
description:
Pull the lever and let the reels decide! Trivia Slots is a trivia game with a Las Vegas slot machine twist. The first reel picks your category, the second picks how hard the question is, and the third might land you a bonus. Then answer before the clock runs out.

1,000 QUESTIONS TO START
History, geography, science, movies, music, sports, food and more, at Easy, Medium and Hard levels. You won't see a question twice until you've seen every one at that level.

BONUSES THAT CHANGE THE GAME
• 2× Points, Double or Nothing, Extra Life, Free Eraser and +10 Seconds
• Erasers wipe out wrong answers when you're stuck
• Build streaks for bonus points

WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: three lives, beat the clock, chase a high score
• Daily Challenge: ten questions, the same for everyone, every day
• Family Mode: two to four players pass one device
• Pick a Category: practice just the subject you like
• Relaxed Mode: no timer, take your time

QUESTION PACKS
Add new categories with optional Question Packs of about 1,000 questions each: Pop Culture, Nostalgia, Americana, Holidays & Seasons, Kids & Family, Around the World, Science & Nature, Faith & Bible and Sports Legends. Buy one or get them all. Family Sharing is supported.

EASY TO READ
Big, clear text and bright colors on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro.

• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• iCloud sync between your devices
• Two themes: Neon Vegas and Game Show
• No ads. No tracking. No betting or real money. The slot machine only picks your question.

name: TroopChat
description:
TroopChat is a chat app for Scout units: troops, packs and crews. It keeps leaders, parents and scouts in touch, with youth protection rules built into every conversation instead of left to memory.

• Channels for the whole unit, each patrol or den, adult leaders, and your youth leadership team
• Announcements that always reach every family
• Direct messages and small groups, with the right adults automatically included
• Any conversation with a scout includes that scout's parents and a second trained leader. Nobody can remove them.
• Parents see every conversation their scout is in
• Your unit's YPT leader can review any conversation, read-only
• Messages can't be edited or deleted, so the record is always complete
• Report a message to your unit's YPT leader, or block someone, from any message
• Photos and files, with location removed from photos before they're sent
• Sign in with a one-time code; no passwords. Sign out lost devices from anywhere.
• Notifications as things happen, or an email digest for parents who prefer it

A unit leader or committee chair requests access on troopchat.org and imports the unit's roster. Parents join their unit, then invite their scouts. A scout can only join through a parent.

No ads. We don't sell personal information.

TroopChat is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Scouting America or any council.

name: Truth in Jesus Singles Dating
description:
Truth in Jesus is a dating and courtship community for Christian singles who love the Lord Jesus Christ and want to find a godly, Christ-like spouse.

MEET CHRISTIAN SINGLES
• Browse the newest members, random members, or your matches
• Filter by age, location, distance, denomination, education and more
• See members on a map near you
• Read full profiles, including faith questions like denomination, quiet time, and favourite Bible character

GET TO KNOW EACH OTHER
• Like members and send messages
• Send photos in chat
• Get notified when someone messages you

PLAY GAMES TOGETHER
• Play chess with other members on a beautiful native board
• Invite a friend who isn't a member to play chess with a simple link — no account needed
• Chat with your opponent during the game
• Checkers, chess puzzles and more

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
• Block or report any member
• Control who can see your profile
• Delete your account at any time from Settings

Truth in Jesus members already on the website can sign in with their existing username and password.

name: TryoutScore: Tryout Evaluator
description:
TryoutScore is a scoring tool for club directors, coaches and volunteer evaluators running youth sports tryouts. Build a rubric, score athletes by tryout number with big tap targets, combine several evaluators fairly, and turn the results into a ranked list and team placement sheets.

TryoutScore works offline and keeps everything on your phone. There's no account to create, no ads and no tracking.

CUSTOM RUBRICS
- Categories such as Ball control, Speed or Game IQ, each with a weight, a 1–5, 1–10 or pass/fail scale, and optional short descriptions for each score level.
- Group categories by drill or station.
- Starter templates for soccer, basketball, baseball/softball, volleyball and hockey, or start blank. Everything is editable.
- Weights are checked to total 100%, with an auto-balance button.
- Once scores exist the rubric is locked; edits create a new version, and marks in unchanged categories carry over.

FAST SCORING ON THE FIELD
- Pick a station or category, then score by tryout number with large score chips.
- A number pad jumps straight to any athlete. "Next unscored" moves you on.
- Every tap saves instantly, with a light haptic confirmation.
- Mark an athlete absent, skip ahead, or add a short note.
- A progress bar shows scored versus checked-in athletes. The screen stays awake while you score.
- High-contrast clipboard design for sunlight, plus dark mode.

FAIR BY DESIGN
- Blind scoring: each evaluator sees only their own marks. Averages, rankings and other evaluators' marks stay hidden until the tryout lead unlocks results.
- "Numbers only" mode hides athlete names on the scoring screen.
- Share one phone with a hand-off screen ("Pass to Coach B"), protected by an optional 4-digit lead PIN.
- Or use several phones: share the tryout setup as a file, each evaluator scores on their own phone and sends back a scores file, and the lead merges them. Re-importing a file changes nothing; marks edited on two phones keep the newest edit and are listed. Files for a different tryout or rubric version are refused with a clear message.

AVERAGING YOU CAN EXPLAIN
- Per-category averages across evaluators and a weighted overall score from 0 to 100.
- Optional: drop each category's highest and lowest mark when 4 or more evaluators scored it.
- Optional evaluator normalization balances out harsh and lenient graders.
- Missing marks are handled: athletes below your coverage threshold are flagged incomplete.
- Athletes evaluators disagree on are flagged for a second look.
- Ties are broken by a priority category you choose, then the raw average, then tryout number.

RANKED LISTS AND PLACEMENT SHEETS
- A ranked list with per-category bars, flags and note counts.
- Define teams or levels with roster sizes, auto-place by rank (straight or snake fill), then move athletes by hand, lock placements and add placement notes.
- Share a placement sheet as a PDF made on your phone, with posting versions that hide scores or names, or export a CSV, or copy plain text.

A NUMBER AND A FIRST NAME ARE ENOUGH
- Add athletes quickly or paste a list like "12 Maya" or "13 Leo R". Last names are kept as an initial.
- Check athletes in per session, search by number, mark withdrawals.
- No birthdates, photos or contact details are asked for.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
- Everything is stored on this device. Code54 doesn't receive your data.
- Files leave the phone only when you share them through the share sheet.
- Back up a tryout as a file, duplicate a tryout for next season, or erase all data in Settings.

TRY IT IN A MINUTE
Load the sample U12 soccer tryout with 24 athletes, 3 evaluators and scores already in to see scoring, blind mode, results and placement right away. Remove it whenever you like.

TryoutScore is a tool for adults who run tryouts. Placement decisions remain with your club. Questions or ideas: support@code54.dev

name: TSF Booking: Salon Diary
description:
TSF Booking is the phone app for teams that already run their bookings on TSF Booking. Sign in with your TSF Booking account and the day's work is in your hand.

Your diary
- Day, 3 day and week views for you or any team member
- Press and hold on free time to book or block it
- Drag an appointment to a new time or day; the client can be told straight away
- Change an appointment's length without leaving the diary

Appointments
- Mark completed or no-show in one tap, with Undo
- Call, WhatsApp, text or email the client
- Tell a client you're running late, or that you're ready for them
- Team notes, forms, payments and the full history in one place
- Cancel with a reason, with the money position shown first

Booking
- Several services in one visit, with each one's team member, length and price
- Free times for the day at a glance
- Consent and intake questions asked before the booking is made
- Deposits requested as you book

Clients
- Find anyone by name, phone or email
- Credit, gift cards, packages and anything owed
- Upcoming and past visits, notes, photos and files

Checkout
- Cash with change worked out, card reader, gift cards, packages and account credit
- Split payments, discounts and tips
- Receipts by email

Today
- Today's, this week's and this month's appointments, cancellations and how full the diary is
- Requests waiting for your approval and visits still to check out
- Alerts for new bookings and changes, with an inbox to catch up

What each person sees follows their role in your business, so practitioners see their own clients and the money stays with the people who handle it.

You need a TSF Booking account to sign in.

name: Tsovca Work
description:
Tsovca Work là ứng dụng dành cho thợ lành nghề và người làm dịch vụ tại địa phương. Ứng dụng giúp bạn lập hồ sơ dịch vụ, tìm việc trong khu vực và theo dõi từng công việc từ lúc nhận đến khi hoàn thành.

Trong nghề thợ, tay nghề và lời giới thiệu truyền miệng thường là điều quyết định. Nhưng ít ai có thời gian tự làm một trang giới thiệu riêng hay tìm việc một cách bài bản. Tsovca Work ra đời từ chính điều đó: gom những việc cần thiết về một chỗ để bạn yên tâm tập trung vào công việc của mình.

Mọi thứ bắt đầu từ hồ sơ dịch vụ. Đây là nơi bạn giới thiệu nghề của mình, những dịch vụ bạn nhận làm và thế mạnh mà bạn muốn khách hàng biết đến. Hồ sơ không phải một biểu mẫu điền cho xong. Đó là ấn tượng đầu tiên về cách bạn làm nghề, nên đáng để chăm chút từng dòng. Khi tay nghề tiến bộ hay phạm vi công việc thay đổi, bạn có thể quay lại cập nhật hồ sơ bất cứ lúc nào.

Khi hồ sơ đã sẵn sàng, bạn mở danh sách việc làm tại địa phương. Mỗi mục là một công việc đang cần người làm ngay trong khu vực quen thuộc của bạn. Bạn có thể xem nhanh, so sánh và chọn những việc hợp với nghề và lịch của mình. Phần tìm việc được tách riêng khỏi phần việc đang làm, nên việc mới và việc đã nhận không bao giờ bị lẫn vào nhau.

Tìm được việc ưng ý, bạn nhận việc. Từ lúc đó, ứng dụng bắt đầu theo dõi công việc. Nó không còn là một dòng trong danh sách tìm kiếm mà đã thành cam kết cụ thể của bạn, và bạn cần một nơi để nắm rõ tiến độ.

Mỗi công việc đã nhận đi qua các giai đoạn, từ lúc nhận cho đến khi hoàn thành. Nhờ vậy, bạn luôn biết việc nào còn dang dở, việc nào đã xong. Khi có nhiều việc trong cùng một tuần, chỉ cần nhìn qua là bạn nắm được tiến độ và không bỏ sót việc nào đang chờ hoàn tất.

Khi bạn đánh dấu hoàn thành, công việc chính thức khép lại trong ứng dụng. Khoảnh khắc ấy tuy nhỏ nhưng có ý nghĩa với người làm nghề. Sau nhiều năm, thành quả của người thợ thường nằm rải rác trong trí nhớ, trong cuốn sổ tay hay trong những tin nhắn cũ. Có một nơi ghi lại rõ ràng từng công việc từ đầu đến cuối là điều thật đáng quý.

Tsovca Work dành cho những người làm dịch vụ ở địa phương: thợ điện nước, thợ mộc, thợ sơn và nhiều nghề dịch vụ gia đình khác. Họ thường làm theo mùa, theo lời giới thiệu và theo nhu cầu của bà con trong xóm. Với họ, một ứng dụng gọn nhẹ, đi thẳng vào việc chính thường có ích hơn một hệ thống rườm rà với đủ thứ chức năng không bao giờ dùng đến.

Ứng dụng không ôm đồm. Tsovca Work giúp bạn lập hồ sơ dịch vụ, tìm việc tại địa phương và theo dõi từng công việc từ lúc nhận đến khi hoàn thành. Với nhiều người làm nghề, chừng ấy đã đủ để công việc gọn gàng hơn, và để mỗi việc đã làm xong đều được ghi nhận.

name: Tsuzuri: One-Line Daily Diary
description:
Tsuzuri is a diary where you write just one line a day. No long entries, no pressure. Jot down what happened today, or a thought that crossed your mind, and you're done.

HOW IT WORKS
- Today: write one line (up to 120 characters) and, if you like, pick a mood from five faces. Save or delete it any time. A streak counter shows how many days in a row you've written.
- On this day: see the lines you wrote on the same date 1, 2, 3 years ago and more.
- Calendar: a month view with a mood mark on every day you wrote. Tap a day to write or edit it (future days are locked), or scroll through the month's lines as a list.
- Search: find past lines by word, and filter them by mood.
- Daily reminder: get a notification at the time you choose (9 PM by default). It stays quiet on days you've already written.
- Export and backup: export your diary as a text file (.txt), and back up or restore it as a file through the share sheet.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP USING IT
- One line a day is small enough to fit even the busiest day
- No account and no sign-up
- A calm, simple design that gets out of your way
- Available in 7 languages: Japanese, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Korean and Traditional Chinese

GOOD FOR
- Anyone who wants to start a daily journal but gives up on long entries
- Keeping a quick log of everyday moments, trips, or little things your kids said
- Looking back on what you wrote a year ago today
- A simple 5-year-diary style habit, built one line at a time

Your entries are stored only on your device. There is no server and no account (they are included in your normal iCloud or Android device backups).

Tsuzuri is free to use with a small banner ad. You can remove the ad with a one-time purchase, "Remove Ads". It is not a subscription.

name: Tu mens!
description:
Tu mens! ("you're lying!") is the bluffing card game played all over Cameroon, now on your phone.

Everyone lays cards face down and says what they are. True or not? If you doubt it, shout TU MENS! Right, and the liar takes every card on the table. Wrong, and they are yours. The first to get rid of their cards wins.

- Play with 2 to 4 people: create a table and share the link, friends join in one tap.
- Or play against the computer, with no account and no waiting.
- A first lesson teaches the game in one made-up round.
- Make your own character: face, hair, hat and clothes.
- Recorded shouts in French, English and Camfranglais when someone is called out.
- A leaderboard for those who lie best.
- In English and French.

Tu mens! is a game by Atalaku Studio.

name: Tundra: Workout Tracker Log
description:
Tundra is the workout log that lets you record every set in seconds and get stronger every week.

SMART WEIGHT SUGGESTIONS
Tundra looks at your past sets and RPE (rate of perceived exertion) to suggest your next weight and reps. It adds weight when you hit the target, holds it when you stall, and backs off if you struggle twice in a row.

FAST LOGGING
• Weight, reps, time and RPE
• Warm-up, drop and failure sets
• Your previous numbers next to every set
• A rest timer that starts automatically, with notifications

MUSCLE MAP ANALYTICS
See on a front and back muscle map what share of its weekly set target each muscle got, which muscles have recovered and which are still fatigued.

PROGRAMS
Foundation Full Body, Strength 5×5, Home Dumbbell and Calisthenics are free. Push Pull Legs, Upper/Lower, Glutes & Legs Focus, Classic 5-Day Split and 35-Minute Express come with Tundra Pro. Your active program prepares the next workout every day.

TUNDRA AI
Pick your goal, days per week, session length and equipment, or just type it ("4 days, leg-focused, with dumbbells at home"), and your weekly plan is ready in seconds. Runs on-device with Apple Intelligence on supported devices.

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
Add friends with a 6-character code, follow their workouts and streaks, and compete in a weekly volume league that resets every Monday. For every friend who joins with your code, you both get 30 days of Pro.

APPLE WATCH
Complete sets from your wrist and feel a tap when your rest is over.

AND MORE
• 99 exercises with step-by-step form cues and video guides
• Estimated 1RM, personal records and strength charts
• Weekly volume and RPE trends
• Workouts saved to Apple Health
• Plate and 1RM calculators, body-weight tracking
• Build routines and share them with a code
• kg / lb, English and Turkish

TUNDRA PRO
The Tundra AI program builder, 5 expert programs and AI coach notes. Monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TuneMeister
description:
TuneMeister is a precise guitar tuner for Apple Watch and iPhone. Open it, play a string, and feel the moment it is in tune.

TUNE FROM YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app works on its own. No phone in your pocket, no clip-on tuner in your case: raise your wrist and tune.

FEEL THE PERFECT PITCH
When a string settles in tune you feel a tap and hear a soft chime, so your eyes can stay on the instrument.

TUNE CHECK
Play the strings one by one. TuneMeister remembers each result, so you can see at a glance which strings are done and which are still a few cents off.

CLEAR GUIDANCE
A large note, a smooth cents meter and simple directions: Tighten, Loosen, In Tune. Status is shown with words and symbols, not colour alone.

BUILT FOR NEW STRINGS
Automatic string detection knows that fresh strings sit flat. When a string is far from pitch, TuneMeister shows the note you are actually playing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Audio is analysed on your device and is never recorded or shared. No account, no tracking, no ads, and it works fully offline.

• Standard guitar tuning (E A D G B E)
• Automatic or manual string selection
• Adjustable in-tune range (±2, ±3 or ±5 cents)
• Sound and haptic feedback you can switch on or off
• English and Turkish

name: TunerCraft: Guitar Pitch Tuner
description:
TunerCraft turns your iPhone into a studio-grade chromatic instrument tuner with crisp visual stability and zero ad clutter.

Powered by real-time on-device pitch detection, it locks onto acoustic guitar, electric guitar, ukulele, bass, and violin notes in milliseconds.

KEY FEATURES
• Precision Chromatic Pitch Needle: Clear cent offset indicator with instant in-tune visual lock.
• Popular & Alternate Tunings: Standard, Drop D, DADGAD, Open G, Ukulele, Bass, and Violin presets.
• Custom A4 Calibration: Tune smoothly from 415 Hz to 466 Hz for orchestral or vintage instruments.
• 100% Offline & Private: Microphone is analyzed strictly on-device — audio is never recorded or uploaded.
• One-Time Lifetime Pro: No subscriptions, no banner ads — unlock all tunings and A4 calibration forever.

name: TupleGauge
description:
Make a clear coverage plan for settings and test scenarios. TupleGauge shows which option pairs already have a saved test row, which are valid but missing, which are directly excluded, and which cannot occur with the other exclusions in place.

Name your factors and options, add forbidden pairs, and enter scenario rows or import them from CSV. Tap a pair in the matrix to see its state. Add suggested rows to complete reachable pair coverage, or keep working with your own scenario set.

Freeze a report to keep the original inputs and results as your plan changes. Preview and share the PDF or export the saved rows to CSV. Try the included release settings example in a few taps.

For iPhone. The main workflow works offline and has no account, subscriptions or advertising.

name: Turrid
description:
Turrid keeps the shells you notice on a beach walk.

Open a walk and read which shells stayed on the strand. A shell stays when it has a shape sentence, a written color band or texture, or a photo. A shell that is still a question stays in the pocket and is not counted. Two walks on the same beach and the same day stay on separate cards.

Write a glance in centimetres or millimetres. An empty width stays not written. Set the wrack line on a walk that already has a shell on the strand, then place those shells above or below the line.

Get Silt lists Spire Whorl at $0.99, Ribbed Cone at $1.99, Band Chevron at $2.99, Aperture Rim at $4.99, Wrack Drift at $9.99, Nacre Film at $19.99, Suture Groove at $49.99, and Umbo Knurl at $99.99.

Take photo uses the camera. Choose photo picks one picture. Save photo writes a picture into Photos. Record keeps a voice note on the walk. Privacy, Terms, and Support open from the welcome screen and from Kit.

name: TV Art Mode
description:
Turn your TV into a gallery.

TV Art Mode puts great paintings and your own photos on the Samsung The Frame TV on your wall, in native 4K, over your home Wi-Fi. No Art Store subscription needed.

1,700 WORKS IN 4K
• Van Gogh, Monet, Vermeer, Hokusai, Rembrandt and many more, cropped for a 16:9 screen
• Collections for every room, mood and season
• A new picture of the day, every day
• The story behind each painting, in English, Polish and German

PERFECTLY FRAMED
• Full screen or on a mat, with gallery and museum presets
• Mat colour picked from the painting, any width, double mats
• See exactly how it will look on your wall before you send it
• TV hung in portrait? Pictures are prepared for it automatically

YOUR OWN PHOTOS AND COLLAGES
• Send your own photos, cropped to fit the screen
• Two or three pictures on one wall: collages, triptychs and grids
• Your own collections, sent to the TV in one go

ART THAT CHANGES WITH YOUR DAY
• The TV changes pictures by itself, every few minutes or once a day
• TV brightness and colour tone from your phone
• Siri, Shortcuts and Apple Home: show a painting with your evening scene
• Widgets: see what's on your wall and switch to the next picture

ANY TV BECOMES A GALLERY
With TV Art Mode on Apple TV, any TV can show art full screen. One Premium purchase works on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: your own photos, the picture of the day and the first masterpieces.
Premium unlocks the whole library, your own mats, collages, unlimited collections and Siri actions. Choose a yearly plan with a 7-day free trial, a monthly plan, or pay once for life. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://ratajkowski.dev/en/regulamin-tv-art-mode
Privacy Policy: https://ratajkowski.dev/en/privacy-policy-tv-art-mode

Works with Samsung The Frame TVs on the same Wi-Fi network. Samsung and The Frame are trademarks of Samsung Electronics. TV Art Mode is not affiliated with Samsung.

name: Twain - pacing
description:
Twain is a precision speedcubing timer and practice lab for 3x3 solves. Time your attempts, review your history, study phase pacing, and keep clean notes and bench photos for each solve.

Whether you are building consistency or refining competition-style timing, Twain gives you a focused workspace for scramble, start, stop, review, and improvement.

KEY FEATURES

Precision Timer
Use a large timing pad with double-tap start and tap-to-stop controls designed to reduce accidental starts while scrolling. Optional inspection countdown supports familiar practice flow. Apply OK, plus two, or DNF when you commit a solve.

Scramble and Session Tracking
Generate clear 3x3 scrambles and keep an active session of recent captures. Open any solve for details, delete entries you do not need, and move quickly from capture to review.

Logs and Statistics
Browse your solve log with filters and review averages such as Ao5 and Ao12 plus spread metrics. See how your times trend across practice so you can focus on the next improvement.

Phase Annotation and Trace Reports
Mark solve phases, then forge a Trace Report for deeper pacing insight. Reports highlight phase breakdown, pause moments, turns per second style metrics, and concise commentary to help you understand where time is spent.

Solve Inspector
Add typed notes or use speech-to-text dictation for quick comments. Attach a bench photo from camera or photo library as solve evidence. Replace photos freely after the first save. Open Trace Reports or return to phase annotation when you are ready.

Secure Archive
Review session vault status, export a shareable vault card summary, preview exported cards, save cards to Photos, and remove cards you no longer need. Keep your practice record organized in one archive bay.

Trace Credits
Certain advanced actions use Trace Credits, including Trace analysis, vault card export, and first bench photo save for a solve. Welcome credits are granted when you begin. Optional consumable Trace Credit packs are available through Apple In-App Purchase with clear USD prices shown in the shop.

Settings and Support
Adjust preferences, review credit guidance, clear your user data when you choose, and open Privacy Policy and Terms of Use in Safari. Notification permission may be requested after you enter the main workspace.

PERMISSIONS
Camera and Photos are used only when you choose to attach or save images. Microphone and Speech Recognition are used only for optional note dictation. You can deny any permission and continue using the rest of the app.

Twain is built for cubers who want accurate timing, clear review tools, and a calm practice loop from scramble to archive.

Start a session. Capture clean times. Study the Trace. Improve the next solve.

name: Twin Bond: Dungeon Crawlers
description:
Two heroes. One shared destiny. Will you conquer the depths of the abyss or fall into eternal darkness?

"Twin Bond: Dungeon Crawlers" is an exhilarating 16-bit action roguelite that reimagines classic dungeon crawling with seamless single-player dual-character control. Take command of Leon, a steadfast blade-knight, and Violet, an elusive arcane ranger. Swap between them with a single tap to unleash devastating combos, command your companion in real time, crack ancient co-op puzzle mechanisms, and vanquish screen-filling fiends lurking in ever-changing procedural labyrinths!

GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS

SEAMLESS DUAL-HERO COMBAT
Experience fluid tag-team action! Seamlessly switch between Leon's close-quarters cleaves, shields, and whirlwind slashes, and Violet's long-range frost shots, rapid piercing arrows, and teleport dashes. One tanks while the other nukes—adapt your tactics in a fraction of a second!

TACTICAL COMPANION COMMAND & CO-OP PUZZLES
You are never alone in the dark. Command your AI companion to follow your lead into fierce battle, or order them to hold ground on ancient pressure plates to unlock locked iron portcullises. Should your partner collapse under heavy fire, rush to their side to revive them before all hope is lost!

TIERED ARSENAL & MYTHICAL AFFIXES
Discover, equip, and forge weapons across five rarity tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Divine! From the earth-shattering Colossal Greatsword to the infernal Flame Sovereign Staff, each weapon rolls unique randomized combat affixes—such as Life Steal, Critical Burst, Stun Traps, and Chain Elemental Procs. Refine and upgrade your favorite gear at holy supply shrines!

EVER-CHANGING PROCEDURAL DUNGEONS
Every expedition presents a brand-new maze generated on the fly. Explore interconnected halls, scout the real-time minimap, unlock treasure vaults with ancient rune keys, test your mettle in wave-based Combat Trials, and confront monstrous floor Bosses with screen-shaking attack telegraphs.

SOUL ALTAR · PERMANENT META PROGRESSION
Death is merely another step toward mastery. Collect precious Soul Shards from fallen champions and chests to unlock permanent talent blessings at the Soul Altar—boosting max health, critical strike rates, base weapon damage, and dungeon gold discovery across all future runs.

100% CLEAN & PURE GAMING EXPERIENCE
No intrusive ads, no forced commercial video pop-ups, and no predatory in-app purchase traps. Enjoy pure, responsive, nostalgic 16-bit hack-and-slash roguelite fun at your own pace, anytime, anywhere—with complete offline progression support!

CORE FEATURES

• Intuitive Mobile Controls: Responsive 360° virtual joystick and dedicated one-thumb combat action cluster.
• Modern Display Adaptation: Native support for iPhone Dynamic Island, camera notches, iPad ratios, and 60/120 FPS displays.
• Armory & Bestiary Codex: Track your weapon discoveries, loot collection, and monster vanquish logs.
• Procedural Retro Audio: Custom 16-bit synthesized soundscapes and punchy retro sound effects.
• Instant Save & Resume: Seamless local autosave allows you to pick up your dungeon run whenever you want.
• Bilingual Support: One-tap instant toggle between English and Simplified Chinese.

Steel your blades, prepare your incantations, and step into the abyss!
Download Twin Bond: Dungeon Crawlers today!

name: TwistCard: Handspun Yarn
description:
Measure the twist of a handspun yarn sample. Count turns to untwist a known gauge length, choose S or Z direction and record the sample. TwistCard converts the result to turns per inch and turns per centimeter.

Group samples by project, target a twist density and compare successive checks against that target. An optional wheel estimate shows expected twist from a user-entered ratio, treadling speed and delivery rate. Sample projects and a measuring guide are included. Export your twist samples as CSV.

All calculations and records work offline. Use measurement on your own sample to confirm any wheel estimate.

name: Tyoom: AI Calls & Scheduling
description:
Tired of chasing people on the phone just to set a meeting? Tyoom does it for you.

Noa, Tyoom's digital assistant, calls on your behalf in natural, warm Hebrew or English, explains why she is calling, finds a time that is free in your calendar, books the meeting and sends the invitation. After every call you get a summary, a transcript and the recording.

What Tyoom does:
• Schedules meetings by phone, based on your calendar (Outlook or Google)
• Delivers short messages for you
• Searches contacts live in your connected accounts, without importing your address book
• Respects calling hours and a "do not call" list
• Retries at the pace you choose, and can transfer a live call to you
• Learns from every call and improves
• Connects to bots (such as Grok) through MCP and an API

Transparency: Noa always introduces herself as a digital assistant and clearly says she is an AI when asked. Calls are recorded so you can see what was agreed.

Free during launch.

name: UkCaneMis
description:
**UkCaneMis – UK Cane Management Information System**

UkCaneMis is a mobile application designed to provide registered and authorised users with access to the UK Cane Management Information System.

**Secure Login and Access**

- Login using your registered mobile number.
- Verify your identity through OTP authentication.
- Access is restricted to registered and authorised users.
- Only users with valid access permissions can use the application.

**Application Overview**

UkCaneMis provides a convenient mobile interface for accessing available cane management information and services.

The application is intended exclusively for registered and authorised users.

**Important:** New users cannot access the application without prior registration and authorisation.

name: Ukeno: Week Number Calendar
description:
Ukeno shows the ISO week number on your Home Screen, on your Lock Screen and in StandBy. It is made for Norway, Denmark and Sweden, where people plan work, school and holidays in weeks: "uke 48", "uge 48", "vecka 48".

When you open the app, the week number is the first thing you see. Next to it are the dates of the week, the day of the year and how many weeks are left. Month pages have a column of week numbers. Tap a week to see its days and your calendar events. To find the dates of any week, type it, for example "48" or "2027-W12".

Public holidays for Norway, Denmark and Sweden are built in. They show as red days, and the app tells you how many weeks are left until the next one. Ukeno calculates them on your phone for any year, including Easter and the other moving holidays. Official flag days are listed too.

WIDGETS
• Small: today's week number (free)
• Lock Screen: the week number next to the date (free)
• Medium and large: the week, or the month with week numbers, holidays and your events (Ukeno Pro)
• Circular and rectangular Lock Screen widgets, and month widgets (Ukeno Pro)
• Countdown: weeks left until a date you choose, such as the summer holiday (Ukeno Pro)
• Daylight: sunrise, sunset and how much the day grows or shrinks (Ukeno Pro)
• Styles that follow Apple's Calendar widgets: Polar night, Frost or Automatic (Ukeno Pro)
The week number changes at midnight between Sunday and Monday, in local time, and it follows you when you travel.

ALSO
• The week number on the app icon (free)
• Ask Siri: "What week is it in Ukeno?"
• A year view with week numbers (Ukeno Pro)
• Add an event to your calendar from any day
• In English, Norwegian, Danish and Swedish
• No account and no ads. Your calendar and location stay on your phone.

Ukeno Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://lumxstudios.co/ukeno/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://lumxstudios.co/ukeno/privacy/

name: uLumaStage--Shadow Theater
description:
Astut sisään valoisaan pienoisteatteriin, jossa valo, lavasteet ja varjot jakavat saman näyttämön.

Asettele värikkäitä geometrisia paloja alemmalle tasolle, pyöritä yksittäistä lavastetta tai koko näyttämöä ja liu'uta valaisinta kiskoaan pitkin. Seuraa, kuinka yläseinälle piirtyvä elävä varjosiluetti muuttuu, kunnes se vastaa tarkasti tavoiteltua ääriviivaa.

Etene 24 lyhyen esityksen läpi kolmessa luvussa. Tutki valon kulkureittejä muistikirjasta, kerää onnistuneista ratkaisuista merkkejä, merkitse suosikkikohtauksesi kirjanmerkkeihin ja palaa milloin tahansa uudelleen kaikkiin avattuihin esityksiin.

Mikään lähtölaskenta ei kiirehdi tekemistäsi. Onnistuminen riippuu ainoastaan varjokuvion vastaavuudesta, joten myös luovat sommitteluratkaisut voivat täyttää tavoitteen. Selkeä visuaalinen ilme, pyöristetyt kirjaintyypit ja tarkat toimintavihjeet tekevät jokaisesta harjoituksesta hauskan ja huolellisen.

name: Umut Metron
description:
Umut Metron ile dijital eğlenceyi açık havada ve sosyal yaşam alanlarında gerçek fiziksel harekete dönüştürün!

Parklar, belediye yaşam merkezleri, okullar ve sosyal alanlarda kurulu METRON İnteraktif Zemin Oyun Sahaları; çocukların, gençlerin ve ailelerin ekran başında hareketsiz kalmak yerine koşarak, zıplayarak, düşünerek ve eğlenerek vakit geçirmesini sağlayan yeni nesil akıllı oyun alanlarıdır.

Umut Metron mobil uygulaması sayesinde çevrenizdeki aktif METRON oyun sahalarını kolayca bulabilir, oyun alanına geldiğinizde QR tabelasını okutarak dilediğiniz oyunu saniyeler içinde başlatabilirsiniz.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER

• Yakındaki Sahaları Haritada Keşfedin
Bulunduğunuz konuma en yakın METRON oyun alanlarını mesafe bilgisi, saha müsaitlik durumu ve yol tarifi desteğiyle anında görüntüleyin. Üye olmadan da tüm sahaları ve oyun havuzunu serbestçe inceleyebilirsiniz.

• QR Kod ile Hızlı Saha Bağlantısı
Oyun alanına ulaştığınızda uygulama içindeki gelişmiş QR tarayıcı ile saha tabelasını okutun veya listeden sahayı seçerek saniyeler içinde cihaza bağlanın.

• Zengin ve Eğitici Oyun Havuzu (8 Farklı Fiziksel Oyun)
Refleks, hız, görsel-işitsel hafıza (Hafıza Zinciri), heyecan ve strateji (Saatli Bomba), yer kapmaca, renk eşleştirme ve zihinsel aritmetik becerilerini geliştiren interaktif fiziksel zemin oyunları arasından seçiminizi yapın; oyun kurallarını tek dokunuşla inceleyin.

• Canlı Saha Skor Tabelası ve Sesli Yönergeler
METRON sahası oyunu başlattığınız anda Türkçe sesli yönergeler ve oyun müzikleriyle oyuncuları yönlendirir; saha detay ekranındaki canlı skor tabelasından aktif turun durumunu ve oyuncu puanlarını anlık takip edebilirsiniz.

• Güvenli, Reklamsız ve KVKK Uyumlu Deneyim
Uygulama içerisinde üçüncü taraf reklamlar veya uygulama içi satın alımlar yer almaz. Saha sensörleri biyometrik yüz tanıma yapmaz; yalnızca oyun içi hareket ve skor takibi gerçekleştirir. Kullanıcılar hesaplarını ve kişisel verilerini diledikleri an uygulama içerisinden veya web üzerinden kalıcı olarak silebilirler.

name: Unidos Por Gps
description:
UNIDOS POR GPS es la app oficial de Unidos Por Gps para monitorear tus vehículos y equipos GPS desde el celular, estés donde estés.

Con UNIDOS POR GPS puedes:
• Preguntarle al asistente con inteligencia artificial dónde están tus vehículos, cómo va tu flota o pedirle un reporte, por chat o por voz.
• Ver tus vehículos en tiempo real en el mapa, con su estado en colores: en movimiento, ralentí, estacionado o desconectado.
• Leer el resumen del día de tu flota: kilómetros, viajes, excesos de velocidad y vehículos sin señal.
• Seguir un vehículo en vivo desde la pantalla de bloqueo del celular.
• Revisar el historial de recorridos, los eventos y los reportes de viajes y paradas.
