• Bloquear y desbloquear tu vehículo confirmando con un deslizamiento (si tu plan lo incluye).
• Recibir notificaciones al instante: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, geocercas y más.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta del servicio de rastreo de Unidos Por Gps. Si todavía no la tienes, contáctanos:
+51973903111 · unidosporgps@gmail.com

name: Unmuddle: Sliding Puzzle
description:
A picture is cut into squares. One corner is taken out, and the rest are muddled. Slide the squares back, one at a time, until the picture is whole again.

That's all there is to Unmuddle, and that's the point. There is no timer, no leaderboard and no daily target. Every grid and every level is open from the start, and nothing runs out. Pick a picture, pick how hard, and take as long as you like.

YOUR PUZZLE, YOUR WAY
• Three grids: 3×3 for a few quiet minutes, 4×4 for a proper think, 5×5 for a long sit-down
• Three muddles: Light, Medium or Thorough
• Choose which corner square is taken out
• No levels to unlock

PICTURES TO MEND
• 30 pictures in four themes: animals, landscapes, flowers and places
• The classic numbered squares, for the purists
• Or use your own photos: choose one, position it in the square, and it becomes a puzzle. Your photos stay on your phone.
• Extra picture packs, starting with Christmas, if you'd like more. Bought once, yours to keep.

GENTLE HELP
• Hold to peek at the finished picture; the squares still out of place are faded
• Restart takes you back to where this muddle began
• New muddle deals a different one
• Stop whenever you like: every half-done puzzle is kept for next time

EASY ON THE EYE AND EAR
• A soft slide and a click as each square arrives, and nothing else
• Tap or swipe: only a square beside the gap can move
• When the last square slides home, the missing piece fades back in

NO FUSS
• Works offline
• No account, no sign-up
• One quiet banner advert under the puzzle. Adverts are never personalised and never interrupt you.

Every muddle is made with real moves from the finished picture, so every puzzle can be solved.

name: Unreel: No Reels, No Stories
description:
Use Instagram without Reels and Snapchat without Stories.

Unreel opens Instagram and Snapchat on the web, inside the app, and hides the parts that keep you scrolling. Your feed, messages and chats keep working. The endless video feeds don't.

INSTAGRAM, WITHOUT REELS
- The Reels tab is hidden
- Reels mixed into your feed are hidden
- Tap a Reel link and you're sent back to your feed
- Optional: hide Explore too

SNAPCHAT, WITHOUT STORIES
- Chat with your friends as usual
- Stories and Spotlight are hidden

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
A counter shows how many Reels and Stories you skipped today and in total.

LOCK THE OFFICIAL APPS
A one-minute guide shows how to set a Screen Time limit on the official apps, so you use Unreel instead.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. You sign in directly on Instagram's and Snapchat's websites. Your settings and stats stay on your iPhone.

Unreel is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Meta or Snap Inc. Instagram and Snapchat are trademarks of their owners.

name: Unsaid — Witness
description:
Unsaid helps two business partners find the gaps in their agreement before they turn into disputes.

HOW IT WORKS
• Each partner answers a short questionnaire privately and cannot see the other's answers.
• The app compares the answers by fixed rules and shows where your expectations differ: roles, money, decisions, exit, time.
• 12 review lenses explain each difference in plain language and suggest questions to discuss together.
• Export the result as a PDF and share it with your partner.

PRIVACY
• Answers are stored for 72 hours and then deleted.
• You can delete everything at any time with one button.
• Before you answer, the app asks your consent to send answers to a third-party AI service (Anthropic, via the lachuga gateway) for analysis.

IMPORTANT
Unsaid is a self-check tool for discussion. It is not legal advice and does not replace a lawyer. Laws differ by country; check important terms with a qualified professional.

name: Unspoken Social
description:
What do they really think of you?

Unspoken gives the things left unsaid a little room.

DAILY
Share one moment a day, ask a question or let your people choose between two photos. Choose your audience and discover their reactions.

SIGNALS
Receive curated anonymous thoughts, from appreciation to first impressions. Send one thoughtful Signal Back without opening an anonymous chat.

CONNECTIONS
Crush, Reconnect, Closer or Make Peace. Private intentions, mutual feelings and two clear yeses before a reveal.

CIRCLES
A private social space for your people, with shared moments, questions and polls. Invite with a link and approve who joins.

Your boundaries matter. Control eligible Signal audiences and optional categories, report or block unwanted interactions, and delete your account in Settings. Shared content is reviewed before publication. No paid feature reveals a Signal sender or overrides consent.

For adults 18 and over. An internet connection and an active profile are required for online features. Review delays can shorten a Drop's active sharing window.

name: Untoldby
description:
The test you finally passed. The stranger who helped on your worst day. The year everything changed.

Untoldby is a home for real moments, big or small, told in your own words and read by people around the world. No highlight reels, no hot takes: just real life.

WRITE YOUR STORY
• A calm, distraction-free writing space with a full-screen editor
• Add a cover photo and a topic like Family, Resilience or Gratitude
• Bold, italic and underline, and photos inside your story
• Share a story with everyone, or keep it to yourself
• Drafts save as you write, even offline

READ STORIES THAT STAY WITH YOU
• A feed of new stories from around the world, newest first
• Follow people and topics you love in your Following feed
• Search by story, topic, name or @username
• Adjust the text size for comfortable reading

TALK PRIVATELY
• Message the people behind the stories, with photos
• New people ask first, and you choose who can message you
• Share stories and profiles with friends
• Make your profile private and approve who follows you

A KIND COMMUNITY
• Like, comment and save the stories that move you
• Stories, comments and messages are checked for safety, with real moderators behind them
• Report or block anyone, anytime
• Zero tolerance for abuse

Every story is signed "Untold by" its author, because the people who lived them deserve the byline.

Untoldby is for adults (18+).

Terms: https://untoldby.com/terms

name: UP Manager
description:
UP Manager is the installer's tool for UP&SYSTEMS home automation devices: relays, blinds, dimmers and inputs. It finds the devices on the network, sets them up and leaves the installation documented.

FIND AND ADOPT
• Finds the devices on the same network on its own, wired or Wi‑Fi.
• Scans an IP range for other subnets or VLANs.
• Adopts several devices at once and assigns them to the devices planned in the project.

SET UP
• Name outputs and inputs, and test each one from the app.
• Define triggers: what each push-button does.
• Adjust network, Matter and KNX‑IP on every device.
• Update the firmware and save or restore backups.

DOCUMENT THE INSTALLATION
• Place the devices on the floor plans of the home.
• Build the electrical panels in 3D, with their DIN rails and circuits.
• Produce the quote and the commissioning checklist.
• Assign KNX group addresses and exchange the project with ETS.

WORK AS A TEAM
• Without an account, everything is saved on the device as a site file.
• With an UP Manager Cloud account, share projects with your team and carry on from the computer or the browser.

The same app is available for Mac, Windows, Linux and the browser, with the same features.

Requires UP&SYSTEMS devices on the local network to set them up.

name: UPDF: Sign & Compress PDF
description:
Resize a photo to the exact KB size a form asks for. Sign and fill a PDF in a minute. Compress, merge and convert files.
UPDF does it all on your iPhone, offline: no account, no uploads, no tracking.

RESIZE PHOTOS TO A SIZE YOU CHOOSE
• Target 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB or any size you type
• Exact pixels (for example 600 × 600), percent, or common presets
• See the final file size and pixel size before you save. If a size can't be reached, UPDF tells you
• Convert HEIC, JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF and BMP
• Resize or convert many photos at once (Pro)

SIGN AND FILL PDFs, FREE
• Draw, type or use a photo of your signature, saved for next time
• Fill forms: typed text lines up with the form's lines and boxes; tick checkboxes
• Highlight, annotate, add text and images
• Your original file is never overwritten. UPDF saves a new copy

COMPRESS, ORGANISE AND PROTECT
• Compress PDFs and see the real new size (Pro)

name: UPhoto: Photo Cleaner
description:
Free to download and use. No subscription or in-app purchases in this version.

Keep the moments you love. Give the rest a thoughtful look.

UPhoto is a photo-library organizer for iPhone, with a playful photography-inspired design and on-device cleanup suggestions.

REVIEW YOUR LIBRARY
• Find today’s screenshots.
• Group similar photos and review a suggested keeper.
• Review potentially blurry, blank or low-detail pictures.
• Browse videos separately and suggest short clips up to 3, 5 or 10 seconds.
• Favorites are kept out of suggested cleanup selections.

TODAY’S BEST PHOTO
Open and scan each day to find a suggested photo from today for your home screen. On iOS 18 and later, UPhoto uses Apple’s on-device image aesthetics model when available. On older systems, or when the model cannot run, technical-quality suggestions provide a clearly labeled fallback. Every recommendation is yours to adjust.

DAILY PHOTO INSPIRATION
A daily curated photography prompt offers an idea for your next frame: street shadows, reflections, a color to collect, or an ordinary moment in beautiful light. Inspiration artwork is illustrative and separate from your private library.

YOUR CHOICE, EVERY TIME
Review and change selections before cleanup. UPhoto and iOS both ask you to confirm deletion. Deleted items move to Recently Deleted. Reported sizes are estimates, not a measurement of storage already freed.

OPTIONAL COMMUNITY
Open the community website, explicitly submit one photo, and join an anonymous annual favorites board. Nothing is automatically posted. Submissions are moderated before public display, with reporting, withdrawal and contributor-blocking controls. The board is for reference; prizes and product sponsors are not confirmed.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Cleanup scans and daily photo analysis run on your device. UPhoto does not upload your library for scanning. Only a photo you deliberately submit to the separate community is uploaded. English and Simplified Chinese are available in Settings.

Requires iOS 17 or later. AI aesthetics requires iOS 18 or later and model availability. Limited photo access is supported; inaccessible or iCloud-only items may be skipped. Suggestions do not determine a photo’s importance.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

name: VAB: Archive 96
description:
Kadıköy, March 14, 1996. A murder case has gone unsolved for thirty years. Now it is your turn: as an image analyst at the Video Analysis Bureau, you watch that day's security camera tapes from the start.

The cameras saw everything. The tapes won't show it. Someone got to the recordings afterwards.

HOW IT PLAYS
You never leave your desk. Play the tape, freeze the frame, rewind, zoom in, and keep looking until you find the person, the object or the second you were after. Everything you find goes into the case file, and the file grows with your findings.

• Find the tampered tapes. A person may have been erased, a jacket may have changed color, the clock may jump ahead. Lay two copies side by side and catch the difference yourself.
• Test the 1996 case summary. The officer who wrote the file made 11 claims. Each one gets a stamp, "consistent with the footage" or "contradicted by the footage", when it meets what you found.
• Back up Defne from your desk. She is out in the field looking for a witness, with nothing but a description. You pick one face out of a crowd in a 1996 square recording and hand her the frame. The clock is running.
• Read witness statements, work through the documents, recall what you saw. A question waits at the end of every chapter.
• Six squares, eighteen recordings: Taksim, Eminönü, Kadıköy, Sultanahmet, Kızılay and Konak. Each field mission unlocks harder watch recordings for that square.
• Your score and rank rise with what you find, from Trainee Analyst to Chief Analyst. Random tapping gets you nowhere: stop, look, then tap.

FIVE CHAPTERS
1. Kadıköy, March 14: Three tapes. One has been tampered with.
2. Two Copies: Who was the woman watching him in the arcade?
3. The Identification: The man who stayed a suspect for thirty years.
4. Four Missing Minutes: Why is the parking garage empty at the moment of the murder?
5. The Master Tape: Every job has a master recording.

LOOK AND SOUND
Dark and quiet: an analysis desk with a tube monitor, 1996. In Turkish and English.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The story is a murder investigation and is meant for adults. Violence is not shown on screen.
• iPhone and iPad, played in landscape.
• No account needed, no ads. Anonymous usage statistics help us improve the game; you can turn them off in Settings. Episode 1 is free; Episodes 2–5 unlock with a single one-time in-app purchase (not a subscription).
• This story is fiction. Characters, institutions and events are imaginary.

name: Vairai
description:
Vairai is a private capsule of letters to your future self. Write today — an ordinary Tuesday, a decision you keep circling, a good day worth keeping — choose when the letter opens, and seal it. Until that day the body stays hidden, even to you. When the date arrives, the letter waits with a one-tap opening moment, and every letter can be answered.

**A REAL TIME LOCK**
The seal is the point. A sealed letter shows its title, its wax and its countdown on every screen — and nothing else. There is no preview and no exception, because if the body were readable, the opening date would mean nothing.

**24 PROMPTS TO START FROM**
Five families of writing prompts — milestones, ordinary days, feelings, people and places. Ask for courage you do not have yet, write the thank-you that never got sent, or describe the view from your window before it changes. Each prompt carries three questions to sit with and a suggested sealing span.

**A CEREMONY, NOT A NOTIFICATION**
When a letter's day arrives it waits under "Ready to open" with a single button: Break the seal. The moment is yours — the app just makes sure the letter is there.

**WRITE BACK**
Every opened letter accepts replies. One answer becomes a thread, so the exchange with your past self is a conversation you can reread in one place — the letter, the date it was written, and everything you said afterwards.

**SIX WAXES, ONE SIGNATURE**
Seal each letter with terracotta, ink blue, forest, plum, ochre or slate. The wax is purely a mood, but it travels with the letter everywhere it appears — the capsule, the detail page, the countdown card.

**WHAT THE CAPSULE ADDS UP TO**
Insights shows letters written, opened, sealed and replied; the writing rhythm across six months; the average and longest span you have ever sealed; how the writing felt, mood by mood; and a twelve-week calendar of writing days. Nothing scores you — gaps are information, not failures.

**PRIVATE BY DESIGN**
Vairai works fully offline. There is no account, no sign-in, no iCloud sync, no advertising, no in-app purchase, no analytics and no tracking. Letters and preferences live in the device's local storage and can be erased in one tap from More. The only network use is the privacy policy page, which opens only after you tap it, with a complete offline summary built in.

**A NOTE ON CARE**
Vairai is a personal writing space, not a mental health service. Writing to your future self can be a good habit, but it is not a substitute for help. If a letter feels heavier than paper can hold, please talk to someone you trust.

All content is in English. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: Vertumnus
description:
There's something satisfying about knowing exactly when your apple tree should bloom, why your quince smells like pineapple and rose, or what a mulberry needs before it'll drop fruit into your hands. Vertumnus is built around that kind of curiosity.

 At the core is a hand-researched atlas of more than thirty fruits — from the familiar (apples, strawberries, lemons) to the ones that earn second glances at a market stall (quince, persimmon, mulberry). Each entry goes deeper than a quick web search would. You get the fruit's wild origin pinned to a map, its Latin name and plant family, typical height and years to first harvest, the coldest temperature it can survive, and clear notes on pollination — because half the problem with stone fruit is not knowing you need a second tree.

 Growing guides are written to be useful rather than merely decorative. Harvest months are laid out across a twelve-month wheel so you can see at a glance whether two trees will overlap in season. Ripeness cues are specific — not "soft when ripe" but "wait a few days after they turn blue; the flavour keeps improving." Storage notes are practical. Nutritional highlights are there for anyone who wants them.

 The Journal tab is where you track what's growing in your plots and what you're still waiting to find. As you explore the atlas, fruits are added to your passport — a small collection mechanic that makes returning to half-read entries feel purposeful rather than obligatory. Each new discovery earns XP, and a small notification at the top of the screen lets you know the moment it lands.

 Vertumnus works equally well for someone mapping out their first patio container and someone who already has a mature orchard and just wants to understand it better. No subscription required, no sign-in, nothing to sync. The catalogue lives on your device, the growing notes are carefully researched, and the design borrows from vintage fruit-crate labels because, honestly, fruit deserves better than a plain list.

 Plant something. Watch it closely, long enough to understand it.

name: Vexmoru
description:
A little red troublemaker. A magnetic force. Fifteen seconds to find a way through.
Meet Vexmoru, a fast-paced arcade challenge where every movement matters and the path to victory is filled with unexpected obstacles. Guide a mischievous character through carefully designed levels, use magnetic attraction to control its movement, and reach the finish before the countdown reaches zero.
It sounds simple until the obstacles start getting in your way.
Two Sides, One Connected Challenge
Each level takes place on a screen divided into two sections. A magnet operates in the upper area, while your character travels through the lower section.
The magnetic force lifts the character, allowing you to guide it through the environment while avoiding obstacles positioned along the route.
Your objective is to bring the character safely to the end of the level within 15 seconds.
Pay attention to the relationship between the magnet and the character. Every adjustment influences the path below, so successful movement depends on timing, positioning, and quick decisions.
Ten Levels to Conquer
Vexmoru includes 10 playable levels, each built around the same magnetic movement mechanic.
Learn how the character reacts to the magnet, recognize dangerous sections, and adjust your approach as new obstacle arrangements appear.
A failed attempt is an opportunity to try a different route. Experiment with your movements, improve your timing, and discover how to reach the finish more efficiently.
Complete a level to earn 500 coins that can be used to purchase helpful boosts.
Three Ways to Change the Situation
Sometimes a few extra seconds or a clear path can make all the difference. Spend your earned coins on one of three available boosts:
Slo-Mo — 500 Coins
Slow down the timer and the movement of other elements on the screen by half for 15 seconds. Your character remains unaffected, giving you more control while the surrounding action moves at a reduced pace.
Destroy — 500 Coins
Remove all obstacles currently present on the screen. Clear the route and concentrate on guiding your character toward the finish.
Extra Time — 500 Coins
Add 15 seconds to the active level timer. Use the additional time to recover from a difficult section or complete the remaining distance.
Each boost offers a different approach to overcoming a challenging moment. Decide when to use your coins and which advantage fits your situation.
Earn Coins or Visit the Shop
Every successfully completed level rewards you with 500 coins.
You can spend these coins on boosts during gameplay or purchase additional currency through the in-app shop.
Two optional coin packages are available:
	•	1 000 Coins — $0.99
	•	4 000 Coins — $1.99
Coin purchases are optional. The game can be played using coins earned through level completion.
A Bold Arcade Experience
Vexmoru combines quick challenges with a vivid visual identity. Its glossy red character, energetic effects, and striking environments create a playful atmosphere around a mechanic that rewards precision.
The short level timer keeps every attempt focused, while the magnetic movement system encourages you to think about the space between your character and the obstacles ahead.
In Settings, you can independently enable or disable sound effects and music. You can also share the game with others or access the Privacy Policy and Contact Us pages.
Ready to Take Control?
Keep the magnet moving, watch the obstacles, and make every second count.
Ten levels. Three powerful boosts. One little troublemaker waiting for your next move.
Enter the world of Vexmoru and see how far your magnetic skills can take you.

name: VICE CODES
description:
VICE CODES is an independent iPhone companion for finding reported Grand Theft Auto VI story-mode cheat codes. Choose PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S and use three starter codes, favorites, the quick-start guide, Practice Mode for the starter codes, and an Explore sample for free with ads.

Explorer Pack is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks the full code catalog, Explore activities and routes, Unlock Tracker, vehicle guides, hidden spots, My Garage, and My Weekend Plan. The pack includes one new Story Mode location and one challenge each week. Practice any available code sequence, choose when to reveal spoilers, and enable reminders for scheduled drops. The in-app guides are available offline, and progress is stored on your device.

Each code links to its sources, and unpublished inputs are clearly marked. VICE CODES is an unofficial guide and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

name: Vidal: Vilanova Carnival
description:
Got a partner for Comparses yet?

Vidal is the app for finding someone to go arm in arm ("de bracet") with on Comparses Sunday, the big carnival parade in Vilanova i la Geltrú. The name comes from the Vidal, the historical figure who registered the Comparses couples and, for a small extra fee, would assign you one. Now the Vidal has gone digital.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scroll through the whole profile: 3 to 6 photos, their entitat, their song and their answers.
• Swipe right for "De bracet!", or tap the bubble on a photo or an answer to like it with a comment.
• Swipe left to move on to the next profile.
• Send a Caramel when you really like someone: the sweetest way to say it.
• When you both pick each other… it's a comparsa! And it rains candy.
• Chat with your matches using carnival icebreakers: soft or hard candy for the candy war?

MADE FOR COMPARSES
• Choose your entitat and fly its flag: Foment Vilanoví, La Unió Vilanovina, El Coro, Círcol Catòlic, Bordegassos, Can Pistraus and more.
• Share how many years you've been dancing and your song: El Turuta, Amparito Roca, Paquito el Chocolatero…
• Say what you're after: a partner for life, just this Carnival, or new comparsa friends.
• Filter by distance and age to meet people from VNG and nearby.

SAFETY
• Block and report any profile straight from the chat.
• You only talk to people who picked you too.

Vidal is available in Catalan, Spanish and English. You must be 18 or older to use it.

Made with candy in Vilanova i la Geltrú. An independent app, not officially linked to the entitats or the Carnival organisers.

name: vidiprinter
description:
The vidiprinter is how Saturday afternoons used to arrive: a teleprinter rattling out goals along the bottom of the screen, one line at a time. Grandstand had one. Final Score kept the name. Teletext made a generation watch football as text.

This is that machine, rebuilt for the whole planet.

EVERY GOAL, EVERYWHERE
Every goal and every card from every league and cup with football on today - around 480 competitions across 80 countries, roughly 430,000 goals a year - printed the moment the referee gives them. From the Premier League to the Bolivian second tier, in glorious green-on-black.

ALL OF IT, OR JUST YOURS
Watch the whole world print at once, or pick a competition and let the rest roll by. Search every league we carry before you subscribe. A live match list runs alongside the ticker with the score and the minute on every game.

NO NOISE
One line per goal. No video, no adverts, nothing to scroll past. The vidi prints, you watch. Goal alerts are opt-in: follow a team or a league and your phone gets a note when the score changes in their games; follow no one and it never makes a sound.

WHAT IT COSTS
Free: a selection of leagues playing right now, a few minutes behind, just to see how it works.
Subscribe: every league in the world, in real time, with goal alerts. $8.99 a month, and the first 7 days are free. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings. Sign in with Apple and the same subscription works on vidiprinter.app in a desktop browser.

HOW IT WORKS
The app shows the vidiprinter website, so it is never behind the web version. No account is needed for the free plan. A subscriber signs in with Apple; we keep the account's email, the subscription's state from the App Store, and, if you follow teams or leagues for goal alerts, your follow list and a notification token for your phone. Nothing is sold or shared. Privacy policy: https://vidiprinter.app/privacy

Realizer Labs LLC

name: VILLAIN BARBER CO

Book your next cut with VILLAIN BARBER CO in a few taps.

With the VILLAIN BARBER CO app you can:
- See every service with its price and duration
- Pick a time that suits you and book instantly
- Get a reminder before your appointment

name: Vilny
description:
Deixe seus Stories mais bonitos, criativos e com personalidade usando o app Vilny. 

Encontre figurinhas prontas para diferentes momentos do dia, datas especiais, frases, rotina, viagens, relacionamentos e muito mais. 

Escolha a figurinha que combina com o seu Story, copie e cole em segundos. 

Explore novas coleções, encontre seus favoritos e descubra conteúdos adicionados com frequência. Com o Vilny, aquele detalhe que faltava no seu Story está sempre à mão. 

Escolha. Copie. Cole. Pronto.

name: Vinde: Conectados pelo Mundo
description:
O Vinde é uma rede social feita para acolher. Aqui ninguém chega e fica sozinho: você encontra pessoas de verdade, conteúdos que fazem bem e um espaço seguro, sem ofensas.

No começo, a entrada é por convite. Quem já participa pode convidar outras pessoas, e cada convite aceito vira um brotinho na árvore de quem convidou.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO VINDE

• Pausa do dia: três minutos para respirar, ler um texto curto e responder a uma pergunta. Compartilhe a sua reflexão e veja quem também passou por ali hoje.
• Frases para hoje: dez frases novas por dia em uma pilha de cartões. Arraste para o lado, curta, guarde e compartilhe.
• Minha árvore: cada pausa, leitura, conversa e convite faz a sua árvore crescer, das raízes aos frutos, em 8 níveis.
• Sabedoria e jornadas: leituras em sequência, trechos curtidos e compartilhados com amigos.
• Comunidade: publique reflexões, histórias, pedidos de apoio e ações do bem. Reaja com "Amei", "Força" e "Inspirou" e comente com carinho.
• Seu momento: fotos que ficam 24 horas no ar.
• Mapa: amigos do Vinde por perto (sempre em posição aproximada), encontros e locais para participar na sua cidade.
• Encontros: confirme presença, veja quem vai e indique novos encontros.
• Conversas: mensagens com quem aceitou conversar com você.
• Como estou: um check-in rápido para acompanhar como você está e receber conteúdos que combinam com o seu momento.
• Trilhas: playlists para cada momento, no seu app de música preferido.
• Celebrar: aniversários e conquistas de quem você conhece.
• Diário: anotações pessoais que ficam só no seu iPhone, protegidas pelo Face ID.
• Compartilhar com estilo: transforme frases, publicações e momentos em artes para Story ou Feed, com a moldura do Vinde.

UM ESPAÇO SEGURO
Filtro de palavras ofensivas, opção de denunciar e bloquear em tudo e moderação humana. Tolerância zero com ofensas e abuso.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem anúncios, sem venda de dados e sem rastreamento. Você pode sair do mapa e excluir a sua conta quando quiser.

Vinde · Conectados pelo Mundo. Aqui você é recebido.

name: Virmo - little care
description:
A little care. A lifetime together.

Virmo keeps your pet health story in one thoughtful place. Create individual profiles for up to 20 pets, save vaccination and deworming dates, attach vaccine booklets and prescription photos, and keep your own notes from each veterinary visit.

Track weight measurements over time, keep symptom observations with photos and voice notes, and organize medication routines using the instructions supplied by your veterinarian. Local reminders help you remember the dates you enter.

Prepare a clear PDF health summary for your veterinarian or boarding caregiver. Saved summaries stay available to view and share.

Your pet records stay on your device. Export a health archive for safekeeping, import it when needed, and manage camera, photo and microphone access from your device settings. No account is required.

Virmo is a personal record keeper. It does not provide veterinary diagnosis, treatment recommendations or dosage calculations.

name: Visited Map: Countries, Cities
description:
Visited Map is a map of everywhere you have been. Tap Scan my photos and the app reads the place and date of your photos, on your phone, and fills in the countries, US states, Canadian provinces, UK nations and cities. You check the list before anything counts. Prefer not to scan? Pick places by hand from a list. That path is complete on its own.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
- The scan reads only where and when each photo was taken. It never copies, shows or uploads a photo.
- The places are worked out on the phone from bundled map data. There is no web lookup.
- No account, no email, no ads, no tracking.

CHECK BEFORE IT COUNTS
- Every place found is ticked. Untick a wrong match, such as a layover or a photo a friend sent you.
- The app tells you how many photos had no place, so nothing is silently skipped.
- The next scan reads only new photos. If you gave the app a limited photo library, one button lets you add more photos.

YOUR MAP
- Countries, 51 US states including DC, 13 Canadian provinces and territories, the four UK nations, and big cities.
- Pick places from a list that searches as you type and ignores accents.
- Dates for each place: first and last visit and how many photos. Add a note to a place.
- A wish list for places you want to go. They show in amber on the map.
- One switch for disputed borders in Settings.

STATS
- Percent of the world, counted against the 193 UN member states, with the count stated under the number. Other places are listed under More places.
- Continents, US states, Canadian provinces, cities, your busiest year and the farthest place from your home, worked out from your photos.

SHARE
- Share your map as a story, a square or a wide picture. Paper and Night themes are included. No watermark.

BACKUP
- One clear line in Settings shows whether iCloud is on and what it is doing. Turn it on and your map follows you to a new phone.
- Save a copy of your map as JSON or CSV any time, and restore from a copy.

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
- Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode, and runs on a Mac with Apple silicon.

PRICE, PLAINLY
The app is free to download, and the map, places, wish list, stats, sharing, photo scan, iCloud and copies are free for good. One optional one-time purchase adds Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, more map themes, more share styles and alternate app icons. There is no subscription, no ads and no account.

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).

name: Visual Timer & Alarm: Smidge
description:
Kids can't read a clock yet? Look at this.
Smidge is a visual timer you can read from across the room.
The disc gets smaller as the minutes go, so anyone can see what's left.

Smidge is a visual timer. Drag around the disc or tap a time to set it. Hit Start and the color shrinks toward 12 as the minutes go. Put the phone on the counter or the iPad on the whiteboard ledge and the whole room can read it.

When time's up it rings the way the Clock app's alarm does, with the phone on silent, in a Focus, or with Smidge closed. While it runs, the countdown sits on the lock screen, so you can check it with the phone locked.

What's free, and staying free:
• The disc timer, any length up to 2 hours
• Six quick times, from 1 minute to 30
• 5, 20, 60 and 120 minute faces
• Three disc colors to pick from
• The alarm, the lock screen countdown, and "1 more min" right on the alert
• Big numbers, or hide them and let the disc do the talking

For mornings and classrooms, Pro adds:
• Saved timers like Teeth 2 min and Homework 25 min, one tap away
• Routines that run one timer after another. When Get dressed ends, the alarm has a button that starts Breakfast.
• A picture on every step and saved timer, so someone who can't read yet still knows what's next. Pick one of 32 icons or use a photo of their own toothbrush. It sits in the middle of the disc while the time runs.
• Something to look forward to at the end, like a photo of the park. When time's up it fills the disc and stays there until someone taps Done.
• Five more disc colors and three more alarm sounds
• A Control Center button that starts your last timer

Smidge Pro costs $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year, and the year comes with a free week first. Or pay $39.99 once and never think about it again. The monthly and yearly plans auto-renew; cancel from your Apple account settings at least 24 hours before the period is up and the next charge won't happen.

No ads, so nothing pops up on screen when the timer ends. No account, nothing to sign in to, and nothing leaves your phone. It works offline.

Requires iOS 26 for its alarm.

Teachers and parents, we want to hear how you use it: support@rowhousesoftware.com.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rowhousesoftware.com/privacy

name: VitalSheet: Health Data Export
description:
Get your health data out of the Health app and into a file you can actually use: a PDF for your doctor, a spreadsheet, or a workout track. Free, no account, nothing uploaded.

The Health app's own export is one giant XML file. VitalSheet gives you clean files in seconds instead.

FOR YOUR DOCTOR
• Doctor PDF: your typical resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, steps and more, the range most of your days fall in, weekly trends, and space for notes.
• Blood Pressure PDF: morning and evening averages laid out like the ESH home-monitoring protocol, every reading day by day, with resting heart rate and sleep alongside.

FOR SPREADSHEETS AND ANALYSIS
• Excel workbook (.xlsx): separate sheets for sleep, heart, body, movement and workouts, frozen headers, real dates, and a sheet that explains every column.
• CSV bundle: tidy tables with a README, ready for Numbers, Google Sheets, Python or R.
• JSON: every value unrounded, with units.
• Markdown summary: one tap copies a clean summary to paste into an AI assistant or your notes.

FOR WORKOUTS
• GPX and FIT files with the full GPS route and heart rate, ready for Strava, Garmin Connect, Komoot and other training apps.

PICK EXACTLY WHAT GOES IN
• Health, Workouts or Blood Pressure
• 7 days, 30 days, 3 months, a year, all time, or your own dates
• Choose metric groups and see how many days have readings before you export
• Preview, save to Files, AirDrop, Mail, or automate exports with Shortcuts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• VitalSheet reads from the Health app and never writes to it
• No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Files are made on your iPhone and go only where you send them

Try it without connecting anything: tap "Preview with sample data".

VitalSheet is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition.

name: VocalFlow: Sesli Not & Dikte
description:
Konus, Fikirlerin Aninda Notlara ve Gorevlere Donussun!

VocalFlow; akliniza gelen dusunceleri, toplantilari, alisveris listelerini ve gunluk gorevleri yazi yazmakla ugrasmadan sesinizle hizlica kaydetmenizi saglayan modern bir sesli not ve dikte asistanidir.

name: Vokamon
description:
Vokamon is a language-learning app for people who want to learn from real life, not from textbooks.

Pick a language (Spanish, English or Dutch), pick your level (A1 to C2) and learn from things you already enjoy:

TV
Pick a series for your level. Before each episode, a short quiz teaches words and expressions from that episode, so you can follow it without getting stuck. Words you miss come back later, and words you know make room for new ones. TV series are currently available for learners of English; more series and languages are added over time.

MUSIC
Connect Last.fm or Spotify, warm up with common words and earn XP for the songs you listen to.

NEWS
Short articles written for your level, with a question to check you understood.

GAMES
Quick games, such as a geography quiz about the countries where the language is spoken.

Made for real learning
- Questions and answers stay in the language you are learning, so you think in it.
- A daily goal and XP bar keep you coming back.
- Light and dark themes.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

Vokamon is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TV shows, artists or services it mentions.

name: Volt Trip
description:
Volt Trip is the logbook for electric and plug-in hybrid cars. Record every charge with start and end levels, energy, price and odometer, and watch each session fill a battery bar. Home, work, public AC and DC charging are tracked separately, with night-rate pricing applied automatically to home charges. Add receipt photos and notes, and keep a list of your favorite charging stations with connectors, amenities, prices and status reports. 

See what your car really costs to run. Volt Trip calculates real consumption between charges and compares seasons, so you know exactly how much winter takes from your range. Your cost per kilometer is measured against a petrol car you choose, and the yearly savings are summed up in a Year in Review. Track battery health with monthly range readings and capacity tests, with seasonal effects removed, and stay on top of maintenance by date and mileage. 

Plan long drives without a connection. Enter the distance, starting charge and conditions like highway speed or cold weather, and Volt Trip builds a route plan with charging stops, arrival levels, charging times and estimated cost. Reminders cover maintenance, monthly battery checks, night-rate charging and upcoming trips.

name: VoltBook: Electrician Handbook
description:
VoltBook puts the tables and calculations electricians reach for every day into one fast, offline app — with search that actually finds things.

SEARCH THAT WORKS
Type a code reference (310.16, 250.122), a trade term (romex, greenfield, sealtite) or a value from inside a table (14-50, 4/0). Typos are forgiven.

CALCULATORS
• Wire size full check: load + 125 % continuous + voltage drop → wire, breaker, equipment ground and minimum conduit on one screen
• Ampacity with temperature and conductor-count derating and terminal limits
• Voltage drop (Chapter 9 Table 8 and K-method)
• Conduit fill for EMT / IMC / RMC / PVC with mixed wire sizes, box fill
• Motor circuits: full-load current, conductors, breaker / fuse, overloads
• Transformer current, power-factor correction, star–delta, Ohm's law and power, offset bending
• IEC mode: mm², metres, 230/400 V voltage drop and cable sizing

TABLES
Interactive ampacity lookup (tap a size, derating applied), 310.16, correction factors, conduit and wire areas, how many wires fit, box volumes, bending multipliers, motor FLC and protection, grounding conductors, standard breaker sizes, working clearances, arc-flash PPE categories, AWG / mm², wire colors.

DIAGRAMS
Tap-to-toggle wiring diagrams: single-pole, 3-way and 4-way switches, start/stop motor control, GFCI line/load, service voltages, NEMA and IEC plugs.

• Favorites open the exact table or calculator
• Light / dark, English, Spanish and Vietnamese
• Works offline, no account, no tracking

Pay once — every feature, forever. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.

VoltBook is an independent reference. It is not affiliated with NFPA or any publisher and does not reproduce code text; always follow the code edition adopted by your AHJ.

name: VoltPeek: Battery Monitor
description:
VoltPeek shows you how the battery of your car, camper or motorbike is doing, with a BM2 or BM6 Bluetooth battery monitor clipped onto the terminals. All on your phone, no account.

LIVE
• Voltage with two decimals, updated every second
• The state in words: charged, good, needs charging, charging
• Charge and terminal temperature (BM6)
• A chart of the last 5 minutes

TESTS
• Cranking test: the lowest voltage while you start the engine
• Charging test: the average voltage with the engine idling
• A clear written outcome, with the limits of the measurement

HISTORY AND ALERTS
• Charts from 5 minutes to 30 days, with lowest, highest and average
• CSV export
• Low or high voltage alerts, while the app is open and connected

TRULY PRIVATE
• No account and no location
• No server: your data stays on the phone
• No ads, no analytics

TRY IT WITHOUT A MONITOR
Tap "Try the demo": a simulated day with cranking, charging and a weak battery in the cold, even in airplane mode.

COMPATIBILITY
BM2 and BM6 type Bluetooth battery monitors for 12 V systems, also sold under other names. The monitor accepts one phone at a time: close the original app before connecting.

IMPORTANT
VoltPeek shows the device's measurements. It is not a diagnosis of the electrical system and does not replace a check at a garage. Thresholds and estimates are indicative. Do not use it while driving.
VoltPeek is an independent app, not affiliated with the makers of BM2 and BM6 monitors. Names are used only to state compatibility.

Privacy and terms: https://www.neurafit.it/voltpeek/en/privacy/

name: Vous êtes député
description:
Vous êtes député. Vous siégez avec un groupe de l'Assemblée nationale réelle et vous défendez les idées que votre parti a publiées. Chaque mois, votre agenda est trop court : une semaine à Paris pour voter la loi, ou une semaine dans votre circonscription pour écouter les habitants. Il faut choisir.

LE MANDAT, SEMAINE APRÈS SEMAINE
• Commission, séance, journée réservée à l'opposition, questions au Gouvernement : le mois suit l'article 48 de la Constitution.
• Quinze textes de loi fictifs à examiner, à amender et à voter, puis la navette avec le Sénat, la commission mixte paritaire et, pour une révision de la Constitution, le Congrès.
• Le 49.3 et la motion de censure, les droits de l'opposition, le Conseil constitutionnel, le référendum d'initiative partagée.
• 64 situations tirées des textes officiels : cadeaux, conflits d'intérêts, cumul des mandats, visiteurs à la permanence, frais de mandat.
• Le budget du député en euros réels : dotation, collaborateurs, permanence, solde reversé en fin de mandat.
• En fin de législature, la campagne et l'élection : mandataire financier, plafond des dépenses, dons permis et interdits, porte-à-porte.

LA RÉALITÉ, PAS UN AVIS
• Les groupes de l'Assemblée, leurs sièges et leur place dans l'opposition viennent des données officielles et du Journal officiel.
• Les idées des partis sont citées mot pour mot, avec l'adresse de la page où elles sont publiées et la date du relevé.
• Après chaque choix, le jeu montre la règle réelle et sa source.
• Le jeu ne juge ni les partis ni les idées. Les votes calculés et la circonscription sont une simulation.

À VOTRE RYTHME
• Une session d'octobre à juin, environ une heure, pour la classe ; ou la législature complète, cinq sessions puis l'élection.
• Seul ou de deux à quatre sur le même appareil : chacun est député de son parti, les votes se font à découvert.
• Un mode accompagné : votre collaboratrice vous conseille.
• Affichage automatique, clair ou sombre. La partie en cours est gardée.

POUR QUI ?
Collégiens, lycéens et étudiants, enseignants d'enseignement moral et civique, futurs électeurs, et tous ceux qui veulent comprendre ce que fait un député.

Jeu indépendant, sans lien avec l'Assemblée nationale, le Sénat, le Gouvernement ou un parti politique. Sans publicité, sans abonnement, sans achat intégré, sans compte, sans collecte de données. Fonctionne hors ligne, sur iPhone, iPad et Mac.

name: VRS One
description:
VRS One– Corporate Flight & Hotel Booking

VRS is an enterprise travel management application designed exclusively for employees of registered corporate organizations. It enables authorized corporate users to manage their business travel requirements, including flight and hotel bookings, through a centralized and controlled platform.

Employees can search for flights and hotels, submit booking requests for approval, and proceed with bookings based on the permissions granted to them. Managers can review and approve travel requests through their authorized web access, ensuring that corporate travel policies and approval workflows are followed.

Important: Corporate Access Only

VRS is not a public or consumer-facing travel booking application. Access is restricted to employees of existing corporate clients who have been provided with valid login credentials by their organization.

The application does not support public account registration, self-service sign-up, or the creation of new user accounts. Only pre-authorized corporate users can log in and access the services enabled for them.

VRS provides a secure and structured environment for managing corporate flight and hotel bookings, travel approvals, and employee travel permissions.

name: VSHLLC
description: VSHLLCEnter the principal amount of a new loan and allocate it across the loan amount, deducted fees, and the actual bank account into which the funds were deposited. Once the deposit is confirmed, record the principal, interest, and fees, and track any remaining outstanding balances. If you only have information regarding a bank debit, you can record the transaction initially and then break it down into its specific components once you receive the detailed statement. If a settlement statement is corrected, you can update your records by cross-referencing the original statement and the bank transaction history. You can also track regular income and expenses—such as salary, housing costs, and commuting expenses—reconciling them item by item against your bank statements to monitor your monthly cash flow and upcoming payment deadlines. When comparing different repayment plans, you can set a common cutoff date to evaluate monthly installments, projected interest, and the remaining principal balance.

name: Vuelca: your photos, safe
description:
Vuelca moves the photos, videos and documents on your iPhone or iPad wherever you want and sorts them by itself. Nothing is deleted from your phone unless you ask.

WHEREVER YOU WANT
• To your computer over Wi-Fi, with the free Vuelca program for Mac.
• To any cloud: iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive…
• To a drive plugged into your phone.
• To several places at once.

SORTED BY ITSELF
Every photo in its folder by type, year, month and day, with the name of the place: “Photos / 2026 / 08 August / 24 Lisbon”. Screenshots go apart, and the same file is never copied twice, even if you rename it.

NO WORRIES
• Automatic backup: with the phone charging and on your home Wi-Fi, it moves what’s new by itself and lets you know when it’s done.
• Checks that every copy is still in place.
• Choose what to move: photos, videos or documents; only favourites, an album or from a date.

AND MORE
• Clean up: finds near-identical and blurry photos, and frees up space only from what is already safe.
• Lighter videos: videos you’ve already copied take up far less on the phone; the original stays in your copy.
• On this day: photos from this same day in earlier years.
• Paper photos: scan your old photos and keep them in their year.
• Restore old photos: removes scratches and spots, brings back colour, colourises black-and-white photos, enlarges small ones and sharpens faces. With artificial intelligence, on the phone.
• Album to print: composes a PDF with your best photos.
• Family: each person in their own folder.
• Professional: each client or job in its own folder.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY IN YOUR HANDS
Everything happens on your phone and in the places you choose. We never see or keep your photos. No ads.

PRICES
7-day free trial with everything when you start the yearly Vuelca Complete subscription; cancel before it ends and you pay nothing. Also, Vuelca Plus with a yearly subscription or a single payment for ever. Add-ons are bought once and are yours forever. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before, in your Apple account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://vuelca.eu/privacy

name: Vynqora Meltraxis
description:
In Golden Blocks, one of three games in Vynqora Meltraxis, tap to rotate gem pieces and drag them onto an 8-by-8 board to clear full rows and columns. Clear a line through a star to collect it. Every five stars give you another use of each helper, so aiming for a star now can earn you a hammer to free up a square when the board gets crowded.

Keep clearing lines on back-to-back moves to build a streak, and work through ice blocks that take two clears to break. Take your time in Classic mode or see how much you can clear in a two-minute Timed round.

For a faster change of pace, guide an orb through the gate that matches its color in Color Gate, even when a distracting color word appears. In Potion Drops, drag falling drops into matching jars and collect five in a jar to brew a potion.

name: Waelir
description:
4,000-character limit.

> A quiet seed library.
>
> Waelir keeps the varieties you save, swap, buy or inherit: the packet on the shelf, the row in the bed, the first pick and the weight it brought in. It is a private notebook for a real seed habit, not a shop, a course or a social feed.
>
> WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
>
> • A seed shelf: name, family, source, packet weight, grams left, year kept, days to germinate and a note.
> • A sowing log: bed, position, date, seed count, depth, spacing, germination and state.
> • A harvest basket: weighed picks, the row they came from and six simple moods.
> • A garden year: months, beds, varieties and the longest row in one annual reading.
>
> THE SMALL DETAILS
>
> • Packet states: Full, Open, Low and Empty, read from the grams you have left. No automatic stock deduction.
> • Sowing states: Planned, Sown, Up, Planted, Cut and Failed.
> • Six beds: Bed A, Bed B, Raised 1, Raised 2, Greenhouse and Pot row.
> • Search and filters for the shelf, the log and the basket.
> • Favourites for the packets and rows you want close at hand.
> • A month-by-month harvest chart and a six-bed ring that count what is actually there.
> • A germination figure for the rows that came up.
>
> A LIBRARY, NOT A SHOP
>
> There is nothing to buy inside Waelir. No seed catalogue, no affiliate links, no growing course, no plant scanner, no weather feed, no AI garden advice and no score for your harvest. The app records what you decide; it does not tell you what to grow.
>
> KEPT ON THIS IPHONE
>
> The library is one local JSON file. Waelir needs no account and no cloud. It has no analytics, no advertising, no third-party SDK and no background network request. Export a JSON backup or a CSV of your sowings whenever you choose. Delete the app and the local library goes with it.
>
> The only page that uses the network is the hosted Privacy & Support page, opened inside the app when you ask for it. Your seed library is never sent with that request.
>
> A QUIET HOUR
>
> An optional local reminder can be set between 05:00 and 11:00. Notifications are scheduled on the device. If permission is declined, the rest of the app still works.
>
> MADE FOR TWO HANDS
>
> Warm paper, a serif label and a monospaced catalogue. Portrait, light appearance, iPhone. iOS 15 and later.
>
> The sample library contains 12 varieties, 21 sowings and 12 harvests, so the first launch has something to read, edit and clear.
>
> Waelir is for the packet on the shelf and the row that follows it.

name: Wallora - pairing
description:
Wallora is a free local archive for phone wallpapers and home screen pairings. Keep lock screens, home looks, source photos, and short notes on this device so you can revisit what worked and why.

On Records, browse your setups in a grid, filter by home, lock, or source, and start a Quick Home or Quick Lock capture. Open Search when you need a title, note, or device lookup. Tap the Home, Lock, or Photos summary cards to open Archive Insights. Featured moods and sample gallery cards help you start when your own archive is still empty. Sample cards are labeled as examples and are not mixed into your saved archive until you create your own setup.

On Review, compare two frames side by side, see a simple pairing score for contrast and role fit, and fold or expand the recent timeline. Delete setups you no longer need.

On Ideas, shuffle mood boards, save favorites, and use a look to create a setup in Records. Save an idea image to Photos for 1 credit. Widgets and Seasons tools help you plan home widget coverage and seasonal rotation from looks you already like.

Gift credits power optional actions only. Save to Photos costs 1 credit. Export a setup JSON pack costs 2 credits. Browsing, comparing, editing notes, and building your archive stay free. Open Gift Store from the credit chip or Settings. Apple handles payment. Credits are added only after a verified purchase. There is no Restore Purchases button because packs are consumable credits.

Wallora can use the camera and photo library for wallpaper source shots and screenshots, the microphone and speech recognition for setup notes, and may ask once for notifications on first home. Notifications are not used to send campaigns. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use open inside the app. There is no account and no public feed. Your setups stay on this device unless you clear local data.

name: Warehouse IQ
description:
Warehouse IQ helps Dustac plant-floor and warehouse teams manage material bags, production runs, dispatches, and daily stock counts directly from an iPhone or iPad.

Use continuous barcode and QR scanning to receive incoming materials, allocate bags to production batches, dispatch finished Dustloc product with shareable batch certificates, and verify inventory across the plant floor.

Key features:

- Continuous Code 128 barcode and QR bag-label scanning with visual, audio, and haptic confirmation
- On-device printed bag-number recognition and manual code entry when labels are worn or damaged
- Material receiving, traded goods receipt and issue, and production batching
- Dustloc dispatch recording with downloadable, shareable batch certificate PDFs
- Live stock overview, daily stock counts, bag checks, bag lookup, and supervisor sign-off
- Secure sign-in using work email or Microsoft SSO

Warehouse IQ is intended for authorised Dustac warehouse and plant-floor personnel only. Access requires an approved Dust IQ account with warehouse permissions.

Questions or support? Contact developer@dustac.com.au.

name: Washington Mobile Detailing
description:
Washington Mobile Detailing makes it easy to keep your vehicle looking its best without leaving home or work.

Simply choose your service, select a time, and we'll come directly to you. Our professional detailers bring the equipment needed to clean your vehicle at apartments, offices, homes, parking garages, and more.

Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete interior and exterior detail, booking takes just a few minutes.

Features:

• Book appointments in seconds
• Mobile detailing at your home or workplace
• Interior and exterior detailing
• Easy rescheduling
• Secure online payments
• Appointment reminders
• View upcoming bookings
• Professional, insured detailers
• Pet Hair Removal and more

No waiting rooms. No driving across town. Just professional car detailing delivered wherever your vehicle is parked.

Download the Washington Mobile Detailing app today and enjoy a cleaner car without changing your schedule.

name: Wasly Volunteering Connection
description:
Find your way to give back with Wasly.

Browse volunteer opportunities without an account. Choose a city, region or country, filter by cause, and review the schedule, age requirements and organizer's instructions before requesting a place.

With Wasly you can:
• Search published opportunities in the places you care about.
• Review available shifts and request a place.
• Follow requests, read organizer announcements and send private messages about an opportunity.
• View attendance and service hours confirmed by the organizer.
• Report concerns privately to Wasly and block an organization.

Organization coordinators can respond to volunteer requests, exchange private messages and post announcements in the app. Wasly reviews organizations and opportunities before publication.

A place is reserved after the organizer confirms your request. Check your school's service-hour policy and the organizer's transportation, supervision and participation requirements.

Wasly accounts are for ages 13 and older. Volunteers under 18 should involve a parent or guardian and obtain any permission required for the activity.

Availability depends on which organizations have published opportunities in the selected area. Account features require an internet connection.

Support: https://wasly.org/support
Privacy: https://wasly.org/privacy
Terms: https://wasly.org/terms

name: WatchOne IPTV
description:
WatchOne IPTV is a player for your own IPTV subscription. Enter your provider's credentials (Xtream Codes) or the address of an M3U list, and the app shows live TV, TV guide, catch-up, films and series.

WatchOne IPTV is a player. The app contains no channels and no content and does not provide access to any. You need your own playlist from a provider for which you hold the necessary rights.

Live TV
Channel list with categories, favorites and your own lists. Current and next program. Live pause: pause and rewind a broadcast. Change channels by number on Apple TV.

TV guide and catch-up
Program for the coming days, reminders for upcoming broadcasts and access to your provider's archive where catch-up is offered.

Films and series
Library with categories, watchlist and continue watching. The next episode starts automatically.

Multiview
Several channels on one screen at the same time.

Media library
Your own films and series from the home network: shares (SMB), DLNA, Plex and Jellyfin.

All devices
One purchase covers Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Watchlist, favorites and continue watching sync through your iCloud account. Settings and playlists transfer from device to device over Wi-Fi.

More
Profiles with their own PIN, parental control, downloads on iPhone, iPad and Mac, AirPlay, light and dark appearance, built-in manual, 21 languages.

Purchase
Monthly subscription, yearly subscription or one-time purchase. Both subscriptions start with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage and cancel them in the settings of your Apple account.

Privacy: https://watchone.dhu-digital.de/en/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://watchone.dhu-digital.de/en/terms.html

name: Watermark Remover: AI Eraser
description:
Erase watermarks, logos, text and date stamps from your own photos and videos. Just drag a box over the mark and it's gone.
The background is repainted so it looks untouched, right on your device: no upload, no account, works offline.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a photo or a video (up to 60 seconds).
2. Drag a box over the mark, or tap a preset for common spots such as a corner star, a corner wordmark or a top-left badge.
3. Tap Erase, compare before and after, then save to Photos or share.

TWO ERASE ENGINES
• AI fill invents a natural-looking background behind the mark. Best for textured scenes: grass, water, fabric, foliage, crowds.
• Smooth fill is instant and ideal for flat backgrounds: skies, walls, studio shots.

VIDEO, NOT JUST PHOTOS
• Every frame is repainted, with steadiness smoothing so the patch doesn't flicker.
• The original audio is kept.
• Clips up to 60 seconds.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
• Your photos and videos are never uploaded. No account, no sign-up.
• Each export is saved as a new file; your original stays untouched.

MADE TO FEEL EFFORTLESS
• A dark, glass-style interface that keeps your picture front and center.
• A before/after slider to check every detail before you save.

TRY IT FREE
Your first 3 exports are free. Go Pro for unlimited exports: weekly, yearly (best value) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Please use Watermark Remover only on photos and videos you own or have the rights to edit.

SUBSCRIPTIONS & PURCHASES
• Pro Weekly: 1-week subscription, renews automatically.
• Pro Yearly: 1-year subscription, renews automatically.
• Pro Lifetime: one-time purchase, never renews.
• Pro Weekly and Pro Yearly start with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the subscription starts and you are charged.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.
• Prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country or region.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.phanesads.com/privacy

name: WattWindow: Cleaner Timing
description:
Find a lower-carbon time to run a flexible electric load. Enter its energy use, run time and scheduling deadline. WattWindow compares contiguous start windows and shows their estimated emissions alongside the earliest feasible start.

Use the built-in practice forecast, import half-hour data from CSV, or fetch the public Great Britain carbon-intensity forecast. Review the forecast source and timestamps and export a comparison. The app estimates emissions and does not control appliances, chargers or meters.

name: Wavelit: Social Ride
description:
Wavelit is a social game built around What the water keeps. 
Play a short touch-controlled lantern boat ride, then switch into the native social space for chat, friends, feed, and your profile. Launch the same ride from the Wavelit tab, send messages, react to shared rides, and keep the people you meet close. The game runs locally inside the app, with a persistent social/game switch that keeps both surfaces full screen.

name: WearMate
description:
WearMate is an adaptive clothing store for people with limited mobility, those recovering from injury, and families caring for older relatives.

Every product is chosen for easy dressing: magnetic closures, seated fits, and soft seams. The app is built for real accessibility, with large text, high contrast, big buttons, and full VoiceOver support, and you can adjust these anytime in the Me tab.

Shopping is simple. Browse, save favorites, and place an order in a few taps. We call to confirm, then ship it free; you pay when it arrives.

WearMate. Getting dressed shouldn't be the hard part.

name: WeatherLab Gear
description:
WeatherLab Gear makes it easy to rent professional weather observation equipment for fieldwork, education, outdoor events, and short-term projects.

Explore a curated catalog of handheld weather meters, home weather stations, rain gauges, action cameras, lightning detectors, and environmental monitoring tools. Compare daily rental rates, key specifications, package contents, and product highlights to find the right equipment for your needs.

Choose your rental dates, add equipment to your bag, and manage your rental from one place. Round-trip shipping is included, and payment is collected by cash on delivery.

Whether you are measuring wind and rainfall, setting up a temporary weather station, or documenting changing outdoor conditions, WeatherLab Gear gives you access to specialized equipment without the cost of ownership.

FEATURES

· Browse weather observation and photography equipment
· View detailed specifications, daily rates, and package contents
· Select rental dates and estimate rental costs
· Save your favorite equipment for quick access
· Manage your rental bag and saved shipping addresses
· Track confirmed, upcoming, and completed orders
· Round-trip shipping included
· Cash on delivery with no online payment required
· Manage your profile and account data in the app

From occasional measurements to temporary field setups, WeatherLab Gear helps you find and rent the right tools for your next weather observation project.

Weather observation equipment does not replace official forecasts, emergency warnings, or professional judgment. Always follow local safety guidance and avoid hazardous weather conditions.

name: WedaloHub
description:
WedaloHub to panel dla małych firm i agencji, które prowadzą swoje social media i strony same.

W aplikacji:
- odpowiadasz na komentarze z Facebooka, Instagrama i YouTube z jednej listy,
- dostajesz powiadomienie o nowych komentarzach, nieudanej publikacji, awarii strony, zapytaniu o wycenę, rezerwacji i zamówieniu,
- dodajesz i planujesz posty ze zdjęciem lub filmem z telefonu,
- sprawdzasz wyniki postów i odwiedziny stron, zapisujesz raport do PDF,
- agencja przełącza się między kontami klientów.

Aplikacja jest dla osób, które mają już konto WedaloHub.

name: WeekRill
description:
Give every week a realistic shape. Create work blocks with a project, day and duration, then compare planned hours with daily capacity. Move between weeks, open a day to see its work, mark blocks complete and review completed hours. Search across your saved work blocks.

Core tools work offline. No login, ads or in-app purchases. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance and one of eight interface languages. Your records and preferences persist between launches. Optional sample data helps you explore an empty library.

name: Weekwear: Outfit Planner
description:
Get dressed with a plan. Weekwear turns the clothes you already own into a seven-day outfit board.

• Import photos of tops, bottoms, shoes, and layers into a private closet.
• Set a warm, mild, or cool day, then generate outfits that rotate through your pieces.
• Swap individual garments and pin the looks you want to keep.
• Mark an outfit worn and see how often you reach for each item.
• Share an outfit board as an image.

Start with a sample closet or add your own clothes. The app runs offline and weather preferences are set by you. One purchase unlocks the whole app.

name: WeGo: Driver
description:
WeGo Driver is the official delivery courier app for approved drivers on the WeGo B2B delivery network across Lebanon.

Connect directly with local partner stores and restaurants, receive real-time delivery offers while on duty, navigate to pickup and drop-off locations, and track your completed deliveries and earnings in one app.

KEY FEATURES
• Instant On-Duty Control: Switch ONLINE when you are ready to accept deliveries and switch OFFLINE at any time to stop receiving offers and pause location sharing immediately.
• Real-Time Order Dispatch & Alerts: Receive time-limited delivery offers, order assignments, and status updates in real time while on duty.
• One-Tap Navigation & Coordination: Open turn-by-turn directions for pickup and drop-off addresses, call partner stores directly, or message customers on WhatsApp during active deliveries.
• Transparent Earnings & History: Filter your delivery history by date across Open, Delivered, and Declined orders, with a clear Cash on Delivery (COD) breakdown of delivery fees, your cut, and the company cut.

HOW LOCATION IS USED
WeGo Driver uses your GPS location strictly while you are signed in and toggled ONLINE (on duty) to match you with nearby partner store orders, display your live position on the map, and support active delivery tracking. Toggling OFFLINE or signing out stops location sharing immediately.

REQUIREMENTS & ONBOARDING
WeGo Driver is exclusively for approved adult delivery couriers (18+) who hold a valid driver's license, vehicle registration, and insurance in Lebanon. New driver accounts are verified and provisioned by the WeGo team—tap "Sign up" in the app to reach us on WhatsApp or visit https://wego.partners.

All deliveries operate strictly on Cash on Delivery (COD). No online payments or in-app purchases are processed through the app.

name: Wendelbach: Who's Lying?
description:
Nothing terrible ever happens in Wendelbach. Something odd happens all the time.

The bakery's eighty-year-old sourdough starter has vanished. Three hundred rubber ducks are drifting down the stream. Forty-one garden gnomes turn up as a choir on the church steps. And every time, three villagers insist they had nothing to do with it.

One of them is lying.

HOW YOU INVESTIGATE
• Listen to the suspects' statements; every one is voiced.
• Collect evidence and hold it against what they said.
• If it fits, the alibi stands. If it contradicts, you have found the lie.
• You only get three wrong attempts. Guessing will not help, listening will.

WHAT TO EXPECT
• Cosy mysteries with humour and quirky characters, no blood, no violence
• Cases of five to eight minutes, made for a short break
• A week of six daily cases that each yield a clue for the big Sunday case
• Every case is checked to be solvable: there is always exactly one contradiction
• German and English, with voice acting in both languages

NOTE
The texts, voices, music and illustrations in this game were created with AI tools and editorially reviewed.

name: What's for Dinner – Recipe Box
description:
What's for Dinner saves the recipe, not the 2,000-word story above it.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Get the ingredients, steps, photo, servings and cook times, with a link back to the original
• Works with most food blogs and recipe sites
• Type in family recipes yourself, with your own photo and notes

HOW TO ADD A RECIPE FROM A WEBSITE

From Safari:
1. Open the recipe page in Safari.
2. Tap the Share button.
3. Tap What's for Dinner. The first time, you may need to scroll to the end of the row of apps, tap More, and turn it on.
4. Check the preview, add tags like Main or BBQ if you want, and tap Save.
5. Open What's for Dinner and the recipe is in your library.

From any other app (Chrome, Messages, Mail):
1. Copy the recipe's link.
2. In What's for Dinner, tap + and choose Paste Recipe Link.
3. Tap Paste, then Get Recipe.
4. Check the preview and tap Save.
You can also share a link straight to What's for Dinner from apps that offer it.

If a site asks you to confirm you're human, the page appears in the app so you can finish the check, then the recipe loads. If a site doesn't publish its recipe in a readable format, you can still save the link and type the recipe in.

COOK WITHOUT SCROLLING
• Turn your iPhone sideways: ingredients on the left, steps on the right, each in its own scrolling panel
• Tap ingredients to check them off and tap a step to keep your place
• The screen stays awake while you cook, with an option for larger text

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
• Tag recipes by type, style, method, diet and occasion, like Main, BBQ, Smoker, Weeknight
• Search by name, ingredient or tag, and filter your collection
• Favorites and star ratings
• Can't decide? Tap the dice for a random pick

PLAN THE WEEK
• Plan breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for each day
• Make a recipe 1½× or 2× and the shopping list follows
• Add notes like "Leftovers" or "Pizza night"

ONE SHOPPING LIST
• Build a list from the week's plan or straight from a recipe
• Matching ingredients are combined ("1½ cups onion, for Chili and Tacos")
• Sorted by aisle, with salt, pepper and water skipped
• Add your own items and share the list to Messages, Reminders or Notes

Works on iPhone and iPad. Your recipes stay on your device. No account, no ads.

Try everything free for 7 days, then unlock it all with a one-time purchase. It's not a subscription. Recipes you've saved stay readable even if you don't unlock.

name: What's on Cape Town
description:
What's on Cape Town is your guide to going out in Cape Town and the Western Cape. See what's on this weekend, check the wind before you pick a beach, find somewhere to eat, stay or explore, grab a local deal and browse jobs.

Today
When you come back to the app after a while, it can open on Today: the weather and the wind for your part of the city, ideas for the day, what's on today and your nearest beaches. Pick your area by hand or let the app work it out from your location, and switch Start on Today off in the Menu if you would rather go straight to Home.

Beach & wind
What the wind is doing and how hard it gusts, the hours ahead, the sea on each coast, which beaches are sheltered, and every beach rated for the wind, best first.

Events
This weekend's events, and everything else that's coming up. Save events to My plan, which lays them out by day, and add one to your calendar with a tap.

Places
Restaurants, places to stay, things to do, markets, wine farms, the outdoors, bars and nightlife, coffee shops, shops and weddings. Sort by what is nearest to you.

Deals and jobs
Local deals from Cape Town businesses, and jobs posted by local employers.

The Guide
Stories, day trips and practical notes for Cape Town and the Western Cape.

Cape Town essentials and safety
Emergency numbers, including sea rescue, mountain rescue and Shark Spotters, with tips for the beach, the mountain, the sun and getting around.

Alerts
Choose what you hear about (the weekend's events, the weather, new jobs, deals and events) and how often, and set your quiet hours.

For businesses
Sign in with a code we email you: there is no password to remember. List your business, submit an event or post a job for free, and manage your listings, deals and promos from your account. Book a social post, a featured listing or another placement on whatsoncapetown.co.za.

Browsing needs no account. Save places and events on your phone.

Discover Cape Town. Experience More.

Support: info@whatsoncapetown.co.za

name: When by OpenApps
description:
Free group scheduling polls. Pick a few dates and times, share the link, and everyone marks when they can make it. The best time shows as answers come in, in each person's own time zone. No sign-up, no ads, no limit on polls or people.

What you get
- Suggest dates from a calendar, with one or more times each, or all day.
- Everyone answers yes, if need be or no, with no account and nothing to install.
- Times show in each person's own time zone.
- Comments on the poll for notes like "Only after 6 for me".
- Pick the final time, and everyone can add it to their calendar.
- The organizer can download every answer as CSV.

Sharing
Tap Share link and send it to the group. Whoever makes a poll also gets a private admin link to manage it from another device.

Your data
When starts you as a guest on this phone and never asks for an email. You can delete your polls, answers and account from the bottom of the home screen at any time.

When is made by OpenApps. It also works in a web browser at when-free.openapps.xyz.

name: Whetlog
description: Whetlog is a knife-angle notebook. Each knife stores a name, a steel, degrees per side, a stone, and a pass count. The angle is the number you type, from 8 to 30. Steep means that number is 20 or more. Stones group knives by the stone name and show the average of those angles. A session stores its own date, angle, and passes, and saving one does not replace the numbers on the knife. Nothing is uploaded, and the app does not test whether an edge is sharp.

name: Whisker Whack: Cat vs Aliens
description:
Dinner is served. The aliens want it. One cat says no.

Whisker Whack is a two-button arcade game. Tiko the cat peeks over the kitchen counter and guards a plate of fish. Tap left to slap with the left paw. Tap right to slap with the right paw. That is the whole control scheme, and it gets wild fast.

Alien bugs fly in from both sides to steal the fish. Slap each one as it reaches the paw mark on the counter. Chain hits into combos, fill the meter to set off Zoomies, and land both paws together for a Double Whack.

EASY TO START, HARD TO PUT DOWN
The first slap lands within seconds. Then the bugs learn tricks. Darts rush in. Armored Clunks take two hits. Boings hop over to the other side. Twinpods split into two tiny Mites. Lurks hover and wait for a paw that swings too soon. And one of them is a friend: let the Nib courier pass and it drops a crate on the plate.

30 LEVELS, 3 ROOMS, 1 VERY LARGE BEETLE
Earn up to three stars on every level in the Midnight Kitchen, Lilac Dawn and Amber Noon. The last level of each room is a fight with Big Bloop, a horned beetle that comes back tougher each time.

NIGHT SHIFT AND THE DAILY WHACK
Night Shift is the endless mode: the wave gets faster until the plate is empty. The Daily Whack is one new wave every day, with one scored try and as much practice as you like.

DRESS THE CAT
13 cat looks: tuxedo, calico, siamese, a royal crown, an astronaut helmet, a highlander hat and more. 11 of them are earned by playing.

FAIR BY DESIGN
No ads during play, ever. Rewarded ads are always your choice. Coins are earned, never sold on their own. Money buys looks and ad removal, never power.

PLAY YOUR WAY
