Works offline. Every sound cue is on screen too, so it plays with the sound off. Turn the timing guides on or off, slow the motion down, or switch on Relaxed timing for a wider hit window.

Left paw. Right paw. Save dinner.

name: White & Brown Noise: Steady
description:
Can you hear your sleep sound start over? Look at this.
Steady is fan, rain and brown noise that never loops.
Each sound is made on your phone as it plays, so it goes all night without repeating.

Most sleep sound apps play a recording on repeat. Once you notice where it starts over, you hear it every time. Steady doesn't use recordings.

Free:
• Brown and white noise, plus a box fan
• A tone slider for each: deeper or brighter, or the fan's speed
• A sleep timer that fades out slowly instead of cutting off. Or skip it and play all night
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with controls on the lock screen
• "Start Steady" with Siri or Shortcuts
• A Steady button for Control Center and the lock screen

Pro adds more sounds and mixes:
• Rain and ocean waves, and pink noise
• A parent's shush, a muffled heartbeat like in the womb, and a hair dryer, all for the baby
• Up to three sounds at once, each at its own volume
• Saved mixes, one tap to get back to the one that works

Pro is $4.99 a month. A year is $29.99 and starts with a free week, or it's $49.99 to keep for good. The month and the year renew automatically. Cancel whenever you like in your Apple account settings; do it 24 hours or more before the renewal date and you won't be charged again.

If it's for a baby, put the phone across the room, 7 feet or more from the crib, and keep the volume low.

No account and no ads, and nothing is recorded. Steady doesn't use the microphone and doesn't need the internet to play.

Want a sound we don't have? Tell us at support@rowhousesoftware.com.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rowhousesoftware.com/privacy

name: Whitespace: Photo Frames
description:
Whitespace frames your photos the way a gallery would: with quiet margins, beautiful paper and the details of how you made the picture.

FRAME IN SECONDS
• Pick a photo from your library, grouped by month
• Choose a shape for your feed, Stories or print: 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 3:2, 16:9 and more
• Optical lift sets the picture slightly high, the way framers hang it

BORDERS WITH CHARACTER
• Plain, keyline, double, bevel mat, float, film rebate, torn paper and frosted
• 12 traditional paper colours, colours picked from your photo, or any colour you like
• Rounded corners, a white inner border and paper grain

INDIAN FRAMES
• Pattachitra: a hand-painted folk border of daisies and vines
• Haveli: carved wood around an embossed paisley mat
• Jharokha: your photo in a carved sandstone arch window
• Block print, Kolam and Zari: hand-block butas, rice-flour loops, gold brocade for wedding photos
• Twelve Indian colours, from haldi and sindoor to neel, and captions in Hindi

CAPTIONS AND CAMERA DATA
• Add a title above, below, split, in a band or up the sides
• A museum-style caption plate and a handwritten signature
• Your camera, lens, aperture, shutter, ISO and date print themselves from the photo
• Shoot film? Save your cameras, lenses and film stocks and add them in a tap

VIDEO TOO
• Frame videos with the same looks, trim them, mute them, save as MP4

FROM SCREEN TO WALL
• Frame and print size calculator: mat window, borders and outside size
• See a framed print on your wall in AR before you order it

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no servers, no tracking
• Camera data is kept in your exports; location is removed unless you choose to keep it

One purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.

name: Whity
description:
Whity è una lavagna infinita per prendere appunti, disegnare e organizzare le idee, su iPhone e iPad. Gratis e senza abbonamenti.

LAVAGNA INFINITA
• Tela senza limiti e pagine infinite in ogni lavagna
• Scrittura fluida con Apple Pencil, sensibile alla pressione, o con il dito
• Penna, evidenziatore, gomma, forme, testo, foglietti e immagini
• Annulla e ripristina, zoom, griglia a punti e sfondo chiaro o scuro per ogni lavagna
• Esportazione delle pagine come immagine

ORGANIZZAZIONE
• Cartelle e sottocartelle, con la destinazione scelta da te
• Etichette colorate e lavagne preferite
• Ricerca rapida tra le lavagne

APPUNTO VELOCE E TASK DEL GIORNO
• Scrivi un appunto al volo, generico o direttamente in una cartella
• Scrivi le task come le diresti: "Chiamare Rossi alle 15", "domani", "urgente". Whity le numera e le mette in ordine da sola

SPAZI
• Spazio personale: resta solo sul tuo dispositivo
• Spazi condivisi: inviti un altro dispositivo con un QR e lavorate insieme sulle stesse lavagne, con il nome di chi ha creato ogni elemento

SICUREZZA
• Database e file cifrati sul dispositivo
• Negli spazi condivisi i contenuti vengono cifrati prima di lasciare il dispositivo
• Sblocco obbligatorio con Face ID o Touch ID

Tema chiaro e scuro automatico, interfaccia pensata per iPhone e iPad.

name: WhoDB
description:
WhoDB connects your data and lets your team build what comes next: shared business records, apps, workflows and AI, with permissions built in. This app puts your WhoDB project on your phone.

Sign in with your WhoDB account to run the apps your team builds, look up and update records where the work happens, and ask the AI agent about your data.

- Run your team's apps, including offline once they are saved to the device
- Browse connected sources, datasets, business records and files
- Ask the WhoDB agent questions about your data
- Download and share files

Access follows the permissions set in your project, so people see only what has been shared with them.

A WhoDB account is required. Plans and billing are managed on the web.

name: Wickdash: Nightbell Run
description:
Carry a secret letter through ten guarded routes. Watch where the guards turn, slip past their lanterns, and bring the letter back to the rendezvous. A creaking floorboard can give you away. A well-placed stone can draw a guard off your path.

Play as a guest or choose an account. Guest and account progress are saved separately on your iPhone.

name: Wilmington Brew Works
description:
Download the Wilmington Brew Works app for access to our membership & special perks!

With the Wilmington Brew Works app you will find:

- The Cellarman’s Circle
- Brew Works North
- Order Online (Pickup at Miller Road)
- Latest & Greatest
- About The Beer
- WBW Miller Road
- Rewards
- What’s On Tap
- What’s In The Wilm - Newsletter
- Socials

Stay connected to Wilmington Brew Works! Check out our two locations & what they have to offer, see what’s on tap, join our Cellarman’s Circle membership, and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: Win I Chef’s Table
description:
Explore the restaurant menu, book a table, and plan your next dining experience. Order meals for a specific time, join a chef-led masterclass, or discover a dish and drink combination matched to your preferences.

Browse 28 dishes across four categories. Each dish includes ingredients, calorie counts, preparation times, and vegan or vegetarian labels where applicable. Add dishes to your cart and choose immediate or scheduled preparation. Your table number is automatically linked to an active reservation. Alternatively, book a table or select takeaway.

Reserve a table on the first floor, in the outdoor seating area, or on the second-floor terrace. Choose a date and time, explore the seating plan, and select an available table. View your reservation details and a countdown to its start.

Discover seven chef-led masterclasses held throughout the week. Explore event descriptions, images, schedules, and prices. Choose your preferred date and book a ticket.

Find a dish and drink combination through a personalized five-question quiz. Receive recommendations based on your tastes and dining preferences.

Explore the pairing tool to discover drinks that complement your meal. Select a menu category and a dish to receive two drink recommendations, each with a short explanation of the pairing.

Send quick requests to your waiter directly through the app. Request water, napkins, table clearing, the bill, or additional assistance. Track the status of your requests and cancel them if needed.

name: Wingit: Find a +1
description:
Never wing it alone.

Your friend bailed. The show didn't. Wingit finds you someone who's already going to the same gig, comedy night or club night, so a cancelled plan never means a cancelled night.

THE DROP
This week's best nights out in your city, picked around what you love: gigs, club nights, comedy, theatre, festivals and food. Browsing is always free.

TAG ALONG
See who's going solo to an event, send a request, and when they say yes your chat opens. Sort a meet spot and go together.

GOING SOLO? SAY SO
Mark yourself as going and we'll let you know the second someone else is.

GOT A SPARE TICKET?
Find a +1 who actually wants to go, not a stranger on a resale site.

SHOW UP, LEVEL UP
Pick your gig blob, earn XP for every night you actually go to, and lose it for flaking.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report or block anyone in one tap. We review every report within 24 hours. Always meet somewhere public. Wingit is for people 18 and over.

CITIES
London, New York, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Pune and Hyderabad.

WINGIT UNLIMITED
Browsing is free. Tagging along is free for your first 3 days, then needs Wingit Unlimited (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://wingit-offstagelabs.web.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://wingit-offstagelabs.web.app/privacy

name: Wird: Habit Tracker
description:
Wird is a private, beautifully designed spiritual habit tracker for your daily Mamulat (معمولات) — prayers, dhikr, Quran recitation, Lataif and personal routines.

31-DAY MAMULAT MATRIX
• See your entire month at a glance, with Gregorian and Hijri dates side by side
• Edit any day's count directly in the grid with quick +/− steppers
• Monthly summaries for every habit

PRAYER TRACKING
• Log each of the five daily prayers as Takbeer-e-Oola, With Jamat, Individual, or Qaza
• Track Sunnah and Nawafil: Tahajjud, Ishraq, Chaasht, Awabeen and more

DHIKR, QURAN & LATAIF
• Tasbih counters with presets (+1, +5, +10, +100)
• Quran pages and Juz progress
• Moraqiba / meditation minutes

ANALYTICS
• Overall strength index and habit retention curves
• Total zikr, Quran pages and presence time

TEMPLATES & CUSTOM ROUTINES
• Start from curated spiritual routines, a blank template, or generate one
• Add, rename and organize tasks and sections

PRAYER TIMES & REMINDERS
• Local prayer time calculation (no server tracking) with regional calculation methods
• Optional prayer and morning/evening adhkar reminders

WEEKLY POINTS & GROUP CHALLENGES
• Optional weekly scoring with customizable habit weights and challenge rules
• Optional end-to-end encrypted Group Challenges via QR code or invite link (up to 25 members)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• All habit data stays on your device; group keys live in your device Keychain
• Export to Excel, PDF chart or JSON backup anytime

Urdu and Arabic labels are shown throughout, alongside English.

name: Wiregrass AI
description:
Meet Wiregrass AI, your workspace for local discovery and everyday questions.

DISCOVER YOUR COMMUNITY
Search local businesses, products, and services. Browse upcoming events, explore listing details, and open directions in Apple Maps. Save useful listings and share your experience with business reviews.

GET HELP THROUGH CONVERSATION
Ask questions, work through ideas, and follow up in the same conversation. Choose your assistant and thinking settings, organize your chat history, and copy or share useful answers. When voice is available, speak your question and listen to the reply.

WORK WITH YOUR DOCUMENTS
Upload supported documents and images, attach them to a conversation, or search your saved files with Knowledge. Find relevant information with source references, including recognized text from supported images and scanned PDFs.

CREATE AND EDIT IMAGES
Describe an idea, generate an image, or upload reference images to guide an edit. Keep track of requests in your image gallery and save or share completed results.

MAKE IT YOUR WORKSPACE
Switch between light and dark themes, revisit conversations, and manage your files and saved listings. Report an issue or delete your account from Help.

An internet connection and a Wiregrass AI account are required. Account access is subject to approval. Feature availability depends on the service configuration. AI responses can contain mistakes; check important information and confirm business and event details with their source.

Support: support@wiregrass.ai

name: Wirtschaftsfachwirt & Meister
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Industrie- und Handelskammer, zur DIHK oder zu einer Behörde.

Mit Wirtschaftsfachwirt & Meister bereitest du dich auf deine IHK-Fortbildungsprüfung vor. Die Prüfung nimmt ein Prüfungsausschuss der Industrie- und Handelskammer ab, Inhalt und Ablauf regelt für jeden Abschluss eine Verordnung des Bundes. Beim Geprüften Wirtschaftsfachwirt etwa schreibst du zuerst die Prüfung „Wirtschaftsbezogene Qualifikationen“ in Volks- und Betriebswirtschaft, Rechnungswesen, Recht und Steuern sowie Unternehmensführung. Danach folgen eine Situationsaufgabe und ein Fachgespräch.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Volks- und Betriebswirtschaft
- Rechnungswesen, Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung
- Recht und Steuern
- Unternehmensführung, Personal und Organisation
- Investition, Finanzierung und Controlling
- Fachwissen für deinen Abschluss, vom Handel bis zur Industrie

Diese Kurse findest du in der App, insgesamt 66 Abschlüsse, unter anderem:
- Geprüfter Wirtschaftsfachwirt
- Handelsfachwirt
- Industriemeister Metall und Elektrotechnik
- Geprüfter Bilanzbuchhalter
- Geprüfter Technischer Betriebswirt und Geprüfter Betriebswirt
- Industriefachwirt und Technischer Fachwirt
- Personalfachkaufmann und Controller
- Fachwirt im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen
- Immobilien-, Bank-, Versicherungs- und Marketingfachwirt
- Meister für Logistik, Veranstaltungstechnik, Schutz und Sicherheit und viele weitere

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsgebieten
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community für Fragen rund um IHK-Prüfungen

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Quellen für die Angaben zu den Fortbildungsprüfungen in dieser App:
- Berufsbildungsgesetz, § 53 Fortbildungsordnungen: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bbig_2005/__53.html
- Berufsbildungsgesetz, § 56 Fortbildungsprüfungen: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bbig_2005/__56.html
- Berufsbildungsgesetz, § 71 Zuständige Stellen: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bbig_2005/__71.html
- Prüfungsverordnung Geprüfter Wirtschaftsfachwirt: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/wfachwprv/BJNR175200008.html
- Prüfungsverordnung Geprüfter Handelsfachwirt: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/hdlfachwprv/BJNR052700014.html
- Prüfungsverordnung Industriemeister Fachrichtung Metall: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/indmetmeistv_1997/BJNR292300997.html
- Prüfungsverordnung Geprüfter Bilanzbuchhalter: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bibubaprofprv/BJNR307000020.html
- Prüfungsverordnung Geprüfter Technischer Betriebswirt: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/tbetrwprv/BJNR290700004.html

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: WohnenKomfort - WeatherStation
description:
Wohnen Komfort shows the readings of your Netatmo weather station the way they deserve: clear, beautiful and with everything you want to know about your home and the weather outside – on iPhone and iPad.

A LIVING SKY
Sun, clouds, rain, snow, thunderstorms and a starry night – animated to match the current weather and time of day at your location.

INDOOR CLIMATE IN EVERY ROOM
• Temperature, humidity and CO₂ for every indoor module
• A traffic light for air quality and a hint when it’s time to open a window
• Trend, today’s high and low, dew point and feels-like temperature

WIND AND RAIN
Compass with direction, gusts and Beaufort, rain in the last hour, today and the last 24 hours – if wind and rain gauges are connected.

EVERY YEAR OF HISTORY
From 24 hours to “Max”: Wohnen Komfort loads the complete history since your station was set up from Netatmo and keeps it on your device. With several years of data, this happens gradually in the background.

INSIGHTS
Record high and low, summer, hot, frost and ice days, tropical nights, precipitation and rainy days, wind rose, temperature calendar and an indoor climate summary for every room.

FORECAST
Hourly for 48 hours and for 7 days – with chance of rain, feels-like temperature, wind, sunrise and sunset. Powered by Apple Weather.

NOTIFICATIONS, EVEN WHEN THE APP IS CLOSED
• CO₂ too high
• Too cold or too warm – set separately for indoors and outdoors
• Heavy rain and strong wind (when the modules are connected)
• Low batteries: below 10 % and once more below 5 %
Each alert is sent only once, until the value is back to normal.

PERFECT AS A WALL DISPLAY
If you like, the screen stays on while charging and dims at night – turning your iPad into a weather hub on the wall.

SET UP ONCE, USE EVERYWHERE
You connect Wohnen Komfort to your own free Netatmo app. The app guides you through the setup step by step. If you wish, it shares your access with your other iPhones and iPads via iCloud Keychain.

No station yet? Try Wohnen Komfort at your leisure with sample data.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• One-time purchase – no subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads
• No tracking, no analytics, no account with us
• Readings and history stay on your device; the app talks directly to Netatmo
• Family Sharing
• English and German

Requires a Netatmo Weather Station with indoor and outdoor module. Additional indoor modules, rain gauge and wind gauge are detected automatically.

Wohnen Komfort is an independent app by Needful ThingX and is not affiliated with Netatmo. Netatmo is a trademark of Netatmo SA.

name: woLAN
description:
Wo ist das nächste WLAN? woLAN beantwortet genau diese Frage.

Die Karte zeigt dir Orte in deiner Nähe mit WLAN für alle oder für Gäste: öffentliche Hotspots, Cafés, Bibliotheken, Bahnhöfe und Orte zum Arbeiten. Ein Tipp zeigt Kategorie, Entfernung, Gehzeit und wie du ins Netz kommst. Ein zweiter Tipp startet die Route zu Fuß in Apple Karten.

WAS WOLAN KANN
• WLANs auf der Karte und als Liste, sortiert nach Gehzeit
• Das nächste WLAN immer vorn, der Weg als Punktlinie auf der Karte
• Kosten, Anmeldung (offen, mit Passwort, Anmeldeseite) und Netzname, soweit bekannt
• Filter „Ohne Passwort“, Preis, Gehzeit, Kategorie, barrierefrei und „Jetzt geöffnet“
• Route zu Fuß über Apple Karten, vorher umsehen mit Look Around
• Favoriten und Verlauf, ganz ohne Konto
• Mit „Mit Apple anmelden“ bewerten, Angaben ergänzen und neue WLANs eintragen

WOHER DIE DATEN KOMMEN
woLAN hat eine eigene Datenbank in der EU (Frankfurt) mit rund 32.000 Orten aus OpenStreetMap und Beiträgen der Community, bisher nur in Deutschland. Passwörter speichert woLAN nicht. Ob ein WLAN gerade funktioniert, weiß die App nicht; wer etwas weiß, trägt es ein.

DATENSCHUTZ
Kein Tracking, keine Werbung. Den Standort nutzt woLAN nur, während du die App verwendest. Ein Konto brauchst du nur zum Beitragen, es ist pseudonym und jederzeit in der App löschbar.

Kartendaten der Orte © OpenStreetMap-Mitwirkende (ODbL).

name: Wolfstone Mesa
description:
The moon rises over the mesa. You have until dawn.

Wolfstone Mesa is a merge puzzle with a roguelite run. Swipe one row or column of carved stones. Three or more matching stones fuse into a rarer one: Sandstone, Amber, Turquoise, Obsidian, Moonstone and, at the top, the Wolfstone. One new stone can complete the next group, so a single swipe can set off a long chain.

Every move moves the moon one step across the sky. Reach the night's Moonlight goal before it sets. Let the wind bury the board and the run ends.

YOUR PACK:
Each merge fills the Howl medallion. Tap it to let your alpha howl:
- Grey Alpha burns every Sandstone and doubles your next merge.
- Frost Alpha raises your three weakest stones.
- Shadow Alpha silences the wind for three moves.
- Ember Alpha blasts a 3x3 square into gold dust.
Merge three Wolfstones and the whole pack howls at once.

SEVEN NIGHTS:
Pick your path at every fork. Blood Moon, Sandstorm, Frost Night, Meteor Shower, Coyote Night, Eclipse and Thorn Field each change the rules for one night and pay a different reward. On night four the Thunderbird strikes columns with lightning. On night seven the Great Stone Bison shakes the whole board.

TOTEMS AND CHARMS:
After each night you choose a totem for your cord: 24 relics that bend the rules. Twin Moons turns big groups into two stones. Lunar Crown keeps your Howl between nights. Spend Gold Dust at the Trading Post on a Lasso, a Tomahawk, a Rain Dance or a Moon Feather.

COME BACK FOR MORE:
- Journey: seven nights and five Moon Phases of rising difficulty.
- Endless Night: no moon, only the wind. Chase your record.
- Daily Hunt: one board for everyone, new every day.
- The Den: spend Turquoise on new alphas, upgrades and rare totems.
- 16 Trail Marks and a Codex that fills as you explore.

The whole game works offline. You need no account.

name: woObst
description:
Wo ist das nächste Obst? woObst beantwortet genau diese Frage.

Die Karte zeigt dir Obstbäume, Sträucher und Hecken an öffentlich zugänglichen Orten in deiner Nähe: Apfel, Birne, Kirsche, Pflaume, Beeren und Nüsse. Ein Tipp zeigt Obstart, Wuchs, Sorte, Entfernung und Gehzeit. Ein zweiter Tipp startet die Route zu Fuß in Apple Karten.

WAS WOOBST KANN
• Obst auf der Karte und als Liste, sortiert nach Gehzeit
• Der nächste Fundort immer vorn, der Weg als Punktlinie auf der Karte
• Obstart, Wuchs (Baum, Strauch, Hecke) und Sorte, soweit bekannt
• Filter nach Obstart, Gehzeit und barrierefrei
• Route zu Fuß über Apple Karten, vorher umsehen mit Look Around
• Favoriten und Verlauf, ganz ohne Konto
• Mit „Mit Apple anmelden“ bewerten, Angaben ergänzen und neue Fundorte eintragen

WAS WOOBST NICHT WEISS
Ob Früchte gerade reif sind und ob man pflücken darf, weiß die App nicht. Das klärst du vor Ort; woObst gibt keine Erlaubnis.

WOHER DIE DATEN KOMMEN
woObst hat eine eigene Datenbank in der EU (Frankfurt) mit rund 37.000 Obstbäumen und Sträuchern aus OpenStreetMap und Beiträgen der Community, bisher nur in Deutschland. Bekannte Zierformen ohne essbare Früchte sind herausgefiltert.

DATENSCHUTZ
Kein Tracking, keine Werbung. Den Standort nutzt woObst nur, während du die App verwendest. Ein Konto brauchst du nur zum Beitragen, es ist pseudonym und jederzeit in der App löschbar.

Kartendaten der Orte © OpenStreetMap-Mitwirkende (ODbL).

name: Wood Duck Defence
description:
Keep carved wooden ducks away from the nest in a woodland tower defence game. Each time you break a duck’s shell, a smaller duck emerges, so plan for what comes next.

Choose from three winding trails and 18 towers. Set lumberjacks in clearings, deploy boats on open water, and use helicopters to cover the route from above. Earn woodchips, upgrade your towers, and combine perk paths as the flocks grow tougher.

Protect the nest through 80 flocks and adjust the pace with 1×, 2×, and 3× speeds. Tap a tower to see its abilities and choose where to place it.

name: Wordie Crush
description:
Harf şekerlerini kaydır, Türkçe kelime kur, tahtayı patlat! Wordie Crush; satırda ya da sütunda kelime dizdikçe şekerlerin patladığı renkli bir kelime bulmaca oyunu.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Yan yana iki şekeri yukarı, aşağı, sola veya sağa kaydır.
• Satırda ya da sütunda geçerli bir Türkçe kelime oluşursa kelime patlar, üstteki şekerler düşer.
• Kelimeler iki yönden de okunur: soldan sağa ve sağdan sola, yukarıdan aşağı ve aşağıdan yukarı.
• Süre bitmeden bölüm hedefini tamamla: ilk bölümlerde hedef renkteki şekerleri topla, ileriki bölümlerde istenen sayıda kelime bul.

ÖZELLİKLER
• 120 bölüm: 3 harfli kelimelerle başla, 8 harfliye kadar ilerle
• Her bölüm süreli; zamanla yarış
• Her bölüme 5 ipucuyla başla; ard arda 3 kelime patlatınca +1 ipucu kazan
• Roket: rokete dokun, bir harf seç; tahtadaki o harfin her kopyasına bir roket uçar
• Joker şeker: dokun, harfi seç, kelimeyi tamamla
• Zincirleme patlamalarla kombo yap, puanını katla
• Her bölümde 3 yıldıza oyna
• Renkli şeker haritasında bölüm bölüm ilerle
• Oyundan çıksan da bölüme dokununca kaldığın yerden devam et
• Takma ad ve avatarla sıralamada yarış
• Sözlükte olmayan kelimeyi öner; onaylanınca oyuna eklenir

Wordie Crush, Türkçe sözlükle hazırlanmış bir kelime patlatma oyunu. Çevrimdışı da oynanır; sıralama ve profil için internet gerekir.

Kaydır, kelimeyi yakala, tahtayı temizle.

name: Wordy Bus: Group Puzzle
seller_name: YENI PROJELER REKLAM YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Every rider is a word, every bus is a group. Send the words to the right bus; with four riders it drives off!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the rider at the front of a line, then the bus that fits.
• Riders whose bus is not here yet wait on the bench. It is small, so think ahead!
• Guess the name of a "?" bus from the words.
• Watch out for double meanings: is "bat" an animal or sports gear?

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 120 levels that get harder step by step, each with exactly one grouping
• A new puzzle every day, streaks and a result you can share
• London, New York, Paris, Rome, Istanbul, Cappadocia, Berlin, Tokyo
• Clay characters, rainy levels and a cheerful driver
• Puzzles written separately for English, German and Turkish
• No account, no timer, plays offline
• No banners and no interrupting ads: watching a video is always your choice

name: Work Kiwi
description:
Work Kiwi is the mobile app for Work Kiwi, business software for small businesses in New Zealand. Keep track of customers, follow-ups and invoices wherever you are, and see what needs doing today.

TODAY
• One list of what needs doing now: your to-dos, follow-ups that are due and overdue invoices
• Postpone what can wait, tick off what’s done
• A morning notification with today’s list

CUSTOMERS
• Contacts, phone numbers and emails — call or email in one tap
• Notes from every call and a next follow-up date
• Add and edit customers on the go

INVOICES
• Create GST invoices with your own numbering, GST number and bank details
• Email invoices and payment reminders straight from your phone
• Record full or part payments and see who still owes you
• Preview the PDF before you send it

CALENDAR
• To-dos, follow-ups, meetings and invoice due dates in one calendar
• See just yours, or the whole team’s

YOUR TEAM
• Everyone signs in with their own account
• Admins manage users and company details

ALSO
• English and Chinese — each person picks their language
• Light and dark appearance
• Built-in help that knows the page you’re on
• Attach photos and files to records; take a photo with the camera

Organisations with a Work Kiwi custom system sign in with their organisation code and use their own pages in the same app.

New to Work Kiwi? Create your organisation in the app and start a free trial. Bank reconciliation and data import are available in the Work Kiwi web app at crm.workkiwi.com.

Questions? support@workkiwi.com

name: Working Dog World
description:
Working Dog World is the home of Australian working dogs – sheepdogs, cattle dogs and the people who train and trial them.

RESULTS
Follow trial and show results as they're published. Every placing links back to its official source, so you can see where each result came from.

DOGS & HANDLERS
Look up a dog or handler and see their competition history in one place. Pedigrees connect dogs to their sires, dams and offspring.

BARK – THE COMMUNITY
Chat with other working dog people in topic channels: training, trialling, breeding, stock work and more. Report or block anyone who breaks the rules – our team reviews every report.

MARKET & SHOP
Browse working dogs, pups, stud services and gear listed by the community, and shop Working Dog World merchandise.

FREE TO USE
There are no paid tiers. Sign in with Apple, Google or your email and everything is open.

Built in Australia for the working dog community. Questions or corrections to a result? Contact us from the app or at workindogworld.com.

name: World History Timeline - Atlas
description:
Atlas is an illustrated atlas of world history: forty-eight events, from the Great Pyramid of Giza to the first step on the Moon, each opened as a dossier you can read in a few quiet minutes.

FOUR ERAS ON ONE TIMELINE
• Antiquity, the Middle Ages, the Renaissance and the Modern Age
• 48 dossiers in order of date; filter them by wars, discoveries, art, science and statecraft
• The Battle of Manzikert, Magna Carta, the Conquest of Constantinople, the Mona Lisa, the French Revolution, Gallipoli, the proclamation of the Turkish Republic

WHAT A DOSSIER HOLDS
• A painted scene and an illustrated map of where it happened
• A short summary, then the background that led to it
• By the numbers, why it matters, and the key terms explained
• A dated chronology, step by step
• Portraits and short biographies of the people involved: 139 in all
• A bibliography of real sources: 192 across the atlas

THE WORLD TAB
• Every event pinned on a map of the world
• Touch a pin to see the event and open its dossier

YOUR LIBRARY
• Save the dossiers you want to return to
• Your reading progress is kept
• Search by event, year, city or person

ANNIVERSARIES, IF YOU WANT THEM
• An optional reminder on the day an event in the atlas took place

MADE FOR READING
• Day and night pages, three reading sizes
• In English and Turkish, interface and text alike
• No account, no advertising

ABOUT THE IMAGES
The paintings, maps and portraits are AI-generated illustrations made to evoke each period. They are not historical documents, reproductions of real works or exact likenesses, and the maps are not to scale. The texts are written from the sources listed in each dossier.

ATLAS PRO
Five dossiers are open to every reader. Atlas Pro opens all 48 and is offered as a yearly or a monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://tarih-atlasi-api.arctools.dev/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: XP Haul
description:
XPHaul is the load board built for horse and livestock hauling. It connects horse owners who need a ride with haulers who have room on the trailer.

FOR HORSE OWNERS

- Post your haul with the pickup, drop-off, number of horses, and when you need to go
- Your load shows up on a nationwide map that haulers check every day
- Posting is free during beta

FOR HAULERS

- See loads on a live map along your route, not buried in Facebook groups
- Fill empty spots and backhauls so the trip pays for itself
- Find loads near the route you're already running before you commit to a detour
- Founding hauler plan: $49 a month, locked in for the first 100 haulers, with a 30-day free trial

Built by a working horse hauler who got tired of missing loads that were right on her route.

## XPHaul is a listing service that connects owners and haulers. It is not a carrier or a broker. Haulers and owners make their own arrangements.

name: Y2 Garson
description: Masadan mutfağa anında sipariş. Hazır notlar, seçenekler ve tek dokunuşla gönderim.

name: Yaelai
description:
Yaelai is a quiet, offline journal for walking the moors and fells.

Keep a private record of every upland walk: when you went, how long you were out, the route, the shape of the day, the light, the weather, the footing underfoot and the grounds you passed. Twenty-four kinds of ground are built in, from heather moor and gritstone edge to blanket bog, gorse common and fell gate pasture.

WHAT IS INSIDE

• Moor Today — the date, the month's ground window, three suggested grounds and your two most recent walks.
• A 24-ground catalogue in six groups: moor, fell, crag, bog, common and hill pasture. Each ground has a short note and a where-to-walk hint.
• A full walk editor: date, duration, route, pack, shape, light, weather, footing, grounds passed, counts and notes.
• A month-grouped walk log with a detail page for every entry.
• Quiet insights: moor days, ground records, grounds seen, time on foot, group breakdown, a 35-day strip and six-month bars.
• Five short offline notes on first moor walks, wet ground, upland types, shelter and leaving the turf as you found it.
• Logging defaults, a native privacy page and a clear-all-data control.

WHAT IT IS NOT

Yaelai is not a map, a route planner, a weather forecast, a GPS tracker, a plant identifier or a fitness log. The month note is a calendar nudge, never a prediction. Check a local forecast, the wind over the heather and the state of the ground before you go out.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

There is no account, no cloud sync, no advertising, no analytics and no network code. Walks and defaults live in one JSON file inside the app. The only outbound actions are an explicit support email and the published privacy page, opened by the user.

Made for iPhone, in English, from iOS 15.

name: yalla sokhna | يلا سخنة
description:
احجز شاليهك في العين السخنة من غير سماسرة ومن غير ما تتنصب.

يلا سخنة بيجمعلك شاليهات حقيقية في أشهر قرى السخنة: بالميرا، لا سيرينا، وادي دجلة، وبورتو السخنة.

• اعرف القرية قبل ما تروح: التقييم ومستوى الأمان والخدمات
• صور حقيقية وكل تفاصيل الشاليه: عدد الأوض والأفراد والمسافة من البحر
• تقويم بيوريك الأيام الفاضية وسعر كل يوم
• السعر كامل قدامك من الأول، من غير مفاجآت
• ادفع كامل أو عربون والباقي قبل الوصول، بالبطاقة أو من محفظة التطبيق
• تصريح دخول QR على موبايلك بيتقرا على بوابة القرية
• اتجاهات جوجل ماب للقرية والشاليه
• إشعارات بالحجز والدفع ورسالة قبل الوصول بيوم

حمّل يلا سخنة واحجز إجازتك الجاية في دقيقة.

name: Yearmake
description:
Yearmake turns a year of your camera roll into a printed book.

You choose the photos from your phone. We read them — what happened, who was
there, which days mattered — and lay out a hardback book of that year. You see
every page before anything is printed, and you can change any of it.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick the photos. Choose a whole year, or go month by month. Screenshots and
   near-identical bursts are left out for you.
2. We read them. It takes about ten minutes. You answer a few short questions
   while it works — who is in the photos, what they were like that year.
3. You read the book. Every spread, every line. Move photos, rewrite anything,
   take out what you do not want.
4. We print it and post it to you.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

It is not a grid of your favourites. The book is written: the birthday, the
first day of school, the summer nobody photographed on purpose but everybody
remembers. Names are used where you have given them.

Nothing is printed until you say so.

YOUR PHOTOS

Photos you choose are uploaded privately to your own account and used only to
make your book. They are never public, never sold, and never used to advertise
anything. Delete your account and every photo goes with it.

A Yearmake book is bought at yearmake.com. The app is how you get your photos
into it.

name: Yeast Pitch
description:
Yeast Pitch reads the wort, the pack, and the brew day.

Ale and lager use different pitch rates. Older packs carry fewer live cells. The chart picks the smallest malt step that reaches the pitch. A pack that is already dense enough does not grow.

Packs and batches stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: YellowTagFinder
description:
YellowTagFinder finds the clearance deals at local stores near you, so you know what is marked down before you make the trip.

Pick up to 10 stores, run a scan, and get a list of every clearance item each store reports: the clearance price, the regular price, how much is off, how many are in stock, and the aisle and bay to walk to.

WHAT YOU GET
• Clearance deals at the stores you choose, sorted by biggest discount, lowest price, stock, aisle, or newest
• Penny candidates: items a full scan flags as likely to be at their final markdown
• Stock counts where the store reports them, and a clear note where it does not
• Aisle and bay for each deal
• A Trip list: add the deals you want, then check them off in the store, in aisle order
• A watchlist that picks out the deals you care about after every scan
• New deals marked since your last scan
• Search by name, brand, model or SKU
• English and Spanish

HOW IT WORKS
The app loads the retailer's own website on your phone and reads the clearance listings for your stores. Your stores, deals, trip list and watches stay on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
Prices, stock and locations come from the retailer's systems and can be wrong or out of date. A deal in the app is not a promise that the store has the item or will honor the price. Check with the store before a long drive.

SUBSCRIPTION
Free Tial then $19.99 Subscription

• YellowTagFinder Monthly: $19.99 per month (price may vary by country)
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel it in your iPhone's Settings, under your name → Subscriptions

Terms of Use: https://yellowtagfinder.com/legal.html
Privacy Policy: https://yellowtagfinder.com/legal.html#privacy

name: YEM Maps
description:
YEM Maps is the map for overland travelers. Find campsites, workshops, gas stations, viewpoints, drinking water and places to sleep shared by the community, plan your trips with every stop, and share your journey with other travelers.

Made for motorcycles, cars, 4x4s, campers, bicycles and backpackers: choose how you travel and what you care about, and the map shows that first.

EXPLORE THE MAP
• Search for places, towns or addresses.
• Choose a dark, light or satellite map, and turn on 3D terrain and the Elevation layer, with contour lines and your current altitude.
• Every place has photos, reviews and ratings, and opens in Google Maps for directions.

SHARE WHAT YOU FIND
• Publishing places, points, routes and trips is free on every plan.
• The community verifies places and flags what closed or changed. Verifying other travelers' places is included in Plus and Premium.
• Each of your places validated by the community earns points you can redeem for weeks or months of Plus or Premium.

PLAN AND TRAVEL
• Build routes and trips with all their stops and see them whole on the map.
• Start an active trip: see the weather forecast for each stop and get alerts.
• Add your vehicle, with its fuel consumption and range, to estimate the fuel for a trip.
• At meetups, record your route with GPS even with the screen off, share it as a GPX file, and share your live location with a link that expires after 2 hours.

NO SIGNAL, STILL ON TRACK

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Posts with photos and short videos, moments, meetups, groups, comments and reactions.
• Follow other travelers and send them private messages, end-to-end encrypted.
• Block anyone who bothers you and report profiles, posts, comments, messages and reviews. A team moderates content with the help of automated tools.

AI FEATURES (PLUS AND PREMIUM)
• Translate community and place texts.
• Draft a new place from a photo.
• Identify your vehicle from a photo and get tips during an active trip.
Answers are generated by AI and may contain mistakes: double-check what matters.

WIDGET
• Add a home screen widget with a recommended place near you.

PLANS
YEM Maps is free to download. Free includes the map, routes, the community, and English and Spanish. Plus and Premium are monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscriptions that add every language (Spanish, English, French, Italian and Portuguese), translations, AI features, a custom theme and icon, and a star on your profile. On Plus, AI features include a daily allowance (translations have no cap); Premium has no daily quota. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

PLEASE NOTE
YEM Maps is an information and assistance tool: it is not certified turn-by-turn navigation or an emergency service. Information comes from users and map providers and may be out of date. Check roads, weather and places before you go, and don't use the app while driving.

You need an account (email, Google or Apple) and must be at least 16 years old.

Privacy Policy: https://yemaps.blog/en/privacidad/
Terms of Use: https://yemaps.blog/en/terminos/

name: YieldBench
description:
See how inspection outcomes add up across your workshop lots.

YieldBench records inspected, first-pass accepted and successfully reworked units. Scrap is calculated as the remainder, keeping every lot’s counts consistent.

RECORD A LOT
Name the product or lot, choose its date and enter whole-number counts. The app rejects inconsistent totals and keeps notes with each inspection record. Edit or delete a lot as your records change.

READ THE DASHBOARD
See inspected, first-pass, reworked and scrap counts together. First-pass yield is calculated from total accepted units divided by total inspected units, rather than averaging lot percentages. Recovered yield includes successfully reworked units.

COMPARE RESULTS
Browse searchable lot records, inspect the calculation inputs and compare lots in yield order. Accessible numerical labels accompany the charts, including the zero-data state.

Your records stay on your device and core functions work offline. Free, no ads, purchases or account. Optional fictional workshop records are available in Settings. Light, dark and system appearance are supported, with eight App languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.

A read-only CloudKit startup configuration never changes native inspection functions or automatically opens an external destination. It is not record synchronization. This tool records your counts and is not a certification service.

name: Yipao: Carrusel y Collage
description:
Crea carruseles para Instagram que se ven como una sola imagen al deslizar. Con Yipao tu foto cruza de una diapositiva a la siguiente sin cortes, y tu carrusel se ve profesional en minutos, sin saber diseñar.

Elige entre más de 370 plantillas de carrusel, collage e historias. Pon tus fotos, cambia el texto y exporta cada diapositiva lista para publicar en el orden correcto.

CARRUSELES SIN CORTES
• Un solo lienzo continuo: fotos, textos y formas pueden pasar de una diapositiva a otra.
• Carrusel panorámico: convierte una foto ancha en un carrusel que se desliza perfecto.
• Hasta 20 diapositivas por carrusel, en 4:5 o 1:1.
• "Ver como en el feed": revisa cómo se verá tu carrusel antes de publicarlo.

PLANTILLAS PARA TODO
• Más de 370 plantillas de carrusel, collage de fotos e historias.
• Photo dump, viajes, pareja y amigos, moda, comida, emprendimiento, frases y más.
• Estilos con textura: papel rasgado, cinta, scrapbook, polaroid y editorial.
• Busca por tema, estilo, formato o número de fotos.

COLLAGES E HISTORIAS
• Collage de fotos para el feed y plantillas de historias en 9:16.
• Cuadrícula de perfil: divide una foto en 3, 6 o 9 publicaciones para tu feed.
• Llenado inteligente: Yipao detecta las caras y las centra en cada marco, dentro de tu teléfono.

EDITOR FÁCIL Y COMPLETO
• Textos con fuentes sans, serif, manuscrita y de máquina; color, tamaño y alineación.
• Formas, papeles, cintas, marcos, trazos y stickers.
• Filtros y ajustes de foto, aplicables a todas las fotos del carrusel.
• Capas, deshacer y rehacer, y guardado automático de cada proyecto.

EXPORTA EN ALTA CALIDAD
• Guarda cada diapositiva en tu galería, en orden, lista para tu carrusel de Instagram.
• Elige la calidad: liviana para compartir rápido o máxima nitidez.
• Programa un recordatorio para publicar a la mejor hora.

TUS FOTOS SON TUYAS
Yipao funciona en tu teléfono. No necesitas cuenta, y tus fotos no se suben a ningún servidor.

Ideal para creadores de contenido, emprendedores, marcas personales, fotógrafos y cualquiera que quiera que su carrusel de Instagram, su collage o sus historias se vean increíbles.

Descarga Yipao y crea tu primer carrusel hoy.

Yipao no está afiliada, asociada ni respaldada por Instagram ni por Meta.

Yipao Premium desbloquea todas las plantillas PRO y la cuadrícula de perfil de 6 y 9 publicaciones sin marca de agua. Suscripción mensual o anual con renovación automática; el anual incluye 7 días gratis para nuevos suscriptores. El pago se carga a tu Apple ID al confirmar la compra y se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo. Puedes administrarla o cancelarla en los ajustes de tu cuenta.
Términos de uso: https://apps.superbitesstudios.com/yipao/terminos-de-uso
Privacidad: https://apps.superbitesstudios.com/yipao/politica-de-privacidad

name: Ynclwech
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying it out—your support is our motivation, and your feedback shows us the way forward.



Ynclwech checks door, drawer and appliance swing clearances before anything is fitted.

A dropped oven door and an open dishwasher can claim the same strip of floor. A fridge door can meet the hall door. Kitchen guides list the clearances, but they cannot show you your own room. Ynclwech lays every opening at real size and tells you which ones meet, and by how much.

AR VIEW
Point the phone at a wall, aim the ring at a hinge or the middle of a unit face, and pin it. The full swing is drawn on your floor: hinged leaves as filled sectors, drop-down doors and drawers as pull-out boxes. Where two swings overlap, the shared floor turns bright and pulses. Undo the last point, reset the session, save the layout to the room, or capture a snapshot that stays with the room on this phone.

PLANNER
The same room as a floor plan with millimetre rulers. Drag any leaf, drawer, counter run or island and the clashes update as you move. The planner works on every iPhone and opens straight away if AR is not available, with a sample kitchen you can load in one tap.

WHAT IT DOES
- Element library: doors with hinge side and leaf width, ovens, dishwashers, fridges and drawers with pull-out depth, plus counter runs, islands and tall units.
- Collision finder: every pair that meets when fully open, worst first, with the extra distance needed to part them.
- Walkway check: the clear width between facing runs, shut and with everything open, against guideline values you can change per room.
- Open-all slider: swing every element together, or press play and watch the room open.
- Saved rooms: search, filter, rename, copy and delete with undo, plus a summary sheet listing every size.
- Every change can be undone and redone.

Metric or imperial, sound and haptics on or off, and AR options for feature points, plane outlines and guide opacity.

ACCOUNT IS OPTIONAL
Everything works without an account, and as a guest none of your data leaves your phone. If you create one, your rooms sync between phones and are backed up. You can delete the account inside the app at any time.

AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The planner works everywhere.

Sizes come from you or the maker's manual. Ynclwech gives fitting guidance, not certification.
Dowload now to enjoy app!

name: YOBOSHU:Video Intercom
description:
YOBOSHU is for video and voice calls with people you add as contacts.

Tap Start now and enter a display name. The app does not ask for a phone number or a legal name. The display name is what the other person sees.

Contacts exist only inside the app. Add someone with an invite link, a QR code, or a 6-digit code. The app does not upload the phone's address book.

A call is video or voice. The camera and microphone are requested when a call or a QR scan starts. If the camera is not allowed, a voice call is still available.

A one-time call connects once without adding a contact. Share a link or a 9-digit code, review the join request, and then start. The other person can join in a browser without installing the app. Names shown in a one-time call are for that call. This app does not record the call or save photos or notes from it. It cannot stop recording by the other person's device or operating system.

The free start has limits on how many contacts you can add and on daily relay time. An activation key turns on a wider allowance for someone who already has a key. The app does not sell keys or take payment.

New calls can arrive while the app is open on screen. Calls while the screen is locked or the app is in the background depend on push delivery being ready on the server.

The privacy policy is in Settings. Delete registration there to remove this device's registration and contacts. Block and report are on the person's More menu. A report is sent only after you review it, as an email you send yourself.

The app is available in Korean and English.

name: Yomzi: Language Games Emulator
description:
Play your way into a new language.

Yomzi plays the classic handheld games you own, with the dialogue shown in the language you're learning. Tap any word for its meaning and save it for review. It's a way to read every day that doesn't feel like homework.

Yomzi comes with Aevilia, a free and open-source role-playing game, so you can try it straight away. For anything else, you add game files you have the right to use, such as backups of cartridges you own, from the Files app, AirDrop or iCloud Drive. Yomzi doesn't sell or link to any games.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start with the included game, or add one you own.
• Read it in your language: dialogue and menus appear in the game's own text box, translated on your device as you play. The English line is one tap away whenever you need it.
• Save words, then review them in short daily sessions along with the line you found them in.

EIGHT LANGUAGES
Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese (with furigana), Korean (with romanization) and Mandarin Chinese (with pinyin, in Simplified or Traditional characters). Choose one to start and switch any time. Each language keeps its own words and reviews.

BUILT FOR LEARNING
• Help with every word: meanings from real dictionaries, the dictionary form, and how it's read. Drag across a phrase to get the whole thing explained.
• Your reading level: Basic, Intermediate or Advanced. On iPhone and iPad models with Apple Intelligence, lines are rewritten in simpler words while you're starting out; on other devices, lines are translated directly.
• Reviews that stick: flashcards and quizzes made from the words you saved, spaced so you see them right before you'd forget them. Set a daily reminder if you like.
• Teach it a new game: some games work out of the box. For one Yomzi doesn't know yet, type a few words you see on screen and it learns how to read that game.

A PROPER PLAYER
Touch controls, game controllers and keyboards. Battery saves, three save slots and fast-forward. Close the app and it picks up where you left off.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Translation runs on your iPhone or iPad. Your games, saves and words stay on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. Each language has a dictionary to download once, and after that Yomzi works offline.

FREE AND PRO
Yomzi is free to download, with 20 translated lines every day, word help, your Wordbook, reviews and all eight languages. After the day's lines, games keep playing in English until tomorrow.

Youdio Reader is the companion app for Youdio Studio, the AI-assisted studio where anyone can make a graphic novel.

Read your own books, the ones friends and collaborators share with you, and the growing community shelf, all in one place, with real page turns and the lettering, balloons and sound effects exactly as the author made them.

READ THE WAY COMICS SHOULD BE READ
• Real page turns with a satisfying flip, on iPhone and iPad

YOUR LIBRARY

DISCOVER THE COMMUNITY

MAKE YOUR OWN
Youdio Studio (youdiostudio.com) turns a script into a finished graphic novel. Describe a scene in plain language and AI generates the artwork panel by panel, with layout, speech balloons, characters who stay consistent from page to page, and a shareable link to read online. name: yue偶遇记
description:
用当天掉落的票根、天气色块和短句，在车窗上拼出一页日记。
看本页的情绪目标和构图约束，拖放、旋转、缩放，到站前交稿。
对上了，就收进车厢本；没对上，可以再拼。

你像是坐在通勤的车窗边。玻璃上有雨和暮色，手里是今天捡到的纸片：早线票根、天气色块、一枚印章、一句短话。到站之前，要把它们贴成一页能留下的日记。窗的对面，有时会坐着同行的乘客络。她不是来教你怎么贴的人，只是和你一样，把一张纸留在座位边上。

【今日车窗】
打开今日页，先看本页要贴出的情绪，例如「克制的期待」，以及构图上的约定，比如留白靠右、重心偏下。料袋里是这一页可以用的票根、色块、印章和短句。把纸片拖到窗上，旋转、缩放，也可以锁定已经摆好的层。图层有上限，堆叠不是办法。

觉得对了，就交稿。系统会从三个方向来看这一页：情绪吻合、构图平衡、约束遵守。对上了，这一页就收进车厢本，也可以设成封面。没对上，可以回到窗前再贴一版。第一次交稿，又留下一点余料，才有机会拿到三星。

【通勤线与周末加页】
一周通勤线是一章。工作日的页一张张贴过去，章末会打开「周末加页」——一页更完整的构图。收进本之后，才会打开下一章。越往后，过关会逐渐变难。

贴的时候，车厢也不会一直安静。偶尔会晃车，刚摆好的层轻轻发抖，需要先锁住再继续。灯光会在冷暖之间切换，窗上的颜色看起来就不一样。安检抽查时，某一类票根可能暂时不能用，得换一种贴法。

【车厢本】
过关的日记会按章节收在车厢本里。可以再翻开已经贴好的页，选一张做封面，或把今日页导出到相册。封面是你今天留在窗上的那一页心情。

【同车厢】
如果你愿意让今日封面被看见，附近同样在玩的人可以刷到彼此的封面，把一小张「车厢小报」贴到对方的车窗墙上，也可以用短评印章或一句不超过三十字的话打个招呼。出示「月票」码，对方扫入「车窗反光」，就可以配对。查找只为遇见附近的人，不会追踪你的真实通勤线路。

【料袋里的小动作】
你还可以把实物票根的边缘拓进料袋，作为装饰纹理；或录一句本机的「到站广播」，印成字条贴在窗上。这些是这一页的点缀，不会改关卡的判断。

如果你喜欢手账、贴纸和拼贴，也习惯在地铁或公交上留一点给自己的时间，这一页车窗就是为这样的空隙准备的。

本产品仅适用于 iPhone。使用相机或相册，是为了扫描月票、拓印票根或把日记页存进相册；使用麦克风，是为了录制广播短句；使用本地网络，是为了查找附近乘客并粘贴小报。

name: Yuki Ramen

name: z-School
seller_name: AIW CHAPECO CURSOS E IDIOMAS LTDA
description:
O z-School leva a sua escola de idiomas para o celular.

Para alunos
• Pratique com lições curtas e divertidas da sua unidade: escolha, monte frases, ligue pares, escute e marque, fale a frase.
• Ganhe XP e Zollars, mantenha sua sequência de dias e conquiste medalhas com o Zibee, o guaxinim.

Para responsáveis
• Acompanhe frequência, aulas e avisos dos seus dependentes.

Ainda não é aluno? Crie sua conta, faça o nivelamento e comece a praticar de graça.

O acesso de alunos e responsáveis é liberado pela escola.

name: Zaad: Prayer & Deeds Tracker
description:
Zaad means provision for the journey. It is a quiet place to keep your salah steady and to pack a little good every day, one prayer at a time.

PRAYER, AT A GLANCE
• Today opens on the prayer that's due and how much time is left.
• Prayer times for your city, with your madhab for Asr.
• Record a prayer in about ten seconds, and see whether it was in the best time, on time, or in the last part of its time.
• Reminders before each prayer, set the way you like them.

WHEN A PRAYER IS MISSED
• No alarms and no guilt: one quiet card, a gentle make-up, and a fresh start with the next prayer.
• The Qada ledger keeps older prayers to make up, at your own pace.

GOOD DEEDS AND ROUTINES
• One-tap logs for Quran, dhikr, sadaqah and kindness.
• Small, steady routines around your prayers, like morning and evening adhkar.
• A tasbeeh counter, a Tahajjud log, and a weekly look back that starts with what went well.

GUIDES AND A SHORT FILM
• An intro film, "What are you packing?", in Urdu or English.
• Short guides spoken in Urdu, with English captions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no public rankings, no trackers.
• Ikhlas mode hides points, levels and badges.
• App lock with a PIN, and discreet notifications.
• Works offline; your entries sync when you're back online.
• Export or delete your data, or your whole account, at any time.

Points in Zaad are a mirror of your effort, never the Mizan. The real record is with Allah.

name: Zapo: Photo Cleaner Game
description:
Zapo turns cleaning your photo library into a two-minute game.

Swipe left to zap a photo, right to keep it, up to favourite it. Decide fast to build a combo, earn points, level up and keep your daily streak alive. At the end of every round you review what you chose and confirm once.

HOW IT WORKS
• Daily round: random shots from your gallery
• Month by month: finish one month at a time and watch the ring fill up
• Screenshot hunt: clear out forgotten screenshots
• Tap a photo to see it full screen, tap a video to play it

NOTHING IS DELETED BY ACCIDENT
• You review every round before anything is deleted
• Deletion always goes through the iOS confirmation
• Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your photos and videos never leave your iPhone
• No ads, no tracking

ZAPO PRO
The free version gives you 2 rounds a day of 50 cards each, the Daily round, Screenshot hunt and Month by month. Zapo Pro unlocks unlimited rounds that last as long as you like, Video hunt (your biggest videos), This time last year and Oldest memories.

Zapo Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). The yearly plan may include a free trial; when the trial ends you are charged the yearly price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Space is freed on your iPhone when items are removed from Recently Deleted.

description:
Zapsure is a media player for the sources you are allowed to use. Add your own M3U playlist or Xtream login and watch it in one clean, fast player.

• Poster-led home with continue watching and favourites
• Live channels with categories, search and favourites
• Films and series shelves: browse by category, open a series by season

• Subtitles shown by language name, when your stream carries them

• Multi-view: watch two or four channels side by side, sound follows the screen you tap

• Encrypted backup and restore with a passphrase you choose, no account needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads and no analytics
• Source passwords are stored in your device's secure storage
• No account, no cloud sync of your sources

Playback depends on your source, your network and your device. Some sources limit simultaneous streams.

name: Zealous Electric
description:
Zealous Electric Crew is the work app for employees of Zealous Electric Inc. Sign in with the work email the office set up for you.

- Clock in and out, and see your hours for the week
- See your schedule and the jobs you're assigned to
- Open a job for its address, directions, tasks and photos
- Snap a photo of a receipt and attach it to the job
- Request time off and see when it's approved
- Chat with the office and the crew
- Get notified about schedule changes, messages and approvals

This app is only for Zealous Electric employees. Accounts are created by the office.

name: Zeitpost – Mail to Future You
description:
Some things you keep putting off. Zeitpost turns that into something good.

Pack whatever is bugging you into a letter, registered mail or a package – and send it to future you. This evening, tomorrow, at the weekend or exactly when you want. Until then, feel free to forget it.

WHEN IT ARRIVES
The delivery lands right on time. You open it and hear your own message from back then. Done? Then you reply: “It wasn't half as bad – next time just do it right away.” That's how a conversation with yourself begins. And when something like it comes up again, past you cheers you on: Zeitpost finds similar moments and shows you how it went back then.
Only got part of it done? Log a “Step done” – laundry washed, dried, folded – and send the rest on. In the end you see every step.

LETTERS TO FUTURE YOU
Write yourself what you'll want to read in a year – or in ten. Zeitpost brings ideas: on Christmas Eve a letter for next Christmas, on New Year's Eve resolutions with a reply, in between some advice to yourself or the song you're into right now. When the letter arrives, you reply to past you – letter and reply then sit together in the time capsule. If you like, Zeitpost reminds you of the right days.

SO SIMPLE
• Put things off in seconds: what, how heavy, when – done
• Plan to the minute with one tap: an hour from now, tomorrow morning or on a day you choose
• Letters for reminders, registered mail for important things, packages for anything heavy
• Voice note or short text, with a photo, video or file if you like
• Freely adjustable times – even for shift work
• The drawer for everything without a date: open it, look inside, finally get it done
• The time capsule: things you got done, daily recaps, pep talks and lovely moments – sealed until you open it
• For remembering: the time capsule has compartments for days, weeks, months and years – and search finds everything you've written, even in transcripts of your voice notes
• The whole journey of every delivery: when and why you put it off
• Lots of mail for next year? It's neatly stacked until it's due

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Widgets for Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Put things off straight from Control Center or with a shortcut
• iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV

ZEITPOST PLUS (OPTIONAL)
Everything important is free. With Plus, your deliveries, letters, voice notes, photos and Random Mail show up instantly on all your devices – through your private iCloud, no extra sign-in. What you change on your iPhone, you see right away on Apple TV. Monthly or yearly, cancel anytime.

LITTLE EXTRAS
• Random Mail: throw slips into mail sacks and draw one when you don't know where to start – for cleaning plans, workouts or decisions
• Gift package: send someone a surprise that only opens at the time you choose – stamps one at a time or cheaper in bulk

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your deliveries belong to you.

Zenith Driver is the official mobile operations app for Zenith Carex Logistics dispatch and delivery drivers across Nigeria.

Features include:
- Daily Route Manifests: View assigned stops, priority shipments, and real-time package status directly from dispatch hubs.
- Route Navigation: Optimized stop sequences with one-tap turn-by-turn navigation and direct customer calling.
- Digital Proof of Delivery: Capture recipient signatures and delivery photos on the spot.
- Barcode Scanner: Fast scanning of parcel waybills and manifest QR codes.
- On-Shift Location Tracking: Keeps dispatch updated with real-time delivery progress.
- Offline Sync: Deliver without interruption in low-connectivity areas with automatic sync when connection is restored.

name: Zero: Sight-In Calculator
description:
Zero is a sight-in calculator for pistol and rifle optics. Enter your range and where your shots actually landed, and Zero tells you exactly how many turret clicks to dial, and in which direction.
HOW IT WORKS
Pick your optic, enter the distance, enter the vertical and horizontal offset of your group, then tap Calculate clicks. Zero shows the elevation and windage correction in clicks, plus how far one click moves impact at your range. Round to whole clicks is on by default, the way you count on the turret.
WORKS WITH YOUR OPTIC
•  170 built-in red dot and holographic optics, including Holosun, Aimpoint, Trijicon, EOTech, Vortex, SIG Sauer and Shield, with a Common list of the most used models
•  Manual entry for any optic: click value in MOA or MIL (MRAD), True MOA or Shooter's MOA, with separate vertical and horizontal click values for optics whose turrets differ by axis
•  Save your own optics and organize them into named lists, one per gun, per match, per sport, stored only on your phone
•  Optional dot size: Zero also tells you how much of the target your dot covers at your range
PHOTO ZERO
Photograph your target, mark where the shots landed, set the scale from a reference you choose, and Photo Zero works out the same click correction, with group size and a marked-up overlay you can save or share. If you leave mid marking, your photo and markers are still there when you come back within a day.
ZERO DISTANCE
Shoot at one distance and zero for another. Zero allows for bullet drop, and for your sight's height above the bore if you turn that on.
MADE FOR THE RANGE
•  Works completely offline, no signal needed
•  No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected
•  Yards or meters, inches or centimeters
•  Dark mode and a highlight that makes the field you are working in easy to see outdoors
Zero does one job well: getting you on target faster, with fewer wasted rounds.

name: Zip Tangle: Unzip Puzzle Game
description:
Zips cross, overlap and tangle. Find the one on top, pull it open and unzip the whole bag!

Zip Tangle is a satisfying zipper puzzle about order. A zip can't open while another lies across it, so look closely, pick the top zip and work your way down.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a slider along its zip to open it
• Open the zips on top first
• Pulling a stuck zip is a snag; three snags and the bag stays shut
• Padlocked zips need the key carried by another zip
• Rusty zips loosen after you open enough others
• Thaw frozen zips and pull chained zips together
• Beat the alarm zips before they ring, and clear the path for flyaway zips

WHAT'S IN THE BAG?
Every bag you open hides a treasure. Collect all 100 in 10 themed sets: rubber ducks, cupcakes, a rocket, a crown, a jukebox, a baby dragon and more. Finish a set for a big reward!

FEATURES
• 1,000 levels, every one tested to be solvable
• 100 collectible treasures in 10 sets
• 50 worlds with their own backdrops and bag fabrics
• The Snip booster cuts any zip open, however stuck it is
• Undo, hints and extra lives when you need them
• A new Daily Challenge every day: stamp your calendar and win monthly trophies
• Daily quests, a daily gift and a star chest to fill with coins
• Smooth, satisfying zips with haptics and sound
• Color-blind symbols option
• Game Center leaderboards for stars, levels cleared and your collection
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• Play offline, anytime

Grab a zip and start untangling!

name: ZoneWeave
description:
See the same moment in different places with ZoneWeave.

Keep the time zones you use in World. Compare a selected date and time across them, including the local date, UTC offset and daylight-saving status. Inspect the next clock change using the rules installed on your device.

Plan a meeting from the moment selected in Compare. Add a title and duration, preview the start and end in each saved zone, then keep a local summary for later. Share a selected summary through the system share sheet.

• Save up to 12 time zones.
• Compare dates as well as clock times.
• Use elapsed minutes for meetings across clock changes.
• Save up to 100 meeting summaries on this device.

No account, calendar permission or location access is required. The app does not send invitations or create calendar events. Time-zone results depend on your device clock and installed time-zone rules.

name: zongisa
description:
Dans un taxi vert, au marché Total, chez le gardien de l'immeuble : au Congo, les objets changent de main tous les jours. Un passeport ramassé à Ouenzé, un téléphone oublié sur une banquette, un trousseau de clés posé sur un comptoir. Celui qui a trouvé ne sait pas à qui rendre. Celui qui a perdu ne sait pas où chercher.

Zongisa met les deux au même endroit.

CE QUE VOUS POUVEZ FAIRE

• Déposer une fiche en quatre étapes, avec jusqu'à cinq photos. Gratuit.
• Chercher par catégorie, ville, quartier et date. La recherche pardonne les fautes de frappe.
• Dicter une référence au téléphone : chaque fiche porte un code court du genre ZG-7F3K.
• Être prévenu quand un objet ressemblant au vôtre est déposé.
• Débloquer le numéro de la personne qui a trouvé, par mobile money.
• Discuter dans l'application, sans échanger vos numéros.

CE QUI PROTÈGE LES DEUX CÔTÉS

Le numéro du déposant reste masqué. Personne ne peut le recopier depuis le registre : il ne se montre qu'à la personne qui a débloqué le contact, et une seule fois par fiche.

Les documents d'identité sont automatiquement floutés sur les photos, et leur numéro n'est jamais affiché.

Quand quelqu'un revendique un objet, c'est le déposant qui tranche. Il pose une question de reconnaissance — une rayure, le fond d'écran, ce qu'il y a dans la poche intérieure — et décide lui-même si la réponse tient.

Chaque fiche et chaque conversation portent un bouton pour signaler ou bloquer. L'équipe regarde dans la journée.

CE QUE ÇA COÛTE

Déposer une fiche : gratuit. Chercher : gratuit. Recevoir une alerte : gratuit.

Débloquer le contact d'une personne qui a trouvé votre objet : 300 F, par MTN MoMo ou Airtel Money, une seule fois par fiche. Si l'objet ne vous est pas rendu, la somme revient en crédit pour un autre contact.

EN LINGALA AUSSI

kozongisa : rendre, faire revenir. Eloko na yo ezongi — votre objet est revenu. L'application parle français, avec ce qu'il faut de lingala pour qu'on s'y sente chez soi.

Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire, et partout au Congo.

name: Zoo Inheritance: Jessi's Park
description:
A letter, a key and 47 problems: an unexpected inheritance makes the Moll family the owners of a run-down animal park. A cozy simulation with a story, cute animals and animal babies.

Lindenhain Zoo is falling apart. The district vet gives the family six months, and an investor wants the land. Jessi is 15, doesn't say much and would rather draw animals. With her cheeky little sister Moni, her parents and old keeper Kalle, she sets out to restore the old park as a home for Rosi the elephant, the red pandas, penguins, meerkats, otters, alpacas and many more.

BUILD HABITATS AND CARE FOR ANIMALS
• Every enclosure grows through 5 levels: from an overgrown shack to a proper animal house
• Every upgrade step visibly changes something: climbing tree, stream, keeper platform and more
• 14 animal species, including elephants, a lion, a Bengal tigress, ring-tailed lemurs, a mini donkey and a petting zoo
• Animal babies are born, and you get to name them

A STORY AS A VOICED MOTION COMIC
• 20 fully voiced chapters full of heart, humour and small acts of courage
• Friendship, first love, trouble at school and a town council that wants to close the park
• Choices in the comics shape Jessi's friendships

MINIGAMES FOR EVERY STEP
• 20 minigames: mucking out, carpentry, stacking hay bales, penguin feeding, fish slide, food match, building a stream, stormy night, visitor rush and more
• No time pressure and no failing: you earn stars for skill

WATCH YOUR ANIMAL PARK GROW
• New areas: Petting Zoo, Tropical House with ring-tailed lemurs, Tiger Forest and Elephant Park
• Visitors come every game day, and every heart in an enclosure helps your park grow

For kids, families and everyone who loves animals. The game is free to play. It contains ads, which a one-time purchase removes, and optional in-app purchases.

name: ZooDrops
description:
Welcome to the cutest wildlife puzzle adventure! Dive into Zoo Merge!, the ultimate physics-based merging game where your goal is to drop, stack, and evolve adorable round animals to build the biggest Zoo of all!

How big can your animal kingdom grow? Find out in this addictive, brain-teasing, and satisfyingly bouncy puzzle challenge that is perfect for players of all ages!

HOW TO PLAY
Aim and Drop: Tap the screen to aim and drop the round animal of the moment into the box.

Merge & Grow: Drop two of the same animals together to watch them merge into a single, much larger and brand-new animal!

Chain Reaction: Plan your drops carefully—physics will make the bouncy balls roll, slide, and bounce around.

Beat the Clock & The Box: Make sure your growing pile of cute creatures doesn't overflow! Keep matching and merging to keep the game alive.

name: Zorup: Learn & Play

Zorup turns learning into levelling up. Pick any subject, climb 12 grades from beginner to professional, then pass the Expert final to earn your title.

LEARN ANYTHING, ONE GRADE AT A TIME

Math, English, Science, Physics, Chemistry, Geography and History
Coding, Logic, Data and Statistics, Economics, Money Skills, the Stock Market and Entrepreneurship
Languages with pronunciation in English letters: Spanish, French, Emirati Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Urdu, Tagalog, Malayalam and Russian
Piano lessons from your first notes upward
Every grade has a study guide, worked examples, drills and a mastery test. Every answer explains why it is right or wrong, so you learn from each mistake.

TRAIN YOUR BRAIN WITH REAL GAMES

Sudoku with a technique coach, from first steps to expert patterns
Chess, checkers, four in a row, backgammon and more board games, with a coach and smart computer opponents
Sports, racing, space and puzzle games, all original and made for quick sessions
A Practice tab in every game to build the skill, not just play

MADE TO KEEP YOU GOING

XP, ranks from Rookie to Master, streaks and badges
A daily play limit you can set in Settings
Works offline. No adverts, no chat, no tracking.
App language in English, Spanish, Chinese or Arabic

name: Zrihtano Teren
description:
Zrihtano Teren je aplikacija za ekipe, ki delajo pri strankah: serviserje, monterje, vzdrževalce in vse, ki morajo na terenu zabeležiti, kaj so porabili in kaj so naredili.

Nalog odprete na telefonu, med delom vnašate material in ure, na koncu stranka podpiše na zaslon. Poročilo v PDF-ju je takoj pripravljeno – brez prepisovanja v pisarni in brez listkov, ki se izgubijo.

DELO NA TERENU
• Seznam nalogov: danes, odprti, moji, zamuja.
• Material se išče po nazivu, šifri ali črtni kodi.
• Ure dela, opis opravljenega in opombe.
• Fotografije pred delom in po njem.
• Podpis stranke s prstom na zaslon.
• »Na poti«: stranko obvestite s SMS-om ali e-pošto, čas prihoda se izračuna iz vašega položaja.

ZA VODJO
• Razpored v koledarju: nov nalog s tapom na prazen termin, prestavljanje z vlečenjem.
• Pregled strank, objektov in zgodovine dela.
• Poročilo stranki v PDF-ju, izvoz v Excel.

DELUJE TUDI BREZ SIGNALA
Odprt nalog ostane viden brez omrežja; kar vnesete, se pošlje, ko se povezava vrne.

POVEZAVA S POSLOVNIM PROGRAMOM
Aplikacija deluje povsem samostojno. Če podjetje uporablja VASCO, se nalogi in material prenašajo v obe smeri.

ZA KOGA
Za podjetja z lastnimi terenskimi ekipami. Za uporabo potrebujete račun, ki ga ustvari vaše podjetje; aplikacija ni namenjena posameznim potrošnikom.

Spletni del: https://teren.zrihtano.si
Pogoji in zasebnost: https://teren.zrihtano.si/zasebnost

name: Zurix Freight
description:
Zurix Freight keeps a truck driver's loads, paperwork and pay estimates in one place, and keeps dispatch in the loop.

SHARE IT IN, THE LOAD BUILDS ITSELF
Got a rate confirmation by email or in Files? Tap Share, pick Zurix Freight, and the app reads the document and fills in the load for you: pickup and delivery addresses, times, load and PO numbers, miles and rate. Check it, save it, drive.

YOUR NEXT STOP, FRONT AND CENTER
The Home screen shows the stop you are working right now: address, deadline, pickup or delivery number, truck and trailer. One tap opens navigation. Check off each step as you go.

EVERYTHING THE GATE ASKS FOR
PO, pickup and delivery numbers, truck and trailer numbers and plates on one screen, each with a copy button.

PAPERWORK WITHOUT THE PILE
Scan bills of lading and delivery receipts with the camera, keep them with the load, and send them as one document. Share any document or picture when you need to.

DISPATCH, ONE TAP AWAY
Message your dispatcher with text, pictures and documents. Loads your dispatcher sends show up in the app ready to go. Dispatchers work from the Zurix Freight dispatch website.

SEE WHAT THE WEEK SHOULD PAY
Set your percentage of the load and see pay estimates by day, week, month and year, with loaded and deadhead miles. These are estimates from your own numbers. Zurix Freight does not process payments.

BUILT FOR THE ROAD
- Works on iPhone and iPad
- Keeps working without signal and syncs when you are back online
- Truck parking address with estimated deadhead miles
- Reading paperwork with AI can be turned off at any time in Settings
- Delete your account and all data from Settings

Questions or ideas? Write to support@zurixbank.com or use Send feedback in Settings.

name: Аксеум
description:
«Аксеум» — магазин запчастей для ремонта телефонов, планшетов, ноутбуков и смарт-часов. Магазины в Томске, Кемерове и Новокузнецке, доставка по всей России.
